50394.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21089.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

62651.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set on Tide Island, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Shore or the Voice of Nature: Ocean. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62651.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Tidal Island≫,
you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Shore≫ or
≪Voice of Nature: Ocean≫.
We wish you an even richer
life of hunting.
62651.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪潮島≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・磯辺≫や
≪大自然の声・海原≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

50899.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50899.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50899.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50899.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

61758.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
61758.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
61758.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

53216.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐

63181.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63181.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63181.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

60302.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
60302.description: I saw Tigrex in the snowy mountains, land of bitter cold! Showing itself even in the snowy mountains, it seems that for that one, as long as there is prey, it does not care what kind of place it is.
60302.descriptionEn:
I saw the "Tigrex" in the freezing
Snowy Mountains!
Showing up as far as the snowy
peaks... As long as there's prey,
it doesn't seem to care what kind
of place it's in.
60302.descriptionJp:
極寒の地、雪山で≪轟竜≫
ティガレックスを見たんだ！
雪山にまで姿を現すなんて、
アイツにとっては獲物さえい
れば、そこがどんな場所だろ
うと関係ないみたいだな。

55586.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55586.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55586.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

21357.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Volcano, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Crater, the Voice of Nature: Heat Haze, or the Voice of Nature: Wasteland. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21357.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Volcano≫,
you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Crater≫,
≪Voice of Nature: Heat Haze≫,
or ≪Voice of Nature: Wasteland≫.
We wish you an even richer
life of hunting.
21357.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪火山≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・火口≫や
≪大自然の声・陽炎≫、
≪大自然の声・荒野≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

62960.description: When I traveled through a certain region, I heard an old tale in which a woman named Princess Sasa plays an active part. Moved by that story, I decided to recreate the one-handed sword from the legend using Dragon Tears. What do you think? Won't you help me?
62960.descriptionEn:
While traveling through a certain
region, I heard an old tale about
a woman named Princess Sasa.
Moved by that story, I decided to
use ≪Dragon Tears≫ to recreate
the Sword and Shield that
appears in the legend.
What do you say? Would you lend
me your help as well?
62960.descriptionJp:
ある地方を旅した時に、
ササ姫という女性が活躍する
昔話を聞いたんだ。
その物語に心を打たれた僕は、
≪竜のナミダ≫を使って、
伝説に登場する片手剣を
再現してみることにしたのさ。
どうだろう。君たちにも
協力してもらえないだろうか。

55885.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
55885.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55885.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55885.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

50593.description: Lately Great Thunderbugs have been swarming in the sea of trees. At this rate the Mezepor Expedition cannot push into the interior. What? You want to help the expedition? Then hurry and hunt the bugs! As a reward I will give production and upgrade materials for an exceptionally cool bow!
50593.descriptionEn:
Great Thunderbugs have been
swarming badly in the Great
Forest lately. At this rate the
Mezepol expedition cannot reach
the interior. What? You want to
help them? Then hurry and hunt
those bugs! As a reward I will
give you crafting and upgrade
materials for a seriously cool Bow!
50593.descriptionJp:
最近、樹海の中に大雷光虫が
大発生している。これでは、
メゼポル探検隊が奥地へ
踏み込めない。なに？探検隊
の手助けをしたいって？なら
急いで虫どもを狩ってくれ！
報酬に、とびっきりクールな
弓の生産素材と強化素材を
贈ろう！

26739.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
26739.description: The other day, while gathering in the Forest and Hills, I was set upon by 2 Rathalos. I escaped with my life, but I cannot leave that place to them as their territory. Will you not rid us of them? For your trouble, take this Sturdy Jawbone.
26739.descriptionEn:
The other day, while gathering in
the Forest and Hills, two
≪Rathalos≫ attacked me.
I somehow kept my life, but I
cannot leave the Forest and Hills
to those beasts' territory.
Won't you rid us of them?
In thanks, I'll give you this
≪Sturdy Jawbone≫.
26739.descriptionJp:
先日森丘で採取をしていたら、
２頭の≪リオレウス≫に襲わ
れたのだ。わしはなんとか一
命を取り留めたが、いまやそ
いつらの縄張りと化している
森丘をこのまま放っておくこ
とはできぬ。そいつらを退治
してくれないか？お礼に、こ
の≪頑丈な顎骨≫をやろう。

61131.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61131.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61131.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

61119.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61119.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61119.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

53031.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の狩猟
53031.description: It seems you now understand the feelings of both yourself and your Palico. Then, for the finale, go and hunt a monster together with your Palico! Fighting alongside a partner whose feelings you understand will make the two of you stronger.
53031.descriptionEn:
It seems you have come to
understand the feelings of both
yourself and your Felyne comrade.
Now, for the last task, go and
hunt a monster together with
your Felyne comrade!
Fight alongside a partner you
understand, and those two powers
will become all the stronger.
53031.descriptionJp:
自身とパートニャー二つの
気持ちを理解できたよう
だな。では、最後に諸君と
パートニャーで力を合わせて
モンスターを狩猟してくるの
だ！気持ちを理解できた
相棒と協力して戦えば、
その二つの力はより強力な
ものになるだろう。

54540.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
54540.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54540.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54540.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

50513.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟

60640.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Rajang. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60640.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill! Today
the target is the ≪Rajang≫!
To hunt a monster all on your
own — truly admirable spirit!
Overcome yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!
This time it is held for Origin
Species weapons only!
60640.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ラージャン≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は始種武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

54453.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
54453.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Lavasioth, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54453.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
G Rank Guild Priority requests,
we have prepared this quest to
promote them and raise their
profile.
Break the head of Volganos,
and we will grant you a
special ingredient as well.
54453.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
溶岩竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

21648.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
21648.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
21648.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

26350.objectiveJp:
マストオーダー記載モンスター
全ての狩猟
26350.objectiveEn:
Hunt all monsters listed in the
Must-Order

62969.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
62969.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62969.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62969.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

54831.description: That gliding as if sliding through the air, the blizzard from its mouth... No doubt about it! It's him! A Barioth has appeared in the polar sea! I want it hunted before the damage grows! Don't neglect your cold protection!
54831.descriptionEn:
That gliding as if it slid through
the air, the blizzard from its
mouth... No doubt! It's him!
An Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth,
has shown up in the Polar Sea!
Hunt it before the damage grows!
Don't neglect your ice protection!
54831.descriptionJp:
あの宙をすべるような滑空、
口から出るブリザード・・・。
間違いない！ヤツだ！極海に
氷牙竜・ベリオロスが
現れやがった！被害が大きく
なる前に狩猟を頼みたい！
氷への対策を怠るなよ！

53087.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
53087.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!
53087.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のゼニーが入手できる上
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

21932.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21932.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Indigo Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21932.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Indigo Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21932.descriptionJp:
青黛原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

51062.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
51062.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wing claws of a Pink Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
51062.descriptionEn:
We have prepared this quest
to further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
carrying out.
By breaking the Pink Rathian's
wing claws, special ingredients
will also be awarded to you.
51062.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
桜火竜の翼爪を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

60664.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
60664.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60664.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill! Today
the target is a Unique Individual
≪Hypnocatrice (Breeding Season)≫!
To hunt a monster all on your
own — truly admirable spirit!
Overcome yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!
This time it is held for Supremacy
weapons only!
60664.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
特異個体の
≪ヒプノック繁殖期≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

55464.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
55464.description: Hey there, hunter. Do you like counterattacks? I love them. A monster fighting back sets my heart racing. This time I want to see a Shogun Ceanataur's counterattack. Slay it within 20 minutes and I will pay a large bounty, so do your best.
55464.descriptionEn:
Heeey, hunter. Do you like
Counterattacks~? I looove them.
A monster burning for a
counterattack just thrills me.
This time I want to see the
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ counter.
Slay it within 20 minutes and
I'll pay a hefty bounty, so
do your best~.
55464.descriptionJp:
ねぇ〜ハンターさん。逆襲は
お好きかしらぁ？
私はだぁいすきよぉ。
逆襲に燃える姿にそそられる
わぁ。今回は≪鎌蟹≫の逆襲
する姿が見たいの。２０分以
内に討伐してくれたら、
多額の報奨金をあげるから
がんばってねぇ。

61188.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

21616.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Iris Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21616.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Iris Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21616.descriptionJp:
菖蒲原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

23458.description: This quest yields the following materials. Tonfa Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Tonfa Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Tonfa Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23458.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Tonfa Cord: First≫ x100
≪Tonfa Cord: Middle≫ x165
≪Tonfa Cord: Extreme≫ x165
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
23458.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪穿龍棍綬・序≫１００個
≪穿龍棍綬・中≫１６５個
≪穿龍棍綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

26024.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

62865.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62865.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!
62865.descriptionJp:
狩人たちの祭典、狩人祭！
魂を集めて勝利を掴み取れ！
今回紹介するこの依頼は、
シリーズクエスト専用だ！
シナリオを最後まで進めて、
大量の魂をゲットしよう！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

21679.objectiveJp: 溶岩竜の上鱗３個の納品
21679.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Lavasioth's Fine Scale you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
21679.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon, but
I'm short on materials! At this
rate I can't go hunting.
Trade me the ≪Volganos Scale+≫
you have for this ≪Paw Pad
Medal≫! Please!
21679.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいが素材が足
りない！これでは狩りに出ら
れない。キミが持っている
≪溶岩竜の上鱗≫を、この
≪肉球のメダル≫と交換して
くれ！頼む！

21696.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
21696.description: There is a report that Shen Gaoren has invaded the Fortress. All hunters, head out to intercept at once. You may freely use the fortress's interception equipment. Make the most of it and drive the creature back.
21696.descriptionEn:
We have reports that the
Fortress Crab Shen Gaoren
is invading the ≪Fortress≫.
All hunters, head out to
intercept at once. You may
freely use the fortress
defenses. Make full use of
them and drive it back.
21696.descriptionJp:
≪砦≫に砦蟹シェンガオレン
が侵攻してきたと報告があり
ました。ハンターの皆さんは
直ちに迎撃に向かってくださ
い。砦の迎撃設備は自由に
使用しても問題ありません。
最大限に活用してこれを迎撃
してください。

62139.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62139.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62139.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

50946.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50946.description: Kushala Daora seems to be running wild in the Flower Field. It will be dangerous, but please investigate it somehow. The reward is precious decoration material.
50946.descriptionEn:
Kushala Daora seems to be
rampaging in the Flower Field.
I know it is dangerous, but
please see the survey through.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50946.descriptionJp:
花畑でクシャルダオラが
暴れているようです。
危険かとは思いますが、
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50683.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50683.description: This quest raises your standing as a hunter by a wide margin. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50683.descriptionEn:
This quest will raise your
standing as a hunter by a
remarkable margin.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫
is required.
Should you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
50683.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、ハンターと
しての評価が格段に上昇する
クエストです。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

51106.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
51106.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Savage Wyvern will also grant a special ingredient.
51106.descriptionEn:
We have prepared this quest
to further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
carrying out.
By breaking the Taikun Zamuza's
head, special ingredients will
also be awarded to you.
51106.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
蛮竜の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

60009.objectiveJp: イャンクック６頭の狩猟
60009.description: A great outbreak of the bird wyvern Yian Kut-Ku has been reported in the Jungle! Hunt them and more keep coming, their cries echoing through the Jungle! Reverse this situation, which amounts to a counterattack on hunters, and take the Jungle back from the bird wyverns!
60009.descriptionEn:
A great outbreak of the Yian
Kut-Ku has been reported in the
Jungle! Hunt them and still more
of their cries echo through the
woods! Turn this around, this
counterattack on hunters, and
take the Jungle back from them!
60009.descriptionJp:
密林にて怪鳥イャンクックの
大繁殖が報告されました！
狩っても狩っても次々と密林
にこだまする怪鳥たちのいな
なき！狩人への逆襲ともいえ
るこの状況をくつがえし、怪
鳥たちから密林を取り戻せ！

50501.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50501.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rukodiora. I am counting on you!
50501.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
upgrade materials as pay?
It's an easy job — just run
over and slay a Rukodiora
for me. That's all.
I'm counting on you!
50501.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の強化素材一式で
どうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってルコディオラを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

50107.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50107.description: Do you have enough zenny? In this job, you can earn materials that sell for a high price. The job is also reputed to be relatively easy. However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
50107.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough Zenny?
With the request we present today,
you can earn materials that sell
for a high price as your reward.
Word is that the request itself
is also fairly easy to complete.
However, you cannot accept it
several times in a row,
so please be careful.
50107.descriptionJp:
ゼニーは足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
高額で売却できる素材を報酬
として獲得できますよ。
依頼内容も、比較的楽に
達成できると評判です。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

21234.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
21234.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21234.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21234.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

21095.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟

50287.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
50287.description: An especially sturdy Doragyurosu has been sighted. Rumor says rare materials can be obtained from its tail. To confirm the truth, be sure to cut the tail before you slay it.
50287.descriptionEn:
Especially tough ≪Nether
Thunder Dragon≫ specimens
have been sighted.
Rumor says rare materials
can be obtained from its
tail. To confirm the truth,
be sure to sever the tail
before you finish the hunt.
50287.descriptionJp:
≪冥雷竜≫の中でも特に強靭
な個体が目撃されました。
噂ですが、尻尾から希少な
素材が入手できるのでは
ないかと言われています。
真相を確かめるため、必ず
尻尾を切断してから狩猟する
ようにしてください。

61739.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

21227.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21227.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21227.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

50711.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
50711.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
requests we have long been running,
we have prepared this quest in
order to raise awareness and
interest in them.
By breaking the Gravios's chest,
special ingredients will also be
granted to you as a reward.
50711.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鎧竜の胸部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

54556.description: Hey, you there. Help me out. I was spending an elegant night in the desert as usual when a Pink Rathian showed up. My lovely night is ruined. Please deal with it.
54556.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there. Won't you help
me out? I was passing an elegant
night in the Desert as usual,
when that Pink Rathian showed
up and ruined it.
At this rate my lovely night is
in ruins. Please, just get rid
of that thing for me.
54556.descriptionJp:
ちょっと、そこのキミ。助け
てくれないか。いつものよう
に砂漠で優雅な夜を過ごして
いたら、桜火竜のやつがやっ
てきやがったんだ。
このままじゃ、ボクの素敵な
夜がめちゃくちゃだ。どうか
アイツをやっつけてくれ。

54727.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54727.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54727.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23278.description: After searching the Guild's documents from one end to the other, we learned the new monster in the swamp is the Blood Drinker Dragon, Baruragaru. Now there are reports of a sighting in the desert, avoiding the hot sand and hiding in dim caves. We ask for another investigation!
23278.descriptionEn:
After combing through every
document in the Guild, we learned
that the new monster appearing
in the Swamp is the ≪Blood-eating
Wyvern≫, Baruragaru.
And now there is a report of a
sighting in the Desert: it avoids
the burning sand and lurks in
dim caves, they say.
We ask you to investigate once again!
23278.descriptionJp:
ギルドにある文書を片っ端
から調べた結果、沼地に出現
した新たなモンスターは
≪喰血竜≫バルラガルである
ことがわかった。
そして、今度は砂漠で目撃し
たという報告があり、熱砂を
避け、薄暗い洞窟に潜んでい
るそうだ。
再び、調査をお願いしたい！

55215.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55215.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55215.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62389.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐
62389.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained from carving or from the clear reward.
62389.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained from carving
or from the clear reward.
62389.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選クエスト
です。モンスターの剥ぎ取り
とクリア報酬で対象
モンスターの素材は入手
できません。

60559.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Kirin. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60559.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill! Today
the target is the ≪Kirin≫!
You will achieve the goal
together with your guildmates.
This contest is won on team-
work, so claim a place in the
top ranks!
Also, this time Origin Species
weapons only! Choose carefully!
60559.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪キリン≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

62825.description: The climax at last! This is a recreation of the scene where Akaneko and the Golden Fish join forces to take on the villainous boss, the Black Monkey! Please equip Vis Rondo and the Akaneko Outfit Mask. I look forward to the hunter's fine performance!
62825.descriptionEn:
At last, the climax!
This is a re-enactment of the
scene where Akane-ko and the
Golden Fish join forces to face
the Black Monkey, boss of evil!
Please equip ≪Vis Rondo≫ and
the ≪Akane-ko Outfit Mask≫.
We are counting on your finest
acting, hunter!
62825.descriptionJp:
いよいよクライマックス！
あかねこと黄金魚が協力し、
悪の親玉である黒猿に
挑むシーンの再現です！
≪ヴィス・ロンド≫と
≪あかねこ服マスク≫を
装備しておいてくださいね。
ハンターさんの名演技に
期待しています！

55508.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
55508.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields Heavenly Revolving Dragon materials. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55508.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival, we have prepared a
quest that yields
≪Shagaru Magala Materials≫.
Bring ≪Festival Fervor≫ to join.
55508.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に≪天廻龍素
材≫を獲得できるクエストを
用意させていただきました。
受注、参加時に、≪祭典の
熱気≫をお持ちください。

26583.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 600! Deliver the Map by yourself, clear the quest, and take your reward!
26583.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 600!
Deliver the ≪Map≫ by yourself,
clear the quest, and take your
reward!
26583.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ６００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

55431.description: The Variant Species Midogaron has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55431.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps rampaging.
Left as it is, this is very dangerous.
Please prepare thoroughly and
carry out the survey.
55431.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ミドガロン≫は猛
烈な強さとなり、暴れ続けて
います。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

61438.description: Materials for a horn flute? Horned wyverns are the standard, but the same sort of thing can be made from what that carapace species wears. It seems to be in the jungle now, so if you capture it, I will give you a horn flute. Only, it apparently keeps company with a fish wyvern. I have had my leg taken by those before too. Be careful.
61438.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Horn? Diablos is
the usual source, but you can
make the same thing from what
that Carapaceon wears. It is in
the Jungle right now, so capture
it and I will give you a Horn.
Only, it seems to be with a
Plesioth. Those things have taken
a leg of mine before. Watch out.
61438.descriptionJp:
角笛の材料？角竜が基本だが、
あの甲殻種が被っているやつ
でも同じような物が作れるん
だ。いま密林にいるらしい
から、捕獲してくれば角笛を
やってもいいぞ。ただ、どう
も魚竜と一緒にいるらしい。
俺もあいつらに脚をやられた
ことがあるんだ。気をつけろ。

62864.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
62864.description: The final quest at last! Pay the Hazily Glowing Coin you earned as a series quest reward to join! Clear this quest and you can obtain a great many souls! You decide how this nail-biting contest ends!
62864.descriptionEn:
Here it is, the final quest!
Pay the ≪Dimly Glowing Coin≫
you obtained as a reward from
the series quests to join!
Clear this quest and you will
earn a huge amount of souls!
The one who decides the outcome
of this nail-biting contest is
you!
62864.descriptionJp:
いよいよ最後のクエストだ！
シリーズクエストの
報酬として手に入れた
≪朧に光るコイン≫を
支払って参加してほしい！
このクエストをクリアすれば、
魂を大量に獲得できるぞ！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

63262.description: S-something terrible has happened! While surveying the swamp as usual, I found a pack of Khezu Variants lurking! I cannot survey like this, so would you hunt them for me? I will pay an exceptional reward.
63262.descriptionEn:
S-something terrible happened!
I was surveying the Swamp as
usual when a pack of
≪Khezu Rare Species≫ was
lurking there!
I cannot survey like this, so
would you hunt them for me?
I will pay an exceptional reward.
63262.descriptionJp:
た、大変なことが起こったわ！
いつものように沼地を調査
していたら≪フルフル奇種≫
が群れを成して潜んでいたの！
これじゃ調査できないから、
あなた狩ってきてくれない
かしら？
お礼に破格の報酬を出すわよ。

62490.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１０匹の討伐

21651.description: There is a report that 2 unidentified fanged beasts are on a rampage in the Canyon. Information is still scarce, and apart from being red and blue nothing is known. There is no doubt from the report that they are extremely powerful individuals. Prepare fully before heading there.
21651.descriptionEn:
We have a report that two
unidentified Fanged Beasts are
rampaging in the Canyon.
Information is still scarce, and
beyond their being red and blue
nothing is known.
From the reports, there is no
doubt they are extremely strong.
Prepare fully before heading out.
21651.descriptionJp:
峡谷で未確認の２頭の牙獣種
が暴れているとの報告があり
ました。まだ情報も少なく、
赤と青ということ以外、
分かっていません。
報告から極めて強力な個体で
あることは間違いありません。
万全の準備を整えてから
現地へ向かってください。

23257.description: Hyujikiki, also called the Needle-Clad Wyvern, has a very agile and aggressive nature. It attacks everything that passes near and has caused much damage. To deal with it, we must first learn its ecology in detail. We ask for your help with the survey.
23257.descriptionEn:
Hyujikiki, also called the
Needle Coiled Wyvern, is highly
agile and aggressive in nature.
It lunges at everything that
passes nearby, causing a great
deal of damage. To deal with it,
we must first learn its ecology
in detail.
We ask for your help in the survey.
23257.descriptionJp:
針纏竜とも呼ばれる
ヒュジキキは、非常に俊敏で
攻撃的な性格をしています。
近くを通るもの全てに襲いか
かり、多くの被害を出してい
ます。対処するためには、
まず詳しく生態を知る
必要があります。
調査に協力をお願いします。

63303.description: Clear this quest once a day and you'll get lots of Hunter Festival souls, meow. Clear it every day without fail and by the time the Soul-Pouring Festival ends you should have quite a pile, meow. You should tell all your Guild members too, meow.
63303.descriptionEn:
Clear this quest once a day and
you'll get lots of Hunter Festival
souls, meow. Clear it every day
without fail and by the time the
Soul-Pouring Festival ends you
should have quite a pile, meow.
You should tell all your Guild
members too, meow.
63303.descriptionJp:
１日１回このクエストをクリ
アすれば、狩人祭の魂がたく
さん手に入るニャン。毎日欠
かさずクリアすれば、入魂祭
が終わるころには結構な数に
なっているはずニャン。猟団
員のみんなにも教えてあげる
といいニャン。

62776.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62776.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62776.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

58037.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58037.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58037.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58037.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60216.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! 2 Hypnocatrice, the Sleep Bird dressed in beautiful plumage, have been set loose! Step into the arena and you will surely be drawn into a deep sleep! Overcome that temptation and hunt them well!
60216.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
off their skill! Two ≪Hypnocatrice≫,
clad in beautiful plumage, have
been set loose!
Step into the Arena and you will
surely be lured into deep sleep!
Overcome that temptation and
hunt them in style!
60216.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！美しき羽毛を身に
まとう≪眠鳥≫ヒプノックを
２頭、解き放ったぞ！
闘技場に足を踏み入れれば、
深い眠りに誘われること間違
いナシ！この誘惑に打ち勝ち
見事狩猟してみよ！

61513.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61513.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61513.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

26492.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
26492.description: The Shogun Ceanataur apparently uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling! In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too! Beware the sharp claws of each and every one!
26492.descriptionEn:
The sickle crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
uses its bizarre leg joints to
climb all the way to the
ceiling!
In this season's Volcano, many
young ≪Gamizami≫ should be about!
Watch out for their sharp claws!
26492.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登るらしいです！
この季節の火山では、子供た
ち≪ガミザミ≫も数多く生息
してるハズです！それぞれの
鋭い爪には要注意ですよ！

55991.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

50804.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50804.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50804.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

62363.objectiveJp: チャチャブー３０匹の討伐
62363.description: I got hold of something interesting lately, but work keeps me too busy to try it. I will lend it to you, so swing it around in the Forest and tell me what you think.
62363.descriptionEn:
I got my paws on something
interesting the other day, meow.
But work is busy and I can't
try it out, meow. I'll lend it to
you, so give it a swing in the
Great Forest and tell me, meow.
62363.descriptionJp:
この間面白いものを手に入れ
たニャ。でも仕事が忙しくて
なかなか試せないニャ。
これを貸すから、ちょっと樹
海で振り回してきて、感想を
教えてほしいニャ。

55647.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55647.description: The Variant Species Gasurabazura has appeared once more. Its arms have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55647.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gasurabazura≫
has appeared once more.
Its arms have grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
still more power. Please take
great care in your survey.
55647.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ガスラバズラ≫
が再び現れました。
腕はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

56143.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
56143.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period that allow you to craft armor from past festivals. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56143.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special request
and rewards that let you craft
past Hunter Festival armor.
When accepting or joining,
please bring ≪Festival Fervor≫.
56143.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に過去の
狩人祭防具を生産できる
特別依頼と報酬を用意させ
て頂きました。受注、参加
時に≪祭典の熱気≫を
お持ちください。

50037.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50037.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of zenny and Supremacy Tickets! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
50037.descriptionEn:
An urgent notice to all hunters!
On top of the training method
for gaining experience fast, you
can now get piles of Zenny and
Hardcore Tickets!
You cannot take it back to back,
but a single run's effect is
enormous!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!
50037.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法に加え、今なら
大量のゼニーと剛種チケット
が入手できます！
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

26351.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての狩猟
26351.description: A request for hunters who have come into their own only. Many bird wyverns are running wild in the Grand Arena! At the center of it seem to be Variant Iodrome and Variant Velocidrome. To calm things, hunt both of them.
26351.descriptionEn:
This request is for master
hunters only.
Many Bird Wyverns are on a
rampage in the Great Arena!
The ringleaders seem to be
Gendrome and Velocidrome
variants. To calm things down,
hunt both of them.
26351.descriptionJp:
凄腕のハンターさん限定の
依頼です。
大闘技場で多くの鳥竜種が
暴れています！
中心はどうやらドスイーオス
とドスランポスの変種のよう
です。沈静化のため、両方と
も狩猟してきてください。

55038.description: Hypnocatrice and Velociprey appeared during the survey of the sea of trees! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. To hunters who complete the request, we will give production materials for the weapon series Stout Steel Crushed, and G-rank Guard Special Jewel and G-rank Guard Pain Jewel.
55038.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and Velociprey
appeared during the Great
Forest survey! We cannot
complete the survey like this.
Hunters who clear the request
will receive crafting materials
for the "Crush the Sturdy Steel"
weapon series, plus the "G Rank
Guard Special Orb" and "Guard Pain Orb".
55038.descriptionJp:
樹海の調査途中にヒプノック
とランポスが現れました！こ
のままでは調査が完了できま
せん。
依頼を達成して下さったハン
ターさんには、武器「屈強ナ
鋼ヲ粉砕ス」シリーズの生産
素材や「Ｇ級・護特珠」「Ｇ
級・護痛珠」をお渡しします。

22085.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ５ and above.
22085.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass found in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain
regions of the land, we offer
our guidance only to those of
HR5 or above.
22085.descriptionJp:
近年発見されたセンショク草
は、自然を熟知した熟練者で
なければ真贋を見極めること
ができない、レアな一品です。
特定の地域でのみ見られる草
なので、ＨＲ５以上の方に
限ってご案内させていただ
いております。

55184.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
55184.description: Slaying a Yian Kut-Ku raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55184.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Yian Kut-Ku raises your
standing while also netting you
the materials needed to obtain
G Rank decorations, all at a
good value.
Please make the most of it.
55184.descriptionJp:
イャンクックを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

63360.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
63360.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63360.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63360.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

62015.description: I heard a rumor that rare materials can be found in the volcano, so I went to see for myself, and no, not a chance, you must be joking! What happened? There was a Rajang, and it was plainly no ordinary Rajang. What do you mean, what was wrong with it? If you are that curious, go and see for yourself!
62015.descriptionEn:
I heard a rumor that rare
materials can be mined in the
Volcano, so I went, but no way,
not a joke!
What happened, you ask? There's
a ≪Rajang≫ there, and it sure
didn't look like any plain Golden
Lion. What do you mean, what?
If you're that curious, go see!
62015.descriptionJp:
火山で珍しい素材が取れるっ
て噂を聞いて、行ってみたん
だが、ありゃあ無理だ、冗談
じゃないよ！ん、何があった
かって？≪ラージャン≫が
いて、しかも、どう見ても
ただの金獅子じゃないんだよ。
何がって？そんなに気になる
なら、自分で見てきなよ！

26263.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26263.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26263.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26263.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55716.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55716.description: Please help with research on the customs of Eastern regions! I want you to find the ingredients for what our documents describe as chimaki. I heard from a dubious source that it is at the top of the sea of trees, so search there!
55716.descriptionEn:
Please help with our research on
the customs of the eastern
regions! I want you to find the
materials for what our records
describe as "chimaki".
A dubious informant says it is
at the Top of Great Forest, so
go and look for it!
55716.descriptionJp:
東方地域の風習に関する研究
のお手伝いをお願いします！
こちらの資料に「ちまき」と
説明されているものの材料を
探してきてほしいのです。
怪しい情報筋から樹海頂部に
あるという噂を聞いたので探
してみてください！

61107.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61107.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61107.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

17.description: It is I, the Instructor! If you are attacked while carrying an egg, the egg will break. Use {K073}{K080}{K068}{K069} to move your view and keep watch around you! And if your stamina runs out you will drop it too!
17.descriptionEn:
It is I. The Instructor!
If you are attacked while
carrying an egg, the egg will
break. Use {K073}{K080}{K068}{K069} to move
your view and keep watch around!
And if your stamina runs out
you will drop it, so beware!
17.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
卵を持っているときに攻撃を
受けると、卵は割れてしまう
のだ。{K073}{K080}{K068}{K069}を使って視点
を動かし、周囲に気を配れ！
さらに、スタミナが切れても
落っことしてしまうからな！

63165.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63165.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63165.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54538.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
54538.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54538.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54538.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

60529.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
60529.description: In the breeding season, the Hypnocatrice's coat supposedly turns a vivid blue. Now is your chance to behold it. Hurry, or someone else will beat you to it!
60529.descriptionEn:
In the ≪Breeding Season≫
the Hypnocatrice's coat
turns a vivid blue, they say.
Now is your chance to see
it. Move fast or the others
will beat you to it!
60529.descriptionJp:
≪繁殖期≫の眠鳥は、その体
毛が鮮やかな蒼色へ変化する
らしい。
その姿を拝めるのは今がチャ
ンスだ。早くしないと他のや
つらに先越されちまうぜ？

54321.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐

63014.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63014.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63014.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
63014.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26189.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
26189.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26189.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26189.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

1087.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト２匹の納品
1087.description: Find and deliver 5 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! In this breeding season there are more herbivore monsters, so delivering Raw Meat is easy too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
1087.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 5 of the special
mushrooms that grow in the Jungle!
This breeding season there are
plenty of herbivores about, so
delivering ≪Raw Meat≫ is easy too!
Start by getting to know the
Jungle and getting used to it.
1087.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を５つ探して納品してくれ！
この繁殖期は草食タイプの
モンスターが多くなるから、
≪生肉≫の納品も簡単だぜ！
まずは密林を知り、密林に
慣れることから始めるといい。

26027.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
26027.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26027.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26027.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

26152.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟

26665.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26665.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Rathian Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26665.descriptionEn:
This hunting skill quest is for
the slaying of a
≪Rathian Variant≫.
Why not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!
26665.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪リオレイア変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

63398.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
63398.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Odibatorasu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63398.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We are seeking someone to
eliminate an extremely powerful
≪Odibatorasu≫.
If you manage to slay it, we
shall issue more slaying
certificates than usual!
63398.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪オディバトラス≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に討伐
できましたら、普段よりも
多めの討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

60710.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
60710.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60710.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
60710.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60710.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55945.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55945.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55945.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

1014.description: Rathian's other name is the Queen of the Land. That title is no lie: many a hunter has bowed before her. Hunt a Rathian and it means you stand on your own as a hunter. Now, your turn!
1014.descriptionEn:
≪Rathian≫ is also known as
the Queen of the Land. That
name is no lie; many hunters
have bowed before her.
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means you stand on your own.
Now it's your turn!
1014.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫の別名は陸の
女王。その異名は決してウソ
じゃなく、何人もの狩人が
彼女の前に屈してるほどだ。
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたら
それは狩人として独り立ちを
意味する。さぁ君の番だぜ！

61523.objectiveJp: エールナッツ５０個の納品
61523.description: Are you gathering today as well? You do not need tools, but you do want to mind your equipment. Now then, a new gathering request. Hmm, it may be a little tough this time too, but do your best. Of course I will give you a reward.
61523.descriptionEn:
Are you gathering today as well?
Since you don't need tools, you
want to be careful with equipment.
Now then, a new gathering request.
Hmm, this one may be a bit hard
again, but please do your best.
Of course, I will hand over your
reward.
61523.descriptionJp:
今日も採取をしていますか？
道具を必要としない代わりに、
装備に気を使いたいですよね。
さて、新しい採取の依頼です。
んー、今回も少し大変かも
しれませんが頑張ってくださ
いね。もちろん報酬はお渡し
しますから。

61704.objectiveJp: ハンターシール赤１枚の納品
61704.description: Lately the artisan at the arms workshop seems to have developed a way to refine and reuse the iron scraps left after working Black Star Iron. If you bring Hunter Seals (Red) and Hunter Seals (Blue) to the volcano, he will give you a share!
61704.descriptionEn:
Apparently a smith at the Smithy
recently developed a way to refine
and reuse the iron scraps left
after working Black Star Iron.
If you bring ≪Hunter Seal Red≫
and ≪Hunter Seal Blue≫ to the
Volcano, they'll trade with you,
or so the word goes!
61704.descriptionJp:
最近、武具工房の職人が黒星
鉄を加工した後に残る鉄くず
を精製し、再利用する方法を
開発したらしい。
≪ハンターシール赤≫と
≪ハンターシール青≫を火山
まで持ってきたら分けてくれ
るらしいぞ！

26584.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 700! Deliver the Map by yourself, clear the quest, and take your reward!
26584.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 700!
Deliver the ≪Map≫ by yourself,
clear the quest, and take your
reward!
26584.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ７００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

50753.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50753.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50753.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50753.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

51119.objectiveJp:
撃退できずにタイムアップ
報酬金ゼロ　拠点の耐久値ゼロ
51119.description: I love Raviente. Its sharp, tough scales fill me with longing, but my companions do not understand. They go so far as to say the shell of the fortress crab is tougher. Wear the armor I have prepared and repel Shen Gaoren. Show my companions how wonderful Raviente is!
51119.objectiveEn:
Time up without repelling
Zero reward money, zero Base durability
51119.descriptionEn:
I adore Laviente.
Its sharp, stout scales fill me
with longing, but my comrades
don't understand. They even say
things like the Shen Gaoren's
shell is tougher.
Wear the armor I have prepared
and drive off the Shen Gaoren.
Show my comrades Laviente's glory!
51119.descriptionJp:
私はラヴィエンテが大好きだ。
鋭く強靭な鱗には憧憬を覚え
るが、仲間は理解してくれん。
強靭さなら砦蟹の甲殻の方が
などと言い出す始末。
私が用意した防具を身に着け、
砦蟹を撃退して欲しい。
仲間たちにラヴィエンテの
素晴らしさを見せてくれ！

21948.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Espinas. I am counting on you!
21948.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
Word is you've hit HR31.
So I've got a favor to ask,
and the pay's a full set of
weapon materials.
Easy job, really—just run
out there and slay an Espinas
for me and we're square.
I'm counting on you!
21948.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってエスピナスを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

53184.description: A request for hunters who have crafted weapons of the Inity Series. Hunt Basarios and you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the High Rank weapon Ciprela Series.
53184.descriptionEn:
This request is for hunters who
have forged weapons of the
Inity Series.
Hunting a Basarios will get you
the materials needed to forge
and upgrade the High Rank
weapon line, the Siprela Series.
53184.descriptionJp:
「イニティシリーズ」の武器
を生産したハンター向けの
依頼です。
バサルモスを狩猟すると、
上位武器「シプレラシリーズ」
の生産・強化に必要な素材が
入手できます。

55351.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
55351.description: Can we overcome the white wind that blows sharp and wild? The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Galloping Nargacuga. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55351.descriptionEn:
Can we overcome the white wind
that blows so fiercely?
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Dashing Nargacuga'.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!
55351.descriptionJp:
鋭く吹き荒れる白い風に、
我々は打ち勝てるのか。
ギルドでは、光放つヤツを
「極み駆けるナルガクルガ」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

21414.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Your skill has already reached the realm of a master. So, shall I pass on to you a technique handed down from one generation to the next? The conditions are the delivery of a Fish Print [Large] and landing a Variant Plesioth with a single rod. I will be waiting!
21414.descriptionEn:
Fishing: a lonely hunt in
quiet communion with fish.
Your skill has already reached
the realm of a true master.
So I shall pass down to you
a secret art, heir to heir.
The terms: deliver a Fish
Print (Large) and one-cast a
Plesioth Variant. I await you!
21414.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。
その腕前はもはや名人の域に
達しているじゃろ。
そこで、ワシから一子相伝の
技を授けてやろうかの。
条件は、魚拓【大】の納品と
ガノトトス変種の一本釣り
じゃ。待ってるぞ！

21845.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21845.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21845.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21845.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

62034.objectiveJp: ハンターカード白１０枚納品
62034.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62034.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
62034.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

23419.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
23419.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Valsaburos, the Flame Horn Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23419.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Flame Horn
Wyvern ≪Varusaburosu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
23419.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、炎角竜
≪ヴァルサブロス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

62616.description: It's a custom handed down in a certain region. After the New Year, they play with a toy that slides across a board while spinning. I searched high and low to recreate it, and I found it! An individual with a fierce temper that excels at sliding and spinning! Its pattern is red and white, which is auspicious, so do hunt one!
62616.descriptionEn:
A custom from a certain region.
When the year turns, they play
with a toy that spins as it slides
across a board. I ran hither and
thither to recreate it, and I
found one!
A fierce-tempered individual that
spins as if gliding! Red and white
is auspicious, so do hunt it!
62616.descriptionJp:
ある地方に伝わる風習です。
年が明けたら、回転しながら
盤上を滑る玩具で遊ぶとか。
それを再現しようと東奔西走
したところ、発見しましたよ。
滑るように回るのが得意な
激しい気性の個体です！
模様は紅白で縁起が良いし、
ぜひ狩ってみてください！

63243.description: Mezeporuta is currently under attack by Conquest monsters, and further attacks are expected. The guild has therefore decided to give high recognition to hunters who bring down many Conquest monsters, to encourage them further. This is a grave situation, but do not miss this opportunity!
63243.descriptionEn:
Mezepolta is currently under
attack by Zenith monsters,
and the assaults are expected
to continue. The Guild has
thus decided to highly commend
hunters who slay many Zeniths,
to encourage them further.
It is a grave situation, but
do not let this chance slip by!
63243.descriptionJp:
現在メゼポルタは、覇種
モンスターの襲撃を受けてお
り、今後も続くと予想されま
す。そこでギルドでは、多く
の覇種を討ち取ったハンター
を高く評価することで更に励
んでもらおうと考えました。
大変な事態ではありますが、
この機会をお見逃しなく！

63282.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

54163.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54163.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54163.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

61541.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

50087.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
50087.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a recommended request! It is a request that lets you make armor that is stylish, just right for me, but I want you lot to have this stylish armor too! Now, all of you! Depart at once!
50087.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
I have prepared a fine request!
It lets you craft "stylish" armor
that suits me perfectly — and I
want you all to have this
"stylish" armor too!
Now, everyone! Depart at once!
50087.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
お勧めの依頼を用意したぞ！
我輩にピッタリな「お洒落」
な防具が作れる依頼なのだが、
諸君らもこの「お洒落」な
防具を手にしてもらいたい！
さぁ、諸君！今すぐ出発だ！

61710.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
61710.description: A wyvern newly discovered in the Snowy Mountains. We have decided to call it the Doragyurosu, and among this already powerful wyvern a particularly sturdy individual has been confirmed. It is a dangerous request and supplies cannot be sent, so only hunters who can prove their skill are asked to hunt it!
61710.descriptionEn:
A Flying Wyvern newly found in
the Snowy Mountains.
We have chosen to call it the
≪Nether Thunder Wyvern≫, but
even among this mighty species,
an especially robust individual
has been confirmed.
It is dangerous and no supplies
can be sent, so prove your skill!
61710.descriptionJp:
雪山で新たに発見された飛竜。
我々はこれを≪冥雷竜≫
と呼ぶこととしましたが、
ただでさえ強力なこの飛竜の
中でも特に強靭な個体が確認
されたようです。危険な依頼
で、支給品も送れませんが、
腕前の証明が出来るハンター
限定での狩猟をお願いします！

26738.description: Variant Gypceros and Variant Congalala seem to be on a rampage in the Jungle. The Guild has prepared a special emblem as a reward, so please hunt them at once.
26738.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, Variants of both
Gypceros and Congalala seem to
be on the rampage.
The Guild has prepared a special
emblem as a reward.
Please hunt them at once, and
without any delay.
26738.descriptionJp:
密林で、≪ゲリョス≫と
≪ババコンガ≫の変種が
暴れているようです。
ギルドから、特殊な
エンブレムが報酬として
用意されておりますので、
至急、狩猟をお願いします。

55521.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55521.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55521.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

21645.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの達成
21645.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or complete the sub-target

21879.description: A request for hunters who possess Zerureusu Tenran weapons. By repeatedly driving off the mysterious monster that appeared in the Old Tower, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Haku weapons.
21879.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ weapon of
the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly repelling the
mysterious monster in the
Ancient Tower, you obtain
≪Supremacy Weapon≫ material.
21879.descriptionJp:
≪輝界竜≫の≪天嵐武器≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
古塔に現れた謎のモンスター
を繰り返し撃退することで、
≪覇種武器≫の強化に必要な
素材が入手できます。

63216.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
63216.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63216.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63216.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

50391.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

50670.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Gakou (Elegance) and Gasen (Elegance) series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50670.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the crafting and upgrade
materials for one piece of the
≪Hardcore Armor≫ Gakou [Style]
/ Gasen [Style] series.
To accept this quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
50670.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
雅孔【趣】／雅穿【趣】
シリーズの１部位分の生産、
強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

11079.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト３匹の納品
11079.description: Find and deliver 6 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
11079.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 6 Special
Mushrooms that grow in the Jungle!
If you also deliver the ≪Royal Beetle≫,
the insect that sometimes flies
through the Jungle, I'll still pay!
Start by getting to know the Jungle,
then get used to it.
11079.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を６つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

50953.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50953.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50953.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

60607.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
60607.description: Deep in the Snowy Mountains, they say there is a season when white fanged beasts and golden fanged beasts gather. There is no firm record of it, so it is only a rumour among hunters, but is it not a stirring tale for a hardened hunter?
60607.descriptionEn:
Deep in the Snowy Mountains,
they say there is a season when
white fanged beasts and golden
fanged beasts gather.
No record of it has ever been
set down, so it is only hunters'
talk, but doesn't that stir the
heart of a seasoned hunter?
60607.descriptionJp:
雪山深く、白い牙獣と金の牙
獣が集う時期があると言われ
ているわ。
確かな記録として記されたこ
とはないので、飽くまでもハ
ンター達の噂でしかないけど、
筋金入りのハンターには心躍
る話じゃないかしら。

56147.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56147.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.
56147.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫
をお持ちください。

21603.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Crow Beak Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21603.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Crow Beak Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21603.descriptionJp:
鴉嘴原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

26593.objectiveJp: グークの思い出５個の納品

50822.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
50822.description: I want your help with an ecology survey to make a Urki plush. If a Urki is being attacked by another monster, save it! Also, to study its diet, could you bring me a Katabira Fish caught in the flower field? I look forward to your report!
50822.descriptionEn:
I want your help surveying the
ecology so I can make a Uruki
plushie. If a Uruki is being
attacked by another monster,
please save it! Also, to study
the Uruki's diet, could you bring
me Katabira Fish caught in the
Flower Field? I will be looking
forward to your report♪
50822.descriptionJp:
ウルキーのぬいぐるみを作る
ために、生態調査に協力して
ほしいの。もしウルキーが他
のモンスターに襲われていた
ら、助けてあげて！あとウル
キーの食生活を調べるために
花畑で釣れるカタビラウオを
持ってきてくれるかしら。報
告を楽しみにしてるわね♪

50387.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

54976.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
54976.description: Why did the Nargacuga, a swift wyvern never reported before, appear in the Swamp? To find the cause, we will carry out an ecological survey of the subject. It is dangerous, but for the sake of research, please hunt it after severing its tail.
54976.descriptionEn:
Why did the Nargacuga, a Swift
Wyvern never reported before,
appear in the Swamp?
To find the cause, we will survey
its ecology.
It is dangerous, but for the sake
of research, please sever its tail
and then hunt it.
54976.descriptionJp:
今まで報告がなかった迅竜・
ナルガクルガは何故沼地に
現れたのでしょうか？
原因を突き止めるため、対象
の生態調査を行います。
危険ではありますが、研究の
ため、尻尾切断後に狩猟を
お願いいたします。

54196.description: Please investigate the Congalala lurking in the swamp. If you not only hunt it but also splendidly break its head, I will add to the reward!
54196.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Congalala
lurking in the Swamp.
Not only hunt it —
break its head splendidly and I
will add a bonus to your
reward!
54196.descriptionJp:
沼地に潜む桃毛獣の調査を
お願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
桃毛獣の頭部を見事破壊して
くれたら、報酬を上乗せ
しちゃいますよ！

26093.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
26093.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26093.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26093.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

54602.description: Hunters who have only just reached G Rank. Lately there are many veterans, so we are thinking about training young G Rank hunters. We would like to see your skill, so would you slay Pokara in the Polar Sea? Show promise and I will give you a recommendation for Extreme Conquest.
54602.descriptionEn:
Hunters who have only just
reached G Rank. Lately there
are many veterans, so we are
thinking about training young
G Rank hunters. We would like
to see your skill, so would you
slay Pokara in the Polar Sea?
Show promise and I will give you
a recommendation for Extreme Conquest.
54602.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級に成り立てのハンターの
皆さん。最近、ベテランが多
いので、若手のＧ級ハンター
の育成を考えています。腕を
拝見したいので極海でポカラ
を討伐してみせてくれません
か？見込みがあれば、極征に
向けての推薦状を差し上げま
す。

62802.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62802.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62802.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62802.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

62896.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62896.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62896.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

60123.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟

11071.description: Slay the 8 blue hunters, Velociprey, that use the Jungle as their feeding ground! They are just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt!
11071.descriptionEn:
These blue hunters, ≪Velociprey≫,
treat the Jungle as their feeding
ground. Slay 8 of them!
They are just the right opponents
to measure a hunter's skill!
11071.descriptionJp:
密林をエサ場とする、
青き狩人≪ランポス≫８頭を
討伐してください！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手ですよ！

21040.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21040.description: Hunting Iodrome in the volcanic zone may be a little troublesome! A wounded Iodrome may flee into places where a hunter loses stamina fast. The trick is not to let it escape!
21040.descriptionEn:
Hunting ≪Gendrome≫ in the volcano
region may be a bit of a bother!
A Gendrome that has spent its
stamina may flee into nasty spots
that drain a hunter's own stamina!
The trick is not to let it escape!
21040.descriptionJp:
火山地帯で≪ドスイーオス≫
を狩猟するのは、少し面倒か
も知れないです！体力を消耗
したドスイーオスは、狩人が
体力を消耗する、嫌な場所に
逃げ込む可能性があります！
