逃さないのがコツですよ！

62159.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62159.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62159.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62159.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

61338.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61338.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61338.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

1083.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
1083.description: In the skies above the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, two Kings of the Sky dance. Challenging two kings in an unfamiliar land would be a hardship beyond imagination. Do not forget that only one Pitfall Trap or Shock Trap may be set!
1083.descriptionEn:
In the skies over the
≪Ancient Tower≫, the mysterious
unexplored land sleeping beyond
this place, two Kings of the Sky
dance. Facing two kings in an
unfamiliar land will be hardship
beyond imagining. Do not forget:
only one pitfall or Shock Trap may be set!
1083.descriptionJp:
この地の彼方に眠る、謎多き
未開の地≪古塔≫の大空に、
空の王が２頭、舞っておる。
慣れぬ地で２頭の王に挑むは
想像を絶する困難じゃろう。
落とし穴やシビレ罠が設置で
きるのは１つまでということ
を忘れるでないぞ！

21429.objectiveJp: キラビートル５０匹の納品
21429.description: There are all sorts of bugs in this world. Among them, I like Kira Beetles and collect lots of them. If you'll help too, bring me 50 at a time. Then I'll give you one Slash Hard Gem.
21429.descriptionEn:
There are all sorts of insects
in this world, you know.
Among them, I love the
≪Kira Beetle≫ and collect
heaps of them.
If you'll help me too, bring
them to me every 50 you
gather.
Then I'll give you one
≪Slash Hard Jade≫.
21429.descriptionJp:
この世界には様々な虫たちが
いるよね。
その中でも、私は≪キラビー
トル≫が好きでたくさん集め
てるの。
あなたも手伝ってくれるなら、
５０匹ごとに私のところに
持ってきて。
そしたら≪斬硬玉≫を１つあ
げるよ。

54753.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54753.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
54753.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
54753.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

1074.description: Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is an Elder Dragon said to be the incarnation of fire. In the volcano, every flame and every trace of heat is as good as fighting on her side. Do not waste thought on impossible things like capture; repel her again and again to wear down her strength, and slay her after a long battle.
1074.descriptionEn:
Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is
an Elder Dragon said to be the
very embodiment of flame.
In the Volcano, every flame and
heat may as well side with her.
Forget capture: repel her again
and again, then slay her after a long fight.
1074.descriptionJp:
炎妃龍ナナ・テスカトリは炎
の化身とも云われる古龍よ。
火山では全ての炎や熱が彼女
に味方しているに等しいわ。
捕獲など無理なことは考えず
撃退をくり返し体力を削り、
長期戦の末に討伐するのよ。

53107.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
53107.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Daimyo Hermitaur and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
53107.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ and
show us what you can do.
Clear the quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot right
up!
53107.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪盾蟹≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

21972.description: This quest yields the following materials. Switch Axe Soul (Beginning) x８５, Switch Axe Soul (Middle) x１９５, Switch Axe Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Switch Axe Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21972.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Switch Axe Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Switch Axe Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Switch Axe Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Switch Axe Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest,
a ≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
21972.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪剣斧魂・序≫８５枚
≪剣斧魂・中≫１９５枚
≪剣斧魂・極≫２７５枚
≪剣斧魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

56084.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
56084.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56084.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56084.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

62468.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62468.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
62468.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

21598.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
21598.description: Have you heard of the Cat Eye Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21598.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Cat's Eye Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21598.descriptionJp:
猫眼原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

54639.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
54639.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54639.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54639.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

21938.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
21938.description: You there! I hear you produced a Taikun Zamuza weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Taikun Zamuza. I am counting on you!
21938.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a weapon
from the Many-Shell Crab.
So I've got a favor to ask,
how about weapon upgrade mats?
Easy job, really—just run out
and slay a Taikun Zamuza
for me and that's all.
I'm counting on you!
21938.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
多殻蟹の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器の強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってタイクンザムザを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

61226.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
61226.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61226.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
61226.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

62210.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
62210.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62210.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.
62210.descriptionJp:
占いに使う石ころを集めてい
るのですが、モンスターに
襲われ、中々はかどりません。
そこでモンスター達を引きつ
けておいて欲しいんです。
たくさん集めることができた
ら報酬として差し上げますか
ら、どうかお願いします。

62884.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62884.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62884.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62884.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

54894.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
54894.description: We are continuing our survey of the Hypnocatrice Rare Species. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54894.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of the
Hypnocatrice Rare Species.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you did!
Hunters, please lend us your
aid!
54894.descriptionJp:
ヒプノック希少種の調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

60721.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60721.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60721.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60721.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50883.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
50883.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50883.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50883.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

55320.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55320.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55320.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

28076.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
28076.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Break the designated parts of a monster and slay it together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28076.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds between you all,
I have prepared a difficult request
for you. You are to break the
specified parts of a monster and slay it
together with your Guild companions.
No supply items will be provided at all,
so discuss it with your companions
beforehand and then depart.
Your reward shall be a special ore!
28076.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。モンスターの
指定部位の破壊と討伐を、
猟団の仲間と行うのだ。
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

26476.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Against the gluttonous Congalala, poisoned, sleeping and shock raw meat are all effective!
26476.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
For the gluttonous Congalala, poison, sleep and Shock Meat work
great!
26476.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
食いしん坊なババコンガには、毒、眠り、シビレ生肉が有効
ですよ！

50576.description: You there! I hear you produced a Rukodiora weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rukodiora. I am counting on you!
50576.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a weapon
from the Extreme Dragon.
So I've got a favor to ask,
how about weapon upgrade mats?
Easy job, really—
just run out there
and slay a Rukodiora
for me. I'm counting on you!
50576.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
極龍の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、
ひとっ走り行って
ルコディオラを討伐して
くれればいい。頼んだぜ！

55274.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55274.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55274.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

63034.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種２頭の狩猟
63034.description: A monster that looks different from the usual, extremely powerful and acting in ways normally unthinkable, appears to have shown up. An examiner for hunters holding the Secret Scroll is staying here now, so prove your ability, and if you catch his eye, you can be sure to be issued many Secret Proof [Prologue].
63034.descriptionEn:
A monster with a different
appearance, immense strength,
and behavior beyond anything
normal seems to have appeared.
Right now an examiner holding a
Secret Art scroll is staying here,
so prove your ability, and if you
meet his eye, he will reliably
issue you many
≪Secret Art Proof [Intro]≫.
63034.descriptionJp:
見た目が異なり、非常に
強力で通常では考えられない
行動を取るモンスターが
現れたようです。
今、秘伝書所持ハンターの
判定員が滞在しているため、
実力を証明し、彼の眼に
かなえば、多くの
≪秘伝の証【序】≫を確実
に発行してもらえますよ。

54093.description: What will guide us, who began with a small seed and have known harvest, abundance and prosperity, to yet greater heights is nothing other than the glory shown by hunters who have reached G-rank.
54093.descriptionEn:
We began as a small seed and have
known harvest, abundance and
prosperity. What will lead us to
even greater heights can only be
the glory shown by hunters who
have reached ≪G Rank≫.
54093.descriptionJp:
小さな種から始まり収穫、
豊穣、繁栄を経験した私たち
をさらなる高みへ導いて
くれるのは、≪Ｇ級≫へ到達
したハンターの皆さんが示す
栄華のほかにはないでしょう。

62503.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62503.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62503.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

50685.description: Vicious Variant Rathalos and Variant Rathian are in the Forest and Hills at night, and the merchants cannot make camp. At this rate goods cannot be moved and prices will surely soar. With your high skill you should be able to complete this request. I am counting on you!
50685.descriptionEn:
In the Forest and Hills at night
roam vicious
≪Rathalos and Rathian Variants≫,
and the merchants cannot camp.
At this rate supplies cannot be
moved, and prices will surely soar.
With your fine skill you should
be able to clear this request.
I am counting on you!
50685.descriptionJp:
夜の森丘に凶暴な
≪火竜や雌火竜の変種≫が
いて、商人たちが野営できな
い。
これでは物資が運搬できず、
物価の高騰は免れん。
あなたたちの高い腕前なら
この依頼を達成できるはずだ。
頼んだぞ！

62259.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

21906.description: This request is for hunters who own the Siprela series weapon. Hunting the Yian Garuga Variant and Bulldrome Variant yields the materials needed to produce and upgrade the SP weapon Berm series.
21906.descriptionEn:
This request is aimed at hunters
who own the "Ciprela Series"
weapon.
Hunt a Yian Garuga Variant and
a Bulldrome Variant to obtain
the materials needed to craft
and upgrade the SP weapon
"Berm Series".
21906.descriptionJp:
武器「シプレラシリーズ」を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
イャンガルルガ変種とドス
ファンゴ変種を狩猟すると、
ＳＰ武器「ベルムシリーズ」
の生産・強化に必要な素材が
入手できます。

40228.description: This is a trial quest for the armor 'Silver Armor ZP' series and the weapon 'Spinning Wheel of Victory Sword O', both obtainable from the Fate/EXTELLA Collaboration Lottery. Clearing it also earns you the Felyne Comrade gear 'Rose Dance Dress Felyne Series' and the status background image 'Fate/EXTELLA'.
40228.descriptionEn:
≪Fate/EXTELLA Collab Lottery≫
This is a trial quest for
the armor "Silver Mail ZP"
series and the weapon
"Turning Wheel of Victory O".
Clearing it also earns you
Palico gear, the "Rose Dance
Garb Neko Series", plus the
status background image
"Fate/EXTELLA".
40228.descriptionJp:
≪Fate/EXTELLAコラボくじ≫
で入手できる防具「白銀の甲
冑ZP」シリーズと武器「転輪
する勝利の剣O」の体験クエ
ストとなります。クリア報酬
として、パートニャー武具
「薔薇の舞踊服ネコシリーズ」
やステータス背景画像
「Fate/EXTELLA」も入手可能
です。

54280.description: Do you have enough Ｇｚ? In this request, introduced today, you can earn a hefty reward just by doing the same hunting as always. However, note that it cannot be taken consecutively.
54280.descriptionEn:
Are you short on ≪Gz≫?
With today's request, you
only do the same hunting as
always and earn a hefty
reward for it.
However, it cannot be
accepted in succession, so
please keep that in mind.
54280.descriptionJp:
≪Ｇｚ≫は足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
いつもと同じ狩猟をこなして
いただくだけで、高額な報酬
が獲得できます。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

62927.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62927.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62927.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

55992.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

61137.description: I was interested in that sea of trees place, so I went there the other day, but there are so many Hypnocatrice I cannot get close. Could you do something for me? It sounds odd to call it help, but I will prepare the equipment.
61137.descriptionEn:
I got curious about that Great
Forest everyone talks about,
so I went there the other day.
But there's a whole swarm of
Hypnocatrice there and I can't
get near the place.
Could you do something for me?
It feels odd to call it help,
but I'll supply the equipment.
61137.descriptionJp:
樹海とやらに興味があってね、
このあいだ行ってみたんだが、
≪眠鳥≫が大量にいて、
近づけないんだ。
どうにかして来てくれないか？
助けと言ってはなんだが、
装備は俺が用意してくるよ。

55467.description: A Rukodiora with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Rukodiora seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55467.descriptionEn:
An ≪Extreme Dragon≫ with
greatly developed wings
has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
one as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
developed parts and surveys it.
There are also reports that it
is more dangerous than past
Extreme Dragons. Survey carefully.
55467.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した≪極龍≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの極龍より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

62185.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Kirin. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62185.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We are seeking someone to slay
an extremely powerful Kirin.
Should you succeed in the hunt,
we shall issue you more Slay
Proofs than usual as reward!
62185.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪キリン≫の個体を退治して
くださる方を募集しておりま
す。見事に討伐できましたら、
普段よりも多めの討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

40141.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ６頭の討伐
40141.description: Hunters! The seaside open air bath I once designed is in danger! Brutal boars are attacking the bathers. Yesterday 3 old men were attacked and ended up in hospital with strained backs. Unforgivable! I want you to slay these brutal boars! I wish you good hunting!
40141.descriptionEn:
Fellow hunters! The seaside open-
air bath I once designed is now
in grave danger!
Savage boars are attacking the
bathers. Just yesterday three old
men were set upon and ended up
in hospital with bad backs.
Unforgivable! I want you all to
slay these barbarous boars!
I wish you the best of luck!
40141.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君！私がかつて
設計した浜辺の露天風呂が
危機に瀕している！
野蛮な猪どもが入浴客を襲う
のだ。昨日も老人が３人ほど
襲われ、ギックリ腰で入院
した。許せぬ！諸君らに、
この野蛮なる猪どもを討伐
してもらいたいのだ！
健闘を祈る！

62143.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62143.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62143.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62143.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

22147.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22147.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22147.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

55236.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55236.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.
55236.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されて
いる一部防具や装飾品の強化
に使用するＨＣ素材やＧＨＣ
素材を獲得できるクエストを
ご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

26737.objectiveJp: イャンクック２頭の狩猟
26737.description: You pound bird wyverns. With a hammer, like this, you pound bird wyverns. That is both the basics and the secret of the hunter. If you want this rare bone too, I will lend you my favourite equipment, so go and pound those bird wyverns!
26737.descriptionEn:
You've gotta smack Bird Wyverns.
With a hammer, like this,
smack those Bird Wyverns.
That is both the basics and the
secret of a hunter.
If you lot want this rare bone,
I'll lend you my favorite gear,
so go smack some Bird Wyverns!
26737.descriptionJp:
鳥竜を叩くんだよ。ハンマー
でこう、鳥竜をぶっ叩くのさ。
それこそがハンターの基本に
して極意ってもんさ。あんた
らもこの珍しい骨が欲しいな
ら、俺の愛用の装備を貸して
やるから、鳥竜どもをぶっ叩
いてきな！

50013.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
50013.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
50013.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

23604.description: An unprecedented disaster is about to befall that land. It gives off an ominous aura that keeps all at bay, and even the surveyors cannot approach. If left as it is, it could seriously affect the surrounding ecosystem. Hunters of outstanding skill, hurry to the site.
23604.descriptionEn:
An unprecedented disaster is
about to befall that land.
It radiates a sinister aura
that lets no one near; even
surveyors cannot approach.
Left as it is, it could badly
harm the surrounding
ecosystem.
Hunters of outstanding skill,
make haste for the site.
23604.descriptionJp:
彼の地にかつてない災いが
降りかかろうとしています。
何人も寄せ付けない禍々しい
オーラを放ち、調査員も近づ
くことができません。
このままでは、周囲の生態系
に深刻な影響を及ぼしかねま
せん。
卓越した技術をもつハンター
は現地へ急行してください。

40179.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40179.description: A very powerful Daimyo Hermitaur that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
40179.descriptionEn:
A Daimyo Hermitaur that acts
unlike the norm and is very
powerful is in the New Great
Arena. I want you to hunt it.
This request is only for hunters
with Secret Art equipment
recognized by the Guild.
Succeed, and you will earn
even more acclaim as a
top hunter.
40179.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪盾蟹≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

62535.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Deep Forest, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Great Tree or the Voice of Nature: Forest. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62535.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. By completing this
request set in the Great Forest,
you may obtain the Voice of
Nature: Great Tree or the
Voice of Nature: Forest.
I pray your hunting life grows
ever more fulfilling.
62535.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪樹海≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・大樹≫や
≪大自然の声・森林≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

23336.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Giaorugu, the Ice Violent Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23336.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Ice Tyrant
Wyvern ≪Giaorugu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
23336.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、氷獰竜
≪ギアオルグ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54878.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
54878.description: Please cooperate with the investigation of the Thunder Roaring Wyvern inhabiting the top of the sea of trees! If you not only hunt it but also break its head and forelegs, we will add to the reward. Please lend us your strength in our research!
54878.descriptionEn:
We request your aid in a survey
of the Diorex that dwells at the
top of the Great Forest!
Break its head and forelegs as
well as hunting it, and we will
add a bonus to your reward.
Please lend your strength to
our research!
54878.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に生息する
≪雷轟竜≫の調査に
ご協力をお願いします！
狩猟するだけでなく≪雷轟竜≫
の頭部と前脚を破壊して
くれたら報酬を上乗せいたし
ます。どうか我々の研究に力
を貸してください！

23298.description: Thanks to you gathering Rurou Narcissus and mining the Amaterasu Stone, trade with every region is thriving. The Guild presents you with this coin as thanks for the blessings you have brought to Mezeporta.
23298.descriptionEn:
Thanks to you gathering ≪Lulou Suisen≫
and mining ≪Amaterasu Stone≫,
trade with every region is
flourishing.
The Guild presents you with this
coin as thanks for the blessings
you have brought to Mezepolta.
23298.descriptionJp:
あなたが≪ルロウスイセン≫、
を採取し、≪天照石≫を採掘
してくれるおかげで、各地方
からの交易が盛んに行われて
います。
ギルドは、このメゼポルタに
恵みを与えてくれたお礼とし
てこのコインを贈ります。

26678.description: Tide Island in the tropics. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
26678.descriptionEn:
The tropical ≪Tidal Island≫.
It is an uncharted land the Guild
is still surveying, but hunter,
why not go and see it once
for gathering and survey
work yourself?
When you feel like coming back,
just deliver a map!
26678.descriptionJp:
熱帯の≪潮島≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

56074.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
56074.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56074.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56074.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

22151.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
22151.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!
22151.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のゼニーが入手できる上
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

55884.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55884.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55884.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

55028.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
55028.description: Haah. Women these days say they want Teostra materials. How selfish. Apparently they will marry the man who brings precious materials. I have asked for part breaking jobs too so I can offer various materials. If you complete them I will share with you.
55028.descriptionEn:
Haah. The women these days say
they want Teostra materials.
How selfish can they get.
Apparently they marry whichever
man brings the rarest parts.
I've taken on part-breaking jobs
too, so I can offer up all sorts
of materials. Clear this and
I'll share some with you.
55028.descriptionJp:
ハア。最近の女性は炎王龍の
素材が欲しいとか言うんだぜ。
なんてワガママなんだ。
なんでも貴重な素材を持って
きた男と結婚するらしいよ。
僕も様々な素材を献上できる
ように部位破壊の依頼もさせ
てもらったよ。達成したら君
にも分けてあげるよ。

55872.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
55872.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55872.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55872.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

53244.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
53244.description: An empty belly cannot hunt Elder Dragons, nya! To eat, first procure ingredients, nya! Leave the ingredients to the Adventure Felyne, nya! Get tools so the Adventure Felyne can bring back good ingredients, nya!
53244.descriptionEn:
You can't hunt an Elder Dragon
on an empty stomach, nya!
First, gather ingredients!
We ask the adventurer Felynes to
go out and collect them, nya!
Get the tools they need so they
bring back good ingredients, nya!
53244.descriptionJp:
腹が減っては古龍も狩れぬの
ニャ！飯を食べる為にまずは
食材調達ニャ！
食材は冒険ネコにお願いして
採ってきてもらうニャ！
冒険ネコが良い食材
を持って帰れるように道具を
手に入れるのニャ！

55384.description: The nostalgic Variety Soul quest is back again! This time the subject is Zerureusu. Clear it quickly and earn plenty of souls! Rare materials also seem a little easier to obtain than usual.
55384.descriptionEn:
The nostalgic Variety Soul event
is back once again! This time
your task is to slay Mi Ru.
Clear it briskly and rake in a
whole lot of Souls! Rare
materials seem to be a little
easier to get than usual, too.
55384.descriptionJp:
皆さん懐かしのバラエティー
入魂が再び登場ですよ！今回
のお題は輝界竜の討伐です。
さくっと達成して、沢山の魂
を獲得しましょう！希少な素
材もいつもよりちょっぴり入
手しやすいようですよ。

62281.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品
62281.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Hi-Metal R blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62281.descriptionEn:
If you listen to the voice of
nature, you may gain ideas
beyond human wisdom.
This request should help you
upgrade your High Metal R
Blademaster armor. May your
hunting life stay fulfilling
for all time.
62281.descriptionJp:
大自然の声に耳を傾ければ
人智を超えた新しい着想を
得られるかもしれません。
この依頼は≪ハイメタＲ≫の
剣士用防具を強化するために
役立つことでしょう。皆様の
狩猟生活がいつまでも充実
したものでありますように。

51079.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
51079.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the wings of a Yian Garuga will also grant a special ingredient.
51079.descriptionEn:
To further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild
Priority requests we have
long conducted, we have
prepared this quest for you.
Break the wings of the Black
Wolf Bird, and we shall grant
a special ingredient as well.
51079.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒狼鳥の翼を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54821.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54821.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54821.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

55702.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Khezu through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Long Sword, Tonfa, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55702.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade one Supremacy
Khezu weapon from creation to
stage one, plus Polta Card
Sakura worth Gz. The weapon
types available are Dual Blades,
Long Sword, Tonfa, Light Bowgun,
Heavy Bowgun or Bow.
Please make good use of this.
55702.descriptionJp:
辿異種フルフルの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
双剣、太刀、穿龍棍、軽弩、
重弩、弓のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

26467.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Watch out for Rathian's charge and aerial spin attack. Study her movements and strike. A Flash Bomb comes in handy!
26467.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Watch Rathian's charge and
aerial spin attacks. Study
her moves, then strike.
Flash Bombs help a lot~
26467.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
リオレイアは突進と空中回転
攻撃に注意です。動きを良く
見て攻撃してくださいね。
閃光玉があると便利ですよ〜。

21123.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21123.description: Hunting Iodrome in the volcanic zone may be a little troublesome, I suppose. A wounded Iodrome may flee into places where a hunter loses stamina fast. Not letting it escape is the clever way.
21123.descriptionEn:
Hunting a ≪Gendrome≫ in the
Volcano region may be a bit
of a bother. A weakened
Gendrome may flee to places
that drain a hunter's own
stamina. Not letting it run
is the clever approach.
21123.descriptionJp:
火山地帯で≪ドスイーオス≫
を狩猟するのは、少し面倒か
も知れないわね。体力を消耗
したドスイーオスは、狩人が
体力を消耗する、嫌な場所に
逃げ込む可能性があるの。
逃さないのが上手い方法ね。

50332.description: Defeat a monster a little bigger and stronger than usual and find a bracelet, nya! I'll trade you my pick of goods, nya! What's it for? You'd better not pry any further, nya.
50332.descriptionEn:
Beat monsters a teensy bit bigger
and stronger than usual and bring
back the bracelets you find, nya!
I'll trade you my top picks, nya!
What for, you ask?
It's better not to pry any
further than that, nya.
50332.descriptionJp:
いつもよりすこ〜し大きくて
強いモンスターを倒して腕輪
を見つけてくるのニャ！
イチオシの品と交換してやる
ニャよ！
何に使うのかって？
それ以上は踏み込まないほう
がいいニャよ。

1.description: It is I, the Instructor! Good that you read this Quest Confirmation! Nice! Whatever the quest, important hints essential to clearing it are written here. Make sure you read them!
1.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
You have done well to read
this ≪Quest Check≫! Nice!
Whatever the quest, the vital
hints you need to clear it are
written right here.
Make sure you always read them!
1.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
よくぞこの≪クエスト確認≫
に目を通したな！ナイスだ！
どのクエストでも、ここには
クエストクリアに欠かせない
重要ヒントが書かれている。
必ず読むようにするのだぞ！

54546.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Hyujikiki, the Needle Covered Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54546.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Needle
Coiled Wyvern ≪Hyujikiki≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
54546.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、針纏竜
≪ヒュジキキ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54377.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54377.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54377.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54377.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

56060.description: You can obtain the materials needed to produce 1 Bogabadorumu Aberrant weapon and carry it through 2 stages of upgrades, plus Porta Cards Sakura worth the Ｇｚ. The weapon types you can produce are dual blades, lance, gunlance, hunting horn, Tonfa or bow. Do make use of this to produce and upgrade the weapon you like.
56060.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade one
Bogabadorumu Supremacy weapon
from creation to stage two,
plus Polta Card Sakura worth Gz.
The weapon types available are
Dual Blades, Lance, Gunlance,
Hunting Horn, Tonfa or Bow.
Please make good use of this.
56060.descriptionJp:
ボガバドルムの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、槍、銃槍、
狩猟笛、穿龍棍、弓の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

61642.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
61642.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61642.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
61642.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

23474.description: The Variant Species Khezu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23474.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Khezu has grown
ferociously strong and keeps
rampaging without end.
It is extremely dangerous as
things stand. Please prepare
thoroughly before the survey.
23474.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪フルフル≫は猛烈
な強さとなり、暴れ続けてい
ます。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

60049.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

51064.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
51064.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the back of a Brown Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
51064.descriptionEn:
To further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild
Priority requests we have
long conducted, we have
prepared this quest for you.
Break the back of the Espinas
Subspecies, and we shall grant
a special ingredient as well.
51064.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
棘茶竜の背中を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

12043.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品

62003.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Daimyo Hermitaur. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62003.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest to slay
a ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
fellow hunters?
62003.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

62915.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62915.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62915.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

26071.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26071.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26071.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

55106.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
55106.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55106.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55106.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23369.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
23369.description: There was a report of a Hypnocatrice racing at tremendous speed through the daytime sea of trees. According to the investigation, it is not angry but running for courtship, though in any case it is very dangerous as it is. Please head out to hunt it at once.
23369.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a
Hypnocatrice racing at great
speed through the daytime
Great Forest. According to the
survey, it is not angry but
running to court a mate—but
either way, it is extremely
dangerous as things stand.
Please set out to hunt it at once.
23369.descriptionJp:
昼の樹海を猛スピードで駆
け巡る眠鳥を見たとの報告
がありました。調査による
と怒っているのではなく、
求愛のため走っているらし
いのですが、いずれにせよ
そのままでは非常に危険で
す。至急、狩猟に向かって
ください。

23321.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
23321.description: While surveying the creatures living in the swamp, we confirmed an extremely powerful individual Gypceros subspecies. It is a precious individual never found before, so please head to the site at once to investigate.
23321.descriptionEn:
While surveying the creatures
of the Swamp, we confirmed a
very powerful ≪Gypceros
Subspecies≫ individual.
It is a precious specimen never
found before, so please head
to the site at once and carry
out a survey.
23321.descriptionJp:
沼地に生息する生物たちの
調査中に、非常に強力な
≪ゲリョス亜種≫の個体を
確認しました。
これまでに発見されたことの
無い貴重な個体ですので、
至急現地へ向かい調査を
お願いいたします。

55280.description: I love birds! And I realized I love Hypnocatrice too! That fluffy hip is irresistible! I want to be slapped in the face by its tail feathers!
55280.descriptionEn:
I love birds!
And I realized I love
Hypnocatrice too!
That fluffy, frilly hip
is just irresistible!
I want those tail feathers
slapping my face!
55280.descriptionJp:
トリが好きだ！
やっぱりヒプノックも
好きだと気づいた！
あのフリフリのヒップが
たまらん！
尾羽根で顔をしばきたい！

54468.description: Meraginasu has been discovered in the caves of Tide Island. A dragon that carries memories of ancient times, known until now only from fossils. This is a discovery without precedent. The survey is of great importance and failure will not be tolerated. Head to the site at once and secure it.
54468.descriptionEn:
≪Meraginasu≫ has been found in
the caves of the Tidal Island.
A dragon whose existence we
knew only from fossils, carrying
memories of ancient times.
This is an unprecedented find.
It is a most important survey,
so failure is not permitted.
Please head there at once and
secure the area.
54468.descriptionJp:
潮島の洞窟で
≪メラギナス≫が発見されま
した。今まで化石でしか
その存在を知ることができな
かった、太古の記憶を持つ竜
です。これは嘗てない発見と
言えます。非常に重要な調査
のため失敗は許されません。
至急現地へ向かい安全の
確保をお願いします。

54509.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54509.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54509.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

21724.description: This quest yields the following materials. Gunlance Soul (Beginning) x85, Gunlance Soul (Middle) x195, Gunlance Soul (Extreme) x275, Gunlance Soul (Heaven) x85. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21724.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Gunlance Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Gunlance Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Gunlance Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Gunlance Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
21724.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ガンランス魂・序≫85枚
≪ガンランス魂・中≫195枚
≪ガンランス魂・極≫275枚
≪ガンランス魂・天≫85枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

28074.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の討伐
28074.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28074.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!
28074.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を猟団の仲間と行う
のだ。支給品も一切用意
しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

63346.description: A mysterious pink-glowing sphere, my favorite, has been stolen from me in the Jungle, meow! Stealing my collection, what nerve, meow! What was that? You will get it back for me, meow? If that is true, I will give you my secret pink collection as a present, meow!
63346.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, my favorite
mystery orb that gleams pink
was stolen from me, nya!
Stealing my collection takes
some nerve, nya! What's that?
You'll take it back for me, nya?
If you truly will, I'll present
you my treasured pink
collection, nya!
63346.descriptionJp:
密林でお気に入りの桃色に
輝く不思議ニャ珠を奪われて
しまったニャ！我輩のコレク
ションを奪うだニャンていい
度胸ニャ！ニャンだって？
奪い返してくれるニャか？
それが本当ニャら我輩秘蔵の
桃色コレクションを
プレゼントするニャ！

50791.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
50791.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the chest of a Black Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
50791.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Black Gravios's
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50791.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒鎧竜の胸部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

23503.description: You have the Entra GX series but want different armor too! For you I have prepared a quest that gets one piece's worth of production and upgrade materials for the recommended Frogada G series armor all at once! Clear it five times and collect every part!
23503.descriptionEn:
You've made the Entora GX
series, but want other armor
too! For you, we prepared a
quest where one piece's worth
of production and upgrade
materials for the “Frogada G
Series” comes all at once!
Clear it 5 times, get all parts!
23503.descriptionJp:
エントラGXシリーズはできた
けれども違う防具もほしい！
そんなあなたの為のおすすめ
防具「フロガダＧシリーズ」
１部位分の生産強化素材が一
気に入手できるクエストを用
意しました！クエストを５回
クリアして全部位を揃えよう！

54793.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 1 Porta Card Sakura. Hunt a Hypnocatrice and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade 1 piece of Flogada GF.
54793.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely quest you
can take in exchange for one
Polta Card Sakura.
Hunt a Hypnocatrice and you
can get the materials needed
to upgrade one piece of
Frogada GF armor.
54793.descriptionJp:
ポルタカード桜１枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
ヒプノックを狩猟すると、
フロガダGF一部位の
強化に必要な素材が
入手できるわよ。

50751.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
50751.description: We present a request that lets you obtain more than usual of the materials needed to craft and upgrade the Silver Sovereign Wyvern's Hard Species armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
50751.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on how
often you may take it, but I
present a request that yields
more than usual of the materials
needed to craft and upgrade
Giaorugu Hardcore armor.
Mind you don't miss this chance.
50751.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、司銀龍の剛種防
具の生産強化に必要な素材を
通常より多く入手できる依頼
をご紹介します。この機会を
逃さぬようご注意ください。

21264.description: A powerful Basarios has appeared together with a powerful Gravios. The Guild will pay a large sum to the hunter who slays both. In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware.
21264.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Basarios≫ has
appeared, accompanied by a
powerful ≪Gravios≫.
The Guild will pay a hefty
sum to the hunter who slays
both. Other rewards are
slim in exchange, so keep
that in mind.
21264.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫の強力な個体
が、≪グラビモス≫の強力な
個体を伴って現れたわ。
ギルドでは、この２頭を討伐
したハンターに、多額の報酬
金を支払うことになったの。
その代わり、その他の見返り
は控えめなので要注意よ。

53173.description: This is Miyashita! A challenge from me (a quiz), answer check quest 2! 2016 Answer Ticket MA x1, 2016 Answer Ticket NA x1, 2016 Answer Ticket OA x1. You who hold the items above: correct! Congratulations! Take the items and depart on the quest! Receive your present!
53173.descriptionEn:
It's Miyashita!
My challenge to you (a quiz)
Answer-checking quest 2!
2016 Answer Ticket MA x1
2016 Answer Ticket NA x1
2016 Answer Ticket OA x1
You who hold the items above
are correct! Congratulations!
Bring the items and set out
on the quest! Claim your gift!
53173.descriptionJp:
宮下です！
僕からの挑戦状（クイズ）
答え合せクエスト２です！
2016年解答券MＡ１個
2016年解答券NＡ１個
2016年解答券OＡ１個
↑のアイテムを持っている君
正解です！おめでとう！
アイテムを持ってクエストへ
出発！プレゼントを貰おう！

26132.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26132.description: Now, into live combat! Go into the jungle, find a Yian Kut-Ku, and hunt it! Observing and studying its attacks closely is the key to a successful hunt! For example, its tail only sweeps counterclockwise... Observe and study, it matters!
26132.descriptionEn:
Now then, on to real combat!
Let's head into the Jungle and
hunt down a Yian Kut-Ku!
Observing and studying its
attacks closely is the key!
For example, its tail only ever
swings counterclockwise...
Observation and study matter!
26132.descriptionJp:
さて、それでは実戦です！
密林で、≪イャンクック≫を
探して狩猟してみましょう！
攻撃をよーく観察・研究する
ことが、狩猟成功のコツ！
例えば、尻尾は半時計まわり
しか･･･とかですね。
観察と研究は重要ですよ！

61021.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の討伐
61021.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
61021.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.
61021.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。
こちらは祭典の証は必要あり
ません。クエストの達成のみで
様々な報酬が払い出される
ようになっております。

21178.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
21178.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.
21178.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは、対変種に適した特
殊な武器を装備した方限定の
受注、参加となっております。
今回のターゲットには、通常
とは異なる性質、動きがみら
れるそうなのでご注意を。

23445.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23445.description: This quest yields the following materials. Tonfa Merit (Beginning) x５０, Tonfa Merit (Middle) x６０, Tonfa Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23445.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Tonfa Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Tonfa Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Tonfa Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, GR500
or higher is required, so
please be aware.
23445.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪穿龍棍勲・序≫５０個
≪穿龍棍勲・中≫６０個
≪穿龍棍勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

11084.description: We're recruiting hunters to slay 8 Ioprey! Ioprey hits harder in a single blow than Velociprey or Genprey, so mind yourself out there!
11084.descriptionEn:
Seeking hunters to slay 8
≪Ioprey≫!
Compared to Velociprey or
Genprey, a single Ioprey hit
hits harder. Watch out!
11084.descriptionJp:
≪イーオス≫８頭を討伐してく
れる方を募集します！
≪イーオス≫はランポスや、
ゲネポスに比べ一発の攻撃力が
高いので注意して下さい！

62231.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Talos L gunner armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62231.descriptionEn:
If you listen to the voice of
nature, you may gain ideas
beyond human wisdom.
This request should help you
upgrade your Taros L Gunner
armor. May your hunting life
stay fulfilling for all time.
62231.descriptionJp:
大自然の声に耳を傾ければ
人智を超えた新しい着想を
得られるかもしれません。
この依頼は≪タロスＬ≫の
ガンナー用防具を強化する
のに役立つでしょう。皆様の
狩猟生活がいつまでも充実
したものでありますように。

51122.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
51122.description: Help me! Monsters are attacking! I ran and the cargo scattered everywhere! Be careful not to destroy the scattered barrels! And the barrels between the rocks explode if you get close! Mind you do not set them off!
51122.descriptionEn:
Help meee! Monsters came and
attacked us! While we ran, our
cargo got scattered everywhere!
Be careful not to destroy the
barrels lying around, please!
And the barrels between the
rocks explode if you get close!
Don't break those either!
51122.descriptionJp:
助けてくれぇ！モンスターが
襲ってきたんだぁ！逃げてた
ら運搬物が散乱しちまった！
散乱したタルを破壊しないよ
うに気をつけてくれぇ！
それと岩の間にあるタルは
近づくと爆発するぞぉ！破壊
しないよう気をつけてくれぇ！

50993.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50993.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed for the F upgrade of
Secret Art Armor (Blademaster),
with the exception of Weapon
Souls. The yield covers five
pieces. Note that you need a
10th Anniversary Ticket to take
this quest.
50993.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（剣士）のＦ強化時
に必要な武器魂を除く素材を
排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪10周年チケット≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

11004.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
11004.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, often shows itself in the Jungle! It is quite a tough opponent, so rather than slaying it, capturing it with a Shock Trap is also an effective approach!
11004.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, the Bullfango
leader ≪Bulldrome≫ often shows
itself!
It is a fairly tough foe, so
rather than slaying it, using a
≪Shock Trap≫ and capturing it
is also an effective option!
11004.descriptionJp:
密林にはブルファンゴの長
である≪ドスファンゴ≫が
姿を現すことが多いです！
かなりタフな相手なので、
討伐ではなく≪シビレ罠≫
などを使い捕獲してしまう
のも有効な手段ですよ！

23470.description: The Variant Species Hypnocatrice has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23470.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Hypnocatrice has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps rampaging without end.
It is extremely dangerous as
things stand. Please prepare
thoroughly before the survey.
23470.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ヒプノック≫は猛烈
な強さとなり、暴れ続けてい
ます。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

55649.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55649.description: The Variant Species Gasurabazura appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Gasurabazura. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55649.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Gasurabazura≫
seems to have reached a strength
that puts it at the very top of
all Gasurabazura. Its power is
beyond measure. Hunters sure of
their skill to challenge the
summit, please take on the
survey.
55649.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ガスラバズラ≫
はガスラバズラの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

21682.description: There is a report that an unidentified monster suddenly appeared at the top of the tower. It came out of the light leaking through a gap in the clouds, they say, and from the report it is presumed to be Zerureusu, the Glittering World Wyvern. If true, this is a very dangerous situation. Head there at once and investigate.
21682.descriptionEn:
There is a report that an
unidentified monster suddenly
appeared atop the Tower.
It is said to have emerged from
the light leaking through the
gaps in the clouds, and from
that report we surmise it is
the Radiant Wyvern ≪Zerureusu≫.
If true, this is a very dangerous
situation. Head out and survey it!
21682.descriptionJp:
突如、塔の頂部に未確認の
モンスターが現れたとの報告
がありました。雲の隙間から
漏れる光の中より現れたとの
ことですが、報告から輝界竜
≪ゼルレウス≫であると推測
されます。本当であれば、
大変危険な状態です。
至急現地へ向かい調査を
お願いします。

50249.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
50249.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Azure Rathalos and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50249.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Azure Rathalos≫
and prove you can do it.
Clear this quest, and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!
50249.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪蒼火竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

23556.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23556.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please slay Akura Vashimu.
23556.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor, held by
hunters who have mastered
their weapon.
The Guild has long offered
various support, but this time
we provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming even higher.
For the survey, slay the Crystal-Tail Scorpion.
23556.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、
尾晶蠍の討伐をお願いします。

21534.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21534.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21534.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21534.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

63352.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63352.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the hunting horn, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63352.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena I have
loosed a Rathian of great power
that moves in unheard-of ways.
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, show me your
skill before my eyes!
If you can hunt it splendidly,
you shall gain far more than
your daily efforts would
normally bring you.
63352.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪雌火竜≫を放ってある。
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

23456.description: This quest yields the following materials. Gunlance Ribbon (Beginning) x100, Gunlance Ribbon (Middle) x165, Gunlance Ribbon (Extreme) x165. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23456.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Gunlance Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Gunlance Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Gunlance Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
23456.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ガンランス綬・序≫100個
≪ガンランス綬・中≫165個
≪ガンランス綬・極≫165個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

60663.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
60663.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60663.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill! Today's
target is a special individual:
the Hypnocatrice in breeding
season! Achieve the goal together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so go and take a top placing!
This time it's Supremacy weapons
only!
60663.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
特異個体の
≪ヒプノック繁殖期≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！今回は辿異武器限定で
開催されているぞ！

62711.description: Ah, so busy, so busy! Every year at this time, how busy it gets! Hey, you there. If you have time to watch, won't you lend a hand? I'll treat you to Navy materials as thanks!
62711.descriptionEn:
Ahh, busy, busy!
Every year around this time,
I'm run absolutely ragged!
Hey, you over there.
If you've got time to watch,
won't you lend me a hand?
I'll splurge on Kon materials
as thanks!
62711.descriptionJp:
ああ、忙しい忙しい！
いつもこの時期になると、
なんて忙しいのかしら！
ねえ、そこのあなた。
見ている暇があったら、
ちょっと手伝ってくれない？
お礼に≪紺≫の素材を
奮発するから！

62158.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62158.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62158.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

62405.objectiveJp: ハンターダイス赤１個の納品
62405.description: Thanks for the other day! Bring me a Hunter Die Red and I will trade you something lovely for it. Count on me from now on!
62405.descriptionEn:
Thanks for the other day!
Bring me a ≪Red Hunter Die≫
and I'll trade it for
something lovely.
Stick with me from now on too!
62405.descriptionJp:
この間はどうも！
≪ハンターダイス赤≫を
持ってきてくれたら、素敵な
物と交換してあげるぜ。
これからもよろしくな！

53213.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐

61047.description: Highlands test, 10/3 build, stage connections only, finished for now. If the coordinates change it is just swapping the numbers, so it is easy.
61047.descriptionEn:
Highlands Test
October 3 build
Stage stitching only
Done for now
If the coordinates change,
it's just swapping numbers,
so it's easy
61047.descriptionJp:
高地テスト
１０／３作成版
ステージ繋ぎのみ
とりあえず完成
座標変更した場合も
数字入れ替えだけなので
楽です

53131.description: My comrades have vanished from the Doll Workshop, meow! Word is a fight with the Melynx has broken out in the Canyon, and some of the poor things have gone and got themselves locked up. Hunter! Please, bring my friends back, meow!
53131.descriptionEn:
My friends have vanished from
the Doll Workshop, nya!
Seems a fight with the Melynx
broke out in the Canyon, nya.
And some of them, shamefully,
got themselves locked up, nya.
Hunter! I want you to bring my
friends back somehow, nya!
53131.descriptionJp:
僕の仲間が人形工房から
いなくなってしまったニャ！
どうやら峡谷でメラルーとの
争いが始まったらしいニャ。
しかも何匹かは情けないこ
とに閉じ込められたりしてる
らしいニャ。ハンターさん！
なんとか仲間たちを連れ戻し
てほしいニャ！

50998.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50998.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50998.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Giaorugu≫ in the Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.
50998.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55081.description: An unidentified black monster is rampaging in the Old Tower. Who is it? It changes its form, changes its movement, changes its voice, changes its eye color. To whoever ascertains its true identity, I shall surely give production materials for Guild hidden armor.
55081.descriptionEn:
An unidentified black monster is
running wild in the Ancient Tower.
Who is it? It changes its shape,
its movements, its voice,
and the color of its eyes.
Whoever uncovers its true identity
will receive production materials
for Guild-treasured armor.
55081.descriptionJp:
正体不明の黒いモンスターが
古塔で暴れ回っている。
奴は何者だ？姿を変え、動き
を変え、声を変え、眼の色を
変えている。
こいつの正体を突き止めた者
にはギルド秘蔵の防具の生産
素材を必ず渡そう。

23428.description: There has been a sighting of Teostra in the volcano. It appears to unleash attacks unlike those confirmed before. We have decided to entrust the survey only to G-rank hunters of proven skill, so G-rank hunters, please take on the investigation.
23428.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a Teostra
sighted in the Volcano.
It seems to unleash attacks
different from those confirmed
before.
The survey will be entrusted
only to G Rank hunters of
proven skill, so G Rank hunters
are asked to take it on.
23428.descriptionJp:
火山にて、テオ・テスカトル
の目撃情報が入ってきました。
どうやらこれまで確認されて
いたものとは異なる攻撃を繰
り出してくるようです。
腕前の確かなＧ級のハンター
にのみ、調査を依頼すること
となりましたので、Ｇ級ハン
ターは調査をお願い致します。

61156.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
61156.description: Huh? That thing was red. Everything was red. It is the cold season, the cold season! That was definitely not a dream. You go and prove it! Then I will at least pay for your drinks.
61156.descriptionEn:
Huh?
That thing was red, I tell you.
Everything about it was red.
It's the Cold Season, the Cold Season!
That was absolutely no dream.
Go and prove it for me, will you!
Do that, and I'll at least cover
your drinks.
61156.descriptionJp:
んあ？
あれは、赤かったぜっ。
もう何もかも赤いんだ。
寒冷期だよ、寒冷期！
あれは絶対に夢じゃなかった。
あんた、証明してきてくれよ！
そうしたら、酒代くらいは
出してやらぁな。

63171.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Break the designated parts of a monster and slay it together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
63171.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds between you all,
I have prepared a difficult request
for you. You are to break the
specified parts of a monster and slay it
together with your Guild companions.
No supply items will be provided at all,
so discuss it with your companions
beforehand and then depart.
Your reward shall be a special ore!
63171.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。モンスターの
指定部位の破壊と討伐を、
猟団の仲間と行うのだ。
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

53099.description: I am short of autumn mushrooms, so gather specialty mushrooms and deliver them! Depending on how many you deliver, I will release a mushroom-heavy quest later! I have put a Farcaster in the supplies, so do not forget to take it.
53099.descriptionEn:
We're short on autumn mushrooms,
so I want you to gather Special
Mushrooms and deliver them!
Depending on how many you hand
in, I'll release a mushroom-packed
quest later! I've put a Farcaster
in your supplies, so don't forget
to take it along.
53099.descriptionJp:
秋の味覚のキノコが足りない
から、特産キノコを集めて納
品してほしいのじゃ！納品さ
れたキノコの数に応じて、後
日キノコたっぷりクエストを
配信するぞ！支給品にモドリ
玉を用意したから、忘れずに
持っていくのじゃ。

50601.description: My wife says to me: you are always dreaming, do you never tire of it? Indeed I do not! By looking ever forward, a new path can be opened! That joy is what keeps me alive!
50601.descriptionEn:
My wife keeps saying to me,
“Always chasing dreams, don't
you ever get tired of it?”
Damn right I don't!
By keeping your eyes ahead,
a new road can open up before
you!
That joy is what keeps me alive!
50601.descriptionJp:
嫁さんが言いやがるんだよ。
いつも夢ばっかり見ていて、
よく飽きないねえ、だとさ。
そうとも、飽きねぇとも！
前を見続けることで、新たな
道が切り開かれることだって
ある！
その喜びが生きる糧なのさ！

62308.description: Word has it that White Star Iron has been found in the wasteland known as the Canyon. Anyone who wants White Star Iron, why not join the survey party? We supply the goods and the food. Once supplies run out you will be living off the land, so join only if you are prepared for that.
62308.descriptionEn:
There is a rumor that White Star Iron
has been found in the wasteland,
≪Canyon≫. Anyone who wants
White Star Iron, why not join the
survey team? We have prepared
goods and food on our side.
If need be you will live off the
land, so only those with resolve
should join.
62308.descriptionJp:
荒野の大地、≪峡谷≫にて、
あの白星鉄が見つかったとい
う噂がある。白星鉄が欲しい
奴は探索隊に参加してみない
か？物品や食料はこちらで
用意してある。必要になれば
自給自足の生活になるので、
覚悟がある奴だけ参加して
ほしい。

11046.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

26060.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
26060.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26060.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26060.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

55893.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
55893.description: Oh no! Some dreadfully noisy monster has appeared near that tree. Hunter, would you drive that monster off for me? If you do, I will supply you with crackers. Use them and enjoy the flower viewing too.
55893.descriptionEn:
Oh no! A dreadfully noisy monster
has appeared near that tree.
Hunter, would you drive that
monster away for my sake?
If you do, I shall supply you
with party crackers.
Use them and enjoy the flower
viewing yourself, won't you.
55893.descriptionJp:
大変！例の木の近くにボガバ
ガうるさいモンスターが出現
してしまったの。ハンター
さん、私のためにあのモンス
ターを追い払ってくださる？
もしそうして下さったら、
クラッカーを支給しますわ。
それを使って、あなたもお
花見を楽しんでくださいね。

23688.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23688.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, face the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena and show the skill you
have honed!
If you can hunt it well, you
will earn far more reward
than your daily efforts ever
bring.
23688.descriptionJp:
銃槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

1036.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

23270.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
23270.description: According to the surveyor staying in the Jungle, that blue monster appears night after night, and though no great damage has been done, unease is spreading among the surveyors. Please investigate at once what this monster is.
23270.descriptionEn:
According to the researchers
staying in the Jungle, that blue
monster appears night after
night. No major damage has been
reported, but unease is spreading
among the researchers.
Please hurry and survey just
what this monster is.
23270.descriptionJp:
密林に滞在している調査員の
話では、その青いモンスター
は夜な夜な現れるそうで、
大きな被害は出ていませんが、
調査員の間では、不安が
広がっているという事です。
急ぎこのモンスターが何か
調査をお願いします。

40185.description: There is a report that a giant dragon was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano. According to the survey team that found it, it looked like a Fatalis mutated to a crimson, ominous color. There is no telling what may happen as things stand. Please investigate quickly.
40185.descriptionEn:
There was a report that a
giant dragon was sighted at
the crater of the great volcano.
According to the survey team
that found it, the figure was
like a Fatalis mutated into a
crimson, sinister color.
If left alone, there is no
telling what may happen.
Please survey it swiftly.
40185.descriptionJp:
大火山の火口にて、巨大な
龍の姿が目撃されたとの報告
がありました。
発見した調査団いわく、
その姿は紅く禍々しい色に
変異したミラボレアスのよう
だったとのこと。
このままでは、何が起こるか
わかりません。
迅速な調査をお願いします。

23595.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
23595.description: A giant fireball above Schrade Castle, and the investigation revealed a terrible fact. The Fatalis hailed as the black legend had mutated into something even more powerful! Unimaginable damage will occur. Please slay it swiftly.
23595.descriptionEn:
A giant fireball has appeared
above Schrade Castle, and our
investigation revealed a terrible
truth. Fatalis, hailed as the
black legend, had mutated into
a far more powerful form!
If left alone, damage beyond
imagination will surely follow.
We ask for a swift slaying.
23595.descriptionJp:
シュレイド城上空に巨大な火
球が発生しており調査の結果、
恐ろしい事実が判明しました。
なんと、黒き伝説と謳われる
ミラボレアスがより強力に変
異していたのです！
このままでは想像もできない
被害が発生することでしょう。
迅速な討伐をお願いします。

50028.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
50028.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Cephadrome of the desert. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50028.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Go and hunt a Cephadrome in
the Desert. Clear the quest
splendidly and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
straight up!
50028.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
砂漠の≪砂竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。見事クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

54433.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54433.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor.
