The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54433.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54433.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

40207.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40207.description: The Espinas of this forest is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40207.descriptionEn:
The Espinas that lives in this
Great Forest is said to sometimes
carry incredible treasure.
If that's true, I'd very much
like you to go hunt it for us.
We'll split the reward down the
middle.
40207.descriptionJp:
この樹海に生息する棘竜
≪エスピナス≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

55968.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55968.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55968.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

55378.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55378.description: To stand against monsters that only grow more ferocious, Variant Species and Transcendent Species alike, the guild has prepared new armor for Ｇ-rank hunters. Obtain the crafting materials and decorations, and prepare for the threats that press in!
55378.descriptionEn:
To counter monsters like
Supremacy and Transcendent
species that only grow more
savage, the Guild has prepared
new armor for G Rank hunters.
Obtain the crafting materials and
decorations, and ready yourself
for the coming threat!
55378.descriptionJp:
辿異種、遷悠種など凶暴化の
一途をたどるモンスターに対
抗すべく、ギルドではＧ級の
ハンターに向けて新たな防具
を用意しました。
生産素材や装飾品を獲得して
迫りくる脅威に備えてくださ
い！

23720.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
23720.description: The Variant Species Anorupatisu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23720.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Anorupatisu≫
has grown fiercely strong and
keeps rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as
things stand. Prepare fully and
carry out the survey.
23720.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アノルパティス≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

1024.description: You see? It usually lurks in the sand. If you really mean to hunt Daimyo Hermitaur, that's something you mustn't forget. It's called the Shield Crab for a reason: once it guards itself, it's a nuisance!
1024.descriptionEn:
Listen up.
It usually burrows down in the sand.
If you're serious about hunting
a Daimyo Hermitaur, this is
something you mustn't forget.
It's called the shield crab for
a reason. Once it guards up,
it's a real pain!
1024.descriptionJp:
いいかい？
普段は砂に潜ってるんだ。
キミが本気で≪ダイミョウ
ザザミ≫を狩るってんなら
忘れちゃいけないことだ。
盾蟹って呼ばれるだけあって
身を固められたら厄介だぜ！

23452.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Long Sword Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Long Sword Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23452.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Long Sword Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Long Sword Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
23452.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪太刀綬・序≫１００個
≪太刀綬・中≫１６５個
≪太刀綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

12040.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
12040.description: 2 shadows crawling in the darkness have been sighted. The white shadow is Khezu. The red shadow seems to be its subspecies. Hunters willing to face this duet of lightning, please come to the quest counter.
12040.descriptionEn:
Two shadows were seen crawling
in the dark. The white shadow
is a ≪Khezu≫. The red shadow
seems to be its subspecies.
Hunters with the spirit to face
this duet of lightning, come to
the quest counter.
12040.descriptionJp:
暗闇に這う２つの影が目撃
されたようね。白影の正体は
≪フルフル≫。赤影の正体は
その亜種のようね。この雷撃
の２重奏を狩猟に臨む気概の
ある狩人は、クエストカウン
ターまでお越し下さい。

53242.description: Greetings, ladies and gentlemen. This time I have prepared a job befitting you. The noble must never lose elegance. Stand firm in the volcano's heat waves and slay the Gravios. On completion I will present you with noble garb.
53242.descriptionEn:
Greetings, ladies and gentlemen.
I have prepared a request worthy
of you this time.
The noble must never lose their
grace. Even under the heat wave
of the Volcano, stand unshaken
and slay a Gravios.
Upon success, I shall gift you
noble attire.
53242.descriptionJp:
ごきげんよう紳士淑女の諸君。
今回は、君たちにふさわしい
依頼を用意させてもらった。
高貴なるものは常に優雅さを
失ってはならない。
火山で熱波にさらされても
動じず、鎧竜を討伐せよ。
達成のあかつきには、高貴な
衣装をプレゼントしよう。

60633.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60633.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60633.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60633.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

62206.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62206.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62206.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62206.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

54520.description: This is the final quest of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament in Thanksgiving Festival 2014. The time limit is 50 minutes.
54520.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament
in Thanksgiving Festival 2014.
The time limit is 50 minutes.
54520.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントin感謝祭2014の
決勝クエストです。
制限時間は５０分です。

50259.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Soul (Beginning) x85, Light Bowgun Soul (Middle) x195, Light Bowgun Soul (Extreme) x275, Light Bowgun Soul (Heaven) x85. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50259.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪L Bowgun Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪L Bowgun Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪L Bowgun Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪L Bowgun Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
50259.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｌボウガン魂・序≫85枚
≪Ｌボウガン魂・中≫195枚
≪Ｌボウガン魂・極≫275枚
≪Ｌボウガン魂・天≫85枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

55315.description: We ask for your help in the survey of the Water-Rending Wyvern that inhabits Prismatic Falls! Not only hunt it: if you sever the Water-Rending Wyvern's hanging blades and tail, we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
55315.descriptionEn:
We request your aid in a survey
of the Zenaseris that dwells at
Colored Waterfall!
Sever its hanging blades and
tail as well as hunting it, and
we will add a bonus to your
reward. Please lend your
strength to our research!
55315.descriptionJp:
彩の滝に生息する≪裂水竜≫
の調査にご協力をお願い
します！
狩猟するだけでなく
≪裂水竜≫の垂刃と尻尾を
切断してくれたら報酬を
上乗せいたします。
どうか我々の研究に力を
貸してください！

23659.description: A Doragyurosu with greatly developed horns has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Doragyurosu known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23659.descriptionEn:
A ≪Dark Thunder Wyvern≫ with
greatly developed horns
has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
one as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
developed parts and surveys it.
There are also reports that it
is more dangerous than past
ones. Please survey with care.
23659.descriptionJp:
角が大きく発達した≪冥雷竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を部位
の発達した≪辿異種≫と位置
づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの冥雷竜より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

55435.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (arms), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
55435.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed to upgrade G Rank Secret
Art Armor (arm piece), with the
exception of Weapon Ribbons and
Weapon Merits. The yield covers
one type. Note that you need a
10th Anniversary Ticket to take
this quest.
55435.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（腕防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪10周年チケット≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

61549.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
61549.description: You have come, hunters. How about testing your skill for a change? This time, prove to me whether you can slay a certain monster in the swamp. I have set no cheap tricks, so challenge it with confidence.
61549.descriptionEn:
Welcome, hunters.
How about a test of skill for
a change? This time, prove to
me whether you can slay a
certain monster in the Swamp.
There are no cheap tricks here,
so challenge it with confidence.
61549.descriptionJp:
よくきたな。ハンターたちよ。
たまには腕試しでもどうだ？
今回は沼地にいる、あるモン
スターを討伐できるかどうか
私に証明してもらおうか。
下手な小細工は一切していな
いから安心して挑戦してくれ。

63237.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

22025.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
22025.description: The legendary black dragon, Fatalis, seems to be doing something sinister in the deepest reaches of the untrodden volcano! At this rate calamity may rain down on the world! Hurry to the volcano and repel the enraged Fatalis!
22025.descriptionEn:
The legendary Black Dragon, Fatalis,
appears to be up to something
sinister in the deepest reaches of
an untouched volcano!! If this
continues, calamity may rain down
upon the world! Hurry to the
Volcano and repel the angry Black Dragon!
22025.descriptionJp:
伝説の黒龍、ミラボレアスが
前人未踏の火山の最奥地にて
なにやら良からぬ動きをして
いるようです！！このままで
は世界に災厄が降り注ぐかも
知れません！火山へと急行し
怒れる黒龍を撃退して下さい！

26331.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26331.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26331.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26331.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

58035.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58035.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58035.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58035.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

63342.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63342.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the sword and shield, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63342.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena I have
loosed a Rathian of great power
that moves in unheard-of ways.
Hunter who would master the
Sword and Shield, show me your
skill before my eyes!
If you can hunt it splendidly,
you shall gain far more than
your daily efforts would
normally bring you.
63342.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪雌火竜≫を放ってある。
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

21571.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

63215.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63215.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63215.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

62255.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
62255.description: What, you just want a hard Bow? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62255.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Bow, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search for it with spirit!
62255.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅い弓が欲し
いって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

50271.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
50271.description: Happy New Year! For this year's first hunt, by the Guild Master's particular wish, the battledore returns! And! Because his grandchild cried and begged for all the weapons from past years too, we have them ready in full force this year as well!
50271.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year!
For this year's first hunt, by
special request of the Guild
Master, the hagoita returns!
What's more! Because his
grandson cried for every weapon
from past years too, we've
prepared them all again this
year with a boom!
50271.descriptionJp:
新年おめでとうございます！
今年の狩り初めは、
ギルドマスターたっての
希望で、再び羽子板の登場
です！しかも！昨年までの
武器も全部欲しいと孫が
泣いてねだったおかげで、
今年もドドドーンとご用意
しました！

22142.description: Do you have enough armor upgrade materials? On this quest, which I present to you today, you can obtain great quantities of the Mighty Armor Sphere and Heaven Armor Sphere used to upgrade armor. However, please note that the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited.
22142.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough armor
upgrade materials?
In today's request, you can
obtain large amounts of the
≪Hard Armor Sphere≫ and
≪Heavenly Armor Sphere≫ used
to upgrade armor. Note that
the number you can accept per
day is limited, so be careful.
22142.descriptionJp:
防具の強化素材は足りていま
すか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
防具の強化に使用する
≪剛鎧玉≫と≪天鎧玉≫を
大量に獲得できますよ。
ただし、１日に受注できる数
に限りがありますので、
ご注意ください。

26144.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26144.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26144.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

61335.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61335.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61335.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

55622.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (arms), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
55622.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed to upgrade G Rank Secret
Art Armor (arm piece), with the
exception of Weapon Ribbons and
Weapon Merits. The yield covers
one type. Note that you need a
Hunter Dice (White) to take
this quest.
55622.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（腕防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターダイス白≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

58085.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58085.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58085.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58085.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

22094.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22094.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22094.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

50199.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50199.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50199.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

22092.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
22092.description: Thanks for playing MHF for four whole years! Equip Vol Oracle and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude M as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude M you can forge Akra Ain (Dual Blades).
22092.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for four whole years!
Equip ≪Vol Oracle≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude M≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude M≫ you can forge
≪Akra Ain≫ (Dual Blades).
22092.descriptionJp:
４年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ヴォルオラクル≫を装備し、
≪年間特典生産券≫１枚を
納品すると≪感謝の証M≫を
１１枚プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証M≫から
≪アクラアイン≫（双剣）が
生産可能です。

21886.description: A request that yields the Mighty Jewel, a decoration recommended for hunters who reached HR31. Hunt a Gypceros and you can obtain the Mighty Jewel, a decoration that raises attack. Please put it to good use in your future hunts.
21886.descriptionEn:
A request that yields the Mighty
Jewel, a decoration recommended
for hunters who reached HR31.
Hunt a Gypceros and you can
obtain the Mighty Jewel, a
decoration that raises attack.
Please put it to good use in
your future hunts.
21886.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ３１になったハンター
にオススメの装飾品≪剛力珠≫
が入手できる依頼です。
ゲリョスを狩猟すると、攻撃
力を高める装飾品≪剛力珠≫
を入手することができます。
ぜひ今後の狩猟生活にお役立
てください。

55496.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a tail break in slaying Midogaron, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55496.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Midogaron≫ and break its
head and tail, we will grant
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55496.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪爆狼≫討伐にて
頭部破壊と尻尾破壊を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

61887.description: Recover the scattered parts of the prototype Great Sword! One of them, the Ultrahard Board, seems to be in the volcano. Cut down the hateful monsters with righteous fury and you will surely recover the parts. I recommend wiping out the rude small monsters too.
61887.descriptionEn:
Recover the scattered parts of
the prototype Great Sword!
One of them, the Ultra-hard
Board, seems to be somewhere
in the Volcano.
Cut down those loathsome
monsters with righteous fury,
and you'll surely get the parts
back. I also suggest dealing
with the rude small monsters.
61887.descriptionJp:
ばらばらになった試作大剣の
部品を取り戻してください！
そのひとつ「超硬ボード」は
どうやら火山にあるようです。
義憤をもって憎きモンスター
どもを斬り捨てれば、きっと、
部品を取り戻せるでしょう。
無礼な小型モンスター達も
退治することをお勧めします。

21428.description: It seems you have gathered quite a lot. One step closer to my dream. A little more. I want you to stay with me just a little longer. Of course, when it is done I will give you wonderful treasure.
21428.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered quite a
lot. One step closer to my dream.
Just a little more.
I want you to keep me company
just a little longer.
Of course, once it's done I'll
give you splendid treasure.
21428.descriptionJp:
だいぶ集まってきたようだ。
俺の夢までもう一歩。
もう少し。
あともう少しだけ付き合って
欲しい。
もちろん、達成できた暁には
素晴らしいお宝をあげるよ。

21330.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
21330.description: What, you just want a hard Gunlance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21330.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Gunlance, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search for it with spirit!
21330.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬いガン
ランスが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

21798.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
21798.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21798.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21798.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

55244.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55244.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Torid GX Greaves' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55244.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the top
prize in the F Photo Contest
2016, we have prepared a quest
where you can obtain the
materials to craft and upgrade
the Torido GX Greaves worn in
it. Please make use of it.
55244.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「トリドGXグリーヴ」
を生産・強化するための素材
を獲得できるクエストをご用
意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

26396.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26396.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
26396.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

63102.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63102.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63102.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54157.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
54157.description: The survey of the terrifying incarnation of gluttony, Pariapuria, continues. Breaking its parts is not required, but I would be delighted if you did! Hunters, I ask for your help!
54157.descriptionEn:
The survey of Pariapuria, that
terrifying embodiment of gluttony,
continues.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we'd be delighted
if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your
continued support!
54157.descriptionJp:
恐ろしい飽食の権化、
パリアプリアの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

60709.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60709.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60709.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

15.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
15.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
15.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

23618.description: A Rukodiora with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Rukodiora seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23618.descriptionEn:
An ≪Extreme Dragon≫ with
greatly developed wings
has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
one as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
developed parts and surveys it.
There are also reports that it
is more dangerous than past
Extreme Dragons. Survey carefully.
23618.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した≪極龍≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの極龍より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

62256.description: What, you just want a hard Sword and Shield? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62256.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Sword and Shield, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search for it with spirit!
62256.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅い片手剣が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

62877.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
62877.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62877.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62877.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

20009.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
20009.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau warns that a suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress! Make use of the fortress's interception weapons and slay the mysterious giant dragon completely! Please!
20009.descriptionEn:
Word has come from the Elder
Dragon Forecast Office that a
sinister dragon is approaching
the Fort! Use the Fort's
interception weapons and slay
the mysterious giant dragon
completely! Please!
20009.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より、怪しげな龍
が砦に接近しているとの知ら
せが入りました！砦の迎撃兵
器を活用し、謎の巨大龍を
完全に討伐して下さい！
お願いします！

60030.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

26501.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Next you will prove the accumulation of your daily discipline. On your own, land a Plesioth with a single rod and deliver 10 Fish Print [Small]. You must reel in the Plesioth without hunting it, absolutely.
26501.descriptionEn:
Fishing: a lonely hunt where you
face the fish in silence. Next,
prove the results of your daily
training. Alone, land one Plesioth
by rod and deliver 10 Fish Prints
[Small]. You must reel in the
Plesioth without ever hunting it.
26501.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。次は日々の
研鑽の積み重ねを証明して貰
おう。一人でガノトトスの一
本釣りと魚拓【小】１０枚の
納品だ。ガノトトスは絶対に
狩らずに釣り上げるんだぞ。

23344.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
23344.description: Lunastra, Queen of the Flame Nation, has appeared at the top of the Old Tower. Her form is enormous, an overwhelming presence such as we have never encountered, and the situation is very dangerous. With access to the site limited, you must slay her alone.
23344.descriptionEn:
The Queen of the Flame Nation,
Lunastra, has appeared atop
the Ancient Tower.
Her form is enormous, with an
overwhelming presence never
met before—a very dangerous
state. Means to reach the site
are limited, so slay her alone.
23344.descriptionJp:
炎国の王妃ナナ・テスカトリ
が古塔の頂部に現れました。
その姿はとても巨大であり、
これまでに遭遇したことが
ない圧倒的な存在感で、非常
に危険な状態です。
現地へ行く手段が限られてい
る為、１人で討伐して下さい。

60550.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Kushala Daora. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60550.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill! Today's
target is Kushala Daora!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take a
top placing!
Also, this time it's Origin
weapons only! Choose wisely!
60550.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪クシャルダオラ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

55148.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の撃退
55148.description: The Emperor-Conquering Dragon wrapped in light, ruling over Kumomi Fortress. The guild has decided to name it the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. Hunter of courage. When you drive it off, you will surely be granted the materials of guild-treasured armor.
55148.descriptionEn:
The Emperor Conquest Dragon who
holds court at Cloud Viewing
Fortress, wrapped in light.
The Guild has decided to name it
"Guanzorumu, Ruler of the Acme".
Hunters of courage —
drive it off, and I will surely
grant you materials for armor
the Guild has long treasured.
55148.descriptionJp:
雲見砦に君臨せし、
光に包まれし帝征龍。
ギルドでは、ヤツの呼称を
「極み統べるグァンゾルム」
とすることにした。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
ヤツを追い払った暁には、
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を
必ず授けよう。

26273.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26273.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26273.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26273.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

22008.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
22008.description: Hunting Iodrome in the volcanic zone may be a little troublesome! A wounded Iodrome may flee into places where a hunter loses stamina fast. The trick is not to let it escape!
22008.descriptionEn:
Hunting ≪Gendrome≫ in the volcano
region may be a bit of a bother!
A Gendrome that has spent its
stamina may flee into nasty spots
that drain a hunter's own stamina!
The trick is not to let it escape!
22008.descriptionJp:
火山地帯で≪ドスイーオス≫
を狩猟するのは、少し面倒か
も知れないです！体力を消耗
したドスイーオスは、狩人が
体力を消耗する、嫌な場所に
逃げ込む可能性があります！
逃さないのがコツですよ！

63213.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Dyuragaua, then slay the Dyuragaua here in this arena!
63213.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill! If you're confident
you can handle an Ice Fox Wyvern
splendidly, step into this Arena
and slay a Duramboros!
63213.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する闘技場！氷狐竜を
相手に、見事立ち回る自信が
ある者はこの闘技場にて
≪デュラガウア≫を討伐
してみせよ！

61416.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐

60308.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種２頭の狩猟
60308.description: A black Diablos with a terrifying appearance has been sighted. The sight of it cutting down its prey with a single powerful blow is feared as like the grim reaper. Is there no hunter to stand against this threat to the Desert?
60308.descriptionEn:
A black Diablos with a terrifying
appearance has been sighted.
It cuts down its prey with a
single mighty blow, and is feared
as "the Grim Reaper" itself.
Is there no hunter to face this
threat to the Desert?
60308.descriptionJp:
恐ろしい容姿の黒いディアブ
ロスが目撃されたわ。
強力な一撃の下に獲物を屠り
さる姿は「死神のようだ」と
恐れられているわ。
この砂漠の脅威に立ち向かう
ハンターはいないかしら。

55154.description: Hi everyone! It is the autumn sports festival! Aim to clear as many as you can while earning rare First Species materials! If you collect the Bond Coins given as rewards, you can draw a lottery for various prizes!
55154.descriptionEn:
Hello everyone!
It's the autumn Sports Festival!
Aim to clear as many as you can
while earning rare Origin Species
materials!
If you collect the ≪Bond Coins≫
given as rewards, you can also
draw a lottery for all sorts of
prizes!
55154.descriptionJp:
はーい皆さん！
秋の大運動会ですよ！
希少な始種素材を獲得しなが
ら、よりたくさんクリアする
のを目指してくださいね！
報酬としてもらえる
「絆のコイン」を集めれば、
いろいろな景品が当たるくじ
も引けますよ！

54869.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
54869.client: Old Man with a Brown Beard
54869.description: I have always held that people show their true strength under harsh conditions. Have you ever taken a blow from an Espinas Subspecies? If you can weather its fierce assault, I will share the finest materials I have gathered.
54869.clientEn: Old Man with a Brown Beard
54869.descriptionEn:
I have always held that people
show their true strength under
the harshest conditions.
Have you ever taken a blow from
an Espinas Subspecies?
If you can weather its savage
assault, I'll share the finest
materials I've collected.
54869.descriptionJp:
人は過酷な条件下である程、
本来の実力を発揮できると
ワシは常々考えておる。
貴様は≪棘茶竜≫の一撃を
喰らったことがあるか？
奴の猛攻を凌ぐことが
できたら、ワシが集めた
トッテオキの素材を
分けてやろう。

63364.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Hunters who are confident they can face 2 black Gypceros loosed into the arena at once and carry out this hunt without faltering, join this quest and display your nerve and skill!!
63364.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill! Face two black
Gypceros loosed into the Arena
at once. Hunters confident they
can carry out this hunt without
hesitation should join this quest
and display their nerve and
their skill!!
63364.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！闘技場に放たれた
黒き毒怪鳥を２頭同時に相手
とし、惑うことなくこの狩猟
を遂行できるという自負を
持つ狩人はこのクエストに
参加し、その胆力と腕を
披露せよ！！

21204.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
21204.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21204.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21204.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54275.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54275.description: A Berukyurosu seems to have appeared in the canyon during the cold season. This could be a chance. Genprey are said to be wandering nearby, but they shouldn't be much trouble. Still, there's no harm in being careful!
54275.descriptionEn:
≪Belkuros≫ has apparently
appeared in the Canyon in
the cold season.
This could be a chance.
≪Genprey≫ are said to roam
the area, but they shouldn't
be much trouble.
Still, caution never hurts!
54275.descriptionJp:
≪ベルキュロス≫が寒冷期の
峡谷に現れたらしい。
これはチャンスかもしれない。
辺りには≪ゲネポス≫が徘徊
しているらしいが、あまり
問題にならないだろう。
しかし、用心するに越した
ことはないぞ！

61101.objectiveJp: 奇面王の悪戯４枚の納品
61101.description: I want to punish the mischievous Chachabu lot. Will you help me collect fragments of the books they dislike? I am searching here too, so drive off the monsters in the Forest while you are at it. Please!
61101.descriptionEn:
I want to teach those mischief-
loving Shakalaka a lesson.
Would you help me collect the
tome fragments they can't stand?
We're searching on our end too,
so while you're at it, chase off
the Great Forest monsters too.
Please!
61101.descriptionJp:
イタズラ好きな奇面族の連中
を懲らしめたいんだ。あいつ
らが苦手らしい書物の断片を
集める手伝いをしてくれない
か？
こっちでも探してるから、
ついでに樹海のモンスターも
追い払って欲しい。頼むよ！

26450.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time we have prepared the volcano field, but the Volcano depths, the lava pool area, are still unexplored and not open. Please note.
26450.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time we have prepared
a Volcano field, but the Volcano
Depths and the lava pool area
are still unexplored and have not
been released. Please be aware.
26450.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は火山フィールドを
用意させていただきましたが、
火山奥地、溶岩池部分はまだ
未探索のため解放されて
おりません。ご注意ください。

26490.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
26490.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke! They say its appearance makes onlookers tremble! But the reason it is called an armored wyvern is that shell protecting its body, no? What do you suppose happens if the armor is broken?
26490.descriptionEn:
A black subspecies of ≪Gravios≫
seems to have appeared amid the
Volcano's smoke!
They say its looks send shivers
through all who see it!
But it's called the Armor Wyvern
for its armor, so what if you break it?
26490.descriptionJp:
火山の噴煙にまみれて≪グラ
ビモス≫の黒い亜種が出現し
たらしいです！その容姿は見
る者を震え上がらせるって！
でも、鎧竜って呼ばれるのは
体を守る鎧があるからよね？
鎧を壊せばどうなのかしら？

26535.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26535.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26535.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26535.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

26379.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
26379.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Low Rank monster with a designated weapon. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26379.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
low rank monsters with
a specified weapon. We have
special rewards ready, so
come and join us!
26379.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、指定
武器での下位モンスターの
討伐となります。特別な報酬
を用意させていただきました
ので、奮ってご参加ください。

56089.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Fury-Faced Wyvern. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56089.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Rage-Faced Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will specially
add developed part materials to
your Another rewards. Note that
slaying alone grants no such
materials, so take care.
56089.descriptionJp:
辿異種の怒貌竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

23613.description: The Variant Species Giaorugu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Giaorugu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23613.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Giaorugu≫
seems to have reached a strength
that puts it at the very top of
all Giaorugu. Its power is
beyond measure. Hunters sure of
their skill to challenge the
summit, please take on the
survey.
23613.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ギアオルグ≫は
ギアオルグの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

21468.objectiveJp: 氷狐竜の上鱗３個の納品
21468.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Ice Fox Wyvern's Fine Scale you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
21468.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon but
I'm short on materials! At this
rate I can't go hunting. Trade
me the ≪Ice Fox Wyvern Fine
Scale≫ you have for this
≪Paw Pad Medal≫! Please!
21468.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいが素材が足
りない！これでは狩りに出ら
れない。キミが持っている
≪氷狐竜の上鱗≫をこの
≪肉球のメダル≫と交換して
くれ！頼む！

62153.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62153.description: The other day, while gathering in the Forest and Hills, I was set upon by 2 Rathalos. I escaped with my life, but I cannot leave that place to them as their territory. Will you not rid us of them? For your trouble, take this Sturdy Jawbone.
62153.descriptionEn:
The other day, while gathering in
the Forest and Hills, two
≪Rathalos≫ attacked me.
I somehow kept my life, but I
cannot leave the Forest and Hills
to those beasts' territory.
Won't you rid us of them?
In thanks, I'll give you this
≪Sturdy Jawbone≫.
62153.descriptionJp:
先日森丘で採取をしていたら、
２頭の≪リオレウス≫に襲わ
れたのだ。わしはなんとか一
命を取り留めたが、いまやそ
いつらの縄張りと化している
森丘をこのまま放っておくこ
とはできぬ。そいつらを退治
してくれないか？お礼に、こ
の≪頑丈な顎骨≫をやろう。

54783.description: Reports say powerful Brachydios are appearing in various regions. The Guild wants them hunted at once, but study of the Brachydios ecology has not progressed. For research, hunt it after severing its tail. Your reward will be increased accordingly.
54783.descriptionEn:
There are reports of powerful
Brachydios appearing all over.
The Guild wants them hunted at
once, but the ecology of this
Brute Wyvern is still unstudied.
For research, sever its tail
before you hunt it.
Your reward will be bumped up
accordingly.
54783.descriptionJp:
各地に強力な砕竜・ブラキ
ディオスが出現していると
報告がありました。
ギルドはただちに狩猟して
ほしいみたいですが、砕竜
の生態は、調査が進んでいま
せん。研究のため、尻尾切断
後に狩猟してください。
その分、報酬ははずみますよ。

23350.description: Residents nearby report that the Gogomoa of Tide Island are causing serious damage. They say the beasts were caught in thread snares the likes of which they had never seen. To put a stop to this, we ask you to hunt the Gogomoa.
23350.descriptionEn:
We have reports from residents
living nearby that they suffer
serious damage from the Gogomoa
on the Tidal Island.
According to them, they were
caught in thread traps never
seen before.
To stop this damage, we ask you
to hunt the Gogomoa.
23350.descriptionJp:
潮島にいるゴゴモアから
深刻な被害を受けていると
近くに住む住民から報告を受
けています。彼らによると
見たこともない糸の罠に
引っかかったとのことです。
この被害を食い止めるため、
ゴゴモアの狩猟をお願いしま
す。

60704.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
60704.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! It's a weaker individual, so the carving contents are a special arrangement! The rewards are the familiar Genki Drinks and coins!
60704.descriptionEn:
Yes! Today I shall hold a
special exercise limited by
weapon, on my own judgment!
Meet the conditions and your
gear and items are up to you!
It's a weaker individual, so the
carves are a special selection!
Rewards are the familiar Energy
Drink and coins!
60704.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
弱めの個体なので、剥ぎ取り
内容は特別仕様でお送りする！
報酬は、おなじみ≪元気ドリ
ンコ≫やコインだぞ！

26509.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

21992.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21992.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Tigrex, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21992.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Palico doing well, meow?
Time to treat your partner right, meow!
Now, to business, meow. This
request is to hunt one Tigrex,
meow.
The reward is crafting materials
for Palico gear, meow!
I'm counting on you, meow!
21992.descriptionJp:
おう！そこの狩人さん！
アンタのパートニャーは元気
かニャ？たまには相棒孝行し
てやるニャ！
では、本題ニャ。今回の依頼
は轟竜１頭の狩猟ニャ。
報酬はパートニャー用武具の
生産素材だニャ！
たのんだニャー！

61304.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61304.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61304.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

22028.description: Congratulations on reaching HR6! Deliver a Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
22028.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR6! Deliver a Map on your
own, clear the quest, and
claim your reward!
22028.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ６達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

62796.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62796.description: You have come into your own, hunter. Is it not time to replace that armor? You will receive the materials for 1 of 5 kinds of armor. Do give it a try! Note that it cannot be taken on consecutively, so be warned.
62796.descriptionEn:
You've become quite a skilled
hunter. Isn't it about time you
got yourself new armor?
You will obtain one of five
types of armor materials.
Please do give it a try!
However, you cannot accept it
consecutively, so please be
careful.
62796.descriptionJp:
凄腕になったハンターさん。
そろそろ防具を新調しては
いかがですか？
５種類の防具の素材のうち、
どれか１種類が手に入ります。
ぜひ、挑戦してみて下さい！
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

61413.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

62847.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・四章１個の納品

40230.description: Hum hum hmm! Become the cute Hatsune Miku and dance with a cute Erupe! Clear this quest and get a Guild Card background! Oops! Do not attack the Erupe by mistake! Put your weapon away! Now then! Let's! Dance!
40230.descriptionEn:
Hm hm hm-hm♪
Become the cute Hatsune Miku and
dance with the cute Elpe!
Clear this quest and you'll get
a Guild Card background!
Whoa! Don't go attacking the
Elpe by mistake!
Keep your weapon put away!
Now then! Let's! Dance!
40230.descriptionJp:
ふんふふふーん♪
可愛い初音ミクになりきって、
可愛いエルペとおどろう！
このクエストをクリアすると
ギルドカード背景が貰えるぞ！
おっと！間違ってもエルペを
攻撃するんじゃないぞ！
武器はしまっておいてくれ！
それでは！レッツ！ダンシン！

54462.objectiveJp: イカリオオマグロ５０匹の納品
54462.description: A giant fish living in the freezing sea, the Anchor Tuna. I heard a rumor that a mysterious creature called Johnny, which loves that Anchor Tuna, has appeared. To investigate Johnny, we need Anchor Tuna in great quantity! Help with the investigation!
54462.descriptionEn:
A giant fish called “Ikario
Tuna” lives in the freezing sea.
I heard a rumor that “Johnny”,
a mysterious creature that
loves to eat Ikario Tuna, has
appeared.
To investigate “Johnny”, we need
a large amount of Ikario Tuna!
Help us with the survey!
54462.descriptionJp:
極寒の海に生息する巨大な魚
「イカリオオマグロ」。その
イカリオオマグロを好物とす
る謎の生物「ジョニー」が出
現したとの噂を耳にした。
「ジョニー」の調査のために
はイカリオオマグロが大量に
必要だ！
調査を手伝ってくれ！

21904.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
21904.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Berukyurosu at the Old Tower. Clear this request and you can obtain the Artisan's Soul needed to upgrade weapons, so do take it on and see it done.
21904.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's daily life,
we've prepared a request to hunt
a Berukyurosu at the Ancient
Tower. Clear this request and
you can obtain the Weaponsmith
Souls needed to upgrade your
weapons, so be sure to take it
and finish the job.
21904.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、古塔で≪舞雷竜≫を
狩猟する依頼を用意しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、武器
の強化に必要な武具職人魂が
入手できますので、ぜひ受注
して依頼を達成しましょう。

53038.description: The other day a female hunter asked me about womanliness. A hunter must be refined enough to learn grace even from a monster's bearing! Hunt a Rathian and learn its elegant movements.
53038.descriptionEn:
The other day a female hunter
came to me for advice about
femininity as a hunter.
A hunter needs the awareness to
learn grace even from how a
monster carries itself!
Hunt a Rathian and come back
having learned its elegant
bearing.
53038.descriptionJp:
この間、ある女性のハンター
さんから、ハンターとしての
女性らしさについて相談を受
けたの。ハンターたるもの、
モンスターの立ち振る舞いか
らも気品を学べる意識の高さ
が必要よね！≪リオレイア≫
を狩猟して、優雅な立ち振る
舞いを学んできてほしいの。

54146.description: We continue the investigation of Pokaradon, lord of the extreme cold sea. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54146.descriptionEn:
The survey of Pokaradon, lord of
the Polar Sea, continues.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we'd be delighted
if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your
continued support!
54146.descriptionJp:
極海の主ポカラドンの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

63273.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
63273.description: Happy New Year! This year we have prepared bamboo, a plant from the East that serves as the production material for a peculiar gunlance of Eastern origin! To hand it over, we ask you to hunt a carapaceon said to be indispensable at Eastern celebrations. We also have the New Year gifts from past years ready!
63273.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year!
This year we've prepared bamboo,
the plant that becomes the
crafting material for a bizarre
Gunlance from the east!
To hand it over, we ask you to
hunt a Carapaceon said to be
essential to eastern celebrations.
We also have last year's New
Year gifts ready!
63273.descriptionJp:
新年おめでとうございます！
今年は東方伝来の奇抜なガン
ランスの生産素材となる植物、
【竹】をご用意しました！
こちらをお渡しするには、東
方では祝いの席に欠かせない
という甲殻種の狩猟をお願い
致します。また、昨年までの
お年玉もご用意しています！

26287.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

23558.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23558.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23558.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

26203.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26203.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26203.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

63223.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63223.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee! I wish you good fortune!
63223.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Use all of your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
Complete this request splendidly
and you will earn an exceptional
reward! I wish you good fortune!
63223.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られるぞ！
健闘を祈る！

62114.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62114.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a two-handed weapon of outstanding destructive power. Take the armor and Hammer prepared for you and hunt the Ice Fox Wyvern Dyuragaua in the New Grand Arena! Watch for your opening and land heavy damage!
62114.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor! This
time you'll hunt with a two-
handed weapon of superb
destructive power.
Take the armor and Hammer
provided and hunt the Ice Fox
Wyvern Duramboros in the New
Great Arena! Watch for your
chances and land huge damage!
62114.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
破壊力抜群の両手武器で狩猟
をしてもらおう。
予め用意された防具と
ハンマーで新大闘技場にいる
氷狐竜≪デュラガウア≫を狩
猟してきたまえ！攻撃チャン
スを伺いつつ、大ダメージを
叩き込んでやれ！

21002.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21002.description: Velocidrome flees to another area when its stamina runs low and recovers there! It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are many Velociprey minions about, so be careful!
21002.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ flees to
another area when worn down
and recovers health there!
It's a fine test of a
hunter's skill, but this
season its Velociprey
underlings are many. Careful!
21002.descriptionJp:
≪ドスランポス≫は体力を
消耗すると別エリアへ逃げて
体力を回復してしまいます！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手ですが
この季節は、子分のランポス
も多いので注意して下さい！

61574.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
61574.description: A request from a certain beastman. He has a friend he wants to see, who is traveling. On the way the friend must pass through the swamp, but two monsters frighten him too much to go on. They're a rough sort, so hunt them carefully!
61574.descriptionEn:
A request from a beastman.
There's a friend he longs to see,
and that friend is traveling.
The road took him through the
Swamp, but two monsters scare
him too much to go on.
They're said to be a rough sort,
so hunt them carefully!
61574.descriptionJp:
ある獣人族からの依頼だ。
会いたくなった友達がいて、
旅をしているらしい。
途中、沼地を通ることになっ
たんだが、２頭のモンスター
が怖くて先に進めないらしい。
少し乱暴なヤツらしいから、
気をつけて狩ってきてくれ！

55953.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Gravios through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Long Sword, Lance, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55953.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade one Supremacy
Gravios weapon from creation to
stage one, plus Polta Card
Sakura worth Gz. The weapon
types available are Sword and
Shield, Dual Blades, Long Sword,
Lance, Gunlance or Switch Axe.
Please make good use of this.
55953.descriptionJp:
辿異種グラビモスの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
片手剣、双剣、太刀、槍、
銃槍、剣斧のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

55307.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
55307.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Vojan, the Crimson Lotus Lion. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55307.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Crimson
Lotus Lion ≪Vojan≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
55307.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、紅蓮獅子
≪ヴォージャン≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21657.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
21657.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Niobe Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21657.descriptionEn:
Notes recording the lost secret
of forging weapons and armor
are being found on monsters
slain across the land, they say!
Once you get the ≪Niobe Memo≫,
come straight to this workshop
head like a man!
I'll show you some good work!
21657.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ニオベーメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

55896.description: We have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket exclusive to the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55896.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a quest where you
can obtain a special
≪Outerwear Release Ticket≫.
Please bring ≪Festival Excitement≫
when accepting or joining.
55896.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の
≪外装解放券≫を獲得できる
クエストを用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫を
お持ちください。

50983.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50983.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50983.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

11037.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石３個の納品
11037.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern! It doesn't just spit poison; it can also release a strong flash that blinds you. If you can destroy its crest, it seems you can stop the flash!
11037.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ is known by
another name: the Poison
Bird! Besides poison, it
can loose a bright flash
that blinds you. If you
break its crest, the flash
should stop, it seems!
11037.descriptionJp:
≪ゲリョス≫は別名、毒怪鳥
と呼ばれるモンスターです！
毒液を吐くだけじゃなく、
目を眩ませる強い閃光を放つ
こともあります。トサカを
破壊できれば閃光を防ぐこと
ができるみたいですよ！

62105.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
62105.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
62105.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
62105.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

50864.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50864.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
50864.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Lance, show me the skill you
have honed against the
≪Giaorugu≫ in the Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.
50864.descriptionJp:
槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55317.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
55317.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55317.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55317.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

58138.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58138.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58138.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58138.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

21440.objectiveJp: さびた板状の塊１個の納品
21440.description: Now for Part Two. From the five kinds including Rusted Fragments, turn in two different kinds than in Part One. The reward is something the alchemy shop master wants so badly his throat aches, for an experiment. What he will do with it, I do not know.
21440.descriptionEn:
Now, Part 2.
From the five kinds such as
rusted chunks, deliver the two
kinds that differ from Part 1.
The reward is an item the
apothecary's master wants so
badly his throat aches for it,
for some experiment of his.
What he'll do with it, I don't know.
21440.descriptionJp:
さて【後編】だ。
さびた塊などの５種類から、
【前編】とは違う２種類を納
品してもらうぞ。
報酬は、調合屋のあるじが
ある実験をしたい為に喉から
手が出るほど欲しがってる一
品だ。これで何をするのかは
知らんがな。

62719.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

28081.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
28081.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28081.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
28081.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

56062.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Baruragaru through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Great Sword, Hammer, Tonfa, Switch Axe, Light Bowgun, or Heavy Bowgun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56062.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade one Supremacy
Baruragaru weapon from creation
to stage two, plus Polta Card
Sakura worth Gz. The weapon
types available are Great Sword,
Hammer, Tonfa, Switch Axe,
Light Bowgun or Heavy Bowgun.
Please make good use of this.
56062.descriptionJp:
辿異種バルラガルの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、大剣、鎚、
穿龍棍、剣斧、軽弩、重弩
のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

63254.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63254.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63254.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63254.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

20003.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
20003.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The flame wyvern Teostra has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and drive the elder dragon off, we beg of you!
20003.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Office!
Teostra the Flame King Dragon
has invaded Dundorma's lands!
Dundorma now enters its Elder
Dragon interception stance!
Please use the interception gear
set up in the sector to repel
the Elder Dragon!
20003.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
ドンドルマの領内に炎王龍
テオ・テスカトルが侵入しま
した！これよりドンドルマは
古龍の迎撃体制に入ります！
迎撃区画に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を撃退して頂
けますようお願い致します！

55808.description: By completing this request, you can obtain the layered armor release tickets for the Bonne D Series, the layered armor of the Bonne G Series. Bonne Release Ticket D x5.
55808.descriptionEn:
By clearing this request, you
can obtain the layered armor
release tickets for the Bonne D
Series, the layered version of
the Bonne G Series.
- Bonne Release Ticket D x5
55808.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成することで、
≪ボンネＧシリーズ≫の
外装である≪ボンネＤ
シリーズ≫の外装解放券を
入手することができます。
・ボンネ解放券Ｄ５枚

54880.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
54880.description: Please cooperate with the investigation of the Valsaburos lurking in the decisive battlefield! If you not only slay it but also break its horns and sever its tail, we will add to the reward. Please lend us your strength in our research!
54880.descriptionEn:
We request your aid in a survey
of the Varusaburosu lurking in
the Battlefield!
Break its horns and sever its
tail as well as slaying it, and
we will add a bonus to your
reward. Please lend your
strength to our research!
54880.descriptionJp:
決戦場に潜む≪炎角竜≫の
調査にご協力をお願いします！
討伐するだけでなく≪炎角竜≫
の角破壊と尻尾切断をして
くれたら報酬を上乗せいたし
ます。どうか我々の研究に力
を貸してください！

23603.objectiveJp: ディスフィロア１体の討伐
23603.description: A report has come from an investigator that the moon over the farthest land has turned a ghastly deep crimson. The Guild takes this abnormal phenomenon as an unprecedented omen and has decided to send battle-hardened hunters. Depart for the site at once and ascertain the mystery of the crimson moon.
23603.descriptionEn:
A report has arrived from our
researchers that the moon over
the farthest land has turned a
horrifying deep crimson.
The Guild takes this anomaly as
an omen like no other, and has
decided to send veteran hunters.
Depart for the site at once and
uncover the mystery of the
crimson moon.
23603.descriptionJp:
最果ての地の月が
おぞましいほどの深紅色に
染まったとの報告が、
調査員より届きました。
ギルドはこの異常現象を
かつてない凶兆と捉え、
歴戦のハンターを向かわせ
ることを決定しました。
至急、現地へ出発し、紅月の
謎を突き止めてください。

55149.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
55149.description: The survey team that went to the desert has sighted Odibatorasu. It is smaller than any individual observed so far, but reports also say it possesses power equal to or greater than the usual. Watch the monster's behaviour when you head out to slay it.
55149.descriptionEn:
The survey team sent to the
Desert has sighted an
Odibatorasu. It is smaller than
any individual observed so far,
but reports say it holds power
equal to or greater than normal.
When you set out to slay it,
watch its behavior carefully.
55149.descriptionJp:
砂漠に向かった調査団より、
≪弩岩竜≫の目撃情報があり
ました。今まで観測された
どの個体よりも小さいですが、
通常と同等かそれ以上の力を
持っていると報告も上がって
います。討伐に向かう際は
モンスターの行動に気を付け
て下さい。

54206.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54206.client: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang
54206.clientEn: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang

21458.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Plesioth. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21458.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest to slay
a ≪Plesioth≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
fellow hunters?
21458.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ガノトトス≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

58093.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58093.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58093.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58093.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

53135.description: Everyone! You are in burning love! Gentlemen and ladies alike, use blazing hot weapons and make the Conga yelp! There seems to be a big monster too, but with your hearts you will be fine!
53135.descriptionEn:
Everyone! You're burning with
passionate love!!
Boys and girls alike, take your
blazing, heated weapons and make
those Conga scream! ow ow ow!
Seems there's a big monster
around too, but with hearts like
yours, you'll be just fine!
53135.descriptionJp:
みんな！燃えるような恋を
しているね！！
男子諸君も女子諸君も、
燃え盛るヒートな武器で
コンガたちをアチチにして
くれ！どうやらビッグな
モンスターもいるようだが
諸君らのハートなら
きっと大丈夫さ！

54897.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
54897.description: We continue the investigation of the Yian Kut-Ku Subspecies. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54897.descriptionEn:
The survey of the Yian Kut-Ku
Subspecies continues.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we'd be delighted
if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your
continued support!
54897.descriptionJp:
イャンクック亜種の調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

60806.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60806.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60806.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50527.description: So you strengthened it into the Absurou Blade. They say that one nests with the fire wyverns of the Old Tower. And just now I heard talk of a monster that fits. No proof yet. Sorry to put you to the trouble, but I want you to go and investigate.
50527.descriptionEn:
So you upgraded it into the
≪Abyssal Blade≫, I see.
They say it's a fire wyvern
that dens in the Old Tower.
And just now I caught word
of a monster fitting that
description. Nothing certain
yet. Sorry for the trouble,
but go and investigate.
50527.descriptionJp:
≪アブスロウブレイド≫に
強化してくれたのだな。
奴は古塔をねぐらとしている
火竜の類と聞く。
そして、今しがたそれらしい
モンスターの話を耳にした。
確証はまだない。手間をかけ
させてすまないが、調査にむ
かってほしい。

55560.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55560.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55560.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Long Sword, face the Tigrex in
the Desert and show me the skill
you have forged!
If you can hunt it splendidly,
you shall earn a reward far
beyond what your daily efforts
would bring.
55560.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

23384.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
23384.description: A black-bodied subspecies of Diablos was sighted during the survey of White Lake. We ask you to hunt the creature before the surveyors come to harm. Beware the ferocious strike from underground delivered with those two horns.
23384.descriptionEn:
During a survey of White Lake,
a black-bodied subspecies of
≪Diablos≫ was sighted.
Before the surveyors come to
harm, please hunt the target.
Take great care against the
ferocious strike from underground
by its two horns.
23384.descriptionJp:
白湖の調査中に黒い体色を
持つ≪ディアブロス≫の亜種
が目撃されました。調査員に
被害が及ぶ前に、対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
二本の角による地中からの
強烈な一撃に十分注意して
下さい。

23515.description: There has been a sighting of Zenaserisu at Prismatic Falls at night. Encounters are still few and it is a valuable subject for study. Head there at once and begin the survey.
23515.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of
≪Zenaserisu≫ at the nighttime
Waterfall of Colors.
Encounters are still few, making
it a precious subject of study.
Head there at once and begin.
23515.descriptionJp:
夜の彩の滝で≪ゼナセリス≫
の目撃情報がありました。
まだ、遭遇報告も少なく
貴重な調査対象となります。
至急、現地へ向かい調査を
開始してください。

26551.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
26551.description: The Gurenzeburu confirmed on the highlands, which is the target of this request, has been given the name Gurenzeburu by the Hunters Guild. It is an extremely fierce and powerful flying wyvern suited to the peculiar environment of the highlands, so face it fully prepared!
26551.descriptionEn:
The target of this request is
the ≪Barbarian Wyvern≫ found in
the Highlands, which the Hunters
Guild has named ≪Gurenzeburu≫.
It is an extremely wild and
powerful flying wyvern suited to
the Highlands' unique climate,
so challenge it fully prepared!
26551.descriptionJp:
今回の依頼の対象となる、
高地で確認された≪蛮竜≫で
すが、ハンターズギルドでは
これを≪グレンゼブル≫と
名付けました。非常に荒々し
く、高地特有の環境にも適し
た強力な飛竜ですので万全の
態勢で挑んでください！

23403.description: I have received a report that a Doragyurosu was found in the highlands. However, it apparently performs special behavior not recorded in any report to date. Please do investigate the Doragyurosu.
23403.descriptionEn:
We received a report that a
≪Dark Thunder Wyvern≫ was
found in the Highlands.
However, it apparently behaves
in special ways not recorded in
any report so far. We would very
much like you to survey ≪Diorex≫.
23403.descriptionJp:
高地に≪冥雷竜≫を発見した
との報告を受けた。
しかし、今までの報告書に
載っていない特殊な行動を
行うらしい。
是非、≪冥雷竜≫の調査を
お願いしたい。

26506.objectiveJp: エールナッツ５０個の納品
26506.description: Are you gathering today as well? You do not need tools, but you do want to mind your equipment. Now then, a new gathering request. Hmm, it may be a little tough this time too, but do your best. Of course I will give you a reward.
26506.descriptionEn:
Are you gathering today as well?
Since you don't need tools, you
want to be careful with equipment.
Now then, a new gathering request.
Hmm, this one may be a bit hard
again, but please do your best.
Of course, I will hand over your
reward.
26506.descriptionJp:
今日も採取をしていますか？
道具を必要としない代わりに、
装備に気を使いたいですよね。
さて、新しい採取の依頼です。
んー、今回も少し大変かも
しれませんが頑張ってくださ
いね。もちろん報酬はお渡し
しますから。

62788.objectiveJp: ハンターカード青１０枚納品
62788.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62788.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
62788.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

26487.description: If you're going after Basarios, it's best to search the rocky areas! It often hides by blending in with the rocks! If you plan to do some mining, by all means deliver Coal! It's a prized energy source!
26487.descriptionEn:
If you're going after a
≪Basarios≫, try searching the
rocky areas! It often hides
among the rocks, you see.
If you plan to mine, then by
all means deliver ≪Coal≫!
It's a prized energy source,
that stuff!
26487.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫の狩猟に臨む
なら岩場から探してみるとい
いですよ！岩に紛れて隠れて
るケースが多いですからね！
採掘をする予定があるなら
是非とも≪燃石炭≫を納品し
てく下さい！エネルギー源と
して重宝される品なんです！

58013.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58013.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58013.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58013.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

26706.description: An urgent report has come from a surveyor. In the highlands, a monster no one has ever seen has been found. It has a long neck and tail, sturdy limbs, and no wings. Its back is hardened and appears to sprout crystals. Much remains unexplained, so investigate with care.
26706.descriptionEn:
An urgent report came from a
surveyor. A monster no one has
ever seen was found in the Highlands.
It has a long neck and tail,
sturdy limbs, and no wings.
Its back is hardened, and looks
as if crystals grow from it.
Much is still unexplained, so
survey it with care.
26706.descriptionJp:
調査員から緊急報告があった。
高地で誰も見たことのない、
モンスターを発見とのこと。
首と尻尾が長く、強靭な四肢
があり、翼はないそうだ。
背面は硬質化しており、水晶
が生えているように見える。
まだ、未解明な点も多いので、
注意して調査してくれ。

21218.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21218.descriptionEn:
