12065.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke. Its appearance seems to make onlookers tremble. But the reason it is called an armored wyvern is that shell protecting its body, no? I wonder what happens if the armor is broken.
12065.descriptionEn:
A black subspecies of Gravios seems to
have appeared amid the Volcano's smoke.
Its appearance must make all who
see it tremble.
But it is called the Armor Wyvern
because of the armor guarding its body,
right? So what happens if we break it?
12065.descriptionJp:
火山の噴煙にまみれて≪グラ
ビモス≫の黒い亜種が出現し
たらしいわ。その容姿は見る
者を震え上がらせるようね。
でも、鎧竜って呼ばれるのは
体を守る鎧があるからよね？
鎧を壊せばどうなのかしら？

23560.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
23560.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23560.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23560.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

51015.description: A request that lets hunters who have reached HR5 forge the highly recommended Migrant gear, the "Narga Series". Breaking the Nargacuga's head and severing its tail are required, but you will get plenty of materials.
51015.descriptionEn:
A request that lets hunters who
have reached HR5 forge the
highly recommended Migrant gear,
the "Narga Series".
Breaking the Nargacuga's head and
severing its tail are required,
but you will get plenty of materials.
51015.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ５になったハンターに
イチオシの遷悠武具
「ナルガシリーズ」が
生産できる依頼です。
ナルガクルガの頭部破壊と
尻尾切断が必須ですが
十分な素材が入手できます。

56109.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐

61711.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

62347.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62347.description: This is the practice final quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The clear reward does not include materials from the target monster.
62347.descriptionEn:
This is the practice final quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament. The clear reward
does not include materials from
the target monster.
62347.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。クエストの
クリア報酬で、対象モンス
ターの素材は入手できません。

55785.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
55785.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further their recognition and promotion. By breaking the Teostra's head, we will also grant you special food ingredients.
55785.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared this
quest to further their recognition
and promotion.
By breaking the Teostra's head, we
will also grant you special food
ingredients.
55785.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
炎王龍の頭部を破壊す
ることで特別な食材も付与さ
せていただきます。

50697.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50697.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of an Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
50697.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Espinas's horn,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50697.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
棘竜の角を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

23672.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Espinas. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23672.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
monster ≪Espinas≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
23672.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪エスピナス≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50903.description: We present a request that lets you obtain in one go the rare materials of Aberrant individuals needed to upgrade the Frost King Wyvern's Heavenstorm armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50903.descriptionEn:
The number of accepts per day is
limited, but let me introduce a
request that lets you get in one go
the ≪rare materials of a special
individual≫ needed to upgrade the
Frozen King Dragon's ≪Tenran Armor≫.
Please take this chance and try it!
50903.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、凍王龍の≪天嵐
防具≫の強化に必要な≪特異
個体の希少素材≫をまとめて
入手できる依頼をご紹介しま
す。
この機会にぜひチャレンジし
てください！

22125.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
22125.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. The reward is rare decoration materials.
22125.descriptionEn:
The ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫, which
had only been sighted now and then,
has expanded its territory to the
areas where people travel. To
prevent further damage, please
hunt the target.
The reward is a rare decoration
material.
22125.descriptionJp:
ときおり目撃されていた
≪照雷鳥≫が、人の通る
辺りまで縄張りを広げて
きました。これ以上の
被害を防ぐため、対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材
です。

26688.description: Mm, it is I! This quest has the same contents as the one every hunter experiences on first coming to Mezeporta. However! The reward is cheap, and the target Gogo Moa is stronger! Treat it as review and try it!
26688.descriptionEn:
Indeed, it is I!
This quest has the same content as
the one every hunter experienced
when they first came to Mezeporta.
However! The reward is cheap, and
the target ≪Gogomoa≫ has grown
stronger than before.
Try it as a refresher!
26688.descriptionJp:
うむ、我輩だ！
このクエストは、ハンターが
初めてメゼポルタに来たら
必ず体験してもらったものと
同じ内容になっている。
しかし！報酬面は安く、ター
ゲットである≪ゴゴモア≫の
強さは強くなっているぞ。
復習も兼ねてトライだ！

50805.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50805.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
50805.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

62059.description: G-go to the Forest. Go to the Forest and hunt an Espinas! Ah, that is no ordinary Espinas. It is not a subspecies or a rare species, but something was definitely different. I will give you the strange material I picked up there, so please!
62059.descriptionEn:
G-go to the Great Forest. Head
out and hunt an ≪Espinas≫ for
me! Ah, but that is no ordinary
≪Espinas≫. It is not a
subspecies or a rare species,
but something was absolutely
wrong with it. I will give you
the strange material I picked
up out there, so please go!
62059.descriptionJp:
じゅ、樹海へ。樹海に行って
≪エスピナス≫を狩猟してき
てくれ！あ、あれはただの
≪エスピナス≫じゃない。
亜種や希少種じゃないんだけ
ど、絶対に何かが違ったんだ。
現地で拾った変わった素材を
あげるから頼むよ！

62201.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Lunastra. If you succeed in repelling it, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62201.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request. We are
seeking someone to eliminate an
extremely powerful ≪Lunastra≫.
If you succeed in repelling it, we
will issue more slaying certificates
than usual!
We await your bold application.
62201.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ナナ・テスカトリ≫の個体
を退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に撃退で
きましたら、普段よりも多め
の討伐の証を発行いたしま
しょう！

23331.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Pokaradon, the Frozen Sea Beast. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23331.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the frozen sea
beast ≪Pokaradon≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
23331.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、凍海獣
≪ポカラドン≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54566.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
54566.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54566.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54566.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54423.description: We are investigating the Resounding Wolf that appears in the swamp, its limbs covered in ice. Its ecology is still unexplained. Please hunt it and lend us your strength in our research!
54423.descriptionEn:
We are surveying the ≪Orugaron≫
whose limbs are covered in ice,
which appears in the Swamp.
Its ecology is still largely unknown.
Please hunt it and lend your
strength to our research!
54423.descriptionJp:
沼地に現れる、手足が氷で覆
われた≪響狼≫の調査を行っ
ています。
その生態はまだまだ未解明。
どうか狩猟を行い、我々の研
究に力を貸してください！

23715.description: The Variant Species Baruragaru has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23715.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Baruragaru≫ has grown
fiercely strong and continues to
rampage.
As things stand it is highly dangerous.
Please make full preparations before
you begin the survey.
23715.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪バルラガル≫は猛烈
な強さとなり、暴れ続けてい
ます。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

26040.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26040.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26040.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

21053.description: If you're hit by a Conga's flatulence you won't be able to use healing items! If you get smelly, use a Deodorant to take the stench off your body!
21053.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Conga≫ fart
and you can't use healing
items! If you get smelly,
use a ≪Deodorant≫ to clear
the stink off yourself!
21053.descriptionJp:
≪コンガ≫のオナラに当たる
と回復系のアイテムが使えな
くなりますよ！臭くなったら
≪消臭玉≫で身体についた
匂いを消して下さいね！

50452.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

22121.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐

21205.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21205.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21205.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

21703.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
21703.description: Thanks for playing MHF for five whole years! Equip Akra Vantoana and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude N as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude N you can forge Dancing Thunder Claw (Long Sword).
21703.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for five whole years!
Equip ≪Akra Vantoana≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude N≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
N≫ you can forge ≪Dancing
Thunder Claw≫ (Long Sword).
21703.descriptionJp:
５年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪アクラヴァントアナー≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると
≪感謝の証N≫を１１枚
プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証N≫から
≪名刀・舞雷乃爪≫（太刀）
が生産可能です。

54153.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
54153.description: We are seeking hunters to hunt the Pariapuria lurking in the Canyon! If the hunt proves difficult, you may slay Great Thunderbugs and return, no problem.
54153.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters to hunt
the Pariapuria lurking in the Canyon!
If hunting it is too difficult, you
may slay Great Thunderbugs and
return instead. That is no problem.
54153.descriptionJp:
峡谷に潜む呑竜を狩猟してい
ただけるハンターを募集中で
す！
狩猟が難しい場合は大雷光虫
を討伐してご帰還いただいて
も問題ございません。

11086.description: For hunters who want to make ore weapons, mining is the very basics! First, start by learning where you can mine. If you find cracks in a cliff, try digging with a Pickaxe!
11086.descriptionEn:
For hunters who want to make ore
type weapons, mining is the very
basics of the basics!
First, let us start by learning where
you can mine.
If you find cracks in a cliff or
similar, try digging with a
≪Pickaxe≫!
11086.descriptionJp:
鉱石系武器を作りたいハンタ
ーにとって採掘は基本中の基
本ですよ！
まずは、採掘できる場所を知
ることから始めましょう。
崖などにヒビ割れを見つけた
ら、≪ピッケル≫で掘ってみ
てください！

26192.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26192.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26192.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

54929.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please slay Rebidiora.
54929.descriptionEn:
The ≪Secret Art Armor≫ that hunters
who master their weapon receive.
The Guild has long offered various
forms of support, but this time we
will provide extremely rare G Rank
materials for those aiming higher.
In exchange, we ask that you slay
the Thunder Extreme Dragon for
our research.
54929.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、
雷極龍の討伐をお願いします。

60619.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60619.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60619.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

11096.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
11096.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
11096.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!
11096.descriptionJp:
≪シビレ罠≫や≪落とし穴≫
をモンスターの足元に設置す
れば動きを封じることができ
るんです！
それに、モンスターが弱った
ところを捕らえて≪捕獲用麻
酔玉≫で眠らせれば捕獲する
こともできちゃうスグレモノ
なんですよ！

55612.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55612.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55612.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

1023.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
1023.description: Cephalos swim freely through the sand, and hunting them is hard work at the best of times. As for the chief, Cephadrome, it is no exaggeration to call it a battle of patience! Drag it up out of the sand with loud noises and impacts and fight it there!
1023.descriptionEn:
The Cephalos that swim freely
through the sand are a pain to hunt,
and as for the boss ≪Cephadrome≫,
it's no exaggeration to call it
a battle of patience!
Draw it above ground with loud
noises and impacts, then fight!
1023.descriptionJp:
砂の中を自在に泳ぐガレオス
たちは、とにかく狩猟が大変
で、親玉の≪ドスガレオス≫
ときたら、それはもう根気と
の戦いといっても過言じゃ
ないね！大きな音や衝撃で
地上に引き出して戦うんだ！

55946.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55946.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55946.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

26747.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26747.description: Thanks for playing MHF for five whole years! Equip Akra Tsinie and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude N as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude N you can forge Dancing Thunder Claw (Long Sword).
26747.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for five whole years!
Equip ≪Akra Tsinie≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude N≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
N≫ you can forge ≪Dancing
Thunder Claw≫ (Long Sword).
26747.descriptionJp:
５年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪アクラツィーニー≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると
≪感謝の証N≫を１１枚
プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証N≫から
≪名刀・舞雷乃爪≫（太刀）
が生産可能です。

54168.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
54168.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54168.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54168.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54446.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
54446.description: While exploring the Jungle I found a poison bird wyvern different from the usual kind. From the moment we met it repeated utterly outrageous behavior beyond all norms, and we could not handle it. Thinking you will help our survey, would you hunt this monster?
54446.descriptionEn:
While exploring the Jungle, we found
a Gypceros unlike the normal kind.
From the moment we met, it kept up
a stream of utterly outrageous behavior
beyond all norms, and we could not
handle it ourselves.
If you would lend us your aid in our
survey, would you hunt this monster
for us?
54446.descriptionJp:
密林の探索中に通常の種と
は違った毒怪鳥を見つけま
した。出会い頭、突拍子も
ない規格外の行動を繰り返す
為、私たちでは手に負えま
せんでした。
私たちの調査に協力すると
思って、このモンスターを
狩猟してくれませんか？

26540.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26540.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that
Variants are a nightmare because
their sacs are hard to carve.
So I'll quickly carve the sacs for
you, and you folks just make sure
to bag the prey properly.
I added a sub-target so carving
goes easier, so do me that favor!
26540.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
サブターゲットもつけたから
よろしくな！

61773.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61773.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61773.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54912.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Meraginasu, the Black Piercing Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54912.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the black-piercing
wyvern ≪Meraginasu≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
54912.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、黒穿竜
≪メラギナス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55011.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
55011.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55011.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55011.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

50620.description: This is the preliminary quest for the Idaten Cup Champion Tournament, PS Vita edition. The time limit is 10 minutes.
50620.descriptionEn:
Idaten Cup
Champion Tournament
@ PS Vita Version
qualifying quest.
Time limit is 10 minutes.
50620.descriptionJp:
韋駄天杯
チャンピオントーナメント
＠PS Vita版
の予選クエストです。
制限時間は１０分です。

61432.objectiveJp: チャチャブー２０匹の討伐

61550.objectiveJp: カフの素・緑１０個の納品
61550.description: Ye who are strong. Will you not submit to me the thing that serves as proof? Then I shall give you proof of power. And clad in that proof, I very much want you to go out hunting! Is it only I who thinks so?
61550.descriptionEn:
You who are strong.
Won't you present me with something
to serve as proof?
If you do, I shall give you the
Proof of Power.
And then, clad in that proof,
I hope you go out hunting!
Is it only I who thinks so?
61550.descriptionJp:
強き者よ。
私に証拠となるモノを提出し
てくれないか。
さすれば、チカラの証を
渡そう。
そして、その証を身に纏い、
ぜひ狩りに出かけてほしい！
そう思うのは、私だけか？

60243.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
60243.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Toridokuresu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60243.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is ≪Toridcless≫!
You are to achieve the goal together
with your Guild mates.
This contest is all about teamwork,
so try to take a place among the
top ranks!
Also, this time is SP weapons only!
Choose your weapon with care!
60243.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪トリドクレス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

61518.description: I heard lately that a Gougarf swallowed something big. But it seems the thing is heavy and it cannot spit it out. The request is for you to get hold of it somehow. I have the next preparation to see to, so I have gone on ahead to the sea of trees.
61518.descriptionEn:
I heard recently that a Pariapuria
swallowed something big.
But the thing is so heavy that it
can't spit it out, apparently.
The request is for you to get that
thing for us somehow.
I have preparations to make, so
I'm heading to the Great Forest
ahead of you.
61518.descriptionJp:
最近、呑竜が何やら大きな
モノを呑み込んだという話を
聞いたんだ。
しかし、モノが重たいから
吐き出せないらしい。そいつ
をどうにかして入手してきて
くれってのが依頼内容だ。
俺は次の準備があるから、
一足先に樹海へ行ってるぜ。

55505.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
55505.description: If you bring a Secret Bag, I will give you a chance at a special reward. For a Blademaster like you, it is a special reward you could not normally wear, so please do join.
55505.descriptionEn:
If you bring me the Secret Pouch,
I will give you a chance to obtain
a special reward.
For a blademaster like you, it is
a special reward you could never
normally wear, so please do join us.
55505.descriptionJp:
秘袋を頂けたら、
あなた様に特別な報酬を
取得するチャンスを与えます。
剣士のあなた様にとっては、
普段着ることのできない
特別な報酬となっております
ので、是非ご参加下さい。

60062.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62384.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の討伐
62384.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62384.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!
62384.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を猟団の仲間と行う
のだ。支給品も一切用意
しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

60303.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の狩猟
60303.description: A report has come in that hunters who headed for the Snowy Mountains were beaten back by 2 Tigrex! Brave hunters confident in their skill, set out to rescue the injured and hunt the Tigrex!
60303.descriptionEn:
We have a report that hunters who
headed to the Snowy Mountains were
beaten back by 2 ≪Tigrex≫!
Brave hunters confident in their
skill, set out to rescue the wounded
and hunt the Tigrex!
60303.descriptionJp:
雪山に向かったハンター達が
２頭の≪轟竜≫の返り討ちに
あったとの報告が入った！
腕に覚えのある、勇敢なハン
ターは、負傷者の救出および、
轟竜の狩猟に向かうのじゃ！

62293.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62293.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62293.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62293.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

50644.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
50644.description: Hunter who would master the light bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Pariapuria on Tide Island! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50644.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Light Bowgun, show the skill you
have honed against the ≪Pariapuria≫
of the Tidal Island!
If you hunt it in fine style, you
will earn even more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
50644.descriptionJp:
軽弩を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪呑竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

63271.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
63271.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Gurenzeburu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63271.descriptionEn:
An emergency request. We are
seeking someone to eliminate an
extremely powerful ≪Gurenzeburu≫.
If you hunt it successfully, we will
issue more Proofs of Slay than
usual!
63271.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪グレンゼブル≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に狩猟
できましたら、普段よりも
多めに討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

55440.description: There has been a sighting of the scorching-zero dragon at the summit of the Tower. The report describes a white body wreathed in ice and flame. As it remains a monster of many mysteries, G-rank hunters confident in their skill should head out to investigate.
55440.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of the
≪Scorching Zero Dragon≫ at the
Tower's summit.
The report states that it has a white
body wreathed in ice and flame.
As it is still a monster full of mystery,
G Rank hunters confident in their skill
should head out to survey it.
55440.descriptionJp:
塔の頂部にて≪灼零龍≫の
目撃情報がありました。
報告書には、白い身体に氷と
炎を纏っていると記載されて
います。未だ謎の多いモンス
ターのため、腕に自信のある
Ｇ級ハンターは調査へ向かっ
てください。

61561.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン青３個の納品
61561.description: A quest reserved for the 3rd Place server. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Blue) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61561.descriptionEn:
[3rd Place] This is a server-exclusive
quest.
We have prepared an exclusive reward
for hunters who cleared the Guild
Competition Idaten Cup.
The more Hunter Coins Blue you
deliver, the better your chance at
rare materials.
61561.descriptionJp:
【３位】サーバー専用の
クエストです。
猟団対抗韋駄天杯をクリアさ
れたハンターに専用の報酬を
用意させていただきました。
ハンターコイン青の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

60029.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

28092.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28092.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
28092.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

50587.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50587.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the claws of a Congalala will also grant a special ingredient.
50587.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Congalala's claws,
we will also grant you
some special ingredients
as an extra reward.
50587.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
桃毛獣の爪を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

55740.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55740.description: Good evening, I am Orihime. Every night I look up at the sky and wait for the Tanabata star festival. Cannot find his heart? Talk with him often, read his intent, and find the heart of a man. And praise him.
55740.descriptionEn:
Good evening, this is Orihime.
Every night I look up at the sky
and wait for the day of Tanabata
to come.
You can't find his heart?
Talk with him often, read his
intentions and find that man's heart.
And be sure to praise him.
55740.descriptionJp:
こんばんは、オリヒメです。
毎日夜空を見上げては、
七夕の日が来るのを待って
るの。
彼の心が見つからない？
よく会話して意図を汲み取っ
て男心を見つけてあげるの。
そして褒めてあげることよ。

60809.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. This time the reward is a Flying Wyvern Tail L! Bring the specified number of Capture Certificates yourself.
60809.descriptionEn:
The Hunting Guild offers rewards
to hunters who capture many
Variants and Kishu.
This time: Flying Wyvern Tail L!
Bring the required number of
Capture Certificates alone.
60809.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
今回の報酬は飛竜種の尾L！
指定枚数の捕獲保証書を１人
でお持ちください。

58055.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58055.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58055.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58055.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

54495.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54495.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54495.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54495.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

60819.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60819.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly.
60819.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that Variants
are a real pain for hunters, since
their sacs are so hard to carve.
So I'll strip those sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure you bring the
quarry down properly, got it.
60819.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさんたち
は、しっかり獲物をしとめて
くるんだぜ。

54293.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
54293.description: A Gravios Subspecies has appeared in the area under survey. Many hunters are responding, but resistance is fierce and the situation very dangerous. Other monsters are gathering too. Head there at once.
54293.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
Black Gravios has appeared in the
area under survey. Many hunters
are already responding, but they
are meeting fierce resistance and
the situation is extremely dangerous.
There are also reports that other
monsters are gathering there.
Please head for the site at once.
54293.descriptionJp:
グラビモス亜種が調査中の
地域に現れたとの報告があ
りました。多くのハンター
が対応に当たっているとの
ことですが、激しい抵抗に
合い非常に危険な状態です。
他のモンスターも集まって
きているとの報告もあります。
至急、現地に向かってくださ
い。

26058.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26058.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26058.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26058.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

62947.description: Do you like flowers? Flowers have a healing effect. Wouldn't you like Gook to rest easy in such a soothing space? If you bring me bright, cheerful grass and mushrooms for the space's staging, I'll trade you this blueprint.
62947.descriptionEn:
Do you like flowers?
Flowers have a healing effect.
Wouldn't you want your Gook to rest
easy in a healing space like that?
If you bring me bright, cheerful
herbs and mushrooms to set the
scene, I'll trade you this
blueprint.
62947.descriptionJp:
あなた、花は好きかしら？
花には癒しの効果があるのよ。
グークにそんな癒しの空間で
ゆっくり休んで欲しくない？
明るく元気の出るような草と
空間演出のためのキノコを
持ってきてくれるのであれば
この図面と交換してあげるわ。

50551.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
50551.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for a hunter to slay the Garubadaora that appeared suddenly. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50551.descriptionEn:
An emergency request.
We are seeking hunters to slay the
≪Garuba Daora≫ that appeared
suddenly.
If you slay it successfully, we will
issue more Proofs of Slay than usual!
50551.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。
突如現れた≪ガルバダオラ≫
を討伐してくださるハンター
を募集しています。
見事、討伐できましたら、
普段よりも多めに討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

55958.description: Papa and mama are fighting, so I am making a stuffed toy to help them make up. I do not have enough Gougarufu materials, so I want to gather lots. Please do not slay them, it would be sad. I will give you my treasure as a thank you.
55958.descriptionEn:
Papa and Mama are fighting, so
I'm making a stuffed toy to help
them make up.
I don't have enough Gougarf
materials, so I want to gather lots.
They'd be pitiful, so please don't
slay them.
As a thank-you, I'll give you my
treasure.
55958.descriptionJp:
ぱぱとままがけんかしていて
なかなおりさせるのに
ぬいぐるみをつくっているの。
ごうがるふのそざいが
たりないのでいっぱいあつめ
たいの。かわいそうなので、
とうばつしないでください。
おれいに、わたしのたから
ものをあげます。

62286.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退

54626.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54626.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54626.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54626.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

63065.description: When enough coincidences pile up, it may fairly be called fate. In this quest, please do your best to cooperate, to trust, and to recognize one another. Carve the bond between you, which will never fade, into your hearts.
63065.descriptionEn:
When many coincidences pile up,
it would no longer be wrong to
call it fate.
In this quest, please do your best
to cooperate, to trust, and to
acknowledge one another.
Carve the bond between you, one that
will never fade, into your hearts.
63065.descriptionJp:
多くの偶然が重なれば、最早
それは運命と呼んでも差し支
えないことでしょう。
このクエストでは協力と信頼、
そしてお互いを認めあえるよ
う頑張ってくださいね。
あなた達の決して色褪せない
絆を心に刻んでください。

22001.description: A gathering request in the Highlands, an untrodden mountain region. Gathering unknown materials in an untrodden land. How about it? Even if not hunting, a hunter would be intrigued, no? Well, go and see.
22001.descriptionEn:
An unexplored mountain range —
the ≪Highlands≫. A gathering
request for unknown materials
from untouched land. Well? Even
without hunting, any Hunter
would be intrigued, no? Try it.
22001.descriptionJp:
未踏の山岳地帯、≪高地≫
での採取依頼だ。未踏の大地
での、未知の素材の採取。
どうだ？ハンターとしては
狩猟でなくても興味津津だろ
う？まぁいってみるといいさ。

21929.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟

53275.description: I have finally found the phantom fruit! A vivid color and a shape all its own. A truly perfect fruit! If you want this phantom fruit, let us trade for it at Portane in the Rainbow Falls! Gathering is a fine job for a hunter too! I am counting on you!
53275.descriptionEn:
I finally found the phantom fruit!
Vivid color and a distinctive shape.
A truly perfect fruit!
If you want this phantom fruit,
why not trade me the "Portane" from
the Rainbow Falls!
Gathering is a fine hunter's job too,
you know! I'm counting on you!
53275.descriptionJp:
遂に幻の果実を見つけたよ！
鮮やかな色に特徴的な形。
まさに完璧な果実さ！
この幻の果実が欲しければ、
彩の滝にある「ポルタネ」と
交換しようじゃないか！
採集もハンターの立派な仕事
だからね！頼んだよ！

54635.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

50035.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50035.description: We have received reports that Teostra has appeared in the volcano. Several hunters have been sent before, but none have produced results. For that reason this request comes with a number of conditions. It is a difficult task, and we have prepared a reward to match. We thank you in advance.
50035.descriptionEn:
A report has arrived that Teostra
has appeared in the Volcano.
We have sent hunters there several
times already, but no results have
been achieved.
For that reason, we have set several
conditions on this request.
It is a difficult request, but we have
prepared a reward to match.
Thank you for your cooperation.
50035.descriptionJp:
火山に、炎王龍が現れたとの
報告が届きました。
これまで何度かハンターを
向かわせましたが、成果が
得られていません。
そのため、今回依頼に幾つか
の条件を出しています。
困難な依頼ですが、それに
見合う報酬を用意しておりま
す。よろしくお願いします。

21004.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21004.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, often shows itself in the Jungle! It is quite a tough opponent, so rather than slaying it, capturing it with a Shock Trap is also an effective approach!
21004.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, the Bullfango
leader ≪Bulldrome≫ often shows
itself!
It is a fairly tough foe, so
rather than slaying it, using a
≪Shock Trap≫ and capturing it
is also an effective option!
21004.descriptionJp:
密林にはブルファンゴの長
である≪ドスファンゴ≫が
姿を現すことが多いです！
かなりタフな相手なので、
討伐ではなく≪シビレ罠≫
などを使い捕獲してしまう
のも有効な手段ですよ！

23180.description: My stored food is running low. Would you hunt a few Apceros in the volcano? Their meat and eggs make good food. And some Gunpowder Rock for kindling would be nice too. Well, if you have the time.
23180.descriptionEn:
My stockpiled food has been running
a bit low, you see.
Could you go slay a few Apceros
in the Volcano for me?
Their meat and eggs make good
food, after all.
Also, I'd be glad to have some
Gunpowder Rock for lighting fires.
Well, only if you have the time.
23180.descriptionJp:
ちょっと保存してある食糧が
少なくなってきてしまってさ。
火山にいるアプケロスを
何頭か討伐してきてくれない
かな。あいつの肉や卵は、
いい食糧になるからね。
あとは着火用に使う火薬岩も
あると、嬉しいんだけどね。
まあ、余裕があれば頼むよ。

61717.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
61717.description: Nice to meet you! I am the newbie who will be working at the Hunters Guild from now on! Please treat me well! If you take my job now, I will give you a souvenir on top of the usual reward! Do not miss this chance!
61717.descriptionEn:
Nice to meet you, ssu!
I'm the newbie who just got hired
to work at the Hunters Guild, ssu!
Please treat me well, ssu!
If you take my request now, I'll
give you a commemorative gift on
top of the normal reward, ssu!
Don't miss this chance, ssu!
61717.descriptionJp:
はじめましてッス！
今度、ハンターズギルドで
働かせてもらうことになった
新人ッス！よろしくッス！
今、俺からの依頼を受けて
くれたら、普通の報酬の他に
記念品をプレゼントするッス！
この機会をお見逃しなくッス！

21477.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21477.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21477.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21477.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

63187.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
63187.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63187.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63187.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

62906.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
62906.description: An urgent message has arrived from the survey team on Tide Island. They report that an exceptionally powerful Taikun Zamuza has appeared and is raging in the caves. We fear for the team's safety. Head for Tide Island at once and hunt the Taikun Zamuza.
62906.descriptionEn:
An urgent message has come in
from the survey team on Tidal
Island. According to the report,
an extremely powerful Taikun
Zamuza has appeared and is
rampaging in the caves. We fear
for the team's safety. Please
head to Tidal Island at once and
hunt the Taikun Zamuza.
62906.descriptionJp:
潮島にいる調査団から緊急の
連絡が入りました。
報告によると、多殻蟹の極め
て強力な個体が現れ洞窟で
暴れているとのことです。
調査団の安全が心配されます。
直ちに潮島に向かい、
多殻蟹の狩猟をお願いします。

61036.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
61036.description: Hey! Nice to meet you! This job for you is important content every novice hunter should do. Complete it with your comrades! Now! Do your best!
61036.descriptionEn:
Hey! Nice to meet you!
This request for you is important
business every rookie hunter
should handle.
Work together with your companions
and complete the request!
Well then! Do your best!
61036.descriptionJp:
やあ！はじめまして！
今回、あなたへの依頼は
新米狩人ならやっておくべき
大事な内容だ。
仲間と協力して依頼を
達成してくれ！
では！がんばってくれ！

54267.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
54267.description: A peddler reports that a Diablos is running wild in the desert. No notable damage has occurred yet, but please go and deal with it to keep the people traveling the nearby road safe.
54267.descriptionEn:
A traveling merchant has reported
that ≪Diablos≫ is rampaging in the
Desert. There seem to be no notable
casualties at present, but for the
safety of those using the nearby
highway, please head out and
deal with it.
54267.descriptionJp:
砂漠で≪ディアブロス≫が
暴れていると行商人から報告
が上がっております。現在は
目立った被害は出ていない様
ですが、近くの街道を行交う
人の安全確保のために、
対処に向かってください。

55335.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55335.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Akura Vashimu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55335.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Akura Vashimu≫ appears
to have reached a strength that
stands at the very summit even
among Akura Vashimu.
Its strength is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill to
take on the summit, please go and
conduct the survey.
55335.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫
はアクラ・ヴァシムの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

54905.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
54905.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54905.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54905.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62951.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
62951.description: Thanks for playing MHF for four whole years! Equip Vol Grand and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude M as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude M you can forge Akra Ain (Dual Blades).
62951.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for four whole years!
Equip ≪Vol Grand≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude M≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude M≫ you can forge
≪Akra Ain≫ (Dual Blades).
62951.descriptionJp:
４年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ヴォルグランド≫を装備し、
≪年間特典生産券≫１枚を
納品すると≪感謝の証M≫を
１１枚プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証M≫から
≪アクラアイン≫（双剣）が
生産可能です。

54358.description: There is a report that 2 jet-black wyverns were seen in a part of the Ancient Tower where few tread. This is a survey request, but if the report is true, ordinary hunters cannot handle them. We recommend only hunters confident in their skill go.
54358.descriptionEn:
There was a report that two jet-black
Flying Wyverns were seen in a part
of the Ancient Tower where people
rarely set foot. This is a survey
request, but if the report is true,
ordinary Hunters cannot handle them.
I recommend that only Hunters
confident in their own skill
make the trip.
54358.descriptionJp:
古塔の余り人が立ち入らない
場所に、漆黒の飛竜を２頭
見たとの報告がありました。
これは、調査依頼となります
が、報告が本当であるならば、
普通のハンターでは手に負え
ません。腕に自信のある
ハンターの方のみで向かう
事をお勧めします。

54744.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54744.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54744.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

21709.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
21709.description: A blue monster has appeared at the top of the sea of trees. That monster appears together with lightning and shows movements swift as lightning, they say. Several hunters are already dealing with it, but they have not even managed to wound it. Please head to the site at once.
21709.descriptionEn:
A blue monster has appeared at the
Top of Great Forest.
That monster appears together with
lightning, and is said to move as
swiftly as a bolt of lightning.
Several hunters are already dealing
with it, but they have not even been
able to inflict a single wound.
Please head to the site
at once.
21709.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に蒼色のモンスター
が現れました。
そのモンスターは、落雷と
ともに現れ、雷のように
素早い動きを見せるとか。
既に、何人かのハンターが
対応に当たっていますが、
傷を負わせることすらできて
いません。至急、現地へ
向かってください。

54946.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
54946.description: We present a request that lets you obtain some of the materials needed to upgrade Ｇ-rank gear from the Doragyurosu, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
54946.descriptionEn:
The number of accepts per day is
limited, but let me introduce a
request that gives you some of the
materials needed to upgrade the
Berukyurosu Subspecies' G Rank gear.
Be careful not to miss this chance.
54946.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、冥雷竜のＧ級
武具の強化に必要な素材の一
部を入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。この機会を逃さぬよ
うご注意ください。

50918.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
50918.description: The Snowy Mountains have lately been hit by abnormal weather, and many reports have come in of a great shadow walking calmly through the blizzard. Could this blizzard be that monster's doing? We request a survey from all hunters.
50918.descriptionEn:
Lately the Snowy Mountains have
been struck by abnormal weather,
and we have received many
reports of a large shape walking
calmly through the raging
blizzard. Could this blizzard
truly be the work of that
monster? We ask all hunters to
investigate.
50918.descriptionJp:
このところ、異常気象に
見舞われていた雪山ですが、
猛吹雪の中を悠然と歩く
大きな影を見た、との
報告が多数入ってきています。
この吹雪の原因は、果たして
そのモンスターのしわざ
なのでしょうか？ハンターの
皆様に調査を依頼します。

54895.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
54895.description: We are continuing our survey of the Lavasioth Subspecies. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54895.descriptionEn:
We will continue the survey of the
Lavasioth.
Breaking its parts is not required,
but we would be delighted if you
did!
Hunters, please lend us your help!
54895.descriptionJp:
ヴォルガノス亜種の調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

60498.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Green Plesioth. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60498.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is ≪Green Plesioth≫!
To hunt a monster all on your own -
that spirit is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take a place
among the top ranks!
60498.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ガノトトス亜種≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

62804.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐
62804.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62804.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62804.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

61511.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ２頭の狩猟

40239.description: Word has come that a new monster has appeared at Prismatic Falls. According to the witness, it reacts to hunters' movements such as rejoicing and dancing, and is very cute. I am most curious how cute a monster it is. Please investigate at once.
40239.descriptionEn:
Information has come in that a new
monster has appeared at the
Rainbow Falls.
According to witnesses, it reacts to
hunter gestures like cheering or
dancing, and is very cute.
I am terribly curious just how cute
this monster is.
Please survey the area at once.
40239.descriptionJp:
彩の滝に新しいモンスターが
現れたとの情報が入りました。
目撃者の情報によると、
ハンターのよろこぶ、おどる
といった動きに反応し
大変可愛らしいとのことです。
どれほど可愛いモンスター
なのかとても気になります。
至急調査をお願いします。

60622.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
60622.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60622.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
60622.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60622.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50520.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50520.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50520.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

11002.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
11002.description: Velocidrome flees to another area when its stamina runs low and recovers there! It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are many Velociprey minions about, so be careful!
11002.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ flees to
another area when worn down
and recovers health there!
It's a fine test of a
hunter's skill, but this
season its Velociprey
underlings are many. Careful!
11002.descriptionJp:
≪ドスランポス≫は体力を
消耗すると別エリアへ逃げて
体力を回復してしまいます！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手ですが
この季節は、子分のランポス
も多いので注意して下さい！

62574.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
62574.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62574.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62574.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

60221.description: A powerful Basarios has appeared together with a powerful Gravios. The Guild will pay a large sum to the hunter who slays both. In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware.
60221.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Basarios≫ has
appeared, accompanied by a
powerful ≪Gravios≫.
The Guild will pay a hefty
sum to the hunter who slays
both. Other rewards are
slim in exchange, so keep
that in mind.
60221.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫の強力な個体
が、≪グラビモス≫の強力な
個体を伴って現れたわ。
ギルドでは、この２頭を討伐
したハンターに、多額の報酬
金を支払うことになったの。
その代わり、その他の見返り
は控えめなので要注意よ。

56133.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
56133.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, keep pouring in. Judging this an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Elzelion that Burns and Freezes to the Extreme. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special coin!
56133.descriptionEn:
Reports of renewed sightings of
the monsters bearing the name
"Acme", a great threat, keep arriving.
Judging this an emergency, I want
to request their swift elimination.
This time it is "Acme, the Scorching
Freezing Eruzerion".
As proof of the slaying, I will hand
over a special coin!
56133.descriptionJp:
大きな脅威である「極み」と
名の付くモンスターたちの再
目撃報告が続々と届いている。
緊急事態と判断し、迅速な各
個討伐を依頼したい。
今回は「極み灼き凍るエルゼ
リオン」。
討伐した証として、特別なコ
インを渡すぞ！

55630.description: To support hunters' decoration production, the Guild is considering providing materials from its stores. However, supplies are limited, so only for capable hunters. Please try the quest and obtain the materials!
55630.descriptionEn:
To support Hunters in producing
decorations, the Guild is considering
providing materials kept in Guild
storage.

However, as quantities are limited,
we can offer them only to Hunters
of proven ability.
Please take on the quest and
obtain the materials!
55630.descriptionJp:
ギルドではハンターの方々の
装飾品生産を支援するため、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。

ただし、数に限りがあるため
実力のあるハンターのみと
させていただきます。
ぜひクエストに挑戦して、
素材を獲得してください！

55447.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55447.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55447.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

51018.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
51018.description: Here is a request that yields the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of the Voljang Hardcore Armor, the Von series. It is a generous quest, so do give it a try!
51018.descriptionEn:
Let me introduce a request that
gives you the materials needed to
forge and upgrade one piece of the
Vojan's ≪Hardcore Armor≫, the
"Von Series".
It's a great value quest, so please
give it a try!
51018.descriptionJp:
紅蓮獅子の≪剛種防具≫
「ヴォンシリーズ」１部位分
の生産強化に必要な素材を
入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。オトクなクエスト
ですのでぜひチャレンジして
ください！

50101.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50101.description: The contest between the Blue Beast Hunter and the Rajang has begun! To accept this request you must equip the Magxia HS series for gunners on your chest, arms, waist, and legs. Assemble the Blue Beast equipment that speaks of the wild, and hunt the Rajang!
50101.descriptionEn:
The curtain has risen on the match
between the Blue Fighting Beast
hunter and the Rajang!
To accept this request you must wear
the "Gunner's Magshia HS Series" on
chest, arms, waist and legs!
Gear up in the wild-looking Blue
Fighting Beast armor, and hunt that
Rajang!
50101.descriptionJp:
青闘獣ハンターと金獅子の
勝負の幕が切って落とされた！
この依頼を受けるには「ガン
ナー用のマグシアHSシリーズ」
を胴・腕・腰・脚にそれぞれ
装備している必要があるぞ！
野生を感じさせる青闘獣装備
を揃えて、いざ金獅子狩猟！

21045.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21045.description: The Shogun Ceanataur apparently uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling! If the hunt proves difficult, hunting the Gabras that flit about the crater this season to obtain precious food ingredients comes recommended!
21045.descriptionEn:
The Sickle Crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
apparently uses its strange leg
joints to climb all the way to
the ceiling! If the hunt proves
difficult, we also recommend
slaying the ≪Gabras≫ that flit
around the crater this season to
obtain valuable foodstuffs!
21045.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登るらしいです！
狩猟が困難な場合、この季節
火口付近を飛び回る≪ガブラ
ス≫を討伐して、貴重な食材
を入手するのもお勧めです！

50392.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

54486.description: This is the practice final quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament at the 2014 Thanksgiving Festival. The time limit is 50 minutes. Also, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained from carving or from quest clear rewards. Please keep this in mind.
54486.descriptionEn:
This is the practice final quest for
the VS. Quest Champion Tournament
at the 2014 Thanksgiving Festival.
The time limit is 50 minutes.
Also, the target monster's materials
cannot be obtained from carving
or from quest clear rewards.
Please keep this in mind.
54486.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントin感謝祭2014の
練習用決勝クエストです。
制限時間は５０分です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

51041.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
51041.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the claws of a Shogun Ceanataur will also grant a special ingredient.
51041.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Shogun Ceanataur's
claws, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51041.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鎌蟹のツメを破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

54441.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54441.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of the Ice Fox Wyvern, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54441.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly started G Rank
Guild Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to further their
recognition and promotion.
By breaking the ice fox wyvern's head,
we will also grant you special food
ingredients.
54441.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
氷狐竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

23237.description: A Pariapuria has appeared in the highlands! No sooner had it arrived than it started gulping down the plants and animals of the highlands one after another! At this rate the highlands' ecosystem will be in ruins! It should be at the waterside now. Drive it off at once!
23237.descriptionEn:
A Pariapuria has appeared in the
Highlands!
That thing showed up out of nowhere
and started devouring the plants and
animals of the Highlands one after
another! At this rate the Highlands'
ecosystem will be a wreck!
It should be by the water at this
hour. Hurry up and drive it off!
23237.descriptionJp:
高地に呑竜が現れた！
あいつ、突然やってきたと
思ったら、高地の植物や
動物を、次々と喰っちまい
やがった！このままじゃ
高地の生態系は滅茶苦茶だ！
多分今の時間は
水辺にいるはずだ。
さっさと追い払ってくれ！

51112.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の討伐

40236.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40236.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40236.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

54375.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of Ｇｚ and Porta Cards! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
54375.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice to all hunters!
In addition to a training method that
efficiently builds up experience, right
now you can obtain a large amount of
Gz and Porta Cards!
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
enormous!
May your daily training become a
great strength for you, hunters!
54375.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法に加え、今なら
大量のＧｚとポルタカード
が入手できます！
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

55377.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55377.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55377.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

58043.objectiveJp: ケオアルボル１体の討伐
58043.description: This is an emergency. A gigantic monster is reported to be closing on the interception base. Because it is urgent, we are asking only hunters with achievements. Prepare fully and head there at once to slay the gigantic monster.
58043.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency. We have received
a report that a gigantic monster is
closing in on the Base.
Because it is urgent, this request is
extended only to hunters of merit.
After making full preparations,
head to the site at once and
slay the gigantic monster.
Do not underestimate it.
58043.descriptionJp:
緊急事態です。迎撃拠点に
巨大なモンスターが迫ってい
るとの報告がありました。
緊急のため功績あるハンター
だけに依頼しています。
十分な準備をしてから
直ちに、現地へ向かい
巨大なモンスターを
討伐してください。

26441.description: The King of the Sky, Rathalos, and the Queen of the Land, Rathian, who have reigned over the frontier since ages past. Charge in with resolve unto death! Do not forget that only one pitfall trap or shock trap may be set!
26441.descriptionEn:
Since ages past, the king of the
skies ≪Rathalos≫ and the queen
of the land ≪Rathian≫ have ruled
these frontier lands. Go forth
resolved to face death! And do
not forget that you may set only
one pitfall trap or shock trap!
26441.descriptionJp:
辺境に遥か昔より君臨せし、
空の王者≪リオレウス≫と
陸の女王≪リオレイア≫。
決死の覚悟にて挑むがよい！
落とし穴やシビレ罠が設置で
きるのは１つまでということ
を忘れるでないぞ！

23337.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
23337.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Anorupatisu, the Rampage Saw Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23337.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the raging saw
wyvern ≪Anorupatisu≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
23337.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、暴鋸竜
≪アノルパティス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

62251.description: The arena is still in chaos. The Melynx have taken it over, and fanged beasts have settled in as well. The only way to break the deadlock is to capture the 2 fanged beasts and drive out the Melynx. Take care not to hunt the fanged beasts, and do your best!
62251.descriptionEn:
The Arena is still in chaos.
The ≪Melynx≫ have taken over the
arena, and on top of that fanged
beasts have settled in.
To break the deadlock, we have no
choice but to capture two fanged
beasts and drive out the ≪Melynx≫.
Be careful not to slay the fanged
beasts, and do your best!
62251.descriptionJp:
闘技場は未だに混乱している。
≪メラルー≫たちが闘技場を
占拠し、さらに牙獣種たちが
居座っているのだ。
状況を打破するには、２頭の
牙獣種を捕獲し≪メラルー≫
を追い出すしかない。牙獣種
は討伐しないように注意して
がんばってくれ！

60701.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟

50134.description: Nyahaha! So you will challenge a job from us, the Dark Cat Pack, meow? Hunt the Reaper that appeared in the desert, meow! Two of them! Complete it and I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Medal, meow!
50134.descriptionEn:
Nyaha! So you mean to
take on a Dark Cat Corps
request, nya?
Hunt the "Reaper" that
showed up in the Desert!
Two of them, nya!
Clear this request and I
might hand you a ≪Dark Cat Medal≫!
50134.descriptionJp:
ニャハハ！
我ニャ闇猫団の依頼に
挑戦するんだニャ？
砂漠に現れた”死神”を
狩猟することニャ！２頭！
この依頼が達成できたら、
≪闇猫団メダル≫を
くれてやってもいいニャ！

61130.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61130.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61130.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54523.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
54523.description: Lunastra, Queen of the Flame Nation, has appeared at the top of the Old Tower. Her form is enormous, an overwhelming presence such as we have never encountered, and the situation is very dangerous. With access to the site limited, you must slay her alone.
54523.descriptionEn:
The Queen of the Flame Nation,
Lunastra, has appeared atop
the Ancient Tower.
Her form is enormous, with an
overwhelming presence never
met before—a very dangerous
state. Means to reach the site
are limited, so slay her alone.
54523.descriptionJp:
炎国の王妃ナナ・テスカトリ
が古塔の頂部に現れました。
その姿はとても巨大であり、
これまでに遭遇したことが
ない圧倒的な存在感で、非常
に危険な状態です。
現地へ行く手段が限られてい
る為、１人で討伐して下さい。

50228.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
50228.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
50228.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

23341.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
23341.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Forokururu, the Splendid Phoenix Bird. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23341.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the gorgeous
phoenix ≪Forokururu≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
23341.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、華鳳鳥
≪フォロクルル≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50955.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
50955.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, a Nargacuga was newly observed in the jungle. According to the surveyor who encountered it, it performs behavior never observed before. Take the greatest care with the monster's movements!
50955.descriptionEn:
As the Transcendence Species
appeared, surveys across the land
newly observed the Swift Wyvern
Nargacuga in the Jungle.
According to the researchers who
encountered it, it displays
behavior never observed before.
Please be extremely careful of
the monster's actions!
50955.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、密林に
迅竜・ナルガクルガが新たに
観測されました。
遭遇した調査員の報告による
と、今まで観測されていない
行動を行うとのことです。
モンスターの行動にはくれ
ぐれも注意して下さい！

11045.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23725.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Merit (Beginning) x５０, Great Sword Merit (Middle) x６０, Great Sword Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23725.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Great Sword Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Great Sword Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Great Sword Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you need
a ≪Secret Art Merit Crystal≫
and GR500 or higher, so
please keep that in mind.
23725.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪大剣勲・序≫５０個
≪大剣勲・中≫６０個
≪大剣勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

56016.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
56016.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Tigrex. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56016.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the Supremacy
Tigrex.
If you destroy its developed parts in
this quest, we will add developed part
materials to the Another Reward
as a special bonus.
Please note that slaying it alone will
not earn you developed part materials.
56016.descriptionJp:
辿異種の轟竜を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

21485.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

22019.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Odibatorasu Gou armor. By slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the swamp, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
22019.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
By slaying the mysterious
monster that appeared in
the Swamp, you can obtain
the materials needed to
upgrade the ≪Heavenly
Storm≫ "Odiba F" to Lv7.
22019.descriptionJp:
≪弩岩竜≫の≪剛種防具≫を
生産・強化したハンター向け
の依頼です。
沼地に現れた謎のモンスター
を討伐することで
「オディバＦシリーズ」
≪天嵐防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

54381.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
54381.description: Diorekkusu has appeared at the top of the sea of trees. It is a very dangerous monster that hardens its outer shell using the electricity generating organs in its body and shows quick movement. Many hunters have already been harmed. Please proceed to slay it with the utmost care.
54381.descriptionEn:
A ≪Diorex≫ has appeared at the
Top of Great Forest. It hardens
its outer shell using the power
generation organ in its body and
moves with great speed; it is a
very dangerous monster. Many
hunters have already fallen
victim. Please take the utmost
care when you slay it.
54381.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に
≪ディオレックス≫が現れま
した。体内の発電器官を利用
した外殻の硬質化と、素早い
動きを見せる、非常に危険な
モンスターです。既に多くの
ハンターが被害にあっていま
す。細心の注意を払い
討伐に当たってください。

62832.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
62832.description: I hate Gravios Subspecies! Always in my way, not one good memory! You! Would you go and punish a Gravios Subspecies? I have weapons and armor ready! I am counting on you!
62832.descriptionEn:
I hate Black Gravios! It always,
always gets in my way, and I do
not have a single good memory of
it! You there! Would you go and
teach that Black Gravios a lesson
for me? I have weapons and armor
ready for you! I am counting on
you!
62832.descriptionJp:
グラビモス亜種が嫌い！
いつもいつも私の邪魔をして、
いい思い出が一つもないわ！
あなた！グラビモス亜種を
懲らしめて来てくれない？
武器と防具は用意してるわ！
よろしく頼んだわよ！

54915.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
54915.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Valsaburos, the Flame Horn Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54915.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Flame Horn
Wyvern ≪Varusaburosu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
54915.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、炎角竜
≪ヴァルサブロス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

23346.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
23346.description: A Pink Rathian has appeared in the Jungle. It unleashes attacks unlike any before and is said to be giving hunters a great deal of trouble. To keep the damage from spreading further, we ask for your help in hunting it.
23346.descriptionEn:
A Pink Rathian has appeared in
the Jungle. It reportedly unleashes
attacks unlike anything seen before,
and is causing great trouble.
To keep the damage from spreading
any further, we ask for your help
in hunting it.
23346.descriptionJp:
密林にリオレイア亜種が出現
しました。これまでにない
攻撃を繰り出し、非常に手
を焼いているそうです。
これ以上被害が拡大しない
よう、狩猟のご協力をお願
いします。

60441.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
60441.description: A rare report has come from a hunter back from the Jungle. 2 Gypceros are on a rampage in the Jungle, it says. The Guild is eagerly seeking strong hunters to hunt these 2! Do take up the request.
60441.descriptionEn:
Rare news has come in from a hunter
who returned from the Jungle.
Two Gypceros are said to be on a
rampage in the Jungle.
The Guild is now recruiting strong
hunters who will hunt these two!
Please sign up readily.
We look forward to your application.
60441.descriptionJp:
密林から帰ったハンターから
珍しい報せが入りました。
２頭の毒怪鳥が、密林で暴れ
ているとのことです。
ギルドでは、この２頭を狩猟
してやろうという強者ハンタ
ーを、大募集中です！
奮って受注をどうぞ。

21620.description: Do you know the orb called the Yanagicha Orb? Its material is indispensable for producing a certain expensive decoration. If you complete this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21620.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Willow Brown Orb?
Its material is essential to
the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
Complete this request and I
shall give you a valuable
decoration material.
21620.descriptionJp:
柳茶原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

1041.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
1041.description: A Kut-Ku with an odd color has been sighted in the swamp! By my guess it must be a Yian Kut-Ku subspecies! If you go after it, try a Sonic Bomb to stop it in its tracks!
1041.descriptionEn:
A bird wyvern with a strange
body color was spotted in the
Swamp, or so I hear!
By my guess, it must be
a Yian Kut-Ku Subspecies!
If you take up the hunt, try
≪Sonic Bombs≫ to stop it dead!
1041.descriptionJp:
ちょっと変わった体色の怪鳥
が沼地で目撃されたらしい！
オイラの推測からするに、
イャンクックの亜種に間違い
ないだろう！狩猟に臨むなら
ヤツの足止めができる≪音爆
弾≫を使ってみるといいぞ！

50172.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟

26026.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
26026.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26026.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26026.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

58117.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58117.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58117.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
