reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58117.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

50177.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
50177.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Swamp. The ash crystal scorpion Akura Jebia has also been confirmed in the caves. Slay that one too while you are there! Now off you go!!
50177.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
I want you all to explore the
Swamp. It seems the Ash Crystal
Scorpion, ≪Akura Jebia≫, has been
confirmed in the cave as well.
Slay that one too while you're
at it! Now go and do your best!!
50177.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、沼地を探索してきて
もらう。洞窟には灰晶蠍≪ア
クラ・ジェビア≫も確認され
ているようだ。ついでにそい
つも討伐してくるのだ！
さあ頑張ってこい！！

55694.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55694.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Rukodiora. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55694.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Rukodiora≫.
To accept the quest you will
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please be
careful about that.
55694.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ルコディオラ≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

23677.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Rathalos. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23677.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
monster ≪Rathalos≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
23677.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪リオレウス≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61045.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

54640.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54640.description: Please investigate the Silver Sovereign Wyvern that appeared at the interception base. If possible, it would help if you not only hunted it but also broke its claws and tail. Hunters, thank you!
54640.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Rukodiora
that appeared at the Base.
If possible, beyond simply
slaying it, breaking its claws
and tail would be a great help.
Hunters all, thank you in
advance!
54640.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に現れた司銀龍の
調査をお願いします。
できれば討伐だけでなく、
爪や尻尾の破壊をしてきて
くれると助かります。
ハンターの皆さん、よろしく
お願いします！

54272.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
54272.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54272.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54272.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

56152.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
56152.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, do not cease. Treating this as an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Bogabadorumu that Strikes to the Extreme, whose sightings have surged. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special portrait!
56152.descriptionEn:
Reports of resightings of the
monsters bearing the name
"Acme", a great threat, never end.
We treat this as an emergency and
ask for faster slaying of each.
This time it is the one whose
sightings are surging, the
"Acme Assaulting Bogabadorumu".
As proof of the kill, a special portrait!
56152.descriptionJp:
大きな脅威である「極み」と
名の付くモンスターたちの再
目撃報告が後を絶たない。
緊急事態とし、より迅速な各
個討伐を依頼したい。今回は
特に目撃報告が急増している
「極み襲うボガバドルム」。
討伐した証として、特別な肖
像画を渡すぞ！

50949.description: A powerful Rukodiora showing unprecedented behaviour has been found at the White Lake. Head out and slay it before the danger spreads to others. Hunters who succeed will receive a fitting reward.
50949.descriptionEn:
A powerful Rukodiora showing
unprecedented behavior has been
found at White Lake. Please head
out and slay it before it brings
danger to anyone else. Hunters who
succeed in the slaying will receive
a reward befitting the deed.
50949.descriptionJp:
今までにない行動を示す強力
なルコディオラが、白湖で発
見されました。他に危険が及
ぶ前に討伐に向かってくださ
い。討伐に成功したハンター
の方には、相応の報酬を用意
しております。

21527.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21527.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21527.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26318.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26318.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26318.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26318.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62689.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62689.description: They say this world holds things that are sweet, and things that are love, and things that are simply feelings. Anyone who can feel even a little of that must be happy, I think. Complete this request, and if you learn something, tell me.
62689.descriptionEn:
Sweet things, love, and feelings —
they say such things exist
in this world.
I reckon anyone who can feel
even a little of them must be
a happy soul.
Finish this request, and if you
figure anything out, come
and tell me.
62689.descriptionJp:
甘かったり、愛だったり、
想いだったりするものが
この世にはあるそうだ。
それらを少しでも感じること
ができる奴ってのは幸せなん
だろうなって思う。
この依頼を達成して、何か
分かったことがあればオレに
教えてくれ。

55407.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55407.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55407.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

61126.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての狩猟

54301.description: From time to time something like an orb is found inside a monster's body. It can be used as material for all kinds of gear, and demand for it has been rising lately. Clear this request and I will give you one of those orbs, a Hermit Orb, as your reward.
54301.descriptionEn:
From inside a monster's body,
a ball-like thing is sometimes
found, you see.
It can be used as material for
all sorts of arms and armor,
and demand has risen lately.
Complete this request and I'll
give you one of those balls,
a ≪Pure Orb≫, as your reward.
54301.descriptionJp:
モンスターの体の中から、
時折玉のようなものが
見つかることがあるんです。
さまざまな武具の素材に
使うことができるもので、
最近需要が高まっています。
今回の依頼を達成できたら、
その玉のひとつ≪仙玉≫を
報酬として差し上げます。

23247.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23247.description: I heard there are incredibly beautiful gems in the swamp, do you know? Apparently someone saw a crystal of considerable size. If it really is there, would you fetch it for me? I will thank you properly.
23247.descriptionEn:
I heard there's a really lovely
gem out in the Swamp.
Did you know?
Someone supposedly saw a crystal
of quite a size, or so they say.
If it really is there, would you
go and fetch it for me?
I'll thank you properly, of course.
23247.descriptionJp:
沼地にすっごく綺麗な宝石が
あるって聞いたんだけど、
知ってるかしら？
何でも、結構な大きさの
結晶を見た人がいるらしいの。
それが本当にあるのなら、
とってきてくれないかしら。
ちゃんとお礼はするわよ。

55206.description: Thank you for helping slay Kirin. If you deliver the Beautiful Mirror that regained its true form through Kirin's strange lightning, I will present you with materials for precious armor owned by the Guild as thanks.
55206.descriptionEn:
Thank you for your help in slaying
Kirin.
If you deliver the ≪Beautiful Mirror≫
that regained its true form through
Kirin's wondrous lightning, we will
present you with rare armor materials
owned by the Guild as a token of
our gratitude.
55206.descriptionJp:
キリン討伐にご協力いただき
ありがとうございました。
キリンの不思議な雷光によっ
て本来の姿を取り戻した
「美しい鏡」を納品していた
だければ、お礼として、ギル
ドが所有する貴重な防具の素
材をプレゼントいたします。

51066.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
51066.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
requests we have long been running,
we have prepared this quest in
order to raise awareness and
interest in them.
By breaking the Gravios's chest,
special ingredients will also be
granted to you as a reward.
51066.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鎧竜の胸部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

21987.description: A Conquest monster said to invite calamity has appeared! With no time to lose, this is a short-notice request, but to keep the damage to a minimum, repelling it alone will also count. We are seeking first-rate hunters with a Secret Scroll to face this unprecedented crisis!
21987.descriptionEn:
A Zenith monster said to bring
calamity has appeared! As this is
a race against time, the request
is for a short hunt, but to keep
the damage to a minimum, simply
repelling it will still be rated.
We seek hunters who hold the
Secret Art and will face this
unprecedented crisis!
21987.descriptionJp:
禍を招くといわれる、覇種
モンスターが現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

54306.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
54306.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54306.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54306.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55727.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55727.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55727.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55727.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

1027.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟

55485.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55485.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a horn break and a tail cut in slaying Rukodiora, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55485.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Lucodiora≫ and break its
horns and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55485.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪極龍≫討伐にて
角破壊と尻尾切断を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

23305.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
23305.description: A Resounding Wolf seems to have been found in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. It could hinder the survey, so please head out to hunt it. Another hunter will draw off the male Resounding Wolf, so you take the female.
23305.descriptionEn:
A Howling Wolf seems to have been
found in an unsurveyed part of
the Swamp.
It could become an obstacle to our
survey, so please head out and hunt it.
The male will be kept occupied by
another hunter, so we ask you
to take care of the female.
Thank you for your cooperation.
23305.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域で
響狼が発見されたようです。
調査を進める上での障害に
なり得ますので、狩猟に
向かってください。
雄響狼は別のハンターに気を
引いてもらいますので、
あなた方は雌響狼の方を
お願い致します。

55939.description: There is a report that a white and a brown Espinas have appeared at the ancient ruins. It is extremely rare for these 2 to appear together, and they could bring tremendous damage. Head out to slay them at once. Should you succeed, I will give you earrings long kept in the Guild's vaults.
55939.descriptionEn:
We have reports that a white and
a brown Espinas appeared at the
Ruins.
Both of these two appearing
together is exceedingly rare, and
there is a risk of tremendous
damage. Please head out to slay
them at once. On success, we will
grant you a Piercing from the Guild.
55939.descriptionJp:
古跡に白色と茶色の棘竜が現
れたとの報告がありました。
この２頭がともに出現した
例は非常に稀であり、甚大な
被害をもたらす可能性があり
ます。至急討伐に向かってく
ださい。討伐に成功した暁に
は古くからギルドで蔵されて
きたピアスを差し上げます。

56028.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Hyujikiki. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56028.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Hyujikiki for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.
56028.descriptionJp:
辿異種の針纏竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

55182.description: A Velocidrome and a Conga appeared during the survey of the Jungle! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. Hunters who complete the request will receive the crafting materials for the weapon series Breaking the Illusion.
55182.descriptionEn:
While surveying the Jungle, a
Velocidrome and a Conga appeared!
At this rate the survey cannot be
completed. To the hunter who fulfills
this request, we will give the
production materials for the weapon
series ≪Illusion Breaker≫.
We are counting on you.
55182.descriptionJp:
密林の調査途中にドスランポ
スとコンガが現れました！
このままでは調査が完了でき
ません。依頼を達成して下
さったハンターさんには、
武器「幻想ヲ破リシ」
シリーズの生産素材を
お渡しします。

60416.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
60416.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60416.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60416.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50989.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
50989.description: The heavenly revolving dragon Shagaru Magala has never been observed in this region, and its ecology is wrapped in mystery. To clarify its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its wings or tail in addition to slaying it, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
50989.descriptionEn:
The Heaven's Wheel Dragon, Shagaru
Magala, has never been observed in
this region, and its ecology is
shrouded in mystery.
To shed light on it, if you succeed
in breaking its wings or tail in
addition to slaying it, we will
provide an extra reward.
We await the challenge of brave hunters.
50989.descriptionJp:
天廻龍シャガルマガラはこの
地方での観測例がなく、生態
は謎に包まれています。
生態の解明のため、討伐に
加えて翼ないし尻尾の
部位破壊に成功した場合は
追加の報酬をお渡しします。
勇気あるハンターの挑戦を、
お待ちしております。

50715.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
50715.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Female Roaring Wolf will also grant a special ingredient.
50715.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the female Orugaron's
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50715.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
雌響狼の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

63259.description: This training is the delivery of Firestone. You should be able to gather it from the ground near the crater. It is a very hot and heavy rock, so take great care when carrying it.
63259.descriptionEn:
This time's training is the
delivery of Gunpowder Rocks.
You should be able to gather
them from the ground near
the crater.
They are very hot and heavy, so
please be plenty careful when
you carry them.
63259.descriptionJp:
今回のトレーニングは、
火薬岩の納品になります。
火口付近の地面で、
採取することができたと
思います。
とっても熱くて重い岩なので、
運ぶ時は十分に
注意してくださいね。

50860.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50860.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50860.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Bow,
show us the skill you have honed
against the ≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in
the Arena! If you succeed in
hunting it, you will earn even
more rewards than your daily
efforts bring.
50860.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50317.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
50317.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Pink Rathian beautifully. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50317.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Go and hunt the ≪Pink Rathian≫
with style.
If you clear this quest, your standing
as a hunter will shoot right up!
Now, show us what you can do!
50317.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪桜火竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

58032.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58032.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58032.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58032.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

50374.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50374.description: An extremely ferocious Black Gravios has been found in the volcano. There is no precedent for such an individual, and the guild is still investigating. Approach the hunt with the utmost caution.
50374.descriptionEn:
An extremely ferocious ≪Black
Gravios≫ has been found in the
Volcano.
There is no precedent for such an
individual, and the Guild is still
investigating.
Please head into the hunt with caution.
50374.descriptionJp:
火山にて極めて凶暴な
≪黒鎧竜≫が発見されました。
このような個体は前例がなく
ギルド側でも調査を進めて
いる最中です。
細心の注意を払って狩猟へ
向かって下さい。

21223.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21223.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21223.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26388.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26388.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26388.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

50521.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
50521.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50521.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50521.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54809.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54809.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54809.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55599.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55599.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55599.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
55599.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

53101.description: My friends want to hold a feast, and I need your help getting ready. I made a list of the things they like, so bring back plenty! For a reward I prepared armor that feels like a Chacha. With this, you might become friends with them too!
53101.descriptionEn:
I want your help getting ready
so my friends can hold a feast.
I listed up the things they'd
like, so go and gather lots
of them!
As a reward I've prepared armor
that feels like Chachabu.
With this, you might become
friends with them too!
53101.descriptionJp:
僕の友達が宴をできるように
準備を手伝ってほしいんだ。
彼らが好きそうなものを
リストアップしたから、沢山
集めてきて！
報酬にチャチャブーを感じる
防具を用意したよ。
これで君も、彼らと友達に
なれるかも！

26376.description: In the wasteland known as the Canyon, you are sure to gather things the likes of which you have never laid eyes on. Well? Does that not set your heart racing? I recommend you go and see for yourself.
26376.descriptionEn:
In the ≪Canyon≫, that wild
wasteland, you are sure to
gather things you have never
seen before.
Well? Does that not stir your
heart? I recommend you go there
at least once.
26376.descriptionJp:
荒野の大地、≪峡谷≫では、
きっと、今まで見たことも
ないようなものが採取できる
ことだろう。
どうだ、心が躍るだろう？
一度行ってみることをオスス
メするぜ。

62997.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
62997.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62997.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62997.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

26558.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26558.description: Hello. Thank you for playing MHF for a year! Turn in one Annual Bonus Production Ticket and we will give you eleven Proofs of Gratitude. From a Proof of Gratitude you can produce the Nana Blade [Empress] (Great Sword).
26558.descriptionEn:
Hello there.
Thank you for playing MHF for a year!
If you deliver 1 ≪Yearly Bonus
Production Ticket≫, we will present
you with 11 ≪Proofs of Gratitude≫.
From the ≪Proofs of Gratitude≫, the
≪Nana Blade [Empress]≫ (Great Sword)
can be crafted.
We hope you continue to enjoy the game.
26558.descriptionJp:
こんにちは。
１年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪年間特典生産券≫１枚を納
品すると、≪感謝の証≫を
１１枚プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証≫から≪ナナブレ
イド【炎妃】≫（大剣）が生
産可能です。

51082.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51082.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Tigrex will also grant a special ingredient.
51082.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Tigrex's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51082.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
轟竜の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

23667.objectiveJp: セルレギオス１頭の狩猟
23667.description: The Seregios has been sighted at Prismatic Falls as well. Reports say its attacks with blade-like scales are extremely dangerous. Head there at once and hunt it.
23667.descriptionEn:
≪Seregios≫, the Thousand Blade Wyvern,
has been sighted at Prismatic Falls
as well.
We have received reports that its
attacks using blade-like scales are
extremely dangerous.
Please head to the site at once and hunt it.
23667.descriptionJp:
千刃竜≪セルレギオス≫が
彩の滝でも目撃された。
刃の様な鱗を使った攻撃は
非常に危険であると報告を
受けている。
至急、現地へ向かい狩猟
してほしい。

62787.objectiveJp: ハンターカード赤１０枚納品
62787.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62787.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
62787.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

55753.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55753.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55753.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

54606.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Plesioth and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54606.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Go and hunt the ≪Water Wyvern≫
in fine style.
Clear this quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot right
up, I tell you!
54606.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪水竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

61921.client: Old Man with a Black-and-White Beard
61921.description: Everything has a true form and a false one. First, train your eye for the genuine by completing my jobs. If you do well, I will give you the strange stones I have collected. You should be able to produce a Gunlance of special construction.
61921.clientEn: Old Man with a Black-and-White Beard
61921.descriptionEn:
Everything has a true form and
a false form. First of all,
train your eye to see the real
thing by handling my requests.
If you do well, I shall give you
the curious stones I have gathered.
They should let you craft a
Gunlance of special construction.
61921.descriptionJp:
どんなものにも、本当の姿と
偽りの姿があります。まずは、
私からの依頼をこなすことで、
本物を見抜く目を鍛えなさい。
上手くいったら、私が集めた
奇妙な石を差し上げましょう。
特殊構造のガンランスを生産
することができるはずですよ。

50326.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
50326.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50326.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50326.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

60069.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

55932.description: The Variant Species Harudomerugu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Harudomerugu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55932.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Harudomerugu≫
seems to have reached a strength
that brings it to the very summit
among its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
to challenge the summit, we ask
you to conduct the survey.
55932.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ハルドメルグ≫は
ハルドメルグの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

40177.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
40177.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40177.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40177.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

54415.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54415.description: For the survey, would you hunt an Akura Vashimu for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to sever the tail. It is extremely dangerous and would affect the survey work afterwards.
54415.descriptionEn:
Could you go and slay the
≪Akura Jebia≫ for the survey?
That's right, I forgot something
important.
You must cut off its tail.
It is extremely dangerous, and it
would affect the later work.
54415.descriptionJp:
調査のために、≪灰晶蠍≫を
討伐してきてくれないか。
そうだ、大事なことを忘れて
いた。
必ず尻尾を切断してほしい。
非常に危険なため、後の調査
作業に影響するからな。

55811.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55811.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55811.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

50430.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

23707.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
23707.description: Bogabadorumu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly before you investigate.
23707.descriptionEn:
≪Bogabador≫ has
grown ferocious
and keeps rampaging.
This is extremely dangerous.
Please investigate with full
preparation.
23707.descriptionJp:
≪ボガバドルム≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、
暴れ続けています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

22107.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22107.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22107.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

61038.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種1頭の討伐
61038.description: Do you not think the hunt, hunter and monster clashing, is wonderful music? I have grown tired of ordinary music and want to hear something exciting. I am hoping for a wonderful duet played by hunter and monster.
61038.descriptionEn:
Don't you think the hunt, where
hunters and monsters clash,
is wonderful music?
I've grown bored of ordinary music
and want to hear something exciting.
I'm looking forward to the splendid
duet played by hunter and
monster.
61038.descriptionJp:
ハンターとモンスターが
ぶつかり合う狩りって
素晴らしい音楽だと思わない？
普通の音楽に飽きちゃって
刺激的な音楽が聞きたいの。
ハンターとモンスターが
奏でる素晴らしい二重奏を
期待しているわ。

21850.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21850.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21850.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

54615.description: In praise of the achievements you all left in the Extreme Conquest Battle, we present rewards. Radiant Accumulated Stone x15, Gorgeous Accumulated Stone x15, Extreme Expedition Contribution Certificate x25.
54615.descriptionEn:
In honor of the feats you all left
in the Extreme Conquest, we present
you with rewards.
- 15 Shining Accumulated Stones
- 15 Brilliant Accumulated Stones
- 25 Extreme Conquest Certificates
54615.descriptionJp:
極限征伐戦で皆さんが残した
功績を称え、報酬をお渡しい
たします。
・輝累石１５個
・絢累石１５個
・極征貢献証２５枚

11090.description: For hunters who want to make ore weapons, mining is the very basics! First, start by learning where you can mine. If you find cracks in a cliff, try digging with a Pickaxe!
11090.descriptionEn:
For hunters who want to make ore
type weapons, mining is the very
basics of the basics!
First, let us start by learning where
you can mine.
If you find cracks in a cliff or
similar, try digging with a
≪Pickaxe≫!
11090.descriptionJp:
鉱石系武器を作りたいハンタ
ーにとって採掘は基本中の基
本ですよ！
まずは、採掘できる場所を知
ることから始めましょう。
崖などにヒビ割れを見つけた
ら、≪ピッケル≫で掘ってみ
てください！

26143.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26143.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26143.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

62375.description: Hey, you have finally reached ace hunter. The Hunters Guild gave you a special weapon, right? That is a weapon suited to Variants and is also a condition for some jobs. Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share upgrade materials. Will you try?
62375.descriptionEn:
Hey, so you have finally reached
the rank of ace hunter.
You got a special weapon from the
Hunters Guild, right? That is a
weapon suited to Variants, and it
also serves as a condition for
taking some requests.
Clear the requests I introduce and
I will share upgrade materials.
Wanna give it a try?
62375.descriptionJp:
よう、お前もようやく凄腕
ハンターに到達したんだな。
ハンターズギルドから特殊な
武器を貰っただろ？あれは対
変種に適した武器で一部の
依頼を受ける条件にもなって
いる。
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
強化用の素材を分けてやるぜ。
やってみないか？

28089.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28089.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
28089.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

50973.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50973.description: This request is recommended for hunters fed up with monsters' status ailments, and yields the decoration Status Resist Jewel G2. Please make use of it in your hunting life hereafter.
50973.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain
≪Status Resist Jewel G2≫, a
decoration recommended for hunters
who are fed up with monsters'
status ailments lately.
Please make good use of it in your
hunting life from now on.
50973.descriptionJp:
最近モンスターの状態異常に
うんざりしているそんな
ハンターさんにオススメの
装飾品≪耐状態珠Ｇ２≫が
入手できる依頼です。
ぜひ今後の狩猟生活に
お役立てください。

54644.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
54644.description: There was a report of a Hypnocatrice racing at tremendous speed through the daytime sea of trees. According to the investigation, it is not angry but running for courtship, though in any case it is very dangerous as it is. Please head out to hunt it at once.
54644.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a
Hypnocatrice racing at great
speed through the daytime
Great Forest. According to the
survey, it is not angry but
running to court a mate—but
either way, it is extremely
dangerous as things stand.
Please set out to hunt it at once.
54644.descriptionJp:
昼の樹海を猛スピードで駆
け巡る眠鳥を見たとの報告
がありました。調査による
と怒っているのではなく、
求愛のため走っているらし
いのですが、いずれにせよ
そのままでは非常に危険で
す。至急、狩猟に向かって
ください。

54506.description: A Monoblos has taken up residence in the desert! Thanks to that, work in the desert is not progressing at all! Its habitat is fairly limited so I have a good idea where it is! I ask you to get rid of it at once!
54506.descriptionEn:
A Monoblos has settled down in
the Desert! Thanks to that, work
out there won't move at all!
Its habitat is pretty limited, so
I've got a good idea where! I'm
asking you to drive it off quick!
54506.descriptionJp:
モノブロスが砂漠に住み着き
やがった！おかげで、砂漠で
の仕事が全く進まねえ！
生息地は大体限られてっから
目星はついてる！早急に退治
をお願いするぜ！

26370.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
26370.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26370.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26370.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、上位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

60429.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60429.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60429.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

23591.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
23591.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.
23591.descriptionJp:
生物が存在できない場所だと
言われていた『最果ての地』
に、龍がいたと大型探査船
から報告がありました。
僅かに残る資料から、
『熾凍龍』と呼ばれる古龍で
あると推測されますが、詳細
は全くの不明です。現地へ
向かい、調査をお願いします。

63005.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63005.description: There is a report that a Rajang has appeared in the Snowy Mountains. Its condition seems odd, and reports say that not only its appearance and behavior but something ominous can be felt from it. As it is a quite dangerous request, only veteran hunters are asked to investigate.
63005.descriptionEn:
We have reports that a Rajang
has appeared in the Snowy
Mountains.
It seems to be acting strangely, and
reports say that besides its looks
and behavior, something ominous
can be felt from it.
This request is quite dangerous, so
only veteran hunters should take the survey.
63005.descriptionJp:
雪山にラージャンが
現れたとの報告がありました。
どうも様子がおかしいらしく、
見た目や行動だけでなく、
禍々しい何かが感じられる
との報告が寄せられています。
かなり危険な依頼となるため、
熟練ハンターの方のみでの
調査をお願いします。

55140.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
55140.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Lavasioth while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55140.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Volganos raises your
own standing while letting you
get the materials needed for a
G Rank decoration at a good deal.
Please make good use of it, and
best of luck out there.
55140.descriptionJp:
ヴォルガノスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

26083.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26083.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26083.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

55252.description: There has been a sighting of Zenaserisu at Prismatic Falls at night. Encounters are still few and it is a valuable subject for study. Head there at once and begin the survey.
55252.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of
≪Zenaserisu≫ at the nighttime
Waterfall of Colors.
Encounters are still few, making
it a precious subject of study.
Head there at once and begin.
55252.descriptionJp:
夜の彩の滝で≪ゼナセリス≫
の目撃情報がありました。
まだ、遭遇報告も少なく
貴重な調査対象となります。
至急、現地へ向かい調査を
開始してください。

61547.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61547.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61547.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

23665.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
23665.description: Information has come in that Rukodiora was encountered during the survey of White Lake. Head out to slay it and deepen your knowledge of magnetism. When you complete the quest, do not forget to report to the user of the new weapon type.
23665.descriptionEn:
Word has come in that a Rukodiora
was encountered during the survey
of White Lake.
Head out to slay it and deepen
your knowledge of magnetism.

Once you clear the quest, please
don't forget to report to the
user of the new weapon type, all
right?
23665.descriptionJp:
白湖の調査中にルコディオラ
と遭遇したという情報が入っ
てきました。
討伐へ向かって磁力への
見識を深めてください。

クエストを達成したら、
新しい武器種の使い手さん
に報告を忘れずにお願い
しますね。

21629.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Young Green Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21629.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Young Green Orb?
Its material is essential to
the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
Complete this request and I
shall give you a valuable
decoration material.
21629.descriptionJp:
若緑原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

40138.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40138.description: The Espinas of this forest is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40138.descriptionEn:
The Espinas that lives in this
Great Forest is said to sometimes
carry incredible treasure.
If that's true, I'd very much
like you to go hunt it for us.
We'll split the reward down the
middle.
40138.descriptionJp:
この樹海に生息する棘竜
≪エスピナス≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

62644.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62644.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
62644.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50705.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50705.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
50705.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Diablos's horns,
we will also grant you
some special ingredients
as an extra reward.
50705.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
角竜の角を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

21650.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
21650.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
21650.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

60604.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
60604.description: On the way into the sea of trees, I was surrounded by them. I would gladly have given them all my money and food, but they had the audacity to take all my sheet music! It is second only to my instrument in importance. Can something be done?
60604.descriptionEn:
Just as I reached the Great
Forest, I was surrounded by them.
I'd have given every coin and scrap
of food I had, but those beasts,
of all things, took all my sheet
music!
It's the next most precious thing
after my instrument. Can't you do something?
60604.descriptionJp:
樹海に差し掛かったところで、
ヤツらに囲まれたんだ。
金や食い物なら、ありったけ
くれてやるのに、奴ら、あろ
うことか、私の楽譜を全部奪
っていった！
楽器の次に大切な楽譜なんだ。
なんとかならないだろうか。

55947.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
55947.description: I saw Varusaburosu's lance the other day and took an interest in lances myself. But my boyfriend does not understand at all. If you would show me a hunt with a lance, I will give you a Flame Horn Wyvern Ornament G as thanks! Perhaps I should break up with a boyfriend who will not understand my feelings.
55947.descriptionEn:
After seeing Valsabros's Lance
before, I got interested in lances
too. But my boyfriend doesn't
understand at all. If you'd show me
a hunt with a lance, I'll give you
a ≪Flame-Horned Wyvern Ornament G≫
as thanks! Maybe I should break up
with a boyfriend who won't get
my feelings.
55947.descriptionJp:
前にヴァルサブロスのランス
を見かけてランスにも興味が
出てきたわ。でも彼氏が全然
理解してくれないの。もし
ランスでの狩りを披露してく
れたら≪炎角竜オブジェＧ≫
を御礼に差し上げます！私の
気持ちを理解してくれない
彼氏とは別れようかな。

61159.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
61159.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
61159.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

50066.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
50066.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. Complete it and we will present you with Taikun Zamuza materials, part-break materials included. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50066.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a request
exclusively for members of winning
Guilds in the Hunter Festival.
Complete the request and we will
present you multi-shell crab
materials, including part-break
materials. When accepting, please
bring your Festival Proof.
50066.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用の依頼をご用
意させていただきました。
依頼を達成していただけます
と、特別に部位破壊素材を含
む多殻蟹素材を進呈させてい
ただきます。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

62029.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
62029.description: This is a practice preliminary quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is 10 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
62029.descriptionEn:
This is a practice preliminary
quest for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament. In the real event the
time limit is 10 minutes.
Also, you cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or clear rewards.
62029.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用予選
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が１０分以内です。
また、モンスターの剥ぎ取り
とクリア報酬で、対象モンス
ターの素材は入手できません。

63338.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63338.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63338.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63338.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

62073.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

51040.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
51040.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the fangs of a Blangonga will also grant a special ingredient. A Blangonga's fangs can only be broken with the Fire element.
51040.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Blangonga's fangs,
we will also grant you some special
ingredients as an extra reward.
Blangonga's fangs can only be
broken with the Fire attribute.
Please keep that in mind.
51040.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
雪獅子の牙を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。
雪獅子の牙は火属性でのみ破
壊できます。

63404.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63404.description: Nyahahahaha! Limit break, meow! Two Gravios that broke their limits are wandering the volcano, meow! Can you hunt them, meow? If you do, I will give you a Dark Cat Pack Badge, meow.
63404.descriptionEn:
Nyaha ha ha ha ha!
Limit break, nyaaaaaa!
Two Gravios that broke their own
limits are actually prowling
the Volcano, nya!
Think you can hunt them, nyaa?
If you do manage to hunt them,
I'll give you a ≪Dark Cat Corps
Badge≫, nya.
63404.descriptionJp:
ニャハハハハハハ！
限界突破ニャァァァァァァ！
己の限界を突破した鎧竜が
なんと２頭も火山を
うろついているニャ！
狩れるかニャー？
もしも狩れたニャら、
≪闇猫団バッチ≫を
あげちゃうニャ。

61747.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. Deliver a precious pot and, in return, I will draw up blueprints for a new reel and present them to you. Not an ordinary reel, of course.
61747.descriptionEn:
"Fishing".
It is a solitary hunt, facing the
fish in silence.
If you deliver a valuable pot to
me, I will make you a blueprint
for a new reel as thanks. Of
course, it is no ordinary reel.
61747.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
貴重な壺を納品してくれれば、
お礼に、私が新しいリールの
設計図を作成して進呈しよう。
もちろん、普通のリールじゃ
ないがね。

21606.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21606.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Crocodile Mouth Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21606.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Crocodile Mouth Orb?
Its material is essential to
the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
Complete this request and I
shall give you a valuable
decoration material.
21606.descriptionJp:
鰐口原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

10.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
10.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
10.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

54235.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
54235.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54235.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54235.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

50460.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

23644.description: An Inagami with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Inagami known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23644.descriptionEn:
A ≪Elegant Sire Wyvern≫ whose
tail has grown greatly has
appeared. The Guild classifies
this individual as a Supremacy
with developed parts and will
survey it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any before.
Please survey it with care.
23644.descriptionJp:
尾が大きく発達した≪雅翁龍≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を部位
の発達した≪辿異種≫と位置
づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの雅翁龍より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

62754.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
62754.description: A new species of Carapaceon has been discovered in the caves of Tide Island. The Hunters Guild has named it Taikun Zamuza. It seems to be a Carapaceon that evolved in its own way on the island, and it is said to be marked by two scythes of entirely different shapes. We ask for further study.
62754.descriptionEn:
A new Carapaceon has been found
in the caves of Tidal Island.
The Hunters Guild has named it
the Many-Shell Crab ≪Taikun
Zamuza≫.
It seems to be a Carapaceon that
evolved uniquely on Tidal Island,
and its two scythes of utterly
different shapes are its feature.
We ask for a further survey.
62754.descriptionJp:
潮島の洞窟で新たな甲殻種が
発見されたそうです。
ハンターズギルドでは、
多殻蟹≪タイクンザムザ≫と
名付けました。
どうやら潮島で独自の進化を
遂げた甲殻種のようで、
全く形の違う２本の鎌が
特徴であるとのことです。
更なる調査をお願いします。

22031.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
22031.description: A team member surveying the caves of Tide Island reports that a rumbling can sometimes be heard from deep inside. Some of the team have also seen large rocks move, and unease is spreading. A monster unknown to us may be living there, so we ask for an investigation.
22031.descriptionEn:
From members surveying the caves of
the Tidal Island came a report that
rumbling can sometimes be heard
from deep within the caves.
Also, some members have seen
large rocks moving, and unease
is spreading among them.
An unknown monster may live there,
so please investigate.
22031.descriptionJp:
潮島の洞窟を調査中の団員よ
り、洞窟の奥深くから地響き
が聞こえることがあるとの
報告がありました。
また、団員の中には
大きな岩が動くのを見た者も
おり不安が広がっています。
未知のモンスターが生息して
いる可能性があるため調査を
お願いします。

50758.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50758.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50758.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

54102.description: This time I mean to survey the Pokaradon, whose existence was first confirmed in the Polar Sea. It is a monster with much still unknown, so my hands itch for it! Oh yes, this time I am making breaking its back and severing its tail mandatory. Do not forget.
54102.descriptionEn:
This time we'll be surveying the
Pokaradon, whose habitation was
confirmed in the Polar Sea for the
first time.
It's a monster with plenty still
unknown, so my arms are itching!
Oh, right, I'm making back breaks
and tail cuts mandatory this time.
Don't forget, okay.
54102.descriptionJp:
今回は極海で初めて生息が
確認された、ポカラドンの
調査を行おうと思うの。
まだまだわからないことが
多いモンスターだから、
腕が鳴るわね！そうそう、
背中の破壊と尻尾の切断を
今回は必須にさせてもらって
いるわ。忘れないでね。

55478.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55478.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55478.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55478.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく討究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

50119.description: Listen! A wonderful request has come in! Apparently, if you hunt 1 Aberrant monster including its part breaks, you can get lots of Aberrant Hunting Books! A chance like this does not come often, so why not go?
50119.descriptionEn:
Listen to this! An amazing request has
come in!
Apparently, if you hunt one Rare Species
including part breaks, you will receive
a whole lot of Rare Species Hunting
Notes! A chance like this does not
come often, so why not give it
a try?
50119.descriptionJp:
聞いてください！すごい依頼
が舞い込んできましたよ！
なんと奇種を１頭、部位破壊
込みで狩猟すれば、奇種狩猟
書がたくさんもらえるみたい
です！こんなチャンスはなか
なかないですし、行ってみて
はいかがでしょうか？

50687.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50687.description: We drove the Daimyo Hermitaur Variants causing trouble all over into the New Great Arena. This request is to hunt them. It's a fitting request for skilled hunters like you, don't you think?
50687.descriptionEn:
We have driven the ≪Daimyo
Hermitaur Variants≫ that have been
making trouble everywhere into the
New Great Arena.
This request is to hunt them.
I think it's a request fit for
skilled hunters like you, don't
you agree?
50687.descriptionJp:
あちこちで悪さをしている
≪ダイミョウザザミ変種≫
たちを、新大闘技場に追い
込んだ。
今回の依頼内容は、奴らの
狩猟だ。君たちの様な凄腕の
ハンターにこそ、ふさわしい
依頼だと思うがどうだね？

54318.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐

62580.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の討伐
62580.description: Have you been to the top of the sea of trees!? Word is that from a rare Hypnocatrice species you can get both of the notes recording the lost secret of arms manufacturing, the Mercury Memo and the Neodymium Memo! It seems you need to break its beak too, so be careful!
62580.descriptionEn:
Have you been to the Top of the
Great Forest!?
Word is you can get both
≪Mercury Memo≫ and ≪Neodymium
Memo≫, the notes recording the
lost secret of crafting arms and
armor, from a ≪Hypnocatrice
Rare Species≫!
You'll need to break its beak too, so watch yourself!
62580.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に行ってみたか！？
なんでも、≪ヒプノック希少
種≫から、失われたとされて
いた武具の製造の秘伝を記し
たメモ、≪メルクリメモ≫と
≪ネオジムメモ≫が両方とも
手に入るって噂だぜ！
クチバシの破壊も必要らしい
から気をつけな！

21417.objectiveJp: 七色たんぽぽ５０個の納品
21417.description: Greetings. We meet for the first time. Do you gather between hunts? I think this is a good opportunity, so would you show me the fruits of your gathering? Of course, I will pay.
21417.descriptionEn:
Good day to you.
How do you do.
Do you do any gathering
between your hunts now and then?
I think this is a good opportunity,
so would you show me
the results of your gathering?
Of course, I will give you
a reward for your trouble.
21417.descriptionJp:
ごきげんよう。はじめまして。
ちょっとした狩りの合間に
採取をしていますか？
これも一つのいい機会だと
思いますので、あなたの採取
の成果を見せていただけない
かしら？
もちろん、報酬はお渡ししま
すから。

62643.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62643.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
62643.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

60591.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
60591.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Daimyo Hermitaur. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin and Transcendent weapons only!
60591.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time's
target is the ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫!
You'll clear the objective together
with your Guildmates.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest — go and take a splendid
top placement!
This one is held with Origin and
Transcendent weapons only!
60591.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は始種・遷悠武器限定
で開催されているぞ！

62518.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐

54910.description: This quest yields upgrade materials and the like for 1 part of the Dragon series, G-rank Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54910.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
upgrade materials for one piece of
the ≪G Rank Armor≫ Dragon Series,
among other things.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
54910.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪Ｇ級防具≫
ドラゴンシリーズ１部位分
の強化素材などが入手できま
す。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

26348.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
26348.description: An extremely powerful Bulldrome Variant has been confirmed in the swamp. Please dispose of it with the greatest urgency! If you think of it as an ordinary Bulldrome, you will get hurt!
26348.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Bulldrome
variant has been confirmed in the Swamp.
Please hurry and deal with it!
If you think it is the same as
a normal Bulldrome, you will
get hurt badly!
Do not let your guard down!
26348.descriptionJp:
沼地で、極めて強力なドス
ファンゴの変種が確認されて
います。大至急、退治して
きてください！
普通のドスファンゴと同じ
ように考えていると痛い目
を見ますよ！

21742.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
21742.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
21742.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!
21742.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君！
武具を手に入れただけで
満足しているのでは？
それではイカンのです！
このクエストを達成して、
更なる武具の強化を成し遂げ
ましょう！

28011.description: Hey. This time I trained myself in the volcano, sweating it out. And then it appeared. Honestly, it's rough. But beyond this there must be tomorrow. So I want the hunting party members to try it too.
28011.descriptionEn:
Hey there. This time I was in the
Volcano sweating it out training
myself. And then it showed up.
Honestly, it's rough. But I'm sure
I can see tomorrow beyond this.
So I want all my Guildmates to
take the challenge too.
28011.descriptionJp:
おッス。今回は火山で汗をか
きながら自分自身を鍛えてい
たッス。そしたら出たッス。
正直、しんどいッス。だけど
この先に明日が見えるに違い
ないッス。なので猟団のみな
さんにも挑戦して欲しいッス。

50559.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
50559.description: The moon is beautiful tonight. What do you see in its patterns? A rabbit? Not in my country. That is right, go and hunt a monster that resembles the moon's pattern and compare. Then you will understand something.
50559.descriptionEn:
The moon is beautiful tonight.
What do you see in its pattern?
A rabbit? In my country it's not.
That's it — hunt a monster that
looks like that moon pattern and
compare them.
Then you'll understand something.
50559.descriptionJp:
今夜は月が綺麗だね。
君は月の模様が何に見える？
ウサギ？僕の国では違うね。
そうだ、あの月の模様に
似たモンスターを狩ってきて
比べてご覧よ。
そうしたら何かわかるから。

62688.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

63250.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
63250.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
63250.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

55243.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55243.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.
55243.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されて
いる一部防具や装飾品の強化
に使用するＨＣ素材やＧＨＣ
素材を獲得できるクエストを
ご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

21107.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品
21107.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern. True to the name, it sprays poison everywhere and thrashes about, a nuisance of a bird wyvern. It has a cunning side too, playing dead when it senses danger. Be careful.
21107.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ is known by
another name: Poison Bird.
Just as the name says, it
sprays poison and thrashes
about, a real nuisance. It
plays dead when danger
threatens. Do be careful.
21107.descriptionJp:
≪ゲリョス≫は別名、毒怪鳥
と呼ばれるモンスターだわ。
呼び名のとおり、毒液を吐き
散らして暴れまわる迷惑な怪
鳥なの。自分の身に危機を感
じると死に真似をするズル賢
い面もあるわ。注意してね。

61568.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61568.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61568.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

26145.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26145.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26145.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

50740.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50740.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50740.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

50757.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
50757.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50757.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50757.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

53142.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
53142.description: Do you have enough armor upgrade materials? On this quest, which I present to you today, you can obtain great quantities of the Sharp Armor Sphere and Firm Armor Sphere used to upgrade armor. However, please note that the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited.
53142.descriptionEn:
Are you short on armor upgrade
materials?
This request, introduced today, lets you
obtain large amounts of ≪Armor Sphere++≫
and ≪Hard Armor Sphere≫ used for
armor upgrades.
However, there is a limit to how many
times you can accept it per day,
so please be careful.
53142.descriptionJp:
防具の強化素材は足りていま
すか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
防具の強化に使用する
≪尖鎧玉≫と≪堅鎧玉≫を
大量に獲得できますよ。
ただし、１日に受注できる数
に限りがありますので、
ご注意ください。

23431.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
23431.description: Information has come in that Rukodiora was encountered during the survey of the desert. It appears far more ferocious than previous individuals and to display movements not found in our research records. We ask for further investigation before danger reaches those nearby.
23431.descriptionEn:
Word has come in that a survey team
in the Desert encountered Rukodiora.
It seems to be far more ferocious than
previous individuals, and to show
movements not found in our research
data. Before danger can spread to the
surrounding area, we request a
further survey.
23431.descriptionJp:
砂漠の調査中にルコディオラ
と遭遇したという情報が入っ
てきました。どうやら、今ま
での個体よりも格段に狂暴で、
研究資料にない動きも見せて
いたようです。周囲に危険が
及ぶ前に、さらなる調査を依
頼します。

23656.description: The Variant Species Toridokuresu has appeared once more. Its developed wings not only convert gathered light into electricity more efficiently, they seem to have gained the means to discharge it as well. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23656.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Toridcless≫ has appeared
once again.
Its developed wings not only convert
gathered light into electricity more
efficiently, but also seem to possess
the means to discharge it.
Please take great care
in your survey.
23656.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪トリドクレス≫
が再び現れました。
発達した翼は集めた光をより
効率よく電気に変えるのみな
らず、放出する術も備えてい
る様です。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

26622.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26622.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26622.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

54648.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54648.description: This is terrible! The silver-controlling dragon, a monster of great power, is attacking the interception base! If possible, break its dangerous right and left claws! Please be sure to slay it!
54648.descriptionEn:
This is terrible! A ≪Rukodiora≫
with tremendous power is invading
the Base! If at all possible,
please break the dangerous right
and left claws of the ≪Rukodiora≫!
We ask for a certain slaying,
no matter what it takes!
54648.descriptionJp:
大変です！強力な力を持った
≪司銀龍≫が迎撃拠点に襲来
中です！もし可能であれば、
≪司銀龍≫の危険な右爪と左
爪を破壊してください！
どうか確実な討伐をお願いし
ます！

54482.description: Well? My Stornigred's sharpness is quite good, is it not? While you are at it, I have one request. I want to test its resistance to animal fat, and the Mosswine in the swamp should do nicely. Stick with it a while and I will prepare extra materials.
54482.descriptionEn:
How about it? Pretty good, isn't
it, the sharpness of my
"Stornigred"?
While we're at it, there's one
thing I'd like to ask.
I want to test its endurance against
animal fat, and a Mosswine in the
Swamp should be just right.
If you keep me company a while,
I'll throw in extra materials, eh?
54482.descriptionJp:
どうだ？なかなか良いだろう
オレの「シュトルニグレド」
の斬れ味は。
ついでに一つ頼みたいことが
ある。
動物の脂への耐久度を試して
みたいんだが、沼地のモスな
んかちょうどいいだろう。
ある程度付き合ってくれたら
追加で素材を用意しとくぜ？

40187.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
40187.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40187.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40187.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

62236.description: What, you have business with me? If you call yourself a full-fledged hunter, will you try this job? It may be a little difficult, but it is a good chance to hone your capturing skill. If you do it well, I will share my secret materials. Fwahahahahahaha!
62236.descriptionEn:
What is it, business with me?
If you call yourself a full-fledged
hunter, won't you take on this
request?
It may be a bit difficult, but I
reckon it's a fine chance to hone
your capturing skill.
Do it splendidly and I'll share
my treasured materials with you.
Fuhahahahahahahaha!
62236.descriptionJp:
なんじゃ、ワシに用かい？
お主、一人前のハンターを
名乗るなら、この依頼を受け
てみんかの？
ちょいと難しいかもしれんが、
捕獲の技を磨くいい機会だと
思うがの。
見事に達成したら、ワシの
秘蔵の素材を分けてやろう。
フハハハハハハハハハハハ！

61424.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
61424.description: One of the important things for a hunter is to know a monster's traits well and bring the right equipment and skills. With the artisan gear lent to you this time, even that Shogun Ceanataur's hard shell should split with ease. Do give it a try!
61424.descriptionEn:
One of the important things for a
hunter is knowing a monster's
traits well and preparing the right
equipment and skills. With the
Artisan equipment lent to you this
time, even that Shogun Ceanataur's
hard shell should be cut with ease.
Please give it a try!
61424.descriptionJp:
ハンターにとって重要なこと
のひとつとして、モンスター
の特徴をよく知り、適切な装
備、スキルを用意することが
あります。今回貸与する匠装
備があれば、あの鎌蟹の堅い
殻も易々と斬り裂けるはず
です。是非お試しください！

22139.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
22139.description: Do you have enough armor upgrade materials? On this quest, which I present to you today, you can obtain great quantities of Armor Spheres and High Armor Spheres used to upgrade armor. However, please note that the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited.
22139.descriptionEn:
Are you short on armor upgrade
materials?
This request, introduced today, lets you
obtain large amounts of ≪Armor Sphere≫
and ≪Armor Sphere+≫ used for
armor upgrades.
However, there is a limit to how many
times you can accept it per day,
so please be careful.
22139.descriptionJp:
防具の強化素材は足りていま
すか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
防具の強化に使用する
≪鎧玉≫と≪上鎧玉≫を
大量に獲得できますよ。
ただし、１日に受注できる数
に限りがありますので、
ご注意ください。

63138.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63138.description: As part of a monster survey, I ask you to hunt the Yian Kut-Ku in the New Great Arena. It is extremely powerful and behaves in ways normally unthinkable, so this is a quite dangerous request, but if the surveyors obtain satisfactory results you should earn high standing from the Guild.
63138.descriptionEn:
As part of our monster survey, we
ask you to hunt the ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫
in the New Great Arena.
It is extremely powerful and acts
in ways normally unthinkable, so
this is a quite dangerous request,
but if you achieve a result that
satisfies the survey team, you
should earn high praise from
the Guild.
63138.descriptionJp:
モンスター調査の一環として
新大闘技場にいる≪怪鳥≫
の狩猟をお願いします。
非常に強力で通常では考えら
れない行動を取るため、
かなり危険な依頼となります
が、調査員が満足できる
結果を得られたならば、
ギルドから高い評価を得られ
るはずです。
