61360.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61360.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
61360.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

23447.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23447.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪H Bowgun Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪H Bowgun Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪H Bowgun Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or higher,
so please keep that in mind.
23447.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｈボウガン勲・序≫５０個
≪Ｈボウガン勲・中≫６０個
≪Ｈボウガン勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

23702.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (arms), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
23702.descriptionEn:
This quest discharges
materials for upgrading
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(arms), excluding weapon
ribbons and weapon merits.
The yield is one type.
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫,
so please keep that
in mind.
23702.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（腕防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

61009.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
61009.description: A mighty flame was sighted in the swamp. Please investigate at once. Because it is unsurveyed, we cannot supply items. Head out with every preparation!
61009.descriptionEn:
A mighty flame was sighted
in the Swamp. We ask for an
urgent survey.
As it is unsurveyed, no items
can be supplied. Go in with
every precaution!
61009.descriptionJp:
沼地で強大な炎が目撃
されました。至急調査を
お願いします。
未調査のためアイテム支給
は不可能です。万全の態勢
をもって向かってください！

50749.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
50749.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to slay an extremely powerful Harudomerugu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50749.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are
seeking those who will slay
an exceptionally powerful
Dahren Mohran.
Slay it with skill and we
shall issue more Proofs of
Slay than usual!
50749.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ハルドメルグ≫の個体を
討伐してくださる方を募集
しております。
見事に討伐できましたら、
普段よりも多めに討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

62070.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
62070.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Red Khezu in the Snowy Mountains. Clear the quest without mishap and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
62070.descriptionEn:
The time has come for
hunters to show their skill!
Hunt the Red Khezu in the
Snowy Mountains.
Clear the quest safely and
your reputation as a
hunter will rise
in a hurry!
62070.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
雪山の≪フルフル亜種≫を
狩猟してみせろ。
無事、クエストをクリア
できたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

62456.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62456.description: What, you just want a hard Hunting Horn? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62456.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really stiff
Hunting Horn?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to come by, and nasty
monsters are prowling around
the area to boot.
Go find it with all your spirit!
62456.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅い狩猟笛が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

55141.description: Slaying an Espinas raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55141.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying Espinas raises
your standing while letting
you cheaply obtain the
materials needed for a
G Rank decoration.
Please make good use of it.
55141.descriptionJp:
エスピナスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

54319.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐

60033.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
60033.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!
60033.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在です。
姿無きところから姿を現わし
熟練の狩人でも手に負えない。
捕獲なんて無理なことは考え
ないで慎重かつ着実に攻撃を
重ねるしかないと思います！

21656.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
21656.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Garum Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21656.descriptionEn:
Those notes on the lost secret
art of forging gear have been
found on monsters slain all
over the place, or so I hear!
Once you get a ≪Garm Memo≫,
man to man, bring it to this
workshop head right here!
I'll show you fine work!
21656.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ガルムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

63410.client: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang
63410.clientEn: Chairman of the Dark Felyne Gang

50770.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
50770.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a limited time request to slay the Greadmos. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Aim for it! G-rank hunter!
50770.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting life,
we have prepared a limited-time
request to slay Gureadomosu.
Clear this request and you
earn higher standing than
usual.
Aim for it! G Rank hunter!
50770.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、≪水砦竜≫を討伐す
る依頼を期間限定で用意しま
した。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より高い評価が得られます。
目指せ！Ｇ級ハンター！

21006.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21006.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! Hunt one and your skill is quite something! They say a sound burst by its ear can make it weep?
21006.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
If you can hunt a Yian Kut-Ku,
your skill is quite something!
They say making a sound by its
ear can even make it shed tears?
21006.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね！
イャンクックが狩猟できれば
狩りの腕もなかなかのもので
す！耳元で音を鳴らせばナミ
ダをこぼすこともあるとか？

63087.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
63087.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63087.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63087.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

61065.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
61065.description: This is the final quest of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from carving or clear rewards.
61065.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Target monster materials
cannot be obtained from
carving or clear rewards.
61065.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの決勝クエスト
です。
モンスターの剥ぎ取りと
クリア報酬で対象モンスター
の素材は入手できません。

26314.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26314.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26314.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26314.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

63276.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Pariapuria. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63276.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are
seeking hunters to slay an
exceptionally powerful
Pariapuria.
Should you hunt it with skill,
we shall issue more Proofs of
Slay than usual!
63276.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪パリアプリア≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に狩猟
できましたら、普段よりも
多めに討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

23549.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23549.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23549.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55662.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55662.descriptionEn:
Hunters who would master
the Gunlance, face the
Baruragaru of the New Great
Arena and show the skill
you have tempered!
Hunt it well and you shall
earn a reward far beyond
what your daily efforts
bring you.
55662.descriptionJp:
銃槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

60644.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
60644.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Kamu Orgaron! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60644.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Kam Orugaron!
To hunt a monster all alone,
what spirit! Bravo! Overcome
yourself and take a top rank!
This time it is Origin weapons
only!
60644.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪カム・オルガロン≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は始種武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

54997.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
54997.description: There has been a sighting of Teostra in the volcano. It appears to unleash attacks unlike those confirmed before. We have decided to entrust the survey only to G-rank hunters of proven skill, so G-rank hunters, please take on the investigation.
54997.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a Teostra
sighted in the Volcano.
It seems to unleash attacks
different from those confirmed
before.
The survey will be entrusted
only to G Rank hunters of
proven skill, so G Rank hunters
are asked to take it on.
54997.descriptionJp:
火山にて、テオ・テスカトル
の目撃情報が入ってきました。
どうやらこれまで確認されて
いたものとは異なる攻撃を繰
り出してくるようです。
腕前の確かなＧ級のハンター
にのみ、調査を依頼すること
となりましたので、Ｇ級ハン
ターは調査をお願い致します。

1010.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
1010.description: The Gypceros seems to have appeared in the jungle!? And word is it is a purplish subspecies! In the jungle this season the small monsters should be less of a nuisance, so it should be a chance! Do not forget antidote items!
1010.descriptionEn:
A Gypceros, the Poison Bird,
has shown up in the Jungle!?
And they say it is the purple-
tinted subspecies! In this
season the Jungle has few
small monsters, so it is your
chance! Do not forget antidotes!
1010.descriptionJp:
毒怪鳥≪ゲリョス≫が密林に
現れたらしいぞ！？しかも
体色が紫がかった亜種だって
話だ！今の季節の密林ならば
小型モンスターたちの邪魔も
少なく、チャンスなハズだ！
解毒アイテムも忘れるなよ！

50381.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50381.description: Lately, when transporting goods in the jungle, we have often been attacked by monsters. I want it dealt with before great damage is done. The goods being transported are armor materials for rookie hunters like you. If you complete the request, I will share a little with you.
50381.descriptionEn:
Lately, whenever we haul supplies
through the Jungle, monsters
attack us so often.
Before real damage is done,
I want it dealt with.
What we carry is equipment
material for rookie hunters
like you. If you clear this
request, I'll share a little
with you.
50381.descriptionJp:
最近、密林で物資の運搬をし
ていると、モンスターに襲わ
れることが多くてね。大きな
被害が出てしまう前に、
なんとかして欲しいんだ。
運搬している物は、キミたち
のような新米ハンター向けの
装備素材だ。もし、依頼を
達成してくれたら少し分けて
あげよう。

61846.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. Deliver a precious pot and, in return, I will draw up blueprints for a new reel and present them to you. Not an ordinary reel, of course.
61846.descriptionEn:
"Fishing".
It is a solitary hunt, facing the
fish in silence.
If you deliver a valuable pot to
me, I will make you a blueprint
for a new reel as thanks. Of
course, it is no ordinary reel.
61846.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
貴重な壺を納品してくれれば、
お礼に、私が新しいリールの
設計図を作成して進呈しよう。
もちろん、普通のリールじゃ
ないがね。

61343.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61343.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61343.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62313.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Hi-Metal L blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62313.descriptionEn:
If you listen to nature's
voice, you may gain ideas
beyond human wit.
This request will help you
upgrade Hi-Metal L blademaster
armor. May your hunting life
remain rich and full
forever.
62313.descriptionJp:
大自然の声に耳を傾ければ
人智を超えた新しい着想を
得られるかもしれません。
この依頼は≪ハイメタＬ≫の
剣士用防具を強化するために
役立つことでしょう。皆様の
狩猟生活がいつまでも充実
したものでありますように。

63085.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63085.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
63085.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
63085.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

50122.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト１匹の納品
50122.description: I wish to tell a friend far away that summer has come. So, if I may ask, would you gather the items that colour the summer? It is a sudden request, so I have arranged the clothing on this side. Please, I ask your help.
50122.descriptionEn:
I wish to tell a friend far
away that summer has come.
So, if I may ask a favor,
would you gather items that
color the summer?
It is a sudden request, so we
have prepared your outfit.
Please, I ask for your help.
50122.descriptionJp:
遠方の知人へ夏が来たことを
伝えたいと思っております。
そこで、お願いなのですが、
夏を彩るアイテムを集めて
きてくれませんか？
急な依頼ですので、服装は
こちらで手配してございます。
是非、よろしくお願いします。

63380.description: So you're the hunter taking my request. That's a help. First, I want you to gather eggs, which go into every kind of sweet. For the sake of everyone trying to convey their feelings through my sweets, I want to make them with care from the ingredients up. Fresh eggs, please!
63380.descriptionEn:
So you are the hunter taking
the job. That helps a lot.
First, I want you to gather
eggs, which every sweet uses.
For everyone trying to convey
their feelings with my sweets,
I want to make candy that is
picky about its ingredients.
Fresh eggs, please!
63380.descriptionJp:
あなたが依頼を受けてくれる
ハンターさんね。助かるわぁ。
まずはどんなお菓子にも使う、
卵を集めて来てほしいの。
アタシのお菓子で想いを
伝えようとしているみんなの
ためにも、材料からこだわった
お菓子を作りたいの。
新鮮な卵を、よろしく頼むわ！

62315.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
62315.description: Lately boars have been multiplying in great numbers in the Snowy Mountains, and injuries keep piling up. The Hunters Guild is seeking people to wipe out this herd led by a Bulldrome. The situation is serious, so the reward includes a rare material some hunters drool over.
62315.descriptionEn:
Lately boars have swarmed the
Snowy Mountains and injuries
keep piling up. The Hunters
Guild is seeking people to wipe
out the herd led by this
≪Bulldrome≫. The situation is
grave, so the reward is rare
material that some hunters
would drool over.
62315.descriptionJp:
近ごろ、雪山に猪が大量に
発生していてケガ人が続出し
ています。ハンターズギルド
は、この≪ドスファンゴ≫を
中心とした群れを退治してく
ださる方々を募集しておりま
す。事態は深刻のため、
報酬も一部のハンターが垂涎
する貴重な素材になります。

55169.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55169.description: Slaying a Tigrex raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55169.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying Tigrex raises
your standing while letting
you cheaply obtain the
materials needed for a
G Rank decoration.
Please make good use of it.
55169.descriptionJp:
ティガレックスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

21076.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21076.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
21076.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!
21076.descriptionJp:
≪シビレ罠≫や≪落とし穴≫
をモンスターの足元に設置す
れば動きを封じることができ
るんです！
それに、モンスターが弱った
ところを捕らえて≪捕獲用麻
酔玉≫で眠らせれば捕獲する
こともできちゃうスグレモノ
なんですよ！

50478.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50478.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
50478.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

50022.description: For hunters who carelessly obtained a Haku Interception Contribution Certificate Yellow from the Harisen Neko. In this request we exchange the certificate for the following materials. Odibatorasu crumbling scale x40, Wyvern shattered claw x40, Pariapuria rotting stone x40.
50022.descriptionEn:
For hunters who happened to
get a ≪Supremacy Yellow
Certificate≫ from Harisen
Neko. This request trades
it for the materials below.
≪Odibatorasu Ruined Scale≫ x40
≪Wyvern Broken Claw≫ x40
≪Devourer Wyvern Rotten Ore≫ x40
50022.descriptionJp:
≪覇種迎撃貢献証黄≫を
ハリセンネコからうっかり
入手したハンターさん。
この依頼で貢献証と引換えに
下記の素材と交換いたします。
≪弩岩竜の崩鱗≫４０個
≪飛竜の砕爪≫４０個
≪呑竜の爛石≫４０個

40162.description: The Pokaradon of the polar sea is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to slay one. We split the reward.
40162.descriptionEn:
The Frozen Sea Beast Pokara
that lives in this Polar Sea
sometimes carries incredible
treasure, or so they say.
If it is true, I would love
for you to slay it for us.
We split the reward.
40162.descriptionJp:
この極海に生息する凍海獣
≪ポカラ≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
討伐してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

50352.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
50352.description: This is sudden, but I want your help with an ecological survey of Nono Orugaron. If possible I would also like parts broken during this survey. I am sorry for the many requests, but for the sake of future research I would be most grateful.
50352.descriptionEn:
This is sudden, but I want
your help surveying the
ecology of Non Orugaron.
For this survey, I would like
part breaks too if possible.
Sorry for all the requests,
but for future research,
please lend a hand.
50352.descriptionJp:
突然だが、≪ノノ・オルガ
ロン≫の生態調査を手伝っ
て欲しい。
今回の調査は可能であれば
部位破壊もお願いしたい。
注文が多く申し訳ないが、
今後の研究のために
是非よろしく頼む。

63027.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
63027.description: This is the practice qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes. Also, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
63027.descriptionEn:
This is the practice qualifying quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
Also, the target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from the clear reward.
63027.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用予選
クエストです。
制限時間は１０分です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

26103.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

22071.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
22071.description: The survey team sent to the volcano reports seeing a gigantic shadow. The shadow had great horns and a silhouette like an oni, they say. We continue to ask hunters to investigate.
22071.descriptionEn:
The survey team sent to the
Volcano reports sighting a
giant shadow.
The shadow had great horns
and a silhouette like an
ogre, they say.
Once again, we ask you
hunters to investigate.
22071.descriptionJp:
火山に派遣されていた調査団
より巨大な影を見たとの報告
が入りました。
その影は大きな角を有し、
まるで鬼のようなシルエット
をしていたといいます。
引き続き、ハンターの皆様に
調査を依頼します。

54352.description: We will continue the investigation of the Hyujikiki that appeared in the highlands. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54352.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of the
Hyujikiki that appeared in
the Highlands. Breaking its
parts is not required, but
we'd be glad if you did!
Hunters, please lend us your
aid!
54352.descriptionJp:
高地に出現したヒュジキキの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

53013.description: This year too I believe many loves were fulfilled, and there were loves that went unanswered. For all of you I have prepared a quest into which you can throw every one of those feelings: hope, expectation, jealousy, despair. Slay the Gypceros and take your next step!
53013.descriptionEn:
This year many loves were
fulfilled, and some were not.
For all of you, we have made
a quest where you can hurl
every feeling you hold:
expectation, hope, envy,
despair, all of it.
Slay the Gypceros and take
your next step!
53013.descriptionJp:
今年も多くの恋が実ったと
思いますし、報われない恋
もあったと思います。
そんな皆様が抱いている期
待、希望、嫉妬、絶望など
の気持ちの全てをぶつける
クエストをご用意しました。
毒怪鳥を討伐し、次なる一
歩を踏み出してください！

62429.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62429.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the devouring wyvern Pariapuria together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62429.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, why not hunt the
Devouring Wyvern Pariapuria
alongside a hunter who has
risen to hold a Secret Art
tome? Learn its unorthodox
moves, and clear the request
together for extra rewards!
62429.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
今回は、秘伝書を持つまでに
上りつめたハンターと一緒に、
呑竜≪パリアプリア≫を
狩猟してきてはいかがだろう。
一味違った身のこなしに倣い、
共に依頼を達成すれば追加で
報酬を用意するぞ！

61201.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

62263.description: It was supposed to end with the last request, but there seems to have been a little more to it. Long ago I found a stone of extreme heat, but I could not carry the ore. Yet I learned that cooling it with that water makes it transportable. So would you deliver a large quantity once more?
62263.descriptionEn:
I thought the last request ended
it, but there seems to be a
little more. Long ago we found
a stone of extreme heat, but we
could not carry that ore.
Yet once cooled by that water,
we learned it could be moved.
So would you deliver a large
amount just one more time?
62263.descriptionJp:
前の依頼で終わりなんだけど、
少し続きがあったみたい。
昔、超高温の石を発見した
のだけれど、この鉱石を運ぶ
ことができなかったの。
でも、あの水で冷却すると、
運べることが分かったわ。
だから、もう一度だけ大量に
納品してくれないかしら？

22021.description: A request recommended for hunters who have come into their own, allowing the production and upgrading of the Stroma Series, Hardcore Armor. Hunt the Baruragaru and you will obtain the materials to craft or upgrade 1 piece of the Stroma Series.
22021.descriptionEn:
This request is recommended
for hunters who have grown
truly skilled.
It lets you forge and upgrade
the Stroma Series, Hardcore
Armor.
Hunt Baruragaru to obtain the
materials to forge and upgrade
one piece of the Stroma Series.
22021.descriptionJp:
凄腕になったハンター
にオススメの
「ストロマシリーズ」
≪剛種防具≫が生産・強化で
きる依頼です。
バルラガルを狩猟すると、
「ストロマシリーズ」１部位
分の生産・強化素材が入手で
きます。

61572.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61572.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61572.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

55835.description: The Variant Species Gravios has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55835.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gravios≫ has
become ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
As it stands this is very dangerous.
Make thorough preparations
before you survey it.
55835.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪グラビモス≫は猛烈
な強さとなり、暴れ続けてい
ます。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

61770.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61770.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61770.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

202.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
202.description: In this arena, monster and hunter face off one on one! This time your opponent is a Yian Kut-Ku. Kut-Ku or not, it is still a wyvern! Do not let your guard down!
202.descriptionEn:
In this Arena you will face
a monster one on one, fair
and square!
This time your opponent is
Yian Kut-Ku. Kut-Ku or not,
it is a wyvern! Do not relax!
202.descriptionJp:
この闘技場ではモンスター対
ハンターで１対１のガチンコ
勝負を行ってもらう！
今回はイャンクックが相手だ。
クックとはいえ、ヤツも飛竜
だからな！気を抜くなよ！

60131.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60131.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60131.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60131.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

55701.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Hypnocatrice through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Great Sword, Hammer, Hunting Horn, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55701.descriptionEn:
From forging one Supremacy
weapon of Supremacy
Hypnocatrice, you obtain the
materials for its first
upgrade and Gz worth of Porta
Card Sakura. Weapon types:
Sword and Shield, Great Sword,
Hammer, Hunting Horn, Gunlance
or Switch Axe. Use it well!
55701.descriptionJp:
辿異種ヒプノックの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
片手剣、大剣、鎚、狩猟笛、
銃槍、剣斧のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

54459.description: The golden dragon we encountered before has, as a result of the survey, been identified as the Gold Dust Dragon, Garuba Daora. Sightings are extremely few, and it is uncertain whether we will meet it on this voyage, but to ensure safety we ask a G-rank hunter to accompany us.
54459.descriptionEn:
It is the golden dragon we met
before. Our survey showed it to
be the Gold Dust Dragon,
≪Garuba Daora≫.
Sightings are extremely few, so
we may not meet it on this
route, but to ensure safety we
ask G Rank hunters to
accompany us.
54459.descriptionJp:
以前に遭遇した金色の龍です
が、調査の結果、金塵龍
≪ガルバダオラ≫であること
がわかりました。
目撃報告が非常に少数で、
今回の運行航路で会遇できる
かわかりませんが、安全確保
の為、Ｇ級ハンターの方の
同行をお願いします。

26340.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26340.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26340.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26340.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54604.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Rathian and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54604.descriptionEn:
The time to show your skill
as a hunter has come!
Hunt the Rathian
with style.
Clear the quest and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!
54604.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪雌火竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

60574.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
60574.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Anorupatisu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60574.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Anorupatisu!
Team up with your Guild mates
and complete the objective.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so aim for the top ranks!
Also, Origin weapons only
this time! Choose with care!
60574.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪アノルパティス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

23405.description: Two Lavasioth have appeared in the G Rank Volcano! I'd love to survey their ecology, so while you slay them, bring back something we can use as a sample. If by chance you get any rare material, it is yours.
23405.descriptionEn:
Two ≪Volganos≫ have appeared
in the G Rank Volcano!
I'd love to survey their
ecology, so while you slay them,
bring back something we can
use as a sample.
If by chance you get any rare
material, it is yours.
23405.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の火山で≪ヴォルガノス≫
が２頭も現れたらしい！
ぜひ生態を調査したいので、
討伐のついでに何かサンプル
になるようなものを取ってき
てください。
万が一、何か珍しい素材が
取れたら差し上げますよ。

62531.description: You love Gunlance, right? Of course you do? Let me tell you something good. No need to hold back! A rare Rathalos has been sighted at the tower, and my hunch says its materials can make an amazing Gunlance. Go once with a Gunlance!
62531.descriptionEn:
You love the Gunlance,
right? Of course you do!
Want me to tell you something
good? No need to hold back!
See, a rare Rathalos was
sighted at the Tower, and my
gut says its parts can forge
a killer Gunlance. Come on,
take your Gunlance out once!
62531.descriptionJp:
キミ、ガンランス大好きだろ
う？そうだろう？イイこと教
えるぞ？な〜に、遠慮しなく
ていいって！なんかさ、塔に
珍しい火竜が目撃されてさ、
僕の勘だと、きっとそいつの
素材で凄いガンランスが作れ
るんだ。さあキミもガンラン
スで一回行ってきなよ！

61347.description: 1 pair of Rathalos was sighted in the Canyon. For an ecological survey, please hunt both. We will take most of the Rathalos materials, but we will pay out some unneeded parts and Canyon specialties as a reward.
61347.descriptionEn:
A pair of Rathalos was sighted
in the Canyon. To survey their
ecology, please hunt both.
We will take most of the
Rathalos materials, but we'll
offer some unneeded parts and
Canyon specialties as
your reward.
61347.descriptionJp:
峡谷で、１対の火竜が目撃さ
れました。生態調査のため、
両方の狩猟をお願いします。
火竜素材の多くはこちらで
引き取らせていただきますが、
一部必要の無い部位や、
峡谷特産品を報酬に出させて
いただきます。

21184.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21184.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21184.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21184.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

50826.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50826.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50826.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

55875.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55875.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55875.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55875.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

26617.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26617.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26617.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

50975.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50975.description: Teostra has been confirmed rampaging in the swamp. It will be dangerous in various ways, but please investigate. The reward is precious decoration materials.
50975.descriptionEn:
Teostra has been confirmed to be
running wild in the Swamp.
It will be dangerous in many ways,
but please carry out a survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50975.descriptionJp:
沼地でテオ・テスカトルが暴
れているのが確認されました。
何かと危険かとは思いますが、
調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55901.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55901.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55901.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55901.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

61864.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
61864.description: Do you know the Wedding Icicle? It is an icicle full of romance, formed over a time so long that a man and woman could be joined, have children, and a whole generation pass. Few know of it and it is precious, but if you complete my request I can share a little with you.
61864.descriptionEn:
Do you know the Wedding
Icicle? A man and woman wed,
a child is born, and over the
long years of a generation
it forms, a truly romantic
icicle. Few know of it and
it is precious, but do my
request and I will share some.
61864.descriptionJp:
「冠婚つらら」をご存じか？
男女が結ばれて子供が生まれ、
世代が一巡するほどの長い
時間をかけてできあがった、
ロマンあふれるつららなんだ。
知る者の少ない貴重品だが、
俺の依頼をこなしてくれたら、
少しくらいは分けてやれるぞ。

26033.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26033.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26033.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26033.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

55375.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
55375.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who wish to craft Nargacuga armor! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade Transcendent armor, so please take it on!
55375.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special quest
for hunters who want armor from
the Swift Wyvern ≪Nargacuga≫!
Clear the sub-target to obtain
the materials needed to upgrade
Transcendence Armor, so please
give it a try!
55375.descriptionJp:
迅竜≪ナルガクルガ≫の防具
を作りたいハンターに向けた、
特別クエストを用意しました！
サブターゲットを達成すると
遷悠防具の強化に必要な
素材を入手できますので、
ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

21942.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
21942.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Dyuragaua. I am counting on you!
21942.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
Word is you've hit HR22.
So I've got a favor to ask,
and the pay's a full set of
weapon materials.
Easy job, really—just run
out there and slay a Duramboros
for me and we're square.
I'm counting on you!
21942.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ２２になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってデュラガウア
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

21959.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Hypnocatrice in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21959.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting life,
we have prepared a request to
hunt a Hypnocatrice in the
New Great Arena.
Clear it and you gain higher
standing than usual.
Train efficiently and aim
for even greater heights.
21959.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、新大闘技場で≪眠鳥≫
を狩猟する依頼を用意しまし
た。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より高い評価が得られます。
効率的な鍛練を積み、さらな
る高みを目指しましょう。

28066.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
28066.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28066.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!
28066.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意したぞ！
複数のモンスターの討伐を、
猟団の仲間と成し遂げるのだ！
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

54201.description: The survey of the extreme cold sea is progressing smoothly, and many new materials have been discovered. Most of the materials found can be used for producing and upgrading arms, they say. Many G-rank hunters, who often go to dangerous lands, may be interested.
54201.descriptionEn:
The Polar Sea survey proceeds
well, and many new materials
have been found. Most of them
can be used to forge and
upgrade gear, they say.
Among G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
many may well be
interested.
54201.descriptionJp:
極海の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

40213.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
40213.description: A monster has appeared at the interception base! I need you to hunt it at once. Let me explain the plan. This time we have prepared more supplies than usual. Use them in the hunt. The basis for this plan? A woman's intuition!
40213.descriptionEn:
A monster has appeared at the
Base! I need you to slay it
right away.
Let me explain the operation.
This time we've prepared
extra supplies.
Use them in the hunt.

My basis for this plan?
A woman's intuition!
40213.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点にモンスターが
現れたわ！至急討伐に
当たってほしいの。
作戦を説明するわね。
今回は、支給品を
多めに用意してあるわ。
活用して討伐に当たって。

この作戦の根拠？
女のカンよ！

62866.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62866.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!
62866.descriptionJp:
狩人たちの祭典、狩人祭！
魂を集めて勝利を掴み取れ！
今回紹介するこの依頼は、
シリーズクエスト専用だ！
シナリオを最後まで進めて、
大量の魂をゲットしよう！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

21719.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Soul (Beginning) x８５, Great Sword Soul (Middle) x１９５, Great Sword Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Great Sword Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21719.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Great Sword Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Great Sword Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Great Sword Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Great Sword Soul: Heaven≫ x85
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
21719.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪大剣魂・序≫８５枚
≪大剣魂・中≫１９５枚
≪大剣魂・極≫２７５枚
≪大剣魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

53007.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
53007.description: While tidying the warehouse I found a book on making gear written in letters I cannot read, and I made a trial piece to see. Please use it and tell me what you think. In return I will share a little of the materials for the trial piece, so do me the favour.
53007.descriptionEn:
While tidying the warehouse I
found a book on forging gear
written in unreadable script,
and made a trial piece.
I'd love you to use it and tell
me what you think. In return
I'll share some of the trial's
forging materials, so please.
53007.descriptionJp:
倉庫を整理したら読めない
文字で書かれた武具の製造法
の書物を見つけて、試しに
試作品を作ってみたんだ。
是非、使って感想を聞かせて
欲しい。代わりに試作品の
製造素材を少し分けるから
よろしく頼むよ。

63332.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that guarantees an Armorer's Soul: Wild. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63332.descriptionEn:
For members of a winning
Hunter Festival Guild only, we
have prepared a quest that is
guaranteed to yield the Smith's
Soul [Rough]. When accepting
or joining, bring a Festival Proof.
63332.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪武具職
人魂【荒】≫が確実に手に入
るクエストを用意させていた
だきました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

55766.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55766.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55766.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55766.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

63009.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63009.description: The Secret Certificate [Swift] is proof that a hunter holding a Secret Scroll has reached a certain level of skill. This time's examiner is the Guild's foremost authority, renowned for his eye, so if you meet his standards you can be sure of receiving a large number of Secret Certificates [Swift]. Do not miss this rare chance.
63009.descriptionEn:
≪Secret Proof [Swift]≫
is proof that a scroll-
holding hunter has reached
a certain level of skill.
Our examiner this time is
the Guild's foremost eye,
so if you satisfy him, he
will surely issue many
≪Secret Proof [Swift]≫.
Do not miss this rare chance.
63009.descriptionJp:
≪秘伝の証【急】≫は、
秘伝書所持ハンターとして
一定の実力に到達した証です。
今回の判定員はギルド随一の
権威と観察眼を誇るため、
彼の眼にかなえば、大量の
≪秘伝の証【急】≫を確実に
発行することができますよ。
この希少な機会をどうぞ
お見逃しなく。

58101.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58101.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58101.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58101.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

63252.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
63252.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
63252.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

54886.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54886.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54886.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

21251.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21251.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21251.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

23461.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Bow Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Bow Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23461.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Bow Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Bow Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Bow Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
23461.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪弓綬・序≫１００個
≪弓綬・中≫１６５個
≪弓綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

26184.description: It seems a great many Gabras have gathered at the tower. They are said to be an omen of calamity, so the Guild cannot ignore it either. Slay 8 Gabras and confirm the situation.
26184.descriptionEn:
It seems a great many Remobra
have gathered at the tower.
They are said to herald disaster,
so the Guild cannot simply
ignore them.
Slay 8 Remobra and check on
the situation for us.
26184.descriptionJp:
何やら塔に多くのガブラスが
群れ集っておるようじゃ。
奴らは災厄の前触れとも言われ
ておるゆえ、ギルドとしても
捨ててはおけぬ。
ガブラス８頭を討伐し、状況
を確認してきて欲しい。

63010.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
63010.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63010.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
63010.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

21910.description: A request recommended for hunters who reached HR100, letting you forge and upgrade the Hardcore Armor "Stroma Series." Hunt a Baruragaru to obtain forge and upgrade materials for one "Stroma Series" piece.
21910.descriptionEn:
A request recommended for
hunters who reached HR100,
letting you forge and upgrade
the ≪Hardcore Armor≫
"Stroma Series."
Hunt a Baruragaru to obtain
forge and upgrade materials
for one "Stroma Series"
piece.
21910.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００になったハンター
にオススメの
「ストロマシリーズ」
≪剛種防具≫が生産・強化で
きる依頼です。
バルラガルを狩猟すると、
「ストロマシリーズ」１部位
分の生産・強化素材が入手で
きます。

51097.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51097.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a Black Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
51097.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the horns of the
Black Diablos also grants
you special ingredients.
51097.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒角竜の角を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

21611.description: Do you know the orb called Moonwhite Orb? Its material is indispensable for producing a certain expensive decoration. If you complete this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21611.descriptionEn:
Do you know the sphere called
Moonwhite Sphere?
Its material is essential to
forging a certain expensive
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I shall give you a precious
decoration material.
21611.descriptionJp:
月白原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

62005.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Plesioth. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62005.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest to slay
a ≪Plesioth≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
fellow hunters?
62005.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ガノトトス≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

23422.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
23422.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Toa Tesukatora, the Frozen King Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23422.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from Toa Tesukatora,
the Freezing King Wyvern.
To accept the quest,
a Superia Ticket is
required.
If the quest fails, the
Superia Ticket is consumed,
so please take care.
23422.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、凍王龍
≪トア・テスカトラ≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

26170.description: I ask you to procure materials for the medicine I am researching now. Once you complete every last must-order, I will give you the Potion materials I have spare! Combine as much as you like!
26170.descriptionEn:
Please gather materials for the
medicine I'm researching now.
Once you clear every Must
Order, I'll give you the
≪Potion≫ materials I have
left over!
Mix as much as you
like!
26170.descriptionJp:
今、僕が研究している薬の
素材調達をお願いします。
マストオーダー全てを達成
した暁には、僕のところに
余っている≪回復薬≫の素材
を差し上げます！
どうぞ好きなだけ調合して
ください！

26018.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
26018.description: So a subspecies of the already rare Monoblos has appeared, has it. To go beyond proving yourself first-rate and make your name ring out, you must hunt it alone! Prepare yourself and take up the hunt!
26018.descriptionEn:
A white one-horned wyvern, no
less: a Monoblos subspecies, a
truly rare sight, has appeared.
To go beyond proving yourself
first-rate and make your name
resound, you must "hunt it
alone". Steel yourself and go!
26018.descriptionJp:
白き一角竜とはこれまた希少
性の高いモノブロスの亜種が
現れたようじゃな。
一流の証明を超えて、己の
名声を響かせるには、やはり
『１人で狩猟』することじゃ
心して狩猟に挑むがよい！

55982.objectiveJp: セルレギオス１頭の討伐
55982.description: So you mean to take on a job from a Dark Cat Pack executive? An executive's job is a cut above the rest. Slack off and you will be crying. Complete it and I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Seal, Blue.
55982.descriptionEn:
You feel like taking on a request
from a Dark Cat Gang exec, nya?
An exec's request is a cut or
two above the rest, nya.
Slack off and you'll be crying, nya.
Clear it and I might even give
you a ≪Dark Cat Gang Seal: Blue≫,
nya.
55982.descriptionJp:
この闇猫団幹部からの依頼に
挑戦する気かニャ？
幹部の出す依頼はひと味も
ふた味も違うニャ。
油断して泣きをみるニャよ。
依頼を達成した暁には、
≪闇猫団シール・青≫を
くれてやってもいいニャ。

54296.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
54296.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54296.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54296.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

26556.description: Hunting in an untrodden land, that is surely the true thrill of the hunter. You understand? So, a hunting request in the Highlands. The purpose is an ecological survey, so finish it quickly while no big game is about.
26556.descriptionEn:
Hunting in untrodden lands, that is
the true thrill of being a hunter.
You know what I mean?
So, here is a hunting request for
the ≪Highlands≫. The goal is an
ecology survey, so finish it quickly
while nothing big is around.
26556.descriptionJp:
未踏の大地での狩猟、これ
こそがハンターの醍醐味
だろう。わかるよな？
てなわけで≪高地≫での狩猟
依頼だ。生態調査が目的なの
で、大物がいない間にさっと
済ませてきてくれよ。

62427.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the snow lion Blangonga together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62427.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, why not hunt the
Snow Lion Blangonga alongside
a hunter who has risen to
hold a Secret Art tome?
Learn its unorthodox moves,
and clear the request with
them for extra rewards!
62427.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
今回は、秘伝書を持つまでに
上りつめたハンターと一緒に、
雪獅子≪ドドブランゴ≫を
狩猟してきてはいかがだろう。
一味違った身のこなしに倣い、
共に依頼を達成すれば追加で
報酬を用意するぞ！

54784.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54784.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54784.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

63146.description: I want to see a new side of Guku. To that end I am making an original pattern, and could you model for it? If you help, I will share some of the finished pattern.
63146.descriptionEn:
I want to see a new side
of the Gook. So I plan to
make an original pattern,
and I was wondering if you
could model for it.
If you help me, I will
share a little of the
finished pattern with you.
63146.descriptionJp:
グークの新しい一面を見たい
と思っているの。そのために
オリジナルの型紙を作ろうと
思っているのだけど、その
モデル役をお願いできない
かしら。手伝ってくれたら
出来上がった型紙を
少し分けてあげるわ。

60065.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61254.description: In celebration of the reborn Mezepolta Plaza, feasts are being held all over. I understand the festive mood, but at this rate the plaza will run out of food in no time. Before that happens, hurry and gather ingredients! There is no time left!
61254.descriptionEn:
To celebrate the reborn
Mezepolta Plaza, there are
feasts everywhere.
I get the festive mood, but
at this rate the food will
vanish from the plaza in no
time. Before that happens,
hurry and gather ingredients!
There is no time left!
61254.descriptionJp:
新しく生まれ変わった
『メゼポルタ広場』を祝って、
そこら中で宴をやっているわ。
浮かれる気持ちも分かるけど、
この分だとあっという間に
広場から食料が消えるわね。
そうなる前に、急いで食材を
集めて来てちょうだい！
もう時間がないわ！

61324.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
61324.description: A suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress at tremendous speed! At once, make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon! If our strength is not enough, breaking that giant leg alone will do.
61324.descriptionEn:
A suspicious dragon is approaching
the Fortress at tremendous speed!
At once, make use of the Fortress's
interceptor weapons and repel the
mysterious giant dragon!
If your strength is not enough, then
at least break those giant legs
for us.
61324.descriptionJp:
怪しげな龍が物凄い勢いで
砦に接近してきています！
大至急、砦の迎撃兵器を活用
し、謎の巨大龍を撃退して
ください！
戦力が及ばない場合、あの巨
大な脚の破壊だけでもお願い
します。

60326.objectiveJp: 銀火竜の尻尾１個の納品
60326.description: To set foot in the closed secret region, a qualification is required. That qualification is none other than the Secret Area Set. He who opens the gates of heaven and takes that qualification in hand will surely find fortune deep within the closed secret region...
60326.descriptionEn:
To set foot in the closed hidden
area, one needs a qualification.
That qualification is none other
than the ≪Secret Area Set≫.
Those who open the gates of
heaven and gain that right shall
find fortune deep in the closed
hidden area...
60326.descriptionJp:
閉ざされた秘境に足を踏み入
れるには、資格が必要となる。
その資格とは≪秘境セット≫
に他ならない。
天国の門を開き、その資格を
手にした者は、閉ざされた
秘境の奥に、幸いを見つける
ことだろう･･･。

26014.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
26014.description: The king of the skies, Rathalos, is said to make its lair in the mysterious hunting ground, the Ancient Tower. We are seeking brave hunters to confirm whether that is true! Your opponent this time is the Azure King. Do not let your guard down until he bows to the ground!
26014.descriptionEn:
The King of the Skies ≪Rathalos≫
is said to nest in the enigmatic
hunting ground ≪Ancient Tower≫.
We seek brave hunters to prove
whether that is true!
Your foe this time is the
≪Azure King≫. Never let your
guard down until he kneels!
26014.descriptionJp:
大空の王≪リオレウス≫は、
謎多き狩猟地≪古塔≫をねぐ
らにしていると云われていま
す。その真偽を確かめられる
勇敢なハンターを募集します！
今度の相手は≪蒼き王者≫。
彼が地にひれ伏すまで、決し
て気を抜かないで下さい！

50994.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50994.descriptionEn:
In this quest we yield the
materials needed to FX-upgrade
Secret Art Armor (blademaster),
excluding weapon souls.
The yield covers five pieces.
To accept the quest, a
10th Anniversary Ticket is
required, so please note.
50994.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（剣士）のFX強化時
に必要な武器魂を除く素材を
排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪10周年チケット≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

23250.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

54418.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54418.description: A surveyor on site reports that Akura Jebia suddenly emerged from underground. The area is said to be calm land where herbivores graze, but if this continues the guild's survey work cannot proceed. We ask you to slay the Akura Jebia!
54418.descriptionEn:
Local surveyors report that
Akura Jebia suddenly
emerged from underground.
The area is said to be calm
land where herbivores graze,
but as things stand the
Guild's survey work cannot
proceed.
Please, we ask you to slay
the Akura Vashimu!
54418.descriptionJp:
現地の調査員から、突如、
地中から≪アクラ・ジェビア≫
が出現したとの報告がありま
した。
辺りは草食種がいる穏やかな
土地らしいのですが、このま
までは、ギルドの調査作業が
進みません。
ぜひ、≪灰晶蠍≫の討伐を
お願いします！

60645.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Plesioth. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60645.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Plesioth!
Team up with your Guild mates
and complete the objective.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so aim for the top ranks!
This time it is Origin weapons
only!
60645.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ガノトトス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は始種武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

60234.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gasurabazura! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60234.descriptionEn:
The hunting tournament where
hunters match their skill!
This time the target is
Gasurabazura!
To hunt a monster all alone,
what spirit! Bravo! Overcome
yourself and take a top rank!
60234.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ガスラバズラ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

62108.description: As for the Great Hunt on Solitude Island, that gigantic monster called Raviente seems to lie silent on one of the islands. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so the survey will be brief, but please join.
62108.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Great Hunt on
the ≪Isolated Island≫: the
colossal monster known as
the ≪Raviente≫ appears to
lie silent on one island.
We are forming a survey
team open only to hunters
who took part, so please do
join us for a short survey.
62108.descriptionJp:
≪絶島≫で行われた大討伐の
結果ですが、≪大巌竜≫と呼
ばれたあの巨大なモンスター
は島のひとつで沈黙している
ようです。大討伐に参加した
ハンター限定の調査団を編成
することとなりましたので、
短時間の調査となってしまい
ますが、是非ご参加ください。

21539.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21539.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21539.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21539.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

62990.description: Reports are coming one after another that an unidentified monster is on the rampage around Mezeporta. The situation is still tense, with even skilled hunters who set out being caught up in it. To save us from this crisis we are recruiting hunters confident in their skill.
62990.descriptionEn:
Reports keep coming in of an
unidentified monster on a rampage
around Mezeporta.
Ace hunters who went out to hunt
have been caught up in it, and
the situation is still tense.
To save us from this crisis we
seek hunters sure of
their skill.
62990.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺で未確認の
モンスターが暴れていると
の報告が相次いでいます。
狩猟に出かけた凄腕ハンター
が巻き込まれるなど、
未だ状況は緊迫しています。
この危機を救うため
腕に自信のあるハンターを
募集します。

26461.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

26220.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

26514.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
26514.description: Monsters vary as individuals. The Khezu is a particularly special case among them, so this sort of individual is comparatively easy to come across... Hunters who cannot quite follow all this, well, hunt one anyway and you will have something to talk about.
26514.descriptionEn:
Monsters differ one from another.
Khezu are an especially peculiar
lot even among them, so
individuals like this turn up
rather often...
Hunters who can't follow all
this talk, well, just hunt one
for the sake of a story.
26514.descriptionJp:
モンスターには個体差がある。
フルフルはその中でも、とり
わけ特殊な部類に入るため、
比較的このような個体が見ら
れやすい･･･。
話がよく見えないハンター諸
君は、まあ、とりあえず話の
種に一つ狩ってきたまえよ。

21348.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21348.description: The other day, while gathering in the Forest and Hills, I was set upon by 2 Rathalos. I escaped with my life, but I cannot leave that place to them as their territory. Will you not rid us of them? For your trouble, take this Sturdy Jawbone.
21348.descriptionEn:
The other day, while gathering in
the Forest and Hills, two
≪Rathalos≫ attacked me.
I somehow kept my life, but I
cannot leave the Forest and Hills
to those beasts' territory.
Won't you rid us of them?
In thanks, I'll give you this
≪Sturdy Jawbone≫.
21348.descriptionJp:
先日森丘で採取をしていたら、
２頭の≪リオレウス≫に襲わ
れたのだ。わしはなんとか一
命を取り留めたが、いまやそ
いつらの縄張りと化している
森丘をこのまま放っておくこ
とはできぬ。そいつらを退治
してくれないか？お礼に、こ
の≪頑丈な顎骨≫をやろう。

61853.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
61853.description: The Barbarian Wyvern newly confirmed in the highlands. It is a dangerous flying wyvern to begin with, but among them an individual of outstanding strength was confirmed the other day. It will be a very dangerous request requiring proof of skill, but please investigate and hunt it!
61853.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gurenzeburu≫ has been newly
confirmed in the Highlands.
Flying wyverns are dangerous
already, but an exceptionally
powerful individual was sighted
the other day. This is a very
dangerous request that proves
your skill, but please take on
the survey and the hunt!
61853.descriptionJp:
高地で新たに確認された
≪蛮竜≫。ただでさえ危険な
飛竜ですが、その中でも飛び
抜けて強力な個体が先日確認
されたようです。腕前の証明
が必要となる大変危険な依頼
となりますが、調査と狩猟を
お願いいたします！

62703.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐

21077.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21077.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
21077.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!
21077.descriptionJp:
≪シビレ罠≫や≪落とし穴≫
をモンスターの足元に設置す
れば動きを封じることができ
るんです！
それに、モンスターが弱った
ところを捕らえて≪捕獲用麻
酔玉≫で眠らせれば捕獲する
こともできちゃうスグレモノ
なんですよ！

26623.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26623.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26623.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

11006.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
11006.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! Hunt one and your skill is quite something! They say a sound burst by its ear can make it weep?
11006.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
If you can hunt a Yian Kut-Ku,
your skill is quite something!
They say making a sound by its
ear can even make it shed tears?
11006.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね！
イャンクックが狩猟できれば
狩りの腕もなかなかのもので
す！耳元で音を鳴らせばナミ
ダをこぼすこともあるとか？

40135.description: The Rathian of this forest is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40135.descriptionEn:
The Rathian living in this
Great Forest sometimes carries
incredible treasure, or so
they say.
If it is true, I would love
for you to hunt it for us.
We split the reward.
40135.descriptionJp:
この樹海に生息する雌火竜
≪リオレイア≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

55066.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
55066.description: It seems you could not fully upgrade the Kushala Daora gear. I have prepared a fine quest for a hunter like you. The number you can accept per day is limited, but it should help. I wish you success.
55066.descriptionEn:
It seems you could not fully
upgrade your Kushala Daora
gear. For a hunter like you,
I have prepared a fine quest.
There is a daily limit on
how often you can take it,
but it will help. Good luck!
55066.descriptionJp:
どうやら≪鋼龍≫の武具を
強化しきれなかったようだね。
そんなハンターさんのために
素敵なクエストを用意したよ。
一日に受注できる回数に限り
はあるけど、きっと君の役に
立つはずだ。健闘を祈るよ。

54554.description: A Pink Rathian has appeared in the Jungle. It unleashes attacks unlike any before and is said to be giving hunters a great deal of trouble. To keep the damage from spreading further, we ask for your help in hunting it.
54554.descriptionEn:
A Pink Rathian has appeared in
the Jungle. It reportedly unleashes
attacks unlike anything seen before,
and is causing great trouble.
To keep the damage from spreading
any further, we ask for your help
in hunting it.
54554.descriptionJp:
密林にリオレイア亜種が出現
しました。これまでにない
攻撃を繰り出し、非常に手
を焼いているそうです。
これ以上被害が拡大しない
よう、狩猟のご協力をお願
いします。

55538.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
55538.description: The Storm Dragon, Amatsu, has appeared in the mountain range called the sacred peaks. The storm is so powerful it defies imagination, and the surveyors cannot even approach. Considering the damage to the surroundings, a response is needed as soon as possible. Head out to hunt it at once.
55538.descriptionEn:
In the mountain range called the
Sacred Peak, the Storm Dragon
≪Amatsu≫ has appeared.
Its storms are beyond imagining,
and our surveyors cannot even
approach. Given the harm to
surroundings, a response is
needed at once.
Head out to slay it immediately.
55538.descriptionJp:
霊峰と呼ばれる山岳地帯に
嵐龍≪アマツマガツチ≫が
現れました。想像を絶する
ほど強力な嵐によって、
調査員たちは近寄ること
さえできません。周囲への
被害を考えると、一刻も
早い対応が求められます。
至急討伐へ向かって下さい。

50340.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
50340.description: The season of love ends again this year. How about polishing yourself in preparation for what comes next? A hunter who masters G-rank weapons looks truly splendid.
50340.descriptionEn:
The season of love ends
again this year.
Why not polish yourself
for what comes next?
A hunter who wields G Rank
weapons with mastery looks
ever so wonderful, you know.
50340.descriptionJp:
今年も恋のシーズンが終わり
ますね。
これからに備えて自分磨きを
してみたらどうでしょう。
Ｇ級武器を使いこなす
ハンターは、とっても素敵に
見えるものですよ。

53035.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
53035.description: Rumor says that to pray for a boy's success in life, one should hunt a Lavasioth at this time of year! I asked the Guild, and there happens to be a weak Lavasioth in the Volcano! Hunter, hunt one for my child's sake!
53035.descriptionEn:
Word has it that to pray for
a boy's success in life,
hunting a Volganos this time
of year is the thing to do!
I asked the Guild, and sure
enough there is a weak
Volganos in the Volcano!
Hunter, go hunt one for
my boy's sake!
53035.descriptionJp:
噂によると、男の子の立身出
世を祈願するには、
この時期に溶岩竜を狩猟する
といいらしい！
ギルドに問い合わせてみた
ところ、ちょうど火山に弱い
溶岩竜がいるんだってよ！
ハンターさん、俺の子のため
にいっちょ狩ってきてくれよ！

23277.description: A researcher who was exploring the swamp has been carried back to the guild in critical condition. According to the observation notes he left behind, Iodrome and Ioprey have been on the decline in the swamp lately. We would like a confident hunter to investigate and confirm whether this is true.
23277.descriptionEn:
A surveyor exploring the Swamp
was carried to the Guild in
critical condition. From the
notes left by the others, the
Gendrome and Genprey there
seem to be dwindling.
So we ask skilled hunters to
survey and confirm the truth
of it.
23277.descriptionJp:
沼地を探索していた調査員が
ギルドに重体で搬送された。
残された調査員の観察記録に
よると、近ごろ沼地でドス
イーオスやイーオスが減少
傾向にあるらしい。
そこで、腕に自信のある
ハンターに真偽を確かめる
べく調査をお願いしたい。

50766.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Tenran armor. By repeatedly driving off Arganos and Golganos, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
50766.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly repelling
Arganos and Gorganos, you
can obtain the materials
needed to upgrade
"Stroma FX Series"
≪Supremacy≫ armor to Lv7.
50766.descriptionJp:
≪喰血竜≫の≪天嵐防具≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
アルガノスとゴルガノスを繰
り返し撃退することで
「ストロマFXシリーズ」
≪覇種防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

55245.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55245.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55245.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

60208.description: In the Guild's history there was a hunter said to have the strongest arm. This Guild gives an incentive award to hunters who slay one on one the fish wyvern that drove that hunter into retirement, the Plesioth. Please join us.
60208.descriptionEn:
In the history of the Guild there was
a hunter praised as the strongest of
all, a mighty arm.
Our Guild awards a prize to any
hunter who slays one on one the
Plesioth, the fish wyvern species that
drove that hunter into retirement.
Please join us enthusiastically.
60208.descriptionJp:
ギルドの歴史の中でも、最強
の豪腕と謳われたハンターが
いました。
当ギルドでは、そのハンター
を引退にまで追いやった魚竜
種、ガノトトスを１対１で討
伐したハンターに、奨励品を
出しています。
奮ってご参加ください。

53205.description: I have been thinking and thinking about what to give back for White Day, and I really do think candy is best! She will surely be pleased! Hunt properly, get the candy, and give it to that cute girl!
53205.descriptionEn:
I kept thinking about what
to give for White Day,
and I really think candy
is the way to go!
She will be happy, I am sure!
Hunt hard,
get the candy,
and give it to that
cute girl!
53205.descriptionJp:
ホワイトデーのお返し、
ずっと考えていたんだけど
やっぱりキャンディがいいと
思うんだ！
きっと喜んでくれるよね！
しっかり狩りをして〜
キャンディを手に入れて〜
可愛いあの子にプレゼント
しよう！

26464.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
26464.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
26464.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!
26464.descriptionJp:
≪閃光玉≫をモンスターの目
前に投げると強力な光で目を
くらませることができるんで
すよ。
これを使いこなせば、怖いも
のナシですね！
支給品ボックスに入ってます
から遠慮なく使って下さい！

61848.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
61848.description: I give you a trial! Hunt the Kut-Ku that has been appearing in the swamp lately! There may be more than one, so do not be careless! If you have strength left, gathering raw Grey Crystal would be good too. I wish you success!
61848.descriptionEn:
I hereby give you a trial!
Lately a Yian Kut-Ku has been
prowling the Swamp. Hunt it!
There may be more than one,
so do not let your guard down!
If you have strength to spare,
gather Ash Crystals too.
I wish you good fortune!
61848.descriptionJp:
これより試練を与える！
最近、沼地に出没する怪鳥を
狩猟してくるのだ！
１頭だけとは限らないから、
油断するでないぞ！
余力があれば、灰水晶の原石
を集めるのもいいだろう。
健闘を祈る！

23392.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
23392.description: Please hunt the Shining Thunder Bird that appeared in the highlands. It was long thought harmless, but having expanded its territory near human settlements it has become very aggressive. According to the last sighting, it seems to prefer moving through sunlit places.
23392.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the
≪Shining Thunder Bird≫
that appeared in the Highlands.
It was long thought harmless,
but as it spread its territory
near settlements it has grown
very aggressive.
The last sighting suggests
it prefers sunny spots.
23392.descriptionJp:
高地に現れた、≪照雷鳥≫
の狩猟をお願いします。
以前から無害と考えられ
ていましたが、人里近くに
縄張りを広げて来たことに
より、非常に好戦的になって
います。最後の目撃情報に
よると日差しの強い所を
好んで移動しているようです。

56072.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56072.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
