promotion of the newly
started UL Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared
this quest.
Destroying the Cephadrome's
fin will also grant you
a special item.
56002.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、ＵＬ
ギルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
砂竜のヒレを破壊すること
で特別なアイテムも
付与させていただきます。

61889.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
61889.description: Recover the scattered parts of the prototype Great Sword! The Ultrahard Bolt was reported in the desert. Hateful as the large monsters are, cutting down small monsters along with them apparently gathers the parts faster. With all three parts back, the prototype Great Sword is complete!
61889.descriptionEn:
Recover the scattered parts
of the prototype Great Sword!
The "Ultrahard Bolt" was
sighted in the Desert.
Big monsters are a pain, but
cutting the small ones too
gathers parts faster, they say.
With 3 part types back, the
prototype sword is complete!
61889.descriptionJp:
ばらばらになった試作大剣の
部品を取り戻してください！
「超硬ボルト」は砂漠で目撃
されたとの報告がありました。
憎きは大型モンスターですが、
小型モンスターもろとも斬る
ことで部品が早く集まるとか。
３種類の部品が戻ればついに
試作大剣の完成です！

54870.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
54870.description: We present a request that lets you obtain some of the materials needed to upgrade the Brown Espinas's Ｇ-rank gear, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
54870.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
how many you can accept,
but this request yields some
of the materials needed to
upgrade Espinas Subspecies
G Rank gear. Don't miss out!
54870.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、棘茶竜のＧ級
武具の強化に必要な素材の一
部を入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。この機会を逃さぬよ
うご注意ください。

21996.description: In the places I travel to trade, mushrooms are apparently more welcome than fish, nya. So I'd like to ask you to stock goods for me, nya. From the look of you, fish seem to be a problem, nya, so how about fish for the reward, nya?
21996.descriptionEn:
Where I am headed to trade, it
seems mushrooms are more welcome
than fish, meow.
So I would like you to stock up
on goods for me, meow.
You look like you are short on
fish, meow, so how about fish as
your reward, meow?
21996.descriptionJp:
この先、あたしが商いに行く
所では、どうもお魚よりもキ
ノコのが喜ばれるそうニャ。
そこで、商品の仕入れをあん
たにお願いしたいニャ。
見たところあんた。お魚に困
っているようニャから、報酬
はお魚でどうかニャ？

60917.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60917.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
60917.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50714.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
50714.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the horns of a Black Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
50714.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the horns of the
Black Diablos also grants
you special ingredients.
50714.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒角竜の角を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

54178.objectiveJp: 木彫りの人形・赤１個の納品
54178.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54178.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.
54178.descriptionJp:
お疲れ様でした。
クエストを達成し、
≪★６解放記念硬貨≫を
受け取ってください。
ハリセンネコへ持っていけば
良い品と交換してもらえ
ますよ。

50786.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
50786.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the chest of a Black Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
50786.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Black Gravios's
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50786.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒鎧竜の胸部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

53030.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53030.description: Now it is your turn to understand your partner's feelings! I have prepared a quest with the same content as before. But this time you will experience it yourselves as Felyne Comrades! As a small Felyne Comrade you will see a view quite different from usual hunting.
53030.descriptionEn:
Now it's your turn to learn
how your partner feels!
I've prepared a quest with
the same content as before.
But this time, you will all
become Partner Felynes and
experience it for yourselves!
As a small Partner Felyne,
hunts will look quite different.
53030.descriptionJp:
では次は相棒の気持ちを理解
する番だ！先ほどと同内容の
クエストを用意した。しかし、
今度はそのクエストを諸君等
自身がパートニャーとなって
疑似体験してくるのだ！
体の小さいパートニャーに
なったら普段の狩猟とは一味
違う景色がみれるだろう。

54595.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
54595.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54595.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54595.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

54806.description: 2 unidentified monsters of great power are on a rampage together at the Ancient Tower. Head out to slay them at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Secret Art armor, in preparation for greater threats.
54806.descriptionEn:
Two unidentified monsters of
great power are on a rampage
at the Ancient Tower at once.
Please head out and slay them
as fast as you can!
If you save us from this crisis,
we will provide materials used
for some G Rank Secret Art
Armor, in preparation for worse.
54806.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが２頭同時に暴れ
まわっています。
一刻も早く討伐に向かって
ください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級秘伝防具に使用す
る素材を提供いたします。

63240.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields decorations suited to beginner hunters. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63240.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival, we have prepared a
quest that yields decorations
for beginner hunters.
Bring your Festival Proof to join.
63240.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、初心者ハ
ンター向けの装飾品が手に入
るクエストを用意させていた
だきました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

54596.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54596.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54596.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54596.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

55105.description: Slaying a Kushala Daora raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55105.descriptionEn:
By slaying Kushala Daora,
you raise your own rating
and get a good deal on the
materials needed to obtain
G Rank decorations - we have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.
55105.descriptionJp:
クシャルダオラを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

58064.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58064.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58064.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58064.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

40139.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
40139.description: In this quest you can obtain one of the production tickets for four kinds of dual blades: 'Pallinjager White Tea', 'Pallinjager White Strawberry', 'Pallinjager Tea Green' and 'Pallinjager Strawberry Tea'. Take the quest while holding 1 Pari Fuwa Fruit.
40139.descriptionEn:
This quest yields one of the
four Dual Blades tickets.
"Parringer White Brown"
"Parringer White Strawberry"
"Parringer Brown Green"
"Parringer Strawberry Brown"
Please hold 1 ≪Fluffy Parri
Fruit≫ when you accept
the quest.
40139.descriptionJp:
このクエストでは、４種類の
双剣の生産券のうちどれか
ひとつを入手できます。
「パリンジャー白茶」
「パリンジャー白苺」
「パリンジャー茶緑」
「パリンジャー苺茶」
≪パリふわの実≫１個を所持
して受注してください。

62136.description: Something terrible has happened! Someone has set nasty traps at the gathering points in the Jungle. I was about to use a Maca Pickling Jar to make a Boost Potion, and now I cannot even gather in peace! Please. Lend us your strength!
62136.descriptionEn:
Something terrible has happened!
Someone has set annoying traps at
the gathering points of the
Jungle. I was about to use my
≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ to make
≪Enhancer≫, but like this I
cannot gather in peace!
Please! Lend us your strength!
62136.descriptionJp:
大変なことが起こりました！
誰かが密林の採取ポイントに
迷惑な仕掛けを施したのです。
せっかく≪マカ漬けの壷≫を
使って≪増強剤≫を作ろうと
していたのに、このままでは
安心して採取もできません！
お願いです。どうか皆さんの
力をお貸しください！

53215.description: The square is in festival uproar too. I ordered ingredients to bake a cake in celebration, but it seems they are stuck in the Jungle in transit because of a greedy monster. Go and give it a thrashing! When you have beaten 5, set off fireworks at the base to let us know.
53215.descriptionEn:
The plaza is in quite a festival
mood. I ordered ingredients to
bake a cake for the celebration,
but on the way through the
Jungle a greedy monster has the
shipment stuck where it stands.
Go give it a thrashing!
Take down five and we'll fire
fireworks at the Base to tell you.
53215.descriptionJp:
広場もお祭り騒ぎだね。
お祝いにケーキを作ろうと
食材を取り寄せたんだけど、
輸送中に密林で食い意地の
はったモンスターのせいで
立ち往生してるみたいでね。
行ってとっちめてきとくれ！
５頭やっつけたら拠点で
花火をあげて報せるんだよ。

12023.description: Daimyo Hermitaur spends most of its time buried in the sand, you know. If you mean to hunt one, try not to forget that. It's called the Shield Crab for a reason: once it guards itself, it's a nuisance.
12023.descriptionEn:
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ mostly
stays buried in the sand.
Remember that when you hunt
it. It's called the Shield
Crab for a reason; once it
guards up, it's a hassle.
12023.descriptionJp:
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫は
普段砂に潜ってることが多い
わね。狩猟をするなら、忘れ
ないようにするといいわ。
盾蟹と呼ばれるだけあって身
を固められたら面倒よ。

63075.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
63075.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63075.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
63075.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

61620.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
61620.description: A quest in which a rookie hunter and a hunter who has just equipped a Secret Tome hunt Yian Kut-Ku together. The must-order includes delivery of 2 Rookie's Proofs, so the 2 rookie hunters must not forget to bring theirs.
61620.descriptionEn:
This quest has Rookie hunters
and a hunter who just put on
a Secret Art book hunting a
≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ together.
The must-order includes
delivering 2 ≪Rookie Proofs≫,
so the two Rookie hunters
must remember to bring theirs.
61620.descriptionJp:
新人のハンターと、秘伝書を
装備したてのハンターが協力
して≪イャンクック≫を狩猟
するクエストです。
マストオーダーに、≪新人の
証≫２枚の納品がありますの
で、新人のハンター２人は忘
れずに持参してくださいね。

2.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this Quest Confirmation section you will find the money needed to accept a quest, the Contract Fee, the Reward Money you receive on clearing it, and the quest's objective, time limit and important matters, all in a row!
2.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
This ≪Quest Info≫ section is
packed with the money needed to
accept a quest, the ≪Contract
Fee≫, the ≪Reward Money≫ you
receive on clearing it, plus the
quest's objective, time limit and
other important matters!
2.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
この≪クエスト確認≫欄には
クエストの受注に必要なお金
≪契約金≫や、クリアの際に
もらえる≪報酬金≫、さらに
クエストの目的や制限時間と
重要事項が目白押しだぞ！

63062.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ３頭の討伐
63062.description: It is I! The Instructor! You have overcome many hardships and come this far! Now, enjoy to the full the novel training method I devised! I look forward to seeing you grown even further as a hunter!
63062.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
You overcame countless
hardships to reach this far!
Now savor the brand-new
training method I devised,
to your heart's content!
I look forward to seeing
you grow even further
as a hunter!
63062.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
数多の困難を乗り越えて、
よくぞここまで辿り着いた！
さあ、我輩が考案した斬新な
トレーニング法を思う存分
堪能するのだ！
ハンターとして更なる成長を
遂げた貴様の姿を楽しみに
しているぞ！

21430.objectiveJp: キラビートル５０匹の納品
21430.description: What is this road to becoming a master insect catcher supposed to be? It surely does not mean walking down a road, I think. Anyway, I am still collecting Kirabeetles, so bring me some. What I use them for is a secret. Deliver about 50 and I will give you three Extreme Flame Jewels.
21430.descriptionEn:
The road to bug-catching fame?
What is that even supposed
to mean. I don't think it's
a road you walk, anyway.
Never mind that, I'm still
collecting ≪Killer Beetles≫,
so bring me some. What for?
That's a secret. Bring 50 and
you get 3 ≪Extreme Flame Jewels≫.
21430.descriptionJp:
虫取り名人への道って何だろ。
間違っても道を歩くことじゃ
ないと思うの。
そんなことより、まだまだ
≪キラビートル≫を集めてい
るから持ってきてほしい。
何に使うかは秘密よ。
５０匹ほど納品したら、
≪極焔珠≫を３つあげるわ。

63265.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63265.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63265.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63265.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

62130.description: Today we train for the coming defense of the city. We could not prepare an Elder Dragon, so hunt the Rathian in the New Great Arena using its interception weapons and special supplied items! It would be even better if you break its parts. Weapons and armor are lent out, so that you cannot simply overpower it.
62130.descriptionEn:
Today we train for the
coming defense of the town.
No Elder Dragon was ready,
so hunt the female wyvern
≪Rathian≫ using the New
Great Arena's defense arms
and special supplies!
Breaking parts is even better.
Weapons and armor are lent.
62130.descriptionJp:
今日は、来るべき街の迎撃に
向けて訓練を行う。古龍は
用意できなかったが、雌火竜
≪リオレイア≫を新大闘技場
の迎撃兵器や、特殊な支給品
を用いて狩猟して見せろ！
部位破壊もできるとなお良い。
力押しができないよう、武器
防具は貸出とさせてもらうぞ。

51001.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51001.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
51001.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Long
Sword, show us the skill you have
honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
51001.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

56118.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56118.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56118.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

63178.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63178.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63178.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63178.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

63289.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63289.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
63289.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

21517.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21517.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21517.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21517.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

11041.description: This season the swamp is crawling with Conga! They live apart from the pack leader, Congalala, but that only proves how strong each one is: they have no need to gather. Watch yourself!
11041.descriptionEn:
Conga seem to thrive in the
Swamp this season!
They live apart from the boss
≪Congalala≫, but that is also
proof each one is strong enough
not to need a herd.
Do be careful!
11041.descriptionJp:
この季節の沼地にはコンガが
多く生息しているみたい！
親玉の≪ババコンガ≫とは群
れずに生活しているけれど、
逆をいえば群れる必要がない
ほど個々が強いという裏付け
でもあるわ。注意して下さい！

61609.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
61609.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
61609.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
61609.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

54183.objectiveJp: 木彫りの人形・黒１個の納品
54183.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54183.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.
54183.descriptionJp:
お疲れ様でした。
クエストを達成し、
≪★６解放記念硬貨≫を
受け取ってください。
ハリセンネコへ持っていけば
良い品と交換してもらえ
ますよ。

50698.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50698.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the fangs of an Akantor will also grant a special ingredient.
50698.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the fangs of the
Akantor also grants you
special ingredients.
50698.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
覇竜の牙を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

23581.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please slay Zerureusu.
23581.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor, worn by
hunters who mastered
their weapons.
The Guild has long lent
various support, but this
time we offer very rare
G Rank materials to those
aiming higher still.
For the survey, slay Zerureusu.
23581.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、
輝界竜の討伐をお願いします。

54641.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
54641.description: Please investigate the Blue Hypnocatrice that appeared in the sea of trees. If possible, I would appreciate it if you not only hunted it but also broke its beak. Hunters, please!
54641.descriptionEn:
We request a survey of
the azure Hypnocatrice
that appeared in the
Great Forest.
If possible, beyond the hunt,
breaking its beak would
help us greatly. Thank you!
54641.descriptionJp:
樹海に現れた蒼眠鳥の
調査をお願いします。
できれば狩猟だけでなく、
クチバシの破壊をしてきて
くれると助かります。
ハンターの皆さん、よろしく
お願いします！

21830.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
21830.description: Lavasioth live in the sea of lava that spreads through the volcano. Their molten breath and attacks that use their massive bodies turn a moment of carelessness into death! The charge of that great body especially demands caution!
21830.descriptionEn:
In the sea of lava that spreads
through the Volcano lives the
lava wyvern ≪Volganos≫.
Its spewed lava and its huge
body's attacks turn a moment's
carelessness into death!
Especially its charge, watch out!
21830.descriptionJp:
火山に広がる溶岩の海には
溶岩竜≪ヴォルガノス≫が棲
んでいます。吐き出す溶岩と
巨体を活かした攻撃は一瞬の
油断が死につながります！
特にその巨体を使った突進は
要注意です！

58077.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58077.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58077.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58077.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

61856.description: A gathering request in the Highlands, an untrodden mountain region. Gathering unknown materials in an untrodden land. How about it? Even if not hunting, a hunter would be intrigued, no? Well, go and see.
61856.descriptionEn:
An unexplored mountain range —
the ≪Highlands≫. A gathering
request for unknown materials
from untouched land. Well? Even
without hunting, any Hunter
would be intrigued, no? Try it.
61856.descriptionJp:
未踏の山岳地帯、≪高地≫
での採取依頼だ。未踏の大地
での、未知の素材の採取。
どうだ？ハンターとしては
狩猟でなくても興味津津だろ
う？まぁいってみるといいさ。

54504.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
54504.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54504.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54504.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

21097.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
21097.description: A Plesioth subspecies sometimes appears in the desert this season. A violent fish wyvern with scales as lovely as jade. Hunting a Plesioth is no simple matter. The trick is to draw it out of the water with a loud noise.
21097.descriptionEn:
In the Desert this season, a
Plesioth subspecies sometimes
shows up. A violent fish wyvern
with beautiful jade coloring.
Hunting a Plesioth is no easy
task. The trick is to draw it
out of the water with loud noise.
21097.descriptionJp:
この季節の砂漠ではときおり
ガノトトスの亜種が出没する
わ。翡翠のように綺麗な体色
をしている強暴な魚竜よ。
ガノトトスを狩猟するのは容
易じゃないわ。大きな音で水
中から引き出すのがコツね。

61738.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
61738.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
61738.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
61738.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

62979.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
62979.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62979.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!
62979.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意したぞ！
複数のモンスターの討伐を、
猟団の仲間と成し遂げるのだ！
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

55949.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
55949.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the black-bodied one the Extreme Pouncing Bogabadorumu. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55949.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it comes
dancing right back.
The Guild has decided to call
the black-bodied one
"Bogabadorumu, the Acme
Assailant".
Hunters who slay it receive
Guild armor materials and a title!
55949.descriptionJp:
追い払えどもヤツは、
再び舞い戻ってくる。
ギルドでは、黒躰のヤツを
「極み襲うボガバドルム」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

50482.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
50482.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50482.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50482.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

40184.description: A giant fireball has been reported above Schrade Castle. It is predicted to be an omen of Fatalis's appearance. Head there at once and investigate. If Fatalis appears, proceed directly to slaying it.
40184.descriptionEn:
We have reports that a
huge fireball has formed
above Schrade Castle. It is
believed to be an omen of
Fatalis appearing.
Head to the site at once and
carry out a survey.
If Fatalis appears, move
straight on to
slaying it.
40184.descriptionJp:
シュレイド城上空にて、巨大
な火球が発生しているとの
報告がありました。これは、
ミラボレアスが現れる前兆で
はないかと予測されます。
至急現地へ向かい、調査を
お願いします。
ミラボレアスが現れた場合に
は、そのまま討伐に移行して
ください。

21541.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21541.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21541.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21541.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

21866.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
21866.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Flor FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21866.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for all 5 parts of
the ≪Zenith Armor≫ Flor FX
series.
Accepting the quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the ≪Superior Ticket≫
will be consumed.
21866.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
フロルFXシリーズの５部位分
の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21871.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
21871.description: We have received a report of encountering a dragon clad in red carapace in the decisive battlefield. It seems they were attacked the moment they tried to take home a cactus growing in that land. There may be some connection between this monster and the cactus. Please head to the site and investigate.
21871.descriptionEn:
We received a report of a dragon
clad in red carapace met at the
Battlefield. It attacked the
moment they tried to carry home
a cactus growing there.
There may be some connection
between this monster and the
cactus. Head to the site and
survey it.
21871.descriptionJp:
決戦場で赤い甲殻を身に纏っ
た竜と遭遇したという報告を
受けました。その地に生息す
るサボテンを持ち帰ろうとし
た瞬間に襲われたそうです。
このモンスターとサボテンに
何らかの関係があるのかもし
れません。現地に向かい、
調査をお願いします。

61934.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
61934.description: Ladies and gentlemen hunters, thank you indeed for joining our party. The main dish will be served shortly, so please wait in the first area outside base camp. May this evening be a fond memory for you all.
61934.descriptionEn:
Ladies and gentlemen hunters,
thank you sincerely for
joining our party.
The main dish will be served
shortly, so please wait in the
first area beyond the Base
Camp.
May tonight be a fond memory
for you all.
61934.descriptionJp:
紳士淑女のハンターの皆様、
この度はパーティへのご参加、
誠にありがとうございます。
メインディッシュはすぐに
お届けしますので、ベース
キャンプを出た最初のエリア
にてお待ちくださいませ。
今宵があなた様方の良き
思い出となりますように。

55450.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐

62076.description: Senior, show me your first-class hunting skill! Hunting that savage monster in that dangerous place is beyond imitation! I will burn your hunting style into my eyes and aim to be a first-class hunter too.
62076.descriptionEn:
Please show me your top-class
hunting skill, Senpai!
Hunting that savage monster
in that dangerous place is
something I could never imitate!
I'll burn your hunting style
into my eyes and aim to be
a top hunter myself!
62076.descriptionJp:
センパイの一流の狩猟技術を
見せてくださいッス！
あの危険な場所であの凶暴な
モンスターを狩猟するなんて、
とても真似できないッス！
センパイの狩りの仕方をこの
目に焼き付けて、おいらも
一流のハンターを目指すッス。

55227.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Jinou GX Greaves' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55227.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
Grand Prize in "F Photo
Contest 2016", we have
prepared a quest where you
can earn materials to craft
and upgrade the armor worn
in it:
"Zinogre GX Greaves".
55227.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「ジンオウGXグリーヴ」
を生産・強化するための素材
を獲得できるクエストをご用
意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

11087.description: The insects that live in the hunting grounds are used in a wide range of ways: crafting and upgrading weapons and armor, mixing items, and more. When you find a place where insects are flitting about, try catching them with a Bug Net!
11087.descriptionEn:
The bugs living in hunting grounds
are used for many things: forging
and upgrading weapons and armor,
and mixing items.
When you find a spot where bugs
flutter about, try catching them
with a ≪Bug Net≫!
11087.descriptionJp:
狩り場に生息する虫たちは、
武器や防具の生産・強化、ア
イテムの調合など幅広い用途
で用いられています。
虫が飛びかっている場所を見
つけたら、≪虫あみ≫を使っ
て捕まえてみましょう！

26542.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26542.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26542.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、上位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

26131.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26131.description: Yian Kut-Ku is a bird wyvern shaped like a flying wyvern, with large ears and a large jaw as its distinctive features. Those big ears make it weak to loud sounds, and it flinches, but afterwards it grows angry and stronger, so take care.
26131.descriptionEn:
≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ is a bird
wyvern shaped like a flying
wyvern, known for its big
ears and jaw. Those ears
make it weak to loud noise,
but it flies into a rage
right after. Be careful.
26131.descriptionJp:
≪イャンクック≫は飛竜のよ
うな形をした鳥竜種で、大き
な耳とアゴが特徴的です。
大きな耳を持つだけに、大き
な音には弱くて怯むのですが
その後は怒って強くなるので
注意が必要です。

51098.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51098.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Black Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
51098.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the chest of the
Black Gravios also grants
you special ingredients.
51098.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒鎧竜の胸部を破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

11012.description: Rathian's other name is the Queen of the Land! That title is no lie: many a hunter has bowed before her! Hunt a Rathian and it will mean you stand on your own as a hunter!
11012.descriptionEn:
≪Rathian≫ is also known as
the Queen of the Land! That
name is no lie; many hunters
have bowed before her!
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and you
stand on your own as a
hunter!
11012.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫の別名は陸の
女王！その異名は決してウソ
じゃなく、何人もの狩人が
彼女の前に屈してるんです！
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたなら
それは狩人として独り立ちを
意味するでしょう！

54941.description: This quest yields the following materials. Switch Axe Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Switch Axe Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Switch Axe Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54941.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Switch Axe Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Switch Axe Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Switch Axe Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
54941.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪剣斧綬・序≫１００個
≪剣斧綬・中≫１６５個
≪剣斧綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

61170.description: An unprecedented great lightning strike has been witnessed at the Ancient Tower. This is a survey request for hunters of skill only. It is too dangerous, so item supply is impossible. Conduct the survey with the utmost care.
61170.descriptionEn:
A lightning strike of unprecedented
scale was witnessed at the Ancient
Tower.
This survey request is for skilled
hunters only. It is far too
dangerous, so no items can be
supplied. Please conduct the
survey with the utmost caution.
61170.descriptionJp:
古塔で、かつてない規模の
大落雷が目撃されました。
凄腕のハンター限定での
調査依頼をいたします。
危険すぎるため、アイテムの
支給も不可能です。
細心の注意を払って調査に
あたってください。

50046.description: Would you look for a rare old box, nya? Find one and bring it to me and I will trade you my top recommendation, nya. Hm? What is inside the box? There are some things in this world better left unknown, nya.
50046.descriptionEn:
Would you search for an old box that is
rarely found, meow? If you find one
and bring it to me, I will trade you
a recommended item, meow.
Hm? What is inside the box, you ask?
There are things in this world you
are better off not knowing, meow.
50046.descriptionJp:
稀に見つかる古い箱を探して
くれニャいか？見つけて届け
てくれたら、イチオシの品と
交換してやるニャよ。
ん？箱の中に何が入っている
のかって？世のニャかには、
知らない方がいい事もあるん
ニャよ。

54902.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
54902.description: We received a report of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku found in the swamp. However, it seems to perform special behavior not recorded in reports to date. Please investigate the Blue Yian Kut-Ku.
54902.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that a
≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫ has been
found in the Swamp.
However, it apparently behaves in
ways not recorded in any report so
far.
We would very much like you to
survey the ≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫.
54902.descriptionJp:
沼地に≪青怪鳥≫を発見した
との報告を受けた。
しかし、今までの報告書に
載っていない特殊な行動を
行うらしい。
是非、≪青怪鳥≫の調査を
お願いしたい。

60112.description: Many reports of damage by flying wyverns come from travelers passing near the sea of trees on their way to other regions. If we reduce the number of flying wyverns that nest in the sea of trees, this damage should subside to some extent. We expect great things from you.
60112.descriptionEn:
Many travelers who pass near the
Great Forest on their way to other
regions report harm from flying
wyverns. If we thin the number of
flying wyverns nesting in the
Great Forest, the damage should
settle somewhat. I expect great
things from you.
60112.descriptionJp:
樹海付近を通って、他地方に
抜ける旅人から、飛竜による
被害報告が多数出ておる。
樹海をねぐらとしている飛竜
の数を減らせば、この被害も
ある程度収束するじゃろう。
おぬしらの働きに期待してお
るぞ。

61967.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Espinas. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
61967.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Espinas≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!
61967.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪エスピナス≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

21878.description: A request for hunters who have crafted Zerureusu Gou weapons. By repeatedly slaying Zerureusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Tenran weapons.
21878.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have forged
the ≪Peerless Weapon≫ of
the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Zerureusu, you can obtain
materials to upgrade the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ weapon.
21878.descriptionJp:
≪輝界竜≫の≪剛種武器≫を
生産したハンター向けの依頼
です。
ゼルレウスを繰り返し討伐す
ることで、≪天嵐武器≫の
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

54369.description: A Resounding Wolf seems to have been found in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. It could hinder the survey, so please head out to hunt it. Another hunter will draw off the female Resounding Wolf, so you take the male.
54369.descriptionEn:
An Orugaron seems to have
been found in an unsurveyed
part of the Swamp. It could
become an obstacle to our
survey, so head out to hunt
it. Another hunter will draw
off the Non Orugaron, so you
are to handle the Kam
Orugaron.
54369.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域で
響狼が発見されたようです。
調査を進める上での障害に
なり得ますので、狩猟に
向かってください。
雌響狼は別のハンターに気を
引いてもらいますので、
あなた方は雄響狼の方を
お願い致します。

61936.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

23256.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
23256.description: The Farnock is a bird wyvern also called the Slanting Thunder Bird, a monster with an extremely gaudy appearance. We are pressing on with the survey, but the truth is that much about it remains unknown. To further the survey, we want to recruit hunters to help.
23256.descriptionEn:
Farunokku is a Bird Wyvern
also called the Slanting
Thunder Bird, a monster with
a remarkably flashy look.
Survey work is underway,
but much remains unknown.
We want hunters to lend
us their aid for future work.
23256.descriptionJp:
ファルノックは傾雷鳥とも
呼ばれている鳥竜種で、
非常に派手な外見をした
モンスターだ。現在調査を
進めているが、まだ不明な
点が多いのが現状だ。
今後の調査のため、協力して
くれるハンターを募集したい。

40219.objectiveJp: フレイムタイラント１体の討伐
40219.description: The Flame Tyrant, a fearsome foe bearing the title of Emperor of Flame, has shown itself. Its purpose is unknown, but we cannot leave such an enemy be. We have prepared a special sword for the fight. Take it and bring down the Emperor of Flame!
40219.descriptionEn:
A mighty foe bearing the
title Emperor of Flame,
"Flame Tyrant", has appeared.
Its aim is unknown, but we
cannot leave this threat be.
We prepared a special sword
to fight it. Slay the Emperor!
40219.descriptionJp:
炎の帝王の二つ名を持つ強敵
「フレイムタイラント」が
姿を現した。目的不明だが、
この難敵をそのままにはして
おけぬ。奴と戦うため特別な
剣を用意した。これを用い、
炎の帝王を倒すのだ！

50075.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
50075.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50075.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
50075.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

21146.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

50648.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50648.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Hardcore Weapon and slay the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a splendid reward awaits you.
50648.descriptionEn:
You who would master the
way of the hunt: take up
≪Hardcore Weapons≫ and
slay Odibatorasu.
Only those who succeed
under such limits
are true hunters.
Succeed, and great rewards await.
50648.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
≪剛種武器≫などを携え、
≪弩岩竜≫を討伐するのだ。
限られた条件の中で狩りを
成功させる者こそ、真の狩人
と言えよう。
成功すれば、素晴らしい報酬
がそなたを待っておるぞ。

22126.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22126.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
22126.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Sword
and Shield, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
22126.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55197.description: An unidentified black monster is rampaging in the Old Tower. Who is it? It changes its form, changes its movement, changes its voice, changes its eye color. To whoever ascertains its true identity, I shall surely give production materials for Guild hidden armor.
55197.descriptionEn:
An unidentified black monster is
running wild in the Ancient Tower.
Who is it? It changes its shape,
its movements, its voice,
and the color of its eyes.
Whoever uncovers its true identity
will receive production materials
for Guild-treasured armor.
55197.descriptionJp:
正体不明の黒いモンスターが
古塔で暴れ回っている。
奴は何者だ？姿を変え、動き
を変え、声を変え、眼の色を
変えている。
こいつの正体を突き止めた者
にはギルド秘蔵の防具の生産
素材を必ず渡そう。

63039.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63039.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63039.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

56039.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
56039.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Doragyurosu. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56039.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Dark Thunder Wyvern
for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.
56039.descriptionJp:
辿異種の冥雷竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

63193.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63193.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
63193.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

26474.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
26474.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. If it looks like getting away, pinning it with a Flash Bomb or Shock Trap is one option. Don't forget your Antidote either!
26474.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
If it looks about to flee,
pin it with a Flash Bomb
or a Shock Trap~
Don't forget Antidotes!
26474.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
逃げられそうになったら、
閃光玉やシビレ罠で足止め
するのも手ですよ〜。
解毒剤もお忘れなく！

15020.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐

60816.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲

26112.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

55909.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
55909.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55909.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.
55909.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪外装解
放券≫を獲得できるクエスト
を用意させていただきまし
た。受注、参加時に、≪祭典
の熱気≫をお持ちください。

55298.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55298.description: The Variant Species Blangonga has appeared once more. Its arms have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55298.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Blangonga≫ has
appeared once again. Its arms
are stronger now, and it seems
to have grown even mightier.
Please take every care in your
survey.
55298.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドドブランゴ≫が再
び現れました。
腕はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

50462.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

26577.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26577.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26577.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26577.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

40173.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil HS Earring.
40173.descriptionEn:
Here we distribute VISA
production tickets to hunters
who possess Gothic
equipment.
Please accept the quest while
wearing the Veil HS Earrings
equipped.
40173.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。
ベイルHSイヤリングを装備
した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

26686.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
26686.description: A new species of Carapaceon has been discovered in the caves of Tide Island. The Hunters Guild has named it Taikun Zamuza. It seems to be a Carapaceon that evolved in its own way on the island, and it is said to be marked by two scythes of entirely different shapes. We ask for further study.
26686.descriptionEn:
A new Carapaceon has been found
in the caves of Tidal Island.
The Hunters Guild has named it
the Many-Shell Crab ≪Taikun
Zamuza≫.
It seems to be a Carapaceon that
evolved uniquely on Tidal Island,
and its two scythes of utterly
different shapes are its feature.
We ask for a further survey.
26686.descriptionJp:
潮島の洞窟で新たな甲殻種が
発見されたそうです。
ハンターズギルドでは、
多殻蟹≪タイクンザムザ≫と
名付けました。
どうやら潮島で独自の進化を
遂げた甲殻種のようで、
全く形の違う２本の鎌が
特徴であるとのことです。
更なる調査をお願いします。

56054.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
56054.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Doragyurosu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Long Sword, Hammer, Gunlance, Switch Axe, or Light Bowgun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56054.descriptionEn:
You can get the materials for
crafting one Supremacy weapon
from Doragyurosu and taking
it 2 upgrade stages, plus Gz
worth of Porta Card Sakura.
Craftable weapon types are
Sword and Shield, Long Sword,
Hammer, Gunlance, Switch Axe,
or Light Bowgun.
Use this for your weapon of choice!
56054.descriptionJp:
辿異種ドラギュロスの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、片手剣、太刀、
鎚、銃槍、剣斧、軽弩の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

61538.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61538.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61538.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50151.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐

53152.description: We have prepared a quest to craft the Lukeze Series. Hunt Rathalos and you can obtain production materials and level-up materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
53152.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest to
craft the "Rukeze Series".
By hunting a Rathalos
you can obtain materials
for one part's crafting
and for leveling it up.
Please make good use
of this chance!
53152.descriptionJp:
「ルケーゼシリーズ」を生産
するためのクエストを準備し
ました。
リオレウスを狩猟すること
で、１部位分の生産素材と
レベルアップできる素材が
入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください！

23467.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
23467.description: To support all the hunters who have just been promoted to G Rank, we have prepared a special quest. Let us learn the basics of hunting G Rank monsters while obtaining new decorations!
23467.descriptionEn:
To support all the hunters who have
just been promoted to G Rank, we
have prepared a special quest.
Let us learn the basics of hunting
G Rank monsters while obtaining
new decorations!
23467.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級へ昇格されたばかりの
ハンターの皆さんを支援する
べく、特別なクエストをご用
意いたしました。
Ｇ級モンスター狩猟の基本を
学びながら、新たな装飾品を
入手しましょう！

50686.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50686.description: Several vicious Variant Espinas have appeared in the hidden area of the Tower, and the surveyors are in danger. So this request is to hunt them. With your high skill you should be able to complete it. I am counting on you!
50686.descriptionEn:
In the Tower's hidden reach,
several savage ≪Espinas
Variants≫ have appeared,
and our surveyors are in danger.
So this request is to hunt
them down. With your high
skill, you should complete
it. I'm counting on you!
50686.descriptionJp:
塔の秘境に複数の凶暴な
≪エスピナス変種≫が出現し、
調査員たちが危険にさらされ
ている。
そこで、今回の依頼は奴らの
狩猟だ。あなたたちの
高い腕前ならこの依頼を達成
できるはずだ。頼んだぞ！

23451.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Great Sword Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Great Sword Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23451.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
23451.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪大剣綬・序≫１００個
≪大剣綬・中≫１６５個
≪大剣綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

50386.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61623.description: A quest in which a rookie hunter and a hunter equipped with a Secret Tome hunt Khezu together. Only rookie hunters can obtain a Rookie's Proof on clearing the quest. The Rookie's Proof is used in the Second Part quests.
61623.descriptionEn:
This quest has Rookie hunters
and a hunter equipped with
a Secret Art book hunting a
≪Khezu≫ together.
Only Rookie hunters can get
a ≪Rookie Proof≫ when the
quest is cleared.
The ≪Rookie Proof≫ is used in
the [Part 2] quest.
61623.descriptionJp:
新人のハンターと、秘伝書を
装備したハンターが協力して
≪フルフル≫を狩猟するクエ
ストです。
新人のハンターのみクエスト
クリア時に≪新人の証≫を入
手することができます。
≪新人の証≫は、【後編】の
クエストで使用します。

22047.description: The Swamp is a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22047.descriptionEn:
The ≪Swamp≫ is a land
still under Guild survey,
but hunters too might like
to go and take a look for
gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22047.descriptionJp:
≪沼地≫は、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

62537.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62537.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62537.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

23621.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
23621.description: The Variant Species Rukodiora appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Rukodiora. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23621.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rukodiora≫
seems to have reached strength
enough to climb to the very
summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident enough to
challenge the summit, please
take on this survey.
23621.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ルコディオラ≫は
ルコディオラの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

56052.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Midogaron through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Great Sword, Long Sword, Lance, Hunting Horn, Tonfa, Magnet Spike, or Light Bowgun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56052.descriptionEn:
You can get the materials for
crafting one Supremacy weapon
from Midogaron and taking it
2 upgrade stages, plus Gz
worth of Porta Card Sakura.
Craftable weapon types are
Great Sword, Long Sword,
Lance, Hunting Horn, Tonfa,
Magnet Spike, or Light Bowgun.
Use this for your weapon of choice!
56052.descriptionJp:
辿異種ミドガロンの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、大剣、太刀、槍、
狩猟笛、穿龍棍、磁斬鎚、
軽弩のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

60410.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
60410.description: A Diablos with a blackened body colour and a dreadfully fearsome appearance has been sighted. Since it was sighted alone, a high-rank hunter is unlikely to be outmatched, but do not take it lightly and get badly hurt.
60410.descriptionEn:
A Diablos with a darkened body
and an especially fearsome
appearance has been sighted.
Since it was seen alone, a top
hunter should hardly fall behind,
but do not underestimate it and
get badly hurt.
60410.descriptionJp:
黒ずんだ体色を持つひときわ
恐ろしい容姿のディアブロス
が目撃されたわ。
単体での目撃なだけに、上位
の狩人が後れをとることは、
まずないと思うけど、甘く見
て大怪我なんてしないでね。

55312.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
55312.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Poborubarumu, the Sound Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55312.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Sound-Creating
Dragon ≪Poborubarumu≫.
To accept this quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
55312.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、創音竜
≪ポボルバルム≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55721.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55721.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55721.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

61725.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61725.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61725.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

61552.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61552.description: I was gathering and fishing in the Jungle when a Daimyo Hermitaur and a Plesioth suddenly came and ruined everything. I will give you the fish and gathered goods that are left, so please hunt the Daimyo Hermitaur, break its parts, and fish up the Plesioth. The Plesioth is my catch, so you need not slay it.
61552.descriptionEn:
I was gathering and fishing in the
Jungle when a Daimyo Hermitaur and a
Plesioth turned up and ruined the
whole thing for me.
You can have the fish and the
gathered goods, so hunt the
Daimyo Hermitaur, break its parts,
and reel in the Plesioth for me.
That Plesioth is my catch, so
you don't need to slay it.
61552.descriptionJp:
密林で採取と漁をしてたんだ
が、急に盾蟹と水竜がやって
きて、全部台無しにしてくれ
やがった。残った魚や採取品
をやるんで、盾蟹の狩猟や
部位破壊、そして水竜の釣り
上げを頼むよ。水竜は俺の獲
物だ、狩猟しないでいいぞ。

62640.description: I want to repair my weapon, but I am a little short of materials! To depart on the hunt as soon as possible, I want your help. So, let us trade the Gurenzeburu's Fine Scale for my Paw Medal. Please!
62640.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon, but I
am a little short on materials!
I must set out hunting as soon as
possible, so I truly need your
help.
So how about we trade your
≪Gurenzeburu Scale+≫ for my
≪Pawprint Medal≫?
I am counting on you!
62640.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいのだが、
少し素材が足りないのだ！
一刻も早く狩りへ出発する為、
ぜひとも協力してほしい。
そこで、≪蛮竜の上鱗≫と
私の≪肉球のメダル≫を交換
しようではないか。
よろしく頼む！

50388.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55859.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55859.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55859.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

22079.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
22079.description: Uragaan, the Crushing Wyvern, appears to have shown itself in the volcano. We have asked other hunters to look into it as well, but information is still scarce and much remains unknown. To keep Mezeporuta safe, we ask for an ecological survey.
22079.descriptionEn:
It seems that Uragaan,
the Blast Hammer Wyvern,
has appeared in the Volcano.
We have also issued requests to
other hunters, but information is
still scarce and many points
remain unclear.
To protect the safety of Mezepolta,
please conduct an ecology survey.
22079.descriptionJp:
火山に
爆鎚竜・ウラガンキンが
現れたようです。
他のハンターにも依頼を
出させて頂きましたが
未だ情報が少なく、不明
な点が多くあります。
メゼポルタの安全を守る
為、生態調査をお願いし
ます。

26538.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, as exploration has confirmed it safe, we are opening the Volcano depths, the lava pool area! Gather to your heart's content!
26538.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time, as our survey confirmed
it is safe, we are opening the
Volcano Depths and the lava pool area!
Please go and gather to your
heart's content!
26538.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は探索の結果、安全が
確認されたため、火山奥地、
溶岩池部分を開放します！
思う存分採取してきちゃって
ください！

21175.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐
またはサブターゲットの達成
21175.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21175.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target
or complete the sub-target
21175.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21175.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

58034.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58034.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58034.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58034.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

21012.description: Rathian's other name is the Queen of the Land! That title is no lie: many a hunter has bowed before her! Hunt a Rathian and it will mean you stand on your own as a hunter!
21012.descriptionEn:
≪Rathian≫ is also known as
the Queen of the Land! That
name is no lie; many hunters
have bowed before her!
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and you
stand on your own as a
hunter!
21012.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫の別名は陸の
女王！その異名は決してウソ
じゃなく、何人もの狩人が
彼女の前に屈してるんです！
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたなら
それは狩人として独り立ちを
意味するでしょう！

63350.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63350.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the long sword, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63350.descriptionEn:
Loosed in the New Great Arena
is a ≪Rathian≫ of great power
that acts in ways normally
unthinkable.
Hunters who would master
the Long Sword, show me
your skill before me!
Hunt it splendidly and you
shall gain far more than
daily effort alone brings.
63350.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪雌火竜≫を放ってある。
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

26179.description: The items familiar to high-rank hunters who favor the bow can now be obtained together as rewards! It is a carefree, easy quest, so please try it between party battles!
26179.descriptionEn:
The items familiar to
high-rank hunters who love
the Bow can now be obtained
all together as rewards!
It's a relaxed, easy quest,
so please try it between
party hunts!
26179.descriptionJp:
弓を愛用される高ランクなハ
ンターの皆さんにはおなじみ
の品々が、報酬でまとめて入
手可能になりました！
お気楽お手軽なクエストです
ので、パーティ戦の合間に是
非お試しくださいね！

53274.description: The king of the skies, who oppresses the people who walk the steep peaks, has taken up position in the Canyon with fierce warriors in tow. Spend too long and he will vanish into the clouds. Use ninja tools to seal his movement and deliver a fatal blow. Slay the king of the skies!
53274.descriptionEn:
The King of the Sky, who
oppresses the folk of the
steep peaks, holds the Canyon
with fierce warriors in tow.
Dawdle, and it will vanish
into the clouds. Use ninja
tools, seal its movement,
strike the killing blow. Slay the King!
53274.descriptionJp:
峻険たる峰をゆく民を圧する
空の王が怒髪天を衝く猛者を、
引き連れ峡谷に陣取っている。
いたずらに時を掛けては、
雲隠れしてしまう。
忍具を駆使して、動きを封じ
必殺の一撃を見舞え。
空の王を討つのだ！

50379.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50379.description: A ferocious and highly dangerous Lavasioth has been confirmed in the volcano. Combined with the harsh environment, this makes for a very dangerous request, so hunt with every precaution.
50379.descriptionEn:
A savage and highly dangerous
≪Volganos≫ was confirmed
in the Volcano.
With the Volcano's harsh
environment, this is a very
dangerous request - hunt with care!
50379.descriptionJp:
火山にて凶暴で非常に危険な
≪溶岩竜≫が確認されました。
火山の過酷な環境も相まって
非常に危険な依頼となって
おりますので、十分注意して
狩猟を行ってください。

62385.description: For first-rate hunters who hold a Secret Scroll, we have prepared a request that allows quick rank advancement. It costs 2 HC Tickets, but you can hunt a Yian Kut-Ku that is not a special individual. Note that special materials and Proof of Effort cannot be obtained.
62385.descriptionEn:
For skilled hunters holding
a Secret Art book, we have
prepared a request that
allows fast rank-ups.
It costs 2 ≪HC Tickets≫,
and you can hunt a
≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ that is not
a Special Individual.
Note: no special materials or Proofs of Effort.
62385.descriptionJp:
秘伝書所持者の凄腕ハンター
向けに、早いランクアップが
可能な依頼をご用意しました。
≪ＨＣチケット≫を２枚頂き
ますが、特異個体ではない
≪イャンクック≫を狩猟する
ことができます。
特別な素材や努力の証は入手
できませんのでご注意下さい。

55389.description: A Variant Species Hyujikiki with greatly developed needles has appeared, and its Variant-specific attacks have caused many hunters to fail in the hunt. To improve the situation, the guild will support the hunt with stronger supplies! When you hunt it, please take care!
55389.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Hyujikiki with
greatly developed needles
has appeared, and its
Supremacy attacks have made
many hunters fail.
To improve things, the Guild
will support the slaying
with upgraded supplies!
Please take care out there!
55389.descriptionJp:
針が大きく発達した辿異種
ヒュジキキが現れ、辿異種
特有の攻撃により数多の
ハンターが討伐に失敗し
ています。
事態改善のため、支給品の
強化などでギルドも討伐を
支援いたします！討伐の際
は、どうかお気を付けて！

22015.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Kukubo Series armor. Hunt Hypnocatrice and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Kukubo F Series up to LV7.
22015.descriptionEn:
This request is for hunters
who crafted and upgraded
"Kukubo Series" armor.
Hunting a Hypnocatrice yields
the materials needed to
upgrade the "Kukubo F Series"
up to LV 7.
22015.descriptionJp:
「ククボシリーズ」の防具
を生産・強化したハンター
向けの依頼です。
ヒプノックを狩猟すると、
「ククボＦシリーズ」ＬＶ７
までの強化に必要な素材が
入手できます。

10104.description: In this arena we put on a straight one-on-one between monster and hunter! Your opponent this time is a Shogun Ceanataur. Do not let those scythe claws cut you open!
10104.descriptionEn:
In this Arena, you'll fight
monster versus hunter,
head on!
Your opponent is a
Shogun Ceanataur.
Mind those sickle claws!
10104.descriptionJp:
この闘技場ではモンスター対
ハンターのガチンコ勝負を
やってもらうよ！
今回の相手はショウグンギザミ
だね。鎌のようなハサミに切り
裂かれないように気をつけな！

23724.description: This quest yields the following materials. Dual Blades Merit (Beginning) x５０, Dual Blades Merit (Middle) x６０, Dual Blades Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23724.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials below.
≪Dual Blades Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Dual Blades Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Dual Blades Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you
need a ≪Secret Art Merit
Crystal≫ and GR 500 or
above, so please be aware.
23724.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪双剣勲・序≫５０個
≪双剣勲・中≫６０個
≪双剣勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

58121.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58121.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58121.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58121.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55276.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
55276.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55276.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55276.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

61422.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61422.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61422.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

55482.description: A Variant Species Khezu with a greatly developed head has appeared. Its violent lightning has led many hunters to give up the hunt. The guild will expand the supplied items and, when you set out as 4, provide further support. Please go to the investigation with care.
55482.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Khezu with a
greatly developed head has
appeared.
Its fierce lightning has
led many hunters to give up
the slaying.
The Guild expands supplies
and gives extra support only
when you depart with 4.
Please head out with care.
55482.descriptionJp:
頭が大きく発達した辿異種の
フルフルが現れました。
その激烈な雷撃に、多くの
ハンターが討伐を断念して
います。
ギルドでは支給品を拡充する
と共に、４名で出発した時に
限り更なる支援を行います。
気をつけて調査に向かってく
ださい。

54398.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

101.description: The purpose of the drill is to reel in a Harimagu Tuna!! First, start by looking for fishing bait! Bring me specialty mushrooms and I will deliver bait!
101.descriptionEn:
The goal of this exercise
is to reel in a Harimargo!!
First, you should start by
looking for fishing bait!
Gather Specialty Mushrooms
and I'll bring you the bait!
101.descriptionJp:
ハリマグロを釣り上げる
ことが演習の目的だ！！
まずは、釣りエサを探す事から
はじめるのがいいだろう！
特産キノコを集めてきたら
釣りエサを届けてやるぞ！

55750.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55750.description: A Variant Species Anorupatisu with greatly developed horns has appeared. Its attacks, peculiar to Variant Species, have caused many hunters to fail in the hunt. The guild will provide support as well, so please form a party of 4 and see the hunt through.
55750.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Anorupatisu with
greatly developed horns has
appeared.
Its Supremacy attacks have
made many hunters fail.
The Guild will also support
you, so form a party of 4
and ensure the kill.
55750.descriptionJp:
角が大きく発達した辿異種
アノルパティスが現れました。
辿異種特有の攻撃で数多の
ハンターが討伐に失敗してい
ます。
ギルド側からも支援を行いま
すので、４人編成の上で確実
な討伐をお願い致します。

55686.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55686.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Daimyo Hermitaur. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55686.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫.
To accept this quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
55686.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

23657.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
23657.description: The Variant Species Toridokuresu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23657.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Toridokuresu≫
has grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as it is.
Please prepare thoroughly before
you set out on the survey.
23657.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪トリドクレス≫
は猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続
けています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

23319.description: The Guild has granted permission to explore the nighttime bamboo forest, previously off limits. So please help with the ecology survey of the Elegant Elder Dragon. The relationship between Inagami and the bamboo forest remains unexplained. Head there with great care.
23319.descriptionEn:
The Guild has granted permission
to explore the nighttime bamboo
grove that was off-limits until now.
So we ask for your aid in a
survey of the ≪Inagami≫'s ecology.
The bond between Inagami and the
bamboo grove is still unexplained
even after all our past surveys.
Please head for the site with the
utmost caution.
23319.descriptionJp:
ギルドより、これまで立入
禁止だった夜の竹林への探索
許可が下りました。
そこで、≪雅翁龍≫の生態
調査のため、協力をお願いし
ます。イナガミと竹林の関係
は、これまでの調査でも解明
できていません。
十分に注意して現地へ向かっ
てください。

26290.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

50508.description: It is I! The Instructor! This time the request is to explore the Swamp. The Guild reports sighting the blood-devouring wyvern Baruragaru. For safety I will lend you armor, but go carefully!
50508.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
This request is an exploration
of the Swamp.
The Guild reports a sighting
of the Blood-Drinking Wyvern
≪Baruragaru≫.
For safety I'll lend armor - be careful!
50508.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
今回の依頼は、沼地の探索だ。
喰血竜≪バルラガル≫を
目撃したと、ギルドより報告
があった。
安全の為、防具を貸し出すが、
気をつけていくのだぞ！

54711.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54711.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54711.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

50818.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50818.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50818.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

21286.objectiveJp: ドラグライト鉱石２５個の納品
21286.description: Ho, so you will take my job. The road to Mining Master is steep. Then gather large amounts of two rare ores. Do that and I will trade you my secret ore. The more secret ore you collect, the closer you come to Mining Master.
21286.descriptionEn:
Oh, so you will accept
my request, will you?
The road to Master Miner is steep.
Then gather two kinds of precious
ore in great quantity for me.
Do so, and I shall trade you
ore from my secret hoard.
The more of that hoard you gather,
the closer you will come
to Master Miner.
21286.descriptionJp:
ほう、ワシの依頼を
受けてくれるというのか。
採掘名人への道は険しいぞ？
それでは、貴重な鉱石２種を
大量に集めてもらおうかの。
そうすれば交換で、秘蔵の
鉱石をくれてやろう。
秘蔵の鉱石を集めれば
集めるほど、オヌシは
採掘名人に近づくじゃろう。

50116.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50116.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.
50116.descriptionJp:
おい！とっておきの依頼が舞
い込んで来たぞ！受注できる
回数に限りはあるが、なんと
覇種の素材を分けてもらえる
らしい。しかも撃退だけでい
いらしいから、討伐できな
いってヤツにもオススメだな。
ただ、そうは言っても覇種は
覇種だ。絶対に油断するなよ。

26306.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26306.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26306.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26306.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26306.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。
