55489.description: To stand against monsters that only grow more ferocious, Variant Species and Transcendent Species alike, we have prepared the Dunru GX series of armor for Ｇ-rank hunters. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare for the threats that press in!
55489.descriptionEn:
To stand against monsters
growing ever more savage,
such as Supremacy and
Transcendent Species, we
prepared the Dunru GX Series
armor for G Rank hunters.
Gather materials and ready for the threat!
55489.descriptionJp:
辿異種、遷悠種など凶暴化の
一途をたどるモンスターに対
抗すべく、Ｇ級ハンター向け
防具ドゥンルGXシリーズを
用意いたしました。
生産素材を獲得して迫りくる
脅威に備えてください！

62025.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

55855.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
55855.description: The true culprit who broke the doll platform is known. Naturally, they will be punished. Yes. Thoroughly. I believe you understand without being told, but you must hunt them. Without fail. For the sake of decorating the doll platform, do it thoroughly.
55855.descriptionEn:
We have identified the true
culprit who broke the doll
platform. Naturally, we
will punish it. Yes.
Thoroughly.
I'm sure you know without
being told, but slay it.
You must. And be thorough for the display.
55855.descriptionJp:
雛壇を壊した真犯人がわかり
ました。当然懲らしめます。
そう。徹底的にね。
言わなくてもわかっていると
思いますが、必ず討伐してく
ださいね。必ずですよ。
雛壇を飾り付けるためにも、
徹底的にお願いしますね。

62874.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62874.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62874.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50574.description: You there! I hear you produced an Abiorugu weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Abiorugu. I am counting on you!
50574.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged an Abiorugu
weapon.
So I've got a favor to ask, and
the pay is weapon upgrade parts.
What? It's an easy job.
Just take a quick run out there
and slay an Abiorugu
for me. I'm counting on you!
50574.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
獰竜の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、
ひとっ走り行って
アビオルグを討伐して
くれればいい。頼んだぜ！

26445.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26445.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
26445.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!
26445.descriptionJp:
うむ！我輩だ！教官だ！
今回は全装備を貸し出しての
演習を行う！
狩猟の対象は各地の鳥竜だ。
まだ経験が浅いハンターに
とってはかなり強力な装備を
用意したので、慣れない武器
だったとしても頑張るんだぞ！

58116.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58116.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58116.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58116.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55246.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55246.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55246.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

63405.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの達成
63405.description: We of the Dark Cat Gang are a group of capable sorts, meow! You will take on my request, meow? The job is to fetch a great treasure that suddenly appeared in the desert, meow. If you can clear this request, I may even give you a Dark Cat Gang Badge, meow.
63405.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or complete the sub-target
63405.descriptionEn:
We of the Dark Cat Gang are
a crew of capable cats, nya!
You want to take on my
request, nya?
The job is to fetch a great
treasure that suddenly
appeared in the Desert, nya.
Clear it and maybe a ≪Dark Cat Gang Badge≫, nya.
63405.descriptionJp:
ボクら闇猫団は有能な者達が
集う集団ニャ！キミがボクの
依頼に挑戦するのニャ？依頼
内容は、砂漠に突如現れた
大秘宝を取ってくることニャ。
もし、この依頼が達成できた
その時は≪闇猫団バッチ≫を
くれてやってもいいニャ。

62220.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62220.description: Our interception posture against the exceptionally powerful Rukodiora now closing on the interception base is ready. We have prepared ample supplies and interception weapons, so though this is an extremely dangerous request, any hunter able to prove their skill should head out and slay it.
62220.descriptionEn:
Preparations are complete to
intercept the extremely strong
individual ≪Rukodiora≫ that is
now closing on the ≪Base≫.
We have prepared ample supplies
and interception weapons, so
anyone able to prove their skill
should head out and slay it.
62220.descriptionJp:
現在≪迎撃拠点≫に迫ってい
る≪ルコディオラ≫の極めて
強力な個体に対する迎撃態勢
が整いました。十分な支給品、
迎撃兵器を用意いたしました
ので、極めて危険な依頼です
が、自分の腕を証明できる方
は討伐に向かってください。

21029.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石３個の納品
21029.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern! It doesn't just spit poison; it can also release a strong flash that blinds you. If you can destroy its crest, it seems you can stop the flash!
21029.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ is known by
another name: the Poison
Bird! Besides poison, it
can loose a bright flash
that blinds you. If you
break its crest, the flash
should stop, it seems!
21029.descriptionJp:
≪ゲリョス≫は別名、毒怪鳥
と呼ばれるモンスターです！
毒液を吐くだけじゃなく、
目を眩ませる強い閃光を放つ
こともあります。トサカを
破壊できれば閃光を防ぐこと
ができるみたいですよ！

55697.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55697.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Toridokuresu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55697.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Toridokuresu≫.
Accepting the quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ to
take part.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the ≪Superior Ticket≫
will be consumed.
55697.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪トリドクレス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61647.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Swamp, hunt Congalala and a flock of bird wyverns, and to finish, bring back 2 pieces of Grey Crystal Ore from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
61647.descriptionEn:
This time, special training for
you hunters with little skill!
Hunt Congalala and a flock of
Bird Wyverns in the Swamp, then
finish by bringing back 2 Raw
Gravierite from the Cave.
It is harsh training, but if you
pull it off, your standing as
hunters will rise sharply!
61647.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！沼地で桃毛獣と、鳥竜
の群れを狩猟し、仕上げに、
洞窟より灰水晶の原石２個を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

22046.description: The Jungle is a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22046.descriptionEn:
The ≪Jungle≫ is a land
still under Guild survey,
but hunters too might like
to go and take a look for
gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22046.descriptionJp:
≪密林≫は、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

55745.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55745.description: The Variant Species Anorupatisu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Anorupatisu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55745.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Anorupatisu≫
seems to have reached the strength
of the very summit among all
Anorupatisu.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
at challenging the summit are
asked to take on this survey.
55745.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アノルパティス≫は
アノルパティスの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

50611.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50611.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Heavenly Storm Weapon and hunt the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a fitting reward awaits you.
50611.descriptionEn:
Thou who would master the way of
the hunt. Bear the 'Tenran Weapon'
and hunt the ≪Doragyurosu≫.
Only one who succeeds under
limited conditions can be called
a true hunter.
Succeed, and a fitting reward
awaits thee.
50611.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
『天嵐武器』を携え、≪弩岩
竜≫を狩るのだ。限られた条
件の中で狩りを成功させる者
こそ、真の狩人と言えよう。
成功すれば、それなりの褒美
がそなたを待っておるぞ。

55475.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55475.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55475.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

55926.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
55926.description: The Variant Species Taikun Zamuza appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Taikun Zamuza. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55926.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Taikun Zamuza≫
seems to have reached a
strength that puts it at the
top of all Taikun Zamuza.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters sure of their skill
at challenging the summit,
please take on the survey.
55926.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪タイクンザムザ≫は
タイクンザムザの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

62515.description: I see it! I see it plainly! Your love of mushrooms has reached its peak! You must take the next step. Bring me 6 Aster Rare Sacks and you will come one step closer to the true essence of a mushroom maniac!
62515.descriptionEn:
I see it! I do see it!
Your love of mushrooms has
reached its peak!
I truly want you to take the
next step forward.
Bring me 6 Shion Rare Pouches,
and you too will come one step
closer to the true essence
of a mushroom maniac!
62515.descriptionJp:
判る！判るぞ！
君のキノコへの愛が高みに達
したことが！
是非、君には次のステップへ
と進んでもらいたい。
紫苑の稀袋を６個持ってきて
くれれば、君もキノコマニア
の真髄に、また一歩近づける
ことだろう！

21127.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
21127.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke. Its appearance seems to make onlookers tremble. But the reason it is called an armored wyvern is that shell protecting its body, no? I wonder what happens if the armor is broken.
21127.descriptionEn:
A black subspecies of Gravios seems to
have appeared amid the Volcano's smoke.
Its appearance must make all who
see it tremble.
But it is called the Armor Wyvern
because of the armor guarding its body,
right? So what happens if we break it?
21127.descriptionJp:
火山の噴煙にまみれて≪グラ
ビモス≫の黒い亜種が出現し
たらしいわ。その容姿は見る
者を震え上がらせるようね。
でも、鎧竜って呼ばれるのは
体を守る鎧があるからよね？
鎧を壊せばどうなのかしら？

55150.description: We are seeking hunters to help survey the Midogaron that appeared in the volcano. The individual found this time is said to be larger than any Midogaron previously reported. Take even greater care during the hunt.
55150.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to
help survey the Midogaron
that appeared in the Volcano.
The Midogaron found this time
is said to be more gigantic
than any reported before.
Please be extra careful
when you hunt it.
55150.descriptionJp:
火山に出現したミドガロンを
調査するため、協力して頂け
るハンターを募集いたします。
今回発見したミドガロンは
今まで報告を受けている、
どのミドガロンよりも巨大な
姿をしているとのこと。狩猟
の際は一層注意して下さい。

62829.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
62829.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
62829.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
62829.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

61427.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
61427.description: Do you know the Moonlight Stone? It is a strange stone, said to be moonlight crystallized, and rumor has it that cooperation with companions is essential to obtain one. But cooperation with companions is the basics of a hunter. You will surely be able to gather some too.
61427.descriptionEn:
Do you know the Moonlight Stone?
It is a strange stone said to be
moonlight crystallized, and rumor
has it that allies' cooperation is
essential to obtain one.
But well, cooperating with allies is
the basics of a hunter.
I am sure you can mine some too.
61427.descriptionJp:
月光石って知ってるかい？
なんでも月の光が結晶化した
とかいう変わった石でな、
手に入れるには仲間との
協力が必須って噂だぜ。
でもまあ仲間との協力は
ハンターの基本だからな。
アンタにもきっと採れるさ。

21399.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

55822.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55822.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55822.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

21043.description: Gravios is called the Tyrant of the Blaze, and its outer shell, grown to absurd hardness by eating coal and ore, calls for well-honed equipment! You could also slip past the Armor Wyvern and deliver Blast Rock!
21043.descriptionEn:
≪Gravios≫ is called the
Emperor of Blazing Heat. It
eats coal and ore, growing a
shell so hard you'll need
well-honed gear! You may
also sneak past the Armor
Wyvern to deliver ≪Blast Stone≫!
21043.descriptionJp:
≪グラビモス≫は灼熱の覇者
とも呼ばれてて、燃石や鉱石
を食べて異常なまでの硬度に
発達した外殻には、相当に磨
かれた装備が必要ですよ！鎧
竜の目を盗んで≪火薬岩≫を
納めてくれてもいいですよ！

54720.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
54720.description: We are surveying Gasurabazura, the monster found at White Lake. According to one account, anger greatly changes Gasurabazura's nature. If you can confirm this change in detail, we will deliver the guild's reward to your supply box.
54720.descriptionEn:
We are surveying the monster
Gasurabazura found at White Lake.
According to one testimony,
rage greatly changes the nature
of Gasurabazura.
If you can confirm this change
in detail, we will deliver the
Guild's reward to your supply box.
54720.descriptionJp:
白湖で発見されたモンスター
「ガスラバズラ」を調査して
います。ある証言によれば、
怒りがガスラバズラの性質を
大きく変化させるとのこと。
この変化を詳細に確認して
いただければ、ギルドからの
報奨品を支給品ボックスに
お届けします。

54855.description: This is a request that lets hunters who reached G Rank obtain the recommended jewel G Rank Guardian Flash Jewel. Hunt a Hypnocatrice Rare and you can obtain the G Rank Guardian Flash Jewel, a jewel with the skills Flash, Protection of the Three Realms and Wrath. Please make good use of it in your future hunting life.
54855.descriptionEn:
This is a request that lets hunters
who reached G Rank obtain the
recommended jewel ≪G Rank
Guardian Flash Jewel≫.
Hunt a Hypnocatrice Rare and you
can obtain the ≪G Rank Guardian
Flash Jewel≫, a jewel with the
skills Flash, Protection of the
Three Realms and Wrath.
Please make good use of it in your
future hunting life.
54855.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級になったハンターにオス
スメの装飾品≪Ｇ級・護閃珠≫
が入手できる依頼です。
蒼眠鳥を狩猟すると、一閃、
三界の護り、怒のスキル値を
持つ装飾品≪Ｇ級・護閃珠≫
を入手することができます。
ぜひ今後の狩猟生活にお役立
てください。

61752.description: Well? Have you found any clue about the ore? No luck here at all. Actually there is said to be an ore called Jet Black Dragon Iron, but how to dig it is likewise unknown. Perhaps it is not mined, but obtained when something lures you.
61752.descriptionEn:
So? Have you found any clue
about the ore?
Nothing at all on my end.
Actually, there is said to be an ore
called Jet-Black Dragon Iron, but
how to dig it is likewise unknown.
Maybe it isn't mined at all —
perhaps you get it when you are
invited to something.
61752.descriptionJp:
どうだ？鉱石について手がか
りでも見つかったか？
こっちは全然ダメだ。
実は「漆黒の龍鉄」って鉱石
もあるらしいんだが、同じく
掘る方法が判明していない。
もしかすると、採掘するので
はなく、何かへ誘われた時に
入手できるのかもしれないな。

63008.description: The Secret Certificate [Break] is proof that a hunter holding a Secret Scroll has reached a certain level of skill. This time's examiner is the Guild's foremost authority, renowned for his eye, so if you meet his standards you can be sure of receiving a large number of Secret Certificates [Break]. Do not miss this rare chance.
63008.descriptionEn:
≪Secret Proof [Rending]≫
is proof that a scroll-
holding hunter has reached
a certain level of skill.
Our examiner this time is
the Guild's foremost eye,
so if you satisfy him, he
will surely issue many
≪Secret Proof [Rending]≫.
Do not miss this rare chance.
63008.descriptionJp:
≪秘伝の証【破】≫は、
秘伝書所持ハンターとして
一定の実力に到達した証です。
今回の判定員はギルド随一の
権威と観察眼を誇るため、
彼の眼にかなえば、大量の
≪秘伝の証【破】≫を確実に
発行することができますよ。
この希少な機会をどうぞ
お見逃しなく。

55234.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
55234.description: Slaying a Velocidrome raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55234.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Velocidrome,
you raise your own rating
while getting a good deal on
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations - such a
quest is ready. Please use it.
55234.descriptionJp:
ドスランポスを討伐すること
で、自身の評価を上げつつ、
Ｇ級装飾品を手に入れるため
に必要な素材をお得に入手で
きるクエストを準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

51080.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
51080.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the crest of a Purple Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
51080.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Purple Gypceros' crest,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51080.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
紫毒鳥のトサカを破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

55596.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55596.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55596.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
55596.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

26246.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

55479.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55479.description: An Anomalous Species Rukodiora with greatly developed wings has appeared. It rages with the peculiar ferocity of the Anomalous Species, and hunters are withdrawing one after another. In response the guild will provide strong support for the hunt. Head out fully prepared.
55479.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Rukodiora with
greatly developed wings has
appeared.
Unleashing Supremacy's fierce
might, it has hunters
retreating one after another.
The Guild will give strong
support. Go forth fully prepared.
55479.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した辿異種
ルコディオラが現れました。
辿異種特有の猛威を奮い、
ハンターが次々と撤退してい
ます。この事態にギルドは
対策として、強固な討伐支援
を行います。万全を期して
調査に向かってください。

54215.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
54215.description: I want you to slay an Akura Vashimu with its tail cut off, for the investigation! I know it is an unreasonable request. But I must ask! I will prepare a large reward, so please!
54215.descriptionEn:
To survey Akura Vashimu, I
want you to slay it with its
tail cut off!
I know full well this is an
unreasonable ask. But I
really must insist!!
I'll prepare plenty of reward,
so please, I'm counting on you!
54215.descriptionJp:
アクラ・ヴァシムを調査する
ために尻尾を切断した状態で
討伐をお願いしたいんだ！
無茶なお願いだというのは
十分承知している。けど、
どうしてもお願いしたい！！
報酬は多く用意するから
是非、よろしく頼むよ！

54785.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54785.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54785.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

58025.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58025.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58025.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58025.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

26714.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
26714.description: What, you just want hard Dual Blades? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26714.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
pair of Dual Blades?
Then I'll refine some Argen Steel
for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
are prowling around the area
to top it off.
Go find it with all you've got!
26714.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬い双剣が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

23587.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
23587.description: The sky-soaring dragon has been confirmed near the course of the large survey ship. Even with interception equipment, we cannot survey if it attacks again and again. Board the survey ship and slay the sky-soaring dragon.
23587.descriptionEn:
Near the route of the large survey
ship, the Sky-Soaring Dragon was
sighted. Even with interception
equipment, we cannot carry out
our survey if it keeps attacking.
Please board the large survey ship
and slay the Sky-Soaring Dragon.
23587.descriptionJp:
大型探査船の航路付近に、
天翔龍の姿が確認されました。
迎撃用の装備があるとはいえ、
そう何度も襲われていては
調査を行うことができません。
大型探査船に同乗し、天翔龍
の討伐に当たって下さい。

55559.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55559.description: The Variant Species Doragyurosu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Doragyurosu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55559.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Doragyurosu≫
seems to have reached the strength
of the very summit among all
Doragyurosu.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
at challenging the summit are
asked to take on this survey.
55559.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドラギュロス≫
はドラギュロスの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

55033.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55033.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55033.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55033.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

61040.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
61040.description: We have readied a support structure to oppose the extremely powerful Elder Dragon found in the desert. To guarantee the ability of participants, please bring monster oil. We cannot issue proof of slaying, but we have prepared powerful supplies and Blast Vials as rewards.
61040.descriptionEn:
To oppose the extremely
powerful Elder Dragon found
in the Desert, we have set
up a support system.
To vouch for your skill,
participants must bring
Monster Extreme Oil.
No Slaying Proof can be
issued, but supplies and Bomb Bottles await.
61040.descriptionJp:
砂漠で発見された、極めて
強力な古龍に対抗するため、
支援体制を整えました。
参加者は実力を保証するため、
モンスターの極油をお持ちく
ださい。討伐の証は発行でき
ませんが、強力な支給品と、
報酬には爆撃ビンを用意
させていただきました。

23260.description: We are seeking hunters to help survey the Midogaron that appeared in the volcano. Midogaron generally act alone, and we believe that is because they are strong enough not to need a pack. This is a dangerous request, and only hunters with a solid record should apply.
23260.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to help
survey the Midogaron that appeared
in the Volcano.
Midogaron basically acts alone,
but that is thought to be because
it is strong enough that it has no
need to gather in packs.
This request is dangerous for any
hunter without a solid record.
23260.descriptionJp:
火山に出現したミドガロンを
調査するため、協力して頂け
るハンターを募集いたします。
ミドガロンは基本的に単体で
行動していますが、それは
自身が強いため、群れる必要
が無いからだと思われます。
十分な実績を持ったハンター
でなくては、危険な依頼です。

54464.description: Do you have enough Ｇｚ? In this request, introduced today, you can earn a hefty reward just by doing the same hunting as always. However, note that it cannot be taken more than the set number of times.
54464.descriptionEn:
Are you short on ≪Gz≫?
With today's request, you
only do the same hunting as
always and earn a hefty
reward for it.
Note that it cannot be
accepted beyond the set
number of times.
54464.descriptionJp:
≪Ｇｚ≫は足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
いつもと同じ狩猟をこなして
いただくだけで、高額な報酬
が獲得できます。
ただし、規定回数を超えて
受注することはできません
ので、ご注意ください。

50395.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21164.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
21164.description: When the monster the surveyor found was checked with the guild, it proved to be a relative of the sea wyverns, a Crystal Wyvern by the name of Kuarusepusu. Moreover, an extremely powerful individual seems to dwell in the highlands, and the surveyor's safety is feared for. Head for the highlands at once and hunt the Crystal Wyvern.
21164.descriptionEn:
When the Guild examined the
monster our surveyor found, it was
a kind of Leviathan named
Kuarlusepusu, the Crystal Dragon.
What is more, an extremely strong
individual seems to live up in the
Highlands, and the surveyor's
safety is feared for.
Hurry there and hunt it.
21164.descriptionJp:
調査員が発見したモンスター
をギルドに確認したところ、
海竜種の仲間で名前は晶竜
≪クアルセプス≫。
さらに高地には極めて強力な
個体が生息しているらしく、
調査員の安否が心配とのこと。
直ちに高地へ向かい、晶竜の
狩猟をお願いします。

60926.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60926.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
60926.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50044.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
50044.description: Hunters, since you are heading to the Snowy Mountains where the Kelbi live, try mixing Kelbi Horns and a Vitality Drink out in the field and making an Ancient Potion! Then, with that surging strength, hunt the Red Khezu!
50044.descriptionEn:
Hunters all, since you go to
the Snowy Mountains where
Kelbi live, combine Kelbi
Horns with Nutrients on the
hunting ground and make an
"Ancient Potion"!
Then with that surging power,
hunt a Khezu Subspecies!
50044.descriptionJp:
ハンターのみなさん、
ケルビが住まう雪山に行く
からには、ケルビの角と
活力剤を狩場で調合して、
見事「いにしえの秘薬」を
作成してみてください！
そして漲る力で、フルフル
亜種を狩猟しましょう！

55113.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
55113.description: Slaying a Gurenzeburu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55113.descriptionEn:
By slaying Gurenzeburu, you
raise your own rating while
getting a good deal on the
materials needed to obtain
G Rank decorations - we have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.
55113.descriptionJp:
グレンゼブルを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

54109.description: The Hyujikiki has needles all over its body, but those are actually its body hair hardened by its fluids. The surveys have turned up a great deal, but this time I want to focus especially on its parts. Could I ask you to hunt it after breaking its parts?
54109.descriptionEn:
Hyujikiki has needles all
over its body, but those are
really its fur hardened by
body fluids.
The survey has taught us much,
but this time I want to focus
the survey on its parts.
Could you break its parts
and then hunt it?
54109.descriptionJp:
ヒュジキキは体中に針がある
けど、あれって実は体毛が
体液で硬くなったものなの。
調査でいろいろわかってきた
けど、今回は特に、部位に
絞って調査をしてみようと
思っているの。部位破壊を
達成したうえで、狩猟を
頼めるかしら？

50836.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
50836.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50836.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
50836.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

21214.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
21214.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21214.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21214.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54170.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
54170.description: For the survey, please hunt a Lavasioth. I want to record its behavior when parts are broken as well, so be sure to break the head and the dorsal fin. I have prepared plenty of rewards, so do give it your best!
54170.descriptionEn:
For our survey, please hunt
a Volganos.
We also want to record its
behavior when parts break,
so be sure to break its
head and dorsal fin.
Plenty of reward is ready,
so please give it your best!
54170.descriptionJp:
調査のために、ヴォルガノ
スの狩猟をお願いします。
部位破壊時の挙動も記録
しておきたいので、必ず
頭と背ビレの破壊もお願い
しますね。報酬はたくさん
用意していますから、ぜひ
とも頑張ってください！

54322.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54322.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54322.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

26443.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の狩猟
26443.description: A report has come in that hunters who headed for the Snowy Mountains were beaten back by 2 Tigrex! Brave hunters confident in their skill, set out to rescue the injured and hunt the Tigrex!
26443.descriptionEn:
We have a report that hunters who
headed to the Snowy Mountains were
beaten back by 2 ≪Tigrex≫!
Brave hunters confident in their
skill, set out to rescue the wounded
and hunt the Tigrex!
26443.descriptionJp:
雪山に向かったハンター達が
２頭の≪轟竜≫の返り討ちに
あったとの報告が入った！
腕に覚えのある、勇敢なハン
ターは、負傷者の救出および、
轟竜の狩猟に向かうのじゃ！

21058.description: Hermitaur buried in the sand burst out suddenly. Running around is dangerous, so be careful! They faint when startled by loud noises, so do not forget to bring Sonic Bombs!
21058.descriptionEn:
The Yaozami that lurk in the
sand will burst out without
warning. Running around is
dangerous, so please be careful!
Loud noises stun them, so do not
forget to bring Sonic Bombs
along with you!
21058.descriptionJp:
砂に潜っている≪ヤオザミ≫は
突然飛び出してきます。
走り回っていると危ないので
気をつけてくださいね！
大きな音にびっくりして気絶
するので≪音爆弾≫を忘れずに
もって行ってくださいね！

23294.description: The survey of the flower field is proceeding smoothly, and many new materials have been discovered. Most of what has been found can apparently be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Among Ｇ-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous lands, quite a few may take an interest.
23294.descriptionEn:
The survey of the Flower Field
is going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.
23294.descriptionJp:
花畑の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

23723.description: This quest yields the following materials. Sword and Shield Merit (Beginning) x５０, Sword and Shield Merit (Middle) x６０, Sword and Shield Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23723.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials below.
≪Sword and Shield Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Sword and Shield Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Sword and Shield Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you
need a ≪Secret Art Merit
Crystal≫ and GR 500 or
above, so please be aware.
23723.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪片手剣勲・序≫５０個
≪片手剣勲・中≫６０個
≪片手剣勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

60639.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
60639.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Silver Rathalos and Gold Rathian. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60639.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Azure Rathalos≫ and ≪Pink
Rathian≫!
Achieve it together with your
Guild mates. Teamwork decides
this contest - take a top
place! Genesis Weapons only!
60639.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪リオレウス希少種≫と≪リ
オレイア希少種≫だ！猟団の
仲間と一緒に目標を達成して
もらうぞ。チームワークが物
を言うこの競技、見事上位に
入賞してみせよ！今回は始種
武器限定で開催されるぞ！

60941.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60941.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
60941.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62457.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
62457.description: What, you just want a hard Lance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62457.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Lance?
Then I'll refine some Argen Steel
for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
are prowling around the area
to top it off.
Go find it with all you've got!
62457.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅いランスが
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

23694.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23694.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Bow,
show us the skill you have honed
against the ≪Baruragaru≫ waiting
in the New Great Arena!
Should you hunt it magnificently,
you will earn an even greater
reward than what your daily
efforts bring.
23694.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55287.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
55287.description: The Gore Magala has been sighted at the tower. According to the report, it appeared to be in a Frenzy state, but far more ominous in form than any Frenzy state reported so far. At this rate the Frenzy Virus will spread. Hunt the Gore Magala.
55287.descriptionEn:
A Gore Magala was sighted at
the Tower.
According to reports, the Gore
Magala had been Frenzied,
but its form was said to be far
more sinister than any
Frenzy reported until now.
At this rate the Frenzy Virus
will spread. Hunt the Gore Magala.
55287.descriptionJp:
黒蝕竜が塔で目撃された。
報告によると、黒蝕竜は
狂竜化していたようだが、
今まで報告されている
狂竜化よりも遥かに
禍々しい姿だったという。
このままだと狂竜ウイルスが
拡散していってしまう。
黒蝕竜を狩猟してくれ。

62740.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の捕獲

26293.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, would you plant the Guild Flag at the summit for me?
26293.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, has no
fixed territory, and because
its numbers are so few it is
also called the Phantom Beast.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
could you plant a Guild Flag
at the summit for me?
26293.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物ね。雪山に行くなら山頂に
≪ギルドフラッグ≫を立てて
くるのをお願いしてもいい？

62716.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62716.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62716.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62716.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

26162.description: The season is the breeding season! The stage is the Jungle at night! Gather the monsters' eggs and deliver them! If you obtain gold or silver eggs as a reward, they can be sold for a high price! Hunters aiming to make a fortune at one stroke, do join us!
26162.descriptionEn:
The season is the breeding season!
Gather monster eggs in the Jungle
at night and deliver them!
If you get Gold or Silver Eggs in
your rewards, they sell for a high
price!
Hunters chasing a fortune, come
join us, every one of you!
26162.descriptionJp:
季節は繁殖期！舞台となる夜
の密林でモンスターたちの卵
を採取して納品せよ！
報酬で金や銀のタマゴが入手
できれば高額で売却が可能！
一獲千金を狙うハンターたち
はもれなくご参加ください！

21590.description: Have you heard of the Rhinoceros Horn Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21590.descriptionEn:
Do you know the sphere
called Rhinohorn Sphere?
That material is vital for
crafting a certain expensive
decoration.
Complete this request and I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21590.descriptionJp:
犀角原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

21945.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
21945.description: You there! I hear you produced a Gurenzeburu weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gurenzeburu. I am counting on you!
21945.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a Taikun Zamuza
weapon.
So I've got a favor to ask, and
the pay is weapon upgrade parts.
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay a
Gurenzeburu for me.
I'm counting on you!
21945.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
蛮竜の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってグレンゼブルを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

58060.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58060.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58060.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58060.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

50811.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟

63335.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that guarantees an Armorer's Soul: Fortune. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63335.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival, we have prepared a
quest that guarantees a
≪Gear Smith Soul [Luck]≫.
Bring your Festival Proof to join.
63335.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪武具職
人魂【幸】≫が確実に手に入
るクエストを用意させていた
だきました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

62782.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62782.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62782.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

61537.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61537.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61537.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62276.objectiveJp: バサルモス変種１頭の捕獲
62276.description: A Felyne's treasure? Of course I know it, meow. It should be hidden in the volcano, so I will do a little cleaning, meow! Basarios should be there too, so put it to sleep, meow. Of course cut the tail too, meow?
62276.descriptionEn:
The cat's secret treasure? Of
course I know it, nya.
It should be hidden in the
Volcano, so go tidy up, nya!
A Basarios should be there
too, so put it to sleep, nya.
And of course, cut its tail
while you're at it, nya?
62276.descriptionJp:
ネコのヒホウ？もちろん知っ
てるニャ。火山に隠してある
ハズニャから少し掃除してく
るのニャ！バサルモスもいる
はずニャから眠らせておくの
ニャ。
もちろん尻尾は斬っておくの
ニャよ？

22078.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
22078.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, a Nargacuga was newly observed in the jungle. According to the surveyor who encountered it, it performs behavior never observed before. Take the greatest care with the monster's movements!
22078.descriptionEn:
As the Transcendence Species
appeared, surveys across the land
newly observed the Swift Wyvern
Nargacuga in the Jungle.
According to the researchers who
encountered it, it displays
behavior never observed before.
Please be extremely careful of
the monster's actions!
22078.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、密林に
迅竜・ナルガクルガが新たに
観測されました。
遭遇した調査員の報告による
と、今まで観測されていない
行動を行うとのことです。
モンスターの行動にはくれ
ぐれも注意して下さい！

55780.description: To further awareness and promotion of the newly started G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest. Breaking Abiorugu's tail also grants a special ingredient.
55780.descriptionEn:
To further awareness and
promotion of the newly
started G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking Abiorugu's tail
also grants a special ingredient.
55780.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
獰竜の尻尾を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

60316.description: Patients wounded and suffering from illness need nourishing food. I want to give at least the patients in the square proper care, but there is still not enough... Hunters, I am counting on you.
60316.descriptionEn:
Wounded patients suffering from
illness need nourishing food.
At the very least I want to give
the patients in the plaza proper
care, but we still lack the numbers….
Hunters, I am counting on you.
60316.descriptionJp:
傷つき、病に苦しむ患者には
滋味ある食物が必要だ。
せめて、広場の患者だけでも
手厚い医療を施したいが、
まだまだ数が足りない･･･。
ハンター諸君、頼んだぞ。

50413.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21528.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
21528.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21528.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21528.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

62699.description: There are reports that an Abiorugu has appeared in the swamp. Much about Abiorugu remains a mystery, but the investigation seems to be progressing little by little. We ask for your continued cooperation.
62699.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that
Abiorugu has appeared in the
Swamp. Much about Abiorugu still
remains a mystery, but our
survey seems to be advancing
little by little.
We ask for your continued help.
62699.descriptionJp:
アビオルグが沼地に
現れたとの報告がありました。
まだ、アビオルグに関しては
謎の多いままですが、
少しずつ調査は進んでいる
ようです。
更なる協力をお願いします。

55951.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the crimson one the Extreme Radiant Zerureusu. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55951.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it comes
dancing right back.
The Guild has decided to call
the crimson one
"Zerureusu, the Acme
Brilliance".
Hunters who slay it receive
Guild armor materials and a title!
55951.descriptionJp:
追い払えどもヤツは、
再び舞い戻ってくる。
ギルドでは、紅いヤツを
「極み耀くゼルレウス」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

60325.description: Small jobs rarely find anyone willing to take them. But odd jobs are honest work too. For hunters who have just risen to high rank, this quest, which combines groundwork with mining, is recommended. Fail to prepare a pickaxe, though, and retirement is certain.
60325.descriptionEn:
Odd jobs never seem to find
any takers….
But even chores are honest work.
For hunters who have just reached
High Rank, I recommend this quest:
it covers both groundwork and
mining.
Just don't neglect your pickaxe,
or you are certain to retire.
60325.descriptionJp:
細々とした仕事は、なかなか
受注者はいないものなの･･･。
でも、雑用も立派な仕事。
上位にあがりたてのハンター
には、下積みと採掘を兼ねる
このクエストはオススメよ。
ただし、ピッケルの準備を怠
ると、リタイアは必至よ。

21481.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21481.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21481.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21481.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

53134.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
53134.description: Everyone! Are you in burning love? You who received hot feelings from the gentlemen, I want you to hunt the monster waiting in the volcano and become even hotter, sweeter hearts! I am counting on you!
53134.descriptionEn:
Everyone! Are you burning
with love??
To you who took such hot
feelings from the boys,
I want you to hunt
the monster waiting in the
Volcano and become even
more heated and sweet
at heart! I'm counting on you!!
53134.descriptionJp:
みんな！燃えるような恋を
しているかい？？
男子諸君から熱い気持ちを
受け取った君たちには、
火山に待ち受ける
モンスターを狩猟して、
さらにヒートでスイーツな
心になってもらいたい！
期待してるぜ！！

54185.objectiveJp: 木彫りの人形・青１個の納品
54185.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54185.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.
54185.descriptionJp:
お疲れ様でした。
クエストを達成し、
≪★６解放記念硬貨≫を
受け取ってください。
ハリセンネコへ持っていけば
良い品と交換してもらえ
ますよ。

50036.description: A report has arrived that a Chameleos appeared in the swamp. We have sent hunters several times before, but no results have been obtained. Therefore we have set several conditions on this request. It is a difficult request, but we have prepared rewards to match. Please.
50036.descriptionEn:
Reports have arrived that a
Chameleos appeared in the
Swamp.
We have sent hunters there
several times, but with no
results.
Therefore this request comes
with several conditions.
It is a hard request, but
the rewards match. Thank you.
50036.descriptionJp:
沼地に、霞龍が現れたとの
報告が届きました。
これまで何度かハンターを
向かわせましたが、成果が
得られていません。
そのため、今回依頼に幾つか
の条件を出しています。
困難な依頼ですが、それに
見合う報酬を用意しておりま
す。よろしくお願いします。

40186.description: Do you have the Wooden Doll (Jade)? Then go and slay the Mosswine in the Far Reaches. Search for it. Do so and I'll give you something special.
40186.descriptionEn:
Do you hold a ≪Wooden Doll -
Jade≫?
Then go slay the Mosswine in
≪the Farthest Land≫. Seek
it out.
Do so, and I'll give you something special.
40186.descriptionJp:
おぬし≪木彫りの人形・翠≫
を持っておるか？
ならば、≪最果ての地≫
にいるモスを討伐しにいくの
じゃ。探すのじゃ。
さすればトッテオキをやろう。

23528.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
23528.description: In a region where entry has been forbidden for many years, incidents of monsters turning abnormally ferocious have occurred frequently of late. The Heaven-Circling Dragon, Shagaru Magala, must have appeared! There is no telling how much damage this will cause if it goes on. Head out to hunt it at once.
23528.descriptionEn:
In a region where entry has been
forbidden for many years, there have
been many cases of monsters turning
strangely vicious lately.
The Heavenly Revolving Dragon
≪Shagaru Magala≫ must be behind it!
There is no telling how much damage
this will cause if left alone.
Please head out and slay it at once.
23528.descriptionJp:
長年、足を踏み入れることを
禁じられてきた地域で、最近
モンスターが異常に凶暴化す
る事件が多発しています。
天廻龍≪シャガルマガラ≫が
現れたに違いありません！
このままではどれ程の被害に
なるか予想もつきません。
至急討伐へ向かって下さい。

53249.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

28010.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ２頭の狩猟

23402.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
23402.description: The survey team that went to the desert has sighted a gigantic Odibatorasu. Reports also say it launches powerful attacks using the sand. Hunters confident in their skill, prepare fully and investigate.
23402.descriptionEn:
From the survey team sent to the
Desert came a sighting of a giant
≪Doragyurosu≫.
There are also reports that it
launches powerful attacks that
make use of the sand.
Hunters confident in their skill,
prepare well before you take on
this survey.
23402.descriptionJp:
砂漠に向かった調査団より、
巨大な≪弩岩竜≫の目撃情報
がありました。
砂を利用した強力な攻撃を
仕掛けてくるとの報告も
上がっています。
腕に自信のあるハンターさん、
十分な準備の上、調査をお願
いします。

61305.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
61305.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61305.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61305.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

21018.description: Daimyo Hermitaur spends most of its time buried in the sand. If you mean to hunt one, please don't forget that. It's called the Shield Crab for a reason: once it guards itself, it's a nuisance!
21018.descriptionEn:
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ spends
most of its time in the
sand. Don't forget that
when hunting. It's called
the Shield Crab for a
reason; guarding is a pain!
21018.descriptionJp:
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫は普段
は砂に潜ってることが多い
です。狩猟をするなら忘れな
いようにして下さい。
盾蟹と呼ばれるだけあって身
を固められたら面倒ですよ！

21206.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
21206.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21206.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21206.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54129.description: Hunter there. Do not be surprised by the high contract fee. This job exchanges your 10000Ｇｚ for ten Porta Cards Purple. Perfect for growing your assets, would you not say?
54129.descriptionEn:
Hunter over there. Don't be
shocked by the contract fee.
This is a request to exchange
your 10,000 Gz for 10
≪Porta Card Purple≫.
I think it's perfect for
growing your assets - how about it?
54129.descriptionJp:
そこのハンターさん。契約金
の高さに驚いてはダメよ。
これは、あなたの１万Ｇｚを
≪ポルタカード紫≫１０枚と
交換する依頼なの。
資産を増やすのに最適だと
思うけど、いかがかしら？

55115.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
55115.description: Slaying an Akantor raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55115.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying an Akantor raises your
standing while letting you obtain
the materials needed for G Rank
jewels at a good value.
Please make the most of it.
55115.descriptionJp:
アカムトルムを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

54447.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
54447.description: While surveying the creatures living in the swamp, we confirmed an extremely powerful individual Gypceros subspecies. It is a precious individual never found before, so please head to the site at once to investigate.
54447.descriptionEn:
While surveying the creatures
of the Swamp, we confirmed a
very powerful ≪Gypceros
Subspecies≫ individual.
It is a precious specimen never
found before, so please head
to the site at once and carry
out a survey.
54447.descriptionJp:
沼地に生息する生物たちの
調査中に、非常に強力な
≪ゲリョス亜種≫の個体を
確認しました。
これまでに発見されたことの
無い貴重な個体ですので、
至急現地へ向かい調査を
お願いいたします。

60313.description: Iron Ore is needed for one thing or another when preparing equipment. Have you ever found yourself saying, ah, not enough, at the worst possible moment? On this quest, those who complete the main target will receive at least 7 Iron Ore!
60313.descriptionEn:
Iron Ore is always needed for
putting your gear together.
Have you ever found yourself
short of it right when you
need it most?
In this quest, everyone who
clears the main target will
receive at least 7 Iron Ore
from us!
60313.descriptionJp:
装備を調えるには、
何かと必要な鉄鉱石。
いざ、という時に
「あ！足りない！」なんてこ
と、よくありませんか？
このクエストでは、
メインターゲットを達成され
た方に、最低でも７つの
鉄鉱石を進呈しますよ！

3.description: It is I, the Instructor! Mm. Good that you looked here. Whatever quest you go on, check this section carefully. Now, this time the quest is to find Honey. If you find a bee hive, you can take the honey!
3.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
Mm. Good that you looked here.
No matter which quest you take,
always check this section well.
Now, this time it is a quest to
find ≪Honey≫. Find a bee nest
and you can take the honey!
3.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
うむ。よくぞここを見たな。
どのクエストに行くときも、
この項目はしっかり確認だ。
さて、今回は≪ハチミツ≫を
探すクエストだ。ハチの巣を
見つければ、蜜を取れるぞ！

61624.description: A quest in which a rookie hunter and a hunter who has just equipped a Secret Tome hunt Rathian together. The must-order includes delivery of 2 Rookie's Proofs, so the 2 rookie hunters must not forget to bring theirs.
61624.descriptionEn:
This quest has Rookie hunters
and a hunter who just put on
a Secret Art book hunting a
≪Rathian≫ together.
The must-order includes
delivering 2 ≪Rookie Proofs≫,
so the two Rookie hunters
must remember to bring theirs.
61624.descriptionJp:
新人のハンターと、秘伝書を
装備したてのハンターが協力
して≪リオレイア≫を狩猟す
るクエストです。
マストオーダーに、≪新人の
証≫２枚の納品がありますの
で、新人のハンター２人は忘
れずに持参してくださいね。

61977.description: I am a musician who came from afar. Lately I have heard a rumor that at a certain hour a mysterious sound echoes from the swamp near this square. Would you go and find out what that sound is? I will provide the supplies and armor you need. It will not take much of your time, so please hurry.
61977.descriptionEn:
I am a musician who came from
far away. Lately I heard a rumor
that at a certain hour a strange
sound echoes from the swamp
near this square. Would you go
and find out what that sound is?
I will prepare whatever supplies
and armor you need. It will not
take much effort, so be quick.
61977.descriptionJp:
私は遠方から来た楽師の一人。
最近、この広場に近い沼地か
ら、ある時刻になると謎の音
が響き渡るという噂を聞いた。
その音とは何なのか調べてき
てくれないか？
必要な支給品や防具は私が用
意する。そんなに手間はとら
せないから、早いとこ頼むよ。

55257.description: Brachydios's ecology is a mystery. Just when we had reports of sightings in the volcano, now comes a report of it appearing in the polar sea. A creature whose whole body is like an explosive is extremely dangerous. Head there at once and hunt it.
55257.descriptionEn:
The ecology of the Brute Wyvern
Brachydios is a mystery. Right
after sightings in the Volcano,
reports came of one appearing
in the Polar Sea. A beast whose
whole body is like an explosive
is extremely dangerous.
Head there at once and hunt it.
55257.descriptionJp:
砕竜・ブラキディオスの生態
が謎だ。火山での目撃情報が
あった矢先、今度は極海に
出現したとの報告があった。
全身が爆発物のようなヤツの
存在は非常に危険だ。
早急に現地へ向かい、狩猟
してほしい。

23524.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟

60646.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Plesioth. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60646.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Plesioth≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster
all alone is truly fine!
Overcome yourself and take
a splendid top placement!
Genesis Weapons only this time!
60646.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ガノトトス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は始種武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

54307.description: Meraginasu has been discovered in the caves of Tide Island. A dragon that carries memories of ancient times, known until now only from fossils. This is a discovery without precedent. The survey is of great importance and failure will not be tolerated. Head to the site at once and secure it.
54307.descriptionEn:
≪Meraginasu≫ has been found in
the caves of the Tidal Island.
A dragon whose existence we
knew only from fossils, carrying
memories of ancient times.
This is an unprecedented find.
It is a most important survey,
so failure is not permitted.
Please head there at once and
secure the area.
54307.descriptionJp:
潮島の洞窟で
≪メラギナス≫が発見されま
した。今まで化石でしか
その存在を知ることができな
かった、太古の記憶を持つ竜
です。これは嘗てない発見と
言えます。非常に重要な調査
のため失敗は許されません。
至急現地へ向かい安全の
確保をお願いします。

23721.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
23721.description: The Variant Species Anorupatisu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Anorupatisu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23721.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Anorupatisu≫
seems to have reached the strength
of the very summit among all
Anorupatisu.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
at challenging the summit are
asked to take on this survey.
23721.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アノルパティス≫は
アノルパティスの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

50873.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
50873.description: Nya! Nya! Hunter! Try taking my guidance, meow! Hunt a Forokururu beautifully and I will tell you about a decoration that makes the Tower survey a tiny bit easier, meow! The survey will surely progress, meow!
50873.descriptionEn:
Nya! Nya! Hunter!
Why not try my guidance, nya!
If you splendidly hunt a
≪Toa Tesukatora≫, I'll tell
you of a decoration that
makes the Shantien survey
just a bit easier, nya!
The survey will surely progress, nya!
50873.descriptionJp:
ニャ！ニャ！ハンターさん！
試しにボクのシナンを受けて
みるニャ！≪華鳳鳥≫を
みごと狩猟できたら、
天廊調査がすこ〜しだけ
ラクチンになる装飾品をお教
えしますニャ！これで調査も
進むこと間違いなしニャ！

53129.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
53129.description: I want to make a big ohina-sama that will not lose to last year's, nya! But! It is important to pursue not only scale but the artisan's spirit, nya! Dress up as the ohina-sama in beautiful pink and white equipment and hunt Pink Rathian, nya! If you succeed, I'll present you with a lovely stiff paper as thanks, nya!
53129.descriptionEn:
I want to make hina dolls so
big they beat last year, nya!
But! Not just scale -
pursuing the smith's spirit
is what matters, nya!
Dress as hina dolls in lovely
pink and white gear and hunt
a Pink Rathian, nya!
Succeed and I'll give you lovely paper, nya!
53129.descriptionJp:
昨年に負けない、大きなおひ
なさまを作りたいのニャ！
しかし！スケールだけでなく
職人魂を追及することが大切
ニャ！ピンクと白の綺麗な装
備でおひなさまになりきって、
桜火竜を狩猟するのニャ！
成功した時にはお礼に素敵な
堅紙をプレゼントするニャ！

55015.description: To hunters whose Slash Axe F GSR reached 999: upgrade Lilie (Slash Axe F) and we will give you materials for Lilie Grace. Materials obtainable: FG5 Production Ticket 4 x 60
55015.descriptionEn:
To hunters whose Switch Axe F
has reached GSR 999:
"Lilie"
(Switch Axe F)
Upgrade it and
we will present you
with materials for
"Lilie Grace".
[Obtainable Materials]
- FG5 Production Ticket 4 x60
55015.descriptionJp:
スラッシュアックスＦの
ＧＳＲが９９９に到達した
ハンターさんへ
「リーリエ」
（スラッシュアックスＦ）
強化すると
「リーリエ・グレイス」
の素材をプレゼントします。
【入手できる素材】
・ＦＧ５生産券・４×６０

26502.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. The reward is a certain material that proves you an angler. Show me the fruits of all your work so far! Since fishing is the aim, absolutely do not hunt the Plesioth Subspecies this time either!
26502.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. The
reward is a certain material that
proves you are an angler.
Show me the sum of all your skill!
Fishing is the goal, so this time
you must not slay the Green Plesioth!
26502.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。報酬は、
釣師の証になる、ある素材だ。
今までの集大成を見せてくれ！
釣りが目的だから、ガノトト
ス亜種は今回も絶対に狩らな
いように！

11003.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
11003.description: Hunt the 1 blue hunter, Velocidrome, that uses the Jungle as its feeding ground! It is just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt! In this season there are fewer Velociprey minions, so it is a good opportunity!
11003.descriptionEn:
Hunt 1 of the blue hunters,
≪Velocidrome≫, that feed in
the Jungle!
He is just the right foe to
test your skill as a hunter!
This season his Velociprey
lackeys are scarce, so go now!
11003.descriptionJp:
密林をエサ場とする、青き
狩人≪ドスランポス≫１頭
を狩猟してください！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手です！
この季節なら子分のランポス
も少ないので、好機ですよ！

23476.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
23476.description: A Daimyo Hermitaur with greatly developed claws has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Daimyo Hermitaur seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23476.descriptionEn:
A ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ whose claws
have grown enormous has appeared.
The Guild classifies this specimen
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will conduct a survey.
There are also reports it is more
dangerous than any Daimyo Hermitaur
so far.
Please survey it with great care.
23476.descriptionJp:
爪が大きく発達した≪盾蟹≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの盾蟹より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

55101.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
55101.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55101.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55101.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

21084.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21084.description: If you can hunt Yian Kut-Ku, you'll prove you can hold your own even in the Elder Hall. If you have room to spare, try making aged mushrooms too. Put specialty mushrooms in a Maka Pickling Jar and bury it. Simple, yes?
21084.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ and
that proves you can hold
your own even in the
Great Hall. With time to
spare, try aging mushrooms
too: Special Mushrooms in
a ≪Maka Pot≫. Simple, no?
21084.descriptionJp:
≪イャンクック≫を狩猟する
ことができれば、大老殿でも
そこそこやれる証拠ね。
もし余裕があれば熟成キノコ
作りにも挑戦してみてね。
≪マカ漬けの壷≫に特産キノ
コを入れて埋める。簡単よ？

61715.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
61715.description: Thanks for playing MHF for three whole years! Equip Akam Superb and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude L as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude L you can forge Vol Impact (Hammer).
61715.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for three whole years!
Equip ≪Akam Superb≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude L≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude L≫ you can forge
≪Vol Impact≫ (Hammer).
61715.descriptionJp:
３年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪アカムシュペルブ≫を装備
し、≪年間特典生産券≫１枚
を納品すると≪感謝の証L≫
を１１枚プレゼントいたしま
す。≪感謝の証L≫から
≪ヴォルインパクト≫
（ハンマー）が生産可能です。

55213.description: Slaying a Plesioth Subspecies raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55213.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Green Plesioth, you
can raise your own standing while
also getting hold of the materials
needed for G Rank decorations
at a bargain. We have prepared
a quest that lets you do just
that. Please make good use of it.
55213.descriptionJp:
ガノトトス亜種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

62759.description: We have reports that a mysterious monster is present in the jungle. Its species remains unidentified and much about it is still unknown, but it may be new. It is said to be extremely ferocious, so this will be a dangerous survey. We appreciate your help.
62759.descriptionEn:
We have reports that a
mysterious monster is now in
the Jungle.
Its species is still unidentified
and much remains unknown, but
it may be a new species.
It is said to be very savage,
so this is a dangerous survey,
but we ask for your help.
62759.descriptionJp:
現在、謎のモンスターが、
密林にいるとの報告が
ありました。
未だ種を特定できず、
多くが謎のままですが、
新種の可能性があります。
非常に獰猛とのことなので、
危険な調査依頼となりますが、
よろしくお願いします。

50241.description: My first request, so I am nervous. There is a musician I simply must tell music lovers about. They are so cool, truly. But I am too shy, so I would be glad if you would film them for me instead. I will cheer from the shadows! Once you meet them, spread the word to everyone!
50241.descriptionEn:
This is my first request, so I'm
nervous. There's a musician I
really want music lovers to hear.
He's cool, seriously.
But I'm too shy, so I'd be glad
if you could take photos instead.
I'll be cheering from the shadows!
If you meet him, tell everyone!
50241.descriptionJp:
初めての依頼で緊張するなぁ。
音楽好きな人にぜひ教えたい
ミュージシャンがいるんだ。
クールだよ、ほんと。
でも恥ずかしいから代わりに
撮ってきてくれたらうれしい。
影ながら応援するよ！
会えたらみんなに広めてよね！

62155.description: This is the practice finals quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or from clear rewards.
62155.descriptionEn:
This is the practice finals quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or from clear rewards.
62155.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で、
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

62557.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Volcano, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Heat Haze or the Voice of Nature: Wasteland. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62557.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request,
which is set in the ≪Volcano≫,
you may come to obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Heat Haze≫
or ≪Voice of Nature: Wasteland≫.
I pray your hunting life becomes
ever more fulfilling.
62557.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪火山≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・陽炎≫や
≪大自然の声・荒野≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

54443.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54443.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Gurenzeburu, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54443.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority requests that have newly
begun, we have prepared this
quest to further their recognition
and promotion.
By breaking Gurenzeburu's head,
we will also grant you some
special ingredients.
54443.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
蛮竜の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

55629.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55629.description: To support hunters' decoration production, the Guild is considering providing materials from its stores. However, supplies are limited, so only for capable hunters. Please try the quest and obtain the materials!
55629.descriptionEn:
To support Hunters in producing
decorations, the Guild is considering
providing materials kept in Guild
storage.

However, as quantities are limited,
we can offer them only to Hunters
of proven ability.
Please take on the quest and
obtain the materials!
55629.descriptionJp:
ギルドではハンターの方々の
装飾品生産を支援するため、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。

ただし、数に限りがあるため
実力のあるハンターのみと
させていただきます。
ぜひクエストに挑戦して、
素材を獲得してください！

54479.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
54479.description: Please investigate the Espinas rare species. Not just hunting: destroy its back and cut its tail, and I will add to the reward!
54479.descriptionEn:
We would like you to survey the
Espinas Rare Species.
Not only by hunting it — if you
break the Espinas Rare Species'
back and sever its tail, I will
add a little extra to your
reward!
54479.descriptionJp:
エスピナス希少種の
調査をお願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
棘白竜の背中破壊と
尻尾切断をしてくれたら、
報酬を上乗せしちゃい
ますよ！

55360.description: As a warrior, having vanquished Kushala Daora, I must take on an even greater trial! As a warrior! I must vanquish Rathalos!
55360.descriptionEn:
I, as a warrior,
have vanquished
Kushala Daora,
so now I must take
on a stronger trial!
As a warrior!
I must vanquish
Rathalos!
55360.descriptionJp:
拙者、武者として
クシャルダオラを
成敗したからには
もっと強い試練に
挑まねばならぬ！
武者として！
リオレウスを成敗せねば
ならぬのだー！

26327.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26327.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26327.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26327.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55529.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55529.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55529.descriptionEn:
Drive it off, and the beast will
come dancing back once more.
So the Guild has decided to call
that shining one "Guanzorumu,
Ruler of the Acme."
In the end, we must slay it.
To any hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild armor, and a title!
55529.descriptionJp:
追い払えどもヤツは、
再び舞い戻ってくる。
ギルドでは、光放つヤツを
「極み統べるグァンゾルム」
と呼ぶことにした。
やはり討伐するしかないか。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

62872.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62872.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62872.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62872.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

26707.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26707.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
26707.descriptionEn:
Hey! This time I had some special
equipment and supplies prepared
for you.
Take these and blow those guys
away with one big boom!
I've also got some special
rewards ready, so enjoy
yourselves out there!
26707.descriptionJp:
オウ！今回は特別な
装備品、支給品を
用意させてもらった。
これで一発あいつらを
ドカンとやってきてくれ！
多少だが特殊な報酬も
用意したから、せいぜい
楽しんでくんな！

62110.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

21189.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21189.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21189.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26147.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26147.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26147.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

50944.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
50944.description: For members of hunting parties that took part in the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward that allow you to craft armor from past festivals. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50944.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds that took
part in the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special request
and rewards that let you craft
past Festival armor. Please bring
a ≪Festival Proof≫ to accept it.
50944.descriptionJp:
狩人祭に参加した猟団に所属
しているかた専用に過去の
狩人祭防具を生産できる特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて頂き
ました。受注、参加に、≪祭
典の証≫をお持ちください。

63196.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 5 Wyvern Shatterclaws and I will give you 6 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63196.descriptionEn:
Shh, quiet down, nya! This is
a secret exchange, nya. Give me
5 ≪Wyvern Shatterclaw≫ and
I'll give you 6 ≪Master Felyne's
Favorite≫, nya.
Slip them to the Master Felyne
and he'll make ≪Hardcore Felyne
Weapons≫ with no materials, nya!
Aim for the dream jackpot and
do your best, nya!
63196.descriptionJp:
シッ、静かにするニャ！ここ
は秘密の取引所ニャ。≪飛竜
の砕爪≫を５個くれたら、
≪親方ネコの大好物≫を
６個あげるニャ。
こっそり親方ネコに渡せば、
素材なしで≪剛猫武器≫を
作ってくれる優れ物ニャ！
夢の大当たりを狙って
頑張るニャ！

26258.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
