26258.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26258.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26258.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

23443.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23443.description: This quest yields the following materials. Switch Axe Merit (Beginning) x５０, Switch Axe Merit (Middle) x６０, Switch Axe Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23443.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Switch Axe Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Switch Axe Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Switch Axe Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR 500 or above, so please
be aware.
23443.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪剣斧勲・序≫５０個
≪剣斧勲・中≫６０個
≪剣斧勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

62933.description: There was a report that 2 Crystal Wyverns, Kuarusepusu, appeared in the desert. Some investigators testify that the ground suddenly began to shake greatly, and though the details are unclear, the situation seems quite dangerous. Please investigate with every precaution.
62933.descriptionEn:
We have reports that 2 Crystal
Wyverns, ≪Kuarlusepusu≫, have
appeared in the Desert. Some of
our surveyors even testify that
the ground suddenly shook hard,
and though details are unclear,
the situation seems quite
dangerous. Please survey with
every precaution taken.
62933.descriptionJp:
晶竜≪クアルセプス≫が
砂漠に２頭現れたとの報告が
ありました。調査員の中には、
突然大地が大きく揺れだした
と証言する者までおり、
詳しくは分かりませんが、
かなり危険な状態のよう
です。万全の態勢で調査を
お願いします。

62751.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
62751.description: Do you have enough zenny? In this job, you can earn materials that sell for a high price. The job is also reputed to be relatively easy. However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
62751.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough Zenny?
With the request we present today,
you can earn materials that sell
for a high price as your reward.
Word is that the request itself
is also fairly easy to complete.
However, you cannot accept it
several times in a row,
so please be careful.
62751.descriptionJp:
ゼニーは足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
高額で売却できる素材を報酬
として獲得できますよ。
依頼内容も、比較的楽に
達成できると評判です。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

50590.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50590.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
50590.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

62117.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
62117.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt the dancing thunder wyvern Berukyurosu in the Arena. I have prepared armor for it as well! It is a formidable monster, so do not forget to heal often, understood? Now off you go!
62117.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
I want you all to hunt the
Dancing Thunder Wyvern in the
Arena, ≪Berukyurosu≫. I have even
prepared armor for it in advance!
It is quite a tough monster, so
do not forget to heal often, all
right? Now go and give it your all!
62117.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、闘技場にいる舞雷竜、
≪ベルキュロス≫の狩猟をし
てもらおう。そのための防具
も予め用意してやったぞ！
かなり手強いモンスターなの
で、こまめに回復を忘れるな
よ？さあ頑張ってこい！

62550.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62550.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62550.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

12050.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

60423.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
60423.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60423.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60423.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

22062.description: The depths of Tide Island are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22062.descriptionEn:
The depths of the
≪Tidal Island≫ are still
under Guild survey, but
hunters too might like to go
and take a look for
gathering and research.
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22062.descriptionJp:
≪潮島≫の奥深くは、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

56117.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56117.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56117.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

23579.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23579.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23579.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55977.description: The Blast Mist Wyvern has appeared in the Ashen Gleam Sphere survey area. We want it driven off. As an advance payment, so to speak, a small story: the Ashen Gleam Sphere is known in a distant land as mithril, and is said to be a phantom. How fortunate we are.
55977.descriptionEn:
A blast-mist wyvern has appeared
in the Ashgleam Orb survey area.
We would like you to drive it off.
As an advance on our thanks, so
to speak, let me share a small tale.
The Ashgleam Orb is, in a certain
distant land, called mithril and
said to be a phantom.
How fortunate we are.
55977.descriptionJp:
灰輝原珠の調査区域に
爆霧竜が現れました。
追い払って頂きたいのです。
そのお礼の前金、と言っては
なんですが、小話を一つ。
灰輝原珠は、とある遠国
ではミスリルと呼ばれ、
幻とされているそうです。
我々は幸運ですね。

55125.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields Prime Species materials. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55125.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival, we have prepared a
quest that yields ≪Origin Species
Materials≫. Please bring a
≪Festival Fervor≫ when accepting.
55125.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に≪始種素
材≫を獲得できるクエストを
用意させていただきました。
受注、参加時に、≪祭典の
熱気≫をお持ちください。

26281.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26281.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26281.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

26198.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
26198.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26198.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26198.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

55445.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55445.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55445.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

62218.description: We have completed defensive preparations against the mysterious flying wyvern now approaching Mezeporuta. Meet it at the interception base and slay it, making use of the abundant supplies and interception weapons. This time we have also arranged carvers for you!
62218.descriptionEn:
We have completed our defense
preparations against the
mysterious Flying Wyvern now
heading for Mezepolta. Meet it
at the ≪Base≫ and slay it using
the ample supplies and
interception weapons provided.
Carvers have been arranged
for you this time as well!
62218.descriptionJp:
現在、メゼポルタに向けて、
飛来してきている謎の飛竜に
対しての防衛準備を整えまし
た。≪迎撃拠点≫で迎え撃ち、
豊富な支給品と、迎撃兵器を
利用して、討伐してください。
今回は剥ぎ取り職人も手配さ
せていただいていますよ！

60901.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60901.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
60901.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

62494.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62494.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62494.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

26105.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
26105.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!
26105.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在です。
姿無きところから姿を現わし
熟練の狩人でも手に負えない。
捕獲なんて無理なことは考え
ないで慎重かつ着実に攻撃を
重ねるしかないと思います！

55731.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐

54939.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Lance Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Lance Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54939.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Lance Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Lance Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Lance Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept this quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please be aware.
54939.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ランス綬・序≫１００個
≪ランス綬・中≫１６５個
≪ランス綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

53143.description: In this trial you are to capture 1 Congalala. However, to lure it out you must slay 8 Conga, its underlings. And to obtain capture items you must also slay 1 Bulldrome. Split the work between you and get it done!
53143.descriptionEn:
For this trial, you will capture
one Congalala.
However, to lure the brute out,
you must slay 8 of its
underlings, the Conga.
Also, to obtain capture items,
you will need to slay 1 Bulldrome.
Split the work between the two
of you and see it done!
53143.descriptionJp:
今回の試練では、ババコンガ
１頭の捕獲をしてもらう。
しかし、やつをおびき寄せる
には、子分であるコンガを
８頭討伐しなければならない。
また、捕獲用のアイテムを入
手するには、ドスファンゴ１
頭の討伐も必要だ。
手分けして達成してくれ！

60317.description: The far-off land of the Forest and Hills overflows with great bounty. For a fine hunter who has reached ＨＲ５１, surely you are qualified enough to enjoy the bounty of the Forest and Hills? I recommend you go and see for yourself.
60317.descriptionEn:
The far-off land of ≪Forest and
Hills≫ overflows with great bounty.
For a fine hunter who has reached
HR 51, surely you have more than
enough qualification to enjoy the
blessings of Forest and Hills?
I recommend you go there once.
60317.descriptionJp:
遥かなる大地、≪森丘≫には
大いなる恵みが溢れている。
ＨＲ５１にもなろうって立派
なハンターなら、森丘の恵み
を享受するには、十分な資格
があるんじゃないか？
一度行ってみることをオスス
メするぜ。

20011.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
20011.description: Lao-Shan Lung seems to have invaded the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma! Use the fortress interception equipment to the fullest and repel Lao-Shan Lung! Those whose strength is insufficient should ride Lao-Shan Lung's back, obtain Dragon Drug Stones and put them in the delivery box!
20011.descriptionEn:
The Old Mountain Dragon Lao-
Shan Lung seems to be invading
the ≪Fortress≫, the gateway to
Dondruma! Make full use of the
fortress's intercept devices and
repel Lao-Shan Lung! Those
lacking strength should ride on
its back, obtain ≪Dragonite Ore≫
and put it in the delivery box!
20011.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマへの玄関口となる
≪砦≫に老山龍ラオシャンロ
ンが侵攻してきたようじゃ！
砦の迎撃設備を最大限に活用
し老山龍を撃退するのじゃ！
戦力の及ばぬ者は老山龍の背
に乗り≪龍薬石≫を入手して
納品ＢＯＸに納めるのじゃ！

21895.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
21895.description: This is the quest for the HR 800 Breakthrough Trial. After accepting the trial from the Guildmaster or the HR Trial Board, please set out on the quest alone.
21895.descriptionEn:
This is the quest for the
HR 800 Breakthrough Trial.
After accepting the trial from
the Guildmaster or the HR Trial
Board, please set out on the
quest alone.
21895.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ８００突破試練のための
クエストです。ギルドマス
ターまたはＨＲ試練掲示板
から試練を受注した後、
お一人でクエストへ出発して
ください。

63249.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
63249.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
63249.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

63179.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63179.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63179.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63179.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

56058.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Gasurabazura through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Great Sword, Hammer, Tonfa, Switch Axe, Bow, or Heavy Bowgun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56058.descriptionEn:
By crafting one Supremacy weapon
from Gasurabazura and upgrading
it two stages, you can obtain the
materials needed, plus Porta Card
Sakura worth Gz.
The weapon types you can craft are
Great Sword, Hammer, Tonfa, Switch
Axe, Bow, or Heavy Bowgun.
Please make use of this to craft
and upgrade the weapon you like.
56058.descriptionJp:
辿異種ガスラバズラの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、大剣、鎚、
穿龍棍、剣斧、弓、重弩の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

62478.objectiveJp: 黄晶石の欠片９９個の納品

50617.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
50617.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Doragyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
50617.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Doragyurosu's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50617.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
冥雷竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54656.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54656.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54656.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

62135.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
62135.description: Just as a hunter has trials to overcome, the Lavasioth that lives in the volcano has a difficult barrier of its own to pass. Hunters and monsters alike are desperate to survive, that is what it comes down to. I would say it is no bad thing to go and see such a fine sight.
62135.descriptionEn:
Just as hunters face trials they
must overcome, the ≪Volganos≫
that dwells in the Volcano has
a hard barrier it must surpass.
Hunters and monsters alike are
desperate simply to survive.
I think it wouldn't be bad to
go and see such a gallant
sight, don't you?
62135.descriptionJp:
ハンターに越えなければなら
ない試験があるように、火山
に棲む≪ヴォルガノス≫にも
乗り越えるべき難しい関門が
ある。
ハンターもモンスターも生き
るのに必死ってことだ。
そんな雄姿を見に行くのも
悪くないと思うぜ？

63344.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63344.description: A Plesioth has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the heavy bowgun, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63344.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena we have
loosed a ≪Water Wyvern≫ that is
fearsomely strong and acts in
ways beyond all reason.
Hunter who would master the Heavy
Bowgun, show me your skill
before my eyes!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
shall gain more than what your
daily efforts earn you.
63344.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪水竜≫を放ってある。
重弩を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

50637.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki on Tide Island! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50637.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show the skill you
have honed against the ≪Leaping
Crimson Beast≫ on the Tidal Island!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
shall gain even more rewards
than what your daily efforts
earn you.
50637.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

54605.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Congalala beautifully. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
54605.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Congalala≫ and
show me what you can do.
Clear the quest, and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!
54605.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪桃毛獣≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

61435.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
61435.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61435.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
61435.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

1069.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
1069.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke! They say its appearance makes onlookers tremble! But an armored wyvern is only armored while its shell holds! Break its chest and the armor peels away, right?
1069.descriptionEn:
Wreathed in the Volcano's smoke,
the black subspecies of ≪Gravios≫
has shown itself! They say its
looks make all who see it tremble!
But a Gravios is only armored
because of its shell! Break its
chest and that armor peels off!
1069.descriptionJp:
火山の噴煙にまみれ≪グラビ
モス≫の黒き亜種が姿を現し
たらしい！その容姿は見る者
を震え上がらせるって話だ！
ただ、鎧竜ってのは体を守る
鎧があればこそだ！胸部が破
壊できれば鎧は剥がれるぜ？

62191.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62191.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62191.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62191.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

21903.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21903.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to slay the Espinas Rare Species at the Old Tower. Clear this request and you can obtain the set of Secret Notes needed to upgrade gear, so do take it on and see it done.
21903.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's daily life,
we have prepared a request to
slay an Espinas Aberrant at the
Ancient Tower.
Complete this request and you
will obtain a full set of secret
notes needed to upgrade gear,
so please accept it and see
the request through.
21903.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、古塔でエスピナス奇
種を討伐する依頼を用意しま
した。
この依頼を達成すれば、武具
の強化に必要な秘伝のメモ
一式が入手できますので、
ぜひ受注して依頼を達成しま
しょう。

60624.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60624.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60624.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60624.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55636.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55636.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55636.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

21113.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品

50858.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50858.description: Hunter who would master the light bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50858.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Light Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.
50858.descriptionJp:
軽弩を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

22154.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
22154.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
22154.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!
22154.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のゼニーが入手できる上
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

60135.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60135.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60135.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60135.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

26059.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26059.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26059.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26059.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

50425.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61328.description: A tremendous number of Gypceros seem to have gathered in the swamp. It is dangerous as it is, so hunt as many as you can. For safety, we will lend reassuring equipment to hunters who take it on with ranged weapons.
61328.descriptionEn:
A staggering number of Gypceros
seem to have gathered in the Swamp.
It is dangerous as things stand,
so hunt as many as you can.
For safety, hunters who take up
ranged weapons will be lent some
reassuring equipment.
61328.descriptionJp:
沼地にすごい数の毒怪鳥が
集まっているらしい。
このままでは危険なので、
できるだけ多く狩猟してきて
くれ。安全のため、遠距離
武器で挑むハンターには、
心強い装備を貸してあげよう。

62169.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
62169.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Do not let your guard down; approach it as though it were a Hardcore Quest. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62169.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for members
of winning Hunting Festival guilds.
Please face it as if it were a
≪Hardcore Quest≫, and do not let
your guard down.
Note that once you depart, the
Festival Proof cannot be returned
no matter what happens.
62169.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。油断なさらぬよう
≪剛種クエスト≫のつもりで
お向かいください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

21741.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
21741.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!
21741.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君！
武具を手に入れただけで
満足しているのでは？
それではイカンのです！
このクエストを達成して、
更なる武具の強化を成し遂げ
ましょう！

21818.description: I saw Tigrex in the snowy mountains, land of bitter cold! Showing itself even in the snowy mountains, it seems that for that one, as long as there is prey, it does not care what kind of place it is.
21818.descriptionEn:
I saw the "Tigrex" in the freezing
Snowy Mountains!
Showing up as far as the snowy
peaks... As long as there's prey,
it doesn't seem to care what kind
of place it's in.
21818.descriptionJp:
極寒の地、雪山で≪轟竜≫
ティガレックスを見たんだ！
雪山にまで姿を現すなんて、
アイツにとっては獲物さえい
れば、そこがどんな場所だろ
うと関係ないみたいだな。

62296.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62296.description: Reading the lost map has revealed a new fact. The weapon that slept beyond the Dragon Sluice can be upgraded further, it seems. There is a stone monument in the Highlands recording the method, and to reach that place you need an Iron Compass. Now, get one quickly!
62296.descriptionEn:
Reading the lost map revealed
a new fact. The weapon sleeping
beyond the Dragon Sluice can be
upgraded further.
In the ≪Highlands≫ stands a stele
that records the method, and to
reach that place you need an
≪Iron Compass≫.
Now, hurry and get one!
62296.descriptionJp:
失われた地図を読み解くこと
で新たな事実が判明した。
竜水門の先に眠っていた武器
は、さらに強化できるようだ。
≪高地≫に強化方法が記され
た石碑があり、その場所へ行
くには、≪鉄製の方位磁針≫
が必要とのことだ。
さ、急いで入手するんだ！

60213.description: I heard from a traveler that he nearly lost his life in the desert recently. Sudden intense drowsiness, loss of consciousness, and when he came to he had heat stroke. This must be that thing's doing. I want you to secure the safety of the road.
60213.descriptionEn:
I heard from a traveler who
nearly died in the Desert
recently. A sudden, heavy
sleepiness took his senses, and
he woke to heatstroke.
This must be that one's doing.
Please make the road safe.
60213.descriptionJp:
ある旅人から、最近砂漠で命
を落としかけたと聞いた。
突然強烈な眠気に意識を失い
気が付けば熱射病にかかって
いたということだ。
これはヤツの仕業に違いない。
旅路の安全を確保してほしい。

62852.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62852.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of zenny! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62852.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice to all hunters!
Along with a training method to
efficiently build up experience,
right now you can also get a huge
amount of zenny!
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
immense!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!
62852.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法に加え、今なら
大量のゼニーが入手できます！
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

1001.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト２匹の納品
1001.description: Find and deliver 5 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
1001.descriptionEn:
Find 5 specialty mushrooms that
grow in the Jungle and deliver them!
If you also deliver the insect that
sometimes flies about the Jungle,
the ≪Royal Beetle≫, I'll pay up too!
It's best to start by learning the
Jungle, then getting used to it.
1001.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を５つ探して納品してくれ！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品
してくれても報酬を払うぜ！
まずは密林を知り、密林に
慣れることから始めるといい。

51002.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51002.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
51002.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice
Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.
51002.descriptionJp:
鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

28030.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

21338.description: My master gave me a sudden order. A fully fledged carver can carve the tail bone from a Variant Gravios, so he told me to bring one back. It seems I may ask a hunter to capture it and sever its tail, so please do what you can. Once the tail bone is taken, I will give it to you after showing it to my master.
21338.descriptionEn:
My master gave me a sudden
order, see. A full-fledged carver
can carve the tailbone from a
Gravios Variant, so bring one
back and show him, he says.
Asking hunters for the capture
and the tail cut is fine, so
please, help me out. Once we
have the tailbone, it is yours
after he sees it.
21338.descriptionJp:
師匠から急な命令があってね。
一人前の剥ぎ取り職人なら、
鎧竜変種からその尾骨を剥ぎ
取れるんで、それを取って来
て見せろとさ。捕獲と、尻尾
の切断はハンターに依頼して
いいらしいから、なんとか頼
むよ。尾骨が取れたら、師匠
に見せたあとにあげるからさ。

55723.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55723.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55723.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

60611.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60611.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60611.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60611.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50704.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50704.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the claws of a Shogun Ceanataur will also grant a special ingredient.
50704.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Shogun Ceanataur's
claws, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50704.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鎌蟹のツメを破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

60502.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
60502.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
60502.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

55638.description: A quest aimed at hunters who do not yet possess the Variant skill cuffs Sleep Resistance Boost Cuff ＳＺ and Wind Pressure Boost Cuff ＳＺ, intended to spread those cuffs. So that the guild can support you as well, the rewards lean toward cuff crafting. Please take the quest with vigour.
55638.descriptionEn:
This quest is aimed at those who
do not yet own the Supremacy
skill cuffs ≪Sleep Resist Cuff SZ≫
and ≪Wind Pressure Cuff SZ≫,
and its aim is to spread those
cuffs. So that the Guild can
back you up, the rewards lean
more toward cuff crafting.
Please accept it with gusto!
55638.descriptionJp:
辿異スキルカフである、
≪耐睡強化カフＳＺ≫並びに
≪風圧強化カフＳＺ≫を
未所持の方へ向けた、上記
カフの普及を目的とした
クエストです。ギルド側でも
支援できるよう、報酬をより
カフ作成に寄せていますので、
奮って受注ください。

55641.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55641.description: An Anomalous Species Toridokuresu with greatly developed wings has appeared. Its earlier than predicted appearance has caused tremendous damage. Swift and certain action is required. The guild will provide support too, so set out with 4 hunters and make sure of the kill.
55641.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Toridcless whose wings
have grown enormous has appeared.
Its emergence sooner than predicted
has caused tremendous damage.
Swift and certain action is
required of us now.
The Guild will provide support as
well, so form a party of 4 and
slay it without fail.
55641.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した辿異種
トリドクレスが現れました。
予測よりも早い出現により、
甚大な被害が発生しています。
迅速かつ確実な対処が求めら
れる状況です。
ギルド側からも支援を行いま
すので、４人編成の上で確実
な討伐をお願い致します。

61502.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61502.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61502.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

21863.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21863.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Odiba FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21863.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the upgrade materials for all 5
parts of the ≪Zenith Armor≫
Odibatorasu FX series.
Accepting the quest requires a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that if you fail the
quest, the ≪Superior Ticket≫
will be consumed.
21863.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
オディバFXシリーズの５部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50824.description: It is I, the Instructor! Is your heart burning today as well? I thought so! Then take on the Hardcore Abiorugu Special Individual! It may be a hunt decided by a hair. Even so, try to carry out breaking its horns and tail perfectly!
50824.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Is your heart burning today as well?
It is! Then take on the Hardcore
Abiorugu Unique Individual!
It may turn into a hunt by the
skin of your teeth. Even so,
pull off the horn and tail
breaks without fail!
50824.descriptionJp:
我輩だ、教官だ！
今日も心は燃えているか？
いるな！ならば剛種アビ
オルグ特異個体に挑めっ！
ギリギリの狩りになるかも
しれん。そんな中でも
角と尻尾の部位破壊を
キッチリこなしてみろっ！

61339.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61339.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61339.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

12032.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62861.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
62861.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62861.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!
62861.descriptionJp:
狩人たちの祭典、狩人祭！
魂を集めて勝利を掴み取れ！
今回紹介するこの依頼は、
シリーズクエスト専用だ！
シナリオを最後まで進めて、
大量の魂をゲットしよう！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

15013.description: You who seek greater heights. To confirm your skill, hunt the monster I designate. I call it the Official Hunting Exam! This time, hunt an Espinas! It is a tough foe, but I believe you will succeed!
15013.descriptionEn:
One who seeks still greater heights.
To confirm your skill, hunt the
monster we have specified here.
Thus it is named the ≪Official
Hunt Exam≫! This time, hunt the
≪Espinas≫!
It will be a tough foe, but I
believe you can do it!
15013.descriptionJp:
さらなる高みを目指す者よ。
オヌシの腕前を確認するべく
こちらで指定したモンスター
を狩猟してみせよ。
名づけて≪公式狩猟試験≫！
今回は≪棘竜≫を狩猟じゃ！
難敵となるが達成を信じて
おるぞ！

61341.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61341.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61341.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50613.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ４匹の捕獲

21449.description: Hello. I am the master of bouquets of love and miracles. Hmm, is there someone you want to pierce right through the heart? Then leave it to me! Gather the plants I name and I will make you a wonderful bouquet. To celebrate the fate that brought us together, I will pour my heart into it!
21449.descriptionEn:
Hello there. I am the Bouquet Master
of love and miracles. Hmm hmm,
is there someone special whose heart
you want to strike dead-on?
Then leave it to me!
Gather the plants I specify and I
will make you a wonderful bouquet.
To celebrate the fate that brought
us together, I will put my heart
into it!
21449.descriptionJp:
こんにちは。僕は愛と奇跡の
花束マイスターさ。ふむふむ、
ハートをズドンと射止めたい、
気になる相手がいるのかい？
それなら、僕に任せてよ！
指定の植物を集めてくれたら、
素敵な花束を作ってあげる。
君と出会えたこの運命を祝し、
心を込めて取り掛かるよ！

54250.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
54250.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
54250.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

51010.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51010.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
51010.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Bow,
show us the skill you have honed
against the ≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in
the Arena! If you succeed in
hunting it, you will earn even
more rewards than your daily
efforts bring.
51010.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

54732.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス２頭の討伐
54732.description: Two Lavasioth have appeared in the G Rank Volcano! I'd love to survey their ecology, so while you slay them, bring back something we can use as a sample. If by chance you get any rare material, it is yours.
54732.descriptionEn:
Two ≪Volganos≫ have appeared
in the G Rank Volcano!
I'd love to survey their
ecology, so while you slay them,
bring back something we can
use as a sample.
If by chance you get any rare
material, it is yours.
54732.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の火山で≪ヴォルガノス≫
が２頭も現れたらしい！
ぜひ生態を調査したいので、
討伐のついでに何かサンプル
になるようなものを取ってき
てください。
万が一、何か珍しい素材が
取れたら差し上げますよ。

50099.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50099.description: The contest between the Red Beast Hunter and the Rajang has begun! To accept this request you must equip the Magxia HS series for blademasters on your chest, arms, waist, and legs. Assemble the Red Beast equipment that speaks of the wild, and hunt the Rajang!
50099.descriptionEn:
The curtain has risen on the match
between the Red Fighting Beast
hunter and the Rajang!
To accept this request, you must
equip the Blademaster Magshia HS
series on your chest, arms,
waist, and legs! Don wild Red
Fighting Beast armor and hunt Rajang!
50099.descriptionJp:
赤闘獣ハンターと金獅子の
勝負の幕が切って落とされた！
この依頼を受けるには「剣士
用のマグシアHSシリーズ」を
胴・腕・腰・脚にそれぞれ
装備している必要があるぞ！
野生を感じさせる赤闘獣装備
を揃えて、いざ金獅子狩猟！

55515.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55515.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55515.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

61222.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hardclaw! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61222.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association rewards
hunters who capture many Variants
and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying Wyvern
Hardclaw!
Deliver the guarantee when you
accept or join, and hunt the
specified monster.
Note that the guarantee cannot be
returned once you depart.
61222.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の剛爪！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

55973.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55973.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55973.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

62690.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

55974.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55974.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55974.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

62591.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
62591.description: Do you know of the lost famed bow, the Black Bow? I hold its material, but I do not give it away for free. Hunt the Basarios that dwells in the Volcano with a bow and I will acknowledge your skill and give you this Ink Scrap.
62591.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the lost famed bow,
the Black Bow?
I hold its materials, but I won't
give them away for free.
Hunt the Black Gravios that dwells
in the Volcano with a Bow, and I
will acknowledge your skill and
give you this ≪Ink Fragment≫.
62591.descriptionJp:
失われた名弓「黒弓」を知っ
ているか？その素材を持って
いるが、タダではやらないよ。
火山に棲みつく黒鎧竜を弓で
狩猟してくれれば、キミの実
力を認めて、この≪墨のカケ
ラ≫を差し上げよう。

58113.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58113.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58113.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58113.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60935.description: We have a report that a giant Plesioth was sighted in the desert. It is a fine catch, so reel it in once and then slay it. The reward will be generous. And if you slay it without fishing? You are out!
60935.descriptionEn:
A giant Plesioth was sighted in
the Desert, per the report.
It is a big catch, so reel it in
once first, then slay it.
The reward will be generous.
What if you slay it without fishing?
You retire!
60935.descriptionJp:
砂漠で巨大なガノトトスが目
撃されたとの報告が入った。
せっかくの大物なので、１回
釣り上げた上で討伐して
きてくれ。報酬は弾むぞ。
釣らずに討伐したら？
リタイアだ！

21167.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21167.description: The guild has named the mighty monster that suddenly appeared in the desert Odibatorasu. We have reports that it is gigantic and extremely powerful, making this a very dangerous request. First-rate hunters confident in their skill, we ask you to investigate and repel it!
21167.descriptionEn:
A mighty monster suddenly appeared
in the Desert, and the Guild has
named it ≪Doragyurosu≫.
We have received reports that it is
gigantic and extremely powerful,
making this a very dangerous request.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please take on the survey and
repel it!
21167.descriptionJp:
砂漠に突如現れた強大な
モンスターですが、
ギルドはこれを≪弩岩竜≫
と名付けました。
巨大で非常に強力であるとい
う報告を受けており、
大変危険な依頼となります。
腕前に自信のある
凄腕ハンターさん調査と
撃退をお願いします！

21803.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21803.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21803.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

60445.objectiveJp: 特産キノコキムチ２個の納品
60445.description: It is a chore, but a request has come in through guild channels. As the reward, we have prepared a Vitality Drink, guild-approved, that restores stamina smartly with little delay, anytime and anywhere! If you have the time, please.
60445.descriptionEn:
It is a chore, but a quest
request has come from Guild
connections. The reward is
≪Energy Drink≫, the Guild-
approved bottle that restores
stamina in a flash, anytime,
anywhere. Come if you are free!
60445.descriptionJp:
雑用ですが、ギルド関連筋か
らクエスト依頼が来ています。
報酬には、いつでもどこでも
少ない隙でグイッとスタミナ
回復。ギルド公認の一本！
≪元気ドリンコ≫を用意して
います。お暇でしたらどうぞ！

62106.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
62106.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
62106.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

26420.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26420.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26420.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

60407.description: We discovered a vast sea of trees in an unexplored land. The moment we stepped in, a great swarm of Vespoid! We fled for our lives and left our baggage behind. It is important baggage! Will someone drive off that swarm!
60407.descriptionEn:
I discovered a vast Great Forest
in an unexplored land. The moment
I stepped in, a swarm of Vespoids!
I ran for my life and left my
cargo behind. It's important
cargo! Won't someone drive off
that swarm for me!
60407.descriptionJp:
未開の地に広大な樹海を発見
したんだ。足を踏み入れると
ランゴスタの大群さ！
逃げるのに必死で荷物を残し
てきてしまった。大事な荷物
なんだ！誰かあの大群を追い
払ってくれないか！

21444.objectiveJp: オオツノアゲハ９９匹の納品

23320.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
23320.description: While exploring the Jungle I found a poison bird wyvern different from the usual kind. From the moment we met it repeated utterly outrageous behavior beyond all norms, and we could not handle it. Thinking you will help our survey, would you hunt this monster?
23320.descriptionEn:
While exploring the Jungle, we found
a Gypceros unlike the normal kind.
From the moment we met, it kept up
a stream of utterly outrageous behavior
beyond all norms, and we could not
handle it ourselves.
If you would lend us your aid in our
survey, would you hunt this monster
for us?
23320.descriptionJp:
密林の探索中に通常の種と
は違った毒怪鳥を見つけま
した。出会い頭、突拍子も
ない規格外の行動を繰り返す
為、私たちでは手に負えま
せんでした。
私たちの調査に協力すると
思って、このモンスターを
狩猟してくれませんか？

61713.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
61713.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Imperial Consort] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
61713.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Imperial Consort]≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).
61713.descriptionJp:
２年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ナナブレイド【皇妃】≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると、≪感謝の
証K≫を１１枚プレゼント
いたします。
≪感謝の証K≫から≪アカム
スクウィード≫（ランス）が
生産可能です。

62976.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62976.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62976.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

54445.description: The ecology of Inagami is gradually being revealed. It is a very interesting monster with high intelligence that has adapted splendidly to the special environment of the bamboo forest. In particular, many reports concern its tail, so caution is needed. We ask for your cooperation in further investigation.
54445.descriptionEn:
The ecology of Inagami is gradually
coming to light.
It possesses high intelligence and
has adapted splendidly to the
special environment of the bamboo
grove — a most fascinating monster.
Many reports concern its tail in
particular, so caution is needed.
We ask for your help to push the
survey further.
54445.descriptionJp:
イナガミの生態が、
徐々に解明されてきました。
高い知能を持ち、竹林という
特殊な環境に、見事適応した
非常に興味深いモンスターと
言えます。特に尻尾には、
多くの報告が寄せられており
注意が必要です。
さらに調査を進めるための
協力をお願いします。

21578.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21578.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Snake Scale Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21578.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb that is
called the Serpent Scale Orb?
That material is indispensable
to crafting a certain expensive
decoration.
If you will complete this request,
I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21578.descriptionJp:
蛇鱗原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55527.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
55527.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55527.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55527.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

21151.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
21151.description: There is information that the Doragyurosu, previously found in the Snowy Mountains, has been sighted on the Highlands as well. It seems to be an especially tough individual among its kind, and hunting it will carry considerable danger. Hunters confident in their skill, please take this request!
21151.descriptionEn:
We hear the ≪Dark Thunder Wyvern≫
found before in the Snowy
Mountains is now sighted in
the Highlands. It seems even
tougher than its kind usually
is, and hunting it will carry
real danger. Hunters sure of
their skill, please take it!
21151.descriptionJp:
以前、雪山で発見された
≪冥雷竜≫が、高地でも目撃
されたとの情報がありました。
同種の中でも特に強靭な個体
らしく、その狩猟にはかなり
危険が伴うことでしょう。
腕に自信のあるハンターは、
依頼の受注をお願いします！

62893.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62893.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62893.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

60019.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１頭の討伐
60019.description: The legendary black dragon, Fatalis, seems to be doing something sinister in the deepest reaches of the untrodden volcano! At this rate calamity may rain down on the world! Hurry to the volcano and repel the enraged Fatalis!
60019.descriptionEn:
The legendary Black Dragon, Fatalis,
appears to be up to something
sinister in the deepest reaches of
an untouched volcano!! If this
continues, calamity may rain down
upon the world! Hurry to the
Volcano and repel the angry Black Dragon!
60019.descriptionJp:
伝説の黒龍、ミラボレアスが
前人未踏の火山の最奥地にて
なにやら良からぬ動きをして
いるようです！！このままで
は世界に災厄が降り注ぐかも
知れません！火山へと急行し
怒れる黒龍を撃退して下さい！

50230.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
50230.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
50230.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
50230.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

62262.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Your skill has already reached the realm of a master. So, shall I pass on to you a technique handed down from one generation to the next? The conditions are the delivery of a Fish Print [Large] and landing a Variant Plesioth with a single rod. I will be waiting!
62262.descriptionEn:
Fishing: a lonely hunt in
quiet communion with fish.
Your skill has already reached
the realm of a true master.
So I shall pass down to you
a secret art, heir to heir.
The terms: deliver a Fish
Print (Large) and one-cast a
Plesioth Variant. I await you!
62262.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。
その腕前はもはや名人の域に
達しているじゃろ。
そこで、ワシから一子相伝の
技を授けてやろうかの。
条件は、魚拓【大】の納品と
ガノトトス変種の一本釣り
じゃ。待ってるぞ！

55615.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
55615.description: For members of hunting parties that took part in the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55615.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds that joined
the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into a
≪Festival Emblem≫.
Please bring a ≪Festival Fervor≫
when accepting and joining.
55615.descriptionJp:
狩人祭に参加した猟団に所属
しているかた専用に≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に
交換できるクエストを用意
させていただきました。
受注、参加時に、≪祭典の
熱気≫をお持ちください。

26142.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26142.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26142.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

61655.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石２個の納品
61655.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Bird Wyvern Secret Stone! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61655.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association rewards
hunters who capture many Variants
and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Bird Wyvern
Secret Stone!
Deliver the guarantee when you
accept or join, and hunt the
specified monster.
Note that the guarantee cannot be
returned once you depart.
61655.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
メイン報酬は鳥竜種の秘石！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

50627.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
50627.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to slay an extremely powerful Poborubarumu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50627.descriptionEn:
An emergency request. We are
seeking hunters to slay an
extremely powerful individual
of ≪Poborubarumu≫. If you can
slay it splendidly, we shall
issue you more Slay Proofs than
usual!
50627.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ポボルバルム≫の個体を
討伐してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に討伐
できましたら、普段よりも
多めに討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

62783.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

1042.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石１個の納品
1042.description: Gypceros is a monster known by another name: the Poison Bird Wyvern! True to the name, it sprays poison everywhere and thrashes about, a real nuisance. It's cunning too: it plays dead when it senses danger! Never let your guard down!
1042.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ goes by another
name: the Poison Bird!
True to it, it sprays poison
everywhere and thrashes
about, a real nuisance.
When it senses danger it
plays dead, sly thing! Careful!
1042.descriptionJp:
≪ゲリョス≫は別名、毒怪鳥
って呼ばれるモンスターだ！
呼び名のとおり、毒液を吐き
散らして暴れまわる迷惑な
怪鳥だ。自分の身の危機を感
じると死んだふりをするズル
賢い面もある！油断禁物だ！

63211.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐

62702.description: Among the Violent Wyverns, Abiorugu, confirmed in the swamp, an extremely ferocious and powerful individual seems to have appeared. Because it is very dangerous, this is an investigation and hunting request limited to hunters we approve. Face it fully prepared.
62702.descriptionEn:
Among the Violent Wyverns
≪Abiorugu≫ confirmed in the
Swamp, an extremely ferocious and
powerful individual has appeared.
As it is very dangerous, this
survey and hunt is limited to
hunters we approve of. Please
face it fully prepared.
62702.descriptionJp:
沼地で確認されている
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫の中でも
極めて狂暴で、強力な個体が
現れたそうです。
大変危険なため我々が認める
ハンターさん限定での調査、
狩猟依頼となります。
万全の態勢で挑んでください。

55628.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55628.description: To support hunters' decoration production, the Guild is considering providing materials from its stores. However, supplies are limited, so only for capable hunters. Please try the quest and obtain the materials!
55628.descriptionEn:
To support Hunters in producing
decorations, the Guild is considering
providing materials kept in Guild
storage.

However, as quantities are limited,
we can offer them only to Hunters
of proven ability.
Please take on the quest and
obtain the materials!
55628.descriptionJp:
ギルドではハンターの方々の
装飾品生産を支援するため、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。

ただし、数に限りがあるため
実力のあるハンターのみと
させていただきます。
ぜひクエストに挑戦して、
素材を獲得してください！

63112.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
63112.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63112.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
63112.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

60930.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
60930.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
60930.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
60930.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

21791.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
21791.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21791.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21791.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

55518.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55518.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55518.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55518.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

102.description: The purpose of this exercise is to slay the Vespoid swarming in the Jungle! If killing them 1 at a time is hard, making Poison Smoke Bombs is also a good idea!
102.descriptionEn:
The goal of this exercise is to slay
the Vespoids that have swarmed
the Jungle! If killing them one
by one is tough, making Poison
Smoke Bombs is a good idea too!
102.descriptionJp:
密林に大量発生したランゴスタ
を討伐するのが演習の目的だ！
１匹ずつ倒すのがつらいなら
毒けむり玉を作ってみるのも
いい方法だぞ！

50158.description: The other day, while surveying the Deep Forest, I felt eyes on me. A very sharp, oppressive gaze. I never did learn what it was. It eats at me! As a survey team member it is humiliating! Please, find out what that thing is!
50158.descriptionEn:
The other day, while surveying
the Great Forest, I felt a gaze
upon me.
It was very sharp and overbearing.
To the very end, I could not tell
what it was.
It eats at me! As a member of the
survey team, it frustrates me too!
Please, find out its true identity!
50158.descriptionJp:
先日、樹海を調査中に視線
を感じたんです。
非常に鋭く威圧的でした。
最後までその正体について
はわかりませんでした。
気になるんです！調査団員
として悔しくもあります！
どうか、奴の正体を突き止
めてください！

56138.description: As one who has long wielded the Tonfa, it is only natural to pay respect to its origins. But I think passing that on is just as important. I will lend you weapon and armor, so I want you to experience the origin of the Tonfa. If you need help, try clearing the sub-target.
56138.descriptionEn:
As someone who has handled the
Tonfa for years, it is only
natural to pay respects to its
origins. But I think passing
that on is just as important.
We will lend you weapon and armor,
so experience the Tonfa's
origins for yourself. If you need
help, try clearing the sub-target.
56138.descriptionJp:
日ごろから穿龍棍を
扱っている身からすれば、
原点に敬意を払って当然だ。
だが、それを伝えていくのも
同じぐらい重要だと思ってな。
武器防具は貸すから、穿龍棍
の原点を体験して欲しい。
助力が必要なら、サブター
ゲットをクリアしてみてくれ。

61622.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61622.description: A quest in which a rookie hunter and a hunter who has just equipped a Secret Tome hunt Daimyo Hermitaur together. The must-order includes delivery of 2 Rookie's Proofs, so the 2 rookie hunters must not forget to bring theirs.
61622.descriptionEn:
This quest has a rookie hunter
and a hunter who has just equipped
a Secret Art book cooperate to
hunt a ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫.
A Must-Order requires delivering
2 ≪Rookie Proofs≫, so the two
rookie hunters must remember to
bring theirs along.
61622.descriptionJp:
新人のハンターと、秘伝書を
装備したてのハンターが協力
して≪ダイミョウザザミ≫を
狩猟するクエストです。
マストオーダーに、≪新人の
証≫２枚の納品がありますの
で、新人のハンター２人は忘
れずに持参してくださいね。

50886.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の討伐
50886.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50886.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50886.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

50988.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
50988.description: The heavenly revolving dragon Shagaru Magala has never been observed in this region, and its ecology is wrapped in mystery. To clarify its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its wing limbs or wings in addition to slaying it, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
50988.descriptionEn:
The Heavenly Revolving Dragon
Shagaru Magala has never been
observed in this region, and its
ecology is wrapped in mystery.
To unravel it, we will give extra
rewards if, besides slaying it,
you succeed in breaking its
winglegs or wings.
We await a brave hunter's challenge.
50988.descriptionJp:
天廻龍シャガルマガラはこの
地方での観測例がなく、生態
は謎に包まれています。
生態の解明のため、討伐に
加えて翼脚ないし翼の
部位破壊に成功した場合は
追加の報酬をお渡しします。
勇気あるハンターの挑戦を、
お待ちしております。

21986.description: A Supreme Species Gougarf that tramples the earth as its instincts dictate has appeared! Because this is a matter of urgency, the request is for a quick kill, but to keep damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also count in your favor. We are recruiting ace hunters holding Secret Tomes to face this unprecedented crisis!
21986.descriptionEn:
A Zenith Devouring Dragon that
crushes the land on instinct has
appeared!
As this is a race against time,
the request is for a short hunt, but
to keep the damage to a minimum,
repelling it alone will be counted.
We seek skilled hunters holding a
Secret Art book to face this
unprecedented crisis!
21986.descriptionJp:
本能のままに大地を踏みにじ
る覇種呑竜が現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

60726.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60726.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60726.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60726.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26596.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26596.description: Thanks for playing MHF for four whole years! Equip Vol Sanctuary and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude M as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude M you can forge Akra Ain (Dual Blades).
26596.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for four whole years!
Equip ≪Vol Sanctuary≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude M≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
M≫ you can forge ≪Akra
Ain≫ (Dual Blades).
26596.descriptionJp:
４年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ヴォルサンクチュアリ≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると
≪感謝の証M≫を１１枚プレ
ゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証M≫から
≪アクラアイン≫（双剣）が
生産可能です。

61446.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン赤３個の納品
61446.description: A quest reserved for the 2nd Place server. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Red) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61446.descriptionEn:
[2nd Place] This is a quest
exclusive to this server.
We have prepared exclusive rewards
for hunters who cleared the
Idaten Cup between Guilds.
The more Red Hunter Coins you
deliver, the better your chance
of obtaining rare materials.
61446.descriptionJp:
【２位】サーバー専用の
クエストです。
猟団対抗韋駄天杯をクリアさ
れたハンターに専用の報酬を
用意させていただきました。
ハンターコイン赤の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

61802.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61802.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61802.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

21920.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21920.description: A request to repel a Supremacy species has arrived. If you complete it, you can obtain Supremacy materials. Repel it though you may, a Supremacy is still a Supremacy. Please take care never to let your guard down.
21920.descriptionEn:
A Zenith repel request has arrived.
Complete it splendidly and you
can obtain Zenith materials.
Even for a repel, a Zenith is
still a Zenith.
Please be absolutely sure
not to let your guard down.
21920.descriptionJp:
覇種撃退の依頼が届きました。
見事、依頼を達成すれば、
覇種の素材が入手できます。
撃退といっても、覇種は覇種
です。
絶対に油断しないように、
お気を付け下さい。

61957.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
61957.description: When one calamity arrives, whether you think this is the end or think of what comes next differs from person to person. I never thought the Great Arena would become such a dangerous place, but once you survive this, the Guild shall give you an exceptional reward.
61957.descriptionEn:
When a calamity comes, whether you
think this is the end or wonder
what comes next differs from
person to person.
I never thought the Great Arena
would become such a dangerous
place, but if you survive it,
the Guild will grant you an
exceptional reward.
61957.descriptionJp:
一つの災いが訪れたとき、こ
れで終わりと思うか、次は何
だと考えるか、人によって
答えが異なるだろう。
まさか、大闘技場がこれほど
危険な場所になるとは思わな
かったが、ここから生還した
暁にはギルドから格別の報酬
をいただくとしよう。

61901.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61901.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
61901.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！
