61245.description: The last trial of the Hunting Companion Festival is for a man and a woman to face a monster together. The monsters come in male and female pairs too, so go carefully. Hunting the Rathian alone is enough, so the two of you must act in step. Now then, off you go!
61245.descriptionEn:
The finale of the Hunting Friends
Festival: two people, a man and
a woman, take on a monster.
Monsters come in male-female
pairs too, so be careful out there.
You only need to hunt the
Rathian, so the two of you must
act in perfect tandem. Now go!
61245.descriptionJp:
猟友祭最後の仕上げは、男女
２人でモンスターに挑むんだ。
モンスターも雌雄そろっている
から、気をつけて行っといで。
狩るのはリオレイアだけでいい
から、２人の呼吸を合わせて
行動するんだ。
ささ、頑張ってきな！

61006.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの狩猟
61006.description: A request for hunters who have come into their own only. Several Variant Gendrome have been confirmed in the Desert. They are vicious, so take care and hunt 2. If that proves too much, you may return after 1. Do your best!
61006.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or hunt a sub-target
61006.descriptionEn:
A request limited to skilled hunters.
Multiple Iodrome Variants have been
confirmed in the Desert.
They are vicious, so hunt 2 of them
with care.
If that proves too difficult,
returning after 1 is fine.
Do your best out there!
61006.descriptionJp:
凄腕のハンターさん限定の
依頼です。
砂漠で、複数のドスゲネポス
変種が確認されました。
凶暴な個体のため、注意して
２頭狩猟してきてください。
難しいようでしたら、１頭で
戻ってきても結構です。
頑張ってきてください！

61719.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の捕獲
61719.description: The Wyverian lady said the Guild is short of ingredients lately. At this rate she is worried whether they can properly entertain the hunters who visit Mezepolta Plaza. So she said that if you procure ingredients, she will give you a red gem as thanks!
61719.descriptionEn:
Lately the Guild is short on food,
the Wyverian lady said. At this
rate she worries they can't
properly serve the hunters who
visit Mezeporuta Square.
So she said if you gather some
ingredients for them, she'll give
you a red gem as thanks.
That's what she told me!
61719.descriptionJp:
最近、ギルドの食材が不足し
ているって竜人族のお姉さま
が言ってたわ。このままだと、
メゼポルタ広場を訪れるハン
ターたちをちゃんと持て成す
ことができるか心配なんだっ
て。そこで、食材を調達して
くれたら、お礼に赤い玉をあ
げるって言ってたよ！

62834.description: Today's exhibition is a dream match! I want to see you take on the most advanced hunting in vintage, tasteful armor! The weapon types you may use are limited to 6 simple, nostalgic ones! This is something to look forward to!
62834.descriptionEn:
Today's exhibition is a dream
match, a real dream, yes!
I'd love to see you wear old,
seasoned armor and take on
the most cutting-edge hunting!
The weapon types are limited
to 6 simple ones that even
feel nostalgic, yes!
This is going to be fun, yes!
62834.descriptionJp:
今日のエキシビションは、
夢のドリームマッチッス！
年代物の渋い防具を着て、
最先端の狩猟に挑む姿を
ぜひ見せて頂きたいッス！
使う武器種も、シンプルで
懐かしささえ感じさせる
６種類限定ッス！
これは楽しみッスよ！

23464.description: Hypnocatrice and Velociprey appeared during the survey of the sea of trees! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. To hunters who complete the request, we will give production materials for the weapon series Stout Steel Crushed.
23464.descriptionEn:
During the Great Forest survey,
a Hypnocatrice and a Velociprey
appeared! As things stand, the
survey cannot be completed.
Hunters who complete this request
will receive the crafting
materials for the weapon series
"Stout Steel Smasher".
23464.descriptionJp:
樹海の調査途中にヒプノック
とランポスが現れました！こ
のままでは調査が完了できま
せん。
依頼を達成して下さったハン
ターさんには、武器「屈強ナ
鋼ヲ粉砕ス」シリーズの生産
素材をお渡しします。

26125.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
26125.description: Bulldrome is the boss of a pack of Fango, with a body a size larger than theirs and large tusks. As you'd expect, it's a headlong charger, so fight it the same way you fight Fango!
26125.descriptionEn:
≪Bulldrome≫ is the boss of
the ≪Bullfango≫ herd, and
it's a size bigger than
them, with big tusks to
match.
It charges straight ahead,
so fight it just like a
≪Bullfango≫!
26125.descriptionJp:
≪ドスファンゴ≫は、≪ファ
ンゴ≫たちの群れのボスで、
≪ファンゴ≫より、ひとまわ
り大きな体と、大きな牙が特
徴です。
やっぱり、猪突猛進な相手に
なりますので、≪ファンゴ≫
と同じように戦いましょう！

51120.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
51120.description: A certain region in the East seems in a frenzy over a new era name. Perhaps drawn by the commotion, a Taikun Zamuza seems to have appeared on the tidal island. Since we have the chance, why not wear nostalgic equipment and try breaking parts? Note that breaking parts requires exposing the shell on many of the Taikun Zamuza's parts.
51120.descriptionEn:
A region in the east seems to be
in a frenzy over a new era name.
Drawn by the commotion, a
Many-Shell Crab seems to have
appeared on the Tidal Island.
Since we have the chance, why not
wear nostalgic gear and try part
breaking? Note that you must
expose shell on many of its parts.
51120.descriptionJp:
東方のとある地域は新しい元
号に大わらわみたいだね。
騒ぎにつられたのか、潮島に
多殻蟹が現れたようだよ。
せっかくだし、懐かしい装備
を着て部位破壊にも挑んでも
らおうか。部位破壊には多殻
蟹の多くの部位で殻を露出さ
せる必要があるから注意だ。

60705.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60705.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
60705.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

63083.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63083.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
63083.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
63083.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

21952.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
21952.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ６１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Orugaron. I am counting on you!
21952.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 61.
So I've got a favor to ask — how
about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay an
Orugaron for me.
I'm counting on you!
21952.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ６１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってオルガロンを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54826.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
54826.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! An unusual individual, a Hypnocatrice Rare Species, has been found at the top of the Jungle! There is only a short window in which to hunt it! We have prepared generous rewards, so please take the hunt!
54826.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice to all hunters!
At the Top of Great Forest we
have found a strange individual
of Hypnocatrice Rare!!
The chance to hunt it lasts only
a short time!
We have prepared generous
rewards, so please hunt it!
54826.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
樹海頂部で変わった個体の
ヒプノック希少種を発見し
ました！！
短い時間しか狩猟のチャンス
はありません！
お得な報酬を用意しましたの
で、ぜひ狩猟をお願いします！

54543.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Shantien, the Heaven Soaring Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54543.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Sky Soaring
Dragon ≪Shantien≫.
To accept this quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
54543.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、天翔龍
≪シャンティエン≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61875.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61875.description: 2 Khezu Variants are rampaging in the swamp, apparently. Speaking of Khezu, it is fire, right? Yes! Go and blast them down with a gunlance! If you pull it off, I will give special rewards like the hides I carved before!
61875.descriptionEn:
Two Khezu Variants are said to
be on a rampage in the Swamp.
Khezu means fire, right?
Yes! Go blast them apart with
a Gunlance!
Do it and I will hand over the
hides I carved and more!
61875.descriptionJp:
沼地で２頭のフルフル変種が
暴れているらしい。
フルフルといえば炎だよな。
そう！ガンランスであいつら
をドカンドカンと撃ち倒して
くるんだ！やり遂げれば、
俺が以前剥ぎ取ってきた皮等、
特別な報酬を出すぞ！

21397.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

21868.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Gakou FX (Elegance) and Gasen FX (Elegance) series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21868.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the upgrade materials for all 5
parts of the ≪Zenith Armor≫
Gakou FX [Style] / Gasen FX [Style]
series.
Accepting the quest requires a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that if you fail the
quest, the ≪Superior Ticket≫
will be consumed.
21868.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
雅孔FX【趣】／雅穿FX【趣】
シリーズの５部位分の強化
素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

58028.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58028.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58028.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58028.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

63149.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
63149.description: The guild has named the mighty monster that suddenly appeared in the desert Odibatorasu. We have reports that it is gigantic and extremely powerful, making this a very dangerous request. First-rate hunters confident in their skill, we ask you to investigate and repel it!
63149.descriptionEn:
A mighty monster suddenly appeared
in the Desert, and the Guild has
named it ≪Doragyurosu≫.
We have received reports that it is
gigantic and extremely powerful,
making this a very dangerous request.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please take on the survey and
repel it!
63149.descriptionJp:
砂漠に突如現れた強大な
モンスターですが、
ギルドはこれを≪弩岩竜≫
と名付けました。
巨大で非常に強力であるとい
う報告を受けており、
大変危険な依頼となります。
腕前に自信のある
凄腕ハンターさん調査と
撃退をお願いします！

23513.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
23513.description: The Gore Magala has been sighted at the tower. According to the report, it appeared to be in a Frenzy state, but far more ominous in form than any Frenzy state reported so far. At this rate the Frenzy Virus will spread. Hunt the Gore Magala.
23513.descriptionEn:
A Gore Magala was sighted at
the Tower.
According to reports, the Gore
Magala had been Frenzied,
but its form was said to be far
more sinister than any
Frenzy reported until now.
At this rate the Frenzy Virus
will spread. Hunt the Gore Magala.
23513.descriptionJp:
黒蝕竜が塔で目撃された。
報告によると、黒蝕竜は
狂竜化していたようだが、
今まで報告されている
狂竜化よりも遥かに
禍々しい姿だったという。
このままだと狂竜ウイルスが
拡散していってしまう。
黒蝕竜を狩猟してくれ。

61929.description: Another reckless fool has come, have they. Well, fine. Show me how far you can go against a savage monster in harsh conditions. I warn you, if you are only after the reward, you will get hurt.
61929.descriptionEn:
So another one who doesn't fear
for his life has come. Very well.
Show me how far you can go
against ferocious monsters in
harsh conditions.
I'll warn you now — if you're
only after the reward, you'll suffer.
61929.descriptionJp:
また命知らずな輩がやって
きおったか。まあ良かろう。
過酷な状況で凶暴なモンス
ターを相手にどこまでやれる
か見せてもらおうか。
言っておくが、報酬目当て
だったら、痛い目にあうぞ。

21157.description: An extremely powerful individual Gogomoa has appeared. Also, insect activity in Shiojima increases in the evening. The hunt will surely be harsh. Be careful.
21157.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Gogomoa
individual has appeared.
In addition, we have reports that
insects grow very active on the
Tidal Island in the evening.
There is no doubt this will be
a harsh hunt.
Please be careful out there.
21157.descriptionJp:
ゴゴモアの極めて強力な
個体が現れたそうです。
さらに、潮島の夕方は
虫の活動が活発になるとの
報告もあります。
厳しい狩猟になることは
間違いありません。
気を付けてください。

61263.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・一章１個の納品

50288.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50288.description: Hey, you there. A hunter who has obtained the Secret Scroll cannot eat the same meal forever, he would grow tired of it. When hunting, even if your comrades give it their all, food comes first. So I will introduce a job that gets you fresh, nutritious ingredients. Go on.
50288.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there.
A hunter who has earned a Secret
Art book will grow tired of eating
the same meals over and over.
When hunting, even if your allies
give it their all, the first thing
that matters is food.
So I'll introduce you to a request
that gets you fresh, nutritious
ingredients. Go on, then.
50288.descriptionJp:
これ、そこのアンタ。
秘伝書を入手したハンターが
いつも同じ食事をしていたら
飽きちまうよ。
狩りの時、仲間が全力を出す
にしても、まず大事なのは
食事だね。
そこで、栄養満点の新鮮な
食材が入手できる依頼を紹介
するから、行ってきなよ。

21542.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21542.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21542.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21542.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

15014.description: This official hunting exam has 3 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! Hunt 2 Daimyo Hermitaur standing like fortresses on the sandy land!
15014.descriptionEn:
There are 3 Official Hunt Exams
this time! To reconfirm your
skill, you shall hunt every
monster we specify!
Hunt the two Daimyo Hermitaur
that tower like fortresses in
the sandy land, and do it
splendidly!
15014.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
３つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
砂の地にそびえる砦のごとき
２匹のダイミョウザザミを見
事、狩猟してみせるのじゃ！

21034.description: If you're hit by the dung Congalala throws, you won't be able to use healing items! If hunting Congalala is difficult, please trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
21034.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Congalala≫'s
dung and you can't use
healing items!
If hunting the ≪Congalala≫
is too hard, trade the
≪Khezu Whelp≫ from under
the ground to the Veggie
Elder and deliver it, please!
21034.descriptionJp:
≪ババコンガ≫の投げるフン
に当たると回復系のアイテム
が使えなくなりますよ！
≪ババコンガ≫の狩猟が困難
な場合は地中にいる≪フルフ
ルベビー≫を山菜ジイさんと
交換して、交換後のアイテム
を納品してくださいね！

21812.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

55047.objectiveJp: ハンターパス・黄１個の納品
55047.description: Hunters who believe that Frau is the most suitable legend Rasta to go in search of a new prayer jewel, please deliver a Hunter Pass (Yellow) through this request and cast your vote. As thanks for voting, we will give you materials such as the Steel Dragon Hardclaw.
55047.descriptionEn:
If you think ≪Frau≫ is the most
suitable Legend Rasta to go
searching for a new prayer orb,
please deliver a "Hunter Pass:
Yellow" through this request to
cast your vote.
As thanks for voting, we will
give you materials such as
"Kushala Daora Hardclaw".
55047.descriptionJp:
新たな祈珠を探しに行くレ
ジェンドラスタとして
【フラウ】が最も適してい
ると考えるハンターの方は、
こちらの依頼から「ハンター
パス・黄」を納品して投票を
お願いします。投票のお礼と
して、「鋼龍の剛爪」などの
素材をお渡しします。

61515.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61515.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61515.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

1079.description: Chameleos is an existence considered heretical even among elder dragons. Its very existence is rarely confirmed. Do not think of impossible things like capture; repel it repeatedly to wear down its health! Slay it in the end!
1079.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
Its very existence is rarely
confirmed at all.
Do not think of impossible things
like capture — repel it again and
again to wear down its strength!
Slay it after a long, drawn-out
fight!
1079.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在じゃ。
存在そのものすら滅多に確認
されることが無いほどじゃ。
捕獲など無理なことは考えず
撃退をくり返し体力を削る！
長ぎ末に討伐するのじゃ！

23605.description: A great disaster is about to befall that land once more. The surroundings are covered in pitch-black darkness, and no living thing can approach. It seems to have grown even more powerful than when it last appeared. Hunters with the strength to resist this calamity, head to the site at once.
23605.descriptionEn:
A great calamity is about to
befall that land once more.
The surroundings are covered in
pitch-black darkness, and no
living thing can approach.
It seems even more powerful than
when it appeared before.
Hunters with the power to resist
this disaster must head to the
site at once.
23605.descriptionJp:
彼の地に再び大いなる災いが
降りかかろうとしています。
周囲は漆黒の闇に覆われ、
いかなる生物も近づくことが
できなくなりました。
以前姿を現した時よりもさ
らに力を増しているようです。
この災禍に抗する力をもつ
ハンターは至急現場に
向かってください。

50897.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
50897.description: The Snowy Mountains have lately been hit by abnormal weather, and many reports have come in of a great shadow walking calmly through the blizzard. Could this blizzard be that monster's doing? We request a survey from all hunters.
50897.descriptionEn:
Lately the Snowy Mountains have
been struck by abnormal weather,
and we have received many
reports of a large shape walking
calmly through the raging
blizzard. Could this blizzard
truly be the work of that
monster? We ask all hunters to
investigate.
50897.descriptionJp:
このところ、異常気象に
見舞われていた雪山ですが、
猛吹雪の中を悠然と歩く
大きな影を見た、との
報告が多数入ってきています。
この吹雪の原因は、果たして
そのモンスターのしわざ
なのでしょうか？ハンターの
皆様に調査を依頼します。

22123.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
22123.description: Teostra has been confirmed rampaging in the swamp. It will be dangerous in various ways, but please investigate. The reward is precious decoration materials.
22123.descriptionEn:
Teostra has been confirmed to be
running wild in the Swamp.
It will be dangerous in many ways,
but please carry out a survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
22123.descriptionJp:
沼地でテオ・テスカトルが暴
れているのが確認されました。
何かと危険かとは思いますが、
調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54492.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の捕獲
54492.description: Do you have the skill to capture the Orugaron couple? If you complete the job, I will give you materials for two Tonfas! I look forward to the day I see you and your partner equipped with matching Tonfas!
54492.descriptionEn:
Do you have what it takes to
capture the Orugaron pair?
If you complete the request,
I'll give you materials for two
of the same Tonfa!
I look forward to the day I see
you and your partner both
wielding matching Tonfa —
craft them properly, all right?
54492.descriptionJp:
アナタ、オルガロン夫妻を
捕獲する実力はある？
もし依頼を達成できたなら、
同じ穿龍棍２本分の素材を
あげちゃうぞ！
ちゃんと生産して、アナタと
パートナーがお揃いの穿龍棍
を装備している姿が見れる日
を楽しみにしているわ！

62080.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐

21544.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21544.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21544.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21544.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54624.description: There is a report that a monster wrapped in a red aura has appeared in the arena. We do not know how many there are, but if this goes on the damage may spread. Please hunt it at once. When you succeed, we will give you armor long treasured by the guild.
54624.descriptionEn:
There are reports of monsters
wrapped in a red aura appearing
in the Arena.
We do not know how many there are,
but if this continues the damage may
spread.
Please slay them at once.
Upon success, we will give you
armor long kept in the Guild's
vaults.
54624.descriptionJp:
闘技場に赤いオーラを纏った
モンスターが現れたとの報告
がありました。何頭いるのか
分からない状況ですが、この
ままだと被害が拡大する恐れ
があります。至急討伐をお願
いします。討伐に成功した暁
には古くからギルドで蔵され
てきた防具を差し上げます。

55907.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
55907.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55907.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.
55907.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪外装解
放券≫を獲得できるクエスト
を用意させていただきまし
た。受注、参加時に、≪祭典
の熱気≫をお持ちください。

62717.description: In the final chapter of the Claire epic, Claire, daughter of the Bound King and the Revived Queen, meets two beast wyverns. Today I have prepared a situation as close to that as possible. Like Claire that day, it should be good experience in how to deal with monsters.
62717.descriptionEn:
In the final chapter of the Cléa
Epic, Cléa — daughter of the
Binding King and Revived Queen —
meets two Beast Wyverns.
Today I have prepared a
situation as close to that as
possible. It should be good
practice in handling monsters.
62717.descriptionJp:
クレア叙事詩の最終章では、
束縛王と復活妃の娘クレアが
２頭の獣竜種に出会うのじゃ。
今日は、限りなくそれに近い
状況を用意させてもらったよ。
その日のクレアと同じように、
モンスターとの接し方を知る
良い経験になることじゃろう。

53154.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
53154.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
53154.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
53154.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

60565.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Zenaserisu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60565.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is ≪Zenaserisu≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and claim
a splendid top rank!
Also, Origin Species weapons only
this time! Choose your weapon well!
60565.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ゼナセリス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

61229.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. We ask only first-rate hunters to investigate and, if possible, to slay its source. It is too dangerous for us to supply items. Prepare thoroughly!
61229.descriptionEn:
A sandstorm of tremendous scale
has been measured in the Desert.
We ask skilled hunters only to
survey it and, if possible, to
slay whatever is causing it.
It is far too dangerous, so no
items can be supplied.
Please prepare thoroughly!
61229.descriptionJp:
砂漠で、極めて大規模の
砂嵐が計測されました。
凄腕のハンター限定での
調査と、可能であれば
発生源の討伐をお願い
いたします。危険すぎるた
め、アイテム支給はできま
せん。万全の準備を！

56161.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟

54103.description: Have you ever wondered where on earth the stench a Congalala gives off is made? I thought I would look into it this time. I want you to do a little hunting for me. The reward will be generous. But you must break the claws and the head, without fail. If you fail, there is no reward.
54103.descriptionEn:
Have you ever wondered where
the awful stench of a Congalala
is actually produced?
I thought I'd look into it this
time. I want to ask you for a
hunt. The pay will be good.
However, you must break its
claws and head without fail.
If you fail, there's no reward.
54103.descriptionJp:
ババコンガの放つ悪臭は、
一体どこで作られているのか
気になったことはないか？
今回はその調査をしてみよう
と思ってな。ちょっと狩猟を
頼みたい。報酬は弾むよ。
ただし、爪と頭部の破壊は、
必ず達成してくれよ。失敗
したら、報酬の話はナシだ。

21953.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
21953.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Akura Jebia. I am counting on you!
21953.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a favor to ask — how
about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay an
Akura Jebia for me.
I'm counting on you!
21953.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってアクラ・ジェビア
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

61926.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟

21445.description: I am a flower seller. But I am usually not in the plaza. Where I sell is a secret. Ah, right. I have a request for you, hunter. I want you to gather lots of Iwahime Grass in the highlands. Give it to me and I will give you one seed that flew here from far away.
21445.descriptionEn:
I'm a flower seller, you know.
But I'm not usually in the plaza.
Where I sell is a secret.
Ah, that's right. I have a favor to
ask of you, hunter.
I want you to gather lots of
Iwahime Grass from the Highlands.
If you give them to me, I'll give
you one seed that flew here from
far away.
21445.descriptionJp:
わたしはねー花売りなのー。
でも、普段は広場にいません。
どこで売ってるか秘密なのー。
あ、そうだ。ハンターさんに
お願いがあるんだ―。
高地にあるイワヒメ草をたく
さん採ってきてほしいのー。
わたしにくれたら、遠くから
飛んできた種を１つあげるー。

26472.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26472.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Lavasioth is tough. Use a hunter's wisdom, prepare properly and take it on!
26472.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Volganos is a tough one.
Use a hunter's wisdom,
prepare well, and take
him on~!
26472.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
ヴォルガノスは手強いです。
ハンターさんの知恵を活かし
て、しっかり準備して挑んで
くださいね〜！

26267.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26267.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26267.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26267.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50266.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50266.description: Workers extracting ore in the highlands report encountering a Dyuragaua and fleeing for their lives with the work suspended. Hunters, head for the site at once and work to secure it.
50266.descriptionEn:
Workers mining ore in the Highlands
have reported encountering a
≪Duramboros≫, forcing them to halt
work and flee for their lives.
All hunters, please hurry to the
site and work to secure the area's
safety.
50266.descriptionJp:
高地で鉱石採取の作業を
行っている作業員から
≪デュラガウア≫と遭遇し、
作業を中断し命からがら逃げ
てきたと報告がありました。
ハンターの皆さんは、
急ぎ現地へ向かい安全の確保
に務めてください。

54568.description: Valsaburos has appeared in the decisive battlefield. It seems to favor the cactus that grows in this land, but its ecology is not yet understood. We have received reports that it is a very dangerous monster. Prepare thoroughly and head out to slay it.
54568.descriptionEn:
At the Battlefield,
≪Varusaburosu≫ has appeared.
It seems to favor the cactus that
grows in this land, but its ecology
is still unexplained.
We have received reports that it is
a highly dangerous monster.
Prepare carefully, then head out
to slay it.
54568.descriptionJp:
決戦場で
≪ヴァルサブロス≫が現れま
した。この地に生息する
サボテンを好物としているよ
うですが、その生態は未だ
解明されていません。
非常に危険なモンスターであ
ると報告を受けています。
念入りに準備をし、
討伐に向かってください。

21873.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
21873.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Dull Blue Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21873.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb that is
called the Blue Dull Orb?
That material is indispensable
to crafting a certain expensive
decoration.
If you will complete this request,
I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21873.descriptionJp:
青鈍原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

62451.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の捕獲
62451.description: All right, all right! Really, the potential of monsters is infinite. They say my favorite Berukyurosu is flying around the canyon field. Would you catch that one for me too? From the field.
62451.descriptionEn:
Mmh~ mmh~ good, good, good!
You know~ the possibilities of
monsters really are infinite.
In the field called Canyon, my
favorite Berukyurosu is flying
around, isn't it.
Could you go and catch that one
for me too~?
                    From Hata
62451.descriptionJp:
んぅ〜ん〜よ〜しよしよし！
本当にね〜モンスターの可能
性って無限大なんですよ。
峡谷というフィールドでボク
の好きなベルキュロスが飛び
回っているっていうじゃない
ですか。それも捕まえてきて
くれませんか〜？
                    畑より

63341.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
63341.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63341.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63341.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

61118.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
61118.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61118.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61118.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

60548.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
60548.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Guanzorumu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60548.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is ≪Guanzorumu≫!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and claim
a splendid top rank!
Also, Origin Species weapons only
this time! Choose your weapon well!
60548.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪グァンゾルム≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

61068.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

26669.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26669.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Plesioth Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26669.descriptionEn:
This time, the Hunting Skill quest
is to slay a
≪Plesioth Variant≫.
Why not sharpen your skills
against one another, hunters!
26669.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪ガノトトス変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

26507.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・１を１０個納品

61868.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

62119.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

63035.description: A monster that looks different from the usual, extremely powerful and acting in ways normally unthinkable, appears to have shown up. An examiner for hunters holding the Secret Scroll is staying here now, so prove your ability, and if you catch his eye, you can be sure to be issued many Secret Proof [Break].
63035.descriptionEn:
A monster with a different look,
very powerful and acting in ways
beyond all reason, seems to have
appeared.
Right now an examiner for Secret
Art holders is staying here, so
if you prove your skill and
meet his eye, you can be sure
he will issue you many
≪Secret Art Proof [Break]≫.
63035.descriptionJp:
見た目が異なり、非常に
強力で通常では考えられない
行動を取るモンスターが
現れたようです。
今、秘伝書所持ハンターの
判定員が滞在しているため、
実力を証明し、彼の眼に
かなえば、多くの
≪秘伝の証【破】≫を確実
に発行してもらえますよ。

60913.objectiveJp: 部位破壊保証書３０枚の納品
60913.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. This time the reward is a Fanged Beast Claw L! Bring the specified number of Part Break Certificates yourself.
60913.descriptionEn:
The Hunting Guild offers rewards
to hunters who break many
parts of Variants and Kishu.
This time: Fanged Beast Claw L!
Bring the required number of
Part Break Certificates alone.
60913.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
今回の報酬は牙獣種の爪L！
指定枚数の部位破壊保証書を
１人でお持ちください。

26195.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26195.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26195.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

12041.description: If you can hunt a Rathian, it means you're a hunter who can hunt well enough even in the Elder Hall. It's a famous saying among hunters, isn't it? But making the queen cry would be even more impressive. I wonder if she cries if she drinks a lot of water?
12041.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means a hunter who can
hunt even in the Great Hall.
A famous saying among
hunters, isn't it? But if
you could make the queen
cry, that'd be even better.
Would lots of water do it?
12041.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたら、
それは大老殿でも充分に狩猟
が果たせる狩人を意味する。
狩人たちの間でも有名な謳い
言葉よね？でも、もしも女王
を泣かせることができたら、
それはもっと凄いことね。水
を大量に飲めば泣くかしら？

55516.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55516.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55516.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

23249.description: It happened as I passed near the highlands, where they say surveys have not progressed. Suddenly a roar came that made the very air tremble. Everyone is frightened and refuses to go near the highlands, and I am at a loss. Hunt it a little and set our minds at ease.
23249.descriptionEn:
It happened when I passed near
the Highlands, where they say
survey work has stalled.
Suddenly a roar came that made
the very air around me tremble.
Everyone's terrified and refuses
to go near the Highlands, so
we're stuck. Do a little hunting
and put our minds at ease.
23249.descriptionJp:
調査が進んでいないと言われ
ている高地の付近を通った
時のことだ。突然あたりの
空気が震えるほどの咆哮が
聞こえて来てな。
みんな高地の近くを通るのは
嫌だとおびえちまって困って
るんだ。ちょいと狩猟して、
俺たちを安心させてくれよ。

54926.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Roaring Zinogre. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
54926.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it simply
comes right back.
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Howling Zinogre'.
I suppose we must slay it after all.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!
54926.descriptionJp:
追い払えどもヤツは、
再び舞い戻ってくる。
ギルドでは、光放つヤツを
「極み吼えるジンオウガ」
と呼ぶことにした。
やはり討伐するしかないか。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

55024.description: Please cooperate with the investigation of the Chameleos inhabiting the Forest and Hills! If you not only slay it but also break its horns and sever its tail, we will add to the reward. For the safety of Mezepolta too, lend us your strength in our research!
55024.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help surveying
the ≪Chameleos≫ that inhabits
Forest and Hills!
If you not only slay it but also
break its horns and sever its
tail, we'll add to your reward.
For Mezeporta's safety, please
lend us your strength!
55024.descriptionJp:
森丘に生息する≪霞龍≫の
調査にご協力をお願いします！
討伐するだけでなく≪霞龍≫
の角破壊と尻尾切断を達成し
てくれたら報酬を上乗せいた
します。メゼポルタの安全の
ためにも我々の研究に力を貸
してください！

62237.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62237.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. This may be a good chance to hunt a monster. Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! There is no time to wait for others, so please depart as 1 hunter.
62237.descriptionEn:
A specimen of a relatively
weak monster has been confirmed.
This may be a fine chance
to hunt a monster.
Before it flees far away,
please hurry and get ready!
There is no time to wait for others,
so please depart alone.
62237.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
これは、モンスターを狩猟す
るいい機会かもしれません。
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
人を待つ時間もないため、
１人での出発をお願いします。

22097.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22097.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22097.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

54135.description: I cannot resist rare things. Monster materials, ore, anything rare I want! This time I want you to slay a few Pokara to gather Pokara materials. Succeed and I will share a little of the rare materials I hold. Not a bad deal, is it?
54135.descriptionEn:
I just can't resist rare things.
Monster materials, ore, anything
rare — I want it all!
This time I want you to slay a few
Pokara to gather their materials.
If you pull it off,
I'll share a little of the rare
materials I have with you.
Not a bad deal, is it?
54135.descriptionJp:
俺は珍しい物に目がなくてな。
モンスターの素材や鉱石など、
珍しい物なら何でも欲しい！
今回はポカラの素材を集める
ために、数頭討伐を頼みたい。
成功させてくれたら、
俺の持っている珍しい素材を
少しだけお前に分けてやろう。
悪い話ではないだろう？

21935.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
21935.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 3.
So I've got a favor to ask — how
about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay a Gogomoa
for me.
I'm counting on you!
21935.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってゴゴモアを討伐し
てくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54179.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54179.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.
54179.descriptionJp:
お疲れ様でした。
クエストを達成し、
≪★６解放記念硬貨≫を
受け取ってください。
ハリセンネコへ持っていけば
良い品と交換してもらえ
ますよ。

55060.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Heavy Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55060.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪H Bowgun Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪H Bowgun Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪H Bowgun Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or higher,
so please keep that in mind.
55060.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｈボウガン勲・序≫５０個
≪Ｈボウガン勲・中≫６０個
≪Ｈボウガン勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

55385.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55385.description: The nostalgic Variety Soul quest is back again! This time the subject is the Water Fortress Wyvern. Clear it quickly and earn plenty of souls! Rare materials also seem a little easier to obtain than usual.
55385.descriptionEn:
Everyone's nostalgic Variety Soul
is back once again! This time
the task is slaying the Water
Fortress Wyvern ≪Gureadomosu≫.
Let's clear it briskly and rake
in lots of Souls! Rare materials
seem a bit easier to get too.
55385.descriptionJp:
皆さん懐かしのバラエティー
入魂が再び登場ですよ！今回
のお題は水砦竜の討伐です。
さくっと達成して、沢山の魂
を獲得しましょう！希少な素
材もいつもよりちょっぴり入
手しやすいようですよ。

21078.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21078.description: Velocidrome runs off to another area when its stamina runs low and recovers there. It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are lots of Velociprey minions, so be careful.
21078.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ runs off to
the next area when worn
down and heals up.
A good measure of a
hunter's skill, but this
season the Velociprey
are many. So be careful.
21078.descriptionJp:
≪ドスランポス≫は体力を
消耗すると別エリアへ逃げて
体力を回復してしまうわ。
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度いい相手だけど
この季節は、子分のランポス
も多いから注意してね。

53166.description: This is Miyashita! Still hot out! Stay properly hydrated. [Question 4] The only monster belonging to the fanged wyvern class is the Zinogre (subspecies included). If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53166.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here! It's still hot!
Let's drink water properly.
[Question 4]
The only monsters belonging
to the "Fanged Wyvern" class
are "Zinogre (including
subspecies)".
If you think the answer is O (A),
accept this quest
over here!
53166.descriptionJp:
宮下です！まだ暑い！
ちゃんと水分とりましょう。
【第４問】
「牙竜種」に属すモンスター
は、
「ジンオウガ（亜種含む）」
のみである。
答えが○（Ａ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

62477.objectiveJp: きれいな貝殻１０個の納品
62477.description: One request, a hunt. I love it. Not hunting beasts, but shell gathering! My dream is to spend my future buried in shells. Would you gather lots of shells for me? Of course the reward is generous.
62477.descriptionEn:
One hunt, if you please.
I absolutely love it.
Not just any hunt — shell gathering!
My dream is to spend my future
buried in shells.
Would you gather a whole lot of
shells for me?
Of course, the reward will be good.
62477.descriptionJp:
ひとつ、狩りをお願いする。
俺は大好きなんだ。
狩りは狩りでも潮干狩り！
将来は貝に埋もれて過ごすの
が夢なんだ。貝をいっぱいあ
つめてきてくれないか？
もちろん、報酬も弾むぜ？

26753.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

28059.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
28059.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28059.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!
28059.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意したぞ！
複数のモンスターの討伐を、
猟団の仲間と成し遂げるのだ！
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

50202.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
50202.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50202.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50202.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54436.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
54436.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.
54436.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆をさらに
深めるべく、難しい依頼を
用意させてもらった。
モンスターの討伐と部位破壊
を、猟団の仲間と行うのだ。
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。

55925.description: The Variant Species Taikun Zamuza has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55925.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Taikun Zamuza≫
has grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
As things stand it is extremely
dangerous. Please prepare fully
before heading out to survey it.
55925.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪タイクンザムザ≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

50625.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt an Espinas beautifully. Clear the quest and I will give you more rewards than usual!
50625.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Espinas≫ and
show me what you can do.
Clear the quest, and I'll give
you a bigger reward than
usual!
50625.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪棘竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
いつもより多目の報酬を
くれてやろう！

55606.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55606.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
55606.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

55645.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55645.description: An Anomalous Species Gasurabazura with greatly developed arms has appeared. Many hunters have abandoned the hunt in the face of its deadly poison. The guild will expand the supply items and, when 4 hunters set out together, provide further support. Head out with care.
55645.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Gasurabazura with
greatly developed arms has
appeared. Its deadly venom has
made many hunters give up on
slaying it.
The Guild is expanding supplies
and will give further support
only to parties of 4.
Please go to the survey with care.
55645.descriptionJp:
腕が大きく発達した辿異種の
ガスラバズラが現れました。
その猛毒に、多くのハンター
が討伐を断念しています。
ギルドでは支給品を拡充する
と共に、４名で出発した時に
限り更なる支援を行います。
気をつけて調査に向かってく
ださい。

53060.description: This is Miyashita! It is summer! Watch out for heat stroke! [Question 4] In Mezeporuta there is a saying that even Gogomoa falls from a tree. If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53060.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here! It's summer!
Watch out for heatstroke!
[Question 4]
In Mezeporta, the saying
"Even a Gogomoa falls from
a tree" has been passed down.
If you think the answer is X (B),
accept this quest
over here!
53060.descriptionJp:
宮下です！夏だね！
熱中症に気を付けようね！
【第４問】
メゼポルタには「ゴゴモアも
木から落ちる」という言葉が
伝わっている
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

22075.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
22075.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
22075.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50030.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
50030.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Taikun Zamuza of Shiojima. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50030.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Taikun Zamuza≫
on the Tidal Island.
Clear the quest splendidly, and
your standing as hunters will
shoot right up!
50030.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
潮島の≪多殻蟹≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
見事クエストクリアできたら
諸君のハンターとしての
評価はグイっと上がるぞ！

50190.description: Hunting and capturing are not everything! You agree that breaking parts is the true thrill of the hunt, do you not? Your quarry this time is a Leaping Scarlet Beast. Break the specified parts in style and show off your skill.
50190.descriptionEn:
Slaying and capturing aren't
everything! Part breaking is the
real thrill of hunting — you
agree, don't you? Your foe this
time is the ≪Leaping Crimson Beast≫.
Break the specified parts with
flair and show off your skill.
50190.descriptionJp:
討伐や捕獲が全てではない！
部位破壊こそが狩猟の醍醐味
だと君も思うだろ？
今回の相手は≪跳緋獣≫だ。
指定の部位を華麗に破壊して
君の腕前を見せつけてくれ。

26312.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26312.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26312.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

11501.description: It is I, the Instructor! Today I have come on a special trip from Jumbo Village! If you are still uneasy after finishing this quest, come to the village! In the village I have prepared many more basic quests!
11501.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Today I have come all the way
from Jumbo Village on business!
If you are still uneasy after
finishing this quest, come to the village!
In the village I have far more basic
quests prepared for you!
11501.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
今日は特別にジャンボ村から
出張に来ているのだ！
このクエストを終了しても
まだ不安なら、村へ来い！
村でなら、もっと多くの基本
クエストを用意しているぞ！

61608.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

55563.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55563.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55563.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Gunlance,
show me the skill you have honed
against the Tigrex in the Desert!
If you can hunt it splendidly,
you shall receive a reward far
beyond what your daily efforts
would ever bring you.
55563.descriptionJp:
銃槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

56124.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56124.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56124.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

55964.description: We have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket exclusive to the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55964.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a quest where you
can obtain a special
≪Outerwear Release Ticket≫.
Please bring ≪Festival Excitement≫
when accepting or joining.
55964.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の
≪外装解放券≫を獲得できる
クエストを用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫を
お持ちください。

54265.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54265.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54265.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

54134.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54134.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54134.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

12042.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon also called the Sickle Crab. If the Shield Crab is defense, the Sickle Crab is offense. Those sharp claws swung down with force will cut through almost anything. If the hunt fails, break the claws and withdraw.
12042.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon called the Scythe
Crab. Shield Crab defends;
Scythe Crab attacks. Those
claws slash through almost
anything. If hunting fails,
break the claws and leave.
12042.descriptionJp:
≪ショウグンギザミ≫は鎌蟹
とも呼ばれてる甲殻生物よ。
盾蟹が守りなら鎌蟹は攻め。
力強く振り下ろされる鋭い爪
は大抵のものを切り裂いてし
まうほどよ。狩猟がダメなら
ツメを破壊して戻りなさい。

28024.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟

55833.description: A Basarios with a greatly developed body has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Basarios known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55833.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gravios≫ with a greatly
developed body has appeared.
The Guild classifies this individual
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will conduct a survey.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Gravios so far.
Please take care during the survey.
55833.descriptionJp:
躰が大きく発達した≪鎧竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの鎧竜より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

54876.description: We ask for your help in the survey of the Zerureusu that inhabits the Tower! Not only slay it: if you break its head and wings, we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
54876.descriptionEn:
We request your aid in surveying
the Zerureusu that dwells in the Tower!
Not only slaying it, if you break
its head and wings we shall add
extra to your reward.
Please lend your strength
to our research!
54876.descriptionJp:
塔に生息する≪輝界竜≫の調
査にご協力をお願いします！
討伐するだけでなく
≪輝界竜≫の頭部と翼を
破壊してくれたら報酬を
上乗せいたします。
どうか我々の研究に力
を貸してください！

55302.description: A Rathalos with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Rathalos seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55302.descriptionEn:
A ≪Rathalos≫ with greatly
developed wings has appeared.
The Guild classifies this individual
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will conduct a survey.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Rathalos so far.
Please take care during the survey.
55302.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した≪火竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの火竜より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

55572.description: An Inagami with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Inagami known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55572.descriptionEn:
A ≪Elegant Sire Wyvern≫ whose
tail has grown greatly has
appeared. The Guild classifies
this individual as a Supremacy
with developed parts and will
survey it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any before.
Please survey it with care.
55572.descriptionJp:
尾が大きく発達した≪雅翁龍≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を部位
の発達した≪辿異種≫と位置
づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの雅翁龍より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

21010.description: The Congalala is a greedy fanged beast, and word is it has a special weakness for mushroom dishes! Of course its minions the Conga love mushrooms too! If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, it might come out.
21010.descriptionEn:
The ≪Congalala≫ is a stubborn,
greedy fanged beast, and I hear
it can't resist anything made of
mushrooms! Of course its minions
the Conga love mushrooms too!
If you carry plenty of specialty
mushrooms, it may show up.
21010.descriptionJp:
桃毛獣≪ババコンガ≫は食い
意地の張った牙獣で、特にキ
ノコ系の食べ物には目がない
って話です！もちろん子分の
コンガもキノコが大好き！
特産キノコを多めに持ってれ
ば出てくるかも知れません。

63175.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63175.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Fermi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
63175.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secret
art of forging equipment have been
found on monsters slain all over
the land, or so I hear!
Once you get the "Fermi Memo",
come alone, like a man! Bring it
to this workshop master!
I'll show you some good work!
63175.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪フェルミメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

21259.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21259.description: A powerful Velocidrome has appeared. The Guild will pay a large reward to the hunter who slays it! In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware!
21259.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Velocidrome≫
has appeared.
The Guild will pay a large
sum to the hunter who slays
it. Other rewards are
modest in return, so do
take note!
21259.descriptionJp:
≪ドスランポス≫の強力な
個体が現れました。
ギルドでは、これを討伐した
ハンターに、多額の報酬金を
支払うことになりました！
その代わり、その他の見返り
は控えめなので要注意です！

63011.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
63011.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63011.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
63011.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

54136.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54136.description: Good news for all you G Rank hunters! A training method to efficiently build up experience has been developed. You cannot accept it consecutively, but the effect of a single run is immense! May your daily training become great strength for you!
54136.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you G Rank
hunters!
A training method to efficiently
build up experience has been
developed.
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
immense!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!
54136.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の皆様に朗報です！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法が開発されました。
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

60133.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60133.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60133.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60133.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

60025.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

61777.description: This is a practice quest for the preliminaries of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is five minutes or less. Except for a few cases, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards.
61777.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
preliminaries of the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament. In the
real event the time limit is
five minutes or less. Except for
a few cases, the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained by
carving or from clear rewards.
61777.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選練習用
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が５分以内です。
一部を除き、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

62479.objectiveJp: 橙晶石の欠片４個の納品
62479.description: It seems you have gathered quite a lot. One step closer to my dream. A little more. I want you to stay with me just a little longer. Of course, when it is done I will give you wonderful treasure.
62479.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered quite a
lot. One step closer to my dream.
Just a little more.
I want you to keep me company
just a little longer.
Of course, once it's done I'll
give you splendid treasure.
62479.descriptionJp:
だいぶ集まってきたようだ。
俺の夢までもう一歩。
もう少し。
あともう少しだけ付き合って
欲しい。
もちろん、達成できた暁には
素晴らしいお宝をあげるよ。

55771.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
55771.description: Hey there, hunter. Do you like counterattacks? I love them. A monster fighting back sets my heart racing. This time I want to see an Orugaron's counterattack. Slay it within 20 minutes and I will pay a large bounty, so do your best.
55771.descriptionEn:
Hey there, hunter. Do you like
counterattacks?
I simply loooove them.
A beast burning for revenge just
thrills me. This time I want to see
an Orugaron's counterattack.
Slay it within twenty minutes
and I'll give you a hefty bonus,
so do your best, okay?
55771.descriptionJp:
ねぇ〜ハンターさん。逆襲は
お好きかしらぁ？
私はだぁいすきよぉ。
逆襲に燃える姿にそそられる
わぁ。今回は≪響狼≫の逆襲
する姿が見たいの。２０分以
内に討伐してくれたら、
多額の報奨金をあげるから
がんばってねぇ。

55290.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for one material, and break the specified part for one more!
55290.descriptionEn:
A chance to get a Supremacy
weapon prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal fixed damage to the target
for 1 material, and break the
specified part for one more
as a gift!
55290.descriptionJp:
ギルドで準備した辿異武器を
入手するチャンス！
参加条件はＧＲ２００！
ターゲットに一定ダメージを
与えることで素材を１個、
指定の部位を破壊することで
さらに１個プレゼント！

54853.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
54853.description: Do you have enough Ｇｚ? Complete this request and you can earn a great many Porta Cards (Sakura). However, note that it cannot be taken more than the set number of times.
54853.descriptionEn:
Are you short on ≪Gz≫?
Clear this request and you
will earn plenty of Porta
Card Sakura.
Note that it cannot be
accepted beyond the set
number of times.
54853.descriptionJp:
≪Ｇｚ≫は足りていますか？
この依頼をこなしていただく
とポルタカード桜を沢山獲得
できます。
ただし、規定回数を超えて
受注することはできません
ので、ご注意ください。

21423.objectiveJp: パルサント鉱石９９個の納品
21423.description: It began as a small seed, but tended with care it came to harvest, and in time it brought abundance as well. Yet this is not the end. A hunter who holds a Secret Arts Scroll will be able to encourage further prosperity.
21423.descriptionEn:
It began as a tiny seed, but by
tending it with care it came to
bear fruit, and in time it brought
forth abundance as well.
Yet this is not the end, not by
any means. If you are a hunter
who holds a Secret Art Tome,
you should be able to encourage
even greater prosperity.
21423.descriptionJp:
始まりは小さな種でしたが、
心を込めて育てることで
収穫に至り、やがてそれは
豊穣をも生み出しました。
しかし、まだまだ終わりでは
ありません。≪秘伝書≫を
お持ちのハンターさんならば、
さらなる繁栄を促すことが
できるでしょう。

61192.description: Apparently it is the custom of the Hunting Friends Festival for men and women each to overcome a trial befitting them. This one is for female hunters, so male hunters should take the other quest.
61192.descriptionEn:
First, it seems the custom of the
Hunting Buddy Festival is for men and
women each to clear their own trial.
This one is for female hunters, so
male hunters should take the other
quest, alright?
61192.descriptionJp:
まずは男女それぞれで
それなりの試練を突破するのが
猟友祭の習わしらしいんだ。
こっちは女性ハンター用だから
男性ハンターはもう１つの
クエストを受けておくれよ。

21128.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ２匹の狩猟
21128.description: The Shogun Ceanataur is a creature that uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling. If the hunt proves difficult, hunting the Gabras that flit about the crater this season and then heading home is not a bad idea either.
21128.descriptionEn:
The Sickle Crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
is a creature that uses its strange
leg joints to climb all the way to
the ceiling.
If hunting it proves difficult,
slaying the ≪Gabras≫ that flit
around the Volcano crater this
season and heading home is not a
bad option either.
21128.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登る生き物よ。
狩猟が困難な場合、この季節
火山の火口を飛び回る≪ガ
ブラス≫を上手く討伐して、
帰還するのも悪くないわ。

62471.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62471.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
62471.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

60125.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟

61778.description: This is a practice quest for the preliminaries of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is five minutes or less. Except for a few cases, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards.
61778.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
preliminaries of the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament. In the
real event the time limit is
five minutes or less. Except for
a few cases, the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained by
carving or from clear rewards.
61778.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選練習用
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が５分以内です。
一部を除き、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

23472.description: A White Shadow with a greatly developed head has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the White Shadow known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23472.descriptionEn:
A Khezu with a greatly developed
head has appeared.
The Guild classifies this specimen
as a Supremacy species with an
enlarged part, and will survey it.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Khezu so far.
Please conduct the survey with
care.
23472.descriptionJp:
頭が大きく発達した≪白影≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの白影より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

21776.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21776.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21776.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

54420.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

54348.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54348.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54348.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

62176.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival. But you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. One person only, and nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
62176.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival.
But you just have to have a
memory of the festivities!
Yes, you there! Why not take
this quest? Mind you, the terms
are strict, so I do not recommend
it to the winning side.
One person only, and if you fail
the goods are not returned, so
be careful!
62176.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で負けてしまった。
でも、どうしても祭典の思い
出が欲しい！と思っている
そこのアナタ！このクエスト
を受注してみないか？ただし、
条件が厳しいから、勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。
１人限定で、失敗してもブツ
は返さないから慎重にな！

62214.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62214.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
62214.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62392.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62392.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a one-handed weapon that can guard with a shield. Take the armor and sword and shield set prepared for you and hunt the Roaring Wolf Nono Orugaron somewhere in the Swamp! Make good use of the weapon's strengths!
62392.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
you shall hunt with a one-handed
weapon that can guard with a shield.
With the armor and Sword and Shield
set prepared for you, go hunt the
Orugaron known as Non Orugaron
somewhere in the Swamp! Make good
use of the weapon's strengths!
62392.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
盾でガードできる片手武器で
の狩猟をしてもらおう。
予め用意された防具と片手剣
一式で沼地のどこかにいる
響狼≪ノノ・オルガロン≫を
狩猟してきたまえ！武器の
利点を活用するんだぞ！

55854.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55854.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55854.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

51009.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51009.description: Hunter who would master the heavy bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
51009.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.
51009.descriptionJp:
重弩を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50908.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
50908.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Toa Tesukatora. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50908.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are seeking
someone to dispose of an extremely
powerful Toa Tesukatora specimen.
If you slay it splendidly, we shall
issue you more slaying certificates
than usual!
50908.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪トア・テスカトラ≫の個
体を退治してくださる方を
募集しております。見事に
討伐できましたら、普段よ
りも多めに討伐の証を発行
いたしましょう！

62432.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の討伐
62432.description: What, you just want a hard Hammer? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62432.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Hammer
that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!
62432.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅いハンマー
が欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

62142.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62142.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62142.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62142.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

26620.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26620.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26620.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

50216.description: The Guku clothes I ordered for the Guku Gallery have not arrived on time. Could you go and check on things nearby for me? If you help, I will give you my secret Guku collection.
50216.descriptionEn:
I ordered a Gook outfit for
the Gook Gallery opening,
but it still hasn't arrived.
Could you go and check on
things nearby for me?
If you help me out, I'll
give you a piece of my
treasured Gook collection.
50216.descriptionJp:
グークギャラリーを開こうと
思って発注したグーク服が
時間になっても届かないんだ。
ちょっと代わりに近くの
様子を見てきてくれないか？
手伝ってくれるなら、秘蔵の
グークコレクションを
プレゼントするよ。

26605.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
26605.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Garum Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26605.descriptionEn:
Those notes on the lost secret
art of forging gear have been
found on monsters slain all
over the place, or so I hear!
Once you get a ≪Garm Memo≫,
man to man, bring it to this
workshop head right here!
I'll show you fine work!
26605.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ガルムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50565.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の捕獲

61720.description: Hey hey! I was invited by a Guild person to come to Mezeporta plaza, but monsters are in the way and I cannot get through! You skilled hunter there, do something! I will give you my treasure as thanks.
61720.descriptionEn:
Hey, hey!
A Guild fellow invited me to come
to Mezeporta Square, but a monster
is in the way and I can't get through!
You skilled hunter over there,
do something about it!
I'll give you my treasure as
a thank-you, so come on!
61720.descriptionJp:
ちょっとちょっと！
ギルドの人からメゼポルタ広
場へ来るようにって招待され
たんだけど、モンスターが邪
魔で通れないんですけどぉ！
そこの腕利きのハンターさん、
なんとかしなさいっ！
お礼にあたしの宝物をあげる
からさ。

50112.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
50112.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50112.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.
50112.descriptionJp:
おい！とっておきの依頼が舞
い込んで来たぞ！受注できる
回数に限りはあるが、なんと
覇種の素材を分けてもらえる
らしい。しかも撃退だけでい
いらしいから、討伐できな
いってヤツにもオススメだな。
ただ、そうは言っても覇種は
覇種だ。絶対に油断するなよ。

62681.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62681.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62681.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
