but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!
62681.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法が開発されました。
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛錬がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

62178.description: I've developed a new hammer, but the structure has become a bit complicated, so would you test its strength for me? I've chosen armor to match the weapon, so no worries! Full of skills, and it looks good too! Wear it without hesitation!
62178.descriptionEn:
I developed a new Hammer, but
the structure came out a bit
complex, so would you go test
its strength for me? I picked
armor to match the weapon, so
no worries!
Full of skills and good looking!
Wear it without holding back!
62178.descriptionJp:
新しいハンマーを開発したん
だが、ちょっと構造が複雑に
なっちまったんで、強度を試
して来てくれねえか？武器に
合わせて防具もチョイスして
あるから心配いらねえ！
スキル満載、見た目も良し！
遠慮せず着て行け！

50397.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

53026.description: We are recruiting hunters to procure food for the Guild's cherry blossom viewing. Procure the Golden Potato Sake for the toast, and if you have time, fresh Hoppy Sake and well-done meat too.
53026.descriptionEn:
We are seeking hunters to procure
ingredients to be served at the
Guild-sponsored flower viewing.
Besides providing the Golden Yam Sake
for the toast that day, if you have
spare room, we also ask for fresh
Hopi Wine and well-done steak.
53026.descriptionJp:
ギルド主催のお花見にてふる
まう食材を調達してくださる
ハンターを募集しています。
当日の乾杯で使う黄金芋酒を
調達していただく他、もし余
裕がありましたら、新鮮なホ
ピ酒や、こんがり肉の調達も
お願いします。

50341.description: We have received reports from the researchers surveying the sea of trees that they are too afraid of Espinas to proceed! Please hunt it at once! However, Espinas itself is very interesting, so they said they would like you to break its horns too if possible! That is all!!
50341.descriptionEn:
Researchers surveying the Great Forest
report that they are too afraid of the
Espinas to make any progress!
Please go and hunt it at once!
However, the Espinas itself is very
interesting, so they also want you
to break its horns if you can!
That is all!!
50341.descriptionJp:
樹海の調査をしている研究員
達から、≪エスピナス≫が怖
くて調査が進まないと報告が
きております！
至急狩猟してきてください！
ただ、≪エスピナス≫自体も
大変興味深い為、角の破壊も
できれば行ってきて欲しいと
の事でした！以上！！

55651.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (chest), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
55651.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(chest piece), excluding
weapon ribbons and weapon
merits. The yield is one
type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass Sakura≫
is required, so please take note.
55651.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（胴防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

62966.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
62966.description: Can the shell covering a Monoblos' body withstand simultaneous attacks from many directions? Since one can only set out on a Monoblos quest alone, this is the only way to know the answer. You, hunter, will play the part of the Monoblos!
62966.descriptionEn:
Can the shell covering a Monoblos'
body withstand simultaneous attacks
from many directions?
Since Monoblos quests can only be
departed on alone, this is the only
way to learn the answer.
You, hunter, will play the part of
the Monoblos!
62966.descriptionJp:
モノブロスの体を覆う甲殻は、
多方向からの同時の攻撃に
耐えうるのか？
モノブロスのクエストには
１人でしか出発できない以上、
正解を知る方法はこれしか
ありません。ハンターさんが
モノブロスを演じるんです！

40205.description: A surveyor reported sighting a gigantic creature. When it charged and nearly trampled him, he was saved by a person called the Unwavering Seeker, who wears battered training garb. He apparently trains here often, so why not test your own skill as well?
40205.descriptionEn:
A surveyor reported sighting a
gigantic creature.
When it charged and nearly crushed
him, he was saved by a person in
tattered training garb called the
'Relentless Seeker.'
He apparently trains here often,
so why not test your own skill
against him?
40205.descriptionJp:
調査員から、巨大な生物を目
撃したと報告がありました。
突進され、危うく踏みつぶさ
れそうになった時、ボロボロ
の道着を着た「不断の探究者」
と呼ばれる人に助けられたそ
うです。
彼はここで度々修行している
そうなので、あなたも腕試し
をしてはいかが？

21174.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの狩猟
21174.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21174.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or hunt a sub-target
21174.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21174.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

50458.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

18.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
18.description: It is I, the Instructor! The battle with the Velocidrome begins! Make full use of the items supplied and hunt with all your strength! Once you are used to slaying, practice capturing too. Knowing capture widens your range of hunts!
18.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Your fight with ≪Velocidrome≫
begins! Use your supply
items and hunt at full power!
Once you're used to slaying,
practice ≪Capture≫ too. It
broadens your hunting range!
18.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
≪ドスランポス≫との戦いが
始まるぞ！支給したアイテム
を駆使し、全力で狩猟せよ！
討伐に慣れたら、≪捕獲≫の
練習もしておくのだ。捕獲を
知れば狩りの幅が広がるぞ！

62417.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62417.description: Gazing at the blue sky, I find I have come to a place with a fine view. The place beyond reach is the sky, so then, is there a hunter who can break the back of a Barbarian Wyvern? If you break it splendidly, I will give you the materials of the armor I wear.
62417.descriptionEn:
Gazing at the blue sky, I've come
to quite a fine vantage point.
They say the sky is out of reach,
but then, is there a hunter who
can break a Taikun Zamuza's back?
If you break it splendidly, I'll
give you the materials for the
armor I'm wearing.
62417.descriptionJp:
青い空を眺めてたら、随分と
見晴らしのいい場所に来たな。
手の届かない場所といえば
空だが、では、蛮竜の背中を
壊すことができるハンターは
いるかな？
見事に壊して見せたら、俺が
着ている防具の素材をくれて
やろう。

60621.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60621.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60621.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60621.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26355.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26355.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26355.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

21770.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
21770.description: To the hunters of Dundorma, information about the proud lone wolf, the black wolf bird Yian Garuga. In my estimation, it will come at you with resolve to die this time. Slaying it is the only way to answer that resolve.
21770.descriptionEn:
To the hunters of Dundorma,
here is information on the proud
lone wolf, the Black Wolf Bird
≪Yian Garuga≫. My guess is
that in this hunt he will come
at us ready to die.
Slaying him is the only way to
answer that resolve, I say.
21770.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマの狩人たちへ、誇
り高き一匹狼、黒狼鳥≪イャ
ンガルルガ≫に関する情報だ。
オレの予想では、今回の狩り
では、奴は恐らく決死の覚悟
で向かってくる。
討伐こそが、奴の覚悟に報い
る唯一の手段だろうな。

50990.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50990.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed to FX-upgrade Secret Art
Armor (Gunner), excluding Weapon
Souls.
The yield covers five pieces.
Please note that accepting the
quest requires a 10th Anniversary
Ticket.
50990.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（ガンナー）の
FX強化時に必要な武器魂を
除く素材を排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪10周年チケット≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

50919.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
50919.description: Here is a request that yields the materials needed to craft and upgrade 1 piece of the Toa Series, Hardcore Armor of Toa Tesukatora. It is a generous quest, so please give it a try!
50919.descriptionEn:
I present a request that
nets you the materials to
craft and upgrade one piece
of the Frozen King Dragon's
≪Hardcore Armor≫, the
"Toa Series." It's a great
deal, so do take the challenge!
50919.descriptionJp:
凍王龍の≪剛種防具≫
「トアシリーズ」１部位分の
生産強化に必要な素材を
入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。オトクなクエスト
ですのでぜひチャレンジして
ください！

21192.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21192.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21192.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

50660.description: This is a quest for the HR Trial used to rise to HR 100. Do not forget to accept the trial from the Price/HR Trial Board. It is a quest to slay one Rathian by yourself, so please set out after preparing yourself sufficiently.
50660.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the HR Trial
used to rise to HR 100.
Do not forget to accept the
trial from the Price/HR
Trial Board.
It is a quest to slay one Rathian
by yourself, so please set out
after preparing yourself
sufficiently.
50660.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００に上がるための
ＨＲ試練用のクエストとなり
ます。≪価格・ＨＲ試練情
報板≫より、試練を受注する
のを忘れずにお願いします。
リオレイア１頭を１人で討伐
するクエストとなりますので、
十分な用意をした後、出発し
てください。

63301.objectiveJp: よく磨かれた鏡石１個の納品

26575.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26575.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26575.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26575.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

62560.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62560.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62560.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62560.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

22050.description: The Sea of Trees is a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22050.descriptionEn:
The ≪Sea of Trees≫ is a
land still under Guild
survey, but hunters too
might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22050.descriptionJp:
≪樹海≫は、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

61816.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
61816.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 5 minutes. With some exceptions, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
61816.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 5 minutes.
With some exceptions, the target
monster's materials cannot be
obtained by carving or from the
clear reward.
61816.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選用
クエストです。
制限時間は５分以内です。
一部を除き、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

60678.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Giaorugu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60678.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is the Giaorugu!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest, so
try to place among the top!
This time it is held with
Supremacy weapons only!
60678.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ギアオルグ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

40233.description: The Black Caster appears to have built a golem modelled on a dragon and is testing it. Its power is immense, and at this rate even uninvolved people may come to harm. Join with the Black Saber, who agreed to cooperate, and stop the damage!
40233.descriptionEn:
It seems the Black Caster has built
a dragon-shaped golem and is
testing it.
Its power is immense, and at this
rate harm may reach innocent
bystanders.
Together with the Black Saber, who
has agreed to help, stop the damage
from spreading!
40233.descriptionJp:
黒のキャスターが竜を模した
ゴーレムを作り、テストを
行っている様です。
その力は強大で、
このままでは無関係な人間
にも被害が及び兼ねません。
協力に同意してくれた
黒のセイバーと共に被害を
食い止めてください！

23660.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
23660.description: The Variant Species Doragyurosu has appeared once more. Its developed horns seem able to command a more powerful dark thunder. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23660.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Doragyurosu≫
has appeared once more.
Its developed horns seem able
to command a more powerful
dark thunder than before.
Please take great care in
your survey.
23660.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドラギュロス≫
が再び現れました。
発達した角は、より強力な
冥雷を操れるようになって
いる様です。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

50023.description: For hunters who carelessly obtained a Haku Interception Contribution Certificate Green from the Harisen Neko. In this request we exchange the certificate for the following materials. Doragyurosu scorched scale x40, Gold and Silver Fish Wyvern torn shell x40, Teostra scorched wing x40.
50023.descriptionEn:
For hunters who happened to
get a ≪Supremacy Green
Certificate≫ from Harisen
Neko. This request trades
it for the materials below.
≪Doragyurosu Charred Scale≫ x40
≪Arganos Riot Shell≫ x40
≪Teostra Burning Wing≫ x40
50023.descriptionJp:
≪覇種迎撃貢献証緑≫を
ハリセンネコからうっかり
入手したハンターさん。
この依頼で貢献証と引換えに
下記の素材と交換いたします。
≪冥雷竜の焦鱗≫４０個
≪金銀魚竜の乱殻≫４０個
≪炎王龍の灼翼≫４０個

50737.description: I found a Flame Horn Wyvern in the decisive battlefield. But it seems it is no ordinary Flame Horn Wyvern. From what I hear, it is a highly renowned Flame Horn Wyvern. Word is you get a huge amount of rewards when you slay it! Look, it will be gone soon! Hurry!
50737.descriptionEn:
I found a Varusaburosu in the
Battlefield, you see. But it seems
it's no ordinary Varusaburosu.
Word has it this one is a highly
renowned Varusaburosu. Slaying it
brings a simply huge reward,
or so the rumor goes!
Look, it'll be gone soon!
Get going!
50737.descriptionJp:
決戦場で炎角竜を見つけたん
だけどね。それがただの炎角
竜じゃないようなのよ。
聞くところによると、誉れ高
い炎角竜らしくて。討伐時に
は、そりゃあ大量の報酬がも
らえるって噂よぉ！ほら、も
ういなくなっちゃうから！
早くおいき！

53057.description: It is Miyashita! The fun weekend is finally here! [Question 3] In the Supremacy Continuous Interception Battle, the one with the lowest slay rate was UNKNOWN. If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53057.descriptionEn:
It's Miyashita!
The fun weekend is finally here!
[Question 3]
In the 'Zenith Continuous Interception
Battle,' the one with the lowest
slay success rate is UNKNOWN.
Hunters who think the answer is
True (A), accept this quest
right here!
53057.descriptionJp:
宮下だよ！
いよいよ楽しい週末だね！
【第３問】
「覇種連続迎撃戦」で
最も討伐成功率が低かった
のは≪ＵＮＫＮＯＷＮ≫
である
答えが○（Ａ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

26664.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26664.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Rajang Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26664.descriptionEn:
This hunting skill quest is for
slaying a Rajang Variant.
Why not sharpen your skills
together with fellow hunters!
26664.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪ラージャン変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

63002.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟

61148.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

50396.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55696.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Inagami. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55696.descriptionEn:
This quest allows you to obtain
the materials of the Supremacy
Inagami.
Accepting the quest requires a
Superior Ticket.
Please be aware that if you
should fail the quest, the
Superior Ticket will be
consumed.
55696.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪イナガミ≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

26689.objectiveJp: 銀火竜の尻尾１個の納品
26689.description: To set foot in the closed secret region, a qualification is required. That qualification is none other than the Secret Area Set. He who opens the gates of heaven and takes that qualification in hand will surely find fortune deep within the closed secret region...
26689.descriptionEn:
To set foot in the closed hidden
area, one needs a qualification.
That qualification is none other
than the ≪Secret Area Set≫.
Those who open the gates of
heaven and gain that right shall
find fortune deep in the closed
hidden area...
26689.descriptionJp:
閉ざされた秘境に足を踏み入
れるには、資格が必要となる。
その資格とは≪秘境セット≫
に他ならない。
天国の門を開き、その資格を
手にした者は、閉ざされた
秘境の奥に、幸いを見つける
ことだろう･･･。

55314.description: An Anomalous Species Rathalos with greatly developed wings has appeared. Its attacks, peculiar to the Anomalous Species, have defeated many hunters. In response the guild will provide strong support for the hunt. Head out with care.
55314.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Rathalos with greatly
developed wings has appeared.
Its Supremacy-specific attacks have
caused many hunters to fail.
In response, the Guild will provide
strong slaying support.
Please proceed to the survey with
caution.
55314.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した辿異種
リオレウスが現れました。
辿異種特有の攻撃で数多の
ハンターが討伐に失敗してい
ます。この事態にギルドは
対策として、強固な討伐支援
を行います。気を付けて調査
に向かってください。

62679.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

21758.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Daimyo Hermitaur will be judged by our Guild, so please concentrate on completing the main target!
21758.descriptionEn:
At the Elder Hall Guild's
request, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
We will judge the 'fixed
damage' dealt to
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ here, so
everyone please focus on
clearing the main target!
21758.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫への
『一定ダメージ』は、当ギル
ドで判断しますので、皆さん
はメインターゲットの達成に
専念してくださいね！

60056.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21177.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの達成
21177.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21177.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or complete the sub-target
21177.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21177.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

26716.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
26716.description: What, you just want a hard Long Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26716.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Long Sword
that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!
26716.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬い太刀が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

28079.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28079.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
28079.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

26115.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared! You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best!
26115.descriptionEn:
Beyond these lands, in the mysterious
untouched ≪Ancient Tower≫, the
Phantom Beast ≪Kirin≫ appears
to have shown itself! You cannot
reach the Ancient Tower anytime —
only while the weather and climate
are stable. Do your best!
26115.descriptionJp:
この地の彼方に眠る、謎多き
未開の地≪古塔≫に、幻獣
≪キリン≫が現れたようです！
古塔へはいつでも行けるわけ
じゃなく、天候や気候を始め
とする環境が安定してる期間
だけです。頑張って下さい！

55675.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
55675.description: So you mean to take on a job from a Dark Cat Pack executive? An executive's job is a cut above the rest. Slack off and you will be crying. Complete it and I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Seal, Blue.
55675.descriptionEn:
You feel like taking on a request
from a Dark Cat Gang exec, nya?
An exec's request is a cut or
two above the rest, nya.
Slack off and you'll be crying, nya.
Clear it and I might even give
you a ≪Dark Cat Gang Seal: Blue≫,
nya.
55675.descriptionJp:
この闇猫団幹部からの依頼に
挑戦する気かニャ？
幹部の出す依頼はひと味も
ふた味も違うニャ。
油断して泣きをみるニャよ。
依頼を達成した暁には、
≪闇猫団シール・青≫を
くれてやってもいいニャ。

62637.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
62637.description: I cannot forget the memory of wearing fluffy clothes and throwing snowballs for fun. Will you not try it too? If you are short of tools, gathering them on site is important too. If it goes well, I will give you a pattern for a Gook.
62637.descriptionEn:
I can't forget the memory of wearing
fluffy clothes and throwing snowballs
for fun.
Won't you give it a try too?
If you're short on tools, gathering
them on site is important as well.
If it goes well, I'll give you a
paper pattern for a Gook outfit.
62637.descriptionJp:
モフモフした服を着て、
雪のかたまりを投げて遊んだ
思い出が忘れられないの。
君たちも挑戦してみない？
道具が足りなかったら、
現地調達するのも大切だよ。
上手くいったら、グーク用の
型紙をプレゼントするよ。

55732.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の捕獲
55732.description: Please become my favorite Brachydios and go punch each other with a Brachydios. Please do not slay it, it would be sad. I will give you my treasure as a thank you.
55732.descriptionEn:
Please pretend to be my favorite
Brachydios and go have a punch-for-punch
match with a Brachydios.
It'd be too sad, so please don't
slay it.
As a reward,
I'll give you my treasure.
55732.descriptionJp:
ぼくのだいすきな
ぶらきでぃおすになりきって、
ぶらきでぃおすとぱんちのし
あいっこをしてきてください。
かわいそうなので、
とうばつはしないでください。
おれいに、
ぼくのたからものをあげます。

22106.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22106.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22106.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

62361.description: My wife says to me: you are always dreaming, do you never tire of it? Indeed I do not! By looking ever forward, work that was once finished can advance one more step! That joy is what keeps me alive!
62361.descriptionEn:
My wife keeps telling me,
'Always chasing dreams like that,
how do you never get bored?'
That's right, I never do!
By keeping your eyes forward, work
you once thought finished can take
one more step ahead!
That joy is what keeps me alive!
62361.descriptionJp:
嫁さんが言いやがるんだよ。
いつも夢ばっかり見ていて、
よく飽きないねえ、だとさ。
そうとも、飽きねぇとも！
前を見続けることで、一度は
完成した仕事が、さらに一歩
前進することだってある！
その喜びが生きる糧なのさ！

50451.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55019.description: You found this job well! I am a genius! I have developed a new weapon not found in Mezeporuta. If you want to know the secret, complete as many hidden jobs as you can. However, you must always complete at least the main target. I wish you success!
55019.descriptionEn:
You found this request — well done!
I am a genius! I've developed
a new weapon that Mezeporta
never had. If you wish to know
this secret, complete as many
hidden requests as you can.
However, at the very least you
must complete the main target.
I wish you good fortune!
55019.descriptionJp:
よくぞこの依頼を見つけた！
ワシは天才じゃ！メゼポルタ
には無かった新しい武器を開
発したぞい。この秘密を知り
たくば、隠された依頼をでき
るだけ多く達成することじゃ。
ただし、最低でも必ずメイン
ターゲットは達成しなければ
ならぬぞ。健闘を祈る！

23664.description: I have received a report that the Lightning Extreme Dragon will soon appear at the interception base. Go at once to hunt Revidiora. Do not forget to report to that one once you complete the quest.
23664.descriptionEn:
I have received a report that
a Thunder Extreme Dragon will soon
appear at the Base.
Go at once to slay Rebidiora.

When you have cleared the quest,
do not forget to report to
that fellow.
23664.descriptionJp:
間もなく迎撃拠点に
雷極龍が現れるという
報告を受けたぞい。
早速レビディオラを討伐
に向かってくるのじゃ。

クエストを達成したら
あやつに報告を
忘れんようにの。

62381.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62381.description: The season of beautiful moons has come. Do you know the branch of the Yugen Tree? It is said to harbor mysterious power when bathed in moonlight. I want to go and fetch that branch. If you hunt the monsters in the way, I will share the branch with you.
62381.descriptionEn:
The season of the beautiful moon is here.
Do you know the branch of the
Profound Tree?
They say it holds mysterious power
when bathed in moonlight.
I want to go and get that branch.
Hunt the monsters in the way, and
I'll share a branch with you.
62381.descriptionJp:
月が綺麗な季節になったな。
幽玄樹の枝を知っているか？
月光を浴びると不思議な力が
宿るという。
この枝を取りに行きたい。
邪魔なモンスターを狩猟して
くれたら君にも枝を分けて
あげよう。

21013.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21013.description: Rathian is said to have a subspecies! The queen clad in sakura pink is a troublesome queen with a fiercer temper than the original! Whether to slay or capture, it's important to judge the monster's state and your own situation!
21013.descriptionEn:
≪Rathian≫ apparently has a
Subspecies, you know! This
queen wrapped in cherry
pink is a real handful,
wilder than the original!
Slay or capture, it's key
to judge both sides well!
21013.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫には亜種が
いるらしいですよ！桜色に身
を包んだ女王は、原種よりも
気性の荒い困った女王様だっ
て！討伐するか捕獲するか、
相手の状態と自分の状況を
見極めることが大事ですよ！

26416.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26416.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26416.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

62610.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62610.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62610.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62610.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

55016.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
55016.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
55016.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

55421.objectiveJp: ギルド黒晶紋章１０個の納品
55421.description: By completing this request, you can obtain the layered armor release tickets for the Azure D Series, the layered armor of the Azure G Series. Azure Release Ticket D x5.
55421.descriptionEn:
By completing this request, you can
obtain the layered armor unlock ticket
for the ≪Azure D Series≫, the layered
version of the ≪Azure G Series≫.
-Azure Unlock Ticket D x5
Do not miss this chance.
55421.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成することで、
≪アスールＧシリーズ≫の
外装である≪アスールＤ
シリーズ≫の外装解放券を
入手することができます。
・アスール解放券Ｄ５枚

63057.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Purple Yian Kut-Ku in the arena. Clear the quest without mishap and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
63057.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Hunt the Purple Yian Kut-Ku in
the Arena. If you clear the quest
safely, your standing as hunters
will shoot right up!
63057.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
闘技場の≪紫怪鳥≫を狩猟
してみせろ。無事、クエス
トをクリアできたら、諸君
のハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

56076.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for five materials, and break the specified part for five more!
56076.descriptionEn:
A chance to obtain Supremacy
weapons prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal a set amount of damage to
the target for 5 materials, and
break the specified parts for
5 more of each!
56076.descriptionJp:
ギルドで準備した辿異武器を
入手するチャンス！
参加条件はＧＲ２００！
ターゲットに一定ダメージを
与えることで素材を５個、
指定の部位を破壊することで
さらに５個ずつプレゼント！

21619.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Light Green Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21619.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb known as
the Yellow-Green Origin Orb?
Its material is essential to the
production of a certain expensive
decoration.
If you can complete this request,
I shall give you precious decoration
materials.
21619.descriptionJp:
萌黄原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

21363.objectiveJp:
メインターゲット、もしくは
サブターゲットＡの狩猟
21363.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Desert, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Fallen Tree or the Voice of Nature: Snowstorm. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21363.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target
or sub-target A
21363.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. This request is set
in the ≪Desert≫, and by
clearing it you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Fallen Tree≫
or ≪Voice of Nature: Blizzard≫.
I pray your hunting life grows
ever more fulfilling.
21363.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪砂漠≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・倒木≫や
≪大自然の声・吹雪≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

54281.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Basarios beautifully. Clear the quest and I will give you more rewards than usual!
54281.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Go and hunt ≪Basarios≫
for all to see.
Clear the quest and I'll
give you rewards more
generous than usual!
54281.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪岩竜≫を狩猟してみ
せろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
いつもより多目の報酬を
くれてやろう！

50025.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト４匹の納品

62576.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62576.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62576.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.
62576.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。思い出よりも追憶が
大切なかた、祭典の証をご用
意の上、ぜひご参加ください。
出発後は、祭典の証の返却が
できませんので、ご注意を。

62737.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
62737.description: If I told you Hardcore weapons could be made even stronger, would you believe me? Word is the material comes from a Teostra, but this one seems unlike the usual sort, and a nasty piece of work besides. Wave it off as an old man's rambling if you like, but if you are curious, go and see.
62737.descriptionEn:
If I told you a Hardcore weapon could
be made even stronger, would you
believe me?
Word is the material for it comes
from a Teostra, but it seems this
one is not the usual sort,
and quite a handful.
Well, you may laugh it off as an
old man's rambling, but if you're
interested, go and see for yourself.
62737.descriptionJp:
剛種武器を更に強くできると
言ったらお前は信じるかな？
なんでもその素材が、
炎王龍から取れるという話
じゃが、どうもいつもの
ヤツとは違うらしくての、
かなり厄介という話じゃ。
まあ、爺の戯言と聞き流して
もかまわんが、興味がある
なら行ってみなされ。

62799.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62799.description: We have prepared a request that issues the tickets needed for Gou quests. A comparatively weak monster appears, so why not join? However, note that it cannot be taken consecutively.
62799.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a request
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
Relatively weak monsters
will appear, so why not come
along and take part?
However, it cannot be taken
in succession, so please
keep that in mind.
62799.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する依頼
を用意いたしました。
比較的弱めのモンスターが
登場しますので、参加
されてはいかがでしょうか。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

55109.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
55109.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Rohok GX Series. Hunt Forokururu and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
55109.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest to upgrade
the 'Rohokku GX Series.'
By hunting a Forokururu, you can
obtain upgrade materials for one
piece of the set.
Please make good use of it!
55109.descriptionJp:
「ロホックGXシリーズ」を強
化するためのクエストを準備
しました。
フォロクルルを狩猟すること
で、１部位分の強化素材が入
手できます。
ぜひお役立てください！

55430.description: The Variant Species Midogaron has appeared once more. Its legs have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55430.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ has
appeared once more.
Its legs have grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
even more power. Please take
great care in your survey.
55430.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ミドガロン≫が再び
現れました。
脚はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

60304.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
60304.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time your opponent is a new species of flying wyvern, the Tigrex! In a closed space with nowhere to run, we await the challenge of any with the courage to face it!
60304.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
their skill!
The next opponent is a new species
of Flying Wyvern, the Tigrex!
In a closed space with nowhere to
flee, we await the challenge of
those with courage!
60304.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！
今度の相手は新種の飛竜種、
≪轟竜≫ティガレックスだ！
逃げ場のない閉鎖された空間
で、立ち向かう勇気のある者
の挑戦をまってるぞ！

55810.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55810.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55810.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55810.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

60601.description: Hypnocatrice are breeding in great numbers! We have asked hunters from every region for help, but the truth is there are simply too many. So we are looking for hunters willing to take this hunt with 2 hunters at most. Those aiming to rank up quickly are especially encouraged.
60601.descriptionEn:
The Hypnocatrice are breeding wildly!
We have asked hunters everywhere
for their help, but the truth is
there are simply too many.
So we seek those who can set out
on this hunt in pairs at most.
I especially recommend it to those
aiming for a fast rank-up.
60601.descriptionJp:
眠鳥が大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

56008.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
56008.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the ears of Yian Kut-Ku, we will also grant a special item.
56008.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun UL
Guild Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to spread
awareness and promote them.
By breaking a Yian Kut-Ku's ear,
we will also grant you a
special item.
56008.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、ＵＬ
ギルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
怪鳥の耳を破壊すること
で特別なアイテムも
付与させていただきます。

55415.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55415.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55415.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

26384.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a High Rank monster with a designated weapon. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26384.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
high rank monsters with
a specified weapon. We have
special rewards ready, so
come and join us!
26384.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、指定
武器での上位モンスターの
討伐となります。特別な報酬
を用意させていただきました
ので、奮ってご参加ください。

62458.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
62458.description: What, you just want a hard Heavy Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62458.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Heavy
Bowgun that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!
62458.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅いヘビィボ
ウガンが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

54507.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
54507.description: We are seeking hunters to help investigate the Khezu subspecies living in the Snowy Mountains. The Khezu subspecies is relatively docile if you do not approach, but beware the ferocity it shows when it senses your presence. Depart after thorough preparation.
54507.descriptionEn:
We are seeking hunters to help
survey the Red Khezu that inhabits
the Snowy Mountains.
It is fairly docile if you keep
your distance, but its ferocity
once it senses you demands caution.
Please set out only after
preparing sufficiently.
54507.descriptionJp:
雪山に生息しているフルフル
亜種の調査にご協力いただけ
るハンターを募集しています。
近づかなければ比較的大人し
いフルフル亜種ですが、こち
らの存在を察知された際に見
られる獰猛性には警戒が必要
です。十分な用意をしてから
出発してください。

54123.description: We are recruiting hunters to help investigate the Shogun Ceanataur that appeared in the swamp! While you are at it, could you also slay Aptonoth? For future surveys, please help!
54123.descriptionEn:
We seek hunters to help survey the
Shogun Ceanataur that appeared in
the Swamp!
It may sound like an afterthought,
but could you also slay some
Aptonoth for us?
Please lend your aid for our
future research!
54123.descriptionJp:
沼地に出現したショウグン
ギザミ調査のため、協力して
頂けるハンター募集です！
ついでと言っては何ですが、
アプトノスの討伐も併せて
お願いできますか？
今後の調査のために、どうか
ご協力を！

61641.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61641.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
61641.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

62863.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62863.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!
62863.descriptionJp:
狩人たちの祭典、狩人祭！
魂を集めて勝利を掴み取れ！
今回紹介するこの依頼は、
シリーズクエスト専用だ！
シナリオを最後まで進めて、
大量の魂をゲットしよう！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

62958.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62958.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62958.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
62958.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

61164.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61164.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61164.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61164.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

21065.description: We're recruiting hunters to slay 8 Ioprey! Ioprey hits harder in a single blow than Velociprey or Genprey, so mind yourself out there!
21065.descriptionEn:
Seeking hunters to slay 8
≪Ioprey≫!
Compared to Velociprey or
Genprey, a single Ioprey hit
hits harder. Watch out!
21065.descriptionJp:
≪イーオス≫８頭を討伐してく
れる方を募集します！
≪イーオス≫はランポスや、
ゲネポスに比べ一発の攻撃力が
高いので注意して下さい！

50569.description: Clear this quest once a day and you'll get lots of Hunter Festival souls, meow. Clear it every day without fail and by the time the Soul-Pouring Festival ends you should have quite a pile, meow. You should tell all your Guild members too, meow.
50569.descriptionEn:
Clear this quest once a day and
you'll get lots of Hunter Festival
souls, meow. Clear it every day
without fail and by the time the
Soul-Pouring Festival ends you
should have quite a pile, meow.
You should tell all your Guild
members too, meow.
50569.descriptionJp:
１日１回このクエストをクリ
アすれば、狩人祭の魂がたく
さん手に入るニャン。毎日欠
かさずクリアすれば、入魂祭
が終わるころには結構な数に
なっているはずニャン。猟団
員のみんなにも教えてあげる
といいニャン。

26262.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26262.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26262.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54702.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
54702.description: To those aiming for GR 500: we have prepared a quest where hunting a Velocidrome greatly raises your standing as a hunter and also lets you obtain 'Velocidrome Bone,' a material recommended for making elemental Seals. Please make good use of it.
54702.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for GR 500:
we have prepared a quest where
hunting a Velocidrome greatly raises
your standing as a hunter and also
lets you obtain 'Velocidrome Bone,'
a material recommended for making
elemental Seals.
Please make good use of it.
54702.descriptionJp:
ＧＲ５００を目指す方々へ
ドスランポスを狩猟すること
で、ハンターとしての評価が
大きく上がりつつ、属性値
シジル作成にオススメの素材
である「ドスランポスの骨」
も入手可能なクエストを準備
しました。
ぜひお役立てください。

58074.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58074.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58074.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58074.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55361.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55361.description: The Silver Sovereign Wyvern has appeared at the interception base. The guild will pay a handsome reward to any hunter who intercepts this Silver Sovereign Wyvern within 20 minutes. Hunt it at once, before damage is done!
55361.descriptionEn:
A Harudomerugu has appeared at
the Base.
The Guild will pay a large reward to
any hunter who repels this
Harudomerugu within twenty minutes.
Slay it urgently, before damage
spreads!
55361.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に≪司銀龍≫が現れ
ました。
ギルドではこの≪司銀龍≫を
２０分以内に迎撃してくれた
ハンターに、多額の報酬を
支払います。
被害が出る前に、早急に討伐
してください！

54341.description: 2 monsters suddenly appeared in the New Great Arena. Both are monsters the guild considers the most dangerous. We have somehow kept the damage from spreading, but the situation allows no complacency. Head there at once and slay the monsters.
54341.descriptionEn:
Suddenly, two monsters have
appeared in the New Great Arena.
Both are monsters the Guild ranks
as the most dangerous of all.
For now the damage has not spread,
but the situation allows no room
for complacency.
Go to the site at once and set
about slaying the monsters.
54341.descriptionJp:
突如、新大闘技場に２頭の
モンスターが現れました。
どちらもギルドが最も危険と
位置付けるモンスターです。
なんとか、被害を拡大させず
に済んでいますが、予断を
許さない状態です。
至急現地に向かいモンスター
の討伐に当たってください。

23206.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟

60230.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Baruragaru. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60230.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is the Baruragaru!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest, so
try to place among the top!
Also, this time it's SP weapons only!
Choose your weapon carefully!
60230.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪バルラガル≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

12008.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
12008.description: At the waterside this season, the Shield Crab Daimyo Hermitaur may show itself. Dealing damage to a body protected by a hard shell is not easy. Carving Crab Miso from Zamite and delivering that is fine too, you know?
12008.descriptionEn:
At the waterside this season,
the Shield Crab
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ may show
itself. Its hard shell makes
dealing damage no easy task.
You could always carve
≪Zazamiso≫ from Yaozami, no?
12008.descriptionJp:
この季節の水辺には、盾蟹
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫が姿を
現すことがあるわ。硬い殻に
守られた体にダメージを与え
ることは容易くないわ。
ヤオザミから≪ザザミソ≫を
剥いで収めてもいいわよ？

55429.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種２頭の討伐
55429.description: 2 ferocious Crimson Lavasioth seem to have appeared in a distant volcano! I want to survey their ecology, so please hunt both of them together. If by chance some rare material turns up, I will give it to you.
55429.descriptionEn:
Apparently two ferocious Lavasioth
have appeared in a distant Volcano!
We wish to survey their ecology,
so please slay both of them.
Should you happen to carve something
rare, it's yours to keep.
55429.descriptionJp:
遠い火山で狂暴な≪紅溶岩竜≫
が２頭も現れたらしい！
生態を調査したいので
２頭合わせての討伐を
お願いします。
万が一、何か珍しい素材が
取れたら差し上げますよ。

62319.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62319.description: It is I, the Instructor! This is a quest for the Refined Monster trial! Today's target is the Variant Gypceros! I wish to hear how the feel of the fight changed before and after refining!
62319.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This is a quest for the Refine
Monster trial event!
This time's target is a
Gypceros Variant!
I wish to hear how the challenge
changes before and after the
refinement!
62319.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！
これはリファインモンスター
体験会用のクエストである！
今回のターゲットは、
≪ゲリョス変種≫だ！
リファインの前と後とで、
手ごたえがどのように変化
したのかお聞かせ願いたい！

55454.description: Halloween is pumpkins? Where are you from! Until recently there was no such custom! Have some decency! Pumpkins are not just for Halloween! Delicious all year! Better than fish! You may slay the fish!
55454.descriptionEn:
Halloween means pumpkins?
Where are you from?!
Until just recently we had no
such custom! Have some decency!
Pumpkins, you see,
aren't only for Halloween!
They're tasty all year round!
Tastier than fish!
And you may slay all the fish you like!
55454.descriptionJp:
ハロウィンはカボチャ？
お前はどこの出身だ！
ついこの前までそんな習慣
なかったろ！節操なしめ！
カボチャはな、
ハロウィンだけじゃない！
一年中美味い！
サカナより美味い！
サカナは討伐していいぞ！

55071.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
55071.description: Slaying an Akantor raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55071.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying an Akantor raises your
standing while letting you obtain
the materials needed for G Rank
jewels at a good value.
Please make the most of it.
55071.descriptionJp:
アカムトルムを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

62599.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62599.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62599.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

62821.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種２頭の狩猟

62870.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62870.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62870.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62870.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

23316.description: Hunter there. Do not be surprised by the high contract fee. This job exchanges your Ｇｚ for twenty Porta Cards Sakura. Perfect for growing your assets, would you not say?
23316.descriptionEn:
Hey there, hunter. Don't be
shocked by the contract fee.
This request trades your Gz
for 20 ≪Porta Card Sakura≫.
I think it's perfect for
growing your assets.
So, what do you say?
23316.descriptionJp:
そこのハンターさん。契約金
の高さに驚いてはダメよ。
これは、あなたのＧｚを
≪ポルタカード桜≫２０枚と
交換する依頼なの。
資産を増やすのに最適だと
思うけど、いかがかしら？

62772.description: An unprecedented great lightning strike has been witnessed at the Ancient Tower. This is a survey request for hunters of skill only. It is too dangerous, so item supply is impossible. Conduct the survey with the utmost care.
62772.descriptionEn:
A lightning strike of unprecedented
scale was witnessed at the Ancient
Tower.
This survey request is for skilled
hunters only. It is far too
dangerous, so no items can be
supplied. Please conduct the
survey with the utmost caution.
62772.descriptionJp:
古塔で、かつてない規模の
大落雷が目撃されました。
凄腕のハンター限定での
調査依頼をいたします。
危険すぎるため、アイテムの
支給も不可能です。
細心の注意を払って調査に
あたってください。

50554.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Kuarusepusu. I am counting on you!
50554.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of
weapon materials as pay?
It's an easy job. Just run
over and slay a Kuarlusepusu
for me. That's all.
I'm counting on you!
50554.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってクアルセプスを討
伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

26610.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26610.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Fermi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26610.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secret
art of forging equipment have been
found on monsters slain all over
the land, or so I hear!
Once you get the "Fermi Memo",
come alone, like a man! Bring it
to this workshop master!
I'll show you some good work!
26610.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪フェルミメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

55847.description: A Baruragaru with a greatly developed head has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Baruragaru known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55847.descriptionEn:
A ≪Baruragaru≫ with a greatly
developed head has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫
with developed parts, and will
conduct a survey. Reports say
it is more dangerous than
Baruragaru seen before.
Please survey it with care.
55847.descriptionJp:
頭が大きく発達した
≪喰血竜≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの喰血竜より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

21148.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

50713.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
50713.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Tigrex will also grant a special ingredient.
50713.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Tigrex's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50713.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
轟竜の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

62463.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the fire wyvern Rathalos together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62463.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, why not hunt the
Rathalos together with a hunter
who has risen to hold a Secret Art
tome?
Learn from that distinctive
footwork, and clear the request
together for an extra reward!
62463.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
今回は、秘伝書を持つまでに
上りつめたハンターと一緒に、
火竜≪リオレウス≫を
狩猟してきてはいかがだろう。
一味違った身のこなしに倣い、
共に依頼を達成すれば追加で
報酬を用意するぞ！

53256.description: Hello, I am Orihime. Every night I gaze at the sky and wait for Tanabata. But you must not simply close the distance to the man you care about. In love's tactics, the thrill of pulling away is needed too.
53256.descriptionEn:
Hello, this is Orihime.
Every night I look up at the sky
and wait for the day of the
Star Festival.
But you mustn't close the distance
to the one you fancy too easily.
In the game of love, the thrill of
pulling away is needed too.
53256.descriptionJp:
どうも、オリヒメです。
毎日夜空を見上げては、
七夕の日が来るのを待って
るの。
でも気になる彼との距離を
簡単に近づけてはダメ。
恋の駆け引きとしてはうまく
遠ざかる刺激も必要になって
くるのよ。

54864.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54864.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54864.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

21523.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21523.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21523.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54813.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
54813.description: To all who aim for the heights of GR: we prepared a quest where slaying a Gasurabazura raises your standing and lets you cheaply obtain the materials needed for G Rank decorations. Please make good use of it.
54813.descriptionEn:
To all who aim for the
heights of GR: we prepared a
quest where slaying a
Gasurabazura raises your
standing and lets you cheaply
obtain the materials needed
for G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.
54813.descriptionJp:
ＧＲの高みを目指す方々へ
ガスラバズラを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

63194.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63194.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
63194.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

61191.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス変種の狩猟

23516.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
23516.description: A Blangonga with greatly developed arms has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Blangonga seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23516.descriptionEn:
A ≪Blangonga≫ with greatly
developed arms has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫
with developed parts, and will
conduct a survey. Reports say
it is more dangerous than
Blangonga seen before.
Please survey it with care.
23516.descriptionJp:
腕が大きく発達した
≪雪獅子≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの雪獅子より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

63116.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63116.description: A truly excellent hunter must be versed in many things besides outstanding hunting skill. This time the guild has prepared the Difficult Book Yellow for hunters of ability. Keep striving for still greater heights.
63116.descriptionEn:
A truly excellent hunter must be
well versed in many things beyond
outstanding hunting skill.
This time the Guild has prepared
a difficult Tome [Yellow] for
capable hunters.
Please strive further toward the
heights of the hunter's path.
63116.descriptionJp:
真に優れたハンターとは、
卓越した狩猟技術のほか、
様々なことへ精通していなけ
ればなりません。
今回ギルドでは、実力ある
ハンターへ向け、
難しい書物【黄】を用意しま
した。さらにハンターの高み
を目指し頑張ってください。

11020.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
11020.description: We are looking for people to hunt Gendrome! If you seem to have time to spare, please deliver Herbivore Eggs that can be gathered this season. They're an item hugely popular with merchants and gourmets!
11020.descriptionEn:
We're looking for hunters to
hunt ≪Gendrome≫!
If you seem to have time to
spare, please deliver
≪Herbivore Eggs≫ gathered
this season. Merchants and
gourmets can't get enough!
11020.descriptionJp:
≪ドスゲネポス≫を狩猟して
くれる方を募集します！
ゆとりがありそうな場合は、
この季節に採れる≪草食竜の
卵≫を納品してください。
栄養満点で商人や美食家たち
に大人気の品物なんです！

50495.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐
50495.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ６１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Orugaron. I am counting on you!
50495.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 61.
So I've got a favor to ask — how
about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay an
Orugaron for me.
I'm counting on you!
50495.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ６１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってオルガロンを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

61737.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
61737.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
61737.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

1070.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
1070.description: The strange leg joints of the Shogun Ceanataur extend its range even to the ceiling! If hunting it is difficult, you might hunt the Gabras that flit about the crater this season and obtain food ingredients instead?
1070.descriptionEn:
The bizarre leg joints of the Shogun
Ceanataur let it expand its range
even to the ceiling!
If hunting it proves difficult, you
could slay the Gabras flitting around
the crater this season and gather
food instead, maybe?
1070.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫の
奇妙な足関節はその生息域を
天井にまで広げているぞ！
ヤツの狩猟が困難な場合は、
この季節に火口付近を飛び回
る≪ガブラス≫を討伐して食
材を入手してもいいかもな？

53115.description: The Christmas tree that's standard for this season hasn't arrived, nya! Without it everyone can't enjoy Christmas, nya... In that case I'll make one, nya! Hunter! Will you help me by hunting a Rathian, nya?
53115.descriptionEn:
The Christmas tree that's standard
for this season hasn't arrived, meow!
Without it, nobody can enjoy
Christmas, meow...
Then I'll just make one myself, meow!
Hunter!
Will you hunt a Rathian and
help me out, meow?
53115.descriptionJp:
この季節に定番のクリスマス
ツリーが届かないのニャ！
あれがないとみんながクリス
マスを楽しめないニャ・・
こうなったら僕が作るニャ！
ハンターさん！
リオレイアを狩猟して、僕を
手伝ってくれるかニャ？

56149.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
56149.description: Nwahahaha! It is I!! You, who were a novice hunter, are now a first-class hunter!! I am proud!! So I have a request! Before you leave Mezeporuta, show me the sight of you as a first-class hunter! I want to boast about it!
56149.descriptionEn:
Nwahahaha! It is I!!
To think you, once a rookie hunter,
are now a first-rate hunter!!
I am so proud!!
Now, I have a request!
Before I leave Mezeporta,
I want you to show me the hunter
you've become!
I mean to boast about you!
56149.descriptionJp:
ヌハハハハハ！我輩だ！！
新米ハンターだった貴様が
今や一流ハンターとは！！
我輩も鼻が高いぞ！！
そこで頼みがある！
メゼポルタを去る前に、
一流ハンターになった
貴様の姿を見せて欲しい！
大いに自慢したいからな！

62892.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62892.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62892.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

54858.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
54858.description: We have a report that a Blue Yian Kut-Ku has been found on Tide Island. It appears to differ from the Blue Yian Kut-Ku seen so far. Please see the creature with your own eyes and confirm it.
54858.descriptionEn:
We received a report that a
≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫ was
found on Tidal Island.
It seems to differ from the
ones seen so far. Please see
the ≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫ yourself.
54858.descriptionJp:
潮島にて≪青怪鳥≫を見つけ
たと報告を受けました。
今までの≪青怪鳥≫とは
様子が違うみたいです。
是非、貴方の目で≪青怪鳥≫
の姿を確かめてください。

21847.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21847.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21847.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

63330.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
63330.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
63330.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
63330.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

50179.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
50179.description: It is I, the Instructor! What is the most reliable partner for you lot! Yes! Powerful, sturdy arms and armor! This time I have prepared some quite powerful and quirky partners! Complete the request I set and craft them!!
50179.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
What is the most reliable
partner for you all?
Yes! Strong, sturdy gear!
This time I've prepared
partners that are quite
powerful and quirky!
Clear my request and craft them!!
50179.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！
諸君にとって最も頼れる相棒
とは何であるか！
そう！強力で強固な武具だ！
今回はなかなか強力で癖のあ
る相棒達を用意したぞ！
吾輩の出す依頼を達成し生産
するのだ！！

21526.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
21526.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21526.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21526.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

50226.description: I am a musician who came from afar. Lately I have heard a rumor that at a certain hour a mysterious sound echoes from the swamp near this square. Would you go and find out what that sound is? I will provide the supplies and armor you need. It will not take much of your time, so please hurry.
50226.descriptionEn:
I am a musician who came from
far away. Lately I heard a rumor
that at a certain hour a strange
sound echoes from the swamp
near this square. Would you go
and find out what that sound is?
I will prepare whatever supplies
and armor you need. It will not
take much effort, so be quick.
50226.descriptionJp:
私は遠方から来た楽師の一人。
最近、この広場に近い沼地か
ら、ある時刻になると謎の音
が響き渡るという噂を聞いた。
その音とは何なのか調べてき
てくれないか？
必要な支給品や防具は私が用
意する。そんなに手間はとら
せないから、早いとこ頼むよ。

26345.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26345.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26345.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

61056.description: Patients wounded and suffering from illness need nourishing food. But the reality is that such food reaches only the mouths of a few wealthy people. At least I want to give the patients in the square proper care. Hunters, I am counting on you.
61056.descriptionEn:
Patients wounded and suffering
from illness need nourishing
food. Yet the truth is that such
food reaches only the mouths of
a few wealthy folk.
At least for the patients in the
plaza, I want to give proper
care. Hunters, I leave it to you.
61056.descriptionJp:
傷つき、病に苦しむ患者には
滋味ある食物が必要だ。
しかし、そういった食物は
一部富豪の口にしか入らない
のが、現実なのだ。
せめて、広場の患者だけでも
手厚い医療を施したい。
ハンター諸君、頼んだぞ。

23592.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
23592.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.
23592.descriptionJp:
生物が存在できない場所だと
言われていた『最果ての地』
に、龍がいたと大型探査船
から報告がありました。
僅かに残る資料から、
『熾凍龍』と呼ばれる古龍で
あると推測されますが、詳細
は全くの不明です。現地へ
向かい、調査をお願いします。

11070.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト３匹の納品
11070.description: Find and deliver 6 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
11070.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 6 Special
Mushrooms that grow in the Jungle!
If you also deliver the ≪Royal Beetle≫,
the insect that sometimes flies
through the Jungle, I'll still pay!
Start by getting to know the Jungle,
then get used to it.
11070.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を６つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

55291.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55291.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.
55291.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されて
いる一部防具や装飾品の強化
に使用するＨＣ素材やＧＨＣ
素材を獲得できるクエストを
ご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

55219.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55219.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55219.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

26419.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26419.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26419.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

50258.description: This quest yields the following materials. Gunlance Soul (Beginning) x85, Gunlance Soul (Middle) x195, Gunlance Soul (Extreme) x275, Gunlance Soul (Heaven) x85. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50258.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Gunlance Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Gunlance Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Gunlance Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Gunlance Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
50258.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ガンランス魂・序≫85枚
≪ガンランス魂・中≫195枚
≪ガンランス魂・極≫275枚
≪ガンランス魂・天≫85枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

62346.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐
62346.description: This is a practice qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is ten minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
62346.descriptionEn:
This is a practice qualifier quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is ten minutes.
Also, you cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or clear rewards.
62346.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用予選
クエストです。
制限時間は１０分以内です。
また、モンスターの剥ぎ取り
とクリア報酬で、対象モンス
ターの素材は入手できません。

61041.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61041.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61041.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62084.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
62084.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
62084.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
62084.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

51088.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51088.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the claws of a Congalala will also grant a special ingredient.
51088.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Congalala's claws,
we will also grant you
some special ingredients
as an extra reward.
51088.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
桃毛獣の爪を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

61220.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Fang! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61220.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
