hunters who break many parts
on Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying
Wyvern's Heavy Fang! When
accepting or joining, deliver
the guarantee slip, then hunt
the specified monster. The slip
is not returned once you depart.
61220.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の重牙！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

61122.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61122.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61122.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61122.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

61058.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種の討伐
61058.description: Lately the sea of trees has been strange. It seems something at its top is exerting an influence. Could you investigate for us? The request is to find the cause of the anomaly and resolve it as well.
61058.descriptionEn:
Lately the Great Forest has
been acting strange. Something
at the Top of Great Forest
seems to be the cause. Could
you look into it? Once you
find the source, fix it too.
61058.descriptionJp:
最近、樹海の様子がおかしい
んだ。どうやら樹海頂部の
何かが影響を与えている様だ。
どうか調査をお願いできない
か？異変の原因を見つけ次第、
その解決も合わせての依頼だ。

54112.description: Please help investigate the Khezu in the swamp. This survey examines its electricity generating organs, so to keep it proceeding smoothly, please also break its head and torso at the same time. Note that if you hunt it without breaking them, it will count as a failure.
54112.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help in surveying
the Khezu in the Swamp.
This survey examines its
electric organs, so to keep the
survey running smoothly, please also
break its head and torso.
If you hunt it without breaking
them, the quest will fail, so
please be careful.
54112.descriptionJp:
沼地にいるフルフルを調査す
るためのお手伝いをお願いし
ます。今回の調査は、
発電器官を調べることなので
スムーズに調査が進められる
ように頭と胴の破壊も
一緒に達成してください。
壊さずに狩猟してしまった
場合は失敗となるので
注意してください。

61631.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

61556.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61556.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61556.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62662.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐

62023.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

50674.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50674.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Flor F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50674.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain upgrade
materials for one piece of the
Skystorm Armor Flor F series.
Accepting the quest requires a
Superior Ticket.
Please note that if you fail the
quest, the Superior Ticket will
be consumed.
50674.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
フロルＦシリーズの１部位分
の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55163.description: Slaying two Gougarufu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55163.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying two Gogarufu raises your
standing while letting you obtain
materials needed for G Rank
decorations at a bargain.
Please make good use of it.
55163.descriptionJp:
ゴウガルフ２頭を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

28020.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ10匹の狩猟

61639.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61639.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61639.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

61067.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

26042.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26042.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26042.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

26579.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 200! Deliver the Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26579.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching HR 200!
Deliver the Map on your own,
clear the quest, and claim
your reward!
26579.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ２００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

55582.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の撃退
55582.description: A black-bodied scorching-zero dragon that reigns over the Tower. The Guild has decided to call it Elzelion that Burns and Freezes to the Extreme. Hunter of courage, drive it off and I will surely grant you materials for armor the Guild keeps in secret.
55582.descriptionEn:
The black-bodied Scorching Zero Dragon
that reigns over the Tower.
The Guild has decided to name it
'Eruzerion, the Acme of Burning Cold.'
Brave hunters.
Once you have driven it off, I shall
surely grant you materials for the
Guild's treasured armor.
55582.descriptionJp:
塔に君臨せし黒躰の灼零龍。
ギルドでは、ヤツの呼称を
「極み灼き凍るエルゼリ
オン」とすることにした。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
ヤツを追い払った暁には、
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を
必ず授けよう。

60403.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
60403.description: To the hunters of Dundorma, information about the proud lone wolf, the black wolf bird Yian Garuga. In my estimation, it will come at you with resolve to die this time. Slaying it is the only way to answer that resolve.
60403.descriptionEn:
To the hunters of Dundorma,
here is information on the proud
lone wolf, the Black Wolf Bird
≪Yian Garuga≫. My guess is
that in this hunt he will come
at us ready to die.
Slaying him is the only way to
answer that resolve, I say.
60403.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマの狩人たちへ、誇
り高き一匹狼、黒狼鳥≪イャ
ンガルルガ≫に関する情報だ。
オレの予想では、今回の狩り
では、奴は恐らく決死の覚悟
で向かってくる。
討伐こそが、奴の覚悟に報い
る唯一の手段だろうな。

62726.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Canyon, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Glacier, the Voice of Nature: Cavern, or the Voice of Nature: Cliff. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62726.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. This request is set
in the ≪Canyon≫, and by
clearing it you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Glacier≫,
≪Voice of Nature: Cavern≫,
or ≪Voice of Nature: Cliff≫.
I pray your hunting life grows
ever more fulfilling.
62726.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪峡谷≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・氷河≫や
≪大自然の声・岩窟≫、
≪大自然の声・断崖≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

12062.description: If you're going after Basarios, it's best to search the rocky areas. Basarios often lurks hidden among the rocks. If you plan to do some mining, I'd be grateful if you delivered Coal. It's a prized energy source.
12062.descriptionEn:
If you're going after a
≪Basarios≫, search around the
rocks. It often lurks among
them, blending in. If you
plan to do some mining, I'd
be grateful if you delivered
≪Coal≫. It's a prized
energy source, you know.
12062.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫の狩猟に臨む
なら岩場から探してみるとい
いわ。バサルモスは岩に紛れ
て潜んでるケースが多いの。
採掘をする予定があるのなら
≪燃石炭≫を納品してくれる
と有難いわ。エネルギー源と
して重宝される品なのよ。

50676.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50676.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Gakou F (Elegance) and Gasen F (Elegance) series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50676.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain upgrade
materials for one piece of the
Skystorm Armor Gakou F [Grace] /
Gasen F [Grace] series.
Accepting the quest requires a
Superior Ticket.
Please note that if you fail the
quest, the Superior Ticket will
be consumed.
50676.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
雅孔Ｆ【趣】／雅穿Ｆ【趣】
シリーズの１部位分の強化
素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50950.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50950.description: In the East, they say that when two things look alike but differ beyond comparison, it is expressed as the moon and a soft-shelled turtle. In the desert of Mezepolta too there is a monster with a shell called the Crossbow Rock Wyvern, I hear. I want to know whether that wyvern resembles the moon in shape too. Will you go and investigate?
50950.descriptionEn:
In the East, they say a pair alike in
shape yet worlds apart in worth is
called 'the moon and a turtle.'
In the Desert of Mezeporta there is
said to be a shelled monster called
the Odibatorasu.
I want to learn whether its shape
too resembles the moon.
Will you go and survey it?
50950.descriptionJp:
東方では形は似ているが二つ
の差が比較にならないほど大
きいことを「月とすっぽん」
などと表すそうじゃ。
メゼポルタの砂漠にも弩岩竜
という甲羅を持つモンスター
がおるそうじゃな。弩岩竜も
月と形が似ているか調べたい。
調査をしてきてくれぬか？

23391.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン１Ｇ２０個の納品
23391.description: To all hunters who cleared the requests from three Guild members and obtained several of each of the three coins, we praise your effort and talent, and grant a special coin needed to craft certain gear. The requests are all hard, but the satisfaction is unmatched!
23391.descriptionEn:
To all hunters who cleared
the requests from three Guild
members and obtained several
of each of the three coins,
we praise your effort and
talent, and grant a special
coin needed to craft certain gear.
The requests are all hard, but
the satisfaction is unmatched!
23391.descriptionJp:
３名のギルド員からの依頼を
見事達成し、３種類のコイン
を複数入手したハンターの
皆様には、その収穫に対する
努力と才能を称え、ある装備
を生産するのに必要な特別な
コインをお渡しします。
困難な依頼ばかりですが、
その達成感は一入ですよ！

54225.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54225.description: We will continue the investigation of the Gurenzeburu that appeared in the highlands. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54225.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Gurenzeburu that appeared
in the Highlands.
Breaking parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you do!
Hunters, we ask for your
kind cooperation!
54225.descriptionJp:
高地に出現した
グレンゼブルの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

23354.description: A request for hunters who possess Zerureusu Haku weapons. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the desert, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen G Rank Haku weapons.
23354.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Supremacy Weapon≫ of the
≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Desert, you can obtain
≪G-Rank Supremacy≫ material.
23354.descriptionJp:
≪輝界竜≫の≪覇種武器≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
砂漠に現れた謎のモンスター
を繰り返し討伐することで、
≪Ｇ級覇種武器≫の強化に
必要な素材が入手できます。

62885.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62885.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62885.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

55139.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
55139.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Poborubarumu while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55139.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Poborubarumu raises your
standing while letting you obtain
materials needed for G Rank
decorations at a bargain.
Please make good use of it.
55139.descriptionJp:
ポボルバルムを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

109.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

60944.objectiveJp: イャンクック６頭の狩猟
60944.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
60944.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.
60944.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。
こちらは祭典の証は必要あり
ません。クエストの達成のみで
様々な報酬が払い出される
ようになっております。

54962.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
54962.description: Hunters who have risen to G Rank and taken up G Rank weapons. Are you missing materials you need for upgrades? Clearing this quest may let you obtain a Yellow Warrior Orb, Crimson Warrior Orb, Azure Warrior Orb, Jade Warrior Orb or an Extreme Conquest Certificate. Please give it a try!
54962.descriptionEn:
Hunters who have risen to G Rank
and taken up G Rank weapons.
Are you missing materials you
need for upgrades?
Clearing this quest may let you
obtain a Yellow Warrior Orb,
Crimson Warrior Orb, Azure Warrior
Orb, Jade Warrior Orb or an
Extreme Conquest Certificate.
Please give it a try!
54962.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級に昇格しＧ級武器を手に
したハンターさん。
強化に必要な足りない素材は
ありませんか？
今回、このクエストをクリア
すると、≪黄武玉≫≪紅武玉≫
≪蒼武玉≫≪碧武玉≫
≪極征貢献証≫が入手できる
かもしれません。
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

56031.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Frost Fierce Wyvern. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56031.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Ice Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56031.descriptionJp:
辿異種の氷獰竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

60035.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

21860.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21860.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Flor F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21860.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain upgrade
materials for all five pieces of the
Skystorm Armor Flor F series.
Accepting the quest requires a
Superior Ticket.
Please note that if you fail the
quest, the Superior Ticket will
be consumed.
21860.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
フロルＦシリーズの５部位分
の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

63268.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63268.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63268.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63268.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

54726.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
54726.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54726.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54726.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54673.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
54673.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to spread awareness and promote them further. By breaking a Silver Rathalos' head, we will also grant you special ingredients.
54673.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared this quest
to spread awareness and promote
them further.
By breaking a Silver Rathalos'
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
54673.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
銀火竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

62004.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Hypnocatrice. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62004.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Hypnocatrice≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!
62004.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ヒプノック≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

60409.description: It seems a great many Gabras have gathered at the tower. They are said to be an omen of calamity, so the Guild cannot ignore it either. Slay 8 Gabras and confirm the situation.
60409.descriptionEn:
It seems a great many Remobra
have gathered at the tower.
They are said to herald disaster,
so the Guild cannot simply
ignore them.
Slay 8 Remobra and check on
the situation for us.
60409.descriptionJp:
何やら塔に多くのガブラスが
群れ集っておるようじゃ。
奴らは災厄の前触れとも言われ
ておるゆえ、ギルドとしても
捨ててはおけぬ。
ガブラス８頭を討伐し、状況
を確認してきて欲しい。

60510.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
60510.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Yian Kut-Ku will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
60510.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Great Hall
Guild, we recommend trying a new
sub-target. The "set damage"
dealt to the ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ will
be judged by our Guild, so you
need only focus on clearing the
main target!
60510.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪イャンクック≫への『一定
ダメージ』は、当ギルドで判
断しますので、皆さんはメイ
ンターゲットの達成に専念し
てくだされば結構ですよ！

51051.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
51051.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed for FX
upgrades of Secret Art Armor
(gunner), excluding weapon
souls. The yield covers five
parts. To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass Sakura≫
is required, so please
take note.
51051.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（ガンナー）の
FX強化時に必要な武器魂を
除く素材を排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

63056.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Basarios of the volcano. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
63056.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Hunt the Basarios in the Volcano.
Clear the quest safely, and your
standing as hunters will shoot
right up!
63056.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
火山の≪岩竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。無事、クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

56087.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Plesioth. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56087.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Water Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56087.descriptionJp:
辿異種の水竜を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

61830.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. Only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it, so please note.
61830.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
Only hunters equipped with
the special anti-Variant
arms may accept or join, so
please take care.
61830.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

26110.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. If a Melynx steals an item, do not panic, just take it back! You might even pick up their pouch instead, you know?
26110.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, is called
the Phantom Beast for the way it
commands lightning at will.
If a Melynx steals an item, do
not panic, just take it back!
On the contrary, you might even
pick up its pouch, you know?
26110.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、雷を自在にあやつるさま
から≪幻獣≫と呼ばれる生き
物です。アイテムを≪メラル
ー≫に奪われたら焦らず取り
返しましょう！逆にポーチを
拾えるかも知れないですよ？

21514.description: There is a report of a Pariapuria sighted in the highlands. Perhaps because it has eaten all sorts of things, it seems to be a powerful individual. Unfortunately supplies cannot be delivered, but hunt it with care!
21514.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a
Pariapuria sighted in the
Highlands. Perhaps because it
has eaten all sorts of things,
it seems to be a powerful one.
Sadly we cannot deliver
supplies, but hunt with care!
21514.descriptionJp:
高地で呑竜を目撃したという
報告があった。
いろいろな物を食したからか、
強力な個体らしい。
残念ながら支給品を届ける
ことはできないが、注意して
狩猟してくれ！

20018.objectiveJp:
撃退できずにタイムアップ
報酬金ゼロ　拠点の耐久値ゼロ
20018.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The wind wyvern Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and drive the elder dragon off, we beg of you!
20018.objectiveEn:
Time up without repelling
Zero reward money, zero Base durability
20018.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the Elder
Dragon Forecast Station!
The Wind Dragon Kushala Daora has
invaded Mezeporta's territory!
Mezeporta now enters Elder Dragon
interception posture!
Please use the interception equipment
installed at the Base to repel
the Elder Dragon!
20018.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
メゼポルタの領内に風翔龍
クシャルダオラが侵入しまし
た！これよりメゼポルタは、
古龍の迎撃態勢に入ります！
迎撃拠点に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を撃退して頂
けますようお願い致します！

23297.description: Thanks to you gathering Rurou Narcissus and mining the Amaterasu Stone, trade with every region is thriving. The Guild presents you with this coin as thanks for the blessings you have brought to Mezeporta.
23297.descriptionEn:
Thanks to you gathering ≪Lulou Suisen≫
and mining ≪Amaterasu Stone≫,
trade with every region is
flourishing.
The Guild presents you with this
coin as thanks for the blessings
you have brought to Mezepolta.
23297.descriptionJp:
あなたが≪ルロウスイセン≫、
を採取し、≪天照石≫を採掘
してくれるおかげで、各地方
からの交易が盛んに行われて
います。
ギルドは、このメゼポルタに
恵みを与えてくれたお礼とし
てこのコインを贈ります。

20029.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
20029.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! An extremely powerful Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon! This is a very dangerous request. Return safely!
20029.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Post!
A very powerful Kushala Daora
has invaded Mezepolta's
territory! Mezepolta now
moves to intercept it! Use
the gear at the Base to slay
the Elder Dragon! A very
dangerous request. Stay safe!
20029.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
メゼポルタの領内に非常に
強力な風翔龍が侵入しまし
た！これよりメゼポルタは、
古龍の迎撃態勢に入ります！
迎撃拠点に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を討伐して
下さい！これは非常に危険な
依頼です。どうぞご無事で！

53140.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
53140.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the shell crab Daimyo Hermitaur! Clear the quest and your standing will rise sharply!
53140.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the Shield Crab
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫!
Clear the quest safely and
your standing will shoot
right up!
53140.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
盾蟹≪ダイミョウザザミ≫を
狩猟してみせろ！
無事、クエストをクリア
できたら、諸君らの評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

54887.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54887.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54887.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

63370.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63370.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63370.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63370.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

21630.description: Do you know the orb called the Mid Yellow Origin Orb? Its material is indispensable to the production of a certain expensive decoration. If you clear this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21630.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb known as
the Mid-Yellow Origin Orb?
Its material is essential to the
production of a certain expensive
decoration.
If you can complete this request,
I shall give you precious decoration
materials.
21630.descriptionJp:
中黄原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

50819.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50819.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
50819.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

54834.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
54834.description: A Crimson Lavasioth that moves unlike any other has been discovered in the volcano. According to the finder, it unleashed attacks never seen before. Please take the greatest care during the hunt.
54834.descriptionEn:
In the Volcano, a ≪Lavasioth≫
that moves unlike any normal
one has been found.
According to the finder, it
unleashed attacks never seen
before.
Please take the utmost care
when you hunt it.
54834.descriptionJp:
火山にて、通常とは異なる動
きをする≪紅溶岩竜≫が発見
されました。
発見者によると今まで見たこ
ともない攻撃を繰り出してき
たとのことです。
くれぐれも気を付けて狩猟に
当たってください。

60716.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60716.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60716.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60716.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

58058.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58058.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58058.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58058.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

54675.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
54675.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to spread awareness and promote them further. By breaking a Kam Orugaron's head, we will also grant you special ingredients.
54675.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared this quest
to spread awareness and promote
them further.
By breaking an Orugaron's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
54675.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
響狼の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

63369.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63369.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63369.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63369.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

62239.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62239.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt the female Roaring Wolf Nono Orugaron in the Swamp. Rumor says it is a rare individual, so take the greatest care!
62239.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
I want you all to hunt the female
Orugaron in the Swamp,
Non Orugaron. Word has it this is
a rare individual, so take
great care out there!
62239.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、沼地に居る雌響狼
≪ノノ・オルガロン≫を
狩猟してきてもらう。噂に
よると、珍しい個体らしい
ので、くれぐれも気をつけ
たまえ！

54487.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
54487.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54487.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54487.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

28093.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28093.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
28093.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

54327.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
54327.description: We will continue the survey of the Revidiora that appeared at the interception base. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54327.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Rukodiora that appeared
at the Base.
Breaking parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you do!
Hunters, we ask for your
kind cooperation!
54327.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に出現した
レビディオラの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

62523.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62523.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62523.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.
62523.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。思い出よりも追憶が
大切なかた、祭典の証をご用
意の上、ぜひご参加ください。
出発後は、祭典の証の返却が
できませんので、ご注意を。

62162.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. This may be a good chance to hunt a monster. Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! There is no time to wait for others, so please depart as 1 hunter.
62162.descriptionEn:
A specimen of a relatively
weak monster has been confirmed.
This may be a fine chance
to hunt a monster.
Before it flees far away,
please hurry and get ready!
There is no time to wait for others,
so please depart alone.
62162.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
これは、モンスターを狩猟す
るいい機会かもしれません。
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
人を待つ時間もないため、
１人での出発をお願いします。

21393.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟

23264.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
23264.description: Anorupatisu is a flying wyvern species called the Violent Saw Dragon for the distinctive shape of its snout. It moves freely through land and air and attacks its prey, possessing high combat ability and a very violent nature. I know it is dangerous, but please hunt this Violent Saw Dragon.
23264.descriptionEn:
Anorupatisu is a Flying Wyvern
monster called the Saw Wyvern for
its distinctive snout.
It moves freely between land and
sky and throws itself at prey,
possessing high combat ability and
a very violent nature.
We know it is dangerous, but we
ask you to hunt this Saw Wyvern.
23264.descriptionJp:
アノルパティスは特徴的な
鼻先から暴鋸竜と呼ばれる
飛竜種のモンスターです。
陸と空を自在に移動し
獲物に襲い掛かるなど、
高い戦闘能力を持ち、非常
に狂暴な性格をしています。
危険なことは承知ですが、
この暴鋸竜の狩猟を
よろしくお願いします。

58059.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58059.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58059.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58059.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

21642.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
21642.description: There are reports of a Lavasioth in the volcano far stronger than usual. We want to study its ecology, so bring back anything that might serve as a sample when you slay it. Should a rare material turn up, it is yours.
21642.descriptionEn:
There are reports of a
≪Volganos≫ stronger than usual
in the Volcano. I want to
survey its ecology, so while
you slay it, bring back
something we can sample.
If by chance you get a rare
material, it's yours.
21642.descriptionJp:
火山で、通常よりも強力な
≪ヴォルガノス≫の目撃報告
があります。生態を調査した
いので、討伐のついでに何か
サンプルになるようなものを
取ってきてください。万が一、
何か珍しい素材が取れたら
差し上げますよ。

21201.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21201.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21201.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

1061.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, plant the Guild Flag at the summit and set your sights on being an alpinist.
1061.descriptionEn:
The Kirin, an Elder Dragon species,
has no fixed habitat, and because
it is so few in number it is also
called the Phantom Beast.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
plant a Guild Flag at the summit
and aim to be an Alpinist.
1061.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物よ。雪山に行くなら山頂に
≪ギルドフラッグ≫を立てて
アルピニストを目指すのよ。

54672.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
54672.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to spread awareness and promote them further. By breaking a Kuarusepusu's head, we will also grant you special ingredients.
54672.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared this quest
to spread awareness and promote
them further.
By breaking a Kuarlusepusu's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
54672.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
晶竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

63081.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. Reports suggest it may be Kushala Daora, which has appeared repeatedly before, but this appearance falls outside the guild's predictions and can be called extremely rare. We ask for an urgent investigation.
63081.descriptionEn:
An extremely large sandstorm has been
measured in the Desert.
Reports suggest it may be the
Kushala Daora that has appeared
repeatedly before, but this sighting
falls outside the Guild's predictions
and can be called very rare.
Please survey at once.
63081.descriptionJp:
砂漠で、極めて大規模の
砂嵐が計測されました。
報告から以前より度々現れて
いる≪鋼龍≫ではないかとい
う事ですが、この出現は、
ギルドの予測から外れており、
非常に稀であると言えます。
至急、調査をお願いします。

50423.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

62733.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62733.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62733.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50488.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
50488.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
50488.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

55737.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55737.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55737.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく討究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

26165.description: Just when I thought those noisy ones were gone, now there is a swarm of Cantaro thick enough to cover the ground! I left my important baggage behind! Someone drive them off!
26165.descriptionEn:
Just when those noisy pests
were gone, now the ground is
crawling with a swarm of
Kantharos!
I left my important cargo
behind! Someone drive those
things off for me!
26165.descriptionJp:
五月蝿いあいつらがいなく
なったと思ったら、今度は
足元を埋め尽くさんばかりの
カンタロスの大群！
大事な荷物を残してきたまま
なんだ！誰かあいつらを追い
払ってくれよ！

63242.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
63242.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest whose rewards may include materials such as Elder Dragon Upper Wings. Do not let your guard down; approach it as though it were a Hardcore Quest. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63242.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of a winning
Hunter Festival Guild, we have prepared
a quest whose rewards may include
materials such as Elder Dragon
Upper Wings.
Please approach it as if it were a
Hardcore Quest, without letting your
guard down. When accepting or
joining, bring your Festival Proof.
63242.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪古龍種
の上翼≫などの素材が報酬で
手に入ることがあるクエスト
を用意させていただきました。
油断なさらぬよう≪剛種クエ
スト≫のつもりでお向かいく
ださい。受注、参加時に、祭
典の証をお持ちください。

26167.objectiveJp: チャチャブー３０匹の討伐

50839.description: We present a request that lets you obtain in one go the rare materials of Aberrant individuals needed to upgrade the Floating Peak Wyvern's Heavenstorm armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50839.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on how many
times you can accept it, but we
present a request that lets you
gather the Special Individual's rare
materials needed to upgrade Yama
Tsukami Skystorm Armor all at once.
Please take this chance to
try it!
50839.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、浮峰龍の≪天嵐
防具≫の強化に必要な≪特異
個体の希少素材≫をまとめて
入手できる依頼をご紹介しま
す。
この機会にぜひチャレンジし
てください！

63199.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
63199.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63199.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63199.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

26341.description: A subspecies of Espinas has appeared at the top of the tower close to the sea of trees. According to the documents left by the Royal Paleontology Scriveners, there is a record that against the wholehearted blow it delivers after storing power, defense was of no use at all. Please take care.
26341.descriptionEn:
An Espinas Subspecies has
appeared at the top of the Tower
near the Great Forest. Documents
left by the Royal Paleontology
Scrivener Corps record that
against the all-out blow it
charges up, defense was of no
use at all.
Please be careful.
26341.descriptionJp:
樹海に程近い塔の頂に、エス
ピナスの亜種が出現しました。
王立古生物書士隊の残した文
献によれば、力を溜めて繰り
出す渾身の一撃には、防御は
一切役に立たなかったという
記述が残っています。
ご注意ください。

54940.description: This quest yields the following materials. Gunlance Ribbon (Beginning) x100, Gunlance Ribbon (Middle) x165, Gunlance Ribbon (Extreme) x165. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54940.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Gunlance Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Gunlance Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Gunlance Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
54940.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ガンランス綬・序≫100個
≪ガンランス綬・中≫165個
≪ガンランス綬・極≫165個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

63040.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
63040.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63040.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63040.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

23385.description: A peddler walking the desert reports sighting a Black Diablos moving under cover of darkness. It is violent in temper, and its jet-black body is feared as a messenger of death. Hunt with the utmost care.
23385.descriptionEn:
A traveling merchant walking
the Desert reported seeing a
≪Black Diablos≫ moving under
cover of darkness. It is
violent, and its jet-black
body is feared as a reaper.
Please hunt it with great care.
23385.descriptionJp:
砂漠を歩く行商人から、闇に
紛れて動く≪黒角竜≫を目撃
したと報告がありました。
気性が荒く、その漆黒の体は
死神と称され恐れられていま
す。細心の注意を払っての狩
猟をお願いします。

54429.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
54429.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54429.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54429.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

60141.description: The sea of trees is still an unexplored land. Rather than heading straight out to hunt, how about exploring first? Please find just 1 Chipped Shell from the den of a certain monster said to be in this land, and deliver it. If you have time to spare, do the sub-target too.
60141.descriptionEn:
The Great Forest is still
unexplored land. Instead of
rushing off to hunt, why not
start with some exploration?
Find just 1 ≪Chipped Shell≫ in
the nest of a monster said to
live here and deliver it.
Do the sub-target too if you can.
60141.descriptionJp:
樹海はまだまだ未開の地です。
いきなり狩りに出かけないで、
まずは探索でもどうでしょう？
この地にあると言われている、
あるモンスターのねぐらから
≪かけた貝殻≫を１つだけ
見つけて納品してください。
余裕があればサブもどうぞ。

22080.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, an Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, was newly observed in the Snowy Mountains. According to hunters who faced it, it unleashes attacks using ice. Please take the greatest care not to neglect your preparations.
22080.descriptionEn:
With the appearance of the
Transcendent species, surveys
have been pushed across the land,
and a Barioth, the Ice Fang Wyvern,
has now been sighted in the
Snowy Mountains. Hunters who faced
it report it unleashes ice attacks.
Please do not neglect your preparations.
22080.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、雪山に
氷牙竜・ベリオロスが新たに
観測されました。対峙した
ハンターの情報によると、
氷を使った攻撃を繰り出して
くるとのこと。準備を怠らぬ
ようくれぐれもご注意下さい。

50579.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! A Super Golden Experience request has appeared, a further boost to the rewards of the Golden Experience, which lets you build experience efficiently and obtain large amounts of zenny too. Do take the chance to try it!
50579.descriptionEn:
Emergency notice to all hunters!
The 'Super Golden Experience'
request is now available, with
even better rewards than the
'Golden Experience' that lets
you earn experience efficiently
and gain loads of zenny.
Please take this chance to try
it out!
50579.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
ことができ、大量のゼニーも
入手できる「黄金体験」の
報酬をさらに強化した
「超・黄金体験」の依頼が
発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

61576.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

50995.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50995.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed to F-upgrade Secret Art
Armor (Gunner), excluding Weapon
Souls.
The yield covers five pieces.
Please note that accepting the
quest requires a 10th Anniversary
Ticket.
50995.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（ガンナー）の
Ｆ強化時に必要な武器魂を
除く素材を排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪10周年チケット≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

26326.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26326.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26326.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55671.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55671.description: Reports have come in of a shadow of the Doragyurosu. In anticipation of a new Divergent species, the Guild has prepared weapons for promising hunters to face them. Obtain the crafting materials and ready yourself to hunt the Divergent!
55671.descriptionEn:
A report has arrived that a shadow
of a Doragyurosu was sighted.
At the sign of a new Supremacy
appearance, the Guild has prepared
weapons to face Supremacy monsters
for promising hunters.
Obtain the production materials and
prepare to slay the Supremacy!
55671.descriptionJp:
冥雷竜の影を目撃したという
報告が届きました。
新たな辿異種出現の兆しに、
ギルドでは有望なハンターに
向けて、辿異種に立ち向かう
ための武器を用意しました。
生産素材を獲得して、辿異種
の討伐に備えてください！

62087.description: I found rare materials in the swamp. I was gathering them frantically when a Gypceros came, and I thought I would brush it off, but it seemed no ordinary Gypceros, so I fled somehow. If you hunt it, I will give you the materials I gathered.
62087.descriptionEn:
Rare materials can be gathered
in the Swamp, you see. I was
lost in collecting them when
≪Gypceros≫ turned up, and I
thought I would just shoo it off,
but it was no ordinary Poison
Bird, it seemed, so I ran for it.
Hunt it for me and I will give
you the materials I gathered.
62087.descriptionJp:
沼地で珍しい素材が取れてね。
夢中になって集めていたら
≪ゲリョス≫がやってきて、
適当にあしらってやろうと
思ったんだが、どうもただの
毒怪鳥じゃないようで、何と
か逃げてきたんだ。狩猟して
きてくれたら取れた素材を
やってもいいぞ。

26261.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26261.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26261.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26261.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

60682.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Hyujikiki. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60682.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the
target is the Hyujikiki!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest, so
try to place among the top!
This time it is held with
Supremacy weapons only!
60682.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ヒュジキキ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

23265.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
23265.description: Revidiora has been confirmed approaching the interception base. We have readied an interception stance against a powerful individual, but we cannot let our guard down at all. Prepare thoroughly beforehand and head out to the hunt.
23265.descriptionEn:
It has been confirmed that a
Rebidiora is approaching the Base.
We have prepared an interception
posture for this powerful specimen,
but we cannot let our guard down.
Make thorough preparations and
set out to slay it.
23265.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点にレビディオラが
近づいていることが確認され
ました。強力な個体に対して
の迎撃態勢を整えてはいます
が、全く油断はできません。
事前に十分な準備を整え、
討伐に向かってください。

22077.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
22077.description: The survey party reports detecting charged erosion dragonbugs from monster footprints found in the Snowy Mountains. This may be a new subspecies! However, contact with the party has been cut off since! Head for the site at once!
22077.descriptionEn:
We have reports that charged
Erosion Dragonbugs were
detected in monster footprints
found by the survey team in the
≪Snowy Mountains≫.
It may be a new Subspecies
monster! But since then all
contact with the team has
ceased!
Head for the site at once!
22077.descriptionJp:
調査隊が≪雪山≫で発見した
モンスターの足跡から
帯電した蝕龍蟲を検出した
との報告がありました。
新たな亜種モンスターの
可能性があります！しかし、
それ以降は調査隊からの
連絡が途絶えたままです！
至急、現地に向かって下さい！

50562.description: Look at this hammer! It will take a little more time to finish, but I am confident in it! And those fellows have the nerve to say their long swords are better! Perfect timing, I will show them the difference between us. Sorry, but you are helping me!
50562.descriptionEn:
Look at this Hammer!
It'll take a little more time to
finish, but it's a piece I'm proud of!
And those guys keep running their
mouths that their Long Swords
are better!
A fine chance, this - I'll teach them
the difference between us.
Sorry, but you're helping me!
50562.descriptionJp:
見てくれ、このハンマーを！
完成まではあと少し時間がか
かるが、かなりの自信作だ！
それをあいつら、自分達の
太刀の方が上だなどと
ぬかしやがる！
丁度いい機会だ、ここいらで
俺との差をわからせてやる。
わるいが協力してもらうぜ！

55471.description: A Plesioth with a greatly developed head has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Plesioth known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55471.descriptionEn:
A Water Wyvern with a greatly
developed head has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫
with developed parts, and will
conduct a survey. Reports say
it is more dangerous than
Water Wyvern seen before.
Please survey it with care.
55471.descriptionJp:
頭が大きく発達した
≪水竜≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの水竜より危険
との報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

55438.description: An Anomalous Species Midogaron with greatly developed legs has appeared. Its attacks, peculiar to the Anomalous Species, have defeated many hunters. In response the guild will provide strong support for the hunt. Head out with care.
55438.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Midogaron with greatly
developed legs has appeared.
Its Supremacy-specific attacks have
caused many hunters to fail.
In response, the Guild will provide
strong slaying support.
Please proceed to the survey with
caution.
55438.descriptionJp:
脚が大きく発達した辿異種
ミドガロンが現れました。
辿異種特有の攻撃で数多の
ハンターが討伐に失敗してい
ます。この事態にギルドは
対策として、強固な討伐支援
を行います。気を付けて調査
に向かってください。

55173.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Khezu while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55173.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Khezu raises your standing
while letting you obtain materials
needed for G Rank decorations
at a bargain.
Please make good use of it.
55173.descriptionJp:
フルフルを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

26006.description: Thank you for waiting. Here is the hunting ground information. This time's hunting ground is the Sea of Trees, with its dense trees and somehow mysterious air. Along with an ecological survey, please deliver 12 Specialty Mushrooms.
26006.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Here's the hunting ground
info. This time it's the Great
Forest, dense with trees and
strangely mystical air. Along
with the ecology survey,
please deliver 12 Special Mushrooms.
26006.descriptionJp:
お待ちかね。狩場の情報です。
今回の狩場は、鬱蒼と茂る
木々と、どこか神秘的な
空気を感じる樹海です。
生態の調査も兼ねて、
特産キノコ１２個の納品を
お願いします。

55655.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn a reward far beyond the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
55655.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Sword and Shield, show me the skill
you have honed against the Baruragaru
in the New Great Arena!
If you can hunt it splendidly, you
shall receive a reward far beyond
what your daily efforts would ever
bring you.
55655.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

12058.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. Also, if a Melynx steals an item, do not panic, just take it back. You might even pick up their pouch instead.
12058.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder
Dragon species, and because it
wields thunder freely it is
called the ≪Phantom Beast≫.
Also, if a ≪Melynx≫ steals
your item, don't panic. Take it
back; you might get a pouch too.
12058.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、雷を自在にあやつるさま
から≪幻獣≫と呼ばれる生き
物よ。それと、アイテムを
≪メラルー≫に奪われたら焦
らず取り返すことね。逆にポ
ーチを拾えるかも知れないわ。

56004.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
56004.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the ears of Blue Yian Kut-Ku, we will also grant a special item.
56004.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly launched UL
Guild Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest in order to
raise still greater awareness
and promote them.
Breaking the Blue Yian Kut-Ku's
ears will also grant you
special items.
56004.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、ＵＬ
ギルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
青怪鳥の耳を破壊すること
で特別なアイテムも
付与させていただきます。

21649.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
21649.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
21649.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

55507.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields Harudomerugu materials. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55507.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of a guild
on the winning side of the
Hunters Festival, we prepared a
quest that yields ≪Scorching
Zero Dragon Materials≫.
Please carry ≪Festival Fever≫
when you accept or join.
55507.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に≪灼零龍素
材≫を獲得できるクエストを
用意させていただきました。
受注、参加時に、≪祭典の
熱気≫をお持ちください。

26005.description: The sea of trees is still an unexplored land. Rather than heading straight out to hunt, how about exploring first? Please find just 1 Chipped Shell from the den of a certain monster said to be in this land, and deliver it. If you have time to spare, do the sub-target too.
26005.descriptionEn:
The Great Forest is still
unexplored land. Instead of
rushing off to hunt, why not
start with some exploration?
Find just 1 ≪Chipped Shell≫ in
the nest of a monster said to
live here and deliver it.
Do the sub-target too if you can.
26005.descriptionJp:
樹海はまだまだ未開の地です。
いきなり狩りに出かけないで、
まずは探索でもどうでしょう？
この地にあると言われている、
あるモンスターのねぐらから
≪かけた貝殻≫を１つだけ
見つけて納品してください。
余裕があればサブもどうぞ。

62254.description: What, you just want a hard Light Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62254.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Light
Bowgun that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!
62254.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅いライト
ボウガンが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

61066.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
61066.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament finals. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards in this quest.
61066.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament
finals.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from clear rewards
in this quest.
61066.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの決勝練習用
クエストです。
モンスターの剥ぎ取りと
クリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

15003.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
15003.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! This time it is the hunt for the Cephadrome that swim through the desert and the monsters that swarm there! Do your best!
15003.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam has
four parts in all! To confirm
your skill once more, you'll
hunt every monster we specify!
This time it's the sand wyverns
that swim the Desert and the
monsters that gather there!
Do your best!
15003.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
４つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
今回は砂漠を泳ぐ砂竜たちと
砂漠に群れるモンスターたち
の狩猟じゃ！頑張るのじゃ！

54765.description: Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing their surroundings red with rage. We will somehow drive them into the Arena, so we ask you hunters to slay them and keep the damage from spreading any further. Upon your success, we will give you armor materials long stored away by the Guild.
54765.descriptionEn:
Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing
their surroundings red with rage.
We will somehow drive them into
the Arena, so we ask you hunters
to slay them and keep the damage
from spreading any further.
Upon your success, we will give
you armor materials long stored
away by the Guild.
54765.descriptionJp:
２頭の獣が怒りで周囲を赤く
染めながら暴れ回っています。
何とか闘技場までは私たちが
追い込むので、ハンターの方
には、これ以上被害を拡大さ
せないために討伐をお願いし
ます。討伐に成功した暁には
古くからギルドで蔵されてき
た防具の素材を差し上げます。

22072.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
22072.description: Thanks for playing MHF for nine whole years! Equip Galba Poplar and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 77 Proof of Gratitude R as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude R you can forge Haldo Plata (Heavy Bowgun).
22072.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for nine whole years!
Equip ≪Galba Poplar≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 77
≪Proof of Gratitude R≫ as
a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude R≫ you can forge
≪Haldo Plata≫ (Heavy Bowgun).
22072.descriptionJp:
９年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ガルバポプラ≫を装備し、
≪年間特典生産券≫１枚を
納品すると≪感謝の証R≫を
７７枚プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証R≫から
≪ハルド・プラタ≫（ヘビィ
ボウガン）が生産可能です。

23575.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
23575.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23575.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23575.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

21284.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
21284.description: Do you know of the lost famed bow, the Black Bow? I hold its material, but I do not give it away for free. Hunt the Basarios that dwells in the Volcano with a bow and I will acknowledge your skill and give you this Ink Scrap.
21284.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the lost famed bow,
the Black Bow?
I hold its materials, but I won't
give them away for free.
Hunt the Black Gravios that dwells
in the Volcano with a Bow, and I
will acknowledge your skill and
give you this ≪Ink Fragment≫.
21284.descriptionJp:
失われた名弓「黒弓」を知っ
ているか？その素材を持って
いるが、タダではやらないよ。
火山に棲みつく黒鎧竜を弓で
狩猟してくれれば、キミの実
力を認めて、この≪墨のカケ
ラ≫を差し上げよう。

21075.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21075.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
21075.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!
21075.descriptionJp:
≪シビレ罠≫や≪落とし穴≫
をモンスターの足元に設置す
れば動きを封じることができ
るんです！
それに、モンスターが弱った
ところを捕らえて≪捕獲用麻
酔玉≫で眠らせれば捕獲する
こともできちゃうスグレモノ
なんですよ！

53250.description: We do not have enough materials to finish the special fireworks. Those materials are said to be in the volcano. Without them, the result will not be good enough! For the success of the fireworks festival, please procure them!
53250.descriptionEn:
We're short on materials to
finish the special fireworks.
The materials are said to be
in the Volcano.
Without them I can't make
anything I'd be satisfied with!
For the fireworks show's sake,
please gather them for us!
53250.descriptionJp:
特製花火を完成させるには材
料が足りないんだ。
その材料は火山にあるらしい。
こいつが揃わないと納得いく
出来にはならない！
花火大会成功のためにも、材
料の調達をお願いしたい！

55077.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
55077.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
55077.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

62698.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
62698.description: This is a request to drive off a giant Lunastra. I would like it slain quickly, but if that is difficult, driving it off alone will do. As this is a special request, please present proof of sufficient skill when accepting it. Also, depending on the situation, proof of the kill may not be issued.
62698.descriptionEn:
This is a request to repel a
giant Lunastra. We would like
it slain in a short time, but
if that is too hard, repelling
it alone is fine. As this is a
special request, you must show
proof of ample skill to accept.
Also, depending on the
situation, no slay proof may be issued.
62698.descriptionJp:
巨大な炎妃龍の撃退依頼です。
短時間での討伐をお願いした
いのですが、難しい場合、
撃退のみでも結構です。
特別な依頼のため、受注する
場合には十分な腕前の証の
提示をお願いします。また、
状況により討伐の証を発行
できない場合もあります。

50802.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50802.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Heavenly Storm Weapon and hunt the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a fitting reward awaits you.
50802.descriptionEn:
Thou who would master the way of
the hunt. Bear the 'Tenran Weapon'
and hunt the ≪Doragyurosu≫.
Only one who succeeds under
limited conditions can be called
a true hunter.
Succeed, and a fitting reward
awaits thee.
50802.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
『天嵐武器』を携え、≪弩岩
竜≫を狩るのだ。限られた条
件の中で狩りを成功させる者
こそ、真の狩人と言えよう。
成功すれば、それなりの褒美
がそなたを待っておるぞ。

54959.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
54959.description: Please hunt the Emperor-Conquering Dragon that dwells in Kumomi Fortress. The ecology of this monster is wrapped in mystery and information is scarce. According to the survey team, the flying wyverns that fly around the Emperor-Conquering Dragon also have a connection to it.
54959.descriptionEn:
We ask you to slay the
≪Guanzorumu≫ that dwells in
Cloud Viewing Fortress.
This monster's ecology is
shrouded in mystery, and
information is scarce. The
survey team says the Flying
Wyverns around it are linked to it.
54959.descriptionJp:
雲見砦に棲む、≪帝征龍≫
の討伐をお願いします。
このモンスターの生態は謎
に包まれており、情報が少な
い状態です。調査班の報告に
よると帝征龍の周囲に飛ぶ
飛竜種も帝征龍と関係性が
有るということです。

54654.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54654.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54654.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

50610.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50610.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Hardcore Weapon and hunt the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a fitting reward awaits you.
50610.descriptionEn:
Thou who would master the way
of the hunt. Bear the 'Hardcore
Weapon' and hunt ≪Gasurabazura≫.
Only one who succeeds under
limited conditions can be
called a true hunter.
Success will bring a fitting reward.
50610.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
『剛種武器』を携え、≪弩岩
竜≫を狩るのだ。限られた条
件の中で狩りを成功させる者
こそ、真の狩人と言えよう。
成功すれば、それなりの褒美
がそなたを待っておるぞ。

55654.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (legs), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
55654.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(leg piece), excluding
weapon ribbons and weapon
merits. The yield is one
type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass Sakura≫
is required, so please take note.
55654.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（脚防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

61840.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

12046.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

54850.description: Hunter! How about spending a rare day off with Wurky and the others in the flower field, snoozing and taking it easy? Only do not doze off too long because it feels so good! You can never let your guard down around monsters, ever!
54850.descriptionEn:
Hunter! On your rare day off,
why not come to the Flower Field
with the Uruki and have a
nice, sound sleep? ♪
Just don't doze off too much,
it feels so good!
Monsters can show up at any
time, so never let your guard
down! ♪
54850.descriptionJp:
ハンターさん！たまの休み、
ウルキーたちと花畑で
「ぐっすりのんびり♪」して
きたらどうかしら？
ただし、気持ち良すぎて
あまりうとうとしすぎない
ようにね！いつだって
モンスターの出現に
油断は禁物よ♪

23311.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
23311.description: A Resounding Wolf seems to have been found in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. It could hinder the survey, so please head out to hunt it. Another hunter will draw off the female Resounding Wolf, so you take the male.
23311.descriptionEn:
An Orugaron seems to have
been found in an unsurveyed
part of the Swamp. It could
become an obstacle to our
survey, so head out to hunt
it. Another hunter will draw
off the Non Orugaron, so you
are to handle the Kam
Orugaron.
23311.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域で
響狼が発見されたようです。
調査を進める上での障害に
なり得ますので、狩猟に
向かってください。
雌響狼は別のハンターに気を
引いてもらいますので、
あなた方は雄響狼の方を
お願い致します。

22156.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Kalais series, available from this request? It combines a vivid look with performance, truly a set that has both beauty and brains.
22156.descriptionEn:
Hunter, thinking of changing
out of your ≪Hope Series≫
armor?
How about the ≪Karais
Series≫ armor you can get
from this request?
It boasts both vivid looks and
solid performance, truly a
piece with beauty and brains.
22156.descriptionJp:
防具≪ホープシリーズ≫から
着替えたいと考えているハン
ターさん。
この依頼で入手可能な防具
≪カライスシリーズ≫はどう
ですか？
鮮やかな見た目と性能を兼ね
備えた、まさしく才色兼備な
防具ですよ。

50270.description: Happy New Year! For this year's first hunt, by the Guild Master's particular wish, the battledore returns! Apparently his grandchild is terribly fond of it. Now, do your best to grant his grandchild's wish!
50270.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year!
For this year's first hunt, by
special request of the Guild
Master, the hagoita returns!
Apparently his grandson is
terribly fond of them.
Now, do your best to grant
his grandson's wish!
50270.descriptionJp:
新年おめでとうございます！
今年の狩り初めは、
ギルドマスターたっての
希望で、再び羽子板の登場
です！
何でも、お孫さんの受けが
ものすごく良いとか。
さあ、孫の願いを叶えるべく
頑張ってください！

23493.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
23493.description: The survey team that was separated still has not returned! I saw them being chased by a Stygian Zinogre toward the secret region of the tower, and red-black lightning was coiling high into the sky and resounding! Please! Go and save them quickly!
23493.descriptionEn:
The separated survey team has
still not returned! I saw them
being chased by a Stygian Zinogre
toward the hidden area of the
Tower, and red-black lightning
was coiling high into the sky and
roaring!
Please! Go and save them, quickly!
23493.descriptionJp:
離別した調査隊がまだ
戻ってこない！彼らが
ジンオウガ亜種に追われ
塔の秘境へ向かって
いるのを目撃したのだが、
赤黒い稲妻が天高く巻き
上がり鳴り響いていた！
頼む！早く彼らを助けに
行ってくれないか！

23606.description: A Hyujikiki with greatly developed needles has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Hyujikiki known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23606.descriptionEn:
A ≪Hyujikiki≫ with greatly
developed needles has
appeared. The Guild
classifies this individual as
a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will survey it.
Reports say it is more
dangerous than Hyujikiki seen
before. Please survey with care.
23606.descriptionJp:
針が大きく発達した
≪針纏竜≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの針纏竜より危険
との報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

53064.description: This is Miyashita! The final question at last! [Question 6] I! Love all of you! If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53064.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here!
It's finally the last question!
[Question 6]
I!
Love all of you!!
So very much!!!
Hunters who think the answer is
x (B), accept this quest
right here!
53064.descriptionJp:
宮下です！
いよいよ最終問題です！
【第６問】
僕は！
みなさんのことが！！
大好きです！！！
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

26066.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26066.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26066.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26066.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

61505.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
61505.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61505.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
61505.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

50049.description: Would you look for a rare old box, nya? Find one and bring it to me and I will trade you my top recommendation, nya. Hm? What is inside the box? There are some things in this world better left unknown, nya.
50049.descriptionEn:
Would you search for an old box that is
rarely found, meow? If you find one
and bring it to me, I will trade you
a recommended item, meow.
Hm? What is inside the box, you ask?
There are things in this world you
are better off not knowing, meow.
50049.descriptionJp:
稀に見つかる古い箱を探して
くれニャいか？見つけて届け
てくれたら、イチオシの品と
交換してやるニャよ。
ん？箱の中に何が入っている
のかって？世のニャかには、
知らない方がいい事もあるん
ニャよ。

50123.objectiveJp: ペリカン鉱石１個の納品
50123.description: I love summer! I want to feel summer on my skin at all times! That is why I came all the way to Tide Island! Comrades! You feel the same, surely. But first, show me that passion!
50123.descriptionEn:
I love summer!
I want to feel it on my skin
always! That is why I came all
the way to this ≪Tidal Island≫!
Comrades! You feel the same.
But first, show me that
passion of yours!
50123.descriptionJp:
私は夏が大好きだッ！
常に夏を肌で感じていたい！
そのためにこの≪潮島≫まで
やってきたのだ！
同士諸君！思いは同じだろう。
しかし、まずはその意気込み
を私に見せてもらいたいッ！
