50817.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
50817.description: We are surveying Gasurabazura, the monster found at White Lake. According to one account, anger greatly changes Gasurabazura's nature. If you can confirm this change in detail, we will deliver the guild's reward to your supply box.
50817.descriptionEn:
We are surveying the monster
Gasurabazura found at White Lake.
According to one testimony,
rage greatly changes the nature
of Gasurabazura.
If you can confirm this change
in detail, we will deliver the
Guild's reward to your supply box.
50817.descriptionJp:
白湖で発見されたモンスター
「ガスラバズラ」を調査して
います。ある証言によれば、
怒りがガスラバズラの性質を
大きく変化させるとのこと。
この変化を詳細に確認して
いただければ、ギルドからの
報奨品を支給品ボックスに
お届けします。

26176.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
26176.description: I want it! I want it! I want it no matter what! The cute furniture of the Kut-Ku! Kind hunter! Hunt lots for me! I will give you plenty of the materials for Blast Powder I filched from the house storehouse! Please!
26176.descriptionEn:
I want it! I want it!
I just have to have it!
The cute Yian Kut-Ku furniture!
Kind hunter! Go hunt lots and
lots of them for me!
I will give you loads of
≪Gunpowder≫ ingredients I
swiped from our storehouse!
Please!
26176.descriptionJp:
欲しいの！欲しいの！
どおぉ〜しても欲しいの！
怪鳥さんの可愛い家具が！
優しい狩人さん！あたしの為
に、たぁくさん狩ってきて！
家の倉庫からくすねてきた
≪爆薬≫の材料をいっぱい
あげちゃうから！
おねがいね！

54191.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54191.description: We ask you to survey the Daimyo Hermitaur lurking in the desert. Beyond the hunt itself, if you break its parts, we will add to your reward!
54191.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Daimyo
Hermitaur lurking in the Desert.
Not only hunting it, but if you
break its parts well, we'll add
a bonus to your reward!
54191.descriptionJp:
砂漠に潜む盾蟹の調査を
お願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
見事、盾蟹の部位破壊を
してくれたら、報酬を上乗せ
しちゃいますよ！

50938.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
50938.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50938.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50938.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

51126.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
51126.description: I am a collector of equipment. Weapons and armor shine only when used. A mere pretty piece has no meaning. Do you not think so? I will lend you arms from my collection that shaped an era, so slay with them. If you need a helping hand, try two kinds of provocation against Lunastra.
51126.descriptionEn:
I am an equipment collector.
Arms shine only when they are
used. A mere pretty piece has
no meaning. Don't you agree?
I will lend you arms from my
collection that built an era,
so I want you to slay with them.
If you need aid, try two kinds
of taunts toward the Lunastra.
51126.descriptionJp:
私は装備コレクター。
武具は使われてこそ輝く。
ただの美品に意味は無い。
そうは思わないかね？
私のコレクションから
一時代を築いた武具を
お貸しするので、これで
討伐して頂きたい。
助力が必要なら、炎妃龍
に向かって２種類の挑発を
行ってみてくれ。

23437.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23437.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Merit (Beginning) x５０, Great Sword Merit (Middle) x６０, Great Sword Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23437.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
the following materials.
≪Great Sword Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Great Sword Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Great Sword Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you must
be GR 500 or higher, so
please take note.
23437.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪大剣勲・序≫５０個
≪大剣勲・中≫６０個
≪大剣勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

50479.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The floating wyvern seems to have invaded Mezeporuta's territory! It is thought merely to be passing overhead, but if it attacks we have not a moment's chance! Please slay it!
50479.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Post!
A ≪Yama Tsukami≫ seems to
have invaded Mezepolta!
It may only pass overhead,
but if it attacks, we're done
for! Please slay it!
50479.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
メゼポルタ領内に≪浮岳龍≫
が侵入したようです！
上空を通り過ぎるだけと思わ
れますが、襲われたらひとた
まりもありません！
討伐をお願いします！

26054.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26054.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26054.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

21991.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
21991.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Gold Rathian, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21991.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner well,
nyah? Treat your partner
right once in a while, nyah!
Now, the point, nyah. This
request is to hunt 1 Gold
Rathian, nyah. The reward is
materials to craft partner
gear, nyah! I'm counting on you!
21991.descriptionJp:
おう！そこの狩人さん！
アンタのパートニャーは元気
かニャ？たまには相棒孝行し
てやるニャ！
では、本題ニャ。今回の依頼
は金火竜１頭の狩猟ニャ。
報酬はパートニャー用武具の
生産素材だニャ！
たのんだニャー！

26498.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Fanged Beast Heavy Fang! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26498.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who capture many
Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Fanged
Beast's Heavy Fang! When
accepting or joining, deliver
the guarantee slip, then hunt
the specified monster. The slip
is not returned once you depart.
26498.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
メイン報酬は牙獣種の重牙！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

54947.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
54947.description: For further investigation of Odibatorasu, please destroy its head and back in addition to slaying it! If you do, I will pay more materials than usual as a reward!
54947.descriptionEn:
For a further survey of
Odibatorasu, please break its
head and back in addition to
slaying it!
If you manage it, we will pay
out more materials than usual
as your reward!
54947.descriptionJp:
オディバトラスのさらなる
調査のため、討伐に加え
頭部破壊と背中破壊をお願い
します！
達成いただけましたら、
報酬としていつもより多めの
素材をお支払いいたします！

26426.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐

15016.description: This official hunting exam has 3 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! Hunt the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land, 2 flying wyverns, and show us how it is done!
15016.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam has
three parts in all! To confirm
your skill once more, you'll
hunt every monster we specify!
Hunt the King of the Sky and
the Queen of the Land, the two
flying wyverns that dwell in
that land!
15016.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
３つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
かの地に棲まう空の王と陸の
女王、２頭の飛竜を見事狩猟
してみせるのじゃ！

58119.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを討伐
58119.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58119.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58119.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

28061.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
28061.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28061.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
28061.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

54260.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
54260.description: A pack of Cephalos seems to be blocking peddlers in the desert. We ask you to hunt their boss, the Cephadrome. Deal with the one at the center and the situation should improve. We thank you in advance.
54260.descriptionEn:
A pack of Cephalos in the Desert
is said to be blocking the
merchants' passage. So we ask
you to hunt their boss, the
≪Cephadrome≫. Deal with the
one at the center and things
should improve. Thank you
in advance.
54260.descriptionJp:
砂漠でガレオスの群れが行商
人の通行を邪魔しているよう
です。そこで、彼らのボス
≪砂竜≫の狩猟をお願いしま
す。中心となる存在を対処
できれば事態も好転するはず
です。それでは、よろしく
お願いします。

55296.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
55296.description: The damage caused by the Gore Magala has not subsided, but the survey is going well. I want you to continue hunting it. Word has come in that it has appeared at the tower. This time we will increase the reward as thanks from the guild. Head out to hunt it at once.
55296.descriptionEn:
The damage caused by the Gore
Magala has not stopped, but our
survey goes well. We ask you to
keep hunting it.
Word has come that one has
appeared at the Tower.
This time, as thanks from the
Guild, we've raised the reward.
Please go at once.
55296.descriptionJp:
黒蝕竜による被害は収まって
いないが、調査は順調だ。
引続き狩猟をお願いしたい。
塔に出現したという情報
が入った。
今回はギルドからのお礼とし
て報酬を増量させておく。
至急、狩猟に行ってほしい。

54406.description: The survey of the flower field is proceeding smoothly, and many new materials have been discovered. Most of what has been found can apparently be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Among Ｇ-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous lands, quite a few may take an interest.
54406.descriptionEn:
The survey of the Flower Field
is going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.
54406.descriptionJp:
花畑の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

54249.description: The survey of Tide Island is going well, and many new materials have been found. Word is that most of them can be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Many G-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous places, will surely be interested.
54249.descriptionEn:
The Tidal Island survey is
going well, and many new
materials are being found.
Most of them can be used to
craft and upgrade gear, or so
we hear. Many G Rank hunters
who venture into dangerous
lands may well be interested.
Won't you take part?
54249.descriptionJp:
潮島の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

50207.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
50207.description: A special job from the Guild to train hunters! Guild support is generous, and those who complete the quest are paid richly! Those with ambition should use this chance to rise!
50207.descriptionEn:
A special request from the Guild,
aimed at training up hunters!
The Guild's support is generous,
and those who complete the quest
are paid a handsome reward!
Let those with ambition take this
chance and rise higher!
50207.descriptionJp:
ギルドからハンターの育成
を目的とした特別な依頼だ！
ギルドからのサポートも厚
く、クエストを達成した者
には潤沢な報酬が支払われ
る！志しある者はこれを機
に駆け上がるのだ！

23226.description: There has been a report of a white shadow sighted in the swamp of an unsurveyed region. Please head out to hunt it to secure safety. Khezu attacks without making any sound at all. It is difficult even to detect, so take great care not to be caught off guard.
23226.descriptionEn:
In the uncharted reaches of
the Swamp, a Khezu has been
reported. Head out and hunt
it to keep the area safe.
Khezu attacks without making
a single sound. Finding one is
hard enough, so take great
care not to be caught off
guard.
23226.descriptionJp:
未調査地域の沼地で、
白影の発見報告がありました。
安全確保のために、
狩猟へ向かって下さい。
フルフルは一切音を発さずに
襲い掛かってきます。
発見することも困難ですが、
不意を突かれないよう、
十分注意してください。

50124.description: To chase a reward this far, what spirit! The materials everyone wants drop in plenty, but this Lao-Shan Lung is strong, so go at it as if it were a Hardcore quest! Ah, note that you need a Festival Proof to accept it.
50124.descriptionEn:
Getting this reward too shows
real guts, nyah! You'll get
all sorts of materials folks
crave, but this ≪Lao-Shan Lung≫
is strong, so go in thinking
it's a ≪Hardcore Quest≫, nyah!
Oh, you need a ≪Festival Proof≫
to accept, so be aware, nyah.
50124.descriptionJp:
この褒賞までゲットするとは
見上げた根性ニャン！みんな
欲しがる素材がいろいろ出る
けど、この≪老山龍≫は強い
から、≪剛種クエスト≫の
つもりで向かうといいニャン！
あ、受注には≪祭典の証≫が
必要だから気をつけるニャン。

23526.description: To you who upgraded the Entra GF series to LV7! I have prepared a quest to support you with upgrade materials for the Entra GX series armor! Please use it!
23526.descriptionEn:
For those who upgraded the Entora
GF Series to LV7!
We've prepared a quest to
support you with upgrade
materials for the armor
"Entora GX Series"!
Please make good use of it!
23526.descriptionJp:
エントラGFシリーズをＬＶ７
まで強化できたあなたへ！
防具「エントラGXシリーズ」
の強化素材をサポートする
クエストを用意しました！
ぜひ、ご活用ください！

63343.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63343.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the dual blades, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63343.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena I have
loosed a ≪Rathian≫ of great
power that acts in ways you
would never expect.
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me that
skill before me!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
far more than your daily efforts
would ever bring you.
63343.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪雌火竜≫を放ってある。
双剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

53117.description: If you like, let us go hunting together! Wear a lovely Lance shaped like a cute Christmas tree that spins round and round! Do you need a cape too? Let us begin a stylish hunt together! Let us hunt loads of Gaushika!
53117.descriptionEn:
If you like,
let's go hunting together!
Wearing a lovely Lance shaped
like a cute tree that spins
round and round!
Do I need a cape too?
A stylish hunt,
let's start it together now!
Let's slaughter Gargwa!
53117.descriptionJp:
よかったら
いっしょに狩り行きましょ！
クルクルと回る、かわいいツ
リーの形をした、素敵なラン
スを身に着けて！
マントも必要かしら？
スタイリッシュな狩り
を、さあ一緒に始めましょう
！ガウシカ狩りまくろ！

23608.description: The Variant Species Hyujikiki has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23608.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Hyujikiki≫
has grown ferociously strong
and keeps rampaging.
At this rate it is very
dangerous. Prepare fully
before you set out to survey it.
23608.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ヒュジキキ≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

50353.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
50353.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the fangs of a Blangonga will also grant a special ingredient. A Blangonga's fangs can only be broken with the Fire element.
50353.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Blangonga's fangs,
we will also grant you some special
ingredients as an extra reward.
Blangonga's fangs can only be
broken with the Fire attribute.
Please keep that in mind.
50353.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
雪獅子の牙を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。
雪獅子の牙は火属性でのみ破
壊できます。

50489.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Espinas. I am counting on you!
50489.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
Word is you've hit HR31.
So I've got a favor to ask,
and the pay's a full set of
weapon materials.
Easy job, really—just run
out there and slay an Espinas
for me and we're square.
I'm counting on you!
50489.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってエスピナスを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54893.description: We continue the investigation of Toridokuresu. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54893.descriptionEn:
We will continue our survey of
Toridcless.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we'd be glad if
you did!
Hunters, thank you for your
cooperation!
54893.descriptionJp:
トリドクレスの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

26682.objectiveJp: ハーフチケット白１枚の納品
26682.description: A quest reserved for hunters who have earned excellent results in official hunting tournaments! You can get your hands on an HC Ticket. Once you have made your mark in an official tournament and obtained a Half Ticket White, come and see me!
26682.descriptionEn:
This quest is only for hunters
who scored well in the
official hunting tournament!
You can get an "HC Ticket."
If you did well in the
official tournament and got a
"Half Ticket White," come
and join us!
26682.descriptionJp:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「ＨＣチケット」が、
手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を
入手したら、ぜひ来てくれ！

26127.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
26127.description: Gendrome is the boss of a pack of Genprey, and as you'd expect it's a size larger than they are. It flinches less easily than Velocidrome, so if you get greedy with attacks you'll be countered. Watch out for its paralyzing attacks too!
26127.descriptionEn:
≪Gendrome≫ is the boss of
the ≪Genprey≫ pack, and
just as you'd expect, a
size bigger than them.
It flinches less than a
≪Velocidrome≫, so greedy
attacks invite a counter.
Watch its paralysis too!
26127.descriptionJp:
≪ドスゲネポス≫は、≪ゲネ
ポス≫たちの群れのボスで、
やっぱり≪ゲネポス≫よりも
ひとまわり大きいです。
≪ドスランポス≫よりも怯み
づらい敵なので、欲張って攻
撃したら、反撃されますよ。
麻痺攻撃にも要注意です！

11057.description: If you're going after Basarios, it's best to search the rocky areas! It often hides by blending in with the rocks! If you plan to do some mining, by all means deliver Coal! It's a prized energy source!
11057.descriptionEn:
If you're going after a
≪Basarios≫, try searching the
rocky areas! It often hides
among the rocks, you see.
If you plan to mine, then by
all means deliver ≪Coal≫!
It's a prized energy source,
that stuff!
11057.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫の狩猟に臨む
なら岩場から探してみるとい
いですよ！岩に紛れて隠れて
るケースが多いですからね！
採掘をする予定があるなら
是非とも≪燃石炭≫を納品し
てく下さい！エネルギー源と
して重宝される品なんです！

62380.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62380.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62380.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.
62380.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。思い出よりも追憶が
大切なかた、祭典の証をご用
意の上、ぜひご参加ください。
出発後は、祭典の証の返却が
できませんので、ご注意を。

55418.description: We have received a report that 2 Violent Wyverns appeared in the sea of trees. If we leave them be, these monsters said to communicate their intentions to one another, people may be attacked. To prevent damage before it happens, please head to the site at once and hunt them.
55418.descriptionEn:
We received a report that two
≪Abiorugu≫ have appeared in the
Great Forest.
They are said to communicate
with one another, and if left
alone, people may be attacked.
To prevent harm before it
happens, head to the site at
once and hunt them.
55418.descriptionJp:
樹海に２頭の≪獰竜≫が出現
したとの報告を受けました。
互いに意思を通わせるモンス
ターだと言われている彼らを
放っておくと、襲われる人が
出るかもしれません。被害を
未然に防ぐためにも、至急現
地に向かい、狩猟をお願いし
ます。

1043.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
1043.description: A subspecies of Gypceros seems to have appeared in the swamp! Word is its body color is purplish and its appearance even more eerie! It likes to collect shiny things, and if you break its crest you may sometimes get a precious crystal!
1043.descriptionEn:
A subspecies of the Poison
Wyvern ≪Gypceros≫ has appeared
in the Swamp! Word is its hide
is purplish and even creepier
than usual, yeah?
Break the crest of that
shiny-thing collector, and you
might get a rare crystal!
1043.descriptionJp:
毒怪鳥≪ゲリョス≫の亜種が
沼地に現れたらしい！体色が
紫がかってて一層不気味な姿
だって話だぜ？光り物を好み
集める、ヤツのトサカを破壊
できれば貴重なクリスタルが
手に入ることもあるらしい！

53277.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
53277.description: The doll platform had been broken. Is that to be permitted? It is not, is it? I have a suspect in mind. So I thought the Emperor and I would punish them in the inner hall, but everyone stopped me. Would you punish them in place of the Emperor and me? Yes. Thoroughly, of course.
53277.descriptionEn:
The hina doll tier was broken.
Can that be allowed? It cannot,
can it? I have a suspect in
mind. So I thought the Emperor
and I would punish them, but
everyone stopped us.
Would you punish them in place
of the Emperor and me?
Yes. Thoroughly, of course.
53277.descriptionJp:
雛壇が壊されていたの。これ
が許されていいの？許されま
せんよね？犯人の目星はつい
ているのです。だから、私と
内裏で懲らしめようと思った
のですが皆に止められてしま
いました。私と内裏の代わり
に懲らしめてくれませんか？
ええ。もちろん徹底的に。

21336.description: You want my horn? Hmm, I cannot give it for money or goods. It seems there are folk in the desert just now who have a feud with this horn and with the scar on my face, so if you hunt them and show me your strength I might give it to you.
21336.descriptionEn:
So you want my Horn?
Hmm, I cannot hand it over for
money or goods. Seems there are
folk in the Desert right now
with a grudge tied to this Horn
and the scar on my face, so if
you hunt them and show me your
strength, I might give it to you.
21336.descriptionJp:
俺の角笛が欲しいってか？
うーん、金や物じゃ渡せねぇ
なぁ。どうやらいま砂漠に、
この角笛、そして俺の顔の
傷と因縁がある連中がいる
らしいから、あいつらを狩猟
して力を示してくれたら
やってもいいぞ。

21786.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62383.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
62383.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62383.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!
62383.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を猟団の仲間と行う
のだ。支給品も一切用意
しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

21694.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
21694.description: We have reports that Kushala Daora is currently flying toward Mezeporuta. Hunters confident in their skill should meet it at the interception base and slay it, making use of the abundant supplies and interception weapons.
21694.descriptionEn:
Reports have come in that a
Kushala Daora is flying toward
Mezeporuta right now.
Hunters confident in their skill
should intercept it at the Base,
and use the plentiful supplies
and the interception weapons to slay it.
21694.descriptionJp:
現在、メゼポルタに向けて、
風翔龍が飛来中との報告が
ありました。
腕に自信のあるハンターは、
≪迎撃拠点≫で迎え撃ち、
豊富な支給品と、迎撃兵器を
利用して、討伐してください。

55844.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55844.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55844.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

54212.description: We are seeking hunters to help investigate the Barbarian Wyvern that appeared in the highlands. The Barbarian Wyvern basically acts alone, but that is likely because it is strong enough not to need a pack. This is a dangerous request, open only to hunters with a solid record.
54212.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to
help survey the ≪Gurenzeburu≫
that appeared in the Highlands.
It normally acts alone, but
that is likely because it is
so strong it has no need to
pack together.
This is a dangerous request;
only proven hunters need apply.
54212.descriptionJp:
高地に出現した蛮竜を
調査するため、協力して頂け
るハンターを募集いたします。
蛮竜は基本的に単体で行動
していますが、それは自身が
強いため、群れる必要が無い
からだと思われます。
十分な実績を持ったハンター
でなくては危険な依頼です。

55805.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55805.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55805.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
55805.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

55806.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55806.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55806.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
55806.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

21549.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21549.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21549.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21549.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

23246.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐

1085.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
1085.description: Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is an Elder Dragon said to be the incarnation of fire. It feels as though this old tower's whole environment fights on her side. Do not waste thought on impossible things like capture; repel her again and again to wear down her strength, and slay her after a long battle.
1085.descriptionEn:
Lunastra, the Flame Empress
Dragon, is an Elder Dragon
said to be fire incarnate.
This old Tower's whole
environment favors her.
Forget capture. Repel her again
and again, then win a long fight.
1085.descriptionJp:
炎妃龍ナナ・テスカトリは炎
の化身とも云われる古龍よ。
この古き塔の環境が全て彼女
に味方してる感じがするわ。
捕獲など無理なことは考えず
撃退をくり返し体力を削り、
長期戦の末に討伐するのよ。

61627.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
61627.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
61627.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

1039.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
1039.description: Iodrome hits harder per blow than Velocidrome or Gendrome! If you feel your life is in danger, deliver the Specialty Mushrooms that grow in the swamp! Aging them in a Maka Pickling Jar is fine as well!
1039.descriptionEn:
≪Iodrome≫ hits harder per
blow than Velocidrome or
Gendrome!
If your life feels at risk,
deliver ≪Special Mushrooms≫
from the swamp! Aging them
in a ≪Maka Pot≫ is fine too!
1039.descriptionJp:
≪ドスイーオス≫はドスラン
ポスや、ドスゲネポスに比べ
一発単位の攻撃力が高いぞ！
身の危険を感じたら、沼地に
生えている≪特産キノコ≫を
納品してくれ！≪マカ漬けの
壷≫で熟成にしてもいいぞ！

54989.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Blood Devouring Wyvern in the new arena! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
54989.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
lance, face the ≪Baruragaru≫
in the New Great Arena and
show the skill you have
honed!
If you succeed in hunting it,
you will earn even more
rewards than your daily
efforts bring you.
54989.descriptionJp:
槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50745.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50745.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50745.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50745.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

54633.description: To express our gratitude to everyone who has been enjoying MHF-G, we have prepared a place for exchange. We hope you will take this opportunity to visit. We await you all.
54633.descriptionEn:
To express our thanks to all
of you who enjoy MHF-G every
day, we have prepared a place
to gather and mingle. We hope
you will take this chance to
come and join us.
We look forward to seeing
you all there.
54633.descriptionJp:
日ごろよりＭＨＦ−Ｇを
お楽しみ頂いている皆さま
に感謝の気持ちをお伝えす
るため、交流の場をご用意
させていただきました。この
機会にぜひお越しいただけ
ればと思います。皆様のお
越しをお待ちしております。

50209.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲
50209.description: T-terrible! A fearsome secret weapon's design document was eaten by a Yian Kut-Ku! I managed to bring it to the Great Arena, but I cannot do anything about it... Please! Capture it for me!
50209.descriptionEn:
Th-this is bad!
The blueprints for a terrifying
secret weapon were eaten by a
≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
I managed to lure it into the
Great Arena, but I can't do
anything more myself...
Please! Go capture it for me!
50209.descriptionJp:
た、大変だ！
恐るべき秘密兵器の設計書が
≪イャンクック≫に食べられ
てしまったんだ！
どうにか、ヤツを大闘技場へ
はつれてきたが俺ではどうし
ようもなさそうだ...。頼む！
ヤツを捕獲してきてくれ！

60563.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60563.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is
≪Espinas≫!
Going after a monster all on
your own, that spirit is
truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a fine top ranking!
Also, this time it's Origin
Species weapons only! Choose
carefully!
60563.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪エスピナス≫だ！
たった１人で
モンスターを狩ろうという
その心意気、誠にあっぱれ！
自らに打ち勝ち、見事上位
に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

61535.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Fanged Beast Heavy Fang! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61535.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who capture many
Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Fanged
Beast's Heavy Fang! When
accepting or joining, deliver
the guarantee slip, then hunt
the specified monster. The slip
is not returned once you depart.
61535.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
メイン報酬は牙獣種の重牙！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

55411.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55411.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55411.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく討究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

61731.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
61731.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! The rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61731.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim and
bias, I hold a weapon-limited
special exercise! Meet the
conditions and bring whatever
equipment you like!
The rewards are ≪Energy Drink≫
and coins!
61731.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
報酬は≪元気ドリンコ≫や
コインだぞ！

62611.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62611.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62611.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62611.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

56115.description: This is terrible! Help me! I have to deliver scorching-zero dragon materials right now, but the materials are late arriving! Would you break the parts that yield the materials I need within 8 minutes! Then I can just make it! There is plenty of reward for you, so please!
56115.descriptionEn:
This is bad! Help me!
I have to deliver Scorching Zero
Dragon materials right now, but
the shipment is running late!
Within eight minutes, break the
parts that yield the materials
we need!
That should just make it!
There's a big reward in it!
56115.descriptionJp:
大変だ！助けてくれ！
灼零龍の素材をいますぐ
納品しなきゃいけないのに、
素材の到着が遅れてる！
８分以内に必要な素材の
部位を破壊してくれないか！
そうすれば何とか間に合う！
お礼の報酬もたくさんあるか
ら頼むよ！

56046.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Khezu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Long Sword, Tonfa, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56046.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to forge one Supremacy
weapon from a Supremacy Khezu
and upgrade it two stages, plus
Porta Card Sakura worth Gz.
The weapon types you can forge
are Dual Blades, Long Sword,
Tonfa, Light Bowgun, Heavy
Bowgun or Bow.
Please use this to forge and
upgrade your favorite.
56046.descriptionJp:
辿異種フルフルの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、太刀、
穿龍棍、軽弩、重弩、弓の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

53246.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
53246.description: Unyanya! Long time no see, meow! The Dark Cat Pack's turn has come again, meow! First a tiny little test, meow! It is an easy quest, but clear it and I will give you a precious Dark Cat Pack Seal, White, meow! Even the Dark Cat Pack has mercy, meow!
53246.descriptionEn:
Unya nya!
It's been a while, nya!
The Dark Cat Gang's turn has
come around again, nya!
First, just a tiny little test, nya!
It's an easy quest, nya, but
clear it and I'll give you the
precious ≪Dark Cat Gang
Seal: White≫, nya!
Even the Dark Cat Gang has
some pity, nya!
53246.descriptionJp:
ウニャニャ！
久しぶりだニャ！
再び闇猫団の出番が
やってきたニャ！
まずはほんのコテ調べニャ！
簡単なクエストニャけど
クリアできれば貴重な
≪闇猫団シール・白≫を
くれてやるニャ！
闇猫団にも情けはあるニャ！

61821.description: A quest where delivering 5 Festival Certificates earns you Festival Memories as a reward. Be sure to carry your Festival Certificates when you depart, and deliver them after you arrive.
61821.descriptionEn:
Deliver 5 ≪Festival Proofs≫
and you will receive a
≪Festival Memory≫ as your
reward.

Be sure to carry the
≪Festival Proofs≫ with you
when you depart, then
deliver them on arrival.
61821.descriptionJp:
≪祭典の証≫を５枚納品する
ことで≪祭典の思い出≫が
報酬として貰えるクエスト
です。

クエスト出発時に必ず、
≪祭典の証≫をお持ちに
なって、到着後に納品して
ください。

60124.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟

26704.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26704.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Fermi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26704.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secret
art of forging equipment have been
found on monsters slain all over
the land, or so I hear!
Once you get the "Fermi Memo",
come alone, like a man! Bring it
to this workshop master!
I'll show you some good work!
26704.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪フェルミメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

61249.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23578.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
23578.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23578.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23578.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55210.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
55210.description: We ask for your help in surveying the Voljang that dwells in the volcano! Break its head and sever its tail as well as slaying it, and we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
55210.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help surveying
the ≪Crimson Lotus Lion≫ that
lives in the Volcano!
Beyond slaying it, break its
head and tail and we will add
to your reward.
Please lend your strength to
our research!
55210.descriptionJp:
火山に生息する≪紅蓮獅子≫
の調査にご協力をお願いしま
す！
討伐するだけでなく≪紅蓮獅
子≫の頭部と尻尾を破壊して
くれたら報酬を上乗せいたし
ます。
どうか我々の研究に力を貸し
てください！

62738.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62738.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62738.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62738.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

1084.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
1084.description: Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is an Elder Dragon said to be the incarnation of fire. It feels as though this old tower's whole environment fights on her side. Do not waste thought on impossible things like capture; repel her again and again to wear down her strength, and slay her after a long battle.
1084.descriptionEn:
Lunastra, the Flame Empress
Dragon, is an Elder Dragon
said to be fire incarnate.
This old Tower's whole
environment favors her.
Forget capture. Repel her again
and again, then win a long fight.
1084.descriptionJp:
炎妃龍ナナ・テスカトリは炎
の化身とも云われる古龍よ。
この古き塔の環境が全て彼女
に味方してる感じがするわ。
捕獲など無理なことは考えず
撃退をくり返し体力を削り、
長期戦の末に討伐するのよ。

62074.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
62074.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
62074.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
62074.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

61054.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の狩猟
61054.description: A report has come in that hunters who headed for the Snowy Mountains were beaten back by 2 Tigrex! Brave hunters confident in their skill, set out to rescue the injured and hunt the Tigrex!
61054.descriptionEn:
We have a report that hunters who
headed to the Snowy Mountains were
beaten back by 2 ≪Tigrex≫!
Brave hunters confident in their
skill, set out to rescue the wounded
and hunt the Tigrex!
61054.descriptionJp:
雪山に向かったハンター達が
２頭の≪轟竜≫の返り討ちに
あったとの報告が入った！
腕に覚えのある、勇敢なハン
ターは、負傷者の救出および、
轟竜の狩猟に向かうのじゃ！

54965.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
54965.description: A trial quest for the G10 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy the new G10 monster, the Emperor Wyvern Guanzorumu, a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
54965.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
"G10 Preview Event."
Please enjoy G10's new monster,
the Emperor's Conquering Dragon
≪Guanzorumu≫, ahead of time!
The time limit is 10 minutes.
54965.descriptionJp:
「Ｇ１０先行体験会」の
体験会用のクエストです。
Ｇ１０の新モンスター
帝征龍≪グァンゾルム≫を
一足早くお楽しみください！
制限時間は１０分です。

62886.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62886.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62886.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

55322.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55322.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55322.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23351.description: The other day I took my girl to see the moon over Tide Island, and a Hyujikiki attacked us. I ran for my life and we came through unharmed, but she dumped me for it! Please! So that there is no second me, hunt that Hyujikiki!
23351.descriptionEn:
The other day I took my girl to see the
moon over the Tidal Island, and we were
attacked by a ≪Leaping Crimson Beast≫.
I ran for dear life and somehow came
out unharmed, but because of that
she dumped me!
Please! So that there is no second me,
hunt the ≪Leaping Crimson Beast≫
for us!
23351.descriptionJp:
先日、彼女を連れて潮島の月
を見に行ったら、≪跳緋獣≫
に襲われたんだ。死にもの狂
いで逃げてなんとか事無きを
得たんだが、そのせいで彼女
にフラれてしまったんだ！
頼む！第二の俺を出さないた
めにも、≪跳緋獣≫を狩猟し
てくれ！

56140.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
56140.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
56140.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

23312.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
23312.description: We are recruiting hunters to help investigate the Akura Jebia that appeared in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. Investigations of Akura Jebia always produce many casualties, and many are expected this time too. Please join only after making thorough preparations.
23312.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to
help survey the Akra Jebia
that appeared in the uncharted
Swamp.
Surveys of Akra Jebia always
produce many casualties, and
many are expected this time
as well.
Please prepare fully before
you take part.
23312.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域に出現した
アクラ・ジェビアを調査する
ため、協力して頂ける
ハンターを募集します。
アクラ・ジェビアの調査では、
いつも多くの被害が出ており
今回の調査でも、多くの被害
が予想されます。
万全の準備を整え、参加する
ようにお願いします。

62715.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62715.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62715.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62715.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

56156.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
56156.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56156.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.
56156.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫
をお持ちください。

21235.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21235.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21235.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21235.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

50145.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★３ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50145.descriptionEn:
Clear this request and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade G★3 monster G Rank
armor! Mind you, you won't get
G Rank materials here, so
gather those from other requests.
50145.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成してもらえ
れば、Ｇ★３モンスターの
Ｇ級防具強化に必要な素材
を入手できるぞ！ただし、
Ｇ級素材は入手できないか
ら、他の依頼で集めてくれ。

62850.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
62850.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of zenny and consumables! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62850.descriptionEn:
An urgent notice to all hunters!
On top of a training method that
efficiently builds experience,
right now you can get piles of
Zenny and consumables!
You cannot accept it back to
back, but a single run's effect
is enormous!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!
62850.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法に加え、今なら
大量のゼニーと消耗品が
入手できます！
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

50996.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50996.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50996.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Sword
and Shield, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
50996.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26036.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
26036.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26036.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26036.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

26177.description: Few people take on small jobs, so the guild has prepared a slightly larger reward than usual. A little mining on the side, and this job is child's play. Recommended! Just be warned, if you do not bring a pickaxe you are guaranteed to retire!
26177.descriptionEn:
Small odd jobs get few takers,
so the Guild prepared a
slightly bigger reward.
It's a quick job you can do
while mining. Recommended!
But if you don't bring a
pickaxe, you're guaranteed to
retire, so be careful!
26177.descriptionJp:
細々とした仕事は、受注者が
少ないので、ギルドでは心も
ち多めに報酬を用意しました。
採掘のついで･･･で、朝飯前
なこの仕事。オススメです！
ただし、ちゃんとピッケルを
用意していかないと、リタイ
ア確定なので、要注意です！

61563.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61563.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61563.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

55954.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55954.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55954.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

54567.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
54567.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54567.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54567.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

22168.description: This quest yields the following materials. Magnet Spike Soul (Beginning) x８５, Magnet Spike Soul (Middle) x１９５, Magnet Spike Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Magnet Spike Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
22168.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
the following materials.
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
22168.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪磁斬鎚魂・序≫８５枚
≪磁斬鎚魂・中≫１９５枚
≪磁斬鎚魂・極≫２７５枚
≪磁斬鎚魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

21614.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
21614.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Steamed Chestnut Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21614.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Steamed Chestnut
Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21614.descriptionJp:
蒸栗原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

26119.description: Conga is a small fanged beast with pink fur. If it turns its back and makes a suspicious motion, that's the sign of a fart attack, so beware! Being hit by it leaves you unable to use items for a while, so take care!
26119.descriptionEn:
≪Conga≫ are small fanged
beasts with pink fur.
If one turns its back and
acts strangely, that's the
sign of a fart attack!
Get hit and you can't use
items for a while, so
please be careful!
26119.descriptionJp:
≪コンガ≫は桃色の毛を持つ
小型の牙獣種です。
背を向けて訝しげな動きをし
たら、おなら攻撃の前兆なの
で要注意です！
おなら攻撃に当たると、しば
らくアイテムが使えなります
ので、気をつけて下さいね！

23378.description: The survey of White Lake is going well, and many new materials have been found. Word is that most of them can be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Many G-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous places, will surely be interested.
23378.descriptionEn:
The survey of White Lake is
going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.
23378.descriptionJp:
白湖の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

21943.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
21943.description: You there! I hear you produced a Dyuragaua weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Dyuragaua. I am counting on you!
21943.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you crafted a weapon
from the Ice Fox Dragon.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about upgrade materials
as pay?
It's an easy job. Just run
over and slay a Duramboros.
I'm counting on you!
21943.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
氷狐竜の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、
ひとっ走り行って
デュラガウアを討伐して
くれればいい。頼んだぜ！

56093.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
56093.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56093.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Daimyo Hermitaur.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56093.descriptionJp:
辿異種の盾蟹を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

54359.description: White and black wyverns have appeared at the summit of the Ancient Tower. These 2 are opposites by nature and could never appear in the same place. This must be called a reckless request. Yet I believe that you, with all your achievements, will find a way.
54359.descriptionEn:
White and black wyverns have
appeared at the top of the
Ancient Tower. These two are
opposites by nature, so they
could never appear in the same
place.
I must call this a reckless
request. But I believe that you,
with all your achievements,
will somehow see it through.
54359.descriptionJp:
古塔の頂部に、白と黒の飛竜
が現れました。本来この２頭
は、相反する存在であるため、
同じ場所に現れることはあり
えないことです。
これは、無謀な依頼と言わざ
るを得ません。しかし、数多
くの功績を残したあなたなら
なんとかしてくれると信じて
います。

23165.description: I am fed up! Ioprey have taken over the place where I always mine raw White Crystal! It is too dangerous to go mining! Mine it for me instead! Drive them off too and I will pay well.
23165.descriptionEn:
I'm at my wit's end!
Genprey have taken up residence
where I always mine white crystal
ore!
It's far too dangerous to go
and mine now! So go mine for me,
would you?
And if you shoo them off while
you're at it, I'll pay you well.
23165.descriptionJp:
もう嫌になっちゃうわ！
いつも白水晶の原石を採掘
している場所に、イーオスが
住み着いてしまったの！
これじゃ危なくって採掘に
行けないわ！　アタシの
代わりに採掘してきて頂戴！
ついでに奴らを追い払って
くれたら、御礼ははずむわよ。

51084.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51084.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Rajang will also grant a special ingredient.
51084.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Rajang's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51084.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
金獅子の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

23168.description: It happened when I went to the desert to gather ingredients for medicine. I had gathered enough and was about to head home when I ran into a pack of Galeos. They took every last bit of my precious ingredients. I will pay a fitting fee. Hunt them so that I can gather in safety.
23168.descriptionEn:
It was when I went to the Desert
to gather medicine materials.
Just as I'd gathered enough and
was about to head home, I ran
into a pack of Cephalos.
They made off with my precious
materials. I'll pay a fitting fee.
So they can be gathered safely,
go and slay them for me.
23168.descriptionJp:
薬の材料を採りに、砂漠へ
行った時のことじゃ。
材料も集まってさあ帰ろうと
いう時に、ガレオスの群れと
遭遇しての。貴重な薬の
材料を奪われてまったんじゃ。
相応の依頼料は払う。
安全に採取を行えるよう、
奴らを討伐して来てくれんか。

55567.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55567.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55567.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Switch Axe, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
reward far beyond what your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.
55567.descriptionJp:
剣斧を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

54397.description: I have made yet another new discovery! A lump of ice of high purity that will not melt, the Eternal Ice Block. Gather several and I can produce a beautiful blue block of ice. Help me gather the materials again and I will share the product.
54397.descriptionEn:
I've made yet another new
discovery! A chunk of ice of
high purity that hardly melts,
the "Eternal Ice Chunk." Gather
several and I can create a
beautiful azure ice chunk.
If you help me gather
materials again, I'll share
the results with you.
54397.descriptionJp:
わしはまたまた新たな発見を
した！純度が高くなかなか融
けない氷の塊「永久氷塊」、
これを複数集めれば、蒼く
美しい氷の塊を生成できるん
じゃ。
今回も素材の採取を手伝って
くれたら、生成物を分けて
やるぞい。

51044.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
51044.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the ears of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku will also grant a special ingredient.
51044.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Blue Yian Kut-Ku's ears,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51044.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
青怪鳥の耳を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

53158.description: We have information that a book for solving the mystery of the snow mountains is hidden in the Flower Field, blocking the way. To obtain that book, the key seems to be finding the boss hidden among the Bullfango that have multiplied in the Flower Field! Please investigate!
53158.descriptionEn:
We have word that a book to
solve the mystery of the blocked
Snowy Mountains path is hidden
in the Flower Field.
Apparently, getting that book
hinges on finding the boss
hidden among the Bullfango that
have swarmed the Flower Field!
Please look into it!
53158.descriptionJp:
花畑の中に、道を塞がれてし
まった雪山の謎を解くための
本が隠されているとの情報を
得ました。
なんでもその本を入手するに
は、花畑に大量発生したブル
ファンゴの中に紛れたボスを
探し出すことが鍵となるよう
です！調査をお願いします！

23248.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
23248.description: There is a report that a Gurenzeburu was encountered while exploring an unsurveyed region of the highlands. Continuing the survey as it stands will not yield the results we hope for. First we will hunt the Gurenzeburu and secure safety. Can someone take this on?
23248.descriptionEn:
While exploring unsurveyed parts
of the Highlands, a team reports
encountering a Gurenzeburu.
If we keep surveying as we are,
we won't get the results we
hoped for.
First we will hunt the
Gurenzeburu and secure safety.
Can someone take this on?
23248.descriptionJp:
高地の未調査地域を探索中に、
グレンゼブルと遭遇したと
報告がありました。
調査をこのまま続けても、
思ったような成果を得る事は
できないでしょう。
まずは、グレンゼブルを狩猟
し、安全を確保します。
どなたかお願いできますか？

22099.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22099.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22099.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

26435.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
26435.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.
26435.descriptionJp:
どこでこの話を聞きつけたか
は知らんが、ヤバい話には失
敗の救済など一切ないぞ？
ブツの用意もいいだろうな？
必要なブツの数は条件通りだ。
あとは、現地で１人で働いて
もらう。徒党を組むとナメた
真似するヤツが出るんでな。

55571.description: I've given up expecting anything in return from him. At this point, I'll be satisfied if he just comes hunting with me. White Day isn't only about gifts, after all. Returning a favor through action isn't bad either.
55571.descriptionEn:
I've stopped expecting anything
back from him. At this point,
I'll settle for him just coming
hunting with me.
White Day isn't only about
gifts, after all.
Returning a favor through
actions isn't bad either.
55571.descriptionJp:
あの人のお返しに期待するの
は止めたわ。この際一緒に狩
りに行ってくれるだけで満足
しましょう。
物だけがホワイトデーのお返
しというわけでは無いものね。
行動でお返しだって悪くは無
いわ。

62671.description: The savage wyvern confirmed in the Jungle has been found to be a beast wyvern species that never lived around Mezeporuta before. The Hunters Guild seems to have named it Abiorugu. Please investigate further.
62671.descriptionEn:
The ≪Tyrant Wyvern≫ confirmed
in the Jungle has been found to
be a Beast Wyvern species that
had never lived around
Mezepolta until now.
The Hunters Guild appears to
have named it ≪Abiorugu≫.
We ask for further surveys
of the area.
62671.descriptionJp:
密林で確認された≪獰竜≫
ですが、今までメゼポルタ
周辺には生息していなかった
獣竜種であることが
判明しました。
ハンターズギルドでは、
これを≪アビオルグ≫と
名付けたようです。
更なる調査をお願いします。

23285.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

62502.description: Hi there. Flower seller here. I planted the Iwahime Grass I got from a hunter in the highlands and lots of flowers bloomed. Hooray! By the way, I found a spot in the highlands where strange water springs up. I will trade that water for seeds I give you.
62502.descriptionEn:
Yoo-hoo. It's the flower girl.
I planted the Iwahime grass
a hunter gave me in the
Highlands, and lots of flowers
bloomed. Yay!
By the way, I found a spot in
the Highlands where strange
water springs up. I'll trade
it for seeds I hand out, hey.
62502.descriptionJp:
やっほー。花売りだよー。
ハンターさんからもらった
イワヒメ草を高地に植えたら
たくさんの花が咲いたよー。
やったね！
そういえば、高地で不思議な
水が湧く場所を見つけたんだ。
この水をわたしがあげた種と
交換してあげるよー。

11081.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
11081.description: Cephalos swim freely through the sand, and hunting them is hard work at the best of times. As for the boss, Cephadrome, it is no exaggeration to call it a battle of patience! It is important to force it above ground with loud noises and impacts!
11081.descriptionEn:
The Cephalos that swim freely
through the sand are a real pain
to hunt, and as for the boss,
"Cephadrome", it's no exaggeration
to call it a battle of patience!
It's important to force it above
ground with loud noise or impact!
11081.descriptionJp:
砂の中を自在に泳ぐガレオス
たちは、とにかく狩猟が大変
で、ボスの≪ドスガレオス≫
ときたら、それはもう根気と
の戦いといっても過言じゃ
ないです！大きな音や衝撃で
地上に出すのが大事ですよ！

61175.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61175.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61175.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

26310.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26310.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26310.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26310.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

12037.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品
12037.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern. True to the name, it sprays poison everywhere and thrashes about, a nuisance of a bird wyvern. It has a cunning side too, playing dead when it senses danger. Be careful.
12037.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ is known by
another name: Poison Bird.
Just as the name says, it
sprays poison and thrashes
about, a real nuisance. It
plays dead when danger
threatens. Do be careful.
12037.descriptionJp:
≪ゲリョス≫は別名、毒怪鳥
と呼ばれるモンスターだわ。
呼び名のとおり、毒液を吐き
散らして暴れまわる迷惑な怪
鳥なの。自分の身に危機を感
じると死に真似をするズル賢
い面もあるわ。注意してね。

40081.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil Earring.
40081.descriptionEn:
Here we distribute VISA
Production Tickets to hunters
who own Gothic equipment.
Please accept the quest while
wearing the Veil Earrings.
40081.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。ベイルイヤリング
を装備した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

63311.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63311.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63311.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63311.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

21712.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
21712.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Young Purple Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21712.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Young Violet Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21712.descriptionJp:
若紫原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55167.description: Slaying a Gravios raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55167.descriptionEn:
We prepared a quest where
slaying a Gravios raises your
standing and lets you obtain
the materials needed for G Rank
decorations at a good value.
Please make good use of it.
55167.descriptionJp:
グラビモスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

23709.description: A Basarios with a greatly developed body has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Basarios known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23709.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gravios≫ with a greatly
developed body has appeared.
The Guild classifies this individual
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will conduct a survey.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Gravios so far.
Please take care during the survey.
23709.descriptionJp:
躰が大きく発達した≪鎧竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの鎧竜より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

54667.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru G Rank Haku armor. By repeatedly slaying Zerureusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma GF Series Retsu Armor up to LV7.
54667.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪G-Rank Supremacy≫ armor
of the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Zerureusu, you can obtain
the materials needed to
upgrade the ≪Fierce≫ armor
"Stroma GF Series" up to
Lv7.
54667.descriptionJp:
≪喰血竜≫の≪Ｇ級覇種防具≫
を所持しているハンター向け
の依頼です。
ゼルレウスを繰り返し討伐す
ることで、
「ストロマGFシリーズ」
≪烈種防具≫ＬＶ７まで
の強化に必要な素材が入手で
きます。

60507.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
60507.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60507.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
60507.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

61560.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン青３個の納品
61560.description: A quest reserved for the 2nd Place server. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Blue) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61560.descriptionEn:
[2nd Place] A server-exclusive
quest.
For hunters who cleared the
guild-versus-guild Idaten Cup,
we have prepared a special
reward.
The more Blue Hunter Coins you
deliver, the better your chance
at rare materials.
61560.descriptionJp:
【２位】サーバー専用の
クエストです。
猟団対抗韋駄天杯をクリアさ
れたハンターに専用の報酬を
用意させていただきました。
ハンターコイン青の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

26158.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26158.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26158.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

61976.description: I am a musician who came from afar. Lately I have heard a rumor that at a certain hour a mysterious sound echoes from the swamp near this square. Would you go and find out what that sound is? I will provide the supplies and armor you need. It will not take much of your time, so please hurry.
61976.descriptionEn:
I am a musician who came from
far away. Lately I heard a rumor
that at a certain hour a strange
sound echoes from the swamp
near this square. Would you go
and find out what that sound is?
I will prepare whatever supplies
and armor you need. It will not
take much effort, so be quick.
61976.descriptionJp:
私は遠方から来た楽師の一人。
最近、この広場に近い沼地か
ら、ある時刻になると謎の音
が響き渡るという噂を聞いた。
その音とは何なのか調べてき
てくれないか？
必要な支給品や防具は私が用
意する。そんなに手間はとら
せないから、早いとこ頼むよ。

26511.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

55787.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Rathalos through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55787.descriptionEn:
You can get the materials
needed to craft one Supremacy
Rathalos weapon and take it
through its first upgrade,
plus Porta Card Sakura worth
Gz. Craftable weapon types:
Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance,
Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun,
or Bow. Use it for your favorite!
55787.descriptionJp:
辿異種リオレウスの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
双剣、鎚、銃槍、軽弩、
重弩、弓のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

62493.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
62493.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62493.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62493.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

50113.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50113.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50113.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.
50113.descriptionJp:
おい！とっておきの依頼が舞
い込んで来たぞ！受注できる
回数に限りはあるが、なんと
覇種の素材を分けてもらえる
らしい。しかも撃退だけでい
いらしいから、討伐できな
いってヤツにもオススメだな。
ただ、そうは言っても覇種は
覇種だ。絶対に油断するなよ。

62182.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐

63294.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63294.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63294.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63294.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

62793.description: At last, the weakest Mosswine in history has appeared! Its weakness sets it apart from every Mosswine before, so please hunt one and see for yourself! You there, who could not beat a Mosswine! Now is your chance!
62793.descriptionEn:
At last, the weakest ≪Mosswine≫
in history has appeared!
A weakness that sets it apart
from every ≪Mosswine≫ before,
go slay it and see for yourself!
You there, the one who couldn't
beat a Mosswine!
Now is your perfect chance!
62793.descriptionJp:
ついに出ました史上最高に貧
弱な≪モス≫！
今までの≪モス≫とは一線を
画すその弱さ、是非実際に討
伐して確かめてみてください！
モスに勝てなかった
そこのアナタ！
今が絶好のチャンスですよっ！

21858.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21858.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Stroma F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21858.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
upgrade materials for all five
parts of the ≪Tenran Armor≫
Stroma F Series.
To accept the quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
21858.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
ストロマＦシリーズの５部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

58022.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58022.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58022.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58022.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
