出発をお勧めします。

54125.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
54125.description: I am making warm clothes, so could you gather materials for me? What I want is Blangonga fur. It is hard and not pleasant to the touch, but it is warm and perfect as a material. If you just hunt it, I will do the skinning myself. I am counting on you.
54125.descriptionEn:
I'm making warm clothes—could
you gather the materials?
What I need is Blangonga fur.
It's stiff and not pleasant to
touch, but it's warm and perfect
as a material. If you'll just do
the hunting, I'll handle the
carving. I'm counting on you.
54125.descriptionJp:
暖かい服を作るんだけど、
素材集めを頼めるかしら。
お願いしたいのは雪獅子の毛。
硬くてさわり心地もいまいち
なんだけど、暖かくて素材に
は最適なの。狩猟さえして
くれれば、あとは私の方で
剥ぎ取るわ。頼むわね。

50366.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

62118.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62118.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Desert. The tail crystal scorpion Akura Vashimu has also been confirmed in the very middle of the Desert. Slay that one too while you are there! I have prepared armor for it as well! Now off you go!
62118.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor! This
time you will explore the Desert
for me. In the very middle of
the Desert, the Tail Crystal
Scorpion ≪Akura Vashimu≫ has
been confirmed as well.
Slay that one too while you are
at it! I even prepared armor for
that purpose! Now go and do it!
62118.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、砂漠を探索してきて
もらう。砂漠のど真ん中には
尾晶蠍≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫
も確認されているようだ。
ついでにそいつも討伐してき
たまえ！そのための防具も予
め用意してやったぞ！さあ頑
張ってこい！

54268.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

21680.description: I want to repair my weapon, but I am a little short of materials! To depart on the hunt as soon as possible, I want your help. So, let us trade the Gurenzeburu's Fine Scale for my Paw Medal. Please!
21680.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon, but I
am a little short on materials!
I must set out hunting as soon as
possible, so I truly need your
help.
So how about we trade your
≪Gurenzeburu Scale+≫ for my
≪Pawprint Medal≫?
I am counting on you!
21680.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいのだが、
少し素材が足りないのだ！
一刻も早く狩りへ出発する為、
ぜひとも協力してほしい。
そこで、≪蛮竜の上鱗≫と
私の≪肉球のメダル≫を交換
しようではないか。
よろしく頼む！

21472.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21472.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21472.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21472.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54279.description: Hunter there. Do not be surprised by the high contract fee. This job exchanges your Ｇｚ for twenty Porta Cards Sakura. Perfect for growing your assets, would you not say?
54279.descriptionEn:
Hey there, hunter. Don't be
shocked by the contract fee.
This request trades your Gz
for 20 ≪Porta Card Sakura≫.
I think it's perfect for
growing your assets.
So, what do you say?
54279.descriptionJp:
そこのハンターさん。契約金
の高さに驚いてはダメよ。
これは、あなたのＧｚを
≪ポルタカード桜≫２０枚と
交換する依頼なの。
資産を増やすのに最適だと
思うけど、いかがかしら？

55566.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55566.description: Hunter who would master the heavy gun, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55566.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
reward far beyond what your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.
55566.descriptionJp:
重銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

55978.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55978.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55978.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

21887.description: This is the quest for the HR100 Breakthrough Trial. After accepting the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, please depart on the quest alone.
21887.descriptionEn:
This is the quest for the HR100
Breakthrough Trial. After
accepting the trial from the
Guild Master or the HR Trial
board, please depart on the
quest alone.
21887.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００突破試練のための
クエストです。ギルドマス
ターまたはＨＲ試練掲示板
から試練を受注した後、
お一人でクエストへ出発して
ください。

23541.description: The Variant Species Tigrex has appeared once more. Its claws have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23541.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Tigrex≫ has
appeared once more.
Its claws have grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
even more power. Please take
great care in your survey.
23541.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ティガレックス≫が
再び現れました。
爪はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

54860.description: The survey team that went to the desert has sighted a gigantic Odibatorasu. Reports also say it launches powerful attacks using the sand. Hunters confident in their skill, prepare fully and investigate.
54860.descriptionEn:
From the survey team sent to the
Desert came a sighting of a giant
≪Doragyurosu≫.
There are also reports that it
launches powerful attacks that
make use of the sand.
Hunters confident in their skill,
prepare well before you take on
this survey.
54860.descriptionJp:
砂漠に向かった調査団より、
巨大な≪弩岩竜≫の目撃情報
がありました。
砂を利用した強力な攻撃を
仕掛けてくるとの報告も
上がっています。
腕に自信のあるハンターさん、
十分な準備の上、調査をお願
いします。

62344.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62344.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62344.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62344.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

60647.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
60647.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Daimyo Hermitaur. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60647.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫!
Achieve it together with your
Guild mates.
Teamwork is what counts here,
take a fine top ranking!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only!
60647.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

55857.description: Hunter who would master the Magnetic Slash Hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn a reward far beyond the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
55857.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Magnet Spike, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
reward far beyond what your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.
55857.descriptionJp:
磁斬鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

21126.description: Gravios is known as the Tyrant of the Blaze; to challenge the outer shell it grew to absurd hardness by eating coal and ore, you need well-honed equipment. Slipping past the Armor Wyvern to deliver Blast Rock is fine as well, you know?
21126.descriptionEn:
≪Gravios≫ is known as the
Emperor of Blazing Heat. To
face the shell it grew from
eating coal and ore, you
need finely honed gear.
Slipping past the Armor
Wyvern to deliver ≪Blast Stone≫?
21126.descriptionJp:
≪グラビモス≫は灼熱の覇者
とも呼ばれる存在、燃石や鉱
石を食べ、異常なまでの硬度
に発達した外殻に挑むには、
相当に磨かれた装備が必要。
鎧竜の目を盗んで≪火薬岩≫
を納めてくれてもいいわよ？

55890.description: This is an emergency request. A sinister presence from that land grows stronger by the day. Even if we wish to identify the monster behind it, our surveyors cannot approach. Any hunter able to deal with this unknown monster should hurry to the site at once!
55890.descriptionEn:
An emergency request.
An ominous presence from that
land grows stronger by the day.
We would identify the monster
behind it, but our surveyors
cannot even get close.
Any hunter able to deal with
this unidentified monster should
rush to the site at once!
55890.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。
彼の地より凶いの気配が
日に日に強くなっています。
原因となっているモンスター
を特定しようにも調査員で
は近づくこともできません。
この正体不明のモンスターに
対処できるハンターはただち
に現地へ急行してください！

61716.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の捕獲
61716.description: Thank you for always taking our requests! We'll be introducing many new requests from here on, but before that, how about a little game? Treat it as a warm-up for other difficult quests and take it easy!
61716.descriptionEn:
Thank you so much for always
taking our requests!
We'll keep introducing plenty of
new requests, but before that,
how about a little game?
Think of it as a warm-up for
other tough quests, feel free
to take it easy!
61716.descriptionJp:
いつも僕たちの依頼を受けて
くれて、本当にありがとう！
今後もたくさんの新しい
依頼を紹介させてもらうけど、
その前にこんな遊びはどう？
他の困難なクエストに向けた
肩慣らしのつもりで、気楽に
受けてもらってかまわないよ！

61052.description: A rare report has come in that Rathian are descending on the desert one after another! Hunting the queen, a tough foe even alone, again and again will be quite difficult! Those confident in their skill, and those who need Rathian materials, sign up!
61052.descriptionEn:
An unusual report has come in:
Rathians are descending on the
Desert one after another!
Hunting these queens, each one
a formidable foe, back to back
will be quite a challenge!
Those confident in their skill, and
those needing Rathian parts, join in!!
61052.descriptionJp:
砂漠地帯にリオレイアが次々
と舞い降りていると、珍しい
報告が入りました！１頭でも
難敵となる女王を連続で狩猟
することは、かなりの困難と
なるでしょう！腕に自信のあ
る方や、レイアの素材が必要
な方もふるってご参加を！！

60653.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Yian Garuga. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60653.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is a
Unique Individual
≪Yian Garuga≫!
Achieve it together with your
Guild mates.
Teamwork is what counts here,
take a fine top ranking!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only!
60653.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
特異個体の
≪イャンガルルガ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！今回は辿異武器限定で
開催されているぞ！

50290.description: Instructor trainee Nyanya! In this quest I'll give you the materials so you can reliably craft the Gogo series armor, which is especially recommended for newcomers, nya. Those of you who have not crafted it yet should give it a try, nya!
50290.descriptionEn:
Instructor Trainee Cat, nya!
In this quest, I'll give you the
materials to reliably forge the
armor "Gogo Series," which is
especially recommended for
you rookies, nya.
If you haven't forged it yet,
give it a try, nya!
50290.descriptionJp:
教官見習ネコニャ！
このクエストでは、
特に新米諸君にオススメの
防具「ゴゴシリーズ」を、
確実に生産できるように
素材をあげちゃうニャ。
まだ生産してない諸君は
やってみるといいニャ！

53282.description: I have surveyed the highlands a good deal, but there is still much I do not know. That is how fascinating a land it is. So I have one request for you. I want you to gather Iwahime Grass without damaging the Elpe. Also, would you write up the conditions at the time as a report and deliver it?
53282.descriptionEn:
We've surveyed the Highlands a
good deal, but there's still so
much we don't know. That's how
appealing this land is.
So I have one favor for you.
Without hurting any Elpe, I want
you to gather Iwahime Herbs.
Also, could you write up the
situation there in a report?
53282.descriptionJp:
高地をだいぶ調べているが、
まだ知らないことがたくさん
ある。それだけ魅力的な土地
なんだよな。そこでキミには
ひとつお願いが。エルペを傷
付けることなく、イワヒメ草
を採って来て欲しい。
また、その際の状況をレポー
トにして届けてくれないか？

51052.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
51052.description: You can obtain the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of the Transcendent armor Narga series. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
51052.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
needed to forge and upgrade one
piece of the Migrant Armor
"Narga Series."
It's a bargain quest, so please
give it a try!
51052.descriptionJp:
遷悠防具「ナルガシリーズ」
の１部位分の生産・強化に
必要な素材が入手可能です。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

54735.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
54735.description: Great numbers of Yian Kut-Ku seem to be breaking out around Mezeporta! Hunters, please help slay the Yian Kut-Ku! If you do it splendidly, we will give you a higher reward than usual!
54735.descriptionEn:
Yian Kut-Ku seem to be breaking
out in great numbers around
Mezepolta!
Hunters, please lend your aid in
slaying them!
If you slay them well, we'll pay
a higher reward than usual!
54735.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に怪鳥が
大量発生しているようです！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
怪鳥の討伐に協力してくだ
さい！
見事討伐いただけましたら、
通常より高い報酬金をお渡し
します！

21688.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
21688.description: Have you heard of the Crimson Red Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21688.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Crimson Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21688.descriptionJp:
紅赤原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

50218.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
50218.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!
50218.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
のだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

61837.objectiveJp: エールナッツ５０個の納品
61837.description: Are you gathering today as well? You do not need tools, but you do want to mind your equipment. Now then, a new gathering request. Hmm, it may be a little tough this time too, but do your best. Of course I will give you a reward.
61837.descriptionEn:
Are you gathering today as well?
Since you don't need tools, you
want to be careful with equipment.
Now then, a new gathering request.
Hmm, this one may be a bit hard
again, but please do your best.
Of course, I will hand over your
reward.
61837.descriptionJp:
今日も採取をしていますか？
道具を必要としない代わりに、
装備に気を使いたいですよね。
さて、新しい採取の依頼です。
んー、今回も少し大変かも
しれませんが頑張ってくださ
いね。もちろん報酬はお渡し
しますから。

63275.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
63275.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Doragyurosu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63275.descriptionEn:
An emergency request.
We are seeking someone to
exterminate an extremely powerful
≪Doragyurosu≫.
Hunt it well, and we will issue
more Slay Proofs than usual!
63275.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ドラギュロス≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に狩猟
できましたら、普段よりも
多めに討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

21708.description: We have received reports that Forokururu has appeared in the Flower Field. Its great beauty leads surveyors to compare it to a huge flower. But it is still a dangerous monster. Head there at once and secure the area.
21708.descriptionEn:
We received a report that a
≪Forokururu≫ has appeared in
the Flower Field. Its great
beauty leads surveyors to
compare it to a giant flower.
However, that does not change
the fact that it is a
dangerous monster.
Head to the site at once and
secure the area.
21708.descriptionJp:
花畑に≪フォロクルル≫が
現れたとの報告が届きました。
その非常に美しい姿から、
調査員の間では、大きな花に
例えられることもあるようで
す。しかし、危険な
モンスターであることには
変わりありません。
直ちに、現地へ向かい安全を
確保してください。

53048.description: For those aiming at HR100, we've prepared a quest to upgrade the "Clanto Series" into the "Clanto F Series." By hunting a Gogomoa, you can obtain materials to upgrade one piece into High Rank armor and raise its level a little. Please make good use of it.
53048.descriptionEn:
For those aiming at HR100, we've
prepared a quest to upgrade the
"Clanto Series" into the
"Clanto F Series."
By hunting a Gogomoa, you can
obtain materials to upgrade one
piece into High Rank armor and
raise its level a little.
Please make good use of it.
53048.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００を目指す方々へ
「クラントシリーズ」を
「クラントＦシリーズ」へ強
化するためのクエストを準備
しました。
ゴゴモアを狩猟することで、
１部位分を上位防具へ強化し
少しレベルアップできる素材
が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください。

50986.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50986.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Larve Series into the Larve HS Series. Hunt a Rathian Variant and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part.
50986.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest to
upgrade the "Lave Series" into
the "Lave HS Series."
By hunting a Rathian Variant,
you can obtain the materials to
upgrade one piece.
50986.descriptionJp:
「ラーヴェシリーズ」を
「ラーヴェHSシリーズ」へ
強化するためのクエストを
準備しました。
リオレイア変種を狩猟する
ことで、１部位分を強化する
素材が入手できます。

60599.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
60599.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Diorekkusu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin and Transcendent weapons only!
60599.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is
≪Diorex≫!
Achieve it together with your
Guild mates.
Teamwork is what counts here,
take a fine top ranking!
This time it's Origin Species
and Migrant weapons only!
60599.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ディオレックス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は始種・遷悠武器限定
で開催されているぞ！

50182.description: There was a report that an unidentified monster appeared in the swamp. As a result of the investigation, it was determined to be the Blood Devouring Wyvern, Baruragaru, never before confirmed around Mezepolta. The survey continues. Please head to the site at once and secure safety.
50182.descriptionEn:
We have reports that an
unidentified monster appeared in
the Swamp. As a result of our
survey, it was determined to be
the Blood-Eating Wyvern
≪Baruragaru≫, never before
confirmed around Mezepolta.
The survey is still ongoing.
Please head to the site at once
and secure the area.
50182.descriptionJp:
沼地に未確認のモンスターが
現れたとの報告がありました。
調査の結果、これまで
メゼポルタ周辺では確認され
たことのない喰血竜
≪バルラガル≫であると判明
しました。現在も調査は進め
られています。
至急現地へ向かい、
安全の確保をお願いします。

21764.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
21764.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21764.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21764.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

50213.description: Perhaps because the invitations went out, hunters have been gathering. Some are assembling companions and setting off on quests, others are forming hunting parties and calling for members; it is lively and a joy to see. Would you take on this request together with such companions? On success, I shall give you a black jewel.
50213.descriptionEn:
Perhaps because we sent out
invitations, hunters have been
gathering. Some set off on
quests with friends, others form
Guilds and call for members; it
is lively and a joy to see.
Why not take this request on
together with such companions?
Upon success, I will give you
a black jewel.
50213.descriptionJp:
招待状を出したからか、ハン
ターが集まってきたな。
仲間を集めてクエストに出発
する者や、猟団を結成し猟団
員を募集する声があり、賑や
かで喜ばしいことだ。
そんな仲間と一緒に、この依
頼を受けてみないか？
成功の暁には、黒い宝玉を
差し上げよう。

63287.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63287.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63287.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63287.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

26568.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26568.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26568.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26568.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

60654.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
60654.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Yian Garuga. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60654.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is a
Unique Individual
≪Yian Garuga≫!
Going after a monster all on
your own, that spirit is
truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a fine top ranking!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only!
60654.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
特異個体の
≪イャンガルルガ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

21529.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21529.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21529.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

53059.description: This is Miyashita! It is summer! Watch out for heat stroke! [Question 4] In Mezeporuta there is a saying that even Gogomoa falls from a tree. If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53059.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here! It's summer!
Let's watch out for heatstroke!
[Question 4]
In Mezepolta, the saying goes,
"Even a Gogomoa falls from
a tree."
Hunters who think the answer is
o (A), accept this quest
right here!
53059.descriptionJp:
宮下です！夏だね！
熱中症に気を付けようね！
【第４問】
メゼポルタには「ゴゴモアも
木から落ちる」という言葉が
伝わっている
答えが○（Ａ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

62294.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
62294.description: Word is going around that collecting the lost map will get you a powerful weapon. Let me tell you about a nice treasure you can get without any effort. Go to the Snowy Mountains now and you will find Cuff Material that has emerged from the melting ice. It is no lie, so go and see.
62294.descriptionEn:
Word around town is that
collecting lost maps gets you
powerful weapons.
Let me tell you about a fine
treasure you can get without
any of that trouble.
Go to the ≪Snowy Mountains≫ now
and you'll find ≪Kafu Essence≫
that melted out of the ice.
No lie, go see for yourself.
62294.descriptionJp:
巷では失われた地図を集める
ことで、強力な武器が手に入
ると騒がれているな。
オレが苦労をしなくても入手
できるグットなお宝を紹介し
よう。
いま≪雪山≫へいくと、氷が
溶けて出てきた≪カフの素≫
が手に入るぞ。
嘘じゃねぇから行ってみな。

22144.description: In a mountain region known as the sacred peak, an elder dragon wreathed in storms has been confirmed. Many nearby villages have voiced their unease, and a swift response is needed. Hunters, head for the sacred peak at once.
22144.descriptionEn:
In a mountain region known as
the Sacred Peak, an Elder Dragon
wreathed in storms has been
confirmed. Many voices of worry
have come from nearby villages,
so a swift response is needed.
Hunters, head for the Sacred
Peak at once.
22144.descriptionJp:
とある山岳地帯にある、霊峰
と呼ばれる地域にて、嵐を
纏う古龍が確認されました。
近隣の村々からは不安の声が
多数寄せられており、早急に
対応が必要です。
ハンターは至急、霊峰へと
向かってください。

55399.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
55399.description: A white swift wyvern that races like the wind howling at the top of the sea of trees, giving off light. The Guild has decided to call it Nargacuga that Runs to the Extreme. Brave hunter. When you slay it, you shall surely be granted materials for Guild hidden armor.
55399.descriptionEn:
A white Nargacuga that races
like the wind howling over
the Top of Great Forest,
giving off light.
The Guild has decided to call
it "Nargacuga, the Acme Runner."
Brave hunter. When you slay
it, the Guild will surely grant
you materials from its secret
armor.
55399.descriptionJp:
樹海の頂部で吹き荒れる
風のごとく駆けまわり、
光を放つ白い迅竜。
ギルドでは、ヤツの呼称を
「極み駆けるナルガクルガ」
とすることにした。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
ヤツを討伐した暁には、
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を
必ず授けよう。

54131.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54131.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54131.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54131.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

62542.objectiveJp: ハーフチケット白１枚の納品
62542.description: A quest reserved for hunters who have earned excellent results in official hunting tournaments! You can get your hands on a Hardcore Ticket. Once you have made your mark in an official tournament and obtained a Half Ticket White, come and see me!
62542.descriptionEn:
This quest is only for hunters
who earned excellent results
in official hunting contests!
You can get a
"Hardcore Ticket."
Once you've done well there
and obtained a
"Half Ticket White," come see us!
62542.descriptionJp:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「剛種チケット」が、
手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を
入手したら、ぜひ来てくれ！

26518.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲
26518.description: I want to ask you for urgent work. A bird wyvern has appeared in the Forest and Hills. Usually I would not mind, but unluckily a trade caravan is passing through, so I want it driven off at once. I do not want the smell of blood drawing other wyverns, so capture it, please. I am begging you!
26518.descriptionEn:
I have a rush job for you.
A Yian Kut-Ku has shown up in
the Forest and Hills. Usually I
would not care, but our caravan
passes through, so drive it off
quickly. The smell of blood
would draw other wyverns, so
capture it, please. I beg you!
26518.descriptionJp:
急ぎの仕事を頼みたいんだ。
森丘に怪鳥が出たんだ。
いつもなら気にしないんだが
運悪く通商隊が通過するので
すぐに追い払って欲しい。
血の臭いで、他の飛竜を
呼び寄せては困るから
捕獲で頼むよ。ほんと頼むよ！

23393.description: Please accompany us to the canyon to investigate the Toridcless. According to prior survey, it can finish its prey by discharging electricity from all over its body. We ask for your help in learning more of its ecology.
23393.descriptionEn:
We ask you to accompany us
to the Canyon to study the
≪Toridokuresu≫. Prior
surveys say it can finish
its prey by discharging
electricity from all over
its body. Please lend your
aid to learn more of it.
23393.descriptionJp:
≪照雷鳥≫の調査のため、
峡谷までご同行をお願い
します。事前の調査によると
体のいたる所から放電を行う
ことで獲物を仕留めることが
できるそうです。
更なる生態を知るために
ご協力を頼みます。

21982.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
21982.description: A Supremacy Teostra has appeared. The purpose of this request is to prevent the damage from spreading until the hunt party arrives. Therefore, please complete it by repelling the monster. Act with your own safety first.
21982.descriptionEn:
A Zenith Teostra has appeared.
The aim of this request is to
prevent the damage from spreading
until the slaying party arrives.
So we ask you to achieve it by
repelling it.
Please act with your own safety
first in mind.
21982.descriptionJp:
覇種テオ・テスカトルが
現れました。この依頼は、
討伐隊が到着するまでの、
被害拡大を防ぐことが目的
となります。
そのため、撃退での達成を
お願いします。
ハンターさん自身の安全を
第一に行動してください。

53325.objectiveJp: チャチャブー５匹の討伐
53325.description: There is something I need done urgently. I want you to plant the Guild Flag at the summit of the Snowy Mountains. There is no room for such heavy-looking equipment! I have prepared the supplies, so you need not bring any items. In this season the Shakalaka are active. Be careful!
53325.descriptionEn:
There's something I need done
right away. I want you to plant
the ≪Guild Flag≫ at the summit
of the Snowy Mountains.
There's no time for armor that
heavy!
We've readied supplies, so you
don't need to bring items.
Shakalaka get active this
season. Be careful!
53325.descriptionJp:
大至急で頼みたいことがある。
≪ギルドフラッグ≫を雪山の
山頂に立ててきてほしい。
そんな重たそうな装備を着て
いる余裕はないぞ！
支給品は揃えたからアイテムを
持っていく必要もないからな。
この季節は奇面族の活動が
活発になる。注意するように！

50076.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50076.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
50076.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

26658.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26658.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
26658.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

53047.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
53047.description: For those aiming at HR100, we've prepared a quest to forge the "Clanto Series." By hunting a Taikun Zamuza, you can obtain forge materials for one piece plus materials to raise its level a little. Please make good use of it.
53047.descriptionEn:
For those aiming at HR100, we've
prepared a quest to forge the
"Clanto Series."
By hunting a Taikun Zamuza, you
can obtain forge materials for
one piece plus materials to
raise its level a little.
Please make good use of it.
53047.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００を目指す方々へ
「クラントシリーズ」を生産
するためのクエストを準備し
ました。
タイクンザムザを狩猟するこ
とで、１部位分の生産素材と
少しレベルアップできる素材
が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください。

1051.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
1051.description: The King of the Smoky Skies has appeared in the Swamp! It must have come for the ore there. And it is a subspecies clad in black armor unlike the base species! Among flying wyverns it is surely an opponent of the strongest class, so be careful!
1051.descriptionEn:
The King of Smoke seems to have
shown up in the Swamp! He surely
made his way there for the
Swamp's ore.
And he's a subspecies clad in
black armor unlike the original!
Among flying wyverns he's
undoubtedly top class. Be wary!
1051.descriptionJp:
噴煙の王者が沼地に出没した
らしいぞ！おそらくは沼地の
鉱石を目当てに辿り着いたに
違いない。しかも原種とは違
う黒鎧に身を包んだ亜種だ！
飛竜種では間違いなく最強ク
ラスの相手だ、用心しろよ！

1012.objectiveJp: なわばりのフン１個の納品

23708.description: Bogabadorumu seems to have reached the strength of one who stands at the summit. Its power is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge that summit, please investigate.
23708.descriptionEn:
≪Bogabador≫ has
grown strong enough to
reach the summit.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident enough to
challenge the peak, please
investigate.
23708.descriptionJp:
≪ボガバドルム≫は
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

50867.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
50867.description: Reports say Brachydios are appearing in various regions. The Guild wants them hunted at once, but study of the Brachydios ecology has not progressed. For research, break its forelegs and sever its tail as far as you can. Your reward will be increased accordingly.
50867.descriptionEn:
Reports say the Brute Wyvern
Brachydios is appearing all over.
The Guild wants it hunted at
once, but its ecology remains
unstudied.
For our research, break its
forelegs and sever its tail as
much as you can.
Your reward will grow to match.
50867.descriptionJp:
各地に砕竜・ブラキディオス
が出現していると報告があり
ました。
ギルドはただちに狩猟して
ほしいみたいですが、砕竜
の生態は、調査が進んでいま
せん。研究のため、可能な限
り前脚の破壊や尻尾を切断し
てください。
その分、報酬ははずみますよ。

50081.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! Honestly, I am busy! So, hunters! In my place, defeat an Odd Species Diablos, and break its horns too! So that no horns stand in the way of wishes! Hahahahaha!
50081.descriptionEn:
Sasatto the Eccentric, protector
of lovers' love and peace!
Honestly, I am terribly busy!
So, hunters! In my place, defeat
an Aberrant Diablos and break its
horns as well!
May no horns stand against
my wishes! Hahahahahaha!
50081.descriptionJp:
恋人達の愛と平和を守る
怪傑ササットだ！
正直、私は多忙だ！だから
ハンター諸君！私に代わり
ディアブロス奇種を倒し、
さらに角を破壊して欲しい！
願いに角が立たないように！
ふははははははは！

54747.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54747.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of Ｇｚ and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
54747.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A request is now available that
lets you earn a huge amount of Gz
and gain plenty of experience.
Please take this chance and
give it a try!
54747.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のＧｚが入手できる上、
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

21061.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
21061.description: Cephalos swim freely through the sand, and hunting them is hard work at the best of times. As for the boss, Cephadrome, it is no exaggeration to call it a battle of patience! It is important to force it above ground with loud noises and impacts!
21061.descriptionEn:
The Cephalos that swim freely
through the sand are a real pain
to hunt, and as for the boss,
"Cephadrome", it's no exaggeration
to call it a battle of patience!
It's important to force it above
ground with loud noise or impact!
21061.descriptionJp:
砂の中を自在に泳ぐガレオス
たちは、とにかく狩猟が大変
で、ボスの≪ドスガレオス≫
ときたら、それはもう根気と
の戦いといっても過言じゃ
ないです！大きな音や衝撃で
地上に出すのが大事ですよ！

12063.description: Basarios grows by eating ore, so its outer shell often contains ore. By destroying its parts, you can sometimes get ore without mining. When that happens, it's two birds with one stone.
12063.descriptionEn:
≪Basarios≫ grows by eating
ore, so its shell often
contains minerals. Break its
parts and you can get ore
without mining, it seems.
That would be two birds
with one stone, wouldn't it.
12063.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫は鉱石を食べ
て成長するためその外殻には
鉱石が含まれてることが多い
わね。部位を破壊することで、
採掘しなくても鉱石が入手
できることもあるわ。そうな
ったら一石二鳥ってとこね。

54350.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54350.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the claws of Shogun Ceanataur, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54350.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
newly launched G Rank Guild
Priority Requests and promote
them, we have prepared this
quest for you.
Breaking the Shogun
Ceanataur's claw will also
grant you special ingredients.
54350.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鎌蟹のツメを破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

61954.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
61954.description: This is the final round quest of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials by carving it or from the clear reward.
61954.descriptionEn:
This is the final round quest of
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials by carving
it or from the clear reward.
61954.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの決勝
クエストです。モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

23371.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
23371.description: There are reports that a Green Plesioth has appeared in the desert. Unlike the usual, the color of its fins shines like a jewel sunk in a desert oasis, and hunters have been harmed by mistake. There is danger in it, so hunt with great care.
23371.descriptionEn:
A Green Plesioth has been
reported in the Desert.
Unlike normal ones, its fins
shine like a jewel sunk in
a desert oasis, and hunters
have been harmed by mistake,
they say. It holds danger,
so please hunt with the
greatest care.
23371.descriptionJp:
砂漠で翠水竜が現れたとの
報告がありました。通常と
は異なりヒレの色が砂漠の
オアシスに沈む宝石のよう
に輝いており、間違って
ハンターが被害にあってい
るそうです。危険をはらん
でいるので十分に注意して
狩猟にあたってください。

61644.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61644.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61644.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

5005.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の撃退
5005.description: Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is an Elder Dragon said to be the incarnation of fire. In the volcano, every flame and every trace of heat is as good as fighting on her side. Do not waste thought on impossible things like capture; repel her again and again to wear down her strength, and slay her after a long battle.
5005.descriptionEn:
Lunastra, the Flame Empress, is
an Elder Dragon said to be the
very embodiment of flame.
In the Volcano, every flame and
heat may as well side with her.
Forget capture: repel her again
and again, then slay her after a long fight.
5005.descriptionJp:
炎妃龍ナナ・テスカトリは炎
の化身とも云われる古龍よ。
火山では全ての炎や熱が彼女
に味方しているに等しいわ。
捕獲など無理なことは考えず
撃退をくり返し体力を削り、
長期戦の末に討伐するのよ。

61223.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hard Tail! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61223.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who break many parts
on Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying
Wyvern's Hard Tail! When
accepting or joining, deliver
the guarantee slip, then hunt
the specified monster. The slip
is not returned once you depart.
61223.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の剛尾！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

53011.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の捕獲
53011.description: This year's trend is a sweet scent! How about a sweet fragrance that will make any man swoon? Bring me that red heart shaped thing and I will give it to you together with chocolate! Do present it to the man you have your eye on, and have a lovely Valentine's Day.
53011.descriptionEn:
This year's trend is a sweet
scent! How about a fragrance
that leaves men swooning?
Bring me that red heart-shaped
thing, and I'll hand it over
together with some chocolate!
Do give it to the man you have
your eye on, and have a lovely
Valentine's Day.
53011.descriptionJp:
今年のトレンドは甘い香り！
貴方も男性をメロメロにする
甘い芳香はいかがですか？
赤いハート型のアレを取って
来てくれたら、チョコと一緒
にお渡ししますよ！
ぜひ意中の男性にプレゼント
して、素敵なバレンタインを
お過ごしください。

61619.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
61619.description: A quest in which a rookie hunter and a hunter who has just equipped a Secret Tome hunt Velocidrome together. Only rookie hunters can obtain a Rookie's Proof on clearing the quest. The Rookie's Proof is used in the Second Part quests.
61619.descriptionEn:
A quest where a rookie hunter
and a hunter who has just
equipped a Secret Art scroll work
together to hunt a ≪Velocidrome≫.
Only rookie hunters can obtain
the ≪Rookie's Proof≫ when the
quest is cleared.
The ≪Rookie's Proof≫ is used in
the [Part 2] quest.
61619.descriptionJp:
新人のハンターと、秘伝書を
装備したてのハンターが協力
して≪ドスランポス≫を狩猟
するクエストです。
新人のハンターのみクエスト
クリア時≪新人の証≫を入手
することができます。
≪新人の証≫は、【後編】の
クエストで使用します。

51023.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟

58065.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58065.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58065.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58065.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62258.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21941.description: You there! I hear you produced an Abiorugu weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Abiorugu. I am counting on you!
21941.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged an Abiorugu
weapon.
So I've got a favor to ask, and
the pay is weapon upgrade parts.
What? It's an easy job.
Just take a quick run out there
and slay an Abiorugu
for me. I'm counting on you!
21941.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
獰竜の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、
ひとっ走り行って
アビオルグを討伐して
くれればいい。頼んだぜ！

55393.description: A report has arrived that the shadow of a wyvern bearing needles was sighted. At the sign of a new Variant Species, the guild has prepared a new bow for promising hunters, to stand against Variant Species. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare for the hunt!
55393.descriptionEn:
Word has reached us that the
shadow of a needle-bearing flying
wyvern was sighted.
With signs of a new Supremacy
species, the Guild has prepared
a new Bow for promising hunters
to stand against the Supremacy.
Gather the production materials
and prepare to slay it!
55393.descriptionJp:
針を持つ飛竜の影を目撃した
という報告が届きました。
新たな辿異種出現の兆しに、
ギルドでは有望なハンターに
向けて、辿異種に立ち向かう
ための新たな弓を用意しま
した。
生産素材を獲得して、辿異種
の討伐に備えてください！

55266.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
55266.description: To you who upgraded the Entra GF series to LV7! I have prepared a quest that gets one piece's worth of upgrade materials for the Entra GX series armor all at once! Clear the quest five times and upgrade every part!
55266.descriptionEn:
To those who raised the Entora GF Series
all the way to Lv7!
We have prepared a quest where the
upgrade materials for one piece of the
Entora GX Series armor come all at once!
Clear the quest 5 times and
upgrade every piece!
55266.descriptionJp:
エントラGFシリーズをＬＶ７
まで強化できたあなたへ！
防具「エントラGXシリーズ」
１部位分の強化素材が一気に
入手できるクエストを用意し
ました！クエストを５回クリ
アして全部位を強化しよう！

58106.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58106.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58106.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58106.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60096.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

54694.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54694.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land. My research had once reached completion, but then I heard a rumor of an even more ferocious individual. So would you hunt the Rathalos living in the Old Tower? I will give you a copy of the book recording that survey report.
54694.descriptionEn:
For many years I have studied
the King of the Sky and the
Queen of the Land.
My research once reached
completion, but I heard a
rumor that an even more
savage individual appeared.
So, would you hunt the Rathalos
living in the Ancient Tower? I'll
give you a copy of that book.
54694.descriptionJp:
私は長年、空の王と陸の女王
を研究してきた者だ。
一度私の研究は完成を迎えた
が、さらに凶暴な個体が現れ
たという噂を聞いた。
そこで、古塔に住んでいる
火竜たちを狩猟してくれない
か。その調査報告を記した
書物の写しをキミたちにも
あげよう。

60815.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲

21936.description: You there! I hear you produced a Gogomoa weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
21936.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you crafted a weapon
from the Leaping Crimson
Beast. So I've got a favor
to ask. How about upgrade
materials as pay? It's an
easy job. Just run over
and slay a Gogomoa.
I'm counting on you!
21936.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
跳緋獣の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、
ひとっ走り行って
ゴゴモアを討伐してくれれば
いい。頼んだぜ！

12027.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
12027.description: Diablos is a violent monster whose strength in the desert ecosystem stands in a class of its own. Caught by that charge, you'd take damage you could never recover from. Break its horns and victory looks within reach.
12027.descriptionEn:
≪Diablos≫ is a violent
monster of unmatched power
in the desert ecosystem.
Get caught by that charge
and the damage will end
you. Break its horns and
you'll have a chance.
12027.descriptionJp:
≪ディアブロス≫は砂漠の
生態系において、他の生物
とは別格の強さを誇る強暴な
モンスターよ。あの突進に
はねられたら再起不能のダメ
ージを受けてしまう。角を折
れれば勝機はありそうね。

53178.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
53178.description: A request that lets you craft and upgrade the Kukubo Series, armor recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and you will obtain the crafting materials for all 5 pieces of the Kukubo Series, plus upgrade materials for the Kukubo F Series up to LV7. May it serve you well in your hunting life.
53178.descriptionEn:
A request that lets you forge
and upgrade the Kukubo Series,
armor recommended for rookie
hunters. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku to
obtain materials for all five
Kukubo Series pieces, plus
upgrade materials for the
Kukubo F Series up to Lv7.
May it serve you well in your
hunting life to come.
53178.descriptionJp:
初心者ハンターにオススメの
防具「ククボシリーズ」が
生産・強化できる依頼です。
イャンクックを狩猟すると、
「ククボシリーズ」５部位分
の生産素材と、「ククボＦシ
リーズ」ＬＶ７までの強化素
材が入手できます。
今後の狩猟生活にぜひお役立
てください。

56024.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Akura Jebia. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56024.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Supremacy
Taikun Zamuza.
If you break its developed
parts during this quest, I will
add the developed part
materials to your bonus
rewards as a special extra.
Note that slaying it alone
will not yield those materials.
56024.descriptionJp:
辿異種の尾晶蠍を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

54402.description: We are surveying the Plesioth that lurks in the Jungle and swims with great splashes. Its ecology is still largely unexplained. Please hunt it and lend your strength to our research!
54402.descriptionEn:
We are surveying the Water Wyvern
that lurks in the Jungle and swims
with tremendous splashes.
Its ecology remains a mystery.
Please hunt it and lend
us your strength!
54402.descriptionJp:
密林に潜み、とても大きな飛
沫をあげて泳ぐ≪水竜≫の調
査を行っています。
その生態はまだまだ未解明。
どうか狩猟を行い、我々の研
究に力を貸してください！

1072.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

50929.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50929.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50929.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Switch Axe, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.
50929.descriptionJp:
剣斧を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26415.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26415.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26415.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

55434.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (chest), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
55434.descriptionEn:
In this quest,
for G Rank Secret Art Armor (torso),
the Weapon Ribbons needed for upgrades,
excluding Weapon Merits, materials are
yielded.
The yield is one type.
To accept the quest,
one 10th Anniversary Ticket is
required, so please note.
55434.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（胴防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪10周年チケット≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

62763.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

61214.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐

21536.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21536.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21536.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

55023.description: You found this job well! I am a genius! I have developed a new weapon not found in Mezeporuta. If you want to know the secret, complete as many hidden jobs as you can. However, you must always complete at least the main target. I wish you success!
55023.descriptionEn:
You found this request — well done!
I am a genius! I've developed
a new weapon that Mezeporta
never had. If you wish to know
this secret, complete as many
hidden requests as you can.
However, at the very least you
must complete the main target.
I wish you good fortune!
55023.descriptionJp:
よくぞこの依頼を見つけた！
ワシは天才じゃ！メゼポルタ
には無かった新しい武器を開
発したぞい。この秘密を知り
たくば、隠された依頼をでき
るだけ多く達成することじゃ。
ただし、最低でも必ずメイン
ターゲットは達成しなければ
ならぬぞ。健闘を祈る！

56091.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
56091.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Shining Thunder Bird. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56091.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Supremacy
Forokururu.
If you break its developed
parts during this quest, I will
add the developed part
materials to your bonus
rewards as a special extra.
Note that slaying it alone
will not yield those materials.
56091.descriptionJp:
辿異種の照雷鳥を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

54530.description: 2 monsters suddenly appeared in the New Great Arena. Both are monsters the guild considers the most dangerous. We have somehow kept the damage from spreading, but the situation allows no complacency. Head there at once and slay the monsters.
54530.descriptionEn:
Suddenly, two monsters have
appeared in the New Great Arena.
Both are monsters the Guild ranks
as the most dangerous of all.
For now the damage has not spread,
but the situation allows no room
for complacency.
Go to the site at once and set
about slaying the monsters.
54530.descriptionJp:
突如、新大闘技場に２頭の
モンスターが現れました。
どちらもギルドが最も危険と
位置付けるモンスターです。
なんとか、被害を拡大させず
に済んでいますが、予断を
許さない状態です。
至急現地に向かいモンスター
の討伐に当たってください。

60217.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟

53010.description: My wife says to me: you are always dreaming, do you never tire of it? Indeed I do not! By looking ever forward, a new path can be opened! That joy is what keeps me alive!
53010.descriptionEn:
My wife keeps saying to me,
“Always chasing dreams, don't
you ever get tired of it?”
Damn right I don't!
By keeping your eyes ahead,
a new road can open up before
you!
That joy is what keeps me alive!
53010.descriptionJp:
嫁さんが言いやがるんだよ。
いつも夢ばっかり見ていて、
よく飽きないねえ、だとさ。
そうとも、飽きねぇとも！
前を見続けることで、新たな
道が切り開かれることだって
ある！
その喜びが生きる糧なのさ！

61828.description: Do you know the Moonlight Stone? It is a strange stone, said to be moonlight crystallized, and rumor has it that cooperation with companions is essential to obtain one. But cooperation with companions is the basics of a hunter. You will surely be able to gather some too.
61828.descriptionEn:
Do you know the Moonlight Stone?
It is a strange stone said to be
moonlight crystallized, and rumor
has it that allies' cooperation is
essential to obtain one.
But well, cooperating with allies is
the basics of a hunter.
I am sure you can mine some too.
61828.descriptionJp:
月光石って知ってるかい？
なんでも月の光が結晶化した
とかいう変わった石でな、
手に入れるには仲間との
協力が必須って噂だぜ。
でもまあ仲間との協力は
ハンターの基本だからな。
アンタにもきっと採れるさ。

26729.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

62345.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold an equipment-restricted special exercise! You'll use armor we provide, but as long as you meet the conditions, other equipment you bring is free! The rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
62345.descriptionEn:
Indeed! Today I shall hold a
special exercise limited to set
equipment, on my own judgment!
You will use the armor we have
prepared, but other gear is
free to bring if the conditions
are met! Rewards are Energy
Drinks and coins!
62345.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、装備限定の特別演習を
行う！防具はこちらが用意し
たものを使ってもらうが、
条件さえ満たせば、その他の
装備の持込は自由だ！
報酬は≪元気ドリンコ≫や
コインだぞ！

23439.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23439.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Merit (Beginning) x５０, Hammer Merit (Middle) x６０, Hammer Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23439.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Hammer Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Hammer Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Hammer Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you must
be GR500 or higher, so please
keep that in mind.
23439.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ハンマー勲・序≫５０個
≪ハンマー勲・中≫６０個
≪ハンマー勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

11085.description: We're recruiting hunters to slay 8 Ioprey! Ioprey hits harder in a single blow than Velociprey or Genprey, so mind yourself out there!
11085.descriptionEn:
Seeking hunters to slay 8
≪Ioprey≫!
Compared to Velociprey or
Genprey, a single Ioprey hit
hits harder. Watch out!
11085.descriptionJp:
≪イーオス≫８頭を討伐してく
れる方を募集します！
≪イーオス≫はランポスや、
ゲネポスに比べ一発の攻撃力が
高いので注意して下さい！

11022.description: Daimyo Hermitaur spends most of its time buried in the sand. If you mean to hunt one, please don't forget that. It's called the Shield Crab for a reason: once it guards itself, it's a nuisance!
11022.descriptionEn:
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ spends
most of its time in the
sand. Don't forget that
when hunting. It's called
the Shield Crab for a
reason; guarding is a pain!
11022.descriptionJp:
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫は普段
は砂に潜ってることが多い
です。狩猟をするなら忘れな
いようにして下さい。
盾蟹と呼ばれるだけあって身
を固められたら面倒ですよ！

21112.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon also called the Sickle Crab. If the Shield Crab is defense, the Sickle Crab is offense. Those sharp claws swung down with force will cut through almost anything. If the hunt fails, break the claws and withdraw.
21112.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon called the Scythe
Crab. Shield Crab defends;
Scythe Crab attacks. Those
claws slash through almost
anything. If hunting fails,
break the claws and leave.
21112.descriptionJp:
≪ショウグンギザミ≫は鎌蟹
とも呼ばれてる甲殻生物よ。
盾蟹が守りなら鎌蟹は攻め。
力強く振り下ろされる鋭い爪
は大抵のものを切り裂いてし
まうほどよ。狩猟がダメなら
ツメを破壊して戻りなさい。

54741.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54741.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the claws of Shogun Ceanataur, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54741.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
newly launched G Rank Guild
Priority Requests and promote
them, we have prepared this
quest for you.
Breaking the Shogun
Ceanataur's claw will also
grant you special ingredients.
54741.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鎌蟹のツメを破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

26570.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26570.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26570.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26570.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

55948.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の撃退
55948.description: A black mist-exploding dragon that appeared at the ancient ruins. The Guild has decided to call this one Bogabadorumu that Strikes to the Extreme. Hunter of courage, drive this monster off and I will surely grant you materials for armor the Guild keeps in secret.
55948.descriptionEn:
A black blast-mist wyvern appeared
at the ruins. The Guild has named
this individual Bogabadorumu the
Acme Assailant.
Brave hunters, drive this
monster off, and the Guild will
grant you materials from its
secretly kept armor.
55948.descriptionJp:
古跡に現れた黒い爆霧竜。
ギルドでは、この個体を
「極み襲うボガバドルム」
とすることにした。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
このモンスターを追い払った
暁には、ギルド秘蔵の防具の
素材を必ず授けよう。

55032.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55032.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55032.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

61434.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
61434.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61434.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
61434.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

23610.description: A Giaorugu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Giaorugu known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23610.descriptionEn:
A Giaorugu with a greatly
developed tail has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a Supremacy
with developed parts and
will begin a survey.
Reports say it is more
dangerous than past Giaorugu.
Please survey with caution.
23610.descriptionJp:
尻尾が大きく発達した
≪氷獰竜≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの氷獰竜より危険
との報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

26091.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26091.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26091.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

40224.description: A report has arrived: 'I saw a suspicious monster in the swamp.' It seems to be lurking beyond the white rock, but to go further you must solve a mechanism. The supply box holds a clue to solving it, so read it. Take great care.
40224.descriptionEn:
Word has come that a strange
monster was seen in the Swamp.
It seems to lurk beyond the
white rocks, but the way ahead
is sealed by a mechanism.
The Supply Box holds a clue
to unlocking it, so read that.
Please be careful out there.
40224.descriptionJp:
「沼地で怪しいモンスターを
見た」との報告が届いた。
白い岩の先に潜伏している
ようだが先へ進むには仕掛け
を解く必要があるらしい。支
給品ボックスに仕掛けを解く
手がかりがあるので読むとい
い。くれぐれも気を付けて。

50117.description: Hypnocatrice and the crowd become one, and it is just like a play! I will let you join that feast too. Oops, do not bring anything dangerous in. Only your weapon, the symbol of a hunter, will I allow. Now! Entertain me!
50117.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and the crowd become
one, and it is just like a play!
Let me have you join in that
festival too. Oops, don't bring
anything dangerous in, all right.
Only the weapon that marks you a
hunter will I allow.
Now! Entertain me!
50117.descriptionJp:
ヒプノックと観衆が一体となり
それはまるで劇のようだ！
君も、その宴に参加させて
あげよう。おっと、物騒なモノ
は持ち込まないでくれよ。
ハンターたる象徴の、その武器
だけは許してあげるがね。
さぁ！私を楽しませてくれ！

53034.description: To take this quest you need one Hunter Pass (Purple), myan. Clear quests every day and get lots of souls, myan. If you clear them without fail, by the time the Soul Offering Festival ends you should have quite a number, myan. You should tell your hunting party members, myan.
53034.descriptionEn:
To accept this quest,
one Hunter Pass: Purple is
needed, meow. Clear quests
every day and get lots of
souls, meow. Clear without
fail and when the Soul Festival
ends you should have a good
number, meow. Tell all your
Guild mates, meow.
53034.descriptionJp:
このクエストを受注するには
「ハンターパス・紫」が１個
必要ニャン。毎日クエストを
クリアして、魂をたくさん手
に入れるニャン。欠かさずク
リアすれば入魂祭が終わるこ
ろには結構な数になっている
はずニャン。猟団員のみんな
に教えてあげるといいニャン。

60506.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60506.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
60506.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

55297.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55297.description: A Blangonga with greatly developed arms has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Blangonga seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55297.descriptionEn:
A ≪Blangonga≫ with greatly
developed arms has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫
with developed parts, and will
conduct a survey. Reports say
it is more dangerous than
Blangonga seen before.
Please survey it with care.
55297.descriptionJp:
腕が大きく発達した
≪雪獅子≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの雪獅子より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

54833.description: To ascertain why the Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, appeared in the snowy mountains, we will conduct an ecological survey of the target. It is dangerous, but as part of the research, please break its fangs and then hunt it.
54833.descriptionEn:
To pin down why the Ice Fang
Wyvern Barioth has appeared in
the Snowy Mountains, we will
survey the target's ecology.
It is dangerous, but as part of
our research, please break its
fangs and then hunt it.
54833.descriptionJp:
氷牙竜・ベリオロスが
雪山に現れた原因を
突き止めるため、対象の
生態調査を行ないます。
危険ではありますが、研究の
一環として、牙の破壊後に
狩猟をお願いいたします。

23245.description: In the canyon of an unsurveyed region, a Yian Garuga has been confirmed acting alone. Nearby there is a highway used to cross the canyon. We are recruiting hunters who can deal with it so that it does not reach there.
23245.descriptionEn:
In the unexplored Canyon, a Yian
Garuga has been confirmed
to be acting alone.
Nearby there is a highway
used to cross the Canyon.
So that it does not reach
there, we seek hunters
we can ask to deal with it.
23245.descriptionJp:
未調査地域の峡谷で、黒狼鳥
が単独で行動しているのを
確認しました。
付近には峡谷を越える際に
使用する街道があります。
そこへ到達しないよう、
対処を依頼できるハンターを
募集いたします。

12014.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
12014.description: When you hear 'a riot of flowers', what comes to mind? Here in the Elder Hall, unfortunately, it means two queens descended on the jungle. One dragon clad in clear green, one clad in crimson sakura. Who will take them on, I wonder?
12014.descriptionEn:
When you hear 'a riot of
blossoms,' what comes to mind?
Here at the Grand Hall, it
means two queens descending
upon the Jungle. A wyvern
clad in clear green, and one
wrapped in crimson cherry
blossoms. Who will face them?
12014.descriptionJp:
「百花繚乱」なんて聞いたら
何を思い浮かべるかしら？
この大老殿でのそれは、残念
ながら密林に舞い降りた２頭
の女王を意味するわ。澄んだ
緑をまとう竜と、紅き桜をま
とう竜。誰が挑むのかしら？

61748.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61748.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61748.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

63043.description: The Wyverian lady said the Guild is short of ingredients lately. At this rate she is worried whether they can properly entertain the hunters who visit Mezepolta Plaza. So she said that if you procure ingredients, she will give you a red gem as thanks!
63043.descriptionEn:
Lately the Guild is short on food,
the Wyverian lady said. At this
rate she worries they can't
properly serve the hunters who
visit Mezeporuta Square.
So she said if you gather some
ingredients for them, she'll give
you a red gem as thanks.
That's what she told me!
63043.descriptionJp:
最近、ギルドの食材が不足し
ているって竜人族のお姉さま
が言ってたわ。このままだと、
メゼポルタ広場を訪れるハン
ターたちをちゃんと持て成す
ことができるか心配なんだっ
て。そこで、食材を調達して
くれたら、お礼に赤い玉をあ
げるって言ってたよ！

63312.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63312.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63312.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63312.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

55501.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a dorsal fin break and a tail fin break in slaying Plesioth, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55501.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Plesioth≫ and break its
dorsal and tail fins, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55501.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪水竜≫討伐にて
背ビレ破壊と尾ビレ破壊を
達成した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

11502.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this Quest Confirmation section you will find the money needed to accept a quest, the Contract Fee, the Reward Money you receive on clearing it, and the quest's objective, time limit and important matters, all in a row!
11502.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
This ≪Quest Info≫ section is
packed with the money needed to
accept a quest, the ≪Contract
Fee≫, the ≪Reward Money≫ you
receive on clearing it, plus the
quest's objective, time limit and
other important matters!
11502.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
この≪クエスト確認≫欄には
クエストの受注に必要なお金
≪契約金≫や、クリアの際に
もらえる≪報酬金≫、さらに
クエストの目的や制限時間と
重要事項が目白押しだぞ！

54449.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
54449.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Pariapuria beautifully. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
54449.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Hunt Pariapuria and show us
what you can do.
Clear the quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
right up!
54449.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪呑竜≫を狩猟してみ
せろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

53177.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐

61022.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種の狩猟
61022.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61022.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61022.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

55843.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
55843.description: It is I! The Instructor! The newly discovered Bogabadorumu seems to unleash attacks that make full use of explosions! So! I have prepared a quest where you can get used to explosions before facing Bogabadorumu! Gahaha! Do your best!
55843.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
The newly discovered
'Bogabadorumu' reportedly
unleashes attacks built on
explosions! So I have prepared
a quest that lets you get used
to explosions before you face
it! Gahaha! Do your best!
55843.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
今回新発見された「ボガバド
ルム」は爆発を駆使した攻撃
を繰り出してくるらしい！ 
そこでだ！「ボガバドルム」
に挑む前にあらかじめ爆発に
慣れておけるようなクエスト
を用意した！
ガハハ！頑張ってくれ！

63358.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
63358.description: Teostra the Conquest species, who would create a world of crimson, has appeared! With no time to lose, this is a short-notice request, but to keep the damage to a minimum, repelling it alone will also count. We are seeking first-rate hunters with a Secret Scroll to face this unprecedented crisis!
63358.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Flame King Dragon,
creator of a crimson world,
has appeared! Time is short,
so this is a swift slaying
request, but to keep the damage
to a minimum, a repel alone
will also be counted.
I call for master hunters
bearing Secret Art scrolls!
63358.descriptionJp:
紅蓮の世界を創造せし
覇種炎王龍が現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

50690.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐

61532.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61532.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61532.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

60949.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hardclaw! Bring the specified number of Capture Certificates yourself. You will also receive more rewards if you break the specified monster's parts and hunt it.
60949.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association rewards
hunters who capture many Variants
and Odd Species.
The main reward is a Flying Wyvern
Hardclaw! Bring the set number of
Capture Guarantee Tickets by
yourself. Breaking the parts of or
hunting the specified monsters
also earns you more rewards.
60949.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の剛爪！
指定枚数の捕獲保証書を１人
でお持ちください。また、
指定モンスターの部位破壊や
狩猟を行った場合、より多く
の報酬を用意しております。

62359.objectiveJp:
報酬金ゼロ／タイムアップ
ドスファンゴの捕獲
62359.description: Hey, listen to me for a moment. A lance's blade wears down with every attack, right? So I wondered whether the tip could be made of some substance other than metal. There's apparently a clue to that material in the Old Tower. Would you go and look for it?
62359.objectiveEn:
Reward 0z / Time Up
Capture a Bulldrome
62359.descriptionEn:
Hey, listen to me
for a moment.
A Lance's edge wears down
with every strike, right?
So I thought, could the
tip not be made of some
substance other than metal?
A clue to that material is
said to be in the Ancient Tower.
Go and look for it, would you?
62359.descriptionJp:
おう、ちょっとオレの話を
聞いてくれ。
ランスは、攻撃するごとに
刃先が摩耗するだろ。
そこで、金属ではない別の
物質で刃先を構成することが
できないだろうかと考えた。
その素材の手がかりが古塔に
あるらしいんだ。ちょっと
探してきてくれないか？

26280.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26280.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26280.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

23268.description: I was surveying the extreme cold sea when I found cracked holes all over the ice. That was probably Giaorugu's doing. It seems that one sometimes hunts quite violently to catch prey. Take care not to be eaten yourself.
23268.descriptionEn:
I was surveying the Polar Sea
when I found holes cracked
open all over the ice.
That is likely Giaorugu's work.
It seems to hunt in a rather
violent way to catch prey.
Watch yourself, so you do not
end up eaten instead.
23268.descriptionJp:
極海の調査をしていたんだが、
氷の至るところにひび割れた
ような穴があったんだ。
恐らくあれはギアオルグの
仕業だろうな。
あいつは獲物を捕らえるため
に、かなり乱暴な狩りをする
こともあるようだ。逆に食わ
れないように、気をつけろよ。

54094.description: What will guide us, who began with a small seed and have known harvest, abundance and prosperity, to yet greater heights is nothing other than the glory shown by hunters who have reached G-rank.
54094.descriptionEn:
We began as a small seed and have
known harvest, abundance and
prosperity. What will lead us to
even greater heights can only be
the glory shown by hunters who
have reached ≪G Rank≫.
54094.descriptionJp:
小さな種から始まり収穫、
豊穣、繁栄を経験した私たち
をさらなる高みへ導いて
くれるのは、≪Ｇ級≫へ到達
したハンターの皆さんが示す
栄華のほかにはないでしょう。

53230.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
53230.description: A Shogun of utter cruelty who cuts down the people night after night has taken up position in the Volcano with armored warriors and henchmen. The guard is strict, but there must be a gap. There is no map, but make use of a secret medicine that senses presences and slay the Shogun under cover of darkness!
53230.descriptionEn:
A cruel Shogun Ceanataur that
carves up the people night
after night has taken position
in the Volcano with armored
warriors and underlings.
Its guard is strict, but there
must be a gap. With no map,
use a potion that senses
presence and strike from
the dark!
53230.descriptionJp:
夜な夜な民を切り刻む
残虐きわまるショウグンが、
鎧武者や手下を引き連れて
火山に陣取っている。
警備は厳重だが、かならず
隙があるはずだ。
地図はないが、気配を察する
秘薬を駆使して、闇に紛れて
ショウグンを討つのだ！

54202.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54202.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54202.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23289.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
23289.description: The people who live around the volcano tell many tales of a black dragon like a mountain sleeping deep within. Our survey has identified the place where this dragon is thought to dwell. Head there at once and determine what this monster really is.
23289.descriptionEn:
Volcano folk say that deep
within the Volcano dwells a
black dragon like a mountain,
and many such tales remain.
Our survey has now pinned
down where this dragon is
thought to live. Hurry there
and uncover the truth of
this monster.
23289.descriptionJp:
火山の住人の話では、火山の
奥深くには、山のような
黒い竜が棲むという話が、
多く残っているということで
す。調査の結果、この竜が
棲むと思われる場所が特定で
きました。至急、現地へ向か
いこのモンスターの正体を
突き止めてください。

53155.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐

60670.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
60670.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blangonga. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together.
