Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60670.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill! This time the target is
Blangonga!
Achieve the goal together
with your Guild mates.
This contest is all about
teamwork, so go and take
a splendid top place!
This time it is Supremacy
weapons only!
60670.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ドドブランゴ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

62916.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
62916.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62916.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62916.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50932.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50932.description: Do you have enough armor upgrade materials? On this quest, which I present to you today, you can obtain great quantities of the Heavy Armor Sphere and True Armor Sphere used to upgrade armor. However, please note that the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited.
50932.descriptionEn:
Are you short on armor upgrade
materials?
This request, introduced today, lets you
obtain large amounts of ≪Heavy Armor Sphere≫
and ≪True Armor Sphere≫ used for
armor upgrades.
However, there is a limit to how many
times you can accept it per day,
so please be careful.
50932.descriptionJp:
防具の強化素材は足りていま
すか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
防具の強化に使用する
≪重鎧玉≫と≪真鎧玉≫を
大量に獲得できますよ。
ただし、１日に受注できる数
に限りがありますので、
ご注意ください。

60138.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟

12026.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
12026.description: A Rathian with a vivid cherry-blossom color seems to have appeared in the desert. A rare subspecies of high scarcity. Those with the courage to hunt the cherry blossoms blooming across the desert, please come to the quest counter.
12026.descriptionEn:
A ≪Rathian≫ with vivid cherry
blossom coloring seems to have
appeared in the Desert.
It is a highly rare subspecies.
Those with the courage to hunt
the cherry blossoms that bloom
wild in the Desert, come to the counter.
12026.descriptionJp:
砂漠地帯に桜色のあざやかな
体色を持つ≪リオレイア≫が
出たみたいね。希少性の高い
珍しい亜種だわ。砂漠に咲き
乱れる桜を狩る勇気を持つ方
は、クエストカウンターまで
お越し下さいませ。

55912.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
55912.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55912.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.
55912.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪外装解
放券≫を獲得できるクエスト
を用意させていただきまし
た。受注、参加時に、≪祭典
の熱気≫をお持ちください。

50750.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50750.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50750.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50750.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

61429.objectiveJp: イベント補助券１枚の納品
61429.description: I want to see the feathers of the beautiful birds that live in the sea of trees, nya. If you bring them, I will give you what is needed to make a hunting party Poogie outfit as thanks, nya. Hurry and fetch them, nya!
61429.descriptionEn:
I want to see the feathers of
the beautiful birds of the
Great Forest, nya.
Bring them back and I will
give you what you need to
make Guild Poogie clothes
as thanks, nya.
Hurry and fetch them, nya!
61429.descriptionJp:
樹海に住む美しい鳥の羽根が
見たいニャー。
取ってきてくれたら、お礼と
して猟団プーギーの服を作る
のに必要なものをあげるニャ。
はやく取ってくるのニャー！

61217.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61217.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61217.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61217.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

21031.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon also called the Sickle Crab! If the Shield Crab is defense, the Sickle Crab is offense! Those sharp claws, swung down with force, seem to slash through almost anything! If the hunt is hard, break the claws and come back!
21031.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon called the Scythe
Crab! Shield Crab defends,
Scythe Crab attacks! Its
claws seem to cut through
almost anything! If it's too
much, break its claws and go!
21031.descriptionJp:
≪ショウグンギザミ≫は鎌蟹
とも呼ばれる甲殻生物です！
盾蟹が守りなら鎌蟹は攻め！
力強く振り下ろされる鋭い爪
は大抵のものを切り裂いてし
まうみたい！狩猟が困難なら
ツメを破壊して戻って下さい！

26666.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26666.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Espinas Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26666.descriptionEn:
This hunting skill quest
is an Espinas Variant
slaying.
Why not sharpen your skills
against one another, hunters!
26666.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪エスピナス変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

50294.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
50294.description: I found a very beautiful crystal in the Desert at night. When I went close to touch it, an Akura Vashimu suddenly appeared and attacked me! Be very careful when you go to the Desert too.
50294.descriptionEn:
I found a beautiful crystal in
the Desert at night.
When I reached out to touch it,
Akura Vashimu burst out and
came at me!
Be careful out there when you
head into the Desert.
50294.descriptionJp:
夜の砂漠でとても綺麗な結晶
を見つけたんだ。
近づいて触ろうとしたら突然
≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫が現れ、
襲ってきやがったんだ！
あんたも砂漠に行く時には
十分に注意して向かってくれ。

54356.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54356.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54356.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

60039.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

20014.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The wind wyvern Kushala Daora has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20014.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Office!
Kushala Daora has entered
Dundorma's territory! Dundorma
now moves to intercept the
Elder Dragon! Use the
interception gear in the zone
and slay it completely!
20014.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
ドンドルマの領内に風翔龍
クシャルダオラが侵入しまし
た！これよりドンドルマは、
古龍の迎撃体制に入ります！
迎撃区画に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

21840.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
21840.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21840.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21840.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

62103.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
62103.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
62103.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
62103.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

26457.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26457.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26457.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26457.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

62101.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
62101.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
62101.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
62101.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

62921.objectiveJp: パルサント鉱石９９個の納品
62921.description: It began as a small seed, but tended with care it came to harvest, and in time it brought abundance as well. Yet this is not the end. A hunter who holds a Secret Arts Scroll will be able to encourage further prosperity.
62921.descriptionEn:
It began as a tiny seed, but by
tending it with care it came to
bear fruit, and in time it brought
forth abundance as well.
Yet this is not the end, not by
any means. If you are a hunter
who holds a Secret Art Tome,
you should be able to encourage
even greater prosperity.
62921.descriptionJp:
始まりは小さな種でしたが、
心を込めて育てることで
収穫に至り、やがてそれは
豊穣をも生み出しました。
しかし、まだまだ終わりでは
ありません。≪秘伝書≫を
お持ちのハンターさんならば、
さらなる繁栄を促すことが
できるでしょう。

61662.description: My master gave me a sudden order. A fully fledged carver can carve the tail bone from a Variant Gravios, so he told me to bring one back. It seems I may ask a hunter to capture it and sever its tail, so please do what you can. Once the tail bone is taken, I will give it to you after showing it to my master.
61662.descriptionEn:
My master gave me a sudden
order, see. A full-fledged carver
can carve the tailbone from a
Gravios Variant, so bring one
back and show him, he says.
Asking hunters for the capture
and the tail cut is fine, so
please, help me out. Once we
have the tailbone, it is yours
after he sees it.
61662.descriptionJp:
師匠から急な命令があってね。
一人前の剥ぎ取り職人なら、
鎧竜変種からその尾骨を剥ぎ
取れるんで、それを取って来
て見せろとさ。捕獲と、尻尾
の切断はハンターに依頼して
いいらしいから、なんとか頼
むよ。尾骨が取れたら、師匠
に見せたあとにあげるからさ。

55350.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55350.description: An Akura Vashimu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. As it is an extremely powerful individual and in view of the danger it poses to the ecosystem, the Guild designates it a top-priority target for slaying. We promise to arrange ample supplies, so please slay the Akura Vashimu swiftly.
55350.descriptionEn:
An Akura Vashimu with a hugely
developed tail has appeared.
It is extremely powerful, and
considering the danger it poses to
the ecosystem, the Guild marks it
as a top priority target.
We promise ample supplies,
so please slay the
Akura Vashimu swiftly.
55350.descriptionJp:
尾が大きく発達した≪尾晶蠍≫
が現れました。
非常に強力な個体であり、また
生態系を著しく害する危険性を
鑑みて、ギルドはこれを最重要
討伐対象に位置づけます。
支給品を十分に手配する事を
約束しますので、≪尾晶蠍≫の
迅速な討伐をお願い致します。

54572.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54572.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54572.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54942.description: This quest yields the following materials. Tonfa Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Tonfa Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Tonfa Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54942.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Tonfa Cord: First≫ x100
≪Tonfa Cord: Middle≫ x165
≪Tonfa Cord: Extreme≫ x165
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
54942.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪穿龍棍綬・序≫１００個
≪穿龍棍綬・中≫１６５個
≪穿龍棍綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

50369.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50369.description: Defeat a monster a little bigger than usual and find a bracelet, nya! I'll trade you my pick of goods, nya! What's it for? You'd better not pry any further, nya.
50369.descriptionEn:
Defeat a monster a tiny bit bigger
than usual and find a bracelet,
nyah!
I'll trade you my top pick for it,
nyah!
What do I want it for?
It's better not to pry any further
than that, nyah.
50369.descriptionJp:
いつもよりすこ〜し大きい
モンスターを倒して腕輪を見
つけてくるのニャ！
イチオシの品と交換してやる
ニャよ！
何に使うのかって？
それ以上は踏み込まないほう
がいいニャよ。

63066.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

63050.description: Among unidentified monsters, an individual giving off a bizarre aura has appeared. Many hunters are responding, but the situation allows no optimism. Damage to the residents must be avoided. To break through this crisis, we are recruiting hunters equipped with Secret Tome gear.
63050.descriptionEn:
Among the unidentified monsters,
one radiating an eerie aura
has appeared.
Many hunters are
responding,
but the situation allows no complacency.
Harm to residents must be
avoided. To break this
crisis, we seek hunters with
Secret Art equipment.
63050.descriptionJp:
未確認のモンスターの中に
異様なオーラを放つ
個体が現れました。
多くのハンターが対応に
当たっていますが、
予断を許さない状態です。
住人への被害は避けなければ
なりません。この危機を
打開するため秘伝書装備の
ハンターを募集します。

61740.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟

60925.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60925.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
60925.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54539.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
54539.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54539.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54539.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

54786.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54786.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54786.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

50039.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
50039.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50039.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50039.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

61165.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61165.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61165.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

55404.description: The Variant Species Giaorugu has appeared once more. Its tail has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55404.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Giaorugu has
appeared once more.
Its tail has grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
more power still.
Survey with great care.
55404.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ギアオルグ≫が
再び現れました。
尾はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

61979.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

61970.objectiveJp: ハンターシール赤１枚の納品
61970.description: Lately the artisan at the arms workshop seems to have developed a way to refine and reuse the iron scraps left after working Black Star Iron. If you bring Hunter Seals (Red) and Hunter Seals (Blue) to the volcano, he will give you a share!
61970.descriptionEn:
Apparently a smith at the Smithy
recently developed a way to refine
and reuse the iron scraps left
after working Black Star Iron.
If you bring ≪Hunter Seal Red≫
and ≪Hunter Seal Blue≫ to the
Volcano, they'll trade with you,
or so the word goes!
61970.descriptionJp:
最近、武具工房の職人が黒星
鉄を加工した後に残る鉄くず
を精製し、再利用する方法を
開発したらしい。
≪ハンターシール赤≫と
≪ハンターシール青≫を火山
まで持ってきたら分けてくれ
るらしいぞ！

54287.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54287.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54287.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54906.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
54906.description: Uragaan has been found in the volcano! This is the first sighting in the region. Reports also speak of unusual movement. Skilled hunters, we ask for an ecological survey of the target.
54906.descriptionEn:
The Burst Hammer Wyvern,
Uragaan, has been found in the
Volcano! This is the first such
discovery in this region.
Reports also say it moves in
peculiar ways.
Skilled hunters, please carry
out an ecological survey of it.
54906.descriptionJp:
爆鎚竜・ウラガンキンが
火山にて発見されました！
この地域では初の発見です。
特殊な動きをするとの報告も
あがってきています。
腕利きのハンターの皆様、対
象の生態調査をお願いします。

50739.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
50739.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50739.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50739.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

62970.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
62970.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62970.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62970.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

53185.description: A request that yields 4 kinds of decorations recommended for beginning hunters. Deliver Special Mushrooms in the Jungle and you will receive 10 each of the Power Jewel, Muscle Jewel, Earplug Jewel and Vigor Jewel.
53185.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain 4
kinds of decorations recommended
for rookie hunters.
Deliver ≪Special Mushrooms≫ in
the Jungle to receive ≪Power
Jewel≫, ≪Muscle Jewel≫,
≪Earplug Jewel≫ and ≪Vigor
Jewel≫, 10 of each.
53185.descriptionJp:
初心者ハンターにオススメの
装飾品４種が入手できる依頼
です。
密林で≪特産キノコ≫を納品
すると、≪怪力珠≫≪腕力珠≫
≪防音珠≫≪強精珠≫を
各１０個ずつ入手することが
できます。

62324.description: Hypnocatrice and the crowd become one, and it is just like a play! I will let you join that feast too. Oops, do not bring anything dangerous in. Only your weapon, the symbol of a hunter, will I allow. Now! Entertain me!
62324.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and the crowd become
one, and it is just like a play!
Let me have you join in that
festival too. Oops, don't bring
anything dangerous in, all right.
Only the weapon that marks you a
hunter will I allow.
Now! Entertain me!
62324.descriptionJp:
ヒプノックと観衆が一体となり
それはまるで劇のようだ！
君も、その宴に参加させて
あげよう。おっと、物騒なモノ
は持ち込まないでくれよ。
ハンターたる象徴の、その武器
だけは許してあげるがね。
さぁ！私を楽しませてくれ！

55346.description: Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing their surroundings red with rage. We will somehow drive them into the Arena, so we ask you hunters to slay them and keep the damage from spreading any further. Upon your success, we will give you armor materials long stored away by the Guild.
55346.descriptionEn:
Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing
their surroundings red with rage.
We will somehow drive them into
the Arena, so we ask you hunters
to slay them and keep the damage
from spreading any further.
Upon your success, we will give
you armor materials long stored
away by the Guild.
55346.descriptionJp:
２頭の獣が怒りで周囲を赤く
染めながら暴れ回っています。
何とか闘技場までは私たちが
追い込むので、ハンターの方
には、これ以上被害を拡大さ
せないために討伐をお願いし
ます。討伐に成功した暁には
古くからギルドで蔵されてき
た防具の素材を差し上げます。

62785.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62785.description: The one named Rukodiora, the Extreme Dragon, is closing on the Interception Base. We have readied ample supplies, interception weapons and carving artisans, so please slay it!
62785.descriptionEn:
The one named ≪Rukodiora≫,
the ≪Extreme Dragon≫, is
closing on the
≪Interception Base≫.
We've readied ample supplies,
anti-air weapons and even
carving artisans, so please
slay it!
62785.descriptionJp:
≪ルコディオラ≫≪極龍≫と
名付けられたそれが、
≪迎撃拠点≫に迫っています。
十分な支給品、迎撃兵器、
そして剥ぎ取り職人と、万全
の態勢を整えさせていただき
ましたので、討伐をお願い
します！

54849.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
54849.description: What on earth is happening to them!? Did we push them too far? The Guild has decided to call those shining ones the Deviljho that Devours Extremes. Anyone who succeeds in slaying one will receive the materials for a full set of the Guild's treasured armor and a title! Someone, please!
54849.descriptionEn:
What on earth is happening
to them!? Did we push them too far?
The Guild has decided to call
these shining ones the
'Acme Devouring Deviljho'.
If anyone succeeds in slaying one,
we shall present the materials for
a full set of Guild-hidden armor
and a title! Someone, please!
54849.descriptionJp:
ヤツらに何が起こっているの
だ！？追い込み過ぎたのか？
ギルドでは、光放つヤツらを
「極み喰らうイビルジョー」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐に成功したものがいれば
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！
誰か頼む！

55602.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55602.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
55602.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

26412.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26412.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26412.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

12005.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
12005.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku. Hunt one and you prove you can hold your own even in the Elder Hall. A sound burst by its ear may even make it weep.
12005.descriptionEn:
If you hear a birdlike cry in
this Jungle, it is surely the
Yian Kut-Ku. Hunting one
would prove you can hold your
own even at the Grand Hall.
Ring a sound by its ear and
it may even shed tears.
12005.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね。
イャンクックを狩猟すること
ができれば、大老殿でもそこ
そこやれる証拠ね。耳元で音
を鳴らせばナミダをこぼすこ
ともあるかも知れないわね。

50780.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50780.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the ears of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku will also grant a special ingredient.
50780.descriptionEn:
For the Guild Priority requests
we have long handled,
to raise awareness and interest
we have prepared
this quest.
By breaking the Blue Yian Kut-Ku's
ears, a special ingredient
will also be granted to you.
50780.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
青怪鳥の耳を破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

54908.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
54908.description: To those aiming for the heights of GR, by slaying an Espinas Rare Species you raise your own standing while the materials needed for G Rank decorations can be obtained at a bargain in this quest we prepared. Please make good use of it.
54908.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for the heights of GR,
by slaying an Espinas Rare Species
you raise your own standing
while the materials needed
for G Rank decorations
can be obtained at a bargain
in this quest we prepared.
Please make good use of it.
54908.descriptionJp:
ＧＲの高みを目指す方々へ
エスピナス希少種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

28067.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades well before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28067.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds among
you, I have prepared a
difficult request. Slay several
monsters together with your
Guild companions. No supplies
will be provided, so talk it
over with your friends before
you set out. The reward is a
special ore!
28067.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の仲間と
行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

61922.client: Old Man with a Black-and-White Beard
61922.description: It is important to press on toward your goal, but sometimes it is necessary to take a side path. Cat's Disguise is a special plant that can only be obtained by wandering off the road. It is best to gather it slowly, at your own pace.
61922.clientEn: Old Man with a Black-and-White Beard
61922.descriptionEn:
Moving toward your goal
matters, but sometimes leaving
the path is also necessary.
Nekokaburi can only be obtained
by stopping to smell
the flowers; it is a special plant.
Gather it slowly
at your own pace.
61922.descriptionJp:
目標に向かって進むことは
大切ですが、時には脇道に
それることも必要なのです。
「ネコかぶり」は道草を食う
ことでしか手に入れることが
できない特殊な植物です。
あなたのペースでじっくりと
集めるのがよいでしょう。

23514.description: The survey team that went to Prismatic Falls reports sighting the Water-Rending Wyvern. The parts called hanging blades that grow on both of its wings are sharp as swords and will cut through anything, it seems. Head there and investigate.
23514.descriptionEn:
The survey team at the Painted
Waterfall has sighted a
Mi Ru.
The 'hanging blades' on its
wings are sharp as swords and
can cut through anything.
Head to the site and conduct
a survey.
23514.descriptionJp:
彩の滝へ向かった調査団より
≪裂水竜≫の目撃情報が
ありました。
裂水竜の両翼に生えている
「垂刃」と呼ばれる部位は
刀剣のように鋭く、あらゆる
ものを切断してしまうそう
です。現地へ向かい調査を
お願いします。

60711.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60711.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60711.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61824.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
61824.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Pink Rathian of the jungle. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
61824.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to show
their skill!
Hunt the Pink Rathian of
the Jungle. If you clear the quest
safely, your standing
as a hunter will
shoot right up!
61824.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
密林の≪桜火竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。無事、クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

21483.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21483.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21483.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21483.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62069.objectiveJp: オオツノアゲハ９９匹の納品
62069.description: The thrill of robbing a monster of its freedom, that is worth anything. With my Concentrated Kubiki Extract you too can savour that thrill to the full. However, I only give it to those I recognise as one of my kind. The condition is that you can find pleasure in repeated small bindings.
62069.descriptionEn:
The thrill of robbing a monster
of its freedom is beyond
compare. With my Concentrated
Kubiki Extract, you too can
savor it fully. But I give it
only to those I deem my kind.
You must find joy in repeated
small bindings. That is the
condition.
62069.descriptionJp:
モンスターの自由を奪う快感、
それは何物にも代えがたいわ。
私の≪濃縮クビキエキス≫を
使えば、あなたもその快感を
存分に味わうことができるの。
ただし、私が同類と認めた人
にしか渡さないのよ。小さな
束縛の繰り返しに楽しみを
見出せること。それが条件。

55249.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Gakou GX Greaves' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55249.descriptionEn:
From the photo chosen as
the splendid top winner of
the F Photo Contest 2016,
we prepared a quest to obtain
the materials to craft and upgrade
the armor Gakou GX [Greaves]
worn in it.
Please make use of it.
55249.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「雅孔GX【具足】」
を生産・強化するための素材
を獲得できるクエストをご用
意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

62226.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62226.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.
62226.descriptionJp:
占いに使う石ころを集めてい
るのですが、モンスターに
襲われ、中々はかどりません。
そこでモンスター達を引きつ
けておいて欲しいんです。
たくさん集めることができた
ら報酬として差し上げますか
ら、どうかお願いします。

53002.description: Everyone ran well! But there is an outbound leg and a return leg! Your body is warm now, so run back to base camp at full speed. For those who finish with a good time, I have a New Year's gift useful for hunting!
53002.descriptionEn:
Everyone, that was a fine run!
But where there is a way out
there is a way back! Your bodies
are warm now, so run at full
speed to the base
camp. For those who
finish with a good time, we have
a New Year's gift useful
for hunting!
53002.descriptionJp:
みなさん、いい走りっぷりで
したね！しかし、往路あると
こ復路あり！です。体も温
まってきたところですしベー
スキャンプまで全力で走って
きてください。良いタイムで
ゴールされた方には狩猟に役
立つお年玉をご用意しており
ます！

61346.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の捕獲
61346.description: Everyone seems to be making merry at the Hunters Festa. That reminds me, right now there are not enough ingredients for the hunters. If you are a proper hunter too, would you go and procure what we need? Do that and I will give you this red gem.
61346.descriptionEn:
Everyone is making merry
at the Hunters Festa.
Right, we are short on ingredients
for the hunters right now.
If you are a proper
hunter, would you procure
what we need?
Then I will give you
this red orb.
61346.descriptionJp:
ハンターズフェスタでみんな
お祭り騒ぎみたいね。
そうだ、今、ハンターたちへ
の食材が足りないの。
あなたもいっぱしのハンター
なら、ちょっと必要なものを
調達してきてくれない？
そうしたら、この赤い玉を
あげるわ。

53051.description: To develop a new antidote, I want you to slay the Espinas, which bears powerful venomous spines. For the research, please also break its horn and sever its tail if you can. The more effort you put in, the more the reward swells, so do your best! I'm counting on you!
53051.descriptionEn:
To develop a new antidote,
I want you to slay an Espinas
that bears powerful venomous spikes.
For the research, if possible
please also break its horn
and sever its tail. The harder
you work, the bigger the reward, so
do your best!
I am counting on you!
53051.descriptionJp:
新しい解毒薬の開発のため、
強力な毒の棘を持つ≪エスピ
ナス≫を討伐してほしいの。
研究のため、できれば≪角破
壊≫と≪尻尾切断≫もお願い
するわね。頑張ってくれた
分だけ、報酬も弾むから頑
張ってね！
期待してるわ♪

50187.description: There is a report that an unidentified monster suddenly appeared at the top of the tower. It came out of the light leaking through a gap in the clouds, they say, and from the report it is presumed to be Zerureusu, the Glittering World Wyvern. If true, this is a very dangerous situation. Head there at once and investigate.
50187.descriptionEn:
There is a report that an
unidentified monster suddenly
appeared atop the Tower.
It is said to have emerged from
the light leaking through the
gaps in the clouds, and from
that report we surmise it is
the Radiant Wyvern ≪Zerureusu≫.
If true, this is a very dangerous
situation. Head out and survey it!
50187.descriptionJp:
突如、塔の頂部に未確認の
モンスターが現れたとの報告
がありました。雲の隙間から
漏れる光の中より現れたとの
ことですが、報告から輝界竜
≪ゼルレウス≫であると推測
されます。本当であれば、
大変危険な状態です。
至急現地へ向かい調査を
お願いします。

23684.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23684.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Long Sword, show me the skill
you have honed against the
Baruragaru in the New Great
Arena! If you hunt it well,
you shall earn even more
reward than your daily efforts
would bring.
23684.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

62085.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62085.description: The bond of a mated pair is truly precious. By each making up for what the other lacks, new value is born. Go and hunt the male monster I found. Let us take the male's fighting spirit and nobility as our reference and create a navy blue material.
62085.descriptionEn:
The bond of a mated pair is truly
precious. By covering each other's
shortcomings, new value is born.
Go and hunt the male monster I
have found. Let us use the male's
fighting spirit and nobility to
create a navy-blue material,
shall we.
62085.descriptionJp:
メオトの絆は実に尊きもの。
互いの不足を補い合うことで、
新たな価値が生まれましょう。
私が見つけたオスモンスター
を狩猟してくるのです。
オスの闘志と気高さを参考に、
紺色の素材を作り出して
みせようではありませんか。

55680.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
55680.description: This is an upgrade quest for the Transcendent armor Shagaru GX series. You can obtain more materials than usual. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
55680.descriptionEn:
This is an upgrade quest for the
Transcendent Armor Shagaru GX
Series.
You can obtain more materials
than usual.
It is a bargain quest, so please
give it a try!
55680.descriptionJp:
遷悠防具「シャガルGX
シリーズ」の強化クエストに
なります。
通常よりも多く素材を獲得
することができます。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

21051.description: Slay the 8 blue hunters, Velociprey, that use the Jungle as their feeding ground! They are just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt!
21051.descriptionEn:
These blue hunters, ≪Velociprey≫,
treat the Jungle as their feeding
ground. Slay 8 of them!
They are just the right opponents
to measure a hunter's skill!
21051.descriptionJp:
密林をエサ場とする、
青き狩人≪ランポス≫８頭を
討伐してください！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手ですよ！

26637.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

53224.description: I am the Holy Knight, a gentleman who rides a silver dragon and delivers gifts to good children. However, this year I feel like hunting Gaushika. Please do not overlook a single corner. I am the Holy Knight until 23:59 on the 25th.
53224.descriptionEn:
The gentleman who rides a silver
dragon and delivers gifts
to good children,
Holy Knight,
at your service.
But this year I feel like
hunting Gargwa.
Please do not miss a single one.
I remain Holy Knight until 23:59 on the 25th.
53224.descriptionJp:
銀の竜に乗って良い子に
ギフトを届ける紳士、
ホーリーナイトで
ございます。
しかし今年はガウシカを
狩りたい気分なのです。
どうぞ隅々まで見逃さずに。
25日の23時59分までは
ホーリーナイトですよ。

1065.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
1065.description: Hunting Iodrome in the volcanic zone may prove a little troublesome! A wounded Iodrome may flee into places where a hunter loses stamina fast, so finish it quickly!
1065.descriptionEn:
Hunting a Gendrome in the Volcano
region might be a little
troublesome! A Gendrome that has
spent its stamina may flee
into nasty places that
drain a hunter's stamina!
Finish it in one rush!
1065.descriptionJp:
火山地帯で≪ドスイーオス≫
を狩猟するのは、少しばかり
厄介かも知れないぞ！体力を
消耗したドスイーオスは狩人
が体力を消耗するような、
嫌な場所に逃げ込む可能性が
ある！速攻で仕留めるんだ！

63233.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
63233.description: A sickle crab, different in appearance from the usual and extremely powerful, is on a rampage in the volcano, and word has come that the examiner for Secret Scroll hunters, who is on his way here, cannot get through and is in trouble. If the volcano can be made safe, it seems you can be sure to be issued a Secret Proof [Break].
63233.descriptionEn:
A Shogun Ceanataur unlike
any normal one, frightfully
powerful, is raging
in the Volcano, so the
Secret Art examiners heading
here cannot pass
through; that is the report.
If the Volcano can be made safe,
the Secret Art Proof [Break]
will surely be issued, it seems.
63233.descriptionJp:
見た目が通常と異なり、
非常に強力な鎌蟹が、
火山で暴れているため、
こちらへ向かっている、
秘伝書ハンターの判定員が
通ることができずに困ってい
るとの報告が届いた。
火山の安全を確保できれば、
≪秘伝の証【破】≫を確実
に発行してもらえるらしい。

62645.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
62645.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62645.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62645.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

61891.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61891.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61891.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

26377.description: In the wasteland known as the Canyon, you are sure to gather things the likes of which you have never laid eyes on. Well? Does that not set your heart racing? I recommend you go and see for yourself.
26377.descriptionEn:
In the ≪Canyon≫, that wild
wasteland, you are sure to
gather things you have never
seen before.
Well? Does that not stir your
heart? I recommend you go there
at least once.
26377.descriptionJp:
荒野の大地、≪峡谷≫では、
きっと、今まで見たことも
ないようなものが採取できる
ことだろう。
どうだ、心が躍るだろう？
一度行ってみることをオスス
メするぜ。

21413.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. The reward is a certain material that proves you an angler. Show me the fruits of all your work so far! Since fishing is the aim, absolutely do not hunt the Plesioth Subspecies this time either!
21413.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. The
reward is a certain material that
proves you are an angler.
Show me the sum of all your skill!
Fishing is the goal, so this time
you must not slay the Green Plesioth!
21413.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。報酬は、
釣師の証になる、ある素材だ。
今までの集大成を見せてくれ！
釣りが目的だから、ガノトト
ス亜種は今回も絶対に狩らな
いように！

23518.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
23518.description: The Variant Species Blangonga has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23518.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Blangonga has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous
as things stand.
Prepare fully and survey.
23518.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドドブランゴ≫は猛
烈な強さとなり、暴れ続けて
います。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

21210.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
21210.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21210.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21210.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26701.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Swamp, hunt Congalala and a flock of bird wyverns, and to finish, bring back 2 pieces of Grey Crystal Ore from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
26701.descriptionEn:
This time, special training for
you hunters with little skill!
Hunt Congalala and a flock of
Bird Wyverns in the Swamp, then
finish by bringing back 2 Raw
Gravierite from the Cave.
It is harsh training, but if you
pull it off, your standing as
hunters will rise sharply!
26701.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！沼地で桃毛獣と、鳥竜
の群れを狩猟し、仕上げに、
洞窟より灰水晶の原石２個を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

54399.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54399.description: We are surveying the dancing thunder wyvern in the Canyon that lashes its long tail and calls down lightning. Its ecology is still largely unexplained. Please hunt it and lend your strength to our research!
54399.descriptionEn:
We are surveying the Dancing Thunder
Wyvern in the Canyon that lashes its
long tail and drops lightning.
Its ecology is still unexplained.
Please hunt it and lend
us your strength!
54399.descriptionJp:
峡谷にいる、長い尾を振り乱
して雷を落とす舞雷竜の調査
を行っています。
その生態はまだまだ未解明。
どうか狩猟を行い、我々の研
究に力を貸してください！

50051.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that guarantees an encounter with that black monster. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50051.descriptionEn:
For members of the winning Guild
in the Hunting Festival only, we
have prepared a quest where you
are sure to meet that black
monster. Please carry your
Festival Proof when accepting
and joining.
50051.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪あの
黒いモンスター≫と確実に出
会えるクエストを用意させて
いただきました。受注、参加
時に、祭典の証をお持ちくだ
さい。

50771.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
50771.description: We present a request that lets you obtain more than usual of the materials needed to craft and upgrade the Water Fortress Wyvern's Hard Species gear, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
50771.descriptionEn:
Though there is a limit on how many
you can accept per day, for the materials
needed to craft and upgrade Water Fortress
Wyvern Hardcore gear, here is a request
that yields more than usual. Please
do not let this chance slip by.
50771.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、水砦竜の剛種武
具の生産強化に必要な素材を
通常より多く入手できる依頼
をご紹介します。この機会を
逃さぬようご注意ください。

61831.objectiveJp: カジキマグロ１０匹の納品
61831.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Hunting monsters is not all a hunter does. Fishing is a fine hunt as well. Why not aim to be an angler yourself? If you do, start by delivering 10 Marlin on your own.
61831.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. Hunting
monsters is not all a hunter does.
Fishing is a fine hunt in its own
right. Why not aim to be an angler?
If you do, start by delivering
10 Speartuna on your own.
61831.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。モンスター
を狩るだけがハンターじゃな
い。釣りだって立派な狩猟だ。
君も釣師を目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人でカジ
キマグロ１０匹の納品からだ。

56077.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for five materials, and break the specified part for five more!
56077.descriptionEn:
A chance to obtain Supremacy
weapons prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal a set amount of damage to
the target for 5 materials, and
break the specified parts for
5 more of each!
56077.descriptionJp:
ギルドで準備した辿異武器を
入手するチャンス！
参加条件はＧＲ２００！
ターゲットに一定ダメージを
与えることで素材を５個、
指定の部位を破壊することで
さらに５個ずつプレゼント！

62372.description: Hey, look at this. A fine weapon, no? This is one of the special weapons suited to Variants, and wearing it is a condition for some jobs. Will you make one too? Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share the leftover materials.
62372.descriptionEn:
Hey, take a look at this.
Nice weapon, huh? It's a kind of
special weapon suited for fighting
Variants. What's more, I hear
equipping it is a requirement for
certain requests.
Want to make one yourself?
Clear the requests I introduce
to you, and I'll share spare parts.
62372.descriptionJp:
よう、こいつを見てくれよ。
いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

26322.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26322.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26322.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

53089.description: Our boss wants a big round egg as an offering for moon viewing! So deliver 1 Herbivore Egg. There may be others after the eggs too. Fetch it carefully.
53089.descriptionEn:
Our boss
for the moon-viewing offering
wants a big round egg!
So,
one herbivore egg,
deliver it.
There may be others aiming
for eggs too.
Fetch it carefully.
53089.descriptionJp:
我らのボスが
お月見のお供え物に
大きくて丸い卵をご所望だ！
ということで
草食竜の卵を１個
納品してくれ。
他にも卵を狙ってくるヤツらが
いるかもしれない。
気を付けて取ってきてくれ。

53137.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
53137.description: Haan! What a thing! Flowers should be pure, cute and beautiful! If they get soaked by rain they are no longer tres bien! You! Can I ask you to investigate why the rain will not stop in the highlands? I will pay generously! Ah! Do not hurt cute things or I will not forgive you!
53137.descriptionEn:
Haah! What a disaster!
Flowers ought to be pure, cute
and beautiful! Wet with rain they
stop being tres bien!
You there! Look into why the rain
will not stop in the Highlands?
I shall pay you handsomely!
Ah! Harm anything cute and
I will not forgive you!
53137.descriptionJp:
ハァン！なんということだ！
花は清く可愛く美しくあるべ
きなんだ！雨に濡れたらトレ
ビアンッでなくなるではない
か！君！高地で雨が止まない
理由の調査を頼めるかい？お
礼はたんと弾むからさァ！
アッ！可愛いものを傷つけた
ら許さないぞ！

62115.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62115.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a long-range weapon. Take the armor and Bow prepared for you and hunt the devouring wyvern Pariapuria in the New Grand Arena! Dodge the monster's attacks, put some distance between you, and then shoot!
62115.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This time
you will hunt with a long-range
weapon.
With the armor and Bow prepared
in advance, hunt the Glutton Wyvern
Pariapuria in the New Great Arena!
Dodge the monster's attacks
and shoot after making distance!
62115.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
遠距離武器の狩猟をしてもら
おう。
予め用意された防具と弓で新
大闘技場にいる呑竜≪パリア
プリア≫を狩猟してきたまえ！
モンスターの攻撃を避けつつ
距離を取ってから撃つんだぞ！

55937.description: Two beasts are raging, dyeing their surroundings red with anger. We will drive them as far as the ruins somehow, so hunters, to keep the harm from spreading further, please slay them. Succeed in the slaying and you shall have materials from armor the Guild has hoarded since old.
55937.descriptionEn:
Two beasts are raging, dyeing
their surroundings red with anger.
We will drive them as far as
the ruins somehow, so hunters,
to keep the harm from spreading
further, please slay them.
Succeed in the slaying and
you shall have materials from armor
the Guild has hoarded since old.
55937.descriptionJp:
２頭の獣が怒りで周囲を赤く
染めながら暴れ回っています。
何とか古跡までは私たちが
追い込むので、ハンターの方
には、これ以上被害を拡大さ
せないために討伐をお願いし
ます。討伐に成功した暁には
古くからギルドで蔵されてき
た防具の素材を差し上げます。

26330.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26330.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26330.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26330.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50248.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
50248.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Pink Rathian beautifully. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50248.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Go and hunt the ≪Pink Rathian≫
with style.
If you clear this quest, your standing
as a hunter will shoot right up!
Now, show us what you can do!
50248.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪桜火竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

62790.description: Something terrible has happened! Someone has set nasty traps at the gathering points in the Jungle. I was about to use a Maca Pickling Jar to make a Boost Potion, and now I cannot even gather in peace! Please. Lend us your strength!
62790.descriptionEn:
Something terrible has happened!
Someone has set annoying traps at
the gathering points of the
Jungle. I was about to use my
≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ to make
≪Enhancer≫, but like this I
cannot gather in peace!
Please! Lend us your strength!
62790.descriptionJp:
大変なことが起こりました！
誰かが密林の採取ポイントに
迷惑な仕掛けを施したのです。
せっかく≪マカ漬けの壷≫を
使って≪増強剤≫を作ろうと
していたのに、このままでは
安心して採取もできません！
お願いです。どうか皆さんの
力をお貸しください！

58132.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58132.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58132.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58132.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

21028.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
21028.description: A subspecies of Gypceros has appeared in the swamp! It seems to have an eerie appearance with a purple body color! It has a habit of collecting shiny things, so if you break its crest you may sometimes get a precious stone!
21028.descriptionEn:
A Gypceros subspecies has
appeared in the Swamp!
It has an eerie purple body!
It loves to hoard shiny things,
so breaking its crest may yield
precious stones!
21028.descriptionJp:
毒怪鳥≪ゲリョス≫の亜種が
沼地に現れました！体色が紫
色の不気味な容姿をしている
ようです！光り物を好み集め
る習性があるので、トサカを
破壊すれば、貴重な石が手に
入ることもあるみたいです！

50215.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21601.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21601.description: Have you heard of the Swallowtail Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21601.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb called the
Swallowtail Orb?
Its material is essential to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Complete this request and I shall
give you precious decoration
materials.
21601.descriptionJp:
燕尾原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55621.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (chest), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
55621.descriptionEn:
In this quest,
for G Rank Secret Art Armor (torso),
the Weapon Ribbons needed for upgrades,
excluding Weapon Merits, materials are
yielded.
The yield is one type.
To accept the quest,
one Hunter Die: White
is required, so
please be aware.
55621.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（胴防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターダイス白≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

54697.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

55078.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55078.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55078.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54788.description: Your mushroom deliveries, hunters, were truly splendid! As a reward I have prepared a quest that earns you plenty of ＧＲＰ! Take it on and aim for a good rank up!
54788.descriptionEn:
The mushroom deliveries by you
hunters were truly splendid! As a
reward, a quest where plenty of GRP
can be obtained has been prepared
by me! Take this chance to accept
the quest and aim for a solid
rank up!
54788.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君等によるキノコ
納品、実に見事であった！報
酬として、ＧＲＰがたっぷり
手に入るクエストを用意した
ぞ！この機会にクエストを受
注してガッツリランクアップ
を目指すのじゃ！

61932.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
61932.description: This is a practice qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
61932.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament practice qualifier
quest. In the finals, the
time limit is 5 minutes.
Also, from the monster's
carving and clear rewards,
the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained.
61932.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用予選
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が５分以内です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

23296.description: Thanks to your gathering in unexplored lands and delivering to the Guild, Mezepolta has grown richer. As a token of our gratitude, we present this coin.
23296.descriptionEn:
Thanks to your gathering in
unexplored lands and your
deliveries to the Guild,
Mezeporuta has grown wealthy.
As a token of our gratitude,
please accept this coin.
23296.descriptionJp:
未開の地において採集を行い、
ギルドに納品していただいた
おかげで、メゼポルタも豊か
になりました。
その感謝の証として、この
コインを贈ります。

21453.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Daimyo Hermitaur. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21453.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest to slay
a ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
fellow hunters?
21453.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

55581.description: A report has arrived that the shadow of the Elegant Elder Dragon was sighted. At the sign of a new Variant Species, the guild has researched and prepared new weapons for promising hunters, to stand against Variant Species. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare for the hunt!
55581.descriptionEn:
Reports have come in that the
shadow of Gurenzeburu was sighted.
With signs of a new Supremacy species,
the Guild, for promising hunters,
has studied new weapons
to stand against the Supremacy
and prepared them.
Gather the production materials
and prepare to slay the Supremacy!
55581.descriptionJp:
雅翁龍の影を目撃したという
報告が届きました。
新たな辿異種出現の兆しに、
ギルドでは有望なハンターに
向けて、辿異種に立ち向かう
ための新たな武器を研究し、
用意しました。
生産素材を獲得して、辿異種
の討伐に備えてください！

56130.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
56130.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, keep pouring in. Judging this an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is the Nargacuga that Runs to the Extreme. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special coin, needed to accept the next request!
56130.descriptionEn:
Reports keep arriving that the
monsters bearing the name Acme,
great threats, are being sighted
again. Judging this an emergency,
we request swift slaying of each.
This time: Nargacuga, the Acme
Runner. As proof of the kill, take
the special coin needed to accept
the next request!
56130.descriptionJp:
大きな脅威である「極み」と
名の付くモンスターたちの再
目撃報告が続々と届いている。
緊急事態と判断し、迅速な各
個討伐を依頼したい。今回は
「極み駆けるナルガクルガ」。
討伐した証として、次の依頼
を受注するのに必要となる特
別なコインを渡すぞ！

54625.description: Consulting the Guild's secret records revealed it is an elder dragon called the Silver Dragon. There are reports that this monster is advancing on Mezeporuta. It is thought to be retaliation for intruding on its territory, so please lend your strength to prevent this crisis!
54625.descriptionEn:
Searching the Guild's hidden
texts, we learned it is an
Elder Dragon called Rukodiora.
That monster is advancing on
Mezeporuta. It seems to be
retaliation for trespassing on
its territory. Please lend us
your strength to stop this!
54625.descriptionJp:
ギルド秘蔵の文献をあたった
ところ≪司銀龍≫と呼ばれる
古龍種であることがわかりま
した。
そのモンスターがメゼポルタ
に進行していると報告があり
ました。なわばりに侵入され
たことに対する報復だと思わ
れますが、この危機を防ぐ力
をお貸しください！

61569.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61569.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61569.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50038.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50038.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of zenny and Supremacy Tickets! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
50038.descriptionEn:
An urgent notice to all hunters!
On top of the training method
for gaining experience fast, you
can now get piles of Zenny and
Hardcore Tickets!
You cannot take it back to back,
but a single run's effect is
enormous!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!
50038.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法に加え、今なら
大量のゼニーと剛種チケット
が入手できます！
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

26016.description: I heard from a traveler that he nearly lost his life in the desert recently. Sudden intense drowsiness, loss of consciousness, and when he came to he had heat stroke. This must be that thing's doing. I want you to secure the safety of the road.
26016.descriptionEn:
I heard from a traveler who
nearly died in the Desert
recently. A sudden, heavy
sleepiness took his senses, and
he woke to heatstroke.
This must be that one's doing.
Please make the road safe.
26016.descriptionJp:
ある旅人から、最近砂漠で命
を落としかけたと聞いた。
突然強烈な眠気に意識を失い
気が付けば熱射病にかかって
いたということだ。
これはヤツの仕業に違いない。
旅路の安全を確保してほしい。

11024.description: The watersides of the desert are highly likely to hide the ancient Piscine Wyvern, Plesioth, lying in wait for prey! When fishing a Plesioth out with a Frog, it is important that few people are around! If you have companions, have them leave the area and settle it one on one!
11024.descriptionEn:
The waters of the Desert are
likely hiding the ancient fish
wyvern Plesioth, stalking prey!
When angling a Plesioth with a
Fishing Frog, few people
around is key! If allies are
present, have them leave the
area and fight one on one!
11024.descriptionJp:
砂漠の水辺には太古の魚竜、
≪ガノトトス≫が獲物を狙い
潜んでいる可能性が高いです！
≪釣りカエル≫でガノトトス
を一本釣りする場合は、人の
気配が少ないことが重要です！
仲間がいる場合はエリアの外に
出てもらい、１対１で勝負を！

58109.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58109.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58109.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58109.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

21493.description: There is a strange grass called Dye Grass. It can be gathered in many regions and serves as a material for arms that can hold special decorations. If you complete my request, I'll share a little of it with you.
21493.descriptionEn:
There is a strange
herb called ≪Dye Grass≫.
It grows all over and
serves as material for
gear that takes special
decorations. Finish my
request and I'll share
a little with you.
21493.descriptionJp:
≪センショク草≫という
不思議な草がある。
これは各地で採取が可能
で、特殊な装飾品を装着
できる武具の素材となる
のだ。わたしの依頼を
達成してくれたら、少し
君にも分けてあげよう。

21788.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
21788.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21788.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21788.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

53113.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ５０頭の討伐
53113.description: Meat! I do not have enough meat! At this rate I cannot hold a hot pot party! I do not want that! Bullfango meat is delicious and perfect for hot pot, so go and slay plenty! The parts unsuited to the pot I will give to you as a present! Let us have a wonderful hot pot party!
53113.descriptionEn:
Meat! We do not have enough
meat! We cannot have a hot pot
party like this! I cannot
stand it! Bullfango meat is
delicious and perfect for hot
pot, so slay plenty! The parts
unfit for the pot I will give
to you as a present, hunter!
Let us have a wonderful party!
53113.descriptionJp:
肉が！肉が足りないんです！
このままじゃ鍋パできないで
すよ！そんなの嫌だあー！
ブルファンゴのお肉は美味し
いですし、鍋に最適なので
沢山討伐してきてください！
鍋の具に不向きな部分は
ハンターさんにプレゼント
します！
素敵な鍋パにしましょうね！

26499.description: There seems to be an odd fellow in the Jungle who wants a VS Ticket. If you take one to him, he will trade it for something called a Situru Coin, they say. Lucky you if it is true. That thing is super rare, you know?
26499.descriptionEn:
Seems some odd fellow in the
Jungle wants VS. Tickets.
Bring some and he will trade
you something called Shituruu
Coins. Lucky you, if it is
true. Those are super rare!
26499.descriptionJp:
密林にＶＳ．チケットを
欲しがっている物好きが
居るらしい。持って行ったら
シトゥルゥコインなるものと
交換してくれるらしいぜ。
本当だったら、幸運だな。
アレは超レアなんだぜ？

21460.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Gravios. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21460.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
to slay Gravios.
The reward is a bit lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
sharpen your skills against
other hunters?
21460.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪グラビモス≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

56026.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
56026.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Tigrex. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56026.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the Supremacy
Tigrex.
If you destroy its developed parts in
this quest, we will add developed part
materials to the Another Reward
as a special bonus.
Please note that slaying it alone will
not earn you developed part materials.
56026.descriptionJp:
辿異種の轟竜を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

55198.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
55198.description: They say a raw, wet sound of something devouring flesh and blood comes up from beneath Tide Island. When a hunter went down into the great pit to look, two red eyes came bursting out of the dust and the stench and charged him. Whoever discovers what this creature is will receive the materials to craft armor the guild has kept hidden.
55198.descriptionEn:
They say a raw, fleshy sound of
devouring meat can be heard from
beneath the Tidal Island.
When a hunter climbed down into
the great pit to look, two red
glowing eyes came lunging out of
the dust with a terrible stench.
Whoever uncovers what this thing
is will receive Guild armor materials.
55198.descriptionJp:
潮島の地下から血肉を貪る
生々しい音が聞こえるそうだ。
あるハンターが様子を見に大
穴へ降りた所、土埃の中から
激臭とともに赤く光る二つの
目が勢いよく襲い掛かってき
たらしい。こいつの正体を突
き止めた者にはギルド秘蔵の
防具の生産素材を必ず渡そう。

22006.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22006.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! Hunt one and your skill is quite something! They say a sound burst by its ear can make it weep?
22006.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
If you can hunt a Yian Kut-Ku,
your skill is quite something!
They say making a sound by its
ear can even make it shed tears?
22006.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね！
イャンクックが狩猟できれば
狩りの腕もなかなかのもので
す！耳元で音を鳴らせばナミ
ダをこぼすこともあるとか？

55043.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐

55996.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55996.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55996.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55996.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

55363.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐

10102.description: In this arena we put on a straight one-on-one between monster and hunter! Your opponent this time seems to be a Gypceros. Give that crest of its a solid hit!
10102.descriptionEn:
In this Arena you will fight a
straight match of monster versus
hunter!
Today's opponent seems to be a
Gypceros. Land a blow with all
your might on that crest of his!
10102.descriptionJp:
この闘技場ではモンスター対
ハンターのガチンコ勝負を
やってもらうよ！
今回の相手はゲリョスみたい
だね。アイツのトサカに渾身の
一撃を食らわせてやりな！

62654.description: The most important thing for a hunter is to build up experience. From here on you will have to face tougher and tougher monsters. This time I have prepared a generous supply of items especially for you. Why not take this chance to store up some experience?
62654.descriptionEn:
As a hunter
the most important thing is,
to build up a lot of experience.
From now on, you
must take on more formidable
monsters as opponents.
This time, we have specially
prepared ample supplies.
By all means, why not take this chance
to stock up experience?
62654.descriptionJp:
ハンターとして
一番重要なことは、
多くの経験を積むことです。
これから貴方は、
より手ごわいモンスターを、
相手にしなければいけません。
今回は、特別に十分な
支給品を用意しました。
是非、この機会に経験値を
貯めてみてはどうですか？

62462.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the black armored Gravios Subspecies together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62462.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, together with a hunter who has
climbed all the way to holding a Secret Art tome,
how about hunting Black Gravios
and coming back.
Follow that different way of moving,
and if you clear the request together
I will prepare an extra reward!
62462.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
今回は、秘伝書を持つまでに
上りつめたハンターと一緒に、
黒鎧竜≪グラビモス亜種≫を
狩猟してきてはいかがだろう。
一味違った身のこなしに倣い、
共に依頼を達成すれば追加で
報酬を用意するぞ！

50816.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
50816.description: We present a request that lets you obtain more than usual of the materials needed to craft and upgrade the Fury-Faced Wyvern's Hard Species armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
50816.descriptionEn:
Though there is a limit on how many
you can accept per day, for the materials
needed to craft and upgrade Rage-Faced
Wyvern Hardcore armor, here is a request
that yields more than usual. Please
do not let this chance slip by.
50816.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、怒貌竜の剛種防
具の生産強化に必要な素材を
通常より多く入手できる依頼
をご紹介します。この機会を
逃さぬようご注意ください。

62326.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
62326.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62326.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62326.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

62514.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62514.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
62514.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

21516.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21516.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21516.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21516.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54614.description: In praise of the achievements you all left in the Extreme Conquest Battle, we present rewards. Yellow Weapon Jewel x1, Crimson Weapon Jewel x2, Azure Weapon Jewel x2, Jade Weapon Jewel x3, Extreme Expedition Contribution Certificate x10.
54614.descriptionEn:
In honor of your deeds in the
Extreme Conquest, we present
rewards.
- Yellow Weapon Orb x1
- Crimson Weapon Orb x2
- Azure Weapon Orb x2
- Green Weapon Orb x3
- Extreme Conquest Certificate x10
54614.descriptionJp:
極限征伐戦で皆さんが残した
功績を称え、報酬をお渡しい
たします。
・黄武玉１個
・紅武玉２個
・蒼武玉２個
・碧武玉３個
・極征貢献証１０枚

53231.description: What do you think of the way hunters dress lately? If someone of the opposite sex were dressed like that, I could never concentrate on the hunt! So I have thought up my own excellent improvement. I am having clothes made to order, so I leave the material gathering to you!
53231.descriptionEn:
What do you think of how hunters
dress lately?
With the opposite sex dressed like that,
no one could focus on the hunt!

So I thought up a splendid
improvement.

I am having clothes made to order,
so gather the materials!
53231.descriptionJp:
最近のハンターの恰好
どう思う？
あんな恰好の異性がいたら、
きっと狩りに集中できないわ！

そこで私がとっておきの
改善方法を考えたの。

特注で服を作るから
素材集め、頼んだわよ！

50916.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
50916.description: Uragaan, the Crushing Wyvern, appears to have shown itself in the volcano. We have asked other hunters to look into it as well, but information is still scarce and much remains unknown. To keep Mezeporuta safe, we ask for an ecological survey.
50916.descriptionEn:
It seems that Uragaan,
the Blast Hammer Wyvern,
has appeared in the Volcano.
We have also issued requests to
other hunters, but information is
still scarce and many points
remain unclear.
To protect the safety of Mezepolta,
please conduct an ecology survey.
50916.descriptionJp:
火山に
爆鎚竜・ウラガンキンが
現れたようです。
他のハンターにも依頼を
出させて頂きましたが
未だ情報が少なく、不明
な点が多くあります。
メゼポルタの安全を守る
為、生態調査をお願いし
ます。

55021.description: You found this job well! I am a genius! I have developed a new weapon not found in Mezeporuta. If you want to know the secret, complete as many hidden jobs as you can. However, you must always complete at least the main target. I wish you success!
55021.descriptionEn:
You found this request — well done!
I am a genius! I've developed
a new weapon that Mezeporta
never had. If you wish to know
this secret, complete as many
hidden requests as you can.
However, at the very least you
must complete the main target.
I wish you good fortune!
55021.descriptionJp:
よくぞこの依頼を見つけた！
ワシは天才じゃ！メゼポルタ
には無かった新しい武器を開
発したぞい。この秘密を知り
たくば、隠された依頼をでき
るだけ多く達成することじゃ。
ただし、最低でも必ずメイン
ターゲットは達成しなければ
ならぬぞ。健闘を祈る！

63203.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の捕獲
63203.description: I want to carry out research on Gasurabazura. Capture both the male and the female, somehow. I have no interest in materials, so if anything interesting turns up, you may take it after the research. If you cannot capture them, regrettably it will count as a failure.
63203.descriptionEn:
