I want to research the Orugaron.
Capture both the male and the
female somehow. I care nothing
for materials, so if something
interesting turns up, keep it
after the research.
If you fail to capture them, then
sadly it counts as a failure.
63203.descriptionJp:
響狼たちの研究を行いたい
んだ。何とかして、雄も雌も
捕獲して欲しい。素材には
興味が無いから、面白い素材
が見つかったら、研究後に
持っていっていいよ。
捕獲できなかったら、残念
だが失敗とさせてもらうよ。

61706.description: Hunters who use bowguns, this is what you have been waiting for. A support quest from the Guild! Each one is an odd job, but we will put out useful rewards for each you clear. For gunners who have grown used to handling various bullets and to combining, it is especially recommended!
61706.descriptionEn:
Bowgun-using hunters
everyone, sorry to keep you waiting. A support
quest from the Guild!
Each one is a chore-like job,
but each clear brings a useful
reward. For gunners used
to handling various shots and
combining, it is
especially recommended!
61706.descriptionJp:
ボウガンをお使いのハンター
の皆さんお待ちかね。ギルド
からの支援クエストです！
それぞれ雑用的なお仕事にな
りますが、達成ごとに有用な
報酬を出させていただきます。
色々な弾の扱いや、調合にも
慣れてきたガンナーさんには、
特におすすめですよ！

26392.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26392.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
26392.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

54611.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
54611.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54611.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54611.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

50027.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
50027.description: That season has come again. The season that tests a man. Some of you went through this hot quest last year, but there must be kids who do not know it. So I have put out the job again! Take it gratefully!
50027.descriptionEn:
That season has come around again.
The season that tests a man.
There are guys who went through this
heated quest last year too,
but there must be kids
who do not know it. So I sent
out the request again!
Take it gratefully!
50027.descriptionJp:
またこの季節がやってきた。
オトコを試す季節がよ。
去年もこの熱いクエストを
経験した野郎もいるだろうが
知らないお子ちゃまもいる
だろう。だからまた依頼を
出してやったぜ！
ありがたく受けな！

55865.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
55865.description: The existence of Bogabadorumu has newly been confirmed, but its frequent explosive attacks have led many hunters to give up on slaying it. The Guild will expand the supply items and, only when you depart with 4 hunters, provide further support. Please head out to investigate with care.
55865.descriptionEn:
Bogabadorumu has been newly
confirmed to exist, but its frequent
blast attacks have made many hunters
give up on slaying it.
The Guild is expanding supplies
and, only when departing as four,
will provide further support.
Please head out to
the survey with care.
55865.descriptionJp:
新たに存在が確認されたボガ
バドルムですが、頻発する爆
発攻撃に、多くのハンターが
討伐を断念しています。
ギルドでは支給品を拡充する
と共に、４名で出発した時に
限り更なる支援を行います。
気をつけて調査に向かってく
ださい。

54764.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54764.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54764.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

62911.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62911.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62911.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

50539.description: To what extent did the people of ancient times know the world? Rare materials unknown to us sleep somewhere in the Highlands. Hunt the king of the skies that dwells there, and it will be a clue to finding the bone that serves as material.
50539.descriptionEn:
How much did the humans of old
truly know? Rare materials unknown
to us sleep somewhere in the
Highlands.
Hunt the king of the sky that
dwells there, and the bones that
become materials may be found.
50539.descriptionJp:
太古の人間は、一体どこまで
知りつくしていたのだろうか。
私達の知らない希少素材が
高地のどこかに眠っている。
そこに棲む空の王を狩れば、
素材となる骨を探し出す
手がかりとなるだろう。

60097.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

21007.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! The Kut-Ku is usually pink, but this one is said to be blue! A subspecies for certain!
21007.descriptionEn:
If you hear a birdlike cry in
this Jungle, it is surely the
Yian Kut-Ku! Normally it is
pink, but this time its body
is said to be blue! It must
be the subspecies!
21007.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね！
イャンクックといえば普通は
ピンクの体色なんだけど、今
回は体色が青いって話です！
亜種に間違いないですね！

55029.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
55029.description: I asked the gentlemen to procure Teostra materials, but they never come back. I can wait no longer, so I have issued a request. The reward will be generous, so please make haste. I will say it again. Please make haste.
55029.descriptionEn:
I asked a gentleman to procure
Teostra materials, but no matter
how long it takes, he never
comes back. I can wait no
longer, so I issued the request
myself. The reward is generous,
so please hurry.
I say it again.
Please hurry.
55029.descriptionJp:
殿方に炎王龍の素材の調達を
依頼したのだけれど、いつま
で経っても帰ってこないの。
もう待ちきれないから、依頼
を出させて頂きましたの。報
酬は弾みますから、急ぎでお
願いしますわ。
もう一度言うわね。
急ぎでお願いしますわ。

21687.description: Have you heard of the Peony Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21687.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb called the
Peony Orb?
Its material is essential to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Complete this request and I shall
give you precious decoration
materials.
21687.descriptionJp:
牡丹原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

61842.objectiveJp: さびた板状の塊１個の納品
61842.description: Now for Part Two. From the five kinds including Rusted Fragments, turn in two different kinds than in Part One. The reward is something the alchemy shop master wants so badly his throat aches, for an experiment. What he will do with it, I do not know.
61842.descriptionEn:
Now, Part 2.
From the five kinds such as
rusted chunks, deliver the two
kinds that differ from Part 1.
The reward is an item the
apothecary's master wants so
badly his throat aches for it,
for some experiment of his.
What he'll do with it, I don't know.
61842.descriptionJp:
さて【後編】だ。
さびた塊などの５種類から、
【前編】とは違う２種類を納
品してもらうぞ。
報酬は、調合屋のあるじが
ある実験をしたい為に喉から
手が出るほど欲しがってる一
品だ。これで何をするのかは
知らんがな。

61973.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61973.description: Do you know? There is a game where you hunt monsters and, with luck, a huge amount of zenny comes back. Give me an Event Assistance Ticket and I will tell you where. How about it? Want to try?
61973.descriptionEn:
Hey, you know?
Hunt monsters, and if you're
lucky, a huge pile of zenny
comes right back to you!
Bring me an ≪Event
Assistance Ticket≫ and I'll
show you where. How about it?
Want to give it a try?
61973.descriptionJp:
キミ、知ってるかい？
モンスターを狩猟して、運が
良ければ巨額のゼニーが戻っ
てくる遊びがあるらしいぜ？
≪イベント補助券≫をくれれ
ば場所を教えてやるぞ？どう
だい？チャレンジしてみない
かい？

11039.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon also called the Sickle Crab! If the Shield Crab is defense, the Sickle Crab is offense! Those sharp claws, swung down with force, seem to slash through almost anything! If the hunt is hard, break the claws and come back!
11039.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon called the Scythe
Crab! Shield Crab defends,
Scythe Crab attacks! Its
claws seem to cut through
almost anything! If it's too
much, break its claws and go!
11039.descriptionJp:
≪ショウグンギザミ≫は鎌蟹
とも呼ばれる甲殻生物です！
盾蟹が守りなら鎌蟹は攻め！
力強く振り下ろされる鋭い爪
は大抵のものを切り裂いてし
まうみたい！狩猟が困難なら
ツメを破壊して戻って下さい！

62993.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62993.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62993.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62993.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55523.description: That armor I loved the look of, and this one too, you never wear them anymore, meow! There are even hunters who say they have graduated from them, meow! No, meow! Put on that wonderful Frogada armor once more and show me the hunter in all his glory, meow! I will reward you, meow!
55523.descriptionEn:
Neither that armor I liked the look
of nor this one do they wear any
more, meow! Some hunters even say
they have graduated from them,
meow!
No, meow! Wear that splendid
Frogada armor once more and show
me a hunter in fine form, meow!
I will reward you, meow!
55523.descriptionJp:
見た目がお気に入りだった
あの防具もこの防具も
なかなか着てくれないニャ！
卒業したって言うハンター
さんもいるニャ！
嫌ニャ！もう一度あの素晴ら
しいフロガダ防具を着て、
ハンターさんの雄姿を見せて
くれニャ！お礼はするニャ！

55267.description: You have the Entra GX series but want different armor too! For you I have prepared a quest that gets one piece's worth of production and upgrade materials for the recommended Frogada G series armor all at once! Clear it five times and collect every part!
55267.descriptionEn:
You've made the Entora GX
series, but want other armor
too! For you, we prepared a
quest where one piece's worth
of production and upgrade
materials for the “Frogada G
Series” comes all at once!
Clear it 5 times, get all parts!
55267.descriptionJp:
エントラGXシリーズはできた
けれども違う防具もほしい！
そんなあなたの為のおすすめ
防具「フロガダＧシリーズ」
１部位分の生産強化素材が一
気に入手できるクエストを用
意しました！クエストを５回
クリアして全部位を揃えよう！

21246.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21246.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21246.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

61042.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61042.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61042.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62739.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
62739.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62739.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62739.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

61575.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
61575.description: Two beastmen apparently chose the jungle as their meeting place. But a Pink Rathian is there, and they are searching for each other while trying not to be found, so they never meet. Help them come together.
61575.descriptionEn:
Two beastmen tribes apparently
chose the Jungle as their
meeting place. But a Pink
Rathian is there, and they search
for each other without being
found, so they never meet
at all, it seems.
Help them come together.
61575.descriptionJp:
ある獣人族同士が、お互いの
待ち合わせ場所として密林を
選んだらしい。しかし、≪リ
オレイア亜種≫がいて、見つ
からないようにお互いを探し
てるもんだから、一向に会え
ないそうだ。
出会いを手伝ってやってくれ。

21319.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
21319.description: I obtained information that there are ruins from ancient times somewhere in the swamp, and stormed in to verify it, but Akura Vashimu lives at the destination and I am stuck. Could you slay that monster? In thanks I will present part of the excavated goods.
21319.descriptionEn:
I learned that ancient ruins
lie somewhere in the Swamp,
so I went in to confirm it,
but a Taikun Zamuza has
made its nest at the site,
and I am at a loss. Could
you please slay that monster
for me? As thanks, I will
present part of my finds.
21319.descriptionJp:
沼地のどこかに太古時代の遺
跡があるとの情報を手に入れ
て、真偽を確かめるために沼
地に乗り込みましたが、目的
地に尾晶蠍が生息していて
困っています。どうか、その
モンスターを退治していただ
けないでしょうか。お礼に発
掘品の一部を進呈いたします。

50684.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50684.description: In the Snowy Mountains, a Blangonga variant attacked merchants. The damage was only to the cargo, but this could become a threat in future. The content of this request is the hunting of that one. I think it is a request suited to master hunters such as you, but what do you say?
50684.descriptionEn:
In the Snowy Mountains, an attack
on merchants by a Blangonga Variant
took place.
The damage was only to cargo, but
this could become a future threat.
This request is to slay it.
I think it suits hunters of your
caliber, but
what say you?
50684.descriptionJp:
雪山で≪ドドブランゴ変種≫
による商人達への襲撃が
あった。
被害は積み荷だけだったが、
これは今後の脅威となりうる。
今回の依頼内容は、奴の狩猟
だ。君たちの様な凄腕の
ハンターにこそ、ふさわしい
依頼だと思うがどうだね？

23676.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
23676.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Blangonga. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23676.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Blangonga materials.
To accept it, a Superior Ticket
is required. Note that if the
quest is failed, the Superior
Ticket will be consumed.
23676.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ドドブランゴ≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55687.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55687.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Blangonga. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55687.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Blangonga materials.
To accept it, a Superior Ticket
is required. Note that if the
quest is failed, the Superior
Ticket will be consumed.
55687.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ドドブランゴ≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54431.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
54431.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54431.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54431.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23624.description: The Variant Species Plesioth has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23624.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Plesioth has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous.
Prepare fully and survey.
23624.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ガノトトス≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

54139.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54139.description: From time to time something like an orb is found inside a monster's body. It can be used as material for all kinds of gear, and demand for it has been rising lately. Clear this request and I will give you one of those orbs, a Fine Orb, as your reward.
54139.descriptionEn:
From inside a monster's body,
round orbs are sometimes
found.
They can be used as materials
for all sorts of gear,
and demand has risen lately.
If you complete this request,
one such orb, a Fine Orb,
I will give as your reward.
54139.descriptionJp:
モンスターの体の中から、
時折玉のようなものが
見つかることがあるんです。
さまざまな武具の素材に
使うことができるもので、
最近需要が高まっています。
今回の依頼を達成できたら、
その玉のひとつ≪優玉≫を
報酬として差し上げます。

55157.objectiveJp: イビルジョー１頭の狩猟
55157.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make armor from the rage wyvern Deviljho! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain materials needed to upgrade Transcendence Armor, so please give it a try!
55157.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want
Deviljho armor! Clear the
sub-target to obtain materials
needed to upgrade migration
armor, so please give it a try!
55157.descriptionJp:
恐暴竜≪イビルジョー≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを用意
しました！サブターゲットを
達成すると遷悠防具の強化に
必要な素材を入手できます
ので、ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

23674.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Hypnocatrice. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23674.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Hypnocatrice
materials. To accept it, a
Superior Ticket is required.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the Superior Ticket
will be consumed.
23674.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ヒプノック≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21584.description: Have you heard of the Monkey Rump Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21584.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb called the
Monkey Rump Orb?
Its material is essential to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Complete this request and I shall
give you precious decoration
materials.
21584.descriptionJp:
猿尻原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

26503.description: Oh, you've come. Hunting monsters is fine, but mining is fun too! So, how about testing your mining skill? I want you to gather the ore I'm about to request. The reward will be generous!
26503.descriptionEn:
Hey, glad you came.
Hunting monsters is fine, but
mining is a joy too!
So, how about a test of your
mining skill?
I want you to gather the ore I
am about to ask for.
The pay will be generous!
26503.descriptionJp:
おう、よく来たな。
モンスターを狩るのもいいが、
採掘も楽しいよな！
そこで、採掘の腕試しをして
みないか？
これから依頼する鉱石を集め
てほしい。
報酬は弾むぜ！

26046.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26046.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26046.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

63159.description: I have heard that the Shakalaka are holding some suspicious feast! Very rare drinks are said to be served there. Your task is to slip in disguised as a Shakalaka and investigate what is really going on. Right then, I am counting on you!
63159.descriptionEn:
I have heard word that the masked
tribe is holding some suspicious
banquet! Rare drinks are said to
be served there.
Your request is to slip in
wearing the tribe's guise and
investigate. Well then, I leave
it to you!
63159.descriptionJp:
奇面族達が何やら怪しげな
宴を開くらしいという情報を
耳にしたぞ！そこでは、とて
も珍しい飲み物が振舞われる
そうだ。今回の依頼は、奇面
族の姿で紛れ込みその実態
を調査することだ。それでは、
よろしく頼んだぞ！

55579.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55579.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55579.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

11065.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared! You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best!
11065.descriptionEn:
Beyond these lands, in the mysterious
untouched ≪Ancient Tower≫, the
Phantom Beast ≪Kirin≫ appears
to have shown itself! You cannot
reach the Ancient Tower anytime —
only while the weather and climate
are stable. Do your best!
11065.descriptionJp:
この地の彼方に眠る、謎多き
未開の地≪古塔≫に、幻獣
≪キリン≫が現れたようです！
古塔へはいつでも行けるわけ
じゃなく、天候や気候を始め
とする環境が安定してる期間
だけです。頑張って下さい！

26744.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26744.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Celestial Queen] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
26744.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Celestial Queen]≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).
26744.descriptionJp:
２年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ナナブレイド【天妃】≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると、
≪感謝の証K≫を１１枚
プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証K≫から≪アカム
スクウィード≫（ランス）が
生産可能です。

26721.description: What, you just want a hard Light Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26721.descriptionEn:
What, you just want a really
stiff Light Bowgun? Then I
will refine some Argen Steel!
But the ore needed is hard to
find, and nasty monsters roam
the area. Go find it with all
your spirit!
26721.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬いライト
ボウガンが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

50843.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50843.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
50843.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!
50843.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のゼニーが入手できる上
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

55611.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a foreleg and hind leg break in slaying Inagami, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55611.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Inagami≫ and break its
forelegs and hind legs, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55611.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪雅翁龍≫討伐にて
前脚と後脚の破壊を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

22060.description: The depths of the Highlands are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22060.descriptionEn:
The depths of the
≪Highlands≫ are still under
Guild survey, but hunters
too might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22060.descriptionJp:
≪高地≫の奥深くは、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

53074.description: The Plesioth you caught has escaped! I can't handle it anymore. I don't know if it'll be any use, but I gathered all the festival gear I could. Somehow slay it and set off the signal fireworks at the oasis! When it's done I'll give you something good!
53074.descriptionEn:
The Water Wyvern you
caught got away!
I cannot handle it anymore. I do not
know if they will help, but
I gathered every festival prop
there was. Slay it somehow and
set off the signal firework
at the oasis! When it is done
I will give you something good!
53074.descriptionJp:
お前さんが捕まえてくれた
水竜が逃げちまった！
もう手に負えねえ。使えるか
どうか分からねえが
お祭りの道具をありったけ
集めた。なんとか討伐して
合図の花火をオアシスで
打ち上げてくれ！終わったら
いいものやるからよ！

50170.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

63028.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
63028.description: A practice final for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Clearing it does not grant the target monster's materials.
63028.descriptionEn:
A practice final for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Clearing it does not grant
the target monster's materials.
63028.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。
クリア報酬で対象モンスター
の素材は入手できません。

61522.objectiveJp: 七色たんぽぽ５０個の納品
61522.description: Greetings. We meet for the first time. Do you gather between hunts? I think this is a good opportunity, so would you show me the fruits of your gathering? Of course, I will pay.
61522.descriptionEn:
Good day to you.
How do you do.
Do you do any gathering
between your hunts now and then?
I think this is a good opportunity,
so would you show me
the results of your gathering?
Of course, I will give you
a reward for your trouble.
61522.descriptionJp:
ごきげんよう。はじめまして。
ちょっとした狩りの合間に
採取をしていますか？
これも一つのいい機会だと
思いますので、あなたの採取
の成果を見せていただけない
かしら？
もちろん、報酬はお渡ししま
すから。

55402.description: It is Tanabata, huh. I get to meet my girlfriend! But only once a year. And only for one day. Is that not cruel? Once I sleep it is over. So I really hate birds that put you to sleep! I want you to hunt them!
55402.descriptionEn:
It is Tanabata.
I get to see my girlfriend!
But only once a year.
And only for one day.
Is that not cruel?
If I sleep it is over.
So that bird that puts you to sleep,
I really hate it!
Please hunt it for me!
55402.descriptionJp:
七夕っすね。
カノジョと会えるんっすよ！
けど年に１回だけなんすよ。
しかも１日だけ。
酷くないっすか。
寝たら終わりっすよもう。
だから眠らせてくるトリ、
チョー嫌いっす！
狩っちゃって欲しいっす！

50156.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50156.description: Listen to this! I was in the desert! It looked like an Akura Vashimu but a little different, and that crystal! It was huge! So splendid and lovely I wanted to walk right up to it! Can someone please slay it!
50156.descriptionEn:
Listen to this!
I was in the Desert!
Like an Akura Vashimu but a bit
different, and that crystal body!
And it was huge!
So splendid and lovely I almost
wanted to walk right up to it!
Can nobody slay
that thing?!
50156.descriptionJp:
ちょっと聞いてくれ！
砂漠にいたんだ！
尾晶蠍のようでちょっと違
う、でもあの結晶体を！
それもでかいんだ！
見事でステキで思わず近づ
きたくなるほどに！
どうにか奴を討伐できない
ものか！！

53029.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53029.description: Comrades! Are you getting along with your Felyne comrades? To deepen a bond, one must understand two feelings, one's own and one's partner's! So first, to recognize your own feelings anew, take on the quest I have prepared!
53029.descriptionEn:
Everyone! With your Partner Nyanters,
are you getting along well?
To deepen your bond,
both your own feelings and your partner's
must be understood!
So first, to recognize your own
feelings again, I
have prepared a quest for you
to take on!
53029.descriptionJp:
諸君！パートニャーとは
仲良くやれているか？
より仲を深めるためには、
自身と相手の二つの気持ち
を理解することが必要だ！
そこで、まずは自身の気持
ちを再認識するため、我輩
が用意したクエストに
挑むのだ！

21352.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
21352.description: You love Gunlance, right? Of course you do? Let me tell you something good. No need to hold back! A rare Rathalos has been sighted at the tower, and my hunch says its materials can make an amazing Gunlance. Go once with a Gunlance!
21352.descriptionEn:
You love Gunlance, right?
Of course you do! Shall I tell
you something good? No need to
be shy! A rare Rathalos was
seen at the Tower, and my gut
says its materials make a
wicked Gunlance. Go try it!
21352.descriptionJp:
キミ、ガンランス大好きだろ
う？そうだろう？イイこと教
えるぞ？な〜に、遠慮しなく
ていいって！なんかさ、塔に
珍しい火竜が目撃されてさ、
僕の勘だと、きっとそいつの
素材で凄いガンランスが作れ
るんだ。さあキミもガンラン
スで１回行ってきなよ！

51105.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51105.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of an Azure Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
51105.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Azure Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51105.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
蒼眠鳥のクチバシを破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

60918.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60918.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
60918.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

7.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
7.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
7.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

21519.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21519.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21519.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21519.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26157.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
26157.description: There is a report that a rare pairing can be seen in the swamp right now. A Shogun Ceanataur and a Congalala together is not something you see often, so it might be worth going to look.
26157.descriptionEn:
Right now in the Swamp, reports
have come in that a rare
sighting can be seen.
A Shogun Ceanataur and a Congalala
together is quite rare
to see, so it might be nice
to go and take a look.
26157.descriptionJp:
今、沼地で、めずらしい顔あ
わせが見られるという報告が
入ったわ。
鎌蟹と、桃毛獣の組み合わせ
だなんて、なかなか見られな
いし、行ってみるのもいいか
もしれないわね。

28013.description: This is terrible, meow! That Tigrex is on a rampage in the Snowy Mountains, they say, meow! It is dangerous this time, so I am asking hunters of ＨＲ４ and above, meow. There is a sub-target too, so I would be glad if you tried that as well, meow.
28013.descriptionEn:
It's terrible, nya! That
≪Tigrex≫ is on a rampage in
the Snowy Mountains, nya!
This one is dangerous, so we
are asking HR4 hunters and up,
nya. There are sub-targets too,
so I would be glad if you took
those on as well, nya.
28013.descriptionJp:
大変ですニャ！あの《ティガ
レックス》が雪山で大暴れし
ているそうですニャ！今回は
危険なので、ＨＲ４以上の
ハンターさんにお願いしてい
るニャ。サブターゲットもあ
るので、そちらも挑戦しても
らえると嬉しいですニャ。

63132.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
63132.description: This is a trial quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Please enjoy Forward.5 a little early! Take on the challenge in "Hunt Guard Armor"!
63132.descriptionEn:
This is a trial quest for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Please enjoy Forward.5 a little
early!
Take on the challenge in
"Hunt Guard Armor"!
63132.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの体験会用の
クエストです。
フォワード.５を一足早く
お楽しみください！
「狩護防具」でチャレンジ！

62316.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62316.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62316.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.
62316.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。思い出よりも追憶が
大切なかた、祭典の証をご用
意の上、ぜひご参加ください。
出発後は、祭典の証の返却が
できませんので、ご注意を。

62127.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

21582.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
21582.description: Have you heard of the Dog Fang Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21582.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Hound Fang Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21582.descriptionJp:
犬牙原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55934.description: This quest yields the following materials. Magnet Spike Merit (Beginning) x５０, Magnet Spike Merit (Middle) x６０, Magnet Spike Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
55934.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Magnet Spike Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Magnet Spike Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Magnet Spike Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept it you need a
Secret Art Merit Crystal and
GR500 or higher.
55934.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪磁斬鎚勲・序≫５０個
≪磁斬鎚勲・中≫６０個
≪磁斬鎚勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

21579.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Horse Leg Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21579.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Steed Leg Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21579.descriptionJp:
馬脚原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55114.description: Slaying an Abiorugu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55114.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying an Abiorugu raises your
standing, while letting you
obtain the materials needed for
G Rank decorations at a good
value.
Please make the most of it.
55114.descriptionJp:
アビオルグを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

58068.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58068.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58068.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58068.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55545.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55545.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55545.descriptionEn:
You who would master the Dual
Blades: show me the skill you
have honed against the ≪Tigrex≫
in the Desert!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn a reward far beyond
what your daily efforts bring
you.
55545.descriptionJp:
双剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

53016.description: I mean to make dolls to wish for the healthy growth of the girls of Mezeporta, but making them normally would not be interesting. I shall try making dolls modelled on monsters! So I want you to hunt the monster that will serve as the model, and report on its shape and traits!
53016.descriptionEn:
I mean to make dolls to wish
for the healthy growth of
Mezeporuta's girls, but making
them plainly would be dull.
So I will model them on
monsters! Hunt the model
monster and report its shape
and traits to me!
53016.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタの女の子達の元気
な成長を願って人形を作って
やろうと思うのだが普通に
作っても面白くない。
ワシは、モンスターをモデル
に人形を作ってみようと
思う！そこで、そのモデルと
なるモンスターを狩猟し、
その造形や特徴の報告を
お願いしたい！

23228.description: As you know, the Rathalos is a valiant flying wyvern also called the King of the Sky. I want to become a strong and brave man like that fire wyvern. So I mean to keep a Rathalos fang as a charm. Could I ask you for a little hunt?
23228.descriptionEn:
Rathalos, as you know, is a
valiant flying wyvern called
the King of the Skies.
I want to become a strong,
brave man like that fire
wyvern. So I will keep a
Rathalos fang as a charm.
Could you hunt one for me?
23228.descriptionJp:
リオレウスは知っての通り、
「空の王」とも呼ばれている
勇壮な飛竜だ。
僕もあの火竜のように、
強く勇ましい男になりたい。
そこで、リオレウスの牙を
お守りにしようと思うんだ。
ちょっと狩猟を頼めないかな。

21339.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

63389.description: Having realized that looking at flowers does not fill the belly, I want to shout at those fools gazing at the blossoms! A hunter's instinct is the hunt! Always the hunt! Hunting over flowers!
63389.descriptionEn:
I saw that staring at flowers
does not fill an empty belly,
so I want to shout it out to
those ogling the blossoms!
A hunter's instinct is hunting!
Hunting, always!
Forget the flowers, give me the hunt!
63389.descriptionJp:
花を見たところで、
腹は膨れないと悟った俺は、
花に見惚れている彼奴らに
声を大にして言いたい！
ハンターの本能は狩猟！
いつでも狩猟！
花より狩猟だーーー！

21085.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21085.description: At the waterside this season, the Shield Crab Daimyo Hermitaur may show itself. Dealing damage to a body protected by a hard shell is not easy. Carving Crab Miso from Zamite and delivering that is fine too, you know?
21085.descriptionEn:
At the waterside this season,
the Shield Crab
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ may show
itself. Its hard shell makes
dealing damage no easy task.
You could always carve
≪Zazamiso≫ from Yaozami, no?
21085.descriptionJp:
この季節の水辺には、盾蟹
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫が姿を
現すことがあるわ。硬い殻に
守られた体にダメージを与え
ることは容易くないわ。
ヤオザミから≪ザザミソ≫を
剥いで収めてもいいわよ？

54770.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54770.description: You may only accept so many quests a day, but here is one that yields some of the materials needed to upgrade White Monoblos G Rank gear. Do not let this chance slip by!
54770.descriptionEn:
You may only accept so many
quests a day, but here is one
that yields some of the
materials needed to upgrade
White Monoblos G Rank gear.
Do not let this chance slip by!
54770.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、白一角竜のＧ級
武具の強化に必要な素材の一
部を入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。この機会を逃さぬよ
うご注意ください。

62956.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62956.description: Well? Have you found any clue about the ore? No luck here at all. Actually there is said to be an ore called Jet Black Dragon Iron, but how to dig it is likewise unknown. Perhaps it is not mined, but obtained when something lures you.
62956.descriptionEn:
So? Have you found any clue
about the ore?
Nothing at all on my end.
Actually, there is said to be an ore
called Jet-Black Dragon Iron, but
how to dig it is likewise unknown.
Maybe it isn't mined at all —
perhaps you get it when you are
invited to something.
62956.descriptionJp:
どうだ？鉱石について手がか
りでも見つかったか？
こっちは全然ダメだ。
実は「漆黒の龍鉄」って鉱石
もあるらしいんだが、同じく
掘る方法が判明していない。
もしかすると、採掘するので
はなく、何かへ誘われた時に
入手できるのかもしれないな。

28082.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28082.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
28082.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

50176.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
50176.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Highlands. The crystal wyvern Kuarusepusu has also been confirmed in the depths. Hunt that one too while you are there! Now off you go!!
50176.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
This time, I want you all to
explore the Highlands.
A Crystal Wyvern ≪Kuarlusepusu≫
has been confirmed deep there
too. Hunt that one as well
while you are at it! Now go!
50176.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、高地を探索してきて
もらう。奥地には晶竜≪クア
ルセプス≫も確認されている
ようだ。ついでにそいつも狩
猟してくるのだ！
さあ頑張ってこい！！

22023.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Tenran armor. Drive off Arganos and Golganos and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
22023.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repelling Arganos
and Gorganos, you can get
the materials needed to
upgrade "Stroma FX
Series" ≪Supremacy≫ armor
up to Lv7.
22023.descriptionJp:
≪喰血竜≫の≪天嵐防具≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
アルガノスとゴルガノスを
撃退することで
「ストロマFXシリーズ」
≪覇種防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

54972.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
54972.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Siluk G Series. Hunt Pink Rathian and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
54972.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
to upgrade the
"Shilluk G Series".
By hunting a Pink Rathian,
you can obtain the upgrade
materials for one piece.
Please make good use of it!
54972.descriptionJp:
「シルックＧシリーズ」を
強化するためのクエストを
準備しました。
リオレイア亜種を狩猟する
ことで、１部位分の強化素
材が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください！

55886.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55886.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55886.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

56104.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a wing break and a foreleg break in slaying Harudomerugu, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
56104.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Harudomerugu≫ and break its
wings and forelegs, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
56104.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪司銀龍≫討伐にて
翼破壊と前脚破壊を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

62265.objectiveJp: オオツノアゲハ９９匹の納品

50197.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50197.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50197.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

23544.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23544.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23544.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23544.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55069.description: Slaying an Odibatorasu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55069.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying an Odibatorasu raises
your standing, while letting
you obtain the materials needed
for G Rank decorations at a
good value.
Please make the most of it.
55069.descriptionJp:
オディバトラスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

62824.description: Please recreate a story I came up with on my own. This time it is the scene where the golden fish rescues Akane-ko as promised. Please equip the Light Bowgun Vis Rondo in advance. I will lend you the armor, so please wear it.
62824.descriptionEn:
Please re-enact a story I came
up with on my own.
This time, the Golden Fish saves
Akane-ko, exactly as promised.
Please equip the Light Bowgun
≪Vis Rondo≫ beforehand, all
right?
We will lend you the armor, so
please wear that.
62824.descriptionJp:
わたしが勝手に考えた
物語の再現をお願いします。
今度は黄金魚が約束通り
あかねこを助ける場面です。
事前にライトボウガンの
≪ヴィス・ロンド≫を
装備しておいてくださいね。
防具はお貸ししますので、
そちらをご着用ください。

54403.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
54403.description: We are surveying the Diablos, the beast that storms about the desert swinging its great horns. Its ecology remains largely unknown. Please hunt it and lend your strength to our research!
54403.descriptionEn:
We are surveying the ≪Diablos≫
that rampages in the Desert,
swinging its great horns.
Its ecology is still unknown.
Please hunt it and lend your
strength to our research!
54403.descriptionJp:
砂漠にいる、大きな角を振り
乱して暴れまわる≪角竜≫の
調査を行っています。
その生態はまだまだ未解明。
どうか狩猟を行い、我々の研
究に力を貸してください！

26374.description: It seems a great many Gabras have gathered at the tower. They are said to be an omen of calamity, so the Guild cannot ignore it either. Slay 8 Gabras and confirm the situation.
26374.descriptionEn:
It seems a great many Remobra
have gathered at the tower.
They are said to herald disaster,
so the Guild cannot simply
ignore them.
Slay 8 Remobra and check on
the situation for us.
26374.descriptionJp:
何やら塔に多くのガブラスが
群れ集っておるようじゃ。
奴らは災厄の前触れとも言われ
ておるゆえ、ギルドとしても
捨ててはおけぬ。
ガブラス８頭を討伐し、状況
を確認してきて欲しい。

60031.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

11019.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
11019.description: The boss of the Genprey packs in the desert, Dos-Genprey, is marked by a body a size larger and by sharp claws! If hunting Dos-Genprey proves difficult, put a Cactus Flower in a Maka Pickling Jar and deliver a Hundred-Flower Cactus!
11019.descriptionEn:
The Ioprey that swarm the Desert
are led by the ≪Iodrome≫, known
for its larger body and sharp
claws! If hunting the Iodrome is
difficult, put a ≪Cactus Flower≫
into a ≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ and
deliver a ≪Hundred-Flower
Cactus≫ instead!
11019.descriptionJp:
砂漠に群れるゲネポスの親玉
≪ドスゲネポス≫は、一回り
大きな体に鋭い爪が特徴です！
ドスゲネポスの狩猟が困難な
場合は、≪マカ漬けの壷≫に
≪サボテンの花≫を入れて、
≪百花サボテン≫の納品を！

55352.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐

61124.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種の狩猟
61124.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61124.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61124.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50538.description: To what extent did the people of ancient times know the world? Rare materials unknown to us sleep somewhere in the Snowy Mountains. If you hunt that monster of violent temper, you may be able to find the phantom stone said to look like a dragon's scale, and a beautiful ice flower.
50538.descriptionEn:
How far did the people of old
know the world, I wonder?
Rare materials unknown to us
sleep somewhere in the Snowy
Mountains.
If you hunt that monster of
such fierce temper, you should
be able to find the phantom
stone and a beautiful ice flower.
50538.descriptionJp:
太古の人間は、一体どこまで
知りつくしていたのだろうか。
私達の知らない希少素材が
雪山のどこかに眠っている。
激しい気性を見せるあの
モンスターを狩ってくれれば、
竜の鱗のように見えるという
幻の石と美しい氷の花を探し
出すことができるだろう。

50790.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the crest of a Purple Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
50790.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Purple Gypceros' crest,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50790.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
紫毒鳥のトサカを破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

21455.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
21455.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Blangonga. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21455.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
to slay Blangonga.
The reward is a bit lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
sharpen your skills against
other hunters?
21455.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ドドブランゴ≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

58126.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58126.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58126.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58126.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

22059.description: The depths of the Canyon are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22059.descriptionEn:
The depths of the ≪Canyon≫
are still under Guild
survey, but hunters too
might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22059.descriptionJp:
≪峡谷≫の奥深くは、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

53021.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
53021.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.
53021.descriptionJp:
どうやら修復に必要な地図の
断片を集めてくれたようだな。
ちょっと枚数が多いけど、
私なら元に戻せるだろう。
集めた断片をそこのボックス
に入れといてくれ。
作業が終わったら複製した地
図をやろう。武具工房に持っ
ていくと喜ばれるかもな。

26758.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61652.description: I have a request, trusting in the sturdy bodies and spirits of you hunters. It is my firm belief that people begin to decline the moment they are satisfied. Hunger is what gives people vigor and makes them grow, I believe. Would you prove it for me?
61652.descriptionEn:
I have a request for you hunters,
whose tough bodies and wills
I have taken a liking to.
This is only my own theory, but
people begin to weaken the very
moment they grow satisfied.
I believe hunger is what gives
people vitality and growth.
Could you prove that for me?
61652.descriptionJp:
君たちハンターの強靭な体と
精神力を見込んで頼みがある。
これは私の持論なのだが、
人は、満ち足りてしまった
瞬間から衰えが始まるものだ。
餓えこそが、人に活力を与え、
人を成長させると信じている。
どうか、それを証明しては
もらえないだろうか？

62431.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62431.description: What, you just want a hard Great Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62431.descriptionEn:
What, you just want a really
stiff Great Sword? Then I
will refine some Argen Steel!
But the ore needed is hard to
find, and nasty monsters roam
the area. Go find it with all
your spirit!
62431.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅い大剣が欲
しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

50048.description: Would you look for a rare old box, nya? Find one and bring it to me and I will trade you my top recommendation, nya. Hm? What is inside the box? There are some things in this world better left unknown, nya.
50048.descriptionEn:
Would you search for an old box that is
rarely found, meow? If you find one
and bring it to me, I will trade you
a recommended item, meow.
Hm? What is inside the box, you ask?
There are things in this world you
are better off not knowing, meow.
50048.descriptionJp:
稀に見つかる古い箱を探して
くれニャいか？見つけて届け
てくれたら、イチオシの品と
交換してやるニャよ。
ん？箱の中に何が入っている
のかって？世のニャかには、
知らない方がいい事もあるん
ニャよ。

26251.description: In the Guild's history there was a hunter said to have the strongest arm. This Guild gives an incentive award to hunters who slay one on one the fish wyvern that drove that hunter into retirement, the Plesioth. Please join us.
26251.descriptionEn:
In the history of the Guild there was
a hunter praised as the strongest of
all, a mighty arm.
Our Guild awards a prize to any
hunter who slays one on one the
Plesioth, the fish wyvern species that
drove that hunter into retirement.
Please join us enthusiastically.
26251.descriptionJp:
ギルドの歴史の中でも、最強
の豪腕と謳われたハンターが
いました。
当ギルドでは、そのハンター
を引退にまで追いやった魚竜
種、ガノトトスを１対１で討
伐したハンターに、奨励品を
出しています。
奮ってご参加ください。

40218.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil ZP Earring.
40218.descriptionEn:
Over here, we are distributing
VISA Production Tickets to
hunters who possess Gothic
gear.
Please accept the quest while
you have the Vale ZP Earrings
equipped.
40218.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。
ベイルZPイヤリングを装備
した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

53306.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟

54150.description: We are seeking hunters to hunt the 2 fighting beasts that run wild in the Canyon! If the hunt proves difficult, you may slay Genprey and return, no problem.
54150.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters to
hunt the two battle beasts that
race around the Canyon!
If hunting them proves too hard,
you may slay Ioprey and return
instead, no problem at all.
54150.descriptionJp:
峡谷を走り回る２頭の闘獣
を狩猟していただけるハン
ターを募集中です！
狩猟が難しい場合はゲネポ
スを討伐してご帰還いただ
いても問題ございません。

50490.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Pariapuria. I am counting on you!
50490.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! You reached
HR31, I hear. So I have a
favor to ask. How about a full
set of weapon materials as
reward? Easy job, really.
Just run over and slay a
Pariapuria. I am counting
on you!
50490.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってパリアプリアを討
伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

60127.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟

26247.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

40148.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
40148.description: A special request from the Hunters Guild, limited to N Course and internet cafe players. Clear the quest and get plenty of hunter rank points!
40148.descriptionEn:
A special request from the
Hunters Guild, limited to the
N Course and Net Cafes.
Clear the quest and earn
plenty of Hunter Rank
points for yourself!
40148.descriptionJp:
ハンターズギルドからの
Ｎコース・ネットカフェ限定
の特別な依頼です。
クエストを達成し、ハンター
ランクポイントをたっぷり
手に入れよう！

54766.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
54766.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54766.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54766.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55941.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の討伐
55941.description: This time we have prepared a big roll cake for the bride and groom! Eh? You took an Uragaan instead of a roll cake by mistake? Eeeh! We cannot have it rampaging in the ceremony hall, so someone please slay it! By the way, they say something happens if you hit it while it is rolling!
55941.descriptionEn:
We prepared a big roll cake
for the bride and groom!
Huh? You mixed it up and
ordered a Uragaan instead?
Whaaat! We cannot have it
rampaging at the ceremony, so
somebody please slay it!
By the way, they say hitting
it while it rolls does something!
55941.descriptionJp:
今回は新郎新婦さんのために
大きなロールケーキをご用意
しました！え？ロールケーキ
と間違えてウラガンキンを仕
入れてしまった？えー！式場
で暴れられても困るので、誰
か討伐してください！ちなみ
に、転がり中にある物を当て
ると何かが起きるそうですよ！

21191.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21191.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21191.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

53141.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
53141.description: Do you have enough armor upgrade materials? On this quest, which I present to you today, you can obtain great quantities of Armor Spheres and High Armor Spheres used to upgrade armor. However, please note that the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited.
53141.descriptionEn:
Are you short on armor upgrade
materials?
This request, introduced today, lets you
obtain large amounts of ≪Armor Sphere≫
and ≪Armor Sphere+≫ used for
armor upgrades.
However, there is a limit to how many
times you can accept it per day,
so please be careful.
53141.descriptionJp:
防具の強化素材は足りていま
すか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
防具の強化に使用する
≪鎧玉≫と≪上鎧玉≫を
大量に獲得できますよ。
ただし、１日に受注できる数
に限りがありますので、
ご注意ください。

23678.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23678.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Akura Vashimu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23678.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Akura Vashimu
materials. To accept it, a
Superior Ticket is required.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the Superior Ticket
will be consumed.
23678.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

62634.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

21247.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21247.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21247.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

23481.description: The Variant Species Espinas has appeared once more. Its horns have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23481.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Espinas≫ has
appeared once more.
Its horns have grown stronger,
and it seems even more powerful.
Please survey it with the
greatest of care.
23481.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪エスピナス≫が再び
現れました。
角はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

62410.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
62410.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62410.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
62410.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

62323.description: A giant Diablos has appeared in the Desert. This individual is said to be so ferocious that it threatens the Desert's ecosystem. The merchants' trade routes cannot be used either, and no good can come of leaving it. It is a somewhat dangerous request, but I believe you can slay it.
62323.descriptionEn:
A giant ≪Diablos≫ has appeared
in the Desert. This one is
fierce enough to threaten the
Desert's ecosystem, they say.
The merchants' trade routes are
unusable too, and nothing good
comes of leaving it be. It is a
somewhat dangerous request, but
I believe you can slay it.
62323.descriptionJp:
巨大な≪ディアブロス≫が
砂漠に出現した。この個体は
非常に獰猛で砂漠の生態系を
脅かすほどだという。
商人達の交易路も利用できず
放っておいても良いことは何
も無い。少し危険な依頼では
あるが君たちになら討伐も可
能であると信じているよ。

50654.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
50654.description: Congratulations on reaching HR17! In this quest you can obtain weapon materials from the Lava Wyvern Lavasioth and upgrade materials for the original Corude Series armor. Please do give it a try.
50654.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR17!
In this quest you can obtain
weapon materials from the
Lava Wyvern ≪Volganos≫ and
upgrade materials for the
original ≪Corude Series≫
armor.
Please give it a try.
50654.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１７到達おめでとうござ
います！
このクエストは、溶岩竜
≪ヴォルガノス≫の武器生産
素材及びオリジナル防具
≪コルーデシリーズ≫の
強化素材が入手できます。
ぜひチャレンジしてみてくだ
さい。

21049.objectiveJp: フルベビアイス６個の納品
21049.description: A white shadow crawling in the darkness has been sighted! If you would face the white shadow, Khezu, you must not look only at the ground! It seems very fond of silencing every sound and striking from the ceiling!
21049.descriptionEn:
A white shadow has been seen
crawling through the dark!
If you would face the Khezu
that is that white shadow, do
not just watch the ground!
It loves to silence every
sound and strike from the
ceiling!
21049.descriptionJp:
暗闇を這う白影が目撃され
たようです！白影の正体、
≪フルフル≫の狩猟に臨む
なら、地上ばかりを見てたら
ダメですよ！一切の音を消し
て天井から襲い掛かかるのが
大のお得意みたいですから！

26072.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26072.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26072.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

53258.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
53258.description: Hello, how are you? I am sure you are wearing fine armor and carrying your favorite weapon. I want you to remember when you were a novice hunter. You are sure to gain something.
53258.descriptionEn:
Hey there, how are you?
I'm sure right now you're
wearing fine armor and
carrying your favorite weapon.
I want you to remember
the days when you were
a rookie Hunter.
I'm sure you'll find
something to gain from it.
53258.descriptionJp:
やあ、お元気ですか？
きっと君は今、素敵な防具を
着てお気に入りの武器を
背負っていることと思います。
そんな君にひよっこハンター
だった頃を思い出してほしい
のです。
きっと何か得るものがあるは
ずですよ。

62612.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
62612.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62612.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62612.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

21392.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

40227.description: A report has arrived: 'I saw a suspicious monster in the swamp.' It seems to be lurking beyond the white rock, but to go further you must solve a mechanism. The supply box holds a clue to solving it, so read it. Take great care.
40227.descriptionEn:
Word has come that a strange
monster was seen in the Swamp.
It seems to lurk beyond the
white rocks, but the way ahead
is sealed by a mechanism.
The Supply Box holds a clue
to unlocking it, so read that.
Please be careful out there.
40227.descriptionJp:
「沼地で怪しいモンスターを
見た」との報告が届いた。
白い岩の先に潜伏している
ようだが先へ進むには仕掛け
を解く必要があるらしい。支
給品ボックスに仕掛けを解く
手がかりがあるので読むとい
い。くれぐれも気を付けて。

23645.description: The Variant Species Inagami has appeared once more. There are reports that its developed tail now releases an even more potent sleep gas. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23645.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Inagami has
appeared again.
Its developed tail now emits
a stronger sleep gas, reports
say. Survey with great care.
23645.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪イナガミ≫
が再び現れました。
発達した尾は、より強力な
睡眠ガスを放つようになった
との報告があります。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

55962.description: This is terrible! Help me! I have to deliver Zenaserisu materials right now, but the materials are late arriving! Would you sever the parts that yield the materials I need within 3 minutes! Then I can just make it! There is plenty of reward for you, so please!
55962.descriptionEn:
This is bad! Help me!
I have to deliver Zenaserisu
materials right now, but the
shipment is late!
Can you sever the needed part
within 3 minutes?!
If you do, we can just make it!
I will pay plenty in reward,
so please!
55962.descriptionJp:
大変だ！助けてくれ！
ゼナセリスの素材をいますぐ
納品しなきゃいけないのに、
素材の到着が遅れてる！
３分以内に必要な素材の部位
を切断してくれないか！
そうすれば何とか間に合う！
お礼の報酬もたくさんあるか
ら頼むよ！

26185.description: A Diablos with a blackened body colour and a dreadfully fearsome appearance has been sighted. Since it was sighted alone, a high-rank hunter is unlikely to be outmatched, but do not take it lightly and get badly hurt.
26185.descriptionEn:
A Diablos with a darkened body
and an especially fearsome
appearance has been sighted.
Since it was seen alone, a top
hunter should hardly fall behind,
but do not underestimate it and
get badly hurt.
26185.descriptionJp:
黒ずんだ体色を持つひときわ
恐ろしい容姿のディアブロス
が目撃されたわ。
単体での目撃なだけに、上位
の狩人が後れをとることは、
まずないと思うけど、甘く見
て大怪我なんてしないでね。

28037.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Doragyurosu materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28037.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters, why not pass
your hunting skill on to the
young hunters of the Guild?
This time we are generous
with ≪Berukyurosu Subspecies≫
materials! Grow strong
together and liven up the
Guild. Clearing it with both
Secret Art book holders and
non-holders earns more praise.
28037.descriptionJp:
熟練ハンターの皆さん。
その狩猟技術を猟団の若い
ハンターへ伝えてみません
か？今回は、≪冥雷竜≫の
素材を大奮発！一緒に強く
なって、猟団を盛り上げて
いってください。秘伝書所持、
未所持のハンターで達成する
と、ギルドからの評価が
より得られますよ。

20024.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
20024.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The wind wyvern Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20024.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Office!
Kushala Daora has entered
Mezeporuta's territory!
Mezeporuta now moves to
intercept the Elder Dragon!
Use the interception gear at
the Base and slay it fully!
20024.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
メゼポルタの領内に風翔龍
クシャルダオラが侵入しまし
た！これよりメゼポルタは、
古龍の迎撃態勢に入ります！
迎撃拠点に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

55002.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Gogomoa and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply, and then some!
55002.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Pariapuria≫ in
fine style for us.
Clear the quest, and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot straight up!
55002.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪跳緋獣≫を狩猟してみ
せろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての評価
がグイグイっと上がるぞ！

21017.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
21017.description: Cephalos swim freely through the sand, and hunting them is hard work at the best of times. As for the boss, Cephadrome, it is no exaggeration to call it a battle of patience! It is important to force it above ground with loud noises and impacts!
21017.descriptionEn:
The Cephalos that swim freely
through the sand are a real pain
to hunt, and as for the boss,
"Cephadrome", it's no exaggeration
to call it a battle of patience!
It's important to force it above
ground with loud noise or impact!
21017.descriptionJp:
砂の中を自在に泳ぐガレオス
たちは、とにかく狩猟が大変
で、ボスの≪ドスガレオス≫
ときたら、それはもう根気と
の戦いといっても過言じゃ
ないです！大きな音や衝撃で
地上に出すのが大事ですよ！

58102.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58102.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58102.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58102.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62481.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62481.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62481.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62481.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

21140.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
21140.description: This is a request to drive off a giant Lunastra. I would like it slain quickly, but if that is difficult, driving it off alone will do. Depending on the situation, proof of the kill may not be issued.
21140.descriptionEn:
A request to repel a giant
Lunastra. I would like it slain
quickly, but if that is too
difficult, repelling alone is
fine. Depending on the case,
proof of slay may not be issued.
21140.descriptionJp:
巨大な炎妃龍の撃退依頼です。
短時間での討伐をお願いした
いのですが、難しい場合、
撃退のみでも結構です。
状況により討伐の証を発行
できない場合もあります。

55897.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55897.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55897.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55897.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

61849.description: Getting close to the prey is not the whole of hunting. Sometimes approach, sometimes draw away: polishing the right sense of distance is what matters. Today I have prepared a stage for exactly that. Now, bring your companions and let us go no-touch!
61849.descriptionEn:
Getting close to the prey is
not all there is to hunting.
Now close in, now pull away;
polishing the right sense of
distance is what matters.
Today I prepared a stage for
that. Bring friends, no-touch!
61849.descriptionJp:
獲物に近付くだけが狩猟では
ありません。時には近付き、
時には離れる、適切な距離感
を磨くことが大切なのです。
今日は、そのための舞台を
用意しました。さあ、仲間を
誘ってレッツノータッチ！

61202.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

55607.description: As a result of the Great Hunt in the Depths of Solitude Island, the black Raviente seems to lie silent underground. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so please join.
55607.descriptionEn:
From the Great Hunt in the
≪Isolated Island Depths≫,
the black Raviente seems to
lie silent underground. We
are forming a survey team
limited to hunters who took
part. Please do join us.
55607.descriptionJp:
≪絶島地底≫で行われた
大討伐の結果、黒き大巌竜は
地底で沈黙しているようです。
大討伐に参加したハンター
限定の調査団を編成する
こととなりましたので、
是非ご参加ください。

26215.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Gypceros will be judged by our Guild, so please concentrate on completing the main target!
26215.descriptionEn:
At the Grand Hall Guild's
request, trial use of a new
sub-target is recommended.
The 'fixed damage' on Gypceros
is judged by our Guild, so
focus on the main target!
26215.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ゲリョス≫への『一定ダメ
ージ』は、当ギルドで判断し
ますので、皆さんはメインタ
ーゲットの達成に専念してく
ださいね！

23192.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト１匹の納品
23192.description: Insects all have fascinating shapes, do you not think just looking at them fills the heart? Among them the Royal Beetle is exceptional. I could gaze at one for 1 whole day and never tire! But they are hard to come by. I want someone to help search.
23192.descriptionEn:
Every insect has such an
alluring shape, do you not
think just looking at them
fills the heart?
The Royal Beetle is special
among them. I could gaze at
one all day and never tire!
But they are so hard to find.
Someone please help me look.
23192.descriptionJp:
昆虫はどれも魅力的な形を
していて、見ているだけで
心が満たされていくとは
思わないかね？
中でもロイヤルカブトは格別
だね。まる１日眺めていても
飽きることはないほどだよ！
でも中々手に入らなくてね。
誰か探すのを手伝ってほしい。

23626.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
23626.description: There has been a sighting of the scorching-zero dragon at the summit of the Tower. The report describes a white body wreathed in ice and flame. As it remains a monster of many mysteries, G-rank hunters confident in their skill should head out to investigate.
23626.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of the
≪Scorching Zero Dragon≫ at the
Tower's summit.
The report states that it has a white
body wreathed in ice and flame.
As it is still a monster full of mystery,
G Rank hunters confident in their skill
should head out to survey it.
23626.descriptionJp:
塔の頂部にて≪灼零龍≫の
目撃情報がありました。
報告書には、白い身体に氷と
炎を纏っていると記載されて
います。未だ謎の多いモンス
ターのため、腕に自信のある
Ｇ級ハンターは調査へ向かっ
てください。

21337.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての狩猟

62012.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62012.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62012.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。
