60578.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Espinas and Hypnocatrice. Join your fellow guild hunters, but achieve the objective with just two of you. Hunt them well and a special reward awaits, so do your best!
60578.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the targets are the
≪Espinas≫ and the
≪Hypnocatrice≫!
Team up with Guildmates, but
achieve the targets as a pair.
Slay them well for special rewards!
60578.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪棘竜≫と≪眠鳥≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に、
ただし２人で目標を達成して
きてもらうぞ。
見事討伐すれば、特殊な報酬
もあるので頑張ってくれ！

26097.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

58120.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58120.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58120.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58120.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

50095.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50095.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50095.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

51107.objectiveJp: セルレギオス１頭の狩猟
51107.description: You can obtain the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of the Transcendent armor Regios series. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
51107.descriptionEn:
The materials needed to craft
or upgrade one piece of the
Transcendent Armor "Regios
Series" can be obtained here.
A bargain quest, so try it!
51107.descriptionJp:
遷悠防具「レギオスシリーズ」
の１部位分の生産・強化に
必要な素材が入手可能です。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

61184.description: There seems to be an odd fellow in the Jungle who wants a VS Ticket. If you take one to him, he will trade it for something called a Situru Coin, they say. Lucky you if it is true. That thing is super rare, you know?
61184.descriptionEn:
Seems some odd fellow in the
Jungle wants VS. Tickets.
Bring some and he will trade
you something called Shituruu
Coins. Lucky you, if it is
true. Those are super rare!
61184.descriptionJp:
密林にＶＳ．チケットを
欲しがっている物好きが
居るらしい。持って行ったら
シトゥルゥコインなるものと
交換してくれるらしいぜ。
本当だったら、幸運だな。
アレは超レアなんだぜ？

55260.description: To investigate the Rending Water Wyvern that has been appearing intermittently, I ask you to hunt it and sever its parts. The part to be investigated changes with the time of day it appears, so judge whether the tail, the right hanging blade or the left hanging blade is the target, and if you strike it true I will add to your reward!
55260.descriptionEn:
To survey the Zenaserisu that
appears on and off, please hunt
it and sever its parts. The
part to survey changes with
the time of day it appears,
so judge which part is the
target - tail, right hanging
blade or left hanging blade -
and nail it for a bonus!
55260.descriptionJp:
断続的に出現している裂水竜
の調査のため、裂水竜の狩猟
と部位切断をお願いします。
出現する時間帯によって調査
対象となる部位が替わります
ので、尻尾、右垂刃、左垂刃、
の切断部位の中から、対象部
位を判断し見事当てていただ
きましたら報酬をはずみます！

54211.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
54211.description: We are seeking hunters to help survey the Akura Vashimu that appeared in the desert. Akura Vashimu generally act alone, and we believe that is because they are strong enough not to need a pack. This is a dangerous request, and only hunters with a solid record should apply.
54211.descriptionEn:
We are seeking hunters who can
cooperate in surveying the
Akura Vashimu in the Desert.
The Akura Vashimu basically
acts alone, but that is likely
because it is strong enough
that it need not form packs.
This request is dangerous for
hunters without solid results.
54211.descriptionJp:
砂漠に出現した尾晶蠍を
調査するため、協力して頂け
るハンターを募集いたします。
尾晶蠍は基本的に単体で
行動していますが、それは
自身が強いため、群れる必要
が無いからだと思われます。
十分な実績を持ったハンター
でなくては、危険な依頼です。

21621.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Flower-Hued Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21621.descriptionEn:
Are you familiar with the orb
known as the Blossom Orb?
Its material is indispensable
to the production of a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you precious
decoration materials.
21621.descriptionJp:
花色原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

26529.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26529.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26529.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26529.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

26304.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26304.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26304.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26304.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61806.objectiveJp: キラビートル５０匹の納品
61806.description: There are all sorts of bugs in this world. Among them, I like Kira Beetles and collect lots of them. If you'll help too, bring me 50 at a time. Then I'll give you one Slash Hard Gem.
61806.descriptionEn:
There are all sorts of insects
in this world, you know.
Among them, I love the
≪Kira Beetle≫ and collect
heaps of them.
If you'll help me too, bring
them to me every 50 you
gather.
Then I'll give you one
≪Slash Hard Jade≫.
61806.descriptionJp:
この世界には様々な虫たちが
いるよね。
その中でも、私は≪キラビー
トル≫が好きでたくさん集め
てるの。
あなたも手伝ってくれるなら、
５０匹ごとに私のところに
持ってきて。
そしたら≪斬硬玉≫を１つあ
げるよ。

20017.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The floating wyvern Yama Tsukami has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20017.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning! Yama Tsukami
has entered Dundorma's
territory! Dundorma now moves
to intercept the Elder Dragon!
Use the interception gear in
the zone and slay it fully!
20017.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です
！ドンドルマの領内に浮岳龍
ヤマツカミが侵入しました！
これよりドンドルマは古龍の
迎撃体制に入ります！
迎撃区画に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

63012.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63012.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
63012.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

55087.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
55087.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55087.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55087.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

60070.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

53182.description: Prism Falls at night in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
53182.descriptionEn:
Temperate season, night, at the
Painted Waterfall. It is
unexplored land the Guild is
still surveying. Why not go
have a look for gathering and
survey? When you want to
return, just deliver the map!
53182.descriptionJp:
温暖期・夜の≪彩の滝≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

62991.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62991.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62991.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62991.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55439.description: A report has come in of a sighting of a Blast Wolf. With signs of new Anomalous Species appearing, the guild has researched and prepared new weapons for promising hunters to face them. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare to hunt the Anomalous Species!
55439.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that
the shadow of a Burst Wolf
was sighted.
At the first sign of a new
Supremacy, the Guild has
researched and prepared new
weapons to face Supremacy
monsters. Obtain the crafting
materials and prepare yourself!
55439.descriptionJp:
爆狼の影を目撃したという
報告が届きました。
新たな辿異種出現の兆しに、
ギルドでは有望なハンターに
向けて、辿異種に立ち向かう
ための新たな武器を研究し、
用意しました。
生産素材を獲得して、辿異種
の討伐に備えてください！

21995.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21995.description: A Supremacy Odibatorasu has appeared. The purpose of this request is to prevent the damage from spreading until the hunt party arrives. Therefore, please complete it by repelling the monster. Act with your own safety first.
21995.descriptionEn:
Zenith Odibatorasu has
appeared. This request aims to
prevent the damage from
spreading until the slaying
unit arrives, so please
achieve it by repelling.
Put your own safety first.
21995.descriptionJp:
覇種オディバトラスが現れま
した。この依頼は、討伐隊が
到着するまでの、被害拡大を
防ぐことが目的となります。
そのため、撃退での達成を
お願いします。
ハンターさん自身の安全を
第一に行動してください。

15008.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
15008.description: You who seek greater heights! To reconfirm your skill, hunt every monster I designate! I call it the Official Hunting Exam! This time, hunt the white lions that gather in the frozen land! Mind that they do not surround you!
15008.descriptionEn:
You who aim ever higher!
To check your skill once more,
you will hunt every monster we
designate! We call it the
≪Official Hunting Exam≫!
This time you will hunt the
white lions that gather in the
frozen land! Do not get boxed in!
15008.descriptionJp:
さらなる高みを目指す者よ！
オヌシの腕前を再度確認すべ
く、こちらで指定したモンス
ターを全て狩猟して貰うぞ！
名づけて≪公式狩猟試験≫！
今回は極寒の地に群生する白
き獅子たちを狩猟するのじゃ！
囲まれぬよう注意じゃぞ！

26407.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26407.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?
26407.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た実り豊かなフィールドで、
たまにはのんびり採取でも
いかがですか？

55476.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55476.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55476.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく討究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

28080.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28080.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
28080.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

26586.description: Congratulations on reaching HR900! Deliver the Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26586.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR900!
Deliver the ≪Map≫ on your own,
clear the quest, and claim
your reward!
26586.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ９００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

51059.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51059.description: To take this quest you need a Hunter Ring (White), nya. Take on the hunt for a Bulldrome holding more Song Gems than usual, nya. Choose a Prayer Gem, clear this quest and offer the Song Gems, nya!
51059.descriptionEn:
To accept this quest, you need
the "Hunter Ring White", nya.
Take on the hunt of a
Bulldrome that hides more Song
Orbs than usual, nya.
Choose a Prayer Bead, clear
this quest, and offer up the
Song Orbs, nya!
51059.descriptionJp:
このクエストを受けるには
「ハンターリング白」が
必要ニャ。
通常よりも多くの歌玉を秘め
たドスファンゴの狩猟に挑戦
するニャ。
祈珠を選んでこのクエストを
クリアし、歌玉を捧げるニャ！

55558.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55558.description: The Variant Species Doragyurosu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55558.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Doragyurosu
has grown ferociously strong
and keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous.
Prepare fully and survey.
55558.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドラギュロス≫
は猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続
けています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

62211.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62211.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.
62211.descriptionJp:
占いに使う石ころを集めてい
るのですが、モンスターに
襲われ、中々はかどりません。
そこでモンスター達を引きつ
けておいて欲しいんです。
たくさん集めることができた
ら報酬として差し上げますか
ら、どうかお願いします。

62965.description: Using gear borrowed from someone called Scat, we will conduct an ice element survey. I hear this person once developed a new theory for raising the thunder element of a certain bow. When the survey ends safely, I would like to thank them in person.
62965.descriptionEn:
Using the gear lent to us by
a man named Scat, we will
survey the Ice element.
I hear he once developed a new
theory for raising the Thunder
element of a certain bow.
When the survey ends safely,
I want to thank him in person.
62965.descriptionJp:
スカットさんという方から
お借りした武具を使用して、
氷属性の調査を行います。
かつて、ある弓の雷属性を
高めるための新理論を開発
された方と聞いていますよ。
調査が無事に終わったら、
直接お礼を言いたいですね。

53058.description: It is Miyashita! The fun weekend is finally here! [Question 3] In the Supremacy Continuous Interception Battle, the one with the lowest slay rate was UNKNOWN. If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53058.descriptionEn:
It is Miyashita!
The fun weekend is finally here!
[Question 3]
In the "Zenith Continuous
Interception Battle", the one
with the lowest slay rate
was ≪UNKNOWN≫.
If you think the answer is
x (B), then take
this quest!
53058.descriptionJp:
宮下だよ！
いよいよ楽しい週末だね！
【第３問】
「覇種連続迎撃戦」で
最も討伐成功率が低かった
のは≪ＵＮＫＮＯＷＮ≫
である
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

61958.description: That monster must have a lot of confidence in its own body. After it came bursting up out of the lava with a splash, it went crawling about, and I told it to quit because it's dangerous. So what does it do? It started harassing me in my own miner's fashion.
61958.descriptionEn:
That monster must be awfully
confident in its own body.
After it burst up out of the
lava, it went squirming and
crawling around, and I told it
to stop because it is dangerous.
So then, it came at me with
the tricks of a seasoned
miner, just to spite me.
61958.descriptionJp:
あのモンスターは、自分の
肉体にかなり自信があるんだ
ろうな。
溶岩からざぱーんと飛び出し
た後、びちびちーって這いず
るのは、危ないからやめろっ
て言ったんだけどな。
だからよ、採掘師たるオレの
やり方で嫌がらせしてきたぜ。

21327.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21327.description: What, you just want a hard Hammer? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21327.descriptionEn:
What, you just want a really
stiff Hammer? Then I
will refine some Argen Steel!
But the ore needed is hard to
find, and nasty monsters roam
the area. Go find it with all
your spirit!
21327.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬いハンマー
が欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

22007.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
22007.description: Cephalos swim freely through the sand, and hunting them is hard work at the best of times. As for the boss, Cephadrome, it is no exaggeration to call it a battle of patience! It is important to force it above ground with loud noises and impacts!
22007.descriptionEn:
The Cephalos that swim freely
through the sand are a real pain
to hunt, and as for the boss,
"Cephadrome", it's no exaggeration
to call it a battle of patience!
It's important to force it above
ground with loud noise or impact!
22007.descriptionJp:
砂の中を自在に泳ぐガレオス
たちは、とにかく狩猟が大変
で、ボスの≪ドスガレオス≫
ときたら、それはもう根気と
の戦いといっても過言じゃ
ないです！大きな音や衝撃で
地上に出すのが大事ですよ！

63013.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63013.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63013.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
63013.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

23619.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
23619.description: The Variant Species Rukodiora has appeared once more. Its wings and its magnetic power have grown stronger, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23619.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Rukodiora has
appeared again.
Its wings and magnetism have
grown stronger, and it seems
to have gained more power.
Survey with great care.
23619.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ルコディオラ≫が
再び現れました。
翼と磁力はより強力となり、
さらに力をつけている様です。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

21939.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Hypnocatrice. I am counting on you!
21939.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! You reached
HR11, I hear. So I have a
favor to ask. How about a full
set of weapon materials as
reward? Easy job, really.
Just run over and slay a
Hypnocatrice. I am counting
on you!
21939.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ１１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってヒプノックを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

50525.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of armor materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rajang and a Tigrex. I am counting on you!
50525.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a request for you -
how about a full set of armor
materials as payment?
It's easy work! Just make
one quick run and slay a
Rajang and a Tigrex for me.
I'm counting on you!
50525.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は防具の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってラージャンとティ
ガレックスを討伐してくれれ
ばいい。頼んだぜ！

62849.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62849.description: To what extent did the people of ancient times know the world? Rare materials unknown to us sleep somewhere in the Snowy Mountains. If you hunt that monster of violent temper, you may be able to find the phantom stone said to look like a dragon's scale.
62849.descriptionEn:
How far did the people of old
know the world, I wonder?
Rare materials beyond our
knowledge sleep somewhere in
the Snowy Mountains.
If you hunt that monster of
fierce temper, you may be able
to find the phantom stone that
looks like a dragon's scale.
62849.descriptionJp:
太古の人間は、一体どこまで
知りつくしていたのだろうか。
私達が知りえない希少素材が
雪山のどこかに眠っている。
激しい気性を見せるあの
モンスターを狩ってくれれば、
竜の鱗のように見えるという
幻の石を探し出すことが
できるかもしれない。

26635.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

62266.description: To what extent did the people of ancient times know the world? There is a strong theory that a third book, recording a processing method unknown to us, sleeps in the Desert. If only one could obtain it, the hidden power of a certain weapon could be drawn out.
62266.descriptionEn:
How far did the people of old
know the world, I wonder?
There is a strong theory that
a third tome, recording
processing methods we do not
know, sleeps in the Desert.
If we obtain it, we could draw
out a certain weapon's hidden power.
62266.descriptionJp:
太古の人間は、一体どこまで
知りつくしていたのだろうか。
私達が知りえない加工方法を
記した第三の書物が、砂漠に
眠っているという説が濃厚だ。
それを手に入れさえすれば、
特定の武器の隠された力を
引き出すことができるだろう。

61810.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61810.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61810.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

61110.objectiveJp: 部位破壊保証書４枚の納品
61110.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Fang! This time we ask for joint delivery of certificates, the hunting of the specified monster, and the breaking of its parts. Do not forget to bring your certificates, and do not forget the part breaks!
61110.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union pays rewards to
hunters who break many parts on
Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying
Wyvern's Heavy Fang!
This time: deliver the
guarantee together, hunt the
designated monster, and break
its parts. Do not forget either!
61110.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の重牙！
今回は共同での保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟、及び部位の破壊を
お願いします。保証書持込み、
部位破壊を絶対に忘れずに！

55258.description: The Snowy Mountains are harsh land to begin with. With the arrival of a violent dragon that never existed in Mezepolta, conditions have grown harsher still. I have never seen such a ferocious monster. Please! Stop it.
55258.descriptionEn:
The Snowy Mountains are harsh
land to begin with. And now a
raging dragon that never lived
in Mezepolta has come, making
things even worse than before.
I've never seen a monster so
savage. Please! You have to
stop it for us.
55258.descriptionJp:
雪山はもともと厳しい土地だ。
さらにメゼポルタには存在し
ていなかった荒ぶる竜が訪れ
たことで、より厳しい状態に
なってしまった。
あれほど凶暴なモンスターは
未だ見たことがない。頼む！
奴を止めてくれ。

61433.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟

55773.description: For the G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them further. By hunting a Gravios, we will also grant you special ingredients.
55773.descriptionEn:
For the G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared this
quest to raise awareness and
promotion further.
By hunting a Gravios, we will
also grant you special
ingredients.
55773.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
鎧竜を狩猟することで特別な
食材も付与させていただきま
す。

62774.description: You love Gunlance, right? Of course you do? Let me tell you something good. No need to hold back! A rare Rathalos has been sighted at the tower, and my hunch says its materials can make an amazing Gunlance. Go once with a Gunlance!
62774.descriptionEn:
You love Gunlance, right?
Of course you do! Shall I tell
you something good? No need to
be shy! A rare Rathalos was
seen at the Tower, and my gut
says its materials make a
wicked Gunlance. Go try it!
62774.descriptionJp:
キミ、ガンランス大好きだろ
う？そうだろう？イイこと教
えるぞ？な〜に、遠慮しなく
ていいって！なんかさ、塔に
珍しい火竜が目撃されてさ、
僕の勘だと、きっとそいつの
素材で凄いガンランスが作れ
るんだ。さあキミもガンラン
スで１回行ってきなよ！

11064.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared! You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best!
11064.descriptionEn:
Beyond these lands, in the mysterious
untouched ≪Ancient Tower≫, the
Phantom Beast ≪Kirin≫ appears
to have shown itself! You cannot
reach the Ancient Tower anytime —
only while the weather and climate
are stable. Do your best!
11064.descriptionJp:
この地の彼方に眠る、謎多き
未開の地≪古塔≫に、幻獣
≪キリン≫が現れたようです！
古塔へはいつでも行けるわけ
じゃなく、天候や気候を始め
とする環境が安定してる期間
だけです。頑張って下さい！

53067.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
53067.description: They have finally shown themselves! I know it! By hunting them we can surely recover the lost tone. There is no time to dawdle! Hurry and hunt them!
53067.descriptionEn:
They have finally shown up!
I can tell! If we hunt them,
we will surely bring back the
tones that were lost.
There is no time to sit
around! Quick, as fast as
you can, go and hunt
those beasts for me!
53067.descriptionJp:
ついに現れやがった！
俺には判る！アイツらを
狩猟することで、失われて
いた音色を確実に
取り戻すことができるはず
だ。グズグズしている時間は
無い！早いとこ、アイツらを
狩ってくれ！

26673.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の捕獲
26673.description: Yo! It's me! Have you been capturing every day? Capturing is one of the great pleasures of a hunter. This time go and capture the monsters of the jungle, thump thump. I have prepared a few special rewards too, so do your best. Slaying them will of course be a failure.
26673.descriptionEn:
Yo! It is me!
Been capturing every day?
Capturing is one of the real
joys of hunting. This time, go
and capture the monsters of the
Jungle, thump thump. I have
prepared some special rewards,
so do your best. Slaying fails.
26673.descriptionJp:
ヨウ！俺だよ！
毎日捕獲してるかい？捕獲は
ハンターの醍醐味のひとつだ。
今回は密林のモンスター共を
ドスンドスンと捕獲してきて
くんな。多少だが、特殊な報
酬も用意したから頑張れよ。
討伐したら当然失敗となるぜ。

60674.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Khezu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60674.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is
the ≪Khezu≫!
Team up with Guildmates and
achieve the target together.
This contest is all about
teamwork, so place high!
This time it is Supremacy
weapons only!
60674.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪フルフル≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

54723.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54723.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54723.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

63161.objectiveJp: 弩岩竜の崩鱗１０個の納品
63161.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 10 Midogaron Shattered Scales and I will give you 14 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63161.descriptionEn:
Shh, keep it quiet, nya! This
is a secret trading post, nya.
Give me 10 ≪Odibatorasu
Crumbled Scales≫ and I will
give you 14 ≪Master Felyne's
Favorite≫, nya.
Slip them to the Master Felyne
and he will make a ≪Hardcore
Felyne Weapon≫ with no
materials, nya! Aim for the jackpot!
63161.descriptionJp:
シッ、静かにするニャ！ここ
は秘密の取引所ニャ。≪弩岩
竜の崩鱗≫を１０個くれたら、
≪親方ネコの大好物≫を
１４個あげるニャ。
こっそり親方ネコに渡せば、
素材なしで≪剛猫武器≫を
作ってくれる優れ物ニャ！
夢の大当たりを狙って
頑張るニャ！

54547.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Midogaron, the Blast Wolf. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54547.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Midogaron materials.
To accept it, a Superior Ticket
is required. Note that if the
quest is failed, the Superior
Ticket will be consumed.
54547.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、爆狼
≪ミドガロン≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50491.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ８１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Berukyurosu. I am counting on you!
50491.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! You reached
HR81, I hear. So I have a
favor to ask. How about a full
set of weapon materials as
reward? Easy job, really.
Just run over and slay a
Berukyurosu. I am counting
on you!
50491.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ８１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってベルキュロスを討
伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

50647.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50647.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up an SP Weapon and repel the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a splendid reward awaits you.
50647.descriptionEn:
You who would master the way
of the hunt: take up ≪SP
Weapons≫ and repel the
≪Odibatorasu≫.
Only those who succeed under
limited conditions can be
called true hunters.
Succeed, and a splendid reward awaits!
50647.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
≪ＳＰ武器≫などを携え、
≪弩岩竜≫を撃退するのだ。
限られた条件の中で狩りを
成功させる者こそ、真の狩人
と言えよう。
成功すれば、素晴らしい褒美
がそなたを待っておるぞ。

50140.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50140.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50140.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

26587.description: Congratulations on reaching HR999! Deliver the Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26587.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR999!
Deliver the ≪Map≫ on your own,
clear the quest, and claim
your reward!
26587.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ９９９達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

50194.objectiveJp: チャチャブー６匹の討伐
50194.description: I am the noble Count Kabocha Kabotchan! The leader of the bandits who tried to kidnap me and fled is Jack! The culprit is Jack! Jack may not be there, but give his underlings a thrashing! And bring my favorite, Hoppy Ale, too!
50194.descriptionEn:
I am the noble Count Kabochaka
Botchan!
The leader of the bandits who
tried to kidnap me, failed and
fled, is Jack!
The culprit is Jack!
Jack may not be here, but go
and thrash his underlings!
Also, my favorite, Hopi Wine!
50194.descriptionJp:
私は高貴なるカボチャカ・
ボッチャン伯爵である！
この私を誘拐しようとして
失敗し、逃亡した盗賊団の
頭目はジャック！
犯人はジャック！
ジャックは不在かもしれんが
手下をとっちめてくれ！あと
私の好物、ホピ酒も頼む！

22043.description: An urgent report has come from a surveyor. In the highlands, a monster no one has ever seen has been found. It has a long neck and tail, sturdy limbs, and no wings. Its back is hardened and appears to sprout crystals. Much remains unexplained, so investigate with care.
22043.descriptionEn:
An urgent report came from a
surveyor. A monster no one has
ever seen was found in the Highlands.
It has a long neck and tail,
sturdy limbs, and no wings.
Its back is hardened, and looks
as if crystals grow from it.
Much is still unexplained, so
survey it with care.
22043.descriptionJp:
調査員から緊急報告があった。
高地で誰も見たことのない、
モンスターを発見とのこと。
首と尻尾が長く、強靭な四肢
があり、翼はないそうだ。
背面は硬質化しており、水晶
が生えているように見える。
まだ、未解明な点も多いので、
注意して調査してくれ。

58127.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58127.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58127.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58127.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

54483.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54483.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and you will gain hunting experience and a large sum of Ｇｚ.
54483.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
request and rewards exclusively
for those in a Guild that won
the Hunting Festival.
Please bring the festival's
fervor when you accept and join.
Clear this request to earn
hunting experience and much Gz.
54483.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、祭
典の熱気をお持ちください。
この依頼を達成すれば、
狩りの経験や多額のＧｚを
手に入れることができます。

22088.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Wyvern Eggs. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
22088.descriptionEn:
From the popular tavern Guild comes
a large order for Flying Wyvern
Eggs. Eight is more than one
person can carry and deliver
alone, so we recommend at least
two people take this on.
Note that there are no supply
items for clearing sub-quests.
22088.descriptionJp:
大衆酒場ギルドより、飛竜の
卵の大口注文が入りました。
８個という数は、１人で取り
きって納品できる数ではない
ので、少なくとも２人以上で
の受注をオススメいたします。
尚、サブ達成による支給品は
ありませんので、要注意です。

26096.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

26589.description: Multiple Iodrome Variants have been confirmed in the swamp. Please, skilled hunters, hunt them somehow. They are very ferocious individuals, so 2 if possible. If that is difficult, 1 alone is fine, so please.
26589.descriptionEn:
Several Gendrome Variants have
been confirmed in the Swamp.
We ask you skilled hunters to
hunt them somehow. They are
very violent, so two if you
can. If that is too hard, one
alone is fine, so please see
it done.
26589.descriptionJp:
沼地で、複数のドスイーオス
変種が確認されました。凄腕
のハンターさん達で何とか
狩猟をお願いします。大変
凶暴な個体のため、できれば
２頭。難しいようでしたら
１頭だけでも結構ですので
よろしくお願いします。

60569.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
60569.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Garuba Daora. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60569.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time the target is
the ≪Garuba Daora≫!
To hunt a monster all alone,
what spirit! Truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! Also, this time it is
Origin Weapons only! Choose well!
60569.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ガルバダオラ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

23612.description: The Variant Species Giaorugu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23612.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Giaorugu has
grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous.
Prepare fully and survey.
23612.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ギアオルグ≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

60066.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23641.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23641.description: Hunter who would master the heavy gun, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23641.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show me the
skill you have honed against
the Tigrex in the Desert!
If you hunt it well, you shall
earn even more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
23641.descriptionJp:
重銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61911.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン白３個の納品
61911.description: For those hunters who have obtained White Hunter Coins, we have prepared a dedicated reward. The more White Hunter Coins you deliver, the better your chance of receiving rare materials.
61911.descriptionEn:
To all Hunters who obtained
White Hunter Coins, we have
prepared a special reward.
The more White Hunter Coins
you deliver, the better your
chance of getting rare
materials.
61911.descriptionJp:
ハンターコイン白を入手され
たハンターの皆様に、専用の
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。
ハンターコイン白の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

54825.description: From an investigator who headed to the top of the sea of trees, there was a sighting of a rare Pale Blue Hypnocatrice. It is also reported that it launches attacks gracefully as if dancing. Please prepare fully and investigate.
54825.descriptionEn:
A surveyor who went to the top
of the Great Forest reported a
rare ≪Hypnocatrice Rare≫
sighting. It is also said to
attack with the grace of a
dancing bird. Please prepare
thoroughly before you head
out on the survey.
54825.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に向かった調査員よ
り、珍しい≪蒼白眠鳥≫の
目撃情報がありました。
舞い踊るように華麗に攻撃を
仕掛けてくるという特徴も
同時に報告されています。
十分な準備の上、調査をお願
いします。

56121.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56121.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56121.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

60810.objectiveJp: 部位破壊保証書３０枚の納品
60810.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. This time the reward is a Flying Wyvern Claw L! Bring the specified number of Part Break Certificates yourself.
60810.descriptionEn:
The Hunting Guild offers rewards
to hunters who break many
parts of Variants and Kishu.
This time: Flying Wyvern Claw L!
Bring the required number of
Part Break Certificates alone.
60810.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
今回の報酬は飛竜種の爪L！
指定枚数の部位破壊保証書を
１人でお持ちください。

54768.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54768.description: There are reports that a Monoblos Subspecies is running wild in the desert. We ask you to hunt it before damage is done. Beware its attacks from underground delivered with that great horn.
54768.descriptionEn:
A White Monoblos is said to
be rampaging in the Desert.
Please hunt it before damage
is done. Beware its attacks
from underground with that
huge horn.
54768.descriptionJp:
砂漠で≪モノブロス亜種≫
が暴れていると報告があり
ました。
被害が出る前に対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
大きな角による地中からの
攻撃に注意してください。

26462.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
26462.description: We have a report that a Rathian with a vivid cherry-blossom color has appeared in the desert! A rare subspecies of high scarcity! Any hunter who would take up the hunt, come to our guild counter!
26462.descriptionEn:
A report has come in of a
≪Rathian≫ with vivid cherry
blossom pink coloring in the
Desert! A highly rare and
precious subspecies! Any Hunter
who would take up the hunt,
come to our guild counter!
26462.descriptionJp:
砂漠地帯に桜色のあざやかな
体色を持つ≪リオレイア≫が
出たという報告が入りました！
希少性の高い珍しい亜種です！
我こそは狩猟に挑戦すると
いう狩人さんは、当ギルドの
カウンターまで来て下さい！

61113.objectiveJp: 部位破壊保証書４枚の納品
61113.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Hard Tail! This time we ask for joint delivery of certificates, the hunting of the specified monster, and the breaking of its parts. Do not forget to bring your certificates, and do not forget the part breaks!
61113.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union pays rewards to
hunters who break many parts on
Variants and Rare Species.
The main reward is a Flying
Wyvern's Hard Tail!
This time: deliver the
guarantee together, hunt the
designated monster, and break
its parts. Do not forget either!
61113.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の剛尾！
今回は共同での保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟、及び部位の破壊を
お願いします。保証書持込み、
部位破壊を絶対に忘れずに！

60511.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
60511.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Daimyo Hermitaur will be judged by our Guild, so please concentrate on completing the main target!
60511.descriptionEn:
At the Elder Hall Guild's
request, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
We will judge the 'fixed
damage' dealt to
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ here, so
everyone please focus on
clearing the main target!
60511.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫への
『一定ダメージ』は、当ギル
ドで判断しますので、皆さん
はメインターゲットの達成に
専念してくださいね！

53055.description: Good morning everyone! I came again today! Question 2: The Gunlance I, Miyamoa, hold is an Iron Gunlance. If you think the answer is true (A), take this quest!
53055.descriptionEn:
Morning, everyone!
I am here again today!
[Question 2]
The Gunlance that I
(Miyamoa) own is the
"Iron Gunlance"
If you think the answer is
o (A), then take
this quest!
53055.descriptionJp:
みんなおはよう！
今日も来たよ！
【第２問】
僕（ミヤモア）が持っている
ガンランスは
「アイアンガンランス」である
答えが○（Ａ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

26760.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
26760.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
26760.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

23397.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
23397.description: An Espinas Subspecies appeared during the survey of the Ancient Tower. Reports say it attacks with a dangerous poison breath. Conduct the survey with great care.
23397.descriptionEn:
During a survey of the Ancient
Tower, an Espinas Subspecies
appeared. Reports say it
attacks with a dangerous
poisonous breath.
Survey with great care.
23397.descriptionJp:
古塔の調査中に
≪エスピナス亜種≫が現れ
ました。
報告によると毒を有する危険
なブレスで攻撃を仕掛けてく
るそうです。
十分に注意して調査を
お願いします。

26451.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time we have prepared the volcano field, but the Volcano depths, the lava pool area, are still unexplored and not open. Please note.
26451.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time we have prepared
a Volcano field, but the Volcano
Depths and the lava pool area
are still unexplored and have not
been released. Please be aware.
26451.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は火山フィールドを
用意させていただきましたが、
火山奥地、溶岩池部分はまだ
未探索のため解放されて
おりません。ご注意ください。

50407.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

53020.description: Were you able to convey your feelings to each other? Happy, sad, or perhaps surprised. I think all sorts of feelings were born. Please pour such feelings into this request. I am rooting for everyone's next step!
53020.descriptionEn:
Were you both able to convey
your feelings to each other?
Happy, sad, or perhaps
surprised. I think all kinds of
feelings were born.
Please throw those feelings at
this request.
We are cheering on your next
step forward!
53020.descriptionJp:
お互いに、想いを伝えられ
たでしょうか。
嬉しい、悲しい、はたまた
驚き。いろんな想いが生ま
れたことだと思います。
そんな想いは、ぜひこの依
頼にぶつけてください。
皆さんの次なる一歩を、応
援しています！

54286.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
54286.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54286.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54286.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23219.description: A Rathian has been sighted flying over the highlands, and unease is spreading among the residents. A nest is expected somewhere, but since the area is unsurveyed, discovery has been delayed. Please help with the investigation.
23219.descriptionEn:
A Rathian has been sighted
flying above the Highlands, and
unease is spreading among the
residents.
It is assumed to have a nest
somewhere, but this region
has seen little survey work,
so finding it is slow.
Please help with the survey.
23219.descriptionJp:
高地の上空を雌火竜が飛ん
でいるのが目撃され住人に
不安が広がっています。
どこかに巣があるものと
予想されますが、
調査の進んでいない地域な
ため発見が遅れています。
調査のお手伝いをお願い
します。

54978.description: We ask for your help in surveying the Water Fortress Wyvern that dwells in the desert! Break its head and wings as well as slaying it, and we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
54978.descriptionEn:
Please help us survey the
≪Gureadomosu≫ that lives in
the Desert!
Not only slaying it: break its
head and wings too, and we
will add to your reward.
Please lend us your strength
for our research!
54978.descriptionJp:
砂漠に生息する≪水砦竜≫の
調査にご協力をお願いします！
討伐するだけでなく
≪水砦竜≫の頭部と翼を
破壊してくれたら報酬を
上乗せいたします。
どうか我々の研究に力
を貸してください！

23413.description: This quest yields upgrade materials and the like for 1 part of the Vulcan series, G-rank Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23413.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one part of
the ≪G Rank Armor≫
Vulcan Series, and more.
Accepting the quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
Note that if the quest fails,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will
be consumed, so please
keep that in mind.
23413.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪Ｇ級防具≫
バルカンシリーズ１部位分
の強化素材などが入手できま
す。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50681.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の撃退
50681.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Diore FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50681.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
upgrade materials for one piece
of the ≪Zenith Armor≫ Diore FX
series.
To accept the quest, a
≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
Should you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
50681.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
ディオレFXシリーズの１部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21281.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

62547.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. Thanks to an adaptability that shrugs off harsh environments, elemental attacks seem to be of almost no use against it, so be careful.
62547.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species and has no fixed habitat;
because its numbers are so small it
is a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
Its adaptability shrugs off even harsh
environments, so elemental attacks
seem to hardly work on it.
Be careful.
62547.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物ね。過酷な環境もものとも
しない適応力から、属性の類
は、ほとんど通用しないみた
いだから気をつけてね。

54651.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54651.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54651.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

55782.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
55782.description: For the G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them further. By breaking the Lavasioth Subspecies' head, we will also grant you special ingredients.
55782.descriptionEn:
For the G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared this
quest to raise awareness and
promotion further.
By breaking the Crimson Lava
Wyvern's head, we will also
grant you special ingredients.
55782.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
紅溶岩竜の頭部を破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

21978.description: A Supremacy black flying wyvern has appeared. The purpose of this request is to prevent the damage from spreading until the hunt party arrives. Therefore, please complete it by repelling the monster. Act with your own safety first.
21978.descriptionEn:
A black flying wyvern of the
Zenith has appeared.
This request aims to prevent
the damage from spreading until
the slaying party arrives.
Therefore, please complete it
by repelling.
Put your own safety first.
21978.descriptionJp:
覇種の黒い飛竜が現れまし
た。この依頼は、討伐隊が
到着するまでの、被害拡大を
防ぐことが目的となります。
そのため、撃退での達成を
お願いします。
ハンターさん自身の安全を
第一に行動してください。

21653.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Sodi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21653.descriptionEn:
A memo recording the lost
secret of forging arms was
found on monsters slain across
the land! Once you have the
Sodi Memo, bring it to this
workshop chief, like a man!
I will do a fine job for you!
21653.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ソディメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

60038.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. If a Melynx steals an item, do not panic, just take it back! You might even pick up their pouch instead, you know?
60038.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, is called
the Phantom Beast for the way it
commands lightning at will.
If a Melynx steals an item, do
not panic, just take it back!
On the contrary, you might even
pick up its pouch, you know?
60038.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、雷を自在にあやつるさま
から≪幻獣≫と呼ばれる生き
物です。アイテムを≪メラル
ー≫に奪われたら焦らず取り
返しましょう！逆にポーチを
拾えるかも知れないですよ？

63033.description: The spirit of the artisan is said to lodge a powerful soul in arms. That spirit takes many colors depending on the artisan, and even now new spirit is born from daily effort. Why not take this chance to feel the spirit of the artisans?
63033.descriptionEn:
The spirit of a smith is said
to lodge a powerful soul in
weapons and armor. That spirit
takes many colors depending on
the smith, and even now new
spirit is born from daily effort.
Why not feel the spirit of
the smiths for yourself on
this occasion?
63033.descriptionJp:
職人の心意気は、武具に
強力な魂を宿すと言われて
います。その心意気は、
職人により様々な色を持ち
日々の努力から今も新たな
心意気が生み出されています。
この機会に職人たちの
心意気を感じてはいかがで
しょうか？

26082.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26082.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26082.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

62334.description: It seems you managed a hunt focused on defense, working together with your comrades. So I have prepared a follow-up request that will make you want to set out with them again. If you clear this one splendidly too, I will give you this Large Gem.
62334.descriptionEn:
It seems you fought with
allies and focused on defense.
So I have prepared a follow-up
request to make you want to
set out with them again.
Clear it well and I will give
you this Large Gem.
62334.descriptionJp:
仲間と力を合わせて、防御を
中心とした狩猟をすることが
できたみたいだな。
そこで、また仲間とともに出
発したくなる、続きの依頼を
用意したぞ。
今回も見事に依頼を達成した
ら、この大宝玉を差し上げよ
う。

23650.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
23650.description: The Espinas Rare Species we were seeking for our ecological survey has been found at the top of the forest. To carry out a more detailed study, hunters, head out at once and hunt the Espinas Rare Species.
23650.descriptionEn:
The ≪Espinas Rare Species≫ we
were seeking for an ecological
survey has been found at the
top of the Great Forest.
For a more detailed study, all
Hunters are asked to head out
and hunt it at once.
23650.descriptionJp:
生態調査として探していた
≪エスピナス希少種≫が樹海
頂部で発見されました。
より詳細な調査を行うために
も、ハンターの皆さんは
至急エスピナス希少種の狩猟
に向かってください。

53304.description: I heard a colossal Kantharos appeared in the Forest and Hills. Its figure is so intense that everyone who sees it cries out, apparently. As a Kantharos maniac, I simply must have a piece of that colossal Kantharos's body! I leave the slaying to you!
53304.descriptionEn:
I heard that a super-giant
Kantharos has appeared in the
Forest and Hills. Its figure
is so intense that everyone
who sees it cries out.
As a Kantharos maniac, I
simply must have a piece of
that super-giant Kantharos!
Please slay it!
53304.descriptionJp:
森丘に超巨大な
カンタロスが現れたと聞いた。
その姿はあまりに強烈で、
見る者すべてが声を上げる
らしい。
カンタロスマニアとして、
ぜひともその超巨大カンタロ
スの体の一部が欲しい！
討伐を頼む！

61033.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61033.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61033.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

55164.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
55164.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Pariapuria while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55164.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest where
slaying a Pariapuria raises
your standing, while letting
you obtain the materials needed
for G Rank decorations at a
good value.
Please make the most of it.
55164.descriptionJp:
パリアプリアを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

62725.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Forest and Hills, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Wind Cave, the Voice of Nature: Blossoms, or the Voice of Nature: Grassland. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62725.descriptionEn:
I hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request
set in the Forest and Hills,
you may obtain Voice of
Nature: Wind Cave, Voice of
Nature: Blooming, or Voice
of Nature: Grassland.
May your hunting life flourish.
62725.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪森丘≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・風穴≫や
≪大自然の声・爛漫≫、
≪大自然の声・草原≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

50556.description: You there! I hear you produced a Taikun Zamuza weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Taikun Zamuza. I am counting on you!
50556.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a weapon
from the Many-Shell Crab.
So I've got a favor to ask,
how about weapon upgrade mats?
Easy job, really—just run out
and slay a Taikun Zamuza
for me and that's all.
I'm counting on you!
50556.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
多殻蟹の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器の強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってタイクンザムザを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

62140.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62140.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62140.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62140.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

54934.description: This quest yields the following materials. Dual Blades Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Dual Blades Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Dual Blades Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54934.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Dual Blades Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Dual Blades Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Dual Blades Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept it you need a
Secret Art Ribbon Crystal.
54934.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪双剣綬・序≫１００個
≪双剣綬・中≫１６５個
≪双剣綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

40142.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil F Earring.
40142.descriptionEn:
Over here, we are distributing
VISA Production Tickets to
hunters who possess Gothic
gear.
Please accept the quest while
you have the Vale F Earrings
equipped.
40142.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。
ベイルＦイヤリングを装備
した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

55362.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55362.description: An Anomalous Species Tigrex with greatly developed claws has appeared, and its attacks, peculiar to the Anomalous Species, have defeated many hunters. To improve the situation, the guild will support the hunt with strengthened supply items and more! Please take care during the hunt!
55362.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Tigrex with
greatly developed claws has
appeared, and many hunters
have failed to slay it due to
the attacks unique to
Supremacy monsters.
To improve things, the Guild
will support the slay with
stronger supplies! Take care!
55362.descriptionJp:
爪が大きく発達した辿異種
ティガレックスが現れ、辿
異種特有の攻撃により数多
のハンターが討伐に失敗し
ています。
事態改善のため、支給品の
強化などでギルドも討伐を
支援いたします！討伐の際
は、どうかお気を付けて！

60406.description: I picked up blue hair in the desert that resembles Hypnocatrice down. It must belong to the breeding-season Hypnocatrice everyone has been whispering about. It is still the cold season, so the coat is probably mid-change, but there is a good chance of getting some if you bring one down.
60406.descriptionEn:
I picked up blue fur in the
Desert that looks like
Hypnocatrice hair. It must be
from the breeding-season
Hypnocatrice people whisper about.
It is still the cold season, so
it is mid-shed, but slaying one
seems likely to yield some.
60406.descriptionJp:
砂漠でヒプノックの毛に似た
蒼い毛を拾ったんだ。
これは最近ささやかれている
繁殖期のヒプノックのものだ
ろうな。
まだ寒冷期だから生え変わる
途中なんだろうが、倒せば手
に入る可能性はありそうだな。

55107.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55107.description: We have prepared a quest to strengthen the Rohok G Series. Hunt Tigrex and you can obtain strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
55107.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
for upgrading the
"Rohokku G Series".
By hunting a Tigrex, you can
obtain the upgrade materials
for one piece.
Please make good use of it!
55107.descriptionJp:
「ロホックＧシリーズ」を強
化するためのクエストを準備
しました。
ティガレックスを狩猟するこ
とで、１部位分の強化素材が
入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください！

12024.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
12024.description: A Plesioth subspecies sometimes appears in the desert this season. A violent fish wyvern with scales as lovely as jade. Hunting a Plesioth is no simple matter. The trick is to draw it out of the water with a loud noise.
12024.descriptionEn:
In the Desert this season, a
Plesioth subspecies sometimes
shows up. A violent fish wyvern
with beautiful jade coloring.
Hunting a Plesioth is no easy
task. The trick is to draw it
out of the water with loud noise.
12024.descriptionJp:
この季節の砂漠ではときおり
ガノトトスの亜種が出没する
わ。翡翠のように綺麗な体色
をしている強暴な魚竜よ。
ガノトトスを狩猟するのは容
易じゃないわ。大きな音で水
中から引き出すのがコツね。

56080.description: I hear a Midogaron sometimes appears in the volcano, but it is so fast I have never seen one. For my sake, who has never once laid eyes on it, won't you hunt it and show me the materials? As thanks I will give you armor material that can charm the opposite sex.
56080.descriptionEn:
Sometimes a Midogaron appears
in the Volcano, but it is so
fast I have never seen one.
For my sake, who has never
seen it, hunt one and show me
its materials. In return I
will give you armor materials
that charm the opposite sex.
56080.descriptionJp:
時折、火山に≪爆狼≫が現れ
るそうだけど、脚が早くて見
たことがないの。
１回も姿を見たことがない
ワタシのために、アイツを
狩ってきて、素材をみせて
くれないかしら。
お礼に異性を魅了できる防具
素材をプレゼントするわ。

50636.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki on Tide Island! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50636.descriptionEn:
You who would master the Dual
Blades: show me the skill you
have honed against the
≪Pariapuria≫ of the Tidal Island!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn even more reward
than your daily efforts bring
you.
50636.descriptionJp:
双剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

53148.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の撃退
53148.description: It seems to be saying: 'I want you to fight together with me, kii. We Uruki were living in peace in the flower field, kii, when a legendary Elder Dragon came, kii. It's all a mess now, kii. Be my hands and feet and drive it away, kii.'
53148.descriptionEn:
'I want you to fight with us,
kii. We Uruki were living in
peace in the flower field,
kii, when a legendary Elder
Dragon came, kii. Everything
is a mess now, kii. Become my
arms and legs and drive it
off, kii.'
So it seems to say.
53148.descriptionJp:
「一緒に戦ってほしいキー
　僕らウルキーが花畑で
　平和に暮らしていたら
　伝説の古龍がきたキー
　もうむちゃくちゃだキー
　僕の手足となって、
　追い払うんだキー」
と言っているようだ。

26406.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26406.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?
26406.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た実り豊かなフィールドで、
たまにはのんびり採取でも
いかがですか？

55231.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55231.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Glear GX Leggings' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55231.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
top prize in the "F Photo
Contest 2016", we have
prepared a quest that yields
the materials to craft and
upgrade the armor worn in it,
the "Glare GX Leggings".
Please make use of it.
55231.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「グレアGXレギンス」
を生産・強化するための素材
を獲得できるクエストをご用
意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

62043.description: Man, that was a scare! I never heard of that thing being in the tower. And on top of that, it's different from the usual sort. I got spooked and ended up dropping my precious merchandise and running. I'll make it worth your while, so go hunt it!
62043.descriptionEn:
Man, that was rough!
I never heard of that thing
being in the Tower.
And it looks different from
the usual ones, too.
I got scared and ended up
dropping my precious goods and
running for it.
I will pay you, so
go hunt it for me!
62043.descriptionJp:
いやー、まいったぜ！
まさか塔にアイツがいるなん
て聞いたことがねぇ。
しかも、普通のヤツと様子が
違うときてる。
ビビったオレは、大事な商品
を放り出してとんずらする羽
目になっちまった。
礼はするから、ヤツを狩猟し
てきてくれ！

50820.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50820.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
50820.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

54395.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the chest of Basarios, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54395.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared this
quest to raise awareness and
promotion further.
By breaking the Basarios's
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
54395.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
岩竜の胸部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

26720.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26720.description: What, you just want a hard Gunlance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26720.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Gunlance, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search for it with spirit!
26720.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬いガン
ランスが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

50372.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟

61252.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
61252.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!
61252.descriptionJp:
うむ！我輩だ！教官だ！
今回は全装備を貸し出しての
演習を行う！
狩猟の対象は各地の鳥竜だ。
まだ経験が浅いハンターに
とってはかなり強力な装備を
用意したので、慣れない武器
だったとしても頑張るんだぞ！

60706.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
60706.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
60706.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
60706.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

63371.description: Herbivore hunters of the world! This is no time to be eating grass. Every year! At this time of year! Whether you do it or not, your fate changes greatly! I want you to take on the challenge boldly! By the way, breaking a Congalala's claws will surely bring something good!
63371.descriptionEn:
All you herbivore hunters out
there! This is no time to be
eating plants. Every year!
This season! Your fate changes
greatly on whether you do it
or not! I want you to take it
on boldly! By the way, break a
Congalala's claws for good luck!
63371.descriptionJp:
世の中の草食ハンター諸君！
草食している場合ではない。
毎年！この時期！ヤルか
ヤラないかで諸君の運命は
大きく変わるのだ！果敢に
挑んで欲しい！ついでに
ババコンガの爪を破壊すると
きっと良いことがあるぞ！

55072.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
55072.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55072.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55072.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

53273.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
53273.description: The lord of the sea that has long threatened the coastal folk has shown itself in the jungle. The nuisance is that the beach has become territory for a troop of monkeys. Drive the meddlesome apes off first, or slip past them and strike at the sea lord. Do not miss your chance: pierce it with countless blades and lightning like a sudden downpour, and bring the sea lord down!
53273.descriptionEn:
The lord of the sea that threatens
the coastal folk has appeared
in the Jungle. Trouble is, the
beach is the monkeys' territory.
Drive off the bothersome monkeys,
or seize the moment and aim
for the lord. Do not miss your
chance: pierce him with
countless knives and thunder!
53273.descriptionJp:
海辺の民を脅かす海の主が、
密林に姿を現した。ただ厄介
なことに、浜は猿どもの
縄張りになっている。
先に邪魔な猿どもを退けるか、
隙を突き海の主を狙え。
好機を逃さず、無数の小刀と
雷を驟雨の如く穿ち、
海の主を討つのだ！

50149.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50149.description: Word in your ear, hunter! Apparently a legendary Rajang has appeared in the Snowy Mountains! What? Rajang are nothing rare? Then go and try your luck. That one is no ordinary Rajang, it is something special.
50149.descriptionEn:
Here is some useful news for
you, hunter! A legendary Rajang
seems to have appeared in the
Snowy Mountains!
What? Rajang are nothing rare?
Then try taking it on.
That one is not just any Rajang.
It is something special.
50149.descriptionJp:
ハンターさんに耳よりの情報
だ！なんと雪山に伝説の
ラージャンが現れたらしい！
なに？ラージャンなんて
珍しくない？
じゃあ挑戦してみなよ。
やつはただのラージャン
じゃない特別なんだ。

21441.description: It seems you gathered splendidly the materials the miner requested. According to the owner of the mixing shop, if you mix a large amount of Amber Rare Water and Jade Rare Water with Blast Rock, you get a rare ore that burns as if it were exploding. Won't you try it too?
21441.descriptionEn:
You've gathered all the
materials the miner asked for.
According to the owner of the
mixing shop, blending blasting
rocks into lots of Amber Fluid
and Jade Fluid makes a rare ore
that burns like an explosion.
Won't you try it too?
21441.descriptionJp:
採掘師が依頼した素材を見事
に集めきったようですね。
調合屋のあるじから聞いた話
によると、大量の琥珀の稀水、
翡翠の稀水に火薬岩を調合す
ると、爆発したように燃える
希少な鉱石ができるらしいの。
あなたも試してみない？

21817.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21817.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21817.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21817.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

62064.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Swamp, hunt Congalala and a flock of bird wyverns, and to finish, bring back 2 pieces of Grey Crystal Ore from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
62064.descriptionEn:
This time, special training for
you hunters with little skill!
Hunt Congalala and a flock of
Bird Wyverns in the Swamp, then
finish by bringing back 2 Raw
Gravierite from the Cave.
It is harsh training, but if you
pull it off, your standing as
hunters will rise sharply!
62064.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！沼地で桃毛獣と、鳥竜
の群れを狩猟し、仕上げに、
洞窟より灰水晶の原石２個を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

23459.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Ribbon (Beginning) x100, Light Bowgun Ribbon (Middle) x165, Light Bowgun Ribbon (Extreme) x165. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23459.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Light Bowgun Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept it you need a
Secret Art Ribbon Crystal.
23459.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｌボウガン綬・序≫100個
≪Ｌボウガン綬・中≫165個
≪Ｌボウガン綬・極≫165個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

58104.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58104.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58104.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58104.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55483.description: A Divergent Hypnocatrice with a greatly developed beak has appeared. It strikes hunters with overwhelming drowsiness, and many have given up the hunt. The Guild recommends a large party and will add to the supplies when you depart with 4. Head out to investigate with care.
55483.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Hypnocatrice with
a greatly developed beak has
appeared.
Assailed by terrible drowsiness,
many hunters have given up on
slaying it.
The Guild recommends joining in
numbers, and will add supplies
when you depart as four.
Please head out with care.
55483.descriptionJp:
嘴が大きく発達した辿異種の
ヒプノックが現れました。
猛烈な睡魔に襲われ、多くの
ハンターが討伐を断念して
います。
ギルドでは多人数での参加を
推奨し、４名で出発した時に
支給品の追加を行います。
気をつけて調査に向かってく
ださい。

54519.description: This is a qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament in Thanksgiving Festival 2014. The time limit is 10 minutes.
54519.descriptionEn:
This is a qualifier quest for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament
in Thanksgiving Festival 2014.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
54519.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントin感謝祭2014の
予選クエストです。
制限時間は１０分です。

62446.description: An exceptionally powerful individual of the Tide Island Gogomoa has been found. The hunt will be harsh on an island we still know little about, so we ask that only hunters able to prove their skill take on the survey and hunt!
62446.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful individual
of the Tidal Island's leaping
beast ≪Gogomoa≫ has been found.
Info on the Tidal Island is
still scarce and the hunt is
harsh, so this is limited to
Hunters who can prove their skill!
62446.descriptionJp:
潮島の跳緋獣≪ゴゴモア≫の
極めて強力な個体が発見され
ました。まだ情報も少ない
潮島での過酷な狩猟である
ため、腕前の証明ができる
ハンターさん限定での調査、
狩猟をお願いします！

40134.description: The albino Khezu of these snowy mountains is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40134.descriptionEn:
The Albino ≪Khezu≫ that lives
in these Snowy Mountains is
said to sometimes carry
incredible treasure.
If that is true, I would love
for you to hunt one for us.
We will split the reward.
40134.descriptionJp:
この雪山に生息するアルビノ
≪フルフル≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

50712.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50712.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Kushala Daora will also grant a special ingredient.
50712.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Kushala Daora's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50712.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鋼龍の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

50338.description: Have returns arrived from the male hunters? A present should have come from whoever answered your feelings. This may be a good chance to reconsider the relationships you have day to day.
50338.descriptionEn:
Have the men among you hunters
received anything in return?
A present should have arrived
from whoever answered your
feelings.
Take this chance to reconsider
your everyday relationships; it
might be a good idea.
50338.descriptionJp:
男性ハンターの皆さんから
お返しは届いていますか？
貴女の想いに応じてくれた方
からプレゼントが届いている
はずです。
これを機に日頃の関係を見直
してみるのも良いかもしれま
せんよ。

23389.objectiveJp: タワラサボテン５０個の納品
23389.description: Greetings. Are you still gathering now that you are G rank? My job is plant collection. Gather the plants I name. Thank you.
23389.descriptionEn:
Greetings.
Even at G Rank, are you still
gathering?
My request is plant collecting.
Please gather the plants I am
about to describe and bring
them to me.
Thank you.
23389.descriptionJp:
ごきげんよう。
Ｇ級になっても採取をしてい
ますか？
私からの依頼は植物集めです。
これから伝える植物を集めて
きてください。
よろしくお願いします。

21054.description: If you're hit by a Conga's flatulence you won't be able to use healing items! If you get smelly, use a Deodorant to take the stench off your body!
21054.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Conga≫ fart
and you can't use healing
items! If you get smelly,
use a ≪Deodorant≫ to clear
