50695.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50695.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50695.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

54789.description: This is one of the Anniversary 2015 Premium Goods early purchase campaign quests, 'Get a New Decoration!', which consumes an Anniversary Quest Ticket. Clear the main target to obtain one G rank Dogou Jewel.
54789.descriptionEn:
This is the “Get a New Decoration!”
quest, one of the Anniversary 2015
Premium Goods early purchase
campaign quests, and it consumes
an «Anniversary Quest Ticket».
Clear the main target to obtain
1 «G Rank: Furious Steel Orb».
54789.descriptionJp:
アニバーサリー２０１５
プレミアムグッズ
早期購入キャンペーンの一つ
≪アニバクエスト券≫を消費
して「新装飾品をゲット！」
のクエストになります。
メインターゲット達成で、
≪Ｇ級・怒剛珠≫１個を入手
することができます。

61708.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

21594.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21594.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Leopard Paw Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21594.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called the Leopard Leg Sphere?
Its material is indispensable
for making a certain costly
decoration.
If you complete this request,
I will hand over a precious
decoration material for you.
21594.descriptionJp:
豹脚原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

53122.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
53122.description: Oh, what a disaster! This year I made all sorts of preparations to celebrate Congalala, but I accidentally let it escape! It seems it fled into a troublesome place where Yian Kut-Ku live. So, I'll ask a fine hunter to slay some bird wyverns! I'm counting on you!
53122.descriptionEn:
Oh, what a disaster!
This year I was preparing all sorts
of things to celebrate the
Congalala, but I accidentally let
it escape!
Worse, it seems to have fled into
a troublesome place where Yian
Kut-Ku live.
So I'll ask a fine hunter to
slay some bird wyverns! You're on!
53122.descriptionJp:
あぁなんてことだ！今年は桃
毛獣ババコンガを
祭ろうと色々準備を
していたんだが、うっかり
手違いで逃がしてしまった！
大変なことに怪鳥が生息する
面倒な所へ逃げ込んだ様だ。
でだ、優秀なハンターに
鳥竜種の討伐をお願いしよ
う！頼んだぞ！

26094.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26094.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26094.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

63086.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63086.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
63086.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
63086.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

55861.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55861.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55861.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

28005.description: This time too we have prepared a quest for you hunting party members, meow. This time that one appears as 2 at once, meow. There are no sub-target clears prepared, so ready yourselves well and work together, meow. I wish you good hunting, meow.
28005.descriptionEn:
Once again I've prepared a quest
for all you guild members, meow.
This time that thing shows up
two at once, meow.
There's no sub-target to clear, so
prepare properly and work together
as guild members, meow.
I wish you luck, meow.
28005.descriptionJp:
今回も猟団員の皆様に、クエ
ストを用意させていただいた
ニャ。今度はアイツが、２頭
同時で登場しているニャ。
サブターゲットクリアは用意
していないので、準備をしっ
かりして、猟団員の皆様で力
を合わせて頑張ってください
ニャ。健闘を祈りますニャ。

26342.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26342.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26342.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

55293.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55293.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will surely grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
55293.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to give them
the name "the Famished Deviljho".
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
They have been shut in without
any meat and driven to the limit.
Hunters of courage, hear me.
If you succeed in slaying one,
the Guild will surely grant you
the armor materials it treasures
deep in its vaults.
55293.descriptionJp:
ギルドでは、ヤツらの呼称を
「餓え喰らうイビルジョー」
とすることにした。
ヤツらは唯の恐暴竜ではない。
閉じ込め肉を与えず極限まで
追い込んである。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
もしも討伐に成功したならば
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を必
ず授けよう。

53082.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
53082.description: A hunter thinking of changing from the Hope series armor to another set. How about the Quoiz series, available from this request? It has a stylish look like the Kukubo series, so I think you will like it.
53082.descriptionEn:
To hunters thinking of trading
their Hope Series armor for
something else.
How about the Quoiz Series
armor you can obtain from
this request?
It looks as stylish as the
Kukubo Series, so I am sure
you will like it.
53082.descriptionJp:
防具≪ホープシリーズ≫から
別の防具に変えたいと考えて
いるハンターさん。
この依頼で入手可能な防具
≪クオイズシリーズ≫はどう
ですか？
≪ククボシリーズ≫のように
おしゃれな見た目で気に入る
と思いますよ。

55685.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Hypnocatrice. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55685.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Hypnocatrice
materials. To accept it, a
Superior Ticket is required.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the Superior Ticket
will be consumed.
55685.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ヒプノック≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50383.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50383.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50383.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50383.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54367.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
54367.description: While I was surveying the Yaozami ecology in the Jungle, a Bulldrome suddenly attacked. At this rate the survey cannot proceed! Would you hunt the Bulldrome for me?
54367.descriptionEn:
While we were surveying Yao Zami
ecology in the Jungle, a Bulldrome
suddenly attacked us.
At this rate the survey cannot go
on!
Could you please hunt that
Bulldrome for us?
54367.descriptionJp:
密林でヤオザミの生態調査を
行っていたら、突然ドス
ファンゴが襲ってきました。
このままでは調査が進められ
ません！
どうか、ドスファンゴを狩猟
してきてもらえないでしょう
か？

53151.description: We have prepared a quest to craft the Rohok Series. Hunt Rathian and Brook and you can obtain production and strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
53151.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest for crafting
the “Rohokku Series”.
By hunting a Rathian and a Bullock,
you can obtain production and
upgrade materials for one piece.
Please make good use of it!
53151.descriptionJp:
「ロホックシリーズ」を生産
するためのクエストを準備し
ました。
リオレイアとブルックを狩猟
することで、１部位分の生産
素材と強化素材が入手できま
す。ぜひお役立てください！

63317.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Congalala, then slay the Congalala here in this arena!
63317.descriptionEn:
The Arena, where hunters show
off their skill!
If you're confident you can handle
the pink-furred beast, slay
«Congalala» here in this Arena!
63317.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する闘技場！桃毛獣を
相手に、見事立ち回る自信が
ある者はこの闘技場にて
≪ババコンガ≫を討伐
してみせよ！

23281.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
23281.description: Reports say accidents happen often in the Desert at night. Merchants avoid the strong daylight and transport their loads at night, and a monster seems to leap out of the sand and attack them. The cause is likely a Cephadrome roaming there, so please hunt it.
23281.descriptionEn:
Reports say accidents happen
often in the Desert at night.
Merchants avoiding the strong
daytime sun transport their goods
at night, and it seems monsters
burst out of the sand and
attacked them.
The cause is likely a wandering
≪Cephadrome≫, so please hunt it.
23281.descriptionJp:
夜の砂漠でよく事故が起きる
と報告があった。
商人が日差しの強い日中を
避け、夜に荷物を輸送してい
たら、砂からモンスターが
飛び出してきて襲われたらし
い。
おそらく、原因は≪砂竜≫の
徘徊と思われるので狩猟して
きてほしい。

54364.description: It is hopeless! That vicious monster has appeared at the tower too! Someone save us from this crisis! According to sightings, this time a Dyuragaua is on a rampage! What is this world coming to!
54364.descriptionEn:
It's hopeless! That vicious monster
has appeared in the Tower too!
Someone please save us from
this crisis!
According to sightings, this time
an «Ice Fox Wyvern» is on a rampage!
Just what is this world
coming to!?
54364.descriptionJp:
もうダメです！塔にまで例の
凶悪なモンスターが出現しま
した！誰かこの危機を救っ
てください！
目撃情報によると、今度は
≪氷狐竜≫が暴れているそう
です！
いったいこの世界はどうなっ
てしまうのでしょうか！？

54729.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54729.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54729.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

55269.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
55269.description: To those of you who have upgraded the Flogada GF series to LV7! We have prepared a quest that lets you obtain in one go the upgrade materials for 1 piece of the Flogada GX series armor! Clear the quest 5 times and upgrade every piece!
55269.descriptionEn:
To you who strengthened the
Frogada GF series to LV7!
We have prepared a quest where
you can obtain in one go the
upgrade materials for one piece
of the armor "Frogada GX Series"!
Clear the quest 5 times and
strengthen every piece!
55269.descriptionJp:
フロガダGFシリーズをＬＶ７
まで強化できたあなたへ！
防具「フロガダGXシリーズ」
１部位分の強化素材が一気に
入手できるクエストを用意し
ました！クエストを５回クリ
アして全部位を強化しよう！

26560.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26560.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Divine Consort] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
26560.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Divine Consort]≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).
26560.descriptionJp:
２年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ナナブレイド【神妃】≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると、≪感謝の
証K≫を１１枚プレゼント
いたします。
≪感謝の証K≫から≪アカム
スクウィード≫（ランス）が
生産可能です。

60603.description: The greatest weapon a hunter has. That is courage that nothing can break. Learn from the solitary figure of the Monoblos, which faces any foe alone, and that heart will follow of its own accord. Devote yourself to your training, nothing else.
60603.descriptionEn:
The most important weapon a hunter
has is courage that nothing can break.
Learn from the lone «Monoblos», who
faces any foe alone, and that heart
will follow naturally.
All you can do is keep honing yourself.
60603.descriptionJp:
ハンターの最も大切な武器。
それは、何者にも挫くことの
できぬ勇気じゃ。
どんな敵に対しても、一人で
立ち向かう≪モノブロス≫の
孤高の姿に学べば、その心も
自然と着いてくるものじゃろ
うて。精進あるのみじゃぞ。

26128.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
26128.description: Now, into live combat! Go into the desert, find a Gendrome, and hunt it! Desert nights are cold: without a Hot Drink you will freeze and your maximum stamina will drop, so be careful.
26128.descriptionEn:
Now then, time for real combat!
Let's find and hunt an «Iodrome»
in the Desert!
Desert nights are cold, so if you
don't drink a «Hot Drink» you'll
freeze and your max stamina will
drop, so be careful.
26128.descriptionJp:
さて、それでは実戦です！
砂漠で、≪ドスゲネポス≫を
探して狩猟してみましょう！
砂漠の夜は、寒いので、≪ホ
ットドリンク≫を飲まないと
凍えちゃって、スタミナ上限
が減っていくので注意です。

50376.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50376.description: This time an extremely ferocious Tigrex seems to have appeared in the Desert. It is a Tigrex already ferocious enough, so there are concerns about the effect on the environment. Head out to slay it at once.
50376.descriptionEn:
This time a very ferocious «Tigrex»
seems to have appeared in the Desert.
It's already ferocious, so we fear
the impact on the environment.
Please head out to slay it at once.
50376.descriptionJp:
今度は砂漠で非常に凶暴な
≪轟竜≫が出現したようです。
ただでさえ凶暴な轟竜なので
環境への影響が懸念されます。
至急、討伐へ向かって下さい。

54242.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54242.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54242.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

54108.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54108.description: I want to investigate the habits of Shogun Ceanataur and its shell. I would prefer an individual living in the volcano. Also, claws are not needed for this survey. They are in the way, so break them. It is dangerous, so be sure to break them.
54108.descriptionEn:
I want to survey the habits of the
Shogun Ceanataur and its shell.
I'd prefer one living in the Volcano.
Also, the claws aren't needed for
this survey.
They're in the way, so break them.
They're dangerous, so be sure
to break them!
54108.descriptionJp:
ショウグンギザミとヤドの
習性について調査をしたい。
火山に生息している個体が
望ましいな。それと、今回の
調査に爪は必要ない。
邪魔だから壊しておいてくれ。
危険だから、必ず破壊して
おいてくれよ。

60110.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the volcano lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60110.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Volcano
lie scattered all around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.
60110.descriptionJp:
火山ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代分の価値はあると
思うぜ。

23589.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
23589.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.
23589.descriptionJp:
生物が存在できない場所だと
言われていた『最果ての地』
に、龍がいたと大型探査船
から報告がありました。
僅かに残る資料から、
『熾凍龍』と呼ばれる古龍で
あると推測されますが、詳細
は全くの不明です。現地へ
向かい、調査をお願いします。

55160.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
55160.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Uragaan armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55160.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to make
armor from the ≪Uragaan≫!
Clear the sub-target to obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
Transcend Armor, so please give it
a try!
55160.descriptionJp:
爆鎚竜≪ウラガンキン≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを用意
しました！サブターゲットを
達成すると遷悠防具の強化に
必要な素材を入手できます
ので、ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

60630.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Slip through a duet of sleep breath and land a blow with all your might! Bring down 2 Hypnocatrice and an exceptional purse awaits! Challengers wanted!
60630.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
Dodge the duet of sleep breaths
and land a blow with all your
might!
Bring down the two Hypnocatrice
and an exceptional prize awaits!
Challengers wanted!
60630.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！
睡眠ブレスの２重奏をかいく
ぐり渾身の一撃を叩きこめ！
見事、眠鳥２頭を仕留めれば
破格の賞金が待っているぞ！
求む！挑戦者！

54775.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54775.description: We are continuing our survey of the White Monoblos. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54775.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of the
Monoblos Subspecies.
Breaking parts isn't required, but
we'd be delighted if you did!
Hunters, thank you for your help!
54775.descriptionJp:
モノブロス亜種の調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

50980.description: A request for hunters who possess Baruragaru Tenran armor. Drive off Arganos and Golganos and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
50980.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repelling Arganos
and Gorganos, you can get
the materials needed to
upgrade "Stroma FX
Series" ≪Supremacy≫ armor
up to Lv7.
50980.descriptionJp:
≪喰血竜≫の≪天嵐防具≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
アルガノスとゴルガノスを
撃退することで
「ストロマFXシリーズ」
≪覇種防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

50141.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50141.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50141.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

58081.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１６頭の討伐

62050.description: This is the final round of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Target monster materials cannot be obtained from carving the monster or from clear rewards.
62050.descriptionEn:
This is the final round of the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament.
Target monster materials cannot
be obtained from carving the
monster or from clear rewards.
62050.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの決勝クエスト
です。モンスターの剥ぎ取り
とクリア報酬で対象モンスタ
ーの素材は入手できません。

23221.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

62240.description: I am a flower seller. But I am usually not in the plaza. Where I sell is a secret. Ah, right. I have a request for you, hunter. I want you to gather lots of Iwahime Grass in the highlands. Give it to me and I will give you one seed that flew here from far away.
62240.descriptionEn:
I'm a flower seller, you know.
But I'm not usually in the plaza.
Where I sell is a secret.
Ah, that's right. I have a favor to
ask of you, hunter.
I want you to gather lots of
Iwahime Grass from the Highlands.
If you give them to me, I'll give
you one seed that flew here from
far away.
62240.descriptionJp:
わたしはねー花売りなのー。
でも、普段は広場にいません。
どこで売ってるか秘密なのー。
あ、そうだ。ハンターさんに
お願いがあるんだ―。
高地にあるイワヒメ草をたく
さん採ってきてほしいのー。
わたしにくれたら、遠くから
飛んできた種を１つあげるー。

54394.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Congalala, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54394.descriptionEn:
For the newly started G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we've prepared
this quest to raise awareness
and interest.
By breaking the Congalala's head,
we'll also grant you a special ingredient.
54394.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
桃毛獣の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54096.description: Please help investigate Gravios. This time the targets are the chest and tail. Be sure to destroy or cut them. Note that hunting alone will count as a failure.
54096.descriptionEn:
Please help us survey a Gravios.
This time the targets are its chest
and tail. Be sure to break or
sever them.
If you only hunt it, it counts as a
failure, so please be careful.
54096.descriptionJp:
グラビモスを調査するための
お手伝いをお願いします。
今回の調査の対象は、胸部と
尻尾になります。必ず
破壊もしくは切断をしてくだ
さい。狩猟のみでは、失敗と
なるので注意してくださいね。

55589.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55589.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55589.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

21066.description: For hunters who want to make ore weapons, mining is the very basics! First, start by learning where you can mine. If you find cracks in a cliff, try digging with a Pickaxe!
21066.descriptionEn:
For hunters who want to make ore
type weapons, mining is the very
basics of the basics!
First, let us start by learning where
you can mine.
If you find cracks in a cliff or
similar, try digging with a
≪Pickaxe≫!
21066.descriptionJp:
鉱石系武器を作りたいハンタ
ーにとって採掘は基本中の基
本ですよ！
まずは、採掘できる場所を知
ることから始めましょう。
崖などにヒビ割れを見つけた
ら、≪ピッケル≫で掘ってみ
てください！

60803.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60803.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60803.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54722.description: The survey team that headed for the Snowy Mountains reports finding the carcasses of many monsters near the summit. From their pitiful state, it is assumed to be the work of a very ferocious monster. Hunter confident in your skill, restore peace to the Snowy Mountains.
54722.descriptionEn:
The survey team that went to the
Snowy Mountains reports that many
monster carcasses were found near
the summit.
From that gruesome sight, it is
thought to be the work of a very
ferocious monster.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please restore peace to the
Snowy Mountains.
54722.descriptionJp:
雪山に向かった調査団より、
山頂付近で多数のモンスター
の死骸が発見されたと報告が
ありました。
その見るも無残な様相からも
とても凶暴なモンスターの仕
業だと推測されます。
腕に自信のあるハンターさん。
雪山の平和を取り戻してくだ
さい。

26029.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
26029.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26029.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26029.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

1078.description: Since long ago they have ruled this land: the King of the Sky, Rathalos, and the Queen of the Land, Rathian. Go and face them with resolve unto death! Do not forget that you may set only one Pitfall Trap or Shock Trap!
1078.descriptionEn:
The king of the sky «Rathalos» and
the queen of the land «Rathian»
have reigned here since ages past.
Face them with resolve to die!
And don't forget you can only set
one pitfall or shock trap!
1078.descriptionJp:
この地に遥か昔より君臨し、
空の王者≪リオレウス≫と
陸の女王≪リオレイア≫。
決死の覚悟にて挑むがよい！
落とし穴やシビレ罠が設置で
きるのは１つまでということ
を忘れるでないぞ！

51123.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
51123.description: Brawling is supreme! Long reach is unnecessary! The answer lies in hand to hand combat! Perhaps the wish to spread the charm of the Tonfa was heard, for we met just the right monster. Weapon and armor are ready, so hunt using these.
51123.descriptionEn:
Brawling is supreme! You don't need
long reach! The answer lies in
close-quarters combat!
Perhaps my wish to spread the charm
of the Tonfa was heard, for I've met
just the right monster.
I've prepared weapon and armor,
so hunt with them.
51123.descriptionJp:
殴り合いこそ至高！
長いリーチなど不要！
肉弾戦の中に答えはある！
そんな穿龍棍の魅力を
広く伝えたいという願いが
通じたのか、ちょうどいい
モンスターに出会えたのだ。
武器と防具は用意したので
これを使って狩猟してくれ。

54099.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54099.description: I want you to hunt a Yian Kut-Ku so we can study it. Its ears are nothing but a hindrance to this survey, so break them during the hunt. If you slay it without breaking the ears, the quest will be treated as failed, so be careful.
54099.descriptionEn:
I'd like you to hunt a Yian Kut-Ku
that appeared on Tidal Island,
for a survey.
Its ears are only a nuisance for
this survey, so break them when
you hunt it.
If you hunt it without breaking
them, it counts as a failure,
so be careful.
54099.descriptionJp:
潮島に現れたイャンクックの
調査のため、狩猟を頼みたい。
今回の調査にはヤツの耳は
邪魔なだけだから、狩猟する
時に壊しておいてほしい。
壊さずに狩猟してしまった
場合は失敗とさせてもらう
から、注意してくれよ。

53080.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
53080.description: Great numbers of Yian Kut-Ku seem to be breaking out around Mezeporta! Hunters, please help slay the Yian Kut-Ku! If you do it splendidly, we will give you a higher reward than usual and ingredients!
53080.descriptionEn:
Yian Kut-Ku seem to be swarming
around Mezeporuta!
Hunters, please help us slay them!
If you slay them for us, we'll pay
a higher fee than usual and
give you ingredients!
53080.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に怪鳥が
大量発生しているようです！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
怪鳥の討伐に協力してくだ
さい！
見事討伐いただけましたら、
通常より高い報酬金と食材
をお渡しします！

63101.description: I want to carry out research on the Leaping Scarlet Beast. Capture it, and break some of its parts so that it is easier to study. I have no interest in materials, so if anything interesting turns up, you may take it once the research is done. Capturing it without breaking any parts will count as a failure.
63101.descriptionEn:
I want to do research on the
leaping crimson beast.
Please capture it, and break some
parts so it's easier to study.
I'm not interested in materials, so
if you find something interesting,
you can keep it after the research.
Capture it without breaking parts
and it's a failure.
63101.descriptionJp:
跳緋獣の研究を行いたいんだ。
何とか、捕獲と、研究しやす
いように一部部位の破壊を
頼むよ。素材には興味が無い
から、面白い素材が見つかっ
たら、研究の後に持っていっ
ていいよ。部位破壊無しで
捕獲したら失敗とさせてもら
うよ。

55491.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a horn break and a leg break in slaying Giaorugu, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55491.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Giaorugu≫ and break its
horns and legs, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55491.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪氷獰竜≫討伐にて
角破壊と脚破壊を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

63255.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
63255.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63255.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63255.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

60236.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Abiorugu! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60236.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete in skill!
This time the target is «Abiorugu»!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
alone is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take a top place!
Also, this time only SP weapons are
allowed! Choose your weapon carefully!
60236.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪アビオルグ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

21236.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21236.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21236.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

62632.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62632.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If remembrance matters more to you than memory, do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us. Note that the certificate cannot be returned once you have departed.
62632.descriptionEn:
We have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
belonging to a winning Guild
of the Hunter Festival.
Those who treasure remembrance over
memory, please bring a Festival Proof
and do join us. Note that after
departure the Proof cannot be returned.
62632.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。思い出よりも追憶が
大切なかた、祭典の証をご用
意の上、ぜひご参加ください。
出発後は、祭典の証の返却が
できませんので、ご注意を。

22010.description: The Congalala is a greedy fanged beast, and word is it has a special weakness for mushroom dishes! Of course its minions the Conga love mushrooms too! If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, it might come out.
22010.descriptionEn:
The pink-furred beast «Congalala» is
a greedy fanged beast, and they say
it can't resist mushroom dishes!
Of course its minions the Conga
love mushrooms too!
If you carry plenty of specialty
mushrooms, it might show up.
22010.descriptionJp:
桃毛獣≪ババコンガ≫は
食い意地の張った牙獣で、
特にキノコ系の食べ物には
目がないって話です！
もちろん子分のコンガも
キノコが大好き！
特産キノコを多めに
持ってれば出てくるかも
知れません。

50217.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
50217.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
50217.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!
50217.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
のだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

55895.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55895.description: Thank you for saving my son and me the other day. The boy has taken quite a shine to you, hunter. So I have a request: would you let him watch you fight one more time? For my son's sake, please!
55895.descriptionEn:
Thank you for saving us father and
son earlier.
My son has completely come to look
up to you, hunter.
So I have a request - could you show
my son your fighting one more time?
For my son's sake, please!
55895.descriptionJp:
先刻は我々親子を助けてくだ
さりありがとうございました。
息子はすっかりハンターさん
に憧れているようです。そこ
でお願いなのですが、もう一
度だけ、ハンターさんが戦う
姿を息子に見せてやってもら
えないでしょうか。息子のた
め、どうかお願いします！

55303.description: The Variant Species Rathalos has appeared once more. Its wings have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55303.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rathalos≫ has
appeared once more.
Its wings have grown more
powerful, and it seems to have
gained even more strength.
Please survey it with great care.
55303.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪リオレウス≫が再び
現れました。
翼はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

53103.description: Chachabu... ah, Chachabu, it was a chance to get close to you, but that chance is gone now. I feel not blue but dark. I could never hunt you, my friend, so I hired a hunter. Forgive me. I wanted to stay friends with you.
53103.descriptionEn:
Chachabu... ah, Chachabu, this was
my chance to get close to you, but
that chance is gone now.
I'm not blue, I'm more like dark.
Hunting you, my friend, is
unthinkable, but I put in a request
with a hunter.
Forgive me. I wanted to stay
friends with you.
53103.descriptionJp:
チャチャブー・・ああチャチ
ャブーせっかく君と近づける
チャンスだったのに、そのチ
ャンスはもうないのだろう。
ブルーな気分でなくむしろダ
ークな気分だよ。友達の君
を狩るなんてありえないけど
狩人に依頼したよ。許してく
れ。君と、友達でいたかった。

55129.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
55129.description: Slaying a Dyuragaua raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55129.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Duramboros you can
raise your own rating while getting
a bargain on the materials needed
for G Rank decorations, so we've
prepared a quest for that.
Please make good use of it.
55129.descriptionJp:
デュラガウアを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

54750.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
54750.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
54750.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the Jungle!
We will also pay for the insects
that sometimes fly there,
Royal Beetles, if you deliver them!
Start by learning the Jungle and
getting used to it.
54750.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を８つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

60804.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60804.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60804.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

58021.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58021.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58021.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58021.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

53204.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
53204.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Lukeze series, available from this request? It excels in resistance to status ailments and in evasion, so you can relax even when hunting tough monsters.
53204.descriptionEn:
Hunter, are you thinking of
changing out of the ≪Hope
Series≫ armor?
How about the ≪Luqueze Series≫
armor obtainable in this request?
It excels in status ailment
resistance and evasion, so you can
rest easy even when hunting
formidable monsters.
53204.descriptionJp:
防具≪ホープシリーズ≫から
着替えたいと考えているハン
ターさん。
この依頼で入手可能な防具
≪ルケーゼシリーズ≫はどう
ですか？
状態異常の耐性や回避性能に
優れているので、手強いモン
スターの狩猟でも安心ですよ。

61508.description: A hunter is always either hunting or being hunted. To keep from being hunted, preparation beforehand is what matters. So, let us put it into practice at once. Hunt while watching out for the poison the monster spits!
61508.descriptionEn:
A hunter either hunts or is hunted.
To avoid being hunted, preparing
beforehand is what matters.
So let's put it into practice
right away.
Hunt while watching out for the
poison monsters spit!
61508.descriptionJp:
ハンターは常に狩るか、
狩られるか、だ。
狩られない様にするには、
事前に準備することが
大切だぞ。
そこで、さっそく実践だ。
モンスターの吐く毒に
注意しながら狩猟しろ！

55933.description: This quest yields the following materials. Magnet Spike Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Magnet Spike Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Magnet Spike Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
55933.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Intro≫ x100
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Mid≫ x165
≪Magnet Spike Medal: Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest you need a
≪Secret Medal Crystal≫, so please
take care.
55933.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪磁斬鎚綬・序≫１００個
≪磁斬鎚綬・中≫１６５個
≪磁斬鎚綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

53046.description: A Chameleos has appeared in the swamp. However, the swamp road seems to be blocked by someone. To undo the mechanism, a book hidden in the Old Tower is needed, they say. We will lend you a ward gunlance, so please investigate. As a reward we will give ward materials.
53046.descriptionEn:
A “Chameleos” has appeared in
the Swamp.
However, the swamp road seems to
have been blocked by someone.
To undo the mechanism, a “book”
hidden in the Ancient Tower is needed.
We'll lend you a ward Gunlance, so
please investigate.
We'll give you ward materials as reward.
53046.descriptionJp:
沼地に「霞龍」が現れました。
しかし、沼地の道が何者かに
よって塞がれているようです。
仕掛けを解くには古塔に隠さ
れた「本」が必要とのこと。
魔除けの銃槍を貸し出します
ので、どうか調査をお願い
します。報酬として魔除けの
素材をお渡しします。

54210.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
54210.description: We are seeking hunters to help investigate the black wolf bird that appeared in the Jungle. The black wolf bird basically acts alone, but that is thought to be because it is strong enough not to need a pack. This is a dangerous request unless you are a hunter with a solid record.
54210.descriptionEn:
We are seeking hunters to help
survey the Yian Garuga that
appeared in the Jungle.
Yian Garuga basically act alone,
likely because they're strong enough
not to need a pack.
This is a dangerous request that
requires a hunter with solid results.
54210.descriptionJp:
密林に出現した黒狼鳥を
調査するため、協力して頂け
るハンターを募集いたします。
黒狼鳥は基本的に単体で
行動していますが、それは
自身が強いため、群れる必要
が無いからだと思われます。
十分な実績を持ったハンター
でなくては、危険な依頼です。

21518.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21518.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21518.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21518.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26222.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

53253.description: One does not become a hunter on half-hearted resolve. The craft of facing monsters and surviving, and a strong heart, are both essential. So I ask you this. With what resolve did you become a hunter? Show it to me. Show me that resolve and I will present you with a special reward!
53253.descriptionEn:
One cannot become a hunter with
half-hearted feelings.
The skills to survive facing a
monster and a strong heart are vital.
So I ask you: with what resolve did
you become a hunter? Show it to me.
If you show your resolve, I'll give
you a special reward!
53253.descriptionJp:
ハンターとは生半可な気持ち
でなれるものではない。
モンスターと対峙し生き抜く
術と強い心が不可欠だ。
そこで問いたい。いかなる決
意をもってハンターとなった
のか。それを示してほしいの
だ。決意を示してくれれば特
別な報酬を進呈しよう！

50765.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Baruragaru Gou armor. By repeatedly slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the swamp, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
50765.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By repeatedly slaying the
mysterious monster in the
Swamp, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
"Stroma F Series" ≪Heavenly
Storm≫ armor up to Lv7.
50765.descriptionJp:
≪喰血竜≫の≪剛種防具≫を
生産・強化したハンター向け
の依頼です。
沼地に現れた謎のモンスター
を繰り返し討伐することで
「ストロマＦシリーズ」
≪天嵐防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

54362.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
54362.description: This time there was a report that a Shogun Ceanataur is on the rampage in the Swamp. It seems to be an extremely vicious individual, and several hunters who went to survey it have been injured. Hunters confident in their skill who can slay this Shogun Ceanataur, please take this request.
54362.descriptionEn:
We've received reports that a
«Shogun Ceanataur» is rampaging
in the Swamp.
It seems to be an extremely vicious
one, and several hunters sent to
survey it have been injured.
Hunters confident in their skill,
please take this request.
54362.descriptionJp:
今度は≪鎌蟹≫が、沼地で
暴れているとの報告がありま
した。
非常に凶悪な個体らしく、
調査に向かった何人もの
ハンター達が負傷しています。
この≪鎌蟹≫を討伐できる、
腕に自信のあるハンターは、
ぜひこの依頼を受けて
いただきたい。

50292.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
50292.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt an Akura Vashimu beautifully. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50292.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show their skill!
Hunt the «Tail Crystal Scorpion» well.
Clear the quest and your reputation
as a hunter will shoot up!
50292.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪尾晶蠍≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

50243.description: You are looking for a new weapon, aren't you? I can tell, having provided weapons to all sorts of hunters. Then let me set you this trial. If you clear it splendidly, I'll acknowledge your ability and part with a special material.
50243.descriptionEn:
You're looking for a new weapon,
aren't you? I can tell - I've
provided weapons to all sorts
of hunters.
Then I'll give you this trial.
If you complete it well, I'll
recognize your skill and part with
special materials.
50243.descriptionJp:
あなた、新しい武器を求めて
ますね？様々なハンターさん
に武器を提供してきた私には
分かります。では、あなたに
はこの試練を出しましょう。
これを見事達成できれば、
その実力を認め、特別な素材
をお譲りしましょう。

61666.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の狩猟
61666.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Snowy Mountains, hunt 2 Bulldrome and the Blangonga's underlings. Then raise the guild flag from the supply box at the summit. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
61666.descriptionEn:
This time we hold special
training limited to hunters who
still have little experience!
In the Snowy Mountains, hunt two
great boars and the Snow Lion's
minions. Then plant the Guild
Flag from the supply box at the
summit.
It is harsh training, but once you
see it through, your standing as a
hunter will rise sharply!
61666.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！雪山で２頭の大猪と、
雪獅子の子分達の狩猟。そし
て、支給品ボックスのギルド
フラッグを山頂に立てるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

53132.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
53132.description: To those aiming for HR100! We have prepared a quest to strengthen the "Karais Series" into the "Karais F Series". By hunting Doragyurosu, you can obtain materials to strengthen one piece into High Rank armor and level it up. Please make good use of it.
53132.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for HR100!
We have prepared a quest to
strengthen the "Karais Series"
into the "Karais F Series".
By hunting Doragyurosu, you can
obtain materials to strengthen one
piece into High Rank armor and
level it up.
Please make good use of it.
53132.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００を目指す方々へ
「カライスシリーズ」を
「カライスＦシリーズ」へ強
化するためのクエストを準備
しました。
ドラギュロスを狩猟すること
で、１部位分を上位防具へ
強化しレベルアップできる
素材が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください。

22093.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
22093.description: A report has come in that one monster researcher has developed a condition called Frenzy Fever. It seems he was infected by the Frenzy Virus during a monster survey. The Gore Magala is very likely the source of infection. To curb the spread of the Frenzy Virus, investigate the site at once.
22093.descriptionEn:
A report has come that one
monster researcher has developed
a symptom called Frenzy.
It seems he was infected by the
Frenzy Virus during monster
research.
The Gore Magala is very likely the
cause of infection.
To stop the spread of the Frenzy
Virus, survey the site at once.
22093.descriptionJp:
１人のモンスター研究員が
狂竜症という症状を発症した
と報告がきている。
モンスターの調査中に狂竜
ウイルスが感染したようだ。
黒蝕竜が感染原因である
可能性が非常に高い。
狂竜ウイルス拡散抑止のため
至急、現地を調査してくれ。

56145.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56145.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.
56145.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫
をお持ちください。

55761.description: With Uragaan materials, the strength of the barrel went up dramatically! We're one step from completion. But in exchange for that strength it's become absurdly heavy. The prototype used coal to fuel its drive unit, but we need a higher-output material. Go and slay the Ten'i Species Midogaron!
55761.descriptionEn:
The ≪Uragaan≫ parts sent the
barrel's strength way up!
One more step to done.
But the trade-off is it got
stupidly heavy on us.
The prototype used coal for
the drive's fuel, but we
need something with more
output. Slay the Tesshi
Midogaron and get back!
55761.descriptionJp:
≪爆鎚竜≫の素材で、砲身の
強度が格段に上がったぜ！
完成まであと一歩だ。
ただ強度と引き替えでバカに
重たくなっちまってな。
試作品は駆動部の燃料に
燃石炭を使っていたんだが、
もっと高出力の素材が必要だ。
辿異種ミドガロンを討伐して
来てくれ！

56128.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
56128.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, keep pouring in. Judging this an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Bogabadorumu that Strikes to the Extreme. As proof of the kill, I will give you a special coin, needed to accept the next request!
56128.descriptionEn:
Reports keep pouring in of re-sightings
of the “Acme” monsters, each a
great threat.
Judging this an emergency, I want
each of them slain quickly.
This time: “Acme Strikes Bogabadorumu”.
As proof of the slaying, I'll give you
a special coin needed to accept
the next request!
56128.descriptionJp:
大きな脅威である「極み」と
名の付くモンスターたちの再
目撃報告が続々と届いている。
緊急事態と判断し、迅速な各
個討伐を依頼したい。今回は
「極み襲うボガバドルム」。
討伐した証として、次の依頼
を受注するのに必要となる特
別なコインを渡すぞ！

58087.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58087.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58087.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58087.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

23373.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

50842.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50842.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
50842.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!
50842.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のゼニーが入手できる上
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

26235.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ１００ and above.
26235.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass discovered in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain regions,
we offer guidance only to those
of HR 100 or above.
26235.descriptionJp:
近年発見されたセンショク草
は、自然を熟知した熟練者で
なければ真贋を見極めること
ができない、レアな一品です。
特定の地域でのみ見られる草
なので、ＨＲ１００以上の方
に限ってご案内させていただ
いております。

26475.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
26475.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. The Sand Wyverns show themselves above ground when startled by loud noise, so that's your chance!
26475.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Sand wyverns surface when
startled by loud noise, so
that's your chance!
26475.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
砂竜たちは、大きな音で驚く
と地上に姿を現わしますから
そこがチャンスですよ！

55143.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐

55983.description: Taking on a request from me, the boss of the Dark Cat Gang, shows good nerve, meow. If you pull it off splendidly, I will give you a Dark Cat Gang Pass (White) as proof of membership, meow!
55983.descriptionEn:
Taking on a request from me, the
boss of the Dark Cat Gang - you've
got guts, meow.
If you pull it off, I'll give you a
«Dark Cat Gang Pass: White» as
proof of membership, meow!
55983.descriptionJp:
闇猫団のボスたるワガハイの
依頼に挑戦しようとは、
イイ度胸してるミャ。
見事にやってのけたら、
闇猫団員の証として、
≪闇猫団パス・白≫を
くれてやるミャ！

61330.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

60907.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60907.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
60907.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50863.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50863.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50863.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, display the skill
you have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.
50863.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

60143.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
60143.description: The king of the skies, Rathalos, is said to make its lair in the mysterious hunting ground, the Ancient Tower. We are seeking brave hunters to confirm whether that is true! Your opponent this time is the Azure King. Do not let your guard down until he bows to the ground!
60143.descriptionEn:
The King of the Skies ≪Rathalos≫
is said to nest in the enigmatic
hunting ground ≪Ancient Tower≫.
We seek brave hunters to prove
whether that is true!
Your foe this time is the
≪Azure King≫. Never let your
guard down until he kneels!
60143.descriptionJp:
大空の王≪リオレウス≫は、
謎多き狩猟地≪古塔≫をねぐ
らにしていると云われていま
す。その真偽を確かめられる
勇敢なハンターを募集します！
今度の相手は≪蒼き王者≫。
彼が地にひれ伏すまで、決し
て気を抜かないで下さい！

53176.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐
53176.description: Was that really a Chachabu? I want to dress up in the swamp to understand how a Chachabu feels! But a Nono Orugaron roams the swamp. Slay it so I can dress up in peace! I will give you my old costume as a reward!
53176.descriptionEn:
Was that really
a Chachabu?
I want to dress up in the Swamp
to understand how they feel!
But in the Swamp
a Non Orugaron
is prowling around.
So I can dress up in peace,
go beat it! As a reward
I'll give you my old costume!
53176.descriptionJp:
アイツは本当に
チャチャブーだったのか？
チャチャブーの気持ちを知る
ために沼地で仮装したい！
でも沼地には
ノノ・オルガロンが
うろついてるんだ。
安心して仮装するために
倒してきてくれ！報酬に
ボクのお古仮装をあげるよ！

50699.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50699.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Tigrex will also grant a special ingredient.
50699.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Tigrex's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50699.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
轟竜の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

21968.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21968.description: Odibatorasu seems to be running wild in the desert. It will be dangerous, but please investigate it somehow. The reward is precious decoration material.
21968.descriptionEn:
Odibatorasu seems to be
rampaging in the Desert.
I know it is dangerous, but
please survey it somehow.
The reward is rare decoration
materials.
21968.descriptionJp:
砂漠でオディバトラスが
暴れているようです。
危険かとは思いますが、
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55001.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55001.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55001.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

62009.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62009.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
62009.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

26035.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
26035.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26035.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26035.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

50348.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
50348.description: A quest for the GG Advance Trial Event. Enjoy MHF-GG a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
50348.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
“GG Early Trial Event”.
Enjoy MHF-GG a step ahead of
everyone!
The time limit is 10 minutes.
50348.descriptionJp:
「ＧＧ先行体験会」の
クエストです。
ＭＨＦ−ＧＧを一足早く
お楽しみください！
制限時間は１０分です。

54315.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt a Basarios beautifully. Clear the quest and I will give you more rewards than usual!
54315.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Go and hunt ≪Basarios≫
for all to see.
Clear the quest and I'll
give you rewards more
generous than usual!
54315.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪岩竜≫を狩猟してみ
せろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
いつもより多目の報酬を
くれてやろう！

21165.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
21165.description: There was a report of sighting an extremely powerful individual Crystal Wyvern at the top of the sea of trees. The Crystal Wyvern has a constitution that absorbs and reflects lightning, so hunting it carries considerable danger. We therefore ask skilled hunters to hunt it, so please.
21165.descriptionEn:
A report has come in that an
extremely powerful individual
Crystal Wyvern was sighted at
the top of the Great Forest.
The Crystal Wyvern absorbs and
reflects lightning, so hunting
it carries considerable danger.
We ask our skilled Hunters to
take on the hunt. Thank you.
21165.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部にて極めて強力な
個体の晶竜を目撃したとの
報告がありました。
晶竜は、雷を吸収・反射する
体質で、狩猟はかなりの危険
が伴います。
そこで、腕利きのハンターに
狩猟を依頼しますので、
よろしくお願いします。

55012.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
55012.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55012.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55012.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54122.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ８頭の討伐

50560.description: A monster that eats the moon seems to have appeared. I want to study it, so capture it. If, during the capture, you make the monster spit out the moon, you may keep it. What, it is easy. Place meat in the path of its charge and let it eat to the limit, then attack when its movements slow. It will surely spit it up.
50560.descriptionEn:
A monster that eats the moon
seems to have appeared.
I want to study it, so capture it.
If, during the capture, you make the
monster spit out the moon, you may
keep it for yourself.
It's easy! Set meat to match its
charge and let it eat to the limit;
when it slows, attack.
It'll surely spit it back up.
50560.descriptionJp:
月を食べる怪物が出たらしい。
ぜひ調べたいので捕獲してく
れ。もし捕獲途中、君が怪物
から月を吐かせたら、
君のものにしてもよいぞ。
な〜に簡単さ。突進に合わせ
肉を置いて限界まで食わせて、
動きが遅くなったら攻撃すれ
ばいい。きっと吐き戻す
だろう。

23355.description: A request for hunters who possess Zerureusu G Rank Haku weapons. By repeatedly slaying Zerureusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Retsu weapons.
23355.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪G-Rank Supremacy Weapon≫
of the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Zerureusu, you can obtain
materials needed to upgrade
the ≪Fierce Weapon≫.
23355.descriptionJp:
≪輝界竜≫の≪Ｇ級覇種武器≫
を所持しているハンター向け
の依頼です。
ゼルレウスを繰り返し討伐
することで、≪烈種武器≫の
強化に必要な素材が入手で
きます。

1055.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

53168.description: This is Miyashita. I want to eat a hamburger. [Question 5] The Partnya drawn on the official wallpaper distributed in 2014 number 5. If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53168.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here.
I want a hamburger!
[Question 5]
The “Partnyaa” wallpaper officially
distributed in 2014 depicts
five Partnyaas.
Hunters who think the answer is
O (A), accept this quest!
53168.descriptionJp:
宮下です。
ハンバーグが食べたい♪
【第５問】
２０１４年公式配布の壁紙
「パートニャー」に描かれた
パートニャーは５匹である
答えが○（Ａ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

50928.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50928.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the switch axe, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
50928.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena I have
released a «Rathian» that is very
powerful and acts in ways normally
unthinkable.
Hunter who seeks to master the
Switch Axe, show your skill before me!
Hunt it well and you'll gain even
more than daily effort brings.
50928.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪雌火竜≫を放ってある。
剣斧を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

62779.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62779.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62779.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62779.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

21654.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
21654.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Chlor Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21654.descriptionEn:
Notes said to have been lost,
recording the secret of weapon
crafting, are apparently being
found on monsters slain across
the land, I tell ya!
If you get a ≪Chlor Memo≫, be a
man! Bring it to this workshop
master!
I will show you good work, I
will!
21654.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪クロルメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

54754.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54754.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
54754.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
54754.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

50052.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50052.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields the materials needed to craft white Secret Armor. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50052.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest just
for members of a winning
Hunter Festival Guild, where
you can get the materials
needed to craft white Secret
Art Armor. Please bring your
Festival Proof when joining.
50052.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、白き秘伝
防具の作成に必要な素材を入
手できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、祭典の証をお持ちく
ださい。

23299.objectiveJp: ルロウスイセン９９個の納品
23299.description: What will guide us, who began with a small seed and have known harvest, abundance and prosperity, to yet greater heights is nothing other than the glory shown by hunters who have reached G-rank.
23299.descriptionEn:
We began as a small seed and have
known harvest, abundance and
prosperity. What will lead us to
even greater heights can only be
the glory shown by hunters who
have reached ≪G Rank≫.
23299.descriptionJp:
小さな種から始まり収穫、
豊穣、繁栄を経験した私たち
をさらなる高みへ導いて
くれるのは、≪Ｇ級≫へ到達
したハンターの皆さんが示す
栄華のほかにはないでしょう。

56139.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
56139.description: The slashhh! feeling of Nargacuga's wings from its quick movements is so cool! I want to go slashhh! with a Slash Axe F too! Right!? You do too, right!?
56139.descriptionEn:
Nargacuga's quick moves
unleash a Slaaaash! Those
wings are just so cool!
It makes me want to go
Slaaaash! with a Switch
Axe F myself, just to
keep up!
Right!? You feel it
too, don't you!?
56139.descriptionJp:
ナルガクルガの素早い
動きから繰り出される、
スラァァァッシュッ！って
感じの翼がカッコいい！
こっちも負けじと、
スラッシュアックスＦで
スラァァァッシュッ！って
やりたくなる！
ね！？なるよね！？

55480.objectiveJp: ギルド黒晶紋章１０個の納品
55480.description: By completing this request, you can obtain the layered armor release tickets for the Tangus D Series, the layered armor of the Tangus G Series. Tangus Release Ticket D x5.
55480.descriptionEn:
By clearing this request you can
obtain the layered unlock tickets
for the ≪Tangus D Series≫,
the layered look of the
≪Tangus G Series≫.
- Tangus Unlock Ticket D x5
55480.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成することで、
≪タングスＧシリーズ≫の
外装である≪タングスＤ
シリーズ≫の外装解放券を
入手することができます。
・タングス解放券Ｄ５枚

63385.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
63385.description: There is a report that Shen Gaoren has invaded the Fortress. All hunters, head out to intercept at once. You may freely use the fortress's interception equipment. Make the most of it and drive the creature back.
63385.descriptionEn:
We have reports that the
Fortress Crab Shen Gaoren
is invading the ≪Fortress≫.
All hunters, head out to
intercept at once. You may
freely use the fortress
defenses. Make full use of
them and drive it back.
63385.descriptionJp:
≪砦≫に砦蟹シェンガオレン
が侵攻してきたと報告があり
ました。ハンターの皆さんは
直ちに迎撃に向かってくださ
い。砦の迎撃設備は自由に
使用しても問題ありません。
最大限に活用してこれを迎撃
してください。

55789.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐

60218.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟

26629.description: It seems Guku are gathering in some areas. Maybe you can find what Guku like nearby. Why not go and look? If you want to come back, just deliver a map.
26629.descriptionEn:
It seems Gook have been gathering
in some areas, nyah.
Maybe you'll find the things that
Gook like somewhere nearby,
nyah.
Why not go and take a look?
If you want to come back,
just deliver a map, nyah.
26629.descriptionJp:
どうやら、一部地域にグーク
が集まってきているようニャ。
もしかしたら、その近くなら
グークの好きなものが見つか
るかもしれないニャ。
ちょっと行って、探してみた
らどうニャ？もし帰りたく
なったら地図を納品するニャ。

50426.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

60571.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Meraginasu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60571.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Meraginasu≫! Taking on a
monster all alone — what
spirit, truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and place
high! Origin weapons only
this time, so choose well!
60571.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪メラギナス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50131.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★１ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50131.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to get
the materials needed for
G★1 monster G Rank armor
upgrades! Note that G Rank
materials are not included,
so gather those elsewhere.
50131.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成してもらえ
れば、Ｇ★１モンスターの
Ｇ級防具強化に必要な素材
を入手できるぞ！ただし、
Ｇ級素材は入手できないか
ら、他の依頼で集めてくれ。

14.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
14.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
14.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

50424.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21446.description: Hi there. Flower seller here. I planted the Iwahime Grass I got from a hunter in the highlands and lots of flowers bloomed. Hooray! By the way, I found a spot in the highlands where strange water springs up. I will trade that water for seeds I give you.
21446.descriptionEn:
Yoo-hoo. It's the flower girl.
I planted the Iwahime grass
a hunter gave me in the
Highlands, and lots of flowers
bloomed. Yay!
By the way, I found a spot in
the Highlands where strange
water springs up. I'll trade
it for seeds I hand out, hey.
21446.descriptionJp:
やっほー。花売りだよー。
ハンターさんからもらった
イワヒメ草を高地に植えたら
たくさんの花が咲いたよー。
やったね！
そういえば、高地で不思議な
水が湧く場所を見つけたんだ。
この水をわたしがあげた種と
交換してあげるよー。

21479.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21479.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21479.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21479.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

205.description: This is the final drill in the arena! So I have prepared a special opponent! And that opponent is! The phantom beast Kirin! A fine choice, if I say so myself! Do it properly!
205.descriptionEn:
This is the last Arena
exercise! So I prepared a
special opponent for you!
That opponent is the
Phantom Beast Kirin! A fine
choice, if I say so myself!
205.descriptionJp:
これが闘技場での最後の演習
となる！だから、スペシャルな
相手を用意してやったぞ！
その相手とは！幻獣キリンだ！
我ながらナイスなチョイス
だな！しっかりやれよ！

23539.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
23539.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Akura Vashimu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23539.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Akura Vashimu≫ appears
to have reached a strength that
stands at the very summit even
among Akura Vashimu.
Its strength is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill to
take on the summit, please go and
conduct the survey.
23539.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫
はアクラ・ヴァシムの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

55042.description: I have got great news! Rocks sometimes contain good ore, it seems. You might get Gleaming Sandstone or Kurareamu Ore. I wanted to investigate in the volcano at once, but there are monsters nearby. Could you deal with them?
55042.descriptionEn:
Amazing news has come in!
Apparently rocks sometimes
contain good ore. You might
get ≪Gleaming Sandstone≫
or ≪Kuraream Ore≫ from
them. I meant to survey the
Volcano at once, but there
are monsters nearby. Could
you do something about it?
55042.descriptionJp:
すごい情報が入ったぞい！
なんでもイワには良い鉱石が
含まれていることがあるらし
い。≪煌砂岩≫や≪クラーレ
アム鉱石≫が手に入るかもし
れんのう。早速火山で調査と
思ったのじゃが近くにモンス
ターがおってのう。なんとか
してもらえないかね。

55110.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55110.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55110.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

54772.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54772.description: It's me! You all have the look of veteran hunters now! But! Only by mastering a range of weapons does one become a true veteran! This time I want you to face the White Monoblos with a blunt weapon. Remember the days we trained together!
54772.descriptionEn:
It is I! You all have the
faces of seasoned hunters
now! But! A true veteran
hunter masters many kinds
of weapons! This time,
take on the White Monoblos
with a [Blunt] weapon.
Remember the days we
trained together, side
by side!
54772.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！諸君もすっかり
ベテランハンターの
顔つきをしているな！
しかし！
様々な武器を使い分けてこそ
本当のベテランハンターだ！
今回は【打撃】武器で
白一角竜に挑んでもらいたい。
共に訓練した日々を
思い出すのだ！

61351.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
61351.descriptionEn:
Hey! This time I had some special
equipment and supplies prepared
for you.
Take these and blow those guys
away with one big boom!
I've also got some special
rewards ready, so enjoy
yourselves out there!
61351.descriptionJp:
オウ！今回は特別な
装備品、支給品を
用意させてもらった。
これで一発あいつらを
ドカンとやってきてくれ！
多少だが特殊な報酬も
用意したから、せいぜい
楽しんでくんな！

54505.description: We are recruiting hunters to hunt the Hypnocatrice that appeared in the sea of trees. If hunting is judged difficult, you may slay the Velociprey and return, no problem.
54505.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters
to hunt the Hypnocatrice
that appeared in the Great
Forest. If you judge the
hunt too difficult, you may
slay Velociprey and return
instead — that is fine.
54505.descriptionJp:
樹海に出現した眠鳥を狩猟し
ていただけるハンターを募集
しています。
狩猟困難と判断された場合、
ランポスを討伐してご帰還い
ただいても問題はございませ
ん。

60114.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60114.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60114.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60114.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

62954.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62954.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62954.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62954.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

26230.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
26230.description: If I can just get the blue Hypnocatrice fur that is so hard to obtain, I can make a dress second to none! The party is soon! Get it for me right now!
26230.descriptionEn:
If only I could get the blue
feathers of a Hypnocatrice, so
rarely obtained, I could make a
dress that loses to none!
There is no time left before the
party!
Get them for me this instant!
26230.descriptionJp:
めったに手に入らない眠鳥の
蒼い毛さえ手に入れば、誰に
も負けないドレスが作れるの
よ！パーティまで時間が無い
の！
今すぐ手に入れて来て頂戴！

55364.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
55364.description: In a region where entry has been forbidden for many years, incidents of monsters turning abnormally ferocious have occurred frequently of late. The Heaven-Circling Dragon, Shagaru Magala, must have appeared! There is no telling how much damage this will cause if it goes on. Head out to hunt it at once.
55364.descriptionEn:
In a region where entry has been
forbidden for many years, there have
been many cases of monsters turning
strangely vicious lately.
The Heavenly Revolving Dragon
≪Shagaru Magala≫ must be behind it!
There is no telling how much damage
this will cause if left alone.
Please head out and slay it at once.
55364.descriptionJp:
長年、足を踏み入れることを
禁じられてきた地域で、最近
モンスターが異常に凶暴化す
る事件が多発しています。
天廻龍≪シャガルマガラ≫が
現れたに違いありません！
このままではどれ程の被害に
なるか予想もつきません。
至急討伐へ向かって下さい。

61771.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61771.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61771.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

21098.description: The watersides of the desert are highly likely to hide the ancient Piscine Wyvern, Plesioth, lying in wait for prey. When fishing a Plesioth out with a Frog, it is important that few people are around. If you have companions, have them leave the area and settle it one on one.
21098.descriptionEn:
At the Desert's waterside, there
is a high chance the ancient fish
wyvern ≪Plesioth≫ lurks,
waiting for prey.
When angling a Plesioth with a
≪Fishing Frog≫, it is important
that few people are around.
If you have companions, have them
leave the area and settle it one
on one.
21098.descriptionJp:
砂漠の水辺には太古の魚竜、
≪ガノトトス≫が獲物を狙い
潜んでいる可能性が高いわ。
≪釣りカエル≫でガノトトス
を一本釣りする場合は、人の
気配が少ないことが重要なの。
仲間がいる場合はエリアの外に
出てもらい、１対１で勝負を。

55007.description: There was a report that a powerful Chameleos appeared in the Forest and Hills. It is said to differ in appearance from the individual of before, and an immediate investigation is needed. We have prepared fitting rewards for hunters aiming to produce and upgrade G-rank arms, so please investigate.
55007.descriptionEn:
Reports say a powerful
≪Chameleos≫ has appeared in
Forest and Hills. It differs
from earlier individuals, so
an urgent survey is needed.
We have suitable rewards for
hunters after G Rank gear,
