who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54807.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55469.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55469.description: The Variant Species Rukodiora has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55469.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rukodiora≫ has
grown violently strong and keeps
rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as it
stands. Please prepare fully and
conduct the survey.
55469.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ルコディオラ≫は猛
烈な強さとなり、暴れ続けて
います。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

1016.description: Hunting a Rathian means standing on your own as a hunter. After all, she's known as the Queen of the Land. If the gap in power feels overwhelming, steal a Wyvern Egg from her nest and call it a win this time!
1016.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means you stand on your own.
After all, she bears the
name Queen of the Land.
If the gap feels too wide,
steal a ≪Wyvern Egg≫ from
her nest and call it a win!
1016.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたら
それは狩人として独り立ちを
意味する。なにせ相手は陸の
女王って異名を持つほどだ。
ケタ違いの力差を感じたら、
彼女の巣から≪飛竜の卵≫を
奪って今回は勝ちとしよう！

54687.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
54687.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them far and wide. Break the Pink Rathian's head and we will grant you a special ingredient too.
54687.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to raise
awareness and promote them
far and wide.
Break the Pink Rathian's
head and we will grant you
a special ingredient too.
54687.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼に
つきまして、より一層の
認知、振興のためこちらの
クエストをご用意いたし
ました。
桜火竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

21349.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
21349.description: I saw it! Fireballs raining down from the sky! And not one or two but a tremendous number. If you go to the jungle you should find some trace. However, there have been many Yian Garuga sightings in the jungle lately. Take great care!
21349.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
21349.descriptionEn:
I saw it! Fireballs raining down
from the sky! And not just one or
two, but a huge number of them.
If you go to the Jungle you should
find some trace of it. However,
there have been many sightings of
Yian Garuga in the Jungle lately.
Be on your guard!
21349.descriptionJp:
俺は見た！空から火の玉が降
り注ぐのを！それも１つや２
つじゃなく凄い数だったぞ。
密林に行けば何か痕跡が見つ
かる筈だ。ただし、最近密林
でイャンガルルガの目撃情報
が多く寄せられている。
要注意だ！

63219.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
63219.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee! I wish you good fortune!
63219.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Use all of your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
Complete this request splendidly
and you will earn an exceptional
reward! I wish you good fortune!
63219.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られるぞ！
健闘を祈る！

21804.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
21804.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21804.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21804.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

5.description: It is I, the Instructor! The fish at the fishing points differ by place. It is good to remember where the fish you need can be caught. Also, the kinds of fish change with the season. The mystery of nature!
5.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
The fish at ≪fishing points≫
differ by location. Make sure
to remember where the fish you
need bite.
The kinds of fish also change
with the season. Nature's mystery!
5.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
≪釣りポイント≫にいる魚は
場所によって異なる。必要な
魚が釣れた所は、覚えておく
ようにするといいぞ。また、
季節によっても、魚の種類は
変わるのだ。大自然の神秘！

51087.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51087.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Khezu will also grant a special ingredient.
51087.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
running, we have prepared this
quest to further raise awareness
and promote them.
By breaking the Khezu's head and
body, we will also grant you
some special ingredients.
51087.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
フルフルの頭部と胴体を破壊
することで特別な食材も付与
させていただきます。

51029.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
51029.description: Here is a request that yields the materials needed to craft and upgrade 1 piece of the Toa Series, Hardcore Armor of Toa Tesukatora. It is a generous quest, so please give it a try!
51029.descriptionEn:
I present a request that
nets you the materials to
craft and upgrade one piece
of the Frozen King Dragon's
≪Hardcore Armor≫, the
"Toa Series." It's a great
deal, so do take the challenge!
51029.descriptionJp:
凍王龍の≪剛種防具≫
「トアシリーズ」１部位分の
生産強化に必要な素材を
入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。オトクなクエスト
ですのでぜひチャレンジして
ください！

53179.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
53179.description: A request that lets you craft the Inity Series, a weapon recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Velocidrome and you will obtain the crafting materials for 1 weapon type. May it serve you well in the hunts to come.
53179.descriptionEn:
This request lets you forge the
≪Initiative Series≫ weapons
recommended for new Hunters.
Hunt a Velocidrome to obtain
the materials for one weapon
type.
Please make good use of them
in future hunts.
53179.descriptionJp:
初心者ハンターにオススメの
武器「イニティシリーズ」が
生産できる依頼です。
ドスランポスを狩猟すると、
１武器種の生産素材が入手で
きます。
今後の狩猟にぜひお役立て
ください。

26163.description: Two Velocidrome have wandered into the arena where Felynes and Melynx await! The main target is slaying 20 Felynes, but complete the sub target of slaying 40 Melynx and a lavish reward awaits!?
26163.descriptionEn:
In the Arena where Felynes and
Melynxes lie in wait, 2
Velocidromes have wandered in!
The main target is slaying 20
Felynes, but if you complete
the sub-target of 40 Melynxes,
a lavish reward awaits!?
26163.descriptionJp:
アイルーとメラルーが待ち受
ける闘技場に、ドスランポス
２頭までもが迷い込んだ！！
メインターゲットはアイルー
２０匹の討伐となるが、サブ
ターゲットのメラルー４０匹
討伐を満たせば豪華報酬が！？

28016.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐

23548.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23548.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23548.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

53284.description: A spy we have on the inside obtained the recipe for the chocolate said never to melt, the so-called Unmelting Chocolate. I want you to gather the ingredients that recipe requires. Once the Unmelting Chocolate is finished, I will share some with you. Well then, I am counting on you.
53284.descriptionEn:
I got the recipe for "Insoluble
Chocolate", rumored to never melt
even on a spy's person.
I want you to gather the
materials this recipe needs.
Once the chocolate is finished,
I will share some with you.
Well then, I am counting on you.
53284.descriptionJp:
潜入中のスパイが絶対に溶け
ないと噂の「不溶チョコ」の
レシピを入手したわ。
このレシピに必要な素材を
貴方に集めてほしいの。
「不溶チョコ」が完成したら
貴方にも分けてあげるわ。
それじゃ、よろしくね。

26525.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26525.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26525.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26525.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

50247.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
50247.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50247.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50247.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

61975.description: Oh, you there. Are you eating well? If you keep eating nothing but junk, you won't have the strength for hunting. That's right, why not take my request? If you use the reward ingredients as they are, you can make a fine meal!
61975.descriptionEn:
Oh, you there.
Have you been eating well?
If you keep stuffing down
nothing but junk, you will not
have any strength for hunting.
That's right, why not take on
one of my requests?
Use the ingredients from the
reward as they are and eat well!
61975.descriptionJp:
おや、そこのアンタ。
美味しいもん食べてるかい？
いい加減なものばっかり
食べてると狩りでも力が
出なくなっちまうよ。
そうだね、いっちょあたしの
依頼をうけてごらんよ。
報酬の食材をそのまま使えば
美味しい食事ができるよ！

21715.description: The Flower Field in the breeding season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
21715.descriptionEn:
The ≪Flower Field≫ in breeding
season. It is an unexplored land
the Guild is still surveying, but
why not go have a look yourself
for gathering and survey work?
If you feel like coming home,
just deliver a map to finish
up!
21715.descriptionJp:
繁殖期の≪花畑≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

53235.description: Hey, thanks as always! Honestly, all these hard jobs must be tough. But relax. This one is a gathering quest playing with cute bugs, so it is not hard. Enjoy yourself.
53235.descriptionEn:
Hi there, thanks as always for
your hard work! It must be rough
always getting the harder requests.
But relax. This job is a gathering
quest where you play with cute
little bugs, so it is not hard.
Please take it easy and enjoy!
53235.descriptionJp:
やあ、毎度ご苦労さんデス！
いつも難しめの依頼ばかりで
正直たいへんでしょ。でも、
安心して。この仕事は可愛い
虫さんと戯れる採取クエスト
だから、そう難しくないよ。
お気軽にあそんでいってね！

54631.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54631.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54631.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Bow, show us the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.
54631.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61952.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
61952.description: This is a qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
61952.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament qualifier quest.
In the finals, the time
limit is 5 minutes.
Also, from the monster's
carving and clear rewards,
the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained.
61952.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が５分以内です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

56123.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56123.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56123.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

62967.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
62967.description: While tidying the warehouse I found a book on making gear written in letters I cannot read, and I made a trial piece to see. Please use it and tell me what you think. In return I will share a little of the materials for the trial piece, so do me the favour.
62967.descriptionEn:
While tidying the warehouse I
found a book on forging gear
written in unreadable script,
and made a trial piece.
I'd love you to use it and tell
me what you think. In return
I'll share some of the trial's
forging materials, so please.
62967.descriptionJp:
倉庫を整理したら読めない
文字で書かれた武具の製造法
の書物を見つけて、試しに
試作品を作ってみたんだ。
是非、使って感想を聞かせて
欲しい。代わりに試作品の
製造素材を少し分けるから
よろしく頼むよ。

60109.description: I found a little-known spot in the Snowy Mountains where materials unique to the area lie all about. Do go and have a look. If you come back with a pouch full, it will be worth the price of the information.
60109.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Snowy
Mountains lie scattered around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.
60109.descriptionJp:
雪山ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代分の価値はあると
思うぜ。

26614.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26614.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26614.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

21693.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21693.description: I am about to set out on a long journey. So I want new armor. I have my eye on the Kishin/Doji set, but the quarry is troublesome: I must hunt a Rajang and a Tigrex. Facing two is hard, but succeed and you get cool armor.
21693.descriptionEn:
I am about to set out on a long
journey. So I want new armor.
I am after the ≪Kishin/Douji Set≫,
but the quarry is troublesome:
I have to hunt a ≪Rajang≫ and
a ≪Tigrex≫.
Taking on two at once is very hard,
but if you pull it off, you get
some cool armor.
21693.descriptionJp:
これから長い旅に出るんだ。
そこで、防具を新調したい。
≪鬼神／童子一式≫を狙って
いるのだが、獲物が厄介で、
≪金獅子≫と≪轟竜≫を狩猟
しないといけない。
２頭を相手にするのは至難だ
が、達成すればクールな防具
を手に入れられるぜ。

60003.description: Two Velocidrome have wandered into the arena where Felynes and Melynx await! The main target is slaying 20 Felynes, but complete the sub target of slaying 40 Melynx and a lavish reward awaits!?
60003.descriptionEn:
In the Arena where Felynes and
Melynxes lie in wait, 2
Velocidromes have wandered in!
The main target is slaying 20
Felynes, but if you complete
the sub-target of 40 Melynxes,
a lavish reward awaits!?
60003.descriptionJp:
アイルーとメラルーが待ち受
ける闘技場に、ドスランポス
２頭までもが迷い込んだ！！
メインターゲットはアイルー
２０匹の討伐となるが、サブ
ターゲットのメラルー４０匹
討伐を満たせば豪華報酬が！？

62354.description: Controlling a monster exactly as you wish is impossible, but controlling one to some degree is possible, yes! What matters then is a sense of distance! To take it easy by making use of the monster's movements, shall we try a no touch approach?
62354.descriptionEn:
Making a monster do exactly what
you want is impossible, but
controlling it to some extent
is quite possible!
What matters there is distance!
To ride a monster's movements
and take it easy, why not go
all in? Shall we no-touch?
62354.descriptionJp:
モンスターを自由自在に操る
ことはインポッシブルだけど、
ある程度コントロールする
だけなら可能なのデ〜ス！
そこで大切なのが距離感ネ！
モンスターの動きを利用して
楽するためにも、思い切って
シャルウィーノータッチ？

50274.description: Satisfy my demands and I shall present you with the blueprints for a special remodeling set! Everything can be gathered by collecting alone, though I care not how you get it. For Aged Mushrooms, put Special Mushrooms in a Maca Pickling Jar and let them age underground for 10 minutes or more. Royal Beetles can be found on the northern isolated island as well.
50274.descriptionEn:
Satisfy my demands and I
will hand you the plans for
a special makeover set!
All of it can be gathered
alone, but means are yours.
Aged Mushroom: put a Special
Mushroom in a Maka Pickle
Pot, cure underground 10 min!
Royal Beetles can be found
on the northern isle too.
50274.descriptionJp:
僕の要求を満たしてくれれば
特別な模様替えセットの図面
を進呈しよう！
どれも採取だけで集められる
はずだけど手段は問わない。
熟成キノコは特産キノコをマ
カ漬けの壷に入れ、地中で10
分以上熟成すれば完成！
ロイヤルカブトは北の孤島で
も採れるよ。

21789.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
21789.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21789.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21789.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

23519.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
23519.description: The Variant Species Blangonga appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Blangonga. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23519.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Blangonga≫ seems
to have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Blangonga.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.
23519.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドドブランゴ≫はド
ドブランゴの中でも、頂点に
辿りつくほどの強さに達した
ようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

21505.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの討伐、
またはサブターゲットの達成
21505.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21505.objectiveEn:
Slay the main target,
or complete the sub-target
21505.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21505.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

55344.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
55344.description: They say a raw, wet sound of something devouring flesh and blood comes up from beneath Tide Island. When a hunter went down into the great pit to look, two red eyes came bursting out of the dust and the stench and charged him. Whoever discovers what this creature is will receive the materials to craft armor the guild has kept hidden.
55344.descriptionEn:
They say a raw, fleshy sound of
devouring meat can be heard from
beneath the Tidal Island.
When a hunter climbed down into
the great pit to look, two red
glowing eyes came lunging out of
the dust with a terrible stench.
Whoever uncovers what this thing
is will receive Guild armor materials.
55344.descriptionJp:
潮島の地下から血肉を貪る
生々しい音が聞こえるそうだ。
あるハンターが様子を見に大
穴へ降りた所、土埃の中から
激臭とともに赤く光る二つの
目が勢いよく襲い掛かってき
たらしい。こいつの正体を突
き止めた者にはギルド秘蔵の
防具の生産素材を必ず渡そう。

62325.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１６頭の討伐
62325.description: Why are Hypnocatrice in the breeding season so beautiful? To mar that beauty is absolutely unforgivable. Now, slay every last one of those ruffian-like, ferocious Bullfango! Take the greatest care not to put a single scratch on the Blue Hypnocatrice.
62325.descriptionEn:
Why is a Hypnocatrice in
breeding season so lovely?
To mar that beauty is
absolutely unforgivable.
Now, slay every last one of
those savage Bullfango packs.
But not a single scratch on
the Hypnocatrice, mind you,
so please do be careful.
62325.descriptionJp:
繁殖期を迎えたヒプノックは
なぜああも美しいのでしょう。
その美しさに傷を付けるなど
絶対に許されないことですわ。
さあ、あの暴漢の如き獰猛な
ブルファンゴの群れをすべて
討伐するのです。蒼眠鳥には
傷ひとつ付けないように、
くれぐれもご注意ください。

63115.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63115.description: A truly excellent hunter must be versed in many things besides outstanding hunting skill. This time the guild has prepared the Difficult Book Blue for hunters of ability. Keep striving for still greater heights.
63115.descriptionEn:
A truly excellent hunter
must, besides superb skill,
be well versed in many
different things.
So the Guild has prepared
for capable hunters a
difficult Tome [Blue].
Keep striving for the heights
of the hunter's path!
63115.descriptionJp:
真に優れたハンターとは、
卓越した狩猟技術のほか、
様々なことへ精通していなけ
ればなりません。
今回ギルドでは、実力ある
ハンターへ向け、
難しい書物【青】を用意しま
した。さらにハンターの高み
を目指し頑張ってください。

60046.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
60046.description: So a subspecies of the already rare Monoblos has appeared, has it. To go beyond proving yourself first-rate and make your name ring out, you must hunt it alone! Prepare yourself and take up the hunt!
60046.descriptionEn:
A white one-horned wyvern, no
less: a Monoblos subspecies, a
truly rare sight, has appeared.
To go beyond proving yourself
first-rate and make your name
resound, you must "hunt it
alone". Steel yourself and go!
60046.descriptionJp:
白き一角竜とはこれまた希少
性の高いモノブロスの亜種が
現れたようじゃな。
一流の証明を超えて、己の
名声を響かせるには、やはり
『１人で狩猟』することじゃ
心して狩猟に挑むがよい！

55238.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55238.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.
55238.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されて
いる一部防具や装飾品の強化
に使用するＨＣ素材やＧＨＣ
素材を獲得できるクエストを
ご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

54696.description: Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing their surroundings red with rage. We will somehow drive them into the Arena, so we ask you hunters to slay them and keep the damage from spreading any further. Upon your success, we will give you armor materials long stored away by the Guild.
54696.descriptionEn:
Two beasts are rampaging, dyeing
their surroundings red with rage.
We will somehow drive them into
the Arena, so we ask you hunters
to slay them and keep the damage
from spreading any further.
Upon your success, we will give
you armor materials long stored
away by the Guild.
54696.descriptionJp:
２頭の獣が怒りで周囲を赤く
染めながら暴れ回っています。
何とか闘技場までは私たちが
追い込むので、ハンターの方
には、これ以上被害を拡大さ
せないために討伐をお願いし
ます。討伐に成功した暁には
古くからギルドで蔵されてき
た防具の素材を差し上げます。

62844.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
62844.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!
62844.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
のだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

50638.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki on Tide Island! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50638.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Long Sword, face the
Gogomoa of the Tidal Island
and show the skill you honed!
Hunt it well and you shall
earn far more reward than
your daily efforts bring
you. Go and prove it!
50638.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

40161.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil HC Earring.
40161.descriptionEn:
Here we hand out VISA
production tickets to
hunters who own Gothic
equipment.
Please accept the quest
while wearing the Bale HC
Earring.
40161.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。
ベイルHCイヤリングを装備
した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

55275.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55275.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55275.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55275.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62027.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Rajang. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62027.descriptionEn:
This is the counter for the
Hunt Technique Quest to slay
a ≪Rajang≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
other hunters here!
62027.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ラージャン≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

55214.description: Slaying a Diablos Subspecies raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55214.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Black Diablos
you can raise your standing
and get the materials you
need for G Rank jewels,
all in one quest we have
prepared for you at a bargain.
Please make good use of it.
55214.descriptionJp:
ディアブロス亜種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

63279.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
63279.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Berukyurosu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63279.descriptionEn:
An emergency request! We
seek someone to slay a most
powerful Berukyurosu.
If you can hunt it well,
we will issue more slaying
proofs than usual. Please
answer the call!
63279.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ベルキュロス≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に狩猟
できましたら、普段よりも
多めに討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

54244.description: This is an emergency request. A black, mysterious shadow has reportedly appeared at the tower the survey team is heading for. The team is said to be hiding from the black shadow and waiting for help. Hurry to the tower and deal with the shadow.
54244.descriptionEn:
Emergency request.
A report says a mysterious black
shadow appeared at the Tower
where the survey team is headed.
The team is now hiding from the
black shadow and waiting for
help. Hurry to the Tower and deal
with the black shadow.
54244.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。
調査隊が向かっている塔に、
黒い謎の影が現れたと報告が
ありました。
調査隊は現在黒い影から身を
隠し、助けを待っているとの
ことです。急ぎ塔へ向かい、
黒い影の対処をお願いします。

61746.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. Next, prove to me the accumulation of your daily study. As proof of that study, deliver 10 Silver Secret Pots!
61746.descriptionEn:
≪Fishing≫.
It is a solitary hunt spent
facing the fish in silence.
Next, prove to me the results
of your daily effort.
As proof of that study, deliver
10 Silver Secret Pots!
61746.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
次は日々の研鑽の積み重ねを
証明して貰おう。
その研究の証として、白銀の
秘壺１０個を納品してくれ！

61612.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
61612.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61612.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61612.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

55374.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
55374.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Uragaan armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55374.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to make
armor from the ≪Uragaan≫!
Clear the sub-target to obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
Transcend Armor, so please give it
a try!
55374.descriptionJp:
爆鎚竜≪ウラガンキン≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを用意
しました！サブターゲットを
達成すると遷悠防具の強化に
必要な素材を入手できます
ので、ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

21033.description: This season the swamp is crawling with Conga! They live apart from the pack leader, Congalala, but that only proves how strong each one is: they have no need to gather. Watch yourself!
21033.descriptionEn:
Conga seem to thrive in the
Swamp this season!
They live apart from the boss
≪Congalala≫, but that is also
proof each one is strong enough
not to need a herd.
Do be careful!
21033.descriptionJp:
この季節の沼地にはコンガが
多く生息しているみたい！
親玉の≪ババコンガ≫とは群
れずに生活しているけれど、
逆をいえば群れる必要がない
ほど個々が強いという裏付け
でもあるわ。注意して下さい！

26508.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・３を１０個納品

26175.objectiveJp: ホワイトレバー４個の納品
26175.description: It is the hot season! Are you holding up in the heat? In this season, ingredients that build stamina sell wonderfully, and I am run off my feet! Sorry to ask, but would you help me with the procurement? In return, I will give you my wife's prized ingredient.
26175.descriptionEn:
It's the warm season! Not wilting
in the heat, are you? Ingredients
that build stamina sell well now,
so I am run off my feet!
Sorry, but would you help me
with the stock runs?
As thanks, I will give you some
of the missus's best ingredients.
26175.descriptionJp:
温暖期だよ！暑さでバテてな
いかい？温暖期は体力をつけ
る食材がよく売れるんでね、
もうテンテコ舞いだよ！
悪いけど仕入れを手伝って
くれないかい？
お礼におかみのとっておきの
食材をあげるよ。

54308.description: Greetings, hunter. Have you ever crafted a weapon only to find yourself short of materials and unable to upgrade it? Then I have good news for you. Clear this quest and upgrading that weapon may become an easy matter. I pray the materials you want are among what you find.
54308.descriptionEn:
Hello there, hunter.
Forged a weapon but short
on materials, so you cannot
upgrade it? Is that you?
Then here is good news.
Clear this quest and your
weapon may become easy
to upgrade.
I pray you get the materials
you are hoping for.
54308.descriptionJp:
ハンターさん、ごきげんよう。
武器を生産したものの素材
不足で、強化できないなんて
ことになっていませんか？
そんなあなたに朗報です。
このクエストを達成すると、
武器が楽に強化できるかも
しれません。
あなたの望む素材が入手でき
ることを祈っています。

50255.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Soul (Beginning) x８５, Hammer Soul (Middle) x１９５, Hammer Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Hammer Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50255.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hammer Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Hammer Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Hammer Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Hammer Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest, you will
need a ≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please be aware of that.
50255.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ハンマー魂・序≫８５枚
≪ハンマー魂・中≫１９５枚
≪ハンマー魂・極≫２７５枚
≪ハンマー魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

62487.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62487.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62487.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62487.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62501.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62501.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62501.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

54485.description: This is the practice final quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament at the 2014 Thanksgiving Festival. The time limit is 50 minutes. Also, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained from carving or from quest clear rewards. Please keep this in mind.
54485.descriptionEn:
This is the practice final quest for
the VS. Quest Champion Tournament
at the 2014 Thanksgiving Festival.
The time limit is 50 minutes.
Also, the target monster's materials
cannot be obtained from carving
or from quest clear rewards.
Please keep this in mind.
54485.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントin感謝祭2014の
練習用決勝クエストです。
制限時間は５０分です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

62767.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
62767.description: A wyvern newly discovered in the Snowy Mountains. We have decided to call it the Doragyurosu, and among this already powerful wyvern a particularly sturdy individual has been confirmed. It is a dangerous request and supplies cannot be sent, so only hunters who can prove their skill are asked to hunt it!
62767.descriptionEn:
A Flying Wyvern newly found in
the Snowy Mountains.
We have chosen to call it the
≪Nether Thunder Wyvern≫, but
even among this mighty species,
an especially robust individual
has been confirmed.
It is dangerous and no supplies
can be sent, so prove your skill!
62767.descriptionJp:
雪山で新たに発見された飛竜。
我々はこれを≪冥雷竜≫
と呼ぶこととしましたが、
ただでさえ強力なこの飛竜の
中でも特に強靭な個体が確認
されたようです。危険な依頼
で、支給品も送れませんが、
腕前の証明が出来るハンター
限定での狩猟をお願いします！

50602.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50602.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
50602.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

58012.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58012.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58012.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58012.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

50857.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50857.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50857.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Giaorugu≫ in the Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.
50857.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

63293.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63293.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63293.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63293.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

23692.description: Hunter who would master the light gun, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23692.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Light Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.
23692.descriptionJp:
軽銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50231.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
50231.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
50231.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
50231.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

26414.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26414.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26414.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

60101.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60101.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60101.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60101.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

61879.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
61879.descriptionEn:
Yo! This time I've got
special gear and supplies
ready for you.
Go on and give those guys
one big wallop for me!
There's a little something
special in the rewards too,
so enjoy yourselves out there!
61879.descriptionJp:
オウ！今回は特別な
装備品、支給品を
用意させてもらった。
これで一発あいつらを
ドカンとやってきくれ！
多少だが特殊な報酬も
用意したから、せいぜい
楽しんでくんな！

54773.description: It's me! You all have the look of veteran hunters now! But! Only by mastering a range of weapons does one become a true veteran! This time I want you to face the White Monoblos with a gunner weapon. Remember the days we trained together!
54773.descriptionEn:
It is I! You all have the
faces of seasoned
veteran hunters now!
But!
A true veteran masters many
weapons and uses them all!
This time, take on the White
Monoblos with a Gunner weapon.
Remember the days we
trained together!
54773.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！諸君もすっかり
ベテランハンターの
顔つきをしているな！
しかし！
様々な武器を使い分けてこそ
本当のベテランハンターだ！
今回は【ガンナー】武器で
白一角竜に挑んでもらいたい。
共に訓練した日々を
思い出すのだ！

26254.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種２頭の狩猟
26254.description: A black Diablos with a terrifying appearance has been sighted. The sight of it cutting down its prey with a single powerful blow is feared as like the grim reaper. Is there no hunter to stand against this threat to the Desert?
26254.descriptionEn:
A black Diablos with a terrifying
appearance has been sighted.
It cuts down its prey with a
single mighty blow, and is feared
as "the Grim Reaper" itself.
Is there no hunter to face this
threat to the Desert?
26254.descriptionJp:
恐ろしい容姿の黒いディアブ
ロスが目撃されたわ。
強力な一撃の下に獲物を屠り
さる姿は「死神のようだ」と
恐れられているわ。
この砂漠の脅威に立ち向かう
ハンターはいないかしら。

21778.description: Iron Ore is needed for one thing or another when preparing equipment. Have you ever found yourself saying, ah, not enough, at the worst possible moment? On this quest, those who complete the main target will receive at least 7 Iron Ore!
21778.descriptionEn:
Iron Ore is always needed for
putting your gear together.
Have you ever found yourself
short of it right when you
need it most?
In this quest, everyone who
clears the main target will
receive at least 7 Iron Ore
from us!
21778.descriptionJp:
装備を調えるには、
何かと必要な鉄鉱石。
いざ、という時に
「あ！足りない！」なんてこ
と、よくありませんか？
このクエストでは、
メインターゲットを達成され
た方に、最低でも７つの
鉄鉱石を進呈しますよ！

55746.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55746.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55746.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

61059.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種の討伐
61059.description: Lately the sea of trees has been strange. It seems something at its top is exerting an influence. Could you investigate for us? The request is to find the cause of the anomaly and resolve it as well.
61059.descriptionEn:
Lately the Great Forest has
been acting strange. Something
at the Top of Great Forest
seems to be the cause. Could
you look into it? Once you
find the source, fix it too.
61059.descriptionJp:
最近、樹海の様子がおかしい
んだ。どうやら樹海頂部の
何かが影響を与えている様だ。
どうか調査をお願いできない
か？異変の原因を見つけ次第、
その解決も合わせての依頼だ。

62938.description: This is the practice final of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving the monster or from the quest clear rewards.
62938.descriptionEn:
This is the practice final of
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Also, you cannot obtain the
target monster's materials
from carving the monster or
from the quest clear rewards.
62938.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

54450.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54450.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Berukyurosu and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and I will see that you receive a richer reward than usual!
54450.descriptionEn:
The time has come for you
to show off your skill!
Go hunt that Berukyurosu
and let me see it done.
Clear the quest and I will
give you a bigger reward
than usual!
54450.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪舞雷竜≫を狩猟してみ
せろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
いつもより多目の報酬を
くれてやろう！

26444.description: A call for help has come from the party that set out for the Snowy Mountains to slay Tigrex! It seems they ran into two Tigrex! Every moment counts! Those confident in their skill, head for the Snowy Mountains now!
26444.descriptionEn:
A distress call has come
from the party that went to
the ≪Snowy Mountains≫ to
slay a Tigrex! Seems they
ran into two of them!
There is not a moment to
spare! Any hunter sure of
their skill, head there now!
26444.descriptionJp:
≪雪山≫へティガレックスの
討伐に向かった一団から救援
の要請が届いたぞ！どうやら
２頭のティガレックスに出く
わしたようじゃ！
事態は一刻を争う！腕に自信
のある者は今すぐ雪山へ向か
うのじゃ！

26088.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26088.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26088.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

26278.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26278.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26278.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

61517.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

21215.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21215.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21215.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

21072.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21072.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
21072.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!
21072.descriptionJp:
≪閃光玉≫をモンスターの目
前に投げると強力な光で目を
くらませることができるんで
すよ。
これを使いこなせば、怖いも
のナシですね！
支給品ボックスに入ってます
から遠慮なく使って下さい！

26106.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
26106.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!
26106.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在です。
姿無きところから姿を現わし
熟練の狩人でも手に負えない。
捕獲なんて無理なことは考え
ないで慎重かつ着実に攻撃を
重ねるしかないと思います！

62691.description: Coins are normally obtained by undergoing strict hunting exercises, but this time we have prepared an exercise focused on training. Do not miss this chance to obtain Guild Coins and other coins. We await your applications!
62691.descriptionEn:
Coins are normally earned by
putting in hard hunting drills,
but this time we have prepared
a drill focused on training.
Do not miss this chance to get
≪Guild Coins≫ and other coins.
We are waiting for your
applications!
62691.descriptionJp:
普段は厳しい狩猟演習を積む
ことで入手できるコインだが、
今回は訓練を集中して行う
演習を用意した。
≪ギルドコイン≫など各種
コインが入手できるこの機を
逃すなよ。
諸君らの申込みを待っている！

61648.description: I have a request, trusting in the sturdy bodies and spirits of you hunters. It is my firm belief that people begin to decline the moment they are satisfied. Hunger is what gives people vigor and makes them grow, I believe. Would you prove it for me?
61648.descriptionEn:
I have a request for you hunters,
whose tough bodies and wills
I have taken a liking to.
This is only my own theory, but
people begin to weaken the very
moment they grow satisfied.
I believe hunger is what gives
people vitality and growth.
Could you prove that for me?
61648.descriptionJp:
君たちハンターの強靭な体と
精神力を見込んで頼みがある。
これは私の持論なのだが、
人は、満ち足りてしまった
瞬間から衰えが始まるものだ。
餓えこそが、人に活力を与え、
人を成長させると信じている。
どうか、それを証明しては
もらえないだろうか？

61017.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61017.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61017.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

53296.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
53296.description: I want to see you hunt in a cool kimono, nya! If you can, I'd like the Rajang captured, nya. I want to see that glittering gold up close, nya. I'll pay well for it, nya!
53296.descriptionEn:
I want to see you hunt in
a dashing kimono, nya!
And if you can, I'd like
the Rajang captured, nya.
That glittering gold I've
always admired from afar,
I want to see it up close!
I'll pay you well for it, nya!
53296.descriptionJp:
かっこいい着物を着て、
狩猟する姿を見たいニャ！
できれば、金獅子は捕獲して
ほしいのニャ。
いつも遠くから眺めていた、
煌びやかな金色を
近くで見てみたいニャ。
その分、御礼ははずむニャ！

61615.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

50643.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Gogomoa on Tide Island! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50643.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Tonfa, face the
Gogomoa of the Tidal Island
and show the skill you honed!
Hunt it well and you shall
earn far more reward than
your daily efforts bring
you. Go and prove it!
50643.descriptionJp:
穿龍棍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26433.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
26433.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.
26433.descriptionJp:
どこでこの話を聞きつけたか
は知らんが、ヤバい話には失
敗の救済など一切ないぞ？
ブツの用意もいいだろうな？
必要なブツの数は条件通りだ。
あとは、現地で１人で働いて
もらう。徒党を組むとナメた
真似するヤツが出るんでな。

21825.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21825.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21825.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21825.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

55512.description: A Variant Species Plesioth with a greatly developed head has appeared. Its attacks, peculiar to Variant Species, have caused many hunters to fail in the hunt. In response, the guild will provide firm support for the hunt. Please go to the investigation with care.
55512.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Plesioth with a
greatly swollen head has
appeared.
Its Supremacy attacks have
made many hunters fail.
In response the Guild will
provide strong support for
the slaying. Please go and
survey it with great care.
55512.descriptionJp:
頭が大きく発達した辿異種
ガノトトスが現れました。
辿異種特有の攻撃で数多の
ハンターが討伐に失敗してい
ます。
この事態にギルドは対策とし
て、強固な討伐支援を行い
ます。気を付けて調査にお向
かいください。

28053.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28053.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
28053.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

21963.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
21963.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Pariapuria in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn a larger reward than usual, so do take it on and see it done.
21963.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting life,
we have a request to hunt a
Pariapuria in the New Great
Arena.
Clear this request and you
will earn more than the usual
fee, so do accept it and
see it through!
21963.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、新大闘技場で≪呑竜≫
を狩猟する依頼を用意しまし
た。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より多い報酬金が得られます
ので、ぜひ受注して依頼を
達成しましょう。

60651.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
60651.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Teostra. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60651.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is a
special Teostra!
Achieve the goal together
with your Guild mates.
Teamwork is everything here,
so go and take a top place!
This round is Supremacy
weapons only, got it!
60651.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
特異個体の
≪テオ・テスカトル≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！今回は辿異武器限定で
開催されているぞ！

26602.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Sodi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26602.descriptionEn:
A memo recording the lost
secret of forging arms was
found on monsters slain across
the land! Once you have the
Sodi Memo, bring it to this
workshop chief, like a man!
I will do a fine job for you!
26602.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ソディメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

55387.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55387.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please slay Akura Vashimu.
55387.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor, held by
hunters who have mastered
their weapon.
The Guild has long offered
various support, but this time
we provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming even higher.
For the survey, slay the Crystal-Tail Scorpion.
55387.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、
尾晶蠍の討伐をお願いします。

62109.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の捕獲
62109.description: I want to study the ice fox wyvern that lives in the hidden area of the Ancient Tower. Capture it, and break some parts so it is easier to study. I have no interest in materials, so if you find anything interesting, you may keep it after my research. Capturing it without breaking any parts will count as a failure.
62109.descriptionEn:
I want to study the Rukodiora
that dwells in the Ancient Tower's
hidden reaches. Please capture it,
and break some parts so it is
easier to study. I have no
interest in materials, so keep
anything fascinating you find
after the research is done.
Capture with no part breaks fails.
62109.descriptionJp:
古塔の秘境に住まう氷狐竜の
研究を行いたいんだ。何とか、
捕獲と、研究しやすいように
一部部位の破壊を頼むよ。
素材には興味が無いから、
面白い素材が見つかったら、
研究の後に持っていっていい
よ。部位破壊無しで捕獲した
ら失敗とさせてもらうよ。

53295.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
53295.description: I want to see you hunt in a cool kimono, nya! If you can, I'd like the Pink Rathian captured, nya. I want to see the beautiful Pink Rathian I've always watched from afar asleep, nya. I'll pay well for it, nya!
53295.descriptionEn:
I want to see you hunt in
a dashing kimono, nya!
And if you can, I'd like
the Pink Rathian captured.
That beautiful sleeping form
I've only admired from afar,
I want to see it up close!
I'll pay you well for it, nya!
53295.descriptionJp:
かっこいい着物を着て、
狩猟する姿を見たいニャ！
できれば、桜火竜は捕獲して
ほしいのニャ。
いつも遠くから眺めていた、
美しい桜火竜が眠る姿を
見てみたいニャ。
その分、御礼ははずむニャ！

50067.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50067.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. Complete it and we will present you with a variety of materials. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50067.descriptionEn:
This request is only for those
belonging to a winning Hunter
Festival guild.
Clear the request and we will
present you with a variety of
materials. Please bring your
Festival Proof when accepting
or joining.
50067.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用の依頼をご用
意させていただきました。
依頼を達成していただけます
と、様々な素材を進呈させて
いただきます。受注、参加時
に、祭典の証をお持ちくださ
い。

11074.description: If you're hit by a Conga's flatulence you won't be able to use healing items! If you get smelly, use a Deodorant to take the stench off your body!
11074.descriptionEn:
Get hit by a ≪Conga≫ fart
and you can't use healing
items! If you get smelly,
use a ≪Deodorant≫ to clear
the stink off yourself!
11074.descriptionJp:
≪コンガ≫のオナラに当たる
と回復系のアイテムが使えな
くなりますよ！臭くなったら
≪消臭玉≫で身体についた
匂いを消して下さいね！

21520.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21520.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21520.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21520.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

53175.objectiveJp: チャチャブー５匹の討伐
53175.description: It seems that fellow turned up again this Halloween. But this year something is off. This year it is as if someone is impersonating him. To expose his true identity you may need to learn his feelings or obtain a special item.
53175.descriptionEn:
This Halloween, too,
that fellow seems to have
shown up. But something
is different this year.
It is as if someone is
posing as him this year.
To unmask him, you may
need to learn his feelings
or find a special item.
53175.descriptionJp:
今年のハロウィンも
例のアイツが来たらしい。
でも今年は何か様子が変だ。
今年はまるで何者かが
アイツを装ってるようだ。
アイツの正体を暴くには
アイツの気持ちを知ったり、
特殊なアイテムを入手する
必要があるかもしれない。

55573.description: The Variant Species Inagami has appeared once more. There are reports that its developed tail now releases an even more potent sleep gas. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55573.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Inagami has
appeared again.
Its developed tail now emits
a stronger sleep gas, reports
say. Survey with great care.
55573.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪イナガミ≫
が再び現れました。
発達した尾は、より強力な
睡眠ガスを放つようになった
との報告があります。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

26079.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26079.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26079.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

62827.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
62827.description: This is a quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament trial event. Get an early taste of Forward.4, enjoy!
62827.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament trial event.
Get an early taste of
Forward.4, enjoy!
62827.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの体験会用の
クエストです。
フォワード.４を一足早く
お楽しみください！

62748.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
62748.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Pale Hypnocatrice of the Forest summit. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
62748.descriptionEn:
The time has come to show
what you can do!
Hunt the Pale Hypnocatrice
at the Top of Great Forest.
Clear the quest safely and
your standing as a hunter
will rise in a great leap!
62748.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
樹海頂部の≪蒼白眠鳥≫を
狩猟してみせろ。無事、ク
エストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての評
価はグイっと上がるぞ！

60583.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Congalala. Join your fellow guild hunters, but achieve the objective with just two of you. Take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60583.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
This time the target is a
Congalala!
Do it with your Guild mates,
but only two of you may go.
Go and take a top place!
Also, Origin weapons only!
Choose your weapon with care!
60583.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ババコンガ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に、
ただし、２人で目標を達成
してきてもらうぞ。
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

60305.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
60305.description: To the hunters based in Dundorma, I who continue the supreme hunt will give you valuable information. The whereabouts of the proud lone wolf, the black wolf bird Yian Garuga, just like me!! An ultra savage foe! Will you try?
60305.descriptionEn:
To the Hunters based in the
city of Dundorma, I who have
kept up the finest hunting
will give you some precious
info. It's the whereabouts of
the proud lone wolf ≪Yian
Garuga≫! A savage foe!
Will you take it on?
60305.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマの街を拠点にして
る狩人たちへ、至高の狩りを
続けるこのオレが貴重な情報
を与えてやろう。
オレと同じく誇り高き一匹狼
黒狼鳥≪イャンガルルガ≫の
居場所だ！！超凶暴な相手だ
ぞ！挑んでみるか？

55240.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55240.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Zinogre GX Helm' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55240.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
top prize in the F Photo
Contest 2016, we have made
a quest that lets you get
materials to craft and
upgrade the armor worn in it,
the Hellwolf GX Helm.
Do make use of it.
55240.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「獄狼GXヘルム」を
生産・強化するための素材を
獲得できるクエストをご用意
しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

61180.description: A request to hunt a Tigrex and a Khezu variant in the Snowy Mountains. Neither is a monster you would want to get close to, right? Then ranged weapons! I will not accept melee weapons! Blast away from a distance!
61180.descriptionEn:
A request to slay a Tigrex
and a Khezu Variant in the
Snowy Mountains.
Neither is one you'd want
to get close to, right?
Then use a ranged weapon!
Melee weapons are not allowed!
Blast them from a distance!
61180.descriptionJp:
雪山でティガレックスと
フルフルの変種の討伐依頼だ。
どちらもあまり近寄りたい
モンスターじゃないよな？
ならば遠距離武器だ！
近距離武器なんて認めないぞ！
離れたところからドッカドカ
と撃ちまくるんだ！

55138.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
55138.description: Slaying an Espinas Subspecies raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55138.descriptionEn:
By slaying an Espinas
Subspecies you can raise
your standing and cheaply
get the materials needed
for G Rank jewels. We have
prepared such a quest.
Please make good use of it.
55138.descriptionJp:
エスピナス亜種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

63094.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63094.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63094.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

23177.description: Vespoid are swarming in great numbers from the unsurveyed parts of the volcano and causing damage nearby. One alone is nothing, but together they are a threat. We need coal for the survey and cannot go and dig it ourselves. Could you obtain some for us?
23177.descriptionEn:
From the unsurveyed parts of
the Volcano, swarms of
Vespoid have flown in and
are causing damage nearby.
One alone is nothing, but
together they are a threat.
We need coal for the survey,
but cannot go and mine it.
Won't you bring us some?
23177.descriptionJp:
火山の未調査地域から、
ランゴスタが大量に飛来して
付近に被害が出ている。
１匹なら大したことはないが、
奴らが集まった時は脅威だ。
調査のために燃石炭が必要
なのだが、採りに行けずに
困っている。何とか手に入れ
てはくれないだろうか。

50902.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
50902.description: We present a request that lets you obtain more than usual of the materials needed to craft and upgrade the Frost King Wyvern's Hard Species armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50902.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting it, but may I
present a request that gives
more than usual of the
materials needed to craft
and upgrade Toa Tesukatora
Hardcore armor. Do try it!
50902.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、凍王龍の≪剛種
防具≫の生産強化に必要な
素材を通常より多く入手でき
る依頼をご紹介します。
この機会にぜひチャレンジし
てください！

50528.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
50528.description: My apologies for the trouble I caused you the other day. While you were away I gathered information, and I heard tell of a fire wyvern with silver scales. It apparently lairs where our last survey could not reach. I ask that you look into it.
50528.descriptionEn:
I am sorry for the extra
trouble I caused you before.
Meanwhile I gathered word,
and heard tale of a Rathalos
bearing silver scales.
It seems to make its nest
somewhere our last survey
never reached.
I ask you to investigate.
50528.descriptionJp:
先日は余計な手間をかけさせ
てしまい申し訳ない。
その間、私も情報を集めてい
たのだが銀の鱗を持つ火竜の
話を聞くことができた。
それも前回の調査でおよばな
かった場所をねぐらとしてい
るらしい。
どうか調査をお願いしたい。

61939.description: You did well in the Snowy Mountains. I dropped a bag with something important inside, but an Ice Fox Wyvern is nearby and I cannot easily get in. For one who completed the previous request, hunting an Ice Fox Wyvern should be a piece of cake. Of course, I will be generous with the thanks.
61939.descriptionEn:
You did well in the Snowy
Mountains. I dropped a bag
with something precious in it,
but a Hyujikiki is nearby
and I cannot get close.
One who handled the last
request should find hunting
a Hyujikiki a mere trifle.
Of course, I'll pay well.
61939.descriptionJp:
雪山ではよくぞやってくれた。
大切な物が入った袋を
落としてしまったんじゃが、
氷狐竜が近くにおって、
簡単には立ち入れんのじゃ。
前回の依頼をこなせた者
ならば、氷狐竜を狩猟する
ことも朝飯前のはずじゃ。
もちろん礼ははずむぞぃ。

22017.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of armor materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rajang and a Tigrex. I am counting on you!
22017.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a request for you -
how about a full set of armor
materials as payment?
It's easy work! Just make
one quick run and slay a
Rajang and a Tigrex for me.
I'm counting on you!
22017.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は防具の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってラージャンとティ
ガレックスを討伐してくれれ
ばいい。頼んだぜ！

62664.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

55386.description: The nostalgic Variety Soul quest is back again! This time the subject is Voljang. Clear it quickly and earn plenty of souls! Rare materials also seem a little easier to obtain than usual.
55386.descriptionEn:
The nostalgic Variety Soul
is back again, everyone!
This theme is the slaying
of a Crimson Rajang.
Clear it quick and earn lots
of souls! Rare materials seem
a bit easier to get, too.
55386.descriptionJp:
皆さん懐かしのバラエティー
入魂が再び登場ですよ！今回
のお題は紅蓮獅子の討伐です。
さくっと達成して、沢山の魂
を獲得しましょう！希少な素
材もいつもよりちょっぴり入
手しやすいようですよ。

54812.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54812.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54812.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54812.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

21823.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21823.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21823.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

54353.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54353.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54353.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55465.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55465.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55465.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55465.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

60932.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種の狩猟
60932.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60932.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
60932.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

23267.description: Each time the Giaorugu discovered in the extreme cold sea rampages with its sharp claws, fangs and tail, it opens great cracks in the ice field. If it keeps rampaging, the cracks and falling snow will prevent the survey from proceeding. Immediate action is required.
23267.descriptionEn:
The Giaorugu found in the Polar
Sea, with its sharp claws, fangs
and tail, opens huge cracks in
the frozen ground whenever it
rampages. If it keeps this up,
the cracks and falling snow will
make the survey impossible.
We need this handled at once.
23267.descriptionJp:
極海で発見された氷獰竜は、
鋭利な爪や牙、尾によって
暴れるたびに氷の大地に大き
な亀裂を生じさせます。
このまま暴れられたのでは、
亀裂や落雪のために調査を
進めることができません。
早急に対応が必要です。

58053.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58053.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58053.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58053.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62613.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62613.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62613.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62613.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

21461.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Dyuragaua. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21461.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Duramboros≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!
21461.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪デュラガウア≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

54392.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the dorsal fin of Plesioth, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54392.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun
G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared
this quest to raise awareness
and promote them further.
Break the Plesioth's dorsal
fin and we will grant you a
special ingredient as well.
54392.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
水竜の背ビレを破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

61805.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
61805.description: I want to make a cuff that gives off a manly air, but the exhibition preparations will not let me go! Hey, you there! How about it? Bring me the materials I need instead, and I will give you my very best! I am counting on you!
61805.descriptionEn:
I want to make a cuff with
a manly air, but the exhibit
prep has me stuck here!

Hey, you there! How about it?
Bring me the materials I
need instead, and I'll give
you my very best work!

I'm counting on you!
61805.descriptionJp:
雄々しい雰囲気を出すカフ
が作りたいが、展示会の準備
で手が離せないんだ！

そこのキミ！どうだい？
代わりに必要な素材を取って
来てくれたら、オレさまの
とっておきをやろう！

頼んだぜ！

26137.description: It is I, the Instructor! Combining has something called a success rate. Even if it fails, do not give up, repeat it! The combination recipes are listed under each kind of information, then the Combination List, in the START menu!
26137.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
Combining has a success rate,
you see. Even if you fail,
never give up and try again!
Inside the ≪START Menu≫, under
Info, then Combination List, your
recipes will line up as you learn!
26137.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
調合には、成功確率なるもの
があるぞ。例え失敗しても、
あきらめずに繰り返すのだ！
≪ＳＴＡＲＴメニュー≫内の
各種情報→調合リストの中に
調合レシピが並んでいくぞ！

61823.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61823.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61823.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

54598.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54598.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
54598.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Sword and Shield, show us the
skill you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.
54598.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

21447.objectiveJp: コウザンダケ９９個の納品
21447.description: So you want to become a mushroom maniac too? This path is not as easy as you think. First, gather Kozandake in great quantity! We will talk after that!
21447.descriptionEn:
So you want to become a mushroom
maniac too?
This path is not as easy as you
