Idaten Cup
Champion Tournament
@ PS Vita version
practice final quest.
Time limit: 50 minutes.
50585.descriptionJp:
韋駄天杯
チャンピオントーナメント
＠PS Vita版
の練習用決勝クエストです。
制限時間は５０分です。

54661.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54661.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.
54661.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の航路を制覇されたハン
ターさんですね。このクエス
トではキャラバン秘箱を他の
キャラバン箱に交換すること
ができます。その他にも、Ｇ
ＲＰ、Ｇｚ共に大量に獲得す
ることができます！モンス
ターも登場しますので、油断
せず狩猟に向かってください。

56141.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
56141.description: The cactus that Valsaburos likes to eat is rare! And since much of its ecology is still unclear, it is extremely interesting as a subject of study. But the Valsaburos makes field surveys dangerous, so could I ask you to slay it?
56141.descriptionEn:
The cactus that Valsabros
loves to eat is rare! And
so much of its ecology is
unknown, which makes it
a fascinating subject.
But field work is too
dangerous with Valsabros
around. Please slay it?
56141.descriptionJp:
ヴァルサブロスが好んで食べ
るサボテンは希少なの！そし
て、まだ生態に不明な点が多
いので、研究対象として非常
に興味深いのよ。
だけど、現地調査するのに
ヴァルサブロスが危険だから、
討伐をお願いできないかしら。

60526.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
60526.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.
60526.descriptionJp:
どこでこの話を聞きつけたか
は知らんが、ヤバい話には失
敗の救済など一切ないぞ？
ブツの用意もいいだろうな？
必要なブツの数は条件通りだ。
あとは、現地で１人で働いて
もらう。徒党を組むとナメた
真似するヤツが出るんでな。

50459.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55061.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55061.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Merit (Beginning) x５０, Bow Merit (Middle) x６０, Bow Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55061.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Bow Medal: Intro≫ x50
≪Bow Medal: Mid≫ x60
≪Bow Medal: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or above, so
please be careful.
55061.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪弓勲・序≫５０個
≪弓勲・中≫６０個
≪弓勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

22014.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22014.description: A request that lets you craft the Kukubo Series, armor recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and you will obtain the crafting materials for all 5 pieces of the Kukubo Series, plus upgrade materials up to LV7. May it serve you well in your hunting life.
22014.descriptionEn:
A request that lets you
craft the Kuku Series,
armor recommended for
new hunters. Hunt Yian
Kut-Ku to obtain parts
for all five pieces and
upgrade materials up to
LV7. Put it to good use
in your hunting life!
22014.descriptionJp:
初心者ハンターにオススメの
防具「ククボシリーズ」が
生産できる依頼です。
イャンクックを狩猟すると、
「ククボシリーズ」５部位分
の生産素材と、ＬＶ７までの
強化素材が入手できます。
今後の狩猟生活にぜひお役立
てください。

60648.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
60648.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Daimyo Hermitaur. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60648.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Daimyo Hermitaur!
Taking a monster on all
alone is truly a feat!
Overcome yourself and
claim a top placement!
Supremacy weapons only!
60648.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

50059.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50059.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50059.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

55657.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55657.descriptionEn:
Hunters who would master
the Great Sword, show
the skill you have honed
against the Baruragaru
in the New Great Arena!
Slay it and you will earn
rewards far beyond what
daily effort ever brings
you. Go and prove it!
55657.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

28029.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟

55208.description: A phantom beast said to herald disaster, so rarely seen that its form is almost unknown, has appeared, and 2 of them together. They dance beautifully and command lightning, as if mocking us. This is expected to be a very dangerous survey.
55208.descriptionEn:
A phantom beast said to
herald disaster, rarely
ever seen, has appeared
twice at once. They dance
gracefully, command
lightning, and seem to
mock us. This survey
will be extremely dangerous.
55208.descriptionJp:
災厄の予兆とも言われ、その
姿を見ることは滅多にできな
いという幻獣が、なんと同時
に２頭も出現しました。彼ら
は華麗に舞い、雷を操り、そ
の姿はまるで我々を嘲笑うか
のようです。とても危険な調
査になることが予想されます。

62623.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の捕獲
62623.description: An Ice Fox Wyvern seems to have taken up residence in the highlands, and the people living nearby are beside themselves with worry, I hear. However, hunting it would be a pity, so they ask that it be captured. If you manage it, you might receive a rare material.
62623.descriptionEn:
An Ice Fox Wyvern seems
to have taken up in the
Highlands, and the folks
living nearby are beside
themselves with worry.
Still, slaying it seems
cruel, so capture it.
If you pull it off, rare
materials may be yours.
62623.descriptionJp:
高地に氷狐竜が住みついた
らしくて、近くに住んで
いる人達は、不安で仕方が
ないという話だ。
ただ、討伐は可哀想なので、
捕獲にしてくれとのことだ。
もし、達成できれば、
希少な素材が貰えるかも
知れないぞ。

55262.description: To investigate the Rending Water Wyvern that has been appearing intermittently, I ask you to hunt it and sever its parts. The part to be investigated changes with the time of day it appears, so judge whether the tail, the right hanging blade or the left hanging blade is the target, and if you strike it true I will add to your reward!
55262.descriptionEn:
To survey the Zenaserisu that
appears on and off, please hunt
it and sever its parts. The
part to survey changes with
the time of day it appears,
so judge which part is the
target - tail, right hanging
blade or left hanging blade -
and nail it for a bonus!
55262.descriptionJp:
断続的に出現している裂水竜
の調査のため、裂水竜の狩猟
と部位切断をお願いします。
出現する時間帯によって調査
対象となる部位が替わります
ので、尻尾、右垂刃、左垂刃、
の切断部位の中から、対象部
位を判断し見事当てていただ
きましたら報酬をはずみます！

55158.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Brachydios armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55158.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want
the armor of the Crushing
Wyvern ≪Brachydios≫! Clear
the sub targets to obtain
materials for Sen'yuu Armor
upgrades. Please try it!
55158.descriptionJp:
砕竜≪ブラキディオス≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを用意
しました！サブターゲットを
達成すると遷悠防具の強化に
必要な素材を入手できます
ので、ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

11067.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
11067.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! In this cold season Royal Beetles decrease, but Special Mushrooms are plentiful! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
11067.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the
Jungle! In the cold season
≪Royal Beetle≫ is scarce,
but ≪Specialty Mushroom≫ is
plentiful! Let's start by
getting used to the Jungle.
11067.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を８つ探して納めて下さい！
この寒冷期になると≪ロイヤ
ルカブト≫は減りますが、
≪特産キノコ≫が豊富です！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めましょう。

51003.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51003.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
51003.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, display the skill
you have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.
51003.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55819.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
55819.description: To take this quest you need a Hunter Ring (Red), nya. Take on the hunt for a Bulldrome holding more Song Gems than usual, nya. Choose a Prayer Gem, clear this quest and offer the Song Gems, nya!
55819.descriptionEn:
To take this quest you
need a Hunter Ring Red,
nya. Try hunting the
Bulldrome that hides
more Song Orbs than
usual, nya. Pick a
Prayer Bead, clear it,
and offer up the orbs!
55819.descriptionJp:
このクエストを受けるには
「ハンターリング赤」が
必要ニャ。
通常よりも多くの歌玉を秘め
たドスファンゴの狩猟に挑戦
するニャ。
祈珠を選んでこのクエストを
クリアし、歌玉を捧げるニャ！

21411.objectiveJp: カジキマグロ１０匹の納品
21411.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Hunting monsters is not all a hunter does. Fishing is a fine hunt as well. Why not aim to be an angler yourself? If you do, start by delivering 10 Marlin on your own.
21411.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. Hunting
monsters is not all a hunter does.
Fishing is a fine hunt in its own
right. Why not aim to be an angler?
If you do, start by delivering
10 Speartuna on your own.
21411.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。モンスター
を狩るだけがハンターじゃな
い。釣りだって立派な狩猟だ。
君も釣師を目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人でカジ
キマグロ１０匹の納品からだ。

23313.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

63045.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63045.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
63045.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

61012.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61012.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61012.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

56097.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐

63244.description: Here, a fine present for you. Hm, the present is nowhere to be found. Did I drop it somewhere? Sorry, would you go and look for it instead?
63244.descriptionEn:
Here now, I have a
lovely gift for you.
Hm? The gift isn't
anywhere about. Did I
drop it somewhere?
Sorry, but would you go
and find it for me?
63244.descriptionJp:
ほれ、キミに素敵な
プレゼントじゃ。
はて、プレゼントが
見当たらんぞ。どこかで
落としてしもうたかのぉ。
すまんが、代わりに探しに
行ってきてはくれんかのぉ。

62524.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62524.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62524.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62524.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50257.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Soul (Beginning) x８５, Lance Soul (Middle) x１９５, Lance Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Lance Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50257.descriptionEn:
In this quest, the following materials
can be obtained.
≪Lance Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Lance Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Lance Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Lance Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a ≪Secret Art
Soul Crystal≫ is required, so please
be aware of this.
50257.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ランス魂・序≫８５枚
≪ランス魂・中≫１９５枚
≪ランス魂・極≫２７５枚
≪ランス魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

61733.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61733.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61733.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

55831.description: This quest was prepared to raise awareness of the G Rank Guild Priority Requests. Breaking the Espinas Subspecies' horn also earns you special fare.
55831.descriptionEn:
This quest was prepared
to raise awareness of
the G Rank Guild
Priority Requests.
Breaking the Espinas
Subspecies' horn also
earns you special fare.
55831.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
棘茶竜の角を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

50344.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
50344.description: Defeat a monster a little bigger than usual and find a bracelet, nya! I'll trade you my pick of goods, nya! What's it for? You'd better not pry any further, nya.
50344.descriptionEn:
Defeat a monster a tiny bit bigger
than usual and find a bracelet,
nyah!
I'll trade you my top pick for it,
nyah!
What do I want it for?
It's better not to pry any further
than that, nyah.
50344.descriptionJp:
いつもよりすこ〜し大きい
モンスターを倒して腕輪を見
つけてくるのニャ！
イチオシの品と交換してやる
ニャよ！
何に使うのかって？
それ以上は踏み込まないほう
がいいニャよ。

50940.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50940.description: For members of hunting parties that took part in the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50940.descriptionEn:
A special request and
rewards for members of
a guild that joined the
Hunter Festival. Bring
your Festival Proof.
50940.descriptionJp:
狩人祭に参加した猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

28052.description: Lately there is a fellow running wild in the extreme cold sea, and everyone is troubled, nya. Apparently it has a huge body and runs at tremendous speed, nya. Hunters, this is where you show your skill, nya. Roll up your sleeves and go see what is happening, nya!!
28052.descriptionEn:
Something's been on a
rampage in the Polar Sea
and everyone's worried,
nya. It's huge and runs
at crazy speed, they say.
Time to show your worth,
hunters, nya. Go and have
a look for us, nya!!
28052.descriptionJp:
最近極海にて暴れまわってい
る奴がいて、皆困ってるニャ。
何でも大きな体して凄い
スピードで走るらしいニャ。
ハンター諸君は腕の見せ所な
のニャ。
ここは一肌脱いで様子を見て
くるニャ！！

21951.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
21951.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ５１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Akura Vashimu. I am counting on you!
21951.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR51.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as your reward?
It is a simple job, really. Just
make one quick trip and slay
an Akura Vashimu for me.
I am counting on you!
21951.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ５１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってアクラ・ヴァシム
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

26652.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26652.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
26652.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

61629.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
61629.description: An ice wyvern has been confirmed in a hidden area of the Ancient Tower, one apart from those where the fire wyverns dwell. The Hunters Guild has named that wyvern the Ice Fox Wyvern, Dyuragaua, and is studying its ecology. It is a wyvern we still know little about, so we ask you to investigate.
61629.descriptionEn:
An ice dragon has been
confirmed in a hidden region
of the Ancient Tower, apart
from where the Rathalos
dwell. The Guild named it
the Ice Fox Dragon
≪Duramboros≫ and studies its
ecology. Please survey it.
61629.descriptionJp:
古塔の秘境、それも火竜たち
が住まうものとは別の秘境で
氷の竜が確認されました。
猟団組合ではあの竜を氷狐竜
≪デュラガウア≫と名付け、
その生態を調査しております。
まだ情報が少ない飛竜ですが
調査をお願いします。

63299.description: A Felyne's injuries are not healing well. For treatment I absolutely need a fish wyvern's liver. If I can get that cure-all, it should recover. To save my partner, sorry, but please help!
63299.descriptionEn:
My Felyne's wounds just
won't heal up right.
I need Plesioth guts to
treat them, no matter
what. They say it cures
any ailment, so it should
set my partner right.
I hate to ask, but please
lend me a hand!
63299.descriptionJp:
アイルーの怪我の具合が
あまりよくない。
治療のために、なんとしても
魚竜のキモが必要なんだ。
万病に効くと言われている
あれが手に入れば、
きっと元気になるはずだ。
俺の相棒を助けるために、
すまないが協力してくれ！

56036.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Plesioth. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56036.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Water Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56036.descriptionJp:
辿異種の水竜を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

55448.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
55448.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55448.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55448.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

26578.description: Congratulations on reaching HR100! Deliver a Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26578.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on
reaching HR100! Deliver
a Map on your own, clear
the quest, and claim
your reward!
26578.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

23697.description: I cannot resist rare things. Monster materials, ore, anything rare I want! This time I want you to slay a few Pokara to gather Pokara materials. Succeed and I will share a little of the rare materials I hold. Not a bad deal, is it?
23697.descriptionEn:
I just can't resist rare things.
Monster materials, ore, anything
rare — I want it all!
This time I want you to slay a few
Pokara to gather their materials.
If you pull it off,
I'll share a little of the rare
materials I have with you.
Not a bad deal, is it?
23697.descriptionJp:
俺は珍しい物に目がなくてな。
モンスターの素材や鉱石など、
珍しい物なら何でも欲しい！
今回はポカラの素材を集める
ために、数頭討伐を頼みたい。
成功させてくれたら、
俺の持っている珍しい素材を
少しだけお前に分けてやろう。
悪い話ではないだろう？

54695.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54695.description: So you've conquered the G Rank sea routes. This quest lets you trade a Caravan Secret Box for Parone's wisdom. You'll also earn piles of GRP and Gz! Monsters show up too, so stay sharp and hunt with care.
54695.descriptionEn:
So you've conquered the
G Rank sea routes. This
quest lets you trade a
Caravan Secret Box for
Parone's wisdom. You'll
also earn piles of GRP
and Gz! Monsters show up
too, so stay sharp and
hunt with care.
54695.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の航路を制覇されたハン
ターさんですね。このクエス
トではキャラバン秘箱をパ
ローネの英知に交換すること
ができます。その他にも、Ｇ
ＲＰ、Ｇｚ共に大量に獲得す
ることができます！モンス
ターも登場しますので、油断
せず狩猟に向かってください。

62166.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62166.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62166.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62166.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50106.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
50106.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50106.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
50106.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

55715.description: Please help with research on the customs of Eastern regions! I want you to find the ingredients for what our documents describe as kashiwa mochi. I heard from a reliable source that it is in the sea of trees, so search there!
55715.descriptionEn:
Please help with our
research on eastern
customs! We need the
ingredients for what our
records call kashiwa
mochi. A reliable source
says they're in the Great
Forest, so search there!
55715.descriptionJp:
東方地域の風習に関する研究
のお手伝いをお願いします！
こちらの資料に「柏餅」と説
明されているものの材料を探
してきてほしいのです。
信頼できる情報筋から樹海に
あるとの噂を聞いたので探し
てみてください！

62871.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62871.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62871.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62871.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

11058.description: Basarios grows by eating ore, so its outer shell often contains ore. By destroying parts, it seems you can sometimes get ore without mining at all! That's two birds with one stone!
11058.descriptionEn:
≪Basarios≫ grows by eating
ore, so its shell often
contains minerals. Break its
parts and you may get ore
without mining at all, or so
they say! Two birds with
one stone, eh!
11058.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫は鉱石を食べ
て成長するためその外殻には
鉱石が含まれてることが多い
です。部位を破壊することで、
採掘しなくても鉱石が入手
できることもあるみたいです
よ！これは一石二鳥ですね！

61885.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61885.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
61885.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

54169.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
54169.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54169.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54169.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

26431.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26431.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26431.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26431.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

55466.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55466.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55466.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

61352.description: This is terrible, meow! With the Hunters Festa and all, Mezeporuta square is in an uproar, meow! Deliveries have piled up and I am run off my feet, meow! And on top of that, monsters are in the way and I cannot get through, so I want you to hunt them, meow! If you do, I will give you my treasure, meow!
61352.descriptionEn:
Big trouble, nya!
With Hunters Festa and
all, Mezeporta Square is
in an uproar, nya! The
deliveries piled up too,
so we're swamped, nya!
And monsters are in the
way, so go slay them for
us, nya! Do that and I'll
give you my treasure, nya!
61352.descriptionJp:
大変ですニャ！
ハンターズフェスタとかで、
メゼポルタ広場が大騒ぎです
ニャ！　お届け物もたくさん
増えて、大忙しですニャ！
それなのに、モンスターが
邪魔して通れないから、討伐
してきてほしいニャ！
そうしたら、ぼくの宝物を
あげますニャ！

50849.description: On the highlands where eerie monsters lie in wait, let us join forces and fill the Bruck Gauge! I pray you will clear it without difficulty! Once enough has been gathered I have prepared a reward to share the joy with everyone. Will you get it? For brave ones like you there is no problem.
50849.descriptionEn:
Take the stage in the
Highlands, where creepy
monsters lie in wait, and
pool your strength to
fill the Brook Gauge!
I'm praying you clear it
without trouble! Fill it
up and a reward awaits
to share with everyone.
Brave as you are, no problem?
50849.descriptionJp:
不気味なモンスター待ち構え
る高地を舞台に力合わせブル
ックゲージを溜めよう！
苦も無く攻略してくれるよう
に祈っているぜ！
十分な量が溜まったらみんな
と喜びを分かち合える報しゅ
うを準備している。もらえる
かどうか？勇敢な君たちであ
れば問題ないか。

1002.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
1002.description: Velocidrome will run off to the next area when its stamina runs low and heal itself up! It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are lots of Velociprey minions, so watch yourself!
1002.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ bolts to the
next area when worn down
and heals right up!
A fine test of a hunter's
skill, but this season the
Velociprey underlings are
many, so watch yourself!
1002.descriptionJp:
≪ドスランポス≫は体力を
消耗すると隣のエリアへ逃げ
て体力を回復しちまうぜ！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度いい相手だが、
この季節は、子分のランポス
も多いから注意するんだぜ！

21512.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
21512.description: A Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporta, and an extremely powerful individual at that! Hunters, intercept it at the Interception Base and slay it.
21512.descriptionEn:
A Shantien, and an
extremely powerful one,
has invaded Mezeporta!
Hunters, intercept it at
the Base and slay it
without fail.
21512.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタに風翔龍、それも
極めて強力な個体が侵入しま
した！
ハンターのみなさんは、
≪迎撃拠点≫で迎え撃ち、
これを討伐してください。

62439.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62439.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62439.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

55419.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
55419.description: There is a report that Espinas and Azure Rathalos have taken up residence in the recently discovered Old Tower. For our part, since there is little threat to the surroundings, we would like to watch and see, but we cannot simply ignore it, so hunters who are interested, please investigate.
55419.descriptionEn:
Reports have come in
that Espinas and Azure
Rathalos have taken up
residence in the newly
found Ancient Tower.
The threat to the area
is low, so we'd rather
just watch, but we can't
ignore it. Hunters who
are interested, survey it.
55419.descriptionJp:
最近発見された≪古塔≫にて
≪棘竜≫と≪蒼火竜≫が
棲みついていたと報告が
上がってきました。
我々としては、周囲への
脅威が少ないことから様子を
見たいところですが、無視を
するわけにもいきませんので、
興味のあるハンターは調査を
お願いします。

55879.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55879.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55879.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

40121.description: I have developed an extremely efficient special training method using Felynes and Melynx. The effect is so great it is a problem, so I can only teach it to selected people! Clear the conditions and take my lesson!
40121.descriptionEn:
I've developed one crazy
efficient training method
using Felynes and
Melynxes. It works TOO
well, see, so I can only
teach it to the chosen
few! Clear the conditions
and come take my lesson,
ya hear!
40121.descriptionJp:
アイルーとメラルーを使った
ものすごく効率的な特訓法を
開発したんだゼ。効果が大き
すぎるってのも考えものでサ、
選ばれた人にしかその方法を
教えることはできないんダ！
頑張って条件をクリアして、
ぜひ俺のレッスンを受けて
くれよナ！

62187.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲

61654.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Shell! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
61654.descriptionEn:
The Guild rewards hunters who
break many parts of Variant
and Kishu monsters. The main
reward is a Wyvern's Heavy
Shell! Deliver the
certificate when you accept
or join, then hunt the
specified monster. It cannot
be returned after departure.
61654.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の重殻！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

55417.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55417.description: We have received reports that a Tigrex and a Diablos have appeared in the desert at the same time. Of all the monsters living in the desert, these two are among the most violent, and the combination can only be called the worst. Head there at once and hunt them.
55417.descriptionEn:
We've received reports
that a Tigrex and a
Diablos have appeared in
the Desert at the same
time. Both are among the
fiercest monsters living
there, and that pairing
is the worst case. Head
out and hunt them at once.
55417.descriptionJp:
砂漠に≪轟竜≫と≪角竜≫が
同時に出現したとの報告を、
受けました。
砂漠に生息するモンスターの
中でも特に気性の荒い、
２頭の組み合わせは最悪と
言わざるを得ません。
至急現地へ赴き、狩猟して
ください。

51037.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
51037.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of a Black Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
51037.descriptionEn:
To promote the Guild
Priority Requests we have
long held, we prepared this
quest. Severing a Black
Diablos' tail also grants
you a special ingredient.
51037.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒角竜の尻尾を切断すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

63091.description: At night in the Swamp, hunters are suddenly being attacked by something. What is more, every hunter attacked reports that they never saw it. Something is certainly lurking there. Please investigate to find the cause.
63091.descriptionEn:
At night in the Swamp,
hunters are suddenly
being attacked by
something. Worse, every
hunter attacked reports
never seeing it. There is
no doubt something is
lurking. Please survey
and find the cause.
63091.descriptionJp:
夜の沼地で、突然ハンターが
何者かに襲われるという
問題が発生しています。
しかも、襲われたハンターは、
皆姿は見ていないと報告して
いるようです。何か潜んで
いることは間違いありません。
原因究明のため調査をお願い
します。

50192.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
50192.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50192.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50192.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

40145.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
40145.description: A Pariapuria seems to have attacked merchants in the highlands. It shows no sign of moving from the spot, and the area has been closed off as dangerous. The content of this request is to secure the safety of the highlands. Master hunters, I am counting on you!
40145.descriptionEn:
A ≪Pariapuria≫ seems to have
attacked the merchants in
the Highlands. It shows no
sign of moving on, and the
area is sealed off as
dangerous. This request is
to secure the Highlands.
Skilled hunters, do it!
40145.descriptionJp:
高地で≪パリアプリア≫が
商人たちを襲撃したらしい。
その場所から動こうとする
気配がなく、危険な地域とし
て封鎖されている状況だ。
今回の依頼内容は、高地の
安全を確保することだ。
凄腕のハンターたちよ、
頼んだぞ！

22005.description: Two Velocidrome have wandered into the arena where Felynes and Melynx await! The main target is slaying 20 Felynes, but complete the sub target of slaying 40 Melynx and a lavish reward awaits!?
22005.descriptionEn:
In the Arena where Felynes and
Melynxes lie in wait, 2
Velocidromes have wandered in!
The main target is slaying 20
Felynes, but if you complete
the sub-target of 40 Melynxes,
a lavish reward awaits!?
22005.descriptionJp:
アイルーとメラルーが待ち受
ける闘技場に、ドスランポス
２頭までもが迷い込んだ！！
メインターゲットはアイルー
２０匹の討伐となるが、サブ
ターゲットのメラルー４０匹
討伐を満たせば豪華報酬が！？

61235.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61235.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61235.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

21046.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21046.description: The Shogun Ceanataur apparently uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling! In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too! Beware the sharp claws of each and every one!
21046.descriptionEn:
The sickle crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
uses its bizarre leg joints to
climb all the way to the
ceiling!
In this season's Volcano, many
young ≪Gamizami≫ should be about!
Watch out for their sharp claws!
21046.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登るらしいです！
この季節の火山では、子供た
ち≪ガミザミ≫も数多く生息
してるハズです！それぞれの
鋭い爪には要注意ですよ！

40060.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
40060.description: The Yian Kut-Ku of this jungle is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40060.descriptionEn:
The ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ that lives in
this Jungle is said to sometimes
carry incredible treasure.
If that is true, I would love
for you to go hunt one for us.
We will split the reward
right down the middle.
40060.descriptionJp:
この密林に生息する怪鳥
≪イャンクック≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

63372.description: Elegant carnivorous ladies! The day your daily efforts pay off has come. Take candy from the easygoing herbivore hunters and clear the quest! Getting whatever you want, that is the law of the carnivorous lady!
63372.descriptionEn:
Carnivorous ladies, your
day has come! Get candy
from those easygoing
herbivore hunters and
clear the quest! Take
whatever you want, that's
the code of the meat-
eating lady!
63372.descriptionJp:
華麗なる肉食淑女たちよ！
日頃の努力が報われる日が
きました。ちょろい草食
ハンターからキャンディを
ゲットして、クエストを
クリアしましょう！欲しい
ものは何でも手に入れる、
それが肉食淑女の掟！

62079.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

61718.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
61718.description: Have you heard about the Kinos Secret Stone from the master of the arms workshop? Hm, you don't know? Then this is a good chance, I will invite you on this quest. The Kinos Secret Stone is a special ore that lets you produce a certain armor. Gather lots and take them to the master!
61718.descriptionEn:
Has the smithy master
ever told you about the
Kinos Secret Stone? No?
Then here's your chance:
join this quest. The
Kinos Secret Stone is a
special ore for crafting
certain armor. Gather
plenty and take it to him!
61718.descriptionJp:
武具工房の親方から≪キノス
秘石≫の話を聞いたことがあ
る？ん、知らない？
じゃあ、いい機会だし、この
クエストに招待するよ。
≪キノス秘石≫は、ある防具
が生産できる特殊な鉱石なん
だ。たくさん集めて親方のと
ころへ持っていこう！

61941.description: Just between us, I know a place where you can get quality Porta Pyroxene, but a tough one is blocking the way. I'll tell you the place, so if you're interested, why not go?
61941.descriptionEn:
Between us, I know a spot
with quality Porta
Glowstone, but a nasty
brute is blocking the way.
I'll tell you where it is,
so if you're curious, go
and take a look. Up to you?
61941.descriptionJp:
ここだけの話、実は質のいい
≪ポルタ輝石≫が手に入る場
所を知っているんだが、ごっ
ついヤツが道を塞いでてな。
場所を教えるから、気になる
のであれば行ってみてはどう
だい？

60318.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

63019.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
63019.description: The method of making the Hado Cannon, said to have been held by an ancient conqueror, has been discovered. It requires materials taken from Akantor, but it is not as simple as slaying one. The Hado Cannon cannot be made from damaged materials. The back in particular is vital, and that part must never be broken.
63019.descriptionEn:
The crafting method for
the Overlord Cannon,
once owned by an ancient
conqueror, has been
found. It needs parts
from Akantor, but simply
slaying it won't do.
Damaged parts can't
make the cannon. The back
is vital. Never break it!
63019.descriptionJp:
太古の覇者が所持していたと
いわれる覇導砲の製作方法が、
発見された。
覇竜から取れる素材が必要に
なるのだが、討伐すればよい
という簡単な話ではない。
傷ついた素材からは覇導砲は
製作できないのだ。
特に背中は重要で、そこだけ
は絶対壊してはならない。

40087.description: Congratulations on reaching HR700! Deliver a Map on your own, and after clearing the quest visit the Special Event House for a bonus. Please make good use of it!
40087.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on
reaching HR700! Deliver
a Map on your own, and
after clearing the quest
visit the Special Event
House for a bonus. Please
make good use of it!
40087.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ７００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストクリア後に
特別イベントハウスを訪ねて
いただければ特典を進呈致し
ます。ぜひご活用ください！

62755.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
62755.description: A team member surveying the caves of Tide Island reports that a rumbling can sometimes be heard from deep inside. Some of the team have also seen large rocks move, and unease is spreading. A monster unknown to us may be living there, so we ask for an investigation.
62755.descriptionEn:
From members surveying the caves of
the Tidal Island came a report that
rumbling can sometimes be heard
from deep within the caves.
Also, some members have seen
large rocks moving, and unease
is spreading among them.
An unknown monster may live there,
so please investigate.
62755.descriptionJp:
潮島の洞窟を調査中の団員よ
り、洞窟の奥深くから地響き
が聞こえることがあるとの
報告がありました。
また、団員の中には
大きな岩が動くのを見た者も
おり不安が広がっています。
未知のモンスターが生息して
いる可能性があるため調査を
お願いします。

51007.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51007.description: Hunter who would master the light bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
51007.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Light Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.
51007.descriptionJp:
軽弩を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

21720.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Soul (Beginning) x８５, Long Sword Soul (Middle) x１９５, Long Sword Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Long Sword Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21720.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Long Sword Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Long Sword Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Long Sword Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please note.
21720.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪太刀魂・序≫８５枚
≪太刀魂・中≫１９５枚
≪太刀魂・極≫２７５枚
≪太刀魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

12067.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
12067.description: The Shogun Ceanataur is a creature that uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling. In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too. Mind the sharp claws of each one.
12067.descriptionEn:
The Carapaceon ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
is a creature that uses its strange
leg joints to climb even onto
ceilings.
In the Volcano this season, many
of its young ≪Gamisami≫ should
also be about. Beware the sharp
claws of each.
12067.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登る生き物よ。
この季節の火山では、子供た
ち≪ガミザミ≫も数多く生息
しているハズよ。それぞれの
鋭い爪には注意することね。

50461.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

62482.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. Only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it, so please note.
62482.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
Only hunters equipped with
the special anti-Variant
arms may accept or join, so
please take care.
62482.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

55863.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55863.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55863.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

23477.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
23477.description: The Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur has appeared once more. Its claws have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23477.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Daimyo
Hermitaur has appeared
again. Its claws are
stronger now, and it
seems even more powerful.
Survey it with utmost care.
23477.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ダイミョウザザミ≫
が再び現れました。
爪はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

50952.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50952.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50952.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50952.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

21525.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
21525.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21525.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21525.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26303.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26303.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26303.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26303.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26303.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54794.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54794.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 1 Porta Card Sakura. Hunt a Farnock and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade 1 piece of Flogada GX.
54794.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely
quest you can take for
one Porta Card Sakura.
Hunt a Farunokku and
you'll get the materials
needed to upgrade one
piece of Frogada GX.
54794.descriptionJp:
ポルタカード桜１枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
ファルノックを狩猟すると、
フロガダGX一部位の
強化に必要な素材が
入手できるわよ。

63408.description: A challenge from us, the Dark Cat Gang, meow. We will show you how to hunt the bizarre monster that appeared in the Deep Forest, meow. For a skilled hunter, it is the sort of thing you can do of course, meow. If you complete it well, we will give you the Dark Cat Gang Badge, our very soul, meow.
63408.descriptionEn:
A challenge from us, the
Dark Cat Gang, nya. Go
hunt the bizarre monster
that showed up in the
Great Forest, nya. For a
skilled hunter that's a
given. Clear it and we'll
hand over our soul, the
Dark Cat Gang Badge, nya.
63408.descriptionJp:
我々闇猫団からの挑戦状ニャ。
樹海に出現したキショウな
モンスターを狩猟してみせる
ニャ。熟練のハンターなら、
できて当然の内容ニャ。
見事達成することができたら、
オレたちの魂である
≪闇猫団バッチ≫を
くれてやるニャ。

61153.objectiveJp: イャンクック４頭の捕獲

62161.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62161.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. This may be a good chance to hunt a monster. Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! There is no time to wait for others, so please depart as 1 hunter.
62161.descriptionEn:
A specimen of a relatively
weak monster has been confirmed.
This may be a fine chance
to hunt a monster.
Before it flees far away,
please hurry and get ready!
There is no time to wait for others,
so please depart alone.
62161.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
これは、モンスターを狩猟す
るいい機会かもしれません。
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
人を待つ時間もないため、
１人での出発をお願いします。

61031.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての討伐

55433.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (head), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a 10th Anniversary Ticket is required to accept the quest.
55433.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to
upgrade G Rank Secret
Art Armor (head), save
for Weapon Ribbons and
Weapon Merits. It yields
materials for one type.
Taking it requires a
10th Anniversary Ticket.
55433.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（頭防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪10周年チケット≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

55923.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
55923.description: A Taikun Zamuza with greatly developed claws has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Taikun Zamuza seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55923.descriptionEn:
A Daimyo Hermitaur with
greatly developed claws
has appeared. The Guild
classifies this one as a
Supremacy with enlarged
parts and will survey
it. Reports say it's more
dangerous than before.
Survey with caution.
55923.descriptionJp:
爪が大きく発達した≪多殻蟹≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの多殻蟹より危険
との報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

63235.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

55075.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
55075.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
55075.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

62721.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
62721.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62721.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62721.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

54852.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
54852.description: Do you know? The Crimson Lavasioth attacks at once when it finds an enemy. Then why not become one of them with this equipment! Don't you think it's a good idea? Ready, hunters? Let's have a fish festival!
54852.descriptionEn:
Did you know? Lavasioth
attacks the moment it
spots an outsider. So
why not dress up as one
with this gear? Don't
you think that's a fine
idea? Ready, hunters?
Let's have a fish
festival!
54852.descriptionJp:
きみはしっているか？
紅溶岩竜は外敵をみつけると
すぐに襲いかかってくるんだ
よ。ならば、この装備で彼ら
になりきってみてはどうだろ
う！良いアイデアだと思わな
いかい？
準備は良いかハンター諸君！
レッツおさかなまつり！

54802.description: 2 unidentified monsters of great power are on a rampage together at the Ancient Tower. Head out to slay them at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Secret Art armor, in preparation for greater threats.
54802.descriptionEn:
Two unidentified monsters of
great power are on a rampage
at the Ancient Tower at once.
Please head out and slay them
as fast as you can!
If you save us from this crisis,
we will provide materials used
for some G Rank Secret Art
Armor, in preparation for worse.
54802.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが２頭同時に暴れ
まわっています。
一刻も早く討伐に向かって
ください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級秘伝防具に使用す
る素材を提供いたします。

51021.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
51021.description: Here is a request that yields the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of the Toridokuresu Hardcore Armor, the Torido series. It is a generous quest, so do give it a try!
51021.descriptionEn:
A request that yields the
materials to craft and
upgrade one piece of the
Hardcore Armor for the
Shining Thunderbird, the
Torido Series. It's a
bargain, so give it a go!
51021.descriptionJp:
照雷鳥の≪剛種防具≫
「トリドシリーズ」１部位分
の生産強化に必要な素材を
入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。オトクなクエスト
ですのでぜひチャレンジして
ください！

61179.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
61179.description: A Rajang variant seems to be on a rampage in the Snowy Mountains. This is exactly when you want a melee weapon that can guard. No other equipment is permitted! Take the attacks squarely and hit back hard. Find an opening and break some parts too!
61179.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
61179.descriptionEn:
A Variant Rajang is on a
rampage in the Snowy
Mountains. This is the time
for a guard-capable melee
weapon. No other gear is
allowed! Block its attacks
solid, then hit back hard.
Find an opening and break
its parts too!
61179.descriptionJp:
雪山でラージャン変種が暴れ
ているらしい。
こんな時こそガード可能な
近接武器だ。それ以外の装
備は認めないぞ！
攻撃をガッチリと受け止め、
ガツンとやるんだ。
隙を見つけて部位破壊も
してやれ！

61037.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
61037.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61037.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61037.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

26358.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
26358.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26358.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26358.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、下位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

21821.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, would you plant the Guild Flag at the summit for me?
21821.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, has no
fixed territory, and because
its numbers are so few it is
also called the Phantom Beast.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
could you plant a Guild Flag
at the summit for me?
21821.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物ね。雪山に行くなら山頂に
≪ギルドフラッグ≫を立てて
くるのをお願いしてもいい？

55008.description: There was a report that a powerful Chameleos appeared in the swamp. It is said to differ in appearance from the individual of before, and an immediate investigation is needed. We have prepared fitting rewards for hunters aiming to produce and upgrade G-rank arms, so please investigate.
55008.descriptionEn:
A powerful Chameleos has
been reported in the
Swamp. It differs from
past individuals, so a
prompt survey is needed.
Hunters working toward
G Rank gear get fitting
rewards, so please survey.
55008.descriptionJp:
沼地にて強力な≪霞龍≫が出
現したとの報告がありました。
かつての個体とは様相が違う
とのことで、早急に調査が必
要です。Ｇ級武具の生産や強
化を目指すハンターには相応
の報酬を用意していますので、
ぜひとも調査をお願いします。

60419.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60419.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60419.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

53324.description: Big Miyashita P has appeared on Tide Island. He carries an Iron Gunlance, and witnesses say he also fires something like colorful tape from his hands. It seems his aim is simply to meet hunters. Enjoy the encounter.
53324.descriptionEn:
A big Miyashita P has
appeared on Tidal Island.
Big Miyashita P carries
an Iron Gunlance. There
are also reports he fires
colorful tape-like stuff
from his hands. It seems
he's here to meet
hunters. Enjoy the visit!
53324.descriptionJp:
潮島におっきい宮下Ｐが現れ
ました。おっきい宮下Ｐはア
イアンガンランスを所持して
います。また手からカラフル
なテープのようなものを飛ば
してきたとの証言もあります。
どうやらハンターとの交流を
目的としているようです。
触れあいをお楽しみください。

23683.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23683.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena! Hunt it well and you
shall earn even more rewards
than your daily efforts
bring.
23683.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55153.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55153.description: Hi everyone! It is the autumn sports festival! Aim to clear as many as you can while earning rare First Species materials! If you collect the Bond Coins given as rewards, you can draw a lottery for various prizes!
55153.descriptionEn:
Hello everyone!
It's the autumn Sports Festival!
Aim to clear as many as you can
while earning rare Origin Species
materials!
If you collect the ≪Bond Coins≫
given as rewards, you can also
draw a lottery for all sorts of
prizes!
55153.descriptionJp:
はーい皆さん！
秋の大運動会ですよ！
希少な始種素材を獲得しなが
ら、よりたくさんクリアする
のを目指してくださいね！
報酬としてもらえる
「絆のコイン」を集めれば、
いろいろな景品が当たるくじ
も引けますよ！

60614.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60614.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60614.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60614.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54378.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54378.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54378.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

61151.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will clear a quest in the form of a mock arena exercise! It is by no means because I could not rent the arena! Also, did you clear Trial One? Here is the item you need to complete Trial Two!
61151.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
This time you'll clear a
quest styled after an
arena drill! It is not at
all that the arena was
unavailable! Also, did
you clear Trial I? This
yields what Trial II needs!
61151.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ！教官だ！今度は闘技
演習を模した形でクエストを
突破して貰うぞ！断じて闘技
場が借りれなかったわけでは
ない！
あと、試練その壱を突破して
くれたかな？その弐の達成に
必要なアイテムが出るぞ！

62784.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62784.description: We have now identified the monster approaching the desert. It is Rukodiora, an Elder Dragon with shining wings. It is closing on the desert at tremendous speed. Head for the desert at once and slay it!
62784.descriptionEn:
We have determined what the monster
that is currently flying toward the
Desert actually is.
It is the Elder Dragon species with
shining wings, ≪Rukodiora≫.
It is closing on the Desert at
fierce speed.
Head for the Desert at once
and slay it!
62784.descriptionJp:
現在、砂漠に飛来しつつある
モンスターが何であるか
判明しました。
光り輝く翼を持つ古龍種、
≪ルコディオラ≫です。
猛スピードで砂漠に
迫っています。
大至急、砂漠へ向かい
討伐してください！

62407.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
62407.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62407.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
62407.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

26211.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
26211.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Velocidrome will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
26211.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall
Guild, it has been decided to
recommend trialing a new kind
of sub-target.
Our Guild will judge the set
amount of damage dealt to
≪Velocidrome≫, so please all
focus solely on the main target!
26211.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ドスランポス≫への『一定
ダメージ』は、当ギルドで判
断しますので、皆さんはメイ
ンターゲットの達成に専念し
てくだされば結構ですよ！

55717.description: Seregios is a dangerous monster that scatters countless sharp scales around itself. To further our study of its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its horns or both legs in addition to the hunt, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
55717.descriptionEn:
Seregios, the Thousand Blade
Wyvern, scatters countless
sharp scales around and is
dangerous. To aid our study,
if you also break its horns
or both legs, we will give
extra rewards. We await the
challenge of brave hunters.
55717.descriptionJp:
千刃竜セルレギオスは無数の
鋭い鱗を、辺りにまき散らす
危険なモンスターです。
生態の解明のため、狩猟に
加えて角か両脚の破壊に
成功した場合は、追加の報酬
をお渡しします。
勇気あるハンターの挑戦を、
お待ちしております。

55709.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields Rukodiora materials. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55709.descriptionEn:
For members of a winning
Hunter Festival guild,
I've prepared a quest
that yields Extreme
Dragon materials. Bring
Festival Fever to join.
55709.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に≪極龍素
材≫を獲得できるクエストを
用意させていただきました。
受注、参加時に、≪祭典の
熱気≫をお持ちください。

63241.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
63241.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest whose rewards may include materials such as the Rukodiora Shining Horn and the Rukodiora Thunder Membrane. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63241.descriptionEn:
For winning Hunter
Festival guild members,
I've prepared a quest
whose rewards can
include parts like the
Extreme Dragon's Shining
Horn and Thunder Membrane.
Bring Festival Proof to join.
63241.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪極龍の
曜角≫≪極龍の雷膜≫などの
素材が報酬で手に入ることが
あるクエストを用意させてい
ただきました。受注、参加時
に、祭典の証をお持ちくださ
い。

21937.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Taikun Zamuza. I am counting on you!
21937.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! I hear you
made it to HR3. So I've got
a request for you. How
about a full set of weapon
materials as pay? It's an
easy one: just run over and
slay Taikun Zamuza.
I'm counting on you!
21937.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってタイクンザムザを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

26019.description: In the Guild's history there was a hunter said to have the strongest arm. This Guild gives an incentive award to hunters who slay one on one the fish wyvern that drove that hunter into retirement, the Plesioth. Please join us.
26019.descriptionEn:
In the history of the Guild there was
a hunter praised as the strongest of
all, a mighty arm.
Our Guild awards a prize to any
hunter who slays one on one the
Plesioth, the fish wyvern species that
drove that hunter into retirement.
Please join us enthusiastically.
26019.descriptionJp:
ギルドの歴史の中でも、最強
の豪腕と謳われたハンターが
いました。
当ギルドでは、そのハンター
を引退にまで追いやった魚竜
種、ガノトトスを１対１で討
伐したハンターに、奨励品を
出しています。
奮ってご参加ください。

50414.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61403.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61403.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61403.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61403.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

54247.description: Thanks to you gathering Rurou Narcissus and mining the Amaterasu Stone, trade with every region is thriving. The Guild presents you with this coin as thanks for the blessings you have brought to Mezeporta.
54247.descriptionEn:
Thanks to you gathering ≪Lulou Suisen≫
and mining ≪Amaterasu Stone≫,
trade with every region is
flourishing.
The Guild presents you with this
coin as thanks for the blessings
you have brought to Mezepolta.
54247.descriptionJp:
あなたが≪ルロウスイセン≫、
を採取し、≪天照石≫を採掘
してくれるおかげで、各地方
からの交易が盛んに行われて
います。
ギルドは、このメゼポルタに
恵みを与えてくれたお礼とし
てこのコインを贈ります。

60545.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
60545.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Doragyurosu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60545.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Doragyurosu!
Clear it together with
your guildmates. This
contest is all about
teamwork, so claim a top
placement! This round is
SP weapons only, so choose well!
60545.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ドラギュロス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

62652.description: Fwahaha! It is I, the Instructor! Novice hunter and ace hunter! Are you ready? Skin-to-skin honesty is the first step to friendship! Turn in what you bring and succeed in a hunt without armor! Succeed and a fine reward awaits!
62652.descriptionEn:
Fuhaha! It is I, the Instructor!
You greenhorn and veteran
hunters! Are you ready!
Nothing builds friendship like
a bare-skinned hunt! Deliver
what you brought along and
pull off a hunt with no armor!
Succeed, and a fine reward awaits!
62652.descriptionJp:
ふはは！我輩だ！教官だ！
ひよっこハンターと凄腕ハン
ターよ！準備はいいか！
裸の付き合いこそ仲良しの第
一歩！持ち寄ったものを納品
し、防具なしで狩猟を成功さ
せてみろ！見事成功させれば、
ステキな報酬が待っているぞ！

15012.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! You should be able to fight the Gravios at an advantage by breaking its thick armor, so do not yield to the threat!
15012.descriptionEn:
This official hunting
exam has four parts! To
check your skill once
more, you'll hunt every
monster I designate!
Gravios can be beaten
by breaking its thick
shell. Do not yield!
15012.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
４つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
鎧竜はその厚き鎧を破壊する
ことで優位に戦えるハズじゃ、
脅威に屈するでないぞ！

54285.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
54285.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54285.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54285.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23642.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23642.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23642.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Bow, show us the skill you have
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.
23642.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

53022.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
53022.description: Reading the lost map has revealed a new fact. A Pariapuria more terrible than the usual sort seems to dwell on Tide Island. Hunt it and I will hand over the Guild's secret Heavenstorm Sanskrit Scroll or Earthburst Sanskrit Scroll. Will the ecological survey never end?
53022.descriptionEn:
Reading the lost map
revealed something new.
A Pariapuria more
terrible than the usual
sort lives on Tidal
Island. Hunt it and I'll
hand over the Guild's
Heavenly Storm Sanskrit
Tome or Earthburst Tome.
53022.descriptionJp:
失われた地図を読み解くと、
新たな事実が判明した。
≪潮島≫には、通常の個体
より恐ろしい呑竜が生息して
いるようだ。
そいつを狩猟してくれたら、
ギルド秘蔵≪天嵐梵字の書≫
か≪地噴梵字の書≫を譲ろう。
生態調査に終わりはないのか。

62247.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Capture and slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62247.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the
Instructor! Today I have
prepared a difficult request
to test your bonds. Capture
and slay multiple monsters
with your Guild mates. No
supplies will be given, so
plan ahead with your friends.
The reward is a special ore!
62247.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の捕獲、討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

61646.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
61646.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Desert, hunt 2 bird wyverns and a school of fish wyverns, and to finish, bring back a Herbivore Egg from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
61646.descriptionEn:
This time, we hold special
training for Hunters with
little experience yet!
In the Desert, hunt a flock of
2 Bird Wyverns and a Piscine
Wyvern, then finish by bringing
back a herbivore egg from the
cave. Do it and your standing
will rise!
61646.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！砂漠で２頭の鳥竜と
魚竜の群れを狩猟し、仕上げ
に、洞窟より草食竜の卵を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

63031.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

21182.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21182.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21182.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

62696.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
62696.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.
62696.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは、対変種に適した特
殊な武器を装備した方限定の
受注、参加となっております。
今回のターゲットには、通常
とは異なる性質、動きがみら
れるそうなのでご注意を。

21884.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21884.description: A request for hunters who possess Odibatorasu Tenran armor. By repeatedly driving off Odibatorasu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
21884.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
By repeatedly repelling
Odibatorasu, you can obtain
the materials
needed to upgrade
"Odiba FX Series"
≪Supremacy≫ armor to Lv7.
21884.descriptionJp:
≪弩岩竜≫の≪天嵐防具≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
オディバトラスを繰り返し
撃退することで
「オディバFXシリーズ」
≪覇種防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

63248.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63248.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
63248.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!
63248.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法が開発されました。
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

58112.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58112.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58112.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58112.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

50659.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
50659.description: Congratulations on reaching HR81! This quest yields weapon materials for Berukyurosu and upgrade materials for the original armor, Korude F Series. Please give it a try!
50659.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on
reaching HR81! This quest
yields weapon materials
for the Dancing Thunder
Wyvern Berukyurosu and
upgrade materials for the
original armor, Korude F
Series. Please give it a
try!
50659.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ８１到達おめでとうござ
います！
このクエストは、舞雷竜≪ベ
ルキュロス≫の武器生産素材
及びオリジナル防具≪コルー
デＦシリーズ≫の強化素材が
入手できます。
ぜひチャレンジしてみてくだ
さい。

26528.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26528.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26528.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26528.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

62932.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
62932.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62932.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62932.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

54763.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
54763.description: A Black Diablos, with black body colour and eyes that shine blue, feared in the streets as being like a reaper, has appeared. Multiple sightings have also been reported. Please hunt it with thorough preparation.
54763.descriptionEn:
A Black Diablos has
appeared, feared in
rumors as "like a grim
reaper" with its black
hide and blue glowing
eyes. Other sightings
are in too. Prepare and slay it.
54763.descriptionJp:
黒い体色に蒼く光る目、
巷では「死神のようだ」と
恐れられる≪黒角竜≫が
現れました。また、
複数の目撃情報も寄せられて
います。十分な準備をもって
対象の討伐をお願いします。

54985.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54985.descriptionEn:
