Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena! Hunt it well and you
shall earn even more rewards
than your daily efforts
bring.
54985.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50378.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50378.description: The existence of a mysterious Khezu has been confirmed in the Snowy Mountains. Everyone who sighted it says with one voice that there was a strange atmosphere, and it is thought to differ from a normal individual.
50378.descriptionEn:
A mysterious Khezu has
been confirmed in the
Snowy Mountains. Every
witness says the same:
"a strange atmosphere."
It's not a normal one.
50378.descriptionJp:
雪山にて謎の≪フルフル≫
の存在が確認されております。
目撃した全員が口を揃えて
「奇妙な雰囲気があった」と
証言しており、通常の個体
とは違うと思われます。

54617.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54617.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54617.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Long Sword, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert! Hunt
it well and you shall earn
even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
54617.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26141.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26141.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26141.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

21334.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種２頭の狩猟

61174.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61174.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61174.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

23633.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23633.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23633.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Long Sword, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert! Hunt
it well and you shall earn
even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
23633.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

23329.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Disufiroa, the Blazing Frozen Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23329.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the blazing
frozen wyvern ≪Disufiroa≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
23329.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、熾凍龍
≪ディスフィロア≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

51113.description: Listen, comrade who loves black. With a black one, it is manners to face it in black equipment. This time's opponent is, of course, black. But rest easy. We are providing the equipment. Also, this time's long sword is a new model. If you like it, I'll help you get one.
51113.descriptionEn:
Listen, comrades who
love black. With the
black ones, black gear
is the proper courtesy.
Today's foe is black
too, of course. But rest
easy: we provide the
gear. And this Long Sword
is new. Clear it and keep it.
51113.descriptionJp:
いいか、黒を愛する同志よ。
黒き者には、黒き装備で相手
するのがマナーというもの。
今回の相手も、もちろん黒。
だが安心したまえ。装備は
こちらで用意している。
また、今回の太刀は新作だ。
気に入ったのなら手に入る
よう、協力するぞ。

62229.objectiveJp: 蒼晶石の欠片１個の納品
62229.description: So you have obtained a fragment of the crystal stone. Please expose that fragment to moonlight. I will prepare a special stone for you.
62229.descriptionEn:
So you've got a Crystal
Shard. Take it out into
the moonlight for me.
I'll prepare a special stone.
62229.descriptionJp:
晶石の欠片を手に入れたんで
すね。その欠片を月明かりに
さらして来て下さい。
特別な石をご用意しますよ。

50896.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50896.description: Odibatorasu seems to be running wild in the desert. It will be dangerous, but please investigate it somehow. The reward is precious decoration material.
50896.descriptionEn:
Odibatorasu seems to be
rampaging in the Desert.
I know it is dangerous, but
please survey it somehow.
The reward is rare decoration
materials.
50896.descriptionJp:
砂漠でオディバトラスが
暴れているようです。
危険かとは思いますが、
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

21918.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21918.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Ebony Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21918.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called Ebony Orb?
Its material is vital for
crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
Clear this request and
I'll give you rare
decoration materials.
21918.descriptionJp:
黒檀原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55995.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55995.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55995.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55995.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

63263.description: I let a Congalala and a Yian Garuga variant loose in the arena. I wanted to test the skill of you master hunters. Hunt them splendidly and I will give you the Hard Species Ticket I hold. Both will rampage merrily, so it will be hard work, but do your best!
63263.descriptionEn:
I turned a Variant
Congalala and a Variant
Yian Garuga loose in the
Arena. I want to test you
ace hunters. Hunt them
both and I'll give you
the Hardcore Ticket I
have. They'll both rage,
so it'll be rough. Do it!
63263.descriptionJp:
闘技場に、桃毛獣と黒狼鳥の
変種を放ったんだ。
あなたたち凄腕ハンターの
腕前を試そうと思ってね。
見事に狩猟できれば、オレが
持ってる剛種チケットを
あげよう。
２頭とも元気に暴れるから
苦労するだろうが頑張れよ！

50337.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス３頭の討伐
50337.description: Gentlemen, did you receive plenty of chocolate? Whether you did or not, you must not forget to give the ladies a sweet present. For the sake of the female hunters waiting for one, let us try!
50337.descriptionEn:
Gentlemen hunters, did
you get lots of
chocolate? Whether you
did or not, never forget
to give the ladies a
sweet present. For the
hunter ladies waiting,
let's try!
50337.descriptionJp:
男性ハンターの諸君、沢山
チョコを貰えましたか？
貰えた方も貰えなかった方も
女性にはスイーツのプレゼン
トを忘れてはいけません。
プレゼントを待っている
女性ハンターの為に、レッツ
トライ！

63142.description: There was a report that 2 Crystal Wyverns, Kuarusepusu, appeared in the desert. Some investigators testify that the ground suddenly began to shake greatly, and though the details are unclear, the situation seems quite dangerous. Please investigate with every precaution.
63142.descriptionEn:
We have reports that 2 Crystal
Wyverns, ≪Kuarlusepusu≫, have
appeared in the Desert. Some of
our surveyors even testify that
the ground suddenly shook hard,
and though details are unclear,
the situation seems quite
dangerous. Please survey with
every precaution taken.
63142.descriptionJp:
晶竜≪クアルセプス≫が
砂漠に２頭現れたとの報告が
ありました。調査員の中には、
突然大地が大きく揺れだした
と証言する者までおり、
詳しくは分かりませんが、
かなり危険な状態のよう
です。万全の態勢で調査を
お願いします。

50943.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50943.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50943.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

58056.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58056.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58056.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58056.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

26052.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
26052.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26052.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26052.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

51033.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
51033.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed for FX
upgrades of Secret Art
Armor (Blademaster),
save for Weapon Souls.
It yields materials for
five pieces. Note that a
Hunter Die White is
required to take it.
51033.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（剣士）のFX強化時
に必要な武器魂を除く素材を
排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターダイス白≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

50910.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
50910.description: Uragaan, the Crushing Wyvern, appears to have shown itself in the volcano. We have asked other hunters to look into it as well, but information is still scarce and much remains unknown. To keep Mezeporuta safe, we ask for an ecological survey.
50910.descriptionEn:
It seems that Uragaan,
the Blast Hammer Wyvern,
has appeared in the Volcano.
We have also issued requests to
other hunters, but information is
still scarce and many points
remain unclear.
To protect the safety of Mezepolta,
please conduct an ecology survey.
50910.descriptionJp:
火山に
爆鎚竜・ウラガンキンが
現れたようです。
他のハンターにも依頼を
出させて頂きましたが
未だ情報が少なく、不明
な点が多くあります。
メゼポルタの安全を守る
為、生態調査をお願いし
ます。

55898.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55898.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55898.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55898.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

60496.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
60496.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Green Plesioth. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60496.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Green Plesioth!
Taking a monster on all
alone is truly a feat!
Overcome yourself and
claim a top placement!
SP weapons only this time!
60496.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ガノトトス亜種≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

62630.description: What is that black shadow covering the Tower, you ask? That is the elder dragon Yama Tsukami. The materials from Yama Tsukami are valuable. Hunters flock up the Tower, but many come back down unable to beat it. If you are confident in your skill, why not try?
62630.descriptionEn:
What's that black shadow
covering the Tower? That is
the Elder Dragon Yama
Tsukami. Its materials are
valuable, you see. Hunters
flock up the Tower, but many
come back down beaten. If
you're confident in your
arm, why not try it too.
62630.descriptionJp:
塔を覆っている
黒い影は何だって？
あれがヤマツカミって古龍さ。
ヤマツカミから取れる素材は
価値があるからな。
ハンターは、こぞって塔に
登っていくが、多くの奴が
敵わずに降りてくるのさ。
腕に自信があるならば、
お前も挑戦してみたらどうだ。

62684.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62684.description: We have prepared a request that issues the tickets needed for Gou quests. A comparatively weak monster appears, so why not join? However, note that it cannot be taken consecutively.
62684.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a request
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
Relatively weak monsters
will appear, so why not come
along and take part?
However, it cannot be taken
in succession, so please
keep that in mind.
62684.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する依頼
を用意いたしました。
比較的弱めのモンスターが
登場しますので、参加
されてはいかがでしょうか。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

60713.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60713.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60713.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60713.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26574.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26574.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26574.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26574.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

54440.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head and torso of Khezu, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54440.descriptionEn:
This quest was prepared
to raise awareness of
the new G Rank Guild
Priority Requests.
Breaking Khezu's head and
torso also earns you
special ingredients.
Give it a try.
54440.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
白影の頭と胴を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54536.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54536.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54536.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

62157.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
62157.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62157.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62157.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55397.description: A Zinogre wrapped in light, standing at the top of the sea of trees. The Guild has decided to call it Zinogre that Roars to the Extreme. Brave hunter. When you drive it off, you shall surely be granted materials for Guild hidden armor.
55397.descriptionEn:
At the summit of the Great Forest
stands a Thunder Wolf Wyvern
wrapped in light.
The Guild has decided to call it
the ≪Acme Roaring Zinogre≫.
Brave hunter.
Once you drive it off, we will
surely grant you materials for
the Guild's treasured armor.
55397.descriptionJp:
樹海の頂部にたたずむ
光に包まれし雷狼竜。
ギルドでは、ヤツの呼称を
「極み吼えるジンオウガ」
とすることにした。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
ヤツを追い払った暁には、
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を
必ず授けよう。

55104.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
55104.description: Slaying a Teostra raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55104.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest
where slaying Teostra
raises your evaluation
and earns you the
materials needed for G
Rank decorations at a
good rate. Please use it.
55104.descriptionJp:
テオ・テスカトルを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

21096.description: Daimyo Hermitaur spends most of its time buried in the sand, you know. If you mean to hunt one, try not to forget that. It's called the Shield Crab for a reason: once it guards itself, it's a nuisance.
21096.descriptionEn:
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ mostly
stays buried in the sand.
Remember that when you hunt
it. It's called the Shield
Crab for a reason; once it
guards up, it's a hassle.
21096.descriptionJp:
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫は
普段砂に潜ってることが多い
わね。狩猟をするなら、忘れ
ないようにするといいわ。
盾蟹と呼ばれるだけあって身
を固められたら面倒よ。

54133.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54133.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54133.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

62298.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟

50499.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Abiorugu. I am counting on you!
50499.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
Heard you hit HR71.
So I've got a favor:
how about a full set of
weapon upgrade
materials as pay?
Easy request, really.
Just run off and slay
an Abiorugu for me!
50499.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の強化素材一式で
どうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってアビオルグを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54884.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
54884.description: This is terrible! The Origin Species Toa Tesukatora has appeared in the Polar Sea! There is no time to gather hunters over the usual period. I will pay more material rewards than usual, so hunters who are ready should depart at once!
54884.descriptionEn:
This is urgent!
An Origin Species Toa
Tesukatora has appeared
in the Polar Sea! We
don't have time to
gather hunters the
usual way. We'll pay
more materials than
usual, so any hunter
ready to go, depart now!
54884.descriptionJp:
大変です！
始種≪トア・テスカトラ≫が
極海に出現しました！
いつものように時間をかけて
ハンターたちを招集している
余裕はありません。
いつもより多めに素材の報酬
をお支払い致しますので、
準備のできているハンターは
すぐに出発してください！

21857.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21857.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Odiba F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21857.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
upgrade materials for
all five pieces of the
Heavenly Storm Armor,
Odiba F Series. Taking
it requires a Speria
Ticket. Note that the
ticket is consumed if
the quest fails.
21857.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
オディバＦシリーズの５部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54302.description: From time to time something like an orb is found inside a monster's body. It can be used as material for all kinds of gear, and demand for it has been rising lately. Clear this request and I will give you one of those orbs, a Peerless Orb, as your reward.
54302.descriptionEn:
Sometimes a gem-like
thing is found inside a
monster's body. It can be
used for all sorts of
gear, and demand has
been rising lately.
Clear this request and
I'll give you one such
gem, the Absolute Gem.
54302.descriptionJp:
モンスターの体の中から、
時折玉のようなものが
見つかることがあるんです。
さまざまな武具の素材に
使うことができるもので、
最近需要が高まっています。
今回の依頼を達成できたら、
その玉のひとつ≪絶玉≫を
報酬として差し上げます。

63264.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63264.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63264.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63264.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

50599.description: Dreams of men swirl in the arms workshop. Among them, the thunder element great sword that applies a machine saw is so packed with dreams that it is even said to harbor the power of sleep! It was lost once at the prototype stage, but a hot dream revives any number of times!
50599.descriptionEn:
The workshop swirls with
men's dreams. The Thunder
Great Sword built on a
machine saw is so full of
dreams it even gained the
power of sleep, or so they
say! It was lost once as a
prototype, but a burning
dream can rise any time!
50599.descriptionJp:
武具工房には男たちの夢が
渦巻いてやがるんだ。中でも、
機械鋸を応用した雷属性大剣
なんて、夢が詰まりすぎて、
ついには睡眠のパワーさえも
宿っちまったってぇ噂だぜ！
一度は試作段階で紛失したが、
熱い夢って奴は、何度だって
よみがえるものなのさ！

61562.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61562.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61562.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

58006.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58006.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58006.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58006.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

63269.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63269.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63269.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63269.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

26275.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Blaststone. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
26275.descriptionEn:
The Popular Tavern Guild has
placed a large order for
Firestones.
Eight is not a number that one
hunter can deliver alone,
so we recommend accepting it
with at least two people.
Note that sub-clears give no supplies.
26275.descriptionJp:
大衆酒場ギルドより、火薬岩
の大口注文が入りました。
８個という数は、１人で取り
きって納品できる数ではない
ので、少なくとも２人以上で
の受注をオススメいたします。
尚、サブ達成による支給品は
ありませんので、要注意です。

60306.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟

54899.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
54899.description: We continue the investigation of Doragyurosu. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54899.descriptionEn:
We're continuing the
survey of Doragyurosu.
Breaking parts isn't
required, but we'd be
delighted if you did!
Hunters, thank you in
advance for your help!
54899.descriptionJp:
ドラギュロスの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

23370.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
23370.description: There was a report that a blue Hypnocatrice appeared in the sea of trees. However, it is wrapped in more allure than usual, and as if luring us, it attacks while dancing, they say. Without being swayed by this Hypnocatrice's allure, please investigate its ecology and hunt it.
23370.descriptionEn:
We have reports of an azure
Hypnocatrice in the Great
Forest. It is said to be
more alluring than usual,
dancing as it attacks as if
to lure us. Do not be
swayed; survey it and hunt it.
23370.descriptionJp:
樹海に蒼い眠鳥が登場した
との報告がありました。
ただ、いつも以上に色気を
纏っており、こちらを誘惑
しているのか、踊りながら
襲ってくるそうです。
この眠鳥の色気に惑わされ
ず、生態の調査と狩猟をお
願いします。

50159.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

51058.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Slaying a Kirin will also grant a special ingredient.
51058.descriptionEn:
To promote the Guild
Priority Requests we have
long held, we prepared this
quest. Slaying the Kirin
also grants you a special
ingredient.
51058.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
幻獣を討伐することで特別な
食材も付与させていただきま
す。

22140.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
22140.description: Do you have enough armor upgrade materials? On this quest, which I present to you today, you can obtain great quantities of the Sharp Armor Sphere and Firm Armor Sphere used to upgrade armor. However, please note that the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited.
22140.descriptionEn:
Are you short on armor upgrade
materials?
This request, introduced today, lets you
obtain large amounts of ≪Armor Sphere++≫
and ≪Hard Armor Sphere≫ used for
armor upgrades.
However, there is a limit to how many
times you can accept it per day,
so please be careful.
22140.descriptionJp:
防具の強化素材は足りていま
すか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
防具の強化に使用する
≪尖鎧玉≫と≪堅鎧玉≫を
大量に獲得できますよ。
ただし、１日に受注できる数
に限りがありますので、
ご注意ください。

62891.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62891.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62891.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

21865.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Artela FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21865.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
upgrade materials for
all five pieces of the
Zenith Armor, Altera FX
Series. Taking it
requires a Speria Ticket.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if the quest
fails.
21865.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
アルテラFXシリーズの５部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54458.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
54458.description: We will continue the survey of the Forokururu that appeared in the Flower Field. Breaking its parts is not required, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, we thank you for your help!
54458.descriptionEn:
We're continuing the
survey of the Forokururu
that appeared in the
Flower Field. Breaking
parts isn't required, but
we'd be delighted if you
did! Hunters, thanks!
54458.descriptionJp:
花畑に現れたフォロクルルの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

40178.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40178.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40178.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

21144.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

50552.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50552.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters appearing are increasing. The guild, preparing for this, is promoting the spread of Heavenstorm armor, and the reward for this request lets you obtain the precious materials needed for that gear. Hunters, please do not miss this chance.
50552.descriptionEn:
Reports of extremely
powerful monsters are
on the rise. The Guild
is promoting Heavenly
Storm Armor to prepare,
and this request's
rewards include the rare
materials that gear needs.
Hunters, don't miss out!
50552.descriptionJp:
非常に強力なモンスターの
出現報告が増えている。
ギルドは、これに備え
≪天嵐防具≫の普及を進めて
いるが、この依頼の報酬では、
その武具に必要となる貴重な
素材も入手できるぞ。
ハンター諸君は、是非この
機会を逃さないでほしい。

58018.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58018.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58018.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58018.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60680.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Gougarf. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60680.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
the Special Individual
Gougarufu!
Clear it together with
your guildmates. This
contest is all about
teamwork, so take a top
spot! Supremacy weapons only!
60680.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
特異個体の
≪ゴウガルフ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！今回は辿異武器限定で
開催されているぞ！

23380.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
23380.description: Gasurabazura has appeared at White Lake. Reports describe it as a highly dangerous monster with a talent for poison attacks. We ask for your help with the survey. The Carapaceon found at White Lake as well appears to launch poison attacks of its own. Take great care!
23380.descriptionEn:
A ≪Gasurabazura≫ has
appeared at White Lake.
Reports say it is a very
dangerous monster skilled
in poison attacks. Please
help us survey it. The
Carapaceon at White Lake
also uses poison, it seems.
Take great care!
23380.descriptionJp:
白湖に≪ガスラバズラ≫が現
れました。報告によれば毒に
よる攻撃を得意とする非常に
危険なモンスターとのこと。
調査の協力をお願いします。
また、同じく白湖にいる
甲殻種ですが、こちらも毒に
よる攻撃を仕掛けてくるよう
です。十分に注意してくださ
い！

23241.description: There was a report that Espinas seems to have taken up residence in the sea of trees in an unsurveyed region. We proceeded with the survey so as not to wake the Espinas, but from a certain point it began attacking us. We ask for your help as guards.
23241.descriptionEn:
We have reports that
Espinas seems to have
taken up residence in
the Great Forest of an
unexplored region. We
surveyed quietly so as
not to wake it, but from
one day on, it began to
attack us. Please escort us.
23241.descriptionJp:
未調査地域にある樹海に、
エスピナスが住みついている
ようだと報告がありました。
エスピナスを起こさないよう
調査を進めていたのですが、
あるときを境に、我々に
攻撃をしてくるようになった
のです。護衛のため、
協力を頼みます。

58069.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58069.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58069.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58069.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

1003.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
1003.description: Hunt the 1 blue hunter, Velocidrome, that uses the Jungle as its feeding ground for me! It is just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt! In this season there are fewer Velociprey minions, so it should be easy to hunt!
1003.descriptionEn:
Hunt one Velocidrome, the
blue hunter that feeds in
the Jungle! He's just the
right foe to measure a
hunter's skill! Fewer
Velociprey minions this
season, so he's easier!
1003.descriptionJp:
密林をエサ場とする、青き
狩人≪ドスランポス≫１頭
を狩猟してくれよ！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度いい相手だ！
この季節なら子分のランポス
も少なく狩りやすいハズだ！

54095.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54095.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee! I wish you good fortune!
54095.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Use all of your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
Complete this request splendidly
and you will earn an exceptional
reward! I wish you good fortune!
54095.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られるぞ！
健闘を祈る！

23690.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23690.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Tonfa, show the skill you
have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena! Hunt it well and you
shall earn even more rewards
than your daily efforts
bring.
23690.descriptionJp:
穿龍棍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

60570.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Meraginasu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60570.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Meraginasu!
Clear it together with
your guildmates. This
contest is all about
teamwork, so claim a top
placement! Origin Species
weapons only this time!
60570.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪メラギナス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

63348.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63348.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63348.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63348.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

62878.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62878.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62878.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

50261.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Soul (Beginning) x８５, Bow Soul (Middle) x１９５, Bow Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Bow Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50261.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Bow Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Bow Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Bow Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Bow Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please note.
50261.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪弓魂・序≫８５枚
≪弓魂・中≫１９５枚
≪弓魂・極≫２７５枚
≪弓魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

26732.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

50545.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Lunastra. I am counting on you!
50545.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
Heard you hit HR22.
So I've got a favor:
how about a full set of
weapon materials as pay?
Easy request, really.
Just run off and slay
Lunastra for me!
I'm counting on you!
50545.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ２２になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってナナ・テスカトリ
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

22164.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
22164.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed for F strengthening of
Secret Art Armor (Blademaster),
except for Weapon Souls.
The yield covers 5 pieces.
To accept the quest you need
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫, so please
take care.
22164.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（剣士）のＦ強化時
に必要な武器魂を除く素材を
排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

63117.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
63117.description: Rukodiora, the Ultimate Dragon, appears to have shown itself in the desert. Unlike the interception base, there are no facilities there to oppose it, so I want a hunter confident in their skill to slay it. Even in the cold season, the desert is very hot by day. I am counting on you!
63117.descriptionEn:
Rukodiora, the Extreme Dragon, has
apparently appeared in the Desert.
Unlike the Base, there are no facilities
to counter it, but I would like to ask
a hunter confident in their skill to
slay it.
Though it is the cold season, the
Desert at midday is very hot.
I am counting on you!
63117.descriptionJp:
砂漠に極龍≪ルコディオラ≫
が現れたそうだ。
迎撃拠点と違い対抗する為の
設備はないが、そこは腕に
自信のあるハンターに討伐を
お願いしたい。
寒冷期とはいえ、昼の砂漠は
とても熱い。
よろしく頼んだぞ！

54172.description: For the survey, please hunt a Rajang. This investigation focuses chiefly on the head, where great changes are seen when it is enraged. Be sure to break it before you hunt. I leave it in your hands.
54172.descriptionEn:
For the survey, please
hunt the Rajang. This
survey focuses on the
head, where big changes
show when it's enraged.
Be sure to break the head
before you slay it.
Thank you.
54172.descriptionJp:
調査のために、ラージャンの
狩猟をお願いします。
今回の調査では主に、興奮時
に大きな変化が見られる、
頭部の調査となっています。
必ず破壊してから狩猟する
ようにしてください。
よろしくお願いします。

55877.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55877.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55877.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
to craft one Supremacy
weapon from the Supremacy
Daimyo Hermitaur and upgrade
it once, plus Porta Cards
Sakura worth Gz. Weapon
types: Dual Blades, Hunting
Horn, Switch Axe, Light
Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun or Bow.
Use it to craft your favorite.
55877.descriptionJp:
辿異種ダイミョウザザミの
辿異武器１つの生産から
１段階目の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、狩猟笛、
剣斧、軽弩、重弩、弓の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

23522.description: The Variant Species Rathalos has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23522.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Rathalos≫ has
grown fiercely strong and keeps
rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as
things stand. Prepare fully and
carry out the survey.
23522.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪リオレウス≫は猛
烈な強さとなり、暴れ続けて
います。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

28031.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Gogomoa materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28031.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters, won't
you pass your hunting
skill on to the young
hunters of your guild?
This time we're splurging
on Leaping Scarlet Beast
materials! Grow stronger
together and liven up
your guild. Clear it both
with and without the tome!
28031.descriptionJp:
熟練ハンターの皆さん。
その狩猟技術を猟団の若い
ハンターへ伝えてみません
か？今回は、≪跳緋獣≫の
素材を大奮発！一緒に強く
なって、猟団を盛り上げて
いってください。秘伝書所持、
未所持のハンターで達成する
と、ギルドからの評価が
より得られますよ。

21772.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
21772.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21772.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21772.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

26702.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Snowy Mountains, hunt 2 Bulldrome and the Blangonga's underlings. Then raise the guild flag from the supply box at the summit. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
26702.descriptionEn:
This time we hold special
training limited to hunters who
still have little experience!
In the Snowy Mountains, hunt two
great boars and the Snow Lion's
minions. Then plant the Guild
Flag from the supply box at the
summit.
It is harsh training, but once you
see it through, your standing as a
hunter will rise sharply!
26702.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！雪山で２頭の大猪と、
雪獅子の子分達の狩猟。そし
て、支給品ボックスのギルド
フラッグを山頂に立てるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

54820.description: Amid a violent thunderstorm, a Toridokuresu was sighted in the Highlands. We learned of it too late and there is no time to spare, but if you bring it down, you will receive a greater reward than usual!
54820.descriptionEn:
Under a fierce
thunderstorm, a Shining
Thunderbird was spotted
in the Highlands. We
found it late, so time
is short, but slay it
and the pay will top the usual!
54820.descriptionJp:
激しい雷雨が降り注ぐ中、
高地に≪照雷鳥≫が
目撃されました。発見が
遅れたため、猶予のない
状況ですが、見事狩猟
いただけましたら、通常より
多くの報酬をお渡しします！

21592.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Shark Mouth Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21592.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Sharkmouth Orb?
Its material is vital for
crafting a certain costly
talisman.
Complete this request and
I shall give you rare
talisman materials.
21592.descriptionJp:
鮫口原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

62425.description: It is I, the Instructor! Today's task is the survey of Tide Island! For the sake of my cheerful southern life, survey with vigor! If you do your job properly, I will present you with a splendid thing I obtained (picked up)! Now! Let us live the southern life!
62425.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
Survey Tidal Island!
For my fun southern life,
get out there and survey!
Do the job properly and
the treasure I got (found)
shall be your present!
Now! Let's go tropical!
62425.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ！教官だ！
今回の任務は潮島の調査！
吾輩のウキウキ南国生活の為、
気合を入れて調査してこい！
ちゃーんと仕事をすれば、
吾輩が手に入れた（拾った）
ステキなアイツをプレゼント！
さあ！レッツ南国ライフ！

61453.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
61453.description: This is a request to drive off a giant Lunastra. I would like it slain quickly, but if that is difficult, driving it off alone will do. As this is a special request, please present proof of sufficient skill when accepting it. Also, depending on the situation, proof of the kill may not be issued.
61453.descriptionEn:
This is a request to repel a
giant Lunastra. We would like
it slain in a short time, but
if that is too hard, repelling
it alone is fine. As this is a
special request, you must show
proof of ample skill to accept.
Also, depending on the
situation, no slay proof may be issued.
61453.descriptionJp:
巨大な炎妃龍の撃退依頼です。
短時間での討伐をお願いした
いのですが、難しい場合、
撃退のみでも結構です。
特別な依頼のため、受注する
場合には十分な腕前の証の
提示をお願いします。また、
状況により討伐の証を発行
できない場合もあります。

23323.description: While conducting an ecological survey in the sea of trees, I heard strange voices. That must be the voice of a Hypnocatrice, but no sighting report has come from that area yet. So I want you to investigate on site.
23323.descriptionEn:
While surveying in the Great
Forest, I heard a strange
cry. It must have been a
≪Hypnocatrice≫, but no
sightings have come from
that area yet. So I ask you
to survey the site for us.
23323.descriptionJp:
樹海にて生態調査を行ってい
たところ、奇妙な声が聞こえ
て来た。
あれは≪ヒプノック≫の声に
違いないのだが、あの辺りで
の目撃報告はまだ来ていな
いんだ。
そこで君たちに現地での調査
をお願いしたい。

55006.description: There is a report that a powerful Chameleos has appeared in the Jungle. It is said to differ in appearance from previous individuals, and a swift investigation is needed. For hunters aiming to craft or upgrade G-rank arms, we have a fitting reward ready, so please investigate.
55006.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Chameleos≫ has
been reported in the Jungle.
It differs from past ones,
so an urgent survey is
needed. For hunters who
seek G Rank gear, we have
fitting rewards prepared, so
please take up this survey.
55006.descriptionJp:
密林にて強力な≪霞龍≫が出
現したとの報告がありました。
かつての個体とは様相が違う
とのことで、早急に調査が必
要です。Ｇ級武具の生産や強
化を目指すハンターには相応
の報酬を用意していますので、
ぜひとも調査をお願いします。

60920.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲

50626.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
50626.description: Lately an unexplained situation has arisen in the highlands. There was a report that herbivores are decreasing in one area. When we went to investigate, strange sounds rang out from nowhere, and the investigator fled in fear. Please investigate at once.
50626.descriptionEn:
Lately, unexplained events
have been happening in the
Highlands. Herbivores are
said to be declining in one
area. Our surveyors went,
heard a strange sound from
nowhere and fled in fear.
Please begin a survey at once.
50626.descriptionJp:
最近、高地にて原因不明の
事態が発生しています。
ある一部の地域で草食種が
減少しているという報告があ
りました。
調査に赴いたところ、どこか
らともなく不思議な音が鳴り
響き、調査員は怖くて退避し
たそうです。
直ちに調査をお願いします。

21358.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Swamp, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Wetland, the Voice of Nature: Downpour, or the Voice of Nature: Lakeside. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
21358.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. By completing this
request set in the ≪Swamp≫,
you may obtain ≪Voice of
Nature: Marsh≫, ≪Voice of
Nature: Downpour≫ or ≪Voice
of Nature: Lakeside≫. May
your hunting life be fuller.
21358.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪沼地≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・湿地≫や
≪大自然の声・豪雨≫、
≪大自然の声・湖畔≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

53212.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐

55938.description: 2 enraged beasts have appeared at the ancient ruins, and their fierce fire and lightning are spreading damage around. Hunters, slay them at once. Should you succeed, I will give you Sigil materials long kept in the Guild's vaults.
55938.descriptionEn:
Two raging beasts appeared
at the Ruins, and fire and
thunder spread havoc.
Hunters, we ask you to
slay them at once.
On success, we shall grant
Sigil materials long kept
in the Guild's vaults.
55938.descriptionJp:
古跡に怒れる２頭の獣が現れ
激しい炎と雷で周囲に被害が
広がっています。
ハンターの方は、至急討伐を
お願いします。
討伐に成功した暁には古く
からギルドで蔵されてきた
シジルの素材を差し上げます。

11078.description: Hermitaur buried in the sand burst out suddenly. Running around is dangerous, so be careful! They faint when startled by loud noises, so do not forget to bring Sonic Bombs!
11078.descriptionEn:
The Yaozami that lurk in the
sand will burst out without
warning. Running around is
dangerous, so please be careful!
Loud noises stun them, so do not
forget to bring Sonic Bombs
along with you!
11078.descriptionJp:
砂に潜っている≪ヤオザミ≫は
突然飛び出してきます。
走り回っていると危ないので
気をつけてくださいね！
大きな音にびっくりして気絶
するので≪音爆弾≫を忘れずに
もって行ってくださいね！

54154.description: We are recruiting hunters to hunt the Giaorugu raging in the extreme cold sea! If hunting it is difficult, you may slay the Pokara and return, no problem.
54154.descriptionEn:
We seek hunters to hunt the
Giaorugu rampaging in the
Polar Sea!
If the hunt proves too hard,
slaying Pokara and
returning is fine.
54154.descriptionJp:
極海で暴れまわる氷獰竜を狩
猟していただけるハンターを
募集中です！
狩猟が難しい場合はポカラを
討伐してご帰還いただいて
も問題ございません。

61724.description: It seems you managed a hunt focused on defense, working together with your comrades. So I have prepared a follow-up request that will make you want to set out with them again. If you clear this one splendidly too, I will give you this Large Gem.
61724.descriptionEn:
It seems you fought with
allies and focused on defense.
So I have prepared a follow-up
request to make you want to
set out with them again.
Clear it well and I will give
you this Large Gem.
61724.descriptionJp:
仲間と力を合わせて、防御を
中心とした狩猟をすることが
できたみたいだな。
そこで、また仲間とともに出
発したくなる、続きの依頼を
用意したぞ。
今回も見事に依頼を達成した
ら、この大宝玉を差し上げよ
う。

26533.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26533.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26533.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26533.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

50542.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50542.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! A Super Golden Experience request has appeared, a further boost to the rewards of the Golden Experience, which lets you build experience efficiently and obtain large amounts of zenny. Do take the chance to try it!
50542.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice to hunters!
A 'Super Golden Trial'
request is now available,
boosting the rewards of
'Golden Trial' for fast
experience and tons of
Zenny and more.
Please take the challenge
while you can!
50542.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
ことができ、大量のゼニー
などを入手できる
「黄金体験」の報酬をさらに
強化した「超・黄金体験」の
依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

56113.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56113.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56113.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

50941.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
50941.description: Armor produced from Vojan materials carries a skill value called Submission. So we have specially lent out Vojan armor and prepared a request where you can experience Submission and the slaying of a Vojan! If you slay it splendidly we will issue more proof of the kill than usual!
50941.descriptionEn:
Armor made from Vorjan
materials carries the
'Submission' skill.
So we will lend you
Vorjan armor to try
'Submission' and a Vorjan
slaying quest!
Slay it well and we'll
issue more Slay Proofs
than usual!
50941.descriptionJp:
ヴォージャンの素材から生産
できる防具は「雌伏」という
スキル値を持っています。
そこで、特別にヴォージャン
防具を貸与し、「雌伏」と
ヴォージャン討伐を体験でき
る依頼をご用意しました！
見事に討伐できたら討伐の証
を普段よりも多めに発行いた
します！

12006.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku. The pink hide is its trademark, but this one is reported to be blue. A subspecies, no doubt.
12006.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird-like
cry in this Jungle, it is surely
the Yian Kut-Ku ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫.
Speaking of Yian Kut-Ku, pink is
its signature color, but this one
is reported to have a blue body?
It must be a subspecies.
12006.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね。
イャンクックといえばピンク
の体色が象徴だけれど、今回
は青い体と報告されてるわ？
亜種に間違いないようね。

21186.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21186.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21186.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54221.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
54221.description: We will continue the survey of the Revidiora that appeared at the interception base. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54221.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Rukodiora that appeared
at the Base.
Breaking parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you do!
Hunters, we ask for your
kind cooperation!
54221.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に出現した
レビディオラの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

54944.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Ribbon (Beginning) x100, Heavy Bowgun Ribbon (Middle) x165, Heavy Bowgun Ribbon (Extreme) x165. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54944.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪H Bowgun Cord: Intro≫ x100
≪H Bowgun Cord: Mid≫ x165
≪H Bowgun Cord: Extreme≫ x165
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Art Cord Crystal≫ is
required, so please note.
54944.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｈボウガン綬・序≫100個
≪Ｈボウガン綬・中≫165個
≪Ｈボウガン綬・極≫165個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

54230.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
54230.description: We ask you to investigate the pack of Velociprey living in the Jungle. The pack seems to have 2 bosses, and they are fighting over territory. Would you go and see this for yourself for our survey? Hunters, we ask for your help.
54230.descriptionEn:
Please survey the pack of
Velociprey in the Jungle.
The pack seems to have
two leaders, and they
fight over territory.
Please go and see it
for yourself?
Hunters, we ask for
your cooperation.
54230.descriptionJp:
密林に住むランポスの群れの
調査をお願いいたします。
群れのボスはどうやら２頭
いるようで、縄張りを賭け
争っているようです。
調査のため実際にその様子を
みてきてくれませんか？
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願いいたします。

21333.description: What, you just want a hard Bow? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21333.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really
tough bow? Then I'll refine
some Argen Steel for you!
But the ore is hard to find,
and nasty monsters prowl
around. Go find it with spirit!
21333.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬い弓が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

23440.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23440.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hunting Horn Merit (Beginning) x５０, Hunting Horn Merit (Middle) x６０, Hunting Horn Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23440.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Hunting Horn Medal: Intro≫ x50
≪Hunting Horn Medal: Mid≫ x60
≪Hunting Horn Medal: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or above, so
please be careful.
23440.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪狩猟笛勲・序≫５０個
≪狩猟笛勲・中≫６０個
≪狩猟笛勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

21591.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21591.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Whale Tide Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21591.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Whalestide Orb?
Its material is vital for
crafting a certain costly
talisman.
Complete this request and
I shall give you rare
talisman materials.
21591.descriptionJp:
鯨潮原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

22161.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22161.description: Do you like Guku? In this job I am introducing today, an item that can transform Guku into a surprising form is being distributed. Interested now, right? However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
22161.descriptionEn:
Do you like Gooks? In the
request we present today, an
item that turns a Gook into
an amazing form is being
handed out. Curious now,
right? Note that you cannot
accept it twice in a row.
22161.descriptionJp:
グークのことが好きですか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
グークを驚きの姿に大変身
させることができるアイテム
が配られているようです。
興味出てきましたよね？
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

28055.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
28055.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28055.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
28055.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

61442.description: Hypnocatrice and Cephadrome are breeding in great numbers! We have asked hunters from every region for help, but the truth is there are simply too many. So we are looking for hunters willing to take this hunt with 2 hunters at most. Those aiming to rank up quickly are especially encouraged.
61442.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and Cephadrome
are breeding out of control!
We asked hunters everywhere
for aid, but there are simply
too many. So we seek those
who can take this hunt with
two people. Fast rank-ups
are especially welcome.
61442.descriptionJp:
眠鳥と砂竜が大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

53008.description: I've developed a new hammer, but the structure has become a bit complicated, so would you test its strength for me? I've chosen armor to match the weapon, so no worries! Full of skills, and it looks good too! Wear it without hesitation!
53008.descriptionEn:
I developed a new Hammer, but
the structure came out a bit
complex, so would you go test
its strength for me? I picked
armor to match the weapon, so
no worries!
Full of skills and good looking!
Wear it without holding back!
53008.descriptionJp:
新しいハンマーを開発したん
だが、ちょっと構造が複雑に
なっちまったんで、強度を試
して来てくれねえか？武器に
合わせて防具もチョイスして
あるから心配いらねえ！
スキル満載、見た目も良し！
遠慮せず着て行け！

53318.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
53318.description: I am a collector of equipment. Weapons and armor shine only when used. A mere pretty piece has no meaning. Do you not think so? I will lend you arms from my collection that shaped an era, so slay with them. If you need a helping hand, try clearing the sub-target.
53318.descriptionEn:
I collect equipment.
Gear shines only in use.
A mere showpiece is void.
Don't you agree?
From my collection I
shall lend you gear that
defined an era, so use
it to slay the target.
If you need help, try
clearing the subquest.
53318.descriptionJp:
私は装備コレクター。
武具は使われてこそ輝く。
ただの美品に意味は無い。
そうは思わないかね？
私のコレクションから
一時代を築いた武具を
お貸しするので、これで
討伐して頂きたい。
助力が必要なら、サブター
ゲットをクリアしてみてくれ。

55462.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐
55462.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make armor from the heavenly revolving dragon Shagaru Magala! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain materials needed to upgrade Transcendence Armor, so please give it a try!
55462.descriptionEn:
A special quest for those
who want ≪Shagaru Magala≫
armor is now ready!
Clear the subquest to
get materials needed to
upgrade Migration armor!
Please give it a try!
55462.descriptionJp:
天廻龍≪シャガルマガラ≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを用意
しました！サブターゲットを
達成すると遷悠防具の強化に
必要な素材を入手できます
ので、ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

63407.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
63407.description: A challenge from the Dark Felyne Guild to you hunters, nya! Find the boss of the pack in the Snowy Mountains in a short time and hunt it, nya! If you manage it splendidly, I'll give you the Dark Felyne Guild Badge, our very soul, nya!
63407.descriptionEn:
Hunters, we bring you
a challenge from us, nya!
Find the pack boss in the
Snowy Mountains fast,
then hunt it, nya!
If you pull it off,
we'll give you our soul,
the ≪Dark Cat Badge≫!
Take it, nya!
63407.descriptionJp:
お前らハンターたちに、
闇猫団から挑戦状ニャ！
雪山にいる群れのボスを、
短時間で見つけ出し、
狩猟してみせるニャ！
見事達成することができたら、
オイラたちの魂である
≪闇猫団バッチ≫を
くれてやるニャ！

61168.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61168.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61168.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

63177.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63177.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63177.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63177.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

53262.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
53262.description: I love Raviente. Its sharp, tough scales fill me with longing, but my companions do not understand. They go so far as to say the shell of the fortress crab is tougher. Wear the armor I have prepared and repel Shen Gaoren. Show my companions how wonderful Raviente is!
53262.descriptionEn:
I adore Laviente.
Its sharp, stout scales fill me
with longing, but my comrades
don't understand. They even say
things like the Shen Gaoren's
shell is tougher.
Wear the armor I have prepared
and drive off the Shen Gaoren.
Show my comrades Laviente's glory!
53262.descriptionJp:
私はラヴィエンテが大好きだ。
鋭く強靭な鱗には憧憬を覚え
るが、仲間は理解してくれん。
強靭さなら砦蟹の甲殻の方が
などと言い出す始末。
私が用意した防具を身に着け、
砦蟹を撃退して欲しい。
仲間たちにラヴィエンテの
素晴らしさを見せてくれ！

54524.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟

21459.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
21459.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Diablos. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21459.descriptionEn:
This is the counter for the
Hunt Technique Quest to slay
a ≪Diablos≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
other hunters here!
21459.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ディアブロス≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

55336.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55336.description: An Akura Vashimu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. It is dangerous, so take the quest with 4 people and face it fully prepared. If you do go with 4, I promise the Crystal Resistance skill will activate.
55336.descriptionEn:
A ≪Taikun Zamuza≫ with
a huge tail has appeared.
It is dangerous, so
take the quest with four
and go fully prepared.
If you go with four, we
promise the ≪Crystal Res≫
skill will activate.
55336.descriptionJp:
尾が大きく発達した
≪尾晶蠍≫が現れました。
危険ですので、４人で
クエストを受注し、万全な
態勢で臨んで下さい。
４人で臨まれるようであれば、
スキル≪結晶耐性≫
の発動を約束します。

55634.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55634.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55634.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

26522.description: 1 pair of Rathalos was sighted in the Canyon. For an ecological survey, please hunt both. We will take most of the Rathalos materials, but we will pay out some unneeded parts and Canyon specialties as a reward.
26522.descriptionEn:
A pair of Rathalos was sighted
in the Canyon. To survey their
ecology, please hunt both.
We will take most of the
Rathalos materials, but we'll
offer some unneeded parts and
Canyon specialties as
your reward.
26522.descriptionJp:
峡谷で、１対の火竜が目撃さ
れました。生態調査のため、
両方の狩猟をお願いします。
火竜素材の多くはこちらで
引き取らせていただきますが、
一部必要の無い部位や、
峡谷特産品を報酬に出させて
いただきます。

55986.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55986.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55986.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

53298.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
53298.description: Nngh! Build it up, build it up! And let it fly! This exhilaration! The hammer is the supreme weapon! One who can land attacks neatly even on small foes is a true hammer master. Now, let us try slaying the B rank Dyuragaua that appeared at the tower!
53298.descriptionEn:
Nngh! Charge it up, more!
Let it fly! What a rush!
The Hammer is the finest!
One who can hit even small
foes with precision is a
true Hammer Master.
Now, let's take on the
B-rank Duramboros that
showed up at the Tower!
53298.descriptionJp:
ん〜っ！溜めて溜めて〜！
ぶっ放す！この爽快感！
鎚こそ至高の武器だぜ！
小さき相手にも器用に攻撃を
当てることができる者こそ、
真の鎚マスターだぜ。
さあ、塔に現れた
ｂ級デュラガウアの討伐に
挑戦しようぜ！

54958.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54958.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54958.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Switch Axe, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert! Hunt
it well and you shall earn
even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
54958.descriptionJp:
剣斧を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

54497.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54497.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54497.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

23415.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Zerureusu, the Radiant World Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23415.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Radiant Dragon ≪Zerureusu≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.
23415.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、輝界竜
≪ゼルレウス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55848.description: The Variant Species Baruragaru has appeared once more. The menace of its developed head is dreadful, and its blood drinking with the tongue seems to have grown more vicious. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55848.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Baruragaru≫ has
appeared again. The menace of
its developed head is
tremendous, and its
blood-draining tongue seems
more vicious. Survey with care.
55848.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪バルラガル≫が再び
現れました。
発達した頭部の威圧感は
凄まじく、舌による吸血行動
はより凶悪になっている様で
す。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

26337.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26337.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26337.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26337.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62168.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62168.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62168.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

54243.description: That mischievous Jack who tried to kidnap me and failed! Scold him and scold him and he still misbehaves! He never learns, that Jack! Scold him again and again! And monsters are scary too! Hunt them for me!
54243.descriptionEn:
That cheeky Jack who tried
to kidnap me and failed!
No matter how often I
punish him, he misbehaves!
He never learns, Jack!
Punish him again and again!
Also, monsters are scary!
Slay them for me!
54243.descriptionJp:
この私を誘拐しようとして
失敗したお茶目なジャック！
とっちめてもとっちめても
何度でもおイタをする！
懲りない奴だジャック！
何度でもとっちめてくれ！
ついでにモンスターも怖い！
討伐してくれ！

21643.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21643.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Blangonga and Congalala, the pride of the Fanged Beasts. Is there a hunter who can hunt two of these fanged beasts at once, when even one is utter hardship!? Even a full-fledged hunter can lose their life to a moment's carelessness!
21643.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
off their skill! Here, the finest
Fanged Beasts: Blangonga and
Congalala. Does a hunter exist
who can hunt these two at once,
each a trial on its own!? Even a
full-fledged hunter can lose
their life to a moment's lapse!
21643.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！牙獣種を代表する
ドドブランゴとババコンガ。
１頭でも困難を極めるこの牙獣
を２頭同時に狩猟できる狩人が
果して存在するのか！？一人前
のハンターであっても一瞬の気
の緩みが命取りになるぞ！

50409.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

61703.description: Hey, hunter. Lately the Hunters Guild is said to be recruiting hunters to capture a Gravios in the arena. The condition is to be equipped with a Light Bowgun or Heavy Bowgun. Of course you will join?
61703.descriptionEn:
Excuse me, hunter. I hear the
Hunters Guild is looking for
hunters to capture a
≪Gravios≫ in the Arena. The
condition is a Light or Heavy
Bowgun. Of course you'll
join, right?
61703.descriptionJp:
ちょっとそこのハンターさん。
最近、ハンターズギルドが闘
技場で≪グラビモス≫を捕獲
するハンターを募集している
らしいの。
参加条件はライトボウガンか
ヘビィボウガンを装備してい
ることらしいわ。
当然、参加するよね？

53310.description: This is bad, this is bad! My Baretta collection has been stolen! That Rathalos took part of the collection! Give me a break! I will share a few materials with you at least! Get it back for me! Please!
53310.descriptionEn:
This is bad, so bad!
My Barretta collection
got stolen! That Rathalos
took a chunk of my
collection with him!
Please, have mercy!
I'll share some materials,
just a little!
Get it back! I'm begging!
53310.descriptionJp:
ヤバイよヤバイよ！
集めたバレッタコレクション
が奪われちまったよ！リオレ
ウスの野郎はコレクションの
一部をもっていきやがったよ！
勘弁してくださいよー！
素材だけならちょっとわけて
あげるから！
奪い返してくれよ！頼むよ！

63351.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63351.description: A Rathian has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the hammer, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63351.descriptionEn:
In the New Great Arena we
loosed a ≪Rathian≫ that
acts in unthinkable ways.
Hammer hunters striving
for mastery, show me your
skill here and now!
Hunt it well, and you
shall gain far more than
daily effort could ever
bring you.
63351.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪雌火竜≫を放ってある。
鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

51043.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51043.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Berukyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
51043.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Duramboros' head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51043.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
氷狐竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

23308.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟

55824.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55824.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55824.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

1034.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

26037.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
26037.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26037.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26037.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

53297.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の討伐
53297.description: Guk gwagg gwa! Gyaa gyaa guk gwa! Gugugwaa! Gwa gwa! (It seems to be saying: become one with the Guku, take the Gyaa Gyaa Guku, and try slaying an Iodrome.)
53297.descriptionEn:
Gook gwa ggwa!
Gyaa gyaa gook gwa!
Gugugwaa! Gwa gwa!
(I feel like the Gook is
asking you to take the
Gyaa Gyaa Gook and slay
a Gendrome... or so it
seems to me.)
53297.descriptionJp:
グークグァッググァ！
ギャアギャアグークグァッ！
グググァァ！グァッグァッ！
（グークの気持ちになって、
ギャアギャアグークを持ち、
ドスイーオスを討伐して
みてほしいと言っているよう
な気がします）

50582.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and you will obtain food ingredients useful in the hunt.
50582.descriptionEn:
A special request and
rewards for members of a
winning Hunter Festival
guild. When accepting or
joining, bring a Festival
Proof. Clear this request
