逃げ込む可能性があるの。
逃さないのが上手い方法ね。

51108.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51108.description: To take this quest you need a Hunter Ring (Blue), nya. Take on the hunt for a Bulldrome holding more Song Gems than usual, nya. Choose a Prayer Gem, clear this quest and offer the Song Gems, nya!
51108.descriptionEn:
To take this quest you
need the 'Hunter Ring
Blue,' nya.
Hunt a Bulldrome holding
more Song Orbs than
usual, nya.
Pick a Prayer Orb, clear
this quest, offer the orbs!
51108.descriptionJp:
このクエストを受けるには
「ハンターリング青」が
必要ニャ。
通常よりも多くの歌玉を秘め
たドスファンゴの狩猟に挑戦
するニャ。
祈珠を選んでこのクエストを
クリアし、歌玉を捧げるニャ！

62846.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・一章１個の納品

54368.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
54368.description: A Resounding Wolf seems to have been found in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. It could hinder the survey, so please head out to hunt it. Another hunter will draw off the male Resounding Wolf, so you take the female.
54368.descriptionEn:
A Howling Wolf seems to have been
found in an unsurveyed part of
the Swamp.
It could become an obstacle to our
survey, so please head out and hunt it.
The male will be kept occupied by
another hunter, so we ask you
to take care of the female.
Thank you for your cooperation.
54368.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域で
響狼が発見されたようです。
調査を進める上での障害に
なり得ますので、狩猟に
向かってください。
雄響狼は別のハンターに気を
引いてもらいますので、
あなた方は雌響狼の方を
お願い致します。

54637.description: The Guild has developed new armor for hunters aiming for the Tonfa. Please produce this armor and upgrade it to the Frogada GX series! Then the Guide at the plaza entrance will give you production materials for the Crimson Pact (Tonfa).
54637.descriptionEn:
The Guild developed new
armor for hunters aiming
for the Tonfa.
Craft this armor and
upgrade it to the
'Furogada GX Series'!
Then the 'Guide' at the
plaza entrance will gift
'Crimson Pact' (Tonfa)
crafting materials.
54637.descriptionJp:
ギルドでは『穿龍棍』を目指
すハンター向けに新しい防具
を開発しました。
ぜひ、この防具を生産し、
「フロガダGXシリーズ」まで
強化してください！
そうすると、広場入口にいる
「ガイド」から「クリムゾン
パクト」（穿龍棍）の生産
素材が贈られます。

50930.description: Armor Spheres and the Armor Wyvern are similar yet different. Still, Gravios, which bears the name of armor, is a being I cannot ignore. Hunting and studying it should lead to understanding Armor Spheres. To those who hunt it, I will share Armor Spheres.
50930.descriptionEn:
The ≪Armor Sphere≫ and the
≪Armor Wyvern≫ are alike
yet different things.
Still, the ≪Gravios≫, which
bears the name of armor, is
a being I cannot ignore.
So hunting and studying it
should lead to unraveling
the ≪Armor Sphere≫. Those
who hunt it shall get some.
50930.descriptionJp:
≪鎧玉≫と≪鎧竜≫は似て
非なるものである。
しかし、鎧の名がついている
≪グラビモス≫は、私にとっ
て無視できない存在。
そこで、ヤツを狩り研究する
ことが≪鎧玉≫の解明につな
がるはずだ。
狩猟してきた者には、
≪鎧玉≫を分けてやろう。

51038.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
51038.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Red Shadow will also grant a special ingredient.
51038.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the head and torso
of the Red Shadow, we will also
grant you special ingredients.
51038.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
赤影の頭と胴を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

62365.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
62365.description: I saw it! Fireballs raining down from the sky! And not one or two but a tremendous number. If you go to the jungle you should find some trace. However, there have been many Yian Garuga sightings in the jungle lately. Take great care!
62365.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
62365.descriptionEn:
I saw it! Fireballs raining down
from the sky! And not just one or
two, but a huge number of them.
If you go to the Jungle you should
find some trace of it. However,
there have been many sightings of
Yian Garuga in the Jungle lately.
Be on your guard!
62365.descriptionJp:
俺は見た！空から火の玉が降
り注ぐのを！それも１つや２
つじゃなく凄い数だったぞ。
密林に行けば何か痕跡が見つ
かる筈だ。ただし、最近密林
でイャンガルルガの目撃情報
が多く寄せられている。
要注意だ！

55548.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55548.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55548.descriptionEn:
Bow hunters striving for
mastery, come display the
skill you honed against
the Desert ≪Tigrex≫!
Hunt it well, and you
shall earn rewards far
beyond what daily effort
ever brings you.
55548.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

63411.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
63411.description: In gratitude to those who have contributed to the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. This request yields one item chosen from among all the Festival Remembrances distributed in the past. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63411.descriptionEn:
In gratitude to all who
support the Hunter Festival,
we made a special request.
This request gives you one
of any ≪Festival Memory≫
distributed in the past.
To accept or join it,
please bring a Festival
Proof with you.
63411.descriptionJp:
狩人祭に貢献して頂いている
方に感謝の意を込め、特別に
依頼を用意させて頂きました。
今回の依頼は過去にお配り
した全ての≪祭の追憶≫の
中から、いずれかが手に入る
内容となっております。
受注、または参加する際には、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

54671.description: To boost awareness of the G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest. Slaying the Inagami also grants special ingredients as a bonus.
54671.descriptionEn:
To boost awareness of the
G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest.
Slaying the Inagami also
grants special ingredients
as a bonus.
54671.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
雅翁龍を討伐することで特別
な食材も付与させていただき
ます。

61736.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
61736.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
61736.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
61736.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

23433.description: Word has come that a Kirin was sighted at the Tower. According to the hunter who saw it, it unleashed attacks never seen before. A stronger individual is highly likely, so we will issue this survey request to veteran hunters only.
23433.descriptionEn:
We have word of a Kirin
sighted at the Tower. The
hunter who saw it reports
attacks never seen before.
It is likely a stronger
individual than usual, so we
are issuing a survey request
to veteran hunters.
23433.descriptionJp:
塔にて、キリンを目撃したと
の情報が入ってきました。目
撃したハンターからの報告に
よるとこれまで見たことがな
い攻撃を繰り出してきたとの
ことです。これまでより強力
な個体の可能性が高いため、
熟練のハンターに調査依頼を
出させて頂きます。

21576.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Chicken Wing Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21576.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called the Fowlwing Orb?
Its material is vital for
crafting a certain costly
talisman.
Complete this request and
I shall give you rare
talisman materials.
21576.descriptionJp:
鶏翼原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

50981.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50981.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Lave series, available from this request? If you do not mind the looks, I would recommend it as armor with a fine set of skills!
50981.descriptionEn:
Hunter thinking of changing
out of ≪Hope Series≫ armor.
How about the ≪Lave Series≫
armor you can get from this
request? If you don't mind
the look, I think it is a
fine set with excellent
skills. I recommend it!
50981.descriptionJp:
防具≪ホープシリーズ≫から
着替えたいと考えているハン
ターさん。
この依頼で入手可能な防具
≪ラーヴェシリーズ≫はどう
ですか？
見た目を気にしなければ、優
秀なスキルが揃ったオススメ
できる防具と思いますよ！

26343.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26343.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26343.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

50385.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21260.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
21260.description: A rare report has come from a hunter back from the Jungle. 2 Gypceros are on a rampage in the Jungle, it says. The Guild is eagerly seeking strong hunters to hunt these 2! Do take up the request.
21260.descriptionEn:
Rare news has come in from a hunter
who returned from the Jungle.
Two Gypceros are said to be on a
rampage in the Jungle.
The Guild is now recruiting strong
hunters who will hunt these two!
Please sign up readily.
We look forward to your application.
21260.descriptionJp:
密林から帰ったハンターから
珍しい報せが入りました。
２頭の毒怪鳥が、密林で暴れ
ているとのことです。
ギルドでは、この２頭を狩猟
してやろうという強者ハンタ
ーを、大募集中です！
奮って受注をどうぞ。

22022.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Baruragaru Gou armor. By slaying the mysterious monster that appeared in the swamp, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Stroma F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
22022.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Baruragaru≫.
By slaying the mysterious
monster that appeared in
the Swamp, you can obtain
the materials needed to
upgrade "Stroma F Series"
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor to Lv7.
22022.descriptionJp:
≪喰血竜≫の≪剛種防具≫を
生産・強化したハンター向け
の依頼です。
沼地に現れた謎のモンスター
を討伐することで
「ストロマＦシリーズ」
≪天嵐防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

60106.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
60106.description: Our main product, Fango pelts, is about to run out of stock. I hear the boars of the Sea of Trees are of fine quality, so go and hunt a Sea of Trees Bulldrome for me. I'm counting on you.
60106.descriptionEn:
Our bestseller, Bullfango
hides, is about to run
out of stock.
I hear the boars in the
Great Forest are top grade,
so go hunt a Great Forest
Bulldrome. Thanks.
60106.descriptionJp:
うちの主力商品のファンゴの
毛皮が、そろそろ在庫を
切らしそうなんだ。
樹海の猪は、上物が多いと
聞いたから、いっちょう樹海
のドスファンゴを狩って来て
くれ。頼んだぜ。

62021.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

21047.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
21047.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! In this cold season Royal Beetles decrease, but Special Mushrooms are plentiful! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
21047.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the
Jungle! In the cold season
≪Royal Beetle≫ is scarce,
but ≪Specialty Mushroom≫ is
plentiful! Let's start by
getting used to the Jungle.
21047.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を８つ探して納めて下さい！
この寒冷期になると≪ロイヤ
ルカブト≫は減りますが、
≪特産キノコ≫が豊富です！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めましょう。

63296.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63296.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63296.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63296.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

21082.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21082.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku. Hunt one and you prove you can hold your own even in the Elder Hall. A sound burst by its ear may even make it weep.
21082.descriptionEn:
If you hear a birdlike cry in
this Jungle, it is surely the
Yian Kut-Ku. Hunting one
would prove you can hold your
own even at the Grand Hall.
Ring a sound by its ear and
it may even shed tears.
21082.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね。
イャンクックを狩猟すること
ができれば、大老殿でもそこ
そこやれる証拠ね。耳元で音
を鳴らせばナミダをこぼすこ
ともあるかも知れないわね。

62376.description: Hey, you have finally reached ace hunter. The Hunters Guild gave you a special weapon, right? That is a weapon suited to Variants and is also a condition for some jobs. Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share upgrade materials. Will you try?
62376.descriptionEn:
Hey, so you have finally reached
the rank of ace hunter.
You got a special weapon from the
Hunters Guild, right? That is a
weapon suited to Variants, and it
also serves as a condition for
taking some requests.
Clear the requests I introduce and
I will share upgrade materials.
Wanna give it a try?
62376.descriptionJp:
よう、お前もようやく凄腕
ハンターに到達したんだな。
ハンターズギルドから特殊な
武器を貰っただろ？あれは対
変種に適した武器で一部の
依頼を受ける条件にもなって
いる。
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
強化用の素材を分けてやるぜ。
やってみないか？

61146.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

50236.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の撃退
50236.description: It is I, the Instructor! An Espinas Rare Species has been sighted at the top of the Deep Forest. It is an extremely powerful monster, but right now the hunters of skill are all deployed elsewhere. So I want to ask you to drive it off! As this is a very difficult request, it cannot be helped if you fail! I leave it to you!
50236.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
An Espinas Rare Species
was sighted at the Top of
the Great Forest. It is
very strong, but our top
hunters are all away. So I
ask you to repel it!
It is a very hard request,
so failing is forgivable!
I count on you!
50236.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ！教官だ！
樹海頂部にてエスピナス希少
種が目撃された。非常に強力
なモンスターなのだが、今は
凄腕のハンター達は出払って
いる。そこで諸君に奴の撃退
を依頼したい！
非常に困難な依頼のため、
達成できなくてもやむなしだ！
よろしく頼む！

50563.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

63048.description: Reports are coming one after another that an unidentified monster is on the rampage around Mezeporta. The situation is still tense, with even skilled hunters who set out being caught up in it. To save us from this crisis we are recruiting hunters confident in their skill.
63048.descriptionEn:
Reports keep coming in of an
unidentified monster on a rampage
around Mezeporta.
Ace hunters who went out to hunt
have been caught up in it, and
the situation is still tense.
To save us from this crisis we
seek hunters sure of
their skill.
63048.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺で未確認の
モンスターが暴れていると
の報告が相次いでいます。
狩猟に出かけた凄腕ハンター
が巻き込まれるなど、
未だ状況は緊迫しています。
この危機を救うため
腕に自信のあるハンターを
募集します。

61139.description: T-terrible! Now a Tigrex is on a rampage and we cannot pass through the snowy mountains! Do something about that wild Tigrex so we can go there in peace.
61139.descriptionEn:
Th-this is terrible!
Now a Tigrex is on a
rampage and we can't pass
the Snowy Mountains! Make
it safe to travel: do
something about that Tigrex!
61139.descriptionJp:
た、大変だ！
今度は轟竜が暴れていて
雪山を通ることができない！
安心して雪山に行けるように、
あの暴れモノの轟竜を
どうにかしてくれんかのぅ。

21241.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21241.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21241.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21241.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

55218.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55218.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55218.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

63195.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 2 Wyvern Shatterclaws and I will give you 2 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63195.descriptionEn:
Shh, keep it down, nya!
This is a secret market,
nya. Give me 2 ≪Wyvern
Crushclaws≫ and I'll give
you 2 ≪Master Cat's
Favorite≫, nya. Slip them
to the Master Cat and he
makes ≪Hardcore Cat≫ gear
with no materials! Aim for
the dream jackpot, nya!
63195.descriptionJp:
シッ、静かにするニャ！ここ
は秘密の取引所ニャ。≪飛竜
の砕爪≫を２個くれたら、
≪親方ネコの大好物≫を
２個あげるニャ。
こっそり親方ネコに渡せば、
素材なしで≪剛猫武器≫を
作ってくれる優れ物ニャ！
夢の大当たりを狙って
頑張るニャ！

61457.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
61457.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61457.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61457.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

62349.objectiveJp: ハンターカード青１０枚納品
62349.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62349.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
62349.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

54351.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54351.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54351.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

51068.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
51068.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Tigrex will also grant a special ingredient.
51068.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Tigrex's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51068.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
轟竜の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

11008.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
11008.description: If you can hunt Yian Kut-Ku, your hunting skill is quite something! If you have room to spare, please try making aged mushrooms as well. Put specialty mushrooms in a Maka Pickling Jar and bury it. It's simple!
11008.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ and
your skill is quite
something! If you have
the time, please try aging
mushrooms as well. Put
Special Mushrooms in a
≪Maka Pot≫. Simple, yes!
11008.descriptionJp:
≪イャンクック≫を狩猟する
ことができれば、狩りの腕は
なかなかのものですよ！
もし余裕があれば熟成キノコ
作りにも挑戦してください。
≪マカ漬けの壷≫に特産キノ
コを入れて埋める。簡単よ！

60023.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
60023.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can slay a band of Chachabu, whose fighting strength stands far above the rest of the Lynian tribes and who trouble even seasoned hunters, then display that skill!
60023.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show off
their skill! Among the Wyverians, the
Chachabu pack boasts outstanding
combat strength, enough to trouble
even seasoned hunters. If you are
confident you can slay them with
grace, then come and prove your worth!
60023.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！獣人族の中におい
てひときわ高い戦闘力を持ち、
熟練したハンターであっても
手を焼くチャチャブーの集団
を見事に討伐する自信がある
ならば、その腕前を披露せよ！

63327.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
63327.description: A rather unusual job has arrived. It seems you need a Porta Chocolate to accept it. A very fine reward is prepared, so why not take it?
63327.descriptionEn:
A rather odd request has
arrived. Accepting it needs
a ≪Porta Chocolate≫, they
say. The rewards are said
to be truly wonderful, so
why not take it on?
63327.descriptionJp:
ちょっと風変わりな依頼が
届いています。受注には
≪ポルタチョコ≫が必要だそ
うです。とても素敵な報酬が
用意されているようですので、
受けてみてはいかがですか？

50557.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
50557.description: You there! I hear you produced an Espinas weapon. So I have a request: how about materials to upgrade to an Espinas Subspecies weapon as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Espinas rare species. I am counting on you!
50557.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! I hear you
crafted an Espinas weapon.
So I've got a request. How
about materials to upgrade
it into an Espinas Rare
Species weapon as pay?
It's easy: just run over and
slay an Espinas Rare Species.
I'm counting on you!
50557.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
棘竜の武器を生産したんだっ
てな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は棘白竜の武器への強化素
材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってエスピナス希少種
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

12051.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
12051.description: If you are going to hunt in the Snowy Mountains, it is best to bring a Hot Drink and not forget it. It might be surer to hunt Popo and get used to the mountain environment to some degree, and then hunt a Bulldrome.
12051.descriptionEn:
When you hunt in the Snowy
Mountains, don't forget a
≪Hot Drink≫. It may be safer
to slay ≪Popo≫ and get used
to the cold before you hunt
a ≪Bulldrome≫.
12051.descriptionJp:
雪山で狩猟に臨む場合は、
≪ホットドリンク≫を忘れず
に持ってくといいわよ。
≪ポポ≫の討伐で、ある程度
雪山の環境に慣れてから、
≪ドスファンゴ≫を狩猟した
方が確実かも知れないわね。

21030.description: If you can hunt a Rathian, it means you stand on your own as a hunter. It's a famous saying among hunters, but making the queen cry would be even more impressive, wouldn't it? Maybe she cries if she drinks a lot of water?
21030.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means you stand on your own
as a hunter. It's a famous
saying among hunters, but
making the queen cry would
be even more amazing, no?
Does lots of water do it?
21030.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたなら
それは狩人として独り立ちを
意味します。狩人たちの間で
有名な謳い文句ですが、女王
を泣かせることができたら、
もっと凄いことですよね？
水を大量に飲めば泣くとか？

21740.description: Having Gypceros steal my valuables so many times, I can't do business. Go to the swamp and get them back for me. Lately they've grown bold and attack in groups. As a special exception, I'll give you a prize from one of the gallery tournaments!
21740.descriptionEn:
Having my valuables stolen by
≪Gypceros≫ so often, I can't
do business. Go to the Swamp
and get them back for me.
Lately they've grown bold and
attack in packs. As a special
case, I'll give you a prize
from a Gallery tournament!
21740.descriptionJp:
こう何度も≪ゲリョス≫に
貴重品を盗まれたんじゃ、
商売どころじゃない。
ちょっと沼地へ行って、
取り戻してきてほしいんだ。
最近は、大胆になってきて
複数頭で襲ってくることも
あるらしい。特例として
一部のギャラリー大会の
景品をプレゼントするぜ！

60103.description: We discovered a vast sea of trees in an unexplored land. The moment we stepped in, a great swarm of Vespoid! We fled for our lives and left our baggage behind. It is important baggage! Will someone drive off that swarm!
60103.descriptionEn:
I discovered a vast Great Forest
in an unexplored land. The moment
I stepped in, a swarm of Vespoids!
I ran for my life and left my
cargo behind. It's important
cargo! Won't someone drive off
that swarm for me!
60103.descriptionJp:
未開の地に広大な樹海を発見
したんだ。足を踏み入れると
ランゴスタの大群さ！
逃げるのに必死で荷物を残し
てきてしまった。大事な荷物
なんだ！誰かあの大群を追い
払ってくれないか！

58094.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58094.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58094.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58094.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

54642.description: We ask you to investigate the Green Plesioth that appeared in the Jungle. If possible, not only hunt it but break its dorsal fin, which would help us greatly. Hunters, I ask for your help!
54642.descriptionEn:
A Green Plesioth has
appeared in the Jungle.
We ask you to survey it.
If you can, don't just
hunt it: break the dorsal
fin as well, please.
Hunters, thank you all!
54642.descriptionJp:
密林に現れた翠水竜の
調査をお願いします。
できれば狩猟だけでなく、
背ビレの破壊をしてきてくれ
ると助かります。
ハンターの皆さん、よろしく
お願いします！

55014.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

56050.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Hyujikiki through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Great Sword, Hammer, Switch Axe, Magnet Spike, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56050.descriptionEn:
From a Supremacy Hyujikiki
you can obtain materials
for crafting one Supremacy
weapon and two upgrade
stages, plus Gz worth of
Porta Card Sakura. Types:
Dual Blades, Great Sword,
Hammer, Switch Axe, Tonfa,
Heavy Bowgun, or Bow.
Use it on your favorite!
56050.descriptionJp:
辿異種ヒュジキキの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、大剣、鎚、
剣斧、磁斬鎚、重弩、弓の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

21464.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Pariapuria. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21464.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest, slaying
≪Pariapuria≫.
The reward is a little lower than
a normal hunt, but why not polish
your skills together with fellow
hunters!
21464.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪パリアプリア≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

26699.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Volcano, hunt a Gravios and slay great numbers of Vespoid. Then carry back one red hot Firestone and deliver it. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
26699.descriptionEn:
This time, we hold special
training for Hunters with
little experience yet!
In the Volcano, hunt a Basarios
and slay a large number of
Vespoids, then carry 1 red-hot
blasting rock back and deliver
it. It's harsh, but success
will raise your standing!
26699.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！火山で岩竜の狩猟と、
大量のランゴスタの討伐。
そして熱い熱い火薬岩１個を
運んできて納品するんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

62962.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62962.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62962.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62962.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

26429.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26429.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26429.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26429.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

55987.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55987.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55987.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

55474.description: The Variant Species Plesioth appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Plesioth. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55474.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Plesioth≫ seems
to have reached the strength
of the pinnacle among
Plesioth. Its power is
immeasurable. Hunters
confident in their skill,
please take on this survey.
55474.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ガノトトス≫は
ガノトトスの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

50050.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
50050.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
50050.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the Jungle!
We will also pay for the insects
that sometimes fly there,
Royal Beetles, if you deliver them!
Start by learning the Jungle and
getting used to it.
50050.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を８つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

50956.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
50956.description: Uragaan, the Crushing Wyvern, appears to have shown itself in the volcano. We have asked other hunters to look into it as well, but information is still scarce and much remains unknown. To keep Mezeporuta safe, we ask for an ecological survey.
50956.descriptionEn:
It seems that Uragaan,
the Blast Hammer Wyvern,
has appeared in the Volcano.
We have also issued requests to
other hunters, but information is
still scarce and many points
remain unclear.
To protect the safety of Mezepolta,
please conduct an ecology survey.
50956.descriptionJp:
火山に
爆鎚竜・ウラガンキンが
現れたようです。
他のハンターにも依頼を
出させて頂きましたが
未だ情報が少なく、不明
な点が多くあります。
メゼポルタの安全を守る
為、生態調査をお願いし
ます。

50978.description: A request for hunters who reached HR5, letting you craft and upgrade the recommended Stroma Series Hardcore Armor. Hunt Baruragaru to obtain materials for one piece of the Stroma Series.
50978.descriptionEn:
A request for hunters who
reached HR5, letting you
craft and upgrade the
recommended Stroma Series
≪Hardcore Armor≫. Hunt
Baruragaru to obtain
materials for one piece of
the Stroma Series.
50978.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ５になったハンター
にオススメの
「ストロマシリーズ」
≪剛種防具≫が生産・強化で
きる依頼です。
バルラガルを狩猟すると、
「ストロマシリーズ」１部位
分の生産・強化素材が入手で
きます。

61141.description: Could you do me a favor? If you have the Hagoita Blade [Moe], I want you to hunt an Espinas for last year's luck cleansing. I will share the new model's materials, so swing it with spirit!
61141.descriptionEn:
Could you do me a favor?
If you have the Hagoita
Blade [Moe], I want you to
hunt an Espinas for last
year's luck cleansing.
I'll share new material,
so swing away!
61141.descriptionJp:
ちょっと頼まれてくれないか？
もし羽子板ブレード【萌】を
持っていたら、昨年の厄落と
しで、エスピナスを狩ってき
て欲しいんだ。新作の素材を
分けるからさ、景気良く
振り回してきてくれよ！

21394.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

54907.description: To those aiming for high GR: we prepared a quest where slaying a Gogomoa raises your fame while cheaply granting materials needed for G Rank decorations. Please make use of it.
54907.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for high
GR: we prepared a quest
where slaying a Gogomoa
raises your fame while
cheaply granting materials
needed for G Rank
talismans.
Please make use of it.
54907.descriptionJp:
ＧＲの高みを目指す方々へ
ゴゴモアを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

54354.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54354.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54354.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

26030.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
26030.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26030.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26030.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

26566.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26566.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26566.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26566.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

61812.description: This time you are to slay the Espinas in the Great Arena. There is a strict time limit of 5 minutes, but we have prepared special equipment and a weak individual, so it should be quite possible for you. It is a drill, so there is no reward, but do your best!
61812.descriptionEn:
This time, in the Great
Arena, you will slay an
≪Espinas≫.
There is a harsh 5-minute
limit, but we provide
special gear and a weak
individual, so you should
manage. It's practice, so
no pay, but do your best!
61812.descriptionJp:
今回は諸君に、大闘技場で
≪エスピナス≫の討伐を
行ってきてもらう。
５分という厳しい時間制限が
あるが、特別な装備と、弱い
個体を用意させてもらったの
で、諸君なら十分に可能だろ
う。演習なので、報酬は無い
が、頑張ってくれ！

22145.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
22145.description: Thank you for playing MHF for ten whole years! We truly appreciate it! Equip Haldo Metalenon, deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket, and we will give you 11 Proof of Gratitude S as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude S Elzeacta (Tonfa) can be forged.
22145.descriptionEn:
Thank you for playing
MHF for ten whole years!
We truly appreciate it!
Equip ≪Haldo Metalenon≫,
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫, and we
will give you 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude S≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude S≫
≪Elzeacta≫ (Tonfa) can be
forged.
22145.descriptionJp:
１０年間ＭＨＦを遊んで
いただき誠にありがとう
ございます！
≪ハルド・メタレノン≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると、
≪感謝の証S≫を１１枚
プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証S≫から
≪エルゼアクタ≫（穿龍棍）
が生産可能です。

53187.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

62278.description: A Rajang has appeared in the arena. I am truly sorry, for the guild's sake, but we absolutely need the head broken! And there is very little time left for it. Only you can accomplish this! I am counting on you!
62278.descriptionEn:
A Rajang appeared in the
Arena. I'm truly sorry it's
for Guild reasons, but we
absolutely must have its
head broken! And we have
only a little time left
for it. Only you can
pull this off!
I'm counting on you!
62278.descriptionJp:
闘技場にラージャンが現れた。
ギルドの都合で本当に申し訳
ないのだが、どうしても頭部
の破壊が我々にとって必要
不可欠なのだ！そして、その
ための時間はもう僅かしか
残されていない。これは君た
ちにしか成し得ないのだ！
よろしく頼んだぞ！

50082.description: There is a report that 2 unidentified fanged beasts are on a rampage in the Canyon. Information is still scarce, and apart from being red and blue nothing is known. There is no doubt from the report that they are extremely powerful individuals. Prepare fully before heading there.
50082.descriptionEn:
We have a report that two
unidentified Fanged Beasts are
rampaging in the Canyon.
Information is still scarce, and
beyond their being red and blue
nothing is known.
From the reports, there is no
doubt they are extremely strong.
Prepare fully before heading out.
50082.descriptionJp:
峡谷で未確認の２頭の牙獣種
が暴れているとの報告があり
ました。まだ情報も少なく、
赤と青ということ以外、
分かっていません。
報告から極めて強力な個体で
あることは間違いありません。
万全の準備を整えてから
現地へ向かってください。

53028.description: I saw it clear as day! A Plesioth so tiny I could not help but lose my composure! Everyone just lets it go past and will not listen to me! Then there is nothing for it but for you to see for yourself! Lend me your help, hunter!
53028.descriptionEn:
I saw it clear as day!
A Plesioth so tiny you can't
help but lose your composure!
Everyone just lets it slide,
nobody will listen to me!
Fine, then you'll have to
see for yourself! Lend me
a hand, hunter!
53028.descriptionJp:
バッチリ見たんだ俺は！
取り乱さずにはいられない位、
小さすぎるガノトトスをよ！
皆ただただ聞き流すだけで、
俺の話をあいてにしてくれね
え！じゃあテメェ自身で確か
める他ないだろ！協力してく
れハンターさん！

50789.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
50789.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the crest of a Purple Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
50789.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Purple Gypceros' crest,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50789.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
紫毒鳥のトサカを破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

21689.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
21689.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Spring Green Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21689.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as the Spring Green Orb?
Its material is essential
to crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Complete this request for me
and I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21689.descriptionJp:
萌葱原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

63038.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
63038.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63038.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63038.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

63363.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
63363.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63363.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63363.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

22095.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22095.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22095.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

61404.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61404.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61404.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

51091.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51091.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the claws of a Shogun Ceanataur will also grant a special ingredient.
51091.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Shogun Ceanataur's
claws, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51091.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鎌蟹のツメを破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

54532.description: Kuarusepus has appeared in the highlands. Its attack method changes with the weather, so hunters should hunt with care. If you judge the hunt too difficult, you may slay Kantaros and return.
54532.descriptionEn:
Kuarlusepusu has appeared
in the Highlands. Its attacks
change with the weather,
so hunters should hunt
with care.
If you judge the hunt too hard,
you may slay Kantharos and
return home instead.
54532.descriptionJp:
クアルセプスが高地に
現れました。天候が変わる
と攻撃方法が変わるので
ハンターは注意して
狩猟を行って下さい。
狩猟困難と判断された場合、
カンタロスを討伐してご帰
還いただいても構いません。

56119.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56119.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56119.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

55082.description: A Zinogre wrapped in light, standing at the top of the sea of trees. The Guild has decided to call it Zinogre that Roars to the Extreme. Brave hunter. When you drive it off, you shall surely be granted materials for Guild hidden armor.
55082.descriptionEn:
At the summit of the Great Forest
stands a Thunder Wolf Wyvern
wrapped in light.
The Guild has decided to call it
the ≪Acme Roaring Zinogre≫.
Brave hunter.
Once you drive it off, we will
surely grant you materials for
the Guild's treasured armor.
55082.descriptionJp:
樹海の頂部にたたずむ
光に包まれし雷狼竜。
ギルドでは、ヤツの呼称を
「極み吼えるジンオウガ」
とすることにした。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
ヤツを追い払った暁には、
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を
必ず授けよう。

26191.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26191.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26191.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

58133.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター３頭の狩猟
58133.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58133.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58133.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

21457.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Shogun Ceanataur. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21457.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!
21457.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ショウグンギザミ≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

26588.description: Several Variant Velocidrome have been confirmed in the Jungle. We cannot leave them be, so we ask hunters of skill only to hunt them. They are very vicious, so if hunting 2 proves difficult, 1 alone is fine. Please, do what you can!
26588.descriptionEn:
Several Velocidrome
Subspecies seen in the Jungle.
We can't leave them be,
so this hunt is for skilled
hunters only.
They are extremely vicious, so if
two prove too much, one alone
is fine as well - please, just
help us out!
26588.descriptionJp:
密林で複数のドスランポス
変種が確認されました。この
まま放ってはおけないため、
凄腕ハンターさん限定での
狩猟をお願いします。
大変凶暴な個体であるため、
２頭の狩猟が難しいようでし
たら、１頭だけでも結構です
ので、何とかお願いします！

55271.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
55271.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55271.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55271.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54563.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54563.description: There's a great tremor in the Forest and Hills. A Rathalos Subspecies should be there, but something feels different from usual. The folk nearby are troubled. Won't you please hunt it for us?
54563.descriptionEn:
A tremendous tremor has been
coming from Forest and Hills.
An Azure Rathalos should be
there, but something feels
different from usual. The
neighbors are troubled.
Please, could you hunt it
for us?
54563.descriptionJp:
あの森丘ですごい震動が発生
しておるんじゃ。あそこには
リオレウス亜種がいるはずな
のじゃが、何だかいつもの感
じとは違うのじゃよ。
近隣のみなは迷惑しておる。
是非とも、狩猟をお願いでき
ないだろうかのぉ。

53251.description: According to my research, the rabbit living on the round full moon makes not only rice cakes but medicine too. Which means there is nothing for it but to experience medicine-making and become a rabbit ourselves! I have prepared some tools and materials, so please make use of them.
53251.descriptionEn:
According to my research, the
rabbit living on the round moon
makes not only mochi but
medicine as well. Well then, we
must try making medicine and
become rabbits ourselves!
I have prepared tools and
materials, so help yourself.
53251.descriptionJp:
私の研究によれば、まん丸お
月さまに住む兎さんは、餅だ
けでなく、薬も作っているの
だとか。これはもう、薬作り
を体験して兎になりきるしか
ありませんな！いくつか道具
と材料をご用意しましたので
どうぞお役立て下さい。

61968.description: Hunters who set out with gunlances today as well. Listen to me a moment. Soon the Hunters Guild will loose a Basarios in the arena. And the entry condition is gunlance only. There is no way I could miss that!
61968.descriptionEn:
Hunters heading out with a
Gunlance again today, listen
to me. Soon the Hunters
Guild will release a
≪Basarios≫ in the Arena. And
the condition is Gunlance
only! There's no way I could
miss that!
61968.descriptionJp:
今日もガンランスを装備して
狩りに出かけているハンター
たちよ。ちょっとオレの話を
聞いてくれ。
近々ハンターズギルドが闘技
場に≪バサルモス≫を放つら
しい。しかも参加条件はガン
ランスのみときた。
これは参加せずにはいられな
いな！

23705.description: We have discovered a huge flying wyvern that scatters something like explosive mist at Prismatic Falls. Reports say its ecology is unlike anything known, and the Guild has begun further investigation. Take care of its explosive attacks and complete the quest.
23705.descriptionEn:
At Ayano Falls, a giant
wyvern was found spraying
something like explosive
mist. Its ecology is said to
be unlike any other, and the
Guild began a deeper survey.
Watch for explosive attacks
and complete the quest.
23705.descriptionJp:
彩の滝にて爆発性の霧の様な
ものを撒く巨大な飛竜種を
発見しました。生態は類を見
ない、特殊なものであるとい
う報告があり、ギルドはさら
なる調査を開始しました。
爆発攻撃に注意し、クエスト
を完了してください。

60497.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Green Plesioth. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks!
60497.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! This
time: <<Green Plesioth>>!
Team up with your Guild mates
and achieve the objective.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest - now go and take a
place in the top ranks!
60497.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ガノトトス亜種≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！

61947.description: By the way, there is said to be a highly prized Porta Pyroxene, but that area is a nest of very tough monsters. How about it? If you are confident in your skill, care to make a quick trip?
61947.descriptionEn:
Speaking of which, they say a
<<Porta Pyroxene>> of great value
exists, but that area has become
a nest of terribly tough
monsters. So, what do you say?
If you're confident in your skill,
want to make a quick trip there?
61947.descriptionJp:
そういえば、希少価値の高い
≪ポルタ輝石≫が存在してい
るらしいが、あのあたりは、
非常に手強いモンスターの巣
になっていてな。どうだい？
腕に自信があったら、ひとっ
走り行ってくるかい？

55793.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
55793.description: If you could hunt a Gogomoa, you have some skill. But the path of the Magnetic Slash Hammer user is not built in a day! Your next opponent is Toridokuresu. For a hammer wielder, breaking parts is like twisting a baby's arm. Aim with magnetism and land precise blows!
55793.descriptionEn:
If you can hunt a Gogomoa,
you've got some skill, it seems.
But the path of the Magnet Spike
is not mastered in a day!
Your next foe is Toridokuresu.
For a Magnet Spike user,
breaking parts is child's play.
Aim with the magnetic force and
land your attacks true!
55793.descriptionJp:
ゴゴモアを狩猟できたなら、
多少の心得はあるようだな。
だが、磁斬鎚使いの道は、
１日にしてならず！
次の相手はトリドクレスだ。
磁斬鎚の使い手にとって、
部位破壊など赤子の手を捻る
が如きもの。磁力で狙いを
定め、的確に攻撃を叩きこめ！

50324.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Meraginasu. Any hunter who succeeds in the hunt will receive more proof of slaying than usual!
50324.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are seeking
someone to deal with an
extremely powerful <<Meraginasu>>.
We await your application.
Hunters who slay it with skill
shall be issued more slay proofs
than usual!
50324.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪メラギナス≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。
見事、討伐したハンターには、
普段よりも多く討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

62552.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62552.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62552.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62552.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62040.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

21320.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

51034.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the F upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
51034.descriptionEn:
In this quest you will receive
Secret Art Armor (Gunner)
materials, excluding the weapon
souls needed for F upgrades.
The yield covers 5 parts.
To accept this quest
a <<Hunter Die White>>
is required, so
please take note.
51034.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（ガンナー）の
Ｆ強化時に必要な武器魂を
除く素材を排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターダイス白≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

62840.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62840.description: Have you ever seen Lavasioth? Actually, I came upon a sight I could scarcely believe. I was so astonished I couldn't move as I wished, and I was caught off guard. What astonished me so? Well, seeing is believing. Go and experience it yourself.
62840.descriptionEn:
Have you ever seen a
≪Volganos≫? I ran into a
sight I couldn't believe.
I was so stunned I couldn't
move right and took a bad
hit. What shocked me? Well,
seeing is believing.
Go try it for yourself.
62840.descriptionJp:
≪ヴォルガノス≫って見た
ことあるか？実は、目を疑う
ような光景に出くわしたんだ。
驚きのあまり思い通りに動け
ず、不覚をとってしまった。
何にそんなに驚いたかって？
まぁ百聞は一見にしかずだ。
実際に体験してくるといいぞ。

50623.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
50623.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Female Roaring Wolf will also grant a special ingredient.
50623.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the female Orugaron's
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50623.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
雌響狼の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

11072.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ４頭の討伐
11072.description: We ask you to slay the Jungle's troublemaker, the Bullfango. In the cold season like now they are hungry and short-tempered, so take particular care.
11072.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Jungle
brute, Bullfango. In the
cold season like now they
are hungry and on edge,
so do be especially
careful.
11072.descriptionJp:
密林の暴れん坊、
ブルファンゴの討伐をお願
いします。
今のような寒冷期は、空腹
で気が立っているので、特
に気をつけて下さいね。

55136.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
55136.description: Slaying an Akura Jebia raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55136.descriptionEn:
By slaying Akura Jebia you can
raise your own rating while
getting the materials needed
to obtain G Rank decorations -
we have prepared a quest where
you get them at a bargain.
Please make good use of it.
55136.descriptionJp:
アクラ・ジェビアを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

54389.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
54389.description: There is a report that a giant dragon was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano. According to the survey team that found it, it looked like a Fatalis mutated to a crimson, ominous color. There is no telling what may happen as things stand. Please investigate quickly.
54389.descriptionEn:
There was a report that a
giant dragon was sighted at
the crater of the great volcano.
According to the survey team
that found it, the figure was
like a Fatalis mutated into a
crimson, sinister color.
If left alone, there is no
telling what may happen.
Please survey it swiftly.
54389.descriptionJp:
大火山の火口にて、巨大な
龍の姿が目撃されたとの報告
がありました。
発見した調査団いわく、
その姿は紅く禍々しい色に
変異したミラボレアスのよう
だったとのこと。
このままでは、何が起こるか
わかりません。
迅速な調査をお願いします。

61763.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
61763.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.
61763.descriptionJp:
どうやら修復に必要な地図の
断片を集めてくれたようだな。
ちょっと枚数が多いけど、
私なら元に戻せるだろう。
集めた断片をそこのボックス
に入れといてくれ。
作業が終わったら複製した地
図をやろう。武具工房に持っ
ていくと喜ばれるかもな。

54113.description: For the survey, would you hunt a Rathalos for me? Ah, yes, that is right, the wing claws and tail of a Rathalos are dangerous and get in the way of the survey, so would you break them? A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break them!
54113.descriptionEn:
Could you go hunt a Rathalos
for our survey?
Ah, that's right - a Rathalos'
wing claws and tail are dangerous
and get in the way of the survey,
so break them for me, would you?
Hunting alone won't count.
Be sure to break them!
54113.descriptionJp:
調査のために、リオレウスの
狩猟をしてきてくれないか。
あ、そうそう、リオレウスの
翼爪と尻尾は危険な上に、
調査の邪魔になるので破壊し
ておいてくれないか。
狩猟のみでは認めないからな。
必ず破壊しておいてくれよ！

26271.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26271.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26271.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

21684.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
21684.description: The black dragon that was said to be a legend seems to have shown itself at Castle Schrade! In the tale of the Black Dragon legend it is told that the black dragon will bring calamity to the world! Slay it with all your might so that the legend does not become reality!
21684.descriptionEn:
The black dragon of legend
seems to have shown itself at
≪Schrade Castle≫! The tale of
the Black Dragon says it will
bring ruin to the world! Slay
it with all your might so the
legend never comes true!
21684.descriptionJp:
伝説とされていた黒き龍が、
≪シュレイド城≫にて、その
姿を現したようです！黒龍
伝説の物語では、黒龍が世界
に災いをもたらすと語られて
います！伝説が現実にならな
いよう全力で討伐して下さい！

56092.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Frost Fierce Wyvern. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56092.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Ice Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56092.descriptionJp:
辿異種の氷獰竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

53077.description: Abiorugu! The Abi G series made from its materials! If the sight of those stirs your heart, you are a friend of mine! Show me the sight of you snapping an Abiorugu's horns!
53077.descriptionEn:
Abiorugu, the Violent Dragon!
The Abi G Series,
made from its materials!
If these stir your heart,
then you are my sworn friend!
Show me the sight of you
snapping an Abiorugu's horn!
53077.descriptionJp:
獰竜アビオルグ！
その素材で作られる
アビＧシリーズ！
これらの姿に胸を熱く
したなら、お前は我輩の
朋友だ！獰竜の角を折る
お前の勇姿を見せてくれ！

28095.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
28095.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28095.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
28095.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

53093.description: Hello everyone! Miyashita here! I have come to Shiojima again! This time I present Felyne Comrade gear on the theme 'what happens when a Felyne Comrade equips a Barrel Bomb?' Please come and see me!
53093.descriptionEn:
Hello, everyone!
It's Miyashita!
I'm back on Tidal Island!
This time the theme is "What if
a Felyne comrade equipped a Barrel
Bomb?" - Felyne comrade gear
as a gift!
Please come and see me! ^^
53093.descriptionJp:
みなさん、こんにちは！
宮下です！
またまた潮島へきましたー！
今回は「パートニャーがタル
爆弾を装備したらどうなる？」
をテーマにしたパートニャー
武具をプレゼント！
ぜひ会いに来てくださいね＾＾

63221.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63221.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee! I wish you good fortune!
63221.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Use all of your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
Complete this request splendidly
and you will earn an exceptional
reward! I wish you good fortune!
63221.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られるぞ！
健闘を祈る！

21793.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

50726.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐

60938.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60938.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
60938.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

40143.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil FZ Earring.
40143.descriptionEn:
Here we hand out
VISA production tickets
to hunters who own
Gothic equipment.
Please accept the quest
while equipped with
Veil FZ Earrings.
40143.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。
ベイルFZイヤリングを装備
した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

54701.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
54701.description: For those aiming for GR500: by hunting an Iodrome your rating as a hunter will rise greatly while you obtain a "Guild Hunt Commission". Such a quest is ready. Please make good use of it in your future hunting life.
54701.descriptionEn:
For those aiming for GR500:
by hunting a Gendrome
your rating as a hunter
will rise greatly while
you obtain a
"Guild Hunt Commission"
- such a quest is ready.
Please make good use of it
in your future hunting life.
54701.descriptionJp:
ＧＲ５００を目指す方々へ
ドスイーオスを狩猟すること
で、ハンターとしての評価が
大きく上がりつつ
「ギルド狩猟委任状」を入手
できるクエストを準備しまし
た。
今後の狩猟生活にぜひお役立
てください。

50110.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の撃退
50110.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50110.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.
50110.descriptionJp:
おい！とっておきの依頼が舞
い込んで来たぞ！受注できる
回数に限りはあるが、なんと
覇種の素材を分けてもらえる
らしい。しかも撃退だけでい
いらしいから、討伐できな
いってヤツにもオススメだな。
ただ、そうは言っても覇種は
覇種だ。絶対に油断するなよ。

56041.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Rathalos through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56041.descriptionEn:
From a Supremacy Rathalos you can
get the materials needed to craft
one Supremacy weapon and upgrade
it two stages, plus Gz worth of
Sakura Porta Cards.
The weapon types available are
Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance,
Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun or Bow.
Please use this to craft and
upgrade the weapon you like.
56041.descriptionJp:
辿異種リオレウスの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、鎚、銃槍、
軽弩、重弩、弓の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

21454.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Rathian. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21454.descriptionEn:
This is the counter for the
Hunting Skill Quest: Slay
≪Rathian≫. The reward is a
little lower than a normal
hunt, but why not polish
your skills with other hunters!
21454.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪リオレイア≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

20028.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
20028.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! An extremely powerful Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon! This is a very dangerous request. Return safely!
20028.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Post!
A very powerful Kushala Daora
has invaded Mezepolta's
territory! Mezepolta now
moves to intercept it! Use
the gear at the Base to slay
the Elder Dragon! A very
dangerous request. Stay safe!
20028.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
メゼポルタの領内に非常に
強力な風翔龍が侵入しまし
た！これよりメゼポルタは、
古龍の迎撃態勢に入ります！
迎撃拠点に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を討伐して
下さい！これは非常に危険な
依頼です。どうぞご無事で！

23654.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

61177.objectiveJp: ガルルガ変種１頭の討伐
61177.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note. And do not forget to break parts!
61177.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
And never forget part breaks!
61177.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。
部位破壊も決して忘れずに！

21994.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の狩猟
21994.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Pale Hypnocatrice, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21994.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner doing well,
meow? Time to treat your buddy
for a change, meow!
Now, to business, meow. This
request is to hunt 1 Hypnocatrice
Rare, meow. The reward is
materials to craft Palico gear,
meow! I am counting on you, meow!
21994.descriptionJp:
おう！そこの狩人さん！
アンタのパートニャーは元気
かニャ？たまには相棒孝行し
てやるニャ！
では、本題ニャ。今回の依頼
は蒼白眠鳥１頭の狩猟ニャ。
報酬はパートニャー用武具の
生産素材だニャ！
たのんだニャー！

21421.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・穫を１個納品

62984.description: The Wyverian lady said the Guild is short of ingredients lately. At this rate she is worried whether they can properly entertain the hunters who visit Mezepolta Plaza. So she said that if you procure ingredients, she will give you a red gem as thanks!
62984.descriptionEn:
Lately the Guild is short on food,
the Wyverian lady said. At this
rate she worries they can't
properly serve the hunters who
visit Mezeporuta Square.
So she said if you gather some
ingredients for them, she'll give
you a red gem as thanks.
That's what she told me!
62984.descriptionJp:
最近、ギルドの食材が不足し
ているって竜人族のお姉さま
が言ってたわ。このままだと、
メゼポルタ広場を訪れるハン
ターたちをちゃんと持て成す
ことができるか心配なんだっ
て。そこで、食材を調達して
くれたら、お礼に赤い玉をあ
げるって言ってたよ！

53307.description: Listen!! My treasured ingredients were stolen by a black devil! It was a little large, so perhaps it was in its growing phase, but that is beside the point! Unforgivable! If you punish it for me, I will share ingredients as thanks!
53307.descriptionEn:
Listen to me!!
My treasured ingredients
were stolen by a black devil!
It was a little on the large side,
so maybe it was just in its
growing phase, but still!
I won't forgive it!
If you punish it
in my place,
I'll share ingredients as thanks!
53307.descriptionJp:
聞いてください！！
わたしの秘蔵の食材が
黒い悪魔に盗まれたんです！
少し体が大きかったので
食べ盛りだったのかも
しれませんが、それはそれ！
許せません！
わたしの代わりに
懲らしめてくれたら
お礼に食材をお分けします！

23367.description: Consulting the Guild's secret records revealed it is an elder dragon called the Silver Dragon. There are reports that this monster is advancing on Mezeporuta. It is thought to be retaliation for intruding on its territory, so please lend your strength to prevent this crisis!
23367.descriptionEn:
Searching the Guild's hidden
texts, we learned it is an
Elder Dragon called Rukodiora.
That monster is advancing on
Mezeporuta. It seems to be
retaliation for trespassing on
its territory. Please lend us
your strength to stop this!
23367.descriptionJp:
ギルド秘蔵の文献をあたった
ところ≪司銀龍≫と呼ばれる
古龍種であることがわかりま
した。
そのモンスターがメゼポルタ
に進行していると報告があり
ました。なわばりに侵入され
たことに対する報復だと思わ
れますが、この危機を防ぐ力
をお貸しください！

55343.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55343.description: What on earth is happening to them!? Did we push them too far? The Guild has decided to call those shining ones the Deviljho that Devours Extremes. Anyone who succeeds in slaying one will receive the materials for a full set of the Guild's treasured armor and a title! Someone, please!
55343.descriptionEn:
What on earth is happening
to them!? Did we push them too far?
The Guild has decided to call
these shining ones the
'Acme Devouring Deviljho'.
If anyone succeeds in slaying one,
we shall present the materials for
a full set of Guild-hidden armor
and a title! Someone, please!
55343.descriptionJp:
ヤツらに何が起こっているの
だ！？追い込み過ぎたのか？
ギルドでは、光放つヤツらを
「極み喰らうイビルジョー」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐に成功したものがいれば
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！
誰か頼む！

21612.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Black Kite Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21612.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as the Black Kite Orb?
Its material is essential
to crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Complete this request for me
and I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21612.descriptionJp:
黒鳶原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

50251.description: This quest yields the following materials. Sword and Shield Soul (Beginning) x８５, Sword and Shield Soul (Middle) x１９５, Sword and Shield Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Sword and Shield Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50251.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Intro≫ x85
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Mid≫ x195
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Extreme≫ x275
≪Sword and Shield Soul - Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
50251.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪片手剣魂・序≫８５枚
≪片手剣魂・中≫１９５枚
≪片手剣魂・極≫２７５枚
≪片手剣魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

56085.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
56085.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56085.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Daimyo Hermitaur.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56085.descriptionJp:
辿異種の盾蟹を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

61553.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
61553.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61553.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61553.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62781.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の討伐
62781.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62781.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!
62781.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を猟団の仲間と行う
のだ。支給品も一切用意
しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

62986.description: Once the invitations went out, hunters began to gather. Some are assembling companions and setting off on quests, others are forming hunting parties and calling for members; it is lively and a joy to see. Would you take on this request together with such companions? On success, I shall give you a rare jewel.
62986.descriptionEn:
Once the invitations went out,
hunters gathered. Some form
parties and leave on quests;
others found Guilds and call
for members. It is lively and
gladdening. Won't you take
this request with such
companions? Succeed, and I
shall give you a rare gem.
62986.descriptionJp:
招待状を出したら、ハンター
が集まってきたな。
仲間を集めてクエストに出発
する者や、猟団を結成し猟団
員を募集する声があり、賑や
かで喜ばしいことだ。
そんな仲間と一緒に、この依
頼を受けてみないか？
成功の暁には、稀少な宝玉を
差し上げよう。

21011.objectiveJp: なわばりのフン２個の納品

62578.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62578.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62578.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62578.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50693.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐

40189.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40189.description: A request where you can obtain the three kinds of Secret Certificate needed to strengthen HS armor. Please make use of it for strengthening event armor!
40189.descriptionEn:
This request lets you get
the three ≪Secret Proofs≫
needed to upgrade ≪HS Armor≫.
Please make use of it for
upgrading event armor!
40189.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＳ防具≫の強化に必要な
「秘伝の証」３種が入手でき
る依頼になります。
イベント防具の強化に
ぜひご利用ください！

54738.description: Please investigate the Violent Wyvern that appeared in the sea of trees. If possible, I would appreciate it if you not only hunted it but also broke its fangs and tail. Hunters, please!
54738.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Abiorugu
that appeared in the Great Forest.
If possible, not just the hunt
but breaking its fangs and tail
would help us greatly.
Hunters, thank you
in advance!
54738.descriptionJp:
樹海に現れた獰竜の
調査をお願いします。
できれば狩猟だけでなく、
牙破壊や尻尾破壊をして
きてくれると助かります。
ハンターの皆さん、よろしく
お願いします！

26595.objectiveJp: よれよれの図面５枚の納品

21173.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての討伐
21173.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21173.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21173.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

60598.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
60598.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blangonga. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin, Transcendent and Aberrant weapons only!
60598.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! This
time the target is <<Blangonga>>!
The spirit to hunt a monster all
on your own is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
This time it is limited to Origin,
Sen'yu and Supremacy weapons!
60598.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ドドブランゴ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は始種・遷悠・辿異武器
限定で開催されているぞ！

60602.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
60602.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Lavasioth will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
60602.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall
Guild, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
The 'fixed damage' dealt to
≪Volganos≫ will be judged by
this Guild, so simply focus on
completing the main target,
everyone!
60602.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ヴォルガノス≫への『一定
