ダメージ』は、当ギルドで判
断しますので、皆さんはメイ
ンターゲットの達成に専念し
てくだされば結構ですよ！

60032.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62642.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62642.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
62642.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

23427.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
23427.description: Word has come of a Teostra sighting at the Tower. It seems to unleash attacks different from those confirmed so far. Only G-rank hunters of proven skill will be asked to investigate, so G-rank hunters, please take up the survey.
23427.descriptionEn:
We have received reports of a
Teostra sighting at the Tower.
It seems to be unleashing
attacks different from those
confirmed up to now.
We will ask only G Rank hunters
of proven skill to investigate,
so G Rank hunters, please
take on this investigation.
23427.descriptionJp:
塔にて、テオ・テスカトルの
目撃情報が入ってきました。
どうやらこれまで確認されて
いたものとは異なる攻撃を繰
り出してくるようです。
腕前の確かなＧ級のハンター
にのみ、調査を依頼すること
となりましたので、Ｇ級ハン
ターは調査をお願い致します。

28044.description: I often cross the desert on business, and lately nothing but strange things happen. I suddenly get sleepy, explosions go off, I cannot stand it! I cannot do business in peace like this! The reward is generous, so settle it quickly!
28044.descriptionEn:
I often cross the Desert on
business, and lately nothing but
strange things keep happening.
I get suddenly sleepy, things
blow up out of nowhere - it's
unbearable!
At this rate I can't do business
in peace!
Good pay, so sort it out quick!
28044.descriptionJp:
よく行商で砂漠を通るんだが
な、最近奇妙な事ばかり起こ
りやがる。急に眠くなったり、
突然爆発が起きたり、たまっ
たもんじゃないぜ！
これじゃぁ、安心して商売出
来やしない！
報酬は弾むから、ちゃちゃっ
と解決してきてくれよ！

61356.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land, and at last my ecological study is nearly complete. Once I finish surveying the Rathalos Variant recently discovered in the canyon, my book will be done, so I ask you to capture it. Help me and I will share a copy of the book.
61356.descriptionEn:
For years I have studied the
King of the Sky and the Queen
of the Land, and at last my
research on their ecology is
nearly finished.
Once I survey the Rathalos
Variant lately found in the
Canyon, my book is done, so
please capture it. You'll get a copy.
61356.descriptionJp:
私は長年、空の王と陸の
女王を研究してきたが、
やっとのことで生態の研究が
終わりそうなんだ。
あとは、峡谷に最近発見され
た火竜変種の調査を終えれば
書物が完成するので、捕獲を
頼むよ。協力してくれれば
書物の写しを分けてあげるよ。

55990.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

62683.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62683.description: Do you have enough zenny? In this job, you can earn materials that sell for a high price. The job is also reputed to be relatively easy. However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
62683.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough Zenny?
With the request we present today,
you can earn materials that sell
for a high price as your reward.
Word is that the request itself
is also fairly easy to complete.
However, you cannot accept it
several times in a row,
so please be careful.
62683.descriptionJp:
ゼニーは足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
高額で売却できる素材を報酬
として獲得できますよ。
依頼内容も、比較的楽に
達成できると評判です。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

62006.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
62006.description: There is a record that our guild once held a festival long ago, and there is talk of reviving it. It sounds like hard work so I don't want to, but I have been told to do it. This time we have special sweets ready, so why not give them to a male hunter you have your eye on?
62006.descriptionEn:
There are records of our guild
holding a festival long ago,
and there's talk of bringing
it back.
It sounds exhausting and I don't
want to, but I was told
to do it.
This time I've prepared special
sweets, so why not give them to
a male hunter you like?
62006.descriptionJp:
昔、うちのギルドでお祭りを
開催してた記録があって、
それを復活させようという話
があるの。
大変そうだからやりたくない
けど、やれって言われちゃっ
た。
今回は、特別なお菓子を用意
したので、気になる男性ハン
ターへ贈ってみたら？

26398.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26398.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
26398.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

56009.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the crest of Gypceros, we will also grant a special item.
56009.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly started UL
Guild Priority Requests,
we have prepared this quest
to raise awareness and
promote them further.
By breaking a Gypceros' crest
we will also grant you
a special item.
56009.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、ＵＬ
ギルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
毒怪鳥のトサカを破壊する
ことで特別なアイテムも付与
させていただきます。

12036.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟

26576.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26576.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26576.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26576.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

55339.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
55339.description: In a canyon in a far distant land, a Dancing Thunder Wyvern and a Pariapuria have been confirmed living. It is very rare for these 2 to appear at the same time, so please do investigate.
55339.descriptionEn:
In a far-off Canyon we confirmed
that <<Berukyurosu>> and
<<Pariapuria>> are living there.
It is very rare for these two
to appear at the same time,
so please survey them for us.
55339.descriptionJp:
遠く離れた地の峡谷で
≪舞雷竜≫と≪呑竜≫が生息
しているのを確認しました。
この２頭が同時に出現する
ことは大変珍しいので、
ぜひ調査をお願いいたします。

11050.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

55587.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55587.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55587.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55587.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

23475.description: The Variant Species Khezu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Khezu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23475.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy <<Khezu>> seems to
have reached the strength of
the very top of all Khezu.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
to challenge the summit, please
conduct this survey.
23475.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪フルフル≫はフルフ
ルの中でも、頂点に辿りつく
ほどの強さに達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

54217.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54217.description: We ask for your help surveying the Dyuragaua in the Canyon. To begin with we plan to study its distinctive tail and right claw. It will be hard work, but to make the survey easier, be sure to break them.
54217.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help with
the survey of the Duramboros
in the Canyon.
To begin with, we plan to
study its distinctive tail
and right claw. It will be hard,
but to make the survey easier,
please be sure to
break them.
54217.descriptionJp:
峡谷にいるデュラガウアの
調査のため、お手伝いを
お願いします。
手はじめとして特徴的な
尻尾と右爪の調査をする
予定です。大変でしょうが、
調査がし易いよう
必ず破壊をするようにして
ください。

26430.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26430.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26430.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26430.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

61163.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
61163.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
61163.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
61163.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

21574.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
21574.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Tiger Claw Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21574.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as the Tiger Claw Orb?
Its material is essential
to crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Complete this request for me
and I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21574.descriptionJp:
虎爪原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

61240.description: The sea of trees is somehow restless. I feel a strange presence, so could you go and investigate once? Once you find the cause, please resolve it too. There is a chance you will get a rough welcome, so I will lend you equipment.
61240.descriptionEn:
The Great Forest is awfully noisy
lately. I feel a strange presence
too, so could you go survey it?
Once you find the cause, deal
with it too. There's a chance
you'll get a rough welcome, so
let me lend you some equipment.
61240.descriptionJp:
樹海がなんだか騒がしいんだ。
妙な気配もするから、一度
調査に向かってくれないか？
原因を突き止めたら、その
解決も頼む。手荒な歓迎を
される可能性もあるから、
装備を貸してあげよう。

23255.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟

55054.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55054.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hunting Horn Merit (Beginning) x５０, Hunting Horn Merit (Middle) x６０, Hunting Horn Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55054.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Hunting Horn Medal: Intro≫ x50
≪Hunting Horn Medal: Mid≫ x60
≪Hunting Horn Medal: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or above, so
please be careful.
55054.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪狩猟笛勲・序≫５０個
≪狩猟笛勲・中≫６０個
≪狩猟笛勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

53005.description: Hypnocatrice and the crowd become one, and it is just like a play! I will let you join that feast too. Oops, do not bring anything dangerous in. Only your weapon, the symbol of a hunter, will I allow. Now! Entertain me!
53005.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and the crowd become
one - it's just like a play!
Let me have you join that feast
too. Oops, don't bring anything
dangerous in here.
Only that weapon, the symbol
of a hunter, will I allow.
Now! Entertain me!
53005.descriptionJp:
ヒプノックと観衆が一体とな
りそれはまるで劇のようだ！
君も、その宴に参加させてあ
げよう。おっと、物騒なモノ
は持ち込まないでくれよ。
ハンターたる象徴の、その武
器だけは許してあげるがね。
さぁ！私を楽しませてくれ！

50761.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Scarlet Leaper will also grant a special ingredient.
50761.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long conducted,
we have prepared this quest to
raise awareness and promote
them further.
By breaking a Hyujikiki's head,
we will also grant you
a special ingredient.
50761.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
跳緋獣の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

55772.objectiveJp: セルレギオス１頭の狩猟
55772.description: This is an upgrade quest for the Transcendent armor Regios GX series. You can obtain more materials than usual. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
55772.descriptionEn:
This is an upgrade quest for the
Transcend Armor "Regios GX
Series".
You can obtain more materials
than usual.
It's a bargain quest, so please
give it a try!
55772.descriptionJp:
遷悠防具「レギオスGXシリー
ズ」の強化クエストになりま
す。
通常よりも多く素材を獲得
することができます。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

62491.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
62491.description: The Shakalaka are said to be holding a ball in the Swamp. How elegant, but it is a nuisance to us. They seem to be looking for dance partners, so do go and oblige them. Apparently this year's main dancer is a Shogun Ceanataur. Dance well and break it up quickly.
62491.descriptionEn:
The masked tribe is holding a ball
in the Swamp, apparently. How
elegant - but a nuisance to us.
They seem to be looking for dance
partners, so go and be their
partner for a while.
Also, this year's main dancer
is said to be a Shogun Ceanataur.
Dance well and break up
the party quickly.
62491.descriptionJp:
奇面族が沼地で舞踏会を開催
しているらしい。優雅なこと
だが、こっちはいい迷惑だ。
ダンスの相手を探しているよ
うだから、いっちょお相手し
て差し上げてくれ。
なお、今年のメインダンサー
は鎌蟹だそうだ。
上手に踊って、さっさと解散
させてくれ。

55506.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
55506.description: If you bring a Secret Bag, I will give you a chance at a special reward. For a Gunner like you, it is a special reward you could not normally wear, so please do join.
55506.descriptionEn:
If you can obtain a Secret Bag,
we will give you the chance
to earn a special reward.
For a gunner like you,
it is a special reward
you cannot normally wear,
so please do join in.
55506.descriptionJp:
秘袋を頂けたら、
あなた様に特別な報酬を
取得するチャンスを与えます。
ガンナーのあなた様にとって
は、普段着ることのできない
特別な報酬となっております
ので、是非ご参加下さい。

50741.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
50741.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50741.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50741.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

21633.description: Have you heard of the Glossy Black Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21633.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as the Glossy Black Orb?
Its material is essential
to crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Complete this request for me
and I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21633.descriptionJp:
濡烏原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

53286.description: This quest yields the following materials. Magnet Spike Soul (Beginning) x８５, Magnet Spike Soul (Middle) x１９５, Magnet Spike Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Magnet Spike Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
53286.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
the following materials.
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Magnet Spike Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
53286.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪磁斬鎚魂・序≫８５枚
≪磁斬鎚魂・中≫１９５枚
≪磁斬鎚魂・極≫２７５枚
≪磁斬鎚魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

54535.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54535.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54535.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

28090.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28090.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
28090.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

55665.description: Hunter who would master the light gun, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55665.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Light Bowgun, show off
the skill you have honed
against the <<Baruragaru>>
in the New Great Arena!
If you can hunt it with skill,
you shall earn a reward
far beyond what your daily
efforts would bring you.
55665.descriptionJp:
軽銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

23254.description: I love surveying the ecology of monsters. If it is to study something I am interested in, I do not mind any danger. But if I lose my life, I can no longer survey. Would you take on guarding me?
23254.descriptionEn:
I simply love surveying monster
ecology, you see.
To study what interests me,
no danger is too great. But if I
lose my life, I can no longer
conduct my surveys.
Won't you take on the job
of escorting me?
23254.descriptionJp:
ワタシはモンスターの生態を
調査するのが大好きでね。
興味があるものを調べるため
ならば、どんな危地でもいと
わない。だが、命を落として
しまっては、調査が出来なく
なる。ワタシの護衛を
頼まれてはくれんか。

60115.description: I want 1 Hypnocatrice captured for ecological study of a new species. I cannot provide supply items at the start of the quest, but I have prepared rewards to make up for it. I leave it to you.
60115.descriptionEn:
I want one Hypnocatrice captured
to study a new species' ecology.
I cannot provide supply items
at the start, but I have prepared
rewards to make up for it. Please.
60115.descriptionJp:
新種の生態研究用として
眠鳥を１頭捕獲して欲しい。
クエスト開始時の支給品は
用意できないが、その分報酬
を用意した。よろしく頼む。

50992.description: There are reports of 2 Aberrant Lavasioth in the volcano, both far stronger than usual. We want to study their ecology, so please slay both of them.
50992.descriptionEn:
There are reports of 2 <<Volganos
Rare Species>>, stronger than
usual, sighted in the Volcano.
We want to study their ecology,
so please slay both of them.
Should some rare material turn up,
I will give it to you.
50992.descriptionJp:
火山で、通常よりも強力な
≪ヴォルガノス奇種≫２頭の
目撃報告があります。生態を
調査したいので２頭合わせて
の討伐をお願いします。
万が一、何か珍しい素材が
取れたら差し上げますよ。

55186.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55186.description: Slaying a Daimyo Hermitaur raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55186.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Daimyo Hermitaur you
can raise your own rating while
getting the materials needed
to obtain G Rank decorations -
we have prepared a quest where
you get them at a bargain.
Please make good use of it.
55186.descriptionJp:
ダイミョウザザミを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

11016.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

54690.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
54690.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further raise awareness and promote them. By breaking the back of a Female Roaring Wolf, we will also grant you a special ingredient.
54690.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared
this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the back of a
Female Roaring Wolf,
we will also grant you
a special ingredient.
54690.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼に
つきまして、より一層の
認知、振興のためこちらの
クエストをご用意いたし
ました。
雌響狼の背中を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

60240.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
60240.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Black Diablos. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60240.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! This
time: <<Black Diablos>>!
Team up with your Guild mates
and achieve the objective.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest - go and take a place
in the top ranks!
Also, SP weapons only this time!
Choose your weapon with care!
60240.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ディアブロス亜種≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50306.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50306.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50306.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

50834.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50834.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
50834.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

62734.description: There are reports that Abiorugu has appeared in the forest. Some of the surveyors heard several roars, and testimony suggests they were calling to one another. Bear in mind that there may be more than one, and conduct the survey fully prepared.
62734.descriptionEn:
We received a report that the
Fierce Wyvern ≪Abiorugu≫ has
appeared in the Great Forest.
Some of the surveyors heard
multiple roars, and we have
testimony saying it sounded
as if they were communicating
with one another.
Bearing in mind there may be
several, we advise a full survey.
62734.descriptionJp:
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫が樹海に
現れたとの報告がありました。
調査員の中には、複数の
咆哮を聞いた者もおり、
まるで、お互い連絡を取り
合っているかのようだとの
証言も取れました。
複数頭いる可能性を視野に
入れ、万全の態勢での調査を
お勧めします。

21855.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
21855.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Diore series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21855.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the crafting and upgrade
materials for all 5 parts of
the <<Hardcore Armor>>
Diore Series.
To accept the quest you will
need a <<Superia Ticket>>.
If you fail the quest,
the <<Superia Ticket>> will be
consumed, so please take care.
21855.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
ディオレシリーズの５部位分
の生産、強化素材が入手でき
ます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21258.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
21258.description: A powerful Cephadrome has appeared. The Guild will pay a large reward to the hunter who slays it! In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware!
21258.descriptionEn:
A powerful ≪Cephadrome≫
has appeared.
The Guild will pay a large
sum to the hunter who slays
it! Other rewards, however,
are modest, so do be
careful!
21258.descriptionJp:
≪ドスガレオス≫の強力な
個体が現れました。
ギルドでは、これを討伐した
ハンターに、多額の報酬金を
支払うことになりました！
その代わり、その他の見返り
は控えめなので要注意です！

21225.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21225.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21225.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

63387.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
63387.description: The fortress guard reports that Lao-Shan Lung is advancing. Hunters, head for the fortress at once and repel it. You may use the fortress's equipment freely. Make the most of it in battle.
63387.descriptionEn:
Word has come from the fort's
guards that Lao-Shan Lung is
advancing on us. Hunters, go to
the fort at once and intercept it.
You may use the fort's facilities
freely. Make the fullest use of
them and turn them to your
advantage in battle.
63387.descriptionJp:
老山龍ラオシャンロンが侵攻
してきていると砦の警備兵か
ら連絡が届いています。ハン
ターの皆さんは直ちに砦へ向
かいこれを迎撃してください。
砦の設備は自由に使って構い
ません。最大限に活用し戦い
に役立ててください。

26567.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26567.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26567.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26567.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

55837.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐

26544.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26544.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26544.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

54515.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54515.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54515.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54515.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

62173.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Hypnocatrice of the Forest. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
62173.descriptionEn:
The time has come
for hunters to show their skill!
Hunt the <<Hypnocatrice>>
in the Great Forest. If you
clear the quest safely,
your rating as hunters
will shoot right up!
62173.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
樹海の≪眠鳥≫を狩猟して
みせろ。無事、クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

55802.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55802.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55802.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
55802.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

63236.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

23607.description: The Variant Species Hyujikiki has appeared once more. Its needles have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23607.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Hyujikiki≫ has
appeared once again. Its needles
are stronger now, and it seems
to have grown even mightier.
Please take every care in your
survey.
23607.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ヒュジキキ≫が
再び現れました。
針はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

54659.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
54659.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54659.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.
54659.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の航路を制覇されたハン
ターさんですね。このクエス
トではキャラバン秘箱を他の
キャラバン箱に交換すること
ができます。その他にも、Ｇ
ＲＰ、Ｇｚ共に大量に獲得す
ることができます！モンス
ターも登場しますので、油断
せず狩猟に向かってください。

63123.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63123.description: A very powerful Yian Garuga that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63123.descriptionEn:
A ≪Yian Garuga≫ individual
that behaves unlike any other,
and is incredibly powerful,
is in the New Great Arena.
We want it hunted.
This request is only for
Hunters with Secret Art
scroll gear approved by the
guild. Clear it and earn
even greater renown.
63123.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪黒狼鳥≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

62583.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62583.description: It's me! The Instructor! A group calling itself the Hunter Exchange Committee has sent a request: they want me to help you lot mingle with ace hunters! From here on I'll be driving you hard, so brace yourselves! Come, greenhorn hunters! First, go and handle a monster hunt and a delivery job with distinction!
62583.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
An organization called the Hunter
Exchange Committee has asked us
to help you mingle with skilled
hunters! I'll be strict from here
on, so brace yourself!
Now, you fledgling hunters!
First, go handle monster hunting
and hauling jobs with distinction!
62583.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
狩人交流委員会とかいう団体
から、諸君らが凄腕ハンターと
交流する手助けをしてほしいと
いう依頼が来た！これからビシ
ビシいくから覚悟しておけ！
さあ、ひよっこハンターよ！
まずはモンスターの狩猟と運搬
の仕事を立派にこなしてこい！

22165.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Blademaster), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
22165.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials needed to FX
upgrade Secret Art Armor
(Blademaster), excluding
weapon souls. The yield
covers five pieces. To
accept, ≪Hunter Pass:
Sakura≫ is required, so
please note.
22165.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（剣士）のFX強化時
に必要な武器魂を除く素材を
排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

26089.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26089.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26089.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

56105.client: Man Who Lives in the Tower
56105.clientEn: Man Who Lives in the Tower

63144.objectiveJp: ハンターカード青１０枚納品
63144.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
63144.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
63144.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

63058.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Abiorugu of the swamp. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
63058.descriptionEn:
The time has come
for hunters to show their skill!
Hunt the <<Abiorugu>>
in the Swamp. If you
clear the quest safely,
your rating as hunters
will shoot right up!
63058.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
沼地の≪獰竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。無事、クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

23365.description: A request for hunters who possess Flogada G Series LV7. Hunt Hypnocatrice and you can obtain materials to strengthen the Flogada GF Series to LV7 for one part.
23365.descriptionEn:
This request is for hunters
who own the LV7
"Frogada G Series".
Hunting a <<Hypnocatrice>> will
get you the materials to upgrade
the "Frogada GF Series" to LV7
for one part.
23365.descriptionJp:
「フロガダＧシリーズ」の
ＬＶ７を所持している
ハンター向けの依頼です。
≪眠鳥≫を狩猟すると、
「フロガダGFシリーズ」を
ＬＶ７まで強化する素材が
１部位分入手できます。

50175.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
50175.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Canyon. The dancing thunder wyvern Berukyurosu has also been confirmed in the depths, it seems. Hunt that one too while you are there! Now off you go!!
50175.descriptionEn:
It is I. The Instructor! This time
I want you all to explore the
Canyon. In the depths, the Thunder
Wyvern <<Berukyurosu>> has been
confirmed as well, it seems.
Hunt it too while you're there!
Now, go and do your best!!
50175.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、峡谷を探索してきて
もらう。奥地には舞雷竜≪ベ
ルキュロス≫も確認されてい
るようだ。ついでにそいつも
狩猟してくるのだ！
さあ頑張ってこい！！

60527.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
60527.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.
60527.descriptionJp:
どこでこの話を聞きつけたか
は知らんが、ヤバい話には失
敗の救済など一切ないぞ？
ブツの用意もいいだろうな？
必要なブツの数は条件通りだ。
あとは、現地で１人で働いて
もらう。徒党を組むとナメた
真似するヤツが出るんでな。

50854.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50854.description: For those who have reached SR100, we have prepared a quest to upgrade the "Karais FY Series" to the "Karais HS Series". By hunting a Yian Kut-Ku Rare Species, you can obtain part of the materials needed to upgrade one part to Hunting Guard Armor and level it up.
50854.descriptionEn:
For those who have reached SR100,
we have prepared a quest to
upgrade the "Karais FY Series"
to the "Karais HS Series".
By hunting a Yian Kut-Ku Rare
Species, you can obtain part of
the materials needed to upgrade
one part to Hunting Guard Armor
and level it up.
50854.descriptionJp:
ＳＲ１００に到達した方々へ
「カライスＦＹシリーズ」を
「カライスＨＳシリーズ」へ
強化するためのクエストを
準備しました。
イャンクック奇種を狩猟する
ことで、１部位分を狩護防具
へ強化しレベルアップさせる
素材の一部が入手できます。

61602.description: A request from the Rasta tavern. It seems that on an errand to the volcano, someone left a certain thing behind. It is said to be a very important item, so they want you to find it. Gravios and the like seem to be prowling about, so take care out there.
61602.descriptionEn:
This request comes from the
Rasta Tavern. It seems that
when they went out to the Volcano
on business, they left
something behind.
It is apparently very important,
so they want you to find it.
<<Gravios>> and others are roaming
about, so be careful out there.
61602.descriptionJp:
ラスタ酒場からの依頼だ。
所用で火山に出かけたときに、
ある物を置いてきてしまった
らしい。
とても大切な品らしいので、
探してきてほしいとのことだ。
≪グラビモス≫たちが徘徊し
てるみたいだから、気をつけ
て行って来い。

60722.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60722.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60722.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60722.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

22070.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to handle the Tonfa, which cannot be used unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22070.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope that you will strive
toward G Rank, which only
truly outstanding hunters
can attain.
This time, I have prepared a
chance to handle the <<Tonfa>>,
which none may use unless
they reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22070.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。
今回、特別にＧ級にならぬ
と扱うことが許されぬ、
≪穿龍棍≫を扱う機会を
用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

62548.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
62548.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62548.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62548.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

53054.description: Everyone, how are you! Miyashita here! My challenge to you (a quiz). Question 1: The spiked organ on a Rathian's jaw is poisonous. If you think the answer is false (B), take this quest!
53054.descriptionEn:
Is everyone doing well!?
It's Miyashita!
A challenge from me (a quiz)!
[Question 1]
The spike-like organ growing on a
Rathian's jaw has poison in it.
If you think the answer is X (B),
hunters should accept
this quest!
53054.descriptionJp:
みんな元気ですか！？
宮下です！
僕からの挑戦状（クイズ）
【第１問】
リオレイアの顎に生えている
棘状の器官には毒がある
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

62584.description: Fwahaha! It is I, the Instructor! Novice hunter and ace hunter! Are you ready? Skin-to-skin honesty is the first step to friendship! Turn in what you bring and succeed in a hunt without armor! Succeed and a fine reward awaits!
62584.descriptionEn:
Fuhaha! It is I, the Instructor!
You greenhorn and veteran
hunters! Are you ready!
Nothing builds friendship like
a bare-skinned hunt! Deliver
what you brought along and
pull off a hunt with no armor!
Succeed, and a fine reward awaits!
62584.descriptionJp:
ふはは！我輩だ！教官だ！
ひよっこハンターと凄腕ハン
ターよ！準備はいいか！
裸の付き合いこそ仲良しの第
一歩！持ち寄ったものを納品
し、防具なしで狩猟を成功さ
せてみろ！見事成功させれば、
ステキな報酬が待っているぞ！

21915.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
21915.description: At last the Hunters Guild has discovered a species thought to be the origin of evolution! We tried to capture it to uncover the mystery of evolution, but it will not even approach a trap. Worse, its blasts of water are destroying the desert ecosystem. Slay it!
21915.descriptionEn:
At last, the Hunters Guild
has found a species thought
to be the origin of
evolution! We tried to
capture it to solve the
mystery, but it ignores our
traps. Worse, its blasts of
water are destroying the
Desert ecosystem. Slay it!
21915.descriptionJp:
ついにハンターズギルドでは
進化の起源と思われる種を
発見することに成功した！
進化の謎を究明する為にも
ヤツを捕まえようとしたが
罠をも寄せ付けぬ。
そればかりか、噴き放つ水流
により砂漠の生態系が壊され
つつある。
ヤツを討伐してくれ！

55292.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft the Cuffs 'G Issen Cuff SA1' and 'G Issen Cuff SA6' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55292.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won
the Grand Prize in the
"F Photo Contest 2016",
we have prepared a quest
where you can obtain the
materials to craft the cuffs
"G Flash Cuff SA1" and
"G Flash Cuff SA6" used in it.
Please make use of it.
55292.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
るカフ「Ｇ一閃カフＳＡ１」
「Ｇ一閃カフＳＡ６」
を生産するための素材を獲得
できるクエストをご用意しま
した。
ぜひご利用ください。

62918.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62918.description: Would you be interested in a wonderful play woven by a Hypnocatrice and a Blue Hypnocatrice? Actually, you are perfect for the lead role. Take this costume and these props and let me see your acting. Together, let us bring joy and feeling to everyone!
62918.descriptionEn:
Would you be interested in a
wonderful play woven by a
Hypnocatrice and an Azure
Hypnocatrice? Actually, you are
perfect for the lead role.
Take this costume and props and
show me your acting.
Let's bring joy to everyone!
62918.descriptionJp:
眠鳥と蒼眠鳥が織りなす
素敵な演劇に興味はないか？
実は、主役のイメージに
君がぴったりなんだよ。
この衣装と小道具を持って
君の演技を見せて欲しい。
一緒に、みんなに喜びと
感動を届けようじゃないか！

54466.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54466.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54466.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55672.description: A quest aimed at hunters who do not yet possess the Variant skill cuffs Paralysis Resistance Boost Cuff ＳＺ and Earplug Boost Cuff ＳＺ, intended to spread those cuffs. So that the guild can support you as well, the rewards lean toward cuff crafting. Please take the quest with vigour.
55672.descriptionEn:
This quest is aimed at those who
do not yet own the Supremacy
cuffs <<Anti-Paralysis Cuff SZ>>
and <<Earplug Cuff SZ>>, and is
meant to spread their use.
To support you, the Guild has
weighted the rewards toward
cuff crafting, so please
accept it with enthusiasm.
55672.descriptionJp:
辿異スキルカフである、
≪耐麻強化カフＳＺ≫並びに
≪耳栓強化カフＳＺ≫を
未所持の方へ向けた、上記
カフの普及を目的とした
クエストです。ギルド側でも
支援できるよう、報酬をより
カフ作成に寄せていますので、
奮って受注ください。

23171.objectiveJp: フルベビアイス１個の納品

51012.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の狩猟
51012.description: Do you know the monster called Deviljho? Hunting even one is said to be difficult, and we are recruiting hunters to hunt two at once! Those confident in their skill, please join!
51012.descriptionEn:
Do you know the monster
called the ≪Deviljho≫?
It is said to be hard to
hunt even on its own, and
we are now recruiting
hunters to take down two
at once! If you are sure
of your skill, join us!
51012.descriptionJp:
≪恐暴竜≫というモンスター
を知っているか。
ただでさえ狩猟することが
難しいとされているが、この
モンスターを２頭同時に狩猟
するハンターを募集中だ！
腕に自信のある者は、ぜひ
参加してほしい！

23288.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
23288.description: The survey of the deep swamp has begun, and many reports are now coming in. Among them is a report of a black mountain-like dragon that appears with a rumbling of the earth. Please ascertain the identity of this monster at once.
23288.descriptionEn:
Surveying of the deep Swamp has
begun, and many reports are now
coming in. Among them we have
received word of a black,
mountain-like dragon that appears
alongside rumbling tremors.
Please determine this monster's
identity as a matter of urgency.
23288.descriptionJp:
沼地の深部の調査が開始さ
れ、多くの報告が上がって
くるようになりました。
その中に、地鳴りとともに
現れる黒い山のような竜の
報告が届いています。
至急、このモンスターの
正体を突き止めてください。

54469.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
54469.description: Diorekkusu has appeared at the top of the sea of trees. It is a very dangerous monster that hardens its outer shell using the electricity generating organs in its body and shows quick movement. Many hunters have already been harmed. Please proceed to slay it with the utmost care.
54469.descriptionEn:
A ≪Diorex≫ has appeared at the
Top of Great Forest. It hardens
its outer shell using the power
generation organ in its body and
moves with great speed; it is a
very dangerous monster. Many
hunters have already fallen
victim. Please take the utmost
care when you slay it.
54469.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に
≪ディオレックス≫が現れま
した。体内の発電器官を利用
した外殻の硬質化と、素早い
動きを見せる、非常に危険な
モンスターです。既に多くの
ハンターが被害にあっていま
す。細心の注意を払い
討伐に当たってください。

21530.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21530.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21530.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

60587.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Khezu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60587.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! This
time the target is <<Khezu>>!
Team up with your Guild mates
and achieve the objective.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest - go and take a place
in the top ranks!
Also, Origin weapons only!
Choose your weapon with care!
60587.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪フルフル≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

63277.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
63277.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of extremely powerful Kamu Orugaron and Nono Orugaron. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63277.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We are seeking
someone to deal with
extremely powerful
<<Kam Orugaron>> and
<<Non Orugaron>> individuals.
If you hunt them with skill,
we shall issue more slay proofs
than usual!
63277.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪カム・オルガロン≫と
≪ノノ・オルガロン≫の
個体を退治してくださる方を
募集しております。
見事に狩猟できましたら、
普段よりも多めに討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

60408.description: Just when I thought those noisy ones were gone, now there is a swarm of Cantaro thick enough to cover the ground! I left my important baggage behind! Someone drive them off!
60408.descriptionEn:
Just when those noisy pests were
gone, now there is a swarm of
Hornetaurs that looks ready to
cover the ground!
I left my important cargo behind!
Someone go and drive them off!
60408.descriptionJp:
五月蝿いあいつらがいなくな
ったと思ったら、今度は足元
を埋め尽くさんばかりのカン
タロスの大群！
大事な荷物を残してきたまま
なんだ！誰かあいつらを追い
払ってくれよ！

21665.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21665.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21665.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
21665.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

11069.objectiveJp: フルベビアイス６個の納品
11069.description: A white shadow crawling in the darkness has been sighted! If you would face the white shadow, Khezu, you must not look only at the ground! It seems very fond of silencing every sound and striking from the ceiling!
11069.descriptionEn:
A white shadow has been seen
crawling through the dark!
If you would face the Khezu
that is that white shadow, do
not just watch the ground!
It loves to silence every
sound and strike from the
ceiling!
11069.descriptionJp:
暗闇を這う白影が目撃され
たようです！白影の正体、
≪フルフル≫の狩猟に臨む
なら、地上ばかりを見てたら
ダメですよ！一切の音を消し
て天井から襲い掛かかるのが
大のお得意みたいですから！

22026.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
22026.description: In the mysterious unexplored Old Tower, an unobserved creature with no record at all in the authorities' documents has been confirmed. Surely the White Dragon spoken of in only one book has not appeared...?
22026.descriptionEn:
In the mysterious, unexplored
≪Ancient Tower≫, an unobserved
≪creature≫ with no record at all
in official documents has been
confirmed. Could it be that the
≪White Dragon≫ written of in
only one book has appeared...?
22026.descriptionJp:
謎多き未開の地≪古塔≫にて、
当局の文献にも、一切の記録
が無い、未観測の≪生物≫が
確認されました。まさか、
ある書物にのみ記されている
という≪白き龍≫が現れたと
いうのでしょうか...。

54325.description: For the survey, I ask you to hunt a Baruragaru. This investigation aims first to elucidate the structure of its tongue and tail. Be sure to break them before you hunt it.
54325.descriptionEn:
I need you to hunt a Baruragaru
for our survey.
This time the goal is to first
clarify the structure of the
tongue and tail. Be sure to
break them before the hunt.
54325.descriptionJp:
調査のために、バルラガルの
狩猟をお願いするよ。
今回の調査では、まず舌と
尻尾の構造を解明するのが
目的だ。必ず破壊してから
狩猟するようにしてくれよ。

56134.description: Here it comes! The Top Title Match! The reigning champion, having beaten the legendary Taikun Mask and Great Espi, is the Blue-Red Gougarufu! Challenging him, the superhuman Hunters who surpass everything alongside their partners! Who will win! Ladies and gentlemen, fight!
56134.descriptionEn:
Here it comes!
The Top Title Match!
Reigning supreme is the Azure
Crimson Gougarf, conqueror of
the legendary Taikun Mask and
Great Espi!
Challengers: superhuman Hunters
who surpass all with partners!
Ladiiiies, fight!
56134.descriptionJp:
さあやってまいりました！
テッペンタイトルマッチ！
君臨するは伝説のタイクン・
マスクとグレート・エスピを
制した蒼紅のゴウガルフ！
これに挑むは、パートナーと
なら全てを超えていく超人
ハンターズ！勝者はどちらだ！
レディィィー、ファイッ！

53063.description: This is Miyashita! The final question at last! [Question 6] I! Love all of you! If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53063.descriptionEn:
It's Miyashita!
The final question at last!
[Question 6]
I!
Love all of you!!
So very much!!!
If you think the answer is O (A),
hunters should accept
this quest!
53063.descriptionJp:
宮下です！
いよいよ最終問題です！
【第６問】
僕は！
みなさんのことが！！
大好きです！！！
答えが○（Ａ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

61835.description: Mining is good work. While you dig you can empty your mind. When I head to the hunting grounds, I always bring a pickaxe! So then, the next request. This time too I await a delivery of fine ore. Look forward to the reward!
61835.descriptionEn:
Mining is great, isn't it?
While you dig, your mind goes
blank. When I head out to
hunt, I always bring a
pickaxe along with me!
So, here's the next request.
I'm waiting on good ore again.
Expect a fine reward!
61835.descriptionJp:
採掘はいいよな。
掘ってる最中は無心になれる。
オレも狩り場に行く時は、
必ずピッケル持参だ！
てなわけで、次の依頼だ。
今回も良質な鉱石の納品を
待ってるぞ。
報酬は期待してくれ！

54682.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further raise awareness and promote them. By breaking a Gogomoa's tail, we will also grant you a special ingredient.
54682.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we have prepared
this quest to further raise
awareness and
promote them.
By breaking a Hyujikiki's tail,
we will also grant you
a special ingredient.
54682.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼に
つきまして、より一層の
認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストを
ご用意いたしました。
跳緋獣の尻尾を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

61827.description: Before we knew it, an Espinas had taken up residence in the Great Arena. And a Hypnocatrice too. Won't you take on slaying those troublemakers? Just dealing with the Espinas is enough. Oh, and the reward goes to the first to finish!
61827.descriptionEn:
Before we knew it, an Espinas had
planted itself in the Great Arena.
And on top of that, a Hypnocatrice
has moved in too. Won't you take
on slaying that rampaging brute?
Just deal with the Espinas and
that is enough. Oops, the reward
goes to whoever gets here first!
61827.descriptionJp:
いつの間にか大闘技場に
エスピナスが居座りやがった。
おまけにヒプノックまで
居やがる。あの暴れものの
討伐を引受けてくれないか？
エスピナスさえどうにかして
くれればいい。おっと、報酬
は早い者勝ちだからな！

20002.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の撃退
20002.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The wind wyvern Kushala Daora has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and drive the elder dragon off, we beg of you!
20002.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Office!
The Wind Dragon Kushala Daora
has invaded Dundorma's territory!
Dundorma now enters its Elder
Dragon interception stance!
Please use the intercept devices
set in the zone to repel it!
20002.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
ドンドルマの領内に風翔龍
クシャルダオラが侵入しまし
た！これよりドンドルマは、
古龍の迎撃体制に入ります！
迎撃区画に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を撃退して頂
けますようお願い致します！

26164.description: We discovered a vast sea of trees in an unexplored land. The moment we stepped in, a great swarm of Vespoid! We fled for our lives and left our baggage behind. It is important baggage! Will someone drive off that swarm!
26164.descriptionEn:
I discovered a vast Great Forest
in an unexplored land. The moment
I stepped in, a swarm of Vespoids!
I ran for my life and left my
cargo behind. It's important
cargo! Won't someone drive off
that swarm for me!
26164.descriptionJp:
未開の地に広大な樹海を発見
したんだ。足を踏み入れると
ランゴスタの大群さ！
逃げるのに必死で荷物を残し
てきてしまった。大事な荷物
なんだ！誰かあの大群を追い
払ってくれないか！

21001.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
21001.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
21001.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the Jungle!
We will also pay for the insects
that sometimes fly there,
Royal Beetles, if you deliver them!
Start by learning the Jungle and
getting used to it.
21001.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を８つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

55591.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55591.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55591.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

62075.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
62075.description: Senior, show me your first-class hunting skill! Taking on two large monsters at once is a trick only you can do! Could you hunt the nearer one without the one deeper in noticing? I cannot wait to see how!
62075.descriptionEn:
Please show me your first-class
hunting skill, senpai!
Taking on two large monsters at
once is a feat only you can pull
off, senpai!
Could it be that you can hunt the
one in front without the one in
back noticing?
I can't wait to see how!
62075.descriptionJp:
センパイの一流の狩猟技術を
見せてくださいッス！
大型モンスターを２頭同時に
相手にするなんて、センパイ
にしかできない芸当ッス！
もしかして、奥にいる１頭に
気付かれずに手前の１頭を
狩れちゃうんスか？
どうやるのか楽しみッス！

50639.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Leaping Scarlet Beast on Tide Island! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50639.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show me the skill you
honed against the <<Hyujikiki>>
on Tidal Island!
If you can hunt it with skill,
you shall earn even more rewards
than your daily efforts would
bring you.
50639.descriptionJp:
鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

23471.description: The Variant Species Hypnocatrice appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Hypnocatrice. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23471.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy <<Hypnocatrice>>
seems to have reached the
strength of the very top of all
Hypnocatrice.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
challenge the summit, please
conduct this survey.
23471.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ヒプノック≫はヒプ
ノックの中でも、頂点に辿り
つくほどの強さに達したよう
です。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

62133.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟
62133.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62133.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62133.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

61916.objectiveJp: カフの素・緑１０個の納品
61916.description: Ye who are strong. Will you not submit to me the thing that serves as proof? Then I shall give you proof of power. And clad in that proof, I very much want you to go out hunting! Is it only I who thinks so?
61916.descriptionEn:
You who are strong.
Won't you present me with something
to serve as proof?
If you do, I shall give you the
Proof of Power.
And then, clad in that proof,
I hope you go out hunting!
Is it only I who thinks so?
61916.descriptionJp:
強き者よ。
私に証拠となるモノを提出し
てくれないか。
さすれば、チカラの証を
渡そう。
そして、その証を身に纏い、
ぜひ狩りに出かけてほしい！
そう思うのは、私だけか？

62830.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
62830.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
62830.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
62830.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

26478.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
26478.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Any monster's subspecies is a tough opponent, but basically the same as the original. Fight!
26478.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Subspecies are tough foes
for any monster, but at
heart they're the same. Fight!
26478.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
どのモンスターも、亜種は
手ごわい相手ですが、基本は
原種と同じです。ファイト！

23399.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
23399.description: We have a report that a Blue Yian Kut-Ku has been found on Tide Island. It appears to differ from the Blue Yian Kut-Ku seen so far. Please see the creature with your own eyes and confirm it.
23399.descriptionEn:
We received a report that a
≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫ was
found on Tidal Island.
It seems to differ from the
ones seen so far. Please see
the ≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫ yourself.
23399.descriptionJp:
潮島にて≪青怪鳥≫を見つけ
たと報告を受けました。
今までの≪青怪鳥≫とは
様子が違うみたいです。
是非、貴方の目で≪青怪鳥≫
の姿を確かめてください。

23609.description: The Variant Species Hyujikiki appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Hyujikiki. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23609.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Hyujikiki≫ seems
to have reached the strength
of the pinnacle among
Hyujikiki. Its power is
immeasurable. Hunters
confident in their skill,
please take on this survey.
23609.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ヒュジキキ≫は
ヒュジキキの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

26009.description: Many reports of damage by flying wyverns come from travelers passing near the sea of trees on their way to other regions. If we reduce the number of flying wyverns that nest in the sea of trees, this damage should subside to some extent. We expect great things from you.
26009.descriptionEn:
Many travelers who pass near the
Great Forest on their way to other
regions report harm from flying
wyverns. If we thin the number of
flying wyverns nesting in the
Great Forest, the damage should
settle somewhat. I expect great
things from you.
26009.descriptionJp:
樹海付近を通って、他地方に
抜ける旅人から、飛竜による
被害報告が多数出ておる。
樹海をねぐらとしている飛竜
の数を減らせば、この被害も
ある程度収束するじゃろう。
おぬしらの働きに期待してお
るぞ。

23596.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
23596.description: A giant fireball above Schrade Castle, and the investigation revealed a terrible fact. The Fatalis hailed as the black legend had mutated into something even more powerful! Unimaginable damage will occur. Please slay it swiftly.
23596.descriptionEn:
A giant fireball has appeared
above Schrade Castle, and our
investigation revealed a terrible
truth. Fatalis, hailed as the
black legend, had mutated into
a far more powerful form!
If left alone, damage beyond
imagination will surely follow.
We ask for a swift slaying.
23596.descriptionJp:
シュレイド城上空に巨大な火
球が発生しており調査の結果、
恐ろしい事実が判明しました。
なんと、黒き伝説と謳われる
ミラボレアスがより強力に変
異していたのです！
このままでは想像もできない
被害が発生することでしょう。
迅速な討伐をお願いします。

54239.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
54239.description: After searching the Guild's documents from one end to the other, we learned the new monster in the swamp is the Blood Drinker Dragon, Baruragaru. Now there are reports of a sighting in the desert, avoiding the hot sand and hiding in dim caves. We ask for another investigation!
54239.descriptionEn:
After combing through every
document in the Guild, we learned
that the new monster appearing
in the Swamp is the ≪Blood-eating
Wyvern≫, Baruragaru.
And now there is a report of a
sighting in the Desert: it avoids
the burning sand and lurks in
dim caves, they say.
We ask you to investigate once again!
54239.descriptionJp:
ギルドにある文書を片っ端
から調べた結果、沼地に出現
した新たなモンスターは
≪喰血竜≫バルラガルである
ことがわかった。
そして、今度は砂漠で目撃し
たという報告があり、熱砂を
避け、薄暗い洞窟に潜んでい
るそうだ。
再び、調査をお願いしたい！

56148.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
56148.description: Magnet Spike, Magspa for short. The finest weapon type there is. In honour of Master Graham, evangelist of this weapon, I have prepared a quest like this. I hope you enjoy it! If you need help, try clearing the sub-target.
56148.descriptionEn:
Magnet Spike -
shortened to "Magspa".
The finest weapon type of all.
In honor of Lord Graham, the
missionary of this weapon,
I have prepared a quest like this.
I hope you enjoy it!
If you need help, try clearing
the sub-target.
56148.descriptionJp:
マグネットスパイク、
縮めて「マグスパ」。
最高に素晴らしい武器種だ。
この武器の伝道師たる
グラハム殿に敬意を表して、
このようなクエストを用意
してみた。楽しんで欲しい！
助力が必要なら、サブター
ゲットをクリアしてみてくれ。

55739.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55739.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55739.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

56137.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
56137.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
56137.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54246.description: Thanks to your gathering in unexplored lands and delivering to the Guild, Mezepolta has grown richer. As a token of our gratitude, we present this coin.
54246.descriptionEn:
Thanks to your gathering in
unexplored lands and your
deliveries to the Guild,
Mezeporuta has grown wealthy.
As a token of our gratitude,
please accept this coin.
54246.descriptionJp:
未開の地において採集を行い、
ギルドに納品していただいた
おかげで、メゼポルタも豊か
になりました。
その感謝の証として、この
コインを贈ります。

50148.description: I drank too much, I am sozzled. Brother, do the quick job for me again. Tonight I will howl at the moon again. Kashiraaa! Mizukiii! Demetriaaaan!
50148.descriptionEn:
I'm so drunk~, totally sloshed~.
Brother, go and take care of it
quick like always~.
Me, I'm gonna howl at the moon
again tonight.
Kashiraaaaaaaaaaa!
Mizukiiiiiiiiiiii!
Demetriaaaaaaaaaan!
50148.descriptionJp:
飲みすぎよ〜へべれけよ〜。
兄弟、またちゃちゃっと
やっちゃっておくれよ〜。
オイラはさ〜、また今夜も
月に向かって雄叫びよ。
カシラーーーーーーーーー！
ミズキーーーーーーーーー！
デメトリアーーーーーーン！

21103.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21103.description: The Ioprey are loudly active, which means there is a high chance the leader, Iodrome, is around. Take that poison liquid head on and you could lose your life. Do not forget to bring antidote items.
21103.descriptionEn:
If the Genprey are stirring
so actively, a ≪Gendrome≫ is
likely leading them. Taking
that venom head-on could cost
you your life. Don't forget
to bring antidote items.
21103.descriptionJp:
イーオスたちが活発に騒いで
いるってことは、親玉の≪ド
スイーオス≫がいる可能性が
高いわ。あの毒液をまともに
受けてしまうと、命を落とし
かねない。解毒系アイテムを
忘れずに持っていくことね。

11052.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, please plant our Guild Flag at the summit.
11052.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species, has no fixed habitat, and
because its numbers are so small is
a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
please plant our ≪Guild Flag≫
at the summit♪
11052.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物です。雪山に行くなら山頂
にウチの≪ギルドフラッグ≫
を立ててきてくださいね♪

50723.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Slaying a Kirin will also grant a special ingredient.
50723.descriptionEn:
To promote the Guild
Priority Requests we have
long held, we prepared this
quest. Slaying the Kirin
also grants you a special
ingredient.
50723.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
幻獣を討伐することで特別な
食材も付与させていただきま
す。

28051.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
28051.description: Merchants crossing the desert report being chased by a monster with great horns. It seems that, striking from underground, it has ruined many loads of cargo. This is an important supply route, so please respond at once.
28051.descriptionEn:
We have reports from merchants
crossing the Desert that they were
chased around by a monster with
large horns.
Caught off guard by it burrowing
underground, it seems much of
their cargo was ruined.
This is a vital supply route, so
ask for an urgent response.
28051.descriptionJp:
砂漠を渡る商人たちから、大
きな角を持ったモンスターに
追い掛け回されたとの報告が
入っております。
地中に潜る等、不意を突かれ
ては多くの積み荷が無駄に
なってしまったようです。
重要な物資航路の為、至急対
応願います。

54557.description: We are seeking hunters to hunt the Pink Rathian that has appeared in the Jungle. Should you judge the hunt too difficult, you may slay the nearby Velociprey and return, no problem.
54557.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters to
hunt the Rathian Subspecies that
appeared in the Jungle.
If you judge the hunt too
difficult, you may slay the
nearby Velociprey and return
home instead.
54557.descriptionJp:
密林に現れたリオレイア亜種
を狩猟していただける
ハンターを募集しています。
万一、狩猟が難しいと判断さ
れた場合は、付近のランポス
を討伐してご帰還いただいて
も問題ありません。

61928.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟

60134.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60134.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60134.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60134.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

21849.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
21849.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21849.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21849.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

60137.description: A forest has appeared at the very front line of development. If there is a new species whose ecology is unknown in this land so hard to enter, securing safety is the first step of research. Let us see what you hunters can do.
60137.descriptionEn:
A Great Forest has appeared at
the forefront of exploration.
If an unknown new species lives
in this land so hard to enter,
then securing safety is the
first step of research.
Let us see what you hunters can do.
60137.descriptionJp:
開拓の最前線に現れた樹海。
踏み入ることも困難なこの地に
生態も分からぬ新種がいると
なれば、安全の確保が研究の
第一歩だ。
ハンター諸君のお手並み拝見と
いこう。

50328.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50328.description: Workers extracting ore in the highlands report encountering a Dyuragaua and fleeing for their lives with the work suspended. Hunters, head for the site at once and work to secure it.
50328.descriptionEn:
Workers mining ore in the Highlands
have reported encountering a
≪Duramboros≫, forcing them to halt
work and flee for their lives.
All hunters, please hurry to the
site and work to secure the area's
safety.
50328.descriptionJp:
高地で鉱石採取の作業を
行っている作業員から
≪デュラガウア≫と遭遇し、
作業を中断し命からがら逃げ
てきたと報告がありました。
ハンターの皆さんは、
急ぎ現地へ向かい安全の確保
に務めてください。

54638.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
54638.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54638.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54638.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55248.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Odiba GX Mail' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55248.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
Grand Prize in the
"F Photo Contest 2016",
we have prepared a quest
where you can obtain the
materials to craft and upgrade
the "Odiba GX Mail" armor in it.
Please make use of it.
55248.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「オディバGXメイル」
を生産・強化するための素材
を獲得できるクエストをご用
意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

21248.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21248.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21248.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

54456.description: We continue the investigation of Akura Jebia. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54456.descriptionEn:
We will continue the survey
of Akura Jebia.
Breaking parts is not mandatory,
but we would be delighted
if you did!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid!
54456.descriptionJp:
アクラ・ジェビアの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

26309.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26309.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26309.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61448.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament preliminaries. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials by carving or clear rewards.
61448.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament preliminaries.
In the main round the time
limit is 5 minutes.
Also, you cannot obtain the
target monster's materials
by carving or clear rewards.
61448.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選練習用
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が５分以内です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

55034.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
55034.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55034.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55034.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62377.description: Hey, you have finally reached ace hunter. The Hunters Guild gave you a special weapon, right? That is a weapon suited to Variants and is also a condition for some jobs. Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share upgrade materials. Will you try?
62377.descriptionEn:
Hey, so you have finally reached
the rank of ace hunter.
You got a special weapon from the
Hunters Guild, right? That is a
weapon suited to Variants, and it
also serves as a condition for
taking some requests.
Clear the requests I introduce and
I will share upgrade materials.
Wanna give it a try?
62377.descriptionJp:
よう、お前もようやく凄腕
ハンターに到達したんだな。
ハンターズギルドから特殊な
武器を貰っただろ？あれは対
変種に適した武器で一部の
依頼を受ける条件にもなって
いる。
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
強化用の素材を分けてやるぜ。
やってみないか？

55127.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55127.description: Slaying an Akura Vashimu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55127.descriptionEn:
Slay Akura Vashimu to
raise your own rating
and get G Rank decos.
I've prepared a quest
for cheap materials
needed to make them.
Please make good use!
55127.descriptionJp:
アクラ・ヴァシムを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

26239.objectiveJp: チャチャブー２０匹の討伐

62639.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of the Ultimate Dragon that has invaded the desert. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62639.descriptionEn:
An urgent request.
We seek hunters to slay
the Disufiroa invading
the Desert.
Slay it well and I will
issue more Slay Proofs
than usual for you!
62639.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。
砂漠に襲来した極龍を退治
してくださる方を募集して
おります。
見事に討伐できましたら、
普段よりも多めの討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

55818.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐

55022.description: You found this job well! I am a genius! I have developed a new weapon not found in Mezeporuta. If you want to know the secret, complete as many hidden jobs as you can. However, you must always complete at least the main target. I wish you success!
55022.descriptionEn:
You found this request — well done!
I am a genius! I've developed
a new weapon that Mezeporta
never had. If you wish to know
this secret, complete as many
hidden requests as you can.
However, at the very least you
must complete the main target.
I wish you good fortune!
55022.descriptionJp:
よくぞこの依頼を見つけた！
ワシは天才じゃ！メゼポルタ
には無かった新しい武器を開
発したぞい。この秘密を知り
たくば、隠された依頼をでき
るだけ多く達成することじゃ。
ただし、最低でも必ずメイン
ターゲットは達成しなければ
ならぬぞ。健闘を祈る！

50865.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50865.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50865.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
50865.descriptionJp:
銃槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。
