53120.description: You there, I have a job for you. It is the capture of a young, graceful Rathian seen in the Highlands. The area is full of Brook, so it is a bit dangerous; slay a few dozen of them while you are at it. Whatever you do, do not touch the cute Erupe.
53120.descriptionEn:
You there, I have a job.
It's to capture a young,
graceful <<Rathian>> I
saw.
The area swarms with
<<Brook>>, a bit rough, so
slay a few dozen too.
But please don't touch the
cute <<Erupe>>, you hear?
53120.descriptionJp:
そこの君、仕事を依頼したい。
内容は、高地で見かけた若く
気品のある≪リオレイア≫の
捕獲だ。
辺りは≪ブルック≫だらけで
少し物騒だから、ついでに
何十頭か討伐してくれ。
くれぐれも、可愛い≪エルペ≫
に手を出さないでくれよ。

60041.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61920.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス２頭の狩猟

26168.description: The matter of the flying wyvern dwelling in the Sea of Trees, which seemed settled thanks to your efforts, has seen reports of damage rise again. I am sorry, but go to the Sea of Trees once more and hunt the flying wyvern. I am counting on you.
26168.descriptionEn:
Thanks to your efforts, the
trouble with the flying wyvern
that dwells in the Great Forest
seemed settled, but damage
reports are rising once more.
Sorry, but head to the Great
Forest once again and hunt it.
I am expecting great things!
26168.descriptionJp:
おぬしらの活躍によって収束
したと思われた、樹海に棲ま
う飛竜の件じゃが、またして
も被害報告が増加しておる。
すまぬが、いま一度樹海に向
かい、飛竜の狩猟に当たって
くれ。
期待しておるぞ。

62137.description: Reading a book in a quiet place. That alone is happiness. But my blissful hours were stolen by the roar of the Yian Garuga that appeared in the Canyon, a cry that seems to tear its whole body apart. Ah, I long for silence! If you restore that silence, I will provide all the materials I have gathered!
62137.descriptionEn:
Reading a tome in quiet.
That alone is happiness.
But the Yian Garuga that
appeared in the Canyon
stole my bliss with a roar
that tears the body.
Ah, I miss the silence!
Restore it for me and I
shall give all my mats!
62137.descriptionJp:
静かな場所で書物を読む。
ただそれだけで幸せなんだ。
だが、峡谷に現れた黒狼鳥の
全身を引き裂くような咆哮に
私の幸福な時間が奪われた。
ああ、静寂が恋しい！
静寂を取り戻してくれるので
あれば、私が集めた素材を
まとめて提供しよう！

20010.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The floating wyvern Yama Tsukami has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20010.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning! Yama Tsukami
has entered Dundorma's
territory! Dundorma now moves
to intercept the Elder Dragon!
Use the interception gear in
the zone and slay it fully!
20010.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です
！ドンドルマの領内に浮岳龍
ヤマツカミが侵入しました！
これよりドンドルマは古龍の
迎撃体制に入ります！
迎撃区画に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

62147.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
62147.description: Yo, long time no see! I trust there is no hunter meeting me for the first time? I have grown, you know. As proof, I will guide you to the canyon! There is a monster called the Tyrant of the Earth, can you conquer it?
62147.descriptionEn:
Hey, long time!
I trust no hunter here is
meeting me for the first.
I've grown, you know.
As proof, I'll guide you
to the Canyon!
There's a monster called
<<Tyrant of the Earth>>.
Can you conquer it?
62147.descriptionJp:
よっ、久しぶり！
はじめましてのハンターは
いないと信じてるぜ？
これでも成長したんだ。
その証に、あんたを峡谷へ
案内するよ！
≪大地の暴君≫と呼ばれてい
るモンスターがいるんだが、
征することができるかい？

60717.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60717.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60717.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60717.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61520.description: Oh, you've come. Hunting monsters is fine, but mining is fun too! So, how about testing your mining skill? I want you to gather the ore I'm about to request. The reward will be generous!
61520.descriptionEn:
Hey, glad you came.
Hunting monsters is fine, but
mining is a joy too!
So, how about a test of your
mining skill?
I want you to gather the ore I
am about to ask for.
The pay will be generous!
61520.descriptionJp:
おう、よく来たな。
モンスターを狩るのもいいが、
採掘も楽しいよな！
そこで、採掘の腕試しをして
みないか？
これから依頼する鉱石を集め
てほしい。
報酬は弾むぜ！

21707.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
21707.description: An unknown bird wyvern species has been discovered by a survey team that headed for a flower field full of plants. It seems to like flower nectar, but apparently also has a combative side. The presence of a beastman tribe living in the flower field has also been confirmed. Please head to the site and begin the investigation.
21707.descriptionEn:
The survey team sent to the lush
Flower Field has discovered an
unknown Bird Wyvern species.
It seems to favor flower nectar,
but also has an aggressive side.
In addition, a Beastman tribe
living in the Flower Field has
been confirmed. Please head to
the site and begin the survey.
21707.descriptionJp:
植物の茂る花畑へ向かった
調査団より未知の鳥竜種が
発見されました。
花の蜜を好むようですが、
好戦的な一面もあるようです。
他にも、花畑を住処とする
獣人族の存在も確認されてい
ます。現地へ向かい調査の
開始をお願いします。

50120.description: Listen! A wonderful request has come in! Apparently, if you hunt 1 Aberrant monster including its part breaks, you can get lots of Aberrant Hunting Books! A chance like this does not come often, so why not go?
50120.descriptionEn:
Listen to this! An amazing request has
come in!
Apparently, if you hunt one Rare Species
including part breaks, you will receive
a whole lot of Rare Species Hunting
Notes! A chance like this does not
come often, so why not give it
a try?
50120.descriptionJp:
聞いてください！すごい依頼
が舞い込んできましたよ！
なんと奇種を１頭、部位破壊
込みで狩猟すれば、奇種狩猟
書がたくさんもらえるみたい
です！こんなチャンスはなか
なかないですし、行ってみて
はいかがでしょうか？

61971.description: Do you know? There is a game where you hunt monsters and, with luck, a huge amount of zenny comes back. Give me an Event Assistance Ticket and I will tell you where. How about it? Want to try?
61971.descriptionEn:
Hey, you know?
Hunt monsters, and if you're
lucky, a huge pile of zenny
comes right back to you!
Bring me an ≪Event
Assistance Ticket≫ and I'll
show you where. How about it?
Want to give it a try?
61971.descriptionJp:
キミ、知ってるかい？
モンスターを狩猟して、運が
良ければ巨額のゼニーが戻っ
てくる遊びがあるらしいぜ？
≪イベント補助券≫をくれれ
ば場所を教えてやるぞ？どう
だい？チャレンジしてみない
かい？

23417.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
23417.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Diorekkusu, the Thunder Roaring Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23417.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Thunder
Roaring Wyvern ≪Diorex≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
23417.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、雷轟竜
≪ディオレックス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

23179.description: Ioprey are running wild in the volcano, according to reports. Several hunters are already on their way, but the beasts seem to be on the move and are proving hard to find. Follow their trail and hunt them down.
23179.descriptionEn:
Reports say Genprey are
running wild in Volcano.
Several hunters are
already on their way,
but the pack keeps moving,
so they can't find them.
Track them down and
slay them, please.
23179.descriptionJp:
火山でイーオスが暴れている
との報告が届いています。
既に何人かのハンターが
向かっていますが、
どうやら移動しているらしく、
なかなか発見できないでいる
ようです。やつらの足取りを
追って討伐をお願いします。

63105.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の捕獲
63105.description: I want to study the ice fox wyvern that lives in the hidden area of the Ancient Tower. Capture it, and break some parts so it is easier to study. I have no interest in materials, so if you find anything interesting, you may keep it after my research. Capturing it without breaking any parts will count as a failure.
63105.descriptionEn:
I want to study the Rukodiora
that dwells in the Ancient Tower's
hidden reaches. Please capture it,
and break some parts so it is
easier to study. I have no
interest in materials, so keep
anything fascinating you find
after the research is done.
Capture with no part breaks fails.
63105.descriptionJp:
古塔の秘境に住まう氷狐竜の
研究を行いたいんだ。何とか、
捕獲と、研究しやすいように
一部部位の破壊を頼むよ。
素材には興味が無いから、
面白い素材が見つかったら、
研究の後に持っていっていい
よ。部位破壊無しで捕獲した
ら失敗とさせてもらうよ。

54608.objectiveJp: ギルド黒晶紋章２個の納品
54608.description: By completing this request, you can obtain materials for the Azure G Series. Guild Black Crystal Medal x2, Guild Black Radiance Medal x2, Guild Dark Vermilion Medal x2.
54608.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to
obtain materials for the
<<Azul G Series>>. You
get:
- Guild Dark Crystal x2
- Guild Black Shine x2
- Guild Dark Crimson x2
54608.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成することで、
≪アスールＧシリーズ≫の
素材を入手することができま
す。
・ギルド黒晶勲章２個
・ギルド黒輝勲章２個
・ギルド冥朱勲章２個

23251.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
23251.description: It has been confirmed that ice is mixed into part of the stream flowing out of the highlands. It is likely that an Ice Fox Wyvern has appeared in the highlands upstream, where surveys have not yet progressed. We are seeking hunters to go and confirm.
23251.descriptionEn:
Ice has been confirmed
mixed into the streams
flowing from Highlands.
Likely a Doragyurosu has
appeared upstream, in the
still-unexplored part of
the Highlands.
We seek hunters to go
and confirm the sighting.
23251.descriptionJp:
高地から流れ出ている水流の
一部に、氷が混ざっているこ
とが確認されました。
恐らく上流にあたる、
まだ調査が進められていない
高地に、氷狐竜が出現したの
だと思われます。
確認に向かっていただける
ハンターを募集いたします。

63047.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
63047.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
63047.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
63047.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

23483.description: The Variant Species Espinas appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Espinas. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23483.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy <<Espinas>>
has reached a strength
that touches the summit
of its kind.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their
skill, please take on the
survey.
23483.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪エスピナス≫はエス
ピナスの中でも、頂点に辿り
つくほどの強さに達したよう
です。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

55333.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55333.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu has appeared once more. Its tail has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55333.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Akura Vashimu≫
has appeared once more.
Its tail has grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
still more power. Please take
great care in your survey.
55333.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫
が再び現れました。
尾はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

23411.description: This request lets hunters who reached G Rank obtain the recommended jewel G Rank Rage Jewel. Hunt a Hypnocatrice and you can obtain the G Rank Rage Jewel, a jewel with the skills Might Strike, Protection of the Three Realms and Wrath. Please make good use of it.
23411.descriptionEn:
This request lets hunters who
reached G Rank obtain the
recommended jewel ≪G Rank
Rage Jewel≫. Hunt a Hypnocatrice
and you can obtain the ≪G Rank
Rage Jewel≫, a jewel with the
skills Might Strike, Protection
of the Three Realms and Wrath.
Please make good use of it.
23411.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級になったハンターにオス
スメの装飾品≪Ｇ級・怒剛珠≫
が入手できる依頼です。
眠鳥を狩猟すると、剛撃、
三界の護り、怒のスキル値を
持つ装飾品≪Ｇ級・怒剛珠≫
を入手することができます。
ぜひ今後の狩猟生活にお役立
てください。

21875.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Bulldrome in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn a larger reward than usual, so do take it on and see it done.
21875.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's hunting life,
we have prepared a request to hunt
≪Bulldrome≫ in the New Great Arena.
If you complete this request you
will earn more reward money than
usual, so please take it on and
complete it.
21875.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、新大闘技場で≪大猪≫
を狩猟する依頼を用意しまし
た。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より多い報酬金が得られます
ので、ぜひ受注して依頼を
達成しましょう。

21671.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21671.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21671.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
21671.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

23193.description: We have received a report that there was a material never seen before on the tidal island of an unsurveyed region. For now there is no information of large monsters nearby, so gathering should be comparatively safe. We are recruiting hunters to head to the site to investigate.
23193.descriptionEn:
On Tidal Island, in an
unexplored area, there
was a report of unknown
materials. So far we have
no word of large monsters
nearby, so gathering
should be fairly safe.
We seek hunters to head
there and survey.
23193.descriptionJp:
未調査地域の潮島に、
見たこともない素材があった
という報告を受けました。
今のところ大型モンスターが
近くにいるという情報も
ありませんので、比較的安全
に採取を行えるはずです。
現地へ調査に向かって頂ける
ハンターを募集いたします。

12055.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ２頭の狩猟

51115.description: The cherry blossom viewing season is finally here. I love the blossoms at night, and viewing them every year is my pleasure. But this year I'm short of the lights needed to illuminate them. Hunter, would you find me something to serve as a light source? Please do.
51115.descriptionEn:
The cherry blossom season
is here. I love night
blossoms, and every year
I view them at night.
But this year I lack the
lights for the setup.
Hunter, would you find me
something that gives off
light? Please, I beg you.
51115.descriptionJp:
いよいよお花見の時期ですわ
ね。私は夜桜が好きで、毎年
夜にお花見をするのが趣味で
すの。でも今年はライトアッ
プに必要な灯りが足りず困っ
ておりますわ。ハンターさん、
私のために光源となるものを
探してきてくださる？
どうかお願いしますね。

63212.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63212.description: Do you have enough zenny? In this job, you can earn materials that sell for a high price. The job is also reputed to be relatively easy. However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
63212.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough Zenny?
With the request we present today,
you can earn materials that sell
for a high price as your reward.
Word is that the request itself
is also fairly easy to complete.
However, you cannot accept it
several times in a row,
so please be careful.
63212.descriptionJp:
ゼニーは足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
高額で売却できる素材を報酬
として獲得できますよ。
依頼内容も、比較的楽に
達成できると評判です。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

54508.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54508.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54508.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

40149.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
40149.description: A special request from the Hunters Guild, limited to N Course and internet cafe players. Clear the quest and get plenty of hunter rank points!
40149.descriptionEn:
A special request from the
Hunters Guild, limited to the
N Course and Net Cafes.
Clear the quest and earn
plenty of Hunter Rank
points for yourself!
40149.descriptionJp:
ハンターズギルドからの
Ｎコース・ネットカフェ限定
の特別な依頼です。
クエストを達成し、ハンター
ランクポイントをたっぷり
手に入れよう！

54197.description: We ask you to survey the Basarios lurking in the volcano. Beyond the hunt itself, if you break the Basarios's chest, we will add to your reward!
54197.descriptionEn:
Please survey the
Basarios in Volcano.
Not just the hunt,
break its chest too
and I'll add extra
reward on top for
you!
54197.descriptionJp:
火山に潜む岩竜の
調査をお願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
岩竜の胸部を見事
破壊してくれたら、
報酬を上乗せしちゃい
ますよ！

23630.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23630.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23630.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Sword and Shield, show us the
skill you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.
23630.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

54982.description: A hunter has reported finding a Chameleos in the swamp. When they tried to slay it at once, it cloaked itself completely. The hunter felt their life in danger and fled. Go to the site and find out the true nature of the Chameleos!
54982.descriptionEn:
A hunter reported discovering
the ≪Chameleos≫ in the Swamp.
When they tried to slay it at
once, it cloaked its figure
and vanished completely.
Feeling their life in danger,
the hunter fled right away.
Head to the area and find out
the true nature of ≪Chameleos≫!
54982.descriptionJp:
とあるハンターから沼地で
≪霞龍≫を発見したとの報告
がありました。すぐに討伐を
試みたところ、なんと姿を完
全に眩ましてしまいました。
身の危険を感じたハンターは
すぐに逃げ出したそうです。
現地へ向かい、≪霞龍≫の正
体を突き止めてください！

55769.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55769.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.
55769.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪外装解
放券≫を獲得できるクエスト
を用意させていただきまし
た。受注、参加時に、≪祭典
の熱気≫をお持ちください。

21727.description: This quest yields the following materials. Heavy Bowgun Soul (Beginning) x85, Heavy Bowgun Soul (Middle) x195, Heavy Bowgun Soul (Extreme) x275, Heavy Bowgun Soul (Heaven) x85. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21727.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪H Bowgun Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪H Bowgun Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪H Bowgun Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪H Bowgun Soul: Heaven≫ x85
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
21727.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｈボウガン魂・序≫85枚
≪Ｈボウガン魂・中≫195枚
≪Ｈボウガン魂・極≫275枚
≪Ｈボウガン魂・天≫85枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

61450.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
61450.description: An extremely powerful individual of the flame king dragon Teostra has invaded Dundorma! Either slay it using the interception weapons, or at least destroy parts to buy time! Failure is absolutely unforgivable, so present proof of sufficient skill.
61450.descriptionEn:
A Flame King Dragon,
<<Teostra>>, has entered
the town of Dundorma!
That specimen is mighty.
Slay it with the defense
weapons, or at least break
its parts to buy time!
Failure cannot be allowed,
so show your skill.
61450.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマの街に、炎王龍
≪テオ・テスカトル≫の
極めて強力な個体が侵入しま
した！迎撃兵器を活用しての
討伐か、時間稼ぎのために、
部位破壊だけでもお願いしま
す！失敗は絶対に許されない
ので、十分な腕前の証を
ご提示ください。

61063.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
61063.description: VS Quest Champion Tournament final round. This is it. Note: target monster materials cannot be obtained from carves or clear rewards.
61063.descriptionEn:
VS Quest Champion
Tournament final round.
This is it.
Note: target monster
materials cannot be
obtained from carves
or clear rewards.
61063.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの決勝クエスト
です。
モンスターの剥ぎ取りと
クリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

55229.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55229.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.
55229.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されて
いる一部防具や装飾品の強化
に使用するＨＣ素材やＧＨＣ
素材を獲得できるクエストを
ご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

62418.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62418.description: Gazing at the blue sky, I find I have come to a place with a fine view. The place beyond reach is the sky, so then, is there a hunter who can break the back spikes of an Ice Fox Wyvern? If you break them splendidly, I will give you the materials of the armor I wear.
62418.descriptionEn:
Gazing at the blue sky,
we've come to a fine view.
You can't reach the sky,
but is there a hunter who
can break a Doragyurosu's
back spikes, I wonder?
Break them well and I'll
give you the materials of
my armor.
62418.descriptionJp:
青い空を眺めてたら、随分と
見晴らしのいい場所に来たな。
手の届かない場所といえば
空だが、では、氷狐竜の
背トゲを壊すことができる
ハンターはいるかな？
見事に壊して見せたら、俺が
着ている防具の素材をくれて
やろう。

26028.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
26028.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26028.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26028.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

54408.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
54408.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54408.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54408.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

54779.description: To those aiming for GR500: slay a Silver Rathalos to raise your rating and cheaply obtain the mats needed for popular G Rank decorations. I have made a quest for you. Please make good use of it.
54779.descriptionEn:
To those aiming GR500:
slay an Azure Rathalos
to raise your rating and
cheaply obtain the mats
needed for popular G Rank
decorations. I have made
a quest for you.
Please make good use of it.
54779.descriptionJp:
ＧＲ５００を目指す方々へ
リオレウス希少種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、人気のＧ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

50102.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の狩猟

60905.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
60905.descriptionEn:
Hey! This time I had some special
equipment and supplies prepared
for you.
Take these and blow those guys
away with one big boom!
I've also got some special
rewards ready, so enjoy
yourselves out there!
60905.descriptionJp:
オウ！今回は特別な
装備品、支給品を
用意させてもらった。
これで一発あいつらを
ドカンとやってきてくれ！
多少だが特殊な報酬も
用意したから、せいぜい
楽しんでくんな！

50497.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
50497.descriptionEn:
You there!
Heard you hit HR31.
So I've got a favor.
Payment: a full weapon
upgrade set. Deal?
It's easy, just one run
out to slay a Gogomoa.
That's all.
Count on you!
50497.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の強化素材一式で
どうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってゴゴモアを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

21971.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21971.description: For hunters who reached HR3: a request to get the decoration Gougo Gem. Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur to obtain Gougo Gem, with Attack, Expert and Earplug skill points on it. Please put it to use in your hunts.
21971.descriptionEn:
For hunters who reached
HR3: a request to get the
decoration <<Gougo Gem>>.
Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur to
obtain <<Gougo Gem>>, with
Attack, Expert and Earplug
skill points on it.
Please put it to use in
your hunts.
21971.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ３になったハンターに
オススメの装飾品≪剛護珠≫
が入手できる依頼です。
盾蟹を狩猟すると、攻撃、
達人、聴覚保護のスキル値を
持つ装飾品≪剛護珠≫を入手
することができます。
ぜひ今後の狩猟生活にお役立
てください。

54898.description: We continue the investigation of Odibatorasu. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54898.descriptionEn:
The Odibatorasu survey
continues on.
Part breaks are not
required, but I'd be
glad if you do!
Hunters, please lend
us your aid!
54898.descriptionJp:
オディバトラスの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

56095.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56095.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56095.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

63257.description: Now the real training begins! This time your goal is to destroy the rocks placed in the arena with your own strength. Avoid the monsters that get in the way and destroy every rock!
63257.descriptionEn:
All right, the real
training starts now!
This time your goal is to
break the rocks placed in
the Arena using only your
own strength. Avoid the
monsters in your way and
destroy every rock!
63257.descriptionJp:
さあ、ここからが
トレーニング本番ですよ！
今回は、闘技場に配置された
岩を、自分の力だけで
破壊することが目標です。
邪魔をするモンスターを
回避しながら、全ての岩を
破壊してください！

54148.description: We will continue the investigation of the Hyujikiki that appeared in the highlands. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54148.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of the
Hyujikiki that appeared in
the Highlands. Breaking its
parts is not required, but
we'd be glad if you did!
Hunters, please lend us your
aid!
54148.descriptionJp:
高地に出現したヒュジキキの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

26276.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26276.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26276.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

1059.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
1059.description: This season the snowy mountains belong to the Blango clan alone. Their numbers are outrageous. Following the orders of their leader, Blangonga, they will come at you in packs. Do not let them surround you!
1059.descriptionEn:
In this season the Snowy
Mountains belong to the
Blango family. Their vast
numbers are no joke. The
Blango follow <<Blangonga>>
and attack in packs, so
don't get surrounded!
1059.descriptionJp:
この季節の雪山はブランゴ
一家の独壇場だ。その数たる
や尋常じゃない。ブランゴた
ちは親玉の≪ドドブランゴ≫
の指示に従い、群れを成して
襲い掛かってくるハズだ。
囲まれないように注意しろ！

21589.description: Have you heard of the Bear Fist Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21589.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb
called Bear Fist Orb?
Its material is vital
for crafting a certain
costly gem.
Clear this request and I
shall give you rare
gem materials.
21589.descriptionJp:
熊拳原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

23358.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
23358.description: Recommended for G Rank: a quest to craft and upgrade the Entora G Series armor. By hunting a Gendrome you can get materials to craft the Entora G Series and take all 5 parts to Lv7. After crafting, claim the reward from Hunter Navi.
23358.descriptionEn:
Recommended for G Rank:
armor Entora G Series
craft and upgrade quest.
By hunting <<Iodrome>>
you can get
materials to craft the
Entora G Series and take
all 5 parts to Lv7.
After crafting, claim the
reward from Hunter Navi.
23358.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ハンターにオススメな
防具「エントラＧシリーズ」
の生産・強化依頼です。
≪ドスゲネポス≫を狩猟する
ことで、
「エントラＧシリーズ」を
生産し、ＬＶ７まで強化する
素材が５部位分入手できます。
生産後は、ハンターナビから
報酬をお受け取り下さい。

60939.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
60939.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60939.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
60939.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

26572.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26572.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26572.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26572.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

54380.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54380.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54380.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

50421.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

62564.objectiveJp:
主目標１頭の狩猟
及び、各指定部位の破壊
62564.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target
and break each specified part

60947.objectiveJp: 部位破壊保証書４枚の納品
60947.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who break many parts of Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Fang! Bring the specified number of Part Break Certificates yourself. You will also receive more rewards if you break the specified monster's parts and hunt it.
60947.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who break many
parts of Variant species.
Main reward: Wyvern Heavy
Fangs! Bring the required
Part Break Certificates by
yourself. Also, breaking
parts of or slaying the
target brings more rewards.
60947.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種の
部位を多く破壊したハンター
に報酬を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の重牙！
指定枚数の部位破壊保証書を
１人でお持ちください。また、
指定モンスターの部位破壊や
狩猟を行った場合、より多く
の報酬を用意しております。

20015.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
20015.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The flame wyvern Teostra has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20015.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Station!
The Flame King Dragon Teostra has
invaded Dundorma!
Dundorma now moves to Elder
Dragon interception status!
Use the interception equipment in
the interception zone to slay the
Elder Dragon completely! Please!
20015.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
ドンドルマの領内に炎王龍
テオ・テスカトルが侵入しま
した！これよりドンドルマは
古龍の迎撃体制に入ります！
迎撃区画に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

23186.description: A plant called the cactus grows in the Canyon. The sap of this plant makes various healing medicines and is very precious. This time we are looking for people to help us collect the sap.
23186.descriptionEn:
In the Canyon grows a
plant called the Saguaro.
Its sap makes many kinds
of healing medicine, and
is very precious. This
time we seek those who
will help us gather sap.
23186.descriptionJp:
峡谷には覇王樹という植物が
生えています。この植物の
樹液は、様々な治療薬になる、
とても貴重なものです。
今回は樹液を採取するため、
協力していただける方を
募集させていただきます。

40235.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
40235.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40235.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40235.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

55365.description: A Hyujikiki with greatly developed needles has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Hyujikiki known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55365.descriptionEn:
A ≪Hyujikiki≫ with greatly
developed needles has
appeared. The Guild
classifies this individual as
a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will survey it.
Reports say it is more
dangerous than Hyujikiki seen
before. Please survey with care.
55365.descriptionJp:
針が大きく発達した
≪針纏竜≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの針纏竜より危険
との報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

23623.description: The Variant Species Plesioth has appeared once more. Its head has grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23623.descriptionEn:
Supremacy ≪Plesioth≫ has
appeared once more.
Its head has grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
still more power. Please take
great care in your survey.
23623.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ガノトトス≫が
再び現れました。
頭はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

55679.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
55679.description: This is an upgrade quest for the Transcendent armor Narga GX series. You can obtain more materials than usual. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
55679.descriptionEn:
An upgrade quest for the
Ascension Armor Narga GX
Series. You can obtain
more materials than
usual. It's a great deal,
so please give it a try!
55679.descriptionJp:
遷悠防具「ナルガGXシリーズ」
の強化クエストになります。
通常よりも多く素材を獲得
することができます。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

26550.description: The highlands, an untrodden land. In this newly discovered place, a new flying wyvern seems to have been discovered at last. From its powerful form it was named Gurenzeburu. This time the request is to hunt it. Why not experience a hunt in a new world?
26550.descriptionEn:
An untrodden land, the Highlands.
In this newly discovered place,
a new Flying Wyvern has finally
been found, it seems. For its
powerful form the wyvern was
named ≪Taikun Zamuza≫.
This time the request is to hunt
it. Why not try a hunt in a new land?
26550.descriptionJp:
未踏の地、高地。
新たに発見されたこの地で、
ついに新しく飛竜が発見され
たようです。力強い姿から
≪蛮竜≫と名付けられた飛竜。
今回はそれの狩猟依頼となり
ます。新天地での狩りを体験
してみてはいかがでしょうか？

1053.description: Chameleos is an existence considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. Do not think of impossible things like capture; repel it repeatedly to wear down its health! Slay it in the end!
1053.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is looked on as a
heretic even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from nowhere at all;
even a veteran cannot best it.
Forget capture, impossible as it
is. Repel it again and again to
wear it down, and slay it at last!
1053.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在じゃ。
姿無きところから姿を現す、
熟練の狩人とて手に負えん。
捕獲など無理なことは考えず
撃退をくり返し体力を削る！
長き末に討伐するのじゃ！

50410.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

63297.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63297.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63297.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63297.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

28038.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
28038.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering materials from the Echoing Wolf, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28038.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters,
won't you pass your hunt
skills on to the young
hunters of the Guild?
This time, <<Orugaron>>
materials, a big splurge!
Grow strong together and
liven up the Guild. Clear
it with mixed Secret Art
holders for extra Guild rep!
28038.descriptionJp:
熟練ハンターの皆さん。
その狩猟技術を猟団の若い
ハンターへ伝えてみません
か？今回は、≪響狼≫の
素材を大奮発！一緒に強く
なって、猟団を盛り上げて
いってください。秘伝書所持、
未所持のハンターで達成する
と、ギルドからの評価が
より得られますよ。

21540.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21540.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21540.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21540.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

50970.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
50970.description: A request for hunters who have crafted and strengthened Odibatorasu Gou armor. Slay the ferocious Berukyurosu that lives in the Old Tower and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba F Series Tenran Armor up to LV7.
50970.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have made
and upgraded ≪Peerless≫ armor
of the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
Slay the ferocious
≪Dyuragaua≫ that dwells
in the Ancient Tower and
you will get the materials
to upgrade the ≪Heavenly
Storm≫ "Odiba F" to Lv7.
50970.descriptionJp:
≪弩岩竜≫の≪剛種防具≫を
生産・強化したハンター向け
の依頼です。
古塔に棲む狂暴な≪氷狐竜≫
を討伐していただくと
「オディバＦシリーズ」
≪天嵐防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

63308.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63308.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63308.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63308.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

26373.description: Just when I thought those noisy ones were gone, now there is a swarm of Cantaro thick enough to cover the ground! I left my important baggage behind! Someone drive them off!
26373.descriptionEn:
Just when those noisy pests
were gone, now the ground is
crawling with a swarm of
Kantharos!
I left my important cargo
behind! Someone drive those
things off for me!
26373.descriptionJp:
五月蝿いあいつらがいなく
なったと思ったら、今度は
足元を埋め尽くさんばかりの
カンタロスの大群！
大事な荷物を残してきたまま
なんだ！誰かあいつらを追い
払ってくれよ！

21862.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21862.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Gakou F (Elegance) and Gasen F (Elegance) series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21862.descriptionEn:
This quest gives upgrade
materials for 5 parts of
Tenran Armor Gakou F
[Grace] / Gasen F [Grace].
To accept the quest you
need a <<Superior Ticket>>
to be used up front.
If the quest is failed,
the <<Superior Ticket>> is
consumed, so please note.
21862.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
雅孔Ｆ【趣】／雅穿Ｆ【趣】
シリーズの５部位分の強化
素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50349.objectiveJp: モンスターのフン１個の納品
50349.description: Cherry trees are only cherry trees when they bloom beautifully. To make them bloom beautifully, I need a special fertilizer. It smells a bit, well, but its effect is outstanding! I heard it is lying about in the desert. Fetch it at once!!
50349.descriptionEn:
Cherry trees must bloom
beautifully to be trees.
For that, you need my
special fertilizer. It
smells a bit off, but
the effect is superb!
I hear it lies in the
Desert. Fetch it now!!
50349.descriptionJp:
桜は綺麗に咲いてこそ桜なの。
綺麗に咲かせる為にはね、
とっておきの肥料が必要よ。
ちょっとアレなにおいがする
けれど、効果は抜群！
聞いた話だと砂漠に落ちてる
らしいわ。
至急とってきて頂戴！！

55193.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55193.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will surely grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
55193.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to give them
the name "the Famished Deviljho".
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
They have been shut in without
any meat and driven to the limit.
Hunters of courage, hear me.
If you succeed in slaying one,
the Guild will surely grant you
the armor materials it treasures
deep in its vaults.
55193.descriptionJp:
ギルドでは、ヤツらの呼称を
「餓え喰らうイビルジョー」
とすることにした。
ヤツらは唯の恐暴竜ではない。
閉じ込め肉を与えず極限まで
追い込んである。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
もしも討伐に成功したならば
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を必
ず授けよう。

51124.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
51124.description: Brawling is supreme! Long reach is unnecessary! The answer lies in hand to hand combat! Perhaps the wish to spread the charm of the Tonfa was heard, for we met just the right monster. Weapon and armor are ready, so slay it using these.
51124.descriptionEn:
Fistfights are best!
You need no long reach!
The answer lies in brawls!
That Tonfa charm of yours
must have been heard, for
a perfect monster has
shown itself to you.
Weapons and armor ready,
so slay it with these.
51124.descriptionJp:
殴り合いこそ至高！
長いリーチなど不要！
肉弾戦の中に答えはある！
そんな穿龍棍の魅力を
広く伝えたいという願いが
通じたのか、ちょうどいい
モンスターに出会えたのだ。
武器と防具は用意したので
これを使って討伐してくれ。

61726.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

22096.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22096.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22096.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

54116.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54116.description: A Daimyo Hermitaur has taken up residence in the jungle where we carry our goods. Lately even great numbers of Yao-zami have appeared. At this rate my business is ruined! Drive those lot off at once!
54116.descriptionEn:
The Jungle we use to
haul our goods has
been taken over by a
Daimyo Hermitaur.
Now swarms of Hermitaur
show up too. At this rate
my trade is finished!
Go and drive those
pests off, quick!
54116.descriptionJp:
俺たちが商品を運ぶ時に
通っている密林に、
ダイミョウザザミが
住みつきやがったんだ。
最近は大量のヤオザミまで
現れる始末でな。このまま
じゃ商売あがったりだ！
さっさとあいつらを
追っ払ってくれ！

23448.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23448.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Merit (Beginning) x５０, Bow Merit (Middle) x６０, Bow Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23448.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Bow Medal: Intro≫ x50
≪Bow Medal: Mid≫ x60
≪Bow Medal: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you
must be GR500 or above, so
please be careful.
23448.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪弓勲・序≫５０個
≪弓勲・中≫６０個
≪弓勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

55324.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55324.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55324.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

22024.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
22024.description: The black dragon that was said to be a legend seems to have shown itself at Castle Schrade! In the tale of the Black Dragon legend it is told that the black dragon will bring calamity to the world! Repel it with all your might so that the legend does not become reality!
22024.descriptionEn:
The black dragon that was thought
a legend seems to have shown
itself at ≪Schrade Castle≫! In
the tales of the Black Dragon
legend, it is said to bring
disaster to the world! Repel it
with all your might so that the
legend does not come true!
22024.descriptionJp:
伝説とされていた黒き龍が、
≪シュレイド城≫にて、その
姿を現わしたようです！黒龍
伝説の物語では、黒龍が世界
に災いをもたらすと語られて
います！伝説が現実にならな
いよう全力で撃退して下さい！

61663.description: Yo. Long time no see. Are you enjoying mining today too? I have prepared a job to show you how good mining is again. Gather three of the five kinds including Rusted Fragments. The reward is ready, so go with confidence!
61663.descriptionEn:
Yo. Long time no see.
Still enjoying your mining?
I've got a request for you,
to show off how good mining is.
Gather any 3 of 5 kinds,
rusted chunks and the like.
The reward is ready and waiting,
so off you go with confidence!
61663.descriptionJp:
よぉ。久しぶりだな。
今日も楽しく採掘してるか？
また、採掘の良さを知っても
らう為に、依頼を用意したぞ。
さびた塊など５種類の中から
３つを集めてもらうぜ。
報酬はちゃんと用意してある
から安心して行ってこい！

56153.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
56153.description: Reports of resighting the monsters named Extreme, who are great threats, do not cease. Treating this as an emergency, I want each of them slain swiftly. This time it is Elzelion that Burns and Freezes to the Extreme, whose sightings have surged. As proof of the kill, I will give you Star Sand!
56153.descriptionEn:
Sightings of monsters
bearing the Extreme name,
a great threat, won't stop.
I ask for swift slaying
of each as an emergency.
This time, sightings of
the Extreme Scorching
Frozen Eruzerion soar.
As proof, take Star Sand!
56153.descriptionJp:
大きな脅威である「極み」と
名の付くモンスターたちの再
目撃報告が後を絶たない。
緊急事態とし、より迅速な各
個討伐を依頼したい。
今回は特に目撃報告が急増し
ている「極み灼き凍るエルゼ
リオン」。討伐した証とし
て、星の砂を渡すぞ！

22068.description: An unexplored land has been found at White Lake. The Guild is surveying it, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22068.descriptionEn:
Uncharted land has been
found at the ≪White Lake≫.
The Guild is still surveying
it, but hunters too might
like to go and take a look
for gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22068.descriptionJp:
≪白湖≫に未開拓の地が
発見されました。
ギルドでも調査中ですが、
ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

26229.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
26229.description: In the breeding season, the Hypnocatrice's coat supposedly turns a vivid blue. Now is your chance to behold it. Hurry, or someone else will beat you to it!
26229.descriptionEn:
In the ≪Breeding Season≫
the Hypnocatrice's coat
turns a vivid blue, they say.
Now is your chance to see
it. Move fast or the others
will beat you to it!
26229.descriptionJp:
≪繁殖期≫の眠鳥は、その体
毛が鮮やかな蒼色へ変化する
らしい。
その姿を拝めるのは今がチャ
ンスだ。早くしないと他のや
つらに先越されちまうぜ？

54984.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54984.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!
54984.descriptionJp:
双剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

53027.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
53027.description: Hunt the horned wyverns that appeared in the desert, on the road to the blossom viewing site! There isn't much time before the banquet begins, so please hunt them as quickly as you can.
53027.descriptionEn:
Hunt the Diablos that have
appeared in the Desert on
the way to the
blossom viewing site! We
have little time before
the feast, so be quick.
53027.descriptionJp:
お花見会場への通り道である
砂漠に現れた角竜たちを狩猟
してください！
宴が開始するまであまり時間
がないため、できる限り早い
狩猟をお願いします。

23446.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Light Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Light Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23446.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪L Bowgun Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪L Bowgun Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪L Bowgun Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR500 or higher, so please keep
that in mind.
23446.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｌボウガン勲・序≫５０個
≪Ｌボウガン勲・中≫６０個
≪Ｌボウガン勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

23562.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
23562.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23562.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23562.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

50418.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

26523.objectiveJp: カジキマグロ１０匹の納品
26523.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Hunting monsters is not all a hunter does. Fishing is a fine hunt as well. Why not aim to be an angler yourself? If you do, start by delivering 10 Marlin on your own.
26523.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. Hunting
monsters is not all a hunter does.
Fishing is a fine hunt in its own
right. Why not aim to be an angler?
If you do, start by delivering
10 Speartuna on your own.
26523.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。モンスター
を狩るだけがハンターじゃな
い。釣りだって立派な狩猟だ。
君も釣師を目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人でカジ
キマグロ１０匹の納品からだ。

50104.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50104.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
50104.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

21683.description: Surveys have shown that the caves of Tide Island go deeper still. A considerable space appears to open up within, but a black monster has been confirmed there as well. Until safety is secured, no survey can be carried out. Head for the site at once and secure it.
21683.descriptionEn:
Surveys show the caves of the
Tidal Island go even deeper.
A rather large space seems to
open within, but the form of a
black monster has been sighted
there as well.
Until safety is secured, no
survey can proceed.
Please head to the site at once
and secure the area.
21683.descriptionJp:
調査により、潮島の洞窟には、
更に奥があることが分かり
ました。かなり大きな空間が
広がっているようですが、
黒色のモンスターの姿も
同時に確認されています。
安全が確保されるまで、
調査が行えません。
至急、現地へ向かい安全の
確保をお願いします。

62138.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
62138.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
62138.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

26249.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

26232.description: The Tigrex boasts overwhelming strength, but any creature must have a weak point! I say its weak point is the head! Aim for the head when it turns around!
26232.descriptionEn:
≪Tigrex≫ boasts overwhelming
strength, but every one of them
must have a ≪weak point≫!
I say its weak point is the
≪head≫! Aim for the head at the
moment it turns around!
26232.descriptionJp:
圧倒的な強さを誇る≪ティガ
レックス≫だが、どんなやつ
にだって≪弱点≫は必ずある
はず！オレはあいつの弱点は
≪頭≫だと見た！振り向くタ
イミングで頭を狙うんだ！

50377.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
50377.description: A very active Ice Fox Wyvern seems to have appeared at the tower. The tower is a place of high academic value, so please hunt the Ice Fox Wyvern as soon as possible before it is destroyed!
50377.descriptionEn:
A very active
<<Doragyurosu>> has shown
up at the Tower. That
Tower holds great academic
value, so before it falls,
please slay the wyvern!
50377.descriptionJp:
非常に活発な≪氷狐竜≫が塔
に出現したようです。
塔は学術的価値が高い場所
であるため、破壊される前に
一刻もはやく≪氷狐竜≫の
討伐をお願い致します！

21193.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21193.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21193.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54627.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
54627.description: There was a report that a blue Hypnocatrice appeared in the sea of trees. However, it is wrapped in more allure than usual, and as if luring us, it attacks while dancing, they say. Without being swayed by this Hypnocatrice's allure, please investigate its ecology and hunt it.
54627.descriptionEn:
We have reports of an azure
Hypnocatrice in the Great
Forest. It is said to be
more alluring than usual,
dancing as it attacks as if
to lure us. Do not be
swayed; survey it and hunt it.
54627.descriptionJp:
樹海に蒼い眠鳥が登場した
との報告がありました。
ただ、いつも以上に色気を
纏っており、こちらを誘惑
しているのか、踊りながら
襲ってくるそうです。
この眠鳥の色気に惑わされ
ず、生態の調査と狩猟をお
願いします。

50267.description: Won't you help with an ecological survey of Abiorugu? This time the site is the Snowy Mountains. I'd like you to head there and hunt Abiorugu. Of course you'll be paid. Break the tail as well and I'll add a bonus. Well then, I leave it to you.
50267.descriptionEn:
Care to help me with an
ecology survey of ≪Abiorg≫?
The survey site is the
Snowy Mountains this time.
I'd like you to head out
and hunt ≪Abiorg≫ there.
Reward's a given, and I'll
add a bonus for a tail
break. Alright, off you go.
50267.descriptionJp:
≪アビオルグ≫の生態調査を
手伝ってくれないか？
今回の調査場所は雪山だ。
あんたには現地に向かって
≪アビオルグ≫の狩猟をお願
いしたい。もちろん報酬は
出す。あと、尻尾を破壊で
きれば上乗せしよう。
それじゃあ、頼んだよ。

40223.objectiveJp: チャチャブー３４匹の討伐
40223.description: We have information that a monster wearing the mask of a machine life form is running wild in the desert. According to the report, there are many monsters beyond the blue rock. The clue to solving the rock's mechanism is in the supply box. Use it and slay them.
40223.descriptionEn:
We have word that a monster
wearing the mask of a machine
lifeform is on a rampage in the
Desert.
According to reports, a great
many monsters await beyond the
blue rock.
The clue to solving the rock's
trap lies inside the supply box.
Use it and slay them.
40223.descriptionJp:
砂漠に機械生命体の仮面を
付けたモンスターが暴れて
いるとの情報が入った。
報告によると蒼い岩の先に
大量のモンスターがいるら
しい。岩の仕掛けを解く手が
かりは支給品ボックスの中に
ある。それを元に討伐して
ほしい。

11089.description: The breeding season is a precious season when monster eggs can be obtained. This time, please deliver a Carnivore Egg, which is relatively easy to carry. While carrying it, watch not only for monster attacks but also for your stamina draining!
11089.descriptionEn:
Breeding season is a precious
time when monster eggs can be
obtained. This time, please
deliver a ≪Carnivore Egg≫, which
is relatively easy to carry.
While carrying it, watch out for
monster attacks, of course, and
for your stamina draining too!
11089.descriptionJp:
繁殖期はモンスターの卵が入
手できる貴重な季節です。
今回は比較的簡単に運搬でき
る≪肉食竜の卵≫を納品して
ください。運搬中はモンスタ
ーからの攻撃はもちろん、ス
タミナの減りにも注意してく
ださいね！

21038.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

55203.description: White and black wyverns have appeared at the summit of the Ancient Tower. These 2 are opposites by nature and could never appear in the same place. This must be called a reckless request. Yet I believe that you, with all your achievements, will find a way.
55203.descriptionEn:
White and black wyverns have
appeared at the top of the
Ancient Tower. These two are
opposites by nature, so they
could never appear in the same
place.
I must call this a reckless
request. But I believe that you,
with all your achievements,
will somehow see it through.
55203.descriptionJp:
古塔の頂部に、白と黒の飛竜
が現れました。本来この２頭
は、相反する存在であるため、
同じ場所に現れることはあり
えないことです。
これは、無謀な依頼と言わざ
るを得ません。しかし、数多
くの功績を残したあなたなら
なんとかしてくれると信じて
います。

54935.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Great Sword Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Great Sword Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54935.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Great Sword Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
54935.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪大剣綬・序≫１００個
≪大剣綬・中≫１６５個
≪大剣綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

50245.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
50245.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!
50245.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君！
武具を手に入れただけで
満足しているのでは？
それではイカンのです！
このクエストを達成して、
更なる武具の強化を成し遂げ
ましょう！

26759.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
26759.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
26759.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
26759.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

53039.description: Do you feel confident in your manliness, or in your womanliness, as a hunter? All that remains is for the two of you to face hardship together at the end and overcome it, and then it is perfect! Deliver each other's Ring of Vows to prove your bond, then work together to hunt the Abiorugu for me! I am counting on you!
53039.descriptionEn:
Now you're sure of your
grace as man and woman?
All that's left is to face
hardship as a pair and
overcome it. Perfect!
Deliver each other's
<<Oath Ring>>, prove your
bond, then hunt an
<<Abiorugu>> together!
53039.descriptionJp:
ハンターとしての男らしさ、
女らしさに自信が持てたかし
ら？あとは、最後に二人で困
難に立ち向かい、打ち勝つこ
とが出来れば完璧ね♪お互い
の≪誓いの指輪≫を納品して
絆を確かめた後、協力して
≪アビオルグ≫を狩猟してき
て頂戴！期待してるわ♪

21287.description: I found a stone while digging, but I can see no value in it! So I want you, a hunter, to gather pinky-promise grass for me. Bundled together, that grass can polish the stone. Bring me some, and I will share the leftover stones with you.
21287.descriptionEn:
I found a stone while digging,
but as it is, it has no worth!
So I want you, a hunter, to
gather some Yubikiri Grass.
Bound into a bundle, the grass
can polish the stone right up.
Bring it to me and I will
share the spare stones with you.
21287.descriptionJp:
発掘で石を発見したんじゃが、
これでは価値が見出せん！
そこでハンターであるお主に
ゆびきり草を集めて欲しい。
ゆびきり草を束にすることで、
石を磨くことができるんじゃ。
持ってきてくれれば、
余った石をわけてやるぞい。

26662.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26662.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Yian Garuga Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26662.descriptionEn:
This Hunting Skill quest
is to slay a <<Yian
Garuga Variant>>.
Why not sharpen your
skills against each other!
26662.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪イャンガルルガ変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

21448.description: You have done well to come this far. Your mushroom path is almost complete! Bring me every Aster Rare Bag you have collected! I will present you with proof of a true mushroom maniac!
21448.descriptionEn:
You have done well to come this
far. Your mushroom path is nearly
complete! Bring every Shion Rare
Pouch you have gathered so far
to me! I shall present you with
proof of a true mushroom maniac!
21448.descriptionJp:
よくここまで頑張ったね。
君のキノコ道はあと少しだ！
今まで集めた紫苑の稀袋を全
て私のところへ持ってくるん
だ！キノコマニアとしての証
を君に進呈しよう！

60593.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Aruganosu and Goruganosu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! The tournament is under way with Supremacy, Heavenly Storm and Conquest weapons only!
60593.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Targets: <<Arganos>> and
<<Golganos>>! Clear the
goal together with your
Guild mates. Teamwork
decides this event, so
take a top place! Open
to Hardcore/Tenran/Zenith!
60593.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪アルガノス≫と≪ゴルガノ
ス≫だ！猟団の仲間と一緒
に目標を達成してきてもらう
ぞ。チームワークが物を言う
この競技、見事上位に入賞し
てみせよ！剛種・天嵐・覇
種武器限定で開催中だぞ！

21137.description: A mighty flame thought to belong to an Elder Dragon has been observed in the swamp. Please investigate at once. It is too dangerous to supply items, but please come back safely somehow.
21137.descriptionEn:
A powerful flame, believed to
belong to an Elder Dragon, has
been observed in the Swamp.
Please carry out an urgent survey.
It is so dangerous that we cannot
even supply items, but please,
come back safely no matter what.
21137.descriptionJp:
沼地で、古龍のものと思われ
る、強大な炎が観測された
ようです。至急、調査を
お願いします。あまりに
危険なためアイテムの支給も
できませんが、何とか無事に
帰ってきてください。

63068.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63068.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63068.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

11062.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23368.description: It has been reported that a Silver Dragon attacked on a dark, deserted night. Much about this monster remains a mystery, but its intelligence, flowing control of metal, is thought to be very high even among elder dragons. There is a risk the damage will spread. Please lend your strength to slay it.
23368.descriptionEn:
We have a report that Rukodiora
attacked on a deserted dark
night. Much about this monster
is still a mystery, but the
intellect that commands metal
like flowing water is thought to
rank among the highest of all
Elder Dragons. Damage may well
spread. Please help us slay it!
23368.descriptionJp:
ひとけの無い闇夜に司銀龍が
襲いかかってきたと報告があ
りました。未だ謎が多いモン
スターですが、流れるように
金属を操るその知性は古龍の
中でも非常に高いものだと考
えられます。このままだと被
害の拡大する恐れがあります。
討伐に力を貸してください！

26317.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26317.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26317.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26317.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54273.description: There is a report that a large dragon was seen deep in the Canyon, in an untrodden land where the survey team rarely goes. There is also a report that just before the monster vanished, thunder rang out violently. Please determine the identity of this monster at once.
54273.descriptionEn:
Deep in the Canyon, in an
untrodden land the survey team
has rarely reached, there was a
report of a great dragon seen.
There is also a report that
thunder rang out violently just
before the monster vanished.
At once,
uncover the identity of
this monster.
54273.descriptionJp:
峡谷の奥深く、まだ調査団
も余り行くことのない、
未踏の地で大きな竜を見た
との報告がありました。
また、そのモンスターが、
消える直前に雷が激しく
鳴り響いたとの報告もあり
ます。至急、
このモンスターの正体を
付きとめてください。

62408.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
62408.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
62408.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
62408.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

61115.description: The Dragon Smasher I always wanted is finished! You have done a lot for me! And I am glad you strengthened it so solidly! There is prey in the Arena that suits that hammer and carries a lavish reward, so hunt it and take it!
61115.descriptionEn:
Your dream Dragon Smasher
is done! You've done a lot
for me, and even maxed
out the upgrades. I'm
glad! A foe worthy of
that hammer waits in the
Arena with rich rewards, so
hunt it or just take them!
61115.descriptionJp:
念願の撃龍鎚が完成したぞ！
あんたには色々世話になった
な！おまけにそんなガチガチ
に強化までしてくれて俺も嬉
しいぜ！そのハンマーに見合
う獲物が豪華な報酬を持って
闘技場にいるから、狩ってで
も奪い取ると良いぜ！

58029.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58029.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58029.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58029.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60588.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Khezu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60588.descriptionEn:
A hunting contest where
hunters test their skill!
Target: <<Khezu>>!
That spirit to hunt a
monster all alone is
truly splendid! Beat
yourself and take a top
place! This time Origin
weapons only, choose well!
60588.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪フルフル≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50284.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の撃退
50284.description: It is I, the Instructor! By the good graces of the Hunters Guild, you have been permitted to board the large survey ship! What beautiful scenery you will behold! Clearing the way when monsters attack the survey ship is, of course, a hunter's work! You will fight too!
50284.descriptionEn:
It's me! Instructor!
By grace of the Hunters
Guild, you are permitted
aboard the great airship!
What beautiful sights you
shall see!
When monsters attack the
ship, clearing them is
of course a hunter's job!
So you'll fight too!
50284.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ！教官だ！
なんと！ハンターズギルドの
はからいで諸君の大型探査船
への搭乗が許可されたぞ！
さぞ美しい景色を拝めること
だろう！
大型探査船がモンスターに襲
われた際の露払いは、
もちろんハンターの仕事だ！
諸君にも戦ってもらうぞ！

60083.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

58048.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58048.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58048.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58048.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

12072.description: A blue subspecies of Rathalos has been confirmed in the Forest and Hills. Whoever overcomes its peerless vitality will hold power beyond that of a dragon. I should like to see which hunter harbors such ability.
12072.descriptionEn:
An Azure ≪Rathalos≫ has
been sighted in the
≪Forest and Hills≫, it
seems. Whoever bests its
unmatched vitality gains
power beyond a dragon. I
would love to see who.
12072.descriptionJp:
≪森丘≫で≪リオレウス≫
の蒼き亜種が確認されたよう
ね。その比類なき生命力に
勝つ者は竜を上回る力を持つ
こととなるわ。一体どの狩人
にその能力が秘められている
か、見てみたいものだわ。

62709.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
62709.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
62709.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.
62709.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは、対変種に適した特
殊な武器を装備した方限定の
受注、参加となっております。
今回のターゲットには、通常
とは異なる性質、動きがみら
れるそうなのでご注意を。

21891.description: A quest for the HR400 breakthrough trial. Accept the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, then depart on the quest alone.
21891.descriptionEn:
A quest for the HR400
breakthrough trial. Accept
the trial from the Guild
Master or the HR Trial
board, then depart on the
quest alone.
21891.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ４００突破試練のための
クエストです。ギルドマス
ターまたはＨＲ試練掲示板
から試練を受注した後、
お一人でクエストへ出発して
ください。

54561.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54561.description: An Azure Rathalos has appeared at the Ancient Tower. It breathes a flame never seen before and is causing damage all around. To keep the damage from spreading further, we ask for your help in hunting it.
54561.descriptionEn:
An Azure Rathalos has appeared
at the Ancient Tower. It spits
a breath never seen before and
is bringing harm to the area.
To keep the damage from
spreading further, we ask for
your help in hunting it.
54561.descriptionJp:
古塔にリオレウス亜種が現れ
ました。今まで見たことがな
いブレスを吐き、周囲に被害
をもたらしています。これ以
上被害を拡大させないために
も、狩猟のご協力をお願いし
ます。

55255.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
55255.description: Uragaan has been found in the volcano! This is the first sighting in the region. Reports also speak of unusual movement. Skilled hunters, we ask for an ecological survey of the target.
55255.descriptionEn:
The Burst Hammer Wyvern,
Uragaan, has been found in the
Volcano! This is the first such
discovery in this region.
Reports also say it moves in
peculiar ways.
Skilled hunters, please carry
out an ecological survey of it.
55255.descriptionJp:
爆鎚竜・ウラガンキンが
火山にて発見されました！
この地域では初の発見です。
特殊な動きをするとの報告も
あがってきています。
腕利きのハンターの皆様、対
象の生態調査をお願いします。

21993.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
21993.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one White Espinas, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21993.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner well,
nya? Treat your partner right
once in a while, nya!
Now, to business, nya. This
request is to hunt 1 Espinas
Rare Species, nya. The reward
is materials to craft Felyne
gear, nya! I'm counting on you!
21993.descriptionJp:
おう！そこの狩人さん！
アンタのパートニャーは元気
かニャ？たまには相棒孝行し
てやるニャ！
では、本題ニャ。今回の依頼
は棘白竜１頭の狩猟ニャ。
報酬はパートニャー用武具の
生産素材だニャ！
たのんだニャー！

22152.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of zenny and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
22152.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you hunters!
A request is available that lets
you earn a mountain of zenny and
gain plenty of experience too.
Take this chance and give it a
try, won't you!
22152.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のゼニーが入手できる上
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

50303.description: Controlling a monster exactly as you wish is impossible, but controlling one to some degree is possible, yes! What matters then is a sense of distance! To take it easy by making use of the monster's movements, shall we try a no touch approach?
50303.descriptionEn:
Making a monster do exactly what
you want is impossible, but
controlling it to some extent
is quite possible!
What matters there is distance!
To ride a monster's movements
and take it easy, why not go
all in? Shall we no-touch?
50303.descriptionJp:
モンスターを自由自在に操る
ことはインポッシブルだけど、
ある程度コントロールする
だけなら可能なのデ〜ス！
そこで大切なのが距離感ネ！
モンスターの動きを利用して
楽するためにも、思い切って
シャルウィーノータッチ？

23597.description: A giant dragon's shadow was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano, which erupts constantly, and a survey team was dispatched. According to their report, a crimson Fatalis mutated into an even more monstrous form was lurking there. Past examples show we cannot leave it be. Please slay it quickly.
23597.descriptionEn:
A gigantic dragon's shadow was
sighted in the crater of the great
volcano that ceaselessly erupts,
and we dispatched a survey team.
Their report says a Crimson Fatalis,
mutated into a more monstrous form,
was lurking there. Judging by past
cases, we cannot leave it be.
We ask for a swift slaying.
23597.descriptionJp:
常に噴火を繰り返す大火山の
火口に巨大な龍の影が目撃さ
れ調査団を派遣しました。
彼等の報告では、より異形に
変異した紅きミラボレアスが
潜んでいたとのこと。
過去の例を見てもこのまま
放っておくことは出来ません。
迅速な討伐をお願いします。

26580.description: Congrats on reaching HR300! Deliver a Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26580.descriptionEn:
Congrats on reaching
HR300! Deliver a <<Map>>
on your own, clear the
quest, and claim your
reward!
26580.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ３００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

26417.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26417.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26417.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

55235.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55235.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.
55235.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されて
いる一部防具や装飾品の強化
に使用するＨＣ素材やＧＨＣ
素材を獲得できるクエストを
ご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

50984.description: For hunters at HR5, a request to craft the top pick Ascension gear, Gore Series. Breaking Gore Magala's antennae and tail is required, but mats abound.
50984.descriptionEn:
For hunters at HR5, a
request to craft the
top pick Ascension
gear, Gore Series.
Breaking Gore Magala's
antennae and tail is
