We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Baruragaru≫ and break its
back and tail, we will grant
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55864.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪喰血竜≫討伐にて
背中破壊と尻尾破壊を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

58090.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58090.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58090.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58090.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62922.objectiveJp: パルサント鉱石９９個の納品
62922.description: It began as a small seed, but tended with care it came to harvest, and in time it brought abundance as well. Yet this is not the end. A hunter who holds a Secret Arts Scroll will be able to encourage further prosperity.
62922.descriptionEn:
It began as a tiny seed, but by
tending it with care it came to
bear fruit, and in time it brought
forth abundance as well.
Yet this is not the end, not by
any means. If you are a hunter
who holds a Secret Art Tome,
you should be able to encourage
even greater prosperity.
62922.descriptionJp:
始まりは小さな種でしたが、
心を込めて育てることで
収穫に至り、やがてそれは
豊穣をも生み出しました。
しかし、まだまだ終わりでは
ありません。≪秘伝書≫を
お持ちのハンターさんならば、
さらなる繁栄を促すことが
できるでしょう。

51128.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐

54475.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
54475.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54475.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54475.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

21890.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
21890.description: This quest is for the HR300 breakthrough trial. After accepting the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, depart on the quest alone.
21890.descriptionEn:
This quest is for the
HR300 breakthrough trial.
After accepting the trial
from the Guild Master or
the HR Trial board, depart
on the quest alone.
21890.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ３００突破試練のための
クエストです。ギルドマス
ターまたはＨＲ試練掲示板
から試練を受注した後、
お一人でクエストへ出発して
ください。

26032.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26032.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26032.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

21663.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21663.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Fermi Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21663.descriptionEn:
Memos recording the lost secret
art of forging equipment have been
found on monsters slain all over
the land, or so I hear!
Once you get the "Fermi Memo",
come alone, like a man! Bring it
to this workshop master!
I'll show you some good work!
21663.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪フェルミメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

51022.description: In a mountain region known as the sacred peak, an elder dragon wreathed in storms has been confirmed. Many nearby villages have voiced their unease, and a swift response is needed. Hunters, head for the sacred peak at once.
51022.descriptionEn:
In a mountain region known as
the Sacred Peak, an Elder Dragon
wreathed in storms has been
confirmed. Many voices of worry
have come from nearby villages,
so a swift response is needed.
Hunters, head for the Sacred
Peak at once.
51022.descriptionJp:
とある山岳地帯にある、霊峰
と呼ばれる地域にて、嵐を
纏う古龍が確認されました。
近隣の村々からは不安の声が
多数寄せられており、早急に
対応が必要です。
ハンターは至急、霊峰へと
向かってください。

54719.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
54719.description: We present a request that lets you obtain some of the materials needed to upgrade the Fury-Faced Wyvern's Ｇ-rank gear, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
54719.descriptionEn:
There's a daily limit on
accepts, but here is a
request that yields some
of the materials needed to
upgrade the Furious Wyvern's
G Rank gear. Don't miss it.
54719.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、怒貌竜のＧ級武
具の強化に必要な素材の一部
を入手できる依頼をご紹介し
ます。この機会を逃さぬよう
ご注意ください。

56053.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
56053.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Rukodiora through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Tonfa, Switch Axe, Magnet Spike, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56053.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials to craft one
Rukodiora Supremacy
weapon and upgrade it two
steps, plus Gz worth of
Porta Card Sakura.
Craftable weapon types:
Dual Blades, Hunting Horn,
Tonfa, Switch Axe, Magnet
Spike, Heavy Bowgun, Bow.
56053.descriptionJp:
辿異種ルコディオラの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、狩猟笛、 
穿龍棍、剣斧、磁斬鎚、
重弩、弓のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

54987.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54987.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!
54987.descriptionJp:
鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26715.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26715.description: What, you just want a hard Great Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26715.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Great Sword
that is simply hard as rock?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and nasty
monsters are prowling around
the area on top of that.
So go find it with some spirit!
26715.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬い大剣が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

53018.description: What will you give in return for the chocolate? Sweets are fine, but above all what matters is everyone's pure feelings! I have prepared a job that tests those feelings, so complete it and polish that pure white heart!
53018.descriptionEn:
What will you give back
for the chocolate? Sweets
are fine, but what matters
most is everyone's pure
feelings! I've prepared a
request that tests those
feelings, so clear it and
polish that pure heart of
yours!
53018.descriptionJp:
チョコのお返し、何をあげ
ますか？甘い物もいいです
が、何よりも大事なのは皆
さんの純粋な想いですよ！
そんな想いを試す依頼をご
用意しましたので、この依
頼を達成して、その純白な
気持ちを、より磨いてくだ
さい！

26408.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26408.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?
26408.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た実り豊かなフィールドで、
たまにはのんびり採取でも
いかがですか？

54165.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54165.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54165.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54379.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54379.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54379.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

61162.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
61162.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
61162.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

54703.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
54703.description: For those aiming at GR500, hunting a Bulldrome raises your standing as a hunter a lot, and can also yield 'Great Boar Bone', a fine material for affinity sigils. We have prepared such a quest. Please make good use of it.
54703.descriptionEn:
For those aiming at GR500,
hunting a Bulldrome raises
your standing as a hunter
a lot, and can also yield
'Great Boar Bone', a fine
material for affinity sigils.
We have prepared such a
quest.
Please make good use of it.
54703.descriptionJp:
ＧＲ５００を目指す方々へ
ドスファンゴを狩猟すること
で、ハンターとしての評価が
大きく上がりつつ、会心率
シジル作成にオススメの素材
である「大猪の重骨」も入手
可能なクエストを準備しまし
た。
ぜひお役立てください。

62290.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62290.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62290.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62290.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

50742.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
50742.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50742.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50742.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

21782.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

54421.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

54585.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

21632.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
21632.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Indigo Gray Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21632.descriptionEn:
Do you know the bead known
as Indigo Bead?
That material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Clear this request and I
shall give you rare
decoration materials.
21632.descriptionJp:
藍鼠原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55390.description: A report has arrived that the shadow of a wyvern bearing needles was sighted. At the sign of a new Variant Species, the guild has prepared new dual blades for promising hunters, to stand against Variant Species. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare for the hunt!
55390.descriptionEn:
A report came in of a
winged wyvern with needles
sighted. With signs of a new
Supremacy, the Guild forged
new Dual Blades for
promising hunters to
face them.
Gather the materials and
prepare to slay Supremacies!
55390.descriptionJp:
針を持つ飛竜の影を目撃した
という報告が届きました。
新たな辿異種出現の兆しに、
ギルドでは有望なハンターに
向けて、辿異種に立ち向かう
ための新たな双剣を用意しま
した。
生産素材を獲得して、辿異種
の討伐に備えてください！

54223.description: The survey of the Yian Garuga that appeared in the Canyon continues. Breaking its parts is not required, but I would be delighted if you did! Hunters, I ask for your help!
54223.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey
of the Yian Garuga that
appeared in the Canyon.
Part breaks aren't
required, but we'd be
glad if you did!
Hunters, thank you
for your support!
54223.descriptionJp:
峡谷に出現した
イャンガルルガの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

61564.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61564.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61564.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

21220.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
21220.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21220.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21220.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54518.description: 2 monsters suddenly appeared in the New Great Arena. Both are monsters the guild considers the most dangerous. We have somehow kept the damage from spreading, but the situation allows no complacency. Head there at once and slay the monsters.
54518.descriptionEn:
Suddenly, two monsters have
appeared in the New Great Arena.
Both are monsters the Guild ranks
as the most dangerous of all.
For now the damage has not spread,
but the situation allows no room
for complacency.
Go to the site at once and set
about slaying the monsters.
54518.descriptionJp:
突如、新大闘技場に２頭の
モンスターが現れました。
どちらもギルドが最も危険と
位置付けるモンスターです。
なんとか、被害を拡大させず
に済んでいますが、予断を
許さない状態です。
至急現地に向かいモンスター
の討伐に当たってください。

23703.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (waist), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
23703.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the materials
needed to upgrade G Rank Secret
Art Armor (waist piece),
excluding weapon ribbons and
weapon merits.
The yield is one type's worth.
To accept this quest, you will
need a ≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫,
so please be aware
of that.
23703.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（腰防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

21593.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Eagle Wing Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21593.descriptionEn:
Do you know the bead known
as Eagle Wing Bead?
That material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decoration.
Clear this request and I
shall give you rare
decoration materials.
21593.descriptionJp:
鷲翼原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

63246.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
63246.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!
63246.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法が開発されました。
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

21697.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
21697.description: The fortress guard reports that Lao-Shan Lung is advancing. Hunters, head for the fortress at once and repel it. You may use the fortress's equipment freely. Make the most of it in battle.
21697.descriptionEn:
Word has come from the fort's
guards that Lao-Shan Lung is
advancing on us. Hunters, go to
the fort at once and intercept it.
You may use the fort's facilities
freely. Make the fullest use of
them and turn them to your
advantage in battle.
21697.descriptionJp:
老山龍ラオシャンロンが侵攻
してきていると砦の警備兵か
ら連絡が届いています。ハン
ターの皆さんは直ちに砦へ向
かいこれを迎撃してください。
砦の設備は自由に使って構い
ません。最大限に活用し戦い
に役立ててください。

50019.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

63379.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
63379.description: Reports say Bulldrome and Velocidrome are on a rampage at the same time in the Jungle. Hunters, hurry to the Jungle and put them down.
63379.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, ≪Bulldrome≫
and ≪Velocidrome≫ are said
to be rampaging at the
same time. Hunters, hurry
to the Jungle and put
them down.
63379.descriptionJp:
密林で、≪ドスファンゴ≫と
≪ドスランポス≫が同時に
暴れまわっていると報告が
ありました。ハンターの
皆さんは、急ぎ密林へ向かい
これを鎮圧してください。

26393.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26393.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
26393.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

21056.description: Slay the 8 blue hunters, Velociprey, that use the Jungle as their feeding ground! They are just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt!
21056.descriptionEn:
These blue hunters, ≪Velociprey≫,
treat the Jungle as their feeding
ground. Slay 8 of them!
They are just the right opponents
to measure a hunter's skill!
21056.descriptionJp:
密林をエサ場とする、
青き狩人≪ランポス≫８頭を
討伐してください！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手ですよ！

55972.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55972.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55972.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

55899.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55899.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55899.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

50464.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
50464.description: A blue monster has appeared at the top of the sea of trees. That monster appears together with lightning and shows movements swift as lightning, they say. Several hunters are already dealing with it, but they have not even managed to wound it. Please head to the site at once.
50464.descriptionEn:
A blue monster has appeared at the
Top of Great Forest.
That monster appears together with
lightning, and is said to move as
swiftly as a bolt of lightning.
Several hunters are already dealing
with it, but they have not even been
able to inflict a single wound.
Please head to the site
at once.
50464.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に蒼色のモンスター
が現れました。
そのモンスターは、落雷と
ともに現れ、雷のように
素早い動きを見せるとか。
既に、何人かのハンターが
対応に当たっていますが、
傷を負わせることすらできて
いません。至急、現地へ
向かってください。

23545.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23545.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23545.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

40080.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Gothic F Piercing.
40080.descriptionEn:
Here we hand out VISA
production tickets to
hunters who own Gothic
equipment. Accept the quest
while wearing a Gothic F
Pierce.
40080.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。ゴシックＦピアス
を装備した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

23166.description: We are recruiting hunters to go to an unsurveyed area of the swamp. This survey aims to confirm the ecology, so please slay the monsters living there and, if possible, deliver fish.
23166.descriptionEn:
We are looking for hunters
willing to go to an
unsurveyed part of the
Swamp. This survey aims to
confirm the ecology, so
please slay the monsters
living there and, if you
can, deliver some fish.
23166.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域に行って
いただけるハンターを募集
しております。
今回の調査は生態の確認を
目的としておりますので、
生息するモンスターの討伐と、
できれば魚の納品をお願い
いたします。

61931.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
61931.description: This is a practice qualifier quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
61931.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament practice qualifier
quest. In the finals, the
time limit is 5 minutes.
Also, from the monster's
carving and clear rewards,
the target monster's
materials cannot be obtained.
61931.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用予選
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が５分以内です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

55463.description: An existence believed to be a Ten'i Species of Rukodiora has been confirmed, and it is expected to reach the surrounding region before long. Our Guild, preparing for the unforeseen, is readying anti-Rukodiora weapons for capable hunters. Those with confidence, speak up.
55463.descriptionEn:
An entity believed to be a
≪Tesshi≫ of the ≪Lucodiora≫
has been confirmed, and it
is expected to reach the
surrounding lands soon.
Our Guild, bracing for the
unforeseen, is preparing to
issue anti-Lucodiora arms to
able hunters. Step forward!
55463.descriptionJp:
≪極龍≫の≪辿異種≫と思わ
しき存在が確認されており、
近々に周辺地域へ到達する事
が予測されています。
当ギルドは不測の事態に備え、
実力を備えたハンターへ向け
て対ルコディオラ武器の支給
準備を進めています。自信の
ある方はお声かけください。

23480.description: An Espinas with greatly developed horns has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Espinas known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23480.descriptionEn:
A ≪Espinas≫ with greatly
developed horns has
appeared. The Guild deems
this a ≪Supremacy≫ with
overgrown parts and will
survey it. Reports say it
is more dangerous than
usual Espinas. Please
survey with care.
23480.descriptionJp:
角が大きく発達した≪棘竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの棘竜より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

53259.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
53259.description: Hello, how are you? I am sure you are wearing fine armor and carrying your favorite weapon. I want you to remember when you were a novice hunter. You are sure to gain something.
53259.descriptionEn:
Hey there, how are you?
I'm sure right now you're
wearing fine armor and
carrying your favorite weapon.
I want you to remember
the days when you were
a rookie Hunter.
I'm sure you'll find
something to gain from it.
53259.descriptionJp:
やあ、お元気ですか？
きっと君は今、素敵な防具を
着てお気に入りの武器を
背負っていることと思います。
そんな君にひよっこハンター
だった頃を思い出してほしい
のです。
きっと何か得るものがあるは
ずですよ。

54830.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54830.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.
54830.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の航路を制覇されたハン
ターさんですね。このクエス
トではキャラバン秘箱を他の
キャラバン箱に交換すること
ができます。その他にも、Ｇ
ＲＰ、Ｇｚ共に大量に獲得す
ることができます！モンス
ターも登場しますので、油断
せず狩猟に向かってください。

62913.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
62913.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now thinking
of offering its stored
materials to hunters
with a promising future.
But stock is limited, so
only hunters of proven
skill may take part.
Understood.
62913.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

55546.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55546.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55546.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Great Sword, show the
skills you honed against
the ≪Tigrex≫ of the Desert!
Slay it in style and you
shall earn rewards far
beyond what daily effort
brings.
55546.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

51063.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the ears of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku will also grant a special ingredient.
51063.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Blue Yian Kut-Ku's ears,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51063.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
青怪鳥の耳を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

26085.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26085.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26085.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

54724.description: Abiorugu. Its savagery, attacking anything that moves, threatens the swamp's ecosystem. At this rate the swamp will become a land without life. Skilled hunter, please hunt it and restore peace.
54724.descriptionEn:
Abiorugu. Because it attacks
anything that moves, its ferocity
threatens the Swamp's ecosystem.
At this rate, the Swamp will
become a land with no living
things left.
Skilled hunters, please hunt it
somehow and bring peace back.
54724.descriptionJp:
アビオルグ。動くもの何にで
も襲い掛かるその獰猛さゆえ
に沼地の生態が脅かされてい
ます。
このままでは、沼地は生物の
いない地となってしまいます。
腕のあるハンターさん、何と
かヤツを狩猟して平和を取り
戻してください。

54391.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the fin of Cephadrome, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54391.descriptionEn:
For the newly started
G Rank Guild Priority
Request, we prepared this
quest to raise awareness
and interest.
Breaking the Cephadrome's
fin will also grant you
special ingredients.
54391.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
砂竜のヒレを破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

21050.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト３匹の納品
21050.description: Find and deliver 6 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
21050.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 6 Special
Mushrooms that grow in the Jungle!
If you also deliver the ≪Royal Beetle≫,
the insect that sometimes flies
through the Jungle, I'll still pay!
Start by getting to know the Jungle,
then get used to it.
21050.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を６つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

61845.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. Next, prove to me the accumulation of your daily study. As proof of that study, deliver 10 Silver Secret Pots!
61845.descriptionEn:
≪Fishing≫.
It is a solitary hunt spent
facing the fish in silence.
Next, prove to me the results
of your daily effort.
As proof of that study, deliver
10 Silver Secret Pots!
61845.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
次は日々の研鑽の積み重ねを
証明して貰おう。
その研究の証として、白銀の
秘壺１０個を納品してくれ！

61253.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
61253.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!
61253.descriptionJp:
うむ！我輩だ！教官だ！
今回は全装備を貸し出しての
演習を行う！
狩猟の対象は各地の鳥竜だ。
まだ経験が浅いハンターに
とってはかなり強力な装備を
用意したので、慣れない武器
だったとしても頑張るんだぞ！

53104.description: Your mushroom deliveries, hunters, were truly splendid! As a reward I have prepared a quest that earns you plenty of ＨＲＰ! Take it on and aim for a good rank up!
53104.descriptionEn:
Your mushroom deliveries,
hunters, were splendid!
As a reward I've prepared
a quest that gives plenty
of HRP! Accept it and aim
for a big rank up!
Go on, then!
53104.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君等によるキノコ
納品、実に見事であった！報
酬として、ＨＲＰがたっぷり
手に入るクエストを用意した
ぞ！この機会にクエストを受
注してガッツリランクアップ
を目指すのじゃ！

55194.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55194.description: What on earth is happening to them!? Did we push them too far? The Guild has decided to call those shining ones the Deviljho that Devours Extremes. Anyone who succeeds in slaying one will receive the materials for a full set of the Guild's treasured armor and a title! Someone, please!
55194.descriptionEn:
What on earth is happening
to them!? Did we push them too far?
The Guild has decided to call
these shining ones the
'Acme Devouring Deviljho'.
If anyone succeeds in slaying one,
we shall present the materials for
a full set of Guild-hidden armor
and a title! Someone, please!
55194.descriptionJp:
ヤツらに何が起こっているの
だ！？追い込み過ぎたのか？
ギルドでは、光放つヤツらを
「極み喰らうイビルジョー」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐に成功したものがいれば
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！
誰か頼む！

62942.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62942.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62942.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

60660.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
60660.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a red and white monster of the zodiac. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60660.descriptionEn:
A hunters' tournament where
skills are put to the test!
Today's target is a red and
white monster of the zodiac!
To hunt a monster all alone
shows true spirit, truly
admirable! Best yourself
and take a top placing!
Supremacy weapons only now!
60660.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
干支に紅白なモンスターだ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

54091.description: Each time the Giaorugu discovered in the extreme cold sea rampages with its sharp claws, fangs and tail, it opens great cracks in the ice field. If it keeps rampaging, the cracks and falling snow will prevent the survey from proceeding. Immediate action is required.
54091.descriptionEn:
The Giaorugu found in the Polar
Sea, with its sharp claws, fangs
and tail, opens huge cracks in
the frozen ground whenever it
rampages. If it keeps this up,
the cracks and falling snow will
make the survey impossible.
We need this handled at once.
54091.descriptionJp:
極海で発見された氷獰竜は、
鋭利な爪や牙、尾によって
暴れるたびに氷の大地に大き
な亀裂を生じさせます。
このまま暴れられたのでは、
亀裂や落雪のために調査を
進めることができません。
早急に対応が必要です。

54229.description: A researcher who was exploring the swamp has been carried back to the guild in critical condition. According to the observation notes he left behind, Iodrome and Ioprey have been on the decline in the swamp lately. We would like a confident hunter to investigate and confirm whether this is true.
54229.descriptionEn:
A surveyor exploring the Swamp
was carried to the Guild in
critical condition. From the
notes left by the others, the
Gendrome and Genprey there
seem to be dwindling.
So we ask skilled hunters to
survey and confirm the truth
of it.
54229.descriptionJp:
沼地を探索していた調査員が
ギルドに重体で搬送された。
残された調査員の観察記録に
よると、近ごろ沼地でドス
イーオスやイーオスが減少
傾向にあるらしい。
そこで、腕に自信のある
ハンターに真偽を確かめる
べく調査をお願いしたい。

61460.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
61460.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
61460.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

51073.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
51073.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of an Azure Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
51073.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Azure Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51073.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
蒼眠鳥のクチバシを破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

55288.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for one material, and break the specified part for one more!
55288.descriptionEn:
A chance to get a Supremacy
weapon prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal fixed damage to the target
for 1 material, and break the
specified part for one more
as a gift!
55288.descriptionJp:
ギルドで準備した辿異武器を
入手するチャンス！
参加条件はＧＲ２００！
ターゲットに一定ダメージを
与えることで素材を１個、
指定の部位を破壊することで
さらに１個プレゼント！

55817.description: Was the bizarre tale born from the bizarre? Or was the bizarre born from the bizarre tale? The bizarre is truly fascinating. I want you to slay the Chameleos, which closely resembles a bizarre phenomenon, with the Paper Umbrella Sword [Night Parade]. It may draw something strange to us. As a reward I will prepare my treasured tale of the bizarre.
55817.descriptionEn:
Do oddities birth odd tales?
Do odd tales birth oddities?
Oddities are so fascinating.
I want you to slay a
Chameleos that mimics odd
phenomena with the Kasa
Sword [Night Parade]. It may
draw oddities near.
My secret odd tales await.
55817.descriptionJp:
怪異から怪異譚が生まれた？
怪異譚から怪異が生まれた？
怪異とはまこと興味深い。
怪異現象によく似たオオナズ
チを唐傘ノ剣【百鬼夜行】で
討伐してほしいのじゃ。何か
怪異を呼び寄せるかもしれん。
報酬としてわしの秘蔵の怪異
譚を用意しておこう。

50073.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50073.description: The limited-time Golden Week Festival special quest is a bargain quest where you can get plenty of HRP and Porta Tickets (Sakura). Note that a Golden Week Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50073.descriptionEn:
This limited-time GW Festival
special quest is a great deal,
giving plenty of HRP and
Porta Ticket Sakura.
Note that accepting the quest
requires a ≪GW Ticket≫, so
please be careful.
50073.descriptionJp:
期間限定のＧＷ祭・特別クエ
ストは、ＨＲＰやポルタ
チケット桜がたっぷり貰える
お得なクエストです。
クエストの受注には
「ＧＷチケット」が必要にな
りますのでご注意ください。

61331.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61331.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61331.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62066.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
62066.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
62066.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

61843.description: It seems you gathered splendidly the materials the miner requested. According to the owner of the mixing shop, if you mix a large amount of Amber Rare Water and Jade Rare Water with Blast Rock, you get a rare ore that burns as if it were exploding. Won't you try it too?
61843.descriptionEn:
You've gathered all the
materials the miner asked for.
According to the owner of the
mixing shop, blending blasting
rocks into lots of Amber Fluid
and Jade Fluid makes a rare ore
that burns like an explosion.
Won't you try it too?
61843.descriptionJp:
採掘師が依頼した素材を見事
に集めきったようですね。
調合屋のあるじから聞いた話
によると、大量の琥珀の稀水、
翡翠の稀水に火薬岩を調合す
ると、爆発したように燃える
希少な鉱石ができるらしいの。
あなたも試してみない？

55927.description: A decoration has been completed to protect you from a monster's fierce attacks. With this new decoration you will find it enormously effective against Aberrant species that use fire. We will hand it out as a reward for this quest, so do join us!
55927.descriptionEn:
A decoration to protect you
from the fierce attacks of
monsters is complete.
With this new decoration you
will find immense effect
against fire-using Supremacy
monsters and the like!
It will be given as this quest's
reward, so do join us!
55927.descriptionJp:
モンスターの苛烈な攻撃から
身を護るための装飾品が
完成しました。
この新たな装飾品を使えば
火を使う辿異種などに
絶大な効果を発揮します！
今回のクエスト報酬として
お渡し致しますので、
奮ってご参加ください。

54977.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟
54977.description: Why did the Nargacuga, a swift wyvern never reported before, appear in the Jungle? To find the cause, we will carry out an ecological survey of the subject. It is dangerous, but for the sake of research, please hunt it after breaking its blade wings.
54977.descriptionEn:
Why did the Nargacuga,
never reported before,
appear in the Jungle?
We will survey its ecology
to find the cause.
It is dangerous, but for
research, break the wing
blades before hunting.
54977.descriptionJp:
今まで報告がなかった迅竜・
ナルガクルガは何故密林に
現れたのでしょうか？
原因を突き止めるため、対象
の生態調査を行います。
危険ではありますが、研究の
ため、刃翼破壊後に狩猟を
お願いいたします。

26292.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

55456.description: Everyone knows 2018 is the Year of the Cat, nya! Year One of the Cat, nya! The Cat Union declared it, nya! How auspicious, nya! So that huge fish! I want to eat it, nya! Go catch it, nya!
55456.descriptionEn:
Everyone knows 2018 is
the Year of the Cat, nya!
Year One of the Cat, nya!
The Cat Union declared it,
nya! How auspicious, nya!
So that huge fish!
I want to eat it, nya!
Go catch it, nya!
55456.descriptionJp:
２０１８年が猫年なのは
もうみんな知ってるミャ！
猫年元年ミャ！
猫団組合で制定したミャ！
めでたいミャ！
だからあのデッカイサカナ！
食べたいミャ！
獲ってくるミャ！

21068.description: The fish that live in the hunting grounds are essential materials for mixing bullets! So that you can respond calmly when the moment comes, train your sense for fishing until your body remembers it! The moment to reel in is when the float sinks deep!
21068.descriptionEn:
Fish living in the hunting grounds
are vital ingredients for
≪Bullet Combining≫!
Let's train your body to feel the
rhythm of fishing, so you can
react calmly when the moment comes!
When the float sinks deep, that's
your moment to reel it in!
21068.descriptionJp:
狩り場に生息する魚は≪弾の
調合≫にとって欠かせない素
材です！いざという時に慌て
ず対応できるように、釣りの
感覚を体に覚えさせておきま
しょう！
ウキが深く沈んだ時が釣りあ
げるタイミングですよ！

23734.description: This quest yields the following materials. Light Bowgun Merit (Beginning) x５０, Light Bowgun Merit (Middle) x６０, Light Bowgun Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23734.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials below.
≪L Bowgun Medal - Intro≫ x50
≪L Bowgun Medal - Mid≫ x60
≪L Bowgun Medal - Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you
need a ≪Secret Art Medal
Crystal≫ and GR500 or above,
so please take note.
23734.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪Ｌボウガン勲・序≫５０個
≪Ｌボウガン勲・中≫６０個
≪Ｌボウガン勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

55338.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐

50847.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50847.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50847.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50847.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

40199.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
40199.description: They say even lifeless tools, used for many years, turn into something monstrous. Or perhaps a wandering soul possessed the blade by some chance. Or else an evil one borrowed the form of a blade from the start to manipulate its owner. Either way, show me your true form!
40199.descriptionEn:
They say tools with no life,
used for many years, turn
into vengeful spirits.
Or perhaps a lost soul
latched onto the blade.
Or an evil one took the
shape of a sword to
manipulate its owner.
Either way, show yourself!
40199.descriptionJp:
命の無い道具も長年使ってい
ると、物の怪の類に変わると
いうな。あるいは、迷える魂
が何かの拍子に刀に取り憑い
たか。
それとも、初めから持ち主を
操る目的で邪悪な者が刀の姿
を借りたのか。
いずれにしろ、正体を見せろ！

50518.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の討伐
50518.description: It's me! The Instructor!! Word is that desert monsters have been attacking peddlers a great deal of late. I want you hunters to slay those monsters and make the desert safe again! I have rare materials set aside as the reward, so give it a try!
50518.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
Lately Desert monsters
attacking traveling
merchants has become
common. Hunters, slay
them and secure the
Desert's safety!
Rare materials await!
50518.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！！
近頃、砂漠のモンスターが行
商人を襲う事件が多発してい
るそうだ。ハンター諸君には
モンスターを討伐して砂漠の
安全を確保してほしい！
報酬には珍しい素材を用意し
たから、挑戦してみてくれ！

62205.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62205.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62205.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

54922.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
54922.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54922.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54922.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

62579.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62579.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62579.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62024.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62024.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor
obtain rewards of the official
hunting tournament, so take care.
62024.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報版で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

63140.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63140.description: As part of a monster survey, I ask you to hunt the Rathian in the New Great Arena. It is extremely powerful and behaves in ways normally unthinkable, so this is a quite dangerous request, but if the surveyors obtain satisfactory results you should earn high standing from the Guild.
63140.descriptionEn:
As part of the monster
survey, please hunt the
≪Rathian≫ in the New
Great Arena.
She is very strong and
acts in ways normally
unthinkable, so this is
a risky request, but
with solid results,
the Guild will be pleased.
63140.descriptionJp:
モンスター調査の一環として
新大闘技場にいる≪雌火竜≫
の狩猟をお願いします。
非常に強力で通常では考えら
れない行動を取るため、
かなり危険な依頼となります
が、調査員が満足できる
結果を得られたならば、
ギルドから高い評価を得られ
るはずです。

61129.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61129.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61129.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54284.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の討伐
54284.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54284.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54284.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

61775.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61775.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61775.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

58011.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58011.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58011.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58011.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55619.description: A meteor is reported falling on Schrade Castle. The Guild considers it a sign of Fatalis's revival and asks skilled hunters to investigate on site. If Fatalis appears, please slay it swiftly.
55619.descriptionEn:
A meteor is reported to be
falling on Castle Schrade.
Our Guild sees this as a
sign of Fatalis' revival
and asks skilled hunters
to survey the site.
If Fatalis appears,
slay it swiftly.
55619.descriptionJp:
シュレイド城に隕石が落下中
と報告がありました。
当ギルドはミラボレアス復活
の予兆と考え、腕の立つハン
ターへ現地調査を依頼します。
もし、ミラボレアスが出現し
た場合、迅速な討伐をお願い
します。

62658.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Desert, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Meteor, the Voice of Nature: Quicksand, or the Voice of Nature: Dunes. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62658.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Desert≫, you may obtain
≪Nature's Voice: Meteor≫,
≪Nature's Voice: Quicksand≫,
or ≪Nature's Voice: Dunes≫.
I pray that your hunting life
grows ever richer and more
fulfilling.
62658.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪砂漠≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・流星≫や
≪大自然の声・流砂≫、
≪大自然の声・砂丘≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

62235.description: Hey, got a moment? I went to the swamp for the first time in ages and a Gypceros stole my valuables. Sorry, would you get them back for me? As a special case I will give you a prize from one of the Gallery tournaments!
62235.descriptionEn:
Hey, got a moment?
I went to the Swamp after
a long time and a ≪Gypceros≫
stole my valuables.
Sorry, but could you get
them back? As a special
case I'll give you a prize
from a Gallery event!
62235.descriptionJp:
よう、ちょっといいかい？
久しぶりに沼地へ行ったら
≪ゲリョス≫に貴重品を
盗まれたんだ。
悪いが、ちょっと取り戻して
きてくれないか？特例として
一部のギャラリー大会の景品
をプレゼントするぜ！

11027.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

54574.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54574.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54574.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

50318.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
50318.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Azure Rathalos and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50318.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Azure Rathalos≫
and prove you can do it.
Clear this quest, and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!
50318.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪蒼火竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

23547.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23547.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23547.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

23462.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
23462.description: A Daimyo Hermitaur and a Yaozami appeared during the survey of the Jungle! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. Hunters who complete the request will receive the crafting materials for the weapon series Phantom Mist Clearing.
23462.descriptionEn:
During the Jungle survey,
a Daimyo Hermitaur and
Hermitaurs appeared!
The survey cannot be
completed like this.
Hunters who clear it get
'Phantom Mist Sweeper'
series materials.
23462.descriptionJp:
密林の調査途中にダイミョウ
ザザミとヤオザミが現れまし
た！このままでは調査が完了
できません。依頼を達成して
下さったハンターさんには、
武器「幻影ノ霞払イシ」
シリーズの生産素材をお渡し
します。

22049.description: The Volcano is a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22049.descriptionEn:
The ≪Volcano≫ is a land
still under Guild survey,
but hunters too might like
to go and take a look for
gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22049.descriptionJp:
≪火山≫は、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

20007.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The wind wyvern Kushala Daora has invaded Dundorma's territory! Dundorma is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed in the interception zone and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20007.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Office!
Kushala Daora has entered
Dundorma's territory! Dundorma
now moves to intercept the
Elder Dragon! Use the
interception gear in the zone
and slay it completely!
20007.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
ドンドルマの領内に風翔龍
クシャルダオラが侵入しまし
た！これよりドンドルマは、
古龍の迎撃体制に入ります！
迎撃区画に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

63044.description: Once the invitations went out, hunters began to gather. Some are assembling companions and setting off on quests, others are forming hunting parties and calling for members; it is lively and a joy to see. Would you take on this request together with such companions? On success, I shall give you a rare jewel.
63044.descriptionEn:
Once the invitations went out,
hunters gathered. Some form
parties and leave on quests;
others found Guilds and call
for members. It is lively and
gladdening. Won't you take
this request with such
companions? Succeed, and I
shall give you a rare gem.
63044.descriptionJp:
招待状を出したら、ハンター
が集まってきたな。
仲間を集めてクエストに出発
する者や、猟団を結成し猟団
員を募集する声があり、賑や
かで喜ばしいことだ。
そんな仲間と一緒に、この依
頼を受けてみないか？
成功の暁には、稀少な宝玉を
差し上げよう。

55664.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn a reward far beyond the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
55664.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Tonfa, show the skill
you honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New
Great Arena!
Slay it in style and you
shall earn rewards far
beyond what daily effort
brings.
55664.descriptionJp:
穿龍棍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

23668.description: A Wrathful Wyvern with greatly developed arms has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Wrathful Wyvern seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23668.descriptionEn:
A ≪Doragyurosu≫ with greatly
developed arms has appeared.
The Guild classifies this one
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
overgrown parts, and surveys it.
Reports say it is more dangerous
than any Doragyurosu so far.
Please take care in your
survey.
23668.descriptionJp:
腕が大きく発達した≪怒貌竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの怒貌竜より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

60592.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
60592.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Daimyo Hermitaur. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin, Transcendent and Aberrant weapons only!
60592.descriptionEn:
A hunters' tournament where
skills are put to the test!
Today's target is
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫!
To hunt a monster all alone
shows true spirit, truly
admirable! Win a top place!
Origin, Transient and
Supremacy weapons only!
60592.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は始種・遷悠・辿異武器
限定で開催されているぞ！

26092.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
26092.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26092.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26092.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

28009.description: Lately I have got into egg dishes, and thanks to that no amount of eggs is enough. So please! Bring me 6 Herbivore Eggs! I have a reward ready, so rest easy. It may be a useless thing, though.
28009.descriptionEn:
Lately I've gotten hooked
on egg dishes. Thanks to
that, I never have enough
eggs. So please! Bring me
6 ≪Herbivore Eggs≫, would
you? I've got a reward
ready, so don't worry.
Might be junk, though.
28009.descriptionJp:
最近、卵料理に凝り始めちゃ
ってね。おかげで卵がいくら
あっても足りないんだよな。
だから頼む！オレに≪草食竜
の卵≫を６個運んできてくれ
ないか？礼は用意してあるか
ら安心してくれ。無用の長物
かもしれないがな。

26387.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26387.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26387.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

53065.description: This is Miyashita! A challenge from me (a quiz), answer check quest 1! Question 1: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 1B. Question 2: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 2A. Question 3: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 3B. You who hold the items above: correct! Congratulations! Take the items and depart on the quest! Receive your present!
53065.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here!
My challenge to you (a quiz)
answer-check quest 1!
Q1 Answer Ticket 1B
Q2 Answer Ticket 2A
Q3 Answer Ticket 3B
You holding the items above
are correct! Congrats!
Take the items and depart
on the quest! Get your gift!
53065.descriptionJp:
宮下です！
僕からの挑戦状（クイズ）
答え合せクエスト１です！
第１問 宮下Ｐ解答券１Ｂ
第２問 宮下Ｐ解答券２Ａ
第３問 宮下Ｐ解答券３Ｂ
↑のアイテムを持っている君
正解です！おめでとう！
アイテムを持ってクエストへ
出発！プレゼントを貰おう！

60440.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の討伐
60440.description: A particularly powerful Gendrome is said to go out of its way to attack hunters. For rookie hunters it looks like a very tough opponent to slay, but the reward rises to match.
60440.descriptionEn:
A particularly powerful
≪Gendrome≫ has been known
to go out of its way to
attack hunters.
For rookie hunters it makes
an extremely tough target,
but the reward will be all
the bigger for it.
60440.descriptionJp:
≪ドスゲネポス≫のとりわけ
強力な個体が、ことさらにハ
ンターたちを襲ってくること
があるそうです。
新米のハンターさんたちの討
伐相手としては、非常に手強
い相手になりそうですが、そ
の分報酬ははずみますよ。

61807.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

60231.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Baruragaru. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60231.descriptionEn:
A hunters' tournament where
skills are put to the test!
Today's target is
≪Baruragaru≫!
To hunt a monster all alone
shows true spirit, truly
admirable! Win a top place!
60231.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪バルラガル≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

23638.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23638.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23638.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Switch Axe, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert! Hunt
it well and you shall earn
even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
23638.descriptionJp:
剣斧を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

23505.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
23505.description: To those of you who have upgraded the Flogada GF series to LV7! We have prepared a quest that lets you obtain in one go the upgrade materials for 1 piece of the Flogada GX series armor! Clear the quest 5 times and upgrade every piece!
23505.descriptionEn:
To you who strengthened the
Frogada GF series to LV7!
We have prepared a quest where
you can obtain in one go the
upgrade materials for one piece
of the armor "Frogada GX Series"!
Clear the quest 5 times and
strengthen every piece!
23505.descriptionJp:
フロガダGFシリーズをＬＶ７
まで強化できたあなたへ！
防具「フロガダGXシリーズ」
１部位分の強化素材が一気に
入手できるクエストを用意し
ました！クエストを５回クリ
アして全部位を強化しよう！

54531.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
54531.description: My one weekly pleasure is a drinking party in the Highlands. But lately I have been hearing lively music near the summit, and when I went to check, there was Poborubarumu. Now I cannot drink in peace. I want it slain urgently.
54531.descriptionEn:
My weekly joy is a drink
party in the Highlands.
But lately I hear lively
music near the summit,
so I went to check and
found Poborubarumu there.
Now I can't drink in
peace. Please slay it
right away.
54531.descriptionJp:
私の週１回の楽しみは、高地
での酒盛り。しかし、最近、
高地頂上付近で小気味の良い
音楽が聞こえるようになった
もんだから確かめてみたら、
ポボルバルムがいたんだよ。
これじゃあ、安心して酒盛り
なんてできやしない。
早急な討伐をお願いするよ。

26612.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26612.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26612.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

28041.objectiveJp: 秘密のポーチ４個の納品
28041.description: To complete the many hunting party quests, hunting party tickets are required. First, get hunting party tickets in this quest. It is a very simple quest, so let us finish it quickly.
28041.descriptionEn:
To do the many Guild
quests, Guild Tickets are
required.
First, get a Guild Ticket
from this quest.
Okay?
It's a very easy quest,
so let's clear it quick
and easy.
28041.descriptionJp:
数ある猟団クエストをこなす
ためには、猟団チケットが必
要になります。
まずはこのクエストで、猟団
チケットを手に入れてくださ
い。
とても簡単なクエストですか
ら、ささっとこなしちゃいま
しょう。

26613.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26613.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26613.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

62792.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
62792.description: Have you been to the sea of trees lately? There was a blue Hypnocatrice there, was there not. Won't you bring me its feathers? What? It is the cold season now, so there are only orange Hypnocatrice!? Oh, enough of your noise. Do not think too hard and just go!
62792.descriptionEn:
Been to the Great Forest lately?
There's a blue Hypnocatrice
out there, isn't there. Bring me
its wings, would you?
What? It's the cold season, so
there's only orange ones!
Bah, enough of your noise.
Don't think too hard, just get
out there and do it!
62792.descriptionJp:
最近、樹海へ行ったかね？
あそこには青色の眠鳥が
おっただろ。あいつの羽を
持ってきてくれんか？
何？　今は寒冷期だから橙色
の眠鳥しかおらんだと！
えぇいうるさいわい。
深く考えずにさっさと行って
くるんじゃ！

62964.description: We will carry out further research on monster poison! We have prepared the finest Gypceros material armor, so even if the whole area ends up covered in poison it will be fine! Go and unleash the power of poison to your heart's content!
62964.descriptionEn:
We will conduct further
research on monster venom!
We've prepared top-grade
Gypceros armor for you,
so even if the area is all
poison, you'll be fine!
Unleash the poison's power
to your heart's content!
62964.descriptionJp:
モンスターの毒に関して、
更なる調査を行います！
ゲリョス素材の最高級防具を
用意してもらいましたので、
辺り一面が毒だらけに
なろうとも大丈夫です！
思う存分、毒の力を解放して
来てください！

55220.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
55220.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft the decoration 'Do-Gan Sword Jewel GX2' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55220.descriptionEn:
'F Photo Contest 2016'
grand prize photo used the
decoration 'Do Gan Kenju
GX2'. We prepared a quest
where you can get the
materials to craft it.
Please make use of it.
55220.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る装飾品「弩岩剣珠GX2」を生
産するための素材を獲得でき
るクエストをご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

62975.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62975.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62975.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

50774.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50774.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the crest of a Purple Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
50774.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the Purple Gypceros'
crest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50774.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
紫毒鳥のトサカを破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与
させていただきます。

54708.objectiveJp: イーモンサーモン５０匹の納品
54708.description: A delicious fish living in the freezing sea, the Eemon Salmon. I heard a rumor that a mysterious creature called Smith, which loves that Eemon Salmon, has appeared. To investigate Smith, we need Eemon Salmon in great quantity! Help with the investigation!
54708.descriptionEn:
A delicious fish that lives in
the freezing sea: the "Eemon
Salmon." I heard a rumor that
"Smith," a mysterious creature
fond of that very fish, has
appeared. To survey "Smith" we
need Eemon Salmon in great
quantity! Please help with the
survey!
54708.descriptionJp:
極寒の海に生息する美味な魚
「イーモンサーモン」。
そのイーモンサーモンを好物
とする謎の生物「スミス」が
出現したとの噂を耳にした。
「スミス」の調査のためには
イーモンサーモンが大量に
必要だ！
調査を手伝ってくれ！

63130.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
63130.description: This is the practice finals quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or from clear rewards.
63130.descriptionEn:
This is the practice finals quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or from clear rewards.
63130.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で、
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

55041.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
55041.description: Eh? You're short on Issun Mushi and White Worms? I have plenty! I'll share some! In exchange, I want you to grant my wish too. I'm collecting materials from those bugs that fly off right away! Monsters nearby keep me from getting close, so won't you hunt them?
55041.descriptionEn:
Huh? Short on ≪Issunmushi≫
and ≪White Worm≫? Not enough?
I've got plenty! I'll share!
In return, grant me a wish, okay?
I'm gathering parts from bugs
that fly away as soon as seen!
A monster's nearby, so I can't go.
Won't you hunt it for me? Please?
I'd be ever so grateful, truly!
55041.descriptionJp:
え？≪イッスンムシ≫や≪ホ
ワイトワーム≫が足りない？
僕沢山持ってるよ！分けてあ
げる！その代わり僕のお願い
も叶えてほしいなあ。あのす
ぐ飛んで行っちゃう虫の素材
を集めてるんだ！近くにモン
スターがいて近づけないから
狩猟してくれないかな？

55068.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
55068.description: To support all the hunters who have just been promoted to G Rank, we have prepared a special quest. Let us learn the basics of hunting G Rank monsters while obtaining new decorations!
55068.descriptionEn:
To support all the hunters who have
just been promoted to G Rank, we
have prepared a special quest.
Let us learn the basics of hunting
G Rank monsters while obtaining
new decorations!
55068.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級へ昇格されたばかりの
ハンターの皆さんを支援する
べく、特別なクエストをご用
意いたしました。
Ｇ級モンスター狩猟の基本を
学びながら、新たな装飾品を
入手しましょう！

55457.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55457.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55457.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

63190.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63190.description: A very powerful Hypnocatrice that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63190.descriptionEn:
An individual ≪Hypnocatrice≫ of
great strength that behaves
unlike the norm is in the New
Great Arena, and I want it hunted.
This request is open only to
hunters with Secret Art equipment
approved by the Guild.
Clear it splendidly and you will
earn still greater renown as a
master hunter.
63190.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪眠鳥≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

55642.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55642.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55642.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

58054.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58054.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58054.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58054.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62815.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

61127.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
61127.description: Explosions are everything! You are the type who has been captivated by explosions too, are you not? Give them shelling and blasts so relentless they cannot breathe! I will see to your equipment, so go without a care.
61127.descriptionEn:
Explosions are everything!
You've been charmed by blasts too,
haven't you?
Give them cannon fire and explosions
without a moment's respite!
I'll ready your equipment myself.
Go on out there with confidence.
61127.descriptionJp:
バクハツこそが全てだ！
お前もバクハツに魅了された
クチだろう？
息もつかせぬ程、砲撃、爆発
をくれてやれ！
装備は俺が揃えてやるからな。
安心して行ってこい。

50898.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50898.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50898.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50898.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

60426.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
60426.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60426.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60426.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

11068.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
11068.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! In this breeding season there are more herbivore monsters, so delivering Raw Meat is easy too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
11068.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 8 Special
Mushrooms growing in the Jungle
region! In this breeding season
there are more herbivores, so
≪Raw Meat≫ is easy to deliver
too! First learn the Jungle,
then get used to it.
11068.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を８つ探して納めて下さい！
この繁殖期は草食タイプの
モンスターが多くなるので、
≪生肉≫の納品も簡単です！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めましょう。

54521.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
