54521.description: People living around the highlands are reporting noise damage. It seems that, unlike the monster cries they usually hear, a strange sound can be heard. To prevent the damage from spreading, head to the site and investigate the cause.
54521.descriptionEn:
People living around the
Highlands have reported noise
damage. It seems that, unlike
the monster cries they always
hear, a strange sound reaches
their ears. To keep the damage
from spreading, please head to
the site and investigate the
cause.
54521.descriptionJp:
高地周辺に暮らしている
人々から騒音の被害が届い
ています。どうやら、いつ
も聞いているモンスターの
鳴き声とは違い、奇妙な
音が聞こえてくるそうです。
被害の拡大を防ぐため、
現地に向かい原因調査を
お願いします。

55424.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
55424.description: At the signs of a new Variant appearing, the Guild has prepared a new lance for promising hunters to face the Variants. Obtain the production materials and prepare for the Variant hunt!
55424.descriptionEn:
In anticipation of new Supremacy
Species, the Guild has readied
a new lance for promising hunters
to stand against them.
Gather the crafting materials
and prepare to slay the
Supremacy Species!
55424.descriptionJp:
新たな辿異種出現の兆しに、
ギルドでは有望なハンターに
向けて、辿異種に立ち向かう
ための新たなランスを用意し
ました。
生産素材を獲得して、辿異種
の討伐に備えてください！

54575.description: We are recruiting hunters to hunt the 2 Hypnocatrice that appeared in the sea of trees. They are stronger than usual, so we will give a larger reward. Those confident in their skill, please accept!
54575.descriptionEn:
We seek hunters to hunt the two
Hypnocatrice that appeared
in the Great Forest.
They are stronger than normal,
so the rewards will be greater.
If you're confident in your skill,
please take this quest!
54575.descriptionJp:
樹海に出現した２頭の眠鳥を
狩猟してくださるハンターを
募集しています。
通常よりも強力な個体のため、
報酬を多くお渡しします。
腕に自信のある方は、ぜひ
受注してください！

28070.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
28070.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28070.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!
28070.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を猟団の仲間と行う
のだ。支給品も一切用意
しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

62414.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62414.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Desert. The tail crystal scorpion Akura Vashimu has also been confirmed in the very middle of the Desert. Slay that one too while you are there! I have prepared armor for it as well! Now off you go!
62414.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor! This
time you will explore the Desert
for me. In the very middle of
the Desert, the Tail Crystal
Scorpion ≪Akura Vashimu≫ has
been confirmed as well.
Slay that one too while you are
at it! I even prepared armor for
that purpose! Now go and do it!
62414.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、砂漠を探索してきて
もらう。砂漠のど真ん中には
尾晶蠍≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫
も確認されているようだ。
ついでにそいつも討伐してき
たまえ！そのための防具も予
め用意してやったぞ！さあ頑
張ってこい！

26543.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26543.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26543.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

54473.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54473.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54473.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

22131.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22131.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
22131.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, display the skill
you have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.
22131.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61643.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61643.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61643.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

63135.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
63135.description: There is a report that the Extreme Dragon has invaded Mezeporta. Its intrusions have been permitted often enough before, but this appearance falls far outside the Guild's predictions and can be called extremely rare. At once, intercept it at the Interception Base and slay it.
63135.descriptionEn:
There are reports that Disufiroa
has invaded Mezepolta.
It has been let through many times
before, but this appearance is
far outside the Guild's predictions
and can be called extremely rare.
Make haste to the interception base,
drive it back,
and slay it.
63135.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタに、極龍が侵入
したとの報告がありました。
以前より度々侵入を許して
いますが、この出現は、
ギルドの予測を大きく外れて
おり、非常に稀であると言え
ます。
至急、迎撃拠点で迎え撃ち、
これを討伐してください。

50496.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Akura Jebia. I am counting on you!
50496.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a favor to ask — how
about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay an
Akura Jebia for me.
I'm counting on you!
50496.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってアクラ・ジェビア
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

5007.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

40231.description: The Black Caster appears to have built a golem modelled on a dragon and is testing it. Its power is immense, and at this rate even uninvolved people may come to harm. Join with me and stop the damage!
40231.descriptionEn:
The Black Caster has built a golem
in the shape of a dragon and
appears to be testing it.
Its power is immense,
and at this rate, uninvolved people
may well be caught in the harm.
Together with me,
let us stop the damage!
40231.descriptionJp:
黒のキャスターが竜を模した
ゴーレムを作り、テストを
行っている様です。
その力は強大で、
このままでは無関係な人間
にも被害が及び兼ねません。
私と共に被害を
食い止めましょう！

50428.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

50875.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
50875.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. Also, we have information from an attack victim that it uses lightning. Proceed with great care.
50875.descriptionEn:
The ≪Thunder Bird≫, sighted
only now and then, has spread
its territory as far as the
paths people travel.
To prevent further harm,
please hunt the target.
We also have information from
those attacked that it uses
lightning. Proceed with the
greatest caution.
50875.descriptionJp:
ときおり目撃されていた
≪照雷鳥≫が、人の通る
辺りまで縄張りを広げて
きました。これ以上の
被害を防ぐため、対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
また、襲われた者から
雷を使うという情報を
得ています。十分に注意
して事に当たって下さい。

61660.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
61660.description: One of the important things for a hunter is to know a monster's traits well and bring the right equipment and skills. The gear lent to you this time is ideal for hunting in the Snowy Mountains. It also grants other useful skills, so give it a try.
61660.descriptionEn:
One thing that matters for a hunter
is knowing a monster's traits well
and bringing suitable equipment
and skills.
The gear lent for this quest
is ideal for hunting in the
Snowy Mountains.
It also grants other useful skills,
so please give it a try.
61660.descriptionJp:
ハンターにとって重要なこと
のひとつとして、モンスター
の特徴をよく知り、適切な装
備、スキルを用意することが
あります。今回貸与する装備
は雪山での狩猟に最適なもの
になっております。その他有
用なスキルも付与されており
ますので、お試しください。

21668.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
21668.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over six at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21668.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
If you want a ≪Pawprint Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand over six of them at once.
Bring exactly 3 ≪Quest
Completion Certificates≫ and
come alone, got it? Well then,
I'll be waiting in the Canyon.
21668.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は６枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

20006.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
20006.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau warns that a suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress! Make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon!
20006.descriptionEn:
The Elder Dragon Forecast Post
reports a suspicious dragon
approaching the Fortress! Use
the Fortress's intercept weapons
to repel the mysterious giant dragon!
20006.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より、怪しげな龍
が砦に接近しているとの知ら
せが入りました！砦の迎撃兵
器を活用し、謎の巨大龍を撃
退してください！

21484.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
21484.description: We have completed defensive preparations against the mysterious flying wyvern now approaching Mezeporuta. Meet it at the interception base and slay it, making use of the abundant supplies and interception weapons. This time we have also arranged carvers for you!
21484.descriptionEn:
We have completed our defense
preparations against the
mysterious Flying Wyvern now
heading for Mezepolta. Meet it
at the ≪Base≫ and slay it using
the ample supplies and
interception weapons provided.
Carvers have been arranged
for you this time as well!
21484.descriptionJp:
現在、メゼポルタに向けて、
飛来してきている謎の飛竜に
対しての防衛準備を整えまし
た。≪迎撃拠点≫で迎え撃ち、
豊富な支給品と、迎撃兵器を
利用して、討伐してください。
今回は剥ぎ取り職人も手配さ
せていただいていますよ！

61759.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
61759.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
61759.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
61759.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

63288.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63288.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63288.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63288.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

60610.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60610.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60610.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62510.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
62510.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62510.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62510.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

55762.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55762.description: The Guild seems to have begun a treasure survey of Shiojima. I know where a great treasure is. Deal with the monster there and the island's treasure is yours. But be careful. The island is cursed, and those who approach the treasure are said to face drowning.
55762.descriptionEn:
Seems the Guild has started
surveying Tidal Island's treasures.
I know where the treasure lies.
Drive off the monster there,
and every treasure here is ours.
But be warned.
The island bears a curse,
and ill fortune on the water
comes to any who approach the gold.
55762.descriptionJp:
ギルドが潮島の財宝調査を
始めたようだな。俺は大量の
財宝の在り処を知っているぞ。
そこにいる化け物を退治すれ
ば、島中の財宝が手に入る。
だが注意しろよ。
島には呪いがかけられていて、
宝に近づこうとする者には
水難の相が出るそうだ。

50331.description: There was a report that an unidentified monster appeared in the swamp. As a result of the investigation, it was determined to be the Blood Devouring Wyvern, Baruragaru, never before confirmed around Mezepolta. The survey continues. Please head to the site at once and secure safety.
50331.descriptionEn:
We have reports that an
unidentified monster appeared in
the Swamp. As a result of our
survey, it was determined to be
the Blood-Eating Wyvern
≪Baruragaru≫, never before
confirmed around Mezepolta.
The survey is still ongoing.
Please head to the site at once
and secure the area.
50331.descriptionJp:
沼地に未確認のモンスターが
現れたとの報告がありました。
調査の結果、これまで
メゼポルタ周辺では確認され
たことのない喰血竜
≪バルラガル≫であると判明
しました。現在も調査は進め
られています。
至急現地へ向かい、
安全の確保をお願いします。

60130.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

50203.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
50203.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50203.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50203.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

26489.description: Gravios is called the Tyrant of the Blaze, and its outer shell, grown to absurd hardness by eating coal and ore, calls for well-honed equipment! You could also slip past the Armor Wyvern and deliver Blast Rock!
26489.descriptionEn:
≪Gravios≫ is called the
Emperor of Blazing Heat. It
eats coal and ore, growing a
shell so hard you'll need
well-honed gear! You may
also sneak past the Armor
Wyvern to deliver ≪Blast Stone≫!
26489.descriptionJp:
≪グラビモス≫は灼熱の覇者
とも呼ばれてて、燃石や鉱石
を食べて異常なまでの硬度に
発達した外殻には、相当に磨
かれた装備が必要ですよ！鎧
竜の目を盗んで≪火薬岩≫を
納めてくれてもいいですよ！

62036.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62036.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Kushala Daora. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62036.descriptionEn:
Emergency request. We are seeking
hunters willing to slay a
remarkably powerful ≪Kushala Daora≫.
Should you succeed in the kill,
we will issue more slay proofs
than usual!
We await your application!
62036.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪クシャルダオラ≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に討伐で
きましたら、普段よりも多め
の討伐の証を発行いたしま
しょう！

63272.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Gogomoa. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63272.descriptionEn:
Emergency request. We are seeking
hunters willing to hunt a
remarkably powerful ≪Gogomoa≫.
Should you succeed in the hunt,
we will issue more slay proofs
than usual!
We await your application!
63272.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ゴゴモア≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に狩猟で
きましたら、普段よりも多め
に討伐の証を発行いたしま
しょう！

21427.objectiveJp: 黄晶石の欠片９９個の納品

26674.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
26674.description: 2 Khezu Variants are rampaging in the swamp, apparently. Speaking of Khezu, it is fire, right? Yes! Go and blast them down with a gunlance! If you pull it off, I will give special rewards like the hides I carved before!
26674.descriptionEn:
Two Khezu Variants are said to
be on a rampage in the Swamp.
Khezu means fire, right?
Yes! Go blast them apart with
a Gunlance!
Do it and I will hand over the
hides I carved and more!
26674.descriptionJp:
沼地で２頭のフルフル変種が
暴れているらしい。
フルフルといえば炎だよな。
そう！ガンランスであいつら
をドカンドカンと撃ち倒して
くるんだ！やり遂げれば、
俺が以前剥ぎ取ってきた皮等、
特別な報酬を出すぞ！

50844.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 40 Porta Tickets Sakura. Hunt a Baruragaru and you can obtain the materials needed to produce 1 Supremacy weapon.
50844.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely quest you
can take in exchange for 40
Sakura Porta Tickets.
Hunt a Baruragaru and you'll get
the materials needed to forge
one ≪Hardcore Weapon≫.
Isn't that a fine deal?
50844.descriptionJp:
ポルタチケット桜４０枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
バルラガルを狩猟すると、
≪剛種武器≫１本の生産に
必要な素材が
入手できるわよ。

50781.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50781.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Black Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
50781.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the chest of the
Black Gravios also grants
you special ingredients.
50781.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒鎧竜の胸部を破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

62434.description: What, you just want a hard Light Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62434.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Light
Bowgun that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!
62434.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅いライト
ボウガンが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

60443.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
60443.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time, at the request of the Guild of the Elder Hall, a superb Diablos has been loosed into the arena! Now, who is the strong one who will wrestle this Diablos down and claim the grand purse of honour?
60443.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
off their skill!
This time, at the request of the
Grand Hall Guild, we've released
a superb Diablos into the Arena!
Now, who among you is strong
enough to pin this Diablos and
claim the glorious fortune!?
60443.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！
今回は、大老殿ギルドからの
依頼で、とびきりの角竜を闘
技場に放ったぞ！
さあ、この角竜をねじ伏せて
誉れの大金を手に入れる強者
は一体誰だ！？

55030.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
55030.description: We continue the investigation of Kushala Daora. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
55030.descriptionEn:
We will continue the survey
of Kushala Daora.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but if you do,
it would make me very happy!
Hunters all, thank you
for your cooperation!
55030.descriptionJp:
クシャルダオラの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

55217.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55217.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55217.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55217.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

20012.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン亜種１体の撃退
20012.description: A giant dragon with grey hide like rock has invaded the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma! Use the fortress interception equipment to the fullest and repel it! Those whose strength is insufficient should ride the rock mountain dragon's back, obtain Dragon Drug Stones and put them in the delivery box!
20012.descriptionEn:
A giant dragon, grey as rock,
seems to be invading the
≪Fortress≫, gateway to Dundorma!
Make full use of its intercept
gear and repel it! Those short
on strength should ride its back,
obtain ≪Dragon Medicine Stones≫
and put them in the delivery box!
20012.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマへの玄関口となる
≪砦≫に灰色の体色をした岩
のような巨龍が侵攻してきた
ようじゃ！砦の迎撃設備を最大
限に活用し撃退するのじゃ！
戦力の及ばぬ者は岩山龍の背
に乗り≪龍薬石≫を入手して
納品ＢＯＸに納めるのじゃ！

23182.objectiveJp: チャチャブー８匹の討伐

20021.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
20021.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The flame wyvern Teostra has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20021.descriptionEn:
Emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Post!
Teostra has invaded
Mezepolta's territory!
Mezepolta now moves to
intercept it! Use the gear at
the Base to slay the Elder
Dragon completely! Please!
20021.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
メゼポルタの領内に炎王龍
テオ・テスカトルが侵入しま
した！これよりメゼポルタは
古龍の迎撃態勢に入ります！
迎撃拠点に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

60060.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

51035.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
51035.descriptionEn:
This quest yields materials for
Secret Art Armor (Gunner),
excluding weapon souls needed
for FX upgrades.
The drop count is for five parts.
Taking this quest requires
≪Hunter Die White≫,
so please
be aware of that.
51035.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（ガンナー）の
FX強化時に必要な武器魂を
除く素材を排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターダイス白≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

1040.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ６頭の討伐
1040.description: I had heard the swamp suited Bullfango well, but I never expected this many. While you hunt the Bulldrome, thin out the Bullfango too! The more you slay, the richer the reward!!
1040.descriptionEn:
I'd heard the Swamp was a fine
place for Bullfango to live,
but this many? I'm astonished.
While you hunt the ≪Bulldrome≫,
take out some Bullfango too!
The more you slay, the bigger
the reward! Get to it!
1040.descriptionJp:
沼地はブルファンゴたちが棲
むのに適した環境だとは聞い
ていたがここまでの多さとは
驚いたよ。≪ドスファンゴ≫
の狩猟ついでにブルファンゴ
も討伐してみてくれ！討伐数
が多いほど報酬も弾むぜ！！

23198.description: The night in the extreme cold sea is very cold, and merely standing there drains your stamina. Do not neglect your preparations. By the way, they say a beautiful rainbow of light spans the night sky over the extreme cold sea. When you tire of hunting, why not look up for a while.
23198.descriptionEn:
The Polar Sea night is bitter cold,
and just standing here drains
your stamina.
Do not neglect your preparations.
By the way, they say the Polar Sea
night sky bears a rainbow of light
of great beauty.
When the hunt tires you,
why not look up for a while?
23198.descriptionJp:
極海の夜はとても寒く、
立っているだけでも体力を
奪われてしまいます。
準備は怠らないでください。
そういえば、極海の夜空には
とても美しい光の虹が架かる
そうです。狩りに疲れたら、
少し見上げてみてはいかがで
しょう。

54918.description: This quest lets you obtain the convenient G-rank Rage Jewel and G-rank Guard Flash Jewel. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54918.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
handy ≪G Rank Fury Gem≫ and
≪G Rank Guard Gem≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.
54918.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、便利な
≪Ｇ級・怒剛珠≫と
≪Ｇ級・護閃珠≫を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55841.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
55841.description: The Variant Species Bogabadorumu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55841.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Species ≪Bogabadorum≫
has grown ferociously strong and
rampages without pause.
It is extremely dangerous as it is.
Prepare thoroughly and
carry out the survey.
55841.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ボガバドルム≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

55070.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
55070.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Lavasioth Subspecies while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55070.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Lavasioth, you can
raise your own standing while
gaining, at a bargain, the
materials needed to obtain
G Rank decorations.
I've prepared this quest for it.
Please make good use of it.
55070.descriptionJp:
ヴォルガノス亜種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

55714.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55714.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the black-bodied one the Extreme Scorching Frozen Elzelion. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55714.descriptionEn:
Drive it off and it comes
fluttering back again. The Guild
has decided to call that black
form "Eruzerion, the Acme that
Burns and Freezes". To hunters who
slay it, we shall present the
materials for a full set of Guild
secret armor and a title!
55714.descriptionJp:
追い払えどもヤツは、
再び舞い戻ってくる。
ギルドでは、黒躰のヤツを
「極み灼き凍るエルゼリ
オン」と呼ぶことにした。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

60309.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
60309.description: A hunting encouragement notice for novice hunters. Lately, please hunt the Bulldrome that ravage the crops nearby. Since it is meant to encourage novices, the reward is said to be generous as a form of support!
60309.descriptionEn:
An announcement to encourage
all you rookie hunters.
Lately a ≪Bulldrome≫ has been
ravaging the nearby crops, and
we ask you to slay it.
It is meant to encourage rookies,
so the reward is said to be
generous as support too!
60309.descriptionJp:
駆け出しハンターの皆さんに
狩猟奨励のお知らせです。
最近、近隣の農作物を荒らす
≪ドスファンゴ≫の討伐をお
願いします。
駆け出しのみなさんへの狩猟
奨励だけに、支援の意味でも
報酬は、はずむそうですよ！

62216.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62216.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62216.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62216.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

23552.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
23552.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23552.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23552.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55704.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Rathalos through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55704.descriptionEn:
You can get the materials
needed to craft one Supremacy
Rathalos weapon and take it
through its first upgrade,
plus Porta Card Sakura worth
Gz. Craftable weapon types:
Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance,
Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun,
or Bow. Use it for your favorite!
55704.descriptionJp:
辿異種リオレウスの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
双剣、鎚、銃槍、軽弩、
重弩、弓のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

62742.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62742.description: Oh? So you have business with me, mya, which means you want something, mya? Then here's a tip just between us. Right now in the volcano, hunt the slightly scary Lavasioth and I'll give you a commemorative gift from the past, mya!
62742.descriptionEn:
Oh?
So you've got business with me,
which means there's something
you want, meow?
Then here's a tip, just for you.
Prime info, meow.
Right now in the Volcano, if you
hunt that scary ≪Volganos≫,
I'll gift you a past memento
for free, meow!
62742.descriptionJp:
お？
オイラに用があるってことは
おミャ〜さん、ほしいものが
あるミャ？
では、ここだけの話。
耳寄りじょ〜ほ〜。
いま火山で、ちょっと恐い
≪溶岩竜≫を狩ってくると
過去の記念品をプレゼント
するミャ！

54525.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
54525.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54525.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54525.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23342.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
23342.description: People living around the highlands are reporting noise damage. It seems that, unlike the monster cries they usually hear, a strange sound can be heard. To prevent the damage from spreading, head to the site and investigate the cause.
23342.descriptionEn:
People living around the
Highlands have reported noise
damage. It seems that, unlike
the monster cries they always
hear, a strange sound reaches
their ears. To keep the damage
from spreading, please head to
the site and investigate the
cause.
23342.descriptionJp:
高地周辺に暮らしている
人々から騒音の被害が届い
ています。どうやら、いつ
も聞いているモンスターの
鳴き声とは違い、奇妙な
音が聞こえてくるそうです。
被害の拡大を防ぐため、
現地に向かい原因調査を
お願いします。

21452.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. Deliver a precious pot and, in return, I will draw up blueprints for a new reel and present them to you. Not an ordinary reel, of course.
21452.descriptionEn:
"Fishing".
It is a solitary hunt, facing the
fish in silence.
If you deliver a valuable pot to
me, I will make you a blueprint
for a new reel as thanks. Of
course, it is no ordinary reel.
21452.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
貴重な壺を納品してくれれば、
お礼に、私が新しいリールの
設計図を作成して進呈しよう。
もちろん、普通のリールじゃ
ないがね。

62464.description: Why not test your skill? It is fine to gather good weapons and armor and go hunting, but that will not show me your true ability. Sometimes it is good to be strict with yourself and challenge your limits, is it not?
62464.descriptionEn:
How about testing your skill?
Gathering fine weapons and armor
and heading out to hunt is fine,
but that won't show me
what you're really made of.
Sometimes being strict with yourself
and challenging your limits
is a good thing, don't you think?
62464.descriptionJp:
腕試しをしてみないか？
良い武器、良い防具を揃えて
狩猟に行くのもよいが、
それでは、お前の実力は分か
らんだろう。
時には、自身に厳しく、
限界に挑戦してみるのもいい
のではないか？

26090.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26090.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26090.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

54323.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
54323.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54323.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54323.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

21203.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
21203.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21203.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21203.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

61154.description: In the wasteland known as the Canyon, you are sure to gather things the likes of which you have never laid eyes on. Well? Does that not set your heart racing? I recommend you go and see for yourself.
61154.descriptionEn:
In the ≪Canyon≫, that wild
wasteland, you are sure to
gather things you have never
seen before.
Well? Does that not stir your
heart? I recommend you go there
at least once.
61154.descriptionJp:
荒野の大地、≪峡谷≫では、
きっと、今まで見たことも
ないようなものが採取できる
ことだろう。
どうだ、心が躍るだろう？
一度行ってみることをオスス
メするぜ。

60320.description: I am in trouble. In the cold season I cannot keep up with the supply of ingredients. Sorry, but would you help me with the purchasing? As thanks I will give you my wife's prized ingredients.
60320.descriptionEn:
I'm in trouble.
The cold season has me short
on ingredients.
Sorry, but would you help me
with the supply run?
As thanks, I'll give you my
wife's prized ingredients.
60320.descriptionJp:
困ったよ。
寒冷期で食材の仕入れが
追いつかないんだよ。
悪いけど仕入れを手伝って
くれないかい？
お礼におかみのとっておきの
食材をあげるよ。

54780.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54780.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54780.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

21914.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
21914.description: A mysterious monster has been confirmed in the snow mountains during a raging blizzard. When the master of the weapons workshop saw the sketch our surveyor drew, he went pale with disbelief and fled back to his shop. We will get the details out of him, so hunters, please handle the survey on site.
21914.descriptionEn:
A mysterious monster has been
confirmed in a Snowy
Mountains blizzard. When the
workshop master saw the
surveyor's sketch, he flew
back to the workshop in
disbelief. We will get the
story from him, so please
survey the site for us.
21914.descriptionJp:
猛吹雪の雪山で、謎のモンス
ターが確認されました。
調査員が描いたスケッチを
武具工房の親方が見たところ、
信じられないという表情で
工房へ飛んで帰りました。
私たちは親方から情報を聞き
出しますので、ハンターの
皆さんは現地の調査をお願い
します。

54516.description: There is a report that 2 jet-black wyverns were seen in a part of the Ancient Tower where few tread. This is a survey request, but if the report is true, ordinary hunters cannot handle them. We recommend only hunters confident in their skill go.
54516.descriptionEn:
There was a report that two jet-black
Flying Wyverns were seen in a part
of the Ancient Tower where people
rarely set foot. This is a survey
request, but if the report is true,
ordinary Hunters cannot handle them.
I recommend that only Hunters
confident in their own skill
make the trip.
54516.descriptionJp:
古塔の余り人が立ち入らない
場所に、漆黒の飛竜を２頭
見たとの報告がありました。
これは、調査依頼となります
が、報告が本当であるならば、
普通のハンターでは手に負え
ません。腕に自信のある
ハンターの方のみで向かう
事をお勧めします。

50118.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
50118.description: What a splendid play that was! You can hear it, can you not? This unending roar and applause! You must live up to those expectations! You think so too, do you not? Come, let us move them again with a splendid play!
50118.descriptionEn:
That was a truly splendid play!
Can you hear it? This unending
cheering and applause!
You must live up to
those expectations! Don't you agree?
Now, let's deliver wonder
with another magnificent play!
50118.descriptionJp:
実にすばらしい演劇だった！
聴こえるだろ？この鳴りやま
ぬ歓声と拍手が！
君には、この期待に応える
必要がある！そう思うだろ？
さぁ、再び素晴らしい演劇で
感動を届けようじゃないか！

26703.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
26703.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! Hunt the packs of Daimyo Hermitaur and Congalala on the beaches and islands of the Jungle, and to finish, bring back a Carnivore Egg from the cave. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
26703.descriptionEn:
This time the training is for
hunters with little experience
only! Hunt packs of Shogun
Ceanataur and Congalala on the
beaches and islands of the Jungle,
and to finish, bring back a
carnivore egg from the cave.
It is harsh training, but if you
complete it your standing soars!
26703.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！密林の砂浜や島で盾蟹
と桃毛獣の群れを狩猟し、
仕上げに、洞窟より肉食竜の
卵を持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

56055.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Inagami through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Long Sword, Lance, Tonfa, Magnet Spike, Light Bowgun, or Heavy Bowgun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56055.descriptionEn:
From one Supremacy Inagami
weapon, the materials for
two stages of upgrades
and Gz worth of Sakura Porta Cards
can be obtained. The weapon types
you can forge are Dual Blades,
Long Sword, Lance, Tonfa,
Magnet Spike, Light Bowgun,
and Heavy Bowgun.
Use it on the weapon you favor.
56055.descriptionJp:
辿異種イナガミの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、太刀、槍、
穿龍棍、磁斬鎚、軽弩、
重弩のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

61232.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

11066.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
11066.description: The Shogun Ceanataur apparently uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling! In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too! Beware the sharp claws of each and every one!
11066.descriptionEn:
The sickle crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
uses its bizarre leg joints to
climb all the way to the
ceiling!
In this season's Volcano, many
young ≪Gamizami≫ should be about!
Watch out for their sharp claws!
11066.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登るらしいです！
この季節の火山では、子供た
ち≪ガミザミ≫も数多く生息
してるハズです！それぞれの
鋭い爪には要注意ですよ！

62695.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62695.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62695.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

11080.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト３匹の納品
11080.description: Find and deliver 6 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
11080.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 6 Special
Mushrooms that grow in the Jungle!
If you also deliver the ≪Royal Beetle≫,
the insect that sometimes flies
through the Jungle, I'll still pay!
Start by getting to know the Jungle,
then get used to it.
11080.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を６つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

50443.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

54551.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54551.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Gurenzeburu, the Barbarian Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54551.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Brute
Wyvern ≪Gurenzeburu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
54551.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、蛮竜
≪グレンゼブル≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21521.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21521.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21521.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21521.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

23218.description: From the direction of the unsurveyed part of the Canyon, the roar of a Rathian can now be heard, and voices of unease are growing. The cause is unknown, but this seems a very dangerous situation. Prepare thoroughly and head out to investigate.
23218.descriptionEn:
From the unsurveyed part of the
Canyon, a Rathian's roars can
now be heard, and voices of
unease are growing louder.
We do not know the cause,
but the situation seems
extremely dangerous.
Prepare fully before you go.
23218.descriptionJp:
峡谷の未調査地域の方角より
雌火竜の咆哮が聞こえてく
るようになり、不安の声が
大きくなっています。
原因が分かりませんが
非常に危険な状態だと思われ
ます。十分に準備を整えて
調査に向かってください。

55511.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55511.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55511.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

54236.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
54236.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54236.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54236.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

21080.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21080.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, often shows itself in the Jungle. It is quite a tough opponent, so rather than slaying it, capturing it with a Shock Trap is also an effective approach, you know?
21080.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, the Bullfango
leader ≪Bulldrome≫ often shows
itself.
It is a fairly tough foe, so
rather than slaying it, using a
≪Shock Trap≫ and capturing it
is also an effective option!
21080.descriptionJp:
密林にはブルファンゴの長
である≪ドスファンゴ≫が
姿を現すことが多いわよ。
かなりタフな相手だから、
討伐ではなく≪シビレ罠≫
などを使って捕獲してしま
うのも有効な手段よ？

56112.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
56112.description: Help me! Monsters have appeared at the festival grounds! Might be the explosive gas! If you need the barrel bombs we set up for the festival, use them! There are traps along the way, but it is safe between the white rocks and the black rocks, so make your way carefully!
56112.descriptionEn:
Help me! A monster showed up
at the festival grounds!
Might be the blast gas doing it!
If you need the barrel bombs
set up for the fest, use them!
I've rigged traps along the way,
but between the white rocks
and the black rocks is safe,
so head over carefully!
56112.descriptionJp:
助けてくれぇ！フェス会場に
モンスターが現れたんだぁ！
爆発性ガスの影響かもしれ
ねぇ！フェス用に設置した
タル爆弾が必要なら使って
くれぇ！道中に仕掛けを
施しているが、白い岩と
黒い岩の間なら安全だから
気をつけて向かってくれぇ！

55009.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55009.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55009.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55294.description: A Zinogre wrapped in light, standing at the top of the sea of trees. The Guild has decided to call it Zinogre that Roars to the Extreme. Brave hunter. When you drive it off, you shall surely be granted materials for Guild hidden armor.
55294.descriptionEn:
At the summit of the Great Forest
stands a Thunder Wolf Wyvern
wrapped in light.
The Guild has decided to call it
the ≪Acme Roaring Zinogre≫.
Brave hunter.
Once you drive it off, we will
surely grant you materials for
the Guild's treasured armor.
55294.descriptionJp:
樹海の頂部にたたずむ
光に包まれし雷狼竜。
ギルドでは、ヤツの呼称を
「極み吼えるジンオウガ」
とすることにした。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
ヤツを追い払った暁には、
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を
必ず授けよう。

40181.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40181.description: A very powerful Basarios that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
40181.descriptionEn:
An individual ≪Gravios≫ of
great strength that behaves
unlike the norm is in the New
Great Arena, and I want it hunted.
This request is open only to
hunters with Secret Art equipment
approved by the Guild.
Clear it splendidly and you will
earn still greater renown as a
master hunter.
40181.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪鎧竜≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

54476.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54476.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54476.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

54126.description: There has been a report of a white shadow sighted in the swamp of an unsurveyed region. Please head out to hunt it to secure safety. Khezu attacks without making any sound at all. It is difficult even to detect, so take great care not to be caught off guard.
54126.descriptionEn:
In the uncharted reaches of
the Swamp, a Khezu has been
reported. Head out and hunt
it to keep the area safe.
Khezu attacks without making
a single sound. Finding one is
hard enough, so take great
care not to be caught off
guard.
54126.descriptionJp:
未調査地域の沼地で、
白影の発見報告がありました。
安全確保のために、
狩猟へ向かって下さい。
フルフルは一切音を発さずに
襲い掛かってきます。
発見することも困難ですが、
不意を突かれないよう、
十分注意してください。

54890.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種１頭の討伐
54890.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54890.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54890.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54757.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54757.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
54757.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
54757.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

61530.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61530.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61530.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

54127.description: As you know, the Rathalos is a valiant flying wyvern also called the King of the Sky. I want to become a strong and brave man like that fire wyvern. So I mean to keep a Rathalos fang as a charm. Could I ask you for a little hunt?
54127.descriptionEn:
Rathalos, as you know, is a
valiant flying wyvern called
the King of the Skies.
I want to become a strong,
brave man like that fire
wyvern. So I will keep a
Rathalos fang as a charm.
Could you hunt one for me?
54127.descriptionJp:
リオレウスは知っての通り、
「空の王」とも呼ばれている
勇壮な飛竜だ。
僕もあの火竜のように、
強く勇ましい男になりたい。
そこで、リオレウスの牙を
お守りにしようと思うんだ。
ちょっと狩猟を頼めないかな。

55878.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Plesioth through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Great Sword, Long Sword, Hammer, Lance, or Gunlance. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55878.descriptionEn:
From one Supremacy Plesioth
weapon, the materials for
the first stage of upgrades
and Gz worth of Sakura Porta Cards
can be obtained. The weapon types
you can forge are Sword and Shield,
Great Sword, Long Sword, Hammer,
Lance, and Gunlance.
Please use it for your favored
weapon's forging and upgrading.
55878.descriptionJp:
辿異種ガノトトスの
辿異武器１つの生産から
１段階目の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、片手剣、大剣、
太刀、ハンマー、ランス、
ガンランスのいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

53163.description: Good morning everyone! I am good at waking early! Question 2: The name of the Felyne who raised the songstress is 'Tosshie the Hard Worker'. If you think the answer is false (B), take this quest!
53163.descriptionEn:
Morning, everyone!
I'm great at getting up early!
[Question 2]
The name of the Neko who
raised the songstress is
"Tosshi of the Gambling House".
(That is the claim.)
If you think the answer is × (B),
hunters should accept
this quest!
53163.descriptionJp:
みんなおはよう！
僕は早起きが得意だよ！
【第２問】
歌姫を育てたネコの
名前は
「かんばり屋のトッシー」
である。
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

21585.description: Have you heard of the Boar Crest Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21585.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb called
the Boar Crest Sphere?
Its material is indispensable
for crafting a certain
costly decoration.
If you can complete this request,
I will hand over precious
decoration materials.
21585.descriptionJp:
猪紋原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

26114.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61649.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
61649.description: I have a request, trusting in the sturdy bodies and spirits of you hunters. It is my firm belief that people begin to decline the moment they are satisfied. Hunger is what gives people vigor and makes them grow, I believe. Would you prove it for me?
61649.descriptionEn:
I have a request for you hunters,
whose tough bodies and wills
I have taken a liking to.
This is only my own theory, but
people begin to weaken the very
moment they grow satisfied.
I believe hunger is what gives
people vitality and growth.
Could you prove that for me?
61649.descriptionJp:
君たちハンターの強靭な体と
精神力を見込んで頼みがある。
これは私の持論なのだが、
人は、満ち足りてしまった
瞬間から衰えが始まるものだ。
餓えこそが、人に活力を与え、
人を成長させると信じている。
どうか、それを証明しては
もらえないだろうか？

61565.description: A Velocidrome has wandered into the arena where Felynes and Melynx await! And this time it is not a plain Velocidrome but a Variant! Clear the hunt for lavish beastman materials, and clear the sub target for even more rewards!
61565.descriptionEn:
A Velocidrome has wandered into
the Arena where Felyne and Melynx
lie in wait! And this time it's
not just any Velocidrome,
it's a Variant! Clear the hunt
for lavish beastman materials,
and clear the subquest for
even more rewards!
61565.descriptionJp:
アイルーとメラルーが待ち受
ける闘技場にドスランポスが
迷い込んだ！しかも今回は
ただのドスランポスではなく
変種だぞ！狩猟を達成すれば
豪華獣人素材、そしてサブも
達成すればさらに報酬が
贈られるぞ！

51039.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the crest of a Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
51039.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the Gypceros's
crest, special ingredients will
also be granted to you.
51039.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
毒怪鳥のトサカを破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

40191.description: This quest yields enough materials to produce at once any one weapon that can be made from the materials obtainable from the monsters of the Extreme Expedition quest, A Great Star Shining in the Clouds of Venom. A Special Hunting Ticket is required to accept it. Note that the Special Hunting Ticket is consumed if you fail.
40191.descriptionEn:
This quest grants materials to
forge, in one go, any weapon
craftable from parts of the
Extreme Conquest quest monster
"Great Star Swaying in Venomous
Crawling Clouds." A Special
Hunting Ticket is required
to accept it. Note that the
ticket is consumed on failure,
so please be careful.
40191.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは極征クエスト
「怨毒蠢く暗雲に晃る巨星」
のモンスターから獲得できる
素材で生産可能な武器いずれ
かを一発生産できる素材が獲
得できます。受注には特別狩
猟チケットが必要です。
失敗時は特別狩猟チケットは
消費されますのでご注意くだ
さい。

58097.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58097.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58097.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58097.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55017.description: Pokaradon and Pokara appeared during the survey of the extreme cold sea! At this rate the survey cannot be completed. To hunters who complete the request, we will give production materials for the weapon series Fierce Flame Welcomed and Struck, and G-rank Strength Jewel and G-rank Flash Jewel.
55017.descriptionEn:
Pokaradon and Pokara appeared
during the Polar Sea survey!
As things stand, the survey
cannot be completed.
Hunters who complete the request
will receive the forging materials
for the weapon series "Fierce
Flame Interceptor" plus G Rank
Hardcore and Flash Gems.
55017.descriptionJp:
極海の調査途中にポカラドン
とポカラが現れました！
このままでは調査が完了
できません。依頼を達成して
下さったハンターさんには、
武器「猛炎ヲ迎エ撃ツ」シ
リーズの生産素材や「Ｇ級・
剛薬珠」「Ｇ級・閃薬珠」を
お渡しします。

55056.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55056.description: This quest yields the following materials. Gunlance Merit (Beginning) x５０, Gunlance Merit (Middle) x６０, Gunlance Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55056.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪Gunlance Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Gunlance Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Gunlance Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR500 or higher, so please keep
that in mind.
55056.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ガンランス勲・序≫５０個
≪ガンランス勲・中≫６０個
≪ガンランス勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

26638.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

50431.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21443.objectiveJp: オオツノアゲハ９９匹の納品
21443.description: The thrill of robbing a monster of its freedom, that is worth anything. With my Concentrated Kubiki Extract you too can savour that thrill to the full. However, I only give it to those I recognise as one of my kind. The condition is that you can find pleasure in repeated small bindings.
21443.descriptionEn:
The thrill of robbing a monster
of its freedom is beyond
compare. With my Concentrated
Kubiki Extract, you too can
savor it fully. But I give it
only to those I deem my kind.
You must find joy in repeated
small bindings. That is the
condition.
21443.descriptionJp:
モンスターの自由を奪う快感、
それは何物にも代えがたいわ。
私の≪濃縮クビキエキス≫を
使えば、あなたもその快感を
存分に味わうことができるの。
ただし、私が同類と認めた人
にしか渡さないのよ。小さな
束縛の繰り返しに楽しみを
見出せること。それが条件。

22029.description: Congratulations on reaching HR7! On your own, please deliver the Map, clear the quest, and get your hands on the rewards!
22029.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching HR7!
On your own, please deliver
the ≪Map≫, clear the quest,
and get your hands on
the rewards!
22029.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ７達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

54610.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
54610.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54610.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54610.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

61839.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・３を１０個納品

62972.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62972.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
62972.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
62972.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

21922.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の撃退
21922.description: A request to repel a Supremacy species has arrived. If you complete it, you can obtain Supremacy materials. Repel it though you may, a Supremacy is still a Supremacy. Please take care never to let your guard down.
21922.descriptionEn:
A Zenith repel request has arrived.
Complete it splendidly and you
can obtain Zenith materials.
Even for a repel, a Zenith is
still a Zenith.
Please be absolutely sure
not to let your guard down.
21922.descriptionJp:
覇種撃退の依頼が届きました。
見事、依頼を達成すれば、
覇種の素材が入手できます。
撃退といっても、覇種は覇種
です。
絶対に油断しないように、
お気を付け下さい。

53066.description: This is Miyashita! A challenge from me (a quiz), answer check quest 2! Question 1: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 4A. Question 2: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 5B. Question 3: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 6A. You who hold the items above: correct! Congratulations! Take the items and depart on the quest! Receive your present!
53066.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here!
A challenge from me (a quiz)!
It's Answer-Matching Quest 2!
Q1: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 4A
Q2: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 5B
Q3: Miyashita P Answer Ticket 6A
If you hold the items above,
you're right! Congratulations!
Take the items and set out
on the quest! Claim your gift!
53066.descriptionJp:
宮下です！
僕からの挑戦状（クイズ）
答え合せクエスト２です！
第１問 宮下Ｐ解答券４Ａ
第２問 宮下Ｐ解答券５Ｂ
第３問 宮下Ｐ解答券６Ａ
↑のアイテムを持っている君
正解です！おめでとう！
アイテムを持ってクエストへ
出発！プレゼントを貰おう！

53243.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

50580.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
50580.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! A Super Golden Experience request has appeared, a further boost to the rewards of the Golden Experience, which lets you build experience efficiently and obtain large amounts of zenny too. Do take the chance to try it!
50580.descriptionEn:
Emergency notice to all hunters!
The 'Super Golden Experience'
request is now available, with
even better rewards than the
'Golden Experience' that lets
you earn experience efficiently
and gain loads of zenny.
Please take this chance to try
it out!
50580.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
ことができ、大量のゼニーも
入手できる「黄金体験」の
報酬をさらに強化した
「超・黄金体験」の依頼が
発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

62088.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62088.description: I found rare materials in the swamp. I was gathering them frantically when a Gypceros came, and I thought I would brush it off, but it seemed no ordinary Gypceros, so I fled somehow. If you hunt it, I will give you the materials I gathered.
62088.descriptionEn:
Rare materials can be gathered
in the Swamp, you see. I was
lost in collecting them when
≪Gypceros≫ turned up, and I
thought I would just shoo it off,
but it was no ordinary Poison
Bird, it seemed, so I ran for it.
Hunt it for me and I will give
you the materials I gathered.
62088.descriptionJp:
沼地で珍しい素材が取れてね。
夢中になって集めていたら
≪ゲリョス≫がやってきて、
適当にあしらってやろうと
思ったんだが、どうもただの
毒怪鳥じゃないようで、何と
か逃げてきたんだ。狩猟して
きてくれたら取れた素材を
やってもいいぞ。

50852.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
50852.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50852.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special request
and rewards. When accepting or
joining, please be sure to have
your Festival Proof with you.
50852.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、祭典の証を
お持ちください。

60728.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60728.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60728.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60728.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

21081.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21081.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, is tough and a brute. You must not let your guard down. Especially in this cold season, I think it is on edge from hunger. It is fine to play it safe and catch a Goldenfish instead, you know?
21081.descriptionEn:
The ≪Bulldrome≫, leader of the
Bullfango, is tough and wild.
You must not let your guard down.
In this cold season especially,
I bet he is hungry and on edge.
If it is too much, you could just
fish up a ≪Goldenfish≫ instead?
21081.descriptionJp:
ブルファンゴの長である
≪ドスファンゴ≫はタフで
暴れ者。油断したらダメ。
特に今の寒冷期は、空腹で
気が立ってると思うわ。
無理せず≪黄金魚≫を釣っ
て収めてもいいのよ？

60585.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Basarios. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60585.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where hunters
compete with their skill!
This time the target is ≪Basarios≫!
Achieve the goal together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork is what counts in this
contest, so try for a top place!
Also, this time it's Origin Species
weapons only!
Choose your weapon with care!
60585.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪バサルモス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

23199.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23199.description: I came to Tide Island for a holiday, and a Yian Kut-Ku turned up out of nowhere and wrecked all my food! The vacation is ruined. My girlfriend is arriving any minute now. Drive that thing off before she gets here.
23199.descriptionEn:
I came to Tidal Island on vacation,
but then a Yian Kut-Ku showed up
and wrecked all the food!
My whole vacation is ruined.
My girlfriend is coming here
any moment now.
Before that, chase that thing off
for me.
23199.descriptionJp:
潮島にバカンスへ来ていたん
だけど、突然イャンクックが
現れて、食べ物を荒らして
行ったんだ！せっかくの
バカンスが台無しだよ。
これから彼女がやって来る
事になっているんだ。その前
に、あいつを追い払ってくれ。

62430.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
62430.description: What, you just want hard Dual Blades? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62430.descriptionEn:
What, you want really hard Dual
Blades?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!
62430.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅い双剣が欲
しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

54345.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54345.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54345.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54345.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

26471.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26471.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. An enraged Blangonga demands caution! Until you're used to it, focus on dodging so you don't take a fatal wound.
26471.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Beware an angry
≪Blangonga≫! Until you're
used to it, focus on
dodging, not taking hits.
26471.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
怒ったドドブランゴには要注
意！慣れないうちは致命傷を
負わないように、避けること
に専念してくださいね。

21169.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21169.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21169.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

56146.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
56146.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56146.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
56146.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

21025.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21025.description: Iodrome hits harder in a single blow than Velocidrome or Gendrome! If you feel your life is in danger, deliver Specialty Mushrooms growing in the swamp! Aging them in a Maka Pickling Jar is OK too!
21025.descriptionEn:
≪Iodrome≫ hits harder per
blow than a Velocidrome or
Gendrome!
If you feel your life in
danger, deliver ≪Special
Mushrooms≫ from the swamp!
≪Maka Pot≫ aging? OK!
21025.descriptionJp:
≪ドスイーオス≫はドスラン
ポスや、ドスゲネポスに比べ
一発の攻撃力が高いです！
身の危険を感じたら、沼地に
生える≪特産キノコ≫を納品
して下さい！≪マカ漬けの壷≫
で熟成にしてもＯＫです！

51076.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Rajang will also grant a special ingredient.
51076.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Rajang's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51076.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
金獅子の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54931.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
54931.description: Doragyurosu has appeared at the top of the sea of trees! For the investigation, please hunt it and break its back! There is only a short window to accept, but if you complete it, this request makes it easy to obtain the Nether Thunder Dragon's Twilight Lead Ball!
54931.descriptionEn:
A Doragyurosu has appeared
at the Top of Great Forest!
For the survey, please hunt it
and break its back!
The window to accept this quest
is short, but if you complete it,
it's a request where the "Dark
Thunder Dragon's Twilight Lead Ball"
is easy to obtain!
54931.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部にドラギュロスが
現れました！
調査のため狩猟と背中破壊を
お願いします！
短い時間しか受注のチャンス
はありませんが、達成いただ
ければ「冥雷竜の黄昏鉛玉」
を入手しやすい依頼となって
います！

63314.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63314.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63314.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63314.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

21450.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. A hunter does more than slay monsters. Fishing is a fine hunt in its own right. Why not aim for the path of the angler, and even of the artisan? If you do, deliver 50 Spring Night Carp on your own!
21450.descriptionEn:
"Fishing"
It is a solitary hunt, in which
you quietly face the fish.
A hunter does not only slay
monsters. Fishing is a fine
hunt in its own right.
Why not aim for the path of the
angler, and even a master?
If you do, deliver 50 Springnight
Carp all on your own!
21450.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
ハンターはモンスターを狩る
だけじゃない。釣りだって立
派な狩猟だ。
釣師への道、しかも職人を
目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人で春夜
鯉５０匹の納品だ！

62786.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
62786.description: An urgent message has arrived from the survey team on Tide Island. They report that an exceptionally powerful Taikun Zamuza has appeared and is raging in the caves. We fear for the team's safety. Head for Tide Island at once and hunt the Taikun Zamuza.
62786.descriptionEn:
An urgent message has come in
from the survey team on Tidal
Island. According to the report,
an extremely powerful Taikun
Zamuza has appeared and is
rampaging in the caves. We fear
for the team's safety. Please
head to Tidal Island at once and
hunt the Taikun Zamuza.
62786.descriptionJp:
潮島にいる調査団から緊急の
連絡が入りました。
報告によると、多殻蟹の極め
て強力な個体が現れ洞窟で
暴れているとのことです。
調査団の安全が心配されます。
直ちに潮島に向かい、
多殻蟹の狩猟をお願いします。

55760.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の討伐
55760.description: Thanks to the Firestone you carried, the prototype's firepower went up! Only, it could not withstand the recoil, and after a few shots the barrel cracked. Like this it is too dangerous to use! I want to reinforce it with materials from the Blast Hammer Wyvern, which withstands impact and great heat. I am counting on you to hunt the Blast Hammer Wyvern!
55760.descriptionEn:
The powder rock you hauled paid off!
firepower of my prototype went up!
But it couldn't stand the recoil,
and after a few shots, cracks
ran through the barrel.
This is too dangerous to fire!
I want it reinforced with ≪Uragaan≫
parts, tough against shock and heat.
So go slay that ≪Uragaan≫ for me!
55760.descriptionJp:
運んでくれた火薬岩のお蔭で、
試作品から火力が上がったぜ！
ただ発射の衝撃にたえきれず
何発か撃ったら砲身にヒビが
入っちまってな。
これじゃ、危なくて使えねえ！
衝撃と高熱に強い≪爆鎚竜≫
の素材で補強したい。
≪爆鎚竜≫の討伐頼んだぜ！

22137.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22137.description: Hunter who would master the heavy bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
22137.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in the Arena!
If you can hunt it with style,
you will earn an even greater
reward than your daily efforts
would bring you.
22137.descriptionJp:
重弩を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

51110.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
51110.description: It is I! The Instructor! The newly discovered Bogabadorumu seems to unleash attacks that make full use of explosions! So! I have prepared a quest where you can get used to explosions before facing Bogabadorumu! Gahaha! Do your best!
51110.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
The newly discovered
'Bogabadorumu' reportedly
unleashes attacks built on
explosions! So I have prepared
a quest that lets you get used
to explosions before you face
it! Gahaha! Do your best!
51110.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
今回新発見された「ボガバド
ルム」は爆発を駆使した攻撃
を繰り出してくるらしい！ 
そこでだ！「ボガバドルム」
に挑む前にあらかじめ爆発に
慣れておけるようなクエスト
を用意した！
ガハハ！頑張ってくれ！

54612.description: In praise of the achievements you all left in the Extreme Conquest Battle, we present rewards. Yellow Weapon Jewel x1, Crimson Weapon Jewel x2, Azure Weapon Jewel x2, Jade Weapon Jewel x3, Guild Special Commission x10.
54612.descriptionEn:
In honor of the deeds you all
left in the Extreme Conquest War,
I present these rewards.
- 1 Yellow Warrior Orb
- 2 Crimson Warrior Orbs
- 2 Azure Warrior Orbs
- 3 Emerald Warrior Orbs
- 10 Guild Special Commendations
54612.descriptionJp:
極限征伐戦で皆さんが残した
功績を称え、報酬をお渡しい
たします。
・黄武玉１個
・紅武玉２個
・蒼武玉２個
・碧武玉３個
・ギルド特別委任状１０枚
