61749.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61749.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61749.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54258.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
54258.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.
54258.descriptionJp:
生物が存在できない場所だと
言われていた『最果ての地』
に、龍がいたと大型探査船
から報告がありました。
僅かに残る資料から、
『熾凍龍』と呼ばれる古龍で
あると推測されますが、詳細
は全くの不明です。現地へ
向かい、調査をお願いします。

21415.description: Oh, you've come. Hunting monsters is fine, but mining is fun too! So, how about testing your mining skill? I want you to gather the ore I'm about to request. The reward will be generous!
21415.descriptionEn:
Hey, glad you came.
Hunting monsters is fine, but
mining is a joy too!
So, how about a test of your
mining skill?
I want you to gather the ore I
am about to ask for.
The pay will be generous!
21415.descriptionJp:
おう、よく来たな。
モンスターを狩るのもいいが、
採掘も楽しいよな！
そこで、採掘の腕試しをして
みないか？
これから依頼する鉱石を集め
てほしい。
報酬は弾むぜ！

53241.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
53241.description: Lately that rumor about the red armor has been going around again. According to the rumor, one's form is taken over, or so it goes. A dangerous tale. You are the one who investigates this every time. I think you will be fine, but go carefully.
53241.descriptionEn:
Lately those rumors about the red
armor have been going around again.
Word is it "takes over your body"
or something like that. Scary stuff.
You're the one who keeps looking
into this every time. I think you'll
be fine, but go carefully.
53241.descriptionJp:
最近またあの赤い防具の噂が
聞こえてきてな。噂によると
「姿を乗っ取られる」とか
なんとか。物騒な話だな。
毎度コイツの調査をしている
アンタのことだ。大丈夫だと
は思うが、気を付けて行けよ。

61822.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
61822.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61822.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61822.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

21902.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt a Plesioth Variant and a Gypceros Variant in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you can obtain a comparatively large number of Supremacy Tickets, so do take it on and see it done.
21902.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's hunting life,
we've prepared a request at the
New Great Arena to hunt a Variant
Plesioth and a Variant Gypceros.
Complete this request and you'll
get a comparatively large number
of Hardcore Tickets, so please
accept it and finish the request.
21902.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、新大闘技場でガノト
トス変種とゲリョス変種を狩
猟する依頼を用意しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、比較
的多く「剛種チケット」が
得られますので、ぜひ受注し
て依頼を達成しましょう。

60427.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
60427.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60427.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60427.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

53119.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
53119.description: For those aiming at HR100, we've prepared a quest to upgrade the "Rukeze Series" into the "Rukeze F Series". It's ready for you. By hunting a Doragyurosu, you can obtain materials to upgrade one part to High Rank armor and raise its level. Please make good use of it.
53119.descriptionEn:
For those aiming at HR100,
we've prepared a quest to
upgrade the "Rukese Series"
into the "Rukese F Series".
It's ready for you.
By hunting a Doragyurosu,
you can obtain materials to
upgrade one part to High Rank
armor and raise its level.
Please make good use of it.
53119.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００を目指す方々へ
「ルケーゼシリーズ」を
「ルケーゼＦシリーズ」へ強
化するためのクエストを準備
しました。
ドラギュロスを狩猟すること
で、１部位分を上位防具へ
強化しレベルアップできる
素材が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください。

50588.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
50588.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
50588.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

54263.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54263.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54263.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54263.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

21853.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Artela series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21853.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the forging and
upgrade materials for all five
parts of the ≪Hardcore Armor≫
Artera Series.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
consumed, so please beware.
21853.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
アルテラシリーズの５部位分
の生産、強化素材が入手でき
ます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61019.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
61019.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61019.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61019.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50717.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
50717.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Doragyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
50717.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Doragyurosu's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50717.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
冥雷竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

61055.description: The King of the Sky, Rathalos, and the Queen of the Land, Rathian, who have reigned over the frontier since ages past. Charge in with resolve unto death! Do not forget that only one pitfall trap or shock trap may be set!
61055.descriptionEn:
Since ages past, the king of the
skies ≪Rathalos≫ and the queen
of the land ≪Rathian≫ have ruled
these frontier lands. Go forth
resolved to face death! And do
not forget that you may set only
one pitfall trap or shock trap!
61055.descriptionJp:
辺境に遥か昔より君臨せし、
空の王者≪リオレウス≫と
陸の女王≪リオレイア≫。
決死の覚悟にて挑むがよい！
落とし穴やシビレ罠が設置で
きるのは１つまでということ
を忘れるでないぞ！

26394.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26394.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
26394.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

61318.description: Monsters are breeding in great numbers in the volcano! We have asked hunters across the land for help, but the truth is there are simply too many. So we are looking for hunters willing to take this hunt in pairs at most. Those aiming to rank up quickly are especially encouraged.
61318.descriptionEn:
In the Volcano, monsters are
breeding in great numbers!
We have asked hunters from
every region for help, but the
truth is there are too many.
So we want volunteers who can
set out on this hunt with up to
two people. I especially
recommend it to fast climbers!
61318.descriptionJp:
火山で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

105.description: The purpose of this exercise is to hunt the queen of the Jungle, Rathian! Complete the sub-target and claim the supplies, or make your own hunting items! It is all up to you! I wish you good fortune!
105.descriptionEn:
The goal of this exercise is
hunting the Jungle Queen Rathian!
Clear the subquest for supplies,
or craft your own hunting items!
It's all up to you!
I wish you good hunting!
105.descriptionJp:
密林の女王リオレイアの狩猟が
この演習の目的だ！サブを達成
して支給品を獲得するもよし、
自力で狩猟用のアイテムを作り
出すもよし！全ては貴様次第！
健闘を祈っているぞ！

56029.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Hyujikiki. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56029.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Hyujikiki for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.
56029.descriptionJp:
辿異種の針纏竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

53290.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
53290.description: Please. I want you to procure Blangonga materials. I don't need them right now, but I have a promise I must head out for soon, and the preparations keep me too busy to step away. So I want you to procure them in my place. Please.
53290.descriptionEn:
Please, I need you to procure
Blangonga materials for me.
I don't need them right now,
but I have a promise I must
keep right after this, and the
preparations have me too busy
to step away. So please procure
them in my place.
I'm counting on you.
53290.descriptionJp:
お願いだ。ドドブランゴの
素材を調達してほしい。
今すぐ必要なわけじゃないの
だが、この後すぐに向かわな
きゃいけない約束があって、
その準備で今は忙しくて手が
離せない。だから代わりに調
達しておいてほしいんだ。
よろしく頼むよ。

55383.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
55383.description: The nostalgic Variety Soul quest is back again! This time the subject is Forokururu. Clear it quickly and earn plenty of souls! Rare materials also seem a little easier to obtain than usual.
55383.descriptionEn:
The nostalgic variety event,
Soul Injection, is back again!
This time the theme is slaying
a Toa Tesukatora.
Clear it briskly and earn
loads of souls! Rare materials
seem a bit easier to get too.
55383.descriptionJp:
皆さん懐かしのバラエティー
入魂が再び登場ですよ！今回
のお題は華鳳鳥の討伐です。
さくっと達成して、沢山の魂
を獲得しましょう！希少な素
材もいつもよりちょっぴり入
手しやすいようですよ。

62996.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
62996.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62996.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62996.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

62912.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62912.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62912.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

55408.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55408.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55408.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく討究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

54489.description: A Monoblos has appeared in the unexplored desert. It seems a lone investigator happened to encounter it while surveying, and there had been no sighting reports until now. There seems to be no danger as long as the survey is done by several people, but to be safe, please hunt the target.
54489.descriptionEn:
A ≪Monoblos≫ has appeared in
the unexplored Desert.
It seems a surveyor happened
to run into it while working
alone, and there had been no
sightings until now.
Surveying in a group is said to
be safe enough, but to be sure,
please hunt the target.
54489.descriptionJp:
未開の砂漠に≪モノブロス≫
が出現しました。
たまたま調査員が一人で調査
しているところに遭遇したら
しく、これまで目撃報告が無
かったようです。
複数人で調査を行う分には危
険は無いようですが、念のた
め対象の狩猟をお願いします。

54767.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54767.description: A surveyor who went to White Lake reported sighting a White Monoblos, a beast with a single great horn and a silver-white body. Alongside that shining form, a ferocious nature was reported as well. Prepare fully before you investigate.
54767.descriptionEn:
A surveyor who went to White
Lake reports sighting a ≪White
Monoblos≫, a beast with a huge
single horn and a silver body.
Together with that shining hide,
its savage nature has also been
reported. Please prepare well
before you set out to survey it.
54767.descriptionJp:
白湖へ向かった調査員より巨
大な一本角と白銀の体を持つ
≪白一角竜≫の目撃情報があ
りました。輝く体とは裏腹に
獰猛な生態も同時に報告され
ています。
十分な準備の上、調査をお願
いします。

23550.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
23550.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23550.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23550.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

26160.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26160.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26160.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

22146.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
22146.description: Thank you so very much for playing MHF for eleven years! We are truly grateful! Equip Elzegwen and deliver 1 Yearly Bonus Ticket, and we'll give you 11 Proofs of Gratitude XI! From Proof of Gratitude XI, Zamzarista (Switch Axe) can be forged.
22146.descriptionEn:
Thank you so very much for
playing MHF for eleven years!
We are truly grateful!
Equip ≪Elzegwen≫ and deliver
1 ≪Yearly Bonus Ticket≫,
and we'll give you 11 ≪Proofs
of Gratitude XI≫!
From ≪Proof of Gratitude XI≫,
≪Zamzarista≫ (Switch Axe)
can be forged.
22146.descriptionJp:
１１年間ＭＨＦを遊んで
いただき誠にありがとう
ございます！
≪エルゼグウェン≫を装備し、
≪年間特典生産券≫１枚を
納品すると、≪感謝の証XI≫
を１１枚プレゼント！
≪感謝の証XI≫から
≪ザムザリスタ≫（剣斧）
が生産できます。

22116.description: A request for hunters who have crafted Zerureusu Gou weapons. By repeatedly slaying Zerureusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Tenran weapons.
22116.descriptionEn:
For hunters who have forged
the ≪Peerless Weapon≫ of
the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Zerureusu, you can obtain
materials to upgrade the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ weapon.
22116.descriptionJp:
≪輝界竜≫の≪剛種武器≫を
生産したハンター向けの依頼
です。
ゼルレウスを繰り返し討伐す
ることで、≪天嵐武器≫の
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

26313.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26313.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26313.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26313.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26653.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26653.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
26653.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

56006.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Pokaradon, the Frozen Sea Beast, we will also grant a special item.
56006.descriptionEn:
Regarding the newly begun UL
Guild Priority Requests, we have
prepared this quest to raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the head of the
Pokaradon, special items
will also be
granted to you.
56006.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、ＵＬ
ギルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
凍海獣の頭部を破壊すること
で特別なアイテムも
付与させていただきます。

50841.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for hunters to slay Yamakurai right now. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50841.descriptionEn:
Emergency request.
We are urgently seeking hunters
to slay the ≪Yamakurai≫.
Should you succeed in the kill,
we will issue more slay proofs
than usual!
We await your application!
50841.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。
今すぐ、≪ヤマクライ≫を
討伐してくださるハンター
を募集しております。
見事に討伐できましたら、
普段よりも多めに討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

50971.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50971.description: A request for hunters who possess Odibatorasu Tenran armor. Drive off Odibatorasu and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
50971.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
By repelling Odibatorasu,
you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
"Odiba FX Series"
≪Supremacy≫ armor to Lv7.
50971.descriptionJp:
≪弩岩竜≫の≪天嵐防具≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
オディバトラスを撃退するこ
とで「オディバFXシリーズ」
≪覇種防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

62869.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62869.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62869.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62869.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

1057.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
1057.description: A red shadow crawling across the snowfield, you say!? That must certainly be a Khezu subspecies! But in the Snowy Mountains this season, the Blango gather in herds seeking food! The Khezu and the Blango are trouble if you face them at the same time!
1057.descriptionEn:
A red shadow crawling the snow!?
That must be a Khezu subspecies!
But this season, the Snowy Mountains
are swarming with Blango
searching for food!
Khezu and the Blango together
are a nasty pair to face!
1057.descriptionJp:
雪原を這う赤影だって！？
それは≪フルフル≫の亜種に
間違いないハズだ！だが、今
の季節の雪山はブランゴたち
がエサを求めて群生してる！
フルフルとブランゴたちは、
同時に相手すると厄介だぜ！

54203.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
54203.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54203.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54203.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

61244.description: First, it is the custom of the Hunting Friends Festival for men and women each to overcome a trial befitting them. This one is for female hunters, so male hunters should take the other quest.
61244.descriptionEn:
First, men and women each
must pass their own trial;
that is the Hunters' Festival way.
This one is for female hunters,
so male hunters should take
the other quest.
61244.descriptionJp:
まずは、男女それぞれで
それなりの試練を突破するのが
猟友祭の習わしだ。
こっちは女性ハンター用だから
男性ハンターはもう１つの
クエストを受けておくれ。

55756.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55756.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55756.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

55940.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55940.description: The gears needed to complete the armor seem to have scattered in a certain place in the desert. However, a ferocious Tigrex prowls the area, and one cannot approach carelessly. Would you lend your strength to recover the gears? The reward is the crafting materials for armor my old man designed!
55940.descriptionEn:
The gears needed to finish the
armor seem to have scattered
somewhere in the Desert.
But a vicious Tigrex prowls
the area, so we can't get close.
Please lend your strength to
recover the gears.
The reward is materials for armor
designed by my old man!
55940.descriptionJp:
防具の完成に必要な歯車は、
砂漠のとある場所で散らばっ
てしまったようだ。しかし、
周辺を凶暴なティガレックス
がうろついていて、迂闊に近
寄れない状況だ。歯車を回収
するためにどうか力を貸して
はくれないか。報酬は親父が
設計した防具の生産素材だ！

56061.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Gravios through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Long Sword, Lance, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56061.descriptionEn:
From one Supremacy Gravios
weapon, the materials for
two stages of upgrades
and Gz worth of Sakura Porta Cards
can be obtained. The weapon types
you can forge are Sword and Shield,
Dual Blades, Long Sword, Lance,
Gunlance, and Switch Axe.
Please use it for your favored
weapon's forging and upgrading.
56061.descriptionJp:
辿異種グラビモスの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、片手剣、双剣、
太刀、槍、銃槍、剣斧の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

61769.description: Hm, you have grown a great deal since I last saw you. You are now qualified to attempt my clan's trial! Namely, the secret of bombs! If your supply items run out, smash the exploding rocks and I will add more bombs. Off you go with confidence!
61769.descriptionEn:
Hmph, I haven't seen you in a while
and you've grown a lot, meow.
You're now qualified to face
our clan's trial, meow!
Namely, the secret of bombs, meow!
If the supplies run short, smash
the exploding rocks and I'll add
more bombs for you, meow.
Go on with confidence, meow!
61769.descriptionJp:
ふむ、しばらく見ないうちに
ずいぶん成長したものニャ。
今のキミには、わが一族の
試練に挑む資格があるニャ！
すなわち、爆弾の極意ニャ！
もし、支給品が足りなくても、
爆発する岩を砕いてくれたら、
爆弾を追加してやれるニャ。
安心して行ってくるニャー！

21761.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

54137.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
54137.description: Do you have enough Ｇｚ? In this request, introduced today, you can earn a hefty reward just by doing the same hunting as always. However, note that it cannot be taken consecutively.
54137.descriptionEn:
Are you short on ≪Gz≫?
With today's request, you
only do the same hunting as
always and earn a hefty
reward for it.
However, it cannot be
accepted in succession, so
please keep that in mind.
54137.descriptionJp:
≪Ｇｚ≫は足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
いつもと同じ狩猟をこなして
いただくだけで、高額な報酬
が獲得できます。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

26043.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26043.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26043.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

23335.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Midogaron, the Blast Wolf. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23335.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Midogaron materials.
To accept it, a Superior Ticket
is required. Note that if the
quest is failed, the Superior
Ticket will be consumed.
23335.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、爆狼
≪ミドガロン≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54882.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
54882.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54882.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54882.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

63197.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 10 Wyvern Shatterclaws and I will give you 14 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63197.descriptionEn:
Shh, keep it quiet, meow! This
is a secret trading post, meow.
Give me 10 ≪Flying Wyvern Claws≫
and I'll hand over 14
≪Master Neko's Favorite Food≫.
Slip them to Master Neko quietly
and he'll forge you a ≪Hardcore
Felyne Weapon≫ with no materials!
Aim for that dream jackpot
and do your best, meow!
63197.descriptionJp:
シッ、静かにするニャ！ここ
は秘密の取引所ニャ。≪飛竜
の砕爪≫を１０個くれたら、
≪親方ネコの大好物≫を
１４個あげるニャ。
こっそり親方ネコに渡せば、
素材なしで≪剛猫武器≫を
作ってくれる優れ物ニャ！
夢の大当たりを狙って
頑張るニャ！

50682.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Gakou FX (Elegance) and Gasen FX (Elegance) series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50682.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one part of the
≪Zenith Armor≫ Gakou FX [Grace]
/ Gasen FX [Grace] Series.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ is consumed,
so please be careful.
50682.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
雅孔FX【趣】／雅穿FX【趣】
シリーズの１部位分の強化
素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55626.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55626.description: Nyahaha! An executive of the Dark Cat Pack slaps a quest right at you, meow! The pride of those mocked as the weakest is terrifying, meow. If you complete it, in praise of your courage I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Seal, Blue, meow!
55626.descriptionEn:
Nyahaha! A quest straight from
a Dark Neko Gang executive,
handed right to you, meow!
The pride of those mocked as
the weakest is fearsome, meow.
If you complete the request,
in praise of your courage,
I might just give you a
≪Dark Neko Gang Seal - Blue≫!
55626.descriptionJp:
ニャハハ！闇猫団幹部から
直々にクエストを叩きつけて
やるニャ！最弱と散々こけに
された者達の意地はとっても
恐ろしいものニャ。もし、
依頼を達成できたら、
勇気をたたえ
≪闇猫団シール・青≫
をくれてやってもいいニャ！

55720.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55720.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55720.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

21957.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of armor materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rajang and a Tigrex. I am counting on you!
21957.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a request for you -
how about a full set of armor
materials as payment?
It's easy work! Just make
one quick run and slay a
Rajang and a Tigrex for me.
I'm counting on you!
21957.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は防具の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってラージャンとティ
ガレックスを討伐してくれれ
ばいい。頼んだぜ！

23615.description: The Variant Species Midogaron has appeared once more. Its legs have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23615.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ has
appeared once more.
Its legs have grown stronger,
and it seems to have gained
even more power. Please take
great care in your survey.
23615.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ミドガロン≫が再び
現れました。
脚はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

22101.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22101.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22101.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

50053.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
50053.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Blangonga in the Snowy Mountains. Clear this quest well and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply! As a bonus, I will add ingredients I prepared myself!
50053.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show off their skill!
Hunt the Snowy Mountains'
≪Blangonga≫ for me.
Clear the quest splendidly,
and your standing as hunters
will shoot right up!
As a bonus this time, I'll throw
in ingredients I prepared myself!
50053.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
雪山の≪雪獅子≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
見事クエストクリアできたら
諸君のハンターとしての
評価はグイっと上がるぞ！
今回は、オマケとして吾輩が
用意した食材も付けよう！

61102.description: You must not rely only on guarding. Dodge by a hair's breadth. That is what my master always told me. Now I understand his words. I want to pass the same words to you. Dodge!
61102.descriptionEn:
You cannot rely on guarding
alone. Read it at the last moment
and dodge. My master told me
that constantly. Only now do I
understand his words. I want to
pass the same words to you.
Dodge!
61102.descriptionJp:
ガードにばかり頼っていては
駄目だ。ギリギリで見切って
避けろ。と私は師匠から常々
言われてきた。今になって師
匠の言葉が理解出来た。私も
君達に同じ言葉を伝えたい。
避けろ！

62219.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62219.description: The one named Rukodiora, the Extreme Dragon, is closing on the Interception Base. We have readied ample supplies, interception weapons and carving artisans, so please slay it!
62219.descriptionEn:
The one named ≪Rukodiora≫,
the ≪Extreme Dragon≫, is
closing on the
≪Interception Base≫.
We've readied ample supplies,
anti-air weapons and even
carving artisans, so please
slay it!
62219.descriptionJp:
≪ルコディオラ≫≪極龍≫と
名付けられたそれが、
≪迎撃拠点≫に迫っています。
十分な支給品、迎撃兵器、
そして剥ぎ取り職人と、万全
の態勢を整えさせていただき
ましたので、討伐をお願い
します！

21003.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21003.description: Hunt the 1 blue hunter, Velocidrome, that uses the Jungle as its feeding ground! It is just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt! In this season there are fewer Velociprey minions, so it is a good opportunity!
21003.descriptionEn:
Hunt 1 of the blue hunters,
≪Velocidrome≫, that feed in
the Jungle!
He is just the right foe to
test your skill as a hunter!
This season his Velociprey
lackeys are scarce, so go now!
21003.descriptionJp:
密林をエサ場とする、青き
狩人≪ドスランポス≫１頭
を狩猟してください！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手です！
この季節なら子分のランポス
も少ないので、好機ですよ！

23495.objectiveJp: ウラガンキン１頭の狩猟
23495.description: Uragaan has been found in the volcano! This is the first sighting in the region. Reports also speak of unusual movement. Skilled hunters, we ask for an ecological survey of the target.
23495.descriptionEn:
The Burst Hammer Wyvern,
Uragaan, has been found in the
Volcano! This is the first such
discovery in this region.
Reports also say it moves in
peculiar ways.
Skilled hunters, please carry
out an ecological survey of it.
23495.descriptionJp:
爆鎚竜・ウラガンキンが
火山にて発見されました！
この地域では初の発見です。
特殊な動きをするとの報告も
あがってきています。
腕利きのハンターの皆様、対
象の生態調査をお願いします。

54326.description: We continue the investigation of the Baruragaru that appeared in the swamp. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54326.descriptionEn:
We will continue the survey
of the Baruragaru in the Swamp.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but if you do,
it would make me very happy!
Hunters all, thank you
for your cooperation!
54326.descriptionJp:
沼地に現れたバルラガルの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

23421.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Yama Kurai, the Floating Peak Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23421.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Floating Peak
Dragon ≪Yama Kurai≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.
23421.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、浮峰龍
≪ヤマクライ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21509.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての討伐
21509.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21509.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21509.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

61754.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
61754.description: Oh, it is me! This time use my special supply items and capture a Basarios Variant. Do not overdo it and slay it; your weapon is limited to Sword and Shield. I will give you body fluid I got the other day as a reward, so chop chop bang bang crackle pop!
61754.descriptionEn:
Yo, it's me! This time, use my
special supplies and capture
a Variant Basarios for me.
So you don't overdo it and slay it,
only Sword and Shield are allowed.
For pay, I'll hand over body fluid
I got the other day, so go
slash-slash, boom-boom, zap-zap!
61754.descriptionJp:
オウ、俺だよ！今回は俺特製
の支給品で、岩竜の変種を
捕獲してきてくれ。やりすぎ
て討伐しないよう、武器は
片手剣限定だぜ。報酬にこの
間手に入れた体液を出すんで、
ザクザクドカンドカンビリ
ビリポフッポフッと頼むぜ！

21625.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
21625.description: Do you know of the sphere called the Turtledove Sphere? Its material is essential to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request and I shall give you rare decoration material.
21625.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb called
the Mountain Dove Sphere?
Its material is indispensable
for crafting a certain
costly decoration.
If you can complete this request,
I will hand over precious
decoration materials.
21625.descriptionJp:
山鳩原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

50103.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
50103.description: This is a rush job. I want you to hunt the requested number of Gendrome and Genprey. Sorry to rush you, but for your sake I will carve at least three Paralysis Sacs. I will show you the secrets of a master carver.
50103.descriptionEn:
This is a bit of a rush job.
I want you to hunt the number
of ≪Iodrome≫ and ≪Ioprey≫
we asked for.
Sorry to demand speed like this,
but for your trouble I will carve
at least 3 ≪Paralysis Sacs≫
for you myself.
I will show you the art of carving!
50103.descriptionJp:
ちょっち急ぎの仕事なんだ。
≪ドスゲネポス≫と
≪ゲネポス≫を依頼した数
狩ってきてほしい。
急げなんて勝手言って悪いが、
あんたらのために
≪麻痺袋≫を最低でも３個
剥ぎ取ってやるよ。
剥ぎ職の極意、見せてやるぜ。

62661.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Volcano, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Crater, the Voice of Nature: Heat Haze, or the Voice of Nature: Wasteland. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62661.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of nature.
By completing this request set
in the ≪Volcano≫,
you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Crater≫,
≪Voice of Nature: Heat Haze≫,
or ≪Voice of Nature: Wasteland≫.
We wish you an even richer
life of hunting.
62661.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪火山≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・火口≫や
≪大自然の声・陽炎≫、
≪大自然の声・荒野≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

50481.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50481.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50481.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50481.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

53024.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
53024.description: It seems I dropped my collection of Guku room blueprints while out walking. Sorry, would you go and find them? In return I will give you a few blueprints of my own design.
53024.descriptionEn:
It seems I dropped my collection
of Gook room blueprints while out
walking.
Sorry, but could you go and find
them for me?
As thanks I will give you several
blueprints I designed myself.
53024.descriptionJp:
これまでに作成したグーク
部屋の図面コレクション
を散歩中に落としてしまった
みたいだ。
すまないが、探してきてくれ
ないか？
お礼に私がデザインした図面
をいくつかプレゼントする
よ。

53283.description: Lately when I go to the highlands, the Melynx steal all sorts of things from me more often. Could you go and teach them a lesson? Ah, that's right. You need not do anything to Brook, who has done no wrong. Please report on how it goes this time too.
53283.descriptionEn:
Lately, whenever I go to the
Highlands, the Melynx steal all
sorts of things. Could you go
and teach them a lesson?
Oh, right. Don't do anything
to the Burukku, since they
haven't done anything wrong.
And report how it went this time
too, if you would.
53283.descriptionJp:
最近、高地に行くとメラルー
にいろいろと物を盗まれる
事が多くなってね。ちょっと
懲らしめて来てくれないか？
あ、そうそう。何も悪いこと
をしていないブルックには
何もしないで良いからね。
今回もこの様子をレポートに
して届けるよう、頼むよ。

23661.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
23661.description: The Variant Species Doragyurosu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
23661.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Doragyurosu
has grown ferociously strong
and keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous.
Prepare fully and survey.
23661.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドラギュロス≫
は猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続
けています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

28054.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28054.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!
28054.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を猟団の仲間と行う
のだ。支給品も一切用意
しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

26571.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26571.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26571.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26571.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

54792.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 1 Porta Card Sakura. Hunt a Pokara and you can obtain the materials needed to produce and upgrade 1 piece of Flogada G.
54792.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely quest you
can take in exchange for 1
Sakura Porta Card.
Hunt a Pokara and you'll get
the materials needed to forge
and upgrade one Frogada G part.
Isn't that a fine deal?
54792.descriptionJp:
ポルタカード桜１枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
ポカラを狩猟すると、
フロガダＧ一部位の
生産、強化に必要な素材が
入手できるわよ。

54478.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
54478.description: We continue the investigation of the Gypceros Subspecies. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54478.descriptionEn:
We will continue the survey
of the Purple Gypceros.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but if you do,
it would make me very happy!
Hunters all, thank you
for your cooperation!
54478.descriptionJp:
ゲリョス亜種の調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

63413.description: At the top of the sea of trees, a large number of notes recording the lost secret of arms manufacturing seem to have been found! If you get the notes, bring them to this workshop master! I will show you good work! Kuu! My blood boils after so long!
63413.descriptionEn:
At the Top of Great Forest, a huge
number of notes recording the lost
secrets of weapon and armor
crafting have been found!
If you get your hands on them,
bring them to this workshop head!
I'll show you some fine work!
Kuh! My blood's racing again!
63413.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部で、失われたと
されていた武具の製造秘伝を
記したメモが大量に発見され
たらしい！もしメモを手に
入れたら、この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！
くうう！久々に血が滾るぜい！

50853.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50853.description: For those who have reached HR100, we have prepared a quest to upgrade the "Karais F Series" into the "Karais FY Series". By hunting a Zenith Hypnocatrice, you can obtain materials to upgrade one part to Master Rank armor and raise its level.
50853.descriptionEn:
For those who have reached HR100,
we've prepared a quest to upgrade
the "Karais F Series" into
the "Karais FY Series".
By hunting a Hypnocatrice
Odd Species, you can obtain
materials to upgrade one part
to Master Rank armor and
raise its level.
50853.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００に到達した方々へ
「カライスＦシリーズ」を
「カライスＦＹシリーズ」へ
強化するためのクエストを
準備しました。
ヒプノック奇種を狩猟するこ
とで、１部位分を凄腕防具へ
強化しレベルアップでき
る素材が入手できます。

20013.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
20013.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau warns that a suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress! Make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon!
20013.descriptionEn:
The Elder Dragon Forecast Post
reports a suspicious dragon
approaching the Fortress! Use
the Fortress's intercept weapons
to repel the mysterious giant dragon!
20013.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より、怪しげな龍
が砦に接近しているとの知ら
せが入りました！砦の迎撃兵
器を活用し、謎の巨大龍を撃
退してください！

26039.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26039.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26039.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

1058.description: They say Khezu spends its larval stage underground. That must be why it has a better nose than eyes, eh? If hunting the parent is hard, trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
1058.descriptionEn:
≪Khezu≫ apparently spend
their larval stage in the
ground. That's why their
nose is sharper than their
eyes, I reckon?
If the parent is too much,
trade an underground ≪Khezu
Whelp≫ and deliver the result!
1058.descriptionJp:
≪フルフル≫ってモンスター
は幼生期を地面の中で過ごす
らしい。だから目よりも鼻が
利く生き物なんだろうな？
親の狩猟が困難なら地中にい
る≪フルフルベビー≫を山菜
ジジイと交換して、交換後の
アイテムを納品してくれよ！

62167.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62167.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62167.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

15009.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! First, hunt the desert monsters, beginning with the fish wyvern that lives in the underground lake!
15009.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam has
four parts in all! To reconfirm
your skill, you'll hunt every
monster I designate!
First, hunt the Desert monsters,
starting with the fish wyvern
that dwells in the underground
lake!
15009.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
４つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
まず初めは地底湖に生息する
魚竜を始めとする砂漠のモン
スターを狩るのじゃ！

50526.description: I came to this land chasing a shining wyvern, but I injured my knee and can no longer pursue it. So I want the hunters of this land to carry on my will. I will also give you the materials I gathered to slay it. First, show me your skill with a Great Sword.
50526.descriptionEn:
I came to this land chasing
a shining flying wyvern, but
I injured my knee, and now
even that is beyond me.
So I want the hunters of this
land to carry on my will.
I'll also give you the materials
I gathered to slay it.
First, show me the skill
of your great sword.
50526.descriptionJp:
私は光り輝く飛竜を追いこの
地へ来たのだが、膝に怪我を
負ってしまい、それもかなわ
なくなってしまった。
そこでこの地のハンターに私
の意志を継いでほしいのだ。
奴を討伐するために入手した
素材も譲ろう。
まずは、君の大剣の腕を見せ
てくれ。

50210.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の捕獲
50210.description: Have you heard from the workshop master about a special ore called the Kinos Secret Stone? If not, let me introduce this request. The Kinos Secret Stone is a special material needed to craft a certain armor. Gather enough and have the master craft it for you.
50210.descriptionEn:
Ever heard of the special
ore called ≪Kinos Gemstone≫
from the smithy master?
If not, then let me
recommend this job.
≪Kinos Gemstone≫ is a rare
material needed to forge
certain armor. Gather a few
and have the master craft it.
50210.descriptionJp:
≪キノス秘石≫という特殊な
鉱石を、武具工房の親方から
聞いたことがあるか？
知らないなら、この依頼を
紹介しよう。
≪キノス秘石≫は、ある防具
の生産に必要な特殊な素材だ。
数を集めて、親方に生産して
もらうといいだろう。

23736.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Merit (Beginning) x５０, Bow Merit (Middle) x６０, Bow Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23736.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪Bow Merit - Intro≫ x50
≪Bow Merit - Mid≫ x60
≪Bow Merit - Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest, you need
≪Secret Merit Crystal≫ and
GR500 or higher, so
please be aware of that.
23736.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪弓勲・序≫５０個
≪弓勲・中≫６０個
≪弓勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

54573.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54573.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54573.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

22105.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22105.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22105.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

54130.description: Hunter there. Do not be surprised by the high contract fee. This job exchanges your 30000Ｇｚ for thirty Porta Cards Purple. Perfect for growing your assets, would you not say?
54130.descriptionEn:
Hunter over there. Don't be shocked
by how high the contract fee is.
This is a request to trade
your 30,000 Gz for 30 Porta Cards.
I think it's perfect for growing
your assets.
What do you say?
54130.descriptionJp:
そこのハンターさん。契約金
の高さに驚いてはダメよ。
これは、あなたの３万Ｇｚを
≪ポルタカード紫≫３０枚と
交換する依頼なの。
資産を増やすのに最適だと
思うけど、いかがかしら？

21219.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21219.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21219.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21219.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

61178.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
61178.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
61178.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
61178.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26138.description: It is I, the Instructor! The fish at the fishing points differ by place. It is good to remember where the fish you need can be caught. Also, the kinds of fish change with the season. The mystery of nature!
26138.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
The fish at ≪fishing points≫
differ by location. Make sure
to remember where the fish you
need bite.
The kinds of fish also change
with the season. Nature's mystery!
26138.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
≪釣りポイント≫にいる魚は
場所によって異なる。必要な
魚が釣れた所は、覚えておく
ようにするといいぞ。また、
季節によっても、魚の種類は
変わるのだ。大自然の神秘！

11007.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! The Kut-Ku is usually pink, but this one is said to be blue! A subspecies for certain!
11007.descriptionEn:
If you hear a birdlike cry in
this Jungle, it is surely the
Yian Kut-Ku! Normally it is
pink, but this time its body
is said to be blue! It must
be the subspecies!
11007.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫ね！
イャンクックといえば普通は
ピンクの体色なんだけど、今
回は体色が青いって話です！
亜種に間違いないですね！

26564.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
26564.description: A vicious Shogun Ceanataur is lying in wait at the delivery address for my goods and I am in trouble. At this rate the goods will never arrive. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
26564.descriptionEn:
A ferocious Shogun Ceanataur
is lying in wait at my delivery
address, and I'm stuck.
At this rate the goods won't
arrive. If you help me out,
I'll thank you with a Quest
Completion Certificate you can
trade for Pawprint Coins!
26564.descriptionJp:
商品の納品先に、凶暴な
ショウグンギザミが待ち構え
ていて困っているんだ。
このままじゃ商品が届けられ
ない。助けてくれたら
≪肉球のコイン≫と交換でき
る≪クエスト達成証≫を
お礼にあげるよ！

62455.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62455.description: What, you just want a hard Long Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62455.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Long Sword, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!
62455.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅い太刀が欲
しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

50937.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
50937.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! It has been a while! The marriage-seeking monster that hates June brides is on a rampage! At last it has started saying that your eyes met! Scary! Now, hunters! Protect the bright family plans of lovers!
50937.descriptionEn:
Guardian of lovers' love and peace,
the hero Sasatto! It's been a while!
A marriage-hunting monster that
hates June brides is on a rampage!
Now it's even saying "our eyes met,
so we're destined!" Terrifying!
Now, hunters all!
Protect the lovers' bright
family plans!
50937.descriptionJp:
恋人達の愛と平和を守る
怪傑ササットだ！久々だ！
ジューンブライドを憎悪する
婚活モンスターが大暴走だ！
とうとう「目が合ったから」
とか言い出したぞ！怖い！
さあ、ハンター諸君！
恋人達の明るい家族計画を
守るのだ！

21949.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の討伐
21949.description: You there! I hear you produced an Espinas weapon. So I have a request: how about materials to upgrade to an Espinas Subspecies weapon as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Espinas rare species. I am counting on you!
21949.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! I hear you
crafted an Espinas weapon.
So I've got a request. How
about materials to upgrade
it into an Espinas Rare
Species weapon as pay?
It's easy: just run over and
slay an Espinas Rare Species.
I'm counting on you!
21949.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
棘竜の武器を生産したんだっ
てな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は棘白竜の武器への強化素
材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってエスピナス希少種
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54867.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
54867.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54867.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54867.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55196.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55196.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55196.descriptionEn:
Drive it off, and the beast will
come dancing back once more.
So the Guild has decided to call
that shining one "Guanzorumu,
Ruler of the Acme."
In the end, we must slay it.
To any hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild armor, and a title!
55196.descriptionJp:
追い払えどもヤツは、
再び舞い戻ってくる。
ギルドでは、光放つヤツを
「極み統べるグァンゾルム」
と呼ぶことにした。
やはり討伐するしかないか。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

26294.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

60805.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60805.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60805.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62225.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62225.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62225.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.
62225.descriptionJp:
占いに使う石ころを集めてい
るのですが、モンスターに
襲われ、中々はかどりません。
そこでモンスター達を引きつ
けておいて欲しいんです。
たくさん集めることができた
ら報酬として差し上げますか
ら、どうかお願いします。

23679.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
23679.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Tigrex. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23679.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Tigrex≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
23679.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ティガレックス≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

10103.description: In this arena we put on a straight one-on-one between monster and hunter! Your opponent this time is that Rathian! The key is to slip under it while dodging its fire breath!
10103.descriptionEn:
In this Arena, monsters and
hunters will face off for real!
Your opponent this time is
that Rathian!
The key is dodging her fire breath
and slipping under her guard!
10103.descriptionJp:
この闘技場ではモンスター対
ハンターのガチンコ勝負を
やってもらうよ！
今回の相手は、あのリオレイア
だ！炎ブレスを避けながら
懐にもぐれるかがカギだね！

61062.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
61062.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament finals. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards in this quest.
61062.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament
finals.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from clear rewards
in this quest.
61062.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの決勝練習用
クエストです。
モンスターの剥ぎ取りと
クリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

50295.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
50295.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
50295.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!
50295.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君！
武具を手に入れただけで
満足しているのでは？
それではイカンのです！
このクエストを達成して、
更なる武具の強化を成し遂げ
ましょう！

51031.description: A request for hunters who reached HR5, letting you craft and upgrade the recommended Stroma Series Hardcore Armor. Hunt Baruragaru to obtain materials for one piece of the Stroma Series.
51031.descriptionEn:
A request for hunters who
reached HR5, letting you
craft and upgrade the
recommended Stroma Series
≪Hardcore Armor≫. Hunt
Baruragaru to obtain
materials for one piece of
the Stroma Series.
51031.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ５になったハンター
にオススメの
「ストロマシリーズ」
≪剛種防具≫が生産・強化で
きる依頼です。
バルラガルを狩猟すると、
「ストロマシリーズ」１部位
分の生産・強化素材が入手で
きます。

26048.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26048.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26048.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26048.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

26494.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Bone! Please deliver your certificates when you accept or join, and hunt the specified monster. Note that certificates cannot be returned after departure.
26494.descriptionEn:
The Guild Association pays
rewards to hunters who capture
many variants and rare species.
The main reward is Wyvern Heavy
Bones!
When accepting and joining,
please deliver the guarantee
ticket, and hunt the specified
monster.
Note that the guarantee ticket
cannot be returned after
departure.
26494.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の重骨！
受注、参加時に保証書の納品、
そして、指定モンスターの
狩猟をお願いします。
出発後の保証書の返却はでき
ないため、ご注意ください。

50630.description: In this trial you will use the hunting horn to slay Cephalos! I will teach you a few useful melodies beforehand! Against the heat, Water, Green, Water. To restore health, Green, White, Water. To restore sharpness, Water, Green, Green. And when Cephalos comes close, startle it with a Sonic Blast performance and attack!
50630.descriptionEn:
For this trial, you'll put the
Hunting Horn to work and slay
a Cephalos! I'll teach you a few
useful melodies beforehand!
Heat: "Water, Green, Water"
Health: "Green, White, Water"
Sharpness: "Water, Green, Green"
And when a Cephalos closes in,
startle it with a Sonic Bomb tune
and attack!
50630.descriptionJp:
今回の試練では狩猟笛を駆使
してガレオスを討伐してもら
う！事前に役立つ旋律をいく
つか教えておくぞ！
暑さ対策には「水→緑→水」
体力回復には「緑→白→水」
切れ味回復は「水→緑→緑」
そしてガレオスが近づいてき
たら「音爆演奏」で驚かせて
攻撃だ！

26601.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
26601.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Boron Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26601.descriptionEn:
A memo said to be lost, one that
records the secret of crafting
gear, is being found on monsters
slain all over, I hear!
Get your hands on a ≪Borron
Memo≫ and come to this workshop
boss, man to man!
I'll show you some good work!
26601.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ボロンメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

55876.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55876.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55876.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55876.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

21492.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21492.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21492.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21492.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54932.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
54932.description: Doragyurosu has appeared at the top of the sea of trees! For the investigation, please hunt it and break its left wing! There is only a short window to accept, but if you complete it, this request makes it easy to obtain the Nether Thunder Dragon's Ruinous Hook Claw!
54932.descriptionEn:
A Doragyurosu has appeared
at the Top of Great Forest!
For the survey, please hunt it
and break its left wing!
The window to accept this quest
is short, but if you complete it,
it's a request where the "Dark
Dragon's Annihilation Hook Claw"
is easy to obtain!
54932.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部にドラギュロスが
現れました！
調査のため狩猟と左翼破壊を
お願いします！
短い時間しか受注のチャンス
はありませんが、達成いただ
ければ「冥雷竜の滅鉤爪」を
入手しやすい依頼となってい
ます！

21071.objectiveJp: 大食いマグロ４匹の納品
21071.description: The fish that live in the hunting grounds are essential materials for mixing bullets! So that you can respond calmly when the moment comes, train your sense for fishing until your body remembers it! The moment to reel in is when the float sinks deep!
21071.descriptionEn:
Fish living in the hunting grounds
are vital ingredients for
≪Bullet Combining≫!
Let's train your body to feel the
rhythm of fishing, so you can
react calmly when the moment comes!
When the float sinks deep, that's
your moment to reel it in!
21071.descriptionJp:
狩り場に生息する魚は≪弾の
調合≫にとって欠かせない素
材です！いざという時に慌て
ず対応できるように、釣りの
感覚を体に覚えさせておきま
しょう！
ウキが深く沈んだ時が釣りあ
げるタイミングですよ！

54913.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
54913.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Diorekkusu, the Thunder Roaring Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54913.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Thunder
Roaring Wyvern ≪Diorex≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
54913.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、雷轟竜
≪ディオレックス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21766.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21766.description: A rare combination, a Daimyo Hermitaur and a Piscine Wyvern, has been found in the jungle. It seems to be a welcome quest for advanced hunters, who can take on aquatic monsters all at once. Why not give it a try.
21766.descriptionEn:
A Daimyo Hermitaur and a
Plesioth, a rare pairing,
have been found in the
Jungle.
A quest where you can take
on aquatic monsters at once
seems a treat for High Rank
hunters. Why not try it?
21766.descriptionJp:
盾蟹と魚竜だなんて、めずら
しい組み合わせが、密林で発
見されているわ。
水棲のモンスターが一度にい
ただける、上級ハンターには
うれしいクエストになってい
るようね。
挑戦してみたらどうかしら。

55965.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55965.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.
55965.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫
をお持ちください。

12078.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

50901.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50901.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50901.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

62421.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
62421.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62421.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62421.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50516.description: At last the flute that plays the finest tone is complete! But I want to go further. I want to make the supreme instrument with an even more wonderful tone! So, would you hunt two Basarios? I will use their materials to make the supreme instrument! Please!
50516.descriptionEn:
At last, the flute that plays
the finest tones is complete!
But I want to aim even higher.
I want to craft a supreme piece
that plays still finer tones!
So here's the thing. Could you
hunt 2 ≪Basarios≫ for me?
I'll use those materials to make
that supreme piece!
I'm counting on you!
50516.descriptionJp:
ついに極上の音色を奏でる笛
が完成した！だが、オレはさ
らに上を目指したい。もっと
素晴らしい音色を奏でる至高
の一品を作りたいんだ！
そこでだ。≪バサルモス≫を
２頭狩ってきてくれないか？
その素材を使って至高の一品
を作るんだ！
よろしく頼む！

62026.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62026.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
62026.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

23252.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
23252.description: Frozen plants and animals have been found in an unsurveyed part of the Canyon. The report says it is highly likely a Dyuragaua, but the Guild has judged further activity by the survey team dangerous and decided to ask skilled hunters instead. Hunters, please investigate at once.
23252.descriptionEn:
In the unsurveyed part of the
Canyon, frozen plants and animals
have been found. Reports say
it is highly likely an ice
fox wyvern, but the Guild has
judged further survey team
activity too dangerous, and
will entrust it to skilled hunters.
Hunters all,
please begin the survey at once.
23252.descriptionJp:
峡谷の未調査地域で、
凍った植物や動物が見つかり
ました。報告から氷狐竜であ
る可能性が高いとのことです
が、ギルドはこれ以上、
調査団による活動は危険と
判断、腕の立つハンターへ
依頼することとなりました。
ハンターの皆さん、
至急調査をお願いします。

60024.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Hunters who are confident they can face 2 black Gypceros loosed into the arena at once and carry out this hunt without faltering, join this quest and display your nerve and skill!!
60024.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
off their skill! Two black
poison bird wyverns are loosed
into the Arena at once. Hunters
who are confident they can carry
out this hunt without faltering
should join and display their nerve!
60024.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！闘技場に放たれた
黒き毒怪鳥を２頭同時に相手
とし、惑うことなくこの狩猟
を遂行せし自負を持つ狩人は
このクエストに参加し、その
胆力と腕を披露せよ！！

21997.description: I found a little-known spot in the Snowy Mountains where materials unique to the area lie all about. Do go and have a look. If you come back with a pouch full, it will be worth the price of the information.
21997.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Snowy
Mountains lie scattered around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.
21997.descriptionJp:
雪山ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代分の価値はあると
思うぜ。

54167.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54167.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54167.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

58033.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58033.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58033.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58033.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62275.description: Isn't that a treasure? Don't say such awful things, nya! If we polish it with the rust polish handed down in our clan, it's sure to shine, nya! It should be hidden in the Snowy Mountains, so I'll go tidy it up a bit, nya. Again this time, one tail is fine as reward, nya.
62275.descriptionEn:
That's no secret treasure, is it?
Don't say things that hurt my ears!
If you polish it with the rust
polish handed down in my clan,
it's sure to shine, meow!
It must be hidden in the Snowy
Mountains, so I'll go tidy up, meow.
One tail is the reward again, meow.
62275.descriptionJp:
あんなもの秘宝じゃない？
ネコ聞きの悪いこと言うニャ！
わが一族に伝わる錆び磨き
で磨けばきっと輝くはずニャ！
雪山に隠してあるはずニャか
らちょっと掃除してくるニャ。
今回も報酬は尻尾１本でいい
ニャよ。

60430.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60430.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
