If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60430.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50313.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Zerureusu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50313.descriptionEn:
Emergency request. We are seeking
hunters willing to slay a
remarkably powerful ≪Zerureusu≫.
For the hunters who succeed,
we will issue more slay proofs
than usual!
We await your application!
50313.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ゼルレウス≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。
見事、討伐したハンターには、
普段よりも多く討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

21513.description: There is a report of a great bolt of lightning seen in one corner of a volcanic region. As it is far too dangerous, we request a survey limited to skilled hunters. Supplies cannot be provided either, so investigate with the utmost care.
21513.descriptionEn:
We have reports of a massive
lightning strike witnessed
in a corner of a volcanic
region. It is too dangerous,
so we ask only ace hunters
to survey it. No items can
be supplied either, so take
the utmost care in your
survey.
21513.descriptionJp:
ある火山地帯の一角で大きな
落雷を目撃したと報告があり
ました。
あまりに危険な為、凄腕の
ハンター限定で調査を依頼
いたします。
アイテムの支給も不可能
なので、細心の注意を払って
調査にあたってください。

56071.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
56071.description: The Blast Mist Wyvern has appeared yet again in the Ashen Gleam Sphere survey area. We want it driven off at once. This time we will collect more Starry Sky Coins than before. In exchange, we will give you more ore and other rewards. We thank you in advance.
56071.descriptionEn:
The blast mist wyvern has appeared
yet again in the Ashgleam Sphere
survey zone. We want it driven
off as soon as possible.
This time we'll recover even more
Starry Sky Coins than last time.
In exchange, we'll hand over more
rewards such as raw ore as well.
Thank you for your cooperation.
56071.descriptionJp:
灰輝原珠の調査区域に
爆霧竜がまたまた現れました。
早急に追い払って頂きたいの
です。今回は前回よりもさら
に多くの星空コインを回収さ
せて頂きます。その代わり、
原石などの報酬もさらに多く
お渡しいたします。
よろしくお願いいたします。

26001.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
26001.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
26001.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
26001.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

54584.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟

61909.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン白３個の納品
61909.description: For those hunters who have obtained White Hunter Coins, we have prepared a dedicated reward. The more White Hunter Coins you deliver, the better your chance of receiving rare materials.
61909.descriptionEn:
To all Hunters who obtained
White Hunter Coins, we have
prepared a special reward.
The more White Hunter Coins
you deliver, the better your
chance of getting rare
materials.
61909.descriptionJp:
ハンターコイン白を入手され
たハンターの皆様に、専用の
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。
ハンターコイン白の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

21577.description: Have you heard of the Ox Horn Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21577.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb called
the Bull Horn Sphere?
Its material is indispensable
for crafting a certain
costly decoration.
If you can complete this request,
I will hand over precious
decoration materials.
21577.descriptionJp:
牛角原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

23687.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Blood Devouring Wyvern in the new arena! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
23687.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
lance, face the ≪Baruragaru≫
in the New Great Arena and
show the skill you have
honed!
If you succeed in hunting it,
you will earn even more
rewards than your daily
efforts bring you.
23687.descriptionJp:
槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

60052.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

54336.description: A giant fireball has been reported above Schrade Castle. It is predicted to be an omen of Fatalis's appearance. Head there at once and investigate. If Fatalis appears, proceed directly to slaying it.
54336.descriptionEn:
We have reports that a
huge fireball has formed
above Schrade Castle. It is
believed to be an omen of
Fatalis appearing.
Head to the site at once and
carry out a survey.
If Fatalis appears, move
straight on to
slaying it.
54336.descriptionJp:
シュレイド城上空にて、巨大
な火球が発生しているとの
報告がありました。これは、
ミラボレアスが現れる前兆で
はないかと予測されます。
至急現地へ向かい、調査を
お願いします。
ミラボレアスが現れた場合に
は、そのまま討伐に移行して
ください。

11030.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

61653.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の捕獲
61653.description: Yo! It's me! Have you been capturing every day? Capturing is one of the great pleasures of a hunter. This time go and capture the monsters of the jungle, thump thump. I have prepared a few special rewards too, so do your best. Slaying them will of course be a failure.
61653.descriptionEn:
Yo! It's me! Catching them daily?
Capture is one of a hunter's
greatest joys. This time, go
capture the Jungle's monsters,
thump-thump, one after another.
It's not much, but I've prepared
special rewards, so do your best.
Slay them and you fail, of course.
61653.descriptionJp:
ヨウ！俺だよ！
毎日捕獲してるかい？捕獲は
ハンターの醍醐味のひとつだ
今回は密林のモンスター共を
ドスンドスンと捕獲してきて
くんな。多少だが、特殊な報
酬も用意したから頑張れよ。
討伐したら当然失敗となるぜ。

55162.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55162.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Stygian Zinogre armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55162.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want to
craft Stygian Zinogre
≪Zinogre Subspecies≫ armor!
Clear the sub-target and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade Transcendence Armor, so
please give it a try!
55162.descriptionJp:
獄狼竜≪ジンオウガ亜種≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを
用意しました！
サブターゲットを達成すると
遷悠防具の強化に必要な
素材を入手できますので、
ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

21889.description: This is the quest for the trial to break past HR200. After accepting the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, please depart on the quest on your own.
21889.descriptionEn:
This is the quest for the trial
to break past HR200. After
accepting the trial from the
Guild Master or the HR Trial board,
please depart on the quest
on your own.
21889.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ２００突破試練のための
クエストです。ギルドマス
ターまたはＨＲ試練掲示板
から試練を受注した後、
お一人でクエストへ出発して
ください。

62953.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62953.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62953.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62953.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

54309.description: Greetings, hunter. Have you ever crafted a piece of armor only to find yourself short of materials and unable to upgrade it? Then I have good news for you. Clear this quest and upgrading that armor may become an easy matter. I pray the materials you want are among what you find.
54309.descriptionEn:
Hunter, good day to you.
Have you crafted armor only to find
you lack the materials to upgrade it?
Then we have good news for you.
If you complete this quest, you may
be able to upgrade your armor
with ease.
I pray you obtain the materials
you are hoping for.
54309.descriptionJp:
ハンターさん、ごきげんよう。
防具を生産したものの素材
不足で、強化できないなんて
ことになっていませんか？
そんなあなたに朗報です。
このクエストを達成すると、
防具が楽に強化できるかも
しれません。
あなたの望む素材が入手でき
ることを祈っています。

55828.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
55828.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we've prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them further. By breaking Toridcless's head, special ingredients will also be granted to you.
55828.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we've prepared this quest
to raise awareness and promote
them further.
By breaking the Shining Thunder
Bird's head, special ingredients
will also be granted to you.
55828.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
照雷鳥の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54868.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種２頭の討伐
54868.description: There was a report of a Lavasioth Subspecies found in the G Rank Volcano. It was no mistake. We cannot overlook the fact that several powerful Lavasioth have appeared. We want a survey just to be sure. Materials found during it should be taken home. They will serve you well.
54868.descriptionEn:
There was a report of a ≪crimson
Volganos≫ found in the G Rank
Volcano. It was no mistake.
We cannot overlook the fact
that several powerful
≪Lavasioth≫ have appeared.
We want a survey just to be
sure. Materials found during it
should be taken home.
They will serve you well.
54868.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の火山で≪紅い溶岩竜≫
を発見したとの報告があった。
それは間違いではなかった。
強力な≪紅溶岩竜≫が複数
出現した事態を見過ごすこと
はできない。
念のため調査をお願いしたい。
調査中に発見した素材は持ち
帰ると良いだろう。
君の役に立つはずだ。

50072.description: The limited-time Golden Week Festival special quest is a bargain quest where you can get plenty of HRP and Porta Tickets (Sakura). Note that a Golden Week Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50072.descriptionEn:
This limited-time GW Festival
special quest is a great deal,
giving plenty of HRP and
Porta Ticket Sakura.
Note that accepting the quest
requires a ≪GW Ticket≫, so
please be careful.
50072.descriptionJp:
期間限定のＧＷ祭・特別クエ
ストは、ＨＲＰやポルタ
チケット桜がたっぷり貰える
お得なクエストです。
クエストの受注には
「ＧＷチケット」が必要にな
りますのでご注意ください。

55504.description: Hello everyone! Today's dressing session will be in a kimono with vivid red! Or so I thought, but the roaring is too loud to concentrate. Whoever punishes it will receive the kimono used today. Break its parts to punish it further and I will give even more.
55504.descriptionEn:
Hello, everyone!
Today's dressing will be done
in a kimono with vivid red!
I thought so, but the roaring
is so loud I can't concentrate.
To whoever teaches it a lesson,
I'll give the kimono used today.
Break its parts to scold it further,
and I'll give
even more rewards.
55504.descriptionJp:
はいみなさーん！
今回の着付けは赤色が鮮やか
な着物で行いますよー。
と思いましたが吠える声が
うるさくて集中できませんね。
懲らしめてくれた方には、
今回使用する着物を差し上げ
ますよ。部位破壊でさらに懲
らしめてくれたら、もっと
報酬を差し上げます。

54271.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の討伐
54271.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54271.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54271.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55237.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the HC materials and GHC materials used to strengthen some of the armor and decorations worn in it. Please make use of it.
55237.descriptionEn:
"F Photo Contest 2016"
We have prepared a quest in
which you can obtain the HC
and GHC materials used to
upgrade some of the armor and
decorations worn in the photo
that won the top prize.
Please do give it a try.
55237.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されて
いる一部防具や装飾品の強化
に使用するＨＣ素材やＧＨＣ
素材を獲得できるクエストを
ご用意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

53056.description: Good morning everyone! I came again today! Question 2: The Gunlance I, Miyamoa, hold is an Iron Gunlance. If you think the answer is false (B), take this quest!
53056.descriptionEn:
Morning, everyone!
I'm here again today!
[Question 2]
The gunlance I (Miyamoa) carry
is
"Iron Gunlance."
If you think the answer is × (B),
hunters should accept
this quest!
53056.descriptionJp:
みんなおはよう！
今日も来たよ！
【第２問】
僕（ミヤモア）が持っている
ガンランスは
「アイアンガンランス」である
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

55494.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55494.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55494.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

26480.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
26480.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. It's a special request from certain quarters, so it's a sweet job, but don't underestimate the true power of an Elder Dragon!
26480.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
It's a special request from
certain circles, a tasty job,
but elder dragons are tough!
26480.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
あるスジの特別な依頼なので
オイシイ仕事ですが、本来の
古龍の力は侮れませんよ！

63004.description: Welcome. This is the exchange counter for Half Tickets Purple. We will exchange them for a large number of Hardcore Tickets.
63004.descriptionEn:
Welcome, welcome.
This is the exchange counter for
"Half Tickets Purple."
I will trade you
a large number of "Hardcore Tickets"
for them.
63004.descriptionJp:
ようこそいらっしゃいました。
ここは「ハーフチケット紫」
の交換所です。
「ハーフチケット紫」と
大量の「剛種チケット」を
交換して差上げます。

54448.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
54448.description: The Espinas Rare Species we were seeking for our ecological survey has been found at the top of the forest. To carry out a more detailed study, hunters, head out at once and hunt the Espinas Rare Species.
54448.descriptionEn:
The ≪Espinas Rare Species≫ we
were seeking for an ecological
survey has been found at the
top of the Great Forest.
For a more detailed study, all
Hunters are asked to head out
and hunt it at once.
54448.descriptionJp:
生態調査として探していた
≪エスピナス希少種≫が樹海
頂部で発見されました。
より詳細な調査を行うために
も、ハンターの皆さんは
至急エスピナス希少種の狩猟
に向かってください。

1030.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
1030.description: Diablos is a monster whose ferocity in the desert ecosystem stands in a class of its own! Caught by its charge, you'd take damage you could never recover from. Break even just the horns and I'll pay a bonus!
1030.descriptionEn:
≪Diablos≫ is a monster of
unmatched violence in the
desert ecosystem! Get hit
by that charge and you'd
take damage you won't
recover from. Break even
one horn and I'll pay up!
1030.descriptionJp:
≪ディアブロス≫は砂漠の
生態系において、他の生物と
は別格の強暴さを誇るモンス
ターだ！ヤツの突進にはねら
れたら再起不能のダメージを
受けてしまうだろう。角だけ
でも、折れば報酬を払おう！

60612.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60612.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60612.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60612.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50951.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50951.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50951.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

23275.description: The survey team that went deep into the Ancient Tower reports discovering a Gold Rathian. Encountering one at all is rare, and for one living in an unsurveyed region its research value is beyond measure. Head there at once and investigate.
23275.descriptionEn:
A survey team that went deep
into the Ancient Tower reports
finding a Gold Rathian.
Meeting a Gold Rathian at all is
rare, and one living in an
unsurveyed region is beyond
all measure in survey value.
Please head to the site at once
and carry out the survey.
23275.descriptionJp:
古塔の深部へ向かった調査団
から、金火竜を発見したとの
報告が届きました。
金火竜と遭遇すること自体が
稀であり、未調査地域に
生息する金火竜となると、
その調査価値は計り知れま
せん。至急現地へ向かい
調査をお願いします。

50286.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
50286.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Black Gravios and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50286.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Black Gravios≫
for me.
Clear the quest, and your standing
as hunters will shoot
right up!
50286.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪黒鎧竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

53245.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の捕獲

26270.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26270.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26270.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26270.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

60590.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas Subspecies! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin, Transcendent and Aberrant weapons only!
60590.descriptionEn:
Hunters compete to prove
their skill in this grand
hunting tournament!
Today's target is
≪Espinas Subspecies≫!
Hunting alone shows true
spirit—overcome yourself
and place high! Origin/
Transcendent/Supremacy only!
60590.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪エスピナス亜種≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は始種・遷悠・辿異武器
限定で開催されているぞ！

21328.description: What, you just want a hard Hunting Horn? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21328.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Hunting Horn, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!
21328.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬い狩猟笛が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

63251.description: It is I! The Instructor! I have prepared a request for hunters struggling with Variant and Odd Species monsters! Complete this request and I will provide more monster materials than usual. With this, your skilled hunter equipment will surely be complete! I wish you good fortune!
63251.descriptionEn:
It's me! The Instructor!
I've prepared a request
for hunters who struggle
against Variants and Odd
Species! Clear this request
and I'll hand over more
monster materials than usual.
With this, your master gear
is sure to be complete!
I wish you good hunting!
63251.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
変種や奇種のモンスターに
苦労しているハンター向けの
依頼を用意したぞ！
今回の依頼を達成すれば、
いつもより多くモンスター
素材を提供しよう。
これで、凄腕の装備が整う
こと間違いなしだ！
健闘を祈る！

53004.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
53004.description: That Gasurabazura chase their prey in coordination is a well-known fact, but I believe the secret of that splendid coordination lies in their roars. So I want you to investigate their hunting technique. If you tell me what you see, I will share precious hunting horn materials.
53004.descriptionEn:
The Orugaron hunting in
concert is well known, but
I believe the secret of
that fine teamwork lies
in their roars. So I want
you to survey their
hunting techniques. Tell me
what you see and I'll share
rare Hunting Horn parts.
53004.descriptionJp:
響狼たちが連携しながら獲物
を追うことは周知の事実だが
私はその見事な連携の秘密は、
咆哮にあると考えている。
そこで、彼らの狩猟技術を
調査してきてほしい。
その様子を私に教えてくれる
ならば、貴重な狩猟笛の素材
を分けてあげよう。

21143.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
21143.description: A suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress at tremendous speed! At once, make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon! If our strength is not enough, breaking that giant leg alone will do.
21143.descriptionEn:
A suspicious dragon is approaching
the Fortress at tremendous speed!
At once, make use of the Fortress's
interceptor weapons and repel the
mysterious giant dragon!
If your strength is not enough, then
at least break those giant legs
for us.
21143.descriptionJp:
怪しげな龍が物凄い勢いで
砦に接近してきています！
大至急、砦の迎撃兵器を活用
し、謎の巨大龍を撃退して
ください！
戦力が及ばない場合、あの巨
大な脚の破壊だけでもお願い
します。

26181.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
26181.description: To the hunters of Dundorma, information about the proud lone wolf, the black wolf bird Yian Garuga. In my estimation, it will come at you with resolve to die this time. Slaying it is the only way to answer that resolve.
26181.descriptionEn:
To the hunters of Dundorma,
here is information on the proud
lone wolf, the Black Wolf Bird
≪Yian Garuga≫. My guess is
that in this hunt he will come
at us ready to die.
Slaying him is the only way to
answer that resolve, I say.
26181.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマの狩人たちへ、誇
り高き一匹狼、黒狼鳥≪イャ
ンガルルガ≫に関する情報だ。
オレの予想では、今回の狩り
では、奴は恐らく決死の覚悟
で向かってくる。
討伐こそが、奴の覚悟に報い
る唯一の手段だろうな。

50634.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
50634.description: This is the PC version High Grade Edition trial quest. The time limit is 10 minutes.
50634.descriptionEn:
PC Version
High Grade Edition
Trial Quest.
The time limit is set
at 10 minutes.
50634.descriptionJp:
パソコン版
High Grade Edition
体験クエストです。
制限時間は１０分間となって
おります。

61303.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61303.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61303.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

62925.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Swamp, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Spring or the Voice of Nature: Thick Fog. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62925.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the ≪Swamp≫, you may
obtain ≪Voice of Nature:
Spring≫ or ≪Voice of Nature:
Dense Fog≫.
I wish you all a richer hunting life.
62925.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪沼地≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・源泉≫や
≪大自然の声・濃霧≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

50135.description: This is a challenge flung at you by me, the boss of the Dark Cat Gang, meow! Your opponents this time are the wild monsters even we cannot handle, meow! If you can defeat them, I will give you a Dark Cat Gang Medal, meow!
50135.descriptionEn:
This is a challenge from
Wagahai, boss of the Dark
Cat Gang, meow!
Your opponents this time
are wild monsters even we
can't handle, meow!
If you can bring them down,
I'll give you the ≪Dark Cat
Gang Medal≫, meow!
50135.descriptionJp:
闇猫団のボスたるワガハイ
からお前たちに挑戦状を
叩きつけるミャ！
今回のお前たちの相手は、
我らでも手の付けられない
荒くれモンスター達ミャ！
もしも倒すことができたら
≪闇猫団メダル≫をくれて
やるミャ！

23551.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23551.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23551.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55381.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55381.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55381.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

55652.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (arms), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
55652.descriptionEn:
This quest discharges
materials for upgrading
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(arms), excluding weapon
ribbons and weapon merits.
The yield is one type.
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫,
so please keep that
in mind.
55652.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（腕防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

63006.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

56144.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
56144.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
56144.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.
56144.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫
をお持ちください。

61265.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
61265.description: Oh! It is me! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Lavasioth or ruler of the volcano, I do not care, with this much ready it is like a child! I have some special rewards too, so go and settle it with a bang!
61265.descriptionEn:
Hey! It's me!
This time I've got special
gear and supply items for
you. Lava dragon or lord of
the volcano, who cares—with
this much prep it's just a
kid! I've also readied some
special rewards, so go out
there and nail it!
61265.descriptionJp:
オウ！俺だよ！
今回は特別な装備品と、
支給品を用意させてもらった。
溶岩竜だか火山の支配者だか
知らないが、これだけ用意
すれば子供同然だろう！
多少だが特殊な報酬も
用意したから、ドカンと
決めてくるんだぜ！

62909.description: Oh, you there. Are you eating well? If you keep eating nothing but junk, you won't have the strength for hunting. That's right, why not take my request? If you use the reward ingredients as they are, you can make a fine meal!
62909.descriptionEn:
Oh, you there.
Have you been eating well?
If you keep stuffing down
nothing but junk, you will not
have any strength for hunting.
That's right, why not take on
one of my requests?
Use the ingredients from the
reward as they are and eat well!
62909.descriptionJp:
おや、そこのアンタ。
美味しいもん食べてるかい？
いい加減なものばっかり
食べてると狩りでも力が
出なくなっちまうよ。
そうだね、いっちょあたしの
依頼をうけてごらんよ。
報酬の食材をそのまま使えば
美味しい食事ができるよ！

23713.description: A Baruragaru with a greatly developed head has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Baruragaru known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
23713.descriptionEn:
A ≪Baruragaru≫ with a greatly
developed head has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫
with developed parts, and will
conduct a survey. Reports say
it is more dangerous than
Baruragaru seen before.
Please survey it with care.
23713.descriptionJp:
頭が大きく発達した
≪喰血竜≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの喰血竜より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

28094.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28094.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
28094.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

60324.description: Few people take on small jobs, so the guild has prepared a slightly larger reward than usual. A little mining on the side, and this job is child's play. Recommended! Just be warned, if you do not bring a pickaxe you are guaranteed to retire!
60324.descriptionEn:
Small odd jobs get few takers,
so the Guild prepared a
slightly bigger reward.
It's a quick job you can do
while mining. Recommended!
But if you don't bring a
pickaxe, you're guaranteed to
retire, so be careful!
60324.descriptionJp:
細々とした仕事は、受注者が
少ないので、ギルドでは心も
ち多めに報酬を用意しました。
採掘のついで･･･で、朝飯前
なこの仕事。オススメです！
ただし、ちゃんとピッケルを
用意していかないと、リタイ
ア確定なので、要注意です！

61707.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
61707.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
61707.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.
61707.descriptionJp:
スキルカフの素材？前に依頼
されていくつか作ったよ。
え、また作ってほしいって？
んー、今ちょっと忙しいんだ
が、俺の依頼をこなしてくれ
たら、前に作ったやつの残り
でよければやってもいいぞ。
もしかしたら無いかもしれん
が行ってる間に探しておくよ。

54760.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54760.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
54760.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
54760.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

61743.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
61743.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
61743.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
61743.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

58124.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58124.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58124.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58124.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

61326.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

53223.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の捕獲
53223.description: I am the Holy Knight, a gentleman who rides a silver dragon and delivers gifts to good children. However, this year the silver dragon has been playing around and will not listen. It needs discipline. Please go and catch it.
53223.descriptionEn:
The Holy Knight, at your
service—riding a silver
dragon to bring gifts
to good children.
But this year the silver
dragon is playing hooky
and won't listen at all.
It needs discipline.
Please go catch it.
53223.descriptionJp:
銀の竜に乗って良い子に
ギフトを届ける紳士、
ホーリーナイトで
ございます。
しかし、今年は銀の竜が
遊び呆けて言うことを
聞かないのです。
教育が必要です。
捕まえてきてください。

60817.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60817.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly.
60817.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that Variants
are a real pain for hunters, since
their sacs are so hard to carve.
So I'll strip those sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure you bring the
quarry down properly, got it.
60817.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさんたち
は、しっかり獲物をしとめて
くるんだぜ。

55827.description: That one, name unknown, true form uncertain. Like a shadow melting into the dark night. You who have gathered the codes of land, sea and sky, don the black garb, go to the tower, and strike down the master of shadows. To the one who slays it, I grant the proof of full mastery.
55827.descriptionEn:
Its name unknown,
its true form unclear.
A shadow melting into night.
You who gathered land, sea
and sky ciphers—don
the black raiment, go to
the Tower and slay the
Shadow Lord. Mastery awaits.
55827.descriptionJp:
そのもの、名も知れず
真なる姿も定かならず。
まさに闇夜に融ける影の如し。
陸海空の暗号を集めし強者よ
黒き装束を身に纏い、
塔に赴き、影の主を討つべし。
討ち取りし者には皆伝の証を
授けん。

22084.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ５ and above.
22084.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass found in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain
regions of the land, we offer
our guidance only to those of
HR5 or above.
22084.descriptionJp:
近年発見されたセンショク草
は、自然を熟知した熟練者で
なければ真贋を見極めること
ができない、レアな一品です。
特定の地域でのみ見られる草
なので、ＨＲ５以上の方に
限ってご案内させていただ
いております。

54193.description: Please investigate the Khezu lurking in the Snowy Mountains. If you not only hunt it but splendidly break its head and torso, I will add to the reward!
54193.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Khezu
lurking in the Snowy
Mountains. And not just
hunt it—if you can break
its head and body, I'll
add a bonus to your
reward!
54193.descriptionJp:
雪山に潜むフルフルの
調査をお願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
フルフルの頭と胴を
見事破壊してくれたら、
報酬を上乗せしちゃい
ますよ！

1035.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

26626.description: It seems Guku are gathering in some areas. Maybe you can find what Guku like nearby. Why not go and look? If you want to come back, just deliver a map.
26626.descriptionEn:
It seems Gook have been gathering
in some areas, nyah.
Maybe you'll find the things that
Gook like somewhere nearby,
nyah.
Why not go and take a look?
If you want to come back,
just deliver a map, nyah.
26626.descriptionJp:
どうやら、一部地域にグーク
が集まってきているようニャ。
もしかしたら、その近くなら
グークの好きなものが見つか
るかもしれないニャ。
ちょっと行って、探してみた
らどうニャ？もし帰りたく
なったら地図を納品するニャ。

50532.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one enraged Rathian, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
50532.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner well,
nya? Treat your partner right
once in a while, nya!
Now, to business, nya. This
request is to hunt 1 enraged
Rathian, nya.
The reward is materials for
Felyne gear, nya!
I'm counting on you, nya!
50532.descriptionJp:
おう！そこの狩人さん！
アンタのパートニャーは元気
かニャ？たまには相棒孝行し
てやるニャ！
では、本題ニャ。今回の依頼
は怒り狂ったリオレイア１頭
の狩猟ニャ。
報酬はパートニャー用武具の
生産素材だニャ！
たのんだニャー！

21901.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21901.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Gravios in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21901.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's
hunting life, I've set up
a request to hunt ≪Gravios≫
in the New Great Arena.
Clear this request and
you'll earn a higher rating
than usual. Train hard and
aim for greater heights.
21901.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、新大闘技場で
≪鎧竜≫を狩猟する依頼を
用意しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より高い評価が得られます。
効率的な鍛練を積み、さらな
る高みを目指しましょう。

60067.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, would you plant the Guild Flag at the summit for me?
60067.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, has no
fixed territory, and because
its numbers are so few it is
also called the Phantom Beast.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
could you plant a Guild Flag
at the summit for me?
60067.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物ね。雪山に行くなら山頂に
≪ギルドフラッグ≫を立てて
くるのをお願いしてもいい？

60552.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
60552.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Teostra. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60552.descriptionEn:
Hunters compete to prove
their skill in this grand
hunting tournament!
Today's target is
≪Teostra≫!
Hunting alone shows true
spirit—overcome yourself
and place high! Origin
weapons only—choose wisely!
60552.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪テオ・テスカトル≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50825.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50825.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50825.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

55089.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55089.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55089.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54803.description: 2 unidentified monsters of great power are on a rampage together at the Ancient Tower. Head out to slay them at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Secret Art armor, in preparation for greater threats.
54803.descriptionEn:
Two unidentified monsters of
great power are on a rampage
at the Ancient Tower at once.
Please head out and slay them
as fast as you can!
If you save us from this crisis,
we will provide materials used
for some G Rank Secret Art
Armor, in preparation for worse.
54803.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが２頭同時に暴れ
まわっています。
一刻も早く討伐に向かって
ください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級秘伝防具に使用す
る素材を提供いたします。

63274.description: How do you find the Bamboo? We have also prepared Straw Rope, a material from the East that can power up that Bamboo even further! To hand it over, we ask you to hunt a Piscine Wyvern, which is likewise indispensable at any celebration!
63274.descriptionEn:
How do you like the feel
of your [Bamboo]? I've also
prepared [Straw Rope], an
eastern material that can
power up that bamboo!
To hand it over, I need
you to hunt a Piscine
Wyvern—a must at any
celebratory feast!
63274.descriptionJp:
皆様、【竹】の使い心地はい
かがですか？そんな【竹】を
更にパワーアップするこ
とができる東方伝来の素材
【わら縄】もご用意しました！
こちらをお渡しするには、
これまた祝いの席では
欠かせない魚竜種の
狩猟をお願いします！

23586.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
23586.description: The sky-soaring dragon has been confirmed near the course of the large survey ship. Even with interception equipment, we cannot survey if it attacks again and again. Board the survey ship and slay the sky-soaring dragon.
23586.descriptionEn:
Near the route of the large survey
ship, the Sky-Soaring Dragon was
sighted. Even with interception
equipment, we cannot carry out
our survey if it keeps attacking.
Please board the large survey ship
and slay the Sky-Soaring Dragon.
23586.descriptionJp:
大型探査船の航路付近に、
天翔龍の姿が確認されました。
迎撃用の装備があるとはいえ、
そう何度も襲われていては
調査を行うことができません。
大型探査船に同乗し、天翔龍
の討伐に当たって下さい。

40221.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
40221.description: A great swarm of monsters wearing mechanical life-form masks has appeared in the Grand Arena. Our YoRHa unit alone cannot handle them, so we want to ask for rescue. We have prepared equipment to fight them.
40221.descriptionEn:
A great swarm of monsters
wearing the masks of machine
lifeforms has appeared in the
Great Arena.
Our YoRHa unit alone cannot
handle them all, so we ask for
reinforcements.
We have prepared equipment to
fight them.
40221.descriptionJp:
大闘技場に機械生命体の
仮面を付けたモンスターの
大群が現れた。
私たちヨルハ部隊だけでは
手が足りないので、救援を
頼みたい。対抗するための
装備は用意した。

54189.description: We will continue the investigation of the Rajang that appeared in the Snowy Mountains. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your aid!
54189.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Rajang in the Snowy
Mountains. Breaking parts
isn't mandatory, but I'd be
delighted if you did!
Hunters, I ask for your
kind assistance!
54189.descriptionJp:
雪山に出現したラージャンの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

62907.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石２個の納品
62907.description: It is I! The Instructor! An emergency request from the Guild! It seems that completing the request earns a special reward. I will prepare the armor myself. All of you! Depart at once!
62907.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
An urgent request from the
Guild! It seems clearing it
earns you a special reward.
I'll provide the armor.
Everyone! Move out now!
62907.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
ギルドから緊急の依頼だ！
どうやら、依頼をこなすと、
特別な報酬を貰えるようだ。
防具は我輩の方で用意しよう。
諸君！今すぐ出発だ！

22027.description: Congratulations on reaching HR5! Deliver the Map by yourself, clear the quest and claim your reward!
22027.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR5! Deliver the ≪Map≫
by yourself, clear the
quest and claim your
reward!
22027.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ５達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

61611.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
61611.description: A practice quest for the preliminaries of the VS Quest Champion Tournament. Note: you cannot obtain target monster materials from carving or clear rewards here.
61611.descriptionEn:
A practice quest for the
preliminaries of the VS
Quest Champion Tournament.
Note: you cannot obtain
target monster materials
from carving or clear
rewards here.
61611.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選練習用
クエストです。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

50743.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
50743.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50743.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50743.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

55839.description: We have discovered a huge flying wyvern that scatters something like explosive mist at Prismatic Falls. Reports say its ecology is unlike anything known, and the Guild has begun further investigation. Take care of its explosive attacks and complete the quest.
55839.descriptionEn:
At Ayano Falls, a giant
wyvern was found spraying
something like explosive
mist. Its ecology is said to
be unlike any other, and the
Guild began a deeper survey.
Watch for explosive attacks
and complete the quest.
55839.descriptionJp:
彩の滝にて爆発性の霧の様な
ものを撒く巨大な飛竜種を
発見しました。生態は類を見
ない、特殊なものであるとい
う報告があり、ギルドはさら
なる調査を開始しました。
爆発攻撃に注意し、クエスト
を完了してください。

50550.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for a hunter to slay the Inagami that appeared suddenly. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50550.descriptionEn:
An urgent request.
We seek hunters to slay the
≪Inagami≫ that appeared
without warning.
Slay it and we'll issue
more slay proofs than
usual!
50550.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。
突如現れた≪イナガミ≫を
討伐してくださるハンターを
募集しています。
見事、討伐できましたら、
普段よりも多めに討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

1037.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

61306.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61306.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61306.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61306.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

5008.description: The solitary one-horned wyvern Monoblos may be called the king that pairs with Diablos in the Desert. Yet if you dodge its charge and make it drive its noble horn into a wall, sealing its movement, you should be able to hunt it from advantage!
5008.descriptionEn:
The solitary one-horned
dragon ≪Monoblos≫ could well
be called the king that pairs
with Diablos in the Desert.
But dodge its charge and let
that noble horn lodge in a wall,
and you should gain the upper hand!
5008.descriptionJp:
孤高の一角竜≪モノブロス≫
は砂漠においてディアブロス
と対をなす王者といえよう。
がしかし、ヤツの突進を避け
気高き角を壁に刺させ、動き
を封じてしまえば優位に狩り
を進められるハズじゃぞ！

62678.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
62678.description: A request to hunt the giant Lunastra that has taken up residence at the very top of the Old Tower in the frontier. The tower is now extremely dangerous, but for one person alone it seems you can be carried to the summit by balloon. An extremely dangerous request, but we await a brave soul to take it on!
62678.descriptionEn:
A request to slay the giant Lunastra
that has settled at the very top
of the remote Ancient Tower.
The Ancient Tower is currently
very dangerous, but if you go alone
we should be able to send you to
the top by balloon. It is an extremely
dangerous request, but we await
a brave soul willing to try!
62678.descriptionJp:
辺境の古塔、その最上部に
住みついている、巨大な
炎妃龍の討伐依頼です。
現在古塔は非常に危険な状態
ですが、１人だけであれば、
気球で最上部まで送ることが
できそうです。極めて危険な
依頼ですが、挑戦する勇者を
お待ちしています！

50665.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Stroma series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50665.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials to craft or
upgrade one piece of the
≪Hardcore Armor≫ Stroma
series.
To accept this quest you
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest fails, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed. Please beware.
50665.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
ストロマシリーズの１部位分
の生産、強化素材が入手でき
ます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61801.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61801.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61801.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

61189.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種の狩猟
61189.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61189.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61189.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

28015.description: I have hit the biggest wall of my hunter life. This will be hard even for you. After all, there are two of them! In the desert! Well, even I cannot do it. You can start safely with the sub target.
28015.descriptionEn:
I've hit the toughest wall
of my hunting life. Even
you lot might struggle.
After all, there's two of
them! In the Desert!
Even I can't manage it.
Feel free to play it safe
with the sub-target first.
28015.descriptionJp:
オレのハンター生活で一番の
難関に直面したゼ。こりゃあ
キミ達でも難しいんじゃない
かなぁ。何せ、アイツが２頭
もいるんだぜ？砂漠だぜ？
まぁ、オレでも無理なんだ。
まずはサブターゲットで手堅
くやってくれてもいいぜ。

23201.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23201.description: A researcher surveying the Jungle reported sighting a Yian Kut-Ku. They said something about it seemed different from the bird wyverns known so far, but the details are unclear. We are looking for a hunter who can head out to investigate at once.
23201.descriptionEn:
A researcher surveying the
Jungle reported sighting
a Yian Kut-Ku. They said
it seemed different from
the usual Kut-Ku, but
details are unclear.
We're looking for hunters
to head out at once.
23201.descriptionJp:
密林の調査をしていた研究員
から、イャンクックを目撃
したと報告がありました。
これまでの怪鳥とは何かが
違うようだと言っていまし
たが、詳細は不明です。
急ぎ調査に向かって頂ける
ハンターを探しています。

21765.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21765.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21765.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

21811.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

26627.description: It seems Guku are gathering in some areas. Maybe you can find what Guku like nearby. Why not go and look? If you want to come back, just deliver a map.
26627.descriptionEn:
It seems Gook have been gathering
in some areas, nyah.
Maybe you'll find the things that
Gook like somewhere nearby,
nyah.
Why not go and take a look?
If you want to come back,
just deliver a map, nyah.
26627.descriptionJp:
どうやら、一部地域にグーク
が集まってきているようニャ。
もしかしたら、その近くなら
グークの好きなものが見つか
るかもしれないニャ。
ちょっと行って、探してみた
らどうニャ？もし帰りたく
なったら地図を納品するニャ。

21442.description: It was supposed to end with the last request, but there seems to have been a little more to it. Long ago I found a stone of extreme heat, but I could not carry the ore. Yet I learned that cooling it with that water makes it transportable. So would you deliver a large quantity once more?
21442.descriptionEn:
I thought the last request ended
it, but there seems to be a
little more. Long ago we found
a stone of extreme heat, but we
could not carry that ore.
Yet once cooled by that water,
we learned it could be moved.
So would you deliver a large
amount just one more time?
21442.descriptionJp:
前の依頼で終わりなんだけど、
少し続きがあったみたい。
昔、超高温の石を発見した
のだけれど、この鉱石を運ぶ
ことができなかったの。
でも、あの水で冷却すると、
運べることが分かったわ。
だから、もう一度だけ大量に
納品してくれないかしら？

50948.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
50948.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50948.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50948.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

28021.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

50675.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50675.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Diore F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50675.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of
the ≪Skystorm Armor≫ Diore F
series.
To accept this quest you
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest fails, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed. Please beware.
50675.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
ディオレＦシリーズの１部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55551.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55551.description: A Toridokuresu with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Toridokuresu seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55551.descriptionEn:
A ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫ whose
wings have grown greatly has
appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a Supremacy with
developed parts and will survey
it. Reports say it is more
dangerous than any before.
Please survey it with care.
55551.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した≪照雷鳥≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を部位
の発達した≪辿異種≫と位置
づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの照雷鳥より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

23426.description: A hunter has reported finding a Chameleos in the swamp. When they tried to slay it at once, it cloaked itself completely. The hunter felt their life in danger and fled. Go to the site and find out the true nature of the Chameleos!
23426.descriptionEn:
A hunter reported discovering
the ≪Chameleos≫ in the Swamp.
When they tried to slay it at
once, it cloaked its figure
and vanished completely.
Feeling their life in danger,
the hunter fled right away.
Head to the area and find out
the true nature of ≪Chameleos≫!
23426.descriptionJp:
とあるハンターから沼地で
≪霞龍≫を発見したとの報告
がありました。すぐに討伐を
試みたところ、なんと姿を完
全に眩ましてしまいました。
身の危険を感じたハンターは
すぐに逃げ出したそうです。
現地へ向かい、≪霞龍≫の正
体を突き止めてください！

62001.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
62001.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Blangonga. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62001.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
to slay Blangonga.
The reward is a bit lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
sharpen your skills against
other hunters?
62001.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ドドブランゴ≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

63266.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63266.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63266.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63266.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

50114.description: Hey! A prime request has come in! The number of times it can be taken is limited, but apparently they'll share Haku materials! And apparently just driving it off is enough, so it's recommended even for those who can't slay it. Still, a Haku is a Haku. Never let your guard down.
50114.descriptionEn:
Hey! A special request just came
in! There's a limit to how many
times you can take it, but get
this — they'll share Zenith
materials with you. And a repel
is all it takes, so it's great
for folks who can't slay one.
Still, even so, a Zenith is
a Zenith. Never let your guard down.
50114.descriptionJp:
おい！とっておきの依頼が舞
い込んで来たぞ！受注できる
回数に限りはあるが、なんと
覇種の素材を分けてもらえる
らしい。しかも撃退だけでい
いらしいから、討伐できな
いってヤツにもオススメだな。
ただ、そうは言っても覇種は
覇種だ。絶対に油断するなよ。

53233.description: Yes yes! This is a quest for hunters who reached the seventh challenge of the mysterious sports festival! Clear it quickly and bring this festival to its goal!
53233.descriptionEn:
Hi, hi!
This quest is for hunters
who reached the seventh
challenge of the strange
athletic meet!
Clear it quick and let's
reach the goal of this
meet together!
53233.descriptionJp:
はいはーい！
不思議な運動会の７番目の
お題に辿り着けた
ハンターさんのための
クエストですよ！
さくっとクリアして、
この運動会のゴールを
迎えましょう！

26731.description: I obtained information that there are ruins from ancient times somewhere in the swamp, and stormed in to verify it, but Akura Vashimu lives at the destination and I am stuck. Could you slay that monster? In thanks I will present part of the excavated goods.
26731.descriptionEn:
I learned that ancient ruins
lie somewhere in the Swamp,
so I went in to confirm it,
but a Taikun Zamuza has
made its nest at the site,
and I am at a loss. Could
you please slay that monster
for me? As thanks, I will
present part of my finds.
26731.descriptionJp:
沼地のどこかに太古時代の遺
跡があるとの情報を手に入れ
て、真偽を確かめるために沼
地に乗り込みましたが、目的
地に尾晶蠍が生息していて
困っています。どうか、その
モンスターを退治していただ
けないでしょうか。お礼に発
掘品の一部を進呈いたします。

50358.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50358.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wing claws of a Teostra will also grant a special ingredient.
50358.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking Teostra's wing
claws, special ingredients will
also be granted to you.
50358.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
炎王龍の翼爪を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

55102.description: Slaying a Guanzorumu raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55102.descriptionEn:
By slaying Guanzorumu you
raise your own rating and
earn materials needed for
G Rank decorations at a
nice discount—I've set up
the quest for exactly
that. Do make use of it.
55102.descriptionJp:
グァンゾルムを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

55124.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55124.description: I hear a monster called the Stygian Zinogre has been sighted lately. I have a weakness for materials from new monsters. I simply must have them. Would you get them for me? In return I will share Eroded Dragon Insects.
55124.descriptionEn:
Lately there've been
sightings of a monster
called the Stygian Zinogre,
or so I hear. I can't
resist new monster parts.
I simply must have them.
Would you fetch them for
me? I'll share ≪Erosion Dragonbug≫.
55124.descriptionJp:
なんでも最近、獄狼竜と呼ば
れるモンスターが目撃された
そうじゃないか。私は新しい
モンスターの素材に目がなく
てね。どうしても欲しいんだ。
私に代わって取ってきてくれ
ないかね。お礼に≪蝕龍蟲≫
を分けてあげよう。

21706.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
21706.description: Thanks for playing MHF for seven whole years! Equip Sol Oquvia Thorn and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude P as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude P you can forge Shan Luminare (Bow).
21706.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for seven whole years!
Equip ≪Sol Oquvia Thorn≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫
to get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude P≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude
P≫ you can forge ≪Shan
Luminare≫ (Bow).
21706.descriptionJp:
７年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ソルオクヴィアソーン≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると
≪感謝の証P≫を１１枚
プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証P≫から
≪シャンルミナーレ≫（弓）
が生産可能です。

62321.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62321.description: It is I, the Instructor! This is a quest for the Refined Monster trial! Today's target is the Variant Gendrome! I wish to hear how the feel of the fight changed before and after refining!
62321.descriptionEn:
It is I. The Instructor!
This quest is for the
Refine Monster trial!
Today's target is the
≪Iodrome Variant≫!
I want to hear how the
challenge changed before
and after refinement!
62321.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！
これはリファインモンスター
体験会用のクエストである！
今回のターゲットは、
≪ドスゲネポス変種≫だ！
リファインの前と後とで、
手ごたえがどのように変化
したのかお聞かせ願いたい！

62631.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62631.description: I obtained information that there are ruins from ancient times somewhere in the swamp, and stormed in to verify it, but Akura Vashimu lives at the destination and I am stuck. Could you slay that monster? In thanks I will present part of the excavated goods.
62631.descriptionEn:
I learned that ancient ruins
lie somewhere in the Swamp,
so I went in to confirm it,
but a Taikun Zamuza has
made its nest at the site,
and I am at a loss. Could
you please slay that monster
for me? As thanks, I will
present part of my finds.
62631.descriptionJp:
沼地のどこかに太古時代の遺
跡があるとの情報を手に入れ
て、真偽を確かめるために沼
地に乗り込みましたが、目的
地に尾晶蠍が生息していて
困っています。どうか、その
モンスターを退治していただ
けないでしょうか。お礼に発
掘品の一部を進呈いたします。

5003.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラの撃退

62728.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐

54599.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54599.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54599.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me the skill
you honed against the ≪Tigrex≫
in the Desert!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you.
54599.descriptionJp:
双剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61855.description: A gathering request in the Highlands, an untrodden mountain region. Gathering unknown materials in an untrodden land. How about it? Even if not hunting, a hunter would be intrigued, no? Well, go and see.
61855.descriptionEn:
An unexplored mountain range —
the ≪Highlands≫. A gathering
request for unknown materials
from untouched land. Well? Even
without hunting, any Hunter
would be intrigued, no? Try it.
61855.descriptionJp:
未踏の山岳地帯、≪高地≫
での採取依頼だ。未踏の大地
での、未知の素材の採取。
どうだ？ハンターとしては
狩猟でなくても興味津津だろ
う？まぁいってみるといいさ。

40174.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil GS Earring.
40174.descriptionEn:
Here we hand out VISA
production tickets to
hunters who own Gothic
equipment.
Please accept the quest
while wearing the Bail GS
Earring.
40174.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。
ベイルGSイヤリングを装備
した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

61834.description: Oh, you've come. Hunting monsters is fine, but mining is fun too! So, how about testing your mining skill? I want you to gather the ore I'm about to request. The reward will be generous!
61834.descriptionEn:
Hey, glad you came.
Hunting monsters is fine, but
mining is a joy too!
So, how about a test of your
mining skill?
I want you to gather the ore I
am about to ask for.
The pay will be generous!
61834.descriptionJp:
おう、よく来たな。
モンスターを狩るのもいいが、
採掘も楽しいよな！
そこで、採掘の腕試しをして
みないか？
これから依頼する鉱石を集め
てほしい。
報酬は弾むぜ！

21055.description: Hermitaur buried in the sand burst out suddenly. Running around is dangerous, so be careful! They faint when startled by loud noises, so do not forget to bring Sonic Bombs!
21055.descriptionEn:
The Yaozami that lurk in the
sand will burst out without
warning. Running around is
dangerous, so please be careful!
Loud noises stun them, so do not
forget to bring Sonic Bombs
along with you!
21055.descriptionJp:
砂に潜っている≪ヤオザミ≫は
突然飛び出してきます。
走り回っていると危ないので
気をつけてくださいね！
大きな音にびっくりして気絶
するので≪音爆弾≫を忘れずに
もって行ってくださいね！

53145.client: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy
53145.clientEn: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy

23710.description: The Variant Species Gravios has appeared once more. Its developed body not only stores and vents heat, it seems to generate enough to melt rock. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23710.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gravios≫ has
appeared once more.
Its developed body stores heat,
and not only vents it but seems
to grow hot enough to melt
rock.
Please take great care in your
survey.
23710.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪グラビモス≫が再び
現れました。
発達した躰は熱を蓄え、
噴出させるのみならず
岩を熔解するほど発熱させて
いる様です。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

62589.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62589.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62589.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62589.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

61607.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61607.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61607.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

55497.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55497.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55497.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

54455.description: The Guild has granted permission to explore the nighttime bamboo forest, previously off limits. So please help with the ecology survey of the Elegant Elder Dragon. The relationship between Inagami and the bamboo forest remains unexplained. Head there with great care.
54455.descriptionEn:
The Guild has granted permission
to explore the nighttime bamboo
grove that was off-limits until now.
So we ask for your aid in a
survey of the ≪Inagami≫'s ecology.
The bond between Inagami and the
bamboo grove is still unexplained
even after all our past surveys.
Please head for the site with the
utmost caution.
54455.descriptionJp:
ギルドより、これまで立入
禁止だった夜の竹林への探索
許可が下りました。
そこで、≪雅翁龍≫の生態
調査のため、協力をお願いし
ます。イナガミと竹林の関係
は、これまでの調査でも解明
できていません。
十分に注意して現地へ向かっ
てください。

26484.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

23523.description: The Variant Species Rathalos appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Rathalos. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23523.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rathalos≫ seems
to have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Rathalos.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.
23523.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪リオレウス≫は
リオレウスの中でも、頂点に
辿りつくほどの強さに達した
ようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

26038.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26038.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26038.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

12001.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
12001.description: Velocidrome runs off to another area when its stamina runs low and recovers there. It's just the right opponent for gauging a hunter's skill, but this season there are lots of Velociprey minions, so be careful.
12001.descriptionEn:
≪Velocidrome≫ runs off to
the next area when worn
down and heals up.
A good measure of a
hunter's skill, but this
season the Velociprey
are many. So be careful.
12001.descriptionJp:
≪ドスランポス≫は体力を
消耗すると別エリアへ逃げて
体力を回復してしまうわ。
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度いい相手だけど
この季節は、子分のランポス
も多いから注意してね。

63319.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Rajang, then slay the Rajang here in this arena!
63319.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
off their skill! If you're
sure you can handle the
Golden Lion, come and slay
≪Rajang≫ right here!
Show us what you're made of!
63319.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する闘技場！金獅子を
相手に、見事立ち回る自信が
ある者はこの闘技場にて
≪ラージャン≫を討伐
してみせよ！

61867.description: As you know, I am an explorer. I fear no hardship. And hunter, I sense the same scent on you. Even knowing that a difficult job is only the tip of the iceberg on the road to a great ambition, you keep walking without losing your passion! We are both troublesome sorts!
61867.descriptionEn:
As you know, I'm an explorer.
No hardship frightens me.
And Hunter, I smell that
same scent on you.
Even knowing hard work is
only the tip of the iceberg
on the road to a great wish,
we keep walking, passion
unbroken! We're a troublesome pair!
61867.descriptionJp:
知っての通り、俺は探検家だ。
どんな苦労も恐れはしない。
そしてハンターさんよ、同じ
匂いをあんたからも感じるぜ。
高難度の仕事が、大願成就の
ための氷山の一角でしかない
とわかっていても、それでも
情熱を失わずに歩み続ける！
お互いやっかいな性分だな！

55779.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
55779.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Request, we've made this quest to spread the word and drum up support. Breaking the Doragyurosu's head will also earn you special ingredients.
55779.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild
Priority Request, we've made
this quest to spread the word
and drum up support.
Breaking the Doragyurosu's
head will also earn you
special ingredients.
55779.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
冥雷竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

62856.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
62856.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62856.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62856.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

60686.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Midogaron. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60686.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill!
This time's target is
≪Midogaron≫!
Achieve the objective together
with your Guild comrades.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so go take a top placing!
This time it's held with
Supremacy weapons only!
60686.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ミドガロン≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

60629.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Blaststone. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
60629.descriptionEn:
The Popular Tavern Guild has
placed a large order for
Firestones.
Eight is not a number that one
hunter can deliver alone,
so we recommend accepting it
with at least two people.
Note that sub-clears give no supplies.
60629.descriptionJp:
大衆酒場ギルドより、火薬岩
の大口注文が入りました。
８個という数は、１人で取り
きって納品できる数ではない
ので、少なくとも２人以上で
の受注をオススメいたします。
尚、サブ達成による支給品は
ありませんので、要注意です。

21944.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
21944.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gurenzeburu. I am counting on you!
21944.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
They say you hit HR22.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of weapon
materials as the reward?
What, it's an easy one. Just run
out and slay a Gurenzeburu for
me.
I'm counting on you!
21944.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ２２になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってグレンゼブルを討
伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54837.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
54837.description: There has been a sighting of an Espinas Subspecies in the Canyon. Please hunt the target before damage occurs. Take particular care of its especially fierce charging attack!
54837.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of
≪Espinas Subspecies≫ in the
Canyon. Please hunt the target
before harm is done.
Take special care against its
fierce charging attacks!
54837.descriptionJp:
峡谷で≪エスピナス亜種≫
の目撃報告がありました。
被害が出る前に対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
特に強烈な突進攻撃には
注意してください！

21494.description: This is an exchange post only hunters holding a Secret Scroll may enter. Deliver proof of distinguished results in official hunting tournaments and I'll give you materials to further strengthen the arms you won as prizes. You can't get them with half-hearted skill, you know?
21494.descriptionEn:
This is an exchange post only
hunters with a Secret Art book
may enter. Deliver proof of
outstanding results in an
official hunting tournament,
and as a prize I will give you
materials to further upgrade
the gear you have won.
Half-hearted skill will not earn them!
21494.descriptionJp:
ここは秘伝書を持つハンター
にのみ入場が許された交換所
だ。公式狩猟大会で優秀な成
績をおさめたことを証明する
証を納品すれば、賞品として
手に入れた武具を更に強化す
るための素材をやろう。生半
可な実力では手に入れること
はできんぞ？

26483.description: Khezu spends its larval stage underground, so they say its nose is better than its eyes. If hunting the parent is difficult, please trade the Khezu Whelp in the ground with the Vegetable Elder and deliver what you get!
26483.descriptionEn:
≪Khezu≫ spend their larval
stage underground, so they
say their nose beats their
eyes. If hunting the parent
is too hard, trade the
≪Khezu Whelp≫ from under
the ground to the Veggie
Elder and deliver the result!
26483.descriptionJp:
≪フルフル≫ってモンスター
は幼生期を地面の中で過ごす
ため、目よりも鼻が利くと言
われてます。親の狩猟が困難
な場合は地中にいる≪フルフ
ルベビー≫を山菜ジイさんと
交換して、交換後のアイテム
を納品してくださいね！

63022.description: A white suit is the symbol of pure love! I want you to play the White Hunter infiltrating an evil organization's hideout and recreate the scene where he strikes down the gatekeeper. As always, the armor you need will be lent to you. Risk your life, lose to no one, we are the White Hunters! Strike down the evil organization!
63022.descriptionEn:
A white suit is the symbol
of pure love! Go infiltrate
the evil syndicate's base
as the White Hunter and
recreate that scene where
you strike down the guard.
As always, the gear you need
will be lent to you. Risk
your life! Crush the evil gang!
63022.descriptionJp:
白いスーツは純愛の象徴！
悪の組織のアジトに潜入する
ホワイトハンターになりきり、
門番を打ち倒す場面の再現を
お願いします。例によって、
必要な防具は貸し出します。
命を賭けろ、誰にも負けるな、
ボクらのホワイトハンター！
悪の組織を打ち倒せ！

53114.objectiveJp: ハンターバッジ桜１個の納品
53114.description: VSphoenix and MHF-G collaboration memorial. From 11/19 (Thu) to 12/16 (Wed), get an event code at the in-store Paynetcafe of authorized internet cafes across Japan, and collect the four Hunter Badges: white, sakura, yellow and purple. Felyne armor commemorating each region and the national conquest is yours!
53114.descriptionEn:
VSphoenix x MHF-G collab!
From 11/19 (Thu) to 12/16 (Wed),
get an event code at the
Paynetcafe counter in any
official net cafe in Japan
and collect four hunter
badges: white, sakura,
yellow and purple. Get local
and Felyne armor gifts!
53114.descriptionJp:
VSphoenixとMHF-Gコラボ記念
11/19(木)〜12/16(水)の間に
日本全国の公認ネットカフェ
にある店頭Paynetcafeで
イベントコードをゲットし、
４種類のハンターバッジ
白・桜・黄・紫を集めよう。
各ご当地と全国制覇記念の
アイルー防具をプレゼント！

63347.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
63347.description: I found a mysterious navy-blue shining object in the Snowy Mountains, and when I was about to pick it up, the Blango came and interfered from behind, meow! I want you to get rid of them so I can collect it safely, meow! As thanks I will present you with my navy-blue collection, meow!
63347.descriptionEn:
I found a mysterious navy
glowing thing in the Snowy
Mountains, meow! When I tried
to pick it up, the Blango
came and got in my way, meow!
Please clear them out so I
can collect it safely, meow!
I'll gift you my navy set, meow!
63347.descriptionJp:
雪山で紺色に輝く不思議ニャ
物体を見つけて、拾おうとし
ていたら、後ろからブランゴ
達が邪魔してきたニャ！我輩
が安全に収集できるように退
治してきて欲しいニャ！お礼
に我輩の紺色コレクションを
プレゼントするニャ！

23189.description: I thought I would make a warm fur coat so I can go out even when it is cold. I am looking for someone to gather the materials. Ordinary fur will not do. The fur of the Burukku that live in unsurveyed areas would be good. It is said to be of very fine quality. Could I ask you?
23189.descriptionEn:
I want to make a warm fur
