61311.description: Many monsters are breeding in great numbers in the Jungle! We have asked hunters everywhere for help with the hunt, but the truth is there are too many. So we want to recruit those who can set out on this hunt with up to 2 people. I especially recommend it to those aiming to rank up quickly.
61311.descriptionEn:
Monsters are breeding out of
control in the Jungle!
We have asked hunters all over
for help with the hunt, but the
truth is there are simply too
many of them. So we want
hunters who can head out in
pairs. I warmly recommend it to
anyone aiming to rank up fast.
61311.descriptionJp:
密林で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

11076.description: Slay the 8 blue hunters, Velociprey, that use the Jungle as their feeding ground! They are just the right opponent for measuring your skill at the hunt!
11076.descriptionEn:
These blue hunters, ≪Velociprey≫,
treat the Jungle as their feeding
ground. Slay 8 of them!
They are just the right opponents
to measure a hunter's skill!
11076.descriptionJp:
密林をエサ場とする、
青き狩人≪ランポス≫８頭を
討伐してください！
狩人としての狩りの腕前を
計るには丁度よい相手ですよ！

21488.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

50646.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
50646.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Pariapuria on Tide Island! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50646.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Bow, show the skill you
have honed against the
≪Pariapuria≫ of Tidal Island!
If you succeed in hunting it,
you will earn even more
rewards than your daily
efforts bring.
50646.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪呑竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

54916.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
54916.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Gureadomosu, the Water Fortress Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54916.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Water
Fortress Wyvern ≪Gureadomosu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
54916.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、水砦竜
≪グレアドモス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54601.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54601.description: Hunter who would master the Great Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the Desert! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54601.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Great Sword, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.
54601.descriptionJp:
大剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

63313.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63313.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63313.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63313.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

23662.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
23662.description: The Variant Species Doragyurosu appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Doragyurosu. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23662.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Doragyurosu≫
seems to have reached the strength
of the very summit among all
Doragyurosu.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
at challenging the summit are
asked to take on this survey.
23662.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ドラギュロス≫
はドラギュロスの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

23634.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23634.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23634.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show me the skill you
honed against the ≪Tigrex≫ in
the Desert!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you.
23634.descriptionJp:
鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

22113.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
22113.description: A request for hunters who reached HR5, letting you craft and upgrade the recommended Odiba Series Hardcore Armor. Repel Odibatorasu to obtain materials for one piece of the Odiba Series.
22113.descriptionEn:
A request for hunters who
reached HR5, letting you
craft and upgrade the
recommended Odiba Series
≪Hardcore Armor≫. Repel
Odibatorasu to obtain
materials for one piece of
the Odiba Series.
22113.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ５になったハンターにオ
ススメの「オディバシリーズ」
≪剛種防具≫が生産・強化で
きる依頼です。
オディバトラスを撃退すると、
「オディバシリーズ」１部位
分の生産・強化素材が入手で
きます。

61950.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
61950.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been found! This may be a good chance to gather materials! Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! We have limited the number of participants, so you should be able to depart at once!
61950.descriptionEn:
A comparatively weak individual
monster has been discovered!
This may be a good chance to
gather materials! Before it
flees far away, please hurry
and get ready! We have limited
the number of participants, so
you should be able to depart at once!
61950.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が発見されましたよ！
これは、素材を集める良い
チャンスかもしれませんね！
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
参加人数を制限しましたので、
すぐに出発できるはずです！

50866.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50866.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50866.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Tonfa, display the skill you
have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.
50866.descriptionJp:
穿龍棍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61020.objectiveJp: イャンクック６頭の狩猟
61020.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
61020.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.
61020.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。
こちらは祭典の証は必要あり
ません。クエストの達成のみで
様々な報酬が払い出される
ようになっております。

62230.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62230.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This request will help upgrade the Khezu R blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62230.descriptionEn:
If you listen to the voice of
nature, you may gain new ideas
beyond human wisdom.
This request will help you
upgrade the ≪Khezu R≫ armor
for Blademasters. May your
hunting life always remain
rich and fulfilling.
62230.descriptionJp:
大自然の声に耳を傾ければ
人智を超えた新しい着想を
得られるかもしれません。
この依頼は≪フルフルＲ≫の
剣士用防具を強化するために
役立つことでしょう。皆様の
狩猟生活がいつまでも充実
したものでありますように。

54731.description: There is a daily limit on how often it can be taken, but here is a request that lets you get some of the materials needed to upgrade Doragyurosu G Rank gear. Do not miss this chance.
54731.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on how
often it can be taken, but here
is a request that lets you get
some of the materials needed
to upgrade Doragyurosu G Rank
gear. Do not miss this chance.
54731.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、獰竜のＧ級武
具の強化に必要な素材の一部
を入手できる依頼をご紹介し
ます。この機会を逃さぬよう
ご注意ください。

63093.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
63093.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63093.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63093.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

12007.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
12007.description: If you can hunt Yian Kut-Ku, you'll prove you can hold your own even in the Elder Hall. If you have room to spare, try making aged mushrooms too. Put specialty mushrooms in a Maka Pickling Jar and bury it. Simple, yes?
12007.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ and
that proves you can hold
your own even in the
Great Hall. With time to
spare, try aging mushrooms
too: Special Mushrooms in
a ≪Maka Pot≫. Simple, no?
12007.descriptionJp:
≪イャンクック≫を狩猟する
ことができれば、大老殿でも
そこそこやれる証拠ね。
もし余裕があれば熟成キノコ
作りにも挑戦してみてね。
≪マカ漬けの壷≫に特産キノ
コを入れて埋める。簡単よ？

63258.description: The next training is mining in the highlands. Go around the mining points and gather stones and Lone Iron Ore! Suspicious clouds are gathering, so be careful of rain.
63258.descriptionEn:
Your next training is mining
in the Highlands.
Make the rounds of the
mining points and gather
stones and Kotetsu Ore!
Sinister clouds are gathering,
so please watch out for rain.
63258.descriptionJp:
次のトレーニングは、
高地での採掘です。
採掘ポイントを回って、
石ころと孤鉄石を
集めてきてください！
怪しい雲が出ていますので、
雨には気を付けてくださいね。

55850.description: The Variant Species Baruragaru appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Baruragaru. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55850.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Baruragaru
appears to have reached a
strength that borders on the
very summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters sure of their skill are
asked to take on this survey.
55850.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪バルラガル≫は
バルラガルの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

51030.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
51030.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. The reward is rare decoration materials.
51030.descriptionEn:
The ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫, which
had only been sighted now and then,
has expanded its territory to the
areas where people travel. To
prevent further damage, please
hunt the target.
The reward is a rare decoration
material.
51030.descriptionJp:
ときおり目撃されていた
≪照雷鳥≫が、人の通る
辺りまで縄張りを広げて
きました。これ以上の
被害を防ぐため、対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材
です。

54347.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54347.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54347.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

62746.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62746.description: Our interception posture against the exceptionally powerful Rukodiora now closing on the interception base is ready. We have prepared ample supplies and interception weapons, so though this is an extremely dangerous request, any hunter able to prove their skill should head out and slay it.
62746.descriptionEn:
Preparations are complete to
intercept the extremely strong
individual ≪Rukodiora≫ that is
now closing on the ≪Base≫.
We have prepared ample supplies
and interception weapons, so
anyone able to prove their skill
should head out and slay it.
62746.descriptionJp:
現在≪迎撃拠点≫に迫ってい
る≪ルコディオラ≫の極めて
強力な個体に対する迎撃態勢
が整いました。十分な支給品、
迎撃兵器を用意いたしました
ので、極めて危険な依頼です
が、自分の腕を証明できる方
は討伐に向かってください。

56116.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56116.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56116.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

60595.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Gravios. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin and Transcendent weapons only!
60595.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Gravios≫!
Work with your Guild mates
and achieve the objective.
Teamwork is what counts in
this contest, so aim for a
top placing!
Origin & Migration weapons only!
60595.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪グラビモス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は始種・遷悠武器限定
で開催されているぞ！

55710.objectiveJp: セルレギオス１頭の狩猟
55710.description: The Seregios has been sighted at Prismatic Falls as well. Reports say its attacks with blade-like scales are extremely dangerous. Head there at once and hunt it.
55710.descriptionEn:
≪Seregios≫, the Thousand Blade Wyvern,
has been sighted at Prismatic Falls
as well.
We have received reports that its
attacks using blade-like scales are
extremely dangerous.
Please head to the site at once and hunt it.
55710.descriptionJp:
千刃竜≪セルレギオス≫が
彩の滝でも目撃された。
刃の様な鱗を使った攻撃は
非常に危険であると報告を
受けている。
至急、現地へ向かい狩猟
してほしい。

1004.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
1004.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, often shows itself in the Jungle too! It is quite a tough one, so capturing it instead of slaying it might be one option, no? Give it a clever try!
1004.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, the leader of
the Bullfango, ≪Bulldrome≫,
often shows himself!
He is a pretty tough one,
so capturing him instead of
slaying him might be one plan,
eh? Give it a good try!
1004.descriptionJp:
密林にはブルファンゴの長
である≪ドスファンゴ≫が
姿を現すことも多いんだ！
かなりタフなヤツだから、
討伐じゃなくて捕獲しちゃう
のもひとつの手かも知れない
な？うまくやってみてくれ！

60072.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62745.description: An extremely powerful individual Gogomoa has appeared. Also, insect activity in Shiojima increases in the evening. The hunt will surely be harsh. Be careful.
62745.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Gogomoa
individual has appeared.
In addition, we have reports that
insects grow very active on the
Tidal Island in the evening.
There is no doubt this will be
a harsh hunt.
Please be careful out there.
62745.descriptionJp:
ゴゴモアの極めて強力な
個体が現れたそうです。
さらに、潮島の夕方は
虫の活動が活発になるとの
報告もあります。
厳しい狩猟になることは
間違いありません。
気を付けてください。

58130.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58130.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58130.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58130.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

55118.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields G-rank HC materials from 5 to 7 star monsters. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55118.descriptionEn:
For members of Hunter
Festival winning Guilds only,
we have prepared a quest
to obtain ≪G Rank HC
Materials≫ from ★5-7
monsters. When accepting or
joining, bring ≪Festival Heat≫.
55118.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、★５〜７
モンスターの≪Ｇ級ＨＣ素
材≫を獲得できるクエストを
用意させていただきました。
受注、参加時に、≪祭典の
熱気≫をお持ちください。

40232.description: The Black Caster appears to have built a golem modelled on a dragon and is testing it. Its power is immense, and at this rate even uninvolved people may come to harm. Join with the Red Saber, who agreed to cooperate, and stop the damage!
40232.descriptionEn:
The Black Caster appears to
have built a dragon-shaped
golem and is testing it.
Its power is tremendous,
and at this rate unrelated
people may be harmed too.
Join the Red Saber, who has
agreed to cooperate, and
help stop the damage!
40232.descriptionJp:
黒のキャスターが竜を模した
ゴーレムを作り、テストを
行っている様です。
その力は強大で、
このままでは無関係な人間
にも被害が及び兼ねません。
協力に同意してくれた
赤のセイバーと共に被害を
食い止めてください！

61106.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61106.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61106.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61106.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

63228.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63228.description: A very powerful Hypnocatrice that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63228.descriptionEn:
An individual ≪Hypnocatrice≫ of
great strength that behaves
unlike the norm is in the New
Great Arena, and I want it hunted.
This request is open only to
hunters with Secret Art equipment
approved by the Guild.
Clear it splendidly and you will
earn still greater renown as a
master hunter.
63228.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪眠鳥≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

51095.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51095.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of an Azure Rathalos will also grant a special ingredient.
51095.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long carried out,
we have prepared this quest to
spread awareness and promote them
even further.
By destroying the Azure Rathalos'
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51095.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
蒼火竜の頭部を破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

62857.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
62857.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62857.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62857.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

62387.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
62387.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62387.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62387.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

53165.description: It is Miyashita! Play lots of MHF this weekend! [Question 3] The regular event that began with G10.1 is the Songstress Defense Battle. If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53165.descriptionEn:
It's Miyashita!
Play lots of MHF
this weekend!
[Question 3]
The regularly held event
that started in G10.1
is the Diva Guard Battle.
Hunters who think the
answer is x (B) should
accept this quest!
53165.descriptionJp:
宮下だよ！
週末はＭＨＦを
たくさん遊んでね！
【第３問】
Ｇ１０．１からはじまった
定期開催イベントは、
「歌姫守衛戦」である。
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

55913.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Giaorugu through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Lance, Gunlance, Hammer, Tonfa, or Magnet Spike. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55913.descriptionEn:
Producing one Supremacy
Giaorugu weapon grants the
materials for its first
upgrade plus Porta Card
Sakura worth Gz.
Weapon types: Sword and
Shield, Dual Blades, Lance,
Gunlance, Hammer, Tonfa,
Magnet Spike. Please make
good use of this.
55913.descriptionJp:
辿異種ギアオルグの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
片手剣、双剣、槍、銃槍、
鎚、穿龍棍、磁斬鎚
のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

55917.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55917.description: What on earth is happening to them!? Did we push them too far? The Guild has decided to call those shining ones the Deviljho that Devours Extremes. Anyone who succeeds in slaying one will receive the materials for a full set of the Guild's treasured armor and a title! Someone, please!
55917.descriptionEn:
What on earth is happening
to them!? Did we push them too far?
The Guild has decided to call
these shining ones the
'Acme Devouring Deviljho'.
If anyone succeeds in slaying one,
we shall present the materials for
a full set of Guild-hidden armor
and a title! Someone, please!
55917.descriptionJp:
ヤツらに何が起こっているの
だ！？追い込み過ぎたのか？
ギルドでは、光放つヤツらを
「極み喰らうイビルジョー」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐に成功したものがいれば
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！
誰か頼む！

50926.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50926.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50926.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

53301.description: Overwhelming power and heft. A powerful, dependable hammer is the finest weapon of all. Only one who can land blows skillfully even on small opponents is a true hammer master. Now, take on the B-rank Espinas that appeared in the Deep Forest!
53301.descriptionEn:
Overwhelming power and heft.
A powerful, reliable Hammer
is the finest weapon of all.
Only one who can deftly land
blows even on small foes
is a true Hammer Master.
Now, take on the hunt for
a Class B Espinas in the
Great Forest!
53301.descriptionJp:
圧倒的パワーと重厚感。
パワフルで頼りがいのある
鎚こそ至高の武器だよね。
小さき相手にも器用に攻撃を
当てることができる者こそ、
真の鎚マスターさ。
さあ、樹海に現れた
ｂ級エスピナスの狩猟に
挑戦だ！

26212.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
26212.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Bulldrome will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
26212.descriptionEn:
At the Elder Hall Guild request,
we are recommending trial use of
a new sub-target.
The "set damage" dealt to
Bulldrome will be judged by our
guild, so simply focus on
completing the main target.
Good luck out there!
26212.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ドスファンゴ≫への『一定
ダメージ』は、当ギルドで判
断しますので、皆さんはメイ
ンターゲットの達成に専念し
てくだされば結構ですよ！

26117.description: Velociprey is a small carnivorous bird wyvern with blue scales. It moves fast, so until you're used to it your attacks may be hard to land... But a Flash Bomb in its eyes should stop it in its tracks. Don't rush; take it one step at a time.
26117.descriptionEn:
≪Velociprey≫ are small
carnivorous bird wyverns
with blue scales. They're
fast, so hits may be hard
to land at first...
But a Flash Bomb to the
eyes should stop their feet.
Take it slow, step by step.
26117.descriptionJp:
≪ランポス≫は青い鱗を持つ
小型の肉食獣の鳥竜種です。
動きが速くて、なれないうち
は攻撃が当てづらいかも･･･。
でも、閃光玉で目をくらませ
てしまえば、足も止まるはず。
あせらず、一歩ずつがんばっ
ていきましょう。

55514.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55514.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55514.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

23213.description: The female Rathian I have been tracking for my ecological survey has flown off into an area that has not yet been surveyed. I would like to follow her, but I am not permitted to enter that region. Would someone take me along?
23213.descriptionEn:
The Rathian I have been
tracking for a survey has
flown off into a region
we have not surveyed yet.
I would like to follow her,
but I am not permitted to
enter that area.
Would someone take me
along with them?
23213.descriptionJp:
生態調査のために追っている
雌火竜が、まだ調査の進んで
いない未調査地域へ飛んで
行ってしまったんだ。
私としては追いかけたい
ところなのだが、あの地域へ
入ることを許可されていない。
誰か私を連れていってくれ
ないだろうか。

23359.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
23359.description: A request for hunters who possess the Entra G Series. By hunting Iodrome, you can obtain materials to strengthen the Entra GF Series to LV7 for 5 parts. After strengthening, receive your reward from the Hunter Navi.
23359.descriptionEn:
A request for hunters who
own the Entora G Series.
By hunting ≪Gendrome≫,
you can obtain the materials
to upgrade the Entora GF
Series to LV7 for
5 pieces.
After upgrading, please
collect your reward from
the Hunter Navi.
23359.descriptionJp:
「エントラＧシリーズ」を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
≪ドスイーオス≫を狩猟する
ことで、
「エントラGFシリーズ」を
ＬＶ７まで強化する素材が
５部位分入手できます。
強化後は、ハンターナビから
報酬をお受け取り下さい。

62489.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟

23441.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23441.description: This quest yields the following materials. Lance Merit (Beginning) x５０, Lance Merit (Middle) x６０, Lance Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23441.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain the
following materials.
≪Lance Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Lance Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Lance Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you must be
GR500 or above, so please take
care.
23441.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ランス勲・序≫５０個
≪ランス勲・中≫６０個
≪ランス勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

54324.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
54324.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54324.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54324.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

53261.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
53261.description: I love Raviente. Its mountain-like bulk fills me with awe, but my companions do not understand. They go so far as to say that Lao-Shan Lung is big enough too. Wear the armor I have prepared and repel Lao-Shan Lung. I will pay for a head break as well, but you cannot return until you have repelled it.
53261.descriptionEn:
I adore Raviente.
That mountain-like bulk has real
majesty, yet my comrades do not
see it. They only say Lao-Shan
Lung is plenty big as well.
Wear the armor I prepared and
repel Lao-Shan Lung for me.
Breaking its head pays extra, but
you cannot come home until it
flees.
53261.descriptionJp:
私はラヴィエンテが大好きだ。
山の如き巨躯には威厳を感じ
るが、仲間は理解してくれん。
大きさなら老山龍も充分大き
い、などと言い出す始末。
私が用意した防具を身に着け、
老山龍を撃退して欲しい。
頭部破壊でも報酬をだすが、
撃退するまで帰還はできんぞ。

55528.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land, and just when I thought the ecological study was finally done, yet another presence came to light. Having come this far, I want to make my book perfect, so I must ask again.
55528.descriptionEn:
For years I have studied the
King of the Sky and the Queen
of the Land, and just when I
thought their ecology study
was done, an even greater
being came to light.
Having come this far, I want
my tome finished. Help me again.
55528.descriptionJp:
私は長年、空の王と陸の女王
を研究しているものだが、
やっとのことで生態の研究が
終わったと思ったら、更なる
存在が明らかになってね。
ここまで来たら、私も書物を
完璧なものに仕上げたいので
また今回も頼むよ。

62330.description: Hey hey! I was invited by a Guild person to come to Mezeporta, but monsters are in the way and I cannot get through! You skilled hunter there, do something! I will give you my treasure as thanks.
62330.descriptionEn:
Hey, hey!
The Guild folks invited me to
come to Mezepolta, but some
monsters are in the way and I
simply cannot get through!
You there, skilled hunter,
do something about it!
I'll give you my treasure as a
reward, so come on!
62330.descriptionJp:
ちょっとちょっと！
ギルドの人からメゼポルタへ
来るようにって招待されたん
だけど、モンスターが邪魔で
通れないんですけどぉ！
そこの腕利きのハンターさん、
なんとかしなさいっ！
お礼にあたしの宝物をあげる
からさ。

63336.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that guarantees an Armorer's Soul: Wonder. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63336.descriptionEn:
For members of Hunter Festival
winning Guilds only, we have a
quest that surely gets you a
≪Gear Smith Soul [Rare]≫.
When accepting or joining,
please bring a Festival Proof.
63336.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪武具職
人魂【奇】≫が確実に手に入
るクエストを用意させていた
だきました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

55477.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55477.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55477.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

26409.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26409.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26409.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

55795.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55795.description: This is my final trial for you. Slay the Zenith Rukodiora with the Magnetic Slash Hammer! You cannot bind it with magnetism, but if you truly master the hammer, you have a chance. Clear it and there is nothing left to teach you. As proof of graduation I will give you the fine upgrade material for that hammer!
55795.descriptionEn:
This is my final trial.
Slay the Supremacy
Rukodiora with a Magnet
Spike! You cannot bind it
with magnetism, but if you
truly master the Spike, you
have a chance. Succeed and
I have nothing left to teach.
Take these fine upgrade mats!
55795.descriptionJp:
これが俺からの最後の試練だ。
磁斬鎚で辿異種ルコディオラ
を討伐してみせろ！
磁力で縛ることはできんが、
真に磁斬鎚を使いこなせれば
勝機はある。達成できたなら
もう教えることはない。
卒業の証にあの素晴らしい
磁斬鎚の強化素材を贈ろう！

61176.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61176.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61176.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

22086.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ５ and above.
22086.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass found in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain
regions of the land, we offer
our guidance only to those of
HR5 or above.
22086.descriptionJp:
近年発見されたセンショク草
は、自然を熟知した熟練者で
なければ真贋を見極めること
ができない、レアな一品です。
特定の地域でのみ見られる草
なので、ＨＲ５以上の方に
限ってご案内させていただ
いております。

10009.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
10009.description: The Guild's trial has come! Show them how much you have grown since you came to this town! Treat it as your graduation exam and do your best!
10009.descriptionEn:
Hey, a trial has come
from the Guild! Show
how much you have grown
since you came to this town!
Treat it as your graduation
test and give it your all!
10009.descriptionJp:
さぁギルドから試練がきたよ！
アンタがこの街に来てから
どれだけ成長したかを見せ
つけてやりな！
卒業試験だと思って、がんばる
んだよ！

62853.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62853.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of zenny and Supremacy Tickets! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62853.descriptionEn:
An urgent notice to all hunters!
On top of the training method
for gaining experience fast, you
can now get piles of Zenny and
Hardcore Tickets!
You cannot take it back to back,
but a single run's effect is
enormous!
May your daily training become
great strength for you!
62853.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法に加え、今なら
大量のゼニーと剛種チケット
が入手できます！
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

40194.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40194.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40194.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40194.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

62655.description: My Guku is lovely! That child's room is lovely too! If you want to be surrounded by lovely goods and dream sweet dreams, I will help. Play with a cute kitten and let your sense explode, and a lovely blueprint is complete!
62655.descriptionEn:
My Gook is lovely!
Her room is lovely too!
If you want to be surrounded
by lovely goods and see
wonderful dreams, I will help.
Play with a cute kitten and
let your sense explode, and
a lovely blueprint is done!
62655.descriptionJp:
わたしのグークはラブリー！
あの子のお部屋もラブリー！
ラブリーグッズに囲まれて
素敵な夢を見たいなら、
わたしが協力してあげる。
キュートな子猫と戯れて、
センスを爆発させたなら、
素敵な図面のできあがり！

54270.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
54270.description: For the survey, would you hunt a Diablos for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to break the horns and sever the tail. They are extremely dangerous and get in the way of the survey. A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break the parts!
54270.descriptionEn:
Could you hunt a Diablos
for my survey?
Oh, I forgot something
important. Be sure to break
its horns and cut off its
tail. They are extremely
dangerous and get in the
way of the survey.
Hunting alone will not count,
so break the parts for sure!
54270.descriptionJp:
調査のために、ディアブロス
の狩猟をしてきてくれないか。
そうだ、大事なことを忘れて
いた。必ず角の破壊と尻尾の
切断をしておいてくれ。
非常に危険で調査の邪魔
になるんだ。狩猟のみでは
認めないからな。
必ず部位破壊をしておいてく
れよ！

63402.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
63402.description: I will show you what happens when I, the boss of the Dark Cat Gang, get serious, meow! Try to defeat that scary monster I tamed, with a year's supply of my favourite ○○○○ food as the condition, meow. If you beat it, I might even give you a Dark Cat Gang Badge, meow!
63402.descriptionEn:
I will show you what happens
when the boss of the Dark
Cat Gang gets serious, meow!
Defeat that scary monster I
tamed with a year of my
favorite ○○○○ food, meow.
If you do, I might even give
you the ≪Dark Cat Gang Badge≫,
meow!
63402.descriptionJp:
闇猫団のボスたるワガハイが
本気になるとどうなるか
見せてやるミャ！
ワガハイの大好物である
○○○○フード１年分を
条件に手懐けたあのコワい
モンスターを倒してみろミャ。
倒せたら≪闇猫団バッチ≫を
くれてやってもいいミャ！

15022.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
15022.description: This official hunting exam has 3 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! The Elder Dragon Kushala Daora is in a class apart from the monsters so far! I believe in your strength!
15022.descriptionEn:
This official hunting test has
3 parts! To check your skill
once more, you must hunt
every monster we specify!
The Elder Dragon Kushala
Daora is on another level
from any monster so far!
I believe in your strength!
15022.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
３つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
古龍クシャルダオラは今まで
のモンスターとは別格じゃ！
オヌシの力を信じておるぞ！

54992.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
54992.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Tonfa, show the skill you
have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena! Hunt it well and you
shall earn even more rewards
than your daily efforts
bring.
54992.descriptionJp:
穿龍棍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

40201.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Veil GP Earring.
40201.descriptionEn:
We are handing out VISA
production tickets to
hunters who own Gothic
equipment.
Please accept the quest
while you have the Bail GP
Earring equipped.
40201.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。
ベイルGPイヤリングを装備
した状態で、クエスト
を受注してください。

55781.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
55781.description: For the G Rank Guild Priority requests, we have prepared this quest to raise even more awareness and support. Breaking the Harudomerugu's head will also grant you a special ingredient.
55781.descriptionEn:
For the G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we have prepared
this quest to raise even more
awareness and support.
Breaking the Harudomerugu's
head will also grant you a
special ingredient.
55781.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
司銀龍の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

11088.description: The fish that live in the hunting grounds are essential materials for mixing bullets! So that you can respond calmly when the moment comes, train your sense for fishing until your body remembers it! The moment to reel in is when the float sinks deep!
11088.descriptionEn:
Fish living in the hunting grounds
are vital ingredients for
≪Bullet Combining≫!
Let's train your body to feel the
rhythm of fishing, so you can
react calmly when the moment comes!
When the float sinks deep, that's
your moment to reel it in!
11088.descriptionJp:
狩り場に生息する魚は≪弾の
調合≫にとって欠かせない素
材です！いざという時に慌て
ず対応できるように、釣りの
感覚を体に覚えさせておきま
しょう！
ウキが深く沈んだ時が釣りあ
げるタイミングですよ！

55821.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55821.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55821.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55821.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

61605.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

50514.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟

62563.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62563.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Break the designated parts of a monster and slay it together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62563.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds between you all,
I have prepared a difficult request
for you. You are to break the
specified parts of a monster and slay it
together with your Guild companions.
No supply items will be provided at all,
so discuss it with your companions
beforehand and then depart.
Your reward shall be a special ore!
62563.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。モンスターの
指定部位の破壊と討伐を、
猟団の仲間と行うのだ。
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

21222.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
21222.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21222.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21222.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26524.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26524.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26524.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26524.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

50772.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50772.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of an Akura Jebia will also grant a special ingredient.
50772.descriptionEn:
To spread word of the Guild
Priority requests we have long
run, we have prepared this
quest for you.
Sever the tail of the Akura
Jebia, and a special ingredient
will be granted to you as well.
50772.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
灰晶蠍の尻尾を切断すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54873.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
54873.description: It has been a long time. When did I last forge your Brown Thorn Blade? Now, obtain the material said to come from only one in thousands of Espinas Subspecies, and release its true power.
54873.descriptionEn:
It has been a long while.
When did I last forge your
"Brown Thorn Long Sword"?
Now, go and take the material
said to come from only one
among thousands of Espinas
Subspecies, and unleash
the true power within it.
54873.descriptionJp:
久方振りだな。
最後にお主の「棘茶ノ太刀」
を鍛えたのはいつであったか。
さあ、幾千もの棘茶竜の中で
１頭からしかとれないと
いわれる素材を手に入れて、
その真の力を解放するがいい。

50183.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50183.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. Complete it and we will present you with a variety of materials. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50183.descriptionEn:
This request is only for those
belonging to a winning Hunter
Festival guild.
Clear the request and we will
present you with a variety of
materials. Please bring your
Festival Proof when accepting
or joining.
50183.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用の依頼をご用
意させていただきました。
依頼を達成していただけます
と、様々な素材を進呈させて
いただきます。受注、参加時
に、祭典の証をお持ちくださ
い。

11026.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
11026.description: Diablos is a monster whose ferocity in the desert ecosystem stands in a class of its own! Caught by its charge, you would take damage you could never recover from. Break even just the horns and I will pay a bonus!
11026.descriptionEn:
≪Diablos≫ is a monster of
unmatched violence in the
desert ecosystem! Get hit
by its charge and you'd
take damage you'd never
recover from. Break even
one horn and we'll pay!
11026.descriptionJp:
≪ディアブロス≫は砂漠の
生態系において、他の生物と
は別格の強暴さを誇るモンス
ターです！突進にはねられた
ら再起不能のダメージを受け
てしまうでしょう。角だけで
も、折れば報酬を払います！

60411.description: The sea of trees is still an unexplored land. Rather than heading straight out to hunt, how about exploring first? Please find just 1 Chipped Shell from the den of a certain monster said to be in this land, and deliver it. If you have time to spare, do the sub-target too.
60411.descriptionEn:
The Great Forest is still
unexplored land. Instead of
rushing off to hunt, why not
start with some exploration?
Find just 1 ≪Chipped Shell≫ in
the nest of a monster said to
live here and deliver it.
Do the sub-target too if you can.
60411.descriptionJp:
樹海はまだまだ未開の地です。
いきなり狩りに出かけないで、
まずは探索でもどうでしょう？
この地にあると言われている、
あるモンスターのねぐらから
≪かけた貝殻≫を１つだけ
見つけて納品してください。
余裕があればサブもどうぞ。

50133.description: A challenge from us, the Dark Cat Gang, meow. Hunting water and poison 2 at once, meow! This is a serious contest with the Dark Cat Gang Medal, our pride, on the line, meow! Take it to heart, meow!!
50133.descriptionEn:
A challenge from the Dark
Cat Gang, meow! Hunt two
at once, water and poison!
This is a serious match
with our pride, the ≪Dark
Cat Gang Medal≫, on the line!
50133.descriptionJp:
我々闇猫団からの挑戦状ニャ。
水と毒の２頭同時狩猟ニャ！
これはオレたち闇猫団の誇り
である≪闇猫団メダル≫を
賭けた真剣勝負ニャ！
心して受けて欲しいニャ！！

54159.description: We continue the investigation of Giaorugu, predator of the extreme cold sea. Breaking parts is not mandatory, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, please lend us your help!
54159.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of
the Polar Sea predator,
Giaorugu.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we would be
glad if you did!
Hunters, please lend a hand!
54159.descriptionJp:
極海の捕食者、ギアオルグの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

58015.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の狩猟
58015.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58015.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58015.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

26349.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26349.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26349.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

21121.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ２頭の狩猟

50384.description: We have received reports that Forokururu has appeared in the Flower Field. Its great beauty leads surveyors to compare it to a huge flower. But it is still a dangerous monster. Head there at once and secure the area.
50384.descriptionEn:
We received a report that a
≪Forokururu≫ has appeared in
the Flower Field. Its great
beauty leads surveyors to
compare it to a giant flower.
However, that does not change
the fact that it is a
dangerous monster.
Head to the site at once and
secure the area.
50384.descriptionJp:
花畑に≪フォロクルル≫が
現れたとの報告が届きました。
その非常に美しい姿から、
調査員の間では、大きな花に
例えられることもあるようで
す。しかし、危険な
モンスターであることには
変わりありません。
直ちに、現地へ向かい安全を
確保してください。

50086.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
50086.description: This is a rush job. Slay the Akura Jebia as the job requires. Sorry to rush you, but for your sake I will carve at least two Akura Jebia Blood Crystals. I will show you the secrets of a master carver.
50086.descriptionEn:
This is a bit of a rush job.
Slay the ≪Akura Jebia≫ just
as the request says.
Sorry for rushing you, but
for your sake I will carve at
least 2 ≪Akura Jebia Blood
Crystals≫ myself.
I will show you a carver's art!
50086.descriptionJp:
ちょっち急ぎの仕事なんだ。
≪灰晶蠍≫を依頼内容通りに
討伐してほしい。
急げなんて勝手言って悪いが、
あんたらのために、
≪灰晶蠍の血晶石≫を最低
でも２個剥ぎ取ってやるよ。
剥ぎ職の極意、見せてやるぜ。

55020.description: You found this job well! I am a genius! I have developed a new weapon not found in Mezeporuta. If you want to know the secret, complete as many hidden jobs as you can. However, you must always complete at least the main target. I wish you success!
55020.descriptionEn:
You found this request — well done!
I am a genius! I've developed
a new weapon that Mezeporta
never had. If you wish to know
this secret, complete as many
hidden requests as you can.
However, at the very least you
must complete the main target.
I wish you good fortune!
55020.descriptionJp:
よくぞこの依頼を見つけた！
ワシは天才じゃ！メゼポルタ
には無かった新しい武器を開
発したぞい。この秘密を知り
たくば、隠された依頼をでき
るだけ多く達成することじゃ。
ただし、最低でも必ずメイン
ターゲットは達成しなければ
ならぬぞ。健闘を祈る！

60553.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Chameleos. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60553.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Chameleos≫!
Work with your Guild mates
and achieve the objective.
Teamwork is what counts in
this contest, so aim for a
top placing!
Origin weapons only this time!
60553.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪オオナズチ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

63286.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63286.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63286.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63286.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

50667.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Artela series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50667.descriptionEn:
This quest gives materials to
craft and upgrade one piece
of the ≪Hardcore Armor≫
Artera Series.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
Superior Ticket will be
consumed, so be careful.
50667.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
アルテラシリーズの１部位分
の生産、強化素材が入手でき
ます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

60546.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
60546.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Doragyurosu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60546.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Doragyurosu≫!
Hunting alone shows truly
admirable spirit! Overcome
yourself and reach the top!
60546.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ドラギュロス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

21101.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
21101.description: Diablos is a violent monster whose strength in the desert ecosystem stands in a class of its own. Caught by that charge, you'd take damage you could never recover from. Break its horns and victory looks within reach.
21101.descriptionEn:
≪Diablos≫ is a violent
monster of unmatched power
in the desert ecosystem.
Get caught by that charge
and the damage will end
you. Break its horns and
you'll have a chance.
21101.descriptionJp:
≪ディアブロス≫は砂漠の
生態系において、他の生物
とは別格の強さを誇る強暴な
モンスターよ。あの突進に
はねられたら再起不能のダメ
ージを受けてしまう。角を折
れれば勝機はありそうね。

55743.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55743.description: The Variant Species Anorupatisu has appeared once more. Its developed horns have grown firmer still, and hold the destructive power to split the thick ice of the polar sea with ease. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55743.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Anorupatisu has
appeared once more.
Its developed horns have grown
far tougher, and hold power
enough to split the thick ice of
the Polar Sea with ease.
Please take every care in your
survey.
55743.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アノルパティス≫が
再び現れました。
発達した角はより強固となり、
分厚い極海の氷を容易に割る
ほどの破壊力を秘めています。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

62207.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の討伐
62207.description: There are reports of a Lavasioth Subspecies in the volcano far stronger than usual. We want to study its ecology, so bring back anything that might serve as a sample when you slay it. Should a rare material turn up, it is yours.
62207.descriptionEn:
There are reports of a Lavasioth
stronger than usual in the
Volcano. We want to study its
ecology, so while you slay it,
please bring back anything that
could serve as a sample.
If something rare turns up, it
is yours to keep.
62207.descriptionJp:
火山で、通常よりも強力な
≪ヴォルガノス亜種≫の目撃
報告があります。生態を調査
したいので、討伐のついでに
何かサンプルになるようなも
のを取ってきてください。
万が一、何か珍しい素材が
取れたら差し上げますよ。

26148.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26148.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26148.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

23229.description: In an old tower few people know, a Rathalos has recently taken up residence and we are in trouble. If we cannot gather there, daily life becomes hard. Could you drive it off somehow?
23229.descriptionEn:
An old tower few people know
about has a Rathalos that
moved in recently, and it is
a problem. If we cannot go
there to gather, our daily
life suffers.
Could you chase it off
somehow?
23229.descriptionJp:
みんながあまり知らない
古い塔に、最近火竜が
住みついて困っているんだ。
あそこに採取に行けないと、
普段生活するのに困って
しまうんだ。
どうにかあいつを
追い払ってくれないか？

54138.description: Do you have enough Ｇｚ? In this request, introduced today, you can earn a hefty reward just by doing the same hunting as always. However, note that it cannot be taken consecutively.
54138.descriptionEn:
Are you short on ≪Gz≫?
With today's request, you
only do the same hunting as
always and earn a hefty
reward for it.
However, it cannot be
accepted in succession, so
please keep that in mind.
54138.descriptionJp:
≪Ｇｚ≫は足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
いつもと同じ狩猟をこなして
いただくだけで、高額な報酬
が獲得できます。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

62279.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
62279.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62279.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62279.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

62018.description: Hunters who have been watching 'Muttering'! Miiko saw something outrageous at the New Great Arena, nya. I'll show you the way, so follow me, nya!
62018.descriptionEn:
Hunter who has been watching
the Whispers! Miiko saw
something incredible at the
New Great Arena, meow. I will
guide you, so follow me, meow!
62018.descriptionJp:
「ツブヤキ」に注目していた
ハンターさん！ミーコは新大
闘技場でとんでもないのを見
てしまったニャ。案内するか
らついてきてニャ！

62358.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の討伐
62358.description: You were a great help in the sea of trees! By the way, lately a luminescent phenomenon has been sighted in the canyon, it seems. We intend to go and investigate too, but our preparations will take a little time. If you go and see how it is, I will give you materials to further upgrade the cool bow!
62358.descriptionEn:
Thanks for your help in the
Great Forest! By the way,
lately a glowing phenomenon
has been sighted in the
Canyon. We want to go
survey it, but prep will
take a little time.
If you go check it out, I
will give you cool Bow mats!
62358.descriptionJp:
樹海では世話になったな！
ところで最近、峡谷のほうで
発光現象が目撃されているら
しい。我々も調査に向かおう
と思うのだが、準備に少し
時間がかかる。
もし様子を見てきてくれたら、
クールな弓をさらに強化
できる素材を贈るぞ！

21652.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
21652.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Boron Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21652.descriptionEn:
A memo said to be lost, one that
records the secret of crafting
gear, is being found on monsters
slain all over, I hear!
Get your hands on a ≪Borron
Memo≫ and come to this workshop
boss, man to man!
I'll show you some good work!
21652.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ボロンメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50224.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・四章１個の納品

51045.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Basarios will also grant a special ingredient.
51045.descriptionEn:
We have long been running the
Guild Priority Requests, and to
spread awareness and promote
them we have prepared this
quest for you.
By breaking the Basarios'
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51045.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
岩竜の胸部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

64553.description:
10 years ago a team of
hunters went to the gorge
to end the most fearsome
time that we had!
Now it's back again, you
must clear this task!
Good luck Hunter!

15005.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! First, take on the hunt for the Congalala that use the jungle as their feeding ground! Do your best!
15005.descriptionEn:
This official hunting test has
4 parts! To check your skill
once more, you must hunt
every monster we specify!
First, take on the Congalala
that use the Jungle as
their feeding ground!
Give it your best!
15005.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
４つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
まず初めは密林をエサ場とし
ておる桃毛獣たちの狩猟に臨
むのじゃ！頑張るのじゃぞ！

55903.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55903.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55903.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

26615.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26615.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26615.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

55564.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55564.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn a reward far beyond the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
55564.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Tonfa, show the skill you
have honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ of the Desert!
If you succeed in hunting it,
you will earn rewards far
beyond what your daily
efforts bring.
55564.descriptionJp:
穿龍棍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

61117.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61117.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61117.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

54149.description: We will continue the survey of Midogaron, the lone wolf of the volcano. Breaking its parts is not required, but we would be delighted if you did! Hunters, we thank you for your help!
54149.descriptionEn:
We will continue the survey of that
lone wolf of the Volcano, Midogaron.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you did!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid!
54149.descriptionJp:
火山の一匹狼、ミドガロンの
調査を、引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

62957.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62957.description: According to a certain document, there are other special ores as well. Again there is no description of how to mine it, but it is recorded as having been found in the desert. Perhaps it can be obtained when you are lured out by something and meet it, as before.
62957.descriptionEn:
According to a certain text,
there seem to be other
special ores as well.
Again there is no record of
how to mine it, but it is
recorded as found in the Desert.
Perhaps it can be obtained
when something leads you to it.
62957.descriptionJp:
ある文献によると、他にも
特殊な鉱石があるらしい。
やはり採掘方法の記述はない
が、砂漠で見つけたと記録
されている。
またもや、何かへ誘われて
出会った時に入手できるのか
もしれない。

53045.description: We have information that a book for solving the riddle set in the Swamp is hidden inside the Ancient Tower. To obtain it, one must climb to the top of the tower and play a tone that draws monsters, or so it seems. Hunters, we ask you to investigate.
53045.descriptionEn:
We received word that a book
for solving the riddle set
in the Swamp is hidden in
the Ancient Tower.
Apparently, to get the book,
you must climb to the top of
the Ancient Tower and play a
tune that draws monsters in.
Hunters, please investigate.
53045.descriptionJp:
古塔の中に沼地に仕掛けられ
た謎を解くための本が隠され
ているとの情報を得ました。
なんでも、その本を入手する
には、古塔の頂上に昇り、
モンスターを引き付ける音色
を奏でることが鍵となるよう
です。ハンターの皆さん、
調査をお願いします。

62744.description: An exceptionally powerful individual of the Tide Island Gogomoa has been found. The hunt will be harsh on an island we still know little about, so we ask that only hunters able to prove their skill take on the survey and hunt!
62744.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful individual
of the Tidal Island's leaping
beast ≪Gogomoa≫ has been found.
Info on the Tidal Island is
still scarce and the hunt is
harsh, so this is limited to
Hunters who can prove their skill!
62744.descriptionJp:
潮島の跳緋獣≪ゴゴモア≫の
極めて強力な個体が発見され
ました。まだ情報も少ない
潮島での過酷な狩猟である
ため、腕前の証明ができる
ハンターさん限定での調査、
狩猟をお願いします！

21869.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21869.description: This quest raises your standing as a hunter by a wide margin. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21869.descriptionEn:
This quest raises a hunter's
standing by a wide margin.
Accepting the quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
Note that if the quest fails,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will
be consumed.
Please keep that
in mind.
21869.descriptionJp:
本クエストは、ハンターとし
ての評価が格段に上昇する
クエストです。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61866.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

22129.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22129.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
22129.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Long
Sword, show us the skill you have
honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
22129.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

63270.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63270.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63270.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63270.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

20005.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン亜種１体の撃退
20005.description: A giant dragon with grey hide like rock has invaded the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma! Use the fortress interception equipment to the fullest and repel it! Those whose strength is insufficient should ride the rock mountain dragon's back, obtain Dragon Drug Stones and put them in the delivery box!
20005.descriptionEn:
A giant dragon, grey as rock,
seems to be invading the
≪Fortress≫, gateway to Dundorma!
Make full use of its intercept
gear and repel it! Those short
on strength should ride its back,
obtain ≪Dragon Medicine Stones≫
and put them in the delivery box!
20005.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマへの玄関口となる
≪砦≫に灰色の体色をした岩
のような巨龍が侵攻してきた
ようじゃ！砦の迎撃設備を最大
限に活用し撃退するのじゃ！
戦力の及ばぬ者は岩山龍の背
に乗り≪龍薬石≫を入手して
納品ＢＯＸに納めるのじゃ！

55544.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55544.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn a reward far beyond the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
55544.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Sword and Shield, show
the skill you have honed
against the ≪Tigrex≫ of the
Desert! If you succeed in
hunting it, you will earn
rewards far beyond what your
daily efforts bring.
55544.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

60544.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
60544.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Doragyurosu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60544.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Doragyurosu≫!
Hunting alone shows truly
admirable spirit! Overcome
yourself and reach the top!
Also, this time it is SP
weapons only, so choose well!
60544.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ドラギュロス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50756.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50756.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50756.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50756.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

63396.objectiveJp: クアルセプス２頭の狩猟
63396.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of 2 extremely powerful Kuarusepusu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63396.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We are seeking someone
to exterminate 2 extremely
powerful ≪Kuarlusepusu≫.
If you hunt them well, we
will issue more proofs of
slay than usual!
63396.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪クアルセプス≫の個体を２
頭退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に狩猟で
きましたら、普段よりも多め
の討伐の証を発行いたしま
しょう！

21176.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
21176.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21176.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21176.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

23693.description: Hunter who would master the heavy gun, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23693.descriptionEn:
You who would master the Heavy
Bowgun, show the skill you have
honed against the
Blood-Drinking Wyvern of the New
Great Arena!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn far more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
23693.descriptionJp:
重銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

21880.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21880.description: A request that lets you craft the Kukubo Series, armor recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and you will obtain the crafting materials for all 5 pieces of the Kukubo Series, plus upgrade materials up to LV5. May it serve you well in your hunting life.
21880.descriptionEn:
A request that lets you craft
the Kukubo Series, armor
recommended for rookie
hunters.
Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku to get
crafting materials for all 5
Kukubo pieces and upgrade
materials up to LV5.
Please make good use of it.
21880.descriptionJp:
初心者ハンターにオススメの
防具「ククボシリーズ」が
生産できる依頼です。
イャンクックを狩猟すると、
「ククボシリーズ」５部位分
の生産素材と、ＬＶ５までの
強化素材が入手できます。
今後の狩猟生活にぜひお役立
てください。

55040.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
55040.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! It has been a while! The marriage-seeking monster that hates June brides is on a rampage! It is amazing, it is already in its final form! It has become thoroughly twisted and flowers are blooming! Now, hunters! Be careful in various ways!
55040.descriptionEn:
It's Sasatto, defender of
love and peace! Long time!
The marriage-hunting monster
that hates June brides is on
a rampage! Amazing, it is
already in its final form!
It has gotten so twisted that
flowers are blooming!
Now, hunters, watch your step!
55040.descriptionJp:
恋人達の愛と平和を守る
怪傑ササットだ！久々だ！
ジューンブライドを憎悪する
婚活モンスターが大暴走だ！
すごいぞ、もう最終形態だ！
いろいろとこじらせて
お花が咲いている！
さあ、ハンター諸君！
いろいろ気をつけろよ！

60047.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

23432.description: Information has come in that Rukodiora was encountered during the survey of White Lake. It appears far more ferocious than previous individuals and to display movements not found in our research records. We ask for further investigation before danger reaches those nearby.
23432.descriptionEn:
Information has come in that a
Rukodiora was encountered during
the survey of White Lake.
This one seems far more vicious
than past individuals, and even
showed movements not found in
our records. Before the danger
spreads, we ask for a further
survey.
23432.descriptionJp:
白湖の調査中にルコディオラ
と遭遇したという情報が入っ
てきました。どうやら、今ま
での個体よりも格段に狂暴で、
研究資料にない動きも見せて
いたようです。周囲に危険が
及ぶ前に、さらなる調査を依
頼します。

26491.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
26491.description: The Shogun Ceanataur apparently uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling! If the hunt proves difficult, hunting the Gabras that flit about the crater this season to obtain precious food ingredients comes recommended!
26491.descriptionEn:
The Sickle Crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
apparently uses its strange leg
joints to climb all the way to
the ceiling! If the hunt proves
difficult, we also recommend
slaying the ≪Gabras≫ that flit
around the crater this season to
obtain valuable foodstuffs!
26491.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登るらしいです！
狩猟が困難な場合、この季節
火口付近を飛び回る≪ガブラ
ス≫を討伐して、貴重な食材
を入手するのもお勧めです！

61969.description: Hey, hunter. Lately the Hunters Guild is said to be recruiting hunters to capture a Gravios in the arena. The condition is to be equipped with a Light Bowgun or Heavy Bowgun. Of course you will join?
61969.descriptionEn:
Excuse me, hunter. I hear the
Hunters Guild is looking for
hunters to capture a
≪Gravios≫ in the Arena. The
condition is a Light or Heavy
Bowgun. Of course you'll
join, right?
61969.descriptionJp:
ちょっとそこのハンターさん。
最近、ハンターズギルドが闘
技場で≪グラビモス≫を捕獲
するハンターを募集している
らしいの。
参加条件はライトボウガンか
ヘビィボウガンを装備してい
ることらしいわ。
当然、参加するよね？

21698.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
21698.description: The fortress guard reports that Lao-Shan Lung is advancing. Hunters, head for the fortress at once and repel it. You may use the fortress's equipment freely. Make the most of it in battle.
21698.descriptionEn:
Word has come from the fort's
guards that Lao-Shan Lung is
advancing on us. Hunters, go to
the fort at once and intercept it.
You may use the fort's facilities
freely. Make the fullest use of
them and turn them to your
advantage in battle.
21698.descriptionJp:
老山龍ラオシャンロンが侵攻
してきていると砦の警備兵か
ら連絡が届いています。ハン
ターの皆さんは直ちに砦へ向
かいこれを迎撃してください。
砦の設備は自由に使って構い
ません。最大限に活用し戦い
に役立ててください。

50778.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50778.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Red Shadow will also grant a special ingredient.
50778.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the head and torso
of the Red Shadow, we will also
grant you special ingredients.
50778.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
赤影の頭と胴を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

40140.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
40140.description: In this quest you can obtain one of the production tickets for two kinds of special dual blades: 'S Pallinjager Chacha' and 'S Pallinjager Strawberry'. Take the quest while holding 3 Pari Fuwa Fruits.
40140.descriptionEn:
This quest gives you one of
two special Dual Blades
production tickets.
S Parringer Chacha
S Parringer Berryberry
Please accept it while holding
3 ≪Parifuwa Berries≫.
40140.descriptionJp:
このクエストでは、２種類の
特別な双剣の生産券のうち
どれかひとつを入手できます。
「Sパリンジャー茶茶」
「Sパリンジャー苺苺」
≪パリふわの実≫３個を所持
して受注してください。

62352.description: You want my ice, meow? But I do not give it easily, meow! I only sell to amazing hunters who clear my trial, meow! Show me your skill and I will give you the right to buy my ice, meow!
62352.descriptionEn:
You want my ice cream, meow?
But I won't hand it out
easy, meow! I only sell to
amazing hunters who can
clear my trial!
If you show me your skill,
I will give you the right to
buy my ice, meow!
62352.descriptionJp:
ウチのアイスが欲しいの
ニャ？でも簡単にはやらない
ニャ！ウチの試練を見事に乗
りこえられたすごいハンター
にしか売らないニャ！
アンタが実力を示してくれた
ら、ウチのアイスを買う権利
をやろう、だニャ！

22011.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
22011.description: The Bulldrome, leader of the Bullfango, often shows itself in the Jungle! It is quite a tough opponent, so rather than slaying it, capturing it with a Shock Trap is also an effective approach!
22011.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, the Bullfango
leader ≪Bulldrome≫ often shows
itself!
It is a fairly tough foe, so
