rather than slaying it, using a
≪Shock Trap≫ and capturing it
is also an effective option!
22011.descriptionJp:
密林にはブルファンゴの長
である≪ドスファンゴ≫が
姿を現すことが多いです！
かなりタフな相手なので、
討伐ではなく≪シビレ罠≫
などを使い捕獲してしまう
のも有効な手段ですよ！

21678.objectiveJp: 冥雷竜の堅殻３個の納品
21678.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Nether Thunder Dragon's Hard Shell you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
21678.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon but
I lack the materials! Like this
I can't go out hunting. Trade me
the ≪Dark Thunder Wyvern Shell≫
you have for this
≪Pawprint Medal≫! Please!
21678.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいが素材が足
りない！これでは狩りに出ら
れない。キミが持っている
≪冥雷竜の堅殻≫を、この
≪肉球のメダル≫と交換して
くれ！頼む！

50070.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
50070.description: The limited-time Golden Week Festival special quest is a bargain quest where you can get plenty of HRP and Porta Tickets (Sakura). Note that a Golden Week Ticket is required to accept the quest.
50070.descriptionEn:
This limited-time GW Festival
special quest is a great deal,
giving plenty of HRP and
Porta Ticket Sakura.
Note that accepting the quest
requires a ≪GW Ticket≫, so
please be careful.
50070.descriptionJp:
期間限定のＧＷ祭・特別クエ
ストは、ＨＲＰやポルタ
チケット桜がたっぷり貰える
お得なクエストです。
クエストの受注には
「ＧＷチケット」が必要にな
りますのでご注意ください。

22081.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
22081.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, we found an amazing monster in the volcano! Its name is the Crushing Wyvern, Brachydios! What sort of amazing creature it is, you can look forward to finding out in person!
22081.descriptionEn:
With a Transcendent species
about, we pushed our surveys
across the land and found an
amazing monster in the Volcano!
Its name: Brachydios, the
Crushing Wyvern!
How amazing it is, you'll have to
see for yourself in person!
22081.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、火山に
すごいモンスターを発見しま
した！その名は砕竜・ブラキ
ディオス！
どんなすごいヤツなのかは、
実際に立ち会ってからの
お楽しみです！

61212.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
61212.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
61212.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

53291.description: I am so tired, meow. All these adventures. Sometimes I go adventuring myself. It is shockingly hard, meow. So I am taking a little rest time!
53291.descriptionEn:
Man, I am so tired, meow.
From all these adventures.
Sometimes go adventure
yourself, meow. It is
shockingly hard, meow. So I
am taking a break, meow!
53291.descriptionJp:
まーもう疲れたニャ。
たびかさなる冒険で。
たまには自分で冒険行くニャ。
びっくりするほど大変ニャよ。
というわけでオイラはしばし
れすとたいむニャ！

21150.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
21150.description: A wyvern newly discovered in the Snowy Mountains. We have decided to call it the Doragyurosu, and among this already powerful wyvern a particularly sturdy individual has been confirmed. It is a dangerous request and supplies cannot be sent, but please hunt it!
21150.descriptionEn:
A flying wyvern newly found
in the Snowy Mountains.
We have named it
≪Doragyurosu≫, but an
especially tough individual
has been confirmed among
already strong ones. It is a
dangerous request, but go!
21150.descriptionJp:
雪山で新たに発見された飛竜。
我々はこれを≪冥雷竜≫
と呼ぶこととしましたが、
ただでさえ強力なこの飛竜の
中でも特に強靭な個体が確認
されたようです。危険な依頼
で、支給品も送れませんが、
狩猟をお願いします！

63309.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63309.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63309.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63309.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

54856.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 3 Porta Cards Sakura. Slay the mysterious monster that appeared in the desert and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade the G-rank Conquest weapon of the Zerureusu. Please, take care.
54856.descriptionEn:
In exchange for 3 Porta Card
Sakura, I have prepared a
lovely quest you can accept.
Slay the mysterious monster
that appeared in the Desert,
and you will get materials
needed to upgrade the G Rank
Zenith weapons of Zerureusu.
Please be careful.
54856.descriptionJp:
ポルタカード桜３枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
砂漠に現れた謎のモンス
ターを討伐すると、
輝界竜のＧ級覇種武器の
強化に必要な素材が
入手できるわよ。
どうか、気を付けて。

61005.description: A request for hunters who have come into their own only. Many bird wyverns are running wild in the Grand Arena! At the center of it seem to be Variant Iodrome and Variant Velocidrome. To calm things, hunt both of them.
61005.descriptionEn:
This request is for master
hunters only.
Many Bird Wyverns are on a
rampage in the Great Arena!
The ringleaders seem to be
Gendrome and Velocidrome
variants. To calm things down,
hunt both of them.
61005.descriptionJp:
凄腕のハンターさん限定の
依頼です。
大闘技場で多くの鳥竜種が
暴れています！
中心はどうやらドスイーオス
とドスランポスの変種のよう
です。沈静化のため、両方と
も狩猟してきてください。

21975.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

53207.description: It is here, it is here, finally here! The season when you can drink from midday for cherry blossom reasons has come! I have thought so for a while, but that Espinas is drinking and sleeping. I get it! I get it! Though I will hunt it!
53207.descriptionEn:
It's here, it's here, finally!
The season when you can drink
all day thanks to the sakura

I have thought it for a while,
but that Espinas,
he is drunk and asleep.
I get it! I get it!
But I will still hunt him!
53207.descriptionJp:
キタぞキタぞついにキタ！
昼間っから桜を理由に
飲める季節がついにキタ！

前々から思ってたけどさ、
エスピナスのヤツ、
ありゃ飲んで寝てるね。
わかる！わかるよ！
狩っちゃうけどね！

26513.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26513.description: Deep in the Snowy Mountains, they say there is a season when white fanged beasts and golden fanged beasts gather. There is no firm record of it, so it is only a rumour among hunters, but is it not a stirring tale for a hardened hunter?
26513.descriptionEn:
Deep in the Snowy Mountains,
there is said to be a season
when white fanged beasts and
golden fanged beasts gather.
There is no solid record of it,
so it is only a hunters' rumor,
but does it not thrill a
hardened hunter's heart?
26513.descriptionJp:
雪山深く、白い牙獣と金の牙
獣が集う時期があると言われ
ているわ。確かな記録として
記されたことはないので、
飽くまでもハンター達の噂で
しかないけど、筋金入りの
ハンターには心躍る話じゃ
ないかしら。

61872.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１０匹の討伐

40088.description: Congratulations on reaching HR800! Please deliver a Map on your own, and after clearing the quest, visit the special Event House to receive a bonus. Please make use of it!
40088.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR800! Please deliver a
≪Map≫ on your own, and
after clearing the quest,
visit the special Event
House to receive a bonus.
Please make use of it!
40088.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ８００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストクリア後に
特別イベントハウスを訪ねて
いただければ特典を進呈致し
ます。ぜひご活用ください！

62288.description: Hey, look at this. A fine weapon, no? This is one of the special weapons suited to Variants, and wearing it is a condition for some jobs. Will you make one too? Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share the leftover materials.
62288.descriptionEn:
Hey, take a look at this.
Nice weapon, huh? It's a kind of
special weapon suited for fighting
Variants. What's more, I hear
equipping it is a requirement for
certain requests.
Want to make one yourself?
Clear the requests I introduce
to you, and I'll share spare parts.
62288.descriptionJp:
よう、こいつを見てくれよ。
いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

55233.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft the Cuff 'G Gougeki Cuff SA4' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55233.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
top prize in the F Photo
Contest 2016, we have
prepared a quest that gives
materials to craft the cuff
used in it, the
G Assault Cuff SA4.
Please make use of it.
55233.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
るカフ「Ｇ剛撃カフＳＡ４」
を生産するための素材を獲得
できるクエストをご用意しま
した。
ぜひご利用ください。

54762.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
54762.description: There is a daily limit on how often it can be taken, but here is a request that lets you get some of the materials needed to upgrade Black Diablos G Rank gear. Do not miss it.
54762.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on how
often it can be taken, but here
is a request that lets you get
some of the materials needed
to upgrade Black Diablos G
Rank gear. Do not miss it.
54762.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、黒角竜のＧ級武
具の強化に必要な素材の一部
を入手できる依頼をご紹介し
ます。この機会を逃さぬよう
ご注意ください。

51121.description: What a joyous thing! Golden fish and silver fish exist in this world! Tell me all about their traits! So you can join the fish, I lend you my fish head. When you approach, do not forget to 'greet' them!
51121.descriptionEn:
What a joyous day this is!
That a golden fish and a silver
fish should exist in this world!
Tell me all about their traits,
in detail!
So you can join the fishes, I
will lend you my fish head.
Do not forget to give a
"greeting" when you approach!
51121.descriptionJp:
なんとめでたいことか！
金のおさかなと銀のおさかな
がこの世に存在するとは！
ぜひその特徴をワシに詳しく
聞かせとくれ！
おさかなの仲間になれるよう、
ワシのおさかな頭を貸してや
るわい。近づくときには
「あいさつ」を忘れずにの！

21822.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21822.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21822.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21822.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

53009.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
53009.description: I hate Gravios Subspecies! Always in my way, not one good memory! You! Would you go and punish a Gravios Subspecies? I have weapons and armor ready! I am counting on you!
53009.descriptionEn:
I hate Black Gravios! It always,
always gets in my way, and I do
not have a single good memory of
it! You there! Would you go and
teach that Black Gravios a lesson
for me? I have weapons and armor
ready for you! I am counting on
you!
53009.descriptionJp:
グラビモス亜種が嫌い！
いつもいつも私の邪魔をして、
いい思い出が一つもないわ！
あなた！グラビモス亜種を
懲らしめて来てくれない？
武器と防具は用意してるわ！
よろしく頼んだわよ！

12031.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

60540.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
60540.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Toa Tesukatora. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60540.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Toa Tesukatora≫!
Hunting alone shows truly
admirable spirit! Overcome
yourself and claim the top!
60540.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪トア・テスカトラ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

50972.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50972.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Yian Kut-Ku on Tide Island. Clear this request and you can obtain the Secret Certificate needed to upgrade armor, so do take it on and see it done.
50972.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's life,
we prepared a request to hunt
a ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ on Tidal Island.
Clear this request and you
will get the Secret Art Proof
needed to upgrade armor, so
accept it and clear it!
50972.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、潮島で≪怪鳥≫を
狩猟する依頼を用意しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、防具
の強化に必要な秘伝の証が
入手できますので、ぜひ受注
して依頼を達成しましょう。

54879.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
54879.description: We ask for your help surveying the Garuba Daora that lurks in the skies above! Not only slay it, but break its head and wings and we will add to your reward. Please lend your strength to our research!
54879.descriptionEn:
We ask for your help with
the survey of the ≪Guanzorumu≫
lurking in the skies above!
Beyond slaying it, break its
head and wings and we will
add extra rewards.
Please lend us your strength!
54879.descriptionJp:
上空に潜む≪金塵龍≫の
調査にご協力をお願いします！
討伐するだけでなく≪金塵龍≫
の頭部と翼を破壊して
くれたら報酬を上乗せいたし
ます。どうか我々の研究に力
を貸してください！

62426.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the thorn wyvern Espinas together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62426.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, how about hunting
the Thorn Wyvern ≪Espinas≫
with a hunter who has risen
high enough to hold a Secret
Art tome? Follow its unique
movements, and if we clear it
together, I will add a bonus!
62426.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
今回は、秘伝書を持つまでに
上りつめたハンターと一緒に、
棘竜≪エスピナス≫を
狩猟してきてはいかがだろう。
一味違った身のこなしに倣い、
共に依頼を達成すれば追加で
報酬を用意するぞ！

50785.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
50785.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Cutting the tail of an Akura Jebia will also grant a special ingredient.
50785.descriptionEn:
To spread word of the Guild
Priority requests we have long
run, we have prepared this
quest for you.
Sever the tail of the Akura
Jebia, and a special ingredient
will be granted to you as well.
50785.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
灰晶蠍の尻尾を切断すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

50154.description: There are reports that a Conquest monster, said to invite calamity, was seen flying in. It was visible for only an instant, but we are told it had an appearance unlike the usual. Hunters, head out to slay it with great care.
50154.descriptionEn:
Reports have come in that a
Zenith monster said to bring
calamity was seen flying in.
It was only visible for an
instant, but we are told its
appearance differed from
the usual.
Hunters, take every care
and head out to slay it.
50154.descriptionJp:
禍を招くといわれる、覇種
モンスターが飛来するのを目
撃したと報告が上がっており
ます。一瞬しか見えなかった
ようですが、通常とは異なる
容姿をしていたとも報告を
受けております。ハンターの
皆さんは十分に注意し討伐へ
向かってください。

62508.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
62508.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62508.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62508.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

56023.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
56023.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Blangonga. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56023.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay the
Supremacy Snow Lion.
If you break its developed parts
during this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
reward as a special bonus.
Note that slaying alone will not
grant you those materials.
56023.descriptionJp:
辿異種の雪獅子を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

23716.description: The Variant Species Baruragaru appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Baruragaru. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23716.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Baruragaru
appears to have reached a
strength that borders on the
very summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters sure of their skill are
asked to take on this survey.
23716.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪バルラガル≫は
バルラガルの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

62577.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62577.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62577.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

61261.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
61261.descriptionEn:
I got my hands on an ancient tome
said to record how to make armor
that no one knows anymore,
but I was attacked by monsters
and dropped it.
As long as the writing can still
be read, it needn't be intact.
Please, go and find it for me!
61261.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
んだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

53037.description: Did you know that couples wed this season are said to live long and happy lives? A male hunter came to me recently asking about manliness. Show him how a real hunter works alone in the volcano, and set an example of hunter manliness!
53037.descriptionEn:
Did you know couples wed at
this time of year live long,
happy lives together?
Recently a male hunter asked
me about manliness as a
hunter. Show him what it is
to hunt properly alone in
the Volcano, and set an
example of a hunter's spirit!
53037.descriptionJp:
この時期に結ばれた男女は、
末永く幸せな人生を送ること
ができるって知ってる？
最近、ある男性ハンターから
ハンターとしての男らしさに
ついて相談を受けたの。火山
で一人前に狩猟ができる姿を
見せて、ハンターの男らしさ
の手本を見せてあげて！

63137.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
63137.description: When the monster the surveyor found was checked with the guild, it proved to be a relative of the sea wyverns, a Crystal Wyvern by the name of Kuarusepusu. Moreover, an extremely powerful individual seems to dwell in the highlands, and the surveyor's safety is feared for. Head for the highlands at once and hunt the Crystal Wyvern.
63137.descriptionEn:
When the Guild examined the
monster our surveyor found, it was
a kind of Leviathan named
Kuarlusepusu, the Crystal Dragon.
What is more, an extremely strong
individual seems to live up in the
Highlands, and the surveyor's
safety is feared for.
Hurry there and hunt it.
63137.descriptionJp:
調査員が発見したモンスター
をギルドに確認したところ、
海竜種の仲間で名前は晶竜
≪クアルセプス≫。
さらに高地には極めて強力な
個体が生息しているらしく、
調査員の安否が心配とのこと。
直ちに高地へ向かい、晶竜の
狩猟をお願いします。

11040.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石３個の納品
11040.description: Shogun Ceanataur is a carapaceon with claws so sharp and powerful that it's called the Sickle Crab! This season you can also mine raw Grey Crystal in the swamp. With luck, a Light Crystal might come as a reward, you know!
11040.descriptionEn:
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ is a
carapaceon with claws so
sharp it's called the Scythe
Crab! This season you can
mine ≪Grey Crystal Ore≫ in
the swamp too. With luck,
Light Crystals as reward!
11040.descriptionJp:
≪ショウグンギザミ≫は別名
鎌蟹と呼ばれるほど、鋭くて
強力な爪を持つ甲殻生物よ！
また、この季節は沼地で≪灰
水晶の原石≫も採掘できるわ。
運がよければ、報酬でライト
クリスタルが手に入るかもね！

28085.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
28085.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
28085.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.
28085.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆をさらに
深めるべく、難しい依頼を
用意させてもらった。
モンスターの討伐と部位破壊
を、猟団の仲間と行うのだ。
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。

62061.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の討伐
62061.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62061.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
62061.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

61014.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61014.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61014.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

23364.description: A request to craft and upgrade the Furogada G Series, armor recommended for G Rank hunters. Hunt a Pokaradon or Pokara to obtain materials to craft and upgrade the Furogada G Series to LV7 for 1 piece.
23364.descriptionEn:
A request to craft and upgrade
the Furogada G Series, armor
recommended for G Rank
hunters.
Hunt a Pokaradon or Pokara
to obtain materials to craft
and upgrade the Furogada G
Series to LV7 for 1 piece.
23364.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ハンターにオススメな
防具「フロガダＧシリーズ」
の生産・強化依頼です。
ポカラドンやポカラを狩猟
すると、
「フロガダＧシリーズ」を
生産し、ＬＶ７まで強化する
素材が１部位分入手できます。

50408.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

62065.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins! Hunting without breaking anything? That's a withdrawal.
62065.descriptionEn:
Indeed! Today, by my own
arbitrary judgment, we hold a
weapon-restricted special
exercise!
Meet the conditions and you may
bring any equipment you like!
As it is closer to real combat,
carving is the same as Low Rank
quests, but the rewards are
≪Energy Drinks≫ and coins!
Hunt without breaking parts? That
is a retire.
62065.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！
破壊抜きで狩猟？リタイアだ。

21838.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

11034.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１０頭の討伐
11034.description: The swamp is the most suitable environment for Bulldrome to live in. Hunters facing the Bulldrome hunt, please slay as many Bulldrome as you can! Of course, we will pay rewards!
11034.descriptionEn:
The Swamp is the most fitting
home for Bullfango.
Hunters taking on the Bulldrome
hunt are asked to slay as many
Bullfango as they can as well!
Of course, we will pay for it!
11034.descriptionJp:
沼地はブルファンゴたちが棲
むのに最も適した環境です。
≪ドスファンゴ≫の狩猟に臨
む狩人さんは、できるだけ多
くのブルファンゴも討伐して
頂けますようお願いします！
勿論、報酬は支払います！

22158.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
22158.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Lave series, available from this request? If you do not mind the looks, I would recommend it as armor with a fine set of skills!
22158.descriptionEn:
Hunter thinking of changing
out of ≪Hope Series≫ armor.
How about the ≪Lave Series≫
armor you can get from this
request? If you don't mind
the look, I think it is a
fine set with excellent
skills. I recommend it!
22158.descriptionJp:
防具≪ホープシリーズ≫から
着替えたいと考えているハン
ターさん。
この依頼で入手可能な防具
≪ラーヴェシリーズ≫はどう
ですか？
見た目を気にしなければ、優
秀なスキルが揃ったオススメ
できる防具と思いますよ！

60712.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60712.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60712.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26002.objectiveJp: 毒テングダケ４個の納品
26002.description: I found a little known spot in the swamp where materials unique to it lie all about. By all means, go. If you come back with a full pouch, it should be worth the information fee.
26002.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
Swamp-only materials lie all
over the ground.
Go and have a look.
Come back with a full pouch and
it will be worth the price of
the information.
26002.descriptionJp:
沼地ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代分の価値はあると
思うぜ。

21042.description: Basarios grows by eating ore, so its outer shell often contains ore. By destroying parts, it seems you can sometimes get ore without mining at all! That's two birds with one stone!
21042.descriptionEn:
≪Basarios≫ grows by eating
ore, so its shell often
contains minerals. Break its
parts and you may get ore
without mining at all, or so
they say! Two birds with
one stone, eh!
21042.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫は鉱石を食べ
て成長するためその外殻には
鉱石が含まれてることが多い
です。部位を破壊することで、
採掘しなくても鉱石が入手
できることもあるみたいです
よ！これは一石二鳥ですね！

21245.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
21245.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21245.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21245.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

55699.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Espinas through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Dual Blades, Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Lance, or Gunlance. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55699.descriptionEn:
Producing one Supremacy
Espinas weapon grants the
materials for its first
upgrade plus Porta Card
Sakura worth Gz.
Weapon types: Sword and
Shield, Dual Blades, Long
Sword, Hunting Horn, Lance,
Gunlance. Pick and craft!
55699.descriptionJp:
辿異種エスピナスの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
片手剣、双剣、太刀、狩猟笛、
槍、銃槍のいずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

55316.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55316.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55316.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62974.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
62974.description: Black lightning has been observed over a wide area in the skies above the Snowy Mountains. It may be the influence of the phantom Doragyurosu that is a rumour among the guild. To eliminate this danger, a hunt request has been issued to master hunters. Head for the site at once!
62974.descriptionEn:
Black lightning has been seen
over a wide stretch of the
Snowy Mountains sky.
It may be the work of the
phantom Doragyurosu the guild
speaks of in whispers.
To remove this danger, a slaying
request has gone out to top
hunters. Depart for the site at
once!
62974.descriptionJp:
雪山の空で、広範囲に渡り
黒い雷が観測されました。
もしかすると、ギルドで語草
となっている幻の冥雷竜が
現れた影響かもしれません。
この危険を排除すべく、凄腕
のハンターに討伐依頼が出さ
れています。
直ちに現地へ出発して下さい！

61203.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
61203.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
61203.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
61203.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50845.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 20 Porta Tickets Sakura. Slay a Kirin and you can obtain the production and upgrade materials for 1 piece of the Blitz series.
50845.descriptionEn:
In exchange for 20 Porta Ticket
Sakura, I have prepared a
lovely quest you can accept.
Slay a Kirin and you will get
crafting and upgrade
materials for 1 piece of the
Blitz Series.
50845.descriptionJp:
ポルタチケット桜２０枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
キリンを討伐すると、
「ブリッツシリーズ」１部位
分の生産・強化素材が入手で
きるわよ。

60244.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
60244.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Toridokuresu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60244.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Toridokuresu≫!
Hunting alone shows truly
admirable spirit! Overcome
yourself and claim the top!
60244.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪トリドクレス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

28068.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
28068.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28068.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
28068.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

62089.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62089.description: The savage Gurenzeburu has attacked merchants, it seems. It shows no sign of leaving the Highlands, and the region has been closed off as dangerous. Your task is to secure the Highlands. Hunters of skill, I leave it to you!
62089.descriptionEn:
A ferocious Gurenzeburu has
apparently attacked merchants.
It shows no sign of leaving the
Highlands, and the area has been
sealed off as dangerous.
This request is to secure the
safety of the Highlands.
Top hunters, I leave it to you!
62089.descriptionJp:
凶暴な≪グレンゼブル≫が
商人たちを襲撃したらしい。
高地からいっこうに移動する
気配がなく、危険な地域とし
て封鎖されている状況だ。
今回の依頼内容は、高地の
安全を確保することだ。
凄腕のハンターたちよ、
頼んだぞ！

21522.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21522.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21522.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26301.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26301.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26301.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26301.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61234.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

63084.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63084.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
63084.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
63084.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

62609.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62609.description: This is the practice finals quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or from clear rewards.
62609.descriptionEn:
This is the practice finals quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or from clear rewards.
62609.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で、
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

1045.description: A white shadow crawling in the darkness, you say!? That must be Khezu! If you would face it, you must not look only at the ground! It is good at silencing every sound and striking from the ceiling, so watch out!
1045.descriptionEn:
A white shadow crawling in
the dark!? That has to be a
≪Khezu≫!
If you are going after it,
do not just watch the ground!
It silences all sound and
strikes from above. Watch out!
1045.descriptionJp:
暗闇を這う白影だって！？
それは≪フルフル≫に間違い
ないハズだ！ヤツの狩猟に臨
むなら地上ばかりを見てちゃ
ダメだぜ！ヤツは一切の音を
消して天井から襲い掛かかる
のがお得意だ、注意しろよ！

21161.description: Among the fierce wyverns Abiorugu confirmed in the Snowy Mountains, an extremely violent and powerful individual has appeared. As it is very dangerous, this is an investigation and hunt request limited to hunters we approve. Take it on fully prepared.
21161.descriptionEn:
Reports say an extremely violent
and powerful individual of the
Abiorugu has appeared in the
Snowy Mountains.
It is so dangerous that this
survey and hunt is limited to
hunters we have approved.
Go in fully prepared.
21161.descriptionJp:
雪山で確認されている
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫の中でも
極めて狂暴で、強力な個体が
現れたそうです。
大変危険なため我々が認める
ハンターさん限定での調査、
狩猟依頼となります。
万全の態勢で挑んでください。

11061.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
11061.description: The Shogun Ceanataur apparently uses those strange leg joints to climb all the way to the ceiling! If the hunt proves difficult, hunting the Gabras that flit about the crater this season to obtain precious food ingredients comes recommended!
11061.descriptionEn:
The Sickle Crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
apparently uses its strange leg
joints to climb all the way to
the ceiling! If the hunt proves
difficult, we also recommend
slaying the ≪Gabras≫ that flit
around the crater this season to
obtain valuable foodstuffs!
11061.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫は
その奇妙な足関節を使って、
天井にまで登るらしいです！
狩猟が困難な場合、この季節
火口付近を飛び回る≪ガブラ
ス≫を討伐して、貴重な食材
を入手するのもお勧めです！

63180.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
63180.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63180.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63180.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

21087.description: The Congalala is a greedy beast, and it seems to have a special weakness for mushroom dishes. The Conga that serve it seem just as weak for mushrooms. If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, you might meet one.
21087.descriptionEn:
The Congalala is a greedy beast,
and it seems helpless before
anything mushroom-like.
Its Conga underlings are just as
mad for mushrooms.
Carry plenty of Special
Mushrooms and you may meet one?
21087.descriptionJp:
桃毛獣≪ババコンガ≫は食い
意地が張った獣で、特にキノ
コ系の食べ物には目がないみ
たいね。同じく子分のコンガ
たちもキノコには目がないみ
たい。特産キノコを多めに所
持していれば会えるかもね？

26111.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

50543.description: This bright red Gunlance? I made it from ingredients I gathered at the risk of my life. What, you want one too? Only one who has fought with food in his heart can make it. What, you still ask? Fine! I lend you this weapon. Beyond a fight of single-minded devotion, you will see that legendary ingredient.
50543.descriptionEn:
This bright red Gunlance?
I made it from ingredients
gathered risking my life.
What! You want it too?
Only one who has fought
hard for food can craft this.
What, still asking!? Fine!
I will lend it to you. Fight
on and see that fabled food.
50543.descriptionJp:
この真っ赤なガンランスか？
わしが命懸けで採った食材で
作ったものじゃ。なぬ！お主
も欲しいじゃと？これは食を
思い奮闘した者しか作れん。
なにぃ、まだ言うか！？よか
ろう！この武器を貸してやる。
一心不乱の戦いの先にその伝
説の食材を目にするだろう。

28064.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
28064.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28064.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
28064.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

62823.description: Please recreate a story I came up with on my own. It is the important scene where Akane-ko meets the golden fish. Please produce the Light Bowgun Akane-ko Gun in advance and equip it. I will lend you the armor, so please wear it.
62823.descriptionEn:
Please reenact a story I
came up with on my own.
It is the important scene
where Akaneko meets the
Goldenfish.
Beforehand, craft the Light
Bowgun ≪Akaneko Gun≫ and
keep it equipped, okay?
I will lend armor, so wear it.
62823.descriptionJp:
わたしが勝手に考えた
物語の再現をお願いします。
あかねこと黄金魚が出会う
重要なシーンなんですよ。
事前にライトボウガンの
≪あかねこガン≫を生産し、
装備しておいてくださいね。
防具はお貸ししますので、
そちらをご着用ください。

53254.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
53254.description: To mark a special event, we have prepared a quest that yields lottery tickets. We have outfits from the stylish to the adorable waiting for you, so collect tickets and bring them to the workshop.
53254.descriptionEn:
To mark a special event, we
have prepared a quest that
gives you lottery tickets.
We have everything from
stylish outfits to adorable
ones, so gather tickets and
bring them to the Workshop.
53254.descriptionJp:
特別なイベントを記念して
くじ券が手に入るクエストを
ご用意しました。
お洒落な衣装から、愛らしい
衣装まで取り揃えて、お待ち
していますので、くじ券を集
めて工房までお持ちください。

55230.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55230.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Stroma GX Resist' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55230.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
top prize in the F Photo
Contest 2016, we have
prepared a quest that gives
materials to craft and
upgrade the armor used in it,
Stroma GX Resist.
Please make use of it.
55230.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「ストロマGXレジスト」
を生産・強化するための素材
を獲得できるクエストをご用
意しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

60312.description: The matter of the flying wyvern dwelling in the Sea of Trees, which seemed settled thanks to your efforts, has seen reports of damage rise again. I am sorry, but go to the Sea of Trees once more and hunt the flying wyvern. I am counting on you.
60312.descriptionEn:
Thanks to your efforts, the
trouble with the flying wyvern
that dwells in the Great Forest
seemed settled, but damage
reports are rising once more.
Sorry, but head to the Great
Forest once again and hunt it.
I am expecting great things!
60312.descriptionJp:
おぬしらの活躍によって収束
したと思われた、樹海に棲ま
う飛竜の件じゃが、またして
も被害報告が増加しておる。
すまぬが、いま一度樹海に向
かい、飛竜の狩猟に当たって
くれ。
期待しておるぞ。

60301.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

55534.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の討伐
55534.description: Can we overcome the white wind that blows sharp and wild? The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Galloping Nargacuga. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55534.descriptionEn:
Can we overcome the white wind
that blows so fiercely?
The Guild has decided to call
this shining one the
'Acme Dashing Nargacuga'.
To any Hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild-hidden armor and a title!
55534.descriptionJp:
鋭く吹き荒れる白い風に、
我々は打ち勝てるのか。
ギルドでは、光放つヤツを
「極み駆けるナルガクルガ」
と呼ぶことにした。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

26386.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26386.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26386.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

54811.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
54811.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54811.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54811.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55637.description: Survey results say the pressing Variant Species Shining Thunder Bird is of immeasurable strength. To counter it we have begun research into and crafting of decorations, but information is lacking. It would help if you could obtain samples, especially of the wings, from a Ｇ-rank Shining Thunder Bird.
55637.descriptionEn:
Survey results show the
approaching Supremacy
≪Toridokuresu≫ has
unfathomable strength.
To counter it, we are
working on decoration
research and crafting, but
data is lacking. Wing samples
from a G Rank one would help.
55637.descriptionJp:
迫りくる辿異種≪照雷鳥≫は
計り知れない強さだとの調査
結果があります。これに対抗
すべく、装飾品の研究、及び
作製に取りかかっていますが
情報が不足しています。Ｇ級
の≪照雷鳥≫から、特に翼の
サンプルを取得して頂けると
助かります。

61150.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の捕獲
61150.description: It is I, the Instructor! I have come to see how much your skill as hunters has risen! Clear the main target and you will obtain the Portal Ticket White needed for the 2nd trial! Clearing the sub-target is the key!
61150.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! I
have come to see how much
your skill as hunters has
grown! Clear the main target
to get the Porta Ticket White
needed for the second trial!
The sub target is the key!
61150.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ！教官だ！諸君のハン
ターとしての腕が、どれくら
い上がったか、見にやってき
たぞ！メインターゲット達成
で２つ目の試練に必要な、ポ
ルタチケット白が手に入るぞ！
サブターゲット達成がカギだ！

62353.description: Distance is what matters in the hunt. Getting close for no reason is never the answer. If you can finish without touching a thing, that is best. Sometimes escape. Sometimes run away. Bring everyone along, let us go no-touch!
62353.descriptionEn:
What matters in a hunt is
keeping your distance, yes.
Getting close is not always the
answer, no.
If you can finish without
touching a thing, that is best.
Sometimes escape. Sometimes run
away. Bring everyone along.
Let us go no-touch!
62353.descriptionJp:
狩りで重要なのは距離感デス。
むやみに近づけば良いという
ものでは決してないのデ〜ス。
何にもタッチせずに終われる
なら、それがベストでショウ。
時にはエスケープ。時には
ランナウェイ。皆を誘って、
レッツノータッチ！

56025.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Rathalos. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56025.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Rathalos for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.
56025.descriptionJp:
辿異種の火竜を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

26338.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26338.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26338.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50965.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
50965.description: A report has come in that one monster researcher has developed a condition called Frenzy Fever. It seems he was infected by the Frenzy Virus during a monster survey. The Gore Magala is very likely the source of infection. To curb the spread of the Frenzy Virus, investigate the site at once.
50965.descriptionEn:
A report has come that one
monster researcher has developed
a symptom called Frenzy.
It seems he was infected by the
Frenzy Virus during monster
research.
The Gore Magala is very likely the
cause of infection.
To stop the spread of the Frenzy
Virus, survey the site at once.
50965.descriptionJp:
１人のモンスター研究員が
狂竜症という症状を発症した
と報告がきている。
モンスターの調査中に狂竜
ウイルスが感染したようだ。
黒蝕竜が感染原因である
可能性が非常に高い。
狂竜ウイルス拡散抑止のため
至急、現地を調査してくれ。

21424.description: It began as a small seed, but tended with care it came to harvest, and in time it brought abundance as well. Yet this is not the end. A hunter who holds a Secret Arts Scroll will be able to encourage further prosperity.
21424.descriptionEn:
It began as a tiny seed, but by
tending it with care it came to
bear fruit, and in time it brought
forth abundance as well.
Yet this is not the end, not by
any means. If you are a hunter
who holds a Secret Art Tome,
you should be able to encourage
even greater prosperity.
21424.descriptionJp:
始まりは小さな種でしたが、
心を込めて育てることで
収穫に至り、やがてそれは
豊穣をも生み出しました。
しかし、まだまだ終わりでは
ありません。≪秘伝書≫を
お持ちのハンターさんならば、
さらなる繁栄を促すことが
できるでしょう。

53278.description: To gather invitations, one must defeat large monsters. Simple and clear, but for that very reason it may in turn feel tedious. So I thought, and prepared an event of somewhat unusual character. Hahahaha! Now then, apply yourself.
53278.descriptionEn:
To collect invitations, you
must defeat large monsters.
Simple and clear, but for
that very reason it may feel
boring. So I prepared some
events of a slightly
different flavor. Hahahaha!

Now then, do your best.
53278.descriptionJp:
招待状を集めるには、大型の
モンスターを倒す必要がある。
単純明快ではあるが、それ故、
逆に退屈にも感じるだろう。
なればと思い、少し変わった
趣の催しも用意したという
わけだ。ハハハハハ！

では、励んでくれたまえ。

40188.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
40188.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40188.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40188.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

54335.description: There is a report that that Elder Dragon is active in the farthest land. Please head out to slay it at once. A difficult situation is expected, so steel yourself fully and head for the site.
54335.descriptionEn:
There is a report that the
elder dragon is active in the
far reaches of the land.
Please head out to slay it at
once.
Difficult conditions are
expected, so go to the site
with your guard fully up.
54335.descriptionJp:
最果ての地にて、かの古龍が
活動しているとの報告があり
ます。
至急討伐へ向かってください。
困難な状況が予測されるので、
十分に気を引き締めて現地へ
向かってください。

50442.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

65004.description:
Achieve Main ObjecFaint ３ Times
Time OutSephVII

53266.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種２頭の狩猟
53266.description: 2 aged Black Gravios that once appeared in the swamp seem to have appeared in the volcano again. If they are not in sight, they are said to lurk nearby. In the field survey, break the chest of that individual to confirm. If you check the situation for us, we have Jaguar series outerwear ready as the reward.
53266.descriptionEn:
The two aged Black Gravios
that appeared in the Swamp
long ago seem to be in the
Volcano again. If you do not
see them, they are hiding
nearby. Please break that
individual's chest on site
to confirm. I have prepared a
Jaguar Series outfit as reward.
53266.descriptionJp:
昔、沼地に現れた２頭の年老
いた黒鎧竜が火山に再び現れ
たみたい。見かけない場合
は近くに潜んでるらしいわ。
現地調査でその個体の胸部を
破壊して確かめてほしいの。
状況を確かめてくれたら
ジャガーシリーズの外装を
報酬として用意してるわ。

60015.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Put an end to the feud between Yao-zami and Blangonga with a plague on both their houses! The main target is the slaying of 20 Yao-zami, but settle the quarrel and lavish rewards will follow for certain!?
60015.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
off their skill! Put an end to
the feud between the Yaozami
and the Blangonga, punishing both!
The main target is to slay 20
Yaozami, but succeed in the
double punishment and a lavish
reward is yours for sure!?
60015.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！ヤオザミとドドブ
ランゴの因縁の関係に喧嘩両
成敗の終止符を！
メインターゲットはヤオザミ
２０匹の討伐だが、喧嘩両成
敗に成功すればもれなく豪華
報酬が！？

26410.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26410.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26410.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

60929.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60929.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
60929.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62944.description: This is a preliminary quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes.
62944.descriptionEn:
This is a preliminary quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
62944.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選クエスト
です。
制限時間は１０分です。

51071.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of an Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
51071.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Espinas's horn,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51071.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
棘竜の角を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

55624.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (legs), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
55624.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(leg armor), excluding
Weapon Ribbons and
Weapon Merits.
The amount is for 1 type.
To accept the quest, you
need a ≪Hunter Dice White≫,
so please be aware.
55624.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（脚防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターダイス白≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

51056.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the crest of a Purple Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
51056.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Purple Gypceros' crest,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51056.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
紫毒鳥のトサカを破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

26372.description: We discovered a vast sea of trees in an unexplored land. The moment we stepped in, a great swarm of Vespoid! We fled for our lives and left our baggage behind. It is important baggage! Will someone drive off that swarm!
26372.descriptionEn:
I discovered a vast Great Forest
in an unexplored land. The moment
I stepped in, a swarm of Vespoids!
I ran for my life and left my
cargo behind. It's important
cargo! Won't someone drive off
that swarm for me!
26372.descriptionJp:
未開の地に広大な樹海を発見
したんだ。足を踏み入れると
ランゴスタの大群さ！
逃げるのに必死で荷物を残し
てきてしまった。大事な荷物
なんだ！誰かあの大群を追い
払ってくれないか！

50088.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50088.description: We have received reports that Rukodiora has appeared in the desert. Several hunters have been sent before, but none have produced results. For that reason this request comes with a number of conditions. It is a difficult task, and we have prepared a reward to match. We thank you in advance.
50088.descriptionEn:
We have received a report
that a Rukodiora appeared
in the Desert.
We have sent hunters out
several times so far, but
with no results.
Therefore, this request has
several conditions.
It is a difficult request, but
the rewards match it. Thank you.
50088.descriptionJp:
砂漠に、極龍が現れたと
の報告が届きました。
これまで何度かハンターを
向かわせましたが、成果が
得られていません。
そのため、今回依頼に幾つか
の条件を出しています。
困難な依頼ですが、それに
見合う報酬を用意しておりま
す。よろしくお願いします。

21647.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
21647.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
21647.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

26694.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
26694.description: Monsters are breeding in great numbers in the volcano! We have asked hunters across the land for help, but the truth is there are simply too many. So we are looking for hunters willing to take this hunt in pairs at most. Those aiming to rank up quickly are especially encouraged.
26694.descriptionEn:
In the Volcano, monsters are
breeding in great numbers!
We have asked hunters from
every region for help, but the
truth is there are too many.
So we want volunteers who can
set out on this hunt with up to
two people. I especially
recommend it to fast climbers!
26694.descriptionJp:
火山で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

55633.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55633.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55633.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

21628.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21628.description: Have you heard of the Scarlet Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21628.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called Benihi Orb?
That material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you that precious
decoration material.
21628.descriptionJp:
紅緋原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

62806.description: Fwahaha! It is I, the Instructor! Novice hunter and ace hunter! Are you ready? Skin-to-skin honesty is the first step to friendship! Turn in what you bring and succeed in a hunt without armor! Succeed and a fine reward awaits!
62806.descriptionEn:
Fuhaha! It is I, the Instructor!
You greenhorn and veteran
hunters! Are you ready!
Nothing builds friendship like
a bare-skinned hunt! Deliver
what you brought along and
pull off a hunt with no armor!
Succeed, and a fine reward awaits!
62806.descriptionJp:
ふはは！我輩だ！教官だ！
ひよっこハンターと凄腕ハン
ターよ！準備はいいか！
裸の付き合いこそ仲良しの第
一歩！持ち寄ったものを納品
し、防具なしで狩猟を成功さ
せてみろ！見事成功させれば、
ステキな報酬が待っているぞ！

50250.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50250.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Dyuragaua and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50250.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Duramboros≫
and prove what you can do.
Clear the quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
right up!
50250.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪氷狐竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

63001.description: I found rare materials in the swamp. I was gathering them frantically when a Gypceros came, and I thought I would brush it off, but it seemed no ordinary Gypceros, so I fled somehow. If you hunt it, I will give you the materials I gathered.
63001.descriptionEn:
Rare materials can be gathered
in the Swamp, you see. I was
lost in collecting them when
≪Gypceros≫ turned up, and I
thought I would just shoo it off,
but it was no ordinary Poison
Bird, it seemed, so I ran for it.
Hunt it for me and I will give
you the materials I gathered.
63001.descriptionJp:
沼地で珍しい素材が取れてね。
夢中になって集めていたら
≪ゲリョス≫がやってきて、
適当にあしらってやろうと
思ったんだが、どうもただの
毒怪鳥じゃないようで、何と
か逃げてきたんだ。狩猟して
きてくれたら取れた素材を
やってもいいぞ。

54921.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
54921.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54921.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54921.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55911.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
55911.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields a Layered Armor Release Ticket. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55911.descriptionEn:
Exclusively for members of Guilds
that won the Hunters Festival, we
have prepared a quest that yields
a Layered Armor Release Ticket.
Please have Festival Heat with you
when you accept or join the quest.
55911.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪外装解
放券≫を獲得できるクエスト
を用意させていただきまし
た。受注、参加時に、≪祭典
の熱気≫をお持ちください。

50779.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50779.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a Black Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
50779.descriptionEn:
To raise awareness of the
Guild Priority Requests we
have long run, and to
promote them, we have
prepared this quest.
Breaking the horns of the
Black Diablos also grants
you special ingredients.
50779.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒角竜の角を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

50735.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
50735.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for a hunter to slay the Varusaburos that appeared suddenly. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50735.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We are looking for hunters
to slay the suddenly
appeared ≪Varusaburosu≫.
If you manage to slay it,
we will issue more proofs of
slay than usual!
50735.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。
突如現れた≪ヴァルサブロ
ス≫を討伐してくださるハン
ターを募集しています。
見事、討伐できましたら、
普段よりも多めに討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

61461.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
61461.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
61461.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

55825.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55825.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55825.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55825.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

11095.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
11095.description: Set a Shock Trap or a Pitfall Trap at a monster's feet and you can stop it in its tracks! And if you catch a weakened monster and put it to sleep with a Tranq Bomb, you can capture it. A splendid tool indeed!
11095.descriptionEn:
Set a ≪Shock Trap≫ or a
≪Pitfall Trap≫ at a
monster's feet and you can
lock it in place!
Better yet, catch a weakened
monster and put it to sleep
with a ≪Tranq Bomb≫ to
capture it. What a handy
little trick, right!
11095.descriptionJp:
≪シビレ罠≫や≪落とし穴≫
をモンスターの足元に設置す
れば動きを封じることができ
るんです！
それに、モンスターが弱った
ところを捕らえて≪捕獲用麻
酔玉≫で眠らせれば捕獲する
こともできちゃうスグレモノ
なんですよ！

21607.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
21607.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Weasel Sickle Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21607.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called Itachigama Orb?
That material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you that precious
decoration material.
21607.descriptionJp:
鼬鎌原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55957.description: A Variant Species Baruragaru with a greatly developed head has appeared. Its tongue attacks, striking in every direction, have led many hunters to give up the hunt. The guild will expand the supplied items and, when you set out as 4, provide further support. Please go to the investigation with care.
55957.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Baruragaru with
a greatly developed head has
appeared. Its unrestrained
tongue attacks have made
many hunters give up the slay.
The Guild is expanding
supplies and will give extra
support only when departing
with 4 hunters.
Please survey with care.
55957.descriptionJp:
頭が大きく発達した辿異種の
バルラガルが現れました。
縦横無尽な舌の攻撃に、多く
のハンターが討伐を断念して
います。
ギルドでは支給品を拡充する
と共に、４名で出発した時に
限り更なる支援を行います。
気をつけて調査に向かってく
ださい。

21035.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21035.description: If you are going to hunt in the Snowy Mountains, please do not forget to bring a Hot Drink! It might be surer to hunt Popo and get used to the mountain environment to some degree, and then hunt a Bulldrome!
21035.descriptionEn:
When you head out to hunt in
the Snowy Mountains, don't
forget to bring ≪Hot Drinks≫!
Slaying ≪Popo≫ to get used to
the Snowy Mountains a bit
first, then hunting ≪Bulldrome≫
might be the safer bet!
21035.descriptionJp:
雪山で狩猟に臨む場合は、
≪ホットドリンク≫を忘れず
に持って行ってくださいね！
≪ポポ≫の討伐で、ある程度
雪山の環境に慣れてから、
≪ドスファンゴ≫を狩猟した
方が確実かも知れませんね！

54683.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

26459.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time we have prepared the canyon field, but part of the depths and the high ground are still unexplored and not open. Please note.
26459.descriptionEn:
Thank you for waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Public Bar Guild.
This time we have prepared the
Canyon field, but part of the
inner depths and the high ground
remain unexplored and have not
been unlocked. Please take care.
26459.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は峡谷フィールドを
用意させていただきましたが、
一部奥地、高台の部分はまだ
未探索のため解放されて
おりません。ご注意ください。

11504.description: It is I, the Instructor! Combining has something called a success rate. Even if it fails, do not give up, repeat it! The combination recipes are listed under each kind of information, then the Combination List, in the START menu!
11504.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
Combining has a success rate,
you see. Even if you fail,
never give up and try again!
Inside the ≪START Menu≫, under
Info, then Combination List, your
recipes will line up as you learn!
11504.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
調合には、成功確率なるもの
があるぞ。例え失敗しても、
あきらめずに繰り返すのだ！
≪ＳＴＡＲＴメニュー≫内の
各種情報→調合リストの中に
調合レシピが並んでいくぞ！

61863.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期２頭の狩猟
61863.description: Mm, so you are interested in our activities! That inquiring mind is good! Head into the dangerous Forest and hunt what lurks deep, far beyond! Do that and I will tell you about special armor that even hunters have only heard rumors of!
61863.descriptionEn:
Hmm, so our work has caught
your interest!?
I like that curiosity!
Head into the perilous Great
Forest and hunt what lurks in
its depths, far beyond!
Do that, and I'll tell even a
hunter like you about special
armor you'd only ever heard
of in rumors!
61863.descriptionJp:
むむ、我々の活動に興味が
あるだと！？
その探究心や良し！
危険に満ちた樹海へ向かい、
その奥地、はるか彼方に潜む
ものを狩ってくるのだ！
そうすれば、ハンターといえ
ど、噂でしか聞いたことない
であろう、特別な防具につい
て教えてやろう！

54174.description: The survey team reports that a Lavasioth has been found living in an unsurveyed area of the volcano. If the habitat changes, behavior and habits should change with it. Please investigate with caution.
54174.descriptionEn:
Word from the Research
Commission: a Volganos has
been found living in an
unexplored part of the
Volcano. If its habitat has
changed, its behavior and
habits likely have too.
Please survey with care.
54174.descriptionJp:
調査団から、
火山の未調査地帯にて、
溶岩竜の生息を発見した
との連絡がありました。
生息環境が変われば
行動や習性も変わってくる
はずです。慎重に調査を
お願いします。

55648.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55648.description: The Variant Species Gasurabazura has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55648.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gasurabazura≫
has grown ferociously strong
and keeps on rampaging.
As it stands this is very
dangerous. Please prepare
fully before the survey.
55648.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ガスラバズラ≫
は猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続
けています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

26320.description: Oh! You hunters! Doing well? I've come to make Armor Spheres! There are several kinds, and this time it's the Extreme Armor Sphere. Bring me Gem Fragments!
26320.descriptionEn:
Hey, you hunters!
Keeping busy, are ya?
I'm here for Armor Spheres!
There's several kinds, but
this time it's ≪Extreme Armor
Sphere≫! Bring the ≪Shards≫!
26320.descriptionJp:
おう！ハンターの野郎ども！
元気でやってるか？
鎧玉を作りに来たぜ！
鎧玉は種類がいくつかあるが、
今回は≪極鎧玉≫だ。
≪玉のかけら≫を持ってきな！

26745.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26745.description: Thanks for playing MHF for three whole years! Equip Akam Swoon and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude L as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude L you can forge Vol Impact (Hammer).
26745.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for three whole years!
Equip ≪Akam Swoon≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get 11
≪Proof of Gratitude L≫ as a
gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude L≫ you can forge
≪Vol Impact≫ (Hammer).
26745.descriptionJp:
３年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪アカムスウォーン≫を装備
し、≪年間特典生産券≫１枚
を納品すると≪感謝の証L≫
を１１枚プレゼントいたしま
す。≪感謝の証L≫から
≪ヴォルインパクト≫
（ハンマー）が生産可能です。

60126.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟

55147.description: Thank you for your help in slaying the Rukodiora! If you deliver the Beautiful Metal Fittings, which have regained their lustre through the Rukodiora's powerful magnetic field, I will give you the materials for a precious armor the Guild owns as thanks.
55147.descriptionEn:
Thank you for your help in
slaying the Rukodiora!
If you deliver the Beautiful
Metal Fitting that regained its
shine in the Rukodiora magnetic
field, we will gift you rare
armor materials owned by the
guild as thanks.
55147.descriptionJp:
ルコディオラ討伐にご協力い
ただきありがとうございまし
た！ルコディオラの強力な磁
場によって光沢を取り戻した
「綺麗な金具」を納品してい
ただければ、お礼として、ギ
ルドが所有する貴重な防具の
素材をプレゼントいたします。

21686.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
21686.description: In the mysterious unexplored Old Tower, an unobserved creature with no record at all in the authorities' documents has been confirmed. Surely the White Dragon spoken of in only one book has not appeared...?
21686.descriptionEn:
In the mysterious, unexplored
≪Ancient Tower≫, an unobserved
≪creature≫ with no record at all
in official documents has been
confirmed. Could it be that the
≪White Dragon≫ written of in
only one book has appeared...?
21686.descriptionJp:
謎多き未開の地≪古塔≫にて、
当局の文献にも、一切の記録
が無い、未観測の≪生物≫が
確認されました。まさか、
ある書物にのみ記されている
という≪白き龍≫が現れたと
いうのでしょうか...。

55371.objectiveJp: イビルジョー１頭の狩猟
55371.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make armor from the rage wyvern Deviljho! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain materials needed to upgrade Transcendence Armor, so please give it a try!
55371.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want
Deviljho armor! Clear the
sub-target to obtain materials
needed to upgrade migration
armor, so please give it a try!
55371.descriptionJp:
恐暴竜≪イビルジョー≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを用意
しました！サブターゲットを
達成すると遷悠防具の強化に
必要な素材を入手できます
ので、ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

62675.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
62675.description: A suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress at tremendous speed! At once, make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon! If our strength is not enough, breaking that giant leg alone will do.
62675.descriptionEn:
A suspicious dragon is approaching
the Fortress at tremendous speed!
At once, make use of the Fortress's
interceptor weapons and repel the
mysterious giant dragon!
If your strength is not enough, then
at least break those giant legs
for us.
62675.descriptionJp:
怪しげな龍が物凄い勢いで
砦に接近してきています！
大至急、砦の迎撃兵器を活用
し、謎の巨大龍を撃退して
ください！
戦力が及ばない場合、あの巨
大な脚の破壊だけでもお願い
します。

62820.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62820.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62820.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

22057.description: The depths of the Snowy Mountains are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22057.descriptionEn:
The depths of the ≪Snowy
Mountains≫ are still under
Guild survey, but hunters
too might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22057.descriptionJp:
≪雪山≫の奥深くは、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

63076.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
63076.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63076.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
63076.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

40182.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40182.description: A very powerful Hypnocatrice that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
40182.descriptionEn:
An individual ≪Hypnocatrice≫ of
great strength that behaves
unlike the norm is in the New
Great Arena, and I want it hunted.
This request is open only to
hunters with Secret Art equipment
approved by the Guild.
Clear it splendidly and you will
earn still greater renown as a
master hunter.
40182.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪眠鳥≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

51042.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
51042.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Pink Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
51042.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Pink Rathian's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51042.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
桜火竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

21990.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Rathalos, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
21990.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner doing
well, meow? Time to be good to
your partner, meow!
Now, the point, meow. This
request is to hunt 1 Rathalos,
meow. The pay is materials for
Felyne gear, meow!
Counting on you, meow!
21990.descriptionJp:
おう！そこの狩人さん！
アンタのパートニャーは元気
かニャ？たまには相棒孝行し
てやるニャ！
では、本題ニャ。今回の依頼
は火竜１頭の狩猟ニャ。
報酬はパートニャー用武具の
生産素材だニャ！
たのんだニャー！

62102.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
62102.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
62102.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
62102.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

26332.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26332.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26332.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26332.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26332.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。
