55146.description: Thank you for your help in slaying the Rukodiora! If you deliver the Beautiful Metal Fittings, which have regained their lustre through the Rukodiora's powerful magnetic field, I will give you the materials for a precious armor the Guild owns as thanks.
55146.descriptionEn:
Thank you for your help in
slaying the Rukodiora!
If you deliver the Beautiful
Metal Fitting that regained its
shine in the Rukodiora magnetic
field, we will gift you rare
armor materials owned by the
guild as thanks.
55146.descriptionJp:
ルコディオラ討伐にご協力い
ただきありがとうございまし
た！ルコディオラの強力な磁
場によって光沢を取り戻した
「綺麗な金具」を納品してい
ただければ、お礼として、ギ
ルドが所有する貴重な防具の
素材をプレゼントいたします。

53043.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の狩猟
53043.description: Tonight is the one night a year I can meet my love, but of all nights a herd of Fanngo is spilling across the road like a galaxy and I cannot pass! Could you taunt them and draw the herd away! Do it from a high, well lit spot so you can see clearly!
53043.descriptionEn:
Tonight's the one night a year
I get to see my sweetheart,
but today of all days the road
is packed with Bullfango like
a river of stars! Use Provoke
on them and draw the herd in,
will ya? Do it from somewhere
with a good view of it all!
53043.descriptionJp:
今夜は年に一度だけ恋人に
会える日なんだが、今日に
限って道にファンゴの群れ
が銀河のごとく溢れて通れね
え！あいつらを「挑発して」
群れをおびき寄せてくれねえ
か！よく見えるように見晴ら
しの良い所から頼む！

62608.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62608.description: This is the practice finals quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or from clear rewards.
62608.descriptionEn:
This is the practice finals quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or from clear rewards.
62608.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で、
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

62795.description: It is I! The Instructor! A hunter must never neglect training! Master Fighting! If you can master it, you will be able to destroy even solid rock without a weapon! Do your best, hunters!
62795.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
A hunter must never
neglect their training!
Master the Brawler art!
Once you have it down, you
could shatter solid rock
with your bare hands!
Give it your all, hunters!
62795.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
ハンターたるもの訓練を
怠ってはならん！
「格闘」を使いこなすんだ！
使いこなすことができたなら
強固な岩ですら、武器が
無くとも破壊できるだろう！
頑張れ！ハンター諸君！

62649.objectiveJp: 橙晶石の欠片４個の納品
62649.description: It seems you have gathered quite a lot. One step closer to my dream. A little more. I want you to stay with me just a little longer. Of course, when it is done I will give you wonderful treasure.
62649.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered quite a
lot. One step closer to my dream.
Just a little more.
I want you to keep me company
just a little longer.
Of course, once it's done I'll
give you splendid treasure.
62649.descriptionJp:
だいぶ集まってきたようだ。
俺の夢までもう一歩。
もう少し。
あともう少しだけ付き合って
欲しい。
もちろん、達成できた暁には
素晴らしいお宝をあげるよ。

56082.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56082.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56082.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

50232.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50232.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
50232.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
50232.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

55804.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55804.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55804.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
55804.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

63326.description: A sweet festival is being held. It is a festival for giving Porta Chocolate to men. Perhaps a gift alone does not convey your feelings? Why not add a message to your present? That alone will turn it into a truly wonderful gift!
63326.descriptionEn:
A sweet festival is here.
It's a festival where you give
≪Porta Chocolate≫ to a man.
Just handing it over might not
get your feelings across, you
know? Why not add a message
along with your gift?
That alone will turn it into a
truly wonderful present!
63326.descriptionJp:
甘いお祭りが開催されます。
≪ポルタチョコ≫を男性に
渡すお祭りです。
渡すだけだと気持ちは伝わら
ないかもですよ？プレゼント
と一緒にメッセージを添えて
みてはどうでしょうか。
それだけでとっても素敵な
贈り物に大変身ですよ！

60556.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
60556.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Vojan. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60556.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target this time is ≪Vojan≫!
To hunt a monster all on your
own shows real spirit - truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a place up top!
Also, this one's Origin weapon
only! Choose your weapon well!
60556.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ヴォージャン≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

55561.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
55561.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn a reward far beyond the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
55561.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, show me the
skill you've honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
Hunt it well and you'll earn
a reward far beyond what your
daily efforts would bring
you.
55561.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

62629.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
62629.description: Much about that monster's behavior is still a mystery. To think it would appear at a time like this, no one could have predicted. Seizing this chance, we will conduct a survey that would not normally be possible. Slay it if you can, and if that is too much, at least break some parts.
62629.descriptionEn:
That monster's behavior still
holds so many mysteries.
I never expected it to appear
at a time like this.
Let's use this chance to run
surveys we normally can't.
Slay it if you can; if not,
at least break its parts
somehow. Please.
62629.descriptionJp:
あのモンスターの行動には、
まだまだ謎が多いようですね。
まさか、こんなタイミングで
出現するとは予想不能でした。
この機会を活かし、通常では
できない調査を行ないます。
できれば討伐、難しければ
なんとか部位破壊だけでも
お願いします。

55165.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
55165.description: Slaying Kamu Orugaron and Nono Orugaron raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55165.descriptionEn:
By slaying Kam Orugaron and
Non Orugaron, you can raise
your own rating while cheaply
gathering the materials you
need for G Rank decorations.
We've prepared a quest for
just that.
Please make good use of it.
55165.descriptionJp:
カム・オルガロンとノノ・オ
ルガロンを討伐することで、
自身の評価を上げつつ、Ｇ級
装飾品を手に入れるために
必要な素材をお得に入手
できるクエストを準備
しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

23361.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
23361.description: A request that lets you obtain the Tonfa, the weapon every G Rank hunter wants. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku to get the materials to craft the "Crimson Pact". You can craft it without advancing the Diva's story, so put it to use in your hunting life ahead.
23361.descriptionEn:
A request that lets you obtain
the ≪Tonfa≫, the weapon every
G Rank hunter wants.
Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku to get the
materials to craft the
"Crimson Pact".
You can craft it without
advancing the Diva's story,
so put it to use in your
hunting life ahead.
23361.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ハンターになったら手に
入れたい武器種≪穿龍棍≫が
入手できる依頼です。
イャンクックを狩猟すると、
「クリムゾンパクト」の生産
素材が入手できます。
歌姫ストーリーを進めていな
くても生産できますので、
今後の狩猟生活にぜひお役立
てください。

61145.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

50794.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
50794.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
50794.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

53320.description: I've gathered a great many throwing knives, so this time I want you to show off your skill as a knife thrower! Landing them takes knack, so it will be hard work, but do your best! Also, I've put a Farcaster among the junk in the new arena, so look for it if you are in trouble!
53320.descriptionEn:
I've gathered up tons of
throwing knives, so this time
I want to see you show off
some fine knife throwing!
It takes knack to land a hit,
so it won't be easy - but give
it your best! I left some
Farcasters in the junk at the
New Great Arena - go look!
53320.descriptionJp:
投げナイフをいっぱい集めた
ので、今回ナイフ使いとして、
上手な投げ方を披露してほし
い！当てるにはコツがいるの
で大変だろうけど、頑張って
くれよ！
あと新大闘技場のガラクタに
モドリ玉を用意したから、
困ったら探してみて！

61243.description: First, it is the custom of the Hunting Friends Festival for men and women each to overcome a trial befitting them. This one is for male hunters, so female hunters should take the other quest.
61243.descriptionEn:
First, men and women each
must clear their own trial -
that's the way of the Hunters'
Festival. This one's for male
hunters, so female hunters
take the other quest.
61243.descriptionJp:
まずは、男女それぞれで
それなりの試練を突破するのが
猟友祭の習わしだ。
こっちは男性ハンター用だから
女性ハンターはもう１つの
クエストを受けておくれ。

23292.description: The survey of Tide Island is going well, and many new materials have been found. Word is that most of them can be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Many G-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous places, will surely be interested.
23292.descriptionEn:
The Tidal Island survey is
going well, and many new
materials are being found.
Most of them can be used to
craft and upgrade gear, or so
we hear. Many G Rank hunters
who venture into dangerous
lands may well be interested.
Won't you take part?
23292.descriptionJp:
潮島の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

63176.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63176.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63176.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63176.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

55085.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55085.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55085.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

60220.description: Two powerful Khezu Subspecies have appeared. The Guild will pay a large sum to the hunter who slays both. In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware.
60220.descriptionEn:
Two powerful ≪Khezu
Subspecies≫ have appeared.
The Guild will pay a hefty
sum to the hunter who slays
both. Other rewards are
slim in exchange, so keep
that in mind.
60220.descriptionJp:
≪フルフル≫の亜種の強力な
個体が２頭現れたわ。
ギルドでは、この２頭を討伐
したハンターに、多額の報酬
金を支払うことになったの。
その代わり、その他の見返り
は控えめなので要注意よ。

62362.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
62362.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters alongside your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62362.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I
have prepared a difficult
request. Slay several monsters
together with your Guild
comrades. No supplies at all
will be provided, so talk it
over with your comrades first.
The reward is a special ore!
62362.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を猟団の仲間と行う
のだ。支給品も一切用意
しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

50974.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50974.description: Teostra has been confirmed rampaging in the swamp. It will be dangerous in various ways, but please investigate. The reward is precious decoration materials.
50974.descriptionEn:
Teostra has been confirmed to be
running wild in the Swamp.
It will be dangerous in many ways,
but please carry out a survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50974.descriptionJp:
沼地でテオ・テスカトルが暴
れているのが確認されました。
何かと危険かとは思いますが、
調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50235.description: Word has it that White Star Iron has been found in the wasteland known as the Canyon. Anyone who wants White Star Iron, why not join the survey party? We supply the goods and the food. Once supplies run out you will be living off the land, so join only if you are prepared for that.
50235.descriptionEn:
There is a rumor that White Star Iron
has been found in the wasteland,
≪Canyon≫. Anyone who wants
White Star Iron, why not join the
survey team? We have prepared
goods and food on our side.
If need be you will live off the
land, so only those with resolve
should join.
50235.descriptionJp:
荒野の大地、≪峡谷≫にて、
あの白星鉄が見つかったとい
う噂がある。白星鉄が欲しい
奴は探索隊に参加してみない
か？物品や食料はこちらで
用意してある。必要になれば
自給自足の生活になるので、
覚悟がある奴だけ参加して
ほしい。

23601.description: A giant dragon's shadow was sighted at the crater of the Great Volcano, which erupts constantly, and a survey team was dispatched. According to their report, a crimson Fatalis mutated into an even more monstrous form was lurking there. Past examples show we cannot leave it be. Please slay it quickly.
23601.descriptionEn:
A gigantic dragon's shadow was
sighted in the crater of the great
volcano that ceaselessly erupts,
and we dispatched a survey team.
Their report says a Crimson Fatalis,
mutated into a more monstrous form,
was lurking there. Judging by past
cases, we cannot leave it be.
We ask for a swift slaying.
23601.descriptionJp:
常に噴火を繰り返す大火山の
火口に巨大な龍の影が目撃さ
れ調査団を派遣しました。
彼等の報告では、より異形に
変異した紅きミラボレアスが
潜んでいたとのこと。
過去の例を見てもこのまま
放っておくことは出来ません。
迅速な討伐をお願いします。

60915.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐

23434.description: Information has come in that a Kirin was sighted in the decisive battlefield. According to the report from the hunter who saw it, it unleashed attacks never seen before. Since there is a high chance it is a more powerful individual than before, we are issuing an investigation request to veteran hunters.
23434.descriptionEn:
Word has come in that a Kirin
was sighted at the Battlefield.
According to the hunter who
saw it, it unleashed attacks
never seen before. As it is
likely a stronger individual
than any so far, we are issuing
this survey request to veteran
hunters.
23434.descriptionJp:
決戦場にて、キリンを目撃し
たとの情報が入ってきました。
目撃したハンターからの報告
によるとこれまで見たことが
ない攻撃を繰り出してきたと
のことです。これまでより強
力な個体の可能性が高いため、
熟練のハンターに調査依頼を
出させて頂きます。

61133.description: You must not rely only on guarding. Dodge by a hair's breadth. That is what my master always told me. Now I understand his words. I want to pass the same words to you. Dodge!
61133.descriptionEn:
You cannot rely on guarding
alone. Read it at the last moment
and dodge. My master told me
that constantly. Only now do I
understand his words. I want to
pass the same words to you.
Dodge!
61133.descriptionJp:
ガードにばかり頼っていては
駄目だ。ギリギリで見切って
避けろ。と私は師匠から常々
言われてきた。今になって師
匠の言葉が理解出来た。私も
君達に同じ言葉を伝えたい。
避けろ！

26113.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

50083.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

26657.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26657.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
26657.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

61401.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟
61401.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Once you have departed the certificate cannot be returned for any reason. Take special care, as the opponent this time is extremely dangerous.
61401.descriptionEn:
A special request and reward,
just for members of winning
Hunter Festival guilds.
Please have your Festival
Proof when you accept or join.
Once you depart, it cannot be
returned, no matter what.
And this target is especially
dangerous - do take care.
61401.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできません。
特に、今回は大変危険な相手
のため、ご注意ください。

21471.description: I want to repair my weapon, but I am a little short of materials! To depart on the hunt as soon as possible, I want your help. So, let us trade the Gurenzeburu's Fine Scale for my Paw Medal. Please!
21471.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon, but I
am a little short on materials!
I must set out hunting as soon as
possible, so I truly need your
help.
So how about we trade your
≪Gurenzeburu Scale+≫ for my
≪Pawprint Medal≫?
I am counting on you!
21471.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいのだが、
少し素材が足りないのだ！
一刻も早く狩りへ出発する為、
ぜひとも協力してほしい。
そこで、≪蛮竜の上鱗≫と
私の≪肉球のメダル≫を交換
しようではないか。
よろしく頼む！

61933.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の討伐
61933.description: This is the practice final for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot get the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
61933.descriptionEn:
This is the practice final for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament. You cannot get the
target monster's materials
from carving or clear
rewards.
61933.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

50504.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
50504.description: It is I! The Instructor! This time the request is to explore the Swamp. The Guild reports sighting the Roaring Wolf Kamu Orugaron. For safety I will lend you armor, but go carefully!
50504.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This request is a Swamp hunt.
The Guild reports a sighting
of the Roaring Wolf ≪Kam
Orugaron≫.
I'll lend you armor for safety,
but do be careful out there!
50504.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
今回の依頼は、沼地の探索だ。
響狼≪カム・オルガロン≫を
目撃したと、ギルドより報告
があった。
安全の為、防具を貸し出すが、
気をつけていくのだぞ！

60555.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
60555.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Vojan. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60555.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target this time is ≪Vojan≫!
You'll be taking on the target
together with your guildmates.
Teamwork is everything in this
contest - go take a place up
top!
Also, this one's Origin weapon
only! Choose your weapon well!
60555.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ヴォージャン≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

60943.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種の狩猟
60943.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60943.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
60943.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50092.description: I want to make the same Kuku series for the new hunting party member as I have. This armor is easy to move in and cute in design, a favorite among beginners. You can get it through this request, so why not join in too?
50092.descriptionEn:
I want to make a Kukubo Series
set, matching mine, for the new
member of our guild.
This armor is easy to move in
and its design is cute, so it is
popular with beginners.
You can get it from this
request, so why not come along?
50092.descriptionJp:
新しく入った猟団員に、わた
しとお揃いの≪ククボシリー
ズ≫を作ってあげたいの。
この防具は、動きやすいし、
デザインも可愛くて初心者に
人気の装備よ。
この依頼で手に入るから、
あなたも一緒にいかが？

28050.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
28050.description: We have word from a hunter surveying the Ancient Tower of an Orugaron sighting. It seems to be standing quietly, but hunt it before it harms anything around it.
28050.descriptionEn:
We've word from a hunter who
was surveying the Ancient
Tower: a Roaring Wolf was
sighted. It seems to be
standing quietly, but hunt it
before it harms anyone nearby.
28050.descriptionJp:
古塔を調査していたハンター
より響狼を目撃したとの情報
が届いております。
大人しく佇んでいるとの事で
すが周りに危害を加える前に
狩猟してきてください。

62335.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

22034.description: The highlands, an untrodden land. In this newly discovered place, a new flying wyvern seems to have been discovered at last. From its powerful form it was named Gurenzeburu. This time the request is to hunt it. Why not experience a hunt in a new world?
22034.descriptionEn:
An untrodden land, the Highlands.
In this newly discovered place,
a new Flying Wyvern has finally
been found, it seems. For its
powerful form the wyvern was
named ≪Taikun Zamuza≫.
This time the request is to hunt
it. Why not try a hunt in a new land?
22034.descriptionJp:
未踏の地、高地。
新たに発見されたこの地で、
ついに新しく飛竜が発見され
たようです。力強い姿から
≪蛮竜≫と名付けられた飛竜。
今回はそれの狩猟依頼となり
ます。新天地での狩りを体験
してみてはいかがでしょうか？

58050.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58050.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58050.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58050.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

54114.description: Where does that agility of the Midogaron come from? Where is that strength born? Ah, I cannot stand not knowing. Please, lend me your strength for a survey! I want to investigate it thoroughly, so break its head and back for me too!
54114.descriptionEn:
Where does Midogaron get
that agility from?
Where does it draw that
raw power?
Ah, I simply must know!
Please, lend me your strength
for this survey!
I want to study it thoroughly,
so break its head and back
along the way too!
54114.descriptionJp:
ミドガロンのあの俊敏さは
どこからきているのだろう。
あの力強さはどこから生み
出しているのだろう。
ああ、知りたくてたまらな
い。お願いだ調査のために
力を貸してくれ！
とことん調べてみたいので
頭と背中の破壊も一緒に
頼むよ！

50233.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
50233.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.
50233.descriptionJp:
どうやら修復に必要な地図の
断片を集めてくれたようだな。
ちょっと枚数が多いけど、
私なら元に戻せるだろう。
集めた断片をそこのボックス
に入れといてくれ。
作業が終わったら複製した地
図をやろう。武具工房に持っ
ていくと喜ばれるかもな。

21465.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Rajang. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21465.descriptionEn:
This is the counter for the
Hunt Technique Quest to slay
a ≪Rajang≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills against
other hunters here!
21465.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪ラージャン≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

26695.description: Hypnocatrice and Cephadrome are breeding in great numbers! We have asked hunters from every region for help, but the truth is there are simply too many. So we are looking for hunters willing to take this hunt with 2 hunters at most. Those aiming to rank up quickly are especially encouraged.
26695.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and Cephadrome
are breeding out of control!
We asked hunters everywhere
for aid, but there are simply
too many. So we seek those
who can take this hunt with
two people. Fast rank-ups
are especially welcome.
26695.descriptionJp:
眠鳥と砂竜が大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

62901.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
62901.description: There was a report of sighting an extremely powerful individual Crystal Wyvern at the top of the sea of trees. The Crystal Wyvern has a constitution that absorbs and reflects lightning, so hunting it carries considerable danger. We therefore ask skilled hunters to hunt it, so please.
62901.descriptionEn:
A report has come in that an
extremely powerful individual
Crystal Wyvern was sighted at
the top of the Great Forest.
The Crystal Wyvern absorbs and
reflects lightning, so hunting
it carries considerable danger.
We ask our skilled Hunters to
take on the hunt. Thank you.
62901.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部にて極めて強力な
個体の晶竜を目撃したとの
報告がありました。
晶竜は、雷を吸収・反射する
体質で、狩猟はかなりの危険
が伴います。
そこで、腕利きのハンターに
狩猟を依頼しますので、
よろしくお願いします。

60685.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
60685.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Kuarusepusu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60685.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target is a special
individual: ≪Kuarlusepusu≫!
To hunt a monster all on your
own shows real spirit - truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a place up top!
This one is Supremacy weapon
only, so don't forget!
60685.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
特異個体の
≪クアルセプス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

26670.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26670.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Shogun Ceanataur Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26670.descriptionEn:
This Hunting Skill quest is a
≪Shogun Ceanataur Variant≫
slaying job.
Why not sharpen your skills
against each other, hunters!
26670.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪ショウグンギザミ変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

54662.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54662.description: So you're the Hunter who has conquered the G Rank sea routes. In this quest you can trade Caravan Secret Boxes for other Caravan Boxes. On top of that, you can earn plenty of both GRP and Gz! Monsters will appear as well, so keep your guard up and head out hunting.
54662.descriptionEn:
So you're the Hunter who has
conquered the G Rank sea
routes. In this quest you can
trade Caravan Secret Boxes for
other Caravan Boxes. On top of
that, you can earn plenty of
both GRP and Gz! Monsters will
appear as well, so keep your
guard up and head out hunting.
54662.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級の航路を制覇されたハン
ターさんですね。このクエス
トではキャラバン秘箱を他の
キャラバン箱に交換すること
ができます。その他にも、Ｇ
ＲＰ、Ｇｚ共に大量に獲得す
ることができます！モンス
ターも登場しますので、油断
せず狩猟に向かってください。

50732.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the crest of a Congalala will also grant a special ingredient.
50732.descriptionEn:
To spread word of the Guild
Priority requests we have long
run, we have prepared this
quest for you.
Break the crest of the
Congalala, and a special
ingredient will be granted to
you as well.
50732.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
桃毛獣のトサカを破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

22162.description: Are you eating properly? Without good food you cannot summon strength when it counts! Right, would you take a job from me? For the reward I will prepare ingredients that never sit on shop shelves. Use them to cook something delicious!
22162.descriptionEn:
Are you eating properly?
If you do not eat good food,
you will have no strength when
it counts!
That's right, why not take on
one of my requests?
For the reward, I will prepare
ingredients not normally sold.
Use them and cook something tasty!
22162.descriptionJp:
ちゃんと食事はしてるかい？
いいもんを食べていないと、
肝心な時に力が出ないよ！
そうだ、ちょっとあたしの
依頼を受けてくれないかい？
報酬には、普段店に並ばない
食材も用意させてもらうよ。
これを使って、美味しい食事
を作ってみておくれ！

50282.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50282.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50282.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50282.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

26557.description: Hunting in an untrodden land, that is surely the true thrill of the hunter. You understand? So, a hunting request in the Highlands. The purpose is an ecological survey, so finish it quickly while no big game is about.
26557.descriptionEn:
Hunting in untrodden lands, that is
the true thrill of being a hunter.
You know what I mean?
So, here is a hunting request for
the ≪Highlands≫. The goal is an
ecology survey, so finish it quickly
while nothing big is around.
26557.descriptionJp:
未踏の大地での狩猟、これ
こそがハンターの醍醐味
だろう。わかるよな？
てなわけで≪高地≫での狩猟
依頼だ。生態調査が目的なの
で、大物がいない間にさっと
済ませてきてくれよ。

60723.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60723.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60723.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60723.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26070.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26070.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26070.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

54162.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
54162.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54162.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54162.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62328.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
62328.description: Have you heard from the workshop master about a special ore called the Kinos Secret Stone? If not, let me introduce this request. The Kinos Secret Stone is a special material needed to craft a certain armor. Gather enough and have the master craft it for you.
62328.descriptionEn:
Ever heard of the special
ore called ≪Kinos Gemstone≫
from the smithy master?
If not, then let me
recommend this job.
≪Kinos Gemstone≫ is a rare
material needed to forge
certain armor. Gather a few
and have the master craft it.
62328.descriptionJp:
≪キノス秘石≫という特殊な
鉱石を、武具工房の親方から
聞いたことがあるか？
知らないなら、この依頼を
紹介しよう。
≪キノス秘石≫は、ある防具
の生産に必要な特殊な素材だ。
数を集めて、親方に生産して
もらうといいだろう。

50892.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 8 Porta Tickets Sakura. Repel the mysterious monster that appeared at the Old Tower over and over and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade a Conquest weapon.
50892.descriptionEn:
I've prepared a lovely quest
you can take in exchange for
8 Sakura Porta Tickets.
Repel the mysterious monster
that appeared at the Ancient
Tower again and again, and
you'll get materials to
upgrade ≪Zenith Weapons≫.
50892.descriptionJp:
ポルタチケット桜８枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
古塔に現れた謎のモンス
ターを繰り返し撃退する
と、≪覇種武器≫の強化
に必要な素材が入手でき
るわよ。

55117.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
55117.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Pink Rathian while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55117.descriptionEn:
By slaying a Rathian
Subspecies, you can raise your
rating while cheaply getting
the materials you need for
G Rank decorations. We've
prepared just such a quest.
Please make good use of it.
55117.descriptionJp:
リオレイア亜種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

51072.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
51072.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the wing claws of a Teostra will also grant a special ingredient.
51072.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking Teostra's wing
claws, special ingredients will
also be granted to you.
51072.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
炎王龍の翼爪を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

55327.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a shell break in slaying Daimyo Hermitaur, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55327.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ and
break its shell, we will
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55327.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪盾蟹≫討伐にて
ヤド破壊を達成した際には
さらに報酬をお渡しいたし
ます。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

53156.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

51028.description: In a mountain region known as the sacred peak, an elder dragon wreathed in storms has been confirmed. Many nearby villages have voiced their unease, and a swift response is needed. Hunters, head for the sacred peak at once.
51028.descriptionEn:
In a mountain region known as
the Sacred Peak, an Elder Dragon
wreathed in storms has been
confirmed. Many voices of worry
have come from nearby villages,
so a swift response is needed.
Hunters, head for the Sacred
Peak at once.
51028.descriptionJp:
とある山岳地帯にある、霊峰
と呼ばれる地域にて、嵐を
纏う古龍が確認されました。
近隣の村々からは不安の声が
多数寄せられており、早急に
対応が必要です。
ハンターは至急、霊峰へと
向かってください。

21909.description: A request that lets HR100 hunters craft and upgrade the recommended "Kirin SP Series" armor. Slay the Kirin at the Battlefield, and you'll get the crafting and upgrade materials for one piece of the "Kirin SP Series". Use them well in your hunts!
21909.descriptionEn:
A request that lets HR100
hunters craft and upgrade the
recommended "Kirin SP Series"
armor.
Slay the Kirin at the
Battlefield, and you'll get
the crafting and upgrade
materials for one piece of the
"Kirin SP Series".
Use them well in your hunts!
21909.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００になったハンター
にオススメの防具「キリンSP
シリーズ」が生産・強化でき
る依頼です。
決戦場に現れたキリンを討伐
すると、「キリンSPシリーズ」
１部位分の生産・強化素材が
入手できます。
今後の狩猟生活にぜひお役立
てください。

58070.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58070.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58070.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58070.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

54653.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54653.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54653.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

62017.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
62017.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62017.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor
obtain rewards of the official
hunting tournament, so take care.
62017.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報版で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

63340.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63340.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63340.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63340.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

50679.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Artela FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50679.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of the
≪Zenith Armor≫ Arteria FX
series.
Accepting the quest requires
≪Superior Tickets≫.
Note that if you fail the
quest, your ≪Superior
Tickets≫ will be consumed.
50679.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
アルテラFXシリーズの１部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

62453.objectiveJp: ゲキレツ毒テング５個の納品
62453.description: I am developing a new accessory for Guku. This and that, the image will not settle. I want to see something, well, sharp. I want you to find reference materials in the swamp.
62453.descriptionEn:
I'm developing a new accessory
for the Gook.
This and that, nothing quite
settles into an image.
I want to see something, well,
striking.
Go find me reference materials
in the Swamp, would you?
62453.descriptionJp:
グークの新しいアクセサリー
を開発中である。
あんなもの、こんなもの、
イメージが固まらない。
なにかこう、キバツなもの
を見たい。
沼地で参考材料を探してきて
欲しい。

61559.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン青３個の納品
61559.description: 1st Place server, congratulations. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Blue) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61559.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on taking 1st
place on your server!
We've readied a special reward
for hunters who cleared the
Guild Idaten Cup.
The more Blue Hunter Coins you
deliver, the better your odds
at rare materials.
61559.descriptionJp:
【１位】サーバー、
おめでとうございます。
猟団対抗韋駄天杯をクリアさ
れたハンターに専用の報酬を
用意させていただきました。
ハンターコイン青の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

23163.description: The Mosswine can sniff out the smell of mushrooms keenly and locate them precisely. I have been thinking whether we could do some business using that. First I want to know the Mosswine's ecology. Would you take a little job for me?
23163.descriptionEn:
Mosswine can sniff out the
smell of mushrooms keenly and
find the exact spot.
I've been wondering if I could
make a business of it.
First I want to know their
ecology. Would you take a
little job for me?
23163.descriptionJp:
モスはキノコの匂いを敏感に
かぎ分け、正確に場所を探す
ことができるのだ。
これを利用して、何か商売が
できないかと考えていてね。
まずはモスの生態を知ってお
きたい。ちょっと頼まれては
くれないか？

50503.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
50503.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR11.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of
weapon upgrades as pay?
Easy work - just run out and
slay a Gogomoa.
That's all!
I'm counting on ya!
50503.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ１１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の強化素材一式で
どうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってゴゴモアを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

60002.description: The season is the breeding season! The stage is the Jungle at night! Gather the monsters' eggs and deliver them! If you obtain gold or silver eggs as a reward, they can be sold for a high price! Hunters aiming to make a fortune at one stroke, do join us!
60002.descriptionEn:
The season is the breeding season!
Gather monster eggs in the Jungle
at night and deliver them!
If you get Gold or Silver Eggs in
your rewards, they sell for a high
price!
Hunters chasing a fortune, come
join us, every one of you!
60002.descriptionJp:
季節は繁殖期！舞台となる夜
の密林でモンスターたちの卵
を採取して納品せよ！
報酬で金や銀のタマゴが入手
できれば高額で売却が可能！
一獲千金を狙うハンターたち
はもれなくご参加ください！

26730.description: I wanted to see the Canyon's fine views once, and when I set foot there I ran into vicious monsters. In your terms, I suppose they were a Yian Garuga and a Rajang. I could not face them alone, so I could go no further and had to turn back. Please get rid of them.
26730.descriptionEn:
I longed to see the Canyon's
grand view just once, but the
moment I stepped in I met with
vicious monsters. In your terms,
they would be the Yian Garuga
and the Rajang, I believe. I
could not fight them alone, so
I could go no further and came
back. Please, drive them off!
26730.descriptionJp:
峡谷の絶景を一度見たくて、
足を踏み入れたら、凶暴な
モンスターに遭遇してしまい
ました。そちらの呼び方です
と、黒狼鳥と金獅子でしょう
か。一人では太刀打ちできな
いので、先へ進めず仕方なく
戻ってきました。どうか彼ら
を退治してほしいです。

11056.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
11056.description: Hunting Iodrome in the volcanic zone may be a little troublesome! A wounded Iodrome may flee into places where a hunter loses stamina fast. The trick is not to let it escape!
11056.descriptionEn:
Hunting ≪Gendrome≫ in the volcano
region may be a bit of a bother!
A Gendrome that has spent its
stamina may flee into nasty spots
that drain a hunter's own stamina!
The trick is not to let it escape!
11056.descriptionJp:
火山地帯で≪ドスイーオス≫
を狩猟するのは、少し面倒か
も知れないです！体力を消耗
したドスイーオスは、狩人が
体力を消耗する、嫌な場所に
逃げ込む可能性があります！
逃さないのがコツですよ！

61171.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. We ask only first-rate hunters to investigate and, if possible, to slay its source. It is too dangerous for us to supply items. Prepare thoroughly!
61171.descriptionEn:
A sandstorm of tremendous scale
has been measured in the Desert.
We ask skilled hunters only to
survey it and, if possible, to
slay whatever is causing it.
It is far too dangerous, so no
items can be supplied.
Please prepare thoroughly!
61171.descriptionJp:
砂漠で、極めて大規模の
砂嵐が計測されました。
凄腕のハンター限定での
調査と、可能であれば
発生源の討伐をお願い
いたします。危険すぎるた
め、アイテム支給はできま
せん。万全の準備を！

26311.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26311.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26311.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26311.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

40210.description: You cannot run far. Fighting back will not do either. Once it begins, get close quickly. Even when things look bad, do not give up until the end. That intense light will deal unbelievable damage!
40210.descriptionEn:
You can't run far, and you
can't fight back. Close the
distance fast once it starts.
Even when it looks bad, never
give up. That intense light
deals unthinkable damage!
40210.descriptionJp:
遠くに逃げることはできない。
さからうのもダメだ。開始後、
はやく近くに寄るんだ。
ヤバくなっても最後まであき
らめるな。強烈な光はありえ
ないダメージを受けるぞ！

58115.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58115.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58115.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58115.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62436.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
62436.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62436.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62436.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

26659.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
26659.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
26659.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

62587.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
62587.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62587.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62587.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

26087.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26087.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26087.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

21495.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

61847.objectiveJp: キラビートル５０匹の納品
61847.description: There are all sorts of bugs in this world. Among them, I like Kira Beetles and collect lots of them. If you'll help too, bring me 50 at a time. Then I'll give you one Slash Hard Gem.
61847.descriptionEn:
There are all sorts of insects
in this world, you know.
Among them, I love the
≪Kira Beetle≫ and collect
heaps of them.
If you'll help me too, bring
them to me every 50 you
gather.
Then I'll give you one
≪Slash Hard Jade≫.
61847.descriptionJp:
この世界には様々な虫たちが
いるよね。
その中でも、私は≪キラビー
トル≫が好きでたくさん集め
てるの。
あなたも手伝ってくれるなら、
５０匹ごとに私のところに
持ってきて。
そしたら≪斬硬玉≫を１つあ
げるよ。

60549.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Kushala Daora. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60549.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target is ≪Kushala Daora≫!
You'll take on the target
together with your guildmates.
Teamwork is everything in this
contest - go take a place up
top!
Also, this one's Origin weapon
only! Choose your weapon well!
60549.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪クシャルダオラ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

26719.description: What, you just want a hard Lance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26719.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Lance, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!
26719.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬いランスが
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

50276.description: A very ferocious Odd Species Akura Jebia is in the Desert at night, and the merchants cannot make camp. Supplies tend to run short in the cold season as it is. With your high skill you should be able to complete this request. I am counting on you!
50276.descriptionEn:
In the Desert at night, a very
savage ≪Akura Jebia Rare
Species≫ is around, and the
merchants can't make camp.
Supplies already run short in
the cold season as it is.
With your skill, you should be
able to handle this request.
I'm counting on you!
50276.descriptionJp:
夜の砂漠にて、とても狂暴な
≪アクラ・ジェビア奇種≫が
いて、商人たちが野営できな
いそうだ。
ただでさえ寒冷期は物資が
不足しがちなんだ。
あなたたちの高い腕前なら
この依頼を達成できるはずだ。
頼んだぞ！

55370.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to craft Zinogre armor! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade Transcendent armor, so please take it on!
55370.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to forge
Zinogre armor!
Clear the sub-target and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade Transit armor, so give
it a try!
55370.descriptionJp:
雷狼竜≪ジンオウガ≫の防具
を作りたいハンターに向けた、
特別クエストを用意しました！
サブターゲットを達成すると
遷悠防具の強化に必要な素材
を入手できますので、ぜひ
挑戦して下さい！

54866.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54866.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54866.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

63334.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that guarantees an Armorer's Soul: Harmony. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63334.descriptionEn:
For members of winning Hunter
Festival guilds only, we've
prepared a quest that reliably
grants ≪Smith's Soul [Wa]≫.
Please have your Festival Proof
when you accept and join.
63334.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪武具職
人魂【和】≫が確実に手に入
るクエストを用意させていた
だきました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

26161.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26161.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26161.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

54975.objectiveJp: ナルガクルガ１頭の狩猟

54404.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
54404.description: We are surveying the Black Gravios, the great beast that walks the volcano clad in heavy armor. Its ecology remains largely unknown. Please hunt it and lend your strength to our research!
54404.descriptionEn:
We're surveying the ≪Black
Gravios≫ in the Volcano, the
one clad in heavy armor.
Its ecology is still unknown.
Please hunt it and lend your
strength to our research!
54404.descriptionJp:
火山にいる、大きな鎧を身に
纏った≪黒鎧竜≫の調査を
行っています。
その生態はまだまだ未解明。
どうか狩猟を行い、我々の研
究に力を貸してください！

50533.description: Hunter, this is serious! A request to slay a Meraginasu has come in! And it is a request that calls for Grable G Brave gear! Eh? You do not have any? For hunters like you I have prepared an extra Orb of Light! Just do a simple favour for me and it is yours!
50533.descriptionEn:
Hunter, we've got trouble!
A slaying request for
Meraginasu just came in!
And it needs Grable G Brave!
Eh? You don't have one?
Well, for hunters like you,
I've prepared extra "Orbs of
Light"! Just do a simple favor
for me and they're yours!
50533.descriptionJp:
ハンターさん大変です！
メラギナスの討伐依頼が飛び
込んできました！それもグレ
イブルＧブレイブが必要な依
頼なんです！え？持ってない？
そんなハンターさんのために
「光の鋼玉」を追加で用意し
ました！簡単なお願いを聞い
てくれたら差し上げます！

26268.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26268.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26268.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

54590.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

54552.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Baruragaru, the Blood Devouring Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54552.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Blood
Eating Wyvern
≪Baruragaru≫. Accepting
the quest requires a
≪Superior Ticket≫. Note
that if the quest fails,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will
be consumed.
54552.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、喰血竜
≪バルラガル≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

26328.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26328.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26328.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26328.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

60034.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
60034.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!
60034.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在です。
姿無きところから姿を現わし
熟練の狩人でも手に負えない。
捕獲なんて無理なことは考え
ないで慎重かつ着実に攻撃を
重ねるしかないと思います！

62603.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス２頭の狩猟

60931.objectiveJp: イャンクック６頭の狩猟
60931.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
60931.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.
60931.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。
こちらは祭典の証は必要あり
ません。クエストの達成のみで
様々な報酬が払い出される
ようになっております。

21870.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
21870.description: Lately an unexplained situation has arisen in the highlands. There was a report that herbivores are decreasing in one area. When we went to investigate, strange sounds rang out from nowhere, and the investigator fled in fear. Please investigate at once.
21870.descriptionEn:
Lately, unexplained events
have been happening in the
Highlands. Herbivores are
said to be declining in one
area. Our surveyors went,
heard a strange sound from
nowhere and fled in fear.
Please begin a survey at once.
21870.descriptionJp:
最近、高地にて原因不明の
事態が発生しています。
ある一部の地域で草食種が
減少しているという報告があ
りました。
調査に赴いたところ、どこか
らともなく不思議な音が鳴り
響き、調査員は怖くて退避し
たそうです。
直ちに調査をお願いします。

40204.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟

50861.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50861.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
50861.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Long
Sword, show us the skill you have
honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
50861.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55334.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55334.description: The Variant Species Akura Vashimu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55334.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy Akura Vashimu
has grown ferociously strong and
keeps on rampaging.
It is far too dangerous as it is.
Prepare thoroughly and carry
out the survey.
55334.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫
は猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続
けています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

21773.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21773.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21773.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21773.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

63285.description: A Supremacy Doragyurosu, said to reduce all to ash, has appeared! Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
63285.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Doragyurosu, said to
reduce all things to ash, has
appeared!
This is a race against time, so
the request is to slay it in a
short time, but to keep the
damage minimal, a mere repel will
also be counted.
We seek hunters with Secret Arts
who will face this
unprecedented crisis!
63285.descriptionJp:
全てを灰燼に帰するといわれ
る覇種冥雷竜が現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

60542.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
60542.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blue Yian Kut-Ku. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60542.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target is ≪Yian Kut-Ku
Subspecies≫!
You'll take on the target
together with your guildmates.
Teamwork is everything in this
contest - go take a top spot!
Also, SP weapons only this
time! Choose your weapon well!
60542.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪イャンクック亜種≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

1031.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
1031.description: A Diablos with a blackened body colour and a dreadfully fearsome appearance has been sighted! It must be a subspecies. If you succeed in hunting this subspecies, your skill may exceed even my imagination!
1031.descriptionEn:
A Diablos with blackened hide
and a truly terrifying shape
has been sighted! It's got to
be the Subspecies. If you can
hunt it down, your skill might
be beyond what even I can
imagine!
1031.descriptionJp:
黒ずんだ体色を持つひときわ
恐ろしい容姿のディアブロス
が目撃された！亜種に間違い
ないだろう。もしもキミがこ
の亜種の狩猟に成功したなら
キミの腕前はオイラの想像を
超えてるかも知れないな！

26174.description: I am in trouble. In the cold season I cannot keep up with the supply of ingredients. Sorry, but would you help me with the purchasing? As thanks I will give you my wife's prized ingredients.
26174.descriptionEn:
I'm in trouble.
The cold season has me short
on ingredients.
Sorry, but would you help me
with the supply run?
As thanks, I'll give you my
wife's prized ingredients.
26174.descriptionJp:
困ったよ。
寒冷期で食材の仕入れが
追いつかないんだよ。
悪いけど仕入れを手伝って
くれないかい？
お礼におかみのとっておきの
食材をあげるよ。

55703.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55703.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55703.descriptionEn:
You can obtain the materials
to craft one Supremacy
weapon from the Supremacy
Daimyo Hermitaur and upgrade
it once, plus Porta Cards
Sakura worth Gz. Weapon
types: Dual Blades, Hunting
Horn, Switch Axe, Light
Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun or Bow.
Use it to craft your favorite.
55703.descriptionJp:
辿異種ダイミョウザザミの
辿異武器１つの生産から
１段階目の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、双剣、狩猟笛、
剣斧、軽弩、重弩、弓の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

62317.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Gravios. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
62317.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Skill Quest
to slay Gravios.
The reward is a bit lower than
a normal hunt, but why not
sharpen your skills against
other hunters?
62317.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪グラビモス≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

40190.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
40190.description: To all who aim for the heights of GR: we prepared a quest where slaying a Gasurabazura raises your standing and lets you cheaply obtain the materials needed for G Rank decorations. Please make good use of it.
40190.descriptionEn:
To all who aim for the
heights of GR: we prepared a
quest where slaying a
Gasurabazura raises your
standing and lets you cheaply
obtain the materials needed
for G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.
40190.descriptionJp:
ＧＲの高みを目指す方々へ
ガスラバズラを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

26371.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
26371.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26371.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26371.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、上位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

12034.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
12034.description: Iodrome hits harder in a single blow than Velocidrome or Gendrome. If you feel your life is in danger, deliver Specialty Mushrooms growing in the swamp. Aging them in a Maka Pickling Jar is fine too, you know?
12034.descriptionEn:
≪Iodrome≫ hits harder per
blow than a Velocidrome or
Gendrome.
If your life feels at risk,
deliver ≪Special Mushrooms≫
growing in the swamp. You
may age them in a ≪Maka Pot≫?
12034.descriptionJp:
≪ドスイーオス≫はドスラン
ポスや、ドスゲネポスに比べ
一発の攻撃力が高いわ。
身の危険を感じたら、沼地に
生える≪特産キノコ≫を納品
するのよ。≪マカ漬けの壷≫
で熟成にしてもいいわよ？

62816.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

55767.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55767.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55767.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

53228.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の討伐

23553.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23553.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23553.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

54128.description: We are seeking hunters to help survey the Midogaron that appeared in the volcano. Midogaron generally act alone, and we believe that is because they are strong enough not to need a pack. This is a dangerous request, and only hunters with a solid record should apply.
54128.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to help
survey the Midogaron that appeared
in the Volcano.
Midogaron basically acts alone,
but that is thought to be because
it is strong enough that it has no
need to gather in packs.
This request is dangerous for any
hunter without a solid record.
54128.descriptionJp:
火山に出現したミドガロンを
調査するため、協力して頂け
るハンターを募集いたします。
ミドガロンは基本的に単体で
行動していますが、それは
自身が強いため、群れる必要
が無いからだと思われます。
十分な実績を持ったハンター
でなくては、危険な依頼です。

21331.description: What, you just want a hard Light Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21331.descriptionEn:
What, you just want a really
stiff Light Bowgun? Then I
will refine some Argen Steel!
But the ore needed is hard to
find, and nasty monsters roam
the area. Go find it with all
your spirit!
21331.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬いライト
ボウガンが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

53102.description: I gathered the supplies you collected where the Chacha were about to hold their feast, and a Gravios came around! At this rate my friends will be too frightened to come out. Hunt it in equipment that will not frighten them!
53102.descriptionEn:
I piled up the stuff you
gathered where the Chachabu
were about to throw a feast,
and then a Gravios came
wandering over!
At this rate my friends are
too scared to come out.
Go hunt it in gear that won't
startle them!
53102.descriptionJp:
君が集めてくれた道具を
チャチャブーが宴を開き
そうなところに集めて
おいたら、グラビモスが
寄ってきちゃったんだ！
このままじゃ僕の友達も
怖がって出てこないよ。
彼らを驚かせないような
装備で狩猟してきて！

62391.description: This is a trial quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Enjoy all the new features of Forward.2 to the fullest!
62391.descriptionEn:
This is a trial quest for the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Enjoy all the new features of
Forward.2 to the fullest!
62391.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの、体験会
クエストです。
フォワード．２の新要素を
存分にお楽しみください！

26339.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26339.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26339.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26339.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

26134.description: It is I, the Instructor! Good that you read this Quest Confirmation! Nice! Whatever the quest, important hints essential to clearing it are written here. Make sure you read them!
26134.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
You have done well to read
this ≪Quest Check≫! Nice!
Whatever the quest, the vital
hints you need to clear it are
written right here.
Make sure you always read them!
26134.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
よくぞこの≪クエスト確認≫
に目を通したな！ナイスだ！
どのクエストでも、ここには
クエストクリアに欠かせない
重要ヒントが書かれている。
必ず読むようにするのだぞ！

55670.description: To take this quest you need a Hunter Ring (Purple), nya. Take on the hunt for a Bulldrome holding more Song Gems than usual, nya. Choose a Prayer Gem, clear this quest and offer the Song Gems, nya!
55670.descriptionEn:
To take this quest you need a
"Hunter Ring Purple", meow.
You'll be hunting a Bulldrome
that holds more Song Orbs than
usual, meow.
Pick a Prayer Bead, clear this
quest, and offer up the Song
Orbs, meow!
55670.descriptionJp:
このクエストを受けるには
「ハンターリング紫」が
必要ニャ。
通常よりも多くの歌玉を秘め
たドスファンゴの狩猟に挑戦
するニャ。
祈珠を選んでこのクエストを
クリアし、歌玉を捧げるニャ！

61906.objectiveJp: リオレウス変種１頭の狩猟
61906.description: The King of the Sky, Rathalos, and the Queen of the Land, Rathian, who have reigned over the frontier since ages past. Their variant individuals are gathering in the Forest and Hills to breed. Do not forget that only one pitfall trap or shock trap may be set!
61906.descriptionEn:
Since ages past, the king of the
skies ≪Rathalos≫ and the queen
of the land ≪Rathian≫ have
ruled these frontier lands.
Their variants gather in the
Forest and Hills to breed.
Do not forget that you may set
only one pitfall or shock trap!
61906.descriptionJp:
辺境に遥か昔より君臨せし、
空の王者≪リオレウス≫と
陸の女王≪リオレイア≫。
その変種が、繁殖の為に森丘
に集まっておる。
落とし穴やシビレ罠が設置で
きるのは１つまでということ
を忘れるでないぞ！

61412.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

55458.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55458.description: The scorching-zero dragon has shown itself again at the summit of the Tower. The Guild is looking for hunters willing to attempt part breaks for research. Those who report on the state of the breaks will receive a small token of thanks.
55458.descriptionEn:
The Eruzerion has shown itself
at the top of the Tower once
again.
The guild seeks hunters who
will attempt part breaks for our
research.
Those who report how the break
went will receive a small token
of thanks.
55458.descriptionJp:
塔の頂部に≪灼零龍≫が再び
姿を現しました。
ギルドでは、研究のために部
位破壊に挑戦して頂けるハン
ターを探しています。
部位破壊達成時の様子を報告
して下さった方には、少しば
かりお礼をお渡しします。

53276.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の捕獲
53276.description: My friend goes on about the twin gods of Alke, the Jet Black Darkness, the Sunshine Vice, but I do not understand. In short, it seems they want me to weaken the incomplete Jet Black Darkness and capture it before something terrible happens. I want to do something about it in many senses, so please.
53276.descriptionEn:
The Twin Gods of Arche, the
Pitch-Black Darkness, the Vice
of Sunlight - my friend keeps
going on about them, but I
don't follow. Before anything
awful happens, he wants the
incomplete Pitch-Black
Darkness weakened and caught.
Please, do something!
53276.descriptionJp:
アルケーの双神だとか漆黒の
闇とか陽光のヴァイスとか、
友人が語りかけてくるけど、
私にはわからない。要するに
大変な事が起きる前に不完全
な状態の漆黒の闇を弱らせて
捕まえて欲しいってことみた
いです。色々な意味でなんと
かしたいのでお願いします。

63318.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐
63318.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! If you are confident you can dance around a Diablos, then slay the Diablos here in this arena!
63318.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill! Any who are sure
they can dance around a
horned wyvern, step into this
Arena and slay ≪Diablos≫!
Show us what you've got!
63318.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する闘技場！角竜を
相手に、見事立ち回る自信が
ある者はこの闘技場にて
≪ディアブロス≫を討伐
してみせよ！

23557.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23557.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23557.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

54097.description: I ask you to hunt a Tigrex in the Snowy Mountains for a survey. This time we plan to examine thoroughly the tail and claws that are characteristic of a Tigrex. Be sure to break and sever these 2 before the hunt. I know it is hard work, but I ask your help.
54097.descriptionEn:
I'm asking you to hunt the
Tigrex in the Snowy Mountains
for a survey.
This time we'll thoroughly
study its tail and claws -
its defining features.
Be sure to break and sever
both before you finish it.
I know it's a handful. Thanks.
54097.descriptionJp:
雪山のティガレックスを調査
するため狩猟をお願いする。
今回は、ティガレックスの
特徴と言える尻尾と爪を
徹底的に調査する予定だ。
必ずこの２箇所を破壊、
切断してから狩猟してくれ。
大変だとは思うが
よろしく頼む。

50498.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の討伐
50498.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Taikun Zamuza. I am counting on you!
50498.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR31.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of
weapon upgrades as pay?
Easy work - just run out and
slay a Taikun Zamuza.
That's all!
I'm counting on ya!
50498.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の強化素材一式で
どうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってタイクンザムザを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

23302.description: I have made yet another new discovery! A lump of ice of high purity that will not melt, the Eternal Ice Block. Gather several and I can produce a beautiful blue block of ice. Help me gather the materials again and I will share the product.
23302.descriptionEn:
I've made yet another new
discovery! A chunk of ice of
high purity that hardly melts,
the "Eternal Ice Chunk." Gather
several and I can create a
