61735.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61735.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61735.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50283.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50283.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50283.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50283.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

55159.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make armor from the Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth! If you complete the sub-target, you can obtain materials needed to upgrade Migration armor, so please try it!
55159.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to make
armor from the Ice Fang Wyvern
≪Barioth≫!
Clear the sub-target to obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
Transcend Armor, so please give it
a try!
55159.descriptionJp:
氷牙竜≪ベリオロス≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを用意
しました！サブターゲットを
達成すると遷悠防具の強化に
必要な素材を入手できます
ので、ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

50033.description: The Guku clothes I ordered for the Guku Gallery have not arrived on time. Could you go and check on things nearby for me? If you help, I will give you my secret Guku collection.
50033.descriptionEn:
I ordered a Gook outfit for
the Gook Gallery opening,
but it still hasn't arrived.
Could you go and check on
things nearby for me?
If you help me out, I'll
give you a piece of my
treasured Gook collection.
50033.descriptionJp:
グークギャラリーを開こうと
思って発注したグーク服が
時間になっても届かないんだ。
ちょっと代わりに近くの
様子を見てきてくれないか？
手伝ってくれるなら、秘蔵の
グークコレクションを
プレゼントするよ。

61888.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
61888.description: Recover the scattered parts of the prototype Great Sword! Apparently the Ultrahard Chain was sighted in the jungle! Besides the large monster, we have reports of a great many small monsters appearing, though surely they are not its retinue.
61888.descriptionEn:
Recover the scattered
parts of the prototype
Great Sword!
The 'Ultra Hard Chain'
seems to have been seen
in the Jungle! Besides
large monsters, we hear
that swarms of small
monsters appear as well.
61888.descriptionJp:
ばらばらになった試作大剣の
部品を取り戻してください！
どうやら「超硬チェーン」が
密林で目撃された模様です！
大型モンスターの他にも、
まさか、取り巻きというわけ
ではないでしょうが、大量の
小型モンスターが出現する
という報告を受けています。

54693.description: For the G Rank Guild Priority Request, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote it. Break the Hypnocatrice's beak and we will grant special ingredients too.
54693.descriptionEn:
For the G Rank Guild
Priority Request, we have
prepared this quest to
raise awareness and use.
Break the Hypnocatrice's
beak and we will grant
special ingredients too.
54693.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
眠鳥のクチバシを破壊するこ
とで特別な食材も付与させて
いただきます。

61882.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
61882.description: If you can hunt a Pink Rathian, you're a full-fledged hunter. Go hunt one right away. Break some parts too if you can. Ah, don't worry, we'll prepare the equipment and items!
61882.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian Subspecies≫
and you're a full hunter.
Now go hunt her.
Break parts too, if you can.
Ah, gear and items are
prepared here, so don't
worry!
61882.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア亜種≫を狩れた
なら狩人として一人前だろう。
さっそく狩猟してきてくれ。
できれば部位破壊もたのむぞ。
ああ、装備やアイテムは
こちらで用意しておくから
心配するな！

62459.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
62459.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.
62459.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは、対変種に適した特
殊な武器を装備した方限定の
受注、参加となっております。
今回のターゲットには、通常
とは異なる性質、動きがみら
れるそうなのでご注意を。

62894.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62894.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62894.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

22020.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
22020.description: A request for hunters who possess Odibatorasu Tenran armor. Drive off Odibatorasu and you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba FX Series Haku Armor up to LV7.
22020.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ armor of
the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
By repelling Odibatorasu,
you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
"Odiba FX Series"
≪Supremacy≫ armor to Lv7.
22020.descriptionJp:
≪弩岩竜≫の≪天嵐防具≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
オディバトラスを撃退するこ
とで「オディバFXシリーズ」
≪覇種防具≫ＬＶ７までの
強化に必要な素材が入手でき
ます。

21233.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
21233.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21233.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21233.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26140.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26140.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26140.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

62545.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

50635.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Gogomoa on Tide Island! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50635.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Sword and Shield, show
your polished skill against
the ≪Hyujikiki≫ of Tidal
Island! Hunt it well, and
you shall earn even more
than the usual rewards for
your daily efforts.
50635.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

60909.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
60909.description: An extremely powerful Bulldrome Variant has been confirmed in the swamp. Please dispose of it with the greatest urgency! If you think of it as an ordinary Bulldrome, you will get hurt!
60909.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Bulldrome
variant has been confirmed in the Swamp.
Please hurry and deal with it!
If you think it is the same as
a normal Bulldrome, you will
get hurt badly!
Do not let your guard down!
60909.descriptionJp:
沼地で、極めて強力なドス
ファンゴの変種が確認されて
います。大至急、退治して
きてください！
普通のドスファンゴと同じ
ように考えていると痛い目
を見ますよ！

50578.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
50578.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! A Super Golden Experience request has appeared, a further boost to the rewards of the Golden Experience, which lets you build experience efficiently and obtain large amounts of zenny too. Do take the chance to try it!
50578.descriptionEn:
Emergency notice to all hunters!
The 'Super Golden Experience'
request is now available, with
even better rewards than the
'Golden Experience' that lets
you earn experience efficiently
and gain loads of zenny.
Please take this chance to try
it out!
50578.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
ことができ、大量のゼニーも
入手できる「黄金体験」の
報酬をさらに強化した
「超・黄金体験」の依頼が
発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

61302.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

23521.description: The Variant Species Rathalos has appeared once more. Its wings have grown more powerful, and it seems to have gained further strength. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23521.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rathalos≫ has
appeared once more.
Its wings have grown more
powerful, and it seems to have
gained even more strength.
Please survey it with great care.
23521.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪リオレウス≫が再び
現れました。
翼はより強力となり、さらに
力をつけているようです。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

62438.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62438.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62438.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

51117.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
51117.description: She is crazy about Varusaburosu and is always chasing after it, and I cannot understand it. I am worried, and if she got hurt I would be in trouble, so please slay the Varusaburosu. As thanks I will give you the Flame Horn Wyvern Ornament she gave me.
51117.descriptionEn:
My girl is obsessed with
Valsabros and chases it
all the time. I don't get
it. I worry, and if she
got hurt I'd be lost, so
please slay the
Valsabros. As thanks,
I'll give you the ≪Flame
Horn Wyvern Figure≫.
51117.descriptionJp:
彼女がヴァルサブロスに夢中
でいつもヴァルサブロスを追
いかけていて理解できないん
だ。それが心配で、もし彼女
が怪我をしたら僕も困るので
ヴァルサブロスを討伐してく
ださい。御礼は彼女から
貰った≪炎角竜オブジェ≫を
差し上げます。

55985.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55985.description: Taking on a request from me, the boss of the Dark Cat Gang, shows good nerve, meow. If you pull it off splendidly, I will give you a Dark Cat Gang Pass (Black) as proof of membership, meow!
55985.descriptionEn:
Taking on a request from
me, boss of the Dark Cat
Gang? You've got guts, nya.
Pull it off, and I'll give
you the ≪Dark Cat Gang
Pass - Black≫ as proof
of membership, nya!
55985.descriptionJp:
闇猫団のボスたるワガハイの
依頼に挑戦しようとは、
イイ度胸してるミャ。
見事にやってのけたら、
闇猫団員の証として、
≪闇猫団パス・黒≫を
くれてやるミャ！

60328.description: As support for everyone, we present the habitat of the Aptonoth, ideal for procuring meat. Those short of meat, this is your chance!
60328.descriptionEn:
This time, as support for
everyone, we introduce the
≪Aptonoth≫ habitat best
suited to procuring meat.
If you're short on meat,
this is your chance!
60328.descriptionJp:
今回、皆様への支援として
お肉を調達するのに最適な
≪アプトノス≫の生息域を
ご紹介します。
お肉が不足している方、
チャンスですよ！

62687.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲
62687.description: The sensitive season is here! You can eat Porta Chocolate as is, but why not take this job? When you get Porta Chocolate, be sure to reply with a thank-you message! At that point you may already be caught in a trap!
62687.descriptionEn:
The sensitive season is
here! You can just eat
your ≪Porta Choco≫, but
why not take this quest?
If you get ≪Porta Choco≫,
be sure to send back a
proper thank-you message!
By then you may already
be caught in the trap!
62687.descriptionJp:
センシティブな季節キター！
≪ポルタチョコ≫はそのまま
食べてもいいが、この依頼を
受けてみないか？
≪ポルタチョコ≫を貰ったら
ちゃんとお礼のメッセージを
返すんだぞ！
その時点で、あなたは罠に
ハマってるかもしれないがな！

53303.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の捕獲
53303.description: I hear a colossal Taikun Zamuza has appeared in the caves of Tide Island. If that is true, how wonderful! I want it! I want it whatever it takes! So this time, if the giant Taikun Zamuza is there, I want it captured. Absolutely, absolutely do not slay it. Capture it! I am counting on you!
53303.descriptionEn:
I heard a colossal Taikun
Zamuza appeared in the
caves of Tidal Island.
If true, wonderful!
I want it! Must have it!
So this time, if a giant
Taikun Zamuza is there,
I want it captured.
Absolutely do not slay it,
capture it! I beg you!
53303.descriptionJp:
潮島の洞窟に超巨大な
タイクンザムザが現れた
と聞いた。
それが本当なら素晴らしい！
欲しい！是が非でも欲しい！
そこで今回は
巨大なタイクンザムザが
いたら捕獲をお願いしたい。
絶対に、絶対に討伐せず、
捕獲して欲しい！頼むぞ！

61948.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been found! This may be a good chance to gather materials! Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! We have limited the number of participants, so you should be able to depart at once!
61948.descriptionEn:
A comparatively weak individual
monster has been discovered!
This may be a good chance to
gather materials! Before it
flees far away, please hurry
and get ready! We have limited
the number of participants, so
you should be able to depart at once!
61948.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が発見されましたよ！
これは、素材を集める良い
チャンスかもしれませんね！
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
参加人数を制限しましたので、
すぐに出発できるはずです！

63292.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63292.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63292.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63292.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

12012.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟

54412.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
54412.description: I'm studying the body structure and workings of Kam Orugaron, but I'm short on samples. Bring back the materials that can be taken from Kam Orugaron's fangs and tail. Bring back both, properly.
54412.descriptionEn:
I'm studying the body
structure of the
≪Kamu Orgaron≫, but I'm
short on samples.
Bring back materials from
its fangs and its tail.
Both of them, mind you.
Don't come back with just
one, understand?
54412.descriptionJp:
≪カム・オルガロン≫の
体の構造や仕組みを研究
しているんだが、サンプル
が不足していてね。
≪カム・オルガロン≫の牙と
尻尾から入手できる素材を
持って帰ってきてくれ。
ちゃんと、両方持って帰って
きてくれよ。

54569.description: Residents nearby report that the Gogomoa of Tide Island are causing serious damage. They say the beasts were caught in thread snares the likes of which they had never seen. To put a stop to this, we ask you to hunt the Gogomoa.
54569.descriptionEn:
We have reports from residents
living nearby that they suffer
serious damage from the Gogomoa
on the Tidal Island.
According to them, they were
caught in thread traps never
seen before.
To stop this damage, we ask you
to hunt the Gogomoa.
54569.descriptionJp:
潮島にいるゴゴモアから
深刻な被害を受けていると
近くに住む住民から報告を受
けています。彼らによると
見たこともない糸の罠に
引っかかったとのことです。
この被害を食い止めるため、
ゴゴモアの狩猟をお願いしま
す。

61742.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
61742.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
61742.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
61742.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

61744.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters and break their parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
61744.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters and break parts
together with your guild
mates. I provide no supplies
at all, so plan with your
comrades first. Reward: special ore!
61744.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐と、部位破壊を猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

61316.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61316.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61316.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

22167.description: This quest yields the materials needed for the FX upgrade of Secret Tome armor (Gunner), excluding the weapon souls. The number yielded is enough for 5 parts. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
22167.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed for FX
upgrades of Secret Art Armor
(gunner), excluding weapon
souls. The yield covers five
parts. To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass Sakura≫
is required, so please
take note.
22167.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
秘伝防具（ガンナー）の
FX強化時に必要な武器魂を
除く素材を排出いたします。
排出数は、５部位分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

61410.description: One of the important things for a hunter is to know a monster's traits well and bring the right equipment and skills. With the earplug gear lent to you this time, even a troublesome Rathalos roar turns into a chance to attack! Try it together with a bomb skill!
61410.descriptionEn:
One vital thing for a
hunter is knowing the
monster's traits and
bringing proper gear
and skills. With the
Earplug gear lent today,
even a Rathalos roar
becomes a chance to hit!
Try it with Bomb skills!
61410.descriptionJp:
ハンターにとって重要なこと
のひとつとして、モンスター
の特徴をよく知り、適切な装
備、スキルを用意することが
あります。今回貸与する耳栓
装備があれば、厄介な火竜の
咆哮も、攻撃のチャンスに
変わりますよ！爆弾スキルと
併せて是非お試しください！

21190.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
21190.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21190.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21190.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54277.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１体の討伐
54277.description: A giant fireball above Schrade Castle, and the investigation revealed a terrible fact. The Fatalis hailed as the black legend had mutated into something even more powerful! Unimaginable damage will occur. Please slay it swiftly.
54277.descriptionEn:
A giant fireball has appeared
above Schrade Castle, and our
investigation revealed a terrible
truth. Fatalis, hailed as the
black legend, had mutated into
a far more powerful form!
If left alone, damage beyond
imagination will surely follow.
We ask for a swift slaying.
54277.descriptionJp:
シュレイド城上空に巨大な火
球が発生しており調査の結果、
恐ろしい事実が判明しました。
なんと、黒き伝説と謳われる
ミラボレアスがより強力に変
異していたのです！
このままでは想像もできない
被害が発生することでしょう。
迅速な討伐をお願いします。

50334.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
50334.description: This is sudden, but I want your help with an ecological survey of Kamu Orugaron. If possible I would also like parts broken during this survey. I am sorry for the many requests, but for the sake of future research I would be most grateful.
50334.descriptionEn:
This is sudden, but I need
help with an ecological
survey of ≪Kam Orugaron≫.
If possible, I also want
part breaks during this
survey. Sorry for all the
demands, but for future
research, please help.
50334.descriptionJp:
突然だが、≪カム・オルガ
ロン≫の生態調査を手伝っ
て欲しい。
今回の調査は可能であれば
部位破壊もお願いしたい。
注文が多く申し訳ないが、
今後の研究のために
是非よろしく頼む。

53196.objectiveJp: ポルタブラウニー１個の納品

21108.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
21108.description: A subspecies of Gypceros has appeared in the swamp. It seems to have an eerie appearance with a purple body color. It has a habit of collecting shiny things, so if you break its crest you might get a precious stone.
21108.descriptionEn:
A subspecies of the Gypceros
has appeared in the Swamp.
It seems to have a sinister
purple body.
It likes to hoard shiny things,
so if you break its crest, you
might get a precious stone out
of it, you know?
21108.descriptionJp:
毒怪鳥≪ゲリョス≫の亜種が
沼地に現れたわ。体色が紫色
の不気味な容姿をしているみ
たいね。光り物を好み集める
習性があるから、トサカを
破壊すれば、貴重な石が手に
入るかも知れないわよ？

10105.objectiveJp: ディアブロス２頭の討伐

21254.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
21254.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21254.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21254.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

55459.objectiveJp: エルゼリオン１体の討伐
55459.description: The scorching-zero dragon has shown itself again at the summit of the Tower. The Guild is looking for hunters willing to attempt part breaks for research. Those who report on the state of the breaks will receive a small token of thanks.
55459.descriptionEn:
The Eruzerion has shown itself
at the top of the Tower once
again.
The guild seeks hunters who
will attempt part breaks for our
research.
Those who report how the break
went will receive a small token
of thanks.
55459.descriptionJp:
塔の頂部に≪灼零龍≫が再び
姿を現しました。
ギルドでは、研究のために部
位破壊に挑戦して頂けるハン
ターを探しています。
部位破壊達成時の様子を報告
して下さった方には、少しば
かりお礼をお渡しします。

54213.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54213.description: A report from the survey team. An Ice Fox Wyvern is on a rampage in the Canyon, and the damage appears to reach not only the team but the peddlers who travel the roads. Hunters, head for the site at once and secure it.
54213.descriptionEn:
A report from the survey
team. An Ice Fox Wyvern
rampages in the Canyon.
Damage has reached not
only our team but the
peddlers on the roads.
All hunters, head there
at once and secure safety.
54213.descriptionJp:
調査団からの報告です。
峡谷にて氷狐竜が暴れ
調査団だけでなく、
道中を行き交う
行商人にも被害が及んでいる
ようです。ハンターの皆さん
至急現地へ向かい安全の
確保をお願いいたします。

62837.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
62837.description: This is a qualifier for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Limit: 10 min.
62837.descriptionEn:
This is a qualifier for the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament. Limit: 10 min.
62837.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選クエスト
です。制限時間は１０分です。

21155.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
21155.description: This is a request to slay the Odibatorasu found in the desert. Surveys so far have confirmed powerful attacks that use the sand, and many hunters have been harmed. Information is still scarce and this is an extremely dangerous request, but we ask for your continued investigation!
21155.descriptionEn:
This is a request to slay the
Odibatorasu found in the Desert.
Surveys so far confirm powerful
sand-based attacks, and many
hunters have been hurt.
There is little information yet
and the request is very
perilous, but please continue
the survey!
21155.descriptionJp:
砂漠で発見された≪弩岩竜≫
の討伐依頼となります。
これまでの調査では、
砂を利用した強力な攻撃が
確認され、多数のハンターが
被害を受けているようです。
まだ情報も少なく、極めて
危険な依頼となりますが、
引き続き調査をお願いします！

22045.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
22045.description: The one named Rukodiora, the Extreme Dragon, is closing on the Interception Base. We have readied ample supplies, interception weapons and carving artisans, so please slay it!
22045.descriptionEn:
The one named ≪Rukodiora≫,
the ≪Extreme Dragon≫, is
closing on the
≪Interception Base≫.
We've readied ample supplies,
anti-air weapons and even
carving artisans, so please
slay it!
22045.descriptionJp:
≪ルコディオラ≫≪極龍≫と
名付けられたそれが、
≪迎撃拠点≫に迫っています。
十分な支給品、迎撃兵器、
そして剥ぎ取り職人と、万全
の態勢を整えさせていただき
ましたので、討伐をお願い
します！

12038.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
12038.description: A subspecies of Gypceros has appeared in the swamp. It seems to have an eerie appearance with a purple body color. It has a habit of collecting shiny things, so if you break its crest you might get a precious stone.
12038.descriptionEn:
A subspecies of the Gypceros
has appeared in the Swamp.
It seems to have a sinister
purple body.
It likes to hoard shiny things,
so if you break its crest, you
might get a precious stone out
of it, you know?
12038.descriptionJp:
毒怪鳥≪ゲリョス≫の亜種が
沼地に現れたわ。体色が紫色
の不気味な容姿をしているみ
たいね。光り物を好み集める
習性があるから、トサカを
破壊すれば、貴重な石が手に
入るかも知れないわよ？

50547.description: Oh! Hunter over there! Is your Felyne Comrade well, nya? Once in a while, be good to your partner, nya! Now, to the point, nya. This request is to hunt one Rathalos, nya. The reward is production materials for Felyne Comrade gear, nya! I'm counting on you, nya!
50547.descriptionEn:
Hey! You there, hunter!
Is your Felyne partner doing
well, meow? Time to be good to
your partner, meow!
Now, the point, meow. This
request is to hunt 1 Rathalos,
meow. The pay is materials for
Felyne gear, meow!
Counting on you, meow!
50547.descriptionJp:
おう！そこの狩人さん！
アンタのパートニャーは元気
かニャ？たまには相棒孝行し
てやるニャ！
では、本題ニャ。今回の依頼
は火竜１頭の狩猟ニャ。
報酬はパートニャー用武具の
生産素材だニャ！
たのんだニャー！

23479.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
23479.description: The Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Daimyo Hermitaur. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23479.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Daimyo
Hermitaur≫ seems to have
reached a strength fit to
stand atop all Daimyo
Hermitaur. Its power is
beyond measure. Hunters
confident in their skill,
please take on the survey.
23479.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ダイミョウザザミ≫
はダイミョウザザミの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

54424.description: We are investigating the Resounding Wolf that appeared in the swamp, roaring fiercely. Its ecology is still unexplained. Please hunt it and lend us your strength in our research!
54424.descriptionEn:
We are surveying the fierce,
howling ≪Orugaron≫
that appeared in the Swamp.
Its ecology is unknown.
Please hunt it and lend
your strength to our work!
54424.descriptionJp:
沼地に出現した、猛々しく咆
える≪響狼≫の調査を行って
います。
その生態はまだまだ未解明。
どうか狩猟を行い、我々の研
究に力を貸してください！

63139.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63139.description: As part of a monster survey, I ask you to hunt the Plesioth in the New Great Arena. It is extremely powerful and behaves in ways normally unthinkable, so this is a quite dangerous request, but if the surveyors obtain satisfactory results you should earn high standing from the Guild.
63139.descriptionEn:
As part of our monster
survey, hunt the ≪Water
Wyvern≫ in the New Great
Arena. It is very strong
and acts in ways normally
unthinkable, making this
a dangerous request, but
if you get results that
satisfy our researchers,
the Guild will rate you high.
63139.descriptionJp:
モンスター調査の一環として
新大闘技場にいる≪水竜≫
の狩猟をお願いします。
非常に強力で通常では考えら
れない行動を取るため、
かなり危険な依頼となります
が、調査員が満足できる
結果を得られたならば、
ギルドから高い評価を得られ
るはずです。

55531.description: An unidentified black monster is rampaging in the Old Tower. Who is it? It changes its form, changes its movement, changes its voice, changes its eye color. To whoever ascertains its true identity, I shall surely give production materials for Guild hidden armor.
55531.descriptionEn:
An unidentified black monster is
running wild in the Ancient Tower.
Who is it? It changes its shape,
its movements, its voice,
and the color of its eyes.
Whoever uncovers its true identity
will receive production materials
for Guild-treasured armor.
55531.descriptionJp:
正体不明の黒いモンスターが
古塔で暴れ回っている。
奴は何者だ？姿を変え、動き
を変え、声を変え、眼の色を
変えている。
こいつの正体を突き止めた者
にはギルド秘蔵の防具の生産
素材を必ず渡そう。

62150.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62150.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62150.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

62513.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time, how would it be to hunt the female fire wyvern Rathian together with a hunter who has risen high enough to hold a Secret Arts Scroll? Follow their distinctive way of moving, and if you complete the request together I will prepare an extra reward!
62513.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time, why not hunt
a ≪Rathian≫ together
with a hunter who has
reached the Secret Art
tome? Learn from their
unique moves, and clear
it together for extra pay!
62513.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
今回は、秘伝書を持つまでに
上りつめたハンターと一緒に、
雌火竜≪リオレイア≫を
狩猟してきてはいかがだろう。
一味違った身のこなしに倣い、
共に依頼を達成すれば追加で
報酬を用意するぞ！

51094.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51094.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the crest of a Purple Gypceros will also grant a special ingredient.
51094.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the Purple Gypceros'
crest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51094.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
紫毒鳥のトサカを破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与
させていただきます。

54705.description: The Hunters Guild has discovered a monster never seen in the Mezeporuta region. To unlock hunting them, we want to recruit hunters to go on a preliminary survey. Hunters who think themselves worthy! Take the Advance Hunting Ticket and hunt a Zinogre!
54705.descriptionEn:
The Hunters Guild has
found a monster never
seen in Mezeporta.
To unlock hunting it,
we seek hunters to go
ahead and survey first.
Hunters who would answer!
Take a Head Start Ticket
and hunt the Zinogre!
54705.descriptionJp:
われわれハンターズギルドは
メゼポルタ地方では見たこと
がないモンスターを発見した。
ヤツらの狩猟を解禁するため、
先行して調査に行ってくれる
ハンターを募集したい。
われこそはと思うハンターよ！
先行狩猟チケットを手に
ジンオウガを狩ってくれ！

23540.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
23540.description: A Tigrex with greatly developed claws has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than the Tigrex seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23540.descriptionEn:
A ≪Tigrex≫ with greatly
developed claws has appeared.
The Guild classifies this one
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
overgrown parts, and surveys it.
Reports say it is more dangerous
than any Tigrex so far.
Please take care in your
survey.
23540.descriptionJp:
爪が大きく発達した≪轟竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの轟竜より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

21965.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
21965.description: The Snowy Mountains have lately been hit by abnormal weather, and many reports have come in of a great shadow walking calmly through the blizzard. Could this blizzard be that monster's doing? We request a survey from all hunters.
21965.descriptionEn:
Lately the Snowy Mountains have
been struck by abnormal weather,
and we have received many
reports of a large shape walking
calmly through the raging
blizzard. Could this blizzard
truly be the work of that
monster? We ask all hunters to
investigate.
21965.descriptionJp:
このところ、異常気象に
見舞われていた雪山ですが、
猛吹雪の中を悠然と歩く
大きな影を見た、との
報告が多数入ってきています。
この吹雪の原因は、果たして
そのモンスターのしわざ
なのでしょうか？ハンターの
皆様に調査を依頼します。

55522.description: That armor I loved the look of, and this one too, you never wear them anymore, meow! There are even hunters who say they have graduated from them, meow! No, meow! Put on that wonderful Entra armor once more and show me the hunter in all his glory, meow! I will reward you, meow!
55522.descriptionEn:
That armor you liked, and
this armor too, you never
wear them for me, nya!
Some hunters even say
they've moved on, nya!
No, nya! Wear that fine
Entra armor once more and
show me your gallant form,
nya! I'll make it worth it!
55522.descriptionJp:
見た目がお気に入りだった
あの防具もこの防具も
なかなか着てくれないニャ！
卒業したって言うハンター
さんもいるニャ！
嫌ニャ！もう一度あの素晴ら
しいエントラ防具を着て、
ハンターさんの雄姿を見せて
くれニャ！お礼はするニャ！

61730.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61730.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61730.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

23240.description: I was walking through the brush when I came upon an Espinas asleep. I had my head in the clouds and nearly walked right into it, a hair's breadth from those thorns. First time I have ever seen an Espinas in a place like that.
23240.descriptionEn:
I was walking in the brush
when I came upon a sleeping
Espinas.
I was spacing out, so I
nearly bumped into it and
got a spike in me.
That was the first time I
saw an Espinas there.
23240.descriptionJp:
茂みの中を歩いていたら、
エスピナスが寝ているところ
に遭遇してさ。
ぼんやりしていたから、
危うくぶつかって、
棘が刺さるところだったよ。
あんなところでエスピナスを
見たのは初めてだったなあ。

23418.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
23418.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Garubadaora, the Gold Dust Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23418.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Gold Dust
Dragon Garubadaora.
Accepting the quest requires a
Superior Ticket.
If you fail the quest, the
Superior Ticket will be
consumed, so be warned.
23418.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、金塵龍
≪ガルバダオラ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

63007.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
63007.description: The Secret Certificate [Intro] is proof that a hunter holding a Secret Scroll has reached a certain level of skill. This time's examiner is the Guild's foremost authority, renowned for his eye, so if you meet his standards you can be sure of receiving a large number of Secret Certificates [Intro]. Do not miss this rare chance.
63007.descriptionEn:
≪Secret Proof [Prologue]≫
is proof that a scroll-
holding hunter has reached
a certain level of skill.
Our examiner this time is
the Guild's foremost eye,
so if you satisfy him, he
will surely issue many
≪Secret Proof [Prologue]≫.
Do not miss this rare chance.
63007.descriptionJp:
≪秘伝の証【序】≫は、
秘伝書所持ハンターとして
一定の実力に到達した証です。
今回の判定員はギルド随一の
権威と観察眼を誇るため、
彼の眼にかなえば、大量の
≪秘伝の証【序】≫を確実に
発行することができますよ。
この希少な機会をどうぞ
お見逃しなく。

62422.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62422.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62422.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62422.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50768.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50768.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50768.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

63355.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63355.description: A Plesioth has been released in the new arena, extremely powerful and given to behavior unthinkable in the ordinary. Hunter who would master the bow, show me your skill before me! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more than the fruits of your daily efforts.
63355.descriptionEn:
A ≪Water Wyvern≫ that is
very strong and acts in
unthinkable ways is loose
in the New Great Arena.
Hunter who would master
the Bow, show your skill
before me! Hunt it well,
and you shall gain far
more than your daily
efforts ever bring.
63355.descriptionJp:
新大闘技場に非常に強力で
通常では考えられない行動を
取る≪水竜≫を放ってある。
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、我が前にて
その技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のより更に多くのものが
得られるであろう。

56032.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Frost Fierce Wyvern. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56032.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Ice Wyvern.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56032.descriptionJp:
辿異種の氷獰竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

54759.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54759.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
54759.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
54759.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

55470.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55470.description: The Variant Species Rukodiora appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Rukodiora. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55470.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Rukodiora≫
seems to have reached strength
enough to climb to the very
summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident enough to
challenge the summit, please
take on this survey.
55470.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ルコディオラ≫は
ルコディオラの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

23276.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
23276.description: The Guild is looking for hunters who could become new wielders of the Tonfa. The Guild fervently hopes that by following the hunting trail of the former wielder Toki, a new wielder will appear.
23276.descriptionEn:
The Guild now seeks a
hunter who could become
a new Tonfa wielder.
By tracing the hunting
steps of the former
wielder, ≪Tokishi≫, the
Guild earnestly hopes a
new wielder will appear.
23276.descriptionJp:
ギルドではこの度、穿龍棍の
新たな使い手となり得る
ハンターを探しています。
かつての使い手≪トキシ≫の
狩りの足跡をたどることで、
新たな使い手が現れてくれる
ことを、ギルドは切望して
います。

50090.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Rajang in the Snowy Mountains. Clear this quest well and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50090.descriptionEn:
The time has come for
hunters to show their
skill! Hunt the ≪Rajang≫
of the Snowy Mountains.
Clear the quest and your
name as a hunter will
rise by leaps and bounds!
50090.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
雪山の≪金獅子≫を狩猟して
みせろ。見事クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

61421.description: You want my horn? Hmm, I cannot give it for money or goods. It seems there are folk in the desert just now who have a feud with this horn and with the scar on my face, so if you hunt them and show me your strength I might give it to you.
61421.descriptionEn:
So you want my Horn?
Hmm, I cannot hand it over for
money or goods. Seems there are
folk in the Desert right now
with a grudge tied to this Horn
and the scar on my face, so if
you hunt them and show me your
strength, I might give it to you.
61421.descriptionJp:
俺の角笛が欲しいってか？
うーん、金や物じゃ渡せねぇ
なぁ。どうやらいま砂漠に、
この角笛、そして俺の顔の
傷と因縁がある連中がいる
らしいから、あいつらを狩猟
して力を示してくれたら
やってもいいぞ。

61960.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been found! This may be a good chance to gather materials! Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! We have limited the number of participants, so you should be able to depart at once!
61960.descriptionEn:
A comparatively weak individual
monster has been discovered!
This may be a good chance to
gather materials! Before it
flees far away, please hurry
and get ready! We have limited
the number of participants, so
you should be able to depart at once!
61960.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が発見されましたよ！
これは、素材を集める良い
チャンスかもしれませんね！
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
参加人数を制限しましたので、
すぐに出発できるはずです！

62775.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
62775.description: To draw out the hidden power of the famed Black Bow, it must be worked further with this Ancient Ink I hold, but I do not do it for free. Bring down the rumored Akantor somewhere with a bow and I will acknowledge your skill and give you this.
62775.descriptionEn:
To draw out the hidden power
of the famed bow Black Bow,
it must be worked further with
this ≪Ancient Ink≫ I hold, but
I won't do it for free.
If you bring down the rumored
≪Akantor≫ somewhere with a
bow, I'll acknowledge your skill
and give this to you.
62775.descriptionJp:
名弓「黒弓」の隠された力を
引き出すためには、私が
持っているこの≪いにしえの
墨≫で更に加工する必要があ
るが、タダではやらないよ。
どこかにいる噂の≪覇竜≫を
弓で仕留めてくれれば、キミ
の実力を認めて、これを差し
上げよう。

21510.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての討伐
21510.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21510.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21510.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

55891.description: I revised an earlier design, raised the output and finished an improved gunlance, but I will only give it to someone I acknowledge. Bring down a Guanzorumu and I will acknowledge you. If you break its head too, that would be something.
55891.descriptionEn:
I reworked my old design
and finished an improved
Gunlance with more output,
but I only give it to
someone I approve of.
Beat Guanzorumu and I'll
approve you. Break its head
too and I'll be impressed.
55891.descriptionJp:
以前の設計を見直して
さらにガンランスの出力を
上げて改良したものが出来
上がったんだが、私が認めた
奴にしか渡したくないね。
グァンゾルムを倒してきたら
認めてやろう、頭も壊せたら
大したものだがな。

60314.description: I ask you to procure materials for the medicine I am researching now. Once you complete every last must-order, I will give you the Potion materials I have spare! Combine as much as you like!
60314.descriptionEn:
Please gather materials for the
medicine I'm researching now.
Once you clear every Must
Order, I'll give you the
≪Potion≫ materials I have
left over!
Mix as much as you
like!
60314.descriptionJp:
今、僕が研究している薬の
素材調達をお願いします。
マストオーダー全てを達成
した暁には、僕のところに
余っている≪回復薬≫の素材
を差し上げます！
どうぞ好きなだけ調合して
ください！

21094.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21094.description: I'm recruiting a hunter to hunt Gendrome. If you happen to have time to spare, I'd like you to deliver Herbivore Eggs gathered this season as well. They're an item popular with merchants and celebrities.
21094.descriptionEn:
I'm recruiting hunters to
hunt ≪Gendrome≫.
If you happen to have time,
I'd like ≪Herbivore Eggs≫
gathered this season too.
Merchants and socialites
adore them♪
21094.descriptionJp:
≪ドスゲネポス≫を狩猟する
狩人を募集するわ。
もし、ゆとりがあったなら、
この季節に採れる≪草食竜の
卵≫も納品して欲しいの。
商人やセレブな人たちに人気
がある品物なのよ♪

50198.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50198.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50198.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

21829.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21829.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21829.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

62122.description: Mm, I have a bad feeling, and my hunches are never wrong! So here is a simple job. To prepare for the coming day, I want you to find the Dragon-Killing Fruit that grows in the Forest. I have a special reward ready too! I am counting on you, hunters!
62122.descriptionEn:
Hmm, I sense something bad
coming. My gut is never
wrong! So, a simple task.
To prepare for that day,
I want you all to find
Dragonkiller Fruit growing
in the Great Forest.
Special pay awaits! Go!
62122.descriptionJp:
むむ、何やら悪い予感がする
ぞ、我輩の勘は当たるのだ！
そこで簡単な依頼だ。
来る日に備えるため、諸君に
は樹海に実る龍殺しの実を
探してもらいたい。
特別な報酬も用意している！
頼んだぞ、ハンター諸君！

50641.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Leaping Scarlet Beast on the tidal island! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
50641.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Lance, show your
polished skill against
the ≪Hyujikiki≫ of Tidal
Island! Hunt it well, and
you shall earn even more
than the usual rewards for
your daily efforts.
50641.descriptionJp:
槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61167.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61167.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61167.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54365.description: Lately strange monsters have been increasing. According to witnesses, they behave differently from usual and have become quite ferocious. There is information that one was sighted in the snowy mountains, so those confident in their skill, please investigate.
54365.descriptionEn:
Strange monsters have been
on the rise lately.
Witnesses say they look
different from usual and
have grown far fiercer.
They were seen in the
Snowy Mountains. Skilled
hunters, please investigate.
54365.descriptionJp:
最近おかしなモンスターが
増えています。
目撃者の話によると、普段と
は違う様子で、その上かなり
獰猛になっているようです。
雪山で目撃したとの情報が
あり、腕に自信のある方は、
調査をお願いします。

60021.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
60021.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Even if you are ringed by a swarm of poison that leaps along the ground and poison that dances in the air, masters who cut through the crisis with a struggle like a tornado, prove your strength in the arena!
60021.descriptionEn:
The Arena where hunters show
their skill! Though surrounded
by poison leaping from the
ground and poison dancing in
the air, masters who cut
through peril like a tornado—prove your worth!
60021.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！地を跳ねる毒と空
を舞う毒の群れに囲まれよう
とも、竜巻の如き奮闘で窮地
を抜ける達人たちよ！闘技場
にてその実力を証明せよ！

50511.description: The unidentified monster found deep in the bamboo grove is, according to old documents left in this region, highly likely to be an Elder Dragon called the Elegant Elder Wyvern. If it is an Elder Dragon, the survey will be dangerous. Prepare fully before heading there.
50511.descriptionEn:
The monster found deep in the
bamboo forest is unidentified,
but old documents left in this
region suggest it is very likely
an elder dragon called the
Venerable Elder Dragon.
If it is indeed an elder dragon,
the survey will be dangerous.
Prepare fully before you head
to the site.
50511.descriptionJp:
竹林奥部で発見された、
未確認のモンスターですが、
この地域に残されている
古い文献から≪雅翁龍≫と
呼ばれる古龍種である
可能性が高いということです。
もし古龍種であるならば、
危険な調査となります。
万全の準備を整えてから
現地へ向かってください。

54669.description: A Prime Species monster has been found in the desert. It is a highly important research subject, but the powerful water jets it spews are destroying the desert ecosystem. It is a bitter decision, hunters, but lend us your strength to slay it before the damage spreads further!
54669.descriptionEn:
An Origin Species monster has
been discovered in the Desert.
It is a very important subject
for research, but the powerful
water jets it spews are steadily
destroying the Desert ecosystem.
This is a painful decision, but
hunters! To keep the damage
from spreading any further, lend
us your strength and slay it!
54669.descriptionJp:
砂漠で始種モンスターが
発見されました。
非常に重要な研究材料ですが
彼の噴き放つ強力な水流で、
砂漠の生態系は破壊されつつ
あります。
苦渋の決断ですが
ハンターの皆さん！これ以上
被害を拡大させないためにも
討伐に力を貸してください！

55277.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55277.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55277.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62107.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A gigantic monster never seen before has appeared near the Remote Island, and seems to have caused severe damage in the nearby waters. All hunters who can move are to set out by balloon and, once the target is sighted, set about slaying it.
62107.descriptionEn:
Emergency message from the
Parone Caravan! Near the Lone
Isle, a gigantic monster never
seen before has appeared, and
it is causing terrible damage
in the nearby waters. Every
Hunter able to move is to set
out by balloon, and once the
target is found, slay it.
62107.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫付近で、
見たこともない巨大なモンス
ターが現れ、近くの海域で
甚大な被害が出ているよう
です。動ける全てのハンター
は気球で出発し、目標を捕捉
し次第、討伐にあたってくだ
さい。

50186.description: A Conquest monster said to invite calamity has appeared! With no time to lose, this is a short-notice request, but to keep the damage to a minimum, repelling it alone will also count. We are seeking first-rate hunters with a Secret Scroll to face this unprecedented crisis!
50186.descriptionEn:
A Zenith monster said to bring
calamity has appeared! As this is
a race against time, the request
is for a short hunt, but to keep
the damage to a minimum, simply
repelling it will still be rated.
We seek hunters who hold the
Secret Art and will face this
unprecedented crisis!
50186.descriptionJp:
禍を招くといわれる、覇種
モンスターが現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

50905.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50905.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50905.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50905.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

54678.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54678.description: For the G Rank Guild Priority Request, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote it. Break the Azure Rathalos' head and we will grant special ingredients too.
54678.descriptionEn:
For the G Rank Guild
Priority Request, we have
prepared this quest to
raise awareness and use.
Break the Azure Rathalos'
head and we will grant
special ingredients too.
54678.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
蒼火竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

40195.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
40195.description: It is I! The Instructor! Use your hunting skill to hunt the monster before you! If you complete this request well, you will receive an exceptional reward fee, and your standing will rise sharply!
40195.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
Use all your hunting skill
and hunt the monster before
your eyes!
If you splendidly complete
this request, you will earn
an exceptional reward and
your reputation will soar!
40195.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
己の狩猟技術を駆使して、
目の前のモンスターを狩猟
するのだ！
見事、この依頼を達成すれば、
破格の報酬金が得られ、
諸君の評価も
グイっと上がるぞ！

60689.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
60689.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Purple Gypceros. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60689.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is a
Special Individual
≪Gypceros Subspecies≫!
Going after a monster all
alone is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a top rank! This one is
Supremacy weapons only!
60689.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
特異個体の
≪ゲリョス亜種≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

23301.description: What will guide us, who began with a small seed and have known harvest, abundance and prosperity, to yet greater heights is nothing other than the glory shown by hunters who have reached G-rank.
23301.descriptionEn:
We began as a small seed and have
known harvest, abundance and
prosperity. What will lead us to
even greater heights can only be
the glory shown by hunters who
have reached ≪G Rank≫.
23301.descriptionJp:
小さな種から始まり収穫、
豊穣、繁栄を経験した私たち
をさらなる高みへ導いて
くれるのは、≪Ｇ級≫へ到達
したハンターの皆さんが示す
栄華のほかにはないでしょう。

55816.description: Was the bizarre tale born from the bizarre? Or was the bizarre born from the bizarre tale? The bizarre is truly fascinating. I want you to slay the Chameleos, which closely resembles a bizarre phenomenon, with the Paper Umbrella Sword [Specter]. It may draw something strange to us. As a reward I will prepare my treasured tale of the bizarre.
55816.descriptionEn:
Did the odd spawn the tale?
Or the tale spawn the odd?
The bizarre fascinates me.
Slay a Chameleos, so like
an eerie phenomenon, with
the Karakasa Sword [Chimi].
It may draw out something
strange. As your reward,
I shall ready a rare tale.
55816.descriptionJp:
怪異から怪異譚が生まれた？
怪異譚から怪異が生まれた？
怪異とはまこと興味深い。
怪異現象によく似たオオナズ
チを唐傘ノ剣【魑魅】で討伐
してほしいのじゃ。何か怪異
を呼び寄せるかもしれん。
報酬としてわしの秘蔵の怪異
譚を用意しておこう。

55726.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55726.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55726.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55726.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

61423.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land, but my survey of the King of the Sky is a little lacking. I want information on how it fights alongside anything other than the Queen of the Land. Help me and I will share a copy of the book.
61423.descriptionEn:
For years I've studied the
King of the Sky and the
Queen of the Land, but my
King data is thin. I want
records of it fighting
beside others but the
Queen. Help me, get a tome.
61423.descriptionJp:
私は長年、空の王と陸の女王
を研究してきたが、空の王の
調査が少し不足していてね。
陸の女王以外と一緒に戦って
いるときの情報が欲しいんだ。
協力してくれれば
書物の写しを分けてあげるよ。

62638.description: Something terrible has happened! Someone has set nasty traps at the gathering points in the Jungle. I was about to use a Maca Pickling Jar to make a Boost Potion, and now I cannot even gather in peace! Please. Lend us your strength!
62638.descriptionEn:
Something terrible has happened!
Someone has set annoying traps at
the gathering points of the
Jungle. I was about to use my
≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ to make
≪Enhancer≫, but like this I
cannot gather in peace!
Please! Lend us your strength!
62638.descriptionJp:
大変なことが起こりました！
誰かが密林の採取ポイントに
迷惑な仕掛けを施したのです。
せっかく≪マカ漬けの壷≫を
使って≪増強剤≫を作ろうと
していたのに、このままでは
安心して採取もできません！
お願いです。どうか皆さんの
力をお貸しください！

63170.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
63170.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!
63170.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意したぞ！
複数のモンスターの討伐を、
猟団の仲間と成し遂げるのだ！
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

26236.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ１００ and above.
26236.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass discovered in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain regions,
we offer guidance only to those
of HR 100 or above.
26236.descriptionJp:
近年発見されたセンショク草
は、自然を熟知した熟練者で
なければ真贋を見極めること
ができない、レアな一品です。
特定の地域でのみ見られる草
なので、ＨＲ１００以上の方
に限ってご案内させていただ
いております。

56081.description: Ketuko! Congratulations on taking first place in hunts! It seems a monster that wants to celebrate Ketuko has come to the New Great Arena! Get a supply Gook firework from the supply box or by gathering, and let us celebrate together!
56081.descriptionEn:
Ketuko! Congratulations on
ranking first in slays!
A monster that wants to
celebrate you has come to
the New Great Arena!
Get Supply Gook Fireworks
from the supply box or by
gathering, and celebrate!
56081.descriptionJp:
Ketukoさん！討伐数１位
おめでとうございます！
Ketukoさんをお祝いしたい
モンスターが新大闘技場に
来てくれたみたいです！
支給品ボックスまたは採取で
支給用グーク花火を入手し、
一緒に祝いましょう！

21326.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
21326.description: What, you just want a hard Long Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21326.descriptionEn:
What, you want a Long Sword
that's just plain hard?
Then I'll refine some Argen
steel for you!
But the ore needed to make
that is hard to find, and
nasty monsters are prowling
around here besides.
Go find it with all you've got!
21326.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬い太刀が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

55388.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
55388.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
55388.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

62660.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Deep Forest, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Fresh Green, the Voice of Nature: Great Tree, or the Voice of Nature: Forest. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62660.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the Great Forest, you
may obtain Voice of Nature:
Verdant, Voice of Nature: Great
Tree or Voice of Nature: Forest.
I pray your hunting life grows
all the richer for it.
62660.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪樹海≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・新緑≫や
≪大自然の声・大樹≫、
≪大自然の声・森林≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

54795.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54795.description: Nya! Hunter there aiming to master the light bowgun! Try taking my guidance, meow! Hunt a Tigrex beautifully and you should get more rewards than usual, meow! Take this chance to master the Light Bowgun, meow!
54795.descriptionEn:
Nya! Hunter over there who
would master the Light
Bowgun! Try taking on my
lesson, nya! If you hunt
the ≪Tigrex≫ well, I bet
you'll get lots more
reward than usual, nya!
Take this chance to master
the Light Bowgun, nya!
54795.descriptionJp:
ニャ！軽銃を極めんとする
そこのハンターさん！試しに
ボクのシナンを受けてみる
ニャ！≪轟竜≫をみごと狩猟
することができたニャら、
いつもより沢山のホウシュウ
が貰えると思うニャ！
コレを機にライトボウガンを
極めてみるのニャ！

50967.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
50967.description: The damage caused by the Gore Magala has not subsided, but the survey is going well. I want you to continue hunting it. Word has come in that it has appeared at the Rainbow Falls. This time we will increase the reward as thanks from the guild. Head out to hunt it at once.
50967.descriptionEn:
Damage from the Gore Magala
has not stopped, but our
survey goes well. We ask
you to keep hunting it.
Word came that it appeared
at the Rainbow Waterfall.
The Guild raises your pay
as thanks. Go at once!
50967.descriptionJp:
黒蝕竜による被害は収まって
いないが、調査は順調だ。
引続き狩猟をお願いしたい。
彩の滝に出現したという情報
が入った。
今回はギルドからのお礼とし
て報酬を増量させておく。
至急、狩猟に行ってほしい。

55860.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55860.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55860.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55860.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

51077.objectiveJp: セルレギオス１頭の狩猟
51077.description: Seregios is a dangerous monster that scatters countless sharp scales around itself. To further our study of its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its horns or both legs in addition to the hunt, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
51077.descriptionEn:
Seregios, the Thousand Blade
Wyvern, scatters countless
sharp scales around and is
dangerous. To aid our study,
if you also break its horns
or both legs, we will give
extra rewards. We await the
challenge of brave hunters.
51077.descriptionJp:
千刃竜セルレギオスは無数の
鋭い鱗を、辺りにまき散らす
危険なモンスターです。
生態の解明のため、狩猟に
加えて角か両脚の破壊に
成功した場合は、追加の報酬
をお渡しします。
勇気あるハンターの挑戦を、
お待ちしております。

21794.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
21794.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21794.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21794.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

53326.description: The deeds of you hunters up to now have been splendid! I have asked a rock artisan to express the Hunters Guild's gratitude, so come and see. It is a thing only a master artisan's skill can express!
53326.descriptionEn:
Hunters, your deeds so far
have been magnificent!
I asked the stone smiths
to craft the Guild's
gratitude, so come and
watch. It is a thing only
the skill of master
craftsmen could ever
express!
53326.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君による
これまでの活躍、見事で
あった！
ハンターズギルドからの
感謝の気持ちを岩職人に
依頼したので見物してく
れ。卓越した職人のなせ
る技でしか表現できない
ものじゃ！

21346.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
21346.description: How is that for a fine medallion? Steady effort makes things this good. Patience is what matters, for hunters and craftsmen alike. If you want one, hunt that monster in the desert, or fish it up, and show me your patience.
21346.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
21346.descriptionEn:
A splendid medallion, isn't it?
Keep at it steadily and you can
make things this fine.
Patience is what matters, for a
hunter and a smith alike. If you
want it, hunt that monster in the
Desert, or fish it up, and show
me your patience, that's what
I'd like to see.
21346.descriptionJp:
どうだい、見事なメダリオン
だろ？コツコツ頑張ればこれ
だけいいものが作れる。
ハンターにも職人にも忍耐っ
てもんが大事なのさ。欲しい
なら砂漠であのモンスターを
狩猟するか、釣り上げるかし
てお前さんの忍耐力を見せて
欲しいとこだな。

22103.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22103.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22103.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

61861.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

60580.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Espinas and Hypnocatrice. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60580.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's targets are the
≪Espinas≫ and ≪Hypnocatrice≫!
Going after monsters all
alone is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a top rank! Origin weapons
only this time. Choose well!
60580.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪棘竜≫と≪眠鳥≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50884.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50884.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50884.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

62562.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62562.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
62562.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

50227.description: I am a musician who came from afar. Lately I have heard a rumor that at a certain hour a mysterious sound echoes from the swamp near this square. Would you go and find out what that sound is? I will provide the supplies and armor you need. It will not take much of your time, so please hurry.
50227.descriptionEn:
I am a musician who came from
far away. Lately I heard a rumor
that at a certain hour a strange
sound echoes from the swamp
near this square. Would you go
and find out what that sound is?
I will prepare whatever supplies
and armor you need. It will not
take much effort, so be quick.
50227.descriptionJp:
私は遠方から来た楽師の一人。
最近、この広場に近い沼地か
ら、ある時刻になると謎の音
が響き渡るという噂を聞いた。
その音とは何なのか調べてき
てくれないか？
必要な支給品や防具は私が用
意する。そんなに手間はとら
せないから、早いとこ頼むよ。

53040.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
53040.description: Comrades! Are you so taken with your own appearance that you neglect your Felyne comrade's wardrobe? Look! Look at that gaze that longs for finery! Grant your devoted partner's wish!
53040.descriptionEn:
Hunters! Do you fuss over
your own look and neglect
your Felyne partner's
outfit? Just look at
that gaze begging for
a new style! Grant your
devoted partner's wish,
I beg of you!
53040.descriptionJp:
諸君！普段自分の恰好ばかり
に気をとられてパートニャー
のオシャレをおざなりにして
いないか？
見よ！パートニャーのオシャ
レを望むあのまなざしを！
けなげな相棒のおねだりを
ぜひ叶えてやってくれ！

23696.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of Ｇｚ and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
23696.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A request is now available that
lets you earn a huge amount of Gz
and gain plenty of experience.
Please take this chance and
give it a try!
23696.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のＧｚが入手できる上、
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

50762.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
50762.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Dancing Thunder Dragon will also grant a special ingredient.
50762.descriptionEn:
For the long-running Guild
Priority Request, we have
prepared this quest to
raise awareness and use.
Break the Thunder Wyvern's
head and we will grant
special ingredients as
well.
50762.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
舞雷竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

61173.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61173.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61173.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

40240.description: The tower under survey has been suddenly occupied by a suspicious group. We tried to retake it ourselves, but the enemy's interference is fierce and there is no hope of climbing to the top. Could you storm the tower and drive off the boss said to be at the summit?
40240.descriptionEn:
The Tower we were surveying
was suddenly seized by a
sinister group. We tried to
take it back, but the enemy
resists fiercely and there
is no way we can climb to
the top. Could you clear
the Tower and drive off
the boss at its summit?
40240.descriptionJp:
調査中の塔が突然怪しげな集
団に占拠されてしまいました。
こちらで奪還を試みたのです
が、敵の妨害が激しく、
とても上まで登れそうに
ありません。
どうか塔を攻略し、頂上に
いるというボスを追い払って
くれないでしょうか。

23635.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23635.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23635.descriptionEn:
You who would master the
Hunting Horn, show the skill you
have honed against the Tigrex of
the Desert!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn far more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
23635.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26618.description: Lately hunters on their way to quests seem to be attacked by mysterious monsters while traveling. The guild will prepare a sufficient reward for solid information, so if you encounter one, why not take up the challenge?
26618.descriptionEn:
Lately, hunters on their way
to quests have been attacked
by a mysterious monster
while traveling, it seems.
For solid information, the
Guild will pay a generous
reward, so if you happen to
run into it, why not give
it a try?
26618.descriptionJp:
近頃、クエストに向かう
ハンターが、移動中、謎の
モンスターの襲撃を受ける
ことがあるようです。
有力情報には、ギルドから
十分な報酬を用意させてい
ただきますので、もし遭遇
されたら挑戦してみては
いかがでしょうか。

21262.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Slip through a duet of sleep breath and land a blow with all your might! Bring down 2 Hypnocatrice and an exceptional purse awaits! Challengers wanted!
21262.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
Dodge the duet of sleep breaths
and land a blow with all your
might!
Bring down the two Hypnocatrice
and an exceptional prize awaits!
Challengers wanted!
21262.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！
睡眠ブレスの２重奏をかいく
ぐり渾身の一撃を叩きこめ！
見事、眠鳥２頭を仕留めれば
破格の賞金が待っているぞ！
求む！挑戦者！

26354.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a very gentle and fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26354.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
This ≪Extra Quest≫ is sent
to you by the Public Tavern
Guild.
On a very calm and bountiful
field prepared by the power
of the Guild, why not take it
easy and do some gathering?
26354.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た、大変穏やかで実り豊かな
フィールドで、たまにはのん
びり採取でもいかがですか？

23334.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Hyujikiki, the Needle Covered Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23334.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Needle
Coiled Wyvern ≪Hyujikiki≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
23334.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、針纏竜
≪ヒュジキキ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61109.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種の狩猟
61109.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61109.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61109.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

54426.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
54426.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.
54426.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆をさらに
深めるべく、難しい依頼を
用意させてもらった。
モンスターの討伐と部位破壊
を、猟団の仲間と行うのだ。
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。

50731.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the chest of a Basarios will also grant a special ingredient.
50731.descriptionEn:
We have long been running the
Guild Priority Requests, and to
spread awareness and promote
them we have prepared this
quest for you.
By breaking the Basarios'
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50731.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
岩竜の胸部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

55728.description: One does not become a hunter on half-hearted resolve. I believe a true hunter not only shows strong resolve but carries it through. So I ask you this. Are you a hunter who can see their resolve through to the end? Prove it to me and I will present you with a special reward!
55728.descriptionEn:
One does not become a
hunter on half-hearted
resolve. Showing strong
will is not enough; only
seeing it through makes a
true hunter. So I ask: can
you see your resolve
through? Prove it, and a
special reward is yours!
55728.descriptionJp:
ハンターとは生半可な気持ち
でなれるものではない。
強い決意を示すだけでなく、
それをつらぬいてこそ真の
ハンターだと思っている。
そこで問いたい。決意をつら
ぬくことができるハンターか
否か！証明してくれれば、特
別な報酬を進呈しよう！

53025.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
53025.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ５. So I have a request: how about a full set of materials to produce two pieces of armor as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a monster. I am counting on you!
53025.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR5.
So I have a favor to ask.
How about a full set of materials
enough to craft 2 armor parts?
It is a simple job, really. Just
make one quick trip and slay
the monster for me.
I am counting on you!
53025.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ５になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は防具が２部位生産
できる素材一式でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってモンスターを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！
