23374.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Basarios in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
23374.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's
hunting life, we have a
request to hunt a Basarios
in the New Great Arena.
Clear it and you gain
higher acclaim than usual.
Train efficiently and aim
for even greater heights.
23374.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、新大闘技場にて
バサルモスを狩猟する依頼を
用意しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より高い評価が得られます。
効率的な鍛練を積み、さらな
る高みを目指しましょう。

21149.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
21149.description: At last the ice fox wyvern has settled in the canyon. With its range spreading to the old tower, the highlands and the canyon, it must be highly adaptable. There are reports of powerful individuals too. Prepare well and go hunt it!
21149.descriptionEn:
At last, the Ice Fox Wyvern has
come to live in the Canyon.
Its range now spreads from the
Ancient Tower to the Highlands
and the Canyon, so it must be
highly adaptable.
There are reports of powerful
individuals too. Prepare well
and head out to hunt!
21149.descriptionJp:
ついに、峡谷で氷狐竜が生息
するようになった。
生息範囲が古塔、高地、峡谷
と広がっていることから、
ヤツは環境適応能力が高いの
だろう。
強力な個体であるとの報告も
ある。十分に準備をして、
狩猟に向かってくれ！

21983.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
21983.description: Teostra the Conquest species, who would create a world of crimson, has appeared! With no time to lose, this is a short-notice request, but to keep the damage to a minimum, repelling it alone will also count. We are seeking first-rate hunters with a Secret Scroll to face this unprecedented crisis!
21983.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Flame King Dragon,
creator of a crimson world,
has appeared! Time is short,
so this is a swift slaying
request, but to keep the damage
to a minimum, a repel alone
will also be counted.
I call for master hunters
bearing Secret Art scrolls!
21983.descriptionJp:
紅蓮の世界を創造せし
覇種炎王龍が現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

60576.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
60576.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Harudomerugu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60576.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is the
≪Dahren Mohran≫!
Clear the goal together
with your Guild mates.
Teamwork decides this
contest, so take a top
rank! Origin weapons only
this time. Choose well!
60576.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ハルドメルグ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

61431.objectiveJp: イベント補助券１枚の納品
61431.description: I got hold of something interesting lately, but work keeps me too busy to try it. I will lend it to you, so swing it around in the Forest and tell me what you think.
61431.descriptionEn:
I got my paws on something
interesting the other day, meow.
But work is busy and I can't
try it out, meow. I'll lend it to
you, so give it a swing in the
Great Forest and tell me, meow.
61431.descriptionJp:
この間面白いものを手に入れ
たニャ。でも仕事が忙しくて
なかなか試せないニャ。
これを貸すから、ちょっと樹
海で振り回してきて、感想を
教えてほしいニャ。

23572.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23572.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23572.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

11033.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
11033.description: Iodrome hits harder in a single blow than Velocidrome or Gendrome! If you feel your life is in danger, deliver Specialty Mushrooms growing in the swamp! Aging them in a Maka Pickling Jar is OK too!
11033.descriptionEn:
≪Iodrome≫ hits harder per
blow than a Velocidrome or
Gendrome!
If you feel your life in
danger, deliver ≪Special
Mushrooms≫ from the swamp!
≪Maka Pot≫ aging? OK!
11033.descriptionJp:
≪ドスイーオス≫はドスラン
ポスや、ドスゲネポスに比べ
一発の攻撃力が高いです！
身の危険を感じたら、沼地に
生える≪特産キノコ≫を納品
して下さい！≪マカ漬けの壷≫
で熟成にしてもＯＫです！

26668.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26668.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Gravios Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26668.descriptionEn:
This hunting skill quest
is to slay a
≪Gravios Variant≫.
Why not sharpen your
skills alongside others!
26668.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪グラビモス変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

21221.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21221.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21221.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

58023.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58023.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58023.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58023.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

26512.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の捕獲
26512.description: Lately a rare flying wyvern has been sighted, or so I hear. I heard it has a primitive flying wyvern shape... I would very much like one for myself, so though it is unusual for High Rank, I will provide minimal supplies. Capture it properly.
26512.descriptionEn:
Lately a rare wyvern has been
sighted, has it not?
I heard it has the form of a
primitive wyvern, or so...
I would very much like one for
myself, so though it is unusual
for High Rank, I will provide
minimal supplies.
Capture it properly.
26512.descriptionJp:
ここ最近、珍しい飛竜が目撃
されているそうじゃないか。
なんでも、原始的な飛竜の形
だとか聞いたんだが･･･。
ぜひ１頭私のものにしておき
たいから、上位では異例だが
最低限の支給品も出そう。
しっかり捕獲してきてくれ。

26692.description: This is a hunting request for the Abiorugu confirmed in the swamp. The swamp is a place many novice hunters also visit to hunt, so they want its safety secured. This is just where hunters should show their skill, no?
26692.descriptionEn:
This is a request to hunt the
Abiorugu confirmed in the Swamp.
Many rookie hunters visit the
Swamp to hunt, so we have been
asked to secure their safety.
This is just the time for you
hunters to show what you can do,
is it not?
26692.descriptionJp:
沼地で確認されている
アビオルグの狩猟依頼です。
沼地は、駆け出しの
ハンターの方も多く狩猟に
訪れる場所のため、
安全の確保をしてほしい
とのことです。
こういう時こそ
ハンターさんたちの腕の見せ
どころではないでしょうか。

1006.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
1006.description: If you hear a strange birdlike cry in this jungle, it is without a doubt the Yian Kut-Ku! Hunt one and you can call your skill decent! A sound burst by its ear might make it weep, you know!
1006.descriptionEn:
If you hear a strange bird
cry in this Jungle, it is
surely the ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫!
Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and
your skill is no small
thing! Ring a sound by its
ear and it may weep!?
1006.descriptionJp:
この密林で鳥のような奇声が
聞こえたら、それは間違いな
く怪鳥≪イャンクック≫だ！
イャンクックが狩猟できれば
キミの狩りの腕もなかなかの
もんだよ！耳元で音を鳴らせ
ばナミダをこぼすかもな！？

23185.description: Near the unsurveyed part of the Canyon, Gabras have been confirmed flying in a flock. The appearance of Gabras is said to be an omen of disaster. Slay the Gabras and confirm the situation.
23185.descriptionEn:
Near the unsurveyed part
of the Canyon, a flock of
Gavras was seen flying.
The appearance of Gavras
is said to herald disaster.
Slay the Gavras and report
on the situation.
23185.descriptionJp:
峡谷の未調査地域付近で、
ガブラスが群れで飛んで
いるのが確認されました。
ガブラスの出現は災いの
前触れとも言われています。
ガブラスを討伐し、状況を
確認してきてください。

50744.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の討伐
50744.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
50744.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
50744.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

54650.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期３頭の狩猟

1086.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト２匹の納品
1086.description: Find and deliver 5 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! In this cold season Royal Beetles are scarce, but Special Mushrooms are plentiful! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
1086.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 5 Special
Mushrooms growing in the
Jungle! In this cold season
≪Royal Rhino≫ grows rare,
but ≪Special Mushrooms≫
are plentiful! Start by
learning to love the Jungle.
1086.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を５つ探して納品してくれ！
この寒冷期になると≪ロイヤ
ルカブト≫は少なくなるが、
≪特産キノコ≫が豊富だぜ！
まずは密林を知り、密林に
慣れることから始めるといい。

50174.description: A quest for the G3 Advance Trial Event. Enjoy MHF-G3 a step ahead of everyone! The time limit is 10 minutes.
50174.descriptionEn:
This is a quest for the
'G3 Early Trial Event.'
Enjoy MHF-G3 a step ahead
of everyone!
Time limit: 10 minutes.
50174.descriptionJp:
「Ｇ３先行体験会」の
クエストです。
ＭＨＦ−Ｇ３を一足早く
お楽しみください！
制限時間は１０分です。

28060.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
28060.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28060.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!
28060.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意したぞ！
複数のモンスターの討伐を、
猟団の仲間と成し遂げるのだ！
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

54755.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54755.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
54755.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
54755.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

55984.description: Taking on a request from me, the boss of the Dark Cat Gang, shows good nerve, meow. If you pull it off splendidly, I will give you a Dark Cat Gang Pass (Pink) as proof of membership, meow!
55984.descriptionEn:
Taking on a request from
me, boss of the Dark Cat
Gang? You've got guts, nya.
Pull it off, and I'll give
you the ≪Dark Cat Gang
Pass - Pink≫ as proof
of membership, nya!
55984.descriptionJp:
闇猫団のボスたるワガハイの
依頼に挑戦しようとは、
イイ度胸してるミャ。
見事にやってのけたら、
闇猫団員の証として、
≪闇猫団パス・桃≫を
くれてやるミャ！

54565.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
54565.description: Please investigate the Azure Rathalos that appeared in the Forest and Hills. If you not only hunt it but also break its wing claws and sever its tail, I will add to the reward!
54565.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Azure
Rathalos that appeared in
the Forest and Hills.
Beyond hunting it, break
its wingtalons and sever
its tail, and we'll add to
your reward!
54565.descriptionJp:
森丘に現れた蒼火竜の調査を
お願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
蒼火竜の翼爪破壊と
尻尾切断をしてくれたら
報酬を上乗せしちゃい
ますよ！

54553.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
54553.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Forokururu, the Splendid Phoenix Bird. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54553.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the gorgeous
phoenix ≪Forokururu≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
54553.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、華鳳鳥
≪フォロクルル≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21480.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21480.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21480.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21480.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61143.objectiveJp: カジキマグロ１０匹の納品
61143.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Hunting monsters is not all a hunter does. Fishing is a fine hunt as well. Why not aim to be an angler yourself? If you do, start by delivering 10 Marlin on your own.
61143.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. Hunting
monsters is not all a hunter does.
Fishing is a fine hunt in its own
right. Why not aim to be an angler?
If you do, start by delivering
10 Speartuna on your own.
61143.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。モンスター
を狩るだけがハンターじゃな
い。釣りだって立派な狩猟だ。
君も釣師を目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人でカジ
キマグロ１０匹の納品からだ。

55966.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55966.descriptionEn:
For the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special
request and rewards for you.
When you accept and join,
please bring <<Festival Fever>>.
55966.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫
をお持ちください。

21980.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の撃退
21980.description: A Supremacy Doragyurosu has appeared. The purpose of this request is to prevent the damage from spreading until the hunt party arrives. Therefore, please complete it by repelling the monster. Act with your own safety first.
21980.descriptionEn:
A Zenith Doragyurosu has
appeared. This request aims
to prevent further damage
until the slaying squad
arrives. So we ask you to
clear it by repelling it.
Please put your own safety
first in all you do.
21980.descriptionJp:
覇種ドラギュロスが現れまし
た。この依頼は、討伐隊が
到着するまでの、被害拡大を
防ぐことが目的となります。
そのため、撃退での達成を
お願いします。
ハンターさん自身の安全を
第一に行動してください。

26380.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26380.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26380.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

23625.description: The Variant Species Plesioth appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Plesioth. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23625.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Plesioth≫ seems
to have reached the strength
of the pinnacle among
Plesioth. Its power is
immeasurable. Hunters
confident in their skill,
please take on this survey.
23625.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ガノトトス≫は
ガノトトスの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

54155.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
54155.description: The sky-soaring dragon has been confirmed near the course of the large survey ship. Even with interception equipment, we cannot survey if it attacks again and again. Board the survey ship and slay the sky-soaring dragon.
54155.descriptionEn:
Near the route of the large survey
ship, the Sky-Soaring Dragon was
sighted. Even with interception
equipment, we cannot carry out
our survey if it keeps attacking.
Please board the large survey ship
and slay the Sky-Soaring Dragon.
54155.descriptionJp:
大型探査船の航路付近に、
天翔龍の姿が確認されました。
迎撃用の装備があるとはいえ、
そう何度も襲われていては
調査を行うことができません。
大型探査船に同乗し、天翔龍
の討伐に当たって下さい。

54994.description: Hunter who would master the heavy gun, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54994.descriptionEn:
You who would master the Heavy
Bowgun, show the skill you have
honed against the
Blood-Drinking Wyvern of the New
Great Arena!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn far more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
54994.descriptionJp:
重銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55807.description: As a result of the Great Hunt in the Depths of Solitude Island, the black Raviente seems to lie silent underground. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so please join.
55807.descriptionEn:
From the Great Hunt in the
≪Isolated Island Depths≫,
the black Raviente seems to
lie silent underground. We
are forming a survey team
limited to hunters who took
part. Please do join us.
55807.descriptionJp:
≪絶島地底≫で行われた
大討伐の結果、黒き大巌竜は
地底で沈黙しているようです。
大討伐に参加したハンター
限定の調査団を編成する
こととなりましたので、
是非ご参加ください。

21111.description: If you can hunt a Rathian, it means you're a hunter who can hunt well enough even in the Elder Hall. It's a famous saying among hunters, isn't it? But making the queen cry would be even more impressive. I wonder if she cries if she drinks a lot of water?
21111.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means a hunter who can
hunt even in the Great Hall.
A famous saying among
hunters, isn't it? But if
you could make the queen
cry, that'd be even better.
Would lots of water do it?
21111.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたら、
それは大老殿でも充分に狩猟
が果たせる狩人を意味する。
狩人たちの間でも有名な謳い
言葉よね？でも、もしも女王
を泣かせることができたら、
それはもっと凄いことね。水
を大量に飲めば泣くかしら？

54372.description: A merchant went to a flower field to pick flowers and found a giant Bulldrome there, blowing flowers everywhere as it rampaged. At this rate business cannot continue. Could someone drive off the Bulldrome in the flower field?
54372.descriptionEn:
A merchant went to the Flower
Field to pick flowers, and found
a huge Bulldrome there, blowing
flowers everywhere as it
rampaged. At this rate no trade
can go on. Could someone please
drive off the Bulldrome in the
Flower Field?
54372.descriptionJp:
とある商人が、花畑へ花を摘
みに行くと、そこには巨大な
≪大猪≫がそこら中の花を吹
き飛ばしながら暴れ回ってて
いたそうだ。このままでは商
売ができなくなってしまう。
誰か花畑にいる≪大猪≫の退
治をお願いできないだろうか。

23269.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
23269.description: A surveyor who went to the Jungle reports being attacked by a monster. The monster seems to have appeared suddenly from the shadows of the grass, and no accurate testimony could be obtained, but it was very fast and blue. Please investigate at once what this monster is.
23269.descriptionEn:
A survey team member who
went to the Jungle was
attacked by a monster.
It seemed to appear from
the grass without warning.
We have no firm testimony,
but it was very fast, and
it was blue. Please hurry
and survey just what this
monster is.
23269.descriptionJp:
密林に向かった調査員が、
モンスターに襲われたと
の報告が入りました。
そのモンスターは草陰から
突然現れたらしく、
正確な証言は取れていません
が、とても素早く、そして
青かったということです。
急ぎこのモンスターが何か
調査をお願いします。

56120.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56120.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56120.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

50012.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50012.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
50012.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
50012.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

21595.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
21595.description: Have you heard of the Wolf Fang Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21595.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the
orb called Wolf Fang
Sphere? Its material is
essential to crafting a
certain costly decoration.
Complete this request and
I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21595.descriptionJp:
狼牙原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

21824.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
21824.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21824.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21824.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50487.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50487.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１００. So I have a request: how about a full set of materials to produce one piece of SP armor as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay an Espinas Variant. I am counting on you!
50487.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR100.
So I've got a favor to ask,
and the pay is a full set of
materials for one SP Armor piece.
Easy job, really, just a quick
run out to slay an
Espinas Variant.
I'm counting on you!
50487.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ１００になったんだって
な。そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬はＳＰ防具が１部位生産
できる素材一式でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってエスピナス変種を
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

55332.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55332.description: An Akura Vashimu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Akura Vashimu known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55332.descriptionEn:
An Akura Vashimu with a greatly
developed tail has appeared.
The guild classes this one as a
Supremacy with developed parts,
and will survey it.
Reports say it is more dangerous
than past Akura Vashimu.
Please survey it with care.
55332.descriptionJp:
尾が大きく発達した≪尾晶蠍≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を部位
の発達した≪辿異種≫と位置
づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの尾晶蠍より危険と
の報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

60818.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60818.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly.
60818.descriptionEn:
I've been hearing lately that Variants
are a real pain for hunters, since
their sacs are so hard to carve.
So I'll strip those sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure you bring the
quarry down properly, got it.
60818.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさんたち
は、しっかり獲物をしとめて
くるんだぜ。

28027.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟

54619.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
54619.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
54619.descriptionEn:
You who would master the
Hunting Horn, show the skill you
have honed against the Tigrex of
the Desert!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn far more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
54619.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55744.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55744.description: The Variant Species Anorupatisu has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55744.descriptionEn:
The ≪Supremacy≫ ≪Anorupatisu≫
has grown fiercely strong and
keeps rampaging.
It is extremely dangerous as
things stand. Prepare fully and
carry out the survey.
55744.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪アノルパティス≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

50360.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50360.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Kushala Daora will also grant a special ingredient.
50360.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Kushala Daora's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50360.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鋼龍の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

62694.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request! Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades! No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62694.descriptionEn:
Indeed! It is I, the Instructor!
To test your bonds today, I have
prepared a difficult request!
Slay several monsters and see
it done with your Guild
comrades! No supplies at all
will be provided, so consult
your comrades before you go.
The reward is a special ore!
62694.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意したぞ！
複数のモンスターの討伐を、
猟団の仲間と成し遂げるのだ！
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

60239.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
60239.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Black Diablos. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60239.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is a
≪Black Diablos≫!
Going after a monster all
alone is truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a top rank! SP weapons only
this time. Choose well!
60239.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ディアブロス亜種≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

26299.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26299.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26299.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26299.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26299.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

63302.objectiveJp: よく磨かれた鏡石１個の納品
63302.description: The Melynx are gathering to get Nyah's treasure, meow! Those guys push Velocidrome around, very dangerous, meow! Please, meow! I will trade the treasure and a Well-Polished Mirror Stone, so drive them off, meow!
63302.descriptionEn:
Melynx are gathering to
steal my treasure, nya!
They push around even
Velocidrome, nya!
They're very dangerous!
Please, nya! I'll trade you
a 'Polished Mirrorstone'
for my treasure, so chase
them all off, nya!
63302.descriptionJp:
ニャーの宝物を狙って、メラ
ルーたちが集まってるニャ！
あいつらはドスランポスを
ニャかまにしている、
とってもキケンな奴らニャ！
頼むニャ！宝物と
『よく磨かれた鏡石』を交換
してやるから、あいつらを
追い払ってほしいニャ！

21638.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
21638.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Pig Snout Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21638.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the
orb called Pig Snout
Sphere? Its material is
essential to crafting a
certain costly decoration.
Complete this request and
I shall give you precious
decoration materials.
21638.descriptionJp:
豚鼻原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

60617.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60617.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60617.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60617.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55532.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
55532.description: They say a raw, wet sound of something devouring flesh and blood comes up from beneath Tide Island. When a hunter went down into the great pit to look, two red eyes came bursting out of the dust and the stench and charged him. Whoever discovers what this creature is will receive the materials to craft armor the guild has kept hidden.
55532.descriptionEn:
They say a raw, fleshy sound of
devouring meat can be heard from
beneath the Tidal Island.
When a hunter climbed down into
the great pit to look, two red
glowing eyes came lunging out of
the dust with a terrible stench.
Whoever uncovers what this thing
is will receive Guild armor materials.
55532.descriptionJp:
潮島の地下から血肉を貪る
生々しい音が聞こえるそうだ。
あるハンターが様子を見に大
穴へ降りた所、土埃の中から
激臭とともに赤く光る二つの
目が勢いよく襲い掛かってき
たらしい。こいつの正体を突
き止めた者にはギルド秘蔵の
防具の生産素材を必ず渡そう。

50330.description: Violent tremors are frequently reported in the highlands. It seems a Gurenzeburu is on a rampage. The hunt is expected to be quite dangerous. Go fully prepared.
50330.descriptionEn:
Violent tremors are being
reported frequently in the
Highlands.
It seems a Gurenzeburu is on a
rampage.
The hunt is expected to be quite
dangerous. Prepare fully before
you head out.
50330.descriptionJp:
高地で頻繁に激しい揺れが
報告されております。
どうやら≪グレンゼブル≫が
暴れているものと思われます。
かなり危険な狩猟になると
予想されます。万全な準備を
して向かってください。

62575.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

21962.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の狩猟
21962.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Taikun Zamuza on Tide Island. Clear this request and you will earn a larger reward than usual, so do take it on and see it done.
21962.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's
hunting life, we have a
request to hunt a
≪Multi-Shell Crab≫ on
Tidal Island. Clear it for
more pay than usual, so
take it up and finish it.
21962.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、潮島で≪多殻蟹≫を
狩猟する依頼を用意しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より多い報酬金が得られます
ので、ぜひ受注して依頼を
達成しましょう。

50977.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
50977.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. The reward is rare decoration materials.
50977.descriptionEn:
The ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫, which
had only been sighted now and then,
has expanded its territory to the
areas where people travel. To
prevent further damage, please
hunt the target.
The reward is a rare decoration
material.
50977.descriptionJp:
ときおり目撃されていた
≪照雷鳥≫が、人の通る
辺りまで縄張りを広げて
きました。これ以上の
被害を防ぐため、対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材
です。

61061.description: Before we knew it, an Espinas had taken up residence in the Great Arena. And a Hypnocatrice too. Won't you take on slaying those troublemakers? Just dealing with the Espinas is enough. Oh, and the reward goes to the first to finish!
61061.descriptionEn:
Before we knew it, an Espinas had
planted itself in the Great Arena.
And on top of that, a Hypnocatrice
has moved in too. Won't you take
on slaying that rampaging brute?
Just deal with the Espinas and
that is enough. Oops, the reward
goes to whoever gets here first!
61061.descriptionJp:
いつの間にか大闘技場に
エスピナスが居座りやがった。
おまけにヒプノックまで
居やがる。あの暴れものの
討伐を引受けてくれないか？
エスピナスさえどうにかして
くれればいい。おっと、報酬
は早い者勝ちだからな！

62898.description: An urgent report has come from a surveyor. In the highlands, a monster no one has ever seen has been found. It has a long neck and tail, sturdy limbs, and no wings. Its back is hardened and appears to sprout crystals. Much remains unexplained, but please investigate with caution.
62898.descriptionEn:
An urgent report from a
surveyor. A monster never
seen by anyone was found
in the Highlands. Long neck
and tail, sturdy limbs,
and no wings, they say.
Its back is hardened and
seems to grow crystal.
Much is unknown; be careful.
62898.descriptionJp:
調査員から緊急報告があった。
高地で誰も見たことのない、
モンスターを発見とのこと。
首と尻尾が長く、強靭な四肢
があり、翼はないそうだ。
背面は硬質化しており、水晶
が生えているように見える。
まだ、未解明な点も多いが、
注意して調査をお願いします。

55226.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
55226.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the armor 'Von GX Helm' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55226.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where you can get the mats
to craft and upgrade the
'Von GX Helm' armor worn
in the photo that won the
top prize in the 'F Photo
Contest 2016.'
Please make good use of it.
55226.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る防具「ヴォンGXヘルム」を
生産・強化するための素材を
獲得できるクエストをご用意
しました。
ぜひご利用ください。

62486.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62486.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
62486.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
62486.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

1046.description: If you can hunt a Rathian, it means you stand on your own as a hunter. It's a famous saying among hunters, but making the queen cry would be even more impressive! Maybe she cries if she drinks a lot of water?
1046.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Rathian≫ and it
means you stand on your own.
It's a famous saying among
hunters, but making the
queen cry would be even more
amazing! Drink lots of
water and she cries, no?
1046.descriptionJp:
≪リオレイア≫を狩れたら
それは狩人として独り立ちを
意味する。狩人たちの間じゃ
有名な謳い文句だけど、女王
を泣かせることができたら、
それはもっと凄いことだな！
水を大量に飲めば泣くとか？

55584.description: A Divergent Inagami with a greatly developed tail has appeared. Many hunters have failed to slay it because of the attacks peculiar to Divergent species. The Guild recommends a large party and will add to the supplies when you depart with 4. Head out to investigate with care.
55584.descriptionEn:
A Supremacy Inagami with a
greatly developed tail has
appeared. Its Supremacy
attacks have made many
hunters fail to slay it.
The Guild recommends a
group, and adds supplies
when you depart with four.
Please go carefully on
your survey.
55584.descriptionJp:
尾が大きく発達した辿異種
イナガミが現れました。
辿異種特有の攻撃で数多の
ハンターが討伐に失敗してい
ます。
ギルドでは多人数での参加を
推奨し、４名で出発した時に
支給品の追加を行います。
気をつけて調査に向かってく
ださい。

50917.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
50917.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. Also, we have information from an attack victim that it uses lightning. Proceed with great care.
50917.descriptionEn:
The ≪Thunder Bird≫, sighted
only now and then, has spread
its territory as far as the
paths people travel.
To prevent further harm,
please hunt the target.
We also have information from
those attacked that it uses
lightning. Proceed with the
greatest caution.
50917.descriptionJp:
ときおり目撃されていた
≪照雷鳥≫が、人の通る
辺りまで縄張りを広げて
きました。これ以上の
被害を防ぐため、対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
また、襲われた者から
雷を使うという情報を
得ています。十分に注意
して事に当たって下さい。

26539.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, as exploration has confirmed it safe, we are opening the Volcano depths, the lava pool area! Gather to your heart's content!
26539.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time, as our survey confirmed
it is safe, we are opening the
Volcano Depths and the lava pool area!
Please go and gather to your
heart's content!
26539.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は探索の結果、安全が
確認されたため、火山奥地、
溶岩池部分を開放します！
思う存分採取してきちゃって
ください！

54983.description: Hunter who would master the Sword and Shield, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
54983.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Sword and Shield, show the
skill you have honed against
the ≪Baruragaru≫ in the New
Great Arena! Hunt it well and
you shall earn even more
rewards than your daily
efforts bring.
54983.descriptionJp:
片手剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50895.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50895.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50895.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50895.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

56075.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
56075.description: It seems the era name was changed in an Eastern region. Just as a stone artisan finished a stone ornament as a celebratory gift, a Pink Rathian flew in, so please slay it before damage is done!
56075.descriptionEn:
The era has changed in the
eastern lands, I hear.
Just as the stone smiths
finished a gift stone
figure, a ≪Pink Rathian≫
came crashing in!
Please slay it before any
damage is done!
56075.descriptionJp:
東方の地域で改元されたそう
です。石職人がお祝いとして
贈り物の石のオブジェを
完成させたところに
≪リオレイア亜種≫が
飛び込んできてしまったので
被害が出る前に討伐を
お願いします！

62842.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
62842.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!
62842.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
のだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

58016.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58016.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58016.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58016.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

21753.description: As support for everyone, we present the habitat of the Aptonoth, ideal for procuring meat. Those short of meat, this is your chance!
21753.descriptionEn:
This time, as support for
everyone, we introduce the
≪Aptonoth≫ habitat best
suited to procuring meat.
If you're short on meat,
this is your chance!
21753.descriptionJp:
今回、皆様への支援として
お肉を調達するのに最適な
≪アプトノス≫の生息域を
ご紹介します。
お肉が不足している方、
チャンスですよ！

50485.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rukodiora. I am counting on you!
50485.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR22.
So here is a request for you:
how about a full set of weapon
materials as pay?
It is an easy job, honest.
Just run over there and slay a
Rukodiora for me.
I am counting on you!
50485.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ２２になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってルコディオラを討
伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54376.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54376.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54376.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

54928.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
54928.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54928.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54928.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

23293.description: The survey of the flower field is proceeding smoothly, and many new materials have been discovered. Most of what has been found can apparently be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Among Ｇ-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous lands, quite a few may take an interest.
23293.descriptionEn:
The survey of the Flower Field
is going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.
23293.descriptionJp:
花畑の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

62532.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Desert, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Quicksand or the Voice of Nature: Dunes. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62532.descriptionEn:
I hear it. The voice of
nature. By completing this
request set in the ≪Desert≫,
you may obtain ≪Voice of
Nature: Quicksand≫ or
≪Voice of Nature: Dunes≫.
May your hunting life grow
ever richer.
62532.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪砂漠≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・流砂≫や
≪大自然の声・砂丘≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

62160.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
62160.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. This may be a good chance to hunt a monster. Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! There is no time to wait for others, so please depart as 1 hunter.
62160.descriptionEn:
A specimen of a relatively
weak monster has been confirmed.
This may be a fine chance
to hunt a monster.
Before it flees far away,
please hurry and get ready!
There is no time to wait for others,
so please depart alone.
62160.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
これは、モンスターを狩猟す
るいい機会かもしれません。
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
人を待つ時間もないため、
１人での出発をお願いします。

63283.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63283.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63283.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63283.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

26609.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
26609.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Broac Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26609.descriptionEn:
The lost memos that record the
secret of forging weapons are
apparently turning up on
monsters slain all over!
Once you get the Buroaku Memo,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work!
26609.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ブロアクメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

56021.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
56021.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Daimyo Hermitaur. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56021.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay the
Supremacy Daimyo Hermitaur.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will add
developed part materials to your
Another rewards as a special
gift. Note that slaying alone
will not earn those materials.
56021.descriptionJp:
辿異種の盾蟹を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

21057.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ４頭の討伐
21057.description: We ask you to slay the Jungle's troublemaker, the Bullfango. At this time of year their numbers grow, damage is reported across the land every year, and the Guild is at a loss. Hunters, your help please!
21057.descriptionEn:
Please slay the Bullfango, the
troublemakers of the Jungle.
In this season their numbers
swell, and every year the damage
piles up everywhere, leaving the
guild at a loss.
Hunters, we ask for your help!
21057.descriptionJp:
密林の暴れん坊、
ブルファンゴの討伐をお願
いします。
個体数が増えるこの時期、
毎年各地で被害が相次いで
ギルドも困っています。
ハンターの皆様、ご協力を！

55570.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐

26736.description: How is that for a fine medallion? Steady effort makes things this good. Patience is what matters, for hunters and craftsmen alike. If you want one, hunt that monster in the desert, or fish it up, and show me your patience.
26736.descriptionEn:
A splendid medallion, isn't it?
Keep at it steadily and you can
make things this fine.
Patience is what matters, for a
hunter and a smith alike. If you
want it, hunt that monster in the
Desert, or fish it up, and show
me your patience, that's what
I'd like to see.
26736.descriptionJp:
どうだい、見事なメダリオン
だろ？コツコツ頑張ればこれ
だけいいものが作れる。
ハンターにも職人にも忍耐っ
てもんが大事なのさ。欲しい
なら砂漠であのモンスターを
狩猟するか、釣り上げるかし
てお前さんの忍耐力を見せて
欲しいとこだな。

63153.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
63153.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
63153.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

12069.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62923.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Volcano, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Plateau or the Voice of Nature: Tornado. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62923.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature.
By completing this request,
set in the Volcano, you may
obtain Voice of Nature: Plateau
or Voice of Nature: Tornado.
I pray your hunting life grows
all the richer for it.
62923.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪火山≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・台地≫や
≪大自然の声・竜巻≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

21859.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21859.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Artela F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21859.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for all five
parts of the ≪Storm Armor≫
Altera F series.
To accept the quest, you
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
Note that if you fail,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
consumed, so be careful.
21859.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
アルテラＦシリーズの５部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50982.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
50982.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50982.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50982.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

21463.description: This is the reception for the Hunting Technique Quest: slaying Espinas. The reward is slightly lower than a normal hunt, but why not sharpen your skills against other hunters!
21463.descriptionEn:
This is the reception for the
Hunting Technique Quest
to slay ≪Espinas≫.
The reward is a little lower
than a normal hunt, but why
not sharpen your skills
against fellow hunters!
21463.descriptionJp:
こちらが狩猟技クエスト
≪エスピナス≫
討伐の受付となります。
通常の狩りより若干報酬は
落ちますが、ハンター同士
で腕を磨き合ってはいかが
でしょうか！

50480.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50480.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50480.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55156.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to craft Zinogre armor! Complete the sub-target and you can obtain the materials needed to upgrade Transcendent armor, so please take it on!
55156.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special quest
for hunters who want to forge
Zinogre armor!
Clear the sub-target and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade Transit armor, so give
it a try!
55156.descriptionJp:
雷狼竜≪ジンオウガ≫の防具
を作りたいハンターに向けた、
特別クエストを用意しました！
サブターゲットを達成すると
遷悠防具の強化に必要な素材
を入手できますので、ぜひ
挑戦して下さい！

61838.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・１を１０個納品

62710.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
62710.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
62710.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

61136.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
61136.description: I saw it! Fireballs raining down from the sky! And not one or two but a tremendous number. If you go to the jungle you should find some trace. However, there have been many Yian Garuga sightings in the jungle lately. Take great care!
61136.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
61136.descriptionEn:
I saw it! Fireballs raining down
from the sky! And not just one or
two, but a huge number of them.
If you go to the Jungle you should
find some trace of it. However,
there have been many sightings of
Yian Garuga in the Jungle lately.
Be on your guard!
61136.descriptionJp:
俺は見た！空から火の玉が降
り注ぐのを！それも１つや２
つじゃなく凄い数だったぞ。
密林に行けば何か痕跡が見つ
かる筈だ。ただし、最近密林
でイャンガルルガの目撃情報
が多く寄せられている。
要注意だ！

55295.objectiveJp: ゴア・マガラ１頭の狩猟
55295.description: Reports of damage from the Gore Magala keep coming in. The erosion caused by the Frenzy Virus seems to be spreading. To curb the Frenzy Virus and for our survey, I want to request the hunt and the breaking of the head and antennae. Word has come in that it has appeared at the tower. Head out to hunt it at once.
55295.descriptionEn:
Reports of damage from the
Gore Magala keep coming.
The Frenzy Virus seems to
be spreading its taint.
To contain and study it,
I ask you to hunt it and
break its head and feelers.
It was sighted at the
Tower. Go at once.
55295.descriptionJp:
黒蝕竜の被害報告が相次いで
いる。狂竜ウイルスによる侵
蝕が広まっているようだ。
狂竜ウイルスの抑制と調査の
ため、狩猟と頭部や触角の
部位破壊を依頼したい。
塔に出現したという情報
が入った。
至急、狩猟に行ってほしい。

50031.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
50031.description: We ask you to hunt the bird wyvern and the great boar that appeared in the Jungle. This request is just right for those aiming to become first-rate hunters. As a reward, we have prepared a small gift from the Guild. I hope that one day you will become a splendid hunter.
50031.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the Yian Kut-Ku and
the Bulldrome that appeared in
the Jungle.
This request is just right for
those aiming to become first
rate hunters.
The guild has prepared a small
gift as your reward. I look
forward to the day you become a
fine hunter.
50031.descriptionJp:
密林に現れた、怪鳥と大猪
の狩猟をお願いします。
この依頼は、これから一流の
ハンターを目指す皆さんに
丁度良い依頼となっています。
報酬として、ギルドから
心ばかりの贈り物を用意させ
て頂きました。いつの日か、
立派なハンターとなることを
期待します。

26277.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Wyvern Eggs. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
26277.descriptionEn:
From the popular tavern Guild comes
a large order for Flying Wyvern
Eggs. Eight is more than one
person can carry and deliver
alone, so we recommend at least
two people take this on.
Note that there are no supply
items for clearing sub-quests.
26277.descriptionJp:
大衆酒場ギルドより、飛竜の
卵の大口注文が入りました。
８個という数は、１人で取り
きって納品できる数ではない
ので、少なくとも２人以上で
の受注をオススメいたします。
尚、サブ達成による支給品は
ありませんので、要注意です。

55774.description: For the G Rank Guild Priority Request, we have prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote it. Break the Odibatorasu's head and we will grant special ingredients too.
55774.descriptionEn:
For the G Rank Guild
Priority Request, we have
prepared this quest to
raise awareness and use.
Break the Rock Wyvern's
head and we will grant
special ingredients too.
55774.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
弩岩竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

50342.description: Won't you help with an ecological survey of Abiorugu? This time the site is the Snowy Mountains. I'd like you to head there and hunt Abiorugu. Of course you'll be paid. Break the tail as well and I'll add a bonus. Well then, I leave it to you.
50342.descriptionEn:
Care to help me with an
ecology survey of ≪Abiorg≫?
The survey site is the
Snowy Mountains this time.
I'd like you to head out
and hunt ≪Abiorg≫ there.
Reward's a given, and I'll
add a bonus for a tail
break. Alright, off you go.
50342.descriptionJp:
≪アビオルグ≫の生態調査を
手伝ってくれないか？
今回の調査場所は雪山だ。
あんたには現地に向かって
≪アビオルグ≫の狩猟をお願
いしたい。もちろん報酬は
出す。あと、尻尾を破壊で
きれば上乗せしよう。
それじゃあ、頼んだよ。

54748.description: Good news for all hunters! A request has appeared that lets you obtain a large amount of Ｇｚ and build plenty of experience at the same time. Do take the chance to try it!
54748.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A request is now available that
lets you earn a huge amount of Gz
and gain plenty of experience.
Please take this chance and
give it a try!
54748.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
大量のＧｚが入手できる上、
多くの経験を積むことができ
る依頼が発生しています。
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

21347.description: Variant Gypceros and Variant Congalala seem to be on a rampage in the Jungle. The Guild has prepared a special emblem as a reward, so please hunt them at once.
21347.descriptionEn:
In the Jungle, Variants of both
Gypceros and Congalala seem to
be on the rampage.
The Guild has prepared a special
emblem as a reward.
Please hunt them at once, and
without any delay.
21347.descriptionJp:
密林で、≪ゲリョス≫と
≪ババコンガ≫の変種が
暴れているようです。
ギルドから、特殊な
エンブレムが報酬として
用意されておりますので、
至急、狩猟をお願いします。

62534.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Canyon, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Cavern or the Voice of Nature: Cliff. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62534.descriptionEn:
I hear it. The voice of
nature. By completing this
request set in the ≪Canyon≫,
you may obtain ≪Voice of
Nature: Cavern≫ or
≪Voice of Nature: Cliff≫.
May your hunting life grow
ever richer.
62534.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪峡谷≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・岩窟≫や
≪大自然の声・断崖≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

26333.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26333.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26333.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26333.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61753.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
61753.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61753.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61753.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

50815.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50815.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50815.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50815.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

50166.description: You came at a really good time! No, perfect timing. I want you to take that thing down a peg, the one that lives in the tower like a nuisance. With your skill it is nothing, right? Just think of it as helping me and show me how amazing hunters are!
50166.descriptionEn:
You came at a great time!
Yes, perfect timing.
That thing squatting in the
Tower like a nuisance...
I want you to make it eat
its words. With your skill,
that's nothing, right?
Think of it as helping me
and show a hunter's worth!
50166.descriptionJp:
ジつに良い所に来てくれた！
いャ、実に良いタイミングだ。
塔にイやがらせのように住み
付く、アいつにひと泡吹かせ
て欲しいンだ。あなたの腕な
らなんてこトはないだろう？
ここはひとつコの私を助ける
と思ってハンターの凄さを
見せつけてくれ頼ンだよ！

61881.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61881.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61881.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

61603.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival, but you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are a little harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. Nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
61603.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival,
but you just have to have a
souvenir of the festivities!
That's you, isn't it! Why not
try accepting this quest?
But the conditions are a bit harsh,
so I don't recommend it to the
winning side.
If you fail, the item won't be
returned, so be careful!
61603.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で負けてしまった、
でもどうしても祭典の思い出
が欲しい！と思っているそこ
のアナタ！このクエストを
受注してみないか？
ただしちょっと条件が厳しい
から勝ち組の人にはオススメ
しないぜ。
失敗してもブツは返さない
から慎重にやれよな！

54437.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54437.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the ears of Yian Kut-Ku, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54437.descriptionEn:
The new G Rank Guild
Priority Request is here.
To raise awareness and use,
we have prepared this
quest. Break the Yian
Kut-Ku's ears and we will
grant special ingredients
as well.
54437.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
怪鳥の耳を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

61915.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
61915.description: You have come, hunters. How about testing your skill for a change? This time, prove to me whether you can slay a certain monster in the swamp. I have set no cheap tricks, so challenge it with confidence.
61915.descriptionEn:
Welcome, hunters.
How about a test of skill for
a change? This time, prove to
me whether you can slay a
certain monster in the Swamp.
There are no cheap tricks here,
so challenge it with confidence.
61915.descriptionJp:
よくきたな。ハンターたちよ。
たまには腕試しでもどうだ？
今回は沼地にいる、あるモン
スターを討伐できるかどうか
私に証明してもらおうか。
下手な小細工は一切していな
いから安心して挑戦してくれ。

21854.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
21854.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Flor series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21854.descriptionEn:
This quest yields craft
and upgrade materials for
all five parts of the
≪Hardcore Armor≫ Flor
series.
To accept the quest, you
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
Note that if you fail,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
consumed, so take care.
21854.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
フロルシリーズの５部位分の
生産、強化素材が入手できま
す。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21059.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト３匹の納品
21059.description: Find and deliver 6 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
21059.descriptionEn:
Please find and deliver 6 Special
Mushrooms that grow in the Jungle!
If you also deliver the ≪Royal Beetle≫,
the insect that sometimes flies
through the Jungle, I'll still pay!
Start by getting to know the Jungle,
then get used to it.
21059.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を６つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

50645.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
50645.description: Hunter who would master the heavy bowgun, show the skill you have honed against the Pariapuria on Tide Island! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
50645.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master
the Heavy Bowgun, show
your polished skill against
the ≪Baruragaru≫ of Tidal
Island! Hunt it well, and
you shall earn even more
than the usual rewards for
your daily efforts.
50645.descriptionJp:
重弩を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪呑竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61458.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one may only be taken and joined by those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants. The target this time reportedly shows properties and movements different from the usual, so take care.
61458.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
This one can only be taken
and joined by those with
the special anti-Variant
weapon equipped. The target
this time shows unusual
traits and moves, so beware.
61458.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは、対変種に適した特
殊な武器を装備した方限定の
受注、参加となっております。
今回のターゲットには、通常
とは異なる性質、動きがみら
れるそうなのでご注意を。

21209.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
21209.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21209.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21209.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

15004.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
15004.description: You who seek greater heights. To confirm your skill, hunt the monster I designate. I call it the Official Hunting Exam! This time, hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur! It is a tough foe, but I believe you will succeed!
15004.descriptionEn:
One who seeks still greater heights.
To confirm your skill, hunt the
monster we have specified here.
Thus it is named the ≪Official
Hunt Exam≫! This time, hunt the
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫!
It will be a tough foe, but I
believe you can do it!
15004.descriptionJp:
さらなる高みを目指す者よ。
オヌシの腕前を確認するべく
こちらで指定したモンスター
を狩猟してみせよ。
名づけて≪公式狩猟試験≫！
今回は≪盾蟹≫を狩猟じゃ！
難敵となるが達成を信じて
おるぞ！

55989.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55989.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55989.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

22135.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22135.description: Hunter who would master the Dragon Piercing Rod, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
22135.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Tonfa, display the skill you
have honed against the
≪Gurenzeburu≫ in the Arena!
If you succeed in the hunt,
you will gain far more rewards
than daily effort alone could
ever bring you.
22135.descriptionJp:
穿龍棍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

21599.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Deer Antler Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21599.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called Rokkaku Orb?
That material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you that precious
decoration material.
21599.descriptionJp:
鹿角原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

51078.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
51078.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Destroying the chest of a Black Gravios will also grant a special ingredient.
51078.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Black Gravios's
chest, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51078.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
黒鎧竜の胸部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

54514.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54514.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54514.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

55620.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (head), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Die (White) is required to accept the quest.
55620.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(head), except Weapon
Ribbons and Merits.
It drops one type only.
Note that accepting the
quest requires a
≪Hunter Die White≫,
so please be aware.
55620.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（頭防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターダイス白≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

50985.objectiveJp: シャガルマガラ１体の討伐

55391.description: A report has arrived that the shadow of a wyvern bearing needles was sighted. At the sign of a new Variant Species, the guild has prepared a new hunting horn for promising hunters, to stand against Variant Species. Obtain the crafting materials and prepare for the hunt!
55391.descriptionEn:
Word has reached us that the
shadow of a needle-bearing flying
wyvern was sighted.
With signs of a new Supremacy
species, the Guild has prepared
a new Hunting Horn for promising
hunters to face the Supremacy.
Gather the production materials
and prepare to slay it!
55391.descriptionJp:
針を持つ飛竜の影を目撃した
という報告が届きました。
新たな辿異種出現の兆しに、
ギルドでは有望なハンターに
向けて、辿異種に立ち向かう
ための新たな狩猟笛を用意し
ました。
生産素材を獲得して、辿異種
の討伐に備えてください！

50311.description: Surveys have shown that the caves of Tide Island go deeper still. A considerable space appears to open up within, but a black monster has been confirmed there as well. Until safety is secured, no survey can be carried out. Head for the site at once and secure it.
50311.descriptionEn:
Surveys show the caves of the
Tidal Island go even deeper.
A rather large space seems to
open within, but the form of a
black monster has been sighted
there as well.
Until safety is secured, no
survey can proceed.
Please head to the site at once
and secure the area.
50311.descriptionJp:
調査により、潮島の洞窟には、
更に奥があることが分かり
ました。かなり大きな空間が
広がっているようですが、
黒色のモンスターの姿も
同時に確認されています。
安全が確保されるまで、
調査が行えません。
至急、現地へ向かい安全の
確保をお願いします。

61105.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61105.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61105.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

55510.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55510.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55510.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく討究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

21257.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の討伐
21257.description: A particularly powerful Gendrome is said to go out of its way to attack hunters. For rookie hunters it looks like a very tough opponent to slay, but the reward rises to match.
21257.descriptionEn:
A particularly powerful
≪Gendrome≫ has been known
to go out of its way to
attack hunters.
For rookie hunters it makes
an extremely tough target,
but the reward will be all
the bigger for it.
21257.descriptionJp:
≪ドスゲネポス≫のとりわけ
強力な個体が、ことさらにハ
ンターたちを襲ってくること
があるそうです。
新米のハンターさんたちの討
伐相手としては、非常に手強
い相手になりそうですが、そ
の分報酬ははずみますよ。

62053.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・収を１個納品

54674.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
54674.description: Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we've prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them further. By breaking the Forokururu's head, special ingredients will also be granted to you.
54674.descriptionEn:
Regarding the G Rank Guild Priority
Requests, we've prepared this quest
to raise awareness and promote
them further.
By breaking the Toa Tesukatora's
head, special ingredients
will also be granted to you.
54674.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
華鳳鳥の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

21185.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21185.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21185.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21185.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

21769.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
21769.description: To the hunters based in Dundorma, I who continue the supreme hunt will give you valuable information. The whereabouts of the proud lone wolf, the black wolf bird Yian Garuga, just like me!! An ultra savage foe! Will you try?
21769.descriptionEn:
To the Hunters based in the
city of Dundorma, I who have
kept up the finest hunting
will give you some precious
info. It's the whereabouts of
the proud lone wolf ≪Yian
Garuga≫! A savage foe!
Will you take it on?
21769.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマの街を拠点にして
る狩人たちへ、至高の狩りを
続けるこのオレが貴重な情報
を与えてやろう。
オレと同じく誇り高き一匹狼
黒狼鳥≪イャンガルルガ≫の
居場所だ！！超凶暴な相手だ
ぞ！挑んでみるか？

60679.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Giaorugu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60679.descriptionEn:
A hunters' tournament where
skills are put to the test!
Today's target is ≪Giaorugu≫!
To hunt a monster all alone
shows true spirit, truly
admirable! Best yourself
and take a top placing!
Supremacy weapons only
this time!
60679.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ギアオルグ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

28025.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟

62928.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62928.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62928.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
