54219.descriptionJp:
沼地に潜む桃毛獣の調査を
お願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
桃毛獣の頭部や
爪を見事破壊してくれたら、
報酬を上乗せしちゃいますよ！

61728.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61728.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61728.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

26446.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! This time we hold an exercise with a full loan of equipment! The targets are the bird wyverns of each region. I've prepared quite powerful equipment for hunters who are still inexperienced, so even if the weapon is unfamiliar, do your best!
26446.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
This time we hold an exercise
with a full set of loaned gear!
Your prey is the Bird Wyverns
of every region. I've prepared
quite powerful equipment for Hunters
still short on experience, so even
if the weapon is new, give it your all!
26446.descriptionJp:
うむ！我輩だ！教官だ！
今回は全装備を貸し出しての
演習を行う！
狩猟の対象は各地の鳥竜だ。
まだ経験が浅いハンターに
とってはかなり強力な装備を
用意したので、慣れない武器
だったとしても頑張るんだぞ！

62020.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62020.description: Oh? Noticing me makes you quite a hunter, mya. They're apparently handing out Porta Candy now, mya. I want to try some too, so give me one, mya. In return I'll give you lots of what looks like the raw ingredient, mya!
62020.descriptionEn:
Oh?
Noticing me makes you quite
a fine hunter, mya~.
They say ≪Porta Candy≫ is
being handed out, mya.
I want to try some too,
so give me one, mya~.
In return I'll give you lots
of its ingredients, mya~!
62020.descriptionJp:
お？
オイラに気づくとは、なかな
か見上げたハンターだミャ〜。
いま≪ポルタキャンディ≫を
配っているらしいミャ。
オイラも食べてみたいから
１つくださいミャ〜。
お礼にその原材料っぽいのを
たくさんあげるミャ〜！

50204.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の討伐
50204.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50204.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50204.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

50725.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and the guild will present you with rare Conquest species materials.
50725.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
request and rewards exclusively
for those in a guild on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival. Please bring your
proof of the festival when you
accept or join.
Clear this request and the guild
will present you with rare
Zenith materials.
50725.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
今回の依頼を達成いただけれ
ば、ギルドより覇種の希少素
材を贈呈いたします。

50669.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
50669.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Diore series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50669.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the crafting and upgrade
materials for one part of
the ≪Hardcore Armor≫
Diore Series.
To accept the quest you will
need a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
50669.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
ディオレシリーズの１部位分
の生産、強化素材が入手でき
ます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61908.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐

50188.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Gougarufu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50188.descriptionEn:
An emergency request! We
seek someone to slay a most
powerful ≪Gogomoa≫.
If you can hunt it well,
we will issue more slaying
proofs than usual. Please
answer the call!
50188.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ゴウガルフ≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に狩猟
できましたら、普段よりも
多めに討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

60433.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種２頭の狩猟
60433.description: Monsters vary as individuals. The Khezu is a particularly special case among them, so this sort of individual is comparatively easy to come across... Hunters who cannot quite follow all this, well, hunt one anyway and you will have something to talk about.
60433.descriptionEn:
Monsters differ one from another.
Khezu are an especially peculiar
lot even among them, so
individuals like this turn up
rather often...
Hunters who can't follow all
this talk, well, just hunt one
for the sake of a story.
60433.descriptionJp:
モンスターには個体差がある。
フルフルはその中でも、とり
わけ特殊な部類に入るため、
比較的このような個体が見ら
れやすい･･･。
話がよく見えないハンター諸
君は、まあ、とりあえず話の
種に一つ狩ってきたまえよ。

56088.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Elegant Elder Dragon. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56088.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay
the Supremacy Inagami.
If you destroy its developed
parts in this quest, I will
add developed part materials
to your Another rewards as
a special gift.
Note that slaying alone gives none.
56088.descriptionJp:
辿異種の雅翁龍を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

21171.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21171.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21171.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

53203.description: A hunter thinking of changing out of the Hope series. How about the Kalais series, available from this request? It combines a vivid look with performance, truly a set that has both beauty and brains.
53203.descriptionEn:
Hunter, thinking of changing
out of your ≪Hope Series≫
armor?
How about the ≪Karais
Series≫ armor you can get
from this request?
It boasts both vivid looks and
solid performance, truly a
piece with beauty and brains.
53203.descriptionJp:
防具≪ホープシリーズ≫から
着替えたいと考えているハン
ターさん。
この依頼で入手可能な防具
≪カライスシリーズ≫はどう
ですか？
鮮やかな見た目と性能を兼ね
備えた、まさしく才色兼備な
防具ですよ。

60541.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の討伐
60541.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blue Yian Kut-Ku! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60541.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament
where hunters test their
skill! Today's target is
Blue Yian Kut-Ku!
Taking a monster on all
alone is truly a feat!
Overcome yourself and
claim a top placement!
SP weapons only this time!
60541.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪イャンクック亜種≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

62571.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62571.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62571.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

50056.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
50056.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50056.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50056.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

50433.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

23531.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
23531.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Toridokuresu, the Shining Thunder Bird. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23531.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Thunderbird ≪Toridokuresu≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.
23531.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、照雷鳥
≪トリドクレス≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

23682.description: Hunter who would master the Dual Blades, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
23682.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Dual Blades, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!
23682.descriptionJp:
双剣を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61348.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61348.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61348.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

26594.objectiveJp: ぼろぼろの図面５枚の納品
26594.description: It has been stolen, nya! That drawing, that drawing was stolen, nya! I stayed up all night drawing it for Gooc, and it was stolen, nya! The culprit is a Melynx in the jungle. The drawing may be in pieces, nya, but I want you to get it back, nya. If you do, I will restore it somehow, nya!
26594.descriptionEn:
Stolen again, nya! My
blueprints, stolen, nya!
I wrote them all night for
Gook, and they were stolen!
The culprit is a Jungle
Melynx. The blueprints may
be torn to bits, nya, but
bring them back. Then I'll
restore them somehow, nya!
26594.descriptionJp:
盗まれたニャ！あの図面を、
あの図面を盗まれたニャ！
グークのために徹夜で書いた
のに盗まれたニャ！犯人は
密林のメラルーニャ。図面は
バラバラになってるかもしれ
ニャいけど、取り戻してきて
ほしいニャ。そうすれば、
何とか復元してみせるニャ！

63412.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
63412.description: In gratitude to those who have contributed to the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request. This request yields one item chosen from among all the Festival Echoes distributed in the past. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
63412.descriptionEn:
In gratitude to all who
support the Hunter Festival,
we made a special request.
This request gives you one
of any ≪Festival Resonance≫
distributed in the past.
To accept or join it,
please bring a Festival
Proof with you.
63412.descriptionJp:
狩人祭に貢献して頂いている
方に感謝の意を込め、特別に
依頼を用意させて頂きました。
今回の依頼は過去にお配り
した全ての≪祭の響想≫の
中から、いずれかが手に入る
内容となっております。
受注、または参加する際には、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

54194.description: For the survey, I want you to hunt a Giaorugu. This time I want the hunt carried out with the horns and tail broken. Does it not thrill you, to think this brings the ecological survey of Giaorugu one step further? Then, I leave it to you.
54194.descriptionEn:
I want you to hunt a Giaorugu
for our survey. This time
I want the hunt done with
its horns and tail already
broken. Doesn't it excite you
to think this advances our
study of Giaorugu ecology?
54194.descriptionJp:
調査のためにギアオルグを
狩猟して欲しい。今回は角と
尻尾を破壊した状態で狩猟を
行なって欲しい。これで一歩
ギアオルグの生態調査が進む
と考えると興奮するだろ？
それじゃ、よろしく頼んだよ。

55705.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55705.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Blangonga through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Great Sword, Switch Axe, Tonfa, Light Bowgun, Heavy Bowgun, or Bow. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55705.descriptionEn:
From a Supremacy Blangonga you
can get the materials for one
Supremacy weapon's crafting
and first-stage upgrade, plus
Gz worth of Porta Card Sakura.
The weapon types you can
forge are Great Sword, Switch
Axe, Tonfa, Light Bowgun,
Heavy Bowgun and Bow.
Use this to forge and upgrade.
55705.descriptionJp:
辿異種ドドブランゴの
辿異武器１つの生産から
１段階目の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、大剣、剣斧、
穿龍棍、軽弩、重弩、弓の
いずれかです。お好みの武器
の生産・強化にぜひご活用
ください。

50887.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, an Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, was newly observed in the Snowy Mountains. According to hunters who faced it, it unleashes attacks using ice. Please take the greatest care not to neglect your preparations.
50887.descriptionEn:
With the appearance of the
Transcendent species, surveys
have been pushed across the land,
and a Barioth, the Ice Fang Wyvern,
has now been sighted in the
Snowy Mountains. Hunters who faced
it report it unleashes ice attacks.
Please do not neglect your preparations.
50887.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、雪山に
氷牙竜・ベリオロスが新たに
観測されました。対峙した
ハンターの情報によると、
氷を使った攻撃を繰り出して
くるとのこと。準備を怠らぬ
ようくれぐれもご注意下さい。

50021.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
50021.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
50021.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
50021.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

62224.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62224.description: I am gathering pebbles for divination, but monsters keep attacking and I make no progress. So I want you to draw the monsters away. If I can gather a great many, I will give you some as a reward, so please help.
62224.descriptionEn:
I've been gathering the pebbles
used for fortune-telling, but
monsters attack me and I get nowhere.
So I'd like you to keep the
monsters busy and distracted.
If I can gather a good amount,
I'll give you a reward for it,
so please, I beg of you.
62224.descriptionJp:
占いに使う石ころを集めてい
るのですが、モンスターに
襲われ、中々はかどりません。
そこでモンスター達を引きつ
けておいて欲しいんです。
たくさん集めることができた
ら報酬として差し上げますか
ら、どうかお願いします。

1028.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
1028.description: So a subspecies of the already rare Monoblos has appeared, has it. For all its noble and beautiful looks, in ferocity it likely surpasses the original! Prepare yourself and take up the hunt!
1028.descriptionEn:
A white one-horned wyvern, and
a rare Monoblos subspecies at
that, has appeared.
For all its noble beauty,
its ferocity likely surpasses
the original species! Steel
yourself and take up the hunt!
1028.descriptionJp:
白き一角竜とはこれまた希少
性の高いモノブロスの亜種が
現れたようじゃな。
その気高くも美しき容姿とは
裏腹に獰猛さにおいては原種
を上回るほどじゃろう！
心して狩猟に挑むがよい！

21024.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
21024.description: The Ioprey are loudly active, which means there is a high chance the leader, Iodrome, is around! Take that poison liquid head on and you could lose your life! Do not forget antidote items!
21024.descriptionEn:
The fact that the Genprey are
stirring so actively means there
is a very good chance their
leader, the Gendrome, is nearby!
Taking that poison head-on could
cost you your life! Do not forget
your antidote items!
21024.descriptionJp:
イーオスたちが活発に騒いで
いるってことは、親玉の≪ド
スイーオス≫がいる可能性が
高いです！あの毒液をまとも
に受けてしまうと、命を落と
しかねません！解毒系アイテ
ムを忘れないでくださいね！

21093.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス２頭の狩猟
21093.description: The boss of the Genprey packs in the desert, Dos-Genprey, is marked by a body a size larger and by sharp claws. If hunting Dos-Genprey feels difficult, put a Cactus Flower in a Maka Pickling Jar and deliver a Hundred-Flower Cactus.
21093.descriptionEn:
The Ioprey that swarm the Desert
are led by the ≪Iodrome≫, marked
by its larger body and sharp claws.
If hunting the Iodrome seems
hard, put a ≪Cactus Flower≫ into
a ≪Maca Pickling Pot≫ and
deliver a ≪Hundred-Flower Cactus≫.
21093.descriptionJp:
砂漠に群れるゲネポスの親玉
≪ドスゲネポス≫は、一回り
大きな体に鋭い爪が目印よ。
ドスゲネポスの狩猟が困難に
感じるなら≪マカ漬けの壷≫
に≪サボテンの花≫を入れて
≪百花サボテン≫の納品を。

50181.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
50181.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50181.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50181.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

23360.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
23360.description: A request where you can obtain the materials needed to craft and strengthen the torso armor of the Glen G Series and Glen GF Series. Clear this request, advance the Hunter Navi and collect rewards while aiming to obtain 10 Glen Sword Jewels GF.
23360.descriptionEn:
This request lets you obtain
the materials needed to craft
and upgrade the chest armor
of the Guren G and Guren GF
series. Clear this request,
advance Hunter Navi, and
collect your rewards as you
aim for 10 ≪Guren Sword
Jewel GF≫.
23360.descriptionJp:
「グレンＧシリーズ」、「グ
レンGFシリーズ」の胴防具を
生産・強化するために必要
な素材が入手できる依頼です。
この依頼を達成し、ハンター
ナビを進め、報酬を受け取り
ながら、「グレン剣珠GF」
１０個の入手を目指して
ください。

23398.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
23398.description: There has been a sighting of an Espinas Subspecies in the Canyon. Please hunt the target before damage occurs. Take particular care of its especially fierce charging attack!
23398.descriptionEn:
There has been a sighting of
≪Espinas Subspecies≫ in the
Canyon. Please hunt the target
before harm is done.
Take special care against its
fierce charging attacks!
23398.descriptionJp:
峡谷で≪エスピナス亜種≫
の目撃報告がありました。
被害が出る前に対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
特に強烈な突進攻撃には
注意してください！

50016.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

23602.description: A report has come from an investigator that the moon peering from the farthest land shortens day by day the cycle in which it turns crimson, and deepens that crimson. The Guild takes this as an omen of ill things to come and has decided to send outstanding hunters. Please depart for the site at once.
23602.descriptionEn:
The moon that peers from the far
ends of the earth reddens, its
crimson cycle growing shorter
day by day and its redness
deepening, a researcher reports.
The Guild takes this as an omen
that ill fortune will come, and
has decided to send skilled
hunters.
Depart for the site at once.
23602.descriptionJp:
最果ての地より覗く月が、
紅く染まる周期を日に日に
短くし、その紅さを強めてい
るとの報告が調査員より
届きました。
ギルドは、これを不吉な事が
起こる前兆と捉え、優れた
ハンターを向かわせることを
決定しました。
至急、現地へ出発して下さい。

40175.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
40175.description: Reports are coming in one after another of a powerful storm arising in the distant southern sky. There are also reports that it is moving toward Mezepolta Plaza, so hunters, please investigate.
40175.descriptionEn:
Reports are coming in one after
another that a powerful storm has
arisen in the far southern skies.
There are also reports that it has
moved to Mezepolta Plaza, so all
hunters, please investigate.
Please take care out there.
40175.descriptionJp:
遠き南の空にて強力な嵐が
発生しているとの報告が
相次いでいます。
メゼポルタ広場に移動して
きているとの報告もあるよう
なので、ハンターのみなさん
は、調査をお願いします。

60589.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の討伐
60589.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas Subspecies. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin and Transcendent weapons only!
60589.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is
≪Espinas Subspecies≫!
Work with your Guild mates
and achieve the objective.
Teamwork is what counts in
this contest, so aim for a
top placing!
Origin & Migrant weapons only!
60589.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪エスピナス亜種≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は始種・遷悠武器限定
で開催されているぞ！

21212.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21212.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21212.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21212.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

61757.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61757.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61757.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

61463.description: As for the Great Hunt on Solitude Island, that gigantic monster called Raviente seems to lie silent on one of the islands. We will form a survey party open only to hunters who took part in the Great Hunt, so the survey will be brief, but please join.
61463.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Great Hunt on
the ≪Isolated Island≫: the
colossal monster known as
the ≪Raviente≫ appears to
lie silent on one island.
We are forming a survey
team open only to hunters
who took part, so please do
join us for a short survey.
61463.descriptionJp:
≪絶島≫で行われた大討伐の
結果ですが、≪大巌竜≫と呼
ばれたあの巨大なモンスター
は島のひとつで沈黙している
ようです。大討伐に参加した
ハンター限定の調査団を編成
することとなりましたので、
短時間の調査となってしまい
ますが、是非ご参加ください。

50792.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50792.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a Brown Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
50792.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority
Requests we have long carried
out, we have prepared this quest
to further spread awareness and
promote them.
Breaking the Espinas
Subspecies's horn will also grant
special ingredients.
50792.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
棘茶竜の角を破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

54927.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54927.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54927.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

50144.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★５ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50144.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to get
the materials needed for
G★5 monster G Rank armor
upgrades! Note that G Rank
materials are not included,
so gather those elsewhere.
50144.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成してもらえ
れば、Ｇ★５モンスターの
Ｇ級防具強化に必要な素材
を入手できるぞ！ただし、
Ｇ級素材は入手できないか
ら、他の依頼で集めてくれ。

26169.description: Iron Ore is needed for one thing or another when preparing equipment. Have you ever found yourself saying, ah, not enough, at the worst possible moment? On this quest, those who complete the main target will receive at least 7 Iron Ore!
26169.descriptionEn:
Iron Ore is always needed for
putting your gear together.
Have you ever found yourself
short of it right when you
need it most?
In this quest, everyone who
clears the main target will
receive at least 7 Iron Ore
from us!
26169.descriptionJp:
装備を調えるには、
何かと必要な鉄鉱石。
いざ、という時に
「あ！足りない！」なんてこ
と、よくありませんか？
このクエストでは、
メインターゲットを達成され
た方に、最低でも７つの
鉄鉱石を進呈しますよ！

55852.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55852.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a wing break and a tail cut in slaying Doragyurosu, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55852.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Doragyurosu≫ and break its
wings and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55852.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪冥雷竜≫討伐にて
翼破壊と尻尾切断を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

50359.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50359.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Rajang will also grant a special ingredient.
50359.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Rajang's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50359.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
金獅子の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

62412.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62412.description: Our interception posture against the exceptionally powerful Rukodiora now closing on the interception base is ready. We have prepared ample supplies and interception weapons, so though this is an extremely dangerous request, any hunter able to prove their skill should head out and slay it.
62412.descriptionEn:
Preparations are complete to
intercept the extremely strong
individual ≪Rukodiora≫ that is
now closing on the ≪Base≫.
We have prepared ample supplies
and interception weapons, so
anyone able to prove their skill
should head out and slay it.
62412.descriptionJp:
現在≪迎撃拠点≫に迫ってい
る≪ルコディオラ≫の極めて
強力な個体に対する迎撃態勢
が整いました。十分な支給品、
迎撃兵器を用意いたしました
ので、極めて危険な依頼です
が、自分の腕を証明できる方
は討伐に向かってください。

62841.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
62841.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
62841.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!
62841.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
のだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

56079.description: A chance to get Zenith weapons prepared by the Guild! Requirement is ＧＲ２００! Deal a set amount of damage to the target for five materials, and break the specified part for five more!
56079.descriptionEn:
A chance to obtain Supremacy
weapons prepared by the Guild!
Requirement: GR 200!
Deal a set amount of damage to
the target for 5 materials, and
break the specified parts for
5 more of each!
56079.descriptionJp:
ギルドで準備した辿異武器を
入手するチャンス！
参加条件はＧＲ２００！
ターゲットに一定ダメージを
与えることで素材を５個、
指定の部位を破壊することで
さらに５個ずつプレゼント！

61142.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. The reward is a certain material that proves you an angler. Show me the fruits of all your work so far! Since fishing is the aim, absolutely do not hunt the Plesioth Subspecies this time either!
61142.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. The
reward is a certain material that
proves you are an angler.
Show me the sum of all your skill!
Fishing is the goal, so this time
you must not slay the Green Plesioth!
61142.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。報酬は、
釣師の証になる、ある素材だ。
今までの集大成を見せてくれ！
釣りが目的だから、ガノトト
ス亜種は今回も絶対に狩らな
いように！

26357.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26357.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26357.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、下位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

62633.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62633.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62633.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62633.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

63051.description: It is getting dark and my Gook has not come back from its walk. I am worried, so go and check on it in my place. I have a good idea of the places the Gook likes to go. As thanks, I will give you the pattern for the clothes I meant to dress my Gook in.
63051.descriptionEn:
It's getting dark, and Gook
still hasn't come back from
its walk. I'm worried, so
please go and check on it
for me. I have a good idea
of where Gook might go.
As thanks, I'll give you the
pattern for the clothes I
meant to dress my Gook in.
63051.descriptionJp:
日が暮れるのに、グークが
散歩から帰ってこないの。
心配だから私の代わりに
様子を見てきてちょうだい。
グークが行きそうな場所の
目星は大体ついてるわ。
お礼に、私のグークに
着せるつもりだった
服の型紙をあげるわ。

55738.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55738.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Gasurabazura. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55738.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Gasurabazura≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
55738.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ガスラバズラ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55801.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55801.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55801.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
55801.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

63191.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63191.description: As part of a monster survey, I ask you to hunt the Bulldrome in the New Great Arena. It is extremely powerful and behaves in ways normally unthinkable, so this is a quite dangerous request, but if the surveyors obtain satisfactory results you should earn high standing from the Guild.
63191.descriptionEn:
As part of our monster survey, we
ask you to hunt the ≪Bulldrome≫
in the New Great Arena.
It is extremely powerful and acts
in ways normally unthinkable, so
this is a quite dangerous request,
but if you achieve a result that
satisfies the survey team, you
should earn high praise from
the Guild.
63191.descriptionJp:
モンスター調査の一環として
新大闘技場にいる≪大猪≫
の狩猟をお願いします。
非常に強力で通常では考えら
れない行動を取るため、
かなり危険な依頼となります
が、調査員が満足できる
結果を得られたならば、
ギルドから高い評価を得られ
るはずです。

55794.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
55794.description: If you can hunt Toridokuresu too, your aptitude is sufficient. But the next opponent is tough. Slay Gureadomosu and I will recognize you as full-fledged! Hunting a huge monster is where the Magnetic Slash Hammer shines. Leap in with magnetism and breaking high parts should be easy!
55794.descriptionEn:
If you could hunt Toridcless
too, your talent is ample.
But the next foe is tough.
Slay a Gureadomosu and I'll
acknowledge you as a full hunter!
Hunting giant monsters is
where Magnet Spike users shine.
Leap in with magnetism and
high part breaks come easy!
55794.descriptionJp:
トリドクレスも狩猟できたの
なら素質は充分だ。
だが次の相手は手強いぞ。
グレアドモスを討伐できれば、
一人前と認めてやろう！
巨大なモンスターの狩猟こそ
磁斬鎚使いの腕の見せ所。
磁力で飛び込めば、高い位置
の部位破壊もたやすいはずだ！

61817.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 5 minutes. With some exceptions, the target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from the clear reward.
61817.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The time limit is 5 minutes.
With some exceptions, the target
monster's materials cannot be
obtained by carving or from the
clear reward.
61817.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選用
クエストです。
制限時間は５分以内です。
一部を除き、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

22117.description: A request for hunters who possess Zerureusu Tenran weapons. By repeatedly driving off the mysterious monster that appeared in the Old Tower, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen Haku weapons.
22117.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪Heavenly Storm≫ weapon of
the ≪Zerureusu≫.
By repeatedly repelling the
mysterious monster in the
Ancient Tower, you obtain
≪Supremacy Weapon≫ material.
22117.descriptionJp:
≪輝界竜≫の≪天嵐武器≫を
所持しているハンター向けの
依頼です。
古塔に現れた謎のモンスター
を繰り返し撃退することで、
≪覇種武器≫の強化に必要な
素材が入手できます。

54256.description: This is a report from a surveyor who went to the unsurveyed part of the Jungle. When they went to the waterside at night, they felt a gaze from the bottom of the water and fled in a panic. Many creatures live in the area, so unease is spreading among the surveyors. Head there and begin the survey.
54256.descriptionEn:
This is a report from the
surveyors working the unexplored
part of the Jungle.
At night, by the water, they
felt a gaze from the bottom of
the water and fled in a panic.
Many creatures live in the area,
so unease is spreading.
Head to the site and begin
the survey.
54256.descriptionJp:
密林の未調査地域へ行ってい
る調査員からの報告です。
夜に水辺へ行った時、水の底
から視線を感じ慌てて逃げ
帰ったということです。
付近は多くの生物が生息
しているため、調査員達に
不安が広がっています。
現地へ向かい調査を
開始してください。

62771.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の捕獲

21736.description: The unidentified monster found deep in the bamboo grove is, according to old documents left in this region, highly likely to be an Elder Dragon called the Elegant Elder Wyvern. If it is an Elder Dragon, the survey will be dangerous. Prepare fully before heading there.
21736.descriptionEn:
The monster found deep in the
bamboo forest is unidentified,
but old documents left in this
region suggest it is very likely
an elder dragon called the
Venerable Elder Dragon.
If it is indeed an elder dragon,
the survey will be dangerous.
Prepare fully before you head
to the site.
21736.descriptionJp:
竹林奥部で発見された、
未確認のモンスターですが、
この地域に残されている
古い文献から≪雅翁龍≫と
呼ばれる古龍種である
可能性が高いということです。
もし古龍種であるならば、
危険な調査となります。
万全の準備を整えてから
現地へ向かってください。

1080.description: Chameleos is an existence considered heretical even among elder dragons. Its very existence is rarely confirmed. Do not think of impossible things like capture; repel it repeatedly to wear down its health! Slay it in the end!
1080.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
Its very existence is rarely
confirmed at all.
Do not think of impossible things
like capture — repel it again and
again to wear down its strength!
Slay it after a long, drawn-out
fight!
1080.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在じゃ。
存在そのものすら滅多に確認
されることが無いほどじゃ。
捕獲など無理なことは考えず
撃退をくり返し体力を削る！
長ぎ末に討伐するのじゃ！

55416.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55416.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55416.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

26516.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種２頭の狩猟
26516.description: A rare report has come in that Rathian are descending on the desert one after another! Hunting the queen, a tough foe even alone, again and again will be quite difficult! Those confident in their skill, and those who need Rathian materials, sign up!
26516.descriptionEn:
An unusual report has come in:
Rathians are descending on the
Desert one after another!
Hunting these queens, each one
a formidable foe, back to back
will be quite a challenge!
Those confident in their skill, and
those needing Rathian parts, join in!!
26516.descriptionJp:
砂漠地帯にリオレイアが次々
と舞い降りていると、珍しい
報告が入りました！１頭でも
難敵となる女王を連続で狩猟
することは、かなりの困難と
なるでしょう！腕に自信のあ
る方や、レイアの素材が必要
な方もふるってご参加を！！

62086.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
62086.description: The bond of a mated pair is truly precious. By each making up for what the other lacks, new value is born. Go and hunt the female monster I found. Let us take the female's tenacity and endurance as our reference and create a pink material.
62086.descriptionEn:
The bond of a mated pair is truly
precious. By covering each other's
shortcomings, new value is born.
Go and hunt the female monster
I have found. Let us use the
female's tenacity and patience to
create a pink material,
shall we.
62086.descriptionJp:
メオトの絆は実に尊きもの。
互いの不足を補い合うことで、
新たな価値が生まれましょう。
私が見つけたメスモンスター
を狩猟してくるのです。
メスの執念と忍耐力を参考に、
桃色の素材を作り出して
みせようではありませんか。

54901.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種２頭の討伐

62672.description: Among the newly discovered savage wyvern Abiorugu in the Jungle, an extremely ferocious and powerful individual has appeared. As it is very dangerous, this is a survey and hunting request limited to hunters we approve of. Face it fully prepared.
62672.descriptionEn:
Among the ≪Abiorugu≫ newly
found in the Jungle, an utterly
savage and powerful individual
has appeared.
As it is very dangerous, this
survey is limited to Hunters we
approve of. Please go in with
everything prepared.
62672.descriptionJp:
密林で新たに発見された
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫の中でも
極めて狂暴で、強力な個体が
現れたそうです。
大変危険なため我々が認める
ハンターさん限定での調査、
狩猟依頼となります。
万全の態勢で挑んでください。

50108.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50108.description: Do you have enough zenny? In this job, you can earn materials that sell for a high price. The job is also reputed to be relatively easy. However, note that you cannot accept it consecutively.
50108.descriptionEn:
Do you have enough Zenny?
With the request we present today,
you can earn materials that sell
for a high price as your reward.
Word is that the request itself
is also fairly easy to complete.
However, you cannot accept it
several times in a row,
so please be careful.
50108.descriptionJp:
ゼニーは足りていますか？
本日ご紹介するこの依頼では、
高額で売却できる素材を報酬
として獲得できますよ。
依頼内容も、比較的楽に
達成できると評判です。
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

23576.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23576.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23576.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55212.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Monoblos while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55212.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest where
slaying a Monoblos
raises your standing while
letting you obtain, at a bargain,
the materials needed for G Rank
decorations.
Please make good use of it.
55212.descriptionJp:
モノブロスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

50434.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

54533.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
54533.description: We are continuing our survey of the Poborubarumu. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
54533.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
Poborubarumu.
Breaking parts is not
required, but if you do,
we would be delighted!
Hunters all, please lend
us your aid!
54533.descriptionJp:
ポボルバルムの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

54804.description: 2 unidentified monsters of great power are on a rampage together at the Ancient Tower. Head out to slay them at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Secret Art armor, in preparation for greater threats.
54804.descriptionEn:
Two unidentified monsters of
great power are on a rampage
at the Ancient Tower at once.
Please head out and slay them
as fast as you can!
If you save us from this crisis,
we will provide materials used
for some G Rank Secret Art
Armor, in preparation for worse.
54804.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが２頭同時に暴れ
まわっています。
一刻も早く討伐に向かって
ください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級秘伝防具に使用す
る素材を提供いたします。

54948.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
54948.description: We present a request that lets you obtain some of the materials needed to upgrade the Ballista Rock Wyvern's Ｇ-rank gear, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
54948.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
how many you can accept,
but this request yields some
of the materials needed to
upgrade Odibatorasu
G Rank gear. Don't miss out!
54948.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、弩岩竜のＧ級
武具の強化に必要な素材の一
部を入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。この機会を逃さぬよ
うご注意ください。

26537.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, as exploration has confirmed it safe, we are opening the Volcano depths, the lava pool area! Gather to your heart's content!
26537.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
≪Extra Quest≫ is brought to you
by the Popular Tavern Guild.
This time, as our survey confirmed
it is safe, we are opening the
Volcano Depths and the lava pool area!
Please go and gather to your
heart's content!
26537.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は探索の結果、安全が
確認されたため、火山奥地、
溶岩池部分を開放します！
思う存分採取してきちゃって
ください！

21933.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
21933.description: Have you heard of the Coral Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21933.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called Sango Orb?
That material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you that precious
decoration material.
21933.descriptionJp:
珊瑚原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

50405.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21658.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Achimo Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21658.descriptionEn:
The lost memos that record the
secret of forging weapons are
apparently turning up on
monsters slain all over!
Once you get the Achimo Memo,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work!
21658.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪アチモメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

20022.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の討伐
20022.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau warns that a suspicious dragon is approaching the city! Make use of the interception base's weapons and slay the mysterious giant dragon completely! Please!
20022.descriptionEn:
The Elder Dragon Forecast Post
reports that a suspicious dragon
is approaching the town! Use the
weapons at the Base to slay the
mysterious giant dragon
completely! Please!
20022.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より、怪しげな龍
が街に接近しているとの知ら
せが入りました！迎撃拠点の
兵器を活用し、謎の巨大龍を
完全に討伐して下さい！
お願いします！

53267.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53267.description: The Snow Memory prototype is complete, they say! They are holding a trial event for it, so let us go! I wonder how it looks. I am so excited! The center? Is it doing a cute pose? Hehe!
53267.descriptionEn:
The Snow Memory prototype
is finished, they say!
To mark it, they're holding
a trial session, so let's
go and join in!
I wonder how it turned out.
I'm so looking forward to it!
Is it center? Is it doing
a cute pose? Hehehe♪
53267.descriptionJp:
スノーメモリーの試作品が
完成したそうです！
記念に試作品のお試し会を開
催するとのことなので、参加
しにいきましょう！
わたしどんな風になっている
のかな。すごく楽しみ！
センターかな？可愛いポーズ
とかしてるのかな？ふふふ♪

60936.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種３頭の狩猟
60936.description: A rare report has come in that Rathian are descending on the desert one after another! Hunting the queen, a tough foe even alone, again and again will be quite difficult! Those confident in their skill, and those who need Rathian materials, sign up!
60936.descriptionEn:
An unusual report has come in:
Rathians are descending on the
Desert one after another!
Hunting these queens, each one
a formidable foe, back to back
will be quite a challenge!
Those confident in their skill, and
those needing Rathian parts, join in!!
60936.descriptionJp:
砂漠地帯にリオレイアが次々
と舞い降りていると、珍しい
報告が入りました！１頭でも
難敵となる女王を連続で狩猟
することは、かなりの困難と
なるでしょう！腕に自信のあ
る方や、レイアの素材が必要
な方もふるってご参加を！！

54494.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
54494.description: Signs of burnt trees have been found in the swamp. It may be a monster feeding or a threat display toward rivals. The swamp is now one of our important survey targets, so please eliminate this threat.
54494.descriptionEn:
Signs of burnt trees have been
found in the Swamp.
It may be a monster feeding, or
threat displays toward rivals.
The Swamp is now one of our
most important survey sites, so
please remove this threat.
54494.descriptionJp:
沼地で一部の木が焼けた跡が
見つかりました。モンスター
の捕食か外敵への威嚇行動の
可能性があります。
現在、沼地は重要な調査対象
のひとつとなっていますので、
この脅威の排除をお願いいた
します。

21407.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
21407.description: Skill Cuff materials? You asked before and I made some. Eh, you want more? Hmm, I am a bit busy now, but if you do my job I can give you the leftovers from the ones I made before. There might not be any, but I will look while you are gone.
21407.descriptionEn:
Materials for a Skill Cuff? You
asked me before, so I made a few.
Eh, you want another one? Hmm,
I'm a bit busy right now, but if
you take care of a request of
mine, I could make one from what
is left over from last time.
There might not be any left, but
I'll look while I'm out there.
21407.descriptionJp:
スキルカフの素材？前に依頼
されていくつか作ったよ。
え、また作ってほしいって？
んー、今ちょっと忙しいんだ
が、俺の依頼をこなしてくれ
たら、前に作ったやつの残り
でよければやってもいいぞ。
もしかしたら無いかもしれん
が行ってる間に探しておくよ。

21535.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21535.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21535.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

51101.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
51101.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Female Roaring Wolf will also grant a special ingredient.
51101.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the female Orugaron's
head, we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51101.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
雌響狼の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

21954.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
21954.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ７１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Kuarusepusu. I am counting on you!
21954.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 71.
So I've got a favor to ask.
How about a full set of
weapon materials as pay?
It's an easy job. Just run
over and slay a Kuarlusepusu
for me. That's all.
I'm counting on you!
21954.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ７１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってクアルセプスを討
伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

50583.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and you will obtain rare materials useful in the hunt.
50583.descriptionEn:
A special request and
rewards for members of a
winning Hunter Festival
guild. When accepting or
joining, bring a Festival
Proof. Clear this request
to obtain rare materials
useful for hunting.
50583.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
この依頼を達成すれば、
狩りに役立つ希少素材を
手に入れることができます。

50534.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
50534.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50534.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50534.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

60448.objectiveJp: 特産キノコキムチ１個の納品
60448.description: Steady, patient gathering is the first step to success in the hunt. So that you never forget that beginner's spirit, the guild has prepared this quest. Like the Patience Seed you receive as a reward, keep at it quietly until the day your flower blooms.
60448.descriptionEn:
Hunting, too, starts with steady
and honest gathering.
So that you never forget that
beginner's spirit, our Guild
prepared this quest.
Following the reward ≪Seed of
Patience≫, let us work steadily
until the day the flower blooms.
60448.descriptionJp:
狩りも、地道で堅実な採取が
成功への第一歩。
そんな初心を忘れないために
当ギルドが用意したクエスト
がこのクエストです。
報酬の≪忍耐の種≫に倣って
花が咲くその日まで、コツコ
ツとがんばっていきましょう。

50150.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50150.description: Black lightning has been observed over a wide area in the skies above the Snowy Mountains. It may be the influence of the phantom Doragyurosu that is a rumour among the guild. To eliminate this danger, a hunt request has been issued to master hunters. Head for the site at once!
50150.descriptionEn:
Black lightning has been seen
over a wide stretch of the
Snowy Mountains sky.
It may be the work of the
phantom Doragyurosu the guild
speaks of in whispers.
To remove this danger, a slaying
request has gone out to top
hunters. Depart for the site at
once!
50150.descriptionJp:
雪山の空で、広範囲に渡り
黒い雷が観測されました。
もしかすると、ギルドで語草
となっている幻の冥雷竜が
現れた影響かもしれません。
この危険を排除すべく、凄腕
のハンターに討伐依頼が出さ
れています。
直ちに現地へ出発して下さい！

60942.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
60942.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
60942.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
60942.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

55202.description: There is a report that 2 jet-black wyverns were seen in a part of the Ancient Tower where few tread. This is a survey request, but if the report is true, ordinary hunters cannot handle them. We recommend only hunters confident in their skill go.
55202.descriptionEn:
There was a report that two jet-black
Flying Wyverns were seen in a part
of the Ancient Tower where people
rarely set foot. This is a survey
request, but if the report is true,
ordinary Hunters cannot handle them.
I recommend that only Hunters
confident in their own skill
make the trip.
55202.descriptionJp:
古塔の余り人が立ち入らない
場所に、漆黒の飛竜を２頭
見たとの報告がありました。
これは、調査依頼となります
が、報告が本当であるならば、
普通のハンターでは手に負え
ません。腕に自信のある
ハンターの方のみで向かう
事をお勧めします。

10006.description: Here it comes at last. This is the 100-head hunt exercise, the gateway to a hunter's career! Clear this and you'll grow a size too! Do your best! Right?
10006.descriptionEn:
Here it comes. The 100-kill
exercise, the gateway every
hunter must pass!
Clear this and you'll grow
a whole size as a hunter!
Do your best! Got it?
10006.descriptionJp:
いよいよきたね。ハンターの
登竜門と言ってもいい１００頭
討伐の演習だよ！
これを達成出来れば、アンタも
一回り成長するはずだ！
がんばるんだよ！いいね？

1071.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
1071.description: The strange leg joints of the Shogun Ceanataur extend its range even to the ceiling! In the volcano this season, its young, the Gamizami, should be living in great numbers too! We pay for hunting them as well!
1071.descriptionEn:
The sickle crab ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫
uses its bizarre leg joints to
climb all the way to the
ceiling!
In this season's Volcano, many
young ≪Gamizami≫ should be about!
Watch out for their sharp claws!
1071.descriptionJp:
鎌蟹≪ショウグンギザミ≫の
奇妙な足関節はその生息域を
天井にまで広げているぞ！
この季節の火山ではヤツの子
供たち≪ガミザミ≫も数多く
生息しているハズだ！ヤツら
の討伐でも報酬は支払うぜ！

53001.description: Happy New Year! We have prepared a warm-up for this year's first hunt! Run up to the top of the tower to greet the first sunrise! To ensure a healthy hunting life this year too, we have prepared splendid rewards!
53001.descriptionEn:
Happy New Year!
To warm up for your first
hunt of the year, we have
prepared something for you!
Run up to the top of the
Tower to greet the sunrise!
So that your hunting life
stays healthy this year too,
we have fine rewards ready!
53001.descriptionJp:
新年おめでとうございます！
今年の初狩猟に向けての
ウォーミングアップをご用意
しました！御来光を拝みに
塔頂部までひとっ走り行って
きてください！今年も健やか
に狩猟ライフが送れるよう、
素敵な報酬をご用意しており
ます！

54836.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟
54836.description: An Espinas Subspecies appeared during the survey of the Ancient Tower. Reports say it attacks with a dangerous poison breath. Conduct the survey with great care.
54836.descriptionEn:
During a survey of the Ancient
Tower, an Espinas Subspecies
appeared. Reports say it
attacks with a dangerous
poisonous breath.
Survey with great care.
54836.descriptionJp:
古塔の調査中に
≪エスピナス亜種≫が現れ
ました。
報告によると毒を有する危険
なブレスで攻撃を仕掛けてく
るそうです。
十分に注意して調査を
お願いします。

50347.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の捕獲
50347.description: Comrades! Special training! This time, return to your roots and reconfirm the basics of the hunt! The basics of hunting are to predict the movements around you and act! Observe not only the monster but the movements of other hunters, and match them well!
50347.descriptionEn:
Listen up! Special training!
This time, return to basics
and reconfirm the hunt!
The basics: predict the
movement around you and move!
Observe not only monsters
but other hunters, and match
your timing to theirs well!
50347.descriptionJp:
諸君！特訓だ！
今回は原点に返り、狩りの基
本を再確認してほしい！
狩りの基本、それは周りの動
きを予測し動くこと！
モンスターだけではなく他の
ハンターの動きも良く観察し
上手く合わせるのだ！

26552.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, thanks to the survey team's efforts, the whole canyon has been confirmed safe, so the entire canyon is open! Gather to your heart's content!
26552.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The Extra Quest is brought to
you by the Public Tavern Guild.
This time, thanks to the survey
team, the whole Canyon has been
confirmed safe, so the entire
Canyon is now open! Gather as
much as you like!
26552.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は探索隊の努力の結果、
峡谷全体の安全が確認された
ため、峡谷全体が開放されて
います！思う存分採取して
きちゃってください！

26182.description: We discovered a vast sea of trees in an unexplored land. The moment we stepped in, a great swarm of Vespoid! We fled for our lives and left our baggage behind. It is important baggage! Will someone drive off that swarm!
26182.descriptionEn:
I discovered a vast Great Forest
in an unexplored land. The moment
I stepped in, a swarm of Vespoids!
I ran for my life and left my
cargo behind. It's important
cargo! Won't someone drive off
that swarm for me!
26182.descriptionJp:
未開の地に広大な樹海を発見
したんだ。足を踏み入れると
ランゴスタの大群さ！
逃げるのに必死で荷物を残し
てきてしまった。大事な荷物
なんだ！誰かあの大群を追い
払ってくれないか！

21332.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
21332.description: What, you just want a hard Heavy Bowgun? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
21332.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
Heavy Bowgun?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!
21332.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬いヘビィ
ボウガンが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

22104.description: Well done reaching ＨＲ５! I hope you will strive toward G rank, which only truly excellent hunters can reach. This time I have prepared a chance to use the Extreme Style, which cannot be handled unless you are G rank. Why not try it?
22104.descriptionEn:
Well done reaching HR5!
I hope you will strive toward
G Rank, which only truly
skilled hunters may attain.
This time, I've prepared a
chance to wield the ≪Extreme
Style≫, which cannot be used
unless you reach G Rank.
Why not give it a try?
22104.descriptionJp:
よくぞＨＲ５に到達した！
オヌシ達には、真に優れ
たハンターしかなれぬ
Ｇ級を目指し、精進して
欲しいと思っておる。今回、
特別にＧ級にならぬと扱う
ことができぬ、≪極ノ型≫を
扱う機会を用意した。
試してみてはどうかな？

62601.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62601.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62601.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62601.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

40079.description: At this counter we distribute VISA production tickets to hunters who possess Gothic equipment. Please take the quest while equipped with the Gothic Piercing.
40079.descriptionEn:
Here we hand out VISA
production tickets to
hunters who own Gothic
equipment. Accept the quest
while wearing a Gothic
Pierce.
40079.descriptionJp:
こちらでは、ゴシック装備を
所持しているハンターの方に
ＶＩＳＡ生産券を配布して
おります。ゴシックピアスを
装備した状態で、クエストを
受注してください。

62828.description: A hunter of skill hunts with the best plan, whatever the situation. This time you will slay a Diablos within 15 minutes! You may bring one comrade you trust.
62828.descriptionEn:
A top hunter always hunts
monsters with the best plan,
whatever the situation.
This time, within 15 minutes,
you will slay a Diablos!
You may bring one trusted
companion along with you.
Now go and show me your skill!
62828.descriptionJp:
凄腕ハンターたるもの、
どのような状況でも
常に最善の策を以って
モンスターを狩猟するものだ。
今回お前には、１５分以内に
角竜を討伐してもらう！
お前の信頼できる仲間を
一人連れて行っても構わんぞ。

62111.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

54105.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54105.description: What I want to ask of you is the hunt for the newly discovered Slanting Thunder Bird. There are many things I want to investigate, you see. Break its parts and then hand it over. It would take me many times as long as you. Time is limited. One must use it well.
54105.descriptionEn:
What I want to ask is a hunt
of the recently discovered
Farnock. There's a lot I'd
like to look into, you see.
Hand it over after breaking
its parts. For me, it would
take many times as long as
it takes you. Time is limited.
We must use it well.
54105.descriptionJp:
ボクが頼みたいのは、最近
新たに発見された傾雷鳥の
狩猟だ。いろいろと調べて
みたいことも多いからね。
部位破壊した上、引き渡し
てくれ。ボクでは、君の
何倍も時間がかかってしま
う。時間は限りあるものだ。
有効に使わないとね。

60016.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟

54419.description: We are recruiting hunters to help investigate the Akura Jebia that appeared in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. Investigations of Akura Jebia always produce many casualties, and many are expected this time too. Please join only after making thorough preparations.
54419.descriptionEn:
We are recruiting hunters to
help survey the Akra Jebia
that appeared in the uncharted
Swamp.
Surveys of Akra Jebia always
produce many casualties, and
many are expected this time
as well.
Please prepare fully before
you take part.
54419.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域に出現した
アクラ・ジェビアを調査する
ため、協力して頂ける
ハンターを募集します。
アクラ・ジェビアの調査では、
いつも多くの被害が出ており
今回の調査でも、多くの被害
が予想されます。
万全の準備を整え、参加する
ようにお願いします。

21966.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
21966.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
21966.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55166.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
55166.description: Slaying a Kuarusepus raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55166.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying a Kuarlusepusu
raises your standing
while letting you obtain, at
a bargain, the materials
needed for G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.
55166.descriptionJp:
クアルセプスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

61734.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61734.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61734.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62930.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62930.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62930.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

54745.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54745.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54745.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

26389.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26389.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26389.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

63373.description: Omnivores who will do anything for their goal! At the height of this contest, there is a Hypnocatrice sleeping soundly! Unforgivable! This is no time to sleep! Teach it that fortune and love do not come to those who sleep! While you are at it, try breaking a Cephadrome's fin too!
63373.descriptionEn:
Omnivore friends who'll do
anything for the goal! This
season, a Hypnocatrice is
snoring away! Unforgivable!
No time to sleep! Teach it
that fortune and love won't
come while you sleep! Right,
break a Cephadrome's fin too!
63373.descriptionJp:
目的のためなら何でもイケる
雑食諸君！この勝負の時期に
ぐうぐう寝てる眠鳥がいる！
許すまじ！寝ている場合では
ない！果報と恋は寝てても
こないと教えてやれい！
そうそう砂竜のヒレも壊して
みるといいぞ！

50336.description: There is a report that an unidentified monster suddenly appeared at the top of the tower. It came out of the light leaking through a gap in the clouds, they say, and from the report it is presumed to be Zerureusu, the Glittering World Wyvern. If true, this is a very dangerous situation. Head there at once and investigate.
50336.descriptionEn:
There is a report that an
unidentified monster suddenly
appeared atop the Tower.
It is said to have emerged from
the light leaking through the
gaps in the clouds, and from
that report we surmise it is
the Radiant Wyvern ≪Zerureusu≫.
If true, this is a very dangerous
situation. Head out and survey it!
50336.descriptionJp:
突如、塔の頂部に未確認の
モンスターが現れたとの報告
がありました。雲の隙間から
漏れる光の中より現れたとの
ことですが、報告から輝界竜
≪ゼルレウス≫であると推測
されます。本当であれば、
大変危険な状態です。
至急現地へ向かい調査を
お願いします。

11053.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. If a Melynx steals an item, do not panic, just take it back! You might even pick up their pouch instead, you know?
11053.descriptionEn:
Kirin, an Elder Dragon, is called
the Phantom Beast for the way it
commands lightning at will.
If a Melynx steals an item, do
not panic, just take it back!
On the contrary, you might even
pick up its pouch, you know?
11053.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、雷を自在にあやつるさま
から≪幻獣≫と呼ばれる生き
物です。アイテムを≪メラル
ー≫に奪われたら焦らず取り
返しましょう！逆にポーチを
拾えるかも知れないですよ？

60618.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60618.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60618.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60618.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50515.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス亜種１頭の狩猟
50515.description: You have gathered a full set of red armor? Crafting it alone does not bring out its true performance. If you can cleanly dispel the strong feelings that cling to the armor, the Red Cat will surely become your ally.
50515.descriptionEn:
You've gathered a full set
of red armor, have you?
Crafting alone won't show
its true performance.
If you can cleanse the strong
feelings clinging to it,
Akaneko will surely side with you.
50515.descriptionJp:
赤い防具を全身揃えたじゃと？
生産しただけでは、それは本
当の性能ではないんじゃ。
防具にまとわりつく強い想い
を上手く消し去ることができ
れば、あかねこはきっと、
おぬしの味方になるはずじゃ。

23309.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
23309.description: Forokururu has appeared in the Flower Field. Reports describe a very rare monster that takes in nectar and changes its constitution. We ask for your help with the survey. We also have reports that the Beastmen in the Flower Field do not regard hunters as enemies and pose little danger.
23309.descriptionEn:
A ≪Forokururu≫ has appeared in
the Flower Field. Reports say it
takes in nectar and transforms
its constitution, a very rare
monster indeed. Please help us
survey it. As for the Beastmen
of the Flower Field, word is
they do not regard hunters as
enemies, so the danger is low.
23309.descriptionJp:
花畑に≪フォロクルル≫が
現れました。報告によれば蜜
を摂取し体質変化させる、
非常に珍しいモンスターのよ
うです。調査の協力をお願い
します。また、花畑の獣人族
ですが、ハンターを敵視して
いる様子はなく危険は少ない
という報告も届いています。

63393.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Taikun Zamuza. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
63393.descriptionEn:
This is an emergency request.
We seek someone to slay an
extremely powerful
≪Taikun Zamuza≫.
If you hunt it well, we will
issue more proofs of slay
than usual!
63393.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪タイクンザムザ≫の個体を
退治してくださる方を募集し
ております。見事に狩猟でき
ましたら、普段よりも多めの
討伐の証を発行いたしま
しょう！

62530.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
62530.description: Word is a Lunastra has appeared in the desert lately. As it is a hunt in a harsh place, we can only send 1 hunter, but apparently it is still young and comparatively weak. Brave hunters, why not give it a try?
62530.descriptionEn:
Word is that a Lunastra has
been appearing in the Desert.
The hunt will be in harsh
terrain, so I can only send
one hunter, but apparently
this Lunastra is still
young and rather weak.
Brave hunters out there,
won't you give it a try?
I await your answer.
62530.descriptionJp:
最近、砂漠に炎妃龍が現れる
との情報です。
過酷な場所での狩りになる
ため、１人しか送り出すこと
ができませんが、どうやら
まだ若く比較的弱めの
炎妃龍だという話ですよ。
勇気あるハンターさんは、
挑戦してみてはいかがで
しょうか？

61402.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
61402.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61402.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61402.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50225.description: Hypnocatrice and the crowd become one, and it is just like a play! I will let you join that feast too. Oops, do not bring anything dangerous in. Only your weapon, the symbol of a hunter, will I allow. Now! Entertain me!
50225.descriptionEn:
Hypnocatrice and the crowd become
one, and it is just like a play!
Let me have you join in that
festival too. Oops, don't bring
anything dangerous in, all right.
Only the weapon that marks you a
hunter will I allow.
Now! Entertain me!
50225.descriptionJp:
ヒプノックと観衆が一体となり
それはまるで劇のようだ！
君も、その宴に参加させて
あげよう。おっと、物騒なモノ
は持ち込まないでくれよ。
ハンターたる象徴の、その武器
だけは許してあげるがね。
さぁ！私を楽しませてくれ！

54815.description: Greetings. Are you still gathering now that you are G rank? My job is plant collection. Gather the plants I name. Thank you.
54815.descriptionEn:
Greetings.
Even at G Rank, are you still
gathering?
My request is plant collecting.
Please gather the plants I am
about to describe and bring
them to me.
Thank you.
54815.descriptionJp:
ごきげんよう。
Ｇ級になっても採取をしてい
ますか？
私からの依頼は植物集めです。
これから伝える植物を集めて
きてください。
よろしくお願いします。

50621.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
50621.description: This is the final quest for the Idaten Cup Champion Tournament, PS Vita edition. The time limit is 50 minutes.
50621.descriptionEn:
Idaten Cup
Champion Tournament
@ PS Vita version
final quest.
Time limit: 50 minutes.
50621.descriptionJp:
韋駄天杯
チャンピオントーナメント
＠PS Vita版
の決勝クエストです。
制限時間は５０分です。

55663.description: Hunter who would master the Switch Axe, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn far more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
55663.descriptionEn:
Hunters who would master
the Switch Axe, show
the skill you have honed
against the Baruragaru
in the New Great Arena!
Slay it and you will earn
rewards far beyond what
daily effort ever brings
you. Go and prove it!
55663.descriptionJp:
剣斧を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

50640.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Gogomoa on Tide Island! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
50640.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Pariapuria≫ on Tidal Island!
If you can hunt it with skill,
you shall earn even more
rewards than your daily
efforts would bring you.
50640.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、潮島にいる
≪跳緋獣≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50142.description: If you complete this request, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the G Rank armor of Ｇ★２ monsters! However, G Rank materials cannot be obtained, so gather those with other requests.
50142.descriptionEn:
Clear this request to get
the materials needed for
G★2 monster G Rank armor
upgrades! Note that G Rank
materials are not included,
so gather those elsewhere.
50142.descriptionJp:
この依頼を達成してもらえ
れば、Ｇ★２モンスターの
Ｇ級防具強化に必要な素材
を入手できるぞ！ただし、
Ｇ級素材は入手できないか
ら、他の依頼で集めてくれ。

21626.description: Do you know the orb called the Flax Origin Orb? Its material is indispensable to the production of a certain expensive decoration. If you clear this request, I will give you precious decoration materials.
21626.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the orb
called Ama Orb?
That material is essential
for crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you clear this request, I
will give you that precious
decoration material.
21626.descriptionJp:
亜麻原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

60808.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
60808.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
60808.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
60808.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

60688.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
60688.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Purple Gypceros. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60688.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is a special
Gypceros Subspecies!
Go with your guild mates and
achieve the objective.
Teamwork is everything here,
so aim for the top ranks!
This time Supremacy weapons
only - that's the rule!
60688.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
特異個体の
≪ゲリョス亜種≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！今回は辿異武器限定で
開催されているぞ！

50799.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50799.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up an SP Weapon and repel the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a fitting reward awaits you.
50799.descriptionEn:
You who would master the way of
the hunt. Take up an SP Weapon
and repel the Odibatorasu.
Only one who succeeds under such
limited conditions can be called
a true hunter. Succeed, and a
fitting reward shall await you.
50799.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
『ＳＰ武器』を携え、≪弩岩
竜≫を撃退するのだ。限られ
た条件の中で狩りを成功させ
る者こそ、真の狩人と言えよ
う。成功すれば、それなりの
褒美がそなたを待っておるぞ。

23377.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
23377.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land. My research had once reached completion, but then I heard a rumor of an even more ferocious individual. So would you hunt the Rathalos living in the Old Tower? I will give you a copy of the book recording that survey report.
23377.descriptionEn:
For many years I have studied
the King of the Sky and the
Queen of the Land.
My research once reached
completion, but I heard a
rumor that an even more
savage individual appeared.
So, would you hunt the Rathalos
living in the Ancient Tower? I'll
give you a copy of that book.
23377.descriptionJp:
私は長年、空の王と陸の女王
を研究してきた者だ。
一度私の研究は完成を迎えた
が、さらに凶暴な個体が現れ
たという噂を聞いた。
そこで、古塔に住んでいる
火竜たちを狩猟してくれない
か。その調査報告を記した
書物の写しをキミたちにも
あげよう。
