53308.description: KYOGUWAAAAA! TEEG! GUWAWA NGUWAWAWA DEEG UAGUWAWA HAWAA UWAWAWA NAGGA GAAAGOO BYUUWAWAWA GAA!
53308.descriptionEn:
Kyogwaaaa!
Teeg! Gwawa
Ngu gwawawa
Deeg aguwawa
Hawaa uwwawa
Naagagwaagu
Byuuwwwaga
53308.descriptionJp:
キョグワァァァ！
テーグ！グワワ
ングゥワワワ
デーグアグワワ
ハワーッウワワワ
ナーガッグァーグー
ビュウワワワガー

54550.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
54550.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Rebidiora, the Thunder Extreme Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54550.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Thunder
Extreme Dragon ≪Revidiora≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
54550.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、雷極龍
≪レビディオラ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55005.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55005.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55005.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55005.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

62890.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62890.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62890.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

21673.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21673.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21673.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
21673.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

11044.description: Chameleos is considered heretical even among elder dragons. It appears from nowhere and even veteran hunters cannot handle it. I think there is no choice but to pile on careful, steady attacks without thinking of impossible things like capture!
11044.descriptionEn:
Chameleos is regarded as a heretic
even among Elder Dragons.
It appears from out of nowhere,
and even veteran Hunters cannot
handle it. Don't think of capturing
it — just pile up careful and
steady attacks, that's all!
11044.descriptionJp:
オオナズチは古龍種の中でも
異端視されている存在です。
姿無きところから姿を現わし
熟練の狩人でも手に負えない。
捕獲なんて無理なことは考え
ないで慎重かつ着実に攻撃を
重ねるしかないと思います！

61924.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61924.description: White letters on white paper cannot be read. Black letters on black paper are just the same. Only when white and black combine does new value come into being. To accept both of two opposing things, and so create still greater value: that is sublation.
61924.descriptionEn:
White letters on white paper
cannot be read, can they?
Black letters on black paper
are just the same. Only when
white and black combine does
a new value come to be.
Accepting both opposites
creates even greater worth.
That is sublation, you see.
61924.descriptionJp:
白い紙に白い文字を書いても
読むことができませんよね。
黒い紙に黒い文字を書いても
同じことです。白と黒とが
組み合わさることで、初めて
新たな価値が生まれるのです。
相反するもの、その両方を
認めることで更なる価値を
生むこと、それが止揚です。

12009.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟

60503.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
60503.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
60503.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
60503.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

23617.description: The Variant Species Midogaron appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Midogaron. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23617.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Midogaron≫ seems
to have reached a strength that
puts it at the very summit of
all Midogaron.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their skill
at challenging the summit, we ask
you to take on this survey.
23617.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ミドガロン≫は
ミドガロンの中でも、頂点に
辿りつくほどの強さに達した
ようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

50798.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50798.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50798.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

1049.description: Conga seem to live in great numbers in the swamp this season! They live without joining the boss Congalala's herd. Conversely, that's proof each one is strong enough not to need a herd. Be careful!
1049.descriptionEn:
Conga seem to be thriving
in the Swamp this season!
They don't live in packs with
the big Congalala, you see.
Which means each one is so
strong it needs no pack -
that's proof. So be careful!
1049.descriptionJp:
この季節の沼地にはコンガが
多く生息しているみたいだ！
ヤツらは親玉の≪ババコンガ≫
とは群れずに生活してる。
逆をいえば群れる必要がない
ほど個々が強いという裏付け
でもある。注意するんだぞ！

40063.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
40063.description: The Gypceros of this swamp is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40063.descriptionEn:
The Poison Bird Wyvern ≪Gypceros≫
that lives in this Swamp is said
to rarely carry some incredible
treasure.
If it's true, I'd very much like
you to go and hunt one.
We'll split the reward.
40063.descriptionJp:
この沼地に生息する毒怪鳥
≪ゲリョス≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

61525.objectiveJp: 採集のコイン・３を１０個納品

56005.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
56005.description: Regarding the newly begun UL Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Farnock, the Slanting Thunder Bird, we will also grant a special item.
56005.descriptionEn:
To promote the newly begun
UL Guild Priority Requests,
we have prepared this quest
for you all.
Destroy the head of the
Farnock and we will grant
a special item as a bonus.
We thank you for your help!
56005.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、ＵＬ
ギルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
傾雷鳥の頭部を破壊すること
で特別なアイテムも
付与させていただきます。

50471.description: The Flower Field in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
50471.descriptionEn:
Flower Field in the Warm Season.
The guild is still surveying
this uncharted land even now,
but why not visit it yourself,
hunter, to gather and survey?
If you start missing home,
just deliver a map!
50471.descriptionJp:
温暖期の≪花畑≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

23484.description: A new monster has been discovered in the volcano. The guild has named the creature Voljang, the Crimson Lion, and classified it as a Prime Species. Every blow it lands is terribly heavy, and when enraged it is said to wrap its whole body in searing flame. Please lend us your strength and bring it down!
23484.descriptionEn:
A new monster has been found in
the Volcano.
The guild names it the Crimson
Lion, Vojan, and classes it as
an Origin Species.
Each of its blows is terribly
heavy, and when enraged it
wraps its body in searing flame.
Lend us your strength to slay it!
23484.descriptionJp:
火山で新たなモンスターが
発見されました。
ギルドは対象を紅蓮獅子、
≪ヴォージャン≫と定め、
≪始種≫に分類しました。
繰り出される攻撃は一撃一撃
が非常に重く、怒ると全身に
灼熱の炎をまとうそうです。
討伐に力を貸してください！

21728.description: This quest yields the following materials. Bow Soul (Beginning) x８５, Bow Soul (Middle) x１９５, Bow Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Bow Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
21728.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can get
the following materials.
≪Bow Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Bow Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Bow Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Bow Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept this quest,
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please note.
21728.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪弓魂・序≫８５枚
≪弓魂・中≫１９５枚
≪弓魂・極≫２７５枚
≪弓魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

23349.description: There's a great tremor in the Forest and Hills. A Rathalos Subspecies should be there, but something feels different from usual. The folk nearby are troubled. Won't you please hunt it for us?
23349.descriptionEn:
A tremendous tremor has been
coming from Forest and Hills.
An Azure Rathalos should be
there, but something feels
different from usual. The
neighbors are troubled.
Please, could you hunt it
for us?
23349.descriptionJp:
あの森丘ですごい震動が発生
しておるんじゃ。あそこには
リオレウス亜種がいるはずな
のじゃが、何だかいつもの感
じとは違うのじゃよ。
近隣のみなは迷惑しておる。
是非とも、狩猟をお願いでき
ないだろうかのぉ。

60554.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Chameleos! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60554.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is Chameleos!
Going after a monster all on
your own - truly admirable!
Best yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!
Also, Origin weapons only!
Choose your weapon wisely!
60554.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪オオナズチ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50668.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
50668.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 1 part of the Flor series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50668.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
materials to craft or
upgrade one piece of the
Hardcore Flor series.
Accepting this quest
requires a Superior
Ticket.
If the quest fails, the
Superior Ticket is
consumed - please beware.
50668.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
フロルシリーズの１部位分の
生産、強化素材が入手できま
す。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

60494.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
60494.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks!
60494.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
This time the target is
Breeding Hypnocatrice!
Go with your guild mates and
achieve the objective.
Teamwork is everything here,
so aim for the top ranks!
60494.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪ヒプノック繁殖期≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！

50876.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50876.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50876.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50876.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

58139.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター３頭の狩猟
58139.description: This is the final interception battle. I will never forget the sight of you all. Thank you truly for fighting with us for so long. Let us part brightly with a 'bye-bye'. Now everyone, together. 'Bye-bye.'
58139.descriptionEn:
This is the final defense.
I will never forget how
gallant you all looked.
Thank you for joining us
for so very long.
Let us part with a bright
"bye-bye" at the end.
Now then, all together.
"Bye-bye!"
58139.descriptionJp:
ついに最後の迎撃戦です。
皆様の雄姿を、
私は決して忘れません。
長きに渡る参戦、本当に
ありがとうございました。
最後は明るく「ばいばい」で
お別れにしましょう。
それでは皆様ご一緒に。
「ばいばい」

26361.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26361.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26361.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、下位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

55776.description: To promote the new G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we prepared this quest for you. Cut off Chameleos's tail to receive a special ingredient as a bonus. We thank you for your help!
55776.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests, we
prepared this quest for you.
Cut off the Chameleos tail
to receive a special
ingredient as a bonus.
We thank you for your help!
55776.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
霞龍の尻尾を切断すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

61322.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
61322.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival, but you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are a little harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. Nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
61322.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival,
but you just have to have a
souvenir of the festivities!
That's you, isn't it! Why not
try accepting this quest?
But the conditions are a bit harsh,
so I don't recommend it to the
winning side.
If you fail, the item won't be
returned, so be careful!
61322.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で負けてしまった、
でもどうしても祭典の思い出
が欲しい！と思っているそこ
のアナタ！このクエストを
受注してみないか？
ただしちょっと条件が厳しい
から勝ち組の人にはオススメ
しないぜ。
失敗してもブツは返さない
から慎重にやれよな！

63232.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の討伐
63232.description: A great boar, different in appearance from the usual and extremely powerful, is on a rampage in the swamp, and word has come that the examiner for Secret Scroll hunters, who is on his way here, cannot get through and is in trouble. If the swamp can be made safe, it seems you can be sure to be issued a Secret Proof [Prologue].
63232.descriptionEn:
A great boar unlike any
seen before, terribly
strong, is on a rampage
in the Swamp, and the
Secret Art examiner
heading this way cannot
get through. So we hear.
Make the Swamp safe and
the Secret Art Proof
[Intro] is yours for sure.
63232.descriptionJp:
見た目が通常と異なり、
非常に強力な大猪が、
沼地で暴れているため、
こちらへ向かっている、
秘伝書ハンターの判定員が
通ることができずに困ってい
るとの報告が届いた。
沼地の安全を確保できれば、
≪秘伝の証【序】≫を確実
に発行してもらえるらしい。

55880.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55880.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55880.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55880.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

55832.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の狩猟
55832.description: To promote the new G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we prepared this quest for you. Destroy the head of the Anorupatisu to receive a special ingredient too. We thank you for your help!
55832.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests, we
prepared this quest for you.
Destroy the head of the
Anorupatisu to receive a
special ingredient too.
We thank you for your help!
55832.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
暴鋸竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

62714.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. I believe I gave you blueprints before and you had the workshop master make a hammer, but it can actually be strengthened further! If you want it improved, bring me 33 Silver Secret Pots.
62714.descriptionEn:
"Fishing"
It is a lonely hunt, one that
faces the fish in silence.
I believe you took the blueprints
I gave you to the workshop master
and made a Hammer, but the truth
is it can be strengthened even
further!
If you wish to improve it, bring
me 33 Silver Secret Pots.
62714.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う
孤独な狩り。
以前に渡した設計図を工房の
親方に手渡してハンマーを
作ったと思うが、実はさらに
強化することができるのじゃ！
改良したければ、白銀の秘壺
３３個を持ってくるがよい。

50097.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
50097.description: Will you take on this Rukodiora hunt? It is a little unusual: you must wear the Blademaster Magisa FX series on chest, arms, waist and legs. The reward is generous, so give it a try!
50097.descriptionEn:
How about taking this
Disufiroa hunt?
It's a bit unusual - you
must wear the Blademaster
Magusia FX series on your
chest, arms, waist and legs.
The reward is rich, so give
it a try!
50097.descriptionJp:
この極龍討伐依頼を受けてみ
ないか？
この依頼は少し変わっていて
「剣士用のマグシアFXシリー
ズ」を胴・腕・腰・脚に
それぞれ装備している必要が
ある。報酬は弾むからぜひ
挑戦してくれ！

21026.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１０頭の討伐
21026.description: The swamp is the most suitable environment for Bulldrome to live in. Hunters facing the Bulldrome hunt, please slay as many Bulldrome as you can! Of course, we will pay rewards!
21026.descriptionEn:
The Swamp is the most fitting
home for Bullfango.
Hunters taking on the Bulldrome
hunt are asked to slay as many
Bullfango as they can as well!
Of course, we will pay for it!
21026.descriptionJp:
沼地はブルファンゴたちが棲
むのに最も適した環境です。
≪ドスファンゴ≫の狩猟に臨
む狩人さんは、できるだけ多
くのブルファンゴも討伐して
頂けますようお願いします！
勿論、報酬は支払います！

21482.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21482.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21482.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21482.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61334.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61334.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61334.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62233.description: That Gravios has been sighted near the Swamp. This time we can say our preparations are perfect. Go to the Swamp at once and hunt that monster. If it goes well, I will provide my treasured materials.
62233.descriptionEn:
That Gravios was sighted
near the Swamp, it seems.
This time we'll be fully
prepared, I'd say. Go now
to the Swamp and hunt
that monster. Do well and
I'll share my secret hoard.
62233.descriptionJp:
例の鎧竜が、沼地の近くで
目撃されたようだ。今度こそ
準備は万端と言えるだろう。
今すぐ沼地へ向かい、あの
モンスターを狩猟してほしい。
上手くいったら、私の秘蔵の
素材を提供しよう。

21664.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21664.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21664.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
21664.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

63328.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟
63328.description: Hey there! I, a person with a wealth of experience in the past and nothing else, have come again! I want you to experience memories like mine! Take each other's hands, men and women, and enjoy a splendid hunt!
63328.descriptionEn:
Heeey!
The one with a wealth of
experience - in the past -
is back again! I want you
all to make memories like
mine! Men and women, hand
in hand, enjoy the hunt!
63328.descriptionJp:
ヘェーイ！
過去だけは経験が豊富な
私がまた来ちゃいましたよ！
君たちにも私のような思い出
を体験してもらいたい！
男女手を取り合いステキに
狩りを楽しんでね！

53159.description: A Kirin has appeared in the Snowy Mountains. However, the road up the mountain seems to have been blocked by someone mischievous! To undo the mechanism, a book hidden in the flower field is needed. I will lend you a cute lance, so please investigate.
53159.descriptionEn:
A Kirin has appeared in
the Snowy Mountains. But
someone mean has blocked
the mountain path!
To undo the trap, a Book
hidden in the Flower Field
is needed, they say. We'll
lend you a cute Lance, so
please go and investigate.
53159.descriptionJp:
雪山に「キリン」が現れまし
た。しかし、山に登る道が
いじわるな誰かによって塞が
れているようです！
仕掛けを解くには花畑に隠さ
れた「本」が必要とのこと。
かわいいランスをお貸ししま
すのでどうか調査をお願いし
ます。

53210.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
53210.description: As a warrior, I must vanquish Kushala Daora. As a warrior! Kushala Daora! As a warrior! Having been born a man, I must vanquish Kusha with all my warrior spirit!
53210.descriptionEn:
I, as a warrior,
must vanquish
Kushala Daora.
As a warrior!
Kushala Daora!
As a warrior!
Born a man, I must
with gusto smite
Kushala - it must be so!
53210.descriptionJp:
拙者、武者として
クシャルダオラを
成敗せねばならぬ。
武者として！
クシャルダオラを！
武者として！
男児に生まれたからには、
ムシャでクシャを
成敗せねばならぬのだー！

55725.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55725.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55725.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55725.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

54593.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
54593.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Silver Rathalos and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54593.descriptionEn:
The time has come to show
what you hunters can do!
Go and hunt the mighty
Silver Rathalos!
Clear this quest and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up, I promise!
54593.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪銀火竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

23318.description: The ecology of Inagami is gradually being revealed. It is a very interesting monster with high intelligence that has adapted splendidly to the special environment of the bamboo forest. In particular, many reports concern its tail, so caution is needed. We ask for your cooperation in further investigation.
23318.descriptionEn:
The ecology of Inagami is gradually
coming to light.
It possesses high intelligence and
has adapted splendidly to the
special environment of the bamboo
grove — a most fascinating monster.
Many reports concern its tail in
particular, so caution is needed.
We ask for your help to push the
survey further.
23318.descriptionJp:
イナガミの生態が、
徐々に解明されてきました。
高い知能を持ち、竹林という
特殊な環境に、見事適応した
非常に興味深いモンスターと
言えます。特に尻尾には、
多くの報告が寄せられており
注意が必要です。
さらに調査を進めるための
協力をお願いします。

51109.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51109.description: Hunter who would master the Magnetic Slash Hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
51109.descriptionEn:
You who would master the Magnet
Spike, show the skill you have
honed against the Diamolde of
the Arena!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn far more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
51109.descriptionJp:
磁斬鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61974.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
61974.description: Oh! This time I prepared special equipment and supply items. Use them to give those guys one big blast! I have some special rewards too, so enjoy yourselves!
61974.descriptionEn:
Hey! This time I had some special
equipment and supplies prepared
for you.
Take these and blow those guys
away with one big boom!
I've also got some special
rewards ready, so enjoy
yourselves out there!
61974.descriptionJp:
オウ！今回は特別な
装備品、支給品を
用意させてもらった。
これで一発あいつらを
ドカンとやってきてくれ！
多少だが特殊な報酬も
用意したから、せいぜい
楽しんでくんな！

50439.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

54681.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
54681.description: This is an emergency! A princess touring the desert and her party have reportedly been attacked by the Water Fortress Wyvern, Gureadomosu! We will prepare a special reward for the hunter who saves the princess. Slay the Water Fortress Wyvern at once!
54681.descriptionEn:
Emergency! We have reports
that the princess and her
retinue, touring the Desert,
are under attack by the
Water Fortress Wyvern,
Gureadomosu!
Hunters who rescue her will
receive a special reward -
we are preparing it now.
Slay it at once, please!
54681.descriptionJp:
緊急事態です！砂漠で視察を
されていた王女様の一行が
≪水砦竜グレアドモス≫に襲
われているとの報告がありま
した！
王女様を救っていただける
ハンターには特別な報酬を
渡せるよう準備いたします。
急ぎ水砦竜を討伐してくだ
さい！

62180.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
62180.description: A special job from the Guild to train hunters! Guild support is generous, and those who complete the quest are paid richly! Those with ambition should use this chance to rise!
62180.descriptionEn:
A special request from the Guild,
aimed at training up hunters!
The Guild's support is generous,
and those who complete the quest
are paid a handsome reward!
Let those with ambition take this
chance and rise higher!
62180.descriptionJp:
ギルドからハンターの育成
を目的とした特別な依頼だ！
ギルドからのサポートも厚
く、クエストを達成した者
には潤沢な報酬が支払われ
る！志しある者はこれを機
に駆け上がるのだ！

63154.description: Among the fierce wyverns Abiorugu confirmed in the Snowy Mountains, an extremely violent and powerful individual has appeared. As it is very dangerous, this is an investigation and hunt request limited to hunters we approve. Take it on fully prepared.
63154.descriptionEn:
Reports say an extremely violent
and powerful individual of the
Abiorugu has appeared in the
Snowy Mountains.
It is so dangerous that this
survey and hunt is limited to
hunters we have approved.
Go in fully prepared.
63154.descriptionJp:
雪山で確認されている
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫の中でも
極めて狂暴で、強力な個体が
現れたそうです。
大変危険なため我々が認める
ハンターさん限定での調査、
狩猟依頼となります。
万全の態勢で挑んでください。

62030.description: There! There it is! A magnificent Monoblos is in the desert! Hunt that one alone and you're a first-rate hunter! Hurry there and hunt it! Right now you can apparently get rare materials too, so just go hunt it!
62030.descriptionEn:
There it is! There it is!
A fine ≪Monoblos≫ is in the
Desert!
Hunting that one alone is what
makes a first-rate hunter!
Hurry off and hunt it!
Right now you can get rare
materials too, so go on,
hunt it!
62030.descriptionJp:
あれじゃ！あれじゃよ！
とびっきりの≪モノブロス≫
が砂漠にいるのじゃ！あれを
１人で狩猟してこそ一流の
ハンターじゃ！大急ぎで行っ
て、狩猟してくるのじゃ！
いまならちょうど珍しい素材
も取れるらしいぞ、とにかく、
狩猟してくるのじゃ！

54645.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54645.description: It has been reported that a Silver Dragon attacked on a dark, deserted night. Much about this monster remains a mystery, but its intelligence, flowing control of metal, is thought to be very high even among elder dragons. There is a risk the damage will spread. Please lend your strength to slay it.
54645.descriptionEn:
We have a report that Rukodiora
attacked on a deserted dark
night. Much about this monster
is still a mystery, but the
intellect that commands metal
like flowing water is thought to
rank among the highest of all
Elder Dragons. Damage may well
spread. Please help us slay it!
54645.descriptionJp:
ひとけの無い闇夜に司銀龍が
襲いかかってきたと報告があ
りました。未だ謎が多いモン
スターですが、流れるように
金属を操るその知性は古龍の
中でも非常に高いものだと考
えられます。このままだと被
害の拡大する恐れがあります。
討伐に力を貸してください！

26527.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26527.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26527.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26527.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

26456.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
26456.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26456.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
26456.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

61709.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟

61329.description: A powerful Daimyo Hermitaur seems to be running wild in the desert. It appears to be a rare individual, so I want it captured with a close-range weapon and its parts broken. Since I am asking a lot, I will add to the reward and lend you some reassuring equipment.
61329.descriptionEn:
A powerful shield crab is
on a rampage in the Desert.
It's a rare specimen, so
capture it with a melee
weapon and break its parts.
It's a tall order, so I'll
add to the reward and lend
you some sturdy gear.
61329.descriptionJp:
砂漠でどうも強力な盾蟹が
暴れているらしい。
珍しい個体みたいなんで、
近距離武器での捕獲と、
部位破壊を頼むよ。
無理をいう分、報酬の上乗せ
と、心強い装備の貸し出しを
させてもらうよ。

55084.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス２頭の狩猟
55084.description: While surveying an undiscovered monster in the volcano, we were set upon by a pair of vicious Iodrome and forced to withdraw. Hunters who put those brothers down will receive the materials to craft the Hellfire Quelling Switch Axe, along with G-rank Hardcore Element Jewels and G-rank Hardcore Partner Jewels.
55084.descriptionEn:
While surveying unknown
monsters at the Volcano,
fierce Gendrome brothers
attacked us and forced
our retreat.
The hunter who slays them
receives crafting parts for
the "Kalpa-Quelling Axe"
and G Rank orbs.
55084.descriptionJp:
火山で未発見モンスターを調
査中、獰猛なドスイーオスの
兄弟に襲われ、撤退を余儀な
くされてしまいました。
兄弟を退治して下さったハン
ターさんには、「劫火ヲ滅消
セシ剣斧」の生産素材や
「Ｇ級・剛属珠」「Ｇ級・剛
寵珠」をお渡しします。

62995.objectiveJp: カクサンデメキン３匹の納品
62995.description: I am designing clothes for Guku, but I cannot find the materials I want to use as reference. Please, would you gather them for me? Of course I will pay. Well then, thanks.
62995.descriptionEn:
I'm designing clothes for
my Gook, but I can't find
the material I want to use
as a reference. I'm stuck.
Please, won't you gather
it for me instead?
I'll pay you well, of course.
Well then, thanks a lot!
62995.descriptionJp:
グークに洋服を作ろうと
デザインしているのだけど、
参考に使いたい素材が
見つからなくて困っているの。
お願い、私の代わりに
集めてきてくれないかしら。
もちろんお礼はするわ。
それじゃあ、よろしくね。

60673.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の討伐
60673.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Pariapuria. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60673.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is a special
Pariapuria!
Going after a monster all
on your own - admirable!
Best yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!
Supremacy weapons only
this time - good luck!
60673.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
特異個体の
≪パリアプリア≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

21044.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
21044.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke! They say its appearance makes onlookers tremble! But the reason it is called an armored wyvern is that shell protecting its body, no? What do you suppose happens if the armor is broken?
21044.descriptionEn:
A black subspecies of ≪Gravios≫
seems to have appeared amid the
Volcano's smoke!
They say its looks send shivers
through all who see it!
But it's called the Armor Wyvern
for its armor, so what if you break it?
21044.descriptionJp:
火山の噴煙にまみれて≪グラ
ビモス≫の黒い亜種が出現し
たらしいです！その容姿は見
る者を震え上がらせるって！
でも、鎧竜って呼ばれるのは
体を守る鎧があるからよね？
鎧を壊せばどうなのかしら？

61004.description: An extremely large-scale sandstorm has been measured in the desert. We ask only first-rate hunters to investigate and, if possible, to slay its source. It is too dangerous for us to supply items. Prepare thoroughly!
61004.descriptionEn:
A sandstorm of tremendous scale
has been measured in the Desert.
We ask skilled hunters only to
survey it and, if possible, to
slay whatever is causing it.
It is far too dangerous, so no
items can be supplied.
Please prepare thoroughly!
61004.descriptionJp:
砂漠で、極めて大規模の
砂嵐が計測されました。
凄腕のハンター限定での
調査と、可能であれば
発生源の討伐をお願い
いたします。危険すぎるた
め、アイテム支給はできま
せん。万全の準備を！

55993.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

54298.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
54298.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54298.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54298.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

26403.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

54214.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
54214.description: For the survey, please hunt a Yian Garuga. I want to record its behavior when parts are broken as well, so be sure to break the wings and sever the tail. I have prepared plenty of rewards. Do give it your best!
54214.descriptionEn:
For our survey, please hunt
a Yian Garuga.
We want to record part-break
behavior, so be sure to break
the wings and sever the tail.
The rewards are plentiful.
Please give it your all!
54214.descriptionJp:
調査のために、イャンガルル
ガの狩猟をお願いします。
部位破壊時の挙動も記録して
おきたいので、必ず翼破壊と
尻尾の切断をお願いしますね。
報酬はたくさん用意してます。
ぜひとも頑張ってください！

62758.description: A new report has arrived. Amid the dusk of the jungle, the Violent Wyvern Abiorugu appeared without warning. Another investigator testifies to countless footprints and roars from many directions, so it seems there are several of them. Please prepare carefully and conduct the investigation.
62758.descriptionEn:
A new report has come in.
A Violent Wyvern ≪Abiorugu≫ is
said to have appeared suddenly,
hidden in the Jungle's dusk.
Another surveyor testifies to
countless footprints and to
roars from many directions, so
it seems several of them are
about. Please make thorough
preparations before you survey.
62758.descriptionJp:
新しい報告が届きました。
密林の夕闇に紛れて、突如、
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫が現れた
とのことです。
別の調査員からは、無数の
足跡と多方向からの咆哮を
聞いたと証言しており、
どうやら複数頭いると予想
されます。入念な準備の上、
調査をお願いします。

54988.description: Hunter who would master the Hunting Horn, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
54988.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hunting Horn, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!
54988.descriptionJp:
狩猟笛を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

54451.description: Regarding the newly begun G-rank Guild Priority Requests, we have prepared this quest to further awareness and promotion. By breaking the head of Lolo Gougarf, we will also grant a special ingredient.
54451.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests,
we have prepared this
quest for you all.
Destroy the head of the
Roro Gougarf to receive
a special ingredient as
a bonus. Thank you!
54451.descriptionJp:
新たに始まりました、Ｇ級ギ
ルド優先依頼につきまして、
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
ロロ・ゴウガルフの頭部を
破壊することで特別な食材も
付与させていただきます。

23577.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23577.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23577.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23577.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

60238.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Abiorugu! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60238.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is Abiorugu!
Going after a monster all
on your own - admirable!
Best yourself and claim a
place in the top ranks!
60238.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪アビオルグ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

26356.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26356.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26356.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、下位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

58092.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58092.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58092.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58092.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

53174.description: Do you know the Eastern proverb, a lantern on a moonlit night? It is used for excessive luxury or things one does not need. Though this is no lantern on a moonlit night, this request lends you a gunlance powerful to the point of extravagance. Would you go and hunt Espinas while viewing the moon?
53174.descriptionEn:
Do you know the eastern
saying, "a lantern on a
moonlit night"? It's used
for needless extravagance.
Not that this is needless,
but this request lends you
a Gunlance far too strong
for the job. Hunt an Espinas
while you view the moon?
53174.descriptionJp:
東方に伝わる「月夜に提灯」
ということわざを知っておる
か？過ぎた贅沢や必要ない物
などに対して使われるんじゃ。
「月夜に提灯」ではないが、
この依頼には贅沢すぎるほど
強力な銃槍を貸し出す。
お月見がてら棘竜の狩猟をし
てきてくれぬか？

23543.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
23543.description: The Variant Species Tigrex appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Tigrex. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
23543.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Tigrex≫
seems to have reached a
strength that touches the very
summit of its kind.
Its power is beyond measure.
Hunters confident in their arm
who would challenge the summit
are asked to take the survey.
23543.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ティガレックス≫は
ティガレックスの中でも、
頂点に辿りつくほどの強さに
達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

20023.description: Emergency warning from the Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau! The floating wyvern Yama Tsukami has invaded Mezeporuta's territory! Mezeporuta is now moving to intercept the elder dragon! Make use of the interception equipment installed at the interception base and slay the elder dragon completely! Please!
20023.descriptionEn:
An emergency warning from the
Elder Dragon Forecast Station!
The Floating Peak Dragon Yama
Tsukami has invaded Mezeporuta!
Mezeporuta now moves to Elder
Dragon interception status!
Use the interception equipment
set up at the Base to slay the
Elder Dragon completely! Please!
20023.descriptionJp:
古龍予報所より緊急警告です！
メゼポルタの領内に浮岳龍
ヤマツカミが侵入しました！
これよりメゼポルタは古龍の
迎撃態勢に入ります！
迎撃拠点に設置された迎撃設
備を活用し古龍を完全に討伐
して下さい！お願いします！

62267.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62267.description: What, you just want a hard Long Sword? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62267.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really tough
Long Sword, do you?
Then I'll refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it
is hard to find, and on top of
that, nasty monsters are
prowling around there.
Go search with all your spirit!
62267.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅い太刀が欲
しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

54413.description: I'm studying the body structure and workings of Nono Orugaron, but I'm short on samples. Bring back the materials that can be taken from Nono Orugaron's fangs and tail. Bring back both, properly.
54413.descriptionEn:
I'm studying the body
structure of the
≪Nono Orgaron≫, but I'm
short on samples.
Bring back materials from
its fangs and its tail.
Both of them, mind you.
Don't come back with just
one, understand?
54413.descriptionJp:
≪ノノ・オルガロン≫の
体の構造や仕組みを研究
しているんだが、サンプル
が不足していてね。
≪ノノ・オルガロン≫の牙と
尻尾から入手できる素材を
持って帰ってきてくれ。
ちゃんと、両方持って帰って
きてくれよ。

55614.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55614.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55614.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

26725.description: You want my horn? Hmm, I cannot give it for money or goods. It seems there are folk in the desert just now who have a feud with this horn and with the scar on my face, so if you hunt them and show me your strength I might give it to you.
26725.descriptionEn:
So you want my Horn?
Hmm, I cannot hand it over for
money or goods. Seems there are
folk in the Desert right now
with a grudge tied to this Horn
and the scar on my face, so if
you hunt them and show me your
strength, I might give it to you.
26725.descriptionJp:
俺の角笛が欲しいってか？
うーん、金や物じゃ渡せねぇ
なぁ。どうやらいま砂漠に、
この角笛、そして俺の顔の
傷と因縁がある連中がいる
らしいから、あいつらを狩猟
して力を示してくれたら
やってもいいぞ。

54930.description: Doragyurosu has appeared at the top of the sea of trees! For the investigation, please hunt it and sever its tail! There is only a short window to accept, but if you complete it, this request makes it easy to obtain the Nether Thunder Dragon's Hermit Shell and Nether Thunder Dragon's Hermit Scale!
54930.descriptionEn:
A Doragyurosu has appeared
at the Top of Great Forest!
Please hunt it and sever
its tail for our survey!
The chance to accept this
is brief, but if you clear
it you can easily obtain
the Dark Thunder Wyvern's
Mystic Shell and Scale!
54930.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部にドラギュロスが
現れました！
調査のため狩猟と尻尾切断を
お願いします！
短い時間しか受注のチャンス
はありませんが、達成いただ
ければ「冥雷竜の仙殻」と
「冥雷竜の仙鱗」が入手しや
すい依頼となっています！

63118.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
63118.description: At last the ice fox wyvern has settled in the canyon. With its range spreading to the old tower, the highlands and the canyon, it must be highly adaptable. There are reports of powerful individuals too. Prepare well and go hunt it!
63118.descriptionEn:
At last, the Ice Fox Wyvern has
come to live in the Canyon.
Its range now spreads from the
Ancient Tower to the Highlands
and the Canyon, so it must be
highly adaptable.
There are reports of powerful
individuals too. Prepare well
and head out to hunt!
63118.descriptionJp:
ついに、峡谷で氷狐竜が生息
するようになった。
生息範囲が古塔、高地、峡谷
と広がっていることから、
ヤツは環境適応能力が高いの
だろう。
強力な個体であるとの報告も
ある。十分に準備をして、
狩猟に向かってくれ！

60668.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is a special individual Gurenzeburu. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60668.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target is a special
Gurenzeburu!
Go with your guild mates and
achieve the objective.
Teamwork is everything here,
so aim for the top ranks!
This time Supremacy weapons
only - that's the rule!
60668.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
特異個体の
≪グレンゼブル≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！今回は辿異武器限定で
開催されているぞ！

55734.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55734.description: It is I, the Instructor! No sooner do I catch my breath than I get word of honeymoon trouble! It seems a Toridokuresu is on a rampage at Prismatic Falls, the honeymoon spot, and it has become a great problem! I would deal with it at once, but that is difficult! So I entrust the hunt to you hunters! I wish you good fortune!
55734.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
No rest for me - word of
honeymoon trouble came in!
At the Painted Waterfall
where they're honeymooning,
a Toridcless is on a spree!
I'd go myself, but I can't!
So hunters, I ask you to
slay it! Fight well!
55734.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！
息つく間もなく新婚旅行トラ
ブルの連絡を貰った！
どうやら旅行先の彩の滝で
≪トリドクレス≫が暴れて大
きな問題となっている！すぐ
に対応したいが難しい！
そこでハンター諸君に討伐を
依頼する！健闘を祈る！

21790.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21790.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21790.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

54692.description: To promote the new G Rank Guild Priority Requests, we prepared this quest for you. Cut off the tail of the Akura Jebia to receive a special ingredient too. We thank you for your help!
54692.descriptionEn:
To promote the new G Rank
Guild Priority Requests, we
prepared this quest for you.
Cut off the tail of the
Akura Jebia to receive a
special ingredient too.
We thank you for your help!
54692.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
灰晶蠍の尻尾を切断すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

53321.description: This time, please clear the quest in the outfit I have chosen! You should be moved by an artistic quest! Also, I have already spoken with the Felynes helping us this time, so rest easy!
53321.descriptionEn:
This time, clear the quest
wearing the outfit
that I have chosen!
Prepare to be moved by
this artistic quest!
Also, I've already spoken
with the Felynes helping
you this time, so rest
easy, all right~!
53321.descriptionJp:
今回は、わたしが選んだ
格好でクエストを
クリアして下さい！
芸術的なクエストに
感動するといいですよ！
あと、今回協力して下さる
アイルーさんたちとは、
話はつけてありますので
ご安心ください〜！

26395.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
26395.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
26395.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

50846.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
50846.description: Hello, hunter! Today I have a quest that earns you a coin for a lovely lottery! You can accept it if you have a Hunter Bag (White), so share one with friends who lack it and try it together!
50846.descriptionEn:
Hello there, hunter!
Today I have a quest that
gives you a coin for a
wonderful lottery draw!
You need a Hunter Bag
(White) to accept it, so
trade one to friends who
lack it, and take on the
challenge together, okay?
50846.descriptionJp:
こんにちは、ハンターさん♪
今日はハンターさんに素敵な
くじが引けるコインを貰える
クエストをご用意しました！
ハンターバッグ(白)があれば
受注できますので、持ってな
いお友達にはトレードで分け
てあげて、一緒に挑戦してみ
てくださいね♪

21507.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21507.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21507.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

50976.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
50976.description: The Thunderbird, occasionally sighted, has expanded its territory to where people pass. To prevent further harm, please hunt it. The reward is rare decoration materials.
50976.descriptionEn:
The ≪Shining Thunder Bird≫, which
had only been sighted now and then,
has expanded its territory to the
areas where people travel. To
prevent further damage, please
hunt the target.
The reward is a rare decoration
material.
50976.descriptionJp:
ときおり目撃されていた
≪照雷鳥≫が、人の通る
辺りまで縄張りを広げて
きました。これ以上の
被害を防ぐため、対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材
です。

62192.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62192.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62192.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55576.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
55576.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55576.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55576.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

54491.description: An unprecedented disaster is about to befall that land. It gives off an ominous aura that keeps all at bay, and even the surveyors cannot approach. If left as it is, it could seriously affect the surrounding ecosystem. Hunters of outstanding skill, hurry to the site.
54491.descriptionEn:
An unprecedented disaster is
about to befall that land.
It radiates a sinister aura
that lets no one near; even
surveyors cannot approach.
Left as it is, it could badly
harm the surrounding
ecosystem.
Hunters of outstanding skill,
make haste for the site.
54491.descriptionJp:
彼の地にかつてない災いが
降りかかろうとしています。
何人も寄せ付けない禍々しい
オーラを放ち、調査員も近づ
くことができません。
このままでは、周囲の生態系
に深刻な影響を及ぼしかねま
せん。
卓越した技術をもつハンター
は現地へ急行してください。

55313.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Inagami, the Elegant Elder Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55313.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Elegant Sire
Wyvern ≪Inagami≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
55313.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、雅翁龍
≪イナガミ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

23381.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
23381.description: The ecology of Gasurabazura is gradually being revealed. It seems gentle normally, but anger brings out its hidden savage nature. A rare monster with a very dangerous dual nature. Please investigate with care.
23381.descriptionEn:
The ecology of Gasurabazura
is gradually coming to light.
Normally it seems docile, but
anger brings out the savage
nature it keeps hidden away.
A rare monster with a truly
dangerous two-sided nature.
Please take every care when
you conduct the survey.
23381.descriptionJp:
ガスラバズラの生態が、
徐々に解明されてきました。
普段は大人しいようですが、
怒りの感情により、隠れて
いた凶暴な本性を現すよう
です。非常に危険な二面性を
持つ珍しいモンスターです。
注意して調査をお願いし
ます。

54227.description: A large survey ship reports a dragon in the Farthest Land, a place said to be unfit for life. From the few records that remain, it is thought to be an Elder Dragon called the Blazing Frost Dragon, but the details are entirely unknown. Head there and investigate.
54227.descriptionEn:
There was a report from the large
survey ship that a dragon was
seen in the 'Farthest Land',
a place said to be unfit for life.
From the few records that remain,
it is believed to be an Elder Dragon
called the 'Blazing Frozen Dragon',
but the details are entirely unknown.
Please head there and survey it.
54227.descriptionJp:
生物が存在できない場所だと
言われていた『最果ての地』
に、龍がいたと大型探査船
から報告がありました。
僅かに残る資料から、
『熾凍龍』と呼ばれる古龍で
あると推測されますが、詳細
は全くの不明です。現地へ
向かい、調査をお願いします。

55764.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55764.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55764.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55764.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

11094.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
11094.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
11094.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!
11094.descriptionJp:
≪閃光玉≫をモンスターの目
前に投げると強力な光で目を
くらませることができるんで
すよ。
これを使いこなせば、怖いも
のナシですね！
支給品ボックスに入ってます
から遠慮なく使って下さい！

54434.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
54434.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54434.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54434.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

21116.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

58114.objectiveJp: 大型モンスター２頭の討伐
58114.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt down as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58114.descriptionEn:
We have received reports that a
great horde of large monsters is
closing in on the Base.
Head to the site immediately and
slay as many large monsters as
you can.
A series of battles is expected,
so we recommend departing after
ample preparation.
58114.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
討伐してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60102.objectiveJp: 毒テングダケ４個の納品
60102.description: I found a little known spot in the swamp where materials unique to it lie all about. By all means, go. If you come back with a full pouch, it should be worth the information fee.
60102.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
Swamp-only materials lie all
over the ground.
Go and have a look.
Come back with a full pouch and
it will be worth the price of
the information.
60102.descriptionJp:
沼地ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代分の価値はあると
思うぜ。

61016.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の捕獲
61016.description: I want to ask you for urgent work. A bird wyvern has appeared in the Forest and Hills. Usually I would not mind, but unluckily a trade caravan is passing through, so I want it driven off at once. I do not want the smell of blood drawing other wyverns, so capture it, please. I am begging you!
61016.descriptionEn:
I have a rush job for you.
A Yian Kut-Ku has shown up in
the Forest and Hills. Usually I
would not care, but our caravan
passes through, so drive it off
quickly. The smell of blood
would draw other wyverns, so
capture it, please. I beg you!
61016.descriptionJp:
急ぎの仕事を頼みたいんだ。
森丘に怪鳥が出たんだ。
いつもなら気にしないんだが
運悪く通商隊が通過するので
すぐに追い払って欲しい。
血の臭いで、他の飛竜を
呼び寄せては困るから
捕獲で頼むよ。ほんと頼むよ！

21263.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
21263.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! Blangonga and Congalala, the pride of the Fanged Beasts. Is there a hunter who can hunt two of these fanged beasts at once, when even one is utter hardship!? Even a full-fledged hunter can lose their life to a moment's carelessness!
21263.descriptionEn:
An arena where hunters show
off their skill! Here, the finest
Fanged Beasts: Blangonga and
Congalala. Does a hunter exist
who can hunt these two at once,
each a trial on its own!? Even a
full-fledged hunter can lose
their life to a moment's lapse!
21263.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！牙獣種を代表する
ドドブランゴとババコンガ。
１頭でも困難を極めるこの牙獣
を２頭同時に狩猟できる狩人が
果して存在するのか！？一人前
のハンターであっても一瞬の気
の緩みが命取りになるぞ！

50754.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50754.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50754.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50754.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55594.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55594.description: We have prepared a special quest for hunters who want to make Stygian Zinogre armor! Complete the sub-target and you will obtain the materials needed to upgrade Crossover Armor, so do take it on!
55594.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
quest for hunters who want to
craft Stygian Zinogre
≪Zinogre Subspecies≫ armor!
Clear the sub-target and you can
obtain the materials needed to
upgrade Transcendence Armor, so
please give it a try!
55594.descriptionJp:
獄狼竜≪ジンオウガ亜種≫の
防具を作りたいハンターに
向けた、特別クエストを
用意しました！
サブターゲットを達成すると
遷悠防具の強化に必要な
素材を入手できますので、
ぜひ挑戦して下さい！

1029.description: The solitary one-horned wyvern Monoblos may be called the king that pairs with Diablos in the Desert. Yet if you dodge its charge and make it drive its noble horn into a wall, sealing its movement, you should be able to hunt it from advantage!
1029.descriptionEn:
The solitary one-horned
dragon ≪Monoblos≫ could well
be called the king that pairs
with Diablos in the Desert.
But dodge its charge and let
that noble horn lodge in a wall,
and you should gain the upper hand!
1029.descriptionJp:
孤高の一角竜≪モノブロス≫
は砂漠においてディアブロス
と対をなす王者といえよう。
がしかし、ヤツの突進を避け
気高き角を壁に刺させ、動き
を封じてしまえば優位に狩り
を進められるハズじゃぞ！

26553.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. This time, thanks to the survey team's efforts, the whole canyon has been confirmed safe, so the entire canyon is open! Gather to your heart's content!
26553.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The Extra Quest is brought to
you by the Public Tavern Guild.
This time, thanks to the survey
team, the whole Canyon has been
confirmed safe, so the entire
Canyon is now open! Gather as
much as you like!
26553.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
今回は探索隊の努力の結果、
峡谷全体の安全が確認された
ため、峡谷全体が開放されて
います！思う存分採取して
きちゃってください！

23216.description: Around the sea of trees, reports of damage by flying wyverns come one after another. Hurry to the site and hunt the flying wyverns. As the hunt will be in a poorly surveyed area, there is no telling what the wyvern will do. Do not neglect preparations before departure.
23216.descriptionEn:
Reports of flying wyvern
damage keep coming in
near the Great Forest.
Head there at once and
hunt the wyvern down.
The area is unsurveyed,
so we don't know how it
will behave. Prep well.
23216.descriptionJp:
樹海付近で、飛竜による
被害報告が相次いでいる。
急いで現地へ向かい、
飛竜の狩猟に当たってくれ。
調査が不十分な地域での狩猟
となるため、飛竜がどんな
行動に出るかはわからない。
出発前の準備を怠るなよ。

62838.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

62983.objectiveJp: タイクンザムザ１匹の捕獲
62983.description: Have you heard from the workshop master about a special ore called the Kinos Secret Stone? If not, let me introduce this request. The Kinos Secret Stone is a special material needed to craft a certain armor. Gather enough and have the master craft it for you.
62983.descriptionEn:
Ever heard of the special
ore called ≪Kinos Gemstone≫
from the smithy master?
If not, then let me
recommend this job.
≪Kinos Gemstone≫ is a rare
material needed to forge
certain armor. Gather a few
and have the master craft it.
62983.descriptionJp:
≪キノス秘石≫という特殊な
鉱石を、武具工房の親方から
聞いたことがあるか？
知らないなら、この依頼を
紹介しよう。
≪キノス秘石≫は、ある防具
の生産に必要な特殊な素材だ。
数を集めて、親方に生産して
もらうといいだろう。

65001.description: The time has come for SephV hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Hypnocatrice and prove it. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
65001.descriptionEn:
SephV hunters, the time has
come to show what you can do!
Hunt the splendid
Hypnocatrice and prove it.
Clear this quest and your
standing as a hunter will
shoot right up!
65001.descriptionJp:
SephVハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪眠鳥≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

62504.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62504.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62504.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

63090.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐
63090.description: A request to hunt the Lunastra that dwells at the very top of the Old Tower in the frontier. It is a request issued from time to time, but this appearance falls outside the guild's predictions and can be called rare. The summit is extremely dangerous, and only one person can be sent. Depart in perfect condition.
63090.descriptionEn:
A request to slay the
Lunastra dwelling at the
top of the frontier's
Ancient Tower. Such requests
come often, but this sighting
falls outside the Guild's
predictions - truly rare.
The summit is deadly; only
one hunter may be sent.
Depart fully prepared.
63090.descriptionJp:
辺境の古塔、その最上部に
住む、炎妃龍の討伐依頼で
す。度々発行される依頼で
はありますが、この出現は
ギルドの予測から外れて
おり稀であると言えます。
最上部は大変危険で、
１人しか送り出すことがで
きません。万全の状態で
出発してください。

62067.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐

26272.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26272.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26272.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26272.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62397.description: When enough coincidences pile up, it may fairly be called fate. In this quest, please do your best to cooperate, to trust, and to recognize one another. Carve the bond between you, which will never fade, into your hearts.
62397.descriptionEn:
When many coincidences pile up,
it would no longer be wrong to
call it fate.
In this quest, please do your best
to cooperate, to trust, and to
acknowledge one another.
Carve the bond between you, one that
will never fade, into your hearts.
62397.descriptionJp:
多くの偶然が重なれば、最早
それは運命と呼んでも差し支
えないことでしょう。
このクエストでは協力と信頼、
そしてお互いを認めあえるよ
う頑張ってくださいね。
あなた達の決して色褪せない
絆を心に刻んでください。

62291.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
62291.description: It has been a while since a hunter came here. If you have time, help me collect the torn map pieces. I dropped them while running from a monster. It may be a bit of work, but gather them all by sheer will!
62291.descriptionEn:
It's been a while since a hunter
came all the way out here.
If you've got time to spare, I
need help gathering torn maps.
I dropped them while running
from a monster, you see.
It might be a bit of trouble,
but grit your teeth and get them all!
62291.descriptionJp:
こんなところにハンターが
来るのは久しぶりだ。
手が空いているなら、破れた
地図集めを手伝ってほしい。
モンスターから逃げるときに、
落としてしまったんだ。
少し大変かもしれないが、
気合いで全部集めてくれ！

56099.description: If you hold a Small Portrait: Purple from the Hunter Festival, why not take this quest? The terms come from a certain party, though, so the conditions are harsh and I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side.
56099.descriptionEn:
If you have the
≪Small Portrait: Purple≫
handed out at the Hunter Festival,
won't you take this on?
However, through a deal from
certain quarters the conditions
are strict, so I wouldn't recommend
it to the winning side.
56099.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で貰える
≪小さな肖像・紫≫を
持っているなら受注
しないか？
ただし、とある筋から
の取引で厳しい条件に
なってるから勝ち組の
人にはオススメしないぜ。

55261.description: To investigate the Rending Water Wyvern that has been appearing intermittently, I ask you to hunt it and sever its parts. The part to be investigated changes with the time of day it appears, so judge whether the tail, the right hanging blade or the left hanging blade is the target, and if you strike it true I will add to your reward!
55261.descriptionEn:
To survey the Zenaserisu that
appears on and off, please hunt
it and sever its parts. The
part to survey changes with
the time of day it appears,
so judge which part is the
target - tail, right hanging
blade or left hanging blade -
and nail it for a bonus!
55261.descriptionJp:
断続的に出現している裂水竜
の調査のため、裂水竜の狩猟
と部位切断をお願いします。
出現する時間帯によって調査
対象となる部位が替わります
ので、尻尾、右垂刃、左垂刃、
の切断部位の中から、対象部
位を判断し見事当てていただ
きましたら報酬をはずみます！

50650.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Conquest Weapon and hunt the Gold and Silver Piscine Wyvern. One who has come this far along the hunter's path should be able to bring them down. Do so, and a splendid reward shall be yours.
50650.descriptionEn:
You who would master the
hunting road: take up
Zenith weapons and hunt
the Gold and Silver
Plesioth. One as skilled
as you can surely bring
them down. Do so, and a
splendid reward awaits.
50650.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
≪覇種武器≫などを携え、
≪金銀魚竜≫を狩るのだ。
ここまで狩りの道を極めた
お主なら、奴らも仕留められ
るじゃろう。
見事仕留められれば、素晴ら
しい報酬を取らせよう。

60495.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
60495.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Breeding Season Hypnocatrice. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60495.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
This time the target is the
≪Hypnocatrice (Breeding Season)≫!
Hunting all alone shows truly
admirable spirit! Overcome
yourself and reach the top ranks!
60495.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ヒプノック繁殖期≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

61044.objectiveJp: イャンクック1頭の討伐
61044.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
61044.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.
61044.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。
こちらは祭典の証は必要あり
ません。クエストの達成のみで
様々な報酬が払い出される
ようになっております。

26223.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

55121.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55121.description: Drive it off and the thing comes dancing back. The guild has decided to call the light-radiating one the Extreme Ruling Ganzorumu. In the end there is nothing for it but to hunt it. To hunters who succeed, we will present the materials for a full set of guild-treasured armor and a title!
55121.descriptionEn:
Drive it off, and the beast will
come dancing back once more.
So the Guild has decided to call
that shining one "Guanzorumu,
Ruler of the Acme."
In the end, we must slay it.
To any hunter who slays it, we
shall present the materials for a
full set of Guild armor, and a title!
55121.descriptionJp:
追い払えどもヤツは、
再び舞い戻ってくる。
ギルドでは、光放つヤツを
「極み統べるグァンゾルム」
と呼ぶことにした。
やはり討伐するしかないか。
討伐できたハンターには、
ギルド秘蔵の防具一式の素材
と称号を贈呈させて頂く！

55329.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55329.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a tail cut in slaying Blangonga, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55329.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Blangonga≫ and break its
head and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55329.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪雪獅子≫討伐にて
頭部破壊と尻尾切断を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

53033.objectiveJp: マカライト鉱石１個の納品
53033.description: In this trial you are to deliver Machalite Ore. However, we deliberately will not give you the Picks needed to mine it! How you obtain them is for you to think out! Combine mining tools, carve them from monsters, the answer is not just one!
53033.descriptionEn:
For this trial, you must
deliver Machalite Ore.
However, I will not give
you the Pickaxe you need!
How you obtain one is for
you all to figure out!
Combine gathering tools,
or carve it from monsters
- there is more than one
answer! Now go!
53033.descriptionJp:
今回の試練では、「マカライ
ト鉱石」を納品してもらう。
ただし、採掘に必要な「ピッ
ケル」はあえて渡さない！
どうやって入手するのかは、
諸君等自身が考えるのだ！
採掘道具を調合したり、
モンスターから剥ぎ取ったり
と、答えは一つとは限らない
ぞ！

23485.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
23485.description: An unfamiliar monster has been discovered in the extreme cold sea. The Guild has designated the target as the Frozen King Wyvern, Toa Tesukatora, and classified it as a First Species. A blizzard constantly surrounds Toa Tesukatora, and capture is thought impossible. Please slay it carefully and surely.
23485.descriptionEn:
An unfamiliar monster has been
discovered in the Polar Sea.
The Guild has named it the
Frozen King Dragon,
≪Toa Tesukatora≫, and classed
it as an ≪Origin Species≫.
A blizzard always rages around
it, so capture is thought
impossible. Please slay it
carefully and for certain.
23485.descriptionJp:
極海にて見慣れぬモンスター
が発見されました。
ギルドは対象を凍王龍、
≪トア・テスカトラ≫と定め、
≪始種≫に分類しました。
凍王龍の周りは常に吹雪が
発生しており、捕獲は
不可能と考えられます。
慎重かつ確実に討伐を
お願いします。

60919.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
60919.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
60919.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

63167.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63167.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
63167.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
63167.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

21662.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の討伐
21662.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Broac Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21662.descriptionEn:
The lost memos that record the
secret of forging weapons are
apparently turning up on
monsters slain all over!
Once you get the Buroaku Memo,
be a man! Bring it to this
workshop master!
I will show you good work!
21662.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ブロアクメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50658.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
50658.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 71! This quest yields materials for crafting weapons from Akantor, and upgrade materials for the original Corude F armor series. Do give it a try!
50658.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 71!
This quest yields materials
for crafting weapons from
the Zenith Wyvern Akantor,
and upgrade materials for
the original Corude F
armor series.
Do give it a try!
50658.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ７１到達おめでとうござ
います！
このクエストは、覇竜≪アカ
ムトルム≫の武器生産素材及
びオリジナル防具≪コルーデ
Ｆシリーズ≫の強化素材が入
手できます。
ぜひチャレンジしてみてくだ
さい。

54428.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の討伐
54428.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to deepen your bonds further, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay a monster and break its parts together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing.
54428.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to deepen the bonds
between you all, I have prepared
a difficult request for you.
You are to hunt monsters and
break their parts together with
your Guild companions. No supplies
whatsoever will be provided, so
talk it over with your fellows first.
54428.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆をさらに
深めるべく、難しい依頼を
用意させてもらった。
モンスターの討伐と部位破壊
を、猟団の仲間と行うのだ。
支給品も一切用意しないので、
事前に仲間たちと相談して
出発せよ。

21713.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
21713.description: Have you heard of the Celadon Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21713.descriptionEn:
Do you know the orb known
as the Secret Hue Orb?
Its material is vital to
crafting a certain costly
decorative charm.
If you complete this
request, I shall give you
precious charm materials.
21713.descriptionJp:
秘色原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

55969.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55969.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
