Dragon came, kii. Everything
is a mess now, kii. Become my
arms and legs and drive it
off, kii.'
So it seems to say.
53311.descriptionJp:
「一緒に戦ってほしいキー
　僕らウルキーが花畑で
　平和に暮らしていたら
　伝説の古龍がきたキー
　もうむちゃくちゃだキー
　僕の手足となって、
　追い払うんだキー」
と言っているようだ。

40089.description: Congratulations on reaching HR 900! Deliver the Map on your own, and after clearing the quest visit the Special Event House to receive your bonus. Please make good use of this!
40089.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR 900! Deliver the ≪Map≫
on your own, and after
clearing the quest visit the
Special Event House to receive
your bonus. Please make good
use of this!
40089.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ９００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストクリア後に
特別イベントハウスを訪ねて
いただければ特典を進呈致し
ます。ぜひご活用ください！

21396.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

51017.objectiveJp: アマツマガツチ１体の討伐
51017.description: The storm dragon Amatsu, by its nature of bringing floods, is dangerous even to approach, and its ecology is wrapped in mystery. To clarify its ecology, if you succeed in breaking its head or left foreleg in addition to slaying it, I will pay an extra reward. We await a hunter of courage.
51017.descriptionEn:
The Storm Dragon Amatsu brings
flood and ruin, so even getting
close is dangerous and its
ecology is wrapped in mystery.
To shed light on it, we will
give extra rewards if you also
break its head or left foreleg
in addition to slaying it.
We await the challenge of
brave hunters.
51017.descriptionJp:
嵐龍アマツマガツチは水禍を
引き起こす性質から、近づく
ことすら危険を伴い、生態は
謎に包まれています。
生態の解明のため、討伐に
加えて頭部か左前脚の破壊に
成功した場合は、追加の報酬
をお渡しします。
勇気あるハンターの挑戦を、
お待ちしております。

22051.description: The Highlands are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22051.descriptionEn:
The ≪Highlands≫ are a land
still under Guild survey,
but hunters too might like
to go and take a look for
gathering and research.
How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22051.descriptionJp:
≪高地≫は、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

50477.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
50477.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50477.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
50477.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

62977.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62977.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62977.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

51102.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
51102.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Kushala Daora will also grant a special ingredient.
51102.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Kushala Daora's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51102.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
鋼龍の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

26530.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
26530.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
26530.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
26530.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

23375.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟
23375.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Silver Rathalos at the Old Tower. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
23375.descriptionEn:
To support your hunting life,
we have prepared a request to
hunt a Silver Rathalos at the
Ancient Tower.
Clearing it earns you higher
standing than usual.
Train efficiently and aim
for even greater heights.
23375.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、古塔にてリオレウス
希少種を狩猟する依頼を用意
しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より高い評価が得られます。
効率的な鍛練を積み、さらな
る高みを目指しましょう。

55960.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55960.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55960.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

26081.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26081.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26081.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26081.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

61626.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
61626.description: I would like to try my hand at Elder Dragon research soon myself. I know well that they cannot be captured. But could I ask you to slay one with every part broken, so it is easier to study? If you slay it without breaking the parts, it will be counted as a failure.
61626.descriptionEn:
I'd like to try my hand at
studying Elder Dragons soon.
I know full well they can't
be captured. But could you
slay one after breaking each
part, so it's easier to
study? If you slay it without
breaking the parts, I'll have
to call it a failure.
61626.descriptionJp:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

61514.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61514.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61514.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54192.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54192.description: We ask you to survey the Shogun Ceanataur lurking in the volcano. Beyond the hunt itself, if you break its parts, we will add to your reward!
54192.descriptionEn:
Please survey the Shogun
Ceanataur in the Volcano.
Not just hunting — if you
break its parts as well, I'll
add a little extra to your
reward!
54192.descriptionJp:
火山に潜む鎌蟹の調査を
お願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
見事、鎌蟹の部位破壊を
してくれたら、報酬を上乗せ
しちゃいますよ！

54537.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
54537.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54537.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54537.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

60242.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
60242.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Toridokuresu. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60242.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Toridcless≫!
To hunt a monster all alone —
what spirit! Truly admirable!
Overcome yourself and take
a well-earned top rank!
SP weapons only this time!
Choose your weapon carefully!
60242.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪トリドクレス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

50390.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21016.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21016.description: We are looking for people to hunt Gendrome! If you seem to have time to spare, please deliver Herbivore Eggs that can be gathered this season. They're an item hugely popular with merchants and gourmets!
21016.descriptionEn:
We're looking for hunters to
hunt ≪Gendrome≫!
If you seem to have time to
spare, please deliver
≪Herbivore Eggs≫ gathered
this season. Merchants and
gourmets can't get enough!
21016.descriptionJp:
≪ドスゲネポス≫を狩猟して
くれる方を募集します！
ゆとりがありそうな場合は、
この季節に採れる≪草食竜の
卵≫を納品してください。
栄養満点で商人や美食家たち
に大人気の品物なんです！

61048.description: Supply item test quest. Every supply item is stocked to the maximum you can carry. The shortfall comes after the map is delivered.
61048.descriptionEn:
Supply Item Test Quest
All supplies at max
capacity included

Shortfall after Map delivery
61048.descriptionJp:
支給品テスト用クエスト
全支給品持てる最大数
入っています

不足分は地図納品後

62810.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
62810.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62810.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62810.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

54924.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
54924.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
54924.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
54924.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

55689.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
55689.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Akura Vashimu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55689.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
Supremacy Akura Vashimu
materials. To accept it, a
Superior Ticket is required.
Note that if the quest is
failed, the Superior Ticket
will be consumed.
55689.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

62859.description: There is aesthetics in the sub target. Put the specialty mushroom you took into a Maca Pickling Jar and aim for more rewards, or deliver it as is: follow your aesthetics. Cannot find the specialty mushroom at all? Then retire. I accept nothing but a sub clear.
62859.descriptionEn:
There is aesthetics in sub-targets alone.
Whether you put the Specialty Mushrooms
you gather into the Maca Pickling Jar
to aim for more rewards, or simply
deliver them as they are, is up to
your own aesthetics.
You cannot find the Specialty
Mushrooms at all?
Then you retire.
Nothing but a sub-clear will I accept.
62859.descriptionJp:
サブにこそ、美学がある。
とった特産キノコをマカ漬け
の壷に入れ、より多くの報酬
を狙うか、そのまま特産キノ
コを納品するかは、おぬしの
美学に従うのじゃ。
そもそも特産キノコが見つか
らない？
その時は、リタイアじゃな。
サブクリア以外認めんぞ。

50345.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50345.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50345.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

55597.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
55597.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
55597.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
55597.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

50874.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50874.description: Nya! Hunter there aiming to master the light bowgun! Try taking my guidance, meow! Hunt a Dyuragaua beautifully and you should get more rewards than usual, meow! Take this chance to master the Light Bowgun, meow!
50874.descriptionEn:
Meow! Hunter aiming to
master the light bowgun!
Try taking on my guidance,
meow! If you hunt the
≪Dyuragaua≫ in style,
you'll get more rewards than
usual, I think, meow!
Take this chance to master
the light bowgun, meow!
50874.descriptionJp:
ニャ！軽銃を極めんとする
そこのハンターさん！試しに
ボクのシナンを受けてみる
ニャ！≪氷狐竜≫をみごと
狩猟することができたニャら、
いつもより沢山のホウシュウ
が貰えると思うニャ！
コレを機にライトボウガンを
極めてみるのニャ！

50253.description: This quest yields the following materials. Great Sword Soul (Beginning) x８５, Great Sword Soul (Middle) x１９５, Great Sword Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Great Sword Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50253.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Great Sword Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Great Sword Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Great Sword Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Great Sword Soul: Heaven≫ x85
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
50253.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪大剣魂・序≫８５枚
≪大剣魂・中≫１９５枚
≪大剣魂・極≫２７５枚
≪大剣魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

54822.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
54822.description: There is a daily limit on accepting this, but here is a request that yields some of the materials needed to upgrade Toridcless G Rank gear. Don't miss this chance!
54822.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting this, but here is a
request that yields some of
the materials needed to
upgrade Toridcless G Rank
gear. Don't miss this chance!
54822.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、照雷鳥のＧ級武
具の強化に必要な素材の一部
を入手できる依頼をご紹介し
ます。この機会を逃さぬよう
ご注意ください。

62413.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
62413.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt the dancing thunder wyvern Berukyurosu in the Arena. I have prepared armor for it as well! It is a formidable monster, so do not forget to heal often, understood? Now off you go!
62413.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This
time you will hunt the Dancing
Thunder Wyvern in the Arena,
the ≪Berukyurosu≫. I've even
prepared armor for it!
It's a tough monster, so don't
forget to heal often, got it?
Now go and give it your all!
62413.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、闘技場にいる舞雷竜、
≪ベルキュロス≫の狩猟をし
てもらおう。そのための防具
も予め用意してやったぞ！
かなり手強いモンスターなの
で、こまめな回復を忘れるな
よ？さあ頑張ってこい！

55592.description: New individuals of Variant Species keep appearing, and the threat only grows. To support the strengthening of hunters' gear, the guild has prepared a quest that yields rare materials. Obtain a Purple Hunter Medal through point exchange on the Hunting Road and take up the challenge.
55592.descriptionEn:
New Supremacy individuals
keep appearing, and the threat
only grows.
To back up hunters' gear
upgrades, the Guild has
prepared a quest where rare
materials can be obtained.
Trade Hunting Road points for
a Hunter Medal Purple and take up the challenge.
55592.descriptionJp:
辿異種は今なお新たな個体が
現れ、脅威は増すばかりです。
ギルドではハンターの
武具強化を後押しすべく、
希少素材が手に入るクエスト
を用意しました。
狩煉道のポイント交換で、
ハンターメダル紫を入手して
挑戦してください。

21217.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
21217.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21217.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21217.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

62202.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to rid us of an extremely powerful Chameleos. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
62202.descriptionEn:
An emergency request. We seek
someone to dispose of an
extremely powerful ≪Chameleos≫.
If you slay it in style, we
will issue more Slay Proofs
than usual!
62202.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪オオナズチ≫の個体を退治
してくださる方を募集してお
ります。見事に討伐できまし
たら、普段よりも多めの討伐
の証を発行いたしましょう！

54986.description: Hunter who would master the Long Sword, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the New Grand Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
54986.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Long Sword, show me the skill
you have honed against the
Baruragaru in the New Great
Arena! If you hunt it well,
you shall earn even more
reward than your daily efforts
would bring.
54986.descriptionJp:
太刀を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

61567.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61567.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61567.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

26068.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
26068.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26068.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26068.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

1063.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

62814.objectiveJp: ハンターの本・白１個の納品

23726.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Merit (Beginning) x５０, Long Sword Merit (Middle) x６０, Long Sword Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23726.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Long Sword Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Long Sword Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you need
a ≪Secret Art Merit Crystal≫
and GR 500 or higher, so
please keep that in mind.
23726.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪太刀勲・序≫５０個
≪太刀勲・中≫６０個
≪太刀勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

63192.description: An extremely powerful individual Gogomoa has appeared. Also, insect activity in Shiojima increases in the evening. The hunt will surely be harsh. Be careful.
63192.descriptionEn:
An extremely powerful Gogomoa
individual has appeared.
In addition, we have reports that
insects grow very active on the
Tidal Island in the evening.
There is no doubt this will be
a harsh hunt.
Please be careful out there.
63192.descriptionJp:
ゴゴモアの極めて強力な
個体が現れたそうです。
さらに、潮島の夕方は
虫の活動が活発になるとの
報告もあります。
厳しい狩猟になることは
間違いありません。
気を付けてください。

61851.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
61851.description: The highlands, an untrodden land. In this newly discovered place, a new flying wyvern seems to have been discovered at last. From its powerful form it was named Gurenzeburu. This time the request is to hunt it. Why not experience a hunt in a new world?
61851.descriptionEn:
An untrodden land, the Highlands.
In this newly discovered place,
a new Flying Wyvern has finally
been found, it seems. For its
powerful form the wyvern was
named ≪Taikun Zamuza≫.
This time the request is to hunt
it. Why not try a hunt in a new land?
61851.descriptionJp:
未踏の地、高地。
新たに発見されたこの地で、
ついに新しく飛竜が発見され
たようです。力強い姿から
≪蛮竜≫と名付けられた飛竜。
今回はそれの狩猟依頼となり
ます。新天地での狩りを体験
してみてはいかがでしょうか？

63134.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐

54857.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
54857.description: An unfamiliar monster has been discovered in the extreme cold sea. The Guild has designated the target as the Frozen King Wyvern, Toa Tesukatora, and classified it as a First Species. A blizzard constantly surrounds Toa Tesukatora, and capture is thought impossible. Please slay it carefully and surely.
54857.descriptionEn:
An unfamiliar monster has been
discovered in the Polar Sea.
The Guild has named it the
Frozen King Dragon,
≪Toa Tesukatora≫, and classed
it as an ≪Origin Species≫.
A blizzard always rages around
it, so capture is thought
impossible. Please slay it
carefully and for certain.
54857.descriptionJp:
極海にて見慣れぬモンスター
が発見されました。
ギルドは対象を凍王龍、
≪トア・テスカトラ≫と定め、
≪始種≫に分類しました。
凍王龍の周りは常に吹雪が
発生しており、捕獲は
不可能と考えられます。
慎重かつ確実に討伐を
お願いします。

56034.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Blast Wolf. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56034.descriptionEn:
We would like you to slay a
Supremacy Midogaron.
If you break its developed parts
in this quest, we will specially
add developed part materials to
your Another Reward.
Please note that slaying it alone
will not earn you those materials.
56034.descriptionJp:
辿異種の爆狼を討伐していた
だきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

23266.description: The Elder Dragon Forecast Bureau reports that a Thunder Zenith Dragon will soon appear at the interception base. The battle will be fought in the dark of night, so prepare thoroughly and use the interception facilities to slay it.
23266.descriptionEn:
The Elder Dragon Forecast
Bureau reports that the Thunder
Extreme Dragon will soon appear
at the Base. The fight will be
in the dark of night, so
prepare fully and use the
defense facilities to slay it.
23266.descriptionJp:
古龍予報局より、間もなく
迎撃拠点に雷極龍が現れると
報告がありました。
夜闇の中での戦いとなるため、
準備を十分に行ったうえ、
迎撃施設を利用して
討伐に当たってください。

54184.description: Good work. Clear the quest and receive the Star 6 Release Commemorative Coin. Take it to the Harisen Neko and you can exchange it for fine goods.
54184.descriptionEn:
Good work out there.
You have cleared the quest,
so take the ≪★6 Unlock Commemorative Coin≫.
Bring it to the Harisen Neko
and they will trade it
for a fine item,
you know.
54184.descriptionJp:
お疲れ様でした。
クエストを達成し、
≪★６解放記念硬貨≫を
受け取ってください。
ハリセンネコへ持っていけば
良い品と交換してもらえ
ますよ。

60079.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

50130.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50130.description: A report has arrived that Kushala Daora has appeared in the Snowy Mountains. We have sent hunters there several times so far, but without result. For that reason, we have set several conditions on this request. It is a difficult request, but we have prepared a reward to match. I ask your help.
50130.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that
a Kushala Daora appeared in
the Snowy Mountains.
We have sent hunters several
times so far, but with no
results.
So this request comes with a
few conditions. It is a hard
one, but the reward matches it.
We appreciate your help.
50130.descriptionJp:
雪山に、鋼龍が現れたとの
報告が届きました。
これまで何度かハンターを
向かわせましたが、成果が
得られていません。
そのため、今回依頼に幾つか
の条件を出しています。
困難な依頼ですが、それに
見合う報酬を用意しておりま
す。よろしくお願いします。

62394.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62394.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a long-range weapon. Take the armor and Bow prepared for you and hunt the devouring wyvern Pariapuria in the New Grand Arena! Dodge the monster's attacks, put some distance between you, and then shoot!
62394.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor! This
time you'll hunt with ranged
weapons.
Take the armor and Bow prepared
for you and hunt the Gluttonous
Wyvern ≪Pariapuria≫ in the New
Great Arena! Dodge its attacks,
keep your distance, then fire!
62394.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
遠距離武器での狩猟をしても
らおう。
予め用意された防具と弓で新
大闘技場にいる呑竜≪パリア
プリア≫を狩猟してきたまえ！
モンスターの攻撃を避けつつ
距離を取ってから撃つんだぞ！

21755.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21755.description: I want it! I want it! I want it no matter what! The cute furniture of the Kut-Ku! Kind hunter! Hunt lots for me! I will give you plenty of the materials for Blast Powder I filched from the house storehouse! Please!
21755.descriptionEn:
I want it! I want it!
I just have to have it!
The cute Yian Kut-Ku furniture!
Kind hunter! Go hunt lots and
lots of them for me!
I will give you loads of
≪Gunpowder≫ ingredients I
swiped from our storehouse!
Please!
21755.descriptionJp:
欲しいの！欲しいの！
どおぉ〜しても欲しいの！
怪鳥さんの可愛い家具が！
優しい狩人さん！あたしの為
に、たぁくさん狩ってきて！
家の倉庫からくすねてきた
≪爆薬≫の材料をいっぱい
あげちゃうから！
おねがいね！

21894.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐
21894.description: This quest is for the HR 700 breakthrough trial. After you accept the trial from the Guild Master or the HR Trial board, please depart on the quest on your own.
21894.descriptionEn:
This quest is for the HR 700
breakthrough trial. After you
accept the trial from the Guild
Master or the HR Trial board,
please depart on the quest
on your own.
21894.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ７００突破試練のための
クエストです。ギルドマス
ターまたはＨＲ試練掲示板
から試練を受注した後、
お一人でクエストへ出発して
ください。

62125.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

55729.objectiveJp: チャチャブー２０匹の討伐

63124.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63124.description: A very powerful Basarios that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63124.descriptionEn:
An individual ≪Gravios≫ of
great strength that behaves
unlike the norm is in the New
Great Arena, and I want it hunted.
This request is open only to
hunters with Secret Art equipment
approved by the Guild.
Clear it splendidly and you will
earn still greater renown as a
master hunter.
63124.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪鎧竜≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

55044.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
55044.description: Gathering is fine work. You can get Setuna Visin and Tawara Cactus there. Lovely names, every one, no? Today I meant to gather at the usual spot, but a monster got in the way. Do something about it. I'll have rare gathering materials ready as thanks.
55044.descriptionEn:
Gathering is the best.
You can get ≪Setsuna Bijin≫
and ≪Tawara Cactus≫ there.
Great names, aren't they? Today
I meant to gather at my usual
spot, but a monster got in
the way. Do something about
that thing for me. I'll have
rare gathering mats for you.
55044.descriptionJp:
採取はいいぞ。
≪セツナビジン≫や≪タワラ
サボテン≫が手に入るからな。
どれも素敵な名前だろう？今
日もいつもの場所で採取しよ
うと思ったらモンスターに邪
魔されたんだ。あいつをなん
とかしてくれよ。お礼に貴重
な採取素材を用意しとくよ。

60095.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, is called the Phantom Beast for commanding lightning at will. Thanks to an adaptability that shrugs off harsh environments, elemental attacks seem to be of almost no use against it, so be careful.
60095.descriptionEn:
The ≪Kirin≫ is classed as an
Elder Dragon, and because it
wields lightning at will it is
called the ≪Phantom Beast≫.
Its adaptability shrugs off
harsh environments, and elements
barely work on it — be careful.
60095.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、雷を自在にあやつるさま
から≪幻獣≫と呼ばれる生き
物よ。過酷な環境もものとも
しない適応力から、属性の類
は、ほとんど通用しないみた
いだから気をつけてね。

50597.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
50597.description: A vicious Basarios and a Purple Gypceros have appeared. I want the stones they are said to carry, to display in my home! What say you? Will you hunt them for me?
50597.descriptionEn:
A ferocious Black Gravios and a
Purple Gypceros have shown up.
I want to get the stone they
say those two carry
and display it in my house!
How about it? Would you go
hunt them for me?
50597.descriptionJp:
凶暴な黒鎧竜と紫毒鳥が
現れた。俺はあいつらが
持っているといわれている
石を手に入れて
家に飾りたいんだ！
どうだ？狩ってきてくれ
ないか？

51086.description: You can obtain the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of the Transcendent armor Jin'O series. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
51086.descriptionEn:
Migrant Armor 'Zinogre Series'
— materials for crafting or
upgrading one piece are here.
It's a bargain quest, so
please give it a try!
51086.descriptionJp:
遷悠防具「ジンオウシリーズ」
の１部位分の生産・強化に
必要な素材が入手可能です。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

55310.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
55310.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Gasurabazura, the Raging Visage Wyvern. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55310.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Wrath
Wyvern ≪Gasurabazura≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
55310.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、怒貌竜
≪ガスラバズラ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

26723.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
26723.description: What, you just want a hard Bow? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
26723.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really
tough bow? Then I'll refine
some Argen Steel for you!
But the ore is hard to find,
and nasty monsters prowl
around. Go find it with spirit!
26723.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく硬い弓が
欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

50838.description: We present a request that lets you obtain more than usual of the materials needed to craft and upgrade the Floating Peak Wyvern's Hard Species armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please give it a try while you can!
50838.descriptionEn:
There is a daily limit on
accepting this, but here is a
request that yields more
Yamakurai materials than usual
for crafting Hardcore Armor.
Please take this chance and
give it a try!
50838.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、浮峰龍の≪剛種
防具≫の生産強化に必要な
素材を通常より多く入手でき
る依頼をご紹介します。
この機会にぜひチャレンジし
てください！

61255.description: Mm! Today, by my own arbitrary judgment, we hold a weapon-restricted special exercise! As long as you meet the conditions, equipment and what you bring are free! As a battle closer to the real thing, carving and so on are the same as Low Rank quests, but the rewards are Genki Drinks and coins!
61255.descriptionEn:
Mm! Today, by my own whim
and bias, I'm holding a
weapon-only special exercise!
Meet the terms and any gear
or items are allowed! To keep
it close to real combat, the
carves match Low Rank quests,
but the pay is ≪Energy Drink≫ and coins!
61255.descriptionJp:
うむ！今日は我輩の独断と偏
見で、武器限定の特別演習を
行う！条件さえ満たせば、装
備も持込みも自由だ！
より実戦に近い戦闘として、
剥ぎ取りなどは下位のクエス
トと同内容だが、報酬は≪元
気ドリンコ≫やコインだぞ！

54562.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54562.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54562.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54562.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

23404.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
23404.description: Sightings are coming in from the Snowy Mountains of a Doragyurosu more powerful than any so far. The Hunters Guild has decided to ask you hunters to investigate. Hunters who can cooperate, head for the Snowy Mountains at once.
23404.descriptionEn:
Reports are coming in of a
Doragyurosu in the Snowy
Mountains, far stronger than any
seen before.
The Hunters Guild has decided to
ask all of you to carry out a
survey.
Hunters able to help, please
head for the Snowy Mountains at
once.
23404.descriptionJp:
雪山にて、今までの比になら
ない強力な≪冥雷竜≫の目
撃情報が入ってきています。
ハンターズギルドでは、ハン
ターの皆様に調査をお願いす
る事となりました。
協力頂けるハンターの皆様は
至急、雪山に向かってくださ
い。

51011.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の狩猟
51011.description: Hunter's Festa, is it! Right! Let me recall those days and recreate it with layered armor. Hunt the Toridcless making trouble in the Deep Bamboo Forest and I might just share the materials. If it doesn't drop, try as many times as it takes!
51011.descriptionEn:
The ≪Hunters Festa≫, eh!
Alright! Let's recall those
days and recreate it with
some layered armor.
Hunt the ≪Toridcless≫ causing
trouble in the ≪Deep Bamboo
Forest≫ and I might just
share the materials.
If you don't get them, try
as many times as it takes!
51011.descriptionJp:
≪ハンターズフェスタ≫か！
よし！当時を思い出して、
いっちょ外装防具で再現して
みるか。
≪竹林奥部≫で悪さをしてい
る≪トリドクレス≫を狩猟し
てくれたら、素材を分けて
やらんでもない。
手に入らなかったら、何度で
も挑戦してくれ！

50420.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

53136.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
53136.description: A hunter thinking of changing from the Hope series armor to another set. How about the Quoiz series, available from this request? It has a stylish look like the Kukubo series, so I think you will like it.
53136.descriptionEn:
To hunters thinking of trading
their Hope Series armor for
something else.
How about the Quoiz Series
armor you can obtain from
this request?
It looks as stylish as the
Kukubo Series, so I am sure
you will like it.
53136.descriptionJp:
防具≪ホープシリーズ≫から
別の防具に変えたいと考えて
いるハンターさん。
この依頼で入手可能な防具
≪クオイズシリーズ≫はどう
ですか？
≪ククボシリーズ≫のように
おしゃれな見た目で気に入る
と思いますよ。

62165.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62165.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time I want you to explore the Desert. The tail crystal scorpion Akura Vashimu has also been confirmed in the very middle of the Desert. Slay that one too while you are there! I have prepared armor for it as well! Now off you go!
62165.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor! This
time you will explore the Desert
for me. In the very middle of
the Desert, the Tail Crystal
Scorpion ≪Akura Vashimu≫ has
been confirmed as well.
Slay that one too while you are
at it! I even prepared armor for
that purpose! Now go and do it!
62165.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
諸君に、砂漠を探索してきて
もらう。砂漠のど真ん中には
尾晶蠍≪アクラ・ヴァシム≫
も確認されているようだ。
ついでにそいつも討伐してき
たまえ！そのための防具も予
め用意してやったぞ！さあ頑
張ってこい！

61445.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン赤３個の納品
61445.description: 1st Place server, congratulations. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Red) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61445.descriptionEn:
[1st Place] Server,
congratulations.
We have prepared an exclusive
reward for hunters who cleared
the Guild Idaten Cup.
The more Red Hunter Coins you
deliver, the better your
chance at rare materials.
61445.descriptionJp:
【１位】サーバー、
おめでとうございます。
猟団対抗韋駄天杯をクリアさ
れたハンターに専用の報酬を
用意させていただきました。
ハンターコイン赤の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

26541.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26541.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26541.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、下位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

53180.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53180.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Bulldrome in the New Great Arena. Clear this request and you will earn a larger reward than usual, so do take it on and see it done.
53180.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's hunting life,
we have prepared a request to hunt
≪Bulldrome≫ in the New Great Arena.
If you complete this request you
will earn more reward money than
usual, so please take it on and
complete it.
53180.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、新大闘技場で≪大猪≫
を狩猟する依頼を用意しまし
た。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より多い報酬金が得られます
ので、ぜひ受注して依頼を
達成しましょう。

61570.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61570.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61570.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

23176.description: The Firestone I use for work is gone! Without that I cannot do business. Would you get me some? And while you are at it, it would help if you could slay the Bullfango too. If they were gone I could go and fetch it myself!
23176.descriptionEn:
The Gunpowder Rocks I use
for work have run out!
Without them I can't work.
Would you go get me some?
While you're at it — sorry to
ask — I'd be glad if you'd
also slay some Bullfango.
If those brutes were gone,
I could go get them myself!
23176.descriptionJp:
仕事に使うための火薬岩が
無くなっちまったんだ！
アレがねえと仕事にならん。
手に入れてきてくれんか？
ついでと言ってはなんだが、
ブルファンゴの討伐も頼める
とありがたい。
奴らさえいなければ、俺が
直接取りに行けるからな！

51061.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, a Thousand Blade Wyvern, Seregios, was newly found in the desert. According to the surveyor who encountered it, it performs behavior never observed before. Take the greatest care with the monster's movements!
51061.descriptionEn:
With a Transcendent Species
about, we pushed surveys across
the land, and in the Desert the
Thousand Blade Wyvern
≪Seregios≫ has been newly found.
Reports from the surveyor who
met it say it performs behavior
never observed before. Take the
greatest care around it!
51061.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、砂漠に
千刃竜≪セルレギオス≫が
新たに発見されました。
遭遇した調査員の報告による
と、今まで観測されていない
行動を行うとのことです。
モンスターの行動にはくれ
ぐれも注意して下さい！

62625.description: This is the qualifying quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained from carving or from the clear reward.
62625.descriptionEn:
This is the qualifying quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained from carving
or from the clear reward.
62625.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選クエスト
です。モンスターの剥ぎ取り
とクリア報酬で対象
モンスターの素材は入手
できません。

62732.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62732.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62732.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

63406.description: Nyahaha! An executive of the Dark Cat Pack slaps a quest right at you, meow! The pride of those mocked as the weakest is terrifying, meow. If you complete it, in praise of your courage I might give you a Dark Cat Pack Badge, meow!
63406.descriptionEn:
Nyahaha! A request straight
from a Dark Cat Gang executive!
The pride of those mocked as
the weakest is a terrifying
thing, meow. If you manage to
clear this request, I might
praise your courage with a
≪Dark Cat Gang Badge≫, meow!
63406.descriptionJp:
ニャハハ！闇猫団幹部から
直々にクエストを叩きつけて
やるニャ！最弱と散々こけに
された者達の意地はとっても
恐ろしいものニャ。もし、
依頼を達成できたら、
勇気をたたえ≪闇猫団バッチ≫
をくれてやってもいいニャ！

54470.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
54470.description: For the survey, would you hunt a Purple Gypceros for me? Ah, yes, I forgot something important. Be sure to break the crest. It is extremely dangerous and gets in the way of the survey. A hunt alone will not count. Be sure to break the parts!
54470.descriptionEn:
For a survey, would you go
hunt a ≪Purple Gypceros≫?
Oh right, I nearly forgot
something important. Be sure
to break its crest.
It's extremely dangerous and
gets in the way of the survey.
Hunting alone won't be accepted,
so make sure you break the
parts, got it?
54470.descriptionJp:
調査のために、≪紫毒鳥≫の
狩猟をしてきてくれないか。
そうだ、大事なことを忘れて
いた。必ずトサカの破壊をし
ておくれ。
非常に危険で調査の邪魔
になるんだ。狩猟のみでは
認めないからな。
必ず部位破壊をしておいて
くれよ！

23554.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
23554.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23554.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23554.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

23685.description: Hunter who would master the hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
23685.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Hammer, show me the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
Hunt it splendidly and you will
earn far more reward than your
daily effort would ever bring
you. Now go and prove it!
23685.descriptionJp:
鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

50239.description: My first request, so I am nervous. There is a musician I simply must tell music lovers about. They are so cool, truly. But I am too shy, so I would be glad if you would film them for me instead. I will cheer from the shadows! Once you meet them, spread the word to everyone!
50239.descriptionEn:
This is my first request, so I'm
nervous. There's a musician I
really want music lovers to hear.
He's cool, seriously.
But I'm too shy, so I'd be glad
if you could take photos instead.
I'll be cheering from the shadows!
If you meet him, tell everyone!
50239.descriptionJp:
初めての依頼で緊張するなぁ。
音楽好きな人にぜひ教えたい
ミュージシャンがいるんだ。
クールだよ、ほんと。
でも恥ずかしいから代わりに
撮ってきてくれたらうれしい。
影ながら応援するよ！
会えたらみんなに広めてよね！

51005.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
51005.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
51005.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, show us the skill you
have honed against the ≪Ice Fox
Wyvern≫ in the Arena! If you
succeed in hunting it, you will
earn even more rewards than your
daily efforts bring.
51005.descriptionJp:
銃槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26661.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26661.description: This hunting skill quest is the slaying of the Hypnocatrice Variant. How about hunters polishing each other's skill together!
26661.descriptionEn:
This Hunting Skill Quest is
for slaying the
≪Hypnocatrice Variant≫.
Why not hone your skills
against fellow hunters!
26661.descriptionJp:
今回の狩猟技クエストは、
≪ヒプノック変種≫
の討伐となります。
ハンター同士で、腕を磨き
合ってはいかがでしょうか！

28036.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
28036.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering materials from the Dancing Thunder Wyvern, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28036.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters,
why not pass your hunting
technique on to the young
hunters of your Guild? This
time we're splashing out on
≪Berukyurosu≫ materials! Get
strong together and liven up
your Guild. Clearing it with a
Secret Art book holder and a
non-holder earns more standing.
28036.descriptionJp:
熟練ハンターの皆さん。
その狩猟技術を猟団の若い
ハンターへ伝えてみません
か？今回は、≪舞雷竜≫の
素材を大奮発！一緒に強く
なって、猟団を盛り上げて
いってください。秘伝書所持、
未所持のハンターで達成する
と、ギルドからの評価が
より得られますよ。

12070.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

23559.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
23559.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23559.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23559.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

26375.objectiveJp: 特産キノコキムチ１個の納品

61001.objectiveJp: ティガレックス２頭の討伐

50041.description: Reports have reached us of an unidentified monster on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. Time is short, so this is a request to slay it quickly, though to keep the damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also be counted. I call for hunters who hold the secret arts and will stand against this unprecedented crisis!
50041.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that
an unidentified monster is
rampaging in the Ancient Tower.
As every moment counts, this is
a short-time slaying request,
but to keep the damage to a
minimum, we will accept a mere
repel as well.
We seek hunters with a Secret
Art Tome to face this crisis!
50041.descriptionJp:
古塔で未確認のモンスターが
暴れているとの報告が届きま
した。一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

54496.description: The new processing technique Refinement has brought benefits such as acquiring powerful skills and widening the choice of armor. The Guild has therefore arranged trade with other bases so that it can manage great quantities of materials. If you complete this request, we will provide those materials.
54496.descriptionEn:
The new crafting technique 'Refining'
has granted benefits such as
stronger skills and a wider
choice of armor.
The Guild has therefore arranged
trade with other Bases so that
large amounts of materials can
be managed. If you complete this
request, we will provide them.
54496.descriptionJp:
新たな加工技術『精錬』によ
り強力なスキルの獲得や、
防具の選択の幅を広げるなど
の恩恵を得られました。
そこでギルドは大量の素材を
管理できるよう、他の拠点と
の交易を整備しました。
この依頼を達成いただければ、
それら素材を提供いたします。

54405.description: The survey of the flower field is proceeding smoothly, and many new materials have been discovered. Most of what has been found can apparently be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Among Ｇ-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous lands, quite a few may take an interest.
54405.descriptionEn:
The survey of the Flower Field
is going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.
54405.descriptionJp:
花畑の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

60572.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Inagami. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only Origin weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60572.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters pit their skill!
The target is ≪Inagami≫!
Join your Guild comrades
and achieve the objective.
This contest is won by
teamwork, so aim for a top
rank! Also, Origin Species
weapons only this time!
Choose your weapon carefully!
60572.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪イナガミ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回は始種武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

55083.objectiveJp: イビルジョー２頭の討伐
55083.description: The Guild has decided to call them 'the Starving Deviljho'. They are no ordinary Deviljho. They have been driven to the limit in confinement without meat. Brave hunter. If you succeed in slaying one, I will surely grant you materials for the Guild's secret armor.
55083.descriptionEn:
The Guild has decided to give them
the name "the Famished Deviljho".
They are no ordinary Deviljho.
They have been shut in without
any meat and driven to the limit.
Hunters of courage, hear me.
If you succeed in slaying one,
the Guild will surely grant you
the armor materials it treasures
deep in its vaults.
55083.descriptionJp:
ギルドでは、ヤツらの呼称を
「餓え喰らうイビルジョー」
とすることにした。
ヤツらは唯の恐暴竜ではない。
閉じ込め肉を与えず極限まで
追い込んである。
勇気のあるハンターよ。
もしも討伐に成功したならば
ギルド秘蔵の防具の素材を必
ず授けよう。

55952.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Midogaron through its first upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Great Sword, Long Sword, Lance, Hunting Horn, Tonfa, Magnet Spike, or Light Gun. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
55952.descriptionEn:
Supremacy Midogaron Weapon
Craft once to receive the
materials for the first
upgrade plus Porta Card
Sakura for Gz. Available
weapon types: Great Sword,
Long Sword, Lance, Hunting
Horn, Tonfa, Magnet Spike
and Light Bowgun.
Please put this to good use.
55952.descriptionJp:
辿異種ミドガロンの辿異武器
１つの生産から１段階目の
強化に必要な素材とＧｚ分の
ポルタカード桜が入手できま
す。生産できる武器種は、
大剣、太刀、槍、狩猟笛、
穿龍棍、磁斬鎚、軽銃の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

62248.description: Hmm. I smell it, I smell it! Those Rathians I saw in the jungle have the smell of treasure about them. Hunt those Rathians and the troublesome Yian Kut-Kus, every last one! Hm, the weather is bad now, you say? What is a little thing like that, get going!
62248.descriptionEn:
Mm, I smell it, I smell it!
Those Rathian I saw in the
Jungle... their treasure
smells ripe for the taking.
Hunt every last Rathian and
those pesky Yian Kut-Ku too!
What, the weather is bad?
That's nothing at all, so get
going and don't dawdle!
62248.descriptionJp:
フム。におう、におうぞ！
密林でみかけたあの雌火竜
どもから、お宝のにおいが
するわい。雌火竜どもと、
邪魔な怪鳥どもを、残らず
狩猟してくるのじゃ！ん、
いまは天候が悪いじゃと？
あの程度がなんじゃ、とっと
と行ってくるのじゃ！

62808.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
62808.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62808.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62808.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

61436.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
61436.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over three at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
61436.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want a ≪Paw Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand you three at once.
Bring 3 ≪Quest Completion
Certificates≫ with you, and
come alone. Well then, I'll be
waiting in the Canyon.
61436.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は３枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

61023.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
61023.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
61023.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
61023.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

61072.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
61072.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament finals. The target monster's materials cannot be obtained by carving or from clear rewards in this quest.
61072.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for the
VS. Quest Champion Tournament
finals.
The target monster's materials
cannot be obtained by carving
or from clear rewards
in this quest.
61072.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの決勝練習用
クエストです。
モンスターの剥ぎ取りと
クリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

60247.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
60247.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Greadmos. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks!
60247.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
The target this time is
≪Gureadomosu≫!
Taking on a monster all alone
is truly admirable! Best
yourself and win a top place!
60247.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪グレアドモス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！

28078.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
28078.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28078.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
28078.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

28032.description: Skilled hunters, why not pass your hunting technique on to the young hunters of your party? This time we are offering Taikun Zamuza materials, and plenty of them! Grow stronger together and liven up your party. Completing this with one hunter who holds a Secret Scroll and one who does not earns even more credit from the guild.
28032.descriptionEn:
Veteran hunters, would you
pass your hunting skills
on to the Guild's young
hunters? This time, plenty
of ≪Taikun Zamuza≫
materials! Get stronger
together and liven up the
Guild. Clearing with both
Tome holders and non-holders
earns extra Guild credit.
28032.descriptionJp:
熟練ハンターの皆さん。
その狩猟技術を猟団の若い
ハンターへ伝えてみません
か？今回は、≪多殻蟹≫の
素材を大奮発！一緒に強く
なって、猟団を盛り上げて
いってください。秘伝書所持、
未所持のハンターで達成する
と、ギルドからの評価が
より得られますよ。

55027.description: I came to gather Teostra materials at the young lady's request, but I got beaten back. At this rate I'm out of business! So I've put out a slaying request with special conditions. The reward should match any request! Please, hunter! Save me!
55027.descriptionEn:
I came to gather Teostra
materials for a young lady,
but I got beaten half to
death. I'm ruined otherwise!
So I posted a slaying request
with special conditions.
The reward should beat any
other request! Please, hunter,
help me out here!
55027.descriptionJp:
お嬢様に頼まれてテオ・テス
カトルの素材を集めに来たん
だが、返り討ちに遭っちまっ
た。このままじゃ廃業だ！
そこで、特別な条件で討伐の
依頼を出しておいた。
報酬の量はどの依頼にも負け
ないはずだ！頼むよハンター
さん！俺を助けてくれ！

50831.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
50831.description: A dangerous monster seems to be approaching the area around Mezeporta. Stop the monster's advance before the damage spreads. If you slay it splendidly, we will provide materials used to upgrade some Heavenly Storm weapons and Conquest armor, in preparation for the advance to come.
50831.descriptionEn:
A dangerous monster appears
to be approaching the area
around Mezeporuta.
Before the damage spreads,
please stop the monster's
advance. Should you slay it
handsomely, we will provide
materials used to upgrade
some Tenran weapons and
Zenith armor, in case of future attacks.
50831.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に危険なモン
スターが近づいてきている
ようです。
被害が拡大する前に、モンス
ターの進撃を止めてください。
見事討伐していただけました
ら、今後の進撃に備え、一部
の天嵐武具や覇種防具強化に
使用する素材を提供いたし
ます。

50673.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50673.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Artela F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50673.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of
the ≪Tenran Armor≫ Alter F
series. To accept the quest
you will need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that failing
the quest will consume
your ≪Superior Ticket≫.
50673.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
アルテラＦシリーズの１部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21022.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
21022.description: Diablos is a monster whose ferocity in the desert ecosystem stands in a class of its own! Caught by its charge, you would take damage you could never recover from. Break even just the horns and I will pay a bonus!
21022.descriptionEn:
≪Diablos≫ is a monster of
unmatched violence in the
desert ecosystem! Get hit
by its charge and you'd
take damage you'd never
recover from. Break even
one horn and we'll pay!
21022.descriptionJp:
≪ディアブロス≫は砂漠の
生態系において、他の生物と
は別格の強暴さを誇るモンス
ターです！突進にはねられた
ら再起不能のダメージを受け
てしまうでしょう。角だけで
も、折れば報酬を払います！

53144.description: We have prepared a quest to craft the Siluk Series. Hunt Rathian and Brook and you can obtain production and strengthening materials for one part. Please make good use of it!
53144.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
for crafting the
"Shirukku Series" armor.
Hunt a Rathian and a Brook
to get enough materials to
craft and upgrade one piece
of the set.
Please make good use of it!
53144.descriptionJp:
「シルックシリーズ」を生
産するためのクエストを準
備しました。
リオレイアとブルックを狩
猟することで、１部位分の
生産素材と強化素材が入手
できます。
ぜひお役立てください！

60720.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60720.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60720.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60720.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62527.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟

62204.description: I want to carry out research on the Barbarian Wyvern. Capture it, and break some of its parts so that it is easier to study. I have no interest in materials, so if anything interesting turns up, you may take it once the research is done. Capturing it without breaking any parts will count as a failure.
62204.descriptionEn:
I want to study the Taikun Zamuza.
Please capture one, and break
some parts so it is easier to
study. I am not interested in
the materials, so if you find
anything fascinating, you may
keep it after the research.
If you capture it without any
part breaks, it counts as a failure.
62204.descriptionJp:
蛮竜の研究を行いたいんだ。
何とか、捕獲と、研究しやす
いように一部部位の破壊を
頼むよ。素材には興味が無い
から、面白い素材が見つかっ
たら、研究の後に持っていっ
ていいよ。部位破壊無しで
捕獲したら失敗とさせてもら
うよ。

50279.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
50279.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50279.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50279.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55519.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55519.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55519.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

55268.description: To those of you who have upgraded the Flogada G series to LV7! We have prepared a quest that lets you obtain in one go the upgrade materials for 1 piece of the Flogada GF series armor! Clear the quest 5 times and upgrade every piece!
55268.descriptionEn:
To those who upgraded the
Frogada G series to Lv7! We
prepared a quest that gives
upgrade materials for one
piece of Frogada GF armor at
once! Clear it five times and
upgrade every piece!
55268.descriptionJp:
フロガダＧシリーズをＬＶ７
まで強化できたあなたへ！
防具「フロガダGFシリーズ」
１部位分の強化素材が一気に
入手できるクエストを用意し
ました！クエストを５回クリ
アして全部位を強化しよう！

55205.description: A powerful individual Kirin has appeared! There is a legend that anything exposed to the lightning it wields regains its past beauty, no matter how old and rusted. Take the Rusted Mirror I am handing out and go investigate the legend!
55205.descriptionEn:
A powerful Kirin has appeared!
Legend says anything bathed in
its lightning regains past
beauty, however old and rusty
the antique may be. Take the
"Rusted Mirror" I am handing
out and set off to investigate
the legend!
55205.descriptionJp:
キリンの強力な個体が現れま
した！その操る雷光にさらさ
れた物は、どんなに古く錆び
た骨董品でも過去の美しさ
を取り戻す、という伝承があ
ります。私がお配りしている
「錆びた鏡」を持って、伝承
の調査に向かってください！

60807.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
60807.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
60807.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
60807.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

23454.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hunting Horn Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Hunting Horn Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Hunting Horn Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23454.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hunting Horn Ribbon - Intro≫ x100
≪Hunting Horn Ribbon - Mid≫ x165
≪Hunting Horn Ribbon - Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest, a
≪Secret Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please beware.
23454.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪狩猟笛綬・序≫１００個
≪狩猟笛綬・中≫１６５個
≪狩猟笛綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

50221.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
50221.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!
50221.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
のだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

54237.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54237.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54237.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

26074.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26074.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26074.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

50922.description: We present a request that lets you efficiently obtain the materials needed to craft Hard Species weapons from the Black Piercing Wyvern. It is a bargain of a quest, so please give it a try!
50922.descriptionEn:
A request that lets you get
the materials for the Black
Piercing Dragon's ≪Hardcore
Weapon≫ efficiently. A great
deal, so please try it out!
50922.descriptionJp:
黒穿竜の≪剛種武器≫生産に
必要な素材を効率よく入手で
きる依頼をご紹介します。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

62797.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62797.description: You have come into your own, hunter. Is it not time to replace that armor? You will receive the materials for 1 of 5 kinds of armor. Do give it a try! Note that it cannot be taken on consecutively, so be warned.
62797.descriptionEn:
You've become quite a skilled
hunter. Isn't it about time you
got yourself new armor?
You will obtain one of five
types of armor materials.
Please do give it a try!
However, you cannot accept it
consecutively, so please be
careful.
62797.descriptionJp:
凄腕になったハンターさん。
そろそろ防具を新調しては
いかがですか？
５種類の防具の素材のうち、
どれか１種類が手に入ります。
ぜひ、挑戦してみて下さい！
ただし、連続して受注する
ことはできませんので、
ご注意ください。

60434.description: I do not know where you heard this, but for a shady job there is no rescue for failure, understood? And have the goods ready. The number needed is as stated. After that, you work alone on site. In a group, some smart aleck always tries something.
60434.descriptionEn:
No idea where you heard this,
but there's no saving a
failure on this job, got it?
You're ready with the goods?
The number needed is as
stated. After that, you work
alone out there. When folk
team up, they cut corners.
60434.descriptionJp:
どこでこの話を聞きつけたか
は知らんが、ヤバい話には失
敗の救済など一切ないぞ？
ブツの用意もいいだろうな？
必要なブツの数は条件通りだ。
あとは、現地で１人で働いて
もらう。徒党を組むとナメた
真似するヤツが出るんでな。

54721.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の狩猟
54721.description: The ecology of Gasurabazura is gradually being revealed. It seems gentle normally, but anger brings out its hidden savage nature. A rare monster with a very dangerous dual nature. Please investigate with care.
54721.descriptionEn:
The ecology of Gasurabazura
is gradually coming to light.
Normally it seems docile, but
anger brings out the savage
nature it keeps hidden away.
A rare monster with a truly
dangerous two-sided nature.
Please take every care when
you conduct the survey.
54721.descriptionJp:
ガスラバズラの生態が、
徐々に解明されてきました。
普段は大人しいようですが、
怒りの感情により、隠れて
いた凶暴な本性を現すよう
です。非常に危険な二面性を
持つ珍しいモンスターです。
注意して調査をお願いし
ます。

12039.objectiveJp: 白水晶の原石３個の納品

26307.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
26307.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26307.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26307.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

53147.description: The Mysterious Hero Sasatto, protector of lovers' love and peace! It has been a while! The marriage-seeking monster that hates June brides is on a rampage! It is saying anyone will do! Now, hunters! To protect the bright family plans of lovers! Defeat the marriage-seeking monster!
53147.descriptionEn:
The champion of love and
peace, Sasatto, is back!
A marriage-hunting monster
that hates June brides is on
a rampage! It says anyone
will do! Come, hunters!
To protect the bright family
plans of lovers everywhere!
Defeat the marriage monster!
53147.descriptionJp:
恋人達の愛と平和を守る
怪傑ササットだ！久々だ！
ジューンブライドを憎悪する
婚活モンスターが大暴走だ！
誰でもいいとか言ってるぞ！
さあ、ハンター諸君！
恋人達の明るい家族計画を
守るために！
婚活モンスターを倒すのだ！

26077.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26077.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26077.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

61745.description: 'Fishing.' It is a lonely hunt, facing the fish in silence. A hunter does more than slay monsters. Fishing is a fine hunt in its own right. Why not aim for the path of the angler, and even of the artisan? If you do, deliver 50 Spring Night Carp on your own!
61745.descriptionEn:
"Fishing"
It is a solitary hunt, in which
you quietly face the fish.
A hunter does not only slay
monsters. Fishing is a fine
hunt in its own right.
Why not aim for the path of the
angler, and even a master?
If you do, deliver 50 Springnight
Carp all on your own!
61745.descriptionJp:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
ハンターはモンスターを狩る
だけじゃない。釣りだって立
派な狩猟だ。
釣師への道、しかも職人を
目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人で春夜
鯉５０匹の納品だ！

23714.description: The Variant Species Baruragaru has appeared once more. The menace of its developed head is dreadful, and its blood drinking with the tongue seems to have grown more vicious. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
23714.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Baruragaru≫ has
appeared again. The menace of
its developed head is
tremendous, and its
blood-draining tongue seems
more vicious. Survey with care.
23714.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪バルラガル≫が再び
現れました。
発達した頭部の威圧感は
凄まじく、舌による吸血行動
はより凶悪になっている様で
す。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

58088.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58088.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58088.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58088.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

53220.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
53220.description: The Horuk, who seem to admire musicians, will surely be satisfied by the performance of this weapon! Play to your heart's content and please the Horuk! The Horuk will surely return the favour.
53220.descriptionEn:
Even the Hypnocatrice, who
seems to admire musicians,
should be pleased by this
weapon's performance!
Play to your heart's content
and delight it! The bird will
surely return the favor.
53220.descriptionJp:
ミュージシャンへの憧れを抱
いていると思われるホルクも
この武器の演奏によって満足
してくれるだろう！
存分に演奏してホルクを喜ば
せてほしい！ホルクはきっと
好意に応えてくれるだろう。

21242.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ２頭の討伐
21242.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21242.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21242.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

55052.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
55052.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Merit (Beginning) x５０, Long Sword Merit (Middle) x６０, Long Sword Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
55052.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Long Sword Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Long Sword Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest, GR 500 or
higher is required, so please
take note.
55052.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪太刀勲・序≫５０個
≪太刀勲・中≫６０個
≪太刀勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

26411.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26411.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26411.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

50234.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
50234.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.
50234.descriptionJp:
どうやら修復に必要な地図の
断片を集めてくれたようだな。
ちょっと枚数が多いけど、
私なら元に戻せるだろう。
集めた断片をそこのボックス
に入れといてくれ。
作業が終わったら複製した地
図をやろう。武具工房に持っ
ていくと喜ばれるかもな。

26241.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の狩猟
26241.description: So a subspecies of the already rare Monoblos has appeared, has it. To go beyond proving yourself first-rate and make your name ring out, you must hunt it alone! Prepare yourself and take up the hunt!
26241.descriptionEn:
A white one-horned wyvern, no
less: a Monoblos subspecies, a
truly rare sight, has appeared.
To go beyond proving yourself
first-rate and make your name
resound, you must "hunt it
alone". Steel yourself and go!
26241.descriptionJp:
白き一角竜とはこれまた希少
性の高いモノブロスの亜種が
現れたようじゃな。
一流の証明を超えて、己の
名声を響かせるには、やはり
『１人で狩猟』することじゃ
心して狩猟に挑むがよい！

62980.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62980.description: We have reports that Kushala Daora is currently flying toward Mezeporuta. Hunters confident in their skill should meet it at the interception base and slay it, making use of the abundant supplies and interception weapons.
62980.descriptionEn:
Reports have come in that a
Kushala Daora is flying toward
Mezeporuta right now.
Hunters confident in their skill
should intercept it at the Base,
and use the plentiful supplies
and the interception weapons to slay it.
62980.descriptionJp:
現在、メゼポルタに向けて、
風翔龍が飛来中との報告が
ありました。
腕に自信のあるハンターは、
≪迎撃拠点≫で迎え撃ち、
豊富な支給品と、迎撃兵器を
利用して、討伐してください。

23706.objectiveJp: ボガバドルム１頭の討伐
23706.description: Bogabadorumu has appeared again. Please investigate, taking full care against its more powerful attacks and the explosions that come with them.
23706.descriptionEn:
≪Bogabador≫ has
appeared again.
Please investigate with
great care for its stronger
attacks and the blasts they
set off.
23706.descriptionJp:
≪ボガバドルム≫が
再び現れました。
より強力になった攻撃や、そ
れに伴い発生する爆発に十分
に気を付けて調査をお願いし
ます。

50126.description: To make the event a success, I want you to help inspect Shiojima. We have information that a large monster is there, so prepare well before you go. To prevent major trouble, please help.
50126.descriptionEn:
To make the event a success,
help me inspect Tidal Island.
We have reports that a large
monster is present there, so
prepare thoroughly before
you set out. I ask for your
cooperation to prevent any
serious trouble in advance.
50126.descriptionJp:
イベントを成功させるために、
潮島の視察を手伝ってほしい。
大型モンスターがいるという
情報が入っているので、
向かう前にはしっかりと
準備をしておいてくれ。
大きなトラブルを未然に防ぐ
ため、ぜひ協力を頼む。

63078.description: I want to dress up Guku for its big day, but I only have pebbles. Sorry, would you gather materials for me instead? No one would want them, but take these pebbles. Use them if they seem useful.
63078.descriptionEn:
