I want to dress up Gook's big
day all nice and pretty, but
all I have are pebbles.
Sorry, but could you gather
the materials in my place?
Nobody will want them, but
take these pebbles anyway.
Use them if they help.
63078.descriptionJp:
グークの晴れ舞台を綺麗に
着飾ってあげたいんだが、
石ころしか持っていないんだ。
すまないが、私の代わりに
素材を集めてくれないか？
欲しがる奴はいないだろうが、
この石ころは渡しておくよ。
使えそうだったら使ってくれ。

61558.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟

21674.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証３枚の納品
21674.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. This time I will hand over six at once. Bring three Quest Completion Proofs and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21674.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
If you want a ≪Pawprint Coin≫,
sorry, but I need you to come
to the Canyon. This time I'll
hand over six of them at once.
Bring exactly 3 ≪Quest
Completion Certificates≫ and
come alone, got it? Well then,
I'll be waiting in the Canyon.
21674.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。今度は６枚まとめて
お渡しいたしますよ。
≪クエスト達成証≫３枚を
ちゃんと持って、１人で来て
くれよ。では、峡谷で待って
いるからね。

54142.description: From time to time something like an orb is found inside a monster's body. It can be used as material for all kinds of gear, and demand for it has been rising lately. Clear this request and I will give you one of those orbs, a Stout Orb, as your reward.
54142.descriptionEn:
Sometimes a gem-like thing
is found inside a monster's
body. It can be used as
material for all sorts of
gear, and demand for it has
risen lately. Clear this
request and I'll give you one
of those gems, a ≪Grand Gem≫,
as your reward.
54142.descriptionJp:
モンスターの体の中から、
時折玉のようなものが
見つかることがあるんです。
さまざまな武具の素材に
使うことができるもので、
最近需要が高まっています。
今回の依頼を達成できたら、
その玉のひとつ≪壮玉≫を
報酬として差し上げます。

53316.description: I am a collector of equipment. Weapons and armor shine only when used. A mere pretty piece has no meaning. Do you not think so? I will lend you arms from my collection that shaped an era, so hunt with them. If you need a helping hand, try clearing the sub-target.
53316.descriptionEn:
I am an equipment collector.
Gear only shines when used.
A mere pretty piece has no
meaning. Don't you agree?
I will lend you a weapon
that once defined an era
from my collection, so go
hunt with it. If you need
a hand, try clearing the
sub-targets.
53316.descriptionJp:
私は装備コレクター。
武具は使われてこそ輝く。
ただの美品に意味は無い。
そうは思わないかね？
私のコレクションから
一時代を築いた武具を
お貸しするので、これで
狩猟して頂きたい。
助力が必要なら、サブター
ゲットをクリアしてみてくれ。

50077.objectiveJp: イャンクック２頭の狩猟
50077.description: Good news for novice hunters! We will help you craft Kukubo armor, which is tremendously effective for low-rank hunters! Obtain a Smooth Vertebra on this quest and try crafting Kukubo!
50077.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you rookie
hunters!
We'll help you craft "Kukubo",
armor that works wonders for
Low Rank hunters!
Get a "Smooth Vertebra" in
this quest and try crafting
the "Kukubo" set!
50077.descriptionJp:
駆出しハンターのみなさんに
朗報です！
下位ハンターに絶大な効果を
発揮する防具「ククボ」の
生産の手助けをいたします！
今クエストで「滑らかな椎骨」
を入手して「ククボ」を生産
してみてください！

62622.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

55209.description: We are continuing our survey of the Rukodiora. Breaking its parts is not required, but it would be a joy if you did! Hunters, I ask for your kind cooperation!
55209.descriptionEn:
We continue our survey of
Rukodiora.
Breaking its parts is not
required, but we would be
delighted if you did!
Hunters, thank you in
advance for your help!
55209.descriptionJp:
ルコディオラの調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

54628.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54628.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54628.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

62624.description: This is a trial quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Enjoy Forward.3's new monsters to the fullest!
62624.descriptionEn:
This is a trial quest for the
VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Enjoy Forward.3's new
monsters to the fullest!
62624.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの体験クエスト
です。
フォワード.３の新モンスター
を存分にお楽しみください！

55123.objectiveJp: ジンオウガ亜種１頭の狩猟
55123.description: I hear a monster called the Stygian Zinogre has been sighted lately. I have a weakness for materials from new monsters. I simply must have them. Would you get them for me? In return I will share Stygian Zinogre Dragonfell Fur.
55123.descriptionEn:
I hear a monster called the
Stygian Zinogre was sighted
lately. I simply adore new
monster materials, you see.
I must have them. Would you
fetch some in my stead? In
return I'll share ≪Stygian
Zinogre Dragonbane Fur≫.
55123.descriptionJp:
なんでも最近、獄狼竜と呼ば
れるモンスターが目撃された
そうじゃないか。私は新しい
モンスターの素材に目がなく
てね。どうしても欲しいんだ。
私に代わって取ってきてくれ
ないかね。お礼に≪獄狼竜の
滅龍毛≫を分けてあげよう。

61247.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. All of them are highly difficult, and some restrict your equipment, so please take note.
61247.descriptionEn:
We've prepared quests that
issue tickets needed for
≪Hardcore Quests≫.
All of them are highly
difficult, and some even
restrict your equipment,
so please take note.
61247.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
いずれも高難易度のクエスト
となっている上、一部、装備
を制限させていただくことも
ありますのでご注意ください。

53090.description: The boss had a dream last night, it seems. He says he heard a voice: offer up 2 kinds of eggs, and I shall bestow new power. He cannot stop thinking about it, and wants one more egg! He wants decorations too. I am holding a reward from the boss for whoever presents them!
53090.descriptionEn:
The Boss had a dream last
night. He heard a voice:
"Offer two kinds of eggs.
Do so,
and I shall grant you new
power." He can't stop
thinking about it, and wants
one more egg! He wants an
ornament too. I'm holding a
reward from the Boss for you!
53090.descriptionJp:
ボスが昨晩夢を見たそうだ。
「二種の卵を捧げよ。
さすれば
新たな力を授けよう」
と聞こえたらしい。
気になって仕方ないらしく
卵をもう一つ、ご所望だ！
飾りも欲しいとのことだ。
献上者にはボスから
褒美を預かっているぞ！

53263.objectiveJp: チャチャブー２０匹の討伐
53263.description: A group of Chachabu has appeared on Tide Island. Our survey shows they are digging up treasure that sleeps beneath the island. Unknown treasure could prove invaluable for research, so drive them off at once and bring the treasure back.
53263.descriptionEn:
A group of Chachabu has
appeared on Tidal Island.
Our survey shows they are
digging up treasure sleeping
beneath the island.
Unknown treasure could be
precious for research, so drive
them off at once and bring
the treasure back.
53263.descriptionJp:
潮島にチャチャブーの集団が
出現しました。
調査の結果、彼らは島の地下
に眠る財宝を発掘している
ようです。
未知の財宝は貴重な研究対象
となり得るため、至急彼らを
追い払い、財宝を持ち帰って
ください。

55272.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の討伐
55272.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55272.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55272.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23438.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23438.description: This quest yields the following materials. Long Sword Merit (Beginning) x５０, Long Sword Merit (Middle) x６０, Long Sword Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23438.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Long Sword Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Long Sword Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Long Sword Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest, GR 500 or
higher is required, so please
take note.
23438.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪太刀勲・序≫５０個
≪太刀勲・中≫６０個
≪太刀勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

107.description: A Daimyo Hermitaur has taken up residence in a desert oasis, so I want you to go and slay it! Hermitaur are breeding in great numbers too, so watch out! If you get surrounded, run!
107.descriptionEn:
A Daimyo Hermitaur has made
its nest in a Desert oasis,
so I want you to slay it!
Hermitaurs are breeding in
huge numbers too, so watch
out! Run if you get surrounded!
107.descriptionJp:
砂漠のオアシスにダイミョウ
ザザミが巣くっているので
それを討伐してきて欲しい！
ヤオザミも大量に繁殖している
らしいので、注意しろよ！
囲まれたら逃げるんだぞ！

62903.description: Among the Violent Wyverns, Abiorugu, confirmed in the swamp, an extremely ferocious and powerful individual seems to have appeared. Because it is very dangerous, this is an investigation and hunting request limited to hunters we approve. Face it fully prepared.
62903.descriptionEn:
Among the Violent Wyverns
≪Abiorugu≫ confirmed in the
Swamp, an extremely ferocious and
powerful individual has appeared.
As it is very dangerous, this
survey and hunt is limited to
hunters we approve of. Please
face it fully prepared.
62903.descriptionJp:
沼地で確認されている
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫の中でも
極めて狂暴で、強力な個体が
現れたそうです。
大変危険なため我々が認める
ハンターさん限定での調査、
狩猟依頼となります。
万全の態勢で挑んでください。

26696.description: Many monsters are breeding in great numbers in the Jungle! We have asked hunters everywhere for help with the hunt, but the truth is there are too many. So we want to recruit those who can set out on this hunt with up to 2 people. I especially recommend it to those aiming to rank up quickly.
26696.descriptionEn:
Monsters are breeding out of
control in the Jungle!
We have asked hunters all over
for help with the hunt, but the
truth is there are simply too
many of them. So we want
hunters who can head out in
pairs. I warmly recommend it to
anyone aiming to rank up fast.
26696.descriptionJp:
密林で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

26109.description: Kirin, which belongs to the elder dragon class, has no fixed habitat and is so few in number that it is called the Phantom Beast. If you go to the Snowy Mountains, please plant our Guild Flag at the summit.
26109.descriptionEn:
≪Kirin≫ belongs to the Elder Dragon
species, has no fixed habitat, and
because its numbers are so small is
a creature also called the
≪Phantom Beast≫.
If you go to the Snowy Mountains,
please plant our ≪Guild Flag≫
at the summit♪
26109.descriptionJp:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物です。雪山に行くなら山頂
にウチの≪ギルドフラッグ≫
を立ててきてくださいね♪

60446.description: Hunters who use bowguns, this is what you have been waiting for. A support quest from the Guild! Each one is an odd job, but we will put out useful rewards for each you clear. It may be especially good for a rookie gunner watching their purse!
60446.descriptionEn:
Bowgun hunters, we know you've
been waiting. This is a
support quest from the Guild!
The jobs are odd chores, but
each clear brings useful
rewards. It might be especially
good for rookie gunners looking
to save money!
60446.descriptionJp:
ボウガンをお使いのハンター
の皆さんお待ちかね。ギルド
からの支援クエストです！
それぞれ雑用的なお仕事にな
りますが、達成ごとに有用な
報酬を出させていただきます。
特に駆け出しのガンナーさん
の節約には有効かも！

54132.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54132.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54132.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

62051.description: A hunter is always either hunting or being hunted. Hey, you there, hunter!! Wandering carelessly deep into the jungle is dangerous! Start by learning the lie of the jungle. I happen to have a suitable request form with me, so try taking it. Do not look down on it just because your quarry is a herbivore!
62051.descriptionEn:
A hunter either hunts or
is hunted.
Hey, you there, hunter!!
Wander into the deep Jungle
carelessly and you're dead!
Start by learning the Jungle
terrain. I happen to have a
fine request form, so try
taking it. Don't mock your foe
just because it's a herbivore!
62051.descriptionJp:
ハンターは常に狩るか、
狩られるか、だ。
む、そこのハンター！！
不用意に密林の奥地へ入ると
危険だぞ！まずは密林の地形
を覚えることから始めるんだ。
ちょうどいい依頼書を持って
きたから試しに受けてみろ。
相手が草食種だからといって
侮るなよ！

50068.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50068.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that yields the materials needed to craft red Secret Armor. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50068.descriptionEn:
For members of winning Hunter
Festival Guilds only, we have
prepared a quest where you can
obtain the materials needed to
make red Secret Art Armor.
Please bring your Festival
Proof when you join.
50068.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、赤き秘伝
防具の作成に必要な素材を入
手できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、祭典の証をお持ちく
ださい。

1021.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
1021.description: The boss of the Genprey packs in the desert, Dos-Genprey, is marked by a body a size larger and by sharp claws! If hunting Dos-Genprey seems difficult, put a Cactus Flower in a Maka Pickling Jar and deliver a Hundred-Flower Cactus!
1021.descriptionEn:
The Ioprey boss that swarms
the Desert, ≪Iodrome≫, has a
bigger body and sharp claws!
If hunting an Iodrome feels
tough, put a ≪Cactus Flower≫
in a ≪Maka Pickling Pot≫ and
deliver a ≪Blossom Cactus≫!
1021.descriptionJp:
砂漠に群れるゲネポスの親玉
≪ドスゲネポス≫は、一回り
大きな体に鋭い爪が特徴だ！
ドスゲネポスの狩猟が困難に
感じるなら≪マカ漬けの壷≫
に≪サボテンの花≫を入れて
≪百花サボテン≫を納品だ！

60404.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟
60404.description: A hidden land where dragons rest. But they do not always act together. We continued observing their ecology and determined that for 20 minutes of the day they go their separate ways. Use that as your guide for succeeding at hunting a lone Rare Species.
60404.descriptionEn:
A hidden haven where dragons rest.
But they do not always act
together.
We kept observing their behavior
and confirmed that for just 20
minutes a day they separate.
Use that as your guide to hunt
the lone Rare Species.
60404.descriptionJp:
竜たちが憩う秘境･･･。
しかし、彼らも常時行動を共
にしているわけではない。
我々は生態の観測を続け、彼
らが、一日のうち２０分だけ
別行動を取ることを特定した。
単独の希少種の狩りを成功さ
せる目安としてくれ。

62989.description: The final quest at last! Pay the Faintly Glowing Coin you earned as a series quest reward to join! Clear this quest and you can obtain a great many souls! You decide how this nail-biting contest ends!
62989.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest!
Pay the ≪Faintly Glowing
Coin≫ you got as a reward
from the series quests
to join!
Clear this quest and you'll
earn a pile of Souls!
You decide how this
white-knuckle match ends!
62989.descriptionJp:
いよいよ最後のクエストだ！
シリーズクエストの
報酬として手に入れた
≪微かに光るコイン≫を
支払って参加してほしい！
このクエストをクリアすれば、
魂を大量に獲得できるぞ！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

21692.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21692.description: I want to make the same Kuku series for the new hunting party member as I have. This armor is easy to move in and cute in design, a favorite among beginners. You can get it through this request, so why not join in too?
21692.descriptionEn:
I want to make a Kukubo Series
set, matching mine, for the new
member of our guild.
This armor is easy to move in
and its design is cute, so it is
popular with beginners.
You can get it from this
request, so why not come along?
21692.descriptionJp:
新しく入った猟団員に、わた
しとお揃いの≪ククボシリー
ズ≫を作ってあげたいの。
この防具は、動きやすいし、
デザインも可愛くて初心者に
人気の装備よ。
この依頼で手に入るから、
あなたも一緒にいかが？

23457.description: This quest yields the following materials. Switch Axe Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Switch Axe Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Switch Axe Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23457.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the
following materials.
≪Switch Axe Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Switch Axe Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Switch Axe Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
Accepting the quest needs a
≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫,
so please keep that in mind.
23457.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪剣斧綬・序≫１００個
≪剣斧綬・中≫１６５個
≪剣斧綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

62749.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62749.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the powerful individual Lavasioth of the volcano. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
62749.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the Volcano's ≪Volganos≫
Frenzied individual. Clear the
quest safely and your name
as a hunter will rise in a
hurry!
62749.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
火山の≪溶岩竜≫激個体を
狩猟してみせろ。無事、
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての評
価はグイっと上がるぞ！

55603.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
55603.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
55603.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

54435.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の狩猟

62937.description: This is the practice final of the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving the monster or from the quest clear rewards.
62937.descriptionEn:
This is the practice final of
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
Also, you cannot obtain the
target monster's materials
from carving the monster or
from the quest clear rewards.
62937.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

21781.description: I heard from a traveler that he nearly lost his life in the desert recently. Sudden intense drowsiness, loss of consciousness, and when he came to he had heat stroke. This must be that thing's doing. I want you to secure the safety of the road.
21781.descriptionEn:
I heard from a traveler who
nearly died in the Desert
recently. A sudden, heavy
sleepiness took his senses, and
he woke to heatstroke.
This must be that one's doing.
Please make the road safe.
21781.descriptionJp:
ある旅人から、最近砂漠で命
を落としかけたと聞いた。
突然強烈な眠気に意識を失い
気が付けば熱射病にかかって
いたということだ。
これはヤツの仕業に違いない。
旅路の安全を確保してほしい。

50483.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ３. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gogomoa. I am counting on you!
50483.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR 3.
So I've got a favor to ask — how
about a full set of weapon
materials as payment?
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay a Gogomoa
for me.
I'm counting on you!
50483.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ３になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってゴゴモアを討伐し
てくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

50573.description: You there! I hear you produced a Gurenzeburu weapon. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Gurenzeburu. I am counting on you!
50573.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a Taikun Zamuza
weapon.
So I've got a favor to ask, and
the pay is weapon upgrade parts.
What? It's an easy job. Just take
a quick run out and slay a
Gurenzeburu for me.
I'm counting on you!
50573.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
蛮竜の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってグレンゼブルを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

55380.description: The Guild will now investigate the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55380.descriptionEn:
We have decided to
investigate the ecology of
the ≪Tesshi≫ further inside
the Guild. To those who help,
we will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55380.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく討究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

21170.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21170.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21170.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

55428.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の討伐
55428.description: 2 ferocious Lavasioth seem to have appeared in a distant volcano! I want to survey their ecology, so please hunt both of them together. If by chance some rare material turns up, I will give it to you.
55428.descriptionEn:
Two ferocious ≪Volganos≫
have appeared in a far-off
Volcano! I want to study
their ecology, so please slay
both of them.
If by chance you get any rare
materials, they're yours.
55428.descriptionJp:
遠い火山で狂暴な≪溶岩竜≫
が２頭も現れたらしい！
生態を調査したいので
２頭合わせての討伐を
お願いします。
万が一、何か珍しい素材が
取れたら差し上げますよ。

56162.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
56162.description: Oh! You've come! This time's Tonfa has 'manly romance' as its theme! It's a bit tricky to handle, but that's the romance! I've set a request that suits this weapon, so enjoy it to the full!
56162.descriptionEn:
Hey! Glad you came!
This Tonfa's theme is
"the romance of men"!
It's a bit tricky to handle,
but that's the romance too!
I've prepared a request
perfect for this weapon, so
go and enjoy it to the fullest!
56162.descriptionJp:
おう！よく来たな！
今回の穿龍棍は
「漢の浪漫」がテーマだ！
ちと扱うのに難はあるが
そこも浪漫だな！
この武器におあつらえ向きの
依頼をしたから、
存分に楽しんできてくれ！

22143.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

26606.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の討伐
26606.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Niobe Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26606.descriptionEn:
Notes recording the lost secret
of forging weapons and armor
are being found on monsters
slain across the land, they say!
Once you get the ≪Niobe Memo≫,
come straight to this workshop
head like a man!
I'll show you some good work!
26606.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ニオベーメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

61437.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
61437.description: 2 Khezu Variants are rampaging in the swamp, apparently. Speaking of Khezu, it is fire, right? Yes! Go and blast them down with a gunlance! If you pull it off, I will give special rewards like the hides I carved before!
61437.descriptionEn:
Two Khezu Variants are said to
be on a rampage in the Swamp.
Khezu means fire, right?
Yes! Go blast them apart with
a Gunlance!
Do it and I will hand over the
hides I carved and more!
61437.descriptionJp:
沼地で２頭のフルフル変種が
暴れているらしい。
フルフルといえば炎だよな。
そう！ガンランスであいつら
をドカンドカンと撃ち倒して
くるんだ！やり遂げれば、
俺が以前剥ぎ取ってきた皮等、
特別な報酬を出すぞ！

62867.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62867.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!
62867.descriptionJp:
狩人たちの祭典、狩人祭！
魂を集めて勝利を掴み取れ！
今回紹介するこの依頼は、
シリーズクエスト専用だ！
シナリオを最後まで進めて、
大量の魂をゲットしよう！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

62253.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
62253.description: A friend from the East is visiting on a trip, and it happens to be the season of his hometown festival. So I want to entertain him tonight. Could you get some well-done meat and crab before the sun sets? I will share the souvenir he gave me, so please.
62253.descriptionEn:
A friend from the east is
visiting, and it happens to be
festival season back home.
So tonight I want to throw
him a feast. Before sundown,
could you bring me some
well-done meat and crab?
I'll share a souvenir from my
friend, so please help me out.
62253.descriptionJp:
東方の友人が旅行に来ている
のだが、ちょうど故郷の祭り
の季節らしいんだ。そこで、
今夜、彼をもてなしてやり
たくてね。日が暮れるまで
に、こんがり肉とカニをとっ
てきてくれないか？
友人からもらったお土産を
分けてあげるから頼むよ。

23498.description: The Snowy Mountains are harsh land to begin with. With the arrival of a violent dragon that never existed in Mezepolta, conditions have grown harsher still. I have never seen such a ferocious monster. Please! Stop it.
23498.descriptionEn:
The Snowy Mountains are harsh
land to begin with. And now a
raging dragon that never lived
in Mezepolta has come, making
things even worse than before.
I've never seen a monster so
savage. Please! You have to
stop it for us.
23498.descriptionJp:
雪山はもともと厳しい土地だ。
さらにメゼポルタには存在し
ていなかった荒ぶる竜が訪れ
たことで、より厳しい状態に
なってしまった。
あれほど凶暴なモンスターは
未だ見たことがない。頼む！
奴を止めてくれ。

61260.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
61260.descriptionEn:
I got my hands on an ancient tome
said to record how to make armor
that no one knows anymore,
but I was attacked by monsters
and dropped it.
As long as the writing can still
be read, it needn't be intact.
Please, go and find it for me!
61260.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
んだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

61128.description: The Public Tavern Guild has received a large order for Wyvern Eggs. 8 is not a number 1 person can deliver alone, so we recommend taking the order with at least 2 people. Note that there are no supplies for sub-target completion, so take care.
61128.descriptionEn:
From the popular tavern Guild comes
a large order for Flying Wyvern
Eggs. Eight is more than one
person can carry and deliver
alone, so we recommend at least
two people take this on.
Note that there are no supply
items for clearing sub-quests.
61128.descriptionJp:
大衆酒場ギルドより、飛竜の
卵の大口注文が入りました。
８個という数は、１人で取り
きって納品できる数ではない
ので、少なくとも２人以上で
の受注をオススメいたします。
尚、サブ達成による支給品は
ありませんので、要注意です。

61509.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟

23588.objectiveJp: シャンティエン１体の討伐
23588.description: The sky-soaring dragon has been confirmed near the course of the large survey ship. Even with interception equipment, we cannot survey if it attacks again and again. Board the survey ship and slay the sky-soaring dragon.
23588.descriptionEn:
Near the route of the large survey
ship, the Sky-Soaring Dragon was
sighted. Even with interception
equipment, we cannot carry out
our survey if it keeps attacking.
Please board the large survey ship
and slay the Sky-Soaring Dragon.
23588.descriptionJp:
大型探査船の航路付近に、
天翔龍の姿が確認されました。
迎撃用の装備があるとはいえ、
そう何度も襲われていては
調査を行うことができません。
大型探査船に同乗し、天翔龍
の討伐に当たって下さい。

61345.description: This is terrible! A Rajang attacked me while I was moving through the Canyon! The cargo is surely done for, but if anything remains I want to recover it. If you deal with that Rajang, I will share some valuable goods with you!
61345.descriptionEn:
Big trouble! While moving
through the Canyon, we were
attacked by a ≪Rajang≫!
The cargo is probably done for,
but I want to salvage what's
left. If you deal with that
≪Rajang≫ for us, I'll share
some precious goods with you!
61345.descriptionJp:
大変だ！峡谷を移動中に、
≪ラージャン≫に襲われた！
荷の方はもうだめだろうが、
もし残っていれば回収したい。
あんたが≪ラージャン≫を
どうにかしてくれれば、
貴重な品々を分けてやっても
いいぜ！

22138.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22138.description: Hunter who would master the Bow, show the skill you have honed against the Dyuragaua in the Arena! Hunt it well and you will earn more rewards than your daily efforts alone would bring.
22138.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the Bow,
show us the skill you have honed
against the ≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in
the Arena! If you succeed in
hunting it, you will earn even
more rewards than your daily
efforts bring.
22138.descriptionJp:
弓を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55632.objectiveJp: ガスラバズラ１頭の討伐
55632.description: To support hunters' decoration production, the Guild is considering providing materials from its stores. However, supplies are limited, so only for capable hunters. Please try the quest and obtain the materials!
55632.descriptionEn:
To support Hunters in producing
decorations, the Guild is considering
providing materials kept in Guild
storage.

However, as quantities are limited,
we can offer them only to Hunters
of proven ability.
Please take on the quest and
obtain the materials!
55632.descriptionJp:
ギルドではハンターの方々の
装飾品生産を支援するため、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。

ただし、数に限りがあるため
実力のあるハンターのみと
させていただきます。
ぜひクエストに挑戦して、
素材を獲得してください！

55155.objectiveJp: トア・テスカトラ１体の討伐
55155.description: Hi everyone! It is the autumn sports festival! Aim to clear as many as you can while earning rare First Species materials! If you collect the Bond Coins given as rewards, you can draw a lottery for various prizes!
55155.descriptionEn:
Hello everyone!
It's the autumn Sports Festival!
Aim to clear as many as you can
while earning rare Origin Species
materials!
If you collect the ≪Bond Coins≫
given as rewards, you can also
draw a lottery for all sorts of
prizes!
55155.descriptionJp:
はーい皆さん！
秋の大運動会ですよ！
希少な始種素材を獲得しなが
ら、よりたくさんクリアする
のを目指してくださいね！
報酬としてもらえる
「絆のコイン」を集めれば、
いろいろな景品が当たるくじ
も引けますよ！

21637.description: Have you heard of the Prussian Blue Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21637.descriptionEn:
Do you know the Sphere
called the Ultramarine
Sphere? Its material is
essential for crafting a
certain expensive decoration.
If you can clear this request,
I'll give you some precious
decoration material.
21637.descriptionJp:
紺青原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

58031.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58031.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58031.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58031.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60413.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on such a memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
60413.descriptionEn:
Word is that memos recording the
lost Secret Art of crafting arms
are being found on monsters slain
all over the place!
If you get your hands on one,
be a man and bring it to this
Workshop Master!
I'll show you good work!
60413.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
そんなメモを手に入れたら、
男一匹！この工房長のところ
に持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

21008.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
21008.description: If you can hunt Yian Kut-Ku, your hunting skill is quite something! If you have room to spare, please try making aged mushrooms as well. Put specialty mushrooms in a Maka Pickling Jar and bury it. It's simple!
21008.descriptionEn:
Hunt a ≪Yian Kut-Ku≫ and
your skill is quite
something! If you have
the time, please try aging
mushrooms as well. Put
Special Mushrooms in a
≪Maka Pot≫. Simple, yes!
21008.descriptionJp:
≪イャンクック≫を狩猟する
ことができれば、狩りの腕は
なかなかのものですよ！
もし余裕があれば熟成キノコ
作りにも挑戦してください。
≪マカ漬けの壷≫に特産キノ
コを入れて埋める。簡単よ！

26199.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の討伐
26199.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26199.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26199.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

23563.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23563.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23563.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

62556.description: I can hear them. The voices of nature. By completing this request set in the Forest and Hills, you may obtain the Voice of Nature: Blossoms or the Voice of Nature: Grassland. I pray your hunting life grows ever fuller.
62556.descriptionEn:
I can hear it. The voice of
nature. By completing this
request set in the ≪Forest
and Hills≫, you may obtain
≪Voice of Nature: Bloom≫ or
≪Voice of Nature: Meadow≫.
I wish you all a richer
hunting life.
62556.descriptionJp:
聴こえます。大自然の声が。
≪森丘≫を舞台とした
この依頼をこなすことで、
≪大自然の声・爛漫≫や
≪大自然の声・草原≫が
手に入るかもしれません。
皆様の狩猟生活の更なる
充実をお祈りいたします。

63227.description: A Supreme Species Gougarf that tramples the earth as its instincts dictate has appeared! Because this is a matter of urgency, the request is for a quick kill, but to keep damage to a minimum, driving it off alone will also count in your favor. We are recruiting ace hunters holding Secret Tomes to face this unprecedented crisis!
63227.descriptionEn:
A Zenith Devouring Dragon that
crushes the land on instinct has
appeared!
As this is a race against time,
the request is for a short hunt, but
to keep the damage to a minimum,
repelling it alone will be counted.
We seek skilled hunters holding a
Secret Art book to face this
unprecedented crisis!
63227.descriptionJp:
本能のままに大地を踏みにじ
る覇種呑竜が現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

53081.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
53081.description: Great numbers of Daimyo Hermitaur seem to be breaking out around Mezeporta! Hunters, please help slay the Daimyo Hermitaur! If you do it splendidly, we will give you the materials for a Felyne comrade swimsuit!
53081.descriptionEn:
Daimyo Hermitaur seem to be
swarming around Mezepolta!
Hunters, please lend us your
aid in slaying the Daimyo
Hermitaur!
If you slay them for us, we
will give you materials for a
Partnyaa swimsuit!
53081.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタ周辺に盾蟹が
大量発生しているようです！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
盾蟹の討伐に協力してくだ
さい！
見事討伐いただけましたら、
パートニャー用水着の素材
をお渡しします！

54781.objectiveJp: ブラキディオス１頭の狩猟
54781.description: Reports say powerful Brachydios are appearing in various regions. The Guild wants them hunted at once, but study of the Brachydios ecology has not progressed. For research, hunt it after breaking its head. Your reward will be increased accordingly.
54781.descriptionEn:
Reports say powerful Brachydios
are appearing all over.
The Guild wants them hunted
at once, but the ecology of
this Crushing Wyvern remains
unstudied. For research, break
the head before you slay it.
The reward will be bumped up
accordingly.
54781.descriptionJp:
各地に強力な砕竜・ブラキ
ディオスが出現していると
報告がありました。
ギルドはただちに狩猟して
ほしいみたいですが、砕竜
の生態は、調査が進んでいま
せん。研究のため、頭部破壊
後に狩猟してください。
その分、報酬ははずみますよ。

55455.description: I am the Silent Knight, a gentleman who rides a silver dragon and delivers gifts to good children. A fire wyvern that bewitched the silver dragon is furious, demanding its playmate back, and on a rampage. I am frightened. Please go and defeat it.
55455.descriptionEn:
The gentleman who rides a
silver dragon to bring gifts
to good children, Silent
Knight, at your service.
A Rathalos that bewitched
the silver dragon is raging,
demanding its playmate back.
I'm scared.
Please go defeat it.
55455.descriptionJp:
銀の竜に乗って良い子に
ギフトを届ける紳士、
サイレントナイトで
ございます。
銀の竜をたぶらかした火竜が
遊び仲間を返せとブチ切れて
暴れております。
怖いです。
倒してきてください。

50285.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
50285.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Cephadrome and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
50285.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Cephadrome≫
and prove yourself.
Clear the quest and your
standing as a hunter will
rise in a hurry!
50285.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪砂竜≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

50649.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の討伐
50649.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Heavenly Storm Weapon and slay the ferocious Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a splendid reward awaits you.
50649.descriptionEn:
You who would master the
hunting way. Take up a
≪Tenran Weapon≫ and slay
the ferocious ≪Doragyurosu≫.
Only one who succeeds under
limited conditions is a true
hunter.
Do so, and a splendid reward
awaits you.
50649.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
≪天嵐武器≫などを携え、
凶暴な≪弩岩竜≫を討伐する
のだ。
限られた条件の中で狩りを
成功させる者こそ、真の狩人
と言えよう。
成功すれば、素晴らしい報酬
がそなたを待っておるぞ。

54679.objectiveJp: ヴァルサブロス１頭の討伐
54679.description: Hunters who have achieved upgrades all the way to Origin Species weapons! The time has come to show the power of those new weapons! Slay the Varusaburosu at the decisive battlefield. If you clear the quest well, your standing as hunters will rise sharply!
54679.descriptionEn:
Hunter who has upgraded all
the way to the Origin Weapon!
The time has come to show
your new weapon's power!
Slay the ≪Flame Horn Wyvern≫
at the Battlefield. Clear the
quest splendidly and your
name as a hunter will rise
in a hurry!
54679.descriptionJp:
始種武器までの強化を成し
遂げしハンターたちよ！
その新たなる武器の力を披露
する時がやってきた！
決戦場の≪炎角竜≫を討伐
してみせろ。見事クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

53170.description: This is Miyashita! The final question at last. [Question 6] I! Love all of you! This year too! If you think the answer is right (A), take this quest!
53170.descriptionEn:
This is Miyashita!
The final question at last.
[Question 6]
I!
Love all of you again this
year!!!
If you think the answer is
○ (A), then accept this
quest!
53170.descriptionJp:
宮下です！
いよいよ最終問題。
【第６問】
僕は！
今年もみなさんが！！
大好きです！！！
答えが○（Ａ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

26697.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26697.description: In the Snowy Mountains, many monsters are breeding in great numbers! We are requesting hunting cooperation from hunters everywhere, but the reality is that there are too many. So we want to recruit those who can set out on this hunt with up to 2 people. I especially recommend it to those aiming for a quick rank up.
26697.descriptionEn:
Monsters are breeding out of
control in the Snowy Mountains!
We are asking hunters from all
over to help hunt them, but the
plain truth is there are too many.
So we want volunteers who can
set out in parties of up to two.
I especially recommend it to
those after a quick rank-up.
26697.descriptionJp:
雪山で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

26368.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
26368.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for three to four people and involves hunting a High Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26368.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 3 to 4
players and involve hunting
high rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26368.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、３人〜４人向けの
クエストとなっていて、上位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

54993.description: Hunter who would master the light gun, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54993.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Light Bowgun, show us the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
If you can hunt it in fine style,
you will earn even more rewards
than you would from your daily
efforts.
54993.descriptionJp:
軽銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

62597.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
62597.description: We have now identified the monster approaching the desert. It is Rukodiora, an Elder Dragon with shining wings. It is closing on the desert at tremendous speed. Head for the desert at once and slay it!
62597.descriptionEn:
We have determined what the monster
that is currently flying toward the
Desert actually is.
It is the Elder Dragon species with
shining wings, ≪Rukodiora≫.
It is closing on the Desert at
fierce speed.
Head for the Desert at once
and slay it!
62597.descriptionJp:
現在、砂漠に飛来しつつある
モンスターが何であるか
判明しました。
光り輝く翼を持つ古龍種、
≪ルコディオラ≫です。
猛スピードで砂漠に
迫っています。
大至急、砂漠へ向かい
討伐してください！

21086.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟

55367.description: The Variant Species Hyujikiki has grown ferociously strong and continues to rampage. At this rate it is extremely dangerous. Please prepare thoroughly and investigate.
55367.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Hyujikiki≫
has grown ferociously strong
and keeps rampaging.
At this rate it is very
dangerous. Prepare fully
before you set out to survey it.
55367.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪ヒュジキキ≫は
猛烈な強さとなり、暴れ続け
ています。
このままでは非常に危険です。
万全の準備をして調査をお願
いします。

62735.description: If I told you Hardcore weapons could be made even stronger, would you believe me? Word is the material comes from a Pariapuria, but this one seems unlike the usual sort, and a nasty piece of work besides. Wave it off as an old man's rambling if you like, but if you are curious, go and see.
62735.descriptionEn:
If I told you Hardcore
weapons can be made even
stronger, would you believe me?
Word is the material comes
from a Pariapuria, but it
seems different from the usual
one, and quite a handful.
Well, dismiss it as an old
man's rambling, but if you're
interested, go and see.
62735.descriptionJp:
剛種武器を更に強くできると
言ったらお前は信じるかな？
なんでもその素材が、
呑竜から取れるという話
じゃが、どうもいつもの
ヤツとは違うらしくての、
かなり厄介という話じゃ。
まあ、爺の戯言と聞き流して
もかまわんが、興味がある
なら行ってみなされ。

26628.description: It seems Guku are gathering in some areas. Maybe you can find what Guku like nearby. Why not go and look? If you want to come back, just deliver a map.
26628.descriptionEn:
It seems Gook have been gathering
in some areas, nyah.
Maybe you'll find the things that
Gook like somewhere nearby,
nyah.
Why not go and take a look?
If you want to come back,
just deliver a map, nyah.
26628.descriptionJp:
どうやら、一部地域にグーク
が集まってきているようニャ。
もしかしたら、その近くなら
グークの好きなものが見つか
るかもしれないニャ。
ちょっと行って、探してみた
らどうニャ？もし帰りたく
なったら地図を納品するニャ。

50672.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50672.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Stroma F series, Tenran Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50672.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of
the ≪Tenran Armor≫ Stroma F
series. To accept the quest
you will need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that failing
the quest will consume
your ≪Superior Ticket≫.
50672.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪天嵐防具≫
ストロマＦシリーズの１部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

21244.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
21244.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
21244.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

62879.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62879.description: You know that Gasurabazura chase their prey in coordination. I believe the secret of that splendid coordination lies in their roars. So would you go and see whether they coordinate while roaring? If you let me know what you observe, I will share precious materials.
62879.descriptionEn:
You know how Orugaron work
together to chase prey.
I believe the secret of that
splendid teamwork lies in
their roar.
So, would you go and see
whether they coordinate while
roaring? Tell me what you
see, and I'll share some
precious materials.
62879.descriptionJp:
響狼たちが連携しながら獲物
を追うことは知っているな。
私はその見事な連携の秘密は、
咆哮にあると考えている。
そこで、彼らが咆哮しながら
連携しているかどうか、見に
行ってくれないか。
その様子を私に知らせてくれ
たら、貴重な素材を分けて
あげよう。

21238.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21238.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21238.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

58020.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58020.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58020.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58020.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

62411.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

60620.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60620.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60620.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60620.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

50885.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50885.description: For those who reached HR100, we have prepared a quest to upgrade the "Rukeze F Series" to the "Rukeze FY Series". By hunting an Espinas Subspecies, you can obtain materials to upgrade and level up one piece into master rank armor. Please make good use of it!
50885.descriptionEn:
For those who reached HR100,
we have prepared a quest to
upgrade the "Rukeze F Series"
to the "Rukeze FY Series".
By hunting an Espinas
Subspecies, you can obtain
materials to upgrade and
level up one piece into
master rank armor.
Please make good use of it!
50885.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００を達成した方々へ
「ルケーゼＦシリーズ」を
「ルケーゼFYシリーズ」へ
強化するためのクエスト
を準備しました。
エスピナス変種を狩猟するこ
とで、１部位分を凄腕防具へ
強化しレベルアップできる
素材が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください！

21757.description: In the Guild's history there was a hunter said to have the strongest arm. This Guild gives an incentive award to hunters who slay one on one the fish wyvern that drove that hunter into retirement, the Plesioth. Please join us.
21757.descriptionEn:
In the history of the Guild there was
a hunter praised as the strongest of
all, a mighty arm.
Our Guild awards a prize to any
hunter who slays one on one the
Plesioth, the fish wyvern species that
drove that hunter into retirement.
Please join us enthusiastically.
21757.descriptionJp:
ギルドの歴史の中でも、最強
の豪腕と謳われたハンターが
いました。
当ギルドでは、そのハンター
を引退にまで追いやった魚竜
種、ガノトトスを１対１で討
伐したハンターに、奨励品を
出しています。
奮ってご参加ください。

61027.description: Clear the special event convenience store delivery quest@ and get your hands on rare items!
61027.descriptionEn:
Special Event
Clear the Convenience Store
Report Quest @ in fine style
and claim a rare item!
61027.descriptionJp:
特別イベント
コンビニダレポクエスト@を
みごとクリアして
レアアイテムを手に入れろ！

50572.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
50572.description: You there! I hear you produced Teostra and Lunastra weapons. So I have a request: how about weapon upgrade materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Teostra. I am counting on you!
50572.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! I hear you
crafted Teostra and Lunastra
weapons.
So I've got a request, and the
reward is weapon upgrade
materials, how's that?
Easy job, just make one quick
trip and slay Teostra.
I'm counting on you!
50572.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
炎王龍、炎妃龍の武器を生産
したんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は武器強化素材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってテオ・テスカトル
を討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

60914.objectiveJp: ヒプノック希少種の狩猟

55039.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
55039.description: For those aiming for the heights of GR, we have a quest where slaying a Doragyurosu raises your rating while letting you efficiently get the materials needed for G Rank decorations. Please make good use of it.
55039.descriptionEn:
For those aiming for the
heights of GR, we have a quest
where slaying a Doragyurosu
raises your rating while
letting you efficiently get
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.
55039.descriptionJp:
ＧＲの高みを目指す方々へ
ドラギュロスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

55046.objectiveJp: ハンターパス・黄１個の納品
55046.description: Hunters who believe that Ginel is the most suitable legend Rasta to go in search of a new prayer jewel, please deliver a Hunter Pass (Yellow) through this request and cast your vote. As thanks for voting, we will give you Thick Steel Dragon Scale and Steel Dragon Heavy Shell.
55046.descriptionEn:
If you think [Ginel] is the
best Legend Rasta to search
for new prayer gems, please
deliver a "Hunter Pass: Yellow"
through this request as your
vote. As thanks for voting,
we will give you "Thick Steel
Dragon Scale" and "Kushala
Daora Heavy Shell".
55046.descriptionJp:
新たな祈珠を探しに行くレ
ジェンドラスタとして
【ギネル】が最も適してい
ると考えるハンターの方は、
こちらの依頼から「ハンター
パス・黄」を納品して投票を
お願いします。投票のお礼と
して、「鋼の厚龍鱗」や「鋼
龍の重殻」をお渡しします。

55722.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55722.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55722.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

63281.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐
63281.description: The weapon that slept beyond the Dragon Water Gate seems to be capable of further upgrades. There is a stone monument in the Highlands recording how to upgrade it, and reaching it apparently requires an Iron Compass or a Dowsing Rod. Now, obtain one quickly!
63281.descriptionEn:
The weapon sleeping beyond
the Dragon Water Gate can be
upgraded further. In the
≪Highlands≫ there is a stone
monument with the method, and
reaching it seems to require
a ≪Iron Compass≫ or a
≪Dowsing Rod≫. Now hurry!
63281.descriptionJp:
竜水門の先に眠っていた武器
は、さらに強化できるようだ。
≪高地≫に強化方法が記され
た石碑があり、そこへ行くに
は、≪鉄製の方位磁針≫
もしくは≪ダウジングロッド≫
が必要らしい。
さ、急いで入手するんだ！

23691.description: Hunter who would master the Magnetic Slash Hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Blood-Drinking Wyvern in the New Great Arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23691.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Magnet Spike, show the skill
you have honed against the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena!
If you hunt it splendidly, you
will earn even more rewards
than your daily efforts bring
you.
23691.descriptionJp:
磁斬鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

60327.description: The items familiar to high-rank hunters who favor the bow can now be obtained together as rewards! It is a carefree, easy quest, so please try it between party battles!
60327.descriptionEn:
High Rank hunters who love
the Bow can now get all their
familiar items at once as
rewards!
It's a quick and easy quest,
so please try it between
party battles!
60327.descriptionJp:
弓を愛用される高ランクなハ
ンターの皆さんにはおなじみ
の品々が、報酬でまとめて入
手可能になりました！
お気楽お手軽なクエストです
ので、パーティー戦の合間に
是非お試しくださいね！

26405.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26405.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?
26405.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た実り豊かなフィールドで、
たまにはのんびり採取でも
いかがですか？

50609.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50609.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up an SP Weapon and repel the Odibatorasu. Only one who can bring a hunt to success under restricted conditions deserves to be called a true hunter. Succeed, and a fitting reward awaits you.
50609.descriptionEn:
You who would master the way of
the hunt. Take up an SP Weapon
and repel the Odibatorasu.
Only one who succeeds under such
limited conditions can be called
a true hunter. Succeed, and a
fitting reward shall await you.
50609.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
『ＳＰ武器』を携え、≪弩岩
竜≫を撃退するのだ。限られ
た条件の中で狩りを成功させ
る者こそ、真の狩人と言えよ
う。成功すれば、それなりの
褒美がそなたを待っておるぞ。

61043.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
61043.description: For those who wear the proof of a Hunter Festival winner, we have prepared a special request and reward. The representative should carry the Festival Certificate. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61043.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards exclusively for those
equipped with the Hunter Festival
Victor's Proof. The representative
should have the Festival Proof.
After departure, for any reason,
the Festival Proof cannot be
returned, so please be careful.
61043.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。代表者は
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

26413.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Variant monster. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26413.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
Variant monsters.
We've prepared special
rewards for you, so do
come and join us!
26413.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの討伐となります。
特別な報酬を用意させていた
だきましたので、奮ってご参
加ください。

55330.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a tail cut in slaying Rathalos, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55330.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Rathalos≫ and break its
head and sever its tail, we
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55330.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪火竜≫討伐にて
頭部破壊と尻尾切断を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

62553.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades well before departing. The reward is a special ore!
62553.descriptionEn:
Yes! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds among
you, I have prepared a
difficult request. Slay several
monsters together with your
Guild companions. No supplies
will be provided, so talk it
over with your friends before
you set out. The reward is a
special ore!
62553.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の仲間と
行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

55179.description: Slaying an Inagami raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55179.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying an Inagami
raises your rating while
letting you efficiently get
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.
55179.descriptionJp:
イナガミを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

56030.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Hyujikiki. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56030.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Hyujikiki for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.
56030.descriptionJp:
辿異種の針纏竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

23230.description: The Guild is focusing on surveying unexplored regions, but a Rathalos has appeared and the survey is delayed. At this rate it will only fall further behind. Please ensure safety.
23230.descriptionEn:
The Guild is putting effort
into surveying unexplored
areas, but a Rathalos has
appeared and we cannot survey
as planned. Delays keep
piling up, and we'll only
fall behind. Keep us safe.
23230.descriptionJp:
ギルドでは未調査地域の調査
に力を入れていますが、
火竜が現れ思うような調査が
できず遅れが発生しています。
このままでは遅れる
ばかりです。
安全の確保をお願いします。

40064.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
40064.description: The Gypceros of this swamp is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40064.descriptionEn:
The Poison Bird Wyvern ≪Gypceros≫
that lives in this Swamp is said
to rarely carry some incredible
treasure.
If it's true, I'd very much like
you to go and hunt one.
We'll split the reward.
40064.descriptionJp:
この沼地に生息する毒怪鳥
≪ゲリョス≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

22112.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
22112.description: A request that lets you craft and upgrade the Kukubo Series, armor recommended for beginning hunters. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and you will obtain the crafting materials for all 5 pieces of the Kukubo Series, plus upgrade materials for the Kukubo F Series up to LV7. May it serve you well in your hunting life.
22112.descriptionEn:
A request that lets you forge
and upgrade the Kukubo Series,
armor recommended for rookie
hunters. Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku to
obtain materials for all five
Kukubo Series pieces, plus
upgrade materials for the
Kukubo F Series up to Lv7.
May it serve you well in your
hunting life to come.
22112.descriptionJp:
初心者ハンターにオススメの
防具「ククボシリーズ」が
生産・強化できる依頼です。
イャンクックを狩猟すると、
「ククボシリーズ」５部位分
の生産素材と、「ククボＦシ
リーズ」ＬＶ７までの強化素
材が入手できます。
今後の狩猟生活にぜひお役立
てください。

23162.description: While we were transporting supplies, Hermitaur emerged from underground and destroyed all of it, according to the report. The Hermitaur then went to an unsurveyed part of the jungle. We cannot afford any more losses. Please hunt the Hermitaur.
23162.descriptionEn:
We received a report that
while transporting supplies,
Hermitaurs burst from the
ground and destroyed it all.
The Hermitaurs then headed
into an unexplored part of the
Jungle. We cannot allow any
more damage. Please slay the
Hermitaurs.
23162.descriptionJp:
物資を運んでいたところ、
地中からヤオザミが現れ、
全て壊されてしまったと報告
がありました。
ヤオザミはその後、密林の
未調査地域に行ったという事
です。これ以上被害を出すわ
けにはいきません。ヤオザミ
の討伐をお願いします。

60401.objectiveJp: 銀火竜の尻尾１個の納品
60401.description: To set foot in the closed secret region, a qualification is required. That qualification is none other than the Secret Area Set. He who opens the gates of heaven and takes that qualification in hand will surely find fortune deep within the closed secret region...
60401.descriptionEn:
To set foot in the closed hidden
area, one needs a qualification.
That qualification is none other
than the ≪Secret Area Set≫.
Those who open the gates of
heaven and gain that right shall
find fortune deep in the closed
hidden area...
60401.descriptionJp:
閉ざされた秘境に足を踏み入
れるには、資格が必要となる。
その資格とは≪秘境セット≫
に他ならない。
天国の門を開き、その資格を
手にした者は、閉ざされた
秘境の奥に、幸いを見つける
ことだろう･･･。

53269.objectiveJp: ヒレナガウオ６匹の納品

23727.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Merit (Beginning) x５０, Hammer Merit (Middle) x６０, Hammer Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23727.descriptionEn:
This quest provides the
following materials.
≪Hammer Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Hammer Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Hammer Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept the quest you need
a ≪Secret Art Merit Crystal≫
and GR500 or higher, so please
be aware.
23727.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ハンマー勲・序≫５０個
≪ハンマー勲・中≫６０個
≪ハンマー勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

54818.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
54818.description: This quest gives production materials for the Tonfa whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
54818.descriptionEn:
At the Zinogre hunting release
event "Transcendent Invasion!
Hunt the Zinogre", a survey was
held to mark 700,000 Thunder
Wolf Wyverns hunted, and it
decided the performance of the
Tonfa. This quest lets you obtain
its crafting materials.
54818.descriptionJp:
ジンオウガ狩猟解禁イベント
「遷悠種襲来！ジンオウガを
狩猟せよ」にて
雷狼竜の狩猟数70万頭突破を
記念して行われたアンケート
にて性能が決定された
穿龍棍の生産素材を入手する
クエストになります。

53288.objectiveJp: キングチャチャブー１匹の討伐
53288.description: This time we have prepared gorgeous candles for the bride and groom! Eh? They are gone? Good heavens! The candles seem to have been stolen by a monster! At this rate the ceremony hall will be pitch dark and the future darker still! Someone, get the candles back!
53288.descriptionEn:
This time we prepared gorgeous
candles for the bride and
groom!
What? They're gone? No!
It seems a monster stole the
candles!
The hall will be pitch dark,
our future dark too! Someone
please get those candles back!
53288.descriptionJp:
今回は新郎新婦さんのために
豪華なキャンドルをご用意し
ました！
え？無くなった？なんと！
キャンドルがモンスターに
盗まれてしまったようです！
このままでは式場真っ暗お先
真っ暗です！誰かキャンドル
を取り戻してきてください！

62445.description: This is a hunting request for Gogomoa, a Fanged Beast newly discovered on Tide Island. The tropical island will be an unfamiliar hunting ground, but this is exactly the moment for hunters to show their skill. Do your best out there!
62445.descriptionEn:
This is a hunt request for the
Fanged Beast ≪Gogomoa≫,
newly discovered on the Tidal
Island. The tropics may be an
unfamiliar place to hunt,
but times like this are where
hunters show what they're made
of. Best of luck out there!
62445.descriptionJp:
潮島で新たに発見された、
牙獣種≪ゴゴモア≫の狩猟
依頼です。熱帯の潮島という
慣れない環境での狩りとは
思いますが、こういう時こそ
ハンターさんたちの腕の見せ
どころではないでしょうか。
頑張ってきてください！

60442.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ１６頭の討伐
60442.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time, the notorious Bulldrome that have raided many villages have been loosed into the arena! Their fury-filled tusks bear down on the hunters!
60442.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show off
their skill!
This time, the infamous great
boars that have raided many
villages have been released into
the Arena!
Fangs full of rage assail the
hunters!
60442.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！
今回は、いくつもの村々を襲
ってきた悪名高き大猪たちが
闘技場に放たれた！
怒りに満ちた牙がハンター達
に襲い掛かるぞ！

55873.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Sigil. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55873.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Sigil≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55873.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の刻印≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

23303.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
23303.description: A merchant went to a flower field to pick flowers and found a giant Bulldrome there, blowing flowers everywhere as it rampaged. At this rate business cannot continue. Could someone drive off the Bulldrome in the flower field?
23303.descriptionEn:
A merchant went to the Flower
Field to pick flowers, and found
a huge Bulldrome there, blowing
flowers everywhere as it
rampaged. At this rate no trade
can go on. Could someone please
drive off the Bulldrome in the
Flower Field?
23303.descriptionJp:
とある商人が、花畑へ花を摘
みに行くと、そこには巨大な
≪大猪≫がそこら中の花を吹
き飛ばしながら暴れ回ってて
いたそうだ。このままでは商
売ができなくなってしまう。
誰か花畑にいる≪大猪≫の退
治をお願いできないだろうか。

53299.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
53299.description: The sword and shield, which both attacks and defends and can strike with the shield for blunt damage, is supreme! If you can deftly land hits on even small foes with the sword and shield, you too are a sword and shield master! Now, try your hand at slaying the B-rank Teostra that has appeared in the desert!
53299.descriptionEn:
Combining attack and defense,
and able to deal blunt hits
with its shield, the Sword and
Shield is supreme! Land hits
cleverly even on small foes
and you too are a Sword and
Shield Master!
Now, try slaying the B-rank
Teostra in the Desert!
53299.descriptionJp:
攻撃と防御を兼ね備え、
盾で殴れば打撃攻撃も可能な
片手剣こそ至高！片手剣で
小さき相手にも器用に攻撃を
当てることができれば、
お主も片手剣マスターじゃ！
さあ、砂漠に現れた
ｂ級テオ・テスカトルの討伐
に挑戦するのだ！

62663.description: We have completed defensive preparations against the mysterious flying wyvern now approaching Mezeporuta. Meet it at the interception base and slay it, making use of the abundant supplies and interception weapons. This time we have also arranged carvers for you!
62663.descriptionEn:
We have completed our defense
preparations against the
mysterious Flying Wyvern now
heading for Mezepolta. Meet it
at the ≪Base≫ and slay it using
the ample supplies and
interception weapons provided.
Carvers have been arranged
for you this time as well!
62663.descriptionJp:
現在、メゼポルタに向けて、
飛来してきている謎の飛竜に
対しての防衛準備を整えまし
た。≪迎撃拠点≫で迎え撃ち、
豊富な支給品と、迎撃兵器を
利用して、討伐してください。
今回は剥ぎ取り職人も手配さ
せていただいていますよ！

62013.objectiveJp: イャンクック２頭の狩猟
62013.description: You pound bird wyverns. With a hammer, like this, you pound bird wyverns. That is both the basics and the secret of the hunter. If you want this rare bone too, I will lend you my favourite equipment, so go and pound those bird wyverns!
62013.descriptionEn:
You've gotta smack Bird Wyverns.
With a hammer, like this,
smack those Bird Wyverns.
That is both the basics and the
secret of a hunter.
If you lot want this rare bone,
I'll lend you my favorite gear,
so go smack some Bird Wyverns!
62013.descriptionJp:
鳥竜を叩くんだよ。ハンマー
でこう、鳥竜をぶっ叩くのさ。
それこそがハンターの基本に
して極意ってもんさ。あんた
らもこの珍しい骨が欲しいな
ら、俺の愛用の装備を貸して
やるから、鳥竜どもをぶっ叩
いてきな！

21843.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21843.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21843.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

55682.description: Greetings, hunter. Have you ever crafted a piece of armor only to find yourself short of materials and unable to upgrade it? Then I have good news for you. Clear this quest and upgrading that armor may become an easy matter. I pray the materials you want are among what you find.
55682.descriptionEn:
Hunter, good day to you.
Have you crafted armor only to find
you lack the materials to upgrade it?
Then we have good news for you.
If you complete this quest, you may
be able to upgrade your armor
with ease.
I pray you obtain the materials
you are hoping for.
55682.descriptionJp:
ハンターさん、ごきげんよう。
防具を生産したものの素材
不足で、強化できないなんて
ことになっていませんか？
そんなあなたに朗報です。
このクエストを達成すると、
防具が楽に強化できるかも
しれません。
あなたの望む素材が入手でき
ることを祈っています。

23401.description: We received a report of a Blue Yian Kut-Ku found in the swamp. However, it seems to perform special behavior not recorded in reports to date. Please investigate the Blue Yian Kut-Ku.
23401.descriptionEn:
We have received a report that a
≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫ has been
found in the Swamp.
However, it apparently behaves in
ways not recorded in any report so
far.
We would very much like you to
survey the ≪Blue Yian Kut-Ku≫.
23401.descriptionJp:
沼地に≪青怪鳥≫を発見した
との報告を受けた。
しかし、今までの報告書に
載っていない特殊な行動を
行うらしい。
是非、≪青怪鳥≫の調査を
お願いしたい。

60044.description: At the Old Tower, the mysterious unexplored land sleeping beyond this place, the Phantom Beast Kirin seems to have appeared! You cannot go to the Old Tower anytime, only during periods when the environment, weather and climate included, is stable. Do your best!
60044.descriptionEn:
Beyond these lands, in the mysterious
untouched ≪Ancient Tower≫, the
Phantom Beast ≪Kirin≫ appears
to have shown itself! You cannot
reach the Ancient Tower anytime —
only while the weather and climate
are stable. Do your best!
60044.descriptionJp:
この地の彼方に眠る、謎多き
未開の地≪古塔≫に、幻獣
≪キリン≫が現れたようです！
古塔へはいつでも行けるわけ
じゃなく、天候や気候を始め
とする環境が安定してる期間
だけです。頑張って下さい！

23332.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
23332.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Farnock, the Slanting Thunder Bird. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23332.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can
obtain materials of the
Thunderbird ≪Farunokku≫.
To accept this quest,
≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
Note that the ticket is
consumed if you fail, so
please be careful.
23332.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、傾雷鳥
≪ファルノック≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55079.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55079.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55079.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

54233.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54233.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54233.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55188.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Hypnocatrice while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55188.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
where slaying a Hypnocatrice
raises your rating while
letting you efficiently get
the materials needed for
G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it.
55188.descriptionJp:
ヒプノックを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

60948.description: The Hunting Party Association pays out to hunters who capture many Variant and Aberrant monsters. The main reward is a Flying Wyvern Heavy Bone! Bring the specified number of Capture Certificates yourself. You will also receive more rewards if you break the specified monster's parts and hunt it.
60948.descriptionEn:
The Guild Union rewards
hunters who capture many
variant and rare species.
The main reward is a Heavy
Wyvern Bone! Bring the
required number of Capture
Guarantees yourself. Breaking
parts or hunting the target
monsters earns even more.
60948.descriptionJp:
猟団組合では、変種や奇種を
多く捕獲したハンターに報酬
を出しております。
メイン報酬は飛竜種の重骨！
指定枚数の捕獲保証書を１人
でお持ちください。また、
指定モンスターの部位破壊や
狩猟を行った場合、より多く
の報酬を用意しております。

26381.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Variant monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26381.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
Variant monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26381.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、変種
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

54871.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to G-rank hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
54871.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to G Rank
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
54871.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、Ｇ級ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

21672.objectiveJp: クエスト達成証１枚の納品
21672.description: Hey! Thanks for the other day! When you want a Pawprint Coin, sorry, but come to the canyon. Bring your Quest Completion Proof and come alone. I will be waiting in the canyon.
21672.descriptionEn:
Hey! Thanks for the other day!
When you want ≪Paw Pad Coins≫,
sorry, but you'll have to come
to the Canyon. Bring your
≪Quest Completion Certificate≫
and come alone, all right?
Well, I'll be waiting at the Canyon.
21672.descriptionJp:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

62680.description: Good news for all hunters! A training method that builds experience efficiently has been developed. You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
62680.descriptionEn:
Good news for all hunters!
A training method for gaining
experience efficiently has been
developed.
You cannot take it back to back,
but each single run's effect is
enormous! May your daily
training become your strength!
62680.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に朗報です！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法が開発されました。
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛錬がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

63368.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63368.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63368.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63368.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

61657.description: Whenever I fish in the desert, monsters get in the way, nya! Chase off the nuisances and catch me some fish, would you, nya? Do that and I will trade you a very rare fish, nya! I have no use for fish that cannot be eaten, nya!
61657.descriptionEn:
Whenever I fish in the Desert,
monsters always get in the
way, nya! Could you chase
them off and catch some fish
for me, nya? Then I'll trade
you a really rare fish, nya!
A fish you can't eat is no
good at all, nya~!
61657.descriptionJp:
砂漠で釣りをすると、いつも
モンスターが邪魔するニャ！
邪魔者を追っ払って、お魚を
釣ってきてくれないかニャ？
そしたら、とっても珍しい
お魚と交換してやるニャ！
食べられないお魚なんて
いらないのニャ〜！

61865.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
61865.description: Even in a familiar jungle, a pro like me can find rare materials. Clear out the troublesome monsters wandering about there, and I will find you the rare material Thousand-Year Snow.
61865.descriptionEn:
Even in a familiar Jungle,
a pro like me can sniff out
rare materials, you know.
Just clear out the pesky
monsters wandering around
there, and I'll dig up the
rare "Millennium Snow".
61865.descriptionJp:
見なれた密林であっても、
俺のようなプロにかかれば、
希少素材を見つけ出すことが
可能なのさ。あの辺に徘徊
する邪魔なモンスターさえ
片付けてくれれば、希少素材
「千年雪」を見つけてやるぜ。

62183.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の討伐

21805.description: The Tigrex boasts overwhelming strength, but any creature must have a weak point! I say its weak point is the head! Aim for the head when it turns around!
21805.descriptionEn:
≪Tigrex≫ boasts overwhelming
strength, but every one of them
must have a ≪weak point≫!
I say its weak point is the
≪head≫! Aim for the head at the
moment it turns around!
21805.descriptionJp:
圧倒的な強さを誇る≪ティガ
レックス≫だが、どんなやつ
にだって≪弱点≫は必ずある
はず！オレはあいつの弱点は
≪頭≫だと見た！振り向くタ
イミングで頭を狙うんだ！

26282.description: Oh! You hunters! Doing well? I've come to make Armor Spheres! There are several kinds, and this time it's the Super Armor Sphere. Bring me Gem Fragments!
26282.descriptionEn:
Hey! You hunters, you!
Are you doing well?
I came to make Armor Spheres!
Several kinds exist, but this
time it's ≪Ultra Armor Sphere≫.
Bring me ≪Sphere Fragments≫!
26282.descriptionJp:
おう！ハンターの野郎ども！
元気でやってるか？
鎧玉を作りに来たぜ！
鎧玉は種類がいくつかあるが、
今回は≪超鎧玉≫だ。
≪玉のかけら≫を持ってきな！

62403.objectiveJp: ハンターダイス赤１個の納品
