62403.description: Thanks for the other day! Bring me a Hunter Die Red and I will trade you something lovely for it. Count on me from now on!
62403.descriptionEn:
Thanks for the other day!
Bring me a ≪Red Hunter Die≫
and I'll trade it for
something lovely.
Stick with me from now on too!
62403.descriptionJp:
この間はどうも！
≪ハンターダイス赤≫を
持ってきてくれたら、素敵な
物と交換してあげるぜ。
これからもよろしくな！

26194.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
26194.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26194.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26194.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

54218.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
54218.description: Revidiora has appeared at the interception base. Head to the site at once and deal with it. Word from the guild is that this request will be a joint request with the survey team. For the survey, be sure to break the wings and sever the tail before you hunt it.
54218.descriptionEn:
A Revidiora has appeared at
the Base. Head there at once
and deal with it.
According to the Guild, this
request is a joint operation
with the Research Team.
For the survey, be sure to
break its wings and cut its
tail before slaying it.
54218.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点にレビディオラが
現れました。至急、現地へ
向い対処してください。
ギルドからの連絡で、
今回の依頼は、調査団との
共同依頼となるようです。
調査のため翼の破壊と
尻尾の切断を必ず行って
から討伐してください。

62071.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐

62273.description: Hey, look at this. A fine weapon, no? This is one of the special weapons suited to Variants, and wearing it is a condition for some jobs. Will you make one too? Complete the jobs I recommend and I will share the leftover materials.
62273.descriptionEn:
Hey, take a look at this.
Nice weapon, huh? It's a kind of
special weapon suited for fighting
Variants. What's more, I hear
equipping it is a requirement for
certain requests.
Want to make one yourself?
Clear the requests I introduce
to you, and I'll share spare parts.
62273.descriptionJp:
よう、こいつを見てくれよ。
いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

62032.objectiveJp: ハンターカード赤１０枚納品
62032.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62032.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
62032.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

60246.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
60246.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Greadmos. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60246.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill! The
target this time is
≪Gureadomosu≫!
Achieve the goal together with
your Guildmates.
This contest is all about
teamwork, so take a top spot!
Also, SP weapons only!
Choose your weapon carefully!
60246.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪グレアドモス≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

60719.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60719.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60719.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60719.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

53279.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
53279.description: A corrupt daimyo who crushes the people under his tyranny has taken up position in the Desert with a ruffian bodyguard and his henchmen. The guard is strict, but there must be a gap. Make use of ninja garb and tools suited to stealth, seize the one moment of weakness, and slay the daimyo!
53279.descriptionEn:
A corrupt Daimyo who crushes the
people under his tyranny has taken
position in the Desert with
ruffian bodyguards and henchmen.
The guard is strict, but there
must be an opening somewhere.
Use ninja garb and tools made for
stealth, seize a moment's gap,
and strike down the Daimyo!
53279.descriptionJp:
圧政で民を押しつぶす
悪徳ダイミョウが荒くれ者の
用心棒と手下を連れて
砂漠に陣取っている。
警備は厳重だが、かならず
隙があるはずだ。
隠密に優れた忍装束と忍具を
駆使して、一瞬の隙を突き、
ダイミョウを討つのだ！

54278.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54278.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54278.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

53109.description: In this trial you are to slay one particular monster. But this monster will be hidden and asleep. So combine a Blast Spike, set off the bombs placed in the area and wake it up! Whatever you do, do not get caught in the blast, understood?
53109.descriptionEn:
For this trial, you will slay
a certain monster.
But it will be hidden and
sleeping. So combine a
"Blast Needle" and set off
the bombs placed in the area
to wake it up!
Whatever you do, don't get
caught in the blast!
53109.descriptionJp:
今回の試練ではとあるモンス
ター１頭を討伐してもらう。
ただしこのモンスターは姿を
隠し眠っているだろう。そこ
で「爆雷針」を調合しエリア
内に設置してある爆弾を爆発
させて叩き起こすのだ！
間違っても、爆発に巻き
込まれるんじゃないぞ？

61320.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61320.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61320.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

50329.description: This is sudden, but I want your help with an ecological survey of Kuarusepusu. If possible I would also like parts broken during this survey. I am sorry for the many requests, but for the sake of future research I would be most grateful.
50329.descriptionEn:
This is sudden, but I want help
surveying the ecology of
≪Kuarlusepusu≫.
For this survey I would like part
breaks too, if possible. Sorry for
all the demands, but for future
research, please lend a hand.
50329.descriptionJp:
突然だが、≪クアルセプス≫
の生態調査を手伝って欲しい。
今回の調査は可能であれば
部位破壊もお願いしたい。
注文が多く申し訳ないが、
今後の研究のために
是非よろしく頼む。

54787.description: An unidentified monster of great power is on a rampage at the Ancient Tower. The people around it are in danger as things stand! Head out to slay it at once! Should you save us from this crisis, I will provide materials used for some G-rank Supremacy arms and Fierce Species arms, in preparation for greater threats.
54787.descriptionEn:
An unidentified monster of immense
power is on a rampage at the
Ancient Tower. If this continues,
the people around it are in danger!
Please head out to slay it at once!
Those who save us from this crisis
will be provided with materials used
in some G Rank Zenith arms and
Retsu species arms, to prepare for
even greater threats.
54787.descriptionJp:
古塔で強大な力を持つ未確認
モンスターが暴れています。
このままでは周囲の人々が
危険です！一刻も早く討伐に
向かってください！
この危機を救ってくださった
ら、さらなる脅威に備え、
一部のＧ級覇種武具や烈種武
具に使用する素材を提供いた
します。

23263.description: This happened while I was surveying the extreme cold sea. The weather had been fine, but suddenly an ice fog arose. It had not rained, and the humidity was not high. I have no idea what happened. If you learn anything, tell me too.
23263.descriptionEn:
This happened while I was
surveying the Polar Sea.
The weather had been fine,
when suddenly an ice fog
rolled in.
It hadn't rained, and the
humidity wasn't high either.
I have no idea what happened.
Tell me if you find out.
23263.descriptionJp:
極海の調査をしていた時の
ことだ。これまで天気が
良かったのに、突然氷の霧が
発生したんだ。
雨が降ったわけでもないし、
湿度が高かったわけでもない。
一体何が起きたのか、見当も
つかない。何かわかったら、
僕にも教えてくれ。

62307.description: You have done well to come this far. Your mushroom path is almost complete! Bring me every Aster Rare Bag you have collected! I will present you with proof of a true mushroom maniac!
62307.descriptionEn:
You have done well to come this
far. Your mushroom path is nearly
complete! Bring every Shion Rare
Pouch you have gathered so far
to me! I shall present you with
proof of a true mushroom maniac!
62307.descriptionJp:
よくここまで頑張ったね。
君のキノコ道はあと少しだ！
今まで集めた紫苑の稀袋を全
て私のところへ持ってくるん
だ！キノコマニアとしての証
を君に進呈しよう！

26473.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟

62244.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
62244.description: What, you just want a hard Gunlance? Then I will refine some Argen Steel for you! But the ore needed to make it is hard to find, and troublesome monsters roam nearby. Go and search with spirit!
62244.descriptionEn:
What, you want a really hard
Gunlance?
Then I will refine some Argen
Steel for you!
But the ore needed to make it is
hard to find, and nasty monsters
roam nearby besides.
Go and find it with all your
spirit!
62244.descriptionJp:
なに、とにかく堅いガンラン
スが欲しいって？
それなら、アルゲン鋼を精製
してやろう！
だが、あれを造るのに必要な
鉱石は、なかなか見つからな
い上に、付近には厄介なモン
スターまでうろついてやがる。
気合を入れて探してきてくれ！

53006.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
53006.description: Ladies and gentlemen hunters, thank you indeed for joining our party. The main dish will be served shortly, so please wait in the first area outside base camp. May this evening be a fond memory for you all.
53006.descriptionEn:
Ladies and gentlemen hunters,
thank you sincerely for
joining our party.
The main dish will be served
shortly, so please wait in the
first area beyond the Base
Camp.
May tonight be a fond memory
for you all.
53006.descriptionJp:
紳士淑女のハンターの皆様、
この度はパーティへのご参加、
誠にありがとうございます。
メインディッシュはすぐに
お届けしますので、ベース
キャンプを出た最初のエリア
にてお待ちくださいませ。
今宵があなた様方の良き
思い出となりますように。

55018.description: You found this job well! I am a genius! I have developed a new weapon not found in Mezeporuta. If you want to know the secret, complete as many hidden jobs as you can. However, you must always complete at least the main target. I wish you success!
55018.descriptionEn:
You found this request — well done!
I am a genius! I've developed
a new weapon that Mezeporta
never had. If you wish to know
this secret, complete as many
hidden requests as you can.
However, at the very least you
must complete the main target.
I wish you good fortune!
55018.descriptionJp:
よくぞこの依頼を見つけた！
ワシは天才じゃ！メゼポルタ
には無かった新しい武器を開
発したぞい。この秘密を知り
たくば、隠された依頼をでき
るだけ多く達成することじゃ。
ただし、最低でも必ずメイン
ターゲットは達成しなければ
ならぬぞ。健闘を祈る！

21106.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟

53017.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
53017.description: I mean to make dolls to wish for the healthy growth of the girls of Mezeporta, but making them normally would not be interesting. I shall try making dolls modelled on monsters! So I want you to hunt the monster that will serve as the model, and report on its shape and traits!
53017.descriptionEn:
I mean to make dolls to wish
for the healthy growth of
Mezeporuta's girls, but making
them plainly would be dull.
So I will model them on
monsters! Hunt the model
monster and report its shape
and traits to me!
53017.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタの女の子達の元気
な成長を願って人形を作って
やろうと思うのだが普通に
作っても面白くない。
ワシは、モンスターをモデル
に人形を作ってみようと
思う！そこで、そのモデルと
なるモンスターを狩猟し、
その造形や特徴の報告を
お願いしたい！

54634.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

26641.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

62752.description: Coins are normally obtained by undergoing strict hunting exercises, but this time we have prepared an exercise focused on training. Do not miss this chance to obtain Guild Coins and other coins. We await your applications!
62752.descriptionEn:
Coins are normally earned by
putting in hard hunting drills,
but this time we have prepared
a drill focused on training.
Do not miss this chance to get
≪Guild Coins≫ and other coins.
We are waiting for your
applications!
62752.descriptionJp:
普段は厳しい狩猟演習を積む
ことで入手できるコインだが、
今回は訓練を集中して行う
演習を用意した。
≪ギルドコイン≫など各種
コインが入手できるこの機を
逃すなよ。
諸君らの申込みを待っている！

62807.description: I love petal patterns! I am always making decorations with petal patterns, but today I have run short of materials. Please, hunter, gather them for me instead! In return I will share a little of my collection.
62807.descriptionEn:
I love petal patterns!
I'm always making petal-
pattern decorations, but
today I'm short on materials.
Please, hunter, go gather
them for me!
In return I'll share a little
of my collection.
62807.descriptionJp:
私は花びら柄が好き！
いつも花びら柄の装飾品を
作ってるんだけど、今日は
素材が足りなくて困ってるの。
お願い、ハンターさん、
私の代わりに集めてきて！
お礼に私のコレクションを
少し分けてあげるわ。

54288.description: 2 Shogun Ceanataur are running wild in the volcano! Brave hunters confident in their skill, go and rescue the wounded and hunt the Ceanataur! The bounty will be generous!
54288.descriptionEn:
Two ≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ are
rampaging in the Volcano!
Brave hunters sure of their
skill, go rescue the wounded
and hunt the Shogun Ceanataur!
I'll pay a hefty bounty!
54288.descriptionJp:
火山で２匹の≪鎌蟹≫が大暴
れしておる！
腕に覚えのある、勇敢なハン
ターは、負傷者の救出および、
鎌蟹の狩猟に向かうのじゃ！
賞金はがっつり出すぞい！

40192.description: This quest yields enough materials to produce at once any one weapon that can be made from the materials obtainable from the monsters of the Extreme Expedition quest, Rage Roaring in the Flame that Scorches the Earth. A Special Hunting Ticket is required to accept it. Note that the Special Hunting Ticket is consumed if you fail.
40192.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
the materials to craft any one
of the weapons made from
materials dropped by the
monster in the Extreme Quest
"Roaring Rage in Earth-
Scorching Flames". A Special
Hunting Ticket is required.
Note that failing will consume
your Special Hunting Ticket.
40192.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは極征クエスト
「地焦がす劫焔に轟く憤怒」
のモンスターから獲得できる
素材で生産可能な武器いずれ
かを一発生産できる素材が獲
得できます。受注には特別狩
猟チケットが必要です。
失敗時は特別狩猟チケットは
消費されますのでご注意くだ
さい。

54730.description: Abiorugu are said to communicate their intentions to one another. Their 'double strike' is equal to hunters' teamwork. In other words, this hunt is an even match! Break the Abiorugu's fangs and show skill worthy of a true hunter!
54730.descriptionEn:
Abiorugu are said to share
their thoughts with one
another. Their "Twin Strike"
is equal to hunters'
teamwork. In other words,
this hunt is a fifty-fifty
matchup! Break the Abiorugu's
fangs and show the skill
worthy of a true hunter!
54730.descriptionJp:
アビオルグは互いに意思を
通わせるモンスターだと
言われている。やつらの
「双撃」は、ハンター達の
連携にも等しい。つまり
この狩り、五分と五分！
アビオルグの牙を折り、
真のハンターにふさわしい
腕前を示せっ！

1068.description: Gravios is called the Tyrant of the Blaze. Piercing the outer shell it grew to absurd hardness by eating coal and ore takes a well-honed weapon! Slip past the beast and deliver Blast Rock and that's OK too!
1068.descriptionEn:
≪Gravios≫ is called the
Emperor of Blazing Heat. To
pierce the shell it grew
from eating coal and ore,
you need a finely honed
weapon! Stealing past its
eyes to drop ≪Blast Stone≫? OK!
1068.descriptionJp:
≪グラビモス≫は灼熱の覇者
とも呼ばれてる。燃石や鉱石
を食べて異常なまでの硬度に
発達した外殻を突き破るには
相当磨かれた武器が必要だ！
ヤツの目を盗んで≪火薬岩≫
を納めてくれてもＯＫだぜ！

26687.description: Mm, it is I. In this quest we settle your control type, give the bare minimum of advice, and hunt Gogo Moa together with me! This quest specially has no failure condition. So we won't stop until it's down! Right, let's do our best!
26687.descriptionEn:
Yes, it is I.
In this quest you choose your
control type and get a bare
minimum of advice. Then we
hunt a ≪Gogomoa≫ together!
This quest specially has no
failure conditions. We don't
stop until it's down!
Right, let's do this!
26687.descriptionJp:
うむ、我輩だ。
このクエストでは操作タイプ
の決定と、必要最低限のアド
バイス。そして我輩と共に
≪ゴゴモア≫を狩猟するぞ！
このクエストは特別に、失敗
条件を設けていない。だから
倒すまで終わらせないぞ！
よし、頑張るぞー！

62883.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
62883.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. If a hunter carrying a Secret Scroll comes along, we will give you an even finer reward. Do prepare your Festival Certificate and join us.
62883.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a special
request and rewards for
members of a winning guild
from the Hunter Festival.
If someone with a Secret Art
scroll comes along, we'll give
even finer rewards. Bring
your Festival Proof and join.
62883.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
している方専用の特別依頼と
報酬をご用意させていただき
ました。秘伝書をお持ちの方
が同行すれば、さらに素敵な
報酬を差し上げます。祭典の
証をご用意の上、ぜひご参加
ください。

21815.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21815.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21815.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21815.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

21439.description: Yo. Long time no see. Are you enjoying mining today too? I have prepared a job to show you how good mining is again. Gather three of the five kinds including Rusted Fragments. The reward is ready, so go with confidence!
21439.descriptionEn:
Yo. Long time no see.
Still enjoying your mining?
I've got a request for you,
to show off how good mining is.
Gather any 3 of 5 kinds,
rusted chunks and the like.
The reward is ready and waiting,
so off you go with confidence!
21439.descriptionJp:
よぉ。久しぶりだな。
今日も楽しく採掘してるか？
また、採掘の良さを知っても
らう為に、依頼を用意したぞ。
さびた塊など５種類の中から
３つを集めてもらうぜ。
報酬はちゃんと用意してある
から安心して行ってこい！

53133.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の捕獲
53133.description: Everyone! Are you in burning love? If you catch the hottest Lavasioth for me, I will share my finest sweets! It is White Day, so let us send hot affection to the ladies!
53133.descriptionEn:
Everyone! Are you burning
with love??
Catch the hottest Volganos
around for me,
and I'll share the finest
sweets with you!
It's White Day, after all,
so let's send the ladies
some heated affection!
53133.descriptionJp:
みんな！燃えるような恋を
しているかい？？
最高にヒートな溶岩竜を
捕まえてくれたら、
俺から最高のスイーツを
おすそわけ！
せっかくのホワイトデー
なんだから、女子諸君には
ヒートな愛情を送ろうぜ！

55403.description: A Giaorugu with a greatly developed tail has appeared. The Guild will classify this individual as a Divergent species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports it is more dangerous than the Giaorugu known so far. Conduct the survey with care.
55403.descriptionEn:
A Giaorugu with a greatly
developed tail has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a Supremacy
with developed parts and
will begin a survey.
Reports say it is more
dangerous than past Giaorugu.
Please survey with caution.
55403.descriptionJp:
尻尾が大きく発達した
≪氷獰竜≫が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの氷獰竜より危険
との報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

50661.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
50661.description: Among the children of Mezeporta a rumour called the Legend of a White Christmas is spreading. It seems that if the Snowy Mountains are dyed pure white at this time of year, someone red will appear. For the sake of the children hoping for that red person's arrival, please investigate the rumour!
50661.descriptionEn:
A rumor called "the Legend of
a White Christmas" is going
around among the children of
Mezepolta. They say dyeing
the Snowy Mountains pure
white this season summons
someone in red. For the kids
hoping to see that red
figure, please investigate!
50661.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタの子供たちの間で
「白いクリスマスの伝説」と
いう噂が広まっています。
なんでも、この時期に雪山を
真っ白に染めると赤い何者か
が現れるというのです。
赤いあの方の登場に期待して
いる子供たちのためにも、
噂の調査をお願いします！

61116.objectiveJp: イャンクック亜種１頭の狩猟
61116.description: I found a good vein of ore in the Jungle, but a Blue Yian Kut-Ku is clinging to it and in the way. While I go to dig, I want you to drive it off nicely. I will pay your reward from the ore we dig.
61116.descriptionEn:
I found a fine ore vein in the
Jungle, but a Blue Yian Kut-Ku
is hanging around and in the way.
While I go to dig, I'd like you to
drive it off for me, nicely.
I'll pay you from the ore we
dig up.
61116.descriptionJp:
密林でいい鉱脈を見つけたん
だが、イャンクック亜種が張
りついていて邪魔なんだ。
俺が掘りに行っている間に、
上手く追い払って欲しい。
報酬は掘れた鉱石から支払う
よ。

60219.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ２匹の狩猟
60219.description: Two powerful Daimyo Hermitaur have appeared. The Guild will pay a large sum to the hunter who slays both. In exchange, other returns are modest, so be aware.
60219.descriptionEn:
Two powerful ≪Daimyo
Hermitaur≫ have appeared.
The Guild will pay a hefty
sum to the hunter who slays
both of them. In exchange,
other rewards are slim, so
keep that in mind.
60219.descriptionJp:
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫の強力
な個体が２匹現れたわ。
ギルドでは、この２匹を討伐
したハンターに、多額の報酬
金を支払うことになったの。
その代わり、その他の見返り
は控えめなので要注意よ。

40206.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟

23414.description: This quest yields upgrade materials and the like for 1 part of the Dragon series, G-rank Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23414.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
upgrade materials for one piece of
the ≪G Rank Armor≫ Dragon Series,
among other things.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
23414.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪Ｇ級防具≫
ドラゴンシリーズ１部位分
の強化素材などが入手できま
す。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

55321.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55321.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55321.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

50678.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Stroma FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50678.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of
the Zenith Armor
Stroma FX series.
Accepting it requires a
"Superior Ticket."
Note that if the quest
fails, your "Superior
Ticket" is still consumed.
50678.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
ストロマFXシリーズの１部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

54891.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54891.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54891.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

22036.objectiveJp: ヴォルガノス１頭の狩猟
22036.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Lavasioth will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
22036.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall
Guild, we now recommend trying
a new sub-target.
The 'fixed damage' dealt to
≪Volganos≫ will be judged by
this Guild, so simply focus on
completing the main target,
everyone!
22036.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ヴォルガノス≫への『一定
ダメージ』は、当ギルドで判
断しますので、皆さんはメイ
ンターゲットの達成に専念し
てくだされば結構ですよ！

50273.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

26510.objectiveJp: リオレイア希少種１頭の狩猟

53153.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
53153.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
53153.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

62038.objectiveJp:
撃退できずにタイムアップ
報酬金ゼロ　拠点の耐久値ゼロ
62038.description: Lao-Shan Lung is advancing on the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma, with unprecedented force! Please repel it using the fortress interception equipment! It is an emergency request, so if you repel it we will issue more Proofs of Slaying than usual!
62038.objectiveEn:
Time up without repelling
Zero reward money, zero Base durability
62038.descriptionEn:
Lao-Shan Lung is advancing
on the Fort, the gateway to
Dundorma, with unheard-of
force! Please repel it
using the Fort's defense
installations! This is an
emergency request, so if you
repel it, I'll issue more
Slay Proofs than usual!
62038.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマへの玄関口となる
≪砦≫に、老山龍ラオシャン
ロンが、未だかつてない勢い
で侵攻してきてます！砦の
迎撃設備を利用しての撃退を
お願いします！緊急依頼です
ので、撃退できましたら、
普段よりも多めの討伐の証を
発行いたしましょう！

58047.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58047.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58047.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58047.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

54829.objectiveJp: ハルドメルグ１体の討伐
54829.description: Hunters aiming for GR500, we have prepared a quest where slaying Harudomerugu raises your evaluation and lets you cheaply obtain popular G Rank decorations. Please make good use of it!
54829.descriptionEn:
Hunters aiming for GR500,
we have prepared a quest
where slaying Dahren Mohran
raises your evaluation and
lets you cheaply obtain
popular G Rank decorations.
Please make good use of it!
54829.descriptionJp:
ＧＲ５００を目指す
ハンター様、ハルドメルグを
討伐することで、ハンター様
の評価を上げ、人気Ｇ級
装飾品をお得に入手できる
クエストを準備致しました。
ぜひ、お役立て下さい！

63205.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
63205.description: Reports of extremely powerful monsters' incursions have been increasing lately. The Guild is promoting the spread of Tenran armor in preparation, and the completion reward for this request includes the precious materials that are its base. I want you hunters not to miss this chance.
63205.descriptionEn:
Lately, reports of extremely powerful
monsters' arrival keep increasing.
The Guild is spreading Tenran Armor
to prepare for them, and this
request's completion reward includes
the precious materials behind it.
Hunters, all of you, I ask
that you do not let this
chance slip by.
63205.descriptionJp:
昨今、非常に強力な
モンスターの襲来報告が増え
てきている。ギルドは、
これに備え天嵐防具の普及を
進めているが、この依頼の
達成報酬には、その元となる
貴重な素材が含まれている。
ハンター諸君には、是非
この機会を逃さないでほしい。

21027.objectiveJp: 灰水晶の原石３個の納品
21027.description: Gypceros is also called the Poison Bird Wyvern! True to the name, it sprays poison everywhere and thrashes about, a nuisance of a bird wyvern! It has a cunning side too, playing dead when it senses danger, so do be careful!
21027.descriptionEn:
≪Gypceros≫ is known by
another name: the Poison
Bird! Just as the name
says, it sprays poison and
runs wild, a real nuisance!
It also plays dead when it
senses danger, so take care!
21027.descriptionJp:
≪ゲリョス≫は別名、毒怪鳥
と呼ばれるモンスターです！
呼び名のとおり、毒液を吐き
散らして暴れまわる迷惑な怪
鳥です！自分の身の危機を感
じると死んだふりをするズル
賢い面もあるのでご注意を！

26421.objectiveJp: アカムトルム１頭の討伐

1009.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
1009.description: At the waterside this season, the Shield Crab Daimyo Hermitaur may show itself. Dealing damage to a body protected by a hard shell is no easy thing! It's OK to carve Crab Miso from Zamite and deliver it!
1009.descriptionEn:
In this season, Daimyo
Hermitaur sometimes appears
by the water. Damaging that
hard-shelled body is no
easy task! It's fine to
carve Hermitaur Roe from the
small crabs and deliver it!
1009.descriptionJp:
この季節の水辺には、盾蟹
≪ダイミョウザザミ≫が姿を
現すことがある。硬い殻に守
られた体にダメージを与える
のは容易いことじゃない！
ヤオザミから≪ザザミソ≫を
剥いで納品してもＯＫだぜ！

26562.description: On the way to and from the Canyon I keep being attacked by Felynes and Melynx and I am in trouble. At this rate I cannot deliver my goods. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
26562.descriptionEn:
On the way to and from the
Canyon, I keep getting attacked
by Felynes and Melynxes.
At this rate I can't deliver my
goods. If you help me out, I'll
give you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ you can trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫ as thanks!
26562.descriptionJp:
峡谷との行き帰りの途中で、
アイルーとメラルーに襲われ
て困っているんだ。このまま
じゃ、商品を届ける事ができ
ない。助けてくれたら、≪肉
球のコイン≫と交換できる
≪クエスト達成証≫をお礼に
あげるよ！

21395.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟

60656.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Espinas! That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60656.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is
Espinas!
Taking on a monster all
alone, what splendid spirit!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Supremacy weapons only!
60656.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪エスピナス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

54264.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
54264.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
54264.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
54264.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

54342.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
54342.description: Defeat a monster a little bigger than usual and find a bracelet, nya! I'll trade you my pick of goods, nya! What's it for? You'd better not pry any further, nya.
54342.descriptionEn:
Defeat a monster a tiny bit bigger
than usual and find a bracelet,
nyah!
I'll trade you my top pick for it,
nyah!
What do I want it for?
It's better not to pry any further
than that, nyah.
54342.descriptionJp:
いつもよりすこ〜し大きい
モンスターを倒して腕輪を見
つけてくるのニャ！
イチオシの品と交換してやる
ニャよ！
何に使うのかって？
それ以上は踏み込まないほう
がいいニャよ。

6001.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
6001.description: Yo. I, your destined rival, will give you valuable information. It is the whereabouts of the black wolf bird, Yian Garuga! A proud lone wolf. Exactly the sort I am. Joking aside, it is an outrageously savage foe, but will you try?
6001.descriptionEn:
Yo. Your destined rival,
me, will give you some
precious information. It's
the whereabouts of Yian
Garuga! A proud lone wolf.
Just like me, really.
No joke, it's brutally
savage. Want to try it?
6001.descriptionJp:
よう。宿命のライバルこと
このオレが、オマエに貴重な
情報を与えてやろう。それは、
黒狼鳥≪イャンガルルガ≫の
居場所だ！誇り高い一匹狼。
まさしくオレのようなヤツだ。
冗談抜きでとてつもなく凶暴
な相手だが、挑んでみるか？

21738.objectiveJp: ゲリョス亜種１頭の狩猟
21738.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Vermilion Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21738.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the spheres
called Akatan Spheres?
Their materials are vital
to crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you complete this
request, I'll give you
precious decoration parts.
21738.descriptionJp:
赤丹原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

51019.description: Here is a request that yields the materials needed to craft and upgrade one piece of Floating Peak armor, the Hardcore Armor of Poborubarumu known as the Floating Peak and Floating Ridge series. It is a generous quest, so do give it a try!
51019.descriptionEn:
Here is a request for the
Yama Tsukami Hardcore Armor,
the "Fuhou/Furei" series:
you can get the materials
to craft one piece.
It's a bargain quest, so
please give it a try!
51019.descriptionJp:
浮峰龍の≪剛種防具≫
「浮峰／浮嶺シリーズ」
１部位分の生産強化に
必要な素材を入手できる
依頼をご紹介します。
オトクなクエストですので
ぜひチャレンジしてください！

54603.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Hypnocatrice and prove what you can do. Clear this quest and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
54603.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters to
show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Hypnocatrice≫ and
show us what you can do.
Clear the quest and your standing
as a hunter will shoot right
up!
54603.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
見事≪眠鳥≫を狩猟して
みせろ。
クエストをクリアできたら、
諸君のハンターとしての
評価がグイっと上がるぞ！

50915.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, an Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, was newly observed in the Snowy Mountains. According to hunters who faced it, it unleashes attacks using ice. Please take the greatest care not to neglect your preparations.
50915.descriptionEn:
With the appearance of the
Transcendent species, surveys
have been pushed across the land,
and a Barioth, the Ice Fang Wyvern,
has now been sighted in the
Snowy Mountains. Hunters who faced
it report it unleashes ice attacks.
Please do not neglect your preparations.
50915.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、雪山に
氷牙竜・ベリオロスが新たに
観測されました。対峙した
ハンターの情報によると、
氷を使った攻撃を繰り出して
くるとのこと。準備を怠らぬ
ようくれぐれもご注意下さい。

21624.description: Do you know of the sphere called the Kerria Sphere? Its material is essential to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request and I shall give you rare decoration material.
21624.descriptionEn:
Do you know of the spheres
called Yamabuki Spheres?
Their materials are vital
to crafting a certain
expensive decoration.
If you complete this
request, I'll give you
precious decoration parts.
21624.descriptionJp:
山吹原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

61405.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
61405.description: A suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress at tremendous speed! At once, make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon! If our strength is not enough, breaking that giant leg alone will do.
61405.descriptionEn:
A suspicious dragon is approaching
the Fortress at tremendous speed!
At once, make use of the Fortress's
interceptor weapons and repel the
mysterious giant dragon!
If your strength is not enough, then
at least break those giant legs
for us.
61405.descriptionJp:
怪しげな龍が物凄い勢いで
砦に接近してきています！
大至急、砦の迎撃兵器を活用
し、謎の巨大龍を撃退して
ください！
戦力が及ばない場合、あの巨
大な脚の破壊だけでもお願い
します。

54529.description: White and black wyverns have appeared at the summit of the Ancient Tower. These 2 are opposites by nature and could never appear in the same place. This must be called a reckless request. Yet I believe that you, with all your achievements, will find a way.
54529.descriptionEn:
White and black wyverns have
appeared at the top of the
Ancient Tower. These two are
opposites by nature, so they
could never appear in the same
place.
I must call this a reckless
request. But I believe that you,
with all your achievements,
will somehow see it through.
54529.descriptionJp:
古塔の頂部に、白と黒の飛竜
が現れました。本来この２頭
は、相反する存在であるため、
同じ場所に現れることはあり
えないことです。
これは、無謀な依頼と言わざ
るを得ません。しかし、数多
くの功績を残したあなたなら
なんとかしてくれると信じて
います。

62261.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62261.description: You know that Gasurabazura chase their prey in coordination. I believe the secret of that splendid coordination lies in their roars. So would you go and see whether they coordinate while roaring? If you let me know what you observe, I will share precious hides.
62261.descriptionEn:
You know the Orugarons
hunt their prey together.
I believe the secret of
that fine teamwork is the
roar.
So, would you go and see
whether they roar as they
coordinate their hunt?
If you report what you see
to me, I'll share pelts.
62261.descriptionJp:
響狼たちが連携しながら獲物
を追うことは知っているな。
私はその見事な連携の秘密は、
咆哮にあると考えている。
そこで、彼らが咆哮しながら
連携しているかどうか、見に
行ってくれないか。
その様子を私に知らせてくれ
たら、貴重なケガワを分けて
あげよう。

11054.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐

40208.description: Did you get the Soul Gem from the guide at the entrance? Good. I want you to survey the desert. Once you set out you will lose that gem, but there's no need to panic. You will find it again and bring it to me. I'll make it worth your while.
40208.descriptionEn:
Did you get the ≪Soul Gem≫
from the guide at the gate?
Good. I want you to survey
the desert for me.
You'll lose that gem once
you set out, but there's
no need to panic.
Find it and bring it to me.
I'll make it worth your while.
40208.descriptionJp:
≪ソウルジェム≫を入口の
ガイドから受け取ったかい？
いいだろう。君には砂漠の
調査を頼みたいんだ。
出発後、君はその宝石を失う
ことになるけれど、慌てる
必要はない。
必ず見つけ出し、僕に渡すん
だ。悪いようにはしないよ。

23442.objectiveJp: 秘伝勲の結晶１個の納品
23442.description: This quest yields the following materials. Gunlance Merit (Beginning) x５０, Gunlance Merit (Middle) x６０, Gunlance Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you must be ＧＲ５００ or above.
23442.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials.
≪Gunlance Merit: Intro≫ x50
≪Gunlance Merit: Mid≫ x60
≪Gunlance Merit: Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest, you must be
GR500 or higher, so please keep
that in mind.
23442.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ガンランス勲・序≫５０個
≪ガンランス勲・中≫６０個
≪ガンランス勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

55883.description: White really is best for Guku. It suits any outfit. A Santa outfit looks great with red on a pure white body. White and red is the best set. Right! I want to see other red sets besides Santa! Please! Put a Rathalos and a white Guku on stage together!
55883.descriptionEn:
White is best for Gooks.
Any costume suits them.
The Santa outfit is great:
red on pure white pops.
A white-and-red set is nice.
Oh! I want to see other
red pairings too!
Please! Put a Rathalos and a
white Gook on stage together!
55883.descriptionJp:
やっぱりグークは白が一番。
どんな衣装も似合うし。
サンタ衣装なんて、純白の
体に赤い服が映えて最高。
白と赤のセットがいいわね。
そうだ！サンタ衣装以外の
赤とのセットも見てみたいわ！
お願い！リオレウスと、白い
グークを共演させて！

63399.objectiveJp: ブルファンゴ７頭の討伐
63399.description: Nyaa nyaa! Just a tiny little test, meow! An easy quest, but clear it and I will give you a precious Dark Cat Pack Badge, meow! Even the Dark Cat Pack has mercy, meow!
63399.descriptionEn:
Nyaa nyaa!
Just a tiny little survey!
It's an easy quest, but
clear it and I'll give you
a rare Dark Cat Gang
Badge, nya!
Dark Cat Gang has mercy!
63399.descriptionJp:
ニャーニャー！
ほんのコテコテ調べニャ！
簡単なクエストニャけど
クリアできれば貴重な
≪闇猫団バッチ≫を
くれてやるニャ！
闇猫団にも情けはあるニャ！

55073.description: A new monster has been discovered in the volcano. The guild has named the creature Voljang, the Crimson Lion, and classified it as a Prime Species. Every blow it lands is terribly heavy, and when enraged it is said to wrap its whole body in searing flame. Please lend us your strength and bring it down!
55073.descriptionEn:
A new monster has been found in
the Volcano.
The guild names it the Crimson
Lion, Vojan, and classes it as
an Origin Species.
Each of its blows is terribly
heavy, and when enraged it
wraps its body in searing flame.
Lend us your strength to slay it!
55073.descriptionJp:
火山で新たなモンスターが
発見されました。
ギルドは対象を紅蓮獅子、
≪ヴォージャン≫と定め、
≪始種≫に分類しました。
繰り出される攻撃は一撃一撃
が非常に重く、怒ると全身に
灼熱の炎をまとうそうです。
討伐に力を貸してください！

23520.description: A Rathalos with greatly developed wings has appeared. The guild classifies this individual as an Anomalous Species with developed parts and will investigate it. Reports say it is more dangerous than Rathalos seen so far. Conduct the survey with care.
23520.descriptionEn:
A ≪Rathalos≫ with greatly
developed wings has appeared.
The Guild classifies this individual
as a ≪Supremacy≫ with developed
parts, and will conduct a survey.
There are reports that it is more
dangerous than any Rathalos so far.
Please take care during the survey.
23520.descriptionJp:
翼が大きく発達した≪火竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの火竜より危険との
報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

50268.description: This quest yields the following materials. Tonfa Soul (Beginning) x８５, Tonfa Soul (Middle) x１９５, Tonfa Soul (Extreme) x２７５, Tonfa Soul (Heaven) x８５. Note that a Secret Soul Crystal is required to accept the quest.
50268.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Tonfa Soul: Intro≫ x85
≪Tonfa Soul: Mid≫ x195
≪Tonfa Soul: Extreme≫ x275
≪Tonfa Soul: Heaven≫ x85
To accept the quest,
a ≪Secret Art Soul Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
50268.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪穿龍棍魂・序≫８５枚
≪穿龍棍魂・中≫１９５枚
≪穿龍棍魂・極≫２７５枚
≪穿龍棍魂・天≫８５枚
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝魂の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

23214.description: The survey team reports discovering the dwelling of a Rathian. It is close to where the team is staying, so the situation is quite dangerous. We ask for a prompt resolution. This hunt takes place in a region where the survey has not yet progressed. Take every care.
23214.descriptionEn:
The survey team reports
that a Rathian's nest has
been found.
It is close to where the
team is staying, so the
situation is quite dangerous.
Please resolve it at once.
Note the hunt takes place
in a region not yet fully
surveyed. Exercise caution.
23214.descriptionJp:
調査団からの報告で、
雌火竜の棲みかを発見した
との報告がありました。
調査団の滞在している場所
から近いため、かなり危険
な状態です。早急な解決を
お願いします。
まだ、調査の進んでいない
地域での狩猟となります。
十分注意をしてください。

23273.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
23273.description: Would you take me to the unsurveyed part of the swamp? New discoveries are being reported one after another, are they not. I too wish to go there and make a great discovery. Only, they say it is a dangerous place. I would like you to escort me.
23273.descriptionEn:
Would you take me to the
unsurveyed parts of the
Swamp?
New finds are being
reported one after another,
aren't they?
I want to go there and make
a great discovery myself.
It's risky. Please escort me!
23273.descriptionJp:
私を、沼地の未調査地域へ
連れて行ってくれないか。
新しい発見が次々報告され
ているそうじゃないか。
私もその場所へ行き偉大な
発見をしたいと思っている
のだ。ただ、かなり危険な
場所という話。護衛をお願
いしたいんだ。

26240.description: The solitary one-horned wyvern Monoblos may be called the king that pairs with Diablos in the Desert. To hunt it with 1 hunter is held to be proof of a first-rate hunter. There is nothing for it but to try.
26240.descriptionEn:
The solitary one-horned
dragon ≪Monoblos≫ could well
be called the king that pairs
with Diablos in the Desert.
To ≪hunt it alone≫ is said
to prove a Hunter is first-rate.
All that remains is to try.
26240.descriptionJp:
孤高の一角竜≪モノブロス≫
は砂漠においてディアブロス
と対をなす王者といえよう。
ヤツを『１人で狩る』ことが
ハンターとして、一流の証明
とされておる。
挑戦あるのみじゃ。

53268.objectiveJp: チャチャブー１５匹の討伐
53268.description: The season when the Shakalaka run wild has come again this year, meow. They seem to be waiting for challengers to a game of hide and seek, meow. According to my comrades' information, if you slay a certain number of Shakalaka a closed path opens and you can have an audience with the Hide and Seek King, meow. Do your best, meow.
53268.descriptionEn:
The season when the Masked
Tribe runs wild is here, nya.
Seems they're waiting for
challengers to a hide-and-
seek match, nya. Word from
my pals says slaying enough
of them opens the closed
path, and you can meet the
Hide-and-Seek King, nya!
53268.descriptionJp:
今年も奇面族たちが暴れまわ
る季節がやってきたニャ。
ヤツらはどうやらかくれんぼ
対決の挑戦者を待っているよ
うニャ。仲間の情報によると
奇面族を一定数討伐すれば
閉ざされた道が開いて
かくれんぼキングと謁見でき
るらしいニャ。頑張るニャ。

55264.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟

21771.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟

26642.objectiveJp: ディアブロス亜種１頭の狩猟

50362.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
50362.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the beak of an Azure Hypnocatrice will also grant a special ingredient.
50362.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Azure Hypnocatrice's beak,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50362.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
蒼眠鳥のクチバシを破壊する
ことで特別な食材も付与させ
ていただきます。

22150.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22150.description: Hunter who would master the Magnetic Slash Hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Hyujikiki in the arena! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
22150.descriptionEn:
You who would master the Magnet
Spike, show the skill you have
honed against the Diamolde of
the Arena!
Hunt it in fine style, and you
will earn far more reward than
your daily efforts would bring.
22150.descriptionJp:
磁斬鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

54251.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
54251.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
54251.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

22122.description: Teostra has been confirmed rampaging in the swamp. It will be dangerous in various ways, but please investigate. The reward is precious decoration materials.
22122.descriptionEn:
Teostra has been confirmed to be
running wild in the Swamp.
It will be dangerous in many ways,
but please carry out a survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
22122.descriptionJp:
沼地でテオ・テスカトルが暴
れているのが確認されました。
何かと危険かとは思いますが、
調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54758.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54758.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. Go to the site and stand ready for a support request from the hunting party!
54758.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground. Go
to the site and stand ready for the slaying team's aid request!
54758.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
現地に赴き、討伐隊からの
支援要請に備えてください！

62910.description: This is an exchange post only hunters holding a Secret Scroll may enter. Deliver proof of distinguished results in official hunting tournaments and I'll give you materials to further strengthen the arms you won as prizes. You can't get them with half-hearted skill, you know?
62910.descriptionEn:
This is an exchange post only
hunters with a Secret Art book
may enter. Deliver proof of
outstanding results in an
official hunting tournament,
and as a prize I will give you
materials to further upgrade
the gear you have won.
Half-hearted skill will not earn them!
62910.descriptionJp:
ここは秘伝書を持つハンター
にのみ入場が許された交換所
だ。公式狩猟大会で優秀な成
績をおさめたことを証明する
証を納品すれば、賞品として
手に入れた武具を更に強化す
るための素材をやろう。生半
可な実力では手に入れること
はできんぞ？

50296.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50296.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
50296.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!
50296.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君！
武具を手に入れただけで
満足しているのでは？
それではイカンのです！
このクエストを達成して、
更なる武具の強化を成し遂げ
ましょう！

62327.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
62327.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
62327.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
62327.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

63041.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟

28088.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability.
28088.descriptionEn:
The Guild is considering
offering the materials it
keeps in storage to veteran
hunters.
However, our stock is limited,
so we must ask that only
hunters of proven skill apply
for this offer.
28088.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、凄腕ハンター
の方々に向けて、ギルドで
保管している素材の提供を
考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。

53217.description: It is I! The Instructor! The newly discovered monster is called Elzelion, and it is a terrifying thing wreathed in fire and ice! So! Let us counter by throwing ice bombs at a fire wyvern! I am smart! Gahaha!
53217.descriptionEn:
It is I! The Instructor!
The newly found monster is
called "Eruzerion," and it
wraps itself in fire and
ice, a terrifying beast!
So here's the plan!
Hit the Rathalos with ice
bombs to cancel it out!
I'm so clever! Gahaha!
53217.descriptionJp:
我輩だ！教官だ！
新発見されたモンスターは
「エルゼリオン」といって、
火と氷を纏った恐ろしい
ヤツらしい！
そこでだ！
火竜に氷爆弾をぶつけて
相殺といこうじゃないか！
我輩、頭イイ！ガハハ！

5006.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリの撃退

62063.description: This time we hold special training for hunters with little experience yet! In the Volcano, hunt a Gravios and slay great numbers of Vespoid. Then carry back one red hot Firestone and deliver it. It is harsh training, but if you see it through, your standing as a hunter will rise markedly!
62063.descriptionEn:
This time, we hold special
training for Hunters with
little experience yet!
In the Volcano, hunt a Basarios
and slay a large number of
Vespoids, then carry 1 red-hot
blasting rock back and deliver
it. It's harsh, but success
will raise your standing!
62063.descriptionJp:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！火山で岩竜の狩猟と、
大量のランゴスタの討伐。
そして熱い熱い火薬岩１個を
運んできて納品するんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

63198.description: Shh, keep quiet, meow! This is a secret trading post, meow. Give me 20 Wyvern Shatterclaws and I will give you 30 of the Master Felyne's Favorite Food, meow. Slip it quietly to the Master Felyne and he will make you a Hardcore Cat weapon without materials, meow! Aim for the dream jackpot, meow!
63198.descriptionEn:
Shh, keep it down, nya! This
is a secret trading post, nya.
Give me 20 Wyvern
Shatterclaws and I'll hand
over 30 Master Felyne's
Favorites, nya.
Pass them to him quietly
and he'll craft you a
Hardcore Felyne Weapon with
no materials! Jackpot, nya!
63198.descriptionJp:
シッ、静かにするニャ！ここ
は秘密の取引所ニャ。≪飛竜
の砕爪≫を２０個くれたら、
≪親方ネコの大好物≫を
３０個あげるニャ。
こっそり親方ネコに渡せば、
素材なしで≪剛猫武器≫を
作ってくれる優れ物ニャ！
夢の大当たりを狙って
頑張るニャ！

21956.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
21956.description: You there! I hear you produced a Berukyurosu weapon. So I have a request: how about materials to upgrade to a Doragyurosu weapon as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Doragyurosu. I am counting on you!
21956.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you forged a Berukyurosu
weapon.
So here is a request for you:
how about upgrade materials for
a Doragyurosu weapon as pay?
It is an easy job, honest.
Just run over there and slay a
Doragyurosu for me.
I am counting on you!
21956.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
舞雷竜の武器を生産したん
だってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、報
酬は冥雷竜の武器への強化素
材でどうだ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってドラギュロスを
討伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

61729.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61729.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61729.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

26639.objectiveJp: リオレイア亜種１頭の狩猟

61961.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been found! This may be a good chance to gather materials! Hurry and prepare before it flees far away! We have limited the number of participants, so you should be able to depart at once!
61961.descriptionEn:
A comparatively weak individual
monster has been discovered!
This may be a good chance to
gather materials! Before it
flees far away, please hurry
and get ready! We have limited
the number of participants, so
you should be able to depart at once!
61961.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めなモンスターの
個体が発見されましたよ！
これは、素材を集める良い
チャンスかもしれませんね！
遠くへと逃げてしまう前に、
急いで準備をしてください！
参加人数を制限しましたので、
すぐに出発できるはずです！

60714.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
60714.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60714.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60714.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62467.objectiveJp: 溶岩竜の上鱗３個の納品
62467.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Lavasioth's Fine Scale you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
62467.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon, but
I'm short on materials! At this
rate I can't go hunting.
Trade me the ≪Volganos Scale+≫
you have for this ≪Paw Pad
Medal≫! Please!
62467.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいが素材が足
りない！これでは狩りに出ら
れない。キミが持っている
≪溶岩竜の上鱗≫を、この
≪肉球のメダル≫と交換して
くれ！頼む！

62905.description: A new report has arrived. Amid the dusk of the jungle, the Violent Wyvern Abiorugu appeared without warning. Another investigator testifies to countless footprints and roars from many directions, so it seems there are several of them. Please prepare carefully and conduct the investigation.
62905.descriptionEn:
A new report has come in.
A Violent Wyvern ≪Abiorugu≫ is
said to have appeared suddenly,
hidden in the Jungle's dusk.
Another surveyor testifies to
countless footprints and to
roars from many directions, so
it seems several of them are
about. Please make thorough
preparations before you survey.
62905.descriptionJp:
新しい報告が届きました。
密林の夕闇に紛れて、突如、
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫が現れた
とのことです。
別の調査員からは、無数の
足跡と多方向からの咆哮を
聞いたと証言しており、
どうやら複数頭いると予想
されます。入念な準備の上、
調査をお願いします。

62961.description: The legend of Princess Sasa has many endings. But in any ending, the parting of lovers appears somewhere. I think that by completing this job you can approach the essence of the legend of Princess Sasa.
62961.descriptionEn:
The legend of Princess Sasa
has many endings.
But in every one, somewhere
two lovers are torn apart.
I think by completing this
request, we may be able to
get at the true heart of
the Princess Sasa legend.
62961.descriptionJp:
ササ姫伝説の結末は諸説ある。
しかし、どの結末にせよ、
愛し合う男女が引き裂かれる
描写はどこかで現れるんだ。
この依頼をこなしてもらう
ことで、ササ姫伝説の本質に
迫ることができるんじゃ
ないかと考えているんだよ。

60671.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Blangonga. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60671.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters test their skill!
Today's target is
Blangonga!
Taking on a monster all
alone, what splendid spirit!
Overcome yourself and take
a place in the top ranks!
Supremacy weapons only!
60671.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪ドドブランゴ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

55742.objectiveJp: アノルパティス１頭の討伐
55742.description: A Bogabadorumu with greatly developed horns has appeared. The guild will classify this individual as a Variant Species with developed parts and investigate it. There are reports that it is more dangerous than the Bogabadorumu known so far. Please conduct the investigation with care.
55742.descriptionEn:
A ≪Anorupatisu≫ with greatly
developed horns has appeared.
The Guild classifies this
individual as a ≪Supremacy≫ with
developed parts and will survey
it.
There are reports it is more
dangerous than past ones.
Please survey it with care.
55742.descriptionJp:
角が大きく発達した≪暴鋸竜≫
が現れました。
ギルドでは、この個体を
部位の発達した≪辿異種≫と
位置づけ、調査を行います。
これまでの暴鋸竜より危険
との報告もあります。
気を付けて調査をお願いしま
す。

54896.description: We continue the investigation of the Espinas Subspecies. Destroying parts is not required, but it would be a great help if you did! Hunters, thank you for your cooperation!
54896.descriptionEn:
We continue the survey of
the Espinas Subspecies.
Breaking parts isn't
required, but I'd be glad
if you did!
Hunters, please lend us
your aid once again!
54896.descriptionJp:
エスピナス亜種の調査を、
引き続き行います。
部位の破壊は必須では
ないけれど、やってくれれば
嬉しい限り！
ハンターの皆さん、どうか
よろしくお願い致します！

62388.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐
62388.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62388.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62388.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55090.objectiveJp: ヴォージャン１頭の討伐
55090.description: This is terrible! The Origin Species Voujan is on a rampage in the Volcano! This time it is especially urgent, so there is no time to gather hunters! I will give more materials than usual, so hunters who can head out to slay it should depart at once!
55090.descriptionEn:
This is urgent!
The Origin Species Vojan is
rampaging in the Volcano!
This time there is no time
to gather hunters at our
leisure!
We'll hand out more
materials than usual, so any
hunter who can fight should
set out at once!
55090.descriptionJp:
大変です！
始種≪ヴォージャン≫が火山
で暴れています！
今回は特に緊急性が高いため、
時間をかけてハンターを招集
する余裕がありません！
普段より多めの素材をお渡し
致しますので、討伐に向かえ
るハンターはすぐに出発して
ください！

55175.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
55175.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Red Khezu while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55175.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest where
slaying a Red Khezu raises
your evaluation while also
cheaply giving you the
materials needed for G Rank
decorations.
Please put it to good use.
55175.descriptionJp:
フルフル亜種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

11001.objectiveJp: ロイヤルカブト５匹の納品
11001.description: Find and deliver 8 Special Mushrooms growing in the Jungle region! If you deliver the Royal Beetles that occasionally fly about the Jungle, I will pay you for those too! Start by getting to know the Jungle and getting used to it.
11001.descriptionEn:
Find and deliver 8 Specialty
Mushrooms growing in the Jungle!
We will also pay for the insects
that sometimes fly there,
Royal Beetles, if you deliver them!
Start by learning the Jungle and
getting used to it.
11001.descriptionJp:
密林地帯に生える特産キノコ
を８つ探して納めて下さい！
たまに密林を飛んでる昆虫、
≪ロイヤルカブト≫を納品し
て頂いても報酬は払います！
まずは密林を知り、密林に慣
れることから始めて下さい。

61121.objectiveJp: イャンクック６頭の狩猟
61121.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we have prepared a special request and rewards for those wearing the proof of a Hunter Festival champion. No festival proof is needed here. Simply completing the quest pays out various rewards.
61121.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall Guild,
we have prepared special requests
and rewards exclusively for those
who wear the new Hunter Festival
victor's proof.
No Festival Proof is needed here.
Simply clearing the quest will
pay out a variety of rewards
to you.
61121.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
狩人祭の勝者の証を装備
しているかた専用の
特別依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。
こちらは祭典の証は必要あり
ません。クエストの達成のみで
様々な報酬が払い出される
ようになっております。

50808.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
50808.description: In praise of the achievements you all left in the Extreme Conquest Battle, we have prepared a slaying request that reliably yields HC materials useful for upgrading Akamuto GF Kemaru and Akamuto GF Chikeru.
50808.descriptionEn:
In honor of your deeds in
the Extreme Conquest,
we offer a slay request
that reliably yields HC
materials to upgrade
"Akantor GF Kemal" and
"Akantor GF Chikel."
50808.descriptionJp:
極限征伐戦で皆さんが残した
功績を称え、
「アカムトGFケマル」
「アカムトGFチケル」
の強化に役立つＨＣ素材を
確実に得られる討伐依頼を
ご用意いたしました。

23274.objectiveJp: ドスイーオス１頭の狩猟
23274.description: Development of the unsurveyed parts of the volcano is progressing, and there is talk of building a road, but the planned route crosses the path of a red bird wyvern. A detour would still be too dangerous. We need that red bird wyvern hunted so the road can be made safe.
23274.descriptionEn:
The unsurveyed Volcano area
is being opened up, and there
is even talk of a road, but
the planned route crosses a
red bird wyvern's path. Going
around it is still dangerous.
I want you to hunt that red
bird wyvern and make the
route safe.
23274.descriptionJp:
火山の未調査地域もだいぶ
開拓が進んで街道を作る話も
出ているんだが、予定してい
る場所は、赤い鳥竜の通り道
でもある。迂回させようにも
まだまだ道を逸れると危険な
状態だ。どうにか赤い鳥竜を
狩猟して安全を確保してもら
いたい。

50629.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟
50629.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
50629.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
50629.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

22053.description: Tide Island is a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22053.descriptionEn:
The ≪Tidal Island≫ is a
land still under Guild
survey, but hunters too
might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22053.descriptionJp:
≪潮島≫は、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

54290.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time it is that Rajang! Two of them! And G-rank monsters at that! Who will bring down the great golden beast and seize the fortune? Challengers, come forth!
54290.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
This time, that Rajang! Two
of them! And G Rank, too!
Who will topple the golden
giants and grab the gold?
Challengers, come forth!
54290.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！
今回はあの金獅子！それも２
頭！その上Ｇ級モンスター！
大いなる金色を倒し、大金を
掴むのは誰だ！挑戦者よ来た
れ！

55031.objectiveJp: リオレウス希少種１頭の討伐
55031.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55031.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55031.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55187.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の討伐
55187.description: Slaying a Cephadrome raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55187.descriptionEn:
We've prepared a quest where
slaying a Cephadrome raises
your evaluation while also
cheaply giving you the
materials needed for G Rank
decorations.
Please put it to good use.
55187.descriptionJp:
ドスガレオスを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

28026.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
28026.description: A group of Mosswine seem to be fighting a Gravios. It must be because their mushroom ground was ruined. I understand it, the anger of having your holy mushroom ground ruined! So I have a request for you! Go and help those Mosswine!
28026.descriptionEn:
A herd of Mosswine is
fighting a Gravios, I hear.
Must be because their
mushroom patch got raided.
I get it, the fury of a
raided holy mushroom
ground! So I have a favor
to ask! Go save those
Mosswine!
28026.descriptionJp:
モスの集団が鎧竜と戦って
いるらしいんだ。
きっとキノコの産地を荒ら
されたとかだろう。
オレには分かるぜ、キノコ
の聖地を荒らされた怒りの
気持ちが！だからアンタ達
に頼みがある！あのモスを
助けてやってくれ！

60020.objectiveJp: ミラボレアス１頭の討伐

21946.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
21946.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ２２. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Rukodiora. I am counting on you!
21946.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there!
I hear you hit HR22.
So here is a request for you:
how about a full set of weapon
materials as pay?
It is an easy job, honest.
Just run over there and slay a
Rukodiora for me.
I am counting on you!
21946.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ２２になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってルコディオラを討
伐してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

54107.description: This time I think I will survey a Rathian. It is a monster already much studied, but there must be something new to find. It may be a bother, but I need an individual with its wing claws and tail broken. Could you manage it somehow?
54107.descriptionEn:
This time I'd like to do a
survey of Rathian.
It's a well-studied monster,
but there must be something
new to find.
It's a hassle, I know, but I
need one with broken wing
claws and a severed tail.
Could I ask you to do it?
54107.descriptionJp:
今回はリオレイアの調査を
してみようと思うんだ。
もうずいぶんと研究された
モンスターだけど、きっと
何か新しい発見があるはずさ。
ちょっと面倒かもしれないん
だけど、翼爪と尻尾を破壊し
た個体が必要なんだ。
何とか頼めないかな？

56070.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟

23492.description: Zerureusu has appeared at the summit of the Tower. It is a monster of many mysteries, with few reports, but because legends of it as sacred or as an ill omen differ by region, it is a most valuable subject for study. Which legend this radiant dragon belongs to is unknown, but please investigate at once.
23492.descriptionEn:
≪Zerureusu≫ has appeared atop
the Tower. Reports are few and
the monster is full of mystery,
but since legends differ by
region, sacred here and an ill
omen there, it is a most valuable
subject of survey. Which legend
the Radiant Wyvern belongs to is
unclear, so please survey it at once.
23492.descriptionJp:
塔の頂部に≪ゼルレウス≫が
現れました。報告件数も少な
く謎の多いモンスターですが、
地方によって神聖、不吉と
伝承が異なるため非常に貴重
な調査対象と言えます。
現れた輝界竜が、どちらの
伝承のものかは不明ですが、
至急調査をお願いします。

26315.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26315.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26315.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26315.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26315.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55318.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55318.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55318.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55735.description: The Guild will now survey the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To that end, when you achieve a head break and a tail cut in slaying Toridcless, we will give an additional reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55735.descriptionEn:
We have decided to survey the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. So, when you slay the
≪Toridokuresu≫ and break
its head and sever its tail,
grant an extra reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55735.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく調査
することになりました。
そこで、≪照雷鳥≫討伐にて
頭部破壊と尻尾切断を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

26075.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26075.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26075.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

22055.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の撃退
22055.description: An unconfirmed elder dragon has been found by a survey team dispatched by the Guild. Its ecology is shrouded in mystery, but it is said to skillfully control packs of small wyverns and attack hunters. Go to Cloudview Fortress, where the elder dragon was confirmed, and investigate.
22055.descriptionEn:
A Guild survey team has
found an unidentified Elder
Dragon.
Its ecology is a mystery,
but it reportedly commands
packs of small wyverns to
attack hunters.
Please head to the Cloud
Viewing Fortress to survey.
22055.descriptionJp:
ギルドが派遣した調査団によ
り未確認の古龍が発見され
ました。
その生態は謎に包まれていま
すが、小型飛竜の群れを巧み
に操りハンターを襲ってくる
そうです。
古龍が確認された『雲見砦』
へ向かい調査をお願いします。

61015.description: There is something I need done urgently. I want you to plant the Guild Flag at the summit of the Snowy Mountains. There is no room for such heavy-looking equipment! I have prepared the supplies, so you need not bring any items.
61015.descriptionEn:
I have something urgent for you.
Plant a ≪Guild Flag≫ at the
summit of the Snowy Mountains.
There is no time to be wearing
such heavy-looking gear!
I have readied supplies, so you
need not bring any items.
61015.descriptionJp:
大至急で頼みたいことがある。
≪ギルドフラッグ≫を雪山の
山頂に立ててきてほしい。
そんな重たそうな装備を着て
いる余裕はないぞ！
支給品は揃えたからアイテムを
持っていく必要もないからな。

21036.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
21036.description: A red shadow crawling across the snowfield has been sighted! It is certainly a Khezu subspecies! In the Snowy Mountains this season, the Blango gather in herds seeking food! Take care not to face the Khezu and the Blango at the same time!
21036.descriptionEn:
A red shadow crawling over the
snowy fields has been sighted!
It is surely a ≪Khezu≫
subspecies! This season the
Snowy Mountains swarm with
Blango seeking food! Mind that
you do not face Khezu and Blango at once!
21036.descriptionJp:
雪原を這う赤影が目撃された
ようです！≪フルフル≫の亜
種に間違いありません！今の
季節の雪山はブランゴたちが
エサを求めて群生してます！
フルフルとブランゴ、同時に
相手をしないようご注意を！

54510.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の討伐
54510.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54510.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54510.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

22132.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
22132.description: Hunter who would master the lance, show the skill you have honed against the Ice Fox Wyvern in the arena! If you can hunt it splendidly, you will gain even more rewards than the fruits of your daily efforts.
22132.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Lance, show me the skill you
have honed against the
≪Giaorugu≫ in the Arena!
Hunt it well, and you shall gain
even more reward than your
daily efforts would ever
bring you.
22132.descriptionJp:
槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、闘技場にいる
≪氷狐竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26469.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
26469.description: A Premium Quest is a very rewarding quest that earns you more ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets than usual. Up to two participants. Shogun Ceanataur's claw attacks are fast and hard to dodge. Work together with your fellow hunters and keep moving!
26469.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫ give you
more HRP than usual plus
Porta Tickets. Very
rewarding quests indeed.
Up to 2 players.
Shogun Ceanataur's claws
are fast and hard to dodge.
Work together with your
fellow hunters out there!
26469.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫は、
通常よりも多めのＨＲＰと
ポルタチケットがもらえる
とってもお得なクエストです。
参加人数は２人まで。
ショウグンギザミの爪攻撃は
素早くて避けるのも大変。
ハンターさん同士で協力して
立ち回ってください！

21271.description: An arena where hunters display their skill! This time, 2 black shapes rampage in the arena. You will be hunting that Rajang and a Yian Garuga, Variants both! Who will slay these 2 mighty Variants and take the fortune?
21271.descriptionEn:
An Arena where hunters show
their skill!
Today it is two black shadows
rampaging in the Arena. You will
be slaying that Rajang and the
black wolf bird, and variants at
that!
Who will slay these two mighty
variants and take the big money!?
21271.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露す
る闘技場！
今回は闘技場で暴れている
黒い影２つ。あの金獅子と
黒狼鳥、それも変種の討伐と
なります！強力な２頭の変種
を討伐して、大金を得るのは
一体誰でしょうか！？

62113.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62113.description: It is I, the Instructor! This time you will hunt with a one-handed weapon that can guard with a shield. Take the armor and sword and shield set prepared for you and hunt the Roaring Wolf Kamu Orugaron somewhere in the Swamp! Make good use of the weapon's strengths!
62113.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
This time you'll hunt with
a one-handed weapon that
can guard with a shield.
Using the provided armor
and Sword and Shield, hunt
Kam Orugaron somewhere in
the Swamp! Use its strengths!
62113.descriptionJp:
吾輩だ。教官だ！今回は
盾でガードできる片手武器で
の狩猟をしてもらおう。
予め用意された防具と片手剣
一式で沼地のどこかにいる
響狼≪カム・オルガロン≫を
狩猟してきたまえ！武器の
利点を活用するんだぞ！

26286.description: Thank you for waiting. The Extra Quest is brought to you by the Tavern Guild. On a fruitful field prepared by the Guild's power, why not take it easy and gather for a change?
26286.descriptionEn:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
The <<Extra Quest>> is sent
to you by the Tavern Guild.
In the bountiful fields
the guild prepared for you,
why not take it easy and
do some gathering for a
change of pace?
26286.descriptionJp:
おまたせしました。
≪エクストラクエスト≫は、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
ギルドの力によって用意され
た実り豊かなフィールドで、
たまにはのんびり採取でも
いかがですか？

61207.description: I hear it often lately: Variants are a trial for hunters, with sacs and the like hard to carve. I will carve the sacs off quick for you, so you lot just bring the quarry down properly. I have added weapon restrictions and sub-targets to make carving easier, so do me that favor!
61207.descriptionEn:
I hear it a lot lately: Variants
are a real pain, their sacs
so hard to carve. It's enough
to make a hunter cry, right?
So I'll peel the sacs off
quickly for you, and you lot
just make sure to bag the
prey. I added a weapon limit
and sub-targets to make carving easier, so enjoy!
61207.descriptionJp:
最近よく聞くが、変種は袋の
類が剥ぎづらいハンター泣か
せな相手って話じゃねえか。
ここは俺がサクッと袋を剥い
でやるから、おまえさん達は、
しっかり獲物をしとめてくる
んだぜ。剥ぎ取りし易いよう、
武器制限とサブターゲットも
つけたからよろしくな！

53071.description: The final quest for the Championship Tournament DMM Cup. Please read the participation rules on the tournament's special site carefully, and join after agreeing to them. Taking the final quest counts as participation.
53071.descriptionEn:
This is the final quest of the
"Championship Tournament DMM
Cup".
Please read the participation rules
on the event's special site, and
agree to them before joining.
Accepting the final quest is taken
as your entry into the tournament.
53071.descriptionJp:
「チャンピオンシップトーナ
メントＤＭＭ杯」の決勝クエ
ストです。
大会特設サイトの参加規約を
よくお読みになり、同意いた
だいたうえでご参加ください。
決勝クエストを受注時点で
参加したとみなされます。

23491.description: Meraginasu has been discovered in the caves of Tide Island. A dragon that carries memories of ancient times, known until now only from fossils. This is a discovery without precedent. The survey is of great importance and failure will not be tolerated. Head to the site at once and secure it.
23491.descriptionEn:
≪Meraginasu≫ has been found in
the caves of the Tidal Island.
A dragon whose existence we
