背中破壊と脚破壊を達成
した際にはさらに報酬を
お渡しいたします。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

55189.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
55189.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Breeding Season Hypnocatrice while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55189.descriptionEn:
Slaying a Hypnocatrice in its
breeding season raises your
reputation and earns you the
materials needed for G Rank
decorations, all in one handy
quest we've prepared for you.
Please make good use of it.
55189.descriptionJp:
ヒプノック繁殖期を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

11048.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
11048.description: A red shadow crawling across the snowfield has been sighted! It is certainly a Khezu subspecies! In the Snowy Mountains this season, the Blango gather in herds seeking food! Take care not to face the Khezu and the Blango at the same time!
11048.descriptionEn:
A red shadow crawling over the
snowy fields has been sighted!
It is surely a ≪Khezu≫
subspecies! This season the
Snowy Mountains swarm with
Blango seeking food! Mind that
you do not face Khezu and Blango at once!
11048.descriptionJp:
雪原を這う赤影が目撃された
ようです！≪フルフル≫の亜
種に間違いありません！今の
季節の雪山はブランゴたちが
エサを求めて群生してます！
フルフルとブランゴ、同時に
相手をしないようご注意を！

61571.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61571.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61571.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54717.description: The survey of White Lake is going well, and many new materials have been found. Word is that most of them can be used to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Many G-rank hunters, who often travel to dangerous places, will surely be interested.
54717.descriptionEn:
The survey of White Lake is
going well, and many new
materials have been found.
Most of what has been found can
be used to craft and upgrade arms
and armor, or so we hear.
Many G Rank hunters, who often
head into dangerous lands,
may well be interested.
54717.descriptionJp:
白湖の調査も順調に進み、
多くの新しい素材が発見され
ています。見つかった素材の
多くは、武具の生産や強化に
利用できるという話です。
危険な地へ赴くことが多い、
Ｇ級ハンターの中には、
興味のある方も多いの
ではないでしょうか。

50519.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
50519.description: This is an emergency request. We are looking for someone to slay an extremely powerful Diorekkusu. If you succeed, we will issue more proof of slaying than usual!
50519.descriptionEn:
An urgent request. We're after
hunters to slay an extremely
powerful ≪Diorex≫ specimen.
Complete the hunt and we
will issue a larger number
of slay proofs than usual
as your reward. Good luck!
50519.descriptionJp:
緊急依頼です。極めて強力な
≪ディオレックス≫の個体を
討伐してくださる方を募集
しております。見事に討伐
できましたら、普段よりも
多めに討伐の証を発行いた
しましょう！

53181.description: Prism Falls by day in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
53181.descriptionEn:
The ≪Rainbow Waterfall≫ in the
temperate season, by day. The
Guild is still surveying this
unexplored land, but why don't
you go and take a look for
gathering and survey?
If you want to come home,
just deliver a map!
53181.descriptionJp:
温暖期・昼の≪彩の滝≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

21893.description: This is the quest for the HR600 breakthrough trial. Take the trial from the Guildmaster or the HR Trial board, then set out on this quest on your own. Good luck, hunter.
21893.descriptionEn:
This is the quest for the HR600
breakthrough trial. Take the
trial from the Guildmaster or
the HR Trial board, then set
out on this quest on your own.
Good luck, hunter.
21893.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ６００突破試練のための
クエストです。ギルドマス
ターまたはＨＲ試練掲示板
から試練を受注した後、
お一人でクエストへ出発して
ください。

5001.description: A big carapace creature called Daimyo Hermitaur has been sighted in the desert, they say! Hunt it so it does not get in the way of people visiting Jumbo Village! I am counting on you!!
5001.descriptionEn:
Word is a huge carapace beast
called ≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ was
sighted out in the Desert!?
Hunt it down so it won't get in
the way of folks visiting Jumbo
Village! I'm counting on you!!
5001.descriptionJp:
砂漠地帯で≪ダイミョウザザ
ミ≫と呼ばれるデカイ甲殻生
物が目撃されたらしいぜ！？
ジャンボ村に訪れようとする
人々の妨げにならないよう、
狩猟してくれ！頼んだぜ！！

61764.description: It seems you have gathered the map fragments needed for repair. There are rather a lot, but I can restore it. Put the fragments you collected in that box. When I am done I will give you a copy of the map. The weapon workshop may be pleased to get it.
61764.descriptionEn:
It seems you've gathered the map
fragments needed for the repair.
There are quite a few pieces,
but I should be able to restore it.
Put the fragments you collected
into that box over there.
When the work is done I'll give you
a copied map. Taking it to the
Weapon Workshop might please them.
61764.descriptionJp:
どうやら修復に必要な地図の
断片を集めてくれたようだな。
ちょっと枚数が多いけど、
私なら元に戻せるだろう。
集めた断片をそこのボックス
に入れといてくれ。
作業が終わったら複製した地
図をやろう。武具工房に持っ
ていくと喜ばれるかもな。

23453.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Hammer Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Hammer Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
23453.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hammer Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Hammer Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Hammer Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest,
a ≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
23453.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ハンマー綬・序≫１００個
≪ハンマー綬・中≫１６５個
≪ハンマー綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

63295.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63295.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63295.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63295.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

62245.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62245.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62245.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

50821.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
50821.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Berukyurosu will also grant a special ingredient.
50821.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Duramboros' head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
50821.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
氷狐竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

23731.description: This quest yields the following materials. Switch Axe Merit (Beginning) x５０, Switch Axe Merit (Middle) x６０, Switch Axe Merit (Extreme) x５０. Note that to accept the quest you need a Secret Merit Crystal and ＧＲ５００ or above.
23731.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the following
materials:
≪Switch Axe Honor - Intro≫ x50
≪Switch Axe Honor - Mid≫ x60
≪Switch Axe Honor - Extreme≫ x50
To accept this quest you need
≪Secret Art Honor Crystal≫ and
GR500 or higher, so please
keep that in mind.
23731.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪剣斧勲・序≫５０個
≪剣斧勲・中≫６０個
≪剣斧勲・極≫５０個
クエストを受注するには、
≪秘伝勲の結晶≫と
ＧＲ５００以上である必要が
ありますのでご注意ください。

63260.description: The final stage of training. This time you will face a tough monster! Ah, tough as it is, this individual is easier to hunt than one encountered elsewhere. Do not tense up, fight as usual!
63260.descriptionEn:
The final round of training.
This time you'll be facing a
truly tough monster!
Ah, but tough as it is, this
one's tuned to be easier to
hunt than the ones you'd meet
elsewhere.
Don't psyche yourself out, just
fight like you always do!
63260.descriptionJp:
トレーニングの総仕上げ。
今回は手ごわいモンスターを
相手にしてもらいますよー！
あ、手ごわいと言っても、
他の場所で遭遇するよりは
狩りやすい強さの個体に
なっています。
気負わず、いつも通りに
戦ってくださいね！

55692.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Giaorugu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55692.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Giaorugu≫.
Accepting this quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest ends in failure,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please keep that
in mind.
55692.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ギアオルグ≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61342.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61342.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61342.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

21207.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21207.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21207.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

54544.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Pokaradon, the Frozen Sea Beast. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54544.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the frozen sea
beast ≪Pokaradon≫.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is required.
If you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please
be careful.
54544.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、凍海獣
≪ポカラドン≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

62310.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟

53146.objectiveJp: ガノトトス亜種１頭の狩猟
53146.client: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy
53146.clientEn: Hunter Who Was Once a Boy

26136.description: It is I, the Instructor! Mm. Good that you looked here. Whatever quest you go on, check this section carefully. Now, this time the quest is to find Honey. If you find a bee hive, you can take the honey!
26136.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
Mm. Good that you looked here.
No matter which quest you take,
always check this section well.
Now, this time it is a quest to
find ≪Honey≫. Find a bee nest
and you can take the honey!
26136.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
うむ。よくぞここを見たな。
どのクエストに行くときも、
この項目はしっかり確認だ。
さて、今回は≪ハチミツ≫を
探すクエストだ。ハチの巣を
見つければ、蜜を取れるぞ！

54374.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
54374.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! On top of the training method that builds experience efficiently, right now you can obtain large amounts of Ｇｚ and Porta Cards! You cannot take it on in succession, but the effect of a single run is enormous! May your daily training become a great strength to you, hunter!
54374.descriptionEn:
Urgent notice to all hunters!
In addition to a training method that
efficiently builds up experience, right
now you can obtain a large amount of
Gz and Porta Cards!
You cannot accept it consecutively,
but the effect of a single run is
enormous!
May your daily training become a
great strength for you, hunters!
54374.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
鍛練方法に加え、今なら
大量のＧｚとポルタカード
が入手できます！
連続して受注することこそ
できませんが、１回あたりの
効果は絶大です！
日々の鍛練がハンターさんの
大きな力となりますように！

53289.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
53289.description: I had the most amazing dream! Among a herd of Bullfango there was a huge Bulldrome! It was a sight worth sharing, so I recreated it in the Great Arena! Go and see it!
53289.descriptionEn:
I had the wildest dream the
other day! Right in the middle
of a herd of Bullfango was
this huge Bulldrome!
It was a sight worth sharing,
so I recreated it in the New
Great Arena! Go take a look!
53289.descriptionJp:
この間すっげー夢を見たんだ！
ブルファンゴの集団のなかに、
でっけードスファンゴが
いたんだよ！
皆にも共有したい光景だった
から新大闘技場に再現したぜ！
ぜひ見に行ってくれよな！

50598.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50598.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50598.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

26378.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves slaying a Low Rank monster with a designated weapon. We have prepared a special reward, so please join in!
26378.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve slaying
low rank monsters with
a specified weapon. We have
special rewards ready, so
come and join us!
26378.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、指定
武器での下位モンスターの
討伐となります。特別な報酬
を用意させていただきました
ので、奮ってご参加ください。

62860.description: The Hunter Festival, the hunters' own celebration! Gather souls and seize victory! The request introduced here is exclusive to the series quests! Play the scenario through to the end and collect a great many souls! You are the one who decides how this nail-biting contest ends!
62860.descriptionEn:
The hunters' festival, the Hunter Festival!
Gather Souls and seize victory!
The request we introduce today is
for Series Quests only!
Push the scenario to the very end
and get yourself a mountain of Souls!
The one who decides how this
thrilling contest ends is you!
62860.descriptionJp:
狩人たちの祭典、狩人祭！
魂を集めて勝利を掴み取れ！
今回紹介するこの依頼は、
シリーズクエスト専用だ！
シナリオを最後まで進めて、
大量の魂をゲットしよう！
手に汗握る勝負の行方を
決するのは君だ！

55270.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
55270.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55270.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55270.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55956.description: A decoration has been completed to protect you from a monster's fierce attacks. With this new decoration you will find it enormously effective against Aberrant species that use water. We will hand it out as a reward for this quest, so do join us!
55956.descriptionEn:
A decoration that shields you
from a monster's fierce attacks
has been completed.
With this new decoration, you'll
see immense effect against
water-using Supremacy monsters!
We'll hand it over as this
quest's reward, so please join
in with enthusiasm.
55956.descriptionJp:
モンスターの苛烈な攻撃から
身を護るための装飾品が
完成しました。
この新たな装飾品を使えば
水を使う辿異種などに
絶大な効果を発揮します！
今回のクエスト報酬として
お渡し致しますので、
奮ってご参加ください。

26034.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
26034.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
26034.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
26034.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

53190.objectiveJp: ハンターメダル赤１個の納品
53190.description: We present a great many items to those who have just started! By all means clear this every day and make use of it in your hunting life.
53190.descriptionEn:
For all you hunters just
starting out, we're giving
away a pile of items!
Clear it every day and put
them to use in your hunts.
53190.descriptionJp:
新しく始められた方々に、
たくさんのアイテムを
プレゼント致します！
是非とも毎日クリアして
狩猟生活にお役立てください。

61955.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟

55539.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐
55539.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55539.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55539.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

63122.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63122.description: A very powerful Daimyo Hermitaur that behaves unlike the usual is in the new great arena, and I want you to hunt it. This request is open only to hunters with Secret Scroll equipment approved by the guild. Succeed splendidly and you will gain further renown as a master hunter.
63122.descriptionEn:
A Daimyo Hermitaur that acts
unlike the norm and is very
powerful is in the New Great
Arena. I want you to hunt it.
This request is only for hunters
with Secret Art equipment
recognized by the Guild.
Succeed, and you will earn
even more acclaim as a
top hunter.
63122.descriptionJp:
通常と異なる行動を取る、
非常に強力な≪盾蟹≫の
個体が新大闘技場にいるので、
それを狩猟してほしい。
この依頼は、ギルドが認めた
秘伝書装備のハンターのみの
依頼となる。
見事達成すれば凄腕ハンター
として、更なる評価を
得られるだろう。

58051.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58051.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58051.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58051.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

60211.description: For cold weather gear, decorations, and weapons, Hypnocatrice materials are in constant demand, and the guild regularly encourages hunters to hunt them. Head for the forest and hunt one Hypnocatrice.
60211.descriptionEn:
For cold weather gear, trinkets
and weapons alike, Hypnocatrice
materials are in constant demand,
and the Guild encourages all
hunters to hunt them regularly.
Head for the Great Forest and
hunt 1 Hypnocatrice, please.
60211.descriptionJp:
防寒具に、装飾品に、武具に
眠鳥の素材は、何かと需要が
多く、ギルドでは定期的な
狩猟をハンターの皆さんに奨
励しています。
樹海に向かい、眠鳥１頭の
狩猟をお願いします。

26104.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の討伐

50957.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, an Ice Fang Wyvern, Barioth, was newly observed in the Snowy Mountains. According to hunters who faced it, it unleashes attacks using ice. Please take the greatest care not to neglect your preparations.
50957.descriptionEn:
With the appearance of the
Transcendent species, surveys
have been pushed across the land,
and a Barioth, the Ice Fang Wyvern,
has now been sighted in the
Snowy Mountains. Hunters who faced
it report it unleashes ice attacks.
Please do not neglect your preparations.
50957.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、雪山に
氷牙竜・ベリオロスが新たに
観測されました。対峙した
ハンターの情報によると、
氷を使った攻撃を繰り出して
くるとのこと。準備を怠らぬ
ようくれぐれもご注意下さい。

61539.description: Those infamous great boars have appeared in the Great Arena leading a great herd! How will you face those sharp tusks and that impact!?
61539.descriptionEn:
Those infamous great boars
have brought a whole herd
into the Great Arena!
Against those tusks and that
charge, how will you fight!?
61539.descriptionJp:
あの悪名高き大猪たちが
大群を引き連れて、
大闘技場に現れた！
鋭い牙と、あの衝撃に
君はどう立ち向かう！？

63072.description: Hello. I am the master of bouquets of love and miracles. Hmm, is there someone you want to pierce right through the heart? Then leave it to me! Gather the plants I name and I will make you a wonderful bouquet. To celebrate the fate that brought us together, I will pour my heart into it!
63072.descriptionEn:
Hello there. I am the Bouquet Master
of love and miracles. Hmm hmm,
is there someone special whose heart
you want to strike dead-on?
Then leave it to me!
Gather the plants I specify and I
will make you a wonderful bouquet.
To celebrate the fate that brought
us together, I will put my heart
into it!
63072.descriptionJp:
こんにちは。僕は愛と奇跡の
花束マイスターさ。ふむふむ、
ハートをズドンと射止めたい、
気になる相手がいるのかい？
それなら、僕に任せてよ！
指定の植物を集めてくれたら、
素敵な花束を作ってあげる。
君と出会えたこの運命を祝し、
心を込めて取り掛かるよ！

62701.description: This is a hunting request for the Abiorugu confirmed in the swamp. The swamp is a place many novice hunters also visit to hunt, so they want its safety secured. This is just where hunters should show their skill, no?
62701.descriptionEn:
This is a request to hunt the
Abiorugu confirmed in the Swamp.
Many rookie hunters visit the
Swamp to hunt, so we have been
asked to secure their safety.
This is just the time for you
hunters to show what you can do,
is it not?
62701.descriptionJp:
沼地で確認されている
アビオルグの狩猟依頼です。
沼地は、駆け出しの
ハンターの方も多く狩猟に
訪れる場所のため、
安全の確保をしてほしい
とのことです。
こういう時こそ
ハンターさんたちの腕の見せ
どころではないでしょうか。

60613.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60613.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60613.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

61359.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

63131.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の討伐
63131.description: This is the practice finals quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or from clear rewards.
63131.descriptionEn:
This is the practice finals quest
for the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from carving
or from clear rewards.
63131.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用決勝
クエストです。モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で、
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

23345.objectiveJp: クアルセプス１頭の狩猟

62047.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62047.description: A big eater living in the Canyon is causing trouble for my friends, meow. I want you to get rid of him, meow! As thanks I will give you what you need to make a rare Hunting Party Poogie outfit, meow. I am counting on you, meow!
62047.descriptionEn:
A glutton living in the Canyon is
causing trouble for its fellows,
ya!
I want you to get rid of it, nya!
As thanks I will give you what
you need to make a rare Guild
Poogie outfit, nya. Please do it,
yaa!
62047.descriptionJp:
峡谷に住んでいる大食漢が仲間
に迷惑をかけているのニャ。
そいつを退治してほしいニャ！
お礼として珍しい猟団プーギー
服を作るのに必要なものを
あげるニャ。頼んだニャー！

50677.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
50677.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Odiba FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50677.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of the
≪Zenith Armor≫ Odiba FX series.
Accepting this quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest ends in failure,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please keep that
in mind.
50677.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
オディバFXシリーズの１部位
分の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

61144.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. Next you will prove the accumulation of your daily discipline. On your own, land a Plesioth with a single rod and deliver 10 Fish Print [Small]. You must reel in the Plesioth without hunting it, absolutely.
61144.descriptionEn:
Fishing: a lonely hunt where you
face the fish in silence. Next,
prove the results of your daily
training. Alone, land one Plesioth
by rod and deliver 10 Fish Prints
[Small]. You must reel in the
Plesioth without ever hunting it.
61144.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。次は日々の
研鑽の積み重ねを証明して貰
おう。一人でガノトトスの一
本釣りと魚拓【小】１０枚の
納品だ。ガノトトスは絶対に
狩らずに釣り上げるんだぞ。

53234.description: I heard there was such a thing as a Hypnocatrice Rare Species, so I went to the Jungle. And there was something amazing there. That must be the Rare Species. For how it looks it is timid, so if you carry a frightening weapon it may take fright and hide. If you are curious, go and see! Eh, the Rare Species is white?
53234.descriptionEn:
I heard a Hypnocatrice Kishu
was out there, so I went to
the Great Forest. And wow,
something amazing was there.
That must be the Kishu. It's
timid for how it looks, so a
scary weapon might make it
hide. Curious? Go see it!
Eh, is the Kishu white?
53234.descriptionJp:
ヒプノックキショウ種っての
がいると聞いて樹海に行った。
そしたらなんか凄いのがいた。
あれがキショウ種に違いない。
見た目の割りには臆病だから、
強そうな武器持ってると
怖がって隠れちゃうかもな。
興味があるなら行ってみな！
え、キショウ種って白いの？

55751.description: So that more hunters can help with the Zenith species survey, we have prepared a quest with different conditions from before. We will support you until you faint five times, but note the time limit is shorter at 30 minutes.
55751.descriptionEn:
So that more hunters can help
with the Supremacy survey, we
prepared a quest under different
conditions than usual.
You are supported until you
faint 5 times, but the time limit
is cut to 30 minutes,
so please take care.
55751.descriptionJp:
より多くのハンターに辿異種
の調査に協力頂けるよう、
これまでの依頼とは異なる条
件のクエストを用意しました。
５回力尽きるまでサポートい
たしますが、制限時間が30分
と短くなっておりますので、
ご注意ください。

21531.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の狩猟
21531.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21531.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21531.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

26057.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26057.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26057.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

50544.description: You there! I hear you reached ＨＲ１１. So I have a request: how about a full set of weapon materials as payment? It is an easy job, just run over and slay a Hypnocatrice. I am counting on you!
50544.descriptionEn:
Hey, you there! You reached
HR11, I hear. So I have a
favor to ask. How about a full
set of weapon materials as
reward? Easy job, really.
Just run over and slay a
Hypnocatrice. I am counting
on you!
50544.descriptionJp:
そこのアンタ！
ＨＲ１１になったんだってな。
そこで頼みがあるんだが、
報酬は武器の素材一式でどう
だ？
なーに簡単な依頼さ、ひとっ
走り行ってヒプノックを討伐
してくれればいい。
頼んだぜ！

21230.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21230.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21230.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

55319.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55319.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55319.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

55308.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55308.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from Guanzorumu, the Imperial Conquest Dragon. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55308.descriptionEn:
In this quest you can obtain
materials from the Emperor
Dragon ≪Guanzorumu≫.
To accept the quest you need a
≪Superior Ticket≫.
Please note that the ≪Superior
Ticket≫ is consumed if the quest
fails.
55308.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、帝征龍
≪グァンゾルム≫の素材を
入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50476.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50476.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
50476.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

61630.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟

26135.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this Quest Confirmation section you will find the money needed to accept a quest, the Contract Fee, the Reward Money you receive on clearing it, and the quest's objective, time limit and important matters, all in a row!
26135.descriptionEn:
It is I, your Instructor!
This ≪Quest Info≫ section is
packed with the money needed to
accept a quest, the ≪Contract
Fee≫, the ≪Reward Money≫ you
receive on clearing it, plus the
quest's objective, time limit and
other important matters!
26135.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
この≪クエスト確認≫欄には
クエストの受注に必要なお金
≪契約金≫や、クリアの際に
もらえる≪報酬金≫、さらに
クエストの目的や制限時間と
重要事項が目白押しだぞ！

50153.description: While surveying the sea of trees, I witnessed a mysterious shadow flying through the sky. That is certainly a bizarre monster never seen before! I am counting on your skill! Won't you hunt it in my place?
50153.descriptionEn:
While surveying the Great
Forest I saw a strange shadow
flying through the sky.
That has to be a rare monster
the likes of which I've never
seen before!
I'm counting on your skill!
Would you hunt it for me?
50153.descriptionJp:
樹海を調査中に空を飛んで
いく謎の影を目撃したんだ。
あれは間違いなく、今まで
に見たことが無いキショウ
なモンスターに違いない！
君の腕を見込んでお願いだ！
私の代わりに狩猟してきて
くれないか？

61440.description: How is that for a fine medallion? Steady effort makes things this good. Patience is what matters, for hunters and craftsmen alike. If you want one, hunt that monster in the desert, or fish it up, and show me your patience.
61440.descriptionEn:
A splendid medallion, isn't it?
Keep at it steadily and you can
make things this fine.
Patience is what matters, for a
hunter and a smith alike. If you
want it, hunt that monster in the
Desert, or fish it up, and show
me your patience, that's what
I'd like to see.
61440.descriptionJp:
どうだい、見事なメダリオン
だろ？コツコツ頑張ればこれ
だけいいものが作れる。
ハンターにも職人にも忍耐っ
てもんが大事なのさ。欲しい
なら砂漠であのモンスターを
狩猟するか、釣り上げるかし
てお前さんの忍耐力を見せて
欲しいとこだな。

21851.objectiveJp: オディバトラス１頭の撃退
21851.description: This quest yields the production and upgrade materials for 5 parts of the Odiba series, Hard Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
21851.descriptionEn:
This quest yields the materials
needed to craft and upgrade
all five pieces of the
≪Hardcore Armor≫ Odiba series.
Accepting this quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest ends in failure,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please keep that
in mind.
21851.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪剛種防具≫
オディバシリーズの５部位分
の生産、強化素材が入手でき
ます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

15010.description: This official hunting exam has 4 parts in all! To confirm your skill once more, you will hunt every monster we designate! This time, sweep away the Shogun Ceanataur swarming in the land of scorching heat!
15010.descriptionEn:
This official hunting exam has
four parts in all! To gauge
your skill once more, you'll
hunt every monster we name!
This time, sweep away the
Shogun Ceanataur swarming
over the scorching lands!
15010.descriptionJp:
今回の公式狩猟試験は全部で
４つじゃ！オヌシの腕前を再
度確認すべく、こちらで指定
したモンスターを全て狩猟し
て貰うぞ！
今回は灼熱の地に群がる鎌蟹
たちを掃討するのじゃ！

50680.objectiveJp: テオ・テスカトル１体の撃退
50680.description: This quest yields the upgrade materials for 1 part of the Flor FX series, Supreme Species Armor. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
50680.descriptionEn:
This quest yields upgrade
materials for one piece of the
≪Zenith Armor≫ Flor FX series.
Accepting this quest requires
a ≪Superior Ticket≫.
If the quest ends in failure,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please keep that
in mind.
50680.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、≪覇種防具≫
フロルFXシリーズの１部位分
の強化素材が入手できます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

62374.description: There is a strange grass called Dye Grass. It can be gathered in many regions and serves as a material for arms that can hold special decorations. If you complete my request, I'll share a little of it with you.
62374.descriptionEn:
There is a strange
herb called ≪Dye Grass≫.
It grows all over and
serves as material for
gear that takes special
decorations. Finish my
request and I'll share
a little with you.
62374.descriptionJp:
≪センショク草≫という
不思議な草がある。
これは各地で採取が可能
で、特殊な装飾品を装着
できる武具の素材となる
のだ。わたしの依頼を
達成してくれたら、少し
君にも分けてあげよう。

50219.description: I obtained an ancient book said to record how to make gear that no one knows anymore, but I was attacked by monsters and dropped it. As long as the writing can be read, it need not be intact. Please, find it for me!
50219.descriptionEn:
I finally got my hands on an
ancient tome said to record the
forging methods of equipment
that no one knows anymore —
but a monster attacked me and
I dropped it. As long as the
writing can be read, it need
not be intact. Please, find it!
50219.descriptionJp:
今ではもう誰も知らない武具
の製法が記されているという、
いにしえの書物を手に入れた
のだが、モンスターに襲われ
て落してしまったんだ。
文字さえ読めれば、原型を
とどめていなくてもいい。
頼む、見つけてきてくれ！

50752.description: We present a request that lets you obtain in one go the rare materials of Aberrant individuals needed to upgrade the Silver Sovereign Wyvern's Heavenstorm, Supremacy, and Ｇ-rank armor, though the number of times it can be accepted per day is limited. Please take care not to miss this chance.
50752.descriptionEn:
Orders per day are limited, but
this request bundles the rare
'Variant rare materials' you
need to upgrade the Silver
Rule Dragon's Tenran, Zenith
and G Rank armor all at once.
Don't let this chance slip by.
50752.descriptionJp:
１日に受注できる数に限りは
ありますが、司銀龍の天嵐、
覇種、Ｇ級防具の強化に必要
な『特異個体の希少素材』を
まとめて入手できる依頼をご
紹介します。この機会を逃さ
ぬようご注意ください。

55347.description: An unidentified black monster is rampaging in the Old Tower. Who is it? It changes its form, changes its movement, changes its voice, changes its eye color. To whoever ascertains its true identity, I shall surely give production materials for Guild hidden armor.
55347.descriptionEn:
An unidentified black monster is
running wild in the Ancient Tower.
Who is it? It changes its shape,
its movements, its voice,
and the color of its eyes.
Whoever uncovers its true identity
will receive production materials
for Guild-treasured armor.
55347.descriptionJp:
正体不明の黒いモンスターが
古塔で暴れ回っている。
奴は何者だ？姿を変え、動き
を変え、声を変え、眼の色を
変えている。
こいつの正体を突き止めた者
にはギルド秘蔵の防具の生産
素材を必ず渡そう。

62044.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
62044.description: On the way back from peddling I found a lovely woven cloth at a stall. Certain it would sell, I bought up a great heap of it. On the way home in high spirits I had the bad luck to run into a Pariapuria, and once again I dropped my load and fled. So, hunt the Pariapuria and bring my wares back.
62044.descriptionEn:
On my way back from peddling,
I found some fine fabric at a
stall. Figured it would sell,
so I bought a whole load.
On the way home, feeling good,
I ran into a Pariapuria and
had to drop my goods and run.
So I need you to hunt that
Pariapuria and bring my wares
back home.
62044.descriptionJp:
行商の帰りに、露店で綺麗な
織物を見つけてな。
こいつは売れるって思い、
つい大量に購入したんだ。
上機嫌で帰る途中、運悪く
呑竜に出くわして、また荷物
を置いて逃げてきたんだ。
そこで、呑竜を狩猟して、
オレの商品を持ち帰ってきて
ほしい。

61237.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種の狩猟
61237.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Please note that once you have departed, the certificate cannot be returned for any reason.
61237.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards only for those in a
guild that won the Hunters Festival.
Please have the Festival Proof
with you when accepting and joining.
Once you depart, the Festival Proof
can never be returned, whatever
happens, so please be aware.
61237.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
出発後は、何があっても
祭典の証の返却はできない
ため、ご注意ください。

26150.description: It is I, the Instructor! If you are attacked while carrying an egg, the egg will break. Use the directional buttons to move your view and keep watch around you! And if your stamina runs out you will drop it too!
26150.descriptionEn:
It's me, the Instructor!
Take a hit while carrying an
egg and it will crack. Use
the direction keys to turn
the camera and watch your
surroundings! And if stamina
runs out, you'll drop it too!
26150.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
卵を持っているときに攻撃を
受けると、卵は割れてしまう
のだ。方向キーを使って視点
を動かし、周囲に気を配れ！
さらに、スタミナが切れても
落っことしてしまうからな！

63310.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
63310.description: A somewhat troublesome request. The Odd Species confirmed the other day seem to have appeared 2 at once. So for this request we have increased the number of Odd Species hunting permits issued, and arranged for you to hunt them ahead of others. Please hunt them before the damage reaches nearby villages.
63310.descriptionEn:
This is a rather
troublesome request. The
Rare Species confirmed the
other day appeared two at
once. So we raised the Rare
Species permit count and
arranged for you to hunt
them first. Please hunt them
before villages are harmed.
63310.descriptionJp:
少々やっかいな依頼です。
先日存在が確認された奇種が
２頭同時に出現しているよう
です。そこでこちらの依頼で
は奇種狩猟書の発行数を増加
し、率先して狩猟していただ
けるよう手配致しました。付
近の村に被害が及ぶ前に狩猟
をお願いします。

55834.description: The Variant Species Gravios has appeared once more. Its developed body not only stores and vents heat, it seems to generate enough to melt rock. Please conduct the investigation with every care.
55834.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Gravios≫ has
appeared once more.
Its developed body stores heat,
and not only vents it but seems
to grow hot enough to melt
rock.
Please take great care in your
survey.
55834.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪グラビモス≫が再び
現れました。
発達した躰は熱を蓄え、
噴出させるのみならず
岩を熔解するほど発熱させて
いる様です。
十分に気を付けて調査をお願
いします。

54166.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54166.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54166.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

23357.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
23357.description: A request for hunters who possess Odibatorasu G Rank Haku armor. By repeatedly slaying Diorekkusu, you can obtain the materials needed to strengthen the Odiba GF Series Retsu Armor up to LV7.
23357.descriptionEn:
For hunters who own the
≪G-Rank Supremacy≫ armor
of the ≪Odibatorasu≫.
By repeatedly slaying
Diorex, you can obtain the
materials needed to upgrade
the ≪Fierce≫ armor
"Odiba GF Series" up to
Lv7.
23357.descriptionJp:
≪弩岩竜≫の≪Ｇ級覇種防具≫
を所持しているハンター向け
の依頼です。
ディオレックスを繰り返し
討伐することで、
「オディバGFシリーズ」
≪烈種防具≫ＬＶ７まで
の強化に必要な素材が入手で
きます。

21988.description: Odibatorasu the Conquest species, said to bring destruction, has appeared! With no time to lose, this is a short-notice request, but to keep the damage to a minimum, repelling it alone will also count. We are seeking first-rate hunters with a Secret Scroll to face this unprecedented crisis!
21988.descriptionEn:
The Zenith Odibatorasu, said to
bring destruction, has appeared!
Every moment counts, so this is
a short slaying request, but to
keep the damage to a minimum,
simply repelling it will also be
counted.
We call for hunters who hold a
Secret Art and will face this
unprecedented crisis!
21988.descriptionJp:
破壊をもたらすといわれる、
覇種弩岩竜が現れました！
一刻を争う事態のため、
短時間での討伐依頼となりま
すが、被害を最小限に抑える
ため、撃退のみでも
評価いたします。
このかつてない危機に立ち
向かう凄腕の秘伝書所持
ハンターを募集します！

26521.objectiveJp: エスピナス亜種１頭の狩猟

55369.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a quest that exchanges Festival Fever for a Festival Emblem. Please have your Festival Fever with you when you accept or join.
55369.descriptionEn:
For members of Guilds on the winning
side of the Hunter Festival, we have
prepared a quest that can convert
≪Festival Fervor≫ into
≪Festival Emblem≫. When accepting or
joining, please have your
≪Festival Fervor≫ with you.
55369.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属し
ているかた専用に、≪祭典の
熱気≫を≪祭典の紋章≫に交
換できるクエストを用意させ
ていただきました。受注、参
加時に、≪祭典の熱気≫をお
持ちください。

61239.description: You lost at the Hunter Festival, but you simply must have a memento of the celebration! If that sounds like you, why not take this quest? The conditions are a little harsh, though, so I would not recommend it to anyone on the winning side. Nothing is returned if you fail, so be careful!
61239.descriptionEn:
You lost at the Hunter Festival,
but you just have to have a
souvenir of the festivities!
That's you, isn't it! Why not
try accepting this quest?
But the conditions are a bit harsh,
so I don't recommend it to the
winning side.
If you fail, the item won't be
returned, so be careful!
61239.descriptionJp:
狩人祭で負けてしまった、
でもどうしても祭典の思い出
が欲しい！と思っているそこ
のアナタ！このクエストを
受注してみないか？
ただしちょっと条件が厳しい
から勝ち組の人にはオススメ
しないぜ。
失敗してもブツは返さない
から慎重にやれよな！

53248.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
53248.description: Thank you for playing MHF for ten whole years! We truly appreciate it! Equip Haldo Metalenon, deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket, and we will give you 11 Proof of Gratitude S as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude S Elzeacta (Tonfa) can be forged.
53248.descriptionEn:
Thank you for playing
MHF for ten whole years!
We truly appreciate it!
Equip ≪Haldo Metalenon≫,
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫, and we
will give you 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude S≫ as a gift.
From ≪Proof of Gratitude S≫
≪Elzeacta≫ (Tonfa) can be
forged.
53248.descriptionJp:
１０年間ＭＨＦを遊んで
いただき誠にありがとう
ございます！
≪ハルド・メタレノン≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると、
≪感謝の証S≫を１１枚
プレゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証S≫から
≪エルゼアクタ≫（穿龍棍）
が生産可能です。

22149.description: As we pushed surveys across the land following the appearance of Transcendent Species, a Thousand Blade Wyvern, Seregios, was newly found in the desert. According to the surveyor who encountered it, it performs behavior never observed before. Take the greatest care with the monster's movements!
22149.descriptionEn:
With a Transcendent Species
about, we pushed surveys across
the land, and in the Desert the
Thousand Blade Wyvern
≪Seregios≫ has been newly found.
Reports from the surveyor who
met it say it performs behavior
never observed before. Take the
greatest care around it!
22149.descriptionJp:
遷悠種の出現により、各地の
調査を進めたところ、砂漠に
千刃竜≪セルレギオス≫が
新たに発見されました。
遭遇した調査員の報告による
と、今まで観測されていない
行動を行うとのことです。
モンスターの行動にはくれ
ぐれも注意して下さい！

62217.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62217.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62217.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62217.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

62940.objectiveJp: ハンターカード青１０枚納品
62940.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62940.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
62940.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

26234.description: The Senshoku Grass discovered in recent years is a rare item whose authenticity only a veteran thoroughly versed in nature can judge. As it grows only in specific regions, we guide only those of ＨＲ１００ and above.
26234.descriptionEn:
The Senshoku Grass discovered in
recent years is a rare item whose
authenticity only a veteran who
knows nature well can discern.
As it grows only in certain regions,
we offer guidance only to those
of HR 100 or above.
26234.descriptionJp:
近年発見されたセンショク草
は、自然を熟知した熟練者で
なければ真贋を見極めること
ができない、レアな一品です。
特定の地域でのみ見られる草
なので、ＨＲ１００以上の方
に限ってご案内させていただ
いております。

26323.objectiveJp:
メインターゲットの狩猟、
またはサブターゲットの達成
26323.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26323.objectiveEn:
Hunt the main target,
or complete the sub-target
26323.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26323.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

62628.objectiveJp: シェンガオレン１匹の撃退
62628.description: A suspicious dragon is approaching the Fortress at tremendous speed! At once, make use of the fortress's interception weapons and drive off the mysterious giant dragon! As this is an emergency request, if you drive it off well, I will issue more proof of the kill than usual!
62628.descriptionEn:
A suspicious dragon is closing
on the Fortress at great speed!
Hurry and use the Fortress's
interception weapons to repel
the mysterious giant dragon!
As this is an emergency request,
a successful repel earns you
more slay proofs than usual!
62628.descriptionJp:
怪しげな龍が物凄い勢いで
砦に接近してきています！
大至急、砦の迎撃兵器を活用
し、謎の巨大龍を撃退して
ください！
緊急依頼のため、見事に撃退
できましたら、普段よりも
多く討伐の証を発行します！

26428.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟

23410.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐
23410.description: This quest gives production materials for the Tonfa whose performance was decided by a survey held to mark 700,000 Zinogre hunted in the Zinogre hunting unlock event, 'Migration Species Invasion! Hunt the Zinogre'.
23410.descriptionEn:
At the Zinogre hunting release
event "Transcendent Invasion!
Hunt the Zinogre", a survey was
held to mark 700,000 Thunder
Wolf Wyverns hunted, and it
decided the performance of the
Tonfa. This quest lets you obtain
its crafting materials.
23410.descriptionJp:
ジンオウガ狩猟解禁イベント
「遷悠種襲来！ジンオウガを
狩猟せよ」にて
雷狼竜の狩猟数70万頭突破を
記念して行われたアンケート
にて性能が決定された
穿龍棍の生産素材を入手する
クエストになります。

54616.description: In praise of the achievements you all left in the Extreme Conquest Battle, we present rewards. Heavy Soul Jewel G2 x5, Supreme Heaven Ticket x40, Extreme Expedition Recommendation (Purple) x40.
54616.descriptionEn:
In honor of your deeds in the
Extreme Conquest, we present
you these rewards.
- Heavy Soul Orb G x25
- Shiten Ticket x40
- Extreme Rec. Letter [Purple] x40
54616.descriptionJp:
極限征伐戦で皆さんが残した
功績を称え、報酬をお渡しい
たします。
・重魂玉Ｇ２５個
・至天チケット４０枚
・極征推薦状【紫】４０枚

51118.description: I love Raviente. Its mountain-like bulk fills me with awe, but my companions do not understand. They go so far as to say that Lao-Shan Lung is big enough too. Wear the armor I have prepared and repel Lao-Shan Lung. I will pay for a head break as well, but you cannot return until you have repelled it.
51118.descriptionEn:
I adore Raviente.
That mountain-like bulk has real
majesty, yet my comrades do not
see it. They only say Lao-Shan
Lung is plenty big as well.
Wear the armor I prepared and
repel Lao-Shan Lung for me.
Breaking its head pays extra, but
you cannot come home until it
flees.
51118.descriptionJp:
私はラヴィエンテが大好きだ。
山の如き巨躯には威厳を感じ
るが、仲間は理解してくれん。
大きさなら老山龍も充分大き
い、などと言い出す始末。
私が用意した防具を身に着け、
老山龍を撃退して欲しい。
頭部破壊でも報酬をだすが、
撃退するまで帰還はできんぞ。

51020.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
51020.description: We introduce a request that yields the materials needed to produce and upgrade 1 part of the Gurear series, Hard Species Armor of the Water Fortress Wyvern. It is a bargain quest, so please try it!
51020.descriptionEn:
Here's a request where you can
get the materials to craft and
upgrade one piece of the Water
Fortress Dragon's ≪Hardcore
Armor≫ "Glare Series". It's a
generous quest, so give it a
try!
51020.descriptionJp:
水砦竜の≪剛種防具≫
「グレアシリーズ」１部位分
の生産強化に必要な素材を
入手できる依頼をご紹介
します。オトクなクエスト
ですのでぜひチャレンジして
ください！

60007.description: A rare report has come in that Rathian are descending on the desert one after another! Hunting the queen, a tough foe even alone, again and again will be quite difficult! Those confident in their skill, and those who need Rathian materials, sign up!
60007.descriptionEn:
An unusual report has come in:
Rathians are descending on the
Desert one after another!
Hunting these queens, each one
a formidable foe, back to back
will be quite a challenge!
Those confident in their skill, and
those needing Rathian parts, join in!!
60007.descriptionJp:
砂漠地帯にリオレイアが次々
と舞い降りていると、珍しい
報告が入りました！１頭でも
難敵となる女王を連続で狩猟
することは、かなりの困難と
なるでしょう！腕に自信のあ
る方や、レイアの素材が必要
な方もふるってご参加を！！

50716.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
50716.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head and torso of a Red Shadow will also grant a special ingredient.
50716.descriptionEn:
For some time now we have been
running Guild Priority requests,
and to raise awareness and
promote them further, we have
prepared this quest.
By breaking the head and torso
of the Red Shadow, we will also
grant you special ingredients.
50716.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
赤影の頭と胴を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

21506.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
21506.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
21506.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

21640.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21640.description: We ask you to hunt the bird wyvern and the great boar that appeared in the Jungle. This request is just right for those aiming to become first-rate hunters. As a reward, we have prepared a small gift from the Guild. I hope that one day you will become a splendid hunter.
21640.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the Yian Kut-Ku and
the Bulldrome that appeared in
the Jungle.
This request is just right for
those aiming to become first
rate hunters.
The guild has prepared a small
gift as your reward. I look
forward to the day you become a
fine hunter.
21640.descriptionJp:
密林に現れた、怪鳥と大猪
の狩猟をお願いします。
この依頼は、これから一流の
ハンターを目指す皆さんに
丁度良い依頼となっています。
報酬として、ギルドから
心ばかりの贈り物を用意させ
て頂きました。いつの日か、
立派なハンターとなることを
期待します。

53319.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
53319.description: YO! Gather round, hunters, YO! The Hypnocatrice in breeding season is YO! Those feathers are cool, YO! A hunting horn in the same colors! YEAH! With "Caw Caw Gook J", please take the hunt, YO! Cool birds meet in the Sea of Trees! That sight is peak HAPPY! Huge hopes for YOUR session!
53319.descriptionEn:
YO! Gather round, hunters, YO!
The Hypnocatrice in ≪breeding
season≫ is YO! Those feathers
are cool, YO! A hunting horn in
the same colors! YEAH! With
"Caw Caw Gook J", please take
the hunt, YO! Cool birds meet in
the Sea of Trees! That sight is
peak HAPPY! Huge hopes for YOUR session!
53319.descriptionJp:
ＹＯ！集まれハンターＹＯ！
≪繁殖期≫の眠鳥はＹＯ！
その羽毛がイケててＹＯ！
同じ色した狩猟笛！ＹＥＡＨ！
「カァーカァーグークJ」で
狩猟をたのむＹＯ！
クールなバードが樹海に集合！
その光景は最高にＨＡＰＰＹ！
ＹＯＵのセッションに超期待！

60626.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
60626.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
60626.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
60626.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

1067.description: Basarios grows by eating ore, so its outer shell often contains ore. Destroy its parts and you can get ore without ever mining! Truly two birds with one stone!
1067.descriptionEn:
≪Basarios≫ grows by eating
ore, so its shell often
contains minerals. Break its
parts and you can nab ore
without ever mining, mate!
That's two birds with one
stone, right there!
1067.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫は鉱石を食べ
て成長するためその外殻には
鉱石が含まれてることが多い
んだ。ヤツの部位を破壊する
ことで、採掘しなくても鉱石
を入手することだってできる
んだぜ！まさに一石二鳥さ！

61241.objectiveJp: マストオーダー全ての狩猟
61241.description: The Snowy Mountains are somehow restless. I sense something strange too, so would you go and investigate once? Once you find the cause, please deal with it as well. There is a chance you will get a rough welcome, so I will lend you equipment.
61241.descriptionEn:
Something's stirring in the
Snowy Mountains. There's a
strange presence too, so could
you go take a look? Once you
find the cause, deal with it
as well. You might get a rough
welcome, so I'll lend you gear.
61241.descriptionJp:
雪山がなんだか騒がしいんだ。
妙な気配もするから、一度
調査に向かってくれないか？
原因を突き止めたら、その
解決も頼む。手荒な歓迎を
される可能性もあるから、
装備を貸してあげよう。

61857.description: Hunting in an untrodden land, that is surely the true thrill of the hunter. You understand? So, a hunting request in the Highlands. The purpose is an ecological survey, so finish it quickly while no big game is about.
61857.descriptionEn:
Hunting in untrodden lands, that is
the true thrill of being a hunter.
You know what I mean?
So, here is a hunting request for
the ≪Highlands≫. The goal is an
ecology survey, so finish it quickly
while nothing big is around.
61857.descriptionJp:
未踏の大地での狩猟、これ
こそがハンターの醍醐味
だろう。わかるよな？
てなわけで≪高地≫での狩猟
依頼だ。生態調査が目的なの
で、大物がいない間にさっと
済ませてきてくれよ。

21117.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21117.description: If you are going to hunt in the Snowy Mountains, it is best to bring a Hot Drink and not forget it. It might be surer to hunt Popo and get used to the mountain environment to some degree, and then hunt a Bulldrome.
21117.descriptionEn:
When you hunt in the Snowy
Mountains, don't forget a
≪Hot Drink≫. It may be safer
to slay ≪Popo≫ and get used
to the cold before you hunt
a ≪Bulldrome≫.
21117.descriptionJp:
雪山で狩猟に臨む場合は、
≪ホットドリンク≫を忘れず
に持ってくといいわよ。
≪ポポ≫の討伐で、ある程度
雪山の環境に慣れてから、
≪ドスファンゴ≫を狩猟した
方が確実かも知れないわね。

62306.objectiveJp: コウザンダケ９９個の納品
62306.description: So you want to become a mushroom maniac too? This path is not as easy as you think. First, gather Kozandake in great quantity! We will talk after that!
62306.descriptionEn:
So you want to become a mushroom
maniac too?
This path is not as easy as you
think it is, my friend.
First, go gather Kouzandake in
large quantities!
We will talk after that!
62306.descriptionJp:
君もキノコマニアになりた
いって？
この道は君が考えているほど
簡単な道のりでは無いのだよ。
まずはコウザンダケを大量に
集めてくるんだ！
話はそれからだ！

62049.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の討伐
62049.description: This is a qualifier for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament. The time limit is 10 minutes. You cannot obtain the target monster's materials from carving or clear rewards.
62049.descriptionEn:
This is a qualifier for the VS.
Quest Champion Tournament.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
You cannot obtain the target
monster's materials from
carving or clear rewards.
62049.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選クエスト
です。制限時間は１０分です。
モンスターの剥ぎ取り
とクリア報酬で対象モンスタ
ーの素材は入手できません。

53069.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters they differ in appearance as well and are extremely powerful, and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
53069.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
their looks differ and they are
extremely powerful, taking actions
normally unthinkable, or so it is said.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
53069.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目も異なり非常に強力で、
通常では考えられない行動を
取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

23490.objectiveJp: ディオレックス１頭の討伐
23490.description: Diorekkusu has appeared at the top of the sea of trees. It is a very dangerous monster that hardens its outer shell using the electricity generating organs in its body and shows quick movement. Many hunters have already been harmed. Please proceed to slay it with the utmost care.
23490.descriptionEn:
A ≪Diorex≫ has appeared at the
Top of Great Forest. It hardens
its outer shell using the power
generation organ in its body and
moves with great speed; it is a
very dangerous monster. Many
hunters have already fallen
victim. Please take the utmost
care when you slay it.
23490.descriptionJp:
樹海頂部に
≪ディオレックス≫が現れま
した。体内の発電器官を利用
した外殻の硬質化と、素早い
動きを見せる、非常に危険な
モンスターです。既に多くの
ハンターが被害にあっていま
す。細心の注意を払い
討伐に当たってください。

51013.description: What a joyous thing! Golden fish and silver fish exist in this world! Tell me all about their traits! So you can join the fish, I lend you my fish head. When you approach, do not forget to 'greet' them!
51013.descriptionEn:
What a joyous day this is!
That a golden fish and a silver
fish should exist in this world!
Tell me all about their traits,
in detail!
So you can join the fishes, I
will lend you my fish head.
Do not forget to give a
"greeting" when you approach!
51013.descriptionJp:
なんとめでたいことか！
金のおさかなと銀のおさかな
がこの世に存在するとは！
ぜひその特徴をワシに詳しく
聞かせとくれ！
おさかなの仲間になれるよう、
ワシのおさかな頭を貸してや
るわい。近づくときには
「あいさつ」を忘れずにの！

26319.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26319.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26319.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26319.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

60509.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
60509.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Bulldrome will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
60509.descriptionEn:
At the Elder Hall Guild request,
we are recommending trial use of
a new sub-target.
The "set damage" dealt to
Bulldrome will be judged by our
guild, so simply focus on
completing the main target.
Good luck out there!
60509.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ドスファンゴ≫への『一定
ダメージ』は、当ギルドで判
断しますので、皆さんはメイ
ンターゲットの達成に専念し
てくだされば結構ですよ！

26545.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
26545.description: An ice wyvern has been confirmed in a hidden area of the Ancient Tower, one apart from those where the fire wyverns dwell. The Hunters Guild has named that wyvern the Ice Fox Wyvern, Dyuragaua, and is studying its ecology. It is a wyvern we still know little about, so we ask you to investigate.
26545.descriptionEn:
An ice dragon has been
confirmed in a hidden region
of the Ancient Tower, apart
from where the Rathalos
dwell. The Guild named it
the Ice Fox Dragon
≪Duramboros≫ and studies its
ecology. Please survey it.
26545.descriptionJp:
古塔の秘境、それも火竜たち
が住まうものとは別の秘境で
氷の竜が確認されました。
猟団組合ではあの竜を氷狐竜
≪デュラガウア≫と名付け、
その生態を調査しております。
まだ情報が少ない飛竜ですが
調査をお願いします。

21737.objectiveJp: ガルバダオラ１体の討伐
21737.description: During a test flight over Mezeporuta, we encountered a golden dragon. Gold dust swirled on deck and visibility was poor, so we could not observe it. What may happen is impossible to predict, but please investigate.
21737.descriptionEn:
During a trial flight of a
large exploration ship over
Mezeporta, we encountered a
golden dragon. Gold dust
swirled over the deck, so
visibility was poor and we
could not observe the target.
We cannot predict what will
happen, but please survey it.
21737.descriptionJp:
大型探査船の試行のため、
メゼポルタ上空を飛行して
いる際に、金色の龍に遭遇
しました。
船上には金粉が舞っていた為、
視界が悪く、対象を観察する
ことができませんでした。
何が起こるか予測不可能です
が調査をお願いします。

50291.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
50291.description: Hunters! Are you content merely to have obtained your gear? That will not do! Clear this quest and see your gear strengthened further still!
50291.descriptionEn:
Hunters, all of you!
Are you content merely to
have laid hands on equipment?
That simply will not do!
Clear this quest and take
your equipment to the next
level of power!
50291.descriptionJp:
ハンター諸君！
武具を手に入れただけで
満足しているのでは？
それではイカンのです！
このクエストを達成して、
更なる武具の強化を成し遂げ
ましょう！

21960.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
21960.description: To support hunters in their hunting lives, we have prepared a request to hunt the Shogun Ceanataur on Tide Island. Clear this request and you will earn higher standing than usual. Train efficiently and aim for even greater heights.
21960.descriptionEn:
To support a hunter's life, we
prepared a request to hunt
≪Shogun Ceanataur≫ on the Tidal
Island. Clearing it earns you
higher appraisal than usual.
Train efficiently and aim for
even greater heights.
21960.descriptionJp:
ハンターの狩猟生活を応援す
るため、潮島で≪鎌蟹≫を
狩猟する依頼を用意しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、通常
より高い評価が得られます。
効率的な鍛練を積み、さらな
る高みを目指しましょう。

62873.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62873.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62873.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

54751.objectiveJp: ラヴィエンテ１体の撃退
54751.description: Urgent word from the Pallone Caravan! A mysterious massive tremor has been detected from the Remote Island. According to the advance surveyor's report, a gigantic monster is raging deep underground. All hunters who can move are to head for the Remote Island Underground and slay the target!
54751.descriptionEn:
Emergency contact from the
Parone Caravan! A mysterious
massive tremor was detected
from ≪Isolated Island≫.
Per the advance surveyor's
report, a huge monster is
raging deep underground.
All hunters who can move are
to head to ≪Isolated Depths≫ and slay it!
54751.descriptionJp:
パローネ＝キャラバンから
緊急連絡！≪絶島≫より
謎の巨大震動を確認しました。
先行調査員の報告によると、
巨大なモンスターが地下深く
で暴れているとのことです。
動ける全てのハンターは
≪絶島地底≫へ向かい、目標
を討伐してください！

62801.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
62801.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
62801.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

53023.description: I have opened the Gook Gallery I always dreamed of! But it is noisy around here and customers do not come. Would someone hunt the poison bird wyvern in the Swamp near the gallery? If you help, I will give you my treasured Gook Collection.
53023.descriptionEn:
I have finally opened the Gook
Gallery I always dreamed of!
But it is noisy around here and
customers just will not come.
Would someone hunt the Gypceros
in the Swamp near the gallery
for me?
If you help me out, I will give
you a piece of my treasured
Gook collection.
53023.descriptionJp:
念願のグークギャラリーを
開館したぞ！
だが、周りが騒がしくて
なかなかお客が来ないんだ。
だれかギャラリー近くの沼地
にいる毒怪鳥を狩猟してきて
くれないか？
手伝ってくれるなら、秘蔵の
グークコレクションを
プレゼントするよ。

54559.description: We are promoting the spread of powerful equipment to hunters heading for unsurveyed regions, but because it uses precious materials, the Guild has decided to provide support. If you complete this request, we will provide the materials the investigators brought back. There may be precious materials among them.
54559.descriptionEn:
We are spreading powerful equipment
among hunters heading into unsurveyed
regions, but since it uses precious
materials, the Guild has decided
to give support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
54559.descriptionJp:
未調査地域へ向かうハンター
に、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

40234.description: The Black Caster appears to have built a golem modelled on a dragon and is testing it. Its power is immense, and at this rate even uninvolved people may come to harm. Join with the Black Rider, who agreed to cooperate, and stop the damage!
40234.descriptionEn:
The Black Caster appears to be
building a dragon-shaped golem
and running tests.
Its power is immense, and at
this rate even uninvolved
people may come to harm.
Join forces with the Black
Rider who agreed to help and
stop the damage!
40234.descriptionJp:
黒のキャスターが竜を模した
ゴーレムを作り、テストを
行っている様です。
その力は強大で、
このままでは無関係な人間
にも被害が及び兼ねません。
協力に同意してくれた
黒のライダーと共に被害を
食い止めてください！

50466.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50466.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50466.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

26488.description: Basarios grows by eating ore, so its outer shell often contains ore. By destroying parts, it seems you can sometimes get ore without mining at all! That's two birds with one stone!
26488.descriptionEn:
≪Basarios≫ grows by eating
ore, so its shell often
contains minerals. Break its
parts and you may get ore
without mining at all, or so
they say! Two birds with
one stone, eh!
26488.descriptionJp:
≪バサルモス≫は鉱石を食べ
て成長するためその外殻には
鉱石が含まれてることが多い
です。部位を破壊することで、
採掘しなくても鉱石が入手
できることもあるみたいです
よ！これは一石二鳥ですね！

61869.description: I was carrying a heap of foodstuffs and medicine through the jungle when those Congalala made off with my load! Hey, would you get rid of them and take my cargo back? Especially the big boss, capture, capture, please. As thanks I will give you part of the cargo I get back!
61869.descriptionEn:
I was hauling food and medicine
through the Jungle when those
Congalala wrecked my cargo!
Hey, would you drive them off
and get my goods back? For the
big boss, capture it, capture
it, please. As thanks I'll give
you part of what you recover!
61869.descriptionJp:
食料品や薬をたんまり積んで
密林を通ってたら、桃毛獣の
やつらに荷物をやられちまっ
た！なぁ、あいつらを退治し
て荷物を取り返してくれない
か？特に親玉は捕獲、捕獲で
頼むよ。お礼に取り返した
荷物の一部をあげるから！

55526.description: Perhaps hearing the festival clamor, the Ten'i Species Plesioth is heading this way ahead of schedule. The situation is extremely dangerous. I would like to request a slaying at once, but as the survey is insufficient, I can only permit contact for about 10 minutes. Never overdo it.
55526.descriptionEn:
Whether it heard the festival
or not, a ≪Supremacy≫ Plesioth
is heading this way ahead of
schedule. The situation is
extremely dangerous. I'd like
to send you to slay it at once,
but our survey is incomplete,
so contact is limited to about
10 minutes. Never overdo it.
55526.descriptionJp:
お祭り騒ぎを聞いてか否か、
≪辿異種≫ガノトトスが予定
よりも早く此方へ向かってい
ます。非常に危険な状況です。
直ぐにでも討伐を依頼したい
ところですが、調査が不十分
なため、接敵を許可できるの
はおよそ１０分となります。
絶対に無理はしないで下さい。

62083.objectiveJp: デュラガウア１頭の狩猟
62083.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Dyuragaua in the arena. Clear the quest without mishap and your standing as a hunter will climb sharply!
62083.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show what they can do!
Hunt the ≪Ice Fox Wyvern≫ in
the Arena and prove yourself.
Clear the quest safely, and
your reputation as a hunter
will shoot right up! Now go
and show them what you've got!
62083.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
闘技場の≪氷狐竜≫を
狩猟してみせろ。
無事、クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

50612.description: You who would master the way of the hunt. Take up a Conquest Weapon and hunt the Gold and Silver Piscine Wyvern. One who has come this far along the hunter's path should be able to bring them down. Do so, and a fitting reward shall be yours.
50612.descriptionEn:
You who would master the way of
the hunt. Take up a 『Zenith
Weapon』 and hunt the ≪Gold and
Silver Fish Wyverns≫.
One who has come this far in the
way of the hunt should be able to
bring them down.
Do it splendidly and I will give
you a fitting reward.
50612.descriptionJp:
狩りの道を極めんとする者よ。
『覇種武器』を携え、≪金銀
魚竜≫を狩るのだ。ここまで
狩りの道を極めたお主なら、
金銀魚竜も仕留められるじゃ
ろう。見事仕留められれば、
それなりの褒美を取らせよう。

50470.description: The other day I made a great discovery! Combine a certain ore with several of the frost that settles upon it, and one can produce that rarest of things, a Frozen Crystal. Help me gather these materials and I will share the product with you.
50470.descriptionEn:
The other day I made a great
discovery! If you combine a
certain ore with several of the
frost that settles on it, you can
create the rarest "Freezing
Crystal" in the world.
If you help me gather these
materials, I will share the
results with you!
50470.descriptionJp:
先日わしは大きな発見を
した！とある鉱石とそこに
降り積もる霜を複数個掛け
合わせると世にも珍しい
「凍てつく結晶」を生成
できるんじゃ。
これらの素材の採取を手伝っ
てくれたら、お前さんにも
生成物を分けてやるぞい。

50810.description: The White Lake in the breeding season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
50810.descriptionEn:
The ≪White Lake≫ in breeding
season. It is an unexplored land
the Guild is still surveying, but
why not go have a look yourself
for gathering and survey work?
If you feel like coming home,
just deliver a map to finish
up!
50810.descriptionJp:
繁殖期の≪白湖≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

23287.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟
23287.description: According to the people who live in the Canyon, many legends remain that deep in the Canyon lives a dragon that commands lightning. The truth of the stories is uncertain, but we cannot expose the survey team to danger. Accompany the survey and ensure their safety.
23287.descriptionEn:
According to the people who
live in the Canyon, many tales
remain of a dragon that wields
lightning deep in the Canyon.
Whether the tales are true is
unclear, but we cannot expose
the survey team to danger.
Please accompany the survey and
ensure their safety.
23287.descriptionJp:
峡谷に住む人々の話では、
峡谷の奥深くには、
雷を操る竜がいるとの逸話が
数多く残されているとのこと
です。話の真偽は定かではあ
りませんが、調査団を危険に
さらすわけにはいきません。
調査に同行し、安全の確保を
お願いします。

21754.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
21754.description: At the request of the Elder Hall Guild, we are recommending trial use of a new sub-target. The set amount of damage to the Velocidrome will be judged by our Guild, so you need only concentrate on completing the main target!
21754.descriptionEn:
At the request of the Elder Hall
Guild, it has been decided to
recommend trialing a new kind
of sub-target.
Our Guild will judge the set
amount of damage dealt to
≪Velocidrome≫, so please all
focus solely on the main target!
21754.descriptionJp:
大老殿ギルドの要請で新しい
サブターゲットの試用が勧め
られることになりました。
≪ドスランポス≫への『一定
ダメージ』は、当ギルドで判
断しますので、皆さんはメイ
ンターゲットの達成に専念し
てくだされば結構ですよ！

62311.objectiveJp: アクラ・ジェビア１匹の討伐

21597.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の狩猟
21597.description: Have you heard of the Fox Tail Sphere? Its material is essential to crafting a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will give you that precious decoration material.
21597.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as Fox Tail Sphere?
Its material is essential for
crafting a certain expensive
decoration.
If you can complete this
request, I'll give you that
precious decoration material.
21597.descriptionJp:
狐尾原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

51092.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51092.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of a Diablos will also grant a special ingredient.
51092.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been running, we have
prepared this quest to further raise
awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Diablos's horns,
we will also grant you
some special ingredients
as an extra reward.
51092.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
角竜の角を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

50128.objectiveJp: パリアプリア１頭の狩猟
50128.description: While I was enjoying the resort, the ingredients I had prepared for a night barbecue were all eaten up by a Pariapuria! I cannot stand for this to happen again! I will thank you, so drive that thing off!
50128.descriptionEn:
I was enjoying the resort when
the ingredients I'd readied
for tonight's barbecue were
gobbled up by a Pariapuria!
I won't stand for that again!
I'll pay you well, so go and
chase that thing off for me!
Thanks!
50128.descriptionJp:
リゾートを満喫していたら、
夜のバーベキューのために
用意していた食材が、
パリアプリアによって
食い尽くされてしまった！
またこんなことがあっては
たまらん！礼はするから、
あいつを追い払ってくれ！

54417.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
54417.description: There are reports that a Forokururu has appeared in the area under survey. Many hunters are responding, but they are meeting fierce resistance and the situation is very dangerous. Other monsters are said to be gathering as well. Head to the site at once.
54417.descriptionEn:
A ≪Forokururu≫ has been
reported in the area under
survey. Many hunters are
already responding, but it
is putting up fierce
resistance and the situation
is very dangerous. Other
monsters are said to be
gathering there as well.
Head out at once!
54417.descriptionJp:
≪フォロクルル≫が調査中の
地域に現れたとの報告があ
りました。多くのハンター
が対応に当たっているとの
ことですが、激しい抵抗に
遭い非常に危険な状態です。
他のモンスターも集まって
きているとの報告もあります。
至急、現地に向かってくださ
い。

21228.description: A report has come from a surveyor that a young monster individual has been confirmed. This is a perfect request for learning a monster's ecology and traits. It comes especially recommended to those just beginning their hunter life!
21228.descriptionEn:
Our surveyor filed a report:
a young monster specimen has
been confirmed in the field.
This request is just the thing
for learning a monster's
ecology and traits.
I especially recommend it to
anyone starting hunter life!
21228.descriptionJp:
調査員から報告があり、
若いモンスター個体が
確認されました。
モンスターの生態や特徴を
知るには、もってこいの
依頼です。
特にハンター生活をはじめら
れた方にオススメいたします！

21478.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
21478.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery.
