They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
21478.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
21478.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

55176.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の討伐
55176.description: Slaying a Shogun Ceanataur raises your standing and lets you obtain at a good rate the materials needed for G rank decorations. A quest for that is ready. Please make use of it.
55176.descriptionEn:
Slaying a Shogun Ceanataur
raises your reputation while
also earning you the materials
needed to get G Rank
decorations, all in one handy
quest we've prepared for you.
Please make good use of it.
55176.descriptionJp:
ショウグンギザミを討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

22048.description: The Snowy Mountains are a land the Guild is still surveying, but why not go once yourself, to gather and survey? If you feel like coming home, just deliver a map!
22048.descriptionEn:
The ≪Snowy Mountains≫ are
a land still under Guild
survey, but hunters too
might like to go and take
a look for gathering and
research. How about it?
If you want to head home,
just deliver the map!
22048.descriptionJp:
≪雪山≫は、
ギルドでも調査中の地
ですが、ハンターさんも、
採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

61804.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
61804.description: I want to make a cuff that sparkles at night, but preparations for the exhibition keep me busy! You there! How about it? If you fetch the materials I need instead, I will give you something special of mine! I am counting on you!
61804.descriptionEn:
I want to make a Cuff that
sparkles at night, but I'm
stuck prepping for the expo!

Hey, you there! How about it?
Bring me the materials I need
instead, and I'll give you
something special of mine!

I'm counting on you!
61804.descriptionJp:
夜になるとキラキラ輝く
カフが作りたいが、展示会の
準備で手が離せないんだ！

そこのキミ！どうだい？
代わりに必要な素材を取って
来てくれたら、オレさまの
とっておきをやろう！

頼んだぜ！

61551.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟

62593.objectiveJp: ハンターカード赤１０枚納品
62593.description: Hunters who practiced so hard at the VS. Quest Champion Tournament practice quests: show us the fruit of your efforts.
62593.descriptionEn:
VS. Quest Champion
Hunters who practiced the
tournament practice quests
with all your might:
show me the fruit of your efforts.
62593.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの練習用クエス
トを一生懸命に練習した
ハンターの皆さん。
努力の結晶を見せてください。

54990.description: Hunter who would master the gunlance, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn more reward than your daily efforts would bring.
54990.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Gunlance, face the
≪Baruragaru≫ in the New Great
Arena and show the skill you
have honed!
If you can hunt it well, you
will earn far more reward
than your daily efforts ever
bring.
54990.descriptionJp:
銃槍を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

26724.description: For many years I have studied the King of the Sky and the Queen of the Land, and at last my ecological study is nearly complete. Once I finish surveying the Rathalos Variant recently discovered in the canyon, my book will be done, so I ask you to capture it. Help me and I will share a copy of the book.
26724.descriptionEn:
For years I have studied the
King of the Sky and the Queen
of the Land, and at last my
research on their ecology is
nearly finished.
Once I survey the Rathalos
Variant lately found in the
Canyon, my book is done, so
please capture it. You'll get a copy.
26724.descriptionJp:
私は長年、空の王と陸の
女王を研究してきたが、
やっとのことで生態の研究が
終わりそうなんだ。
あとは、峡谷に最近発見され
た火竜変種の調査を終えれば
書物が完成するので、捕獲を
頼むよ。協力してくれれば
書物の写しを分けてあげるよ。

50089.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Gypceros of the swamp. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
50089.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show off their skill!
Hunt the ≪Gypceros≫ in the
Swamp for us. Clear the quest
in fine style, and your standing
as a hunter will shoot
straight up!
50089.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
沼地の≪毒怪鳥≫を狩猟して
みせろ。見事クエストを
クリアできたら、諸君の
ハンターとしての評価は
グイっと上がるぞ！

21926.description: A recommended request for hunters who reached HR100: craft a Hardcore Weapon from the Blood-Eating Wyvern. Hunting a Baruragaru gives you the materials needed to craft one Hardcore Weapon.
21926.descriptionEn:
A recommended request for
hunters who reached HR100:
craft a ≪Hardcore Weapon≫ from
the ≪Blood-Eating Wyvern≫.
Hunting a Baruragaru gives you
the materials needed to craft
one ≪Hardcore Weapon≫.
21926.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００になったハンター
にオススメの≪喰血竜≫の
≪剛種武器≫が生産できる
依頼です。
バルラガルを狩猟すると、
≪剛種武器≫１本の生産に
必要な素材が入手できます。

21799.objectiveJp: ディアブロス１頭の狩猟
21799.description: Quests bearing the name ＨＲＰ Shift Quest pay little zenny, but in exchange they are wonderful quests that yield a great deal of ＨＲＰ. Hunters who aim for greater heights, please join!
21799.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪HRP Shift
Quests≫ give little Zenny,
but in return they are
splendid quests that earn
you plenty of HRP.
All hunters who aim for
greater heights, come and
join us in force!
21799.descriptionJp:
≪ＨＲＰシフトクエスト≫と
銘打たれたクエストは、報酬
ゼニーが安いですが、その分
多くのＨＲＰを得られる素敵
なクエストです。
より高みを目指したい狩人の
皆さん、奮ってご参加くださ
いね！

54790.objectiveJp: ヒプノック繁殖期１頭の狩猟
54790.description: This is one of the Anniversary 2015 Premium Goods early purchase campaign quests, 'Get a New Decoration!', which consumes an Anniversary Quest Ticket. Clear the main target to obtain one G rank Gosen Jewel.
54790.descriptionEn:
Anniversary 2015 Premium Goods
early purchase campaign -
this is the "Get a New
Decoration!" quest, taken by
spending an ≪Anniversary Quest
Ticket≫.
Clear the main target to
obtain one ≪G Rank Guard
Flash Orb≫.
54790.descriptionJp:
アニバーサリー２０１５
プレミアムグッズ
早期購入キャンペーンの一つ
≪アニバクエスト券≫を消費
して「新装飾品をゲット！」
のクエストになります。
メインターゲット達成で、
≪Ｇ級・護閃珠≫１個を入手
することができます。

61231.description: A mighty flame thought to belong to an Elder Dragon has been observed in the swamp. Please investigate at once. It is too dangerous to supply items, but please come back safely somehow.
61231.descriptionEn:
A powerful flame, believed to
belong to an Elder Dragon, has
been observed in the Swamp.
Please carry out an urgent survey.
It is so dangerous that we cannot
even supply items, but please,
come back safely no matter what.
61231.descriptionJp:
沼地で、古龍のものと思われ
る、強大な炎が観測された
ようです。至急、調査を
お願いします。あまりに
危険なためアイテムの支給も
できませんが、何とか無事に
帰ってきてください。

51060.client: Man Who Lives in the Tower
51060.description: The fish wyverns have started running wild in the Tower! Blast them, ruffians who never mind the trouble they cause! If that is how it is, we will turn into fish ourselves and fight back! Now, you lot, ready! Let the wild party begin!
51060.clientEn: Man Who Lives in the Tower
51060.descriptionEn:
The fish wyverns are running
wild in the Tower! Damn those
brutes, not caring who they
bother! Fine, then I'll turn
fish myself and fight back!
All right you lot, ready!?
Let the ruckus begin!
51060.descriptionJp:
塔で魚竜どもが暴れ出しや
がった！ええい、周りの迷惑
を顧みない乱暴者どもめ！
こうなりゃこっちも魚になっ
て対抗だ！
さあてめえら、準備は良いか！
どんちゃん騒ぎの始まりだ！

53312.description: The square is in festival uproar too. I ordered ingredients to bake a cake in celebration, but it seems they are stuck in the Jungle in transit because of a greedy monster. Go and give it a thrashing! When you have beaten 5, set off fireworks at the base to let us know.
53312.descriptionEn:
The plaza is in quite a festival
mood. I ordered ingredients to
bake a cake for the celebration,
but on the way through the
Jungle a greedy monster has the
shipment stuck where it stands.
Go give it a thrashing!
Take down five and we'll fire
fireworks at the Base to tell you.
53312.descriptionJp:
広場もお祭り騒ぎだね。
お祝いにケーキを作ろうと
食材を取り寄せたんだけど、
輸送中に密林で食い意地の
はったモンスターのせいで
立ち往生してるみたいでね。
行ってとっちめてきとくれ！
５頭やっつけたら拠点で
花火をあげて報せるんだよ。

23232.description: A Gravios has appeared in an unsurveyed area of the swamp. It seems it reached this place while seeking minerals. Before the swamp is dried up by Gravios's heat ray, it seems we must drive it off.
23232.descriptionEn:
A Gravios has appeared in an
unexplored part of the Swamp.
It seems it followed its urge
for minerals and ended up
wandering all the way here.
Before the Swamp is boiled
dry by its heat ray, we'd
better drive it off.
23232.descriptionJp:
沼地の未調査地域に、
鎧竜が出現しました。
どうやら鉱物を求めている
うちに、この場所まで辿り
ついたようなのです。
沼地がグラビモスの熱線で
干上がってしまう前に、
追い払う必要がありそうです。

50422.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

21704.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
21704.description: Thanks for playing MHF for six whole years! Equip Demon Blade: Dancing Thunder Asura and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket, get 11 Proof of Gratitude O! From that, you can forge Haunting Thorn (Sword & Shield).
21704.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for six whole years!
Equip ≪Demon Blade:
Dancing Thunder Asura≫
and deliver 1 ≪Annual
Bonus Production Ticket≫,
get 11 ≪Proof of
Gratitude O≫! From that,
you can forge ≪Haunting
Thorn≫ (Sword & Shield).
21704.descriptionJp:
６年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪魔刀・舞雷乃修羅≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると
≪感謝の証O≫を１１枚プレ
ゼントいたします。
≪感謝の証O≫から
≪ホーンティングソーン≫
（片手剣）が生産可能です。

26031.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
26031.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26031.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26031.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

56108.objectiveJp: イャンクック１頭の狩猟
56108.description: Urgent notice for all hunters! This request lets you build experience efficiently and get your hands on a great pile of Ｇｚ. The target is the Yian Kut-Ku! Do take the chance to try it!
56108.descriptionEn:
Attention, all hunters!
This request lets you build
up experience efficiently
and walk away with a huge
pile of Gz.
The target is "Yian Kut-Ku"!
Be sure to take this chance
and give it a try!
56108.descriptionJp:
ハンターの皆様に緊急連絡！
効率的に多くの経験を積む
ことができ、大量のＧｚが
がっぽりと入手できる
依頼です。
ターゲットは「怪鳥」！
ぜひこの機会に挑戦してみて
ください！

23387.description: There are reports that a Monoblos Subspecies is running wild in the desert. We ask you to hunt it before damage is done. Beware its attacks from underground delivered with that great horn.
23387.descriptionEn:
A White Monoblos is said to
be rampaging in the Desert.
Please hunt it before damage
is done. Beware its attacks
from underground with that
huge horn.
23387.descriptionJp:
砂漠で≪モノブロス亜種≫
が暴れていると報告があり
ました。
被害が出る前に対象の
狩猟をお願いします。
大きな角による地中からの
攻撃に注意してください。

54363.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
54363.description: Another ferocious monster has appeared! This time a Tigrex in the desert is shaking the surroundings with an unprecedented roar. The people living near the desert are in great trouble. Please slay this Tigrex!
54363.descriptionEn:
Another ferocious monster has
appeared! This time a ≪Tigrex≫
in the Desert is shaking the
area with an unprecedented
roar. The residents living near
the Desert are in real trouble.
Please go and slay this
≪Tigrex≫ for us!
54363.descriptionJp:
また獰猛なモンスターが出現
しました！今度は、砂漠で
≪轟竜≫が、かつてない咆哮
で周囲を震撼させています。
砂漠の近くに住む住民が大変
迷惑しています。
どうかこの≪轟竜≫を討伐し
てきてください！

54677.objectiveJp: ポボルバルム１頭の討伐
54677.description: Regarding G Rank Guild Priority requests, we've prepared this quest to raise awareness and promote them further. By breaking the Poborubarumu's head, you'll also be granted special ingredients.
54677.descriptionEn:
Regarding G Rank Guild Priority
requests, we've prepared this
quest to raise awareness and
promote them further.
By breaking the Forokururu's
head, you'll also be granted
special ingredients.
54677.descriptionJp:
Ｇ級ギルド優先依頼につきま
して、より一層の認知、振興
のためこちらのクエストをご
用意いたしました。
創音竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

23574.objectiveJp: フォロクルル１頭の狩猟
23574.description: Secret Tome armor is what hunters who have mastered weapon handling obtain. The Guild has long given various assistance, but this time, for those aiming for greater heights, we will provide extremely precious G-rank materials. However, for the survey, please break the specified parts.
23574.descriptionEn:
Secret Art Armor is worn by hunters
who have mastered their weapon.
The Guild has long lent various
forms of help, and this time
we will provide extremely rare
G Rank materials for those
aiming at still greater heights.
However, for the survey, please
destroy the specified part.
23574.descriptionJp:
武器の扱いを極めたハンター
が手にする『秘伝防具』。
かねてよりギルドから様々な
手助けをしてきましたが、
今回は更なる高みを目指す方
のために非常に貴重なＧ級素
材を提供させていただきます。
ただし、調査のために、指定
の部位の破壊をお願いします。

23280.objectiveJp: ドスガレオス１頭の狩猟
23280.description: Until now, Daimyo Hermitaur and Rathian were often sighted in the desert around here, but lately Cephalos have been migrating in schools. Their boss, the Cephadrome, likely appeared nearby. So we ask an experienced hunter to investigate.
23280.descriptionEn:
Until now we often sighted
≪Daimyo Hermitaur≫ and ≪Rathian≫
in the Desert around here, but
lately Cephalos have been
schooling and roaming about.
Most likely their boss, the
≪Cephadrome≫, has appeared
nearby. So we ask a seasoned
hunter to survey the area.
23280.descriptionJp:
これまで、このあたりの砂漠
では≪盾蟹≫や≪雌火竜≫を
よく目撃していましたが、
最近はガレオスが群れを成し
て回遊しています。
おそらく、彼らのボス≪砂竜≫
が近くに現れたと思われます。
そこで、熟練のハンターさん
に調査をお願いします。

55690.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の討伐
55690.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Tigrex. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
55690.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
materials from the Supremacy
≪Tigrex≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If the quest is failed, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please beware.
55690.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪ティガレックス≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50074.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
50074.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
50074.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

55409.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55409.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55409.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

55676.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の討伐

21283.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
21283.description: Lately boars have been multiplying in great numbers in the Snowy Mountains, and injuries keep piling up. The Hunters Guild is seeking people to wipe out this herd led by a Bulldrome. The situation is serious, so the reward includes a rare material some hunters drool over.
21283.descriptionEn:
Lately boars have swarmed the
Snowy Mountains and injuries
keep piling up. The Hunters
Guild is seeking people to wipe
out the herd led by this
≪Bulldrome≫. The situation is
grave, so the reward is rare
material that some hunters
would drool over.
21283.descriptionJp:
近ごろ、雪山に猪が大量に
発生していてケガ人が続出し
ています。ハンターズギルド
は、この≪ドスファンゴ≫を
中心とした群れを退治してく
ださる方々を募集しておりま
す。事態は深刻のため、
報酬も一部のハンターが垂涎
する貴重な素材になります。

61871.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61871.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61871.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

55920.description: An unidentified black monster is rampaging in the ruins. Who is it? It changes its form, changes its movement, changes its voice, changes its eye color. To whoever ascertains its true identity, I shall surely give production materials for Guild hidden armor.
55920.descriptionEn:
An unidentified black monster
is rampaging through the ruins.
Just what is it? It shifts its
shape, its movements, its
voice, even its eye color.
Whoever uncovers its identity
will be given the materials to
craft the Guild's secret armor.
55920.descriptionJp:
正体不明の黒いモンスターが
古跡で暴れ回っている。
奴は何者だ？姿を変え、動き
を変え、声を変え、眼の色を
変えている。
こいつの正体を突き止めた者
にはギルド秘蔵の防具の生産
素材を必ず渡そう。

55224.objectiveJp: モノブロス亜種１頭の討伐
55224.description: From the photograph that took the Grand Prize at the F Photo Contest 2016, we have prepared a quest where you can obtain the materials needed to craft the decoration 'Monodevi Sword Jewel GX1' worn in it. Please make use of it.
55224.descriptionEn:
From the photo that won the
top prize in the "F Photo
Contest 2016", we've prepared
a quest where you can get the
materials to craft the
decoration it used, "Monodevi
Sword Orb GX1".
Please make use of it.
55224.descriptionJp:
「Ｆフォトコンテスト2016」
にて、みごと最優秀賞に選ば
れた写真より、使用されてい
る装飾品「モノデビ剣珠GX1」
を生産するための素材を獲得
できるクエストをご用意しま
した。
ぜひご利用ください。

61566.description: On the Snowy Mountains, under a heavy snowfall, large-scale lightning strikes were witnessed. The snow seems to have settled somewhat, but the lightning continues still. Please investigate, limited to hunters who can prove their skill, and if at all possible hunt down the cause!
61566.descriptionEn:
In the Snowy Mountains, amid
heavy snowfall, a large-scale
lightning strike was witnessed.
The snow seems to have calmed a
little, but the lightning still
keeps striking.
Please, a survey limited to
hunters who can prove their
skill, and if possible, slay the
cause as well!
61566.descriptionJp:
豪雪の降りしきる雪山で、
大規模な落雷が目撃されまし
た。雪は多少落ち着いてきた
ようですが、雷は依然発生し
続けているようです。何とか、
凄腕の証明ができるハンター
さん限定での調査、できれば
原因の討伐までお願いします！

21141.objectiveJp: ラオシャンロン１体の撃退
21141.description: Lao-Shan Lung is advancing on the Fortress, the gateway to Dundorma, with unprecedented force! Please repel Lao-Shan Lung using the fortress interception equipment! If your strength is insufficient, deliver Dragon Drug Stones taken from Lao-Shan Lung's back.
21141.descriptionEn:
At the ≪Fortress≫ that serves
as the gateway to Dundorma,
Lao-Shan Lung is advancing
with unprecedented force!
Please repel it using the
fortress's interception gear!
If our strength falls short,
deliver the ≪Dragonstone≫
from its back.
21141.descriptionJp:
ドンドルマへの玄関口となる
≪砦≫に、老山龍ラオシャン
ロンが、未だかつてない勢い
で侵攻してきてます！砦の
迎撃設備を利用しての老山龍
の撃退をお願いします！
戦力が及ばない場合、老山龍
の背から取れる≪龍薬石≫を
納品してください。

21162.description: There are reports that Abiorugu has appeared in the forest. Some of the surveyors heard several roars, and testimony suggests they were calling to one another. Bear in mind that there may be more than one, and conduct the survey fully prepared.
21162.descriptionEn:
We received a report that the
Fierce Wyvern ≪Abiorugu≫ has
appeared in the Great Forest.
Some of the surveyors heard
multiple roars, and we have
testimony saying it sounded
as if they were communicating
with one another.
Bearing in mind there may be
several, we advise a full survey.
21162.descriptionJp:
獰竜≪アビオルグ≫が樹海に
現れたとの報告がありました。
調査員の中には、複数の
咆哮を聞いた者もおり、
まるで、お互い連絡を取り
合っているかのようだとの
証言も取れました。
複数頭いる可能性を視野に
入れ、万全の態勢での調査を
お勧めします。

21827.description: A call for help has come from the party that set out for the Snowy Mountains to slay Tigrex! It seems they ran into two Tigrex! Every moment counts! Those confident in their skill, head for the Snowy Mountains now!
21827.descriptionEn:
A distress call has come
from the party that went to
the ≪Snowy Mountains≫ to
slay a Tigrex! Seems they
ran into two of them!
There is not a moment to
spare! Any hunter sure of
their skill, head there now!
21827.descriptionJp:
≪雪山≫へティガレックスの
討伐に向かった一団から救援
の要請が届いたぞ！どうやら
２頭のティガレックスに出く
わしたようじゃ！
事態は一刻を争う！腕に自信
のある者は今すぐ雪山へ向か
うのじゃ！

54199.description: Please investigate the Rathian lurking in the sea of trees. If you not only hunt it but also break its head and sever its tail, I will add to the reward!
54199.descriptionEn:
We'd like you to survey the
Rathian lurking in the Great
Forest.
Not only hunt it, but break
its head and cut off its tail,
and we'll add a little extra
to your reward!
54199.descriptionJp:
樹海に潜む雌火竜の調査を
お願いします。
狩猟するだけでなく、
雌火竜の頭部破壊と
尻尾切断をしてくれたら、
報酬を上乗せしちゃい
ますよ！

62657.description: Gunlances and ballistae often have comparatively complex structures. Will they function correctly in a desert where the temperature swings wildly and sand swirls? Complete the request and you receive armor crafting materials; do more than that and I will hand over upgrade materials.
62657.descriptionEn:
Gunlances and ballistae often
have fairly complex structures.
With such extreme temperature
swings, will they work right
in the sand-blown Desert?
Complete the request for armor
materials; go beyond that and
I'll throw in upgrade materials.
62657.descriptionJp:
銃槍や弩砲は比較的複雑な
構造をしている場合が多い。
気温差が非常に激しく、
砂の舞う砂漠でも正しく
機能するのだろうか。
依頼の達成で防具の生産素材、
それ以上の働きがあれば、
強化用素材を渡すとしよう。

26359.description: From the Tavern Guild, a Premium Quest. This one is for one to two people and involves hunting a Low Rank monster. We have prepared plenty of ＨＲＰ and Porta Tickets, so please join in!
26359.descriptionEn:
≪Premium Quests≫, brought
to you by the Tavern Guild,
at your service.
These are for 1 to 2
players and involve hunting
low rank monsters.
We've prepared plenty of HRP
and Porta Tickets, so do
come and join us!
26359.descriptionJp:
≪プレミアムクエスト≫を、
大衆酒場ギルドより、お送り
いたします。
こちらは、１人〜２人向けの
クエストとなっていて、下位
モンスターの狩猟となります。
多くのＨＲＰとポルタチケッ
トを用意させていただきまし
たので奮ってご参加ください。

10101.objectiveJp: ドスランポス２頭の討伐
10101.description: In this arena we put on a straight one-on-one between monster and hunter! Your opponent this time is a Velocidrome. Knock that thing around and show off your skill!
10101.descriptionEn:
In this Arena, we're having you
take a monster on head-to-head!
Your opponent this time is a
Velocidrome, so go on.
Knock the likes of it flat and
show off what you can do!
10101.descriptionJp:
この闘技場ではモンスター対
ハンターのガチンコ勝負を
やってもらうよ！
今回はドスランポスが相手だか
らね。こんなヤツ軽くのして、
腕前を見せつけてやりな！

58026.objectiveJp: 全ての大型モンスターを狩猟
58026.description: There is a report that a great horde of large monsters is pressing toward the interception base. Head to the site at once and hunt as many large monsters as you can. A run of battles is expected, so we recommend departing after thorough preparation.
58026.descriptionEn:
A horde of large monsters is
reported to be closing in on
the interception base.
Go to the site at once and hunt
as many large monsters as
you can manage.
A running battle is expected;
we advise departing only after
preparing thoroughly.
58026.descriptionJp:
迎撃拠点に大型モンスターの
大群が迫っているとの報告が
ありました。
直ちに、現地へ向かいできる
だけ多くの大型モンスターを
狩猟してください。
連戦が予想されます、
十分な準備をしてからの
出発をお勧めします。

53171.description: This is Miyashita! The final question at last. [Question 6] I! Love all of you! This year too! If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53171.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here!
Now for the final question.
[Question 6]
I!
Love all of you
again this year!!!
If you think the answer is X (B),
hunters should take
this quest!
53171.descriptionJp:
宮下です！
いよいよ最終問題。
【第６問】
僕は！
今年もみなさんが！！
大好きです！！！
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

50806.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
50806.description: For those who reached HR100, we've prepared a quest to upgrade the "Clanto F Series" into the "Clanto FY Series". By hunting an Espinas Variant, you can get materials that upgrade one piece into master armor and raise its level a little. Please put it to good use.
50806.descriptionEn:
For those who reached HR100,
we've prepared a quest to
upgrade the "Clanto F Series"
into the "Clanto FY Series".
By hunting an Espinas Variant,
you can get materials that
upgrade one piece into master
armor and raise its level a
little.
Please put it to good use.
50806.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００に到達した方々へ
「クラントＦシリーズ」を
「クラントFYシリーズ」へ強
化するためのクエストを準備
しました。
エスピナス変種を狩猟するこ
とで、１部位分を凄腕防具へ
強化し少しレベルアップでき
る素材が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください。

62190.objectiveJp: ババコンガ変種１頭の狩猟
62190.description: I want my pupil to hunt an armored wyvern, but there is a Congalala about as well and it is a bit too dangerous, so could you hunt it before the lad reaches the destination? Ah, and while you are at it, cut off the Gravios tail too, it is dangerous. Do not go so far as hunting the armored wyvern!
62190.descriptionEn:
I want my student to hunt a
Gravios, but there's a
≪Congalala≫ around too and
it's a bit too dangerous, so
could you hunt it before the
kid reaches the destination?
Ah, while you're at it, cut
off the ≪Gravios≫ tail too, it's
dangerous. Just don't hunt it!
62190.descriptionJp:
教え子に鎧竜の狩猟をやらせ
たいんだが、≪ババコンガ≫
までいて、ちょっと危険すぎ
るから、あいつが目的地に
着くまでに狩猟しておいてく
れないか？ああ、ついでに、
≪グラビモス≫の尻尾も斬っ
ておいてくれ、危ないからな。
鎧竜の狩猟まではするなよ！

50302.description: Distance is what matters in the hunt. Getting close for no reason is never the answer. If you can finish without touching a thing, that is best. Sometimes escape. Sometimes run away. Bring everyone along, let us go no-touch!
50302.descriptionEn:
What matters in a hunt is
keeping your distance, yes.
Getting close is not always the
answer, no.
If you can finish without
touching a thing, that is best.
Sometimes escape. Sometimes run
away. Bring everyone along.
Let us go no-touch!
50302.descriptionJp:
狩りで重要なのは距離感デス。
むやみに近づけば良いという
ものでは決してないのデ〜ス。
何にもタッチせずに終われる
なら、それがベストでショウ。
時にはエスケープ。時には
ランナウェイ。皆を誘って、
レッツノータッチ！

61057.objectiveJp: ドドブランゴ１頭の狩猟
61057.description: Deep in the Snowy Mountains, they say there is a season when white fanged beasts and golden fanged beasts gather. There is no firm record of it, so it is only a rumour among hunters, but is it not a stirring tale for a hardened hunter?
61057.descriptionEn:
Deep in the Snowy Mountains,
they say there is a season when
white fanged beasts and golden
fanged beasts gather.
No record of it has ever been
set down, so it is only hunters'
talk, but doesn't that stir the
heart of a seasoned hunter?
61057.descriptionJp:
雪山深く、白い牙獣と金の牙
獣が集う時期があると言われ
ているわ。
確かな記録として記されたこ
とはないので、飽くまでもハ
ンター達の噂でしかないけど、
筋金入りのハンターには心躍
る話じゃないかしら。

53150.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の捕獲
53150.description: Hi! I am the ally of girls in love, Miracle Love Hunter! A request from a girl in love! She just cannot give up on the boy she loves! So catch him for her! The other half does not matter! Girls in love are wonderful!
53150.descriptionEn:
Hi there!
Ally of girls in love,
Miracle★Love Hunter here!
A request from a girl in love!
She just can't give up on the
guy she's pining for!
So go catch him for her!
The other half doesn't matter!
Girls in love are wonderful★
53150.descriptionJp:
は〜い！
恋する女の子のミカタ、
ミラクル★恋狩人だよ！
恋する女の子からのお願い！
片思いのカレを、どうしても
諦められないんだって！
だから捕まえてきて！
片割れはどうでもいいから！
恋する女の子って素敵だね★

61833.description: Fishing: a lonely hunt in which one sits quietly with the fish. The reward is a certain material that proves you an angler. Show me the fruits of all your work so far! Since fishing is the aim, absolutely do not hunt the Plesioth Subspecies this time either!
61833.descriptionEn:
Fishing is a lonely hunt, a quiet
facing-off with the fish. The
reward is a certain material that
proves you are an angler.
Show me the sum of all your skill!
Fishing is the goal, so this time
you must not slay the Green Plesioth!
61833.descriptionJp:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。報酬は、
釣師の証になる、ある素材だ。
今までの集大成を見せてくれ！
釣りが目的だから、ガノトト
ス亜種は今回も絶対に狩らな
いように！

11060.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の狩猟
11060.description: A black subspecies of Gravios has appeared, wreathed in the volcano's smoke! They say its appearance makes onlookers tremble! But the reason it is called an armored wyvern is that shell protecting its body, no? What do you suppose happens if the armor is broken?
11060.descriptionEn:
A black subspecies of ≪Gravios≫
seems to have appeared amid the
Volcano's smoke!
They say its looks send shivers
through all who see it!
But it's called the Armor Wyvern
for its armor, so what if you break it?
11060.descriptionJp:
火山の噴煙にまみれて≪グラ
ビモス≫の黒い亜種が出現し
たらしいです！その容姿は見
る者を震え上がらせるって！
でも、鎧竜って呼ばれるのは
体を守る鎧があるからよね？
鎧を壊せばどうなのかしら？

26305.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの捕獲
26305.description: Reports of Variants and Odd Species are coming in from every region. The Variants closely resemble the base species and the Odd Species the subspecies, but the truth is a mystery. They carry the traits of their kind strongly, and from them one can obtain highly versatile materials.
26305.descriptionEn:
Reports of Variant and Aberrant species
are being filed from every region.
Variants closely resemble the original
species, Aberrants the subspecies,
but the truth is a mystery.
They strongly carry that species'
common traits, and yield highly
versatile materials, or so I hear.
26305.descriptionJp:
各地から変種や奇種の発見報
告が上げられています。
変種は原種系、奇種は亜種系
に酷似した姿とのことですが、
真相は謎です。
その種に共通する特徴を強く
持ち、そこから汎用性に優れ
た素材が取れるそうですよ。

21469.objectiveJp: 冥雷竜の堅殻３個の納品
21469.description: I want to repair my weapon but I lack materials! At this rate I cannot go hunting. Trade the Nether Thunder Dragon's Hard Shell you hold for this Paw Medal! Please!
21469.descriptionEn:
I want to repair my weapon but
I lack the materials! Like this
I can't go out hunting. Trade me
the ≪Dark Thunder Wyvern Shell≫
you have for this
≪Pawprint Medal≫! Please!
21469.descriptionJp:
武器を修理したいが素材が足
りない！これでは狩りに出ら
れない。キミが持っている
≪冥雷竜の堅殻≫を、この
≪肉球のメダル≫と交換して
くれ！頼む！

61880.description: The sight of a living creature staking its life in battle, the beauty of a body in motion, is surely worth gold and silver. Bring me the blood and life of your prey, and whoever lets me drown in that beauty will have a reward to match it. Try to entertain me.
61880.descriptionEn:
A creature staking its own life
in battle, the vibrant beauty
of its flesh—these are worth
the gleam of gold and silver.
To those who intoxicate me with
that beauty, through the blood
and life of their prey, I promise
a reward to match. Entertain me.
61880.descriptionJp:
生き物が己の生を賭して戦う
姿や、その肉体の躍動美は、
金銀の輝きに値すると言って
よかろう。
獲物の血と命をもって、その
美しさに私を酔わせた者には
その美に匹敵する報酬を約束
しよう。私を楽しませてみよ。

50356.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の狩猟
50356.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Savage Wyvern will also grant a special ingredient.
50356.descriptionEn:
We have prepared this quest
to further the awareness and
promotion of the Guild Priority
Requests we have long been
carrying out.
By breaking the Taikun Zamuza's
head, special ingredients will
also be awarded to you.
50356.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
蛮竜の頭部を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

62519.objectiveJp: グレンゼブル１頭の討伐

26250.objectiveJp: ナナ・テスカトリ１体の討伐

51026.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51026.description: We have prepared a special request and reward for the Hunter Festival period. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
51026.descriptionEn:
During the Hunter Festival, we
have prepared a special request
and rewards. When accepting or
joining, please be sure to have
your Festival Proof with you.
51026.descriptionJp:
狩人祭の期間に専用の特別
依頼と報酬を用意させて
いただきました。受注、
参加時に、祭典の証を
お持ちください。

54517.description: White and black wyverns have appeared at the summit of the Ancient Tower. These 2 are opposites by nature and could never appear in the same place. This must be called a reckless request. Yet I believe that you, with all your achievements, will find a way.
54517.descriptionEn:
White and black wyverns have
appeared at the top of the
Ancient Tower. These two are
opposites by nature, so they
could never appear in the same
place.
I must call this a reckless
request. But I believe that you,
with all your achievements,
will somehow see it through.
54517.descriptionJp:
古塔の頂部に、白と黒の飛竜
が現れました。本来この２頭
は、相反する存在であるため、
同じ場所に現れることはあり
えないことです。
これは、無謀な依頼と言わざ
るを得ません。しかし、数多
くの功績を残したあなたなら
なんとかしてくれると信じて
います。

23680.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
23680.description: Hunter who would master the Magnetic Slash Hammer, show the skill you have honed against the Tigrex in the desert! If you hunt it well, you will earn more than the usual fruits of your daily efforts.
23680.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Magnet Spike, show the skill
you've honed against the
≪Tigrex≫ in the Desert!
Hunt it well and you shall
earn even greater rewards
than what your daily efforts
would bring.
23680.descriptionJp:
磁斬鎚を極めんとする
ハンターよ、砂漠にいる
≪轟竜≫を相手に鍛え上げ
たその技を披露して見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のよりさらに多くの報酬を
得られるであろう。

55667.description: Hunter who would master the heavy gun, show the skill you have honed against the Baruragaru in the new great arena! If you hunt it splendidly, you will earn rewards far beyond what your daily efforts would bring.
55667.descriptionEn:
Hunter who would master the
Heavy Bowgun, show the skill
you've honed against the
≪Blood-Eating Wyvern≫ in the
New Great Arena!
Hunt it well and you shall
earn rewards that far exceed
what your daily efforts would
bring.
55667.descriptionJp:
重銃を極めんとする
ハンターよ、新大闘技場に
いる≪喰血竜≫を相手に鍛え
上げたその技を披露して
見せよ！
見事狩猟することができたな
ら、日頃の努力で得られるも
のを遥かにこえる報酬を
得られるであろう。

26146.description: It is I, the Instructor! In this quest, the clear condition is the slaying of 5 Velociprey. Once you have learned how to handle your weapon, give it a try as a warm-up! Look for them by their blue scales!
26146.descriptionEn:
It is I, the Instructor!
In this quest, the clear condition
is the slaying of 5 Velociprey.
Once you have learned your weapon's
controls overall, try a battle as
a warm-up!
Look for them by their blue scales!
26146.descriptionJp:
我輩だ。教官だ！
このクエストでは、クリアの
条件がランポス５頭の討伐と
なっている。ひと通り武器の
操作を覚えたら、肩慣らしに
いっちょ戦ってみるがいい！
青い鱗を目印に探すのだぞ！

61503.description: We have prepared quests that issue the tickets needed for Gou quests. This one is a comparatively easy quest, but note that only those equipped with the special weapon suited to Variants may take or join it.
61503.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a quest
that issues the tickets you
need for ≪Peerless Quests≫.
The content is relatively
easy, but it is limited to
hunters equipped with the
special anti-Variant arms,
so please be aware of this
before you apply.
61503.descriptionJp:
≪剛種クエスト≫に必要と
なるチケットを発行する
クエストを用意いたしました。
こちらは比較的お手軽なクエ
スト内容となっていますが、
対変種に適した特殊な武器を
装備した方限定の受注、参加
となっているためご注意くだ
さい。

23488.description: Valsaburos has appeared in the decisive battlefield. It seems to favor the cactus that grows in this land, but its ecology is not yet understood. We have received reports that it is a very dangerous monster. Prepare thoroughly and head out to slay it.
23488.descriptionEn:
At the Battlefield,
≪Varusaburosu≫ has appeared.
It seems to favor the cactus that
grows in this land, but its ecology
is still unexplained.
We have received reports that it is
a highly dangerous monster.
Prepare carefully, then head out
to slay it.
23488.descriptionJp:
決戦場で
≪ヴァルサブロス≫が現れま
した。この地に生息する
サボテンを好物としているよ
うですが、その生態は未だ
解明されていません。
非常に危険なモンスターであ
ると報告を受けています。
念入りに準備をし、
討伐に向かってください。

62442.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の狩猟
62442.description: An individual of a comparatively weak monster has been confirmed. Prepare quickly and accept and depart with up to 2 people. Especially recommended for those unused to the hunting life!
62442.descriptionEn:
A relatively weak monster
specimen has been confirmed.
Please prepare in haste,
and accept and depart with
up to two hunters.
I especially recommend this to
those unused to the hunting life!
62442.descriptionJp:
比較的弱めのモンスターの
個体が確認されました。
急いで準備のうえ、
２人まででの受注、出発を
お願いします。
狩猟生活に不慣れな方には
特におすすめですよ！

61756.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61756.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61756.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

54361.objectiveJp: グラビモス亜種１頭の討伐
54361.description: This is terrible! A monster is on a rampage in the Volcano! According to a hunter's sighting, it looks like a Basarios, but something about it is not normal. Someone with courage, would you investigate for us!?
54361.descriptionEn:
Trouble! A monster is running
wild in the Volcano!
According to hunter sightings,
it looks like a ≪Black Gravios≫
but something about it is off.
Any brave soul, please go and
investigate for us!?
54361.descriptionJp:
大変です！火山でモンスター
が暴れています！
ハンターの目撃情報によると、
≪黒鎧竜≫のような外見だが、
何か普通とは違うそうです。
勇気のある方、どうか調査し
てきてくれませんか！？

62982.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
62982.description: A Kushala Daora has invaded Mezeporta, and an extremely powerful individual at that! Hunters, intercept it at the Interception Base and slay it. Failure will not be tolerated, so present proof of sufficient skill.
62982.descriptionEn:
A Wind Dragon has invaded
Mezeporuta, and an extremely
powerful one at that!
All hunters, intercept it at
the ≪Base≫ and slay it.
Failure will not be
tolerated under any
circumstances, so present
proof of sufficient skill.
62982.descriptionJp:
メゼポルタに風翔龍、それも
極めて強力な個体が侵入しま
した！
ハンターのみなさんは、
≪迎撃拠点≫で迎え撃ち、
これを討伐してください。
失敗は絶対に許されない
ので、十分な腕前の証を
ご提示ください。

62174.description: The time has come for hunters to show their skill! Hunt the Black Diablos of the Great Arena. Clear the quest and your standing as a hunter will rise sharply!
62174.descriptionEn:
The time has come for hunters
to show their skill!
Hunt the ≪Black Diablos≫ in
the Great Arena. Clear the
quest safely and your standing
as a hunter will shoot right
up, all of you!
62174.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を披露
する時がやってきた！
大闘技場の≪黒角竜≫を狩
猟してみせろ。無事、クエ
ストをクリアできたら、諸
君のハンターとしての評価
はグイっと上がるぞ！

55247.objectiveJp: ダイミョウザザミ１匹の討伐
55247.description: In recent years we have promoted the spread of powerful equipment, but because it uses precious materials, the guild has decided to strengthen its support. Complete this request and we will provide materials brought back by surveyors. Among them there may be something precious.
55247.descriptionEn:
In recent years we have spread
powerful equipment, but since it
uses precious materials, the Guild
has decided to strengthen
its support.
Clear this request and we will
provide materials brought back
by our surveyors.
Some of them may be
precious indeed.
55247.descriptionJp:
近年、強力な装備の普及を
進めていますが、貴重な
素材を使用するため、ギルド
は支援を強化することを
決定しました。
この依頼を達成すれば、
調査員が持ち帰ってきた
素材を提供致します。
中には貴重な素材があるか
もしれませんよ。

63053.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐

60643.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
60643.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the targets are Kamu Orgaron and Nono Orgaron. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Origin weapons only!
60643.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! This
time the targets are ≪Kam
Orugaron≫ and ≪Non Orugaron≫!
Team up with your guild mates
and hit the objectives.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so aim for a top placement!
Origin weapons only this time!
60643.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪カム・オルガロン≫と≪ノ
ノ・オルガロン≫だ！猟団の
仲間と一緒に目標を達成して
もらうぞ。チームワークが物
を言うこの競技、見事上位に
入賞してみせよ！今回は始種
武器限定で開催されるぞ！

21710.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの討伐
21710.description: Have you heard of the sphere known as the Young Bamboo Sphere? That material is indispensable to the crafting of a certain costly decoration. Complete this request, and I will present you with a precious decoration material.
21710.descriptionEn:
Have you heard of the orb
known as Young Bamboo Sphere?
Its material is essential for
crafting a certain expensive
decoration.
If you can complete this
request, I'll give you that
precious decoration material.
21710.descriptionJp:
若竹原珠という原珠を
ご存知でしょうか。
その素材は、ある高価な
装飾品の生産にかかせない
ものです。
この依頼を達成していただけ
るなら、貴重な装飾品素材を
差上げましょう。

60676.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Rebidiora. You are to join your fellow guild hunters and achieve the objective together. Teamwork is what counts in this contest, so take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60676.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! The
target this time is ≪Rebidiora≫!
Get together with your guild
mates and clear the objective.
Teamwork decides this contest,
so go and take a top
placement!
This time it's Supremacy
weapons only!
60676.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は、
≪レビディオラ≫だ！
猟団の仲間と一緒に目標
を達成してきてもらうぞ。
チームワークが物を言うこの
競技、見事上位に入賞してみ
せよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

61310.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61310.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61310.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

50079.objectiveJp: クシャルダオラ１体の討伐
50079.description: Good news for novice hunters! We will help you upgrade Kukubo armor, which is tremendously effective for low-rank hunters! Obtain Elder Dragon Bone on this quest and use it to upgrade your Kukubo!
50079.descriptionEn:
Good news for all you rookie
hunters!
We'll help you upgrade "Kukubo",
armor that works wonders for
Low Rank hunters!
Get "Elder Dragon Bones" in
this quest and put them to use
upgrading your "Kukubo"!
50079.descriptionJp:
駆出しハンターのみなさんに
朗報です！
下位ハンターに絶大な効果を
発揮する防具「ククボ」の
強化の手助けをいたします！
今クエストで「古龍骨」を
入手して、「ククボ」の
強化にお役立てください！

21714.description: The Flower Field in the hot season. The guild is still surveying this uncharted land, but hunters are welcome to visit for gathering and exploration. When you feel like coming home, just deliver a map.
21714.descriptionEn:
Flower Field in the Warm Season.
The guild is still surveying
this uncharted land even now,
but why not visit it yourself,
hunter, to gather and survey?
If you start missing home,
just deliver a map!
21714.descriptionJp:
温暖期の≪花畑≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

26207.objectiveJp: 特産キノコキムチ１個の納品

62667.objectiveJp: エスピナス希少種１頭の狩猟

26045.description: Quests bearing the name Z Shift Quest yield little ＨＲＰ, but in exchange they are lavish quests that earn a great deal of zenny. Hunters looking to put their equipment in order, take them one after another!
26045.descriptionEn:
Quests billed as ≪Z Shift
Quests≫ give little HRP,
but in return they are
luxurious quests that earn
you plenty of Zenny.
Hunters who want to gear up,
line right up and take them!
26045.descriptionJp:
≪Ｚシフトクエスト≫と銘打
たれたクエストは、得られる
ＨＲＰは少ないですが、その
分、多くのゼニーを得られる
豪華なクエストです。
装備を整えたい狩人の皆さん
どしどし受注をどうぞ！

53096.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
53096.description: To those aiming for HR100! We have prepared a quest to strengthen the "Karais Series" into the "Karais F Series". By hunting Doragyurosu, you can obtain materials to strengthen one piece into High Rank armor and level it up. Please make good use of it.
53096.descriptionEn:
To those aiming for HR100!
We have prepared a quest to
strengthen the "Karais Series"
into the "Karais F Series".
By hunting Doragyurosu, you can
obtain materials to strengthen one
piece into High Rank armor and
level it up.
Please make good use of it.
53096.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ１００を目指す方々へ
「カライスシリーズ」を
「カライスＦシリーズ」へ強
化するためのクエストを準備
しました。
ドラギュロスを狩猟すること
で、１部位分を上位防具へ
強化しレベルアップできる
素材が入手できます。
ぜひお役立てください。

63109.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の狩猟
63109.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63109.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63109.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55342.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の狩猟
55342.description: We have received a report that a Doragyurosu and a Rajang appeared at the same time in a distant snowy mountain. Both are ferocious, and the combination can only be called the worst. Head for the site at once and hunt them.
55342.descriptionEn:
Reports say a ≪Dark Thunder
Wyvern≫ and a ≪Rajang≫ have
appeared together in the far
Snowy Mountains.
Both are ferocious, and the
match-up couldn't be worse.
Set out for the site at once
and hunt them down.
55342.descriptionJp:
遠く離れた雪山にて、
≪冥雷竜≫と≪金獅子≫が
同時に出現したとの報告を
受けました。
どちらも獰猛で、組合わせが
最悪と言わざるを得ません。
至急、現地へ出発して狩猟し
てください。

23699.description: This quest yields the materials needed for upgrading G-rank Secret Tome armor (head), excluding weapon ribbons and weapon merits. The number yielded is enough for 1 type. Note that a Hunter Pass (Sakura) is required to accept the quest.
23699.descriptionEn:
This quest drops the
materials needed to upgrade
G Rank Secret Art Armor
(head), excluding weapon
ribbons and weapon merits.
The yield is one type only.
To accept the quest,
≪Hunter Pass: Sakura≫
is required, so please
take note.
23699.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、
Ｇ級秘伝防具（頭防具）の
強化時に必要な武器綬、
武器勲を除く素材を排出いた
します。
排出数は、１種類分です。
クエストの受注には、
≪ハンターパス・桜≫
が必要になりますので
ご注意ください。

40133.description: The Gypceros of this swamp is said to carry unbelievable treasure now and then. If the rumor is true, I would very much like you to hunt one. We split the reward.
40133.descriptionEn:
The Poison Bird Wyvern ≪Gypceros≫
that lives in this Swamp is said
to rarely carry some incredible
treasure.
If it's true, I'd very much like
you to go and hunt one.
We'll split the reward.
40133.descriptionJp:
この沼地に生息する毒怪鳥
≪ゲリョス≫は、まれに
とんでもないお宝を持ってい
ることがあるらしい。
もし本当だったら、ぜひとも
狩猟してきてもらいたいもの
だね。報酬は山分けだ。

54541.objectiveJp: ドスファンゴ１頭の狩猟
54541.description: This quest raises your standing as a hunter by a wide margin. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
54541.descriptionEn:
This quest will raise your
standing as a hunter by a
remarkable margin.
To accept the quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫
is required.
Should you fail the quest,
the ≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
54541.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、ハンターと
しての評価が格段に上昇する
クエストです。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50042.description: This quest lets you experience an Idaten Cup that has already been held. Your time is recorded, but note that you cannot check your rank on the ranking board or receive official hunting tournament awards.
50042.descriptionEn:
This quest lets you experience
the Idaten Cup as it was held.
Your time will be recorded,
but you cannot check your rank
on the ranking board, nor obtain
rewards of the official hunting
tournament, so please be aware.
50042.descriptionJp:
すでに実施済みの韋駄天杯を
体験できるクエストです。
タイムは計測できますが、
ランキング情報板で順位を
確認したり、公式狩猟大会の
褒賞を入手したりすることは
できないのでご注意ください。

61808.description: You found me well. As a reward, I will give you a slightly unusual job. You will not lose out on my jobs, I think? For now, go and complete it. We talk after that.
61808.descriptionEn:
You actually found me.
As a reward, I'll hand you
a slightly unusual request.
My requests are never a loss, eh?
For now, just work hard and
clear that request.
We talk after that.
61808.descriptionJp:
よく俺を見つけたな。
褒美として、少し変わった
依頼を出してやろう。
俺の依頼に損はないと思うぞ？
とりあえず、頑張って依頼を
こなしてこい。
話はそれからだ。

62282.description: If you listen to the voice of nature, you may gain new ideas beyond human wisdom. This will help upgrade the Rath Soul R blademaster armor. May your hunting life remain fulfilling always.
62282.descriptionEn:
Lend an ear to the voice of
nature, and you may gain new
ideas beyond human wisdom.
This will help you upgrade the
≪Rath Soul R≫ blademaster
armor.
May your hunting life stay
fulfilling for years to come.
62282.descriptionJp:
大自然の声に耳を傾ければ
人智を超えた新しい着想を
得られるかもしれません。
これは≪リオソウルＲ≫の
剣士用防具を強化するために
役立つことでしょう。皆様の
狩猟生活がいつまでも充実
したものでありますように。

26003.description: I found a little-known spot in the Snowy Mountains where materials unique to the area lie all about. Do go and have a look. If you come back with a pouch full, it will be worth the price of the information.
26003.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Snowy
Mountains lie scattered around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.
26003.descriptionJp:
雪山ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代分の価値はあると
思うぜ。

50767.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
50767.description: At last the Hunters Guild has discovered a species thought to be the origin of evolution! We tried to capture it to uncover the mystery of evolution, but it will not even approach a trap. Worse, its blasts of water are destroying the desert ecosystem. Slay it!
50767.descriptionEn:
At last, the Hunters Guild
has found a species thought
to be the origin of
evolution! We tried to
capture it to solve the
mystery, but it ignores our
traps. Worse, its blasts of
water are destroying the
Desert ecosystem. Slay it!
50767.descriptionJp:
ついにハンターズギルドでは
進化の起源と思われる種を
発見することに成功した！
進化の謎を究明する為にも
ヤツを捕まえようとしたが
罠をも寄せ付けぬ。
そればかりか、噴き放つ水流
により砂漠の生態系が壊され
つつある。
ヤツを討伐してくれ！

50909.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join.
50909.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special request
and rewards for members of Guilds
on the winning side of the Hunter
Festival. When accepting or joining,
please have your Festival Proof.
50909.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。

26188.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Neodym Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
26188.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Neodym Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
26188.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪ネオジムメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

50339.description: Well then, have you two confirmed your feelings for each other? If you need one more push, why not go hunting together? The sight of a hunter hunting beautifully is a hunter's true charm. Even those doing poorly may find a great reversal.
50339.descriptionEn:
Well now, have the two of you
sorted out your feelings?
If you just need one more
little push, why not go on a
hunt together?
A hunter in fine form is
truly at their most charming.
Even if it's not going well,
a big turnaround may be coming.
50339.descriptionJp:
さてさて、お互いの気持ちは
確認できましたか？
後もう一押し！という事なら
一緒に狩りへ行ってみたらど
うでしょう。
華麗に狩る姿こそ、ハンター
の真の魅力ですよね。
上手くいってない方も、大逆
転があるかもしれませんよ。

60107.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
60107.description: Please hunt the Velocidrome prowling the sea of trees! We also have a large order for mushrooms, so for deliveries of specialty mushrooms and aged mushrooms we will respond with a high reward! Off you go with spirit!
60107.descriptionEn:
We'd like you to hunt the
Velocidrome prowling the Great
Forest!
We've also got a big order for
mushrooms, so we'll pay top
rates for Specialty Mushrooms
and Aged Mushrooms!
Now off you go, and good luck!
60107.descriptionJp:
樹海をうろつくドスランポス
の狩猟をお願いします！
キノコの大量注文も入って
きていますので、特産キノコ
と熟成キノコの納品には、
高額報酬でお応えしますよ！
張り切って行ってらっしゃい
ませ！

61601.objectiveJp: イャンガルルガ１頭の討伐
61601.description: This is a practice quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament preliminaries. In the real event the time limit is 5 minutes. Also, you cannot obtain the target monster's materials by carving or clear rewards.
61601.descriptionEn:
This is a practice quest for
the VS. Quest Champion
Tournament preliminaries.
In the main round the time
limit is 5 minutes.
Also, you cannot obtain the
target monster's materials
by carving or clear rewards.
61601.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの予選練習用
クエストです。本番では
制限時間が５分以内です。
また、モンスターの
剥ぎ取りとクリア報酬で
対象モンスターの素材は
入手できません。

50893.description: I have prepared a lovely quest you can take on in exchange for 20 Porta Tickets Sakura. Slay a Zerureusu and you can obtain the materials needed to produce 1 Supremacy weapon.
50893.descriptionEn:
A lovely quest is ready: take
it in exchange for 20 Sakura
Porta Tickets.
Slay a Zerureusu and you'll
get the materials needed to
craft one ≪Hardcore Weapon≫.
Won't you give it a go?
50893.descriptionJp:
ポルタチケット桜２０枚と
引換に受注できる素敵な
クエストを用意したわ。
ゼルレウスを討伐すると、
≪剛種武器≫１本の生産に
必要な素材が入手できるわ
よ。

53128.objectiveJp: フルフル亜種１頭の捕獲
53128.description: 'He' finally accepted my chocolate! He says he is happy just to hear me grumble! Oh! I will share this happiness with all of you! Everyone, go and catch the Khezu Subspecies that can only be heard, never seen!
53128.descriptionEn:
He finally accepted my
chocolate!
He says just hearing me
nag is enough to make him happy!
Oh, stop it!
I'll share this happiness with
all of you! Everyone, go catch
the Red Khezu you can only
hear, all right!?
53128.descriptionJp:
「彼」がついに私のチョコを
受け取ってくれたの！
「彼」は私の小言が聞ける
だけで幸せなんですって！
もう！
この幸せ、皆さんにも分けま
す！声しか聞こえない
フルフル亜種を、皆さんが
捕まえてあげて！

51093.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51093.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the head of a Pink Rathian will also grant a special ingredient.
51093.descriptionEn:
We continue to run our Guild
Priority Requests, and to raise
awareness and promote them we
have prepared this quest for
you.
By breaking the Pink Rathian's head,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51093.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
桜火竜の頭部を破壊すること
で特別な食材も付与させてい
ただきます。

56040.objectiveJp: ドラギュロス１頭の討伐
56040.description: I would like you to hunt the Variant Species Doragyurosu. If you break the Variant's developed parts on this quest, I will specially add developed part materials to your bonus rewards. Please note that a hunt alone will not earn you developed part materials.
56040.descriptionEn:
I would like you to slay a
Supremacy Dark Thunder Wyvern
for us.
Break the Supremacy's developed
parts during this quest and I
will add special developed part
materials to your Another
Rewards. Do note that slaying
alone will not earn you those
materials.
56040.descriptionJp:
辿異種の冥雷竜を討伐してい
ただきたいです。
このクエストで辿異種の発達
部位を破壊いただいたら、特
別に発達部位素材をアナザー
報酬に追加してお渡しします。
討伐だけでは発達部位素材を
お渡しできないのでご注意を。

60677.objectiveJp: レビディオラ１体の討伐
60677.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Rebidiora. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! This time the tournament is open to Aberrant weapons only!
60677.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! The
target this time is ≪Rebidiora≫!
Going after a monster all on
your own - what spirit! Truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a top placement!
This one is Supremacy weapons
only!
60677.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪レビディオラ≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
今回は辿異武器限定で開催さ
れているぞ！

56048.objectiveJp: アクラ・ヴァシム１匹の討伐
56048.description: From the production of one Variant weapon of the Variant Species Akura Vashimu through its second upgrade, you can obtain the materials required and Porta Cards (Sakura) worth Ｇｚ. The weapon types that can be produced are one of Sword and Shield, Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Lance, Gunlance, or Switch Axe. Please make use of this for crafting and upgrading the weapon of your choice.
56048.descriptionEn:
Here you can get the materials
to craft one Supremacy weapon
from the Supremacy Akura
Vashimu and upgrade it two
steps, plus Porta Cards Sakura
worth the Gz.
Craftable types: Sword and
Shield, Long Sword, Hunting
Horn, Lance, Gunlance and
Switch Axe. Make good use of it!
56048.descriptionJp:
辿異種アクラ・ヴァシムの
辿異武器１つの生産から
２段階の強化に必要な素材
とＧｚ分のポルタカード桜が
入手できます。生産できる
武器種は、片手剣、太刀、
狩猟笛、槍、銃槍、剣斧の
いずれかです。
お好みの武器の生産・強化に
ぜひご活用ください。

60945.objectiveJp: サボテンの花４個の納品
60945.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the desert lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
60945.descriptionEn:
I found a little spot where
materials unique to the
Desert lie all over.
You should go check it out.
Come back with a full pouch,
and I think it'll be worth
the price of the info.
60945.descriptionJp:
砂漠ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代を払っただけの
価値はあると思うぜ。

60533.objectiveJp: ティガレックス１頭の狩猟
60533.description: The Tigrex boasts overwhelming strength, but any creature must have a weak point! I say its weak point is the head! Aim for the head when it turns around!
60533.descriptionEn:
≪Tigrex≫ boasts overwhelming
strength, but every one of them
must have a ≪weak point≫!
I say its weak point is the
≪head≫! Aim for the head at the
moment it turns around!
60533.descriptionJp:
圧倒的な強さを誇る≪ティガ
レックス≫だが、どんなやつ
にだって≪弱点≫は必ずある
はず！オレはあいつの弱点は
≪頭≫だと見た！振り向くタ
イミングで頭を狙うんだ！

28071.description: Mm! It is I! The Instructor! Today, to test your bonds, I have prepared a difficult request. Slay multiple monsters together with your hunting party comrades. No supplies at all are provided, so consult your comrades before departing. The reward is a special ore!
28071.descriptionEn:
Mm! It is I! The Instructor!
Today, to test the bonds
between you all, I've prepared
a hard request. Slay several
monsters together with your
guild mates. I provide no
supplies at all, so plan with
your comrades before setting
out. The reward is special ore!
28071.descriptionJp:
うむ！吾輩だ！教官だ！
今日は諸君らの絆を試すべく、
難しい依頼を用意させて
もらった。複数のモンスター
の討伐を、猟団の
仲間と行うのだ。支給品も
一切用意しないので、事前に
仲間たちと相談して出発せよ。
報酬は特殊な鉱石だぞ！

63104.objectiveJp: ショウグンギザミ１匹の狩猟
63104.description: Unusual monster individuals are being confirmed in various regions. Compared with ordinary monsters there is no great difference in appearance, but they are extremely powerful and reportedly act in ways ordinarily unthinkable. Please investigate somehow. The reward is rare decoration material.
63104.descriptionEn:
Unusual monster specimens have
been confirmed across the regions.
Compared with normal monsters
they look much the same,
yet they are extremely powerful
and reportedly take actions
that are normally unthinkable.
Please carry out the survey.
The reward is rare decoration material.
63104.descriptionJp:
各地で変わったモンスターの
個体が確認されています。
普通のモンスターと比べて、
見た目に大きな変化はないの
ですが、非常に強力であり、
通常では考えられないような
行動を取ってくるそうです。
何とか調査をお願いします。
報酬は貴重な装飾品素材です。

55575.description: The Variant Species Inagami appears to have reached a strength that brings it to the summit even among Inagami. That strength is beyond measure. Hunters confident in their skill to challenge the summit are asked to investigate.
55575.descriptionEn:
The Supremacy ≪Inagami≫ seems to
have reached strength enough to
stand at the summit even among
Inagami.
Its power is immeasurable.
Hunters confident in their skill
who would challenge the summit,
please conduct the survey.
55575.descriptionJp:
辿異種≪イナガミ≫はイナガ
ミの中でも、頂点に辿りつく
ほどの強さに達したようです。
その強さは計り知れません。
頂に挑戦する腕に自信のある
ハンターは調査をお願いしま
す。

55410.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55410.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55410.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

61417.description: On the way to the Canyon, a Basarios is blocking the road and I am in trouble. If you help me, I will give you a Quest Completion Certificate, exchangeable for Pawprint Coins, as thanks!
61417.descriptionEn:
On the way to the Canyon,
a Basarios is blocking the
road and I'm in trouble.
If you help me out, I'll give
you a ≪Quest Completion
Certificate≫ to trade for
≪Pawprint Coins≫. Thanks!
61417.descriptionJp:
峡谷へ行く途中で、
バサルモスが道をふさいで
いて困っているんだ。
助けてくれたら、
≪肉球のコイン≫と交換でき
る≪クエスト達成証≫をお礼
にあげるよ！

1011.description: The Congalala is a greedy fellow, and I hear he has a special weakness for mushroom dishes! Of course his minions the Conga must love mushrooms too! If you carry plenty of specialty mushrooms, he might come out.
1011.descriptionEn:
The ≪Congalala≫ is a stubborn
glutton, and word has it that
mushroom dishes are its
weakness! And its underlings
the Conga surely love them too!
Carry plenty of Specialty
Mushrooms and it might appear?
1011.descriptionJp:
桃毛獣≪ババコンガ≫は食い
意地の張ったヤツで、特にキ
ノコ系の食べ物には目がない
って話だぞ！もちろん子分の
コンガもキノコが大好物に違
いない！特産キノコを多めに
持ってれば出てくるかもな？

53062.description: This is Miyashita. I love curry and rice. [Question 5] Miyamoa has FRONTIER written on its forehead. If you think the answer is wrong (B), take this quest!
53062.descriptionEn:
Miyashita here.
I love curry and rice♪
[Question 5]
Miyamoa's forehead has
"FRONTIER" written
on it.
If you think the answer is X (B),
hunters should take
this quest!
53062.descriptionJp:
宮下でーす。
僕はカレーライスが大好き♪
【第５問】
ミヤモアのおでこには
「ＦＲＯＮＴＩＥＲ」と
書いてある
答えが×（Ｂ）だと思う
ハンターはこっちの
クエストを受注しよう！

60245.objectiveJp: グレアドモス１頭の討伐
60245.description: A hunting tournament where hunters compete in skill! This time the target is the Greadmos. That spirit of yours, going out to hunt a monster all alone, is truly admirable! Overcome yourself and take a place among the top ranks! Note that this time only SP weapons are permitted! Choose your weapon with care!
60245.descriptionEn:
A hunting tournament where
hunters compete in skill! The
target is ≪Gureadomosu≫!
Going after a monster all on
your own - what spirit! Truly
admirable! Overcome yourself
and take a top placement!
Also, this one is SP weapons
only! Choose your weapon well!
60245.descriptionJp:
ハンターが己の腕前を競い合
う狩猟大会！今回の目標は
≪グレアドモス≫だ！
たった一人でモンスターを狩
ろうと言うその心意気、誠に
あっぱれ！自らに打ち勝ち、
見事上位に入賞してみせよ！
また、今回はＳＰ武器限定だ！
武器は慎重に選ぶんだぞ！

56106.description: This is bad, this is bad! My Baretta collection has been stolen! That Zerureusu took the whole collection! Give me a break! I will share the materials with you at least! Get it back for me! Please!
56106.descriptionEn:
This is bad, bad, bad!
My collected Balletta Collection
got stolen!
That Zerureusu bastard made off
with the whole collection!
Give me a break!
I'll share the materials with
you, so go take it back!
Please!
56106.descriptionJp:
ヤバイよヤバイよ！
集めたバレッタコレクション
が奪われちまったよ！ゼルレ
ウスの野郎はコレクションを
全部もっていきやがったよ！
勘弁してくださいよー！
素材だけならわけてあげるか
ら！奪い返してくれよ！
頼むよ！

23673.description: This quest lets you obtain materials from the Variant Khezu. A Superior Ticket is required to accept the quest. Note that the Superior Ticket is consumed if the quest fails.
23673.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the materials of the Supremacy
≪Khezu≫.
To accept this quest,
a ≪Superior Ticket≫ is
required.
If you fail the quest, the
≪Superior Ticket≫ will be
consumed, so please take care.
23673.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、辿異種
≪フルフル≫の素材
を入手することができます。
クエストの受注には、
≪スペリアチケット≫が必要
になります。
クエストを失敗した場合、
≪スペリアチケット≫は消費
されますのでご注意ください。

50163.objectiveJp: ノノ・オルガロン１頭の狩猟

55207.description: Thank you for helping slay Kirin. If you deliver the Beautiful Mirror that regained its true form through Kirin's strange lightning, I will present you with materials for precious armor owned by the Guild as thanks.
55207.descriptionEn:
Thank you for your help in slaying
Kirin.
If you deliver the ≪Beautiful Mirror≫
that regained its true form through
Kirin's wondrous lightning, we will
present you with rare armor materials
owned by the Guild as a token of
our gratitude.
55207.descriptionJp:
キリン討伐にご協力いただき
ありがとうございました。
キリンの不思議な雷光によっ
て本来の姿を取り戻した
「美しい鏡」を納品していた
だければ、お礼として、ギル
ドが所有する貴重な防具の素
材をプレゼントいたします。

62124.objectiveJp: ドスランポス１頭の狩猟
62124.description: Please hunt the Velocidrome lurking in the Jungle. On the way, we also ask you to gather Special Mushrooms and slay Bullfango. The theme of this request is the dandy hunt! I will lend you a fitting costume, so show me something cool!
62124.descriptionEn:
Please hunt the ≪Velocidrome≫
lurking in the Jungle.
Along the way, also gather
Specialty Mushrooms and slay
some Bullfango.
The theme of this request is
"Dandy Hunting"!
We'll lend you a fitting
outfit, so show us your
coolest side!
62124.descriptionJp:
密林に潜む≪ドスランポス≫
を狩猟してきてください。
その道中で、特産キノコの採
集やブルファンゴの討伐もお
願いします。
この依頼のテーマは、「ダン
ディな狩猟」です！
それらしい衣装をお貸しする
ので、カッコいいところを見
せてくださいね！

50450.objectiveJp: 古びた金色の木箱１個の納品

55814.description: Was the bizarre tale born from the bizarre? Or was the bizarre born from the bizarre tale? The bizarre is truly fascinating. I want you to slay the Chameleos, which closely resembles a bizarre phenomenon, with the Paper Umbrella Sword [Apparition]. It may draw something strange to us. As a reward I will prepare my treasured tale of the bizarre.
55814.descriptionEn:
Did the strange spawn the tale?
Or did the tale spawn the strange?
The bizarre truly fascinates.
I want you to slay the Chameleos
that resembles those anomalies
using the Karakasa Sword [Yokai].
It may draw something strange
to it. As a reward, I'll prepare
a tale from my own collection.
55814.descriptionJp:
怪異から怪異譚が生まれた？
怪異譚から怪異が生まれた？
怪異とはまこと興味深い。
怪異現象によく似たオオナズ
チを唐傘ノ剣【妖魔】で討伐
してほしいのじゃ。何か怪異
を呼び寄せるかもしれん。
報酬としてわしの秘蔵の怪異
譚を用意しておこう。

61860.description: This time you are to hunt the Espinas in the Sea of Trees. Supplied items are ready. It should be quite possible for you. It is a drill, so there is no reward, but do your best!
61860.descriptionEn:
This time, I'll have you go
hunt an ≪Espinas≫ in the
Great Forest.
Supplies are already prepared.
You lot should handle it fine.
It's only an exercise, so no
reward, but do your best!
61860.descriptionJp:
今回は諸君に、樹海で
≪エスピナス≫の狩猟を
行ってきてもらう。
支給品は用意してある。諸君
なら十分に可能だろう。
演習なので、報酬は無いが、
頑張ってくれ！

50939.description: Hi! I am the ally of girls in love, Miracle Love Hunter! A request from a girl in love! Khezu are said to be a devoted couple! The ultimate form of a girl who wants to be with her boyfriend always! I want to study them, so catch one for me!
50939.descriptionEn:
Hi there!
Ally of girls in love,
Miracle★Love Hunter here!
A request from a girl in love!
Apparently Khezu are
hermaphrodites!
The ultimate form of a girl
who wants to be with him always!
I want to study it, so catch one★
50939.descriptionJp:
は〜い！
恋する女の子のミカタ、
ミラクル★恋狩人だよ！
恋する女の子からのお願い！
フルフルってしゆーどーたい
なんだって！
いつだってカレと一緒に
いたい女の子の究極体だね！
調べたいから捕まえてきて★

50309.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の狩猟
50309.description: Many men and women are taking part in this festival too. And the festival is only just beginning. Not only hearts in love, faint feelings and blazing love, but jealousy, bitterness and sheer irritation! Throw all of those feelings into this request! Participation by men alone is also possible!
50309.descriptionEn:
Many men and women are taking
part in this year's festival.
But the festival has only just
begun. Hearts in love, faint
yearnings, blazing passion,
and jealousy, regret, spite!
Pour every one of those
feelings into this request!
Men-only entry is fine too!
50309.descriptionJp:
今回のお祭りも、多くの男女
に参加いただいております。
そんなお祭りもまだまだこれ
から。恋する心、淡い想い、
燃え上がる愛に限らず、嫉妬
に悔しさに憎たらしさ！
そんな想い全てをこの依頼に
ぶつけてください！
男性のみの参加も可能です！

62931.description: The Guild is now considering providing materials from its stores to skilled hunters with a promising future. However, since the amount of material is limited, we will restrict it to hunters of a certain ability. We have also prepared special supplied items.
62931.descriptionEn:
The Guild is now considering
providing materials from its stores
to hunters with a promising future
and great skill.
However, since supplies are limited,
this is offered only to hunters of
a certain ability. We have also
prepared a special issue of
supplies.
62931.descriptionJp:
今ギルドでは、将来が有望な
凄腕ハンターの方々に向けて、
ギルドで保管している素材の
提供を考えています。
ただし、素材数にも限りがあ
るため、ある程度実力のある
ハンターの方のみとさせて頂
きます。特別に支給品も用意
してあります。

54937.description: This quest yields the following materials. Hammer Ribbon (Beginning) x１００, Hammer Ribbon (Middle) x１６５, Hammer Ribbon (Extreme) x１６５. Note that a Secret Ribbon Crystal is required to accept the quest.
54937.descriptionEn:
In this quest, you can obtain
the following materials.
≪Hammer Ribbon: Intro≫ x100
≪Hammer Ribbon: Mid≫ x165
≪Hammer Ribbon: Extreme≫ x165
To accept the quest,
a ≪Secret Art Ribbon Crystal≫ is
required, so please take note.
54937.descriptionJp:
本クエストでは、下記の素材
が入手できます。
≪ハンマー綬・序≫１００個
≪ハンマー綬・中≫１６５個
≪ハンマー綬・極≫１６５個
クエストの受注には、
≪秘伝綬の結晶≫が必要に
なりますのでご注意ください。

50223.objectiveJp: 破れた書物・一章１個の納品

55171.objectiveJp: リオレウス亜種１頭の討伐
55171.description: We have prepared a quest that lets you raise your standing by slaying the Azure Rathalos while getting the materials needed for G-rank decorations at a good price. Do make use of it.
55171.descriptionEn:
Slaying an Azure Rathalos
raises your reputation while
also earning you the materials
needed to get G Rank
decorations, all in one handy
quest we've prepared for you.
Please make good use of it.
55171.descriptionJp:
リオレウス亜種を討伐する
ことで、自身の評価を上げ
つつ、Ｇ級装飾品を
手に入れるために必要な素材
をお得に入手できるクエスト
を準備しました。
ぜひ、お役立てください。

21661.objectiveJp: カム・オルガロン１頭の討伐
21661.description: The memo said to be lost, recording the secret of weapon crafting, seems to be turning up on monsters slain across the land! If you get your hands on the Mercuri Memo, then be a man! Bring it to this workshop master! I will show you good work!
21661.descriptionEn:
They say notes recording the
lost secret of forging gear
are being found on monsters
slain all over the land!
Get a ≪Mercuri Memo≫ and
bring it to this workshop
chief, man to man!
I'll show you some fine work!
21661.descriptionJp:
失われたとされていた、武具
の製造の秘伝を記したメモが
各地で討伐されたモンスター
から見つかってるらしいぜい！
≪メルクリメモ≫を手に入れ
たら、男一匹！この工房長の
ところに持ってきな！
イイ仕事をしてみせるぜい！

62045.description: Hey, thanks as always! Honestly, all these hard jobs must be tough. But relax. This one is a gathering quest playing with cute bugs, so it is not hard. Enjoy yourself.
62045.descriptionEn:
Hi there, thanks as always for
your hard work! It must be rough
always getting the harder requests.
But relax. This job is a gathering
quest where you play with cute
little bugs, so it is not hard.
Please take it easy and enjoy!
62045.descriptionJp:
やあ、毎度ご苦労さんデス！
いつも難しめの依頼ばかりで
正直たいへんでしょ。でも、
安心して。この仕事は可愛い
虫さんと戯れる採取クエスト
だから、そう難しくないよ。
お気軽にあそんでいってね！

53225.description: I declare, meow! 2018 is the Year of the Cat, meow! Year one of the Cat Era, meow! Established by the Cat Union, meow! Obey what cats say, meow! I want to eat fish, meow! I want to eat, meow! Bring me some, meow!
53225.descriptionEn:
I declare, nya!
2018 is the Year of the Cat, nya!
The first Year of the Cat, nya!
Decreed by the Cat Union, nya!
Obey the cat, nya!
I want fish, nya!
I want to eat, nya!
Go catch some, nya!
53225.descriptionJp:
宣言するミャ！
２０１８年は猫年ミャ！
猫年元年ミャ！
猫団組合で制定したミャ！
猫の言うこと聞くミャ！
サカナ食べたいのミャ！
食べたいのミャ！
獲ってくるミャ！

51081.objectiveJp: メインターゲットの狩猟
51081.description: We have prepared this quest to further raise awareness of and promote the Guild Priority Requests we have long been running. Breaking the horns of an Espinas will also grant a special ingredient.
51081.descriptionEn:
Regarding the Guild Priority Requests
we have long been carrying out, we
have prepared this quest to further
spread awareness and promote them.
By breaking the Espinas's horn,
we will also grant you
special ingredients.
51081.descriptionJp:
かねてから執り行っている、
ギルド優先依頼につきまして
より一層の認知、振興のため
こちらのクエストをご用意い
たしました。
棘竜の角を破壊することで
特別な食材も付与させていた
だきます。

55063.objectiveJp: グァンゾルム１体の討伐
55063.description: It seems you could not fully upgrade the Odibatorasu gear. I have prepared a fine quest for a hunter like you. The number you can accept per day is limited, but it should help. I wish you success.
55063.descriptionEn:
Seems you couldn't fully
upgrade the ≪Emperor Dragon≫
equipment. For hunters like
you, I've prepared a fine quest.
There's a daily limit on how
many times you can take it,
but it should help. Good luck.
55063.descriptionJp:
どうやら≪帝征龍≫の武具を
強化しきれなかったようだね。
そんなハンターさんのために
素敵なクエストを用意したよ。
一日に受注できる回数に限り
はあるけど、きっと君の役に
立つはずだ。健闘を祈るよ。

50942.description: For members of the hunting parties that won the Hunter Festival, we have prepared a special request and reward. Please have your Festival Certificate with you when you accept or join. Complete this request and the guild will present you with rare Conquest species materials.
50942.descriptionEn:
We have prepared a special
request and rewards exclusively
for those in a guild on the
winning side of the Hunter
Festival. Please bring your
proof of the festival when you
accept or join.
Clear this request and the guild
will present you with rare
Zenith materials.
50942.descriptionJp:
狩人祭勝ち組の猟団に所属
しているかた専用の特別依頼
と報酬を用意させていただき
ました。受注、参加時に、
祭典の証をお持ちください。
今回の依頼を達成いただけれ
ば、ギルドより覇種の希少素
材を贈呈いたします。

61661.objectiveJp: ベルキュロス１頭の狩猟

63077.description: A quest for the VS. Quest Champion Tournament trial session. The time limit is 10 minutes.
63077.descriptionEn:
A quest for the VS. Quest
Champion Tournament trial
session.
The time limit is 10 minutes.
63077.descriptionJp:
ＶＳ．クエストチャンピオン
トーナメントの体験会用の
クエストです。
制限時間は１０分です。

55486.objectiveJp: ルコディオラ１体の討伐
55486.description: The Guild will now research the ecology of Ten'i Species in further detail. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55486.descriptionEn:
We have decided to study the
ecology of the ≪Tesshi≫ in
greater detail within the
Guild. To those who help, we
will hand Tesshi materials
as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55486.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
ギルド内でさらに詳しく研究
することになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！

26581.description: Congratulations on reaching HR400! Deliver the Map on your own, clear the quest, and claim your reward!
26581.descriptionEn:
Congratulations on reaching
HR400!
Deliver the ≪Map≫ on your own,
clear the quest, and claim
your reward!
26581.descriptionJp:
ＨＲ４００達成、おめでとう
ございます！お１人で
≪地図≫を納品していただき、
クエストをクリアして、報酬
を手に入れましょう！

26004.description: I have found a hidden spot where materials unique to the volcano lie scattered everywhere. Do go and have a look. Come back with a full pouch and you will have had your money's worth for the information.
26004.descriptionEn:
I found a hidden spot where
materials unique to the Volcano
lie scattered all around.
Go and check it out.
If you come back with a full
pouch, it'll be worth what
you paid for the tip.
26004.descriptionJp:
火山ならではの素材が
ごろごろしている穴場を
見つけたぞ。
ぜひ、行ってみてくれ。
ポーチ満載で帰れば、
情報代分の価値はあると
思うぜ。

26559.objectiveJp: 年間特典生産券１枚の納品
26559.description: Thanks for playing MHF for two whole years! Equip Nana Blade [Imperial Consort] and deliver 1 Annual Bonus Production Ticket to get 11 Proof of Gratitude K as a gift. From Proof of Gratitude K you can forge Akam Squid (Lance).
26559.descriptionEn:
Thanks for playing MHF
for two whole years!
Equip ≪Nana Blade
[Imperial Consort]≫ and
deliver 1 ≪Annual Bonus
Production Ticket≫ to get
11 ≪Proof of Gratitude K≫
as a gift. From ≪Proof of
Gratitude K≫ you can forge
≪Akam Squid≫ (Lance).
26559.descriptionJp:
２年間ＭＨＦを遊んでくれて
ありがとうございます！
≪ナナブレイド【皇妃】≫を
装備し、≪年間特典生産券≫
１枚を納品すると、≪感謝の
証K≫を１１枚プレゼント
いたします。
≪感謝の証K≫から≪アカム
スクウィード≫（ランス）が
生産可能です。

61447.objectiveJp: ハンターコイン赤３個の納品
61447.description: A quest reserved for the 3rd Place server. We have prepared a special reward for hunters who cleared the Guild-versus-Guild Idaten Cup. The more Hunter Coins (Red) you deliver, the better your chance of rare materials.
61447.descriptionEn:
[3rd Place] This quest is
exclusive to this server.
We've prepared a special
reward for hunters who cleared
the Guild Idaten Cup.
The more Hunter Coins (Red)
you deliver, the better your
chance at rare materials.
61447.descriptionJp:
【３位】サーバー専用の
クエストです。
猟団対抗韋駄天杯をクリアさ
れたハンターに専用の報酬を
用意させていただきました。
ハンターコイン赤の納品枚数
が多いほど、レア素材が
手に入るチャンスがあります。

54120.objectiveJp: ファルノック１頭の狩猟
54120.description: Look at this yellow feather! I found it near the Forest, and it shines with such a bright color! I simply must add this monster's materials to my collection! I will pay. Hunt the monster with the yellow feather and bring it back!
54120.descriptionEn:
Look at this yellow feather!
I found it near the Great
Forest, and it shines with
such a bright, vivid color!
I simply must add this
monster's materials to my
collection! I will pay well.
Hunt down the monster with
the yellow feathers for me!
54120.descriptionJp:
この黄色い羽根を見てくれ！
樹海の近くで拾った物なんだ
が、輝きを放っているかの
ような明るい色をしている！
ぜひともこのモンスターの
素材をわがコレクションに
加えたい！報酬は出す。
黄色い羽根のモンスターを
狩猟して来てくれ！

21074.objectiveJp: ドスゲネポス１頭の狩猟
21074.description: Throw a Flash Bomb in front of a monster and its strong light blinds them. Master this and you'll have nothing to fear! They're in the supply box, so use them freely!
21074.descriptionEn:
Throw a ≪Flash Bomb≫ in
front of a monster and the
bright light will stun its
eyes. Master this and there
is nothing left to fear!
They are in the supply box,
so use them all you like
without holding back!
21074.descriptionJp:
≪閃光玉≫をモンスターの目
前に投げると強力な光で目を
くらませることができるんで
すよ。
これを使いこなせば、怖いも
のナシですね！
支給品ボックスに入ってます
から遠慮なく使って下さい！

55820.objectiveJp: トリドクレス１頭の討伐
55820.description: We have had you survey the ecology of Ten'i Species until now, but with this request we will ask you for a report for the time being. To those who cooperate we will give Ten'i Species materials as a reward. Considerable danger is expected, so prepare thoroughly before departing!
55820.descriptionEn:
Thank you for the Tesshi
ecology surveys so far, but
with this request we will
have you submit one final
report. To those who helped,
we will hand Tesshi
materials as a reward.
Considerable danger is
expected, so prepare well
and then set out!
55820.descriptionJp:
≪辿異種≫の生態について、
これまで調査頂きましたが
この依頼をもって一旦報告を
して頂くことになりました。
ご協力頂いた方には報酬と
して辿異種の素材をお渡し
します。
かなりの危険が予想されます
ので、しっかりと準備して
出発してください！
